novel_info.title: Starting With 100 Million Lives
novel_info.author: No. 4 At World's End
novel_info.summary: Both mortals and cultivators are afraid of death, yet Jiang Cheng isn't. With the Undefeated System, he could benefit from each of his deaths and comes back to life every time.“Ding, detected that the host is dead, the Undefeated System is officially activated.”“The host gains a hundred million lives, and once killed in the future, will be resurrected in full health within 30 seconds.”“In the midst of life and death, there is great opportunity, after resurrection, the host will surely defeat the opponent...”

chapters.title: Chapter 1: Why is it so hard to die
chapters.content:
Chapter 1: Chapter 1: Why is it so hard to die
Editor:
EndlessFantasy Translation
Jiang Cheng’s soul hovered beside his corpse, staring blankly at the system’s performance.
"Ding, detected that the host is dead, the Undefeated System is officially activated."
Ding your grandpa, why didn’t you ding a few days ago?
"The host gains a hundred million lives, and once killed in the future, will be resurrected in full health within 30 seconds."
"In the midst of life and death, there is great opportunity, after resurrection, the host will surely defeat the opponent..."
Although the skills were OP, Brother Cheng remained calm, for he knew that after transmigrating, it was impossible not to have a cheat.
The problem was this system was too much of a scam.
The initial transmigration location was directly inside a cave hundreds of meters deep, with smooth walls all around, impossible to climb up.
He waited for seven or eight days and no one passed by, eventually dying of thirst inside, becoming the shame of transmigrators.
Then, this damn system finally showed up.
"Ding, detected that the host just died of thirst, the system is arranging a defeating method."
"The host has obtained the Celestial Desolation Indestructible Body, from now on, no longer needs to eat."
"Note: The Celestial Desolation Indestructible Body is the number one physique in the Three Realms, can automatically absorb surrounding Spiritual Qi, cultivation speed unparalleled in the world. Profound mystery of divine communication, lifespan equal to the heavens, transcend the Three Realms, not affected by the Celestial Five Declines."
"Host, resurrect!"
A dozen seconds later...
Jiang Cheng’s soul returned to his body, enveloped by a golden light descending from the sky.
Bathed in it, he felt as if he was completely renewed.
The light flashed and disappeared.
The feeling of hunger was gone.
His face became more handsome, his body more perfect.
He looked at his system panel.
Host: Jiang Cheng.
Race: Human Race.
Realm: Mortal.
Divine Techniques: None.
Cultivation Technique: None.
Martial Techniques: None.
Magical Treasure: None.
System Level: 1 (once a day, cannot accumulate)
Once a day?
Does that mean only one resurrection chance per day?
Also, traditionally, shouldn’t there be a newbie gift bag?
Jiang Cheng waited for a very long time, very long...
But this system seemed to be out of breath from saying too much earlier, with no more reaction.
What is this supposed to mean?
Is that it?
Except for not needing normal metabolic needs, he didn’t feel any different.
Cultivation speed unparalleled, can automatically absorb surrounding Spiritual Qi, it’s like leveling up even while lying down.
From the sound of it, it’s insanely OP, reaching the realm of flying and getting out, wouldn’t that be marvelous?
The problem is, this cave and the surrounding areas have not a hint of Spiritual Qi.
He now realized that this system is a passive trigger type, to trigger more rewards, he can only die more times.
So, he needs to meet people, hopefully someone who is an expert with great skills.
Unfortunately, this cave is so peaceful, not even a living soul, let alone any insects, he couldn’t encounter any danger.
Looking at the sturdy and smooth walls around, he had a sudden idea.
No crisis, then create a crisis himself!
How about I commit suicide by crashing into the wall?
The next day, after the resurrection cooldown ended, he made a sprinting posture toward the wall.
Sprinted out over thirty meters, the system prompt sounded again just as expected.
"In light of the host’s current suicidal behavior, here’s an extra considerate reminder - suicide is the host’s own will, the system respects the host’s will as the first principle and will not trigger the resurrection function."
Considerate?
Considerate your grandpa!
If you really respect my will, then take me out first!
Jiang Cheng couldn’t stop his momentum, at the critical moment he could only block with his hands, but ended up crashing into the wall.
The cave is apparently in some desolate and uninhabited place, for the next month, there was nothing happening.
Not even a drop of rain.
The Celestial Desolation Indestructible Body was still very OP.
Even without any cultivation, he didn’t age or die, not a hint of fatigue could be seen on his face, and he was automatically dust-free every day.
Jiang Cheng spent most of his time sleeping, occasionally waking up to curse the damn system a few times when bored.
He understood it now, this was to toy with him to death.
Gave him a system, but the spawn point was wrong.
Gave him an overpowered skill, but there’s no one to encounter.
His biggest wish now was for a living person to show up, if not, even a fierce demon beast would do!
"Ah!"
The scream from above interrupted his daydream.
Is there finally a living person appearing?
Brother Cheng’s eyes welled up with tears of joy.
He looked up and saw a skirt that very much respected Newton’s laws of motion.
The white gauze skirt floated upwards as it fell, two slender legs flailing in the air, rapidly enlarging in his view.
Bang!
The owner of the white gauze skirt landed heavily on the cave floor, making a dull thud.
Hiss...
Jiang Cheng couldn’t help but show a regretful expression, from such a high height, wouldn’t the key parts be flattened?
Ji Linghan struggled to get up, her first reaction was not to look around, but to quickly tidy her disheveled hair and dust off her dress.
Image is still very important!
She looked about sixteen or seventeen years old, with delicate and gentle features, fluttering eyelashes, and black eyes like ripples in water.
Although the palace long dress was stained with blood and dust, and her black hair was not smooth, with a slightly flushed face, it gave an astonishingly beautiful impression.
Only after a full 5 seconds, did the neatly dressed Ji Linghan finally notice there was another person here.
Thinking of the pursuers behind her, she was frightened.
She hurriedly took two steps back and summoned her spiritual artifact flying sword.
"Who are you!"
Jiang Cheng laughed, starting to provoke with humor and laughter.
"I’m your grandpa, quickly kill me already!"

chapters.title: Chapter 2: Quick, Kill Me
chapters.content:
Chapter 2: Chapter 2: Quick, Kill Me
Editor:
EndlessFantasy Translation
Though beauties are easy on the eyes, Jiang Cheng is a ’career-oriented’ man who values efficiency.
Hurry up and kill, finish killing so I can level up.
Don’t dawdle!
"Ding, due to the host’s current behavior, here’s a gentle reminder from the system: you may provoke the opponent, but requesting them to kill you verbally will be seen as a desire for suicide."
If you want to commit suicide, the system can assist.
Poof!
The system’s prompt almost made Jiang Cheng spit blood.
He originally thought he’d go out and find people to kill him everywhere.
Even if he has to pay them, so be it!
If he finds the world’s number one expert, wouldn’t he become the strongest very quickly?
Turns out this approach is considered suicide?
"What did you say?"
Ji Linghan stared dumbfoundedly at the young man in front of her, wondering if she heard wrong.
She swore she’d never seen such a handsome person in her life; that face was simply heaven’s favoritism, flawless.
It even subtly harmonized with certain Daoist principles.
It was only natural; Jiang Cheng’s appearance was fine-tuned by the system to match the celestial desolation indestructible body.
But for such a handsome person to seemingly have a problem with his mind.
Asking her to kill him?
"Nothing."
Jiang Cheng quickly waved his hand, full of smiles, pretending that he hadn’t just spoken.
Just kidding, dying from provocation means dying in vain.
On the opposite side, Ji Linghan suddenly covered her mouth and exclaimed.
"You, you’re just a normal person, how did you come here?"
She is a cultivator, and with a slight inspection using her divine sense, she could see Jiang Cheng had no spiritual qi at all.
"Why can’t a normal person come in?"
Jiang Cheng asked with interest, actually just trying to extract some information.
"This is a forbidden land, the pressure is immense, a normal person entering would die with ruptured heart arteries."
Why didn’t he feel anything from the beginning?
Could it be system protection?
"Alas..."
Jiang Cheng sighed longingly, adjusting his expression.
"Girl, I’ve sat here for a thousand years, just waiting for the arrival of a destined person. Congratulations, you’re the lucky winner!"
Chuckling!
"A thousand years?"
Despite having been in a state of being hunted, Ji Linghan was amused by this statement.
"Blow it on, a normal person living to hundreds is rare, yet a thousand!"
She naturally did not believe it, to retain youth, cultivators at least need to ascend to saint realm.
This person has no spiritual power at all, how could it be possible.
Jiang Cheng stood with hands behind his back, looking up at the sky.
Asked again, "With a cave this deep, can a normal person survive falling down?"
Isn’t asking back the way to take the initiative?
Ji Linghan thought, indeed.
Even she, a cultivator who exceeded body tempering, condensed vein, and energy introduction, reaching the gathering yuan realm, felt pain all over after falling, would a normal person end up in pieces?
"Then why do you have no spiritual qi?"
Jiang Cheng had long prepared an excuse.
"I am the Master Taichu from a thousand years ago, who roamed in one direction. In the past, during a duel with an arch-enemy, I was unfortunately deceived, my cultivation sealed, and eventually trapped here!"
"Girl, if you take me out, I shall grant you a providence!"
He himself hasn’t even left the newbie area yet, so where would such providence come from? But to deceive Ji Linghan into taking him up, it was worth racking his brains.
Ji Linghan hadn’t heard of Master Taichu, but considering how vast Feiyun State is.
With seven prefecutres under its jurisdiction, her Qinglan Prefecture alone spans hundreds of thousands of miles, sect clans scatter across it; it’s impossible to know every expert’s name.
Moreover, since it’s a figure from a thousand years ago.
Surviving a thousand years, at least a celestial fate realm expert!
Cultivation begins with body tempering and has condensing vein, energy introduction, spirit formation, gathering yuan, soul splitting, spirit platform, celestial fate, daoist palace and many other realms.
Celestial fate realm exceeds the ceiling of Qinglan Prefecture, Ji Linghan couldn’t imagine how powerful the divine techniques of someone in that realm would be.
The person in front of her hardly seemed like it.
"Senior..."
Though she didn’t quite believe it, caution is wise, she still unconsciously changed her address.
"I can’t fly up either."
"Ha? You can’t fly yet?"
"I can fly, but this is a forbidden land, without reaching soul splitting realm, one cannot overcome the pressure here."
Jiang Cheng was instantly disappointed; this ’tool’ person wasn’t strong enough.
It seems, he still needs to find a way to ’enlighten’ her bit by bit.
In due time... she will fulfill the expectations to kill him.
"Found it!"
"Over here!"
Suddenly, urgent shouts of excitement came from above the cave entrance, followed by four figures jumping down.
"Little wretch, I want to see where you can still escape to!"
The leading woman with a harsh expression, holding a silver sword, pointed directly at Ji Linghan with a wrathful face.
Behind her were three other male disciples, who formed a surrounding stance upon entering.
So truly well-trained, the calmly unfazed Jiang Cheng silently complained.
"Yao Yunxuan, do you really want to drive me to death?"
Ji Linghan stepped forward, conveniently shielding Jiang Cheng behind her.
This little detail made him feel much better about this ’tool’ person.
"Hmph, Ji Linghan, weren’t you quite tough before?"
"Last year during the Seven Sects’ competition, you defeated me in front of everyone. Do you think that was impressive?"
"Now your Feixian Sect has been exterminated, why don’t you keep being impressive!"
```

chapters.title: Chapter 3: Finally Killed
chapters.content:
Chapter 3: Chapter 3: Finally Killed
Editor:
EndlessFantasy Translation
Yao Yunxuan’s eyebrows danced with joy, she was downright smug, like a cat playing with a mouse.
Once deemed the first cultivation genius among the five sects surrounding Changhua Mountain, Ji Linghan was the goddess revered by disciples of various sects, constantly compared to Yao Yunxuan.
Her jealousy and hatred had been brewing for years.
However, three days ago, her Extreme Moon Sect joined forces with three other sects to launch a sudden attack on the Feixian Sect.
Aside from a handful of important disciples, almost all Feixian Sect elders and disciples were decimated, essentially being erased.
Yao Yunxuan also took part in the siege, waving banners behind the elders, but when it came to hunting down Ji Linghan, she was more enthusiastic than anyone else.
The three male disciples also chuckled.
"Junior Sister Yao just got caught off guard by her once."
"No need for Junior Sister Yao to lift a finger, I’ll help you take her down."
"How does Junior Sister plan on having her perish?"
Yao Yunxuan was the daughter of Yao Qiulin, the chief elder of the Alchemy Hall of the Extreme Moon Sect. Which cultivator doesn’t have a need for pills?
Although Ji Linghan was stunning beyond compare, making these enemies’ hearts itch with envy, in terms of temperament, appearance, figure and talent, she thoroughly outmatched Yao Yunxuan.
But they knew which choice was more beneficial for their cultivation path.
Cuddling up to Yao Yunxuan could get them more pills in the future!
"I don’t intend to kill her." Yao Yunxuan smiled strangely.
"What?"
One of the male disciples immediately exclaimed, "Junior Sister is so merciful? Such magnanimity is truly admirable..."
His tone was extremely exaggerated.
His flattery was opportunistically timed, causing the other two male disciples to grit their teeth, bitterly regretting missing the chance to curry favor with the Junior Sister.
Yao Yunxuan sneered, "Are you stupid? Merciful? I’m going to abolish her cultivation, ruin her face, have her as my servant girl to torment every day, isn’t that better?"
The other two male disciples quickly chimed in with loud praise.
"Junior Sister is so inventive!"
"So brilliant, why hadn’t we thought of such a method?"
"Seems there is a reason our cultivation has always been inferior to Junior Sister’s!"
Jiang Cheng, standing by, was speechless; these people were truly top-grade.
Clang!
The indignant Ji Linghan drew her sword, the cold gleam pointing straight at the opposition.
"Yao Yunxuan, even if I die today, I will take someone down with me!"
Her previously gentle eyebrows and eyes now bore an arresting majesty under the flame of fury, causing Yao Yunxuan, two years older than her, to take a step back.
But then she remembered the advantage in numbers, and her confidence returned.
"Die? That depends if you can accomplish it!"
"Ji Linghan, you’re just Gathering Yuan Realm Eighth Layer, we have four Gathering Yuan Realm here, let’s see if you can make any waves!"
After speaking, the other four readied their opening moves.
Although Jiang Cheng didn’t understand cultivation, he could tell from their expressions who was certain of victory.
The show was about over, time for the protagonist to appear.
This was a rare package of four experience points!
"I say, have you all forgotten there’s another person here? You’ve come to my territory and haven’t even paid respects, where is the courtesy?"
He leisurely entered the scene, placing himself between Ji Linghan and the others.
"Senior, this is purely personal enmity between us, you needn’t intervene..."
Ji Linghan felt both touched and anxious; this elder truly had an antiquated heart, yet his cultivation was now abolished.
He wouldn’t stand a chance against Gathering Yuan Realm, even a Body Tempering Realm could kill him.
Rushing in recklessly, wasn’t he seeking death?
Jiang Cheng waved his hand calmly, posing with righteous indifference: "Relax, with me here, they won’t lay a finger on you!"
The experience points had to be collected; favorability could still be gained effortlessly.
The other four looked at each other, then laughed.
"Hahaha, is this man ill?"
"A so-called senior with no cultivation, could he be a fool?"
"Driven by lust, trying to be a hero to save the beauty?"
Yao Yunxuan and the others weren’t blind; they had certainly noticed Jiang Cheng as soon as they entered.
But at first glance, they knew he had no spiritual power, merely a mortal, so they paid him no mind, pretending he didn’t exist.
One of the male disciples, jealous of Jiang Cheng’s handsome looks, sneered and eagerly made a move: "A mortal dares interfere?"
Sword gleams fell, blood sprayed.
Jiang Cheng promptly collapsed into a pool of blood.
"Ah! Senior!"
Ji Linghan shrieked, unable to believe her eyes.
Dead just like that?
Wasn’t he supposed to be a master who dominated an area a thousand years ago? Shouldn’t he have some tricks even with his cultivation gone?
Honestly, seeing Jiang Cheng’s uncharacteristic confidence, she had actually felt a bit of anticipation.
Perhaps he could truly create a miracle?
But now, that miracle had shattered.
"Hahahaha, turned out to be clueless!"
Yao Yunxuan glanced somewhat regretfully at the corpse on the ground; this guy was handsomely outstanding, she had planned to quietly take him back as a plaything.
Just that face was worth a lifetime of collection.
Yet, he was ultimately a mortal, killed, and killed indeed.
"Alright, now it’s your turn!"
She refocused on Ji Linghan, her eyes filled with cruelty and excitement.
"Ding, Host has been killed."
Already in a spectral state, Jiang Cheng’s mind resounded with a series of system notifications.
"Detected the power of four enemies, the system analyzed and decided to replicate the entire power of ’Yao Yunxuan’s father’ for the Host."
"Ding, replication completed! Host now possesses Soul Splitting Realm Third Layer cultivation!"
"Host has attained Fourth Layer in the Extreme Moon Sect’s Moon Observation Heart Method!"
"Host has automatically comprehended Soul Capturing Technique Second Floor!"
"Host has automatically mastered Crescent Moon Swordsmanship first six layers!"
"Host has become a Tier Three Alchemist!"
"Host is about to resurrect!"

chapters.title: Chapter 4 Yao Yunxuan’s Dad
chapters.content:
Chapter 4: Chapter 4 Yao Yunxuan’s Dad
Editor:
EndlessFantasy Translation
Swoosh!
A translucent gleam swept across Jiang Cheng’s corpse, and he was resurrected.
The bloodstains on his body remained, but if you looked closely at the collar, you’d find the previous wound had vanished without a trace.
He felt unprecedentedly good.
His body was filled with abundant spiritual power, his mind exceptionally clear, able to perceive scenes over a thousand meters beyond the cave entrance with just a thought.
Additionally, his mind had inexplicably gained insights into the first four layers of the Moon Observation Heart Method, the second level of the Soul Capturing Technique, and the first six layers of the Crescent Moon Swordsmanship’s Heart Technique.
He knew it was divine sense, cultivation technique, secret technique, sword technique...
It was as though he had cultivated for decades, with ample cultivation and combat experience, feeling entirely natural.
There was no choice, Yao Yunxuan’s father was an elder at the Alchemy Hall of Extreme Moon Sect, and the system transferred all his learning to Jiang Cheng.
So whatever Yao Qiulin knew, Jiang Cheng now knew.
Even his alchemy technique, being related to cultivation, was transferred as well.
Except for lacking memory of his appearance and external belongings, in other respects, Jiang Cheng was a replica of Yao Qiulin.
Seeing him stand up again, the five people ready to act were startled.
Especially the male disciple who had just attacked, he rubbed his eyes, suspecting he saw a ghost.
He distinctly remembered stabbing the vital spot with his sword.
It wouldn’t have spared a normal person, let alone a cultivator in the Gathering Yuan Realm, anyone struck by that sword would undoubtedly die!
"Senior, you’re not dead!"
Ji Linghan exclaimed in joy.
Although she had just recently met Jiang Cheng, she remembered him stepping in to defend her earlier.
Jiang Cheng smiled slightly, "Rest assured, even if their entire family dies, I won’t."
He looked profoundly mysterious, but it didn’t intimidate Yao Yunxuan and the others.
"Playing tricks, let’s kill you again!"
The male disciple, now enraged and embarrassed, swung his sword down again.
This time, spiritual power from the Gathering Yuan Realm infused into it, causing a sudden blaze of light all around.
The white sword aura illuminated the cave like a beam.
A fierce wind arose from thin air, the sword hadn’t even arrived, and the air around was already blurred.
Sizzle!
Only a patch of white remained before Jiang Cheng.
"Senior, be careful!"
Ji Linghan shouted in surprise, not expecting the suddenness of the attack, leaving no time for rescue.
The light flashed and vanished, and a figure fell.
Ji Linghan couldn’t help but turn her head, unable to bear watching.
Yao Yunxuan and others simultaneously smirked; this strike was a full-force blow by Senior Brother Zhu, absolutely flawless.
Being delayed twice by a mortal was utterly frustrating.
But their smiles soon froze.
Jiang Cheng was still standing, holding a sword that was dripping blood.
The sword’s previous owner was that Senior Brother Zhu.
Sadly, he was now lying a dozen meters away, beheaded.
Currently, Jiang Cheng was at the Soul Splitting Realm Third Layer.
A difference in cultivation of one small realm can form suppression, let alone a great realm difference.
Even without a weapon initially, the gap was too vast, allowing easy domination.
"How did you accomplish that?"
Yao Yunxuan and others were shocked.
Senior Brother Zhu was at the Gathering Yuan Realm Sixth Layer, higher than Yao Yunxuan by one layer.
Even Ji Linghan couldn’t defeat him in a solo duel within several dozen moves.
"Who on earth are you?"
Yao Yunxuan remained the most composed.
"You’re not from the Feixian Sect, why are you supporting that little wench? What did she offer you?"
This person’s power exceeded her expectations; supporting Ji Linghan wasn’t ideal.
Her first thought wasn’t outrage but dividing and recruiting.
Eliminate Ji Linghan, leave, then betray later.
Her plan seemed sound, but unfortunately, Jiang Cheng wouldn’t fall for it.
"I’m your dad, kneel and call me father!"
Yao Yunxuan lost her sanity instantly, turning into an enraged lioness.
"Kill him!"
"Skin him alive for me!"
Her plan to recruit was thrown out the window.
Two other male disciples heard her order and immediately charged at Jiang Cheng, attacking him together.
Facing a three-sided assault, Jiang Cheng was unruffled.
He skillfully pinched a sword sign, activating Crescent Moon Swordsmanship.
The sword he’d just seized transformed into six, flying towards the three like meteors.
Subsequently, the initially aggressive three were enveloped by six huge golden crescent sword shadows.
Precisely two per person, quite balanced.
Seeing the sword shadow’s refinement and sheer grandeur, Yao Yunxuan felt her heart freeze.
With just one strike, she was sent flying.
If not for her Treasure Armor reaching Tier Three Spiritual Artifact level, even just that blow would’ve cost her life.
"How do you know our Extreme Moon Sect’s Sword Control skill!"
She shrieked in fear, disbelief written all over.
Extreme Moon Sect’s swordsmanship requires the heart method of Extreme Moon Sect to perform.
Outsiders, even if they learn, can only imitate superficially.
Extreme Moon Sect’s heart method is exclusively taught to inner sect disciples; how could this person possibly know?
And use it far more proficiently, clearly showing years of immersion.
"Told you I’m your father, yet you still don’t believe!"

chapters.title: Chapter 5: Finally the Harvest Season Arrived
chapters.content:
Chapter 5: Chapter 5: Finally the Harvest Season Arrived
Editor:
EndlessFantasy Translation
"Zizi," the two male disciples fell to the ground.
They didn’t have as good a father as Yao Yunxuan, their treasure armor’s grade was too low.
Under the enormous cultivation gap, they couldn’t hold on for even a moment.
Jiang Cheng controlled the four sword shadows, flying them towards the already tottering Yao Yunxuan.
This time, no matter how strong Yao Yunxuan was, she couldn’t block it.
She didn’t want to die.
"You can’t kill me, my father set a spirit talisman on me..."
Bang!
A green light ahead exploded, and a transparent human figure appeared before Jiang Cheng, blocking the fatal blow.
"How dare you, wretch!"
The illusion was a middle-aged man in a Daoist robe, with brows furrowed, exuding an intimidating authority.
This was a fragment of Yao Qiulin’s soul, sealed within the spirit talisman to protect his precious daughter.
"Stand down!"
The split soul shone brightly, exuding an aura of life and death authority!
The air in the cave became stagnant, making Ji Linghan’s face pale and even standing became unsteady.
And Yao Yunxuan suddenly gained confidence.
A strand of a Soul Splitting Realm expert’s soul was formidable, though it lacked a physical body, it could perform many secret techniques the Gathering Yuan Realm couldn’t reach.
"Kill him!"
"Dad, hurry, kill him!"
Her scream echoed in the cave, like a madwoman.
"Aren’t you taking it a bit lightly?"
Jiang Cheng gazed at her like she was an idiot.
He had replicated Yao Qiulin’s entire combat power, not to mention a strand of soul, even if the real body appeared, it couldn’t do anything to him.
"Hmph!"
Activation of the second layer of Soul Capturing Technique!
His eyes shone with divine light, and the split soul was hit by two dark red rays, exploding instantly!
"No!"
Yao Yunxuan couldn’t believe her eyes.
Her ultimate trump card was destroyed just like that?
Swoosh!
Six curved moon sword shadows merged, piercing her straight through.
What needs to be killed should be killed thoroughly; Jiang Cheng wouldn’t play any sentimental games at this point.
After the battle ended, he immediately began scavenging the spoils.
Although he had copied all the combat power, he had no pills, spiritual artifacts, spirit talismans, or array discs.
How could that match Brother Cheng’s current level?
From the three male disciples, he found over a hundred middle-grade spirit stones, along with a few bottles of Qi Gathering Pills.
Truly poor!
Shaking his head, he then targeted Yao Yunxuan.
Ignoring the fact that there was another girl in the cave watching, he searched her top to bottom.
The gains in hand were real, why pretend?
Yao Yunxuan’s Tier Three Spirit Armor was quickly worn by him, immediately increasing his sense of security.
The Tier Two Spiritual Sword in his hand was replaced with a Tier Three Flying Sword.
Finally, he discovered a storage ring on Yao Yunxuan’s finger.
With a surge of his Soul Splitting Realm divine sense, the original restriction on the ring was destroyed.
"Wow!"
Looking at the dazzling array of materials in the ring, Jiang Cheng laughed out loud.
Yao Yunxuan was indeed a ’rich second generation’; the ring contained as many as three thousand middle-grade spirit stones and over two hundred top-grade spirit stones.
Besides over a hundred bottles of Qi Gathering Pills, there were also three Soul Refining Pills for impacting the Soul Splitting Realm.
Additionally, there were more than a dozen talismans of various kinds.
During the combat, the strength gap was too large, so she didn’t have time to use them, but now Jiang Cheng benefitted from it.
It wasn’t until he finished his task that Ji Linghan cautiously spoke.
"Senior..."
She was planning to help earlier, who knew it wasn’t needed at all.
With Yao Yunxuan, the enemy, dead, she was naturally happy.
The originally certain-death situation being resolved made her very grateful, too.
But now she was mostly bewildered.
Wasn’t it said he had no cultivation?
How did he suddenly acquire the ability to instantly kill those four?
Moreover, using her divine sense to probe Jiang Cheng’s strength now revealed nothing.
To her, he felt just like one of the sect’s elders, unfathomable.
What crumbled her perception was this senior’s manner of conducting himself.
Wasn’t the way he scavenged for loot just now too indiscriminate?
Other experts, even if they wanted to take spoils, would consider their image, perhaps letting juniors fetch them, or dismissing them for being too low-grade.
Is this really a senior expert? Not a bit of the expected style!
She had a question mark in her heart.
"Cough!"
Jiang Cheng cleared his throat, not about to reveal the system’s secret.
He had to make something up on the fly.
"I was just disguising myself as an ordinary person to see if the girl had a kind heart."
"You’ve done well, passed the test!"
He suddenly took on a mysterious demeanor, and Ji Linghan believed him.
"I saw earlier that you used Extreme Moon Sect’s swordsmanship, are you one of them..."
Although he had gained Yao Qiulin’s entire power, he hadn’t obtained his memories, so Jiang Cheng wasn’t clear on sect vendettas.
He didn’t even know how to find the front gate of Extreme Moon Sect.
However, he could roughly guess from the earlier conversation.
"Are you stupid? If I were one of them, would I kill them?"
"Alright, alright, we’re leaving now!"
Yao Qiulin was a third-layer Soul Splitting Realm expert, sufficiently powerful to fly out of this cave.
Before Ji Linghan could speak, he grabbed her delicate hand.
With spiritual qi channeling, the two floated upwards.
Soon, they arrived outside the cave.
Gazing at the sprawling barren mountains and wilderness, Jiang Cheng laughed madly.
"Hahaha, I’m finally free!"
"World, here I come!"
He spread his arms wide as if the scene before him was incredibly beautiful.
Ji Linghan’s lips twitched, wondering if he had a screw loose.
"Senior, um..."
"Are you really a Celestial Fate Realm expert?"
Watching her twisting her fingers, with a look of both anticipation and shyness, Jiang Cheng understood what she wanted.
She wanted to ask him for help in seeking revenge.
Though her beautiful face matched with that shy expression had a unique charm, Jiang Cheng disliked trouble.
He had heard that Ji Linghan’s sect had been wiped out.
The enemy must be immensely powerful to obliterate an entire sect.
Even with the system’s resurrection feature, Brother Cheng didn’t want to wade into this muddy water.
Having only one chance a day, he understood the reckless appeal of fate.
So, he decisively clasped his fists.
"Until we meet again!"
Just as he turned around, a system prompt echoed in his head.

chapters.title: Chapter 6 Main Quest
chapters.content:
Chapter 6: Chapter 6 Main Quest
Editor:
EndlessFantasy Translation
"Ding, the main quest ’Unification of the Three Realms’ has been initiated."
The very first line made Jiang Cheng feel as if he was struck by lightning, both inside and out.
We’re talking about the Three Realms here, and he had just begun, yet was given such an enormous task; clearly, it seemed impossible to complete!
Fortunately, the system soon provided an explanation.
"This task is not time-limited and can be completed in stages."
"For each stage completed, the host will receive Points Value."
"Points Value can be used to upgrade the system or choose a lottery draw."
The so-called system upgrade and lottery points were not unfamiliar to Jiang Cheng, and he found it easy to accept.
However, what puzzled him was how the unification of the Three Realms was determined, and what were the standards?
If it meant becoming invincible in the world, that would only require personal power.
But unifying the Three Realms required a massive force; one person couldn’t accomplish that.
The system clearly intended for him to establish a force.
And upon stages, how would one know if a stage was completed?
He discovered that a progress bar indeed appeared on the system interface.
Level: 1
Points: 0/1000
Available Points: 0
Current Skill: Can resurrect once per day (non-cumulative), able to defeat enemies post-resurrection.
Subordinate Skill: Resurrection times increased to twice per day (non-cumulative), able to defeat enemies post-resurrection.
Wow, so the resurrection times per day could actually increase!
Jiang Cheng was not calm anymore.
Being able to resurrect once a day may not be all that secure for a newbie like him who just left the Newbie Area.
For example, having just killed Yao Yunxuan’s group, if an even stronger enemy than the Soul Splitting Realm Third Layer came, he’d still be done for.
Unless he could escape and survive until the next day’s number recovers.
Resurrecting twice per day would be much more stable.
This level, Brother Cheng was determined to level up!
The problem was how to level up, and at this crucial moment, the system chose to play dead without providing even a basic introduction.
Having no other options, Jiang Cheng decided to try whether spirit stones and pills could be of use.
Upon opening the Storage Ring, he found there had indeed been a change.
The spirit stones and Qi Gathering Pills in the ring all had redemption options appear.
He then saw the exchange ratios.
point of points = 100 top-grade spirit stones = 10,000 middle-grade spirit stones.
point of points = 10 bottles of Soul Refining Pills = 100 bottles of Qi Gathering Pills.
point of points = 1 Tier Three Spiritual Artifact.
Excitedly, Jiang Cheng entered the exchange interface but withdrew in disappointment.
The system did accept everything, but after calculating fully, the spoils he had just gathered were only enough for less than 4 points of Points Value.
Leveling up required 1000 points, isn’t that just absurd?
It seemed completing the first stage of the Unification of the Three Realms task might still be more reliable.
He looked back, and Ji Linghan was still standing near the cave entrance.
"Your sect was wiped out?"
"Mm!"
Speaking of this, Ji Linghan’s tears almost fell, as if recalling the tragic events of that day.
That night, her master, martial uncles, and martial aunts all died before her eyes.
The Four Sects’ siege had been planned for a long time, and the Feixian Sect had no power to resist.
If not for the sect leader using her last means to send Ji Linghan out of the encirclement before her death, she too might have perished.
"Do you want revenge?"
"Of course I do!"
Ji Linghan replied without hesitation.
Although she had a gentle disposition, it didn’t mean she was a complete pushover without any temper.
Jiang Cheng pondered for a moment before proposing, "I can help you."
"Ah!"
Ji Linghan was overjoyed.
"Really?"
"If senior is willing to help me seek revenge, I am willing to repay with my utmost..."
She was both expectant and moved.
In her eyes, Jiang Cheng was a Celestial Fate Realm expert, a level far beyond Qinglan Dao’s ceiling, seeking revenge should be just a breeze for him?
Jiang Cheng waved his hand.
"I don’t need you to repay me with servitude, I just need you to agree to one condition."
"What condition?"
"I want to be the sect leader of the Feixian Sect."
He had thought it through; to unify the Three Realms, one must first set a small goal.
For instance, start by flattening Qinglan Prefecture.
How to flatten it?
Rushing into others’ mountain gates for slaughter without reason?
That wouldn’t hold the moral high ground and might even provoke a supposed righteous sect attack.
Having the banner of avenging the Feixian Sect would make it justified and honorable.
Moreover, the task itself required developing his own force, becoming the sect leader was only natural.
"Huh?"
Ji Linghan was stunned.
What kind of move was this?
With the Feixian Sect annihilated, what meaning was there in becoming the sect leader now?
There seemed to be no benefit in it, right?
Moreover, the Four Sects were still hunting down survivors, anyone revealing the Feixian Sect banner would just attract trouble.
"If you don’t agree, then we part ways!"
In the Cultivation Realm, fighting and killing happened daily; obliteration of sects was common, and he couldn’t possibly intervene every time he encountered it.
Seeing that this ’senior’ was about to leave again, Ji Linghan hurriedly followed up.
Repeatedly saying, "I agree!"
"Having senior take the role of Feixian Sect’s sect leader in this time of peril is our fortune!"
As a true disciple, she originally didn’t have the authority to decide on the sect leader’s succession.
However, with the previous sect leader dead and hardly anyone left in the sect, there wasn’t much to consider.
"Great, then I will take on this cause and effect!"
"From now on, I, Jiang Cheng, am the sect leader of the Feixian Sect!"
Only now did Ji Linghan know his real name.
Watching his resolute eyes, her heartstrings trembled, and she knelt down gracefully.
"Ji Linghan, true disciple of the Feixian Sect, pays respect to Sect Leader!"
Jiang Cheng was about to help her up when a system prompt sounded in his head again.

chapters.title: Chapter 7 Treasure Hunting
chapters.content:
Chapter 7: Chapter 7 Treasure Hunting
Editor:
EndlessFantasy Translation
"Ding, congratulations to the host for gaining the allegiance of a subordinate with the Seven-Aperture Exquisite Body."
"Reward: 3000 points."
"Please keep up the good work, host."
What the heck is happening?
Brother Cheng was a bit confused; he had just spent forever scavenging only to gather a little over 3 points.
He originally thought he’d have to at least flatten Qinglan Prefecture to upgrade.
That would take a lot of time and effort, and... dying many times.
But now Ji Linghan just bowed and he got 3000 points.
Isn’t this gap too big?
What’s so special about this Seven-Aperture Exquisite Body?
He quickly entered the system panel and saw that the 3000 points were indeed credited.
Without hesitation, Jiang Cheng chose to upgrade.
The system flashed, upgrading to Level 2.
Level: 2
Points: 0/10000
Available Points: 2000
Current Skill: Resurrection twice a day (non-cumulative), can defeat the enemy after resurrection.
Subordinate Skill: Resurrection times increased to three times a day (non-cumulative), can defeat the enemy after resurrection.
Another resurrection next level, making it even safer.
The problem is, the required points went up by 10 times!
Jiang Cheng was speechless; he originally thought 3000 points would be enough to level up three times.
Thinking about the raffle option in the system, he clicked in.
"Would you like to enter the raffle?"
"Yes!"
"You’ve deducted 1000 points."
Jiang Cheng almost cursed out loud, 1000 points for one draw? System, why don’t you just rob me?
Do you know how hard it is to collect points?
The points were deducted, no chance to regret it.
The system’s wheel spun crazily, Brother Cheng couldn’t see anything clearly, then it suddenly stopped.
"Congratulations, host’s luck exploded, you’ve gained the Insight Skill."
"Note: Nothing in the universe can hide, host can sense surrounding rare creatures and Heavenly and Earthly Treasures."
"Sensing range: Host’s Divine Sense range."
Jiang Cheng, hearing his luck exploded, thought he’d gotten some Divine Weapon or Immortal Artifact, or maybe an Ancient Divine Beast.
But then he realized, if he really got those external objects, he’d certainly win against small fry enemies.
But if he intentionally lost to winnable opponents, the system might consider it suicide, right?
Because that isn’t considered a life or death crisis, it’s seeking death.
Thinking about this, getting a skill seems like a good thing.
No matter what, being invincible after resurrection is fundamental, didn’t see after one resurrection he became Soul Splitting Realm Third Layer, right?
What use is this Insight Skill?
"Do you want to use Insight?"
"Dang, does this also require points?"
Could it be 1000 points again?
Luckily, this time the system considerately provided an answer in advance.
"Using once consumes 10 points."
points, that’s acceptable.
Jiang Cheng used it, and his remaining points became 990.
He immediately noticed a light blue exclamation mark above Ji Linghan’s head—Seven-Aperture Exquisite Body.
There was also a small note below:
"Note: The Seven-Aperture Exquisite Body is a branch of the Nine Great Ancient Cultivation Physiques’ Seven-Star Body, with cultivation speed far exceeding other cultivators, also possessing
So even people count as treasures?
Jiang Cheng maliciously guessed if the system categorized her as Heavenly and Earthly Treasure or rare creature?
This skill is incredibly useful!
Having Insight means no more missing out on treasures.
And based on the 3000 points given by Ji Linghan this time, inviting other extraordinary physique geniuses to pledge loyalty should also increase points in the future.
He was about to leave when he noticed another exclamation mark nearby.
The position of this question mark overlapped with Ji Linghan, if not for the different colors, it would be easy to overlook.
What else is by her side?
Jiang Cheng looked left and right, only seeing a rocky mountain and the cave that trapped him for a year.
He suddenly realized, the treasure was underground in the cave!
"Wait for me, I’ll be right back!"
Saying this, he jumped back into the cave.
Now that he can fly, he wasn’t worried about not getting out.
Back at the cave’s bottom, Jiang Cheng saw the small words below the exclamation mark.
’World Heart Fragment, absorbs the Qi of heaven and earth, captures the essence of sun and moon, subdues all living things...’
This cryptic description was beyond Jiang Cheng’s understanding, fortunately there was a ’popular version’ after.
"When the world was first formed, a naturally generated accompanying spirit object by the Dao rules, capable of turning the surrounding into a place filled with Spiritual Qi. It has a suppressive function on the cultivators of the world, with range effects depending on the fragment’s level."
"The fragment can generate its own consciousness, can be collected and synthesized, and its power will increase."
This fragment has such a huge origin?
Capable of manipulating Spiritual Qi concentration, and can suppress an area’s cultivators?
Jiang Cheng’s eyes lit up; its origin and effects cannot be described just as a treasure!
Must get it!
But he was a bit puzzled.
If there’s a World Heart Fragment here, why didn’t it turn into a place full of Spiritual Qi, instead becoming a barren land?
Could it be that this fragment not only isn’t benefiting a region but instead absorbed the Spiritual Qi back?
Clang! Clang! Clang!
Stones flew around.
The ground below was surprisingly hard, fortunate that he had Soul Splitting Realm cultivation now; otherwise, he couldn’t dig a tiny crack.
"Senior, what are you doing?"
Ji Linghan peered down from the cave entrance, watching him use the Spirit Sword as a hoe to dig the ground, feeling her understanding refreshed again.
This expert’s actions are truly unpredictable and unfathomable, impossible to guess his intentions!
"Digging treasure!"
Jiang Cheng didn’t even lift his head, continuing to swing his sword busily.

chapters.title: Chapter 8: The Daughter Who Killed Her Father Upon Appearing
chapters.content:
Chapter 8: Chapter 8: The Daughter Who Killed Her Father Upon Appearing
Editor:
EndlessFantasy Translation
After digging down over ten meters, finally, there was movement.
A golden light shot up into the sky, illuminating the entire cave with an overwhelming brightness.
Even though he was in the Soul Splitting Realm, Jiang Cheng found it difficult to even stand, and his previously sharp eyes couldn’t clearly see ahead.
All he could see was a finger-sized transparent crystal floating at the center of the light, vaguely forming a human face around it.
Then, he died.
As his soul drifted away from his body, Brother Cheng was dumbfounded.
Although his biggest future goal was to let more experts kill him, thinking of ways to die, this time he was really unprepared.
Who would have thought digging for treasure could actually lead to death?
This world is just too damn dangerous!
If not for the system, it felt like he wouldn’t survive an hour after transmigrating over.
"Ding! The host has been killed by a World Heart Fragment..."
Jiang Cheng felt powerless to complain, being killed by a fragment; it sounded way too humiliating a death.
"The host is currently Level 2 and can resurrect twice a day. Activating the second resurrection, while granting the host the Origin Aura of the world."
"With this aura, the World Heart Fragment will recognize it as its master."
During Jiang Cheng’s resurrection, the fragment that had just been excavated underwent a magical transformation.
The crystal gradually faded, and the human shape became more defined until it transformed into a naked baby.
As soon as it touched the ground, the baby grew rapidly with the wind.
By the time Jiang Cheng opened his eyes after reviving, she had already grown to three or four years old.
She continued to grow until she looked about five or six years old before finally stopping.
"Is this how the fragment has taken form?"
"Has it become sentient?"
Jiang Cheng had a strong ability to accept things. After all, anything was possible in this world.
But then he almost broke down.
The little girl with disheveled hair, yet exquisitely adorable, twirled her shiny black eyes and took small steps.
With chubby little hands, she ran toward him.
"Mama!"
"You’re mama!"
Poof...
Jiang Cheng spat out blood.
He understood it was because of the system, so the fragment recognized him as the master due to some Origin Aura thing.
He’d heard of some animals imprinting on the first creature they see after hatching as their parent.
But he really hadn’t expected the fragment to adopt this method of master recognition.
And calling him mama no less...
The little girl had extraordinary strength, almost knocking Jiang Cheng over.
When he finally got up, she opened her arms again, speaking in a childlike voice.
"Hug, mama hug!"
Jiang Cheng’s mouth twitched as he picked her up.
"I’m your dad, can’t you see I’m a handsome guy?"
The little girl suddenly burst into loud wails: "Mama doesn’t want me anymore, waah waah waah..."
Clinging even tighter, Jiang Cheng felt his neck choking for breath.
He could only adjust his tone.
"There, there, just change how you call me, say daddy, will you?"
"Mama!"
"Can’t you understand human words?"
"Mama!"
When he went out, Jiang Cheng’s handsome face was already covered in saliva.
But in the matter of this address, he ultimately did not win.
Outside the cave, Ji Linghan was laughing so hard she couldn’t straighten up.
She didn’t know that Jiang Cheng had died once again, but she witnessed the process where the fragment formed and recognized him as master.
Though she hadn’t heard about World Heart Fragments, she knew that anything capable of manifesting a form must be a high-grade marvel.
"Congratulations, Sect Leader!"
She now saw Jiang Cheng as one of her own, and it was a great thing for the Sect Leader to subdue such an exotic treasure.
However, while speaking, she couldn’t help but cover her mouth and snicker.
As a man being called mama, Brother Cheng felt rather humiliated.
"You teach her too, get her to change the way she calls, I think this little friend doesn’t understand much."
"Also, help wash her up later and prepare a set of clothes."
After speaking, he handed the little girl over.
"Sure!"
This child was cute enough to melt hearts, and Ji Linghan had long wanted to hold her.
But the little girl puffed her cheeks and turned her face away.
"No! I only want mama!"
Which made Ji Linghan rather embarrassed, her eyes misty with grievance.
However, Jiang Cheng was delighted. It seemed this fragment had maxed out its recognition of him after recognizing him as its master.
"Good child, this auntie is one of our own, she’ll teach you many things, so be good."
The little girl looked at Jiang Cheng, then at Ji Linghan, before finally agreeing.
"I’ll listen to mama."
Jiang Cheng was very gratified: "What a good child!"
Ji Linghan also joyously accepted the child, and then, she collapsed.
What the heck!
Jiang Cheng swiftly caught her.
"What are you doing? Didn’t kill her, did you?"
The system can only revive himself, not others!
Jiang Cheng still had quite a good impression of Ji Linghan.
This girl, unlike other cultivators, didn’t shout and scream to kill when meeting him, and seeing him get the treasure didn’t become greedy. She had a decent character.
Even if it weren’t for the sect leader relationship, he wouldn’t want to see her come to harm.
The little girl smiled with her mouth closed, shook her head: "I didn’t kill her, she’ll wake up in a bit."
"Huh?"
Upon checking, Jiang Cheng indeed found that Ji Linghan had only fainted.
"What did you do to her?"
"Didn’t mama tell me to learn from her? I entered her consciousness and learned all her knowledge."
While speaking, the little girl casually waved, a circle of pink light like stars surrounded her.
Soon, a little dress appeared on her.
The disheveled hair moved without wind, magically forming two pigtails.
Upon closer look, she seemed no different from other human girls.
Except for being more adorable.

chapters.title: Chapter 9 Ah Huang
chapters.content:
Chapter 9: Chapter 9 Ah Huang
Editor:
EndlessFantasy Translation
I told you to learn, not to invade her Sea of Consciousness!
You’re really quite direct and crude.
Jiang Cheng couldn’t help but be speechless.
But what’s done is done, and there’s nothing much to say. Besides, this way indeed saves a lot of trouble.
At least this little girl looks like she knows everything now.
The only downside is feeling a bit sorry for Ji Linghan; she was just so expectant.
"So do you understand things now?"
"Uh-huh." The little girl nodded like a pecking chicken.
"You know everything she knows?"
"Yeah." The little girl sweetly replied.
Jiang Cheng rubbed his smooth chin.
"Then let me test you, where is this place?"
"The northeastern corner of the Forbidden Land in Qinglan Prefecture, Feiyun State."
"How many high-level sects are there in Qinglan Prefecture?"
"There are seventeen sects with strength comparable to the Feixian Sect, and one sect and one noble family that surpass these eight major sects."
The little girl answered without hesitation, not even needing to think.
"And what are that sect and noble family?"
"They are the Red Sun Sect and the Duanmu Family. Both have cultivators in the Spirit Platform Realm."
Jiang Cheng nodded in satisfaction; he actually didn’t know this information.
"Hmm, nice!"
"Hee hee..."
Receiving his praise, the little girl felt very satisfied and snuggled into his arms.
"Since you know everything now..." Jiang Cheng coaxed.
"Then you should know I’m a man, should call me dad, right?"
"I don’t understand what mom is saying."
The little girl’s long eyelashes fluttered, her eyes full of innocence.
This little, and you’ve already learned to pretend, huh!
Jiang Cheng’s eyes twinkled: "You don’t have a name yet, let me give you one."
The little girl immediately clapped her chubby little hands, her face full of joy.
"Okay, okay, please name me, mom!"
"When you were born, a yellow light shot up into the sky, so we’ll call you Ah Huang from now on."
The little girl’s pout appeared instantly, the joy on her face turned into anger, and she loudly protested.
"No, no, I don’t want such an ugly name!"
Having obtained the common knowledge from Ji Linghan’s memory, she certainly knew that the name Ah Huang is usually given to puppies.
"Whether you want it or not! This is a name given by your parents!"
Jiang Cheng grinned ferociously; you killed dad once right after you were born, and I haven’t even held you accountable yet!
"A cheap name is easy to raise; it’s all for your own good. Unless you change to calling me dad, there’s no name change for you."
"Humph!"
Ah Huang glared at him intensely, seeming to try using her gaze to force him to back down.
But Brother Cheng is no pushover, even though those childish eyes are endearing even when angry, this is a matter of principle!
Thus, the big and the small stared at each other like this.
After a long time, Ah Huang finally muttered a sentence.
"Mom’s the worst!"
She still didn’t change how she addressed him; it seems this matter will be a lasting standoff with Jiang Cheng.
Although she said the worst, her little hands wrapped around Jiang Cheng’s neck didn’t loosen at all.
"Ah Huang needs to be obedient."
Jiang Cheng smiled as he patted her head.
Just as he finished speaking, the sound of wind came from afar.
Soon, three figures appeared in front of him.
One of them was someone he was very familiar with, none other than Yao Qiulin, whose cultivation he had copied.
As for the other two, judging by their age and attire, they should also be elders of the Extreme Moon Sect like Yao Qiulin.
"You wretch, you’re the one who killed my daughter!"
Previously, his split soul was killed, revealing the location and Jiang Cheng’s appearance.
Originally, he was at Feixian Sect holding a celebratory gathering, but now he hurriedly rushed over for revenge.
The other two elders were his invited helpers.
"Die!"
The enmity of killing one’s daughter is irreconcilable; Yao Qiulin unsheathed his long sword, emanating radiant beams in midair.
Regarding this move, Jiang Cheng saw through even his liver, spleen, lungs, and kidneys; wasn’t it just the Crescent Moon Swordsmanship he had copied?
If the opponent was only Yao Qiulin, he could have had a fight.
After all, whatever he knows, Jiang Cheng knows too, with identical cultivation and combat experience.
Ending in a draw shouldn’t be a problem.
The issue is that the other two elders look like they are no less powerful than Yao Qiulin, and Brother Cheng really has no confidence in taking on three.
"Elder Yao, hold your hand!"
"Let us ask a few questions first."
At the critical moment, the other two elders stopped Yao Qiulin.
"Are you trying to prevent me from avenging myself?" Yao Qiulin was furious, almost unrecognizable.
"Brother Yao, calm down a little..."
The two elders waved their hands.
"Boy, did you just see a yellow beam shooting into the sky here?"
"Correct, as long as you answer truthfully, we can spare your life!"
The spectacle when Ah Huang was born was too grand.
The three had seen it during their journey, just unsure of the exact location.
They didn’t know what the light was, but even a fool could guess it was most likely a rare treasure.
Mentioning this, even the furious Yao Qiulin calmed down.
Revenge must be taken, but it could be postponed.
"If I tell you, will you not kill me?"
Jiang Cheng seemed genuinely tempted.
The two elders hurriedly patted their chests to assure him.
"Of course, we old fellows never lie!"
Though they said that, in reality, they were thinking, not killing doesn’t mean not harming.
Besides, even if we promise, others haven’t.
Capture him and deliver him to Elder Yao to handle slowly.
"Alright, over there."
Jiang Cheng casually pointed in a direction.
Those little tricks of the three, he’d seen them a hundred times, how could he truly believe them?
He was considering how to escape.
Hiding till tomorrow when his resurrection cooldown ends, then he could continue to show off... uh, he meant, continue to eliminate evildoers.
But Ji Linghan was still lying on the ground.
If he ran, even if the three wanted to chase him, they wouldn’t ignore her.
Brother Cheng wouldn’t leave his people to die.
Not to mention he has a new daughter now.
But escaping with two people would definitely get him caught.
"Mom, are they the bad people who want to kill you?"
Ah Huang in his embrace suddenly blinked her big, black eyes as she curiously asked like an inquisitive baby.
Jiang Cheng almost couldn’t help but hit himself, how could he forget this little girl is a big killer?

chapters.title: Chapter 10: Depleting Spiritual Power
chapters.content:
Chapter 10: Chapter 10: Depleting Spiritual Power
Editor:
EndlessFantasy Translation
He hurriedly sent a secret message.
"Sweet daughter, can you make these three people pass out like you did before?"
In need of help, Brother Cheng refrained from calling her Ah Huang and instead addressed her as sweet daughter.
"Nope, unless I can make contact with them."
Ah Huang’s chuckle echoed in Jiang Cheng’s Sea of Consciousness; she didn’t seem anxious at all.
Tricking the other party into contact wasn’t feasible.
Even if one was knocked out upon contact, wouldn’t the other two notice something amiss?
Jiang Cheng knew she surely had another plan.
"So, do you have a way to take them down?"
"I do, but in the end, Mommy, you’ll have to do it yourself."
"Huh? Why?"
At this point, he was too lazy to argue about the naming issue.
"The world’s fragments can’t kill; it’s a restriction added by the Celestial Dao Rule."
Jiang Cheng couldn’t help but roll his eyes, showing serious disbelief.
Didn’t you kill your biological father before you were born?
Otherwise, why would I still have one resurrection chance left!
"However, I can help Mommy empty their Spiritual Power."
Empty Spiritual Power?
Wouldn’t that turn them into ordinary people?
Jiang Cheng almost burst into laughter; this skill was heaven-defying!
With this trick, what’s there to fear?
He coughed righteously: "Dad respects your no-killing concept; the difficult task of killing should be handled personally by me."
"After all, someone has to silently bear some unknown heavy burdens!"
At this point, even Ah Huang couldn’t help but roll her eyes.
"How could I have such a shameless mommy!"
While they were discussing, the three people opposite were also secretly communicating amongst themselves.
"What if this kid points us in a random false direction?"
"I think he’s lying!"
"Right, I admit he’s handsome, but I don’t trust his character!"
"How about I go investigate over there by myself, and you two keep an eye on him!"
"Elder Yao thinks we’re fools?"
"Yeah, if the treasure is really over there, Brother Yao might never return after getting it, right?"
"Heh heh heh, what a clever calculation!"
"So, what do you propose we do?"
"Let this kid lead the way, and the three of us will escort him together!"
After both sides ’finished their meetings,’ the three people looked at Jiang Cheng again.
"Kid, how can you guarantee that the direction is true?"
"We don’t believe it, unless you..."
Before they could even say they wanted him to lead the way, Jiang Cheng interrupted them.
"You don’t need to disbelieve; I’m fooling you anyway."
An unexpected silence fell across the scene for a moment.
The three elders opposite had seen many situations but had never encountered such a reply before.
It left them speechless, almost too choked up to speak.
"Are you looking for death?"
Yao Qiulin switched back to his furious mode, and his Flying Sword floated up again.
"Yes, I’m looking for death. Come and kill me." Jiang Cheng rubbed his hands with a carefree smile.
With his daughter as this ’big thigh to cling to,’ he felt particularly confident and could show off with ease.
"You!"
Truth be told, before figuring out the location of the treasure, Yao Qiulin couldn’t bear to kill him.
"Teach him a lesson; let him feel the pain!"
The other two elders’ faces darkened as well.
Swish, the Flying Sword split into six, with six beams attacking Jiang Cheng.
Only a few meters away, the six illusions suddenly dissipated.
The long sword seemed to become ordinary iron, losing all its shine, clattering to the ground.
"What?"
Yao Qiulin couldn’t believe his eyes.
Ever since cultivating to the Energy-Introducing Realm, his Flying Sword had never crashed mid-air like this.
"What’s happening?"
The other two elders felt displeased, feeling it a disgrace to be on par with such a person as elders.
Now, just when they wanted to establish their might and make that kid submit, such a low-level mistake occurred.
They even felt it was quite embarrassing themselves.
So the two planned to deploy their Flying Swords and take action personally.
Soon after, they screamed in shock.
"Where’s my Spiritual Power?"
"What’s going on, my Spiritual Power is completely gone!"
"Me too!"
Their expressions showed not just surprise, but deep fear.
For cultivators, Spiritual Power, Divine Sense, and the body are three fundamental aspects.
Without Spiritual Power, all Martial Techniques and Divine Techniques requiring it were nullified.
Not being Body Cultivators, their bodies in the Soul Splitting Realm weren’t extraordinarily strong either.
Without sufficient Spiritual Power in supporting the Spiritual Sense Secret Techniques, their powers greatly diminished.
Now, their combat abilities were even less than Yao Yunxuan in the Gathering Yuan Realm before.
How could they not be panicked by this?
"Could it be because of the Forbidden Land?"
"Impossible!"
"Although the Forbidden Land lacks Spiritual Qi, it doesn’t affect the transmuted Spiritual Power within the body!"
The three gestured wildly, exclaiming repeatedly.
Yet no matter how much they guessed, they couldn’t have imagined it was all due to that little girl opposite them.
Well done!
Jiang Cheng mentally gave his daughter a thumbs-up.
He carried the Spirit Sword and swaggered boldly in front of them.
"You three don’t even give me the respect of using your Flying Swords to kill me?"
Seeing him approach, the three quickly retreated, but then they calmed themselves down again.
"Kid, since we’ve lost our Spiritual Power, you can’t remain unharmed either!"
"That’s right, the three of us against you, you’re still doomed!"
In their minds, this had to be the regional influence, and Jiang Cheng certainly also lost his Spiritual Power.
Before they finished speaking, Jiang Cheng’s figure flickered and disappeared from where he was.
Without Spiritual Power, the speed and reaction of the three elders were extraordinarily slow, too late to dodge.
Bam! Bam! Bam!
Every one of them received a hard knock on the head with the Spirit Sword.
Jiang Cheng didn’t use the blade but the spine of the sword.
Nevertheless, being imbued with the power of the Soul Splitting Realm, the tops of their heads swelled visibly at eye speed.
"You dare!"
"You wicked brat, how dare you humiliate us!"
The three were furious; as elders in the Soul Splitting Realm, they were figures of status in Qinglan Prefecture.
This ’treatment’—being thumped on the head—was an extreme humiliation.
In comparison, they forgot to even ask about why Jiang Cheng still had Spiritual Power.
"Ah, sorry, sorry, I forgot your esteemed identities."
Jiang Cheng feigned a cheerful apology, then summoned the Flying Sword.
Six Sword Shadows slashed through the air, two for each person.
"Does this kind of death match your identities now?"

chapters.title: Chapter 11: Sect Leader, True Divine Being
chapters.content:
Chapter 11: Chapter 11: Sect Leader, True Divine Being
Editor:
EndlessFantasy Translation
This time, the three people’s eyes were almost popping out.
Not only did he still have spiritual power, but he used the secret swordsmanship of their Extreme Moon Sect.
"How can you..."
Zzzzzz!
Three light sounds, and the three fell down simultaneously.
"Why so many questions?"
Jiang Cheng summoned back his spirit sword and began to search the bodies of the three for spoils.
This battle was many times easier than the one in the cave earlier; without spiritual power, they couldn’t withstand even one move.
The three of Yao Qiulin were indeed elders; the spirit stones in their rings were tenfold more than those of Yao Yunxuan.
Besides that, there were over a dozen bottles of pills for cultivation in the Soul Splitting Realm; in the system exchange, one bottle of Soul Splitting Realm pills could be exchanged for one point.
Looking at the spirit medicine, Jiang Cheng suddenly felt overwhelming sadness.
Thinking that one Ji Linghan could be exchanged for 3000 points, he suddenly felt pity for Yao Qiulin!
"Mommy, I want to eat!"
Ah Huang stumbled while wobbling her short legs towards him.
"Ah? Eat what?"
Jiang Cheng patted his sturdy chest.
"I don’t have any milk!"
Ah Huang nearly fell over, looking at him with an expression of disbelief.
"I want spirit stones."
Jiang Cheng suddenly realized.
"Oh yes, you’re already grown up and weaned."
Since she had the ability to manipulate spiritual power, eating spirit stones for replenishment was natural.
He was quite generous to his ’daughter.’
With a wave of his hand, the spirit stones in the three rings piled up into a small mountain.
"Don’t save on behalf of your dad, let your stomach loose and eat!"
Won’t die from overeating!
Slurp!
A streak of golden light swept across the ground, and the pile of spirit stone mountain disappeared.
The entire process took less than a second.
"Mommy, is there more?"
Ah Huang patted her belly and intentionally asked.
Looking at her unchanged small belly, Jiang Cheng chuckled.
"Well, losing weight should start from childhood."
At this point, Ji Linghan finally awoke, relieving his awkwardness.
"Sect Leader, how did I faint?"
"Maybe your blood sugar is low."
His daughter just saved him, still had to cover for her a bit.
Ji Linghan didn’t understand the blood sugar concept, but just waking up and dazed, she let it go.
Soon, her attention was drawn to the three just defeated.
"Ah! That’s Yao Qiulin?"
As a disciple of Feiyun Sect, she still recognized some important figures from surrounding sects.
"And Dai Xin, Xun Mingyou!"
"They are all elders of the Extreme Moon Sect, and Dai Xin is at the sixth layer of the Soul Splitting Realm!"
She was extremely surprised as these figures were renowned and they died here?
If it were three elders from Feiyun Sect, it would be tough to defeat them, killing them would be nearly impossible, especially same-tier battles where you can’t beat them or escape?
There are many methods in the Soul Splitting Realm.
"Sect Leader, are they..."
These three had recently participated in the attack on Feiyun Sect, seeing them killed, Ji Linghan felt quite satisfied.
Jiang Cheng stood with arms behind his back, looking up at the sky, speaking casually, "They were about to kill me, and then they died."
Although she already guessed, Ji Linghan was still shocked.
"Sect Leader killed them all alone?"
This incredulous tone made Jiang Cheng feel comfortable, satisfied his desire to boast immensely.
He glanced at Ah Huang without blushing.
"To this Sect Leader, this is just a trivial scene!"
Seeing his profound demeanor, Ji Linghan felt a deep admiration for his power, absolutely prostrate with respect.
The Sect Leader is indeed powerful, his strength is at least at the Spirit Platform Realm!
"Where is Feixian Sect?"
"Sect Leader plans to go back?"
Ji Linghan was happy at first, then worried.
"There must be many of them left over there, Sect Leader, are you confident?"
Jiang Cheng waved his hand, "What’s there to be afraid of, in front of this Sect Leader, they’re just meager obstacles!"
Though his resurrection count hadn’t renewed, he had Ah Huang’s supreme skills, making the enemy’s numbers non-threatening.
Ji Linghan calmed down, having such a ’strong’ Sect Leader made her feel very safe.
Without a word, the three quickly exited the Forbidden Land.
Once out, Ah Huang, who was on his back, inexplicably felt drowsy.
"Mommy, I’m so sleepy."
Jiang Cheng hurriedly stopped.
"Ah? What’s wrong, are you unwell? Didn’t you just overeat, ruin your stomach?"
Even not for his boasting endeavors ahead, he still cared greatly for this ’daughter’s’ safety.
She was someone whose approval level was off the charts.
"No, it’s suddenly leaving there... I need to rest and recharge..."
After she said that, she fell into a deep sleep.
Jiang Cheng then understood, she had been in the Forbidden Land for countless years.
That place was her home territory, suddenly coming to the outside world might be causing acclimation issues?
As long as it’s nothing major, it’s fine.
"Let’s pause for a moment."
Now that Ah Huang was asleep, they couldn’t immediately attack Feixian Sect.
"What’s wrong, Sect Leader?"
"Nothing, knowing the enemy and knowing oneself leads to countless victories. It’s better to find a place to rest first, investigate what’s happening over there for prudent action."
Even without Ah Huang’s big killer, Jiang Cheng wasn’t worried.
After all, by tomorrow he’d have resurrection counts.
Even boasting needs a recharging period.
"Knowing the enemy and knowing oneself leads to countless victories..."
Ji Linghan repeated once, her beautiful eyes sparkling, she looked at him with growing admiration.
"Sect Leader is truly a divine being. Though we know this principle, we’ve never thought about summarizing it this way."
She couldn’t fathom the Sect Leader was merely waiting for his cooldown time.

chapters.title: Chapter 12 Talent of the Celestial Desolation Indestructible Body
chapters.content:
Chapter 12: Chapter 12 Talent of the Celestial Desolation Indestructible Body
Editor:
EndlessFantasy Translation
The two of them found a deep mountain forest nearby. After Jiang Cheng sat down cross-legged, he finally felt the power of the Celestial Desolation Indestructible Body.
Before he started circulating his cultivation technique, spiritual energy automatically flowed into his body.
This was not a forbidden land without spiritual energy, and it was evident how effective the Three Realms’ number one cultivation physique was.
Even without a cultivation technique, the constant nourishment from spiritual energy would gradually make the body stronger over time.
When he began circulating the Moon Observation Heart Method of the Extreme Moon Sect, Ji Linghan could no longer absorb even a tiny bit of spiritual energy.
The spiritual energy within several tens of miles seemed to form a vortex, with Jiang Cheng at its center.
Spiritual energy frantically rushed into his body, causing strong winds to rise in the surrounding mountains and forests.
The most terrifying aspect of the Celestial Desolation Indestructible Body was not its massive absorption, but its conversion speed.
Speaking of absorbing spiritual energy, some Saint Heirs of the Great Sect Sacred Lands have been consuming spirit stone elixirs like meals since birth.
But when too much spiritual energy is absorbed and cannot be refined into their own spiritual power in a short time, it naturally cannot quickly enhance their strength.
This is why the talent of physique, bloodline, roots, and bones are important.
The Celestial Desolation Indestructible Body seemed to have no such problems; it converted spiritual energy into spiritual power with almost no obstruction, refining as much as it took in.
Ji Linghan was dumbfounded by this scene.
She herself was a cultivation genius, and when she could absorb the spiritual energy within a few miles during cultivation, it was already considered miraculous.
But not only was Jiang Cheng’s range ten times larger, but his means of seizing spiritual energy could be considered plundering; not even a sip was left for those around.
This method of cultivation was like endlessly grabbing top-grade spirit stones for absorption, one could imagine how fast it would be.
The Sect Leader truly is a divine being!
When Jiang Cheng stopped cultivating, his realm had advanced from Soul Splitting Third Layer to Fourth Layer.
"Sect Leader, have you finished cultivating?"
It was only then that Jiang Cheng realized he had just prevented her from cultivating.
Thinking of how this girl had been silently acting as his protector all along, he couldn’t help but feel a sense of guilt.
He always considered her as a tool, which seemed too much.
"I’m sorry. I’ll be more considerate when I cultivate in the future."
Ji Linghan hurriedly waved her hand and smiled, "It’s no problem. The Sect Leader getting stronger is a blessing for the sect!"
What a kind person!
Jiang Cheng stood up, looked at the sky, and realized it was past midnight, so it was already the next day.
"Let’s go to the Feixian Sect."
With his resurrection cooldown ended, he was now full of confidence.
"Ah? Isn’t the Sect Leader planning to scout ahead first?"
Ji Linghan hastily followed him.
Jiang Cheng solemnly said, "I just broke through, my power has greatly increased, so no need to scout, we’ll just charge directly!"
Ji Linghan didn’t understand what "charge" meant, but when she heard that his power had greatly increased, she immediately felt happy.
She asked joyfully, "I wonder what realm the Sect Leader has broken through to?"
"Higher than you can imagine!"
"Ah!"
Ji Linghan couldn’t help but cover her mouth in shock and admiration; she was thinking of the Celestial Fate Realm.
The two of them were just rising into the air when there were rustling sounds in the nearby forest.
Then, three young men and women in ragged clothes emerged from behind the trees.
Upon seeing Ji Linghan, they quickly waved to her.
"It’s Senior Sister Ji! Everyone, come out quickly!"
Ji Linghan was also overjoyed and rushed to meet them.
"Junior Brother Luo Yuan, Junior Sister Yin Xuer, Junior Brother Jiang Hong, you’re all still alive, that’s great!"
Subsequently, more than twenty remaining disciples of the Feixian Sect appeared one after another from the distant forest.
The two sides met and embraced each other while crying, making it an emotional scene.
Jiang Cheng, standing aside, was left with nothing to do, feeling a bit bored.
"Nephew Ji, have you seen any other disciples?"
This group had exceptional talent and were all true disciples of the Feixian Sect.
When wiped out, the elders of the sect had risked their lives to send them out, serving as seeds for revenge and reconstruction.
Apart from the twenty-one disciples, one Elder Liang had also narrowly escaped death, becoming their pillar of hope.
They were being hunted down and now could only hide in the remote mountains and forests.
After the joy of reunion faded, Ji Linghan shook her head dejectedly.
"Reporting to Master Liang, I have not seen anyone else. How about you? Have any other senior uncles, senior aunts, junior brothers, or junior sisters made it out?"
Elder Liang gave a bitter smile, "It seems the Feixian Sect is left with only us, these twenty some saplings."
"Damn the Extreme Moon Sect!"
"And the Profound Ice Sect, Five Thunders Sect, Celestial Flame Sect!"
Junior Brother Luo Yuan flicked his spirit sword, speaking with determination.
"Before my master fell, he passed his Jiu Jue Sword to me. If I cannot bathe it in the blood of those four great sects, wouldn’t I be failing it!"
Meanwhile, Yin Xuer gazed at the ring on her finger, tears streaming down.
"This is the spirit stones and pills that my master left for me when she sent me out. Once I reach the Soul Splitting Realm, I will definitely avenge the old master!"
Seeing these mementos, other disciples also made solemn vows.
"Master Liang, Senior Sister Ji, where should we go next?"
"The first step is to break through and escape!"
"After getting out, should we stay together or separate and seek other sects?"
"What, are you planning to betray the Feixian Sect?"
"I am not! I just want to cultivate to a higher realm; I will never forget to avenge the sect!"
The disciples each expressed their views, engaging in heated discussions.
Elder Liang glanced at their storage rings, spirit swords, and spirit armors, a greedy glint flashing in his eyes.
Although he was an elder, all these individuals were true disciples before.
When their masters risked everything to send them out, they gave them almost all their possessions to enable them to continue cultivating.
Just like Ji Linghan, not only did she wear a defensive Fifth Grade Spiritual Artifact, but the resources stored inside were also all the previous Sect Leader’s savings.
This ring was something Elder Liang had never dared dream of before.
"Quiet, everyone!"
As soon as he spoke, everyone looked at him.
After all, he was the only remaining elder, so they had to listen to him.
"If you want revenge, you don’t have to wait. You can do it right now!"
As soon as these words were spoken, the disciples all stood up, becoming eager and anxious.
"Does Master Liang have a method?"
Even in its prime, the Feixian Sect might not have been a match for the Extreme Moon Sect alone, let alone with their current young generation not yet fully grown.
Revenge was something they all hoped to accomplish in the future.
"As long as I can avenge my master, I am willing to do anything!"
Elder Liang smiled and motioned for everyone to calm down.
"Revenge cannot be achieved by our strength alone!"
Luo Yuan frowned and said, "Is Master Liang suggesting we seek help from other sects?"
Elder Liang stroked his beard and nodded, "Exactly!"
"But we don’t have deep connections with other sects, and they probably won’t help us."
These disciples, although eager for revenge, were still clear-headed.
To become a true disciple, one couldn’t be dim-witted.

chapters.title: Chapter 13 Elder Liang’s Plan
chapters.content:
Chapter 13: Chapter 13 Elder Liang’s Plan
Editor:
EndlessFantasy Translation
Elder Liang smiled and shook his head, as if he had a clever plan of his own.
"You have no association, but I do! I’ve met Duanmu Han, the Second Elder of the Duanmu Family, several times, and we’ve shared drinks and formed a deep friendship."
The other disciples suddenly became excited, immediately seeing a glimmer of hope for revenge.
"The Duanmu Family, they’re the top noble family in Qinglan Prefecture!"
"Yes, they alone have four Spirit Platform Realm elders!"
"If they were to take action, even the combined forces of the Four Great Sects couldn’t stop them!"
"Elder Liang, please step forward quickly..."
Little did they know, Elder Liang’s words were merely made up.
Duanmu Han was already at the Spirit Platform Realm Third Layer; why would he care about an ordinary sect elder at the Soul Splitting Realm Fifth Layer?
Elder Liang had indeed seen Duanmu Han before, but it was from afar among the crowd, with no eligibility to converse.
However, he wasn’t worried, as these disciples currently had no means of exposing him.
After taking the resources, who would be able to find him?
"You’re imagining things too beautifully. How revered is the Duanmu Family? Such a noble family wouldn’t act lightly. Even with my relationship, all I can get is just one opportunity."
"Then, what does Elder Liang mean..."
"If you want them to make a move, you must offer enough reward as a sign of respect for such a great family!"
"This..."
Everyone glanced at their rings and spiritual artifacts, understanding his meaning—they were to be offered.
Elder Liang seized this opportunity and urged them strongly!
"As long as you all contribute a bit, and I personally bring them over, they will be moved for sure. By then, the three Spirit Platform Realm figures from the Duanmu Family would arrive, and the four sects of Extreme Moon Sect would be wiped out with no effort at all!"
Seeing the disciples hesitating, he even used a provocation technique.
"Didn’t you just say you’d do anything for the master’s revenge?"
```
