He sneered coldly, "What, you’re unwilling to part with just a few storage rings?"
"It seems your master chose the wrong people and taught a bunch of ingrates!"
No one can bear such a heavy accusation; Luo Yuan and Yin Xuer quickly took off their rings and spiritual artifacts.
"Uncle Master, can these resources really make the Duanmu Family take action?"
"What if they take the rings but don’t act?"
"Yeah, we’re worried they’ll have greedy intentions too."
Elder Liang’s face turned stern: "Are you doubting the relationship between me and Duanmu Han?"
He brushed his sleeve angrily.
"If that’s the case, then just forget it!"
Luo Yuan hurriedly stepped forward to appease him.
"Uncle Master, you overstate it, I’ll give you the Jiu Jue Sword to take with you..."
"That’s more like it!" Elder Liang’s face was filled with satisfaction.
With these things in hand, he certainly wouldn’t stay in Feiyun State any longer.
With over twenty shares of resources, reaching the Spirit Platform Realm in the future isn’t out of the question.
Just as he was about to accept, Ji Linghan stopped him.
"Uncle Master, actually we don’t need to ask the Duanmu Family for help to get revenge!"
The long sword that Luo Yuan was about to hand over was immediately withdrawn.
"What, Senior Sister, is what you said true?"
"Yes, yes, Senior Sister, do you have a plan?"
All the disciples gathered around as well, aside from Elder Liang, Ji Linghan was the one they esteemed the most.
She was the direct disciple of the former sect leader; although not the oldest, due to her extraordinary talent of the Seven-Aperture Exquisite Body, she was always the head senior sister among these disciples.
Moreover, now without the sect’s protection and the master’s guidance, if they lost those resources, their future would effectively be ruined.
If it weren’t for being pressured by Elder Liang’s words, they wouldn’t have chosen that method.
Seeing the cooked duck flying away, Elder Liang’s face turned dark instantly, wishing he could strangle Ji Linghan.
"You have a plan? What plan could you possibly have? You’re nothing but Gathering Yuan Realm Eighth Layer yourself!"
"Could it be you have a connection with the Duanmu Family, can you climb that high?"
"Or perhaps you’ve been in private contact with some Sect Leader’s Disciple of Red Sun Sect? Can you pull them in?"
In his fury now, his words became filled with sarcasm.
Luo Yuan and others’ expressions changed as well.
Unhappily saying: "Uncle Master Liang, you’re going too far in speaking about Senior Sister Ji!"
"Yeah, why don’t we listen to what Senior Sister has to say first?"
Ji Linghan had always taken care of these junior brothers and sisters and was gentle in temperament, earning their support.
If the Feixian Sect hadn’t been destroyed, in a hundred years, the next Sect Leader would most likely be her.
Seeing that he was about to arouse public anger, Elder Liang had to suppress his hatred for the time being.
"Go ahead, what’s your plan?"
"My plan involves Elder Jiang Cheng!"
Ji Linghan turned to the side, reaching out to introduce him solemnly to everyone.
"This elder’s power is unfathomable; he has already agreed to take over as Sect Leader of Feixian Sect and will help us clear out the Four Great Sects!"
In such a scenario, Jiang Cheng certainly wouldn’t shy away.
This is a man destined to unite the Three Realms; such a small scene is trivial.
Luo Yuan and Yin Xuer’s earlier words and actions were all noticed by him; remembering to avenge the master indicates they’re not ungrateful.
Suffice it to say, they’ve basically earned his approval internally.
In his eyes, they were already considered his disciples.
So, he stepped forward and waved.
"Hey, hello everyone!"
"Ah?"
"Sect Leader?"
"This... Senior Sister Ji, how did he become the Sect Leader?"
This news was quite sudden for everyone.
Ji Linghan understood that they couldn’t accept it upon first meeting.
"We all know the situation our Feixian Sect is in now. Taking over this burden at this time is akin to bringing fire upon oneself."
She was right, jumping out now to claim to be Feixian Sect’s Sect Leader is practically courting the hatred of the Four Great Sects.
Other people wouldn’t dare to take it.
"Just for this reason alone, I recognize Elder Jiang’s position as Sect Leader, not to mention he even saved my life..."
"Ah? He saved Senior Sister?"
"What happened?"
Ji Linghan began recounting the pursuit by Yao Yunxuan and subsequent death of Yao Qiulin and others.
After this recount, the disciples gradually viewed Jiang Cheng with more favor.
"Turns out Elder saved Senior Sister, we were rude earlier!"
"Yes, truly grateful to Elder!"
"Elder, are you really willing to take charge of our Feixian Sect?"
Jiang Cheng could kill three Soul Splitting Realm elders, his power is exceptional.
Such feats, even the former Sect Leader couldn’t achieve.
Given the mess Feixian Sect is in now, it’s unthinkable to ignore such a beneficial alliance offered voluntarily.
"Of course, of course!"
Uniting the Three Realms must start from scratch, and he can’t have nobody under his command.
Jiang Cheng continuously cupped his hands in greeting; he wasn’t shy, and the atmosphere became harmonious.
"Ridiculous, absolutely ridiculous!"
Elder Liang sneered, interrupting everyone.
He glanced at Jiang Cheng and curled his lip.
"You think this old man can’t tell? You’re just Soul Splitting Realm Fourth Layer."
His realm exceeded Jiang Cheng’s; he could discern realms at a glance.
"With that alone, you think you can kill Yao Qiulin, Xun Mingyou, Dai Xin?"
Ji Linghan hurriedly spoke for Jiang Cheng: "Uncle Master, those three truly died. If you don’t believe, you can go to the Forbidden Land now and find their corpses!"
Elder Liang laughed coldly: "Did you personally witness him battle those three?"
Ji Linghan was momentarily stunned.

chapters.title: Chapter 14 Dead?
chapters.content:
Chapter 14: Chapter 14 Dead?
Editor:
EndlessFantasy Translation
"At that time, I passed out, so I didn’t see what happened. But aside from Sect Leader Jiang, there was no one else present..."
Elder Liang, like a detective who had discovered a major clue, immediately jumped up.
"Can you guarantee that no one else passed by at that time?"
"Since you didn’t see it, what makes you so sure?"
"Nephew Ji, without thoroughly investigating, are you really going to acknowledge an outsider as the sect leader?"
"The position of sect leader is extremely important. If this harms us all, what will be your punishment?"
He pressed forward, questioning with every step.
Ji Linghan was not someone with a sharp tongue and couldn’t find any words to respond for a moment.
She just had confidence in Jiang Cheng, besides, she really couldn’t think of anything he would want to gain from Feixian Sect.
"Enough, enough, are you finished yet?"
Jiang Cheng had been watching for quite a while and was starting to feel impatient.
Elder Liang’s intention to swindle the disciples’ resources was obvious to him at first glance.
It was simply because Jiang Cheng had ruined his plans, causing him to turn his attention this way.
"What’s the point of babbling here for so long? I might as well go and take back Feixian Sect right now, wouldn’t that solve everything?"
Elder Liang originally wanted to get angry, but upon hearing this sentence, he burst out laughing.
"Take it back? Just you?"
He eyed Jiang Cheng up and down with disdain.
In his eyes, Jiang Cheng, at the Soul Splitting Realm Fourth Layer, heading to Feixian Sect would be a sure way to seek death.
After the Four Great Sects conquered it and looted the place, some people remained on that side.
There were currently no fewer than twenty individuals at the Soul Splitting Realm there, truly a dragon’s den and tiger’s lair.
"Yes, just me! If I succeed, what will you say then?"
"If you can pull it off, I’ll immediately bow to you as the sect leader!"
Elder Liang could only hope he would go off to die, and after he was dead, these people would be forced to adopt his plan of offering treasures for help again.
"I’m just afraid you won’t dare..."
This tactless provocation technique was too crude, and not only Jiang Cheng, but the others also picked up on it.
Everyone frowned.
No matter his power, Jiang Cheng was willing to join when Feixian Sect was at its most difficult time, which was quite commendable.
Moreover, saving Ji Linghan was a tangible fact.
Luo Yuan and others all tried to persuade him.
"Elder, why not give it some more thought!"
"Yes, there’s no need to rush for revenge..."
Jiang Cheng shook his sword, laughing freely.
"To me, those enemies over there are mere chickens and dogs!"
With that, he simply flew up into the sky.
Ji Linghan had great confidence in him, being the first to follow.
Seeing her go, the others naturally had to follow suit.
Elder Liang stomped his feet in frustration, not wanting to go back.
It was very dangerous over there now; he could get discovered and then be surrounded if not careful, right?
But staying here alone would make him seem too cowardly.
"Hmph, really won’t cry until seeing the coffin, curious to see how you die!"
Upon reaching the mountain range outside Feiyun Sect, everyone looked at the brightly lit familiar place from afar, feeling both sorrowful and angry.
They saw shadows moving about inside, constantly busy.
After the Four Great Sects took Feixian Sect, they began disassembling it.
The Sect Treasure Vault and places like the Pill Pavilion and Artifact Pavilion had long been emptied by the enemy’s upper echelons, and now the remaining elders and disciples of the Four Great Sects were scavenging for remaining wealth.
Judging by their stance, it was as if they intended to scour the place clean.
"They even smashed the statue of the Ancestor!"
"The Spirit Veins have also been cut off by them!"
"They even took down the plaque of the main hall, truly a bunch of bandits!"
"Despicable!"
Watching scene after scene, everyone’s anger soared.
However, with such a difference in strength, even seeing it was of no use.
"Sect Leader, how should we assist you?"
Currently, the only one calling him sect leader, was Ji Linghan.
Jiang Cheng’s lips curled, casually handing his ’daughter’ to her.
"Leave the breaking of the enemy to me alone, all you need to do is cheer me on here."
With those words, he swaggered off into the distance.
Ji Linghan hadn’t heard the term ’cheer on’ before and simply thought his spirit was incredibly charming, leaving her a bit mesmerized.
The others were genuinely left speechless.
"Isn’t Elder being too arrogant..."
"Yes, just flying over there like that, he’ll surely be surrounded!"
"If you ask me, secretly infiltrating for assassination would be much more prudent."
Elder Liang was gloating, "He’s courting death on his own, who can stop him?"
Jiang Cheng flew quickly, and before the enemy could react, he landed in the already fragmented main hall plaza.
The main forces of the Four Great Sects were either searching around to cut the weeds and roots, or they had already returned to their sects with great gains.
Only 18 Soul Splitting Realm elders and more than eighty disciples remained to continue scavenging.
This group was like the last to sweep the battlefield, eager to pry even a single brick.
"Who are you!"
As soon as he appeared, they noticed him.
However, he wasn’t one of Feixian Sect, so they didn’t recognize him.
"We, the Four Sects, are conducting business here. Any irrelevant people should leave!"
If they hadn’t recognized Jiang Cheng as being at the Soul Splitting Realm Fourth Layer, that elder on the opposite side would have probably attacked outright.
"You’re conducting business?"
Jiang Cheng snickered, mocking, "What a coincidence? I’m here for business too."
The elder’s face immediately darkened.
And the surrounding disciples began to gather around.
"What do you mean by that? Are you trying to stand up for Feixian Sect?"
"I advise you to weigh your own power!"
"Leave wisely while you still can!"
Unclear about his background, they hesitated to act rashly.
What if there was a powerful sect backing him?
Jiang Cheng chuckled, correcting them.
"I’m not here to stand up for Feixian Sect, I’m just here to clean up."
Clean up?
The elder didn’t understand for a moment.
"What do you mean?"
"It means, I’m the current sect leader of Feixian Sect. Taking my things right under my nose, isn’t it a bit disrespectful?"
As soon as he finished speaking, the sound of swords being drawn filled the air.
Immediately after, he found himself surrounded.
"You are the new sect leader of Feixian Sect?"
The elder furrowed his brows and confirmed once more.
"Indeed, freshly appointed yesterday!"
"The leftovers of Feixian Sect are truly blind, appointing such a fool to step into a trap as sect leader!"
The other elders left from the Four Sects quickly rushed over.
Even though Jiang Cheng was just a Soul Splitting Fourth Layer, any two elders could handle him.
But since he held the position of sect leader, some ceremony was necessary.
"Since you’re here, don’t think about leaving alive!"
From a distance, hidden on the mountainside, Elder Liang nearly laughed out loud upon seeing this scene.
This guy’s head really is too hard, isn’t it?
He truly doesn’t think he’s dying fast enough!
Luo Yuan and the others were anxious with worry.
"This is bad now, Elder Jiang has been surrounded!"
"Against 18 Soul Splitting Realm elders, over a hundred people, it’s a death trap!"
"Unless he’s at the Spirit Platform Realm, otherwise..."
"Oh..."
Elder Liang, worried they might impulsively run to rescue Jiang Cheng, thus getting trapped there themselves.
"Don’t act rashly, you all."
"If he wants to die, that’s his business, but if you die too, then Feixian Sect will truly vanish without a trace!"
If they died there, the resources in the rings could not be retrieved.
"Elder must have confidence!"
Ji Linghan had personally heard Jiang Cheng mention he’d lived for a thousand years.
However, just as she finished speaking, Jiang Cheng fell into a pool of blood in the distance.

chapters.title: Chapter 15: Profound Celestial Tribulation Thunder
chapters.content:
Chapter 15: Chapter 15: Profound Celestial Tribulation Thunder
Editor:
EndlessFantasy Translation
The elders of the four sects opposite didn’t hesitate much and attacked immediately.
Soul Splitting Realm elders, even Jiang Cheng couldn’t withstand them, and naturally, he was killed.
Because he died too quickly, they were all somewhat dumbfounded.
Was it too easy?
Didn’t this kid say he was the Sect Leader?
They thought he had some hidden tricks, but it turned out to be this?
That’s it?
"Seems like he’s just a fool!"
"What a waste of our time."
On the mountainside, everyone opened their mouths wide, unsure of what to say for a moment.
He’s really dead!
"No..."
Ji Linghan, holding Ah Huang, nearly fainted.
She couldn’t believe her eyes; wasn’t the senior supposed to be very powerful? At least at the Celestial Fate Realm?
"Hmph, it seems Nephew Ji you chose the wrong person!"
When Elder Liang saw Jiang Cheng was killed, he felt relieved.
"Someone like him is qualified to be our Sect Leader?"
"Let’s go, there’s nothing to watch. Thinking about the plan to hire the Duanmu Family is more practical."
For a moment, everyone couldn’t refute him.
Meanwhile, on the main hall square, Jiang Cheng, who had become a spirit, appeared calm.
The system’s pleasing prompt sounded unsurprisingly.
"Host has been killed, system is analyzing enemy power, arranging a revival plan for the host..."
"Given that the enemy’s power exceeds the host’s by many times, the system will prepare a First Layer Profound Celestial Tribulation Thunder for the host. Once the Thunder Tribulation is unleashed, all below Celestial Fate will turn to ashes!"
This Profound Celestial Tribulation Thunder is experienced only when breaking from Daoist Palace Realm to Ascending to Saint.
The First Layer Profound Celestial Tribulation is just an appetizer, very weak. Not to mention Daoist Palace Realm, even Celestial Fate Realm has a chance to withstand it if they fight hard.
Four or Five Layer Thunder Tribulations are extremely dangerous.
And at Eight or Nine layers, the spectacle is already world-destroying, with plenty of peak Daoist Palace Realms dying unfortunate deaths.
However, the highest among them here were only Seventh Layer Soul Splitting Realm.
For them, a First Layer Profound Tier Tribulation Thunder is a catastrophe.
"Ding, Host revived."
Once Jiang Cheng came to life, he flew into the sky.
Although the Thunder Tribulation didn’t require his power to activate, how could he miss the rare chance to show off?
Besides, he knew that to win over the hearts of Feixian Sect’s disciples, he needed to display power that would shock them.
Only then would they wholeheartedly accept him as Sect Leader.
"Sect Leader, Sect Leader is indeed not dead!"
From afar, Ji Linghan was overjoyed, happier than when she herself broke through.
"Haha, turns out the senior was just joking around?"
"Almost scared me to death!"
Luo Yuan and the others breathed a sigh of relief, then grew expectant.
"Hmph, so what if he’s not dead?"
In disappointment, Elder Liang began to pour cold water.
"With his bit of power, it’s like an ant shaking a tree."
On the square, the four sects’ disciples were originally planning to leave.
Seeing Jiang Cheng alive and flying back into the sky, they almost suspected they’d seen a ghost.
"You! Why aren’t you dead yet?"
"Acting mysterious, if you’re not dead, we’ll kill you again!"
As they planned to attack again, above in the sky, layers of fiery red lightning reflected from above Jiang Cheng’s head.
The entire person was thus covered in a glow.
At first glance, this seemed like some kind of cultivation technique of his.
"Witness my Grand Celestial Thunder Skill!"
He raised his right hand high, his long sword slowly slashing down, pretending that the Tribulation Thunder was his Divine Technique.
"What is that?"
"What’s he going to do?"
No one below had run yet.
Ordinary lightning, even Gathering Yuan Realm cultivators could withstand, so it wasn’t that scary.
Moreover, Thunder Element cultivation techniques weren’t rare either.
However, in the next moment, they couldn’t make a sound anymore.
Bang!
Accompanied by the sword’s slash, hundreds of fiery red lightning bolts suddenly roared down.
As if they had eyes, each bolt of lightning accurately struck a disciple of the four sects.
Whether in the square, in the main hall, or elsewhere.
The speed of the Profound Celestial Tribulation Thunder was so fast, this group didn’t have time to utter a sound or resist.
Tribulation Thunder differs from ordinary lightning completely; it directly targets a cultivator’s Sea of Qi and Sea of Consciousness, thousands of times more powerful!
In just a moment after, near hundred smoking holes appeared on the square.
As for the massive and overwhelmingly powerful four sects’ disciples, they’ve all turned to ashes, not a trace left.
Damn, this system is impressive!
Even Jiang Cheng was startled.
He had never witnessed the power of Tribulation Thunder; he just knew he’d definitely win post-revival, but he really hadn’t expected to win so easily.
In a flash, all wiped out, leaving none!
So domineering!
Luo Yuan and the others, watching from afar, were stupefied.
Their first reaction wasn’t joy, but being scared silly.
Those were 18 Soul Splitting Realm!
In its heyday, Feixian Sect had merely over thirty Soul Splitting Realm elders, right?
With just a single strike, wiped out completely?
What kind of power is this!
Even a Spirit Platform Realm could defeat multiple Soul Splitting Realms but couldn’t achieve wiping all out in one move, right?
Could he really be as Senior Sister Ji said, a Celestial Fate Realm Strong Person?
The Tribulation Thunder was too distant from their realm; they’d never witnessed it, mistaking it as Jiang Cheng’s Divine Technique.
Recall just now he soared high, drawing thunder with a sword, shaking the heavens, changing the weather!
With a wave of his hand, the enemies perished; what arrogance....
At that moment, disciples unanimously revealed expressions of admiration.
Jiang Cheng’s goal was achieved.
Just this move today established his indisputable lofty position in the hearts of these disciples.
"Sect Leader!"
Ji Linghan was the first to fly out.
She had the most faith in Jiang Cheng, so she was the most accepting.
As long as the Sect Leader is powerful and awesome, it doesn’t matter how strong, she couldn’t care less.
Watching everyone flying back to the main hall square, Jiang Cheng slowly descended from the sky.
Before landing, he cockily posed a cool stance.
Handsome!
Immediately, several female disciples’ eyes sparkled with stars.
Powerful, with a young and strikingly handsome face far superior to the other sects’ mustached old eccentrics.
At this moment, they felt he was simply the best Sect Leader there could be.
"Sect Leader, this... how did you do it?"
"Yeah, Sect Leader, your power is truly earth-shattering!"
Luo Yuan and Yin Xuer unconsciously changed their address; this moment, deep in their hearts, they formally recognized Jiang Cheng as sect Leader.
Jiang Cheng was about to state that his power far exceeded their imagination, enhancing his prestige further, but suddenly the system chimed.
"Ding, Host has newly acquired 21 subordinates. Analyzing their talent and foundational power, reward of 355 points for Host."
"Please continue your efforts, Host."
Oh wow, points for this?
Jiang Cheng was delighted, thinking that in the future, Feixian Sect must recruit more disciples.
Especially those with outstanding talent!
The system seemed to value talent greatly; one Ji Linghan had 3000 points, while the other 21 combined had only 355.
Apparently, Ji Linghan’s talent truly far surpassed the others.
At this moment, Elder Liang also came into the scene.

chapters.title: Chapter 16: Of Course, Take the Initiative to Attack
chapters.content:
Chapter 16: Chapter 16: Of Course, Take the Initiative to Attack
Editor:
EndlessFantasy Translation
"Elder Liang, do you have anything else to say?"
Jiang Cheng was not a pushover. Previously mocked and ridiculed, now he had proven himself and put those people back in their place. Why shouldn’t he ridicule them back?
"Didn’t you say I was only at the Soul Splitting Fourth Layer?"
"Didn’t you say I was doomed?"
"Didn’t you say you would make me the Sect Leader if I succeeded?"
Elder Liang was left speechless and completely at a loss for words.
Of course, he didn’t want Jiang Cheng to become the Sect Leader.
Moreover, looking at Jiang Cheng’s realm now, he clearly was still at the Soul Splitting Fourth Layer.
However, the terrifying tribulation thunder that just happened occurred right before his eyes, with no tricks involved.
He didn’t dare to test it, assuming that a senior expert was deliberately lowering his divine soul and spiritual power fluctuations to confuse others.
Facing the subtle gazes from the other disciples, he reluctantly bowed.
"Liang Da greets the Sect Leader!"
"At ease!"
Jiang Cheng secretly curled his lip. This old rascal, the system didn’t even ding, indicating he wasn’t genuinely recognizing him as the Sect Leader.
It was just a superficial gesture.
He realized that in the future, the system could serve as a detector for traitors.
Having regained the old sect headquarters, everyone was both excited and saddened.
Some disciples even wept like rain, searching for their late masters’ bodies beneath the rubble.
Jiang Cheng didn’t disturb them.
Until they had buried all the elders and disciples of the Feixian Sect who had died in the battle and held a joint memorial, he then announced the serious matter.
"Now that we have taken back our sect’s foundation, it’s time to consider the next step."
"I’ve decided to immediately attack the Extreme Moon Sect!"
"Blood must be repaid with blood!"
These few words stirred the disciples, filling their eyes with fighting spirit.
If it were someone else announcing it, they would certainly consider it overestimating their abilities.
They had just returned and hadn’t even stabilized.
The foundations of the Four Sects remained, and those who died were only a small portion. They would soon return for revenge.
Attacking proactively now would seem too rash.
But Jiang Cheng had just displayed too strong of a ’magic power’, giving everyone immense confidence. Charging forward to avenge seemed only natural.
"When does the Sect Leader plan to set off?"
Everyone was rubbing their palms, sharpening their knives.
"We’ll go now, but you all should stay here."
Jiang Cheng looked around at everyone: "The Extreme Moon Sect has many people. If we all charge in, I can’t ensure everyone’s safety."
"Moreover, we just reclaimed the mountain gate of the Feixian Sect; we need you to guard it against opportunistic thieves!"
Upon hearing this, everyone nodded repeatedly.
Indeed, the Sect Leader himself was extremely powerful.
But they were too weak; if a surviving Soul Splitting Realm elder appeared, they could be wiped out.
Going would distract the Sect Leader as he cared for others.
Thus, everyone escorted Jiang Cheng to the mountain gate.
Ji Linghan, in particular, held on to his hand, unwilling to let go.
Even after just a day of interaction, she had developed a dependence on Jiang Cheng. The sudden separation made her feel uneasy.
"Sect Leader, you must take care!"
Jiang Cheng thought to himself, I still have one resurrection today, solid as an old dog. Girl, you’re worrying too much.
"While I’m not here, watch the house for me and take care of my daughter!"
Holding her soft, boneless hand, Brother Cheng’s heart was also moved.
Just as he was about to turn around, Elder Liang suddenly jumped out.
"Sect Leader, although your power is profound, going alone might result in oversights!"
"I, though unworthy, am willing to accompany you!"
"It’s my duty as an elder to avenge the sect!"
His words were resolute.
With such righteousness, he looked like a general about to march to his death.
In fact, Elder Liang had thought it through thoroughly.
If it weren’t for Jiang Cheng, this super-powerful figure, he wouldn’t risk it.
With just the two of them charging into the opponent’s expert-laden headquarters, wasn’t that courting death?
But recalling Jiang Cheng’s overwhelming power that wiped out 18 Soul Splitting Realm experts with a wave, he felt reassured.
Following this person, what is there to fear?
Those Gathering Yuan Realm disciples might face accidents, but he was at the Soul Splitting Realm Fifth Layer; he could survive even against isolated enemy elders.
Most importantly, this was a ’plush’ assignment!
Conquering the Extreme Moon Sect itself would be a great achievement. Once the Feixian Sect reestablishes its strength, it becomes experience and military merit!
In terms of seniority, it’s quite convincing.
Moreover, after the capture, wouldn’t it be harvest time for the spoils?
With so many elder stashes at the Extreme Moon Sect, plus the vast resources in the Pill Pavilion, Artifact Pavilion, Array Pavilion, Talisman Pavilion, and the Treasure Pavilion and Scripture Pavilion...
Once the opposite side is annihilated, he’d be like a mouse with free rein in a granary.
Even if Jiang Cheng took the lion’s share, he could still pick up scraps enough to stuff himself to death!
Such a great opportunity, he couldn’t miss it!
Even if the kid didn’t agree, he would quietly follow later. He’d fight to the death to hitch a ride on this journey!
No way would Jiang Cheng believe he’d be so enthusiastic. This system didn’t even ding. Such eagerness must be because there’s no profit in rising early.
After a little speculation, he saw through his intentions.
Yet, he didn’t expose him on the spot.
"Great! Rare for Elder Liang to be so eager!"
Brother Cheng gave a manual thumbs-up.
He patted him heavily on the shoulder and said solemnly, "Since you have such resolve, then let’s embark together!"
"Following the Sect Leader’s command!"
Elder Liang beamed with delight.
This kid, no matter how strong, isn’t he still simple-minded, being played as a tool by me?
He even began imagining how he’d stir things up within the sect once the Feixian Sect regained its strength.
The two flew for miles, soon reaching the Extreme Moon Sect’s station miles away.
Staring at the awe-inspiring, colorful mountain gate, Elder Liang couldn’t help but feel intimidated.
An entire sect wasn’t easy to defeat, not only because of the internal experts but also due to the Sect Protection Array.
Once activated, foreign enemies would fall into a passive position.
The Feixian Sect was only breached last time because the Four Sects joined hands.
If only two sects had arrived, the Feixian Sect could have endured.
He couldn’t help but inch closer to Jiang Cheng, planning to hide behind his strong support when the fight ensued.
At this moment, Jiang Cheng was conversing with the system.
"System, I have a question to ask."
He initially thought the system would play dead like before, but it surprisingly responded this time.
"One question costs 500 points."
"Would the host like to continue?"
Too greedy! Just for a question, does this dog system have a diamond-encrusted mouth?
Do you have any idea how hard it is to earn 500 points?
He currently had over 1300 points, of which 500 points were leftover when Ji Linghan met the Sect Leader last time.
He originally intended to save them for the next upgrade or a lottery.
Suppressing the urge to curse, he chose to deduct 500 points and proceed with the question.
"May I ask if charging to attack the Extreme Moon Sect now counts as voluntary suicide?"
This question was a matter of life and death, no matter how much it cost.
The previous tribulation thunder was already used up, and now he was only at the Soul Splitting Realm Fourth Layer again.
Compared to the Extreme Moon Sect, there was a significant power gap.
If it was deemed as a suicidal action, he would need to plan carefully.
For example, devising a plan or setting a trap to lure the Extreme Moon Sect’s people into attacking him first...

chapters.title: Chapter 17: Harvesting Leeks
chapters.content:
Chapter 17: Chapter 17: Harvesting Leeks
Editor:
EndlessFantasy Translation
"Doesn’t count."
The system’s response was concise.
This answer relieved Jiang Cheng.
Since it doesn’t count as suicide, there’s nothing to fear.
But shortly after, he became curious.
"Why doesn’t it count?"
"Ding, deducting 500 points."
Damn, another deduction, is this the second question?
Damn system, loves to play dead at other times. When deducting points, it’s enthusiastic.
"The host’s current identity is Sect Leader of the Feixian Sect. Feixian Sect was attacked by the Extreme Moon Sect. The system determines the host himself was attacked."
So that’s how it is!
Since Feixian Sect counts as his power, being attacked means anything he does counts as retaliation.
Retaliation doesn’t count as suicide; it’s considered passive self-defense.
Who told the Extreme Moon Sect to strike first?
After understanding this, Brother Cheng didn’t hold back and walked straight out.
At this time, in the Extreme Moon Sect’s main hall, Sect Leader Qi Gaohong was furious.
"Can someone tell me what exactly happened?"
"How did Elder Xu, Elder Li, Elder Feng, and the others die?"
"Feixian Sect is almost wiped out; who could do such a thing?"
"Hmm?"
Jiang Cheng’s Tribulation Thunder directly killed 18 Soul Splitting Realm elders.
This time, Extreme Moon Sect was the main force in the attack on Feixian Sect; among the 18, seven were theirs.
Although all of them died, they didn’t even have time to send a message. But the Extreme Moon Sect has the life token of each elder.
Just recently, the life tokens of seven elders shattered, indicating they were all dead.
The elders in the hall didn’t look too good either; since the founding of the Extreme Moon Sect, they haven’t suffered such a loss.
But no one shouted to attack.
It’s not that they’re weak or have a good temper, but that they’re not foolish.
Seven life tokens shattered simultaneously, meaning they were killed at the same time.
Such a thing they had never heard of.
An enemy capable of this must be incredibly strong.
At least, not at the Soul Splitting Realm level.
Rushing in unwisely might just be courting death; they understood this clearly.
"This matter must be considered carefully."
"I suggest sending someone to investigate the reality over at Feixian Sect."
The elders discussed back and forth, continually analyzing the mastermind behind this incident.
"Only a few remain at Feixian Sect, it must be an external enemy."
"True, if Feixian Sect had such powerful support, they wouldn’t be in such a state."
"Who could it be? Could it be the Duanmu Family?"
"Possible, they are considered part of that faction!"
"Should we seek help from the Red Sun Sect?"
The middle and small sects in Qinglan Prefecture are roughly divided into two factions.
One led by the Red Sun Sect, the four great sects attacking Feixian Sect this time are part of this faction.
They have always followed Red Sun Sect’s lead.
On the other side, led by the Duanmu Family, Feixian Sect belongs to this faction.
In some sense, Elder Liang’s boasting of connections with the Duanmu Family has some basis.
However, this relationship is actually very weak.
Both Red Sun Sect and the Duanmu Family have more than one Spirit Platform Realm presence, their combat power surpasses dozens of other middle and small sects combined.
One reason they haven’t directly dealt with these middle and small sects is the mutual balance between these two forces.
Red Sun Sect wishes to dominate Qinglan Prefecture and be the sole power, but Duanmu Family won’t agree.
And vice versa.
Hence, each force pulls in a batch of middle and small sects, delineating their spheres of influence.
For instance, the Extreme Moon Sect must annually tribute resources to the Red Sun Sect as ’protection fees.’
Protection fees don’t imply protection anywhere.
It’s merely a promise not to attack Extreme Moon Sect.
The Feixian Sect on the other side also must tribute annually to the Duanmu Family.
Back then, Elder Liang followed the Sect Leader to the Duanmu Family for this reason.
Simply put, these middle and small sects are just the crops of the two forces, harvested once a year.
On the other hand, to weaken the opposition, the two forces are very keen on attacking sects under the rival faction.
Take the attack on Feixian Sect as an example, the Duanmu Family loses a source of tribute, their harvest decreases over time, indirectly weakening them.
But since the two forces keep a close eye on each other, it’s difficult to do this personally, only possible by instructing subordinate sects.
This time, Extreme Moon Sect successfully teamed up with Profound Ice Sect, Five Thunders Sect, and Celestial Fire Sect to attack Feixian Sect, with the Red Sun Sect’s indication behind it.
Seventy percent of the resources snatched from Feixian Sect must be handed over.
While the upper echelon of Extreme Moon Sect was considering reporting to Red Sun Sect, Jiang Cheng swaggered up to their mountain gate.
Elder Liang followed closely behind, uncertain of his intended strategy.
"Who are you?"
"Report your name; this is a sect’s restricted area!"
Four disciples stepped forward to block the two.
Before Jiang Cheng could speak, the leading disciple pointed at Elder Liang and shouted.
"I recognize him, he’s Liang Da, an Elder of Feixian Sect!"
"What?"
"Someone from Feixian Sect?"
The four disciples immediately drew their swords and surrounded the two.
This scene made many cultivators outside the mountain gate’s market pause to watch.
The news of Feixian Sect’s destruction spread quickly; Extreme Moon Sect had a grand celebration last night.
This was big news in Qinglan Prefecture, so naturally, they heard about it too.
"Is this Elder from Feixian Sect crazy?"
"Managed to escape, and now he’s showing up voluntarily?"
"Is he here for revenge?"
"Revenge? I’ve heard of Liang Da, he’s only about Fourth or Fifth Layer Soul Splitting Realm. He seems to be looking for death!"
"Who’s that young man beside him, stunningly handsome?"
"Liang Da seems to be following him; could this person be hiding his strength?"
"Forget it, what strong support could Feixian Sect have, especially just one person."
Liang Da heard the discussions of those around him.
Though bitter about being underestimated, thinking of Jiang Cheng’s strength, he couldn’t help but hold his head high.
Just wait, you ignoramuses, soon you’ll see the truth clearly.
"I am the Sect Leader of Feixian Sect, hurry and have your Sect Leader come out to kneel in welcome!"
Jiang Cheng’s first words nearly made Liang Da spit blood.
Brother, haven’t even fought our way in yet, and you’re revealing your identity?
Too arrogant, right?
But thinking about his overwhelming and thunderous ’Thunder Manipulation Technique,’ he seems to warrant such arrogance.
The four disciples across were shocked; Sect Leader of Feixian Sect? Wasn’t he killed?
How come another appears?
But they were immediately angered by Jiang Cheng’s demand for kneeling welcome.
"You call yourself Sect Leader?"
"Surround him, don’t let him run!"
"Send word!"
Just as the four were sending the news inside, Jiang Cheng unsheathed his sword.
"So verbose before dying!"

chapters.title: Chapter 18 Doubting God and Ghosts
chapters.content:
Chapter 18: Chapter 18 Doubting God and Ghosts
Editor:
EndlessFantasy Translation
It was still the Crescent Moon Swordsmanship.
These four disciples were sent out to guard the mountain gate and weren’t even considered Inner Sect Disciples, how strong could they be?
They were only in the Energy-Introducing Realm, so of course they couldn’t stop Jiang Cheng.
A flash of the sword shadow passed, and blood spurted from the four men’s necks as they fell.
Clean and efficient.
"Alright, let’s move on. Lead the way ahead!"
"Sure thing!"
Elder Liang didn’t find it surprising anymore.
He even felt that killing their way in like this was quite bold.
In the future, the stories spreading outside would be ’I and the Sect Leader conquered the Extreme Moon Sect together’, ’I fought side by side with the Sect Leader to carve a bloody path’, ’I and Jiang Cheng jointly slew dozens of elders from the Extreme Moon Sect’...
The name of Liang Da would be spread throughout the Nine Mountains and Seventeen Caves of Qinglan Prefecture, shining for generations.
Thinking about it, it felt quite wonderful!
At this thought, his body felt much lighter.
"Sect Leader, this way, this path is closer!"
The two men killed their way in without any concealment or hesitation because it was so sudden that the Extreme Moon Sect wasn’t prepared at all.
Just a day ago, they had returned triumphantly, who could have expected to be attacked today.
Along the way, there were only some disciples at most in the Gathering Yuan Realm, and Jiang Cheng didn’t even need to take action.
Elder Liang was working hard, killing minor warriors to secure a share of the spoils later.
The hundred-zhang Sword Aura seemed like it was on a mow-down-everything rampage, cutting down whoever it met.
Jiang Cheng was happy to have some leisure, watching him perform from behind.
At this moment, the loose cultivators outside were almost in an uproar.
"Crazy, really crazy!"
"Are those two not afraid of death?"
"Whether they are or not, the Extreme Moon Sect is really taking a hit this time, losing quite a few people."
"Things have gotten serious..."
When Qi Gaohong rushed over with a group of elders, Elder Liang’s head count had already reached 135.
"Liang Da, how dare you!"
"How dare you slaughter my disciples, even the low-tier Outer Sect Disciples, do you have no sense of decorum as someone in the Soul Splitting Realm?"
"Tear him to pieces!"
Qi Gaohong’s eyes were bloodshot, and the other elders were gritting their teeth almost to breaking point.
Though these disciples’ cultivation wasn’t high, they were the future of the sect.
Over a hundred were killed just like that, anyone would be heartbroken, let alone this was a disgrace within their own home.
Who could endure it?
Liang Da was now full of confidence, completely disregarding them as anything significant.
"Not just these disciples, even you will die!"
He wiped the blood from his sword with an arrogant face.
"It’s just a matter of sooner or later."
"Why rush?"
Damn, this Elder Liang was quite adept at pretending too.
Jiang Cheng rolled his eyes helplessly.
This unusual confidence surprisingly left Qi Gaohong and others cautious.
For a moment, they didn’t dare make any reckless moves.
Therefore, their eyes fell on Jiang Cheng.
"Who are you?"
Liang Da jumped out again.
"With the likes of you, miserable worms, how dare you speak directly to our Sect Leader?"
"It’s alright to tell you, our new Sect Leader Jiang Cheng will wipe out your entire sect!"
After saying this, he jumped back and hid behind Jiang Cheng.
This guy, Jiang Cheng really couldn’t complain enough.
Oh, you get to show off, and I have to bear the brunt?
What a sly old fox!
"New Sect Leader?"
Qi Gaohong’s pupils shrank, his gaze pinned sharply on Jiang Cheng.
"Are you the one who killed my sect’s seven elders?"
"Yes, it was me."
Jiang Cheng stepped out boldly.
"I really enjoyed killing those seven elders, if you have any objections, feel free to bring them up, but I definitely won’t change."
On the path of showing off, Brother Cheng must lead the trend, how could he let a mere Elder Liang steal the spotlight.
"You!"
Qi Gaohong was livid, his face almost turning white from red.
"Who is backing you, which power do you belong to? I know the Duanmu Family, they don’t have anyone like you!"
He could tell at a glance that Jiang Cheng was only in the Soul Splitting Fourth Layer.
Such power shouldn’t be capable of such feats.
But even if this person was a lunatic, Liang Da wouldn’t just play along.
Over the years they’d had frequent conflicts with the Feixian Sect, he had studied Elder Liang and knew that fleeing for survival was his greatest skill.
For him to suddenly act as a warrior, could it be that Jiang Cheng’s power wasn’t as simple as his apparent realm?
"No, opposing you is just my personal interest."
Jiang Cheng chuckled: "I’m only in the Soul Splitting Fourth Layer, and you’re too afraid to make a move?"
The more he said this, the more cautiously Qi Gaohong became.
There’s always a reason for the unusual.
Especially when Elder Liang couldn’t help but pop his head out again and shout.
"Sect Leader, stop wasting words with these ants, wipe them out!"
Jiang Cheng was a bit irritated: "Are you teaching me what to do?"
Are you the Sect Leader or am I?
You’re overplaying your hand here, trying to snatch the King Bi’s throne from me?
"No no..."
Liang Da quickly shrank back.
Cursing inwardly, yet not daring to show it.
At this moment, Qi Gaohong finally made a decision.
He signaled Hall Master Zhao Chuyang of the Sword Hall with a glance.
"Test his strength!"
He suspected Jiang Cheng’s strength exceeded the Soul Splitting Fourth Layer, but didn’t dare probe himself in case he got instantly defeated.
Zhao Chuyang, as the Hall Master of the Sword Hall, was second only to him in power, having reached the Soul Splitting Eighth Layer.
If he quickly suffered defeat, it would mean Jiang Cheng was actually in the Spirit Platform Realm.
If that were the case, they would have to swallow their pride today and consider fleeing.
Zhao Chuyang glanced at him resentfully, wishing to curse his ancestors for eighteen generations.
What Qi Gaohong could think of, Zhao Chuyang could too.
At this time, who would dare test?
But the Sect Leader’s order couldn’t be ignored, unless he wanted to defect on the spot.
Ultimately, he could only muster courage and inch his way into the arena.
Amidst sympathetic gazes from other elders, he drew his sword.
"You dare invade my Extreme Moon Sect... just, just think of the cost."
He stammered, even in his speech.
"Are you provoking me?"
Actually, Jiang Cheng at this point didn’t care if they were provoking actively, anyway, the system said he could go wild here at the Extreme Moon Sect.
But this simple sentence scared Zhao Chuyang into a cold sweat.
Afraid of stirring Jiang Cheng’s murderous intent, he changed his tune.
"No, no, I just want to exchange a couple of moves with Sect Leader Jiang, hopefully just a learning experience..."
Jiang Cheng was dissatisfied, exchanging moves without deciding life and death wouldn’t let him die?
"Come on, what’s the fun in just exchanging a couple moves, have you forgotten we are mortal enemies?"
With that, he impatiently summoned his Spirit Sword and charged up.
Seeing that sword, Qi Gaohong’s face turned even worse.
Wasn’t that Elder Yao Qiulin’s personal sword?
It ended up in his hands too, no wonder yesterday’s and two other elders’ Life Tokens shattered as well.
This kid, he’s a star of death!
It seems they need to prepare to flee, scrape oil from the feet when the situation turns bad to escape quickly, lest they got pursued.
He was still contemplating afterward when a bloody flash occurred in the field, and a figure collapsed.

chapters.title: Chapter 19: Three-Eyed Fierce Tiger King
chapters.content:
Chapter 19: Chapter 19: Three-Eyed Fierce Tiger King
Editor:
EndlessFantasy Translation
What, Elder Zhao was killed so quickly?
Qi Gaohong nearly wanted to turn around and run away.
As for the elders beside him, two of them leaped hundreds of meters like rabbits.
But then, everyone realized it wasn’t what it seemed.
Zhao Chuyang was still standing; the one who fell was Jiang Cheng.
His heart was pierced, clearly dead beyond revival.
Having killed him, Zhao Chuyang was somewhat bewildered, seemingly unable to believe he had done it.
After all, Jiang Cheng was four small realms lower than Zhao Chuyang, and he wasn’t fighting seriously, merely seeking death.
So he died quite quickly.
Wow...
What...
What’s going on?
This kid really is only at the Soul Splitting Fourth Layer?
Not some hidden Spirit Platform Realm expert?
Why was I even afraid just now?
Qi Gaohong instantly became furious, daring and bold!
And the other elders immediately drew their swords, murderous aura surging.
Their target was naturally Jiang Cheng’s only companion — Elder Liang.
This is the reason Jiang Cheng was willing to bring him along.
Liang Da first tried to deceive disciples and then became disloyal, with divided loyalties.
Such a person, why keep him around?
However, killing him at the Feixian Sect might waste a resurrection.
Especially in front of Ji Linghan and other disciples, killing a sect elder wasn’t ideal.
What if it affected the disciples’ support?
So, of course, he was brought here to be disposed of casually.
"Liang Da, how do you want to die?"
Qi Gaohong sneered coldly, his teeth seemingly exuding a chilling gleam.
"I, I..."
Liang Da panicked, utterly frightened.
He glanced at Jiang Cheng’s corpse, thinking the script shouldn’t be like this.
Shouldn’t Jiang Cheng be slaughtering everyone, and I follow behind to reap benefits?
"Sect Leader! Sect Leader, you must still be alive, right?"
He cried out in alarm, retreating.
"Stop pretending, you must have a backup plan, right?"
Unfortunately, Jiang Cheng truly was dead.
There were still a dozen seconds before resurrection.
In those few seconds, it was more than enough for the Extreme Moon Sect elders to kill Liang Da a dozen times.
"Liang Da, I thought you really had something to rely on!"
"Turns out you’re really crazy!"
By then, Liang Da was trapped, with no escape.
"It’s not my fault, it was the kid who orchestrated everything, I just followed orders!"
"I was forced!"
"I’m innocent!"
His screams and explanations were utterly useless.
"Forced?"
"Innocent?"
"Your sword is still dripping blood!"
"You just killed sect disciples with enthusiasm!"
"And said we were nothing more than rotten fish and shrimp?"
Elder Liang’s face looked like it was contorted with constipation.
The more he acted tough earlier, the heavier the punishment now.
"Dismember him!"
Qi Gaohong was the first to charge forward, followed by the elders in a frenzy!
Liang Da didn’t last a second before being shredded by thousands of swords.
At that moment, Jiang Cheng remained in soul form, waiting for the system to reward him.
"Ding, host was killed, system analyzing enemy’s power, arranging resurrection plan for host."
"Host receives a summoning talisman, able to summon a random powerful ally to assist once."
Powerful ally?
Jiang Cheng was very dissatisfied. Why wasn’t it elevating him to the Spirit Platform Realm or higher?
Brother Cheng wanted to personally wreak havoc everywhere!
Even as he was dissatisfied, being able to resurrect and defeat opponents was something countless people would wish for.
"Ding, host resurrected!"
"Hmm?"
Qi Gaohong and the others, having just killed Elder Liang, were about to drag the corpses to the back mountain to feed the spirit beasts.
Then they saw Jiang Cheng stand up again.
"How is this possible?"
Zhao Chuyang exclaimed in disbelief.
"I clearly killed him!"
"No worries!"
Qi Gaohong raised his hand, sneering coldly.
"With his level of Daoist practice, he can’t fool anyone."
"This time, I’ll personally deal with him!"
Earlier, fearing Jiang Cheng was a hidden expert, they didn’t dare to act.
Now, Qi Gaohong intended to personally kill him to regain face.
Jiang Cheng wouldn’t give him the chance, he crushed the summoning talisman decisively.
In the distant mountain depths, cloud-covered, with gusts of cold wind, a faint black mist steamed.
In a valley, thunderous roars echoed from time to time.
In the high skies, a slender woman with long furry ears on her head swung her sharp claws, sending pink rays like raindrops falling upon the valley.
The mountains collapsed, the earth trembled, rivers stopped, dust rolled.
Under such mighty power, demon beasts within a thousand miles fled in panic.
"Three-Eyed Tiger, come out and die!"
"Let me see how long you can hide!"
"Coward!"
The crisp voice echoed through the mountains, and some distant great demons shook their heads upon hearing it.
Again.
Similar events occur almost every century.
Every time, they have to temporarily move to avoid it.
It’s foreseeable that a massive beast tide will soon appear on the distant border.
No other choice, the rabbit-eared gorgeous woman in the sky is one of the Twelve Demon Kings of the Celestial Demon Domain, the Silver Moon Frost Rabbit King.
Vast divine techniques make her one of the top existences here, far superior.
Demon beasts are infamous for their ferocity, but those who reach refinement aren’t foolish, knowing when to avoid the edge.
At that moment, deep within the valley, a restriction was being intensely attacked by the Frost Rabbit King.
With vibrant flows of light constantly moving, the restriction was extremely solid, and the near world-shattering attacks didn’t shake it.
"I know you’re inside!"
"Let’s see how long you can hide!"
"You’re disgracefully shaming your Tiger Race!"
Below the restriction, was a luxurious underground palace.
A tiger-headed demon beast with no horizontal stripe but with horizontal eyes was dozing on a thousand-feet-wide Red Jade Bed.
It heard the scolding outside but didn’t bother with it.
Inside the hall, black fog gradually rose, forming a ghostly humanoid shape.
This is the Chang Ghost, the Three-Eyed Fierce Tiger King’s military advisor, considered its most dependable aide.
"King, are you not going out to fight?"
The old voice concealed a sigh.
"Can’t you see I’m busy sleeping?"
The Fierce Tiger King didn’t even turn its head, its voice resounding far like a great bell.
Chang Ghost’s black mist froze; if it had eyes, tears might be streaming down.
There are twelve Demon Kings in the Celestial Demon Domain, and these positions are hereditary.
The old Chang Ghost was a trusted aide of the previous Tiger King and watched over the new Young Master Three-Eyed Tiger’s growth.
Over the millennia, the Young Master has indulged in pleasures without progress, consistently ranking lower among the Twelve Demon Kings.
Back then, the Old Fierce Tiger King ranked second among the Twelve Demon Kings, just behind the Golden Dragon King.
That was a world conquered with iron claws, making all demons bend their heads.
Yet now, the new generation Three-Eyed Tiger has fallen to the last among the Twelve Demon Kings; if not for the innate royal bloodline inheritance, the Demon King title might be lost.
Even the previously bottom-ranked Frost Rabbit King dared come and challenge.
A complete disgrace!

chapters.title: Chapter 20 Too Awesome
chapters.content:
Chapter 20: Chapter 20 Too Awesome
Editor:
EndlessFantasy Translation
"Sigh..."
"Alright, alright, old ghost, don’t be discouraged. That rabbit woman will retreat on her own in a few years. It’s not like we haven’t seen this before."
"But I wish the Young Master would fight with her, even if defeated, it’s better than being a coward!"
The smoke lay down, offering advice with difficulty.
Even if he loses, it counts as a fierce battle; maybe the Young Master will gain courage from shame and bring out his bloodlust.
Over the years, many Great Demons under his command have left, seeking allegiance with other Demon Kings because of his cowardice.
The talents in the Tiger Race are dwindling!
"Old ghost, are you dumb? Fighting when you can’t win, isn’t that self-torture? Grandpa doesn’t have such hobbies!"
The massive body of the Three-Eyed Tiger wriggled like a mountain, impatiently waving its paw backward.
"Alright, alright, this matter is noted. I’ll make the Rabbit Race pay a price for this."
Upon hearing this, the Chang Ghost was not comforted, almost fainting with anger instead.
He knows what the so-called price mentioned by the Three-Eyed Tiger is.
It’s nothing more than going to the Rabbit Race and causing trouble for some young and beautiful Rabbit Little Demons.
The reason the Frost Rabbit King often storms in is precisely because of the amorous troubles the Three-Eyed Tiger stirred in the Rabbit Race a thousand years ago, which completely enraged her.
If he could use half of his thoughts on cultivation, he would probably still be among the top three Demon Kings by now, right?
Suddenly, a white vortex appeared above the large bed in front.
Could it be that the Frost Rabbit King has broken in?
That restriction was set by the old master back in the day, except for the Golden Dragon King and War Monkey King, no demon should be able to break through!
In the next instant, the massive body of the Three-Eyed Tiger was sucked into the white vortex, suddenly disappearing before his eyes.
At the Extreme Moon Sect, when Jiang Cheng crushed the Summoning Talisman, he was still fantasizing about what kind of mighty helper he could summon.
Could it be a hidden expert?
Or perhaps the Unrivaled War God, Sword Saint?
Even a Wraith Heroic Soul?
When the enormous body of the Three-Eyed Tiger landed in front of him, he almost dropped his jaw in shock.
This... is too small, too cute!
The whole body was only a foot long; if not for those three eyes, it might have been mistaken for a little white cat.
The white fur, shining with a cold light, looked quite prickly, while the fleshy limbs gave people an urge to pinch them.
Its fangs were chilling, but the mouth was too small, making it feel more adorably fierce rather than menacing.
In every aspect, it simply doesn’t associate with might!
Just this?
Jiang Cheng was very disappointed, feeling this summoning was quite unimpressive.
In fact, due to the cross-domain summoning, the Three-Eyed Tiger’s size had been suppressed and shrunk by tens of thousands of times due to the Domain rules.
Its power had been weakened by several times.
However, this was already sufficient.
This is a Demon King, even if its power is weakened, it’s still a Demon King.
A Demon King among the Demon Race corresponds to the Saint Tier in human terms.
Jiang Cheng’s disappointment lasted only a brief second.
The next moment, his eyes nearly popped out.
After appearing, the Three-Eyed Tiger landed on the ground.
Despite its extremely small size, it crushed two Elders beside it who couldn’t retreat in time into pulp.
Not even a groan was heard.
The breath it casually exhaled made Qi Gaohong and others on the opposite side wobble, feeling their heads buzzing and hearts about to be squeezed out.
Meow meow meow?
Where is this?
The Three-Eyed Tiger still hasn’t figured out the situation; wasn’t it busy just now?
How did it suddenly end up in this ghostly place?
Who are these ants in front?
"Who did this?"
It roared in anger.
The small body emitted a sound loud enough to spread over thousands of miles, giving an extremely strong sense of abruptness.
Along with the roar, the air around twisted, and the invisible sound waves surged like a hurricane.
On the opposite side, sixteen Elders of the Extreme Moon Sect fell down, all bleeding from their seven apertures and dying.
Those who survived were only the ones who managed to escape far enough.
"I summoned you here."
Standing at the rear, Jiang Cheng beamed with joy.
The appearance was unimpressive, but the power was strong; it seems the system is indeed reliable!
He was not hurt at all.
The Three-Eyed Tiger was summoned by him, and due to the system’s miraculous rules, attacks were ineffective on him.
"So it was you who ruined grandpa’s good thing!"
The Three-Eyed Tiger suddenly turned back, opening its small bloody mouth.
From afar, Qi Gaohong, who was still in shock, was overjoyed.
The strength of the Three-Eyed Tiger threw him into instant despair.
Initially, he thought this terrible Tiger Demon was Jiang Cheng’s ally, but now he sees it’s not.
Kill him!
Eat him!
He was dying to shout out loud.
"Destroy all enemies for me!"
Jiang Cheng directly ordered, without caring about the Three-Eyed Tiger’s fury.
The Three-Eyed Tiger’s mouth seemed to suddenly be welded shut, getting stuck.
An inexplicable task invaded its mind—eliminate everyone in the Extreme Moon Sect.
This task seemed like a rule from the heavens; if it defied it, it might be obliterated by the rules.
Additionally, it had to do it immediately.
Although it was originally very unwilling, it still flew into the air, rushing toward Qi Gaohong.
Seeing it really attack the Extreme Moon Sect, Brother Cheng breathed a sigh of relief.
The system stated that the powerful ally would serve him once, and surely it will serve once.
No matter if it is willing or facing difficulties, it will execute the task.
That’s the logic of it.
But honestly, for mere Soul Splitting Fourth Layer, facing the overwhelming power of a Demon King, there was still pressure.
After all, this Tiger Demon is not his subordinate, just a temporary summon.
A colossal tiger illusion extending for thousands of miles appeared faintly high in the sky.
Blocking the sun, the sky instantly darkened.
At this moment, the cultivators outside the Extreme Moon Sect nearly doubted the coming of the apocalypse.
Screaming, they fled.
And in the center of that illusion, the cute, small tiger paw lightly swung once.
Qi Gaohong’s body bizarrely split into two, along with the grand hall behind him and the buildings spanning hundreds of miles.
All were sliced into two!
The Extreme Moon Sect instantly became a purgatory on earth.
The remaining Elders fled wildly, but immediately it was like being trapped by an invisible giant net, pinned in mid-air.
The Demon King’s Domain, restricts Soul Splitting Realm and Gathering Yuan Realm effortlessly.
Crash!
The sky rained blood.
Numerous platinum rays descended from the sky, which were just a casual strike from the Three-Eyed Tiger.
After this strike, even the sect disciples hiding underground were instantly pinned down dead.
The Three-Eyed Tiger might act cowardly in the Celestial Demon Domain, but that’s relative to the Twelve Demon Kings.
For everyone else, this is definitely a Dimensional Reduction Strike.
In his eyes, Soul Splitting Realm might really be just microbes to humans.
A demon wind passed by.
The originally noisy Extreme Moon Sect fell silent, with no living beings except the Three-Eyed Tiger and Jiang Cheng remaining.
The task in his mind disappeared, and the Three-Eyed Tiger finally didn’t feel the constant shadow of the Heavenly Dao obliteration crisis.
"Now it’s your turn!"
Roar!
It roared, charging toward Jiang Cheng.
A Demon King has dignity. No matter how cowardly or unambitious a Demon King might be, they wouldn’t be controlled by others.

chapters.title: Chapter 21: Harvest Abundant
chapters.content:
Chapter 21: Chapter 21: Harvest Abundant
Editor:
EndlessFantasy Translation
Compared to those from the Extreme Moon Sect, what it hated most was Jiang Cheng, who interrupted its good deed.
"What the hell, did it just backfire?"
Facing this attack, Brother Cheng couldn’t resist at all, nor did he have time to dodge.
He could only hope the system rules were true and that the helpers he summoned couldn’t harm him.
Boom!
Just as the Three-Eyed Tiger was about to touch Jiang Cheng, it was struck as if by lightning.
"Meow..."
The petite body flew backward, not knowing how many hundreds of miles it flew, breaking countless peaks.
Agonizing pain surged, skin cracked and flesh tore.
Even its sharp claws showed signs of melting.
This time, it was almost scared out of its soul.
"Damn it, better just go back."
"You just wait for me!"
After throwing a couple of menacing words symbolically, it didn’t return to the Extreme Moon Sect but turned into a golden light, shooting straight to the distant clouds.
In the blink of an eye, it disappeared.
"Bro, you’re leaving just like that?"
"Aren’t you staying for a cup of tea and a chat?"
"I haven’t even thanked you yet!"
Of course, the thanks were fake.
But anyway, although the Three-Eyed Tiger just now showed its ferocity and even struck at him, Jiang Cheng still wanted to keep it.
It couldn’t hurt him anyway.
Chatting more, coaxing a bit, maybe he could trick it into becoming a mighty mount that could conquer the world?
Speaking of which, that demon beast should be able to grow bigger, right?
How cool would that be!
Unfortunately, the Three-Eyed Tiger lacked the spirit of relentless effort. Unable to kill Jiang Cheng, it couldn’t be bothered to mess around and just slipped back.
Hopefully, there would be another chance to summon it in the future.
Brother Cheng set aside these thoughts and looked towards the empty group halls of the Extreme Moon Sect.
The corners of his mouth involuntarily twisted up to his ears.
For at least two hours, he could take whatever he wanted here.
The entire Extreme Moon Sect, although just a middle-class sect, had an extremely abundant collection!
After all, this sect originally supported tens of thousands of disciples.
Moreover, they had previously robbed the Feixian Sect, and all the loot hadn’t been offered to the Red Sun Sect yet; it was still in the warehouse.
Now it was all his.
Looking at the mountains of Spirit Stones, rows of Spirit Medicines extending out of sight, stacks of countless Spirit Talismans, Spirit Swords, and Spirit Armors like a forest, countless classics...
Jiang Cheng was in a dilemma.
He could only use ’Insight’ to run around and collect all the storage rings scattered during the recent battle from various corners.
Otherwise, his own storage ring wouldn’t be able to hold them all.
And among these storage rings, he discovered many valuable items.
After all, those who owned storage rings were either Elders or True Disciples.
Especially in Qi Gaohong’s storage ring, he even found a Tier Six Spirit Sword!
In addition, there was also the complete set of Crescent Moon Swordsmanship.
This swordsmanship was not highly valued by Jiang Cheng, but since he had this one, it was still worth practicing.
He struck gold!
After busying himself for more than an hour and filling up seventy storage rings, the Extreme Moon Sect was basically emptied by him.
It was then he came to a valley behind the main hall.
Just while using ’Insight’, he noticed a green exclamation mark here, clearly indicating a treasure.
Upon closer inspection, he realized it was the spirit vein of the Extreme Moon Sect below.
’Second-Grade Spirit Vein, cannot be moved. Can enhance the concentration of Spiritual Qi within a thousand miles, and naturally generate Spirit Stones below middle-grade...’
A rough glance revealed the spirit vein stretched for over a hundred miles.
Jiang Cheng wasn’t too shocked, as most sects would choose to establish themselves near a spirit vein.
Plus, with an array, it could turn the sect’s base into a Cultivation Sacred Land.
Of course, this still depended on the grade of the spirit vein.
First Grade is the lowest, but Second Grade is not bad.
Sects like the Duanmu Family and Red Sun Sect should have spirit veins at least above Third Grade.
"If it can’t be moved, what’s the use?"
"I can’t take it with me."
Jiang Cheng pouted, feeling a bit regretful.
Yet, he didn’t think that if spirit veins could be moved, the Duanmu Family and Red Sun Sect would have relocated the spirit veins of the dozen middle-class sects below them long ago.
Even if not as good as Third Grade, it would still boost Spiritual Qi concentration.
As soon as he thought about it, he noticed some small words above part of the spirit vein — whether to exchange.
Oh, this can directly exchange for points?
Since it couldn’t be taken away, he decisively chose to exchange.
In an instant, the spirit vein below disappeared.
The Spiritual Qi across the entire Extreme Moon Sect location sharply decreased twofold, almost no different from outside.
"Ding, exchanged a Second-Grade Spirit Vein, received 2000 points."
Not bad!
Jiang Cheng was quite satisfied.
Without hesitation, he opened the lottery draw.
"Ding, deducted 1000 points!"
"Host won a Tier Nine Spiritual Artifact Gentle Mist Jade Immortal Robe, can resist any attack below Celestial Fate Ninth Layer."
Holding the thin as cicada’s wing with delicate patterns transparent Spirit Armor, Brother Cheng felt a bit sentimental.
He was currently in the Soul Splitting Realm, above which was the Spirit Platform Realm, then the Celestial Fate Realm.
To say the least, wearing this robe right now, not just Qinglan Prefecture, even the entire Feiyun State wouldn’t have anyone who could harm him.
This Spirit Armor was simply awesome.
If it were released now, it would arouse countless people’s greedy instincts, plunging the entire Feiyun State into a bloody storm.
Imagine if a Celestial Fate First Layer wore it, they would be almost invincible against a Celestial Fate Ninth Layer.
One piece of Spirit Armor was enough to change the power structure.
Sects like the Duanmu Family and Red Sun Sect probably wouldn’t dare to get involved.
The reason is simple, this Spirit Armor is not aligned with their power.
Simply put, they don’t deserve to own it.
In front of those higher-level forces in Feiyun State that possess Celestial Fate Realm experts, they would only become cannon fodder.
Unfortunately, this treasure was of no use to Brother Cheng!
Wearing such a piece of Spirit Armor, he could endure attacks for a long time without dying.
If he doesn’t die, how can he resurrect and use the system hacks?
He was hoping that the next time he got killed, the system would directly upgrade him to Spirit Platform or even Celestial Fate Realm.
Brother Cheng now realized that, although treasures are good, they’re not as valuable as system skills like ’Insight’.
Mastering a special skill is something beneficial for life.
"Once more!"
"Ding, congratulations to the host for having a burst of luck, winning a Tier One Transmission skill."
Skills!
Jiang Cheng instantly perked up, and upon closer inspection, this Transmission was incredibly powerful.
Skill Name: Transmission (Tier One, can be upgraded).
Skill Description: With the host as the center, a range of ten thousand miles can be randomly transmitted to any location.
Cooldown Time: 1 day.
Upon opening the skill, the system even thoughtfully provided a live thumbnail map, with a radius of ten thousand miles around him.
Click where you want to go.
This skill is very handy for escaping in critical moments, like when resurrection chances are used up, encountering a crisis.
Especially now that Jiang Cheng is at Soul Splitting Fourth Layer, his traveling speed isn’t fast.
Traveling ten thousand miles would take him over two hours, but teleportation is much more convenient.
However, he could only teleport once a day.

chapters.title: Chapter 22 Choose at Will
chapters.content:
Chapter 22: Chapter 22 Choose at Will
Editor:
EndlessFantasy Translation
He figured if this skill could be upgraded, it would expand the transmission range and shorten the cooldown time.
The key is how to upgrade?
Do I have to rely on a lottery and draw a Tier Two?
He couldn’t consult this damned system, after all, asking a question would cost 500 points.
Looking at his points back to over 300, Brother Cheng felt a wave of emptiness.
As the saying goes, the thrill of gambling lasts only for a moment; after it’s over, you enter the sage mode of regret.
At this rate, when will the system ever reach Level 3?
This is the difference between spendthrifts and savers; spendthrifts never complete the target rewards.
He gritted his teeth and decided to avoid gambling until he saved up 10,000 points.
Then he exchanged the spirit stones and most pills he had looted this time, as well as unused Tier Three and Tier Four spiritual artifacts, finally gaining 3,500 points.
With that, he finally felt a bit more fulfilled.
Looking at the now-empty Extreme Moon Sect base, he activated transmission.
A white light flashed, and he appeared thousands of miles away, only a little over a thousand miles from Feixian Sect.
It was two hours after he left that some loose cultivators dared to sneak into Extreme Moon Sect, seeking information.
Once inside, the scenes nearly scared the hell out of them.
The entire Extreme Moon Sect seemed like a ghostland, devoid of any signs of life.
"Sect Leader Qi’s corpse!"
"It’s horrible, bisected..."
"Here’s Elder Liu’s body!"
"They’re all dead, every single one!"
"Who did this? Their power is terrifying! Extreme Moon Sect has been wiped out!"
All the cultivators present were plunged into deep shock and fear.
"Here, Liang Da is also dead!"
"It was that Tiger Demon Illusion, right? Such a powerful figure!"
"Hey, where’s the Feixian Sect Leader who was with Liang Da?"
"Yeah, I don’t see his body."
"Could it be that the Tiger Demon Illusion was summoned by him?"
"Impossible, right? Someone that strong wouldn’t need to stay in Qinglan Prefecture."
"Indeed, it doesn’t seem likely to me either."
"Hey Brother Zhang, why are you running?"
"You fool, with no one left in Extreme Moon Sect, all the treasures here are unowned now!"
With these words, everyone went crazy, flying towards the various treasure vaults of Extreme Moon Sect.
Loose cultivators lived pretty tight lives; because they mostly didn’t have talent, they never joined a sect from a young age, so they had to scrounge for cultivation resources bit by bit.
Unless they had a fortuitous encounter, many of them would still need to deal with the mortal world for a long time.
The downfall of a sect like Extreme Moon Sect was a great opportunity for them.
"Who dares fight me for this!"
"Don’t crowd!"
"Damn, you actually attacked me!"
"There are no brothers in front of treasures, not to mention we’re just passersby!"
They hadn’t even grabbed anything when fights broke out in several places, blood spurting everywhere.
But soon, everyone was left in tears of despair facing the empty storerooms.
Aside from the empty shelves, Jiang Cheng hadn’t left them a single thing.
"Impossible!"
"For such a great sect, there must be some treasures left!"
"Search!"
Unconvinced and unwilling, they dug vigorously.
But even after digging three feet deep, they couldn’t find a single lower-grade spirit stone.
"Damn it, this is too ruthless!"
"After eating the meat, at least leave us the soup!"
"With his level, lower-grade spirit stones are useless, no need to take them..."
"Though he’s strong, for some reason I feel like despising him!"
"Me too!"
Silent and choked with emotion, countless middle fingers turned into resentful grievances pointed at the sky.
Achoo!
At the foot of the distant Feixian Mountain, Jiang Cheng sneezed.
Touching his sharp nose, he was a bit puzzled. Even at the Fourth Layer of Split Soul and with an invincible Celestial Desolation Indestructible Body, here he was.
"Could it be someone’s jealous of my looks, cursing me behind my back?"
"Seems being too handsome isn’t all good after all."
Back in the sect, he found that things had changed significantly.
Before he left, he remembered Feixian Sect’s spirit vein was cut by the Four Sects, rendering it a place of ruins.
But now, the Spiritual Qi concentration was more than double that of the former Extreme Moon Sect.
Apart from this, the ruins left by the Four Sects at the time of annihilation, such as shattered stones and broken trees, were gone, probably cleaned up by Ji Linghan and the others.
"Sect Leader!"
"Sect Leader, you’re back!"
As soon as he appeared, the disciples who stayed behind rushed to greet him excitedly.
They had only known him for a day, but it wasn’t an exaggeration to say that Jiang Cheng was now their backbone.
His immense power had re-infused the disciples with faith.
"How did the Sect Leader’s journey go?"
Though Jiang Cheng’s ’Thunder Attraction Technique’ was astonishing, it was expected to be a piece of cake. Still, Extreme Moon Sect was a sect with over ten thousand members.
It wouldn’t be surprising if anything unexpected happened.
Besides, it had taken him less than half a day to go back and forth, which was a bit fast.
Before Jiang Cheng could speak, Luo Yuan and Yin Xiaoxue were quick to cover for him.
"Ahem, it’s okay if they weren’t wiped out. We have plenty of time!"
"Yes, yes, yes, Sect Leader is already amazing."
"Revenge isn’t a rush!"
Clang alang alang!
Jiang Cheng rubbed one of the rings, and with a flash of light, dozens of spirit swords and spirit armors fell to the ground.
The cold air was biting, and the treasure light dazzled!
"This, this is the Cyan Cliff Sword, the Extreme Moon Sect Leader’s sword, a Tier Six spiritual artifact!"
"Isn’t this Zhang Huahong’s spirit armor, the Chao Yuan Heavy Wind Armor?"
"I remember from when he bought it at a high price from Feiyun State, making a big fuss about it at the time."
"And this, this is..."
Their eyes were almost blinded.
Although they were True Disciples before, they only used Tier Three spiritual artifacts.
That was already considered very good treatment.
Some struggling loose cultivators, after a lifetime of striving, could only assemble a set of Tier One spiritual artifacts at best.
Before their last escape, although each of their masters left some collections for them, most didn’t include weapons or spirit armors.
After all, the Elders of Feixian Sect needed to fight external enemies at that time.
Yet lying all over the ground were spiritual artifacts, with the lowest being Tier Four.
As for anything lower, Jiang Cheng had already exchanged it for points.
"Take whatever you like."
He was quite generous to those loyal to him.
After all, he couldn’t use them, could he?
"These, these are all for us?"
Luo Yuan and the others could hardly believe it was true.
The resources they got during their last escape were an emergency special case.
In the past, as disciples, they had to demonstrate outstanding contributions to the sect to be rewarded with spiritual artifacts.
Or they had to perform well in a major sect competition.
Unlike now, where they hadn’t achieved anything yet!
Tier Four spirit swords and spirit armor were laid right in front of them, free to pick.
"Of course, I don’t want you to be completely defenseless when I’m not around."
For people on his side, he would naturally lift them up.
"Well, then we won’t be shy about it!"

chapters.title: Chapter 23 Dividing the Treasure
chapters.content:
Chapter 23: Chapter 23 Dividing the Treasure
Editor:
EndlessFantasy Translation
As cultivators, how many can really remain indifferent to better weapons and armor?
Everyone cheerfully picked and chose, soon dividing up all the tier four spiritual artifacts.
However, no one took the tier six spirit sword and the tier five spirit armor.
Jiang Cheng nodded secretly; these disciples were quite commendable for knowing how to be considerate.
This is different from the cultivation realm’s typical style in his memory.
Wasn’t it said that there is ruthless fighting even among sect members?
He was somewhat mistaken, as the disciples of Feixian Sect had reasons for behaving this way.
With Ji Linghan, who has the Seven-Aperture Exquisite Body, being the senior sister, the rest had already given up thoughts of conflict early on, since it was pointless.
The talent gap was too wide, nothing would come from fighting.
Ji Linghan herself had a warm and gentle nature and influenced her disciple brothers and sisters to be quite friendly with one another.
Moreover, they had all survived a sect-destroying calamity together, which made them cherish their dwindling number of companions more.
"Why didn’t anyone take them?"
"Well... we should leave these for you, Sect Leader."
"Yeah, it’s too precious—we’d feel embarrassed to accept such treasures!"
Even among the elders of the Duanmu Family and Red Sun Sect, not everyone owned tier five spirit armor and tier six spirit swords.
The elite disciples over there were still using tier four items.
"Look at your lack of perspective!"
In Jiang Cheng’s eyes, these were nothing but junk, and he wondered why there was such a big reaction.
He stuffed the spirit armor into Luo Yuan’s hands and bestowed the spirit sword to Yin Xiaoxue.
Both were utterly astonished beyond belief.
Tears filled their eyes, and they felt as if the spiritual artifacts in their hands weighed a thousand pounds!
They were nearly ready to pledge their lives for him.
Then, Jiang Cheng took out a pile of bottles and jars, all containing pills for those in the Soul Splitting Realm.
"Go ahead and distribute them; you’ll reach the Soul Splitting Realm sooner or later anyway."
The disciples were taken aback, doubting whether they were dreaming.
Some of these Soul Splitting Realm pills could also be used in the Gathering Essence Realm, multiplying the cultivation effect many times over.
Previously, Feixian Sect had to support over ten thousand disciples.
These pill supplies were limited; generally, only Soul Splitting Realm elders got to use them.
With these pills, combined with Feixian Sect’s current spiritual Qi concentration, they were confident in reaching the Soul Splitting Realm in the shortest time.
After happily distributing the pills, Jiang Cheng touched his ring again.
Bundles upon bundles of spirit talismans appeared before everyone.
"Two bundles per person; distribute them!"
He waved his hand.
Luo Yuan and Yin Xiaoxue were at a loss for words.
Spirit talismans were, of course, valuable!
Throwing one out was akin to making a move, and could save one in a critical moment.
Especially since these spirit talismans were tier four, throwing one out was equivalent to a Soul Splitting Realm strike once.
In Extreme Moon Sect, these would have been sect-protecting treasures and strategic core reserves, right?
Moreover, using spirit talismans in the past was always on a per-sheet basis.
For example, when going on a mission, one could apply at the sect’s General Affairs Hall, go through a series of procedures, and generally receive one or two tier-three spirit talismans.
But now Jiang Cheng was distributing them in bundles.
A bundle contained fifty sheets!
