After everyone took two bundles of spirit talismans each, Jiang Cheng added.
"Don’t be thrifty with consumables like these; use them when necessary and don’t let them rot in your hands. There’ll be more in the future anyway."
The crowd was already completely numb.
Suddenly, they felt having such a powerful and generous sect leader was indeed a blessing honed from a past life.
And he was handsome, exceeding the plane’s limits.
Many female disciples’ eyes began to glitter.
As for the male disciples, their loyalty had reached its peak, wishing to die for Jiang Cheng.
"Did the Sect Leader really destroy Extreme Moon Sect?"
Seeing these ’spoils of war,’ the last shred of doubt was dispelled among the crowd.
If he hadn’t obliterated Extreme Moon Sect, how could he have obtained these things?
"Of course!"
"When this sect leader strikes..."
Jiang Cheng held his hands behind him and said lightly: "Not a soul would escape."
Sss...
The crowd collectively took a cold breath.
Extreme Moon Sect had over ten thousand members; even if one were powerful enough to win, it wouldn’t be possible not to let some slip through.
Leaving none behind—what kind of power was this?
"The Sect Leader is truly a divine being!"
The crowd once again spoke these words from the heart.
Brother Cheng’s pretentious heart was greatly satisfied.
"By the way, where is Elder Liang?"
They finally realized someone was missing.
Mentioning this, Jiang Cheng changed his expression.
"Alas!"
He sighed deeply, his tone heavy.
"After Elder Liang accompanied me into Extreme Moon Sect, he rushed ambitiously for merit, and I couldn’t hold him back in time..."
"He’s dead?"
Luo Yuan and others quickly asked.
However, none seemed to express real sorrow.
They weren’t foolish. Elder Liang had previously asked them to hand over their rings, likely intending to ’make off with the loot.’
At that time, they were pressured by the so-called greater good and couldn’t expose him.
Besides, Elder Liang always opposed Jiang Cheng’s position as sect leader, constantly damping spirits during the Feixian Sect battle, exhibiting twisted yin-yang behavior, further tarnishing his image.
Jiang Cheng nodded and solemnly said: "Yes, unfortunately, I was in the heat of battle and didn’t look after him."
"Elder Liang was surrounded by multiple elders from the opposing side, hacked to the point even his father wouldn’t recognize him..."
"He fell with heroism..."
The disciples had little more to say; attacking a sect was inherently risky.
Elder Liang volunteered, was overconfident, and insisted on going.
"Alas!"
"Hope he travels well on his way!"
"Enough, now all of you go cultivate!"
As everyone was about to leave, Jiang Cheng called: "Ji Linghan, stay!"
Then, he took out the Gentle Mist Jade Immortal Robe.
"Here, take this."
Ji Linghan curiously accepted, her beautiful face lightening up with a smile.
Actually, she had been a little disappointed.
Being the one with the best talent and having been the first to know him as the senior sister, Jiang Cheng had given the tier five spirit armor and tier six spirit sword to others, completely overlooking her.
She was not inclined to conflict and couldn’t express dissatisfaction publicly.
Feeling a bit disappointed was inevitable; it’s only human.
Although she wasn’t sure of the armor’s grade, the fact it was specifically given to her signified her importance.
She gleefully asked: "What is this?"
"Oh, just a tier nine spirit armor, it’s for you."
Jiang Cheng said nonchalantly, even emphasizing the ’just’ as if it were trivial.
The disciples already far away stumbled, nearly falling.
Nine, tier nine?
They didn’t mishear, did they?
Not even Qinglan Prefecture or Feiyun State possessed treasures of this level, right?
Duanmu Family only seemed to have one tier seven spiritual artifact, their family’s supreme treasure, and their greatest card against Red Sun Sect.
And just now...
What did the Sect Leader present to Senior Sister Ji?
A tier nine spirit armor?
Ji Linghan nearly dropped the armor in shock.
She was startled.
"This, this, this is way too precious... I can’t accept it! You’re the sect leader; such a treasure should be yours to wear."
"When I say take it, you take it. This sect leader’s power had long outgrown reliance on external things!"
Jiang Cheng felt no reluctance.
He had no use for this armor; moreover, it was a female style.
While any spirit armor had great elasticity and could fit even a hulking man, it would affect the masculine elements of Brother Cheng’s handsomeness!
He really had no interest.

chapters.title: Chapter 24: The Magical Ah Huang
chapters.content:
Chapter 24: Chapter 24: The Magical Ah Huang
Editor:
EndlessFantasy Translation
After much polite refusal and insistence, Ji Linghan finally put on the Spirit Armor.
With starry glimmers, her entire demeanor seemed to transform once she donned it.
The transparent Spirit Armor quickly merged with her clothing, transforming into a long white palace dress.
Transparent, ethereal flows of light appeared around her, with a faint, ethereal aura.
"A fairy!"
Jiang Cheng was almost entranced.
In the distance, Yin Xiaoxue and other female disciples were filled with envy.
"Ah, it’s obvious our Sect Leader cares most for Senior Sister Ji."
"Looks like we don’t stand a chance."
Though the words were somewhat sour, their eyes showed no jealousy.
Ji Linghan smiled gracefully and bowed respectfully.
"I shall not let down the Sect Leader’s gift!"
...
"By the way, wasn’t our sect’s spirit vein broken? Why is the spirit Qi concentration so high now?"
Upon mentioning this, Ji Linghan gave a sweet smile.
"It’s all thanks to the Sect Leader’s daughter."
Jiang Cheng was puzzled, "Ah Huang’s doing?"
This time, it was Ji Linghan’s turn to be confused.
"Ah Huang?"
"Oh, that’s the name I gave her. Easy to remember, right?"
Ji Linghan was almost speechless.
Such an adorable young girl, and you give her a name like that?
"Ah... after you left, Sect Leader, Ah Huang woke up shortly and headed straight for the spirit vein’s location."
It took her effort to say this name.
"And then? Did she repair the spirit vein?"
Jiang Cheng asked eagerly.
"Yes, it was quite miraculous."
Recollecting, Ji Linghan found it still unbelievable.
That was a spirit vein, after all, and it being restored after breaking was unheard of.
"Not only was it restored, but the spirit Qi concentration is now even higher than before."
"Our Feixian Sect’s spirit vein should now be at Third Grade."
This didn’t surprise Jiang Cheng much.
Ji Linghan wasn’t aware of Ah Huang’s background, but he was. It was a World Heart Fragment.
Spirit Qi and the like were her areas of expertise.
Arriving at the spirit vein in the back mountain, he sensed an even greater difference.
Compared to the Second Grade spirit vein of Extreme Moon Sect, the vein in front of him seemed alive, possessing its own consciousness.
"Mom!"
From within the spirit vein, a figure flew out.
Like a fledgling sparrow returning to the forest, she dashed into his arms.
Brother Cheng nearly landed on the ground from the impact, but thinking of how close his daughter was to him, he couldn’t help but feel ’greatly comforted.’
He didn’t bother with the issue of titles, knowing it was pointless.
"Good daughter, do you like living inside the spirit vein?"
Ah Huang still looked like a seven or eight-year-old, so cute it melted one’s heart.
"It’s so comfy in here; I was just swimming inside."
"Alright, as long as you like it."
Jiang Cheng then asked, "Did you enhance the grade of this spirit vein?"
"Yes, yes!"
Ah Huang nodded, her bright eyes seeming to ask for praise.
Brother Cheng patted her head, gratifying her.
"Job well done!"
And he praised himself a little as well.
"As expected of my daughter."
Ah Huang rubbed her head contentedly against his chest.
"If Mom can find other fragments, I can make the spirit vein’s grade even higher."
"There are other World Heart Fragments?"
Jiang Cheng was surprised; such a miraculous treasure has more than one?
"Yes, but I don’t know where they are. Mom will have to find them."
"Alright, Dad will keep an eye out!"
He was naturally keen to increase Feixian Sect’s spirit Qi concentration.
But the world was enormous, and he hadn’t even explored outside Qinglan Prefecture yet.
Even with Insight, it felt like searching for a needle in a haystack.
"Are the other fragments also in some spirit Qi deprived lands?"
If they were all in spirit Qi barren places, it at least gave him a range of clues.
Ah Huang shook her braids angrily, "I was unlucky to be born in the Forbidden Land, starting with so little spirit Qi that I almost couldn’t grow, but other fragments may not be."
So that’s the case.
It seemed he had to rely on fate.
He chatted with his daughter for a while, played with her, and then returned to the front hall.
The next step was, of course, to annihilate the other three sects involved in attacking Feixian Sect.
But having used up his two resurrections today, Brother Cheng had to curb his strong desire to show off.
He decided to cultivate instead, since he was a cultivator after all.
The Celestial Desolation Indestructible Body was overwhelmingly powerful to cultivate, but with Feixian Sect’s vast expanse of over a thousand miles, he could find a secluded mountain forest to avoid affecting other disciples’ spirit Qi absorption.
While he cultivated for a day and a night, the outside world was already abuzz.
The destruction of Extreme Moon Sect, the Tiger Demon illusion, Jiang Cheng’s visit—all the details had been spread vividly, rapidly evolving into over a hundred versions.
The cultivation realm’s information spread quickly, thanks to Sound Transmission Talismans and Transmission Spirit Artifacts.
Extreme Moon Sect was among the top three middle-class sects within Qinglan Prefecture, a significant power.
Their sudden annihilation, leaving none behind, was a considerable impact.
Even Red Sun Sect and the Duanmu Family expressed close attention, sending many disciples and spies to gather more details.
They naturally didn’t believe Jiang Cheng accomplished this alone.
The saying goes, with such power, why stay in a small place like Feixian Sect?
To them, this seemed likely the doing of forces outside Qinglan Prefecture; there must be deep scheming and conspiracy behind it.
The forces capable of wiping out Extreme Moon Sect in a short time could already pose a threat to them.
That Jiang Cheng was either just a pawn sent by another major power,
or a facade being used.
Regarding this person, both major forces also sent spies, planning to find out the truth.
Jiang Cheng, at the center of this whirlwind, was completely unaware and couldn’t be bothered to investigate.
With only about 20 people under his command, he simply didn’t have enough manpower.
Time quickly moved to the next day.
"Ah, another day full of King Bi vibes!"
With his resurrection count restored, Brother Cheng stretched lazily.
After a night of cultivation, he had already reached the Soul Splitting Realm Sixth Layer.
Rising two small realms overnight, if this spread, it would probably be considered a miracle.
But Brother Cheng appeared calm.
With the Three Realms’ top cultivation physique, what else could he do?
Moreover, his daughter’s enhanced spirit Qi concentration boosted him.
"Greetings, Sect Leader!"
"Has the Sect Leader finished cultivating?"
"Such towering strength, yet so diligent and relentless. The Sect Leader truly is a model for us cultivators!"
"The Sect Leader seems even more handsome than yesterday..."
"Not just seems, definitely is!"
Returning to the main hall, the disciples turned into sycophants, which Brother Cheng thoroughly enjoyed.
Only after they finished their praises did he wave a hand.
"Your heartfelt compliments, try not to say them in crowded places; just praise in private."
"After all, I have a thin skin..."
Everyone nearly stumbled.
They’d never seen someone with such thick skin!
Yet somehow, they felt this stylish Sect Leader was much more approachable than those seriously stern old fogeys.

chapters.title: Chapter 25: Brother Cheng in a Hurry
chapters.content:
Chapter 25: Chapter 25: Brother Cheng in a Hurry
Editor:
EndlessFantasy Translation
After a brief daze, Luo Yuan was the first to jump out and speak passionately.
"Sect Leader, you are truly the epitome of humility, we cannot compare!"
Junior Brother Luo, you’ve changed.
Ji Linghan looked at him with a blank expression, as if she was meeting him for the first time.
She still remembered the year before when Luo Yuan refused to salute a certain Elder, causing a commotion with the Sect Leader, and ultimately being punished yet refusing to bow down.
He had always been known for his forthrightness and refusal to butter up in the Feixian Sect.
But now...
"From now on, we should learn more from the Sect Leader!"
He raised his right hand, like a fervent fanatic.
"Learn from the Sect Leader!"
The other disciples weren’t far behind.
"Good, good, good..."
Brother Cheng was very pleased, pressing his hands down slightly.
"I have received everyone’s opinions, and you can propose more in the future."
Opinions, did we just propose any opinions?
Ji Linghan felt like she was falling behind the pace of this group.
"I’ve gathered everyone here today for two matters."
"The first is that we need to arrange the affairs within the Sect."
Though small, a sparrow has all its vital organs; even though the Feixian Sect, including him and Ah Huang, only counted up to 24 people in total, they still needed to have distinct responsibilities.
Brother Cheng pondered for a long time, deciding to hand over the daily Sect affairs to Senior Sister Ji Linghan, with Luo Yuan and Yin Xiaoxue serving as assistants.
After all, he not only didn’t have the time to manage them, but he also couldn’t.
He had only been out of the Forbidden Land for less than three days.
This decision aroused no objection from the others, who merely thought the Sect Leader was indeed generous in delegating power.
"The second matter is I’m going to destroy the Profound Ice Sect and the Five Thunders Sect; the rest of you will continue guarding the house today."
Even though they knew his ’power reached the sky,’ many disciples still found this too unbelievable.
Annihilating sects seemed as ordinary as eating and drinking, just going out to destroy two sects.
Listen, is this human talk?
However, upon reflection, is there anything the Sect Leader’s ’power’ couldn’t accomplish?
What’s more, those two sects had both participated in the siege of Feixian Sect, bearing deep-seated hatred; they had been thinking of revenge all the time.
It was just unexpected how soon it would happen.
"Wishing the Sect Leader triumphant victory!"
"We will certainly train diligently, striving to catch up to the Sect Leader’s pace soon!"
Jiang Cheng smiled leisurely, appreciating their spirit.
But if you do catch up, what face would I have to see the departed systems beneath?
This time he didn’t use the Transmission Array, after all, it could only be used once a day, better to save it.
Two hours later, he appeared in front of the Profound Ice Sect’s mountain gate.
Unlike last time, this time he was recognized as soon as he showed up.
"Look, that’s Jiang Cheng!"
"Was it him who wiped out the Extreme Moon Sect yesterday?"
"Whether it was him is uncertain, but it’s certainly related to him."
"He has come to the Profound Ice Sect, is he really here to avenge Feixian Sect?"
"In my opinion, he must have some hidden forces backing him from other prefectures, otherwise, how would he dare be so bold?"
Feiyun State not only had Qinglan Prefecture, but it also bordered Qian Ning Prefecture and Chongyan Prefecture.
These two prefectures also spanned over hundreds of thousands of miles, and internally contained Great Sects no lesser than the Duanmu Family and the Red Sun Sect.
Cultivators vie for resources, often using every means possible.
There were naturally conflicts between the two major forces of Qinglan Prefecture and them.
As for middle-class sects like Feixian Sect and Extreme Moon Sect, in Qinglan Prefecture, they could only be considered second-rate, with not much entanglement with outside forces.
Currently, everyone seemed to have reached a consensus that Jiang Cheng was sent by either Qian Ning Prefecture or Chongyan Prefecture.
The Extreme Moon Sect couldn’t escape a single person.
Such a feat couldn’t possibly be accomplished by one person.
There must be a formidable force behind him.
Jiang Cheng paid no attention to their speculations as he heard them.
Brother Cheng aimed to cheat and show off, and no one could block him.
He was too lazy to walk up to the mountain gate, directly choosing to fly.
No one dared to stop him along the way, as if entering an uninhabited domain.
He flew all the way to the vast main hall square of Profound Ice Sect before he saw a massive crowd waiting for him.
Doom! Doom! Doom!
Resounding bell tones reverberated in the mountains, this was the rallying call when under foreign attack.
All Profound Ice Sect disciples rapidly assembled.
Seeing the massive display of at least eight thousand people in front, Jiang Cheng expressed that the welcoming arrangement wasn’t bad.
"Jiang Cheng, you’ve indeed come!"
"But don’t think about leaving now!"
The Profound Ice Sect Leader Shi Canghan flicked his robe sleeves, and in an instant, a cyan light shield isolated the core region of Profound Ice Sect over hundreds of miles.
The Sect Protection Array was activated.
The Sect Protection Array was a sect’s foundational defense strategy.
Once the array was initiated, outside invaders would either find it very difficult to penetrate.
Even if they made it in, they would be attacked by the array.
In such a battle, movement becomes constrained.
The Profound Ice Sect’s Sect Protection Array was the Tier Five Frost Celestial Prison Array, and once activated, even the sky was obscured, sealed off by thick layers of ice.
Jiang Cheng hadn’t cultivated Ice Element Techniques; the sudden drop in temperature by dozens of degrees felt a bit unfamiliar, almost making him shiver.
At the same time, the main peak and surrounding dozens of peaks seemed to come to life, revealing attack Spirit Arrays.
Each Spirit Array flickered with a cold glow, targeting Jiang Cheng.
Once all this was successfully activated, the elders of Profound Ice Sect relaxed completely.
"It’s just you alone, I would like to see how you create disturbances!"
They were worried not about Jiang Cheng himself, but his backing forces.
Now, the array isolated everything; even if Jiang Cheng had support, they couldn’t get in.
"There is a path to paradise that you refuse to take, yet you barge into hell’s gates!"
"Hahahahaha..."
Shi Canghan laughed heartily towards the sky but was soon interrupted by Jiang Cheng.
"Alright, alright, let’s get this started quickly."
"Tell me, who is behind you..."
"Enough already, hurry up and kill!"
"That is offering wine..."
"Not accepting the good offer and choosing the bad one? Can you come up with something fresher, I’m busy and rushing to the next one!"
"You’re merely a Split Soul..."
"Never mind, I’ll do it myself."
In Brother Cheng’s eyes, these people were destined to die.
They were slightly higher in status than wild NPCs in games; who has the time to listen to their endless prattling, of course, he kept skipping the dialogue to start the main event.
Clang!
The moment the Spirit Sword flew out of the sword scabbard, Shi Canghan instinctively stepped back a pace.
Like the earlier Qi Gaohong, he felt Jiang Cheng’s confidence was inexplicable.
Clearly just a Soul Splitting Sixth Layer, yet he seemed to have already clinched victory.
Those old cunning practitioners who have cultivated for hundreds of years, of course, are cautious.
Without absolute certainty, they usually won’t rashly make a move.
Therefore, he chose to attack with arrays first.
"Activate the array!"
In an instant, the arrays long prepared were simultaneously activated with thirty Spirit Arrays on the peaks.
Boom! Boom! Boom!
The whole sky was covered in Ice Swords and Ice Spears, additionally, countless Ice Blades spread across the ground!
All attacks were as fast as a stream of light, targeting only Jiang Cheng.

chapters.title: Chapter 26: The Angry 3-Eyed Tiger
chapters.content:
Chapter 26: Chapter 26: The Angry 3-Eyed Tiger
Editor:
EndlessFantasy Translation
This is the Great Array of the Profound Ice Sect, of course, it will avoid attacking disciples possessing the Sect’s Jade Talisman.
When facing the attack of the Sect Protection Array, either one’s individual strength exceeds the limit, or there are many people dispersing the array’s attack.
A single Soul Splitting Realm cultivator wouldn’t last more than 3 seconds against this concentrated attack.
But Jiang Cheng...
Alright, he’s just an ordinary Soul Splitting Realm cultivator.
Even though he possesses the Celestial Desolation Indestructible Body, it’s not immune to swords and spears, so he only lasted 4 seconds.
Then a particularly crisp ice sword pierced through his heart.
Following that, more ice blade ice spears turned him into a porcupine.
The scene wasn’t bloody because each ice sword and ice blade was infused with ice spiritual power.
Before stabbing him, they had actually already frozen his blood vessels.
Looking at the giant ice sculpture in the shape of a porcupine in front of them, all eight thousand disciples of the Profound Ice Sect were dumbfounded.
Is it over just like that?
They even rang the sect extinguishing assembly bell.
They were ready for a death-defying battle for their sect.
In the end, one round of the array’s volley, and the enemy was dead?
Since Jiang Cheng was dead, with no sign of life, the array also automatically ceased its attack.
Shi Canghan found it inconceivable, as the process of the battle with the Extreme Moon Sect was never relayed back, he had no idea what was about to happen.
It just seemed too absurd to him.
"Thought he was really something, turns out he’s just a straw bag!"
"If we’d known, we could have ended it with a single sword."
"Wasted so many spirit stones activating the array."
"Pah! This person is just a joke, stories outside say he’s amazing."
While the elders of the Profound Ice Sect were complaining, Jiang Cheng heard a pleasant system notification sound.
"Ding, Host has been killed, system analyzes enemy strength, preparing a resurrection plan for the Host."
"Host has received a summoning talisman, which can summon a random powerful helper for one-time service."
Hmm, hmm?
Why does this sound so familiar?
A high in the sky several ten thousand miles away from Qinglan Prefecture, the Three-Eyed Fierce Tiger King was flying towards the Celestial Demon Domain.
The Celestial Demon Domain was really too far from Qinglan Prefecture, even with its great speed, it would still take several days and nights to fly back.
As it got closer to the Celestial Demon Domain, its size had restored to more than a hundred meters. However, that was still far from its peak state.
"Damn brat, summoning this king over, and yet there’s no return talisman, huh?"
"Making this king painstakingly fly back, damn!"
"Better not let me see you in the Celestial Demon Domain!"
"I’ll hit you every time I see you!"
While flying, it was still cursing Jiang Cheng.
As a demon king, it certainly preferred the atmosphere of the Celestial Demon Domain.
Although some native demon beasts existed on this side of the human world, having been born in another domain, it was not accustomed to the rules that oppressed it here.
Not to mention there were Saint Realm cultivators among humans, and coming across them before its power was restored would be quite troublesome.
Once back on that side, it plans to first visit the Rabbit Race to find a few little ladies to dispel a bit of bad luck...
Thinking of those little demons from the Rabbit Race with their alluring bodies, it drooled while flying.
Its mood gradually improved.
As it continued to fly, a milky white teleportation vortex suddenly appeared in front of it.
The vortex seemed somewhat familiar.
"No..."
It recognized it, struggled to avoid, but unfortunately, it was futile.
The summoning transmission was impossible to resist.
In a flash of white light, it disappeared from its original location.
"Ding! Host revival!"
Instantly, the ice sculpture shattered, and all the ice spears and swords flew backward.
This sudden scene startled Shi Canghan.
Dozens of disciples from the Profound Ice Sect, unable to dodge in time, were pierced through by the rebounding ice spears and swords.
As for Jiang Cheng, aside from his tattered clothes, there wasn’t a single wound on his body.
"Ah, looks like my long-concealed true power is going to be exposed again."
"No choice, I have to reveal myself, I’m a peerless expert."
Saying this, he decisively crushed the summoning talisman.
The people opposite stood blankly watching his performance, not sure whether what he said was true or false.
If it’s true, then he was as weak as a spring chicken when he was killed by the array just now.
If it’s false, then how is he still alive and well after such a heavy attack with not a single injury?
Even for a Spirit Platform Realm, that’s impossible!
Before they could react, a crisp cracking sound came from above.
Crash!
Rumble!
The protective shield formed by the Sect Protection Array shattered like an eggshell.
Countless ice spikes fell, and without the array’s control, they attacked indiscriminately, covering all disciples below.
It was as if the sky was falling.
"No..."
"Help!"
This kind of attack, though overwhelming, was still very manageable by those at the Gathering Yuan Realm.
However, most of the disciples present were still at the Energy-Introducing Realm, this was a disaster for them.
Amidst the chaos, a mini version of the three-eyed white tiger appeared in front of Jiang Cheng once more.
This made him feel it was somewhat coincidental, didn’t expect to summon it again.
"Damn, it’s you again!"
After the appearance of the three-eyed tiger, it didn’t attack the Profound Ice Sect immediately, but roared furiously at Jiang Cheng.
Just thinking about it pissed it off.
It had flown for a whole day and night, traveling ten million miles, only for a white light to pull it back to the start.
Anyone would want to vomit blood.
"Cough, cough!"
Brother Cheng was also a bit embarrassed and could only change the subject.
With a wave of his long sword, he directly pointed at the chaotic and panic-stricken Sect Leader of the Profound Ice Sect.
"Let’s settle business, take them down!"
With these words, an irresistible task appeared in the mind of the three-eyed tiger.
"Damn, have to work for this brat again!"
It cursed while launching an attack on everyone in the Profound Ice Sect.
"Activate the array!"
Shi Canghan only managed to utter these two words before he was ripped apart by an aerial claw swipe from the three-eyed tiger.
The spirit array in the distant mountains hadn’t even activated before it, along with the mountain itself, was split into two.
The attack of this Tier Four Spirit Array was simply child’s play for the demon king.
Even though this was just a weakened, bankrupt version of the demon king.
"Ah!"
"Impossible!"
"What kind of monster is this!"
The Profound Ice Sect disciples wanted to escape, but they couldn’t at all.
For the three-eyed tiger, this battle was many times easier than the last.
Because the Profound Ice Sect had gathered all their disciples together, it only needed to swipe its claw thrice to resolve the entire scene.
The first swipe took down the Sect Leader and elders.
The second swipe dismantled the array.
The third swipe eliminated everyone else.
After three swipes, the Profound Ice Sect was completely wiped out.
Task completed, the restriction in the three-eyed tiger’s mind disappeared.
It immediately charged towards Jiang Cheng with rage, baring its teeth.
"Don’t summon carelessly if you don’t have a return talisman!"
"Do you know how exhausting it is for Master Tiger to make a trip?"
"I warn you, stop fooling around, or else..."

chapters.title: Chapter 27: Wholeheartedly Seeking Peace
chapters.content:
Chapter 27: Chapter 27: Wholeheartedly Seeking Peace
Editor:
EndlessFantasy Translation
The Three-Eyed Tiger thought for a moment; it didn’t seem to have any way to threaten this brat.
As the summoned creature, it couldn’t harm Jiang Cheng.
This rendered its harsh words powerless, which was very frustrating.
And Jiang Cheng was exceedingly ’considerate.’
"Big boss, if you find it too troublesome, you can totally stay with us!"
"Let me introduce our sect to you. It’s a place with beautiful mountains and rivers, and people are exceptionally hospitable!"
"This way, you can spare yourself from the toil of traveling. Why not?"
The Three-Eyed Tiger almost exploded in anger, roaring furiously.
"Stay away from me!"
Jiang Cheng’s thoughts weren’t difficult to guess.
This brat was daring, using it as cheap labor was one thing, but wanting it to stay as a free long-term worker?
Wishful thinking!
If not for the inability to retaliate, it would teach him how much cruelty is needed to spell the word ’death’!
Watching it flee hurriedly like escaping, Brother Cheng was quite dejected, like a scumbag brutally rejected by a goddess.
"Sigh, I had true feelings for the bright moon, only for the moon to illuminate a ditch!"
"Such a boiling passionate heart has been hurt, can only be soothed with Spirit Stone Elixirs."
After all, the Profound Ice Sect was also a sect with several thousand people, rich in reserves, almost comparable to the Extreme Moon Sect.
It also had a Spirit Vein.
With a busy half-day, after looting all the valuable items here, he decisively chose to exchange them all.
Points quickly reached 5800. Looking at it this way, upgrading didn’t seem too difficult.
Only then did Brother Cheng feel satisfied, flying up to the clouds.
Not until he left more than two hours later, did some loose cultivators wishing to scavenge come in successively.
Naturally, apart from those empty tiles and stones, they didn’t find a single hair.
How could Jiang Cheng, this human excavator, be famous for nothing?
Over ten thousand loose cultivators expressed their grief, once again denouncing the big boss who wiped out the Profound Ice Sect.
Too ruthless, this doesn’t meet the rules!
Logically, after destroying a sect, a big boss should be overjoyed with their harvest, right?
Shouldn’t they hand out some red envelopes to share the ’luck’?
Flying high in the sky, Jiang Cheng felt a chill on his back, as if countless people were cursing him.
Touching his devilishly handsome face, Brother Cheng felt a bit gloomy.
"Forget it, after all, a tall tree catches the wind; being too handsome invites hatred, which is normal."
Upon arriving at the Five Thunders Sect, they similarly put on a ready-for-battle stance.
Along the way, he didn’t use the transmission array, taking another two hours.
People of the Five Thunders Sect had already learned of the Profound Ice Sect’s demise from Sound Transmission Talismans and Transmission Spirit Artifacts, dare not to treat it lightly.
"Jiang Cheng, don’t bully others too much!"
The Sect Leader of the Five Thunders Sect, Huangfu Zidian, shouted with feigned bravado.
"Destroying two great sects... is a bit too vicious, isn’t it?"
Once these words fell, emotions ran high.
"Sect Master, why bother talking to him, this is the behavior of a demon!"
"Jiang Cheng, how do you have the face to live on this world!"
"Everyone would want to kill him!"
"Why aren’t you dead yet!"
Some people, with spiritual power added, spat out saliva shoots over ten meters; had Jiang Cheng not been standing afar, he would’ve been drenched.
Their logic was simply: you wipe out our sect, you’re a demon; as for our previous wiping out of your Feixian Sect...
Uh...
That was just a trivial matter.
Anyway, you’re unreasonable, we’re reasonable.
Huangfu Zidian was furious hearing his disciples’ vehement curses.
A bunch of pig teammates indeed.
Despite Jiang Cheng being merely Soul Splitting Realm Sixth Layer before him, inferior to his Ninth Layer, the two sects were undeniably obliterated.
Especially the Profound Ice Sect, even when they activated their great array, they couldn’t escape the same fate.
No need to guess, Jiang Cheng surely had a big killer.
Once the fight began, Five Thunders Sect wouldn’t fare differently.
He wanted not to die.
So actually, he wanted to talk it over with Jiang Cheng.
In essence, seeking peace.
Though the Five Thunders Sect also followed in destroying the Feixian Sect, he personally stabbed four Feixian Elders, and opportunistically seized nine rings of considerable resources.
Yet, with his tongue skillful enough to reverse black and white, he could possibly fool the kid around, changing the situation.
Unexpectedly, these disciples went into a frenzy as if on stimulants, all began cursing Jiang Cheng’s ancestors.
Please, we’re the ones who wiped their sect first, aren’t you overly righteous?
How can we negotiate in such a way?
"Seems your people want me dead, then come and kill me quickly!"
Being cursed to death didn’t anger Brother Cheng at all; he even hoped the intensity would increase.
"Dare not, dare not..."
Huangfu Zidian hurriedly smiled conciliatorily, while severely reprimanding his disciples.
"All of you quiet for this Sect Leader!"
"Sect Leader Jiang, I understand your revenge for Feixian Sect,"
"But common words say that it is better to resolve than embrace enmity."
"Those minor grievances with Feixian Sect, let them disappear like the wind!"
"More friends lead to more paths, right?"
He spoke so reasonably, even Jiang Cheng was taken aback.
Hey brother, Feixian Sect was wiped out clean, is that just minor grievances?
Plus, only a few days have passed, isn’t it a bit quick to laugh off enmity?
Huangfu Zidian continued elaborating.
"You’re not a disciple of Feixian Sect, but an outsider, right?"
"Their hatred doesn’t really concern you, you simply need a reason for a battle, don’t you?"
"How about this, from now on, our Five Thunders Sect will submit to your Feixian Sect."
"Thus, everyone becomes brothers, we are willing to be the vanguard for Feixian Sect in conquering Qinglan Prefecture..."
He thought quite beautifully.
Anyway, whether joining Red Sun Sect or Feixian Sect, it didn’t make a difference.
It’s all about finding a strong backer.
If Jiang Cheng was truly from another sect outside with ulterior motives, he might agree.
After all, those outside forces wouldn’t care about Feixian Sect’s hatred, only profit.
With the Five Thunders Sect as a pawn and pathfinder, it better serves their interest in conquering Qinglan Prefecture.
Unfortunately, Jiang Cheng was not.
He has no sect or family pressing him, no sect leader overbearing him, let alone any puppet master pulling strings behind.
Everything he did was based on his own will.
"You make quite a compelling argument, seems to make some sense."
Seeing Jiang Cheng indeed swayed, Huangfu Zidian was overjoyed.
"Sect Leader Jiang truly is a discerning and reasonable person..."
Jiang Cheng waved his hand, smiling widely.
"Since it sounds so reasonable, you should go underground and tell that to the former Feixian Sect Master and those elders."
"Persuade them, then I’ll agree."
Huangfu Zidian’s face shifted, rage surged.
Going underground, isn’t that being dead?
"You... You’re toying with me, damn you!"
The Spirit Sword flew out, Jiang Cheng launched his attack directly.

chapters.title: Chapter 28: Purple Origin Sacred Land
chapters.content:
Chapter 28: Chapter 28: Purple Origin Sacred Land
Editor:
EndlessFantasy Translation
"Attack!"
Seeing the persuasion fail, Huangfu Zidian could only go all out, initiating a counterattack.
As he spoke, he himself was retreating rapidly.
In the blink of an eye, he was behind all the disciples.
He didn’t expect to stop Jiang Cheng, just to stall and buy himself, the Sect Leader, a bit of time to escape.
Faced with the overwhelming attack from over seven thousand disciples, Jiang Cheng didn’t even grunt as he was pulverized to ashes.
Truly—pulverized to ashes!
Not a single hair was left.
What could be done, seven thousand people, with burning, freezing, lightning strikes, wind blades, and sword Qi...
Even adamantine would have been pulverized to dust.
As a result, many of the disciples at the back ended up attacking nothing but air.
Everyone looked at the scorched, thunderstruck, and mutilated open ground, exchanging confused glances.
"Is he dead?"
If the Five Thunders Sect had witnessed the destruction of the Extreme Moon Sect and the Profound Ice Sect, they wouldn’t be celebrating now.
But in those two battles, all participants perished, and no one could report back.
"Hahahahaha..."
Duanmu Zidian flew back to the front with the fastest speed once again.
He held his long sword aloft, laughing maniacally.
"What Jiang Cheng, not worth a strike!"
As he spoke, he couldn’t help but use his Divine Sense to scan the surroundings again.
Confirming that Jiang Cheng had not only turned to ashes, but that there wasn’t even a fluctuation of his Divine Soul left, he finally relaxed.
"This Sect Leader had anticipated that he’d be nothing more than this. Just now, I was deliberately using words to undermine and break him!"
The Elders secretly rolled their eyes, thinking how he had fled faster than anyone else, did he think they hadn’t seen it?
However, the disciples, clueless, all cheered.
"Sect Leader is wise and his calculations are marvelous!"
Duanmu Zidian was brimming with enthusiasm, his fighting spirit soaring.
"I’ve heard there are still remnants of Feixian Sect!"
"All Elders, heed the command, join me in subduing the rebels!"
The long sword was raised high, directing towards the direction of Feixian Sect.
"Kill!"
The scene was thunderous, the cries of slaughter deafening.
In the state of a soul, Jiang Cheng watched his performance speechlessly, suddenly feeling that his own thickness of skin needed more honing.
In the art of pretending, having a thick skin is essential.
Compared to someone like Duanmu Zidian, who was an old hand at deception, he still had much to learn.
"Ding, the host was killed. The system is analyzing the enemy’s strength to arrange a resurrection plan for the host."
"The host has received a summoning talisman, which can summon a randomly powerful helper to serve him once."
Jiang Cheng was so worn out that he couldn’t even complain anymore.
Here we go again?
Will it be the Three-Eyed Tiger again?
Can we get something new?
Thirty million miles away, at the Purple Origin Sacred Land, chaos was already rampant.
This Sacred Land, which had been passed down for hundreds of thousands of years, surpassed Feixian Sect countless times in terms of heritage and power.
But now, the Saint Heirs and Saintesses of the Sacred Land were panic-stricken, as if they had encountered a catastrophic disaster.
Just moments ago, the sect’s last restriction was forcibly broken by an external enemy.
The Master Zhenren was defeated in just one strike, coughing up blood and losing hundreds of years of Daoist practice.
This kind of formidable enemy was unheard of in the Purple Origin Sacred Land.
They all looked uneasily at the Supreme Elder in the sky.
The elder was an Ascending to Saint Realm giant fan, was also the biggest trump card of the Purple Origin Sacred Land, and had not appeared for over a thousand years.
With radiant splendor surging around, an elder in a robe recited true words.
"Oh, Tiger Demon, my Purple Origin Sacred Land and your Demon King’s race had an agreement—Great Demons and above shall not cross territories!"
"Are you really going to break the agreement and face the united assault of all Sacred Lands?"
Below, the Three-Eyed Tiger had already rushed into an ancient super long-distance teleportation array.
This time it didn’t choose to fly, but opted to use the teleportation array.
The distance of a teleportation array could vary, capable of transmitting several million miles in one go, or just hundreds of thousands in a short distance.
This way, it was faster than flying on its own.
All the way, it had been seizing teleportation arrays from the major sects and Sacred Lands, covering fifty million miles in a short time.
It was Jiang Cheng who forced it to this situation.
Due to cross-domain summoning, its power was suppressed by the Celestial Dao Rules numerous times. Originally, it feared being discovered by other Demon Kings and human Saint Realms, hoping to discreetly fly back.
But now, in order to return sooner, it finally threw caution to the wind.
Along the way, it caused chaos, leaving sects and Sacred Lands in a state of perpetual alarm.
As for teleportation arrays capable of a teleport of tens of millions of miles, it dared not hope for them.
There was no way; such places often had Saint Tiers guarding them.
With its current weakened state, what if it got captured and was made into a Sect Guardian Spirit Beast, or even worse, slain for its Demon Pill?
It paid no heed to the Supreme Elder’s intimidation above.
Indeed, Demon Kings had agreements with the Sacred Lands that Great Demons and above should not invade territories without permission.
But that agreement was made between the Demon Kings of the Thousand Spirit Domain and them; it didn’t belong to the Thousand Spirit Domain, but came from the Celestial Demon Domain!
"Scram!"
The Supreme Elder of the Purple Origin Sacred Land was Ascending to Saint Realm, meaning not yet at Saint Tier.
For an existence comparable to a Great Demon, a highly regarded Demon King wouldn’t take him seriously.
Even a weakened Demon King was still a Demon King, not something a Great Demon or Ascending to Saint Realm could challenge!
"Stubborn and ignorant!"
The Supreme Elder in the sky was enraged; he didn’t realize the Three-Eyed Tiger was merely borrowing the teleportation array to pass through.
He thought a calamitous disaster was behind this!
A long rainbow descended from the sky, with a sacred artifact duster transforming into a vast array of starry lights, instantly forming a giant net!
On the giant net, each strand carried a hint of world-destroying power.
It enclosed the Three-Eyed Tiger, whose body had returned to hundreds of meters long.
"Hahahaha..."
"Stay behind for me!"
The entire Sacred Land resonated with awe, and at that moment, the Supreme Elder maneuvering the giant net was a god in everyone’s eyes.
"To hell with you!"
With a tearing sound, all the cheers came to an abrupt halt.
The giant net shattered, its light dissipating and exploding the entire transfer hall and a hundred miles of the palace cluster into ruins.
The Supreme Elder felt as if struck by lightning, his tall figure suddenly shuddered, uncontrollably flying backward for ten thousand miles.
This time, everyone was scared out of their wits.
Those Saint Heirs and Saintesses fled faster than rabbits, as if the sky was collapsing.
"I’m going home!"
"Whoever blocks me is done for!"
The Three-Eyed Tiger was eager to hurry on its way, having no mood to annihilate them.
What’s more, hurrying was a must; an Outer Domain Demon King destroying a sect here would indeed provoke the pursuit of the Great Powers of the Thousand Spirit Domain.
The gains wouldn’t make up for the losses.
The light of the teleportation array ignited.
This time, it should be able to advance another twenty million miles!
In its three eyes was a yearning for its homeland...
It very much wished to return to its underground palace, warm in winter and cool in summer, where its large bed was so comfortable.
It also missed the Silver Frost Forest next door, the enticing and mellow voices of the Rabbit Little Demons seemed to echo vividly.
Ahead, there were no Rabbit Little Demons, but above, a white vortex appeared.
The vortex was so familiar.
As if engraved into its very being.
"Alright, here it goes again."
As this thought crossed its mind, it couldn’t be bothered to resist.

chapters.title: Chapter 29: Extremely Shameless
chapters.content:
Chapter 29: Chapter 29: Extremely Shameless
Editor:
EndlessFantasy Translation
A moment ago...
"Ding, the host has resurrected."
Jiang Cheng, who had been crushed and scattered, suddenly reappeared in the square of the Five Thunders Sect.
His body was flawless without a single wound, and the perfect physique of the Celestial Desolation Indestructible Body was completely revealed before everyone, even some parts were proportioned according to the Heavenly Dao.
There was a dead silence throughout the audience; everyone stared with their mouths wide open.
Not only was his resurrection incredibly miraculous, being reduced to nothing and still coming back to life.
But also because his body was so perfect, so perfect that the male disciples couldn’t even muster ridicule, leaving only jealousy, wishing they could once again crush him into dust.
There was no choice, the system only covers resurrection, not clothes restoration.
Brother Cheng quickly took out a piece of clothing from his Storage Ring and put it on, jokingly, these people didn’t even pay for the ticket, how can they see for free.
Already flown out, aiming to attack the Feixian Sect, Huangfu Zidian and other elders suddenly braked and turned back.
At first glance, they were collectively dumbfounded.
"How, how are you still alive?"
After he was just killed, Jiang Cheng heard their words.
He deliberately said; "I, the sect leader, was merely testing your sincerity in surrendering, seems like you’re quite arrogant!"
Huangfu Zidian shivered instantly, his face turning ashen.
Just now, he was quite sure Jiang Cheng was dead, believing the situation to be set, of course, he could act as fierce as he wanted.
Who knew, the tides would turn so fast?
Under such an attack, unharmed, even the Spirit Platform Realm couldn’t achieve that!
"Sect Leader Jiang, please pardon me, it wasn’t me who gave the order just now!"
He pointed his hand at the elders behind him, loudly distancing himself from them.
"They acted on their own, I didn’t even have time to stop them!"
He then angrily cursed at the disciples.
"And them!"
"They disobeyed orders, disregarded my strict commands, acted without permission, I beg Sect Leader Jiang to punish them for me!"
Now, those elders couldn’t stand it; they no longer had any respect for the sect leader.
"Huangfu Zidian, you despicable scoundrel!"
"Sect Leader Jiang, please pardon me, it was all on his instigation!"
"He even forced us to attack the Feixian Sect, we refused to the death, this villain actually threatened our families’ lives!"
"We never thought of being enemies with Sect Leader Jiang..."
Jiang Cheng was impressed, completely impressed.
The way of thick-skinnedness, immense and profound, turns out so many predecessors have paved the way ahead of me.
The road is long and far, I still have so much to learn!
Unfortunately, it’s not convenient here, otherwise, I’d want to jot down their quotes in a small notebook for nightly review and reinforcement.
"Can’t you hurry up?"
The little three-eyed white tiger, already on the scene, boredly stretched out its plump short leg, brushing the tuft of gold fur on its head.
Without Jiang Cheng’s command, its early action was for nothing.
Due to its small size, and this time Jiang Cheng was lazy to emit any presence during its entry, so nobody noticed it.
Seeing its disheartened and resentful eyes...
Jiang Cheng suddenly felt a bit of sympathy for it, switch places with anyone else, being tormented like this time and again would be unbearable.
The dog system gives only one-time summons, since it’s needed every time, why not simply make it his Spirit Beast mount?
Brother Cheng is quite helpful, this would also save the three-eyed tiger from the hassle of travel.
Three-Eyed Tiger: Meow meow meow, what did you say?
Jiang Cheng waved his hand: "Annihilate them."
Buzz!
The three-eyed tiger didn’t even move, just an imperceptible divine soul wave emitted from its body, covering all directions without a dead angle.
The whole scene seemed as if nothing had happened.
second later.
Whoosh!
From the sky like rain, whether Huangfu Zidian, those elders, or those seven thousand disciples, all fell out of thin air.
They appeared unscathed on the surface but completely lifeless, dead as a doornail.
Not only was the Sea of Consciousness destroyed by the three-eyed tiger’s soul wave, but even their Qi Sea Meridians, not revivable even by Daluo Immortals.
This stunt refreshed Jiang Cheng’s understanding of the three-eyed tiger’s power.
This big shot is a bit too powerful, isn’t it?
"Since you could solve it so easily with just a thought, why did it have to be so bloody and troublesome the first two times?"
The three-eyed tiger blew a breath on its paw, said faintly: "That sort of scene is more impressive, satisfied now?"
Damn, turns out you’re also a King Bi.
"Big shot, look, going back and forth is such a hassle, settling down is the wisest choice..."
"Hey hey, big shot, don’t rush leaving!"
The three-eyed tiger refused to talk to him, even flying faster.
"Come play again next time!"
Jiang Cheng waved his hand, reluctance filled his eyes as he bade farewell to the big shot.
Boom!
Just flown afar, the three-eyed tiger crashed into a mountain.
After completely ransacking the Five Thunders Sect and redeeming some stuff, Jiang Cheng’s points finally broke ten thousand, reaching twelve thousand.
Opened the panel, he unhesitatingly chose to level up.
Each resurrection per day means one more chance to act like a King Bi!
Revisiting the system panel, stats had changed.
Level: 3
Points: 0/100000
Available Points: 2547
Current Skills: Able to resurrect 3 times daily (non-cumulative), resurrect and can defeat the enemy.
Subordinate Skills: Host can consume points to forcibly elevate another target by one Great Realm, target number is 1, cooldown period is 1 month.
What!
Reading the description of the next level skills, Jiang Cheng’s jaw almost dropped.
Elevating another person by one Great Realm, so, I could forcibly turn someone from Soul Splitting Realm First Layer into Spirit Platform Realm First Layer?
What if I elevate someone from Daoist Palace Realm to Ascending to Saint Realm?
Elevate the three-eyed tiger, could it turn into something even stronger than the Demon King?
If I keep elevating the same person, doing it once every month?
This skill is too BUG!
Don’t mind the cooldown period being a whole month, for high-tier Great Powers, time is measured in centuries and millennia.
One month, really isn’t much.
However, the points to level up to the next level have indeed increased tenfold, turning into a hundred thousand.
At the same time, the system chimed another notification.
"Level up to Level 3, Level 2 Lottery unlocked!"
Level 2 Lottery?
What’s that supposed to mean?
Turned out my previous lottery was just elementary?
The system was quite haughty, not providing him any explanation.
But Brother Cheng had some experience now, cautiously opening the lottery interface, he scanned and observed carefully, finally discovering a line of tiny text almost blended with the background in the lower left corner of the lottery panel.
’Level 2 Lottery costs 10,000 points each time.’
"Damn you!"
"I knew this dog system was up to no good, plotting to rob Brother’s points!"
Jiang Cheng couldn’t hold back, thinking Level 2 Lottery was some great news!
Turned out it was just a trap for points!
Once costing ten thousand, was the system a mountain bandit in its past life?
However, after calming down, he somewhat understood a pattern.
Level 2 Mall, should offer some Tier Two skills, right?
No wonder it previously said the transmission was Tier One, requiring upgrades.
It had to be obtained from here.
Seeing this, I need points even more.
"Saving points, a real grind, feels like a corporate slave!"
Perhaps since the thunder in the sky was napping, otherwise, hearing this statement might have struck him uncontrollably.
If this counts as bitter, then what are those cultivators who spend years and months to barely advance a small realm?

chapters.title: Chapter 30: Attacking the Air
chapters.content:
Chapter 30: Chapter 30: Attacking the Air
Editor:
EndlessFantasy Translation
Seeing that it was still early, and having just upgraded with an extra resurrection, Brother Cheng decided to take a trip to the Celestial Flame Sect.
Scoring points with these sects is the easiest because they hold grudges against Feixian Sect, and their self-destructive provocations aren’t considered suicide.
An hour later, Jiang Cheng appeared at the Celestial Flame Sect.
As usual, thousands of people were gathered, filled with murderous intent.
Having seen the same scene twice, he was getting a bit bored.
Just as he was about to draw his sword and get it over with, he noticed that the Celestial Flame Sect Leader, Sha Tai, was saying nothing and sitting among the guests instead.
Beside him, an old man in a blue robe at the Spirit Platform Realm slowly flew out.
"I am Fei Tongzhuo, Inner Sect Elder of the Red Sun Sect, and you must be Jiang Cheng?"
Red Sun Sect?
Jiang Cheng was aware of them, being one of the two top forces in Qinglan Prefecture.
However, that’s about all he knew.
"So, are you here to stand up for the Celestial Flame Sect?"
He didn’t know that the destruction of Feixian Sect was orchestrated by the Red Sun Sect behind the scenes.
Some backstage conspiracies, like those involving Ji Linghan and Luo Yuan, were beyond the reach of ordinary disciples.
So right now, Jiang Cheng wasn’t sure if this elder was an enemy of Feixian Sect.
He could only probe for more information.
"Indeed!"
Fei Tongzhuo’s voice echoed like two belligerent claps of thunder.
Some lower-cultivation disciples in the rear were dizzy, almost unable to stand firm.
"I ask you, who sent you!"
"Speak the truth now!"
Even though three sects had been wiped out, Fei Tongzhuo still looked down on Jiang Cheng, displaying his authority, full of confidence.
The reason was simple, he believed Jiang Cheng was sent by a certain power from neighboring areas to disrupt the situation.
The destruction of those three sects, the Red Sun Sect could have accomplished that.
In his view, Jiang Cheng was nothing, but the experts lurking in the shadows were the ones truly responsible for those sects’ downfall.
And such forces, the Red Sun Sect was fully capable of dealing with and speaking to as equals.
He, as a Spirit Platform Realm Elder, had nothing to fear.
Jiang Cheng nearly burst into laughter, this old guy really thought too highly of himself, like he was conducting an interrogation.
"Judging by your attitude, it looks like the Red Sun Sect had a hand in Feixian Sect’s downfall too?"
Fei Tongzhuo impatiently waved his robe sleeve dismissively.
"You ask the obvious, why bother with such nonsense!"
"My patience is limited, if you don’t reveal the mastermind behind you, I’ll strike you down, giving your sect a warning!"
With that, the Spirit Sword behind him unsheathed and circled Jiang Cheng once.
So you admit you’re culprits too, that’s good!
Brother Cheng sighed for Feixian Sect, what a tough break.
If it weren’t for him, they might never get their revenge.
On the other hand, he was already calculating how many points the Red Sun Sect was worth.
"Then come and kill me."
"Better make it quick, I can hardly wait."
Saying that, he stretched out his neck closer, even pointing to his own throat.
In any case, you have to die once before showing off, he’s become quite adept at it now.
"You, what do you mean?"
This voluntary desire for death left Fei Tongzhuo puzzled.
Even as a decoy or pawn, a person only has one life, no one would willingly seek death, right?
Could it be a trap?
He has a high-tier bursting spirit array strapped to him, if my sword contacts him, he’ll explode?
"You think I’d fall for it?" he mocked coldly.
At this moment, he was caught up in the same paranoid state as Qi Gaohong and the others before.
Jiang Cheng was at a loss for words.
These old geezers, always scheming, planning every move, contemplating ten steps ahead, but when it comes down to it they’re so slow to act.
"Forget it, I knew relying on you was futile."
With that, he charged forward with his sword.
Seeing him charge, Fei Tongzhuo naturally counterattacked.
He was at the Third Layer of the Spirit Platform Realm, a whole Great Realm above Jiang Cheng.
In this counterattack, Jiang Cheng was unsurprisingly killed.
Looking at the corpse on the ground, Fei Tongzhuo felt no joy of victory, rather he was caught off guard.
So this kid really sought death on his own?
How stupid could he be?
Then how did those previous three sects get wiped out?
"Come out, all of you!"
He shouted towards the surrounding mountains, his voice echoing everywhere!
"No more hiding, I know where you are!"
In Fei Tongzhuo’s view, there must be a group of experts lurking behind Jiang Cheng.
Now that Jiang Cheng was dead, they should reveal themselves.
"What, are you not daring to show yourselves with me here?"
While shouting, he sent massive sword qi towards the distant mountain ranges.
Boom, boom, boom!
One peak after another was flattened, temple after temple blasted away.
Under this blanket bombardment, nothing could hide, not even ants.
However, apart from some startled or slain birds and beasts, there wasn’t a single human in the mountains.
All the disciples exchanged puzzled glances.
No way, could an esteemed Spirit Platform Realm Elder have made such a mistake?
For an elder sent by a superior sect to guide their work...
After all the effort, to have judged wrong and acted against thin air was intensely humiliating.
"Ding, host has been slain, system analyzing enemy strength, arranging resurrection plan for host."
"Host has received one Summoning Talisman, which can summon a random powerful helper to assist once."
Can’t we switch with a healing potion?
Even Jiang Cheng was fed up.
But there was no choice, without using the summoning talisman, resurrecting would be pointless, he’d just get killed again.
This is today’s last resurrection chance, no option left.
"Ding, host resurrected."
He crushed the summoning talisman.
Beneath the distant glacier, thousands of miles deep, where spiritual patterns densely covered, brilliance flowed.
Below those complex patterns, the Three-Eyed Tiger lay with eyes closed, without a flicker of spiritual power pulsating through its body.
If someone could come here now, they might mistake it for a dead body.
As a Demon King, it had many tricks up its sleeve.
After leaving the Five Thunders Sect, it arrived here and arranged a Sealing Spirit Altar.
Now the entire glacier stretching thousands of miles had become bleak due to the altar, as if it had turned into another Forbidden Land.
In addition, it had set a hidden restriction beneath the altar.
In fact, even if someone could break in here, they wouldn’t see it; even using Divine Sense to probe would only show ordinary underground scenes.
Finally, it restrained its spiritual energy completely, forcing itself into a death-like state.
It didn’t believe this could still summon it away.
For the time being, it decided not to return to the Celestial Demon Domain, just sleep here for a year or two.
During this time, with that kid’s knack for stirring trouble, he’d likely encounter countless crises.
If he got killed, that would be perfect; Master Tiger would be completely set free.
If he summoned another Demon King, that would also disrupt the current rhythm, maybe he’d summon others from then on.
Ideally, he’d keep summoning that Frost Rabbit King woman, and once she never returns, Master Tiger could ’visit’ the Rabbit Race and swagger around.
Under the restriction, its breathing had already stopped, the Divine Soul fluctuating ever weaker.
Just before entering a deep sleep, it indulged in a little daydream about the alluring figures of the Rabbit Little Demons, hoping for a pleasant dream during this sleep.
Master Tiger was someone who knew how to enjoy life, even now it could find pleasure amidst hardship.
Then it was forced to open its eyes by an intense white light.

chapters.title: Chapter 31: The Scheming of the 3-Eyed Tiger
chapters.content:
Chapter 31: Chapter 31: The Scheming of the 3-Eyed Tiger
Editor:
EndlessFantasy Translation
Fei Tongzhuo also realized he was targeting the air.
However, as a dignified Elder, his ability to dissolve embarrassment was top-notch.
After a mad flurry of attacks, he elegantly flew back to the top of the hall.
"Under this Elder’s attack, those foreign enemies have fled underground!"
"If I weren’t worried about them luring the tiger out of the mountain and you being wiped out, this Elder would pursue them to the Nine Netherworld to destroy them!"
The Sect Leader and Elders of the Celestial Flame Sect weren’t fools; they could clearly see he was covering up his recent misjudgment.
There weren’t any other enemies; you could rest easy, sir.
Despite cursing internally, they still had to agree outwardly.
"Yes, yes, the Elder truly planned flawlessly!"
"Such careful consideration!"
"Luckily, our Celestial Flame Sect has the protection of the Red Sun Sect..."
Looking at the mountains blasted apart, everyone couldn’t help but want to cough up blood.
Those peaks surrounded the main peak, each one very important, housing halls or major spirit arrays’ hubs, all now destroyed.
Rebuilding them would take an unknown amount of time and effort.
Before the enemies even came to wipe us out, did you just give us a demonstration of how it’s done?
At this moment, Jiang Cheng finally resurrected.
"How, how is he not dead!"
Sect Leader Sha Tai of the Celestial Flame Sect was the first to see Jiang Cheng, previously supposed to be dead, rise again.
"What?"
Fei Tongzhuo suddenly turned around, looking like he was suffering a serious digestive problem.
Spent all day targeting the air, yet the first person he personally killed actually didn’t die; his reputation was gone.
"Begin."
The Three-Eyed Tiger spoke weakly.
It felt like it was being forced to act, struggling couldn’t resist.
Given the situation, it would rather comply.
"Get rid of them."
Jiang Cheng also sighed, expressing ’sympathy’ for its ordeal.
The Three-Eyed Tiger accepted the order, and a wave of divine soul spread out in all directions.
The world grew quiet.
Fei Tongzhuo, Spirit Platform Realm Fourth Layer, was no different from others, all overwhelmed thoroughly in soul and meridian and Qi Sea, without so much as a groan.
Afterward, Jiang Cheng rarely thanked it.
"Hey, big guy, you worked hard."
"Truth is, I didn’t want this either..."
Though the Three-Eyed Tiger was sure to roar in anger again, it couldn’t hurt him and he had nothing to fear.
But to his surprise, this time the Three-Eyed Tiger didn’t get angry.
It merely sighed again, then slowly flew to Jiang Cheng face to face.
"Buddy! You honestly tell me, how many summoning talismans do you have?"
"Also, can’t you summon a different demon?"
"Why is it always me every time?"
Being tossed around like this, it was already out of temper, just feeling resigned.
"The Golden Dragon King isn’t strong? The War Monkey King isn’t fierce? Isn’t the Frost Rabbit King alluring and charming?"
"Can’t you spread attention evenly?"
Jiang Cheng had no idea why it always assigned it, that was the system’s arrangement.
He could only make up a false reason.
"Because you are as handsome as me, maybe attracted by similar charm!"
The originally endlessly complaining Three-Eyed Tiger shut up.
It carefully scrutinized Jiang Cheng for the first time.
Couldn’t deny, this guy was indeed handsome.
So handsome that neither the Human nor Demon Race’s standards could find fault.
However, the so-called attraction due to similar charm wasn’t believable.
It did find a similar trait in Jiang Cheng.
Shamelessness.
"Though you have a keen eye, but you know the handsomer the demon, the busier it is. This King deals with countless affairs, many important matters await my handling..."
Plenty of Rabbit Little Demons await my ’attention’ indeed.
"Can you cause less trouble, not summon me without reason?"
If anyone heard its words, their understanding would be questioned.
Demons were known for brutality and ferocity, keen on fighting and destruction.
Yet here a Demon King sincerely advised a human to keep calm, quite odd.
"This, really isn’t under my control."
"It’s irresistible force..."
"Forget it."
Without waiting for him to finish, the Three-Eyed Tiger shook its head to leave, its small figure exuding a sense of lonely nostalgia.
At this moment, Jiang Cheng did feel somewhat sorry.
Think about it, one as a Demon King, likely very busy with affairs, every moment was critical.
Unaware, the Tiger Race wouldn’t notice his absence.
In fact, without him, there’d be less chaos.
Moreover, this time the Three-Eyed Tiger hadn’t flown far.
It reckoned Jiang Cheng had many summoning talismans, would certainly summon it again.
Yet due to system rules, the summoned couldn’t hurt Jiang Cheng, nor threaten him for the talismans.
So...
Its eyes rolled, ultimately deciding to target Jiang Cheng’s peers instead.
After cleaned out Celestial Flame Sect, the points reached 6600.
Staring at the points, Brother Cheng seemed like a farmer after a year’s hard labor, wiped non-existent sweat off his forehead.
"Behind every point, lies unfathomable effort and toil from outsiders."
Making such shameless exclamations, he activated the transmission.
Whoosh, vanished from sight.
Not far off, always watching secretly, the Three-Eyed Tiger’s central eye nearly popped out.
Where’d the kid go?
Feixian Sect and Celestial Flame Sect lacked transmission arrays.
However, the Duanmu Family and Red Sun Sect had them.
Though distance didn’t compare to the stronger sects in Feiyun State.
But the issue was, Jiang Cheng didn’t use a transmission array.
The Three-Eyed Tiger could swear, that wasn’t flying since it couldn’t move that fast.
Instant teleportation was impossible, too; its range was less than 100 kilometers.
Teleport himself?
That was preposterous, even this Demon King didn’t possess such divine techniques.
Mere Soul Splitting Sixth Layer, how was it possible?
Still, even if you’ve teleported away, Master Tiger would dig out your lair!
Initially, it planned to stealthily follow Jiang Cheng, locate his peers to use them for leverage.
Now that he’s lost, it’s no problem.
With divine soul unleashed, in moments all Qinglan Prefecture fell under its perception.
In that moment, countless beings in Qinglan Prefecture felt an inexplicable sense of being observed.
A moment of panic for the Spirit Platform Realm experts in the Duanmu Family and Red Sun Sect, cold sweat trickling down their backs.
Yet those with low cultivation only wore puzzled faces gazing skyward.
"Finally found you!"
"Wait for me, grandmaster!"
Having seen Jiang Cheng, the Three-Eyed Tiger grinned maliciously.
When it stormed menacingly to Feixian Sect, Jiang Cheng was already deeply immersed in the disciples’ adulation.
"My heavens, Sect Leader really wiped out three sects in one day?"
"That’s truly astonishing, what power!"
"With Sect Leader here, why fear Feixian Sect won’t prosper?"

chapters.title: Chapter 32: Walking Into a Trap
chapters.content:
Chapter 32: Chapter 32: Walking Into a Trap
Editor:
EndlessFantasy Translation
A certain disciple hugged Brother Cheng’s leg tightly.
"I’m confessing, actually I’ve admired the Sect Leader for a long time..."
Yin Xiaoxue stomped on his face and kicked him away.
"Get lost! The Sect Leader is mine!"
"Um..."
Ji Linghan, who had been quietly watching them, cleared her throat and sweetly smiled.
"Junior Brother Lang, Junior Sister Yin, some words should not be spoken carelessly."
Her voice was still soft, but her calm eyes inexplicably held a hint of menace, making Brother Cheng feel a bit of danger.
The disciples felt a chill all over, and Yin Xiaoxue quickly released her hands from Jiang Cheng’s neck.
She also let go of her legs and got down to the ground from him.
"Uh, Senior Sister, please, please..."
Joking aside, the disciples’ admiration and worship of him grew daily, which was a fact.
No choice, his power had already surpassed their imagination.
Moreover, he avenged their sect’s destruction and gave them Spiritual Artifacts. How could they not like such a new boss?
Just as he was about to let them go cultivate, Ah Huang ran over excitedly to report her accomplishment.
"Mama, mama, this little kitty just broke in, and I caught it."
Her two pigtails swung back and forth, and her flushed face was full of expressions saying, "Praise me quickly."
"Ah, good daughter, well done..."
Jiang Cheng casually started saying, but his jaw almost dropped in shock.
What Ah Huang held by the neck wasn’t some little kitty at all, it was clearly the Three-Eyed Fierce Tiger King!
Even in its miniaturized form, it was still a Demon King.
Holy crap, how did you bring it here?
If it conjured a fierce thought, the entire Feixian Sect would be left with only him alive.
Just like any other parent seeing kids playing with fire or electricity, he was about to shout "Be careful, put down that dangerous item," when he realized there was no Spiritual Power fluctuation on the Three-Eyed Tiger.
The Three-Eyed Tiger may have been jinxed recently, suffering from bad luck.
It barely reached Feixian Sect and was sensed by Ah Huang.
Its Spiritual Qi was instantly depleted, yet it still possessed a robust Divine Soul.
To be honest, it still could stir up trouble.
But the next instant it was caught by the neck by Ah Huang, sealing its Divine Soul upon contact.
The grand Demon King couldn’t overcome the Power of Rules from the World Heart Fragment.
It was in tears, having become harmless in Ah Huang’s hands like a kitten.
The female disciples weren’t aware of the truth, seeing the appearance of the Three-Eyed Tiger as incredibly cute, and gathered around automatically.
"Wow, such a cute little kitty..."
"Hey, hey, isn’t this a little tiger?"
"Yeah, three eyes; it should be a Demon Beast, right?"
"Demon Beast, but it doesn’t have any Spiritual Power."
In just a few seconds, the Three-Eyed Tiger was being petted nonstop by seven or eight female disciples.
The grand Demon King!
What a disgrace!
Yet, under the eaves, one must bow the head.
Especially with Jiang Cheng casting a suspicious gaze nearby.
Brother Cheng wasn’t foolish; he could easily see through the creature’s intentions.
It probably wasn’t carrying good intentions.
How should he handle it?
Kill it?
Considering the Three-Eyed Tiger helped him win four splendid battles, it contributed greatly, he was indeed a bit reluctant.
But leaving it alone wasn’t an option.
"You all be careful, it’s a powerful Demon Beast, very fierce!"
Watching this group of female disciples pet from head to toe, he was both amused and exasperated.
Haven’t you heard you shouldn’t mess with a tiger’s behind?
If this goes on, the Three-Eyed Tiger will surely be fumed with anger.
Although Ah Huang could subdue it...
"Ah? Does the Sect Leader know this Demon Beast?" Yin Xiaoxue retracted her hand, asking curiously.
"Yes, it’s my yet-to-be-tamed Spirit Pet, full of fierceness."
Jiang Cheng’s introduction hit the Three-Eyed Tiger.
"You’re the Spirit Pet, your whole family are Spirit Pets!" it shouted angrily.
The female disciples gasped again.
"Wow, it can actually speak?"
"Its voice is a bit old and not very pleasant."
"A bit of fierceness is fine, I know well how to tame small animals."
Ji Linghan, as the senior sister, stood up first to relieve the Sect Leader of his troubles.
They saw her wipe her Storage Ring, and a small silver cage appeared out of thin air.
Three-Eyed Tiger: ???
Brother Cheng: ???
Hey, why would you carry a cage with you?
"I’ll fight you all!"
The Three-Eyed Tiger was about to collapse; being caged would ruin its reputation forever!
Jiang Cheng knew that if it were freed in the future, it would inevitably seek revenge.
"Okay, okay, let me talk to it."
"Pshaw, just you?"
Despite being caught by Ah Huang, the Three-Eyed Tiger still showed the aloofness of a Demon King.
"Show some respect."
"You think you’re worthy?"
The Three-Eyed Tiger sneered, disdainful of such Soul Splitting Realm trash.
"So you’re unwilling to submit?"
"Get lost! Demons can be killed but not humiliated!"
"Alright, since you’re so bold and righteous, I won’t force the demon to be in distress."
Jiang Cheng waved his hand.
"Ah Huang, strangle it then, we’ll avoid insulting it."
Upon hearing the first half of the sentence, the Three-Eyed Tiger thought he had found his conscience.
Upon hearing the second half, it immediately panicked.
It didn’t have Jiang Cheng’s resurrection ability; death meant true death.
"No, no, bro, bro, let’s talk nicely..."
Everyone covered their faces; this Tiger Demon changed its stance too fast!
"Why are you doing this?"
Jiang Cheng chuckled gleefully; this really was an unexpected gain.
If it were outside, he could never have subdued the Three-Eyed Tiger. But here it came begging for capture.
"What I want you to do is very simple..."
The Three-Eyed Tiger interrupted him.
"Let me state first, being a Spirit Pet or mount is impossible!"
"If it comes to that, I’d rather die!"
After speaking, it closed its eyes, indeed making a heroic and unyielding appearance.
Brother Cheng looked it up and down for a moment, unsure if it was just putting on a show.
But it didn’t matter.
To be honest, he had no need for Spirit Pets; he relied on the system to show off anyway.
"Be the Sect Guardian Spirit Beast for three years."
Finished?
That’s it?
The Three-Eyed Tiger waited for him to make exorbitant demands, as it understood the predicament of being under a roof.
It was ready to be fleeced hard by this guy.
And that’s it?
"Are you sure?"
Just three years?
It had lived for tens of thousands of years; three years to it was a mere fleeting moment, practically nothing.
As for Celestial Demon Domain, whether absent for three years or even thirty years didn’t make much difference.
Being a Sect Guardian Spirit Beast didn’t require a slave contract; it merely needed to protect the sect from external invasion.
"What, do you find it too lenient? We can make changes."
"No, no, these harsh conditions, I’ll reluctantly agree!"
Both sides quickly reached an agreement.
Jiang Cheng had his reasons for choosing such lenient terms.
He himself feared nothing, but the sect’s power was really too weak; all the disciples were in the Gathering Yuan Realm.
Couldn’t always rely on Ah Huang.
It served as a layer of safety for the headquarters.
As for only choosing three years, with Brother Cheng’s rapid rise, they likely wouldn’t need the Three-Eyed Tiger to bolster their reputation after three years.
Once the agreement was made, Ah Huang released the Restriction, and the Three-Eyed Tiger finally recovered its Spiritual Power and Divine Soul.

chapters.title: Chapter 33 Recruiting Disciples
chapters.content:
Chapter 33: Chapter 33 Recruiting Disciples
Editor:
EndlessFantasy Translation
"Hahaha, kid, you’ll regret this!"
Once freed, the Three-Eyed Tiger started acting up again.
"You think making me a Sect Guardian Spirit Beast is a good thing?"
"I’ll make your place a mess. Just you wait!"
Jiang Cheng glanced at it, looking at it like it’s a fool, letting it amuse itself beside him.
Anyway, as long as it can protect these disciples at critical moments, that’s enough.
The next day, Jiang Cheng cultivated all night and advanced to the Soul Splitting Seventh Layer.
This Celestial Desolation Indestructible Body is just too powerful, upgrading feels like riding a rocket.
Opening the system panel, he found his points had increased by 320.
As a points slave, Brother Cheng remembered the points numbers very clearly.
"What’s going on? The system didn’t prompt anything."
He opened the records and finally understood.
Ji Linghan had advanced from Gathering Essence Eighth Layer to Ninth Layer last night, rewarded with 300 points.
Luo Yuan advanced from Gathering Essence Sixth Layer to Seventh Layer, rewarded with 20 points.
So when his disciples level up, he also receives points rewards?
But the points reward disparity is too huge, isn’t it?
Both advanced one small realm, yet there’s a 15-fold difference between them!
Jiang Cheng rubbed his chin, understanding it.
Ji Linghan’s talent far exceeds Luo Yuan’s, the system determines she’s more valuable, so the reward is higher.
His thoughts started to become lively.
If there were more disciples like this, thousands and thousands, wouldn’t he be able to earn a lot of points while lying down?
He quickly gathered everyone together.
"Alright, now we have the Sect Guardian Spirit Beast, we should consider recruiting new disciples to expand the sect’s scale."
Originally worried that the sect was unsafe, recruiting too many people might not be protected and would harm them instead.
Now without this worry, it can be put on the agenda.
"Sect Leader wants to recruit newcomers, I wonder what requirements there are?"
Everyone also felt that indeed some manpower was needed, the mountain gate was so large, having only 20 or so people didn’t look like a sect.
"My requirements aren’t high, new disciples should have True Disciple level talent and bones, that’s all."
Jiang Cheng said it as if it were a matter of course.
But except for Ji Linghan, all disciples felt like their hearts had been shot with an arrow.
Isn’t this considered not high?
They themselves were True Disciples before.
Jiang Cheng now talks about this level as if it were commonplace, truly too hurtful.
Luo Yuan clutched his chest and smiled bitterly.
"True Disciple is probably not so easy to recruit, ah!"
He remembered when he joined back then, thousands of youths gathered under the Feixian Sect for entry assessment.
In the end, only 105 successfully entered.
Of those 105, 90 had average talents and could only become Outer Disciples.
And 13 who had good talent were chosen to be Inner Disciples, making many onlookers green with envy.
That batch had only two True Disciples, one of which was him.
And that year was indeed still a batch with relatively good disciple quality, sometimes a whole batch wouldn’t even produce one True Disciple, which was quite normal.
The reason geniuses are geniuses is precisely because they are rare.
"Our Feixian Sect’s aim is quality over quantity."
Jiang Cheng had his own calculations.
He knew Luo Yuan’s talent was already quite good, after all, he was a True Disciple.
But even he only got 20 points, so what about ordinary Inner Disciples? Outer Disciples?
Afraid that advancing a small realm, even 1 point would be hard to get.
Recruiting too many such disciples is meaningless, it might even be counterproductive.
After all, cultivating disciples also requires consuming Spirit Stones and Elixirs.
If earned is less than spent in the end, it’s meaningless.
The news that Feixian Sect is recruiting disciples soon spread throughout Qinglan Prefecture.
The news originally spread slowly due to the small number of people, but now Feixian Sect is too popular, even overturning four sects, any little rumor would cause an uproar.
For a while, many people were eager to try.
Feixian Sect is powerful now, extinguishing four sects in two days, there’s a vague trend to become the third pole of Qinglan Prefecture.
Following such a big tree, it’s good to enjoy the shade.
Moreover, everyone knows Feixian Sect is currently short on people, doesn’t that just mean newcomers could share more cultivation resources after joining?
But after seeing the recruitment standards, many people’s hearts sank.
This recruitment is limited to True Disciple level only.
"Is Feixian Sect crazy?"
"Who recruits disciples like this?"
"Only recruiting True Disciples, do they think that level is everywhere?"
