"Even Duanmu Family and Red Sun Sect don’t have such high standards."
While the outside world was in heated discussion, another big news spread.
Due to Fei Tongzhuo being killed and four affiliated sects being extinguished, Red Sun Sect is furious!
It demands Feixian Sect’s Sect Leader Jiang Cheng and all disciples, to kneel and apologize at Red Sun Sect and submit within three days.
Otherwise, Red Sun Sect will invade with its army and annihilate Feixian Sect!
With this, the outside world became even less optimistic about Feixian Sect.
Although Feixian Sect wiped out four sects, Red Sun Sect could do such things too.
And Red Sun Sect has as many as thirty thousand people, being the dominating giant of Qinglan Prefecture for tens of thousands of years, its accumulated prestige is too deep.
No one thought these 20-something people at Feixian Sect could match them.
"Unless the force behind Jiang Cheng shows up, otherwise they’ll be crushed this time."
"As for recruiting disciples, who dares to go now?"
"Of course, what if after joining you’re extinguished, wouldn’t that be accompanying a burial?"
Red Sun Sect’s ultimatum naturally also reached inside Feixian Sect.
"Sect Leader, what should we do?"
"Right, with Red Sun Sect causing a scene, we’re going to have a hard time recruiting disciples."
"Now, instead of recruiting disciples, how to fend off external enemies is the top priority!"
The disciples chatted loudly for a while before turning around together.
"Sect Leader, give the order, how should we defend?"
Seeing the resolve on everyone’s face, Jiang Cheng was a bit surprised, then amused.
"With your little power, you’d be wiped out by one Soul Splitting Realm, defend for what? Sending heads?"
Luo Yuan and Yin Xiaoxue expressed dissatisfaction simultaneously.
"Sect Leader, you’re really hurting our morale!"
"Yes, as a Sect Leader you should at least encourage us, how can you dampen our spirits?"
Being the eldest senior sister, Ji Linghan was more stable, she asked, "Should we retreat like last time?"
"Of course not retreat."
Jiang Cheng shook his head.
"I forgot to tell you, last time the four sects from Extreme Moon Sect attacking Feixian Sect was orchestrated by Red Sun Sect behind the scenes."
"What?"
"It was them?"
"I said, how did those four sects suddenly team up."
"Damn Red Sun Sect!"
Knowing the truth now, everyone naturally hated Red Sun Sect.
Brother Cheng was about to give a rousing declaration of the expedition to cement his image as Sect Leader, but was interrupted by a cold laugh outside the hall.
"Turns out you’re all this stupid, you were exterminated and didn’t even know the mastermind behind!"
Jiang Cheng was very annoyed being cut off from his show-off process.
Looking up, a peculiar white Jade Platform illusion drifted slowly into the hall’s main entrance.
The Jade Platform was three feet high, with strands of soul-stealing aura around it.
In the center of that Jade Platform, sat a small pale-green figure, giving an inviolable sacred feeling.
Upon seeing that figure, Ji Linghan’s expression changed.
"Duanmu Pool of the Duanmu Family, he’s an expert of the Spirit Platform Realm, he’s directly descending with Spirit Platform Out-of-body here."

chapters.title: Chapter 34 Free Mercenary
chapters.content:
Chapter 34: Chapter 34 Free Mercenary
Editor:
EndlessFantasy Translation
In those days, she had followed the former Sect Leader to visit Duanmu Pool at the Duanmu Family.
Upon hearing this name, Luo Yuan and the others shivered slightly.
Although they had never seen him before, they had heard of him as if thunderously familiar.
Duanmu Pool was a strong person at the Spirit Platform Realm Third Layer, a pinnacle in Qinglan Prefecture.
To say they were afraid would be an understatement; ever since they could remember, they had been instilled with obedience and reverence by the two great forces.
"What do you want?"
Entering without announcing himself and speaking so indelicately, Brother Cheng wasn’t pleased.
Though on second thought, no one in his mountain sect was there to watch the gate.
But where was Ah Huang?
Why didn’t it drain this guy’s spiritual power before capturing him?
Speaking of which, if one’s Spirit Platform was drained of spiritual power, would it collapse immediately?
Just as he thought of this, Ah Huang seemed to anticipate his question.
"Mama, I used up all my power yesterday to catch the little kitten meow."
Hearing this message, Brother Cheng immediately showed concern.
He quickly responded with a message.
"Good girl, nothing serious, right?"
"A few days’ rest should be fine, but if there are Spirit Stones to replenish, it would be quicker."
"Why didn’t you say so earlier!"
So, after showing off, you still need to recharge?
I have Spirit Stones, having destroyed so many sects, even though most were traded for points, there’s still quite a bit left over.
While the two were conversing via message, Duanmu Pool, seated on the platform, raised his chin with a snort.
"I’ve come to offer you a bright path!"
After saying this, he waited for Jiang Cheng and the others to beg him.
The Feixian Sect was soon to be attacked by the Red Sun Sect, and to the Duanmu Family, it must be like ants on a hot pan, anxiously panicking.
This was the moment when the Duanmu Family extended a straw, expecting them to hurriedly climb up.
By that time, the Duanmu Family could make outrageous demands.
Instead, the scene remained utterly silent, with no one responding.
Luo Yuan and others wanted to ask what bright path.
But since the Sect Leader was present, they knew the rules; it wasn’t their place to speak.
And yet, Jiang Cheng, the Sect Leader, was busy speaking with his daughter, completely disregarding Duanmu Pool, leaving him hanging there.
After waiting for a long time, Duanmu Pool’s anger surged, and the aura of the Spirit Platform Realm gradually emerged.
Behind him, a giant illusion of five zhang slowly manifested, clearly an enlarged version of a Divine Soul figure.
The ability to control Divine Souls at the Spirit Platform Realm was fundamentally different from that at the Soul Splitting Realm.
"It seems you are quite ungrateful!"
With the appearance of the illusion, the temperature inside the hall dropped, chilling to the bone.
Luo Yuan and others struggled bitterly, feeling their Divine Sense could collapse at any moment.
Even though Duanmu Pool was merely a Divine Soul projection, it was enough to destroy them.
At this moment, Jiang Cheng finished talking with Ah Huang, intent on quickly dealing with this guy to deliver Spirit Stones to his daughter.
"Alright, alright, stop with the damn posturing! Spit it out if you have something to say!"
Although he was only at the Soul Splitting Seventh Layer, he possessed the Celestial Desolation Indestructible Body, the top in the Three Realms.
Let alone the pressure of a Spirit Platform Realm, even the Three-Eyed Tiger had failed to intimidate him before.
The atmosphere in the hall relaxed with his words, allowing many disciples to catch their breath.
Before coming here, the Duanmu Family had envisioned what kind of person Jiang Cheng was, but they certainly didn’t expect him, as a Sect Leader, to speak so crudely.
This was disrespectful to the Duanmu Family!
At this time, in a hall a hundred thousand miles away within the Duanmu Family, several elders watching the projection artifact all showed anger.
"First, politeness, then force!"
"If he refuses to drink the toast, make him drink the penalty wine, and erase him outright!"
"If not for his slight value, mere Soul Splitting Realm..."
Jiang Cheng couldn’t hear the Duanmu Family’s conversation, but he could sense Duanmu Pool’s fury.
"Jiang Cheng, let’s be straightforward, to stand against the Red Sun Sect, you can only seek help from our Duanmu Family!"
"When asking for help, one must show proper attitude!"
Jiang Cheng chuckled, having harbored no goodwill toward the Duanmu Family.
Back when the Feixian Sect was destroyed, where were you?
"Do you think a handsome person like me needs to seek help?"
The disciples all covered their faces, thinking, Brother, now’s the time to discuss sect affairs, can’t we be serious?
"Jiang Cheng, I know you have support behind you, but don’t forget, distant water won’t quench present thirst!"
Duanmu Pool’s Divine Soul churned within him.
"After all, this is the territory of Qinglan Prefecture, and to oppose the Red Sun Sect, cooperation with our Duanmu Family is the only way!"
The Duanmu Family’s eagerness had its reasons.
Having fought with the Red Sun Sect for ten thousand years in balance, neither could prevail over the other.
The emergence of Jiang Cheng gave them a chance to bring down the Red Sun Sect.
Alleged joint efforts were merely exploiting the foreign forces backing this kid to wipe out the Red Sun Sect in one stroke.
Afterward, under the guise of expelling invading foreign powers, they would drive out Jiang Cheng and his ’backing forces’.
At that point, the entire Qinglan Prefecture would be solely under the Duanmu Family’s rule.
Jiang Cheng laughed inwardly, having no interest in whatever cooperation they offered.
He simply didn’t need it.
On the surface, however, he remained unfazed.
"Go ahead, tell me, what’s the cooperation plan?"
Seeing him take the bait, Duanmu Pool immediately laid out the conditions.
"For us to send troops, there are three conditions."
"First, you must hand over the resources and collections of the Four Great Sects!"
"Second, the Feixian Sect must continue as a vassal to our Duanmu Family, paying annual tributes!"
"Third, Ji Linghan must marry Duanmu Zixiu of our Duanmu Family, as a form of alliance between the two families!"
Ji Linghan’s Seven-Aperture Exquisite Body hadn’t been recognized even by the Feixian Sect, but the Duanmu Family had discerned it the year she arrived at their door.
Moreover, being of stunning beauty, they had long desired to pull her into their fold.
Yet the former Sect Leader of the Feixian Sect had always refused.
In truth, even without the issue of the Four Sects attacking, the Duanmu Family would have eventually targeted her sooner or later.
These three conditions filled everyone in the hall with indignance.
Last time the Feixian Sect was destroyed, the Duanmu Family hadn’t even shown up, and now they had the audacity to demand continued tribute?
The spoils from the destruction of the Four Sects had been brought back by Jiang Cheng, with the Duanmu Family having offered no effort, so why should they hand them over?
Finally, it was well-known throughout Qinglan Prefecture that Duanmu Zixiu was a debauched scoundrel with a harem of wives and concubines.
How could they send Senior Sister Ji into such a fire pit?
"We won’t agree!"
"These conditions are outright plunder!"
"Humph!"
Duanmu Pool’s Divine Soul churned once more.
"Sect Leader Jiang, your disciples need to be disciplined."
Jiang Cheng chuckled, thinking this fool really had a high opinion of himself.
"Are you done talking?"
"I’m done."
Duanmu Pool maintained an arrogant demeanor.
"Alright then."
Jiang Cheng waved his hand.
"Shut the doors and release the dog!"
The disciples exchanged looks, not quite understanding his meaning right away.
Instead, the Three-Eyed Tiger burst in on its own.
"Punk, show some respect to your grandpa!"
Jiang Cheng shrugged: "As the Sect Guardian Spirit Beast, you know what to do, right?"
Since he had a free Sect Guardian Spirit Beast around, there was no need to waste one of his resurrections.
"No need for you to tell grandpa how to do things!"
The Three-Eyed Tiger was stubborn but had no choice.
After all, having agreed to become the Sect Guardian Spirit Beast, with this ’foreign enemy invasion’, not stepping up would breach their agreement.
"Is this the wretch?"
"Punk, if you can’t even handle him, you’re too weak."
It disdainfully glanced at Duanmu Pool’s Spirit Platform and Divine Soul, while also looking down on Jiang Cheng.

chapters.title: Chapter 35 Call Master Tiger
chapters.content:
Chapter 35: Chapter 35 Call Master Tiger
Editor:
EndlessFantasy Translation
Duanmu Pool also gazed at the Three-Eyed Tiger. No matter how he looked at it, he couldn’t figure out what was so powerful about this little creature.
He frowned, "Sect Leader Jiang, are you insulting me? Do you want to break off relations with my Duanmu Family?"
"Let’s get this over with quickly, don’t dawdle!"
Jiang Cheng waved his hand dismissively.
Only then did the Three-Eyed Tiger let out a yawn.
Immediately, Duanmu Pool’s Spirit Platform was sucked into its mouth by an invisible, terrifying vortex.
"No..."
Before his death, Duanmu Pool wanted to resist.
But that was wishful thinking.
His Spirit Platform, along with his Divine Soul puppet, were all swallowed, and the Three-Eyed Tiger even chewed on that Spirit Platform.
Crunch, crunch.
The illusion of Duanmu Pool in the hall faded at least tens of times, ready to disperse at any moment.
"You beast, I won’t let you get away with this!"
The Three-Eyed Tiger was also enraged. It didn’t mind Jiang Cheng disrespecting it, but who did this guy think he was?
A beam of light shot from its third eye, and the Divine Soul let out a piercing scream, vanishing into thin air.
The beam shot directly out, traversing countless miles in an instant.
In the distant Duanmu Family’s hall, the true form of Duanmu Pool suddenly exploded, leaving no remains!
The elders of the Duanmu Family were shocked, their faces drastically changing color.
It was one thing to destroy the core of the Divine Soul and the Spirit Platform, but that the demon beast could directly annihilate its physical form tens of thousands of miles away overturned their understanding.
"What, what kind of monster is this?"
"This must be a Celestial Fate Realm Divine Technique!"
"It certainly is!"
"I remember, when the Extreme Moon Sect was destroyed, someone saw the illusion of a Tiger Demon, it must be this one!"
"No wonder Jiang Cheng could wipe out those Four Sects with its help!"
"Our Duanmu Family cannot contend with such a monster, can we?"
...
Over at the Feixian Sect, all the disciples in the hall were dumbfounded.
Duanmu Pool was dead?
Killed effortlessly by that tiny Three-Eyed Tiger?
This was just too outrageous!
Although they all knew the Three-Eyed Tiger was the sect guardian spirit beast appointed by Jiang Cheng, they never thought it could be so formidable.
After all, its appearance and size really couldn’t convince anyone of its strength.
They had always regarded it as a mascot; it was just adorable, that was all.
Who would have known it was a peerless fierce beast...
The female disciples who had hugged it and pinched it yesterday were now drenched in cold sweat.
It felt like they had danced at the Ghost Gate!
"This, this..."
Luo Yuan was stammering.
He swallowed hard, "Sect Leader, why is it so powerful?"
That was a Spirit Platform Realm, and it just disappeared with a casual suck?
Brother Cheng stood with his hands behind his back, turning away as he spoke plainly, "Without this level of power, how could it be worthy of being our sect’s guardian spirit beast?"
After a brief shock, the disciples were overwhelmed with joy.
With such a powerful guardian spirit beast, their sense of security increased ten thousandfold!
No worry about the Red Sun Sect at all.
"Brother Hu, what is your strength really?"
The disciples inadvertently added "Brother" to its name.
However, the Three-Eyed Tiger was not satisfied, it lifted its eyelids slightly.
"Call me Master Tiger!"
"Yes, yes..."
"Master Tiger, you’re too impressive, how did you meet the Sect Leader?"
Truly the question couldn’t be more untimely!
This question, the Three-Eyed Tiger refused to answer.
While everyone was surrounding and praising the Three-Eyed Tiger, Jiang Cheng hadn’t forgotten that his dear daughter was still hungry.
He hurried to the Spirit Vein behind the mountain and handed over two rings full of Spirit Stones.
Upon seeing the Spirit Stones, Ah Huang was instantly overjoyed.
"Wow, so many!"
After speaking, she didn’t forget to add some slobber on Brother Cheng’s face as well.
Wiping his face, Jiang Cheng despisingly remarked, "You’re really lacking ambition, and yet you have a World Heart Fragment!"
"What’s a little Spirit Stone, there’ll be plenty more in the future, follow me and you’ll live in luxury every day!"
"Wow, really? Mama, you’re the best!"
The little girl was so excited she couldn’t help but twirl on the spot.
"Since I’m so good, why don’t you change the name to call me Papa!"
"Mama’s talking nonsense again..."
Jiang Cheng gritted his teeth, this little girl was fine in everything except her bizarre sense of humor.
Returning to the main hall, he saw the Three-Eyed Tiger sitting in a bossy manner on his sect leader’s throne.
Female disciples were feeding it Spirit Fruit on either side, and male disciples were fanning it, even though it wasn’t hot at all.
The flatteries kept flowing.
"Master Tiger, you truly have extraordinary Divine Techniques!"
"Master Tiger, are you in the Celestial Fate Realm?"
"Master Tiger, your presence for three years makes this place shine..."
It was no wonder everyone was being so ’flattering’, after all, the previous sect leader of Feixian Sect was only at the Soul Splitting Realm.
This Spirit Beast that could suddenly kill in the Spirit Platform Realm, what kind of concept was that?
The limit of the disciples’ understanding had been shattered.
Having just been frustrated with Ah Huang, seeing this scene, Brother Cheng couldn’t help but get mischievous.
Sitting in my seat?
And having my people serve you?
Rushing forward, he grabbed it and threw it to the ground.
"Is this a place you can sit?"
"You really have no sense of rules!"
The Three-Eyed Tiger was extremely angry.
"You damn bastard, looking to die?"
The aura of the Demon King instantly began to spread.
Jiang Cheng squinted his eyes, "Looks like you’re asking to be restrained again?"
Ah Huang’s deterrence was indeed strong.
The experience of having its Spiritual Power emptied and its Divine Soul restrained yesterday, the Three-Eyed Tiger didn’t want to experience that again.
"No, no, brother, I’m just messing around with you. Just thought the sect was too quiet, trying to liven things up?"
Everyone’s understanding was refreshed once more.
Seeing the Three-Eyed Tiger being thrown out just now, they almost went crazy with fear.
If Master Tiger went berserk, the Feixian Sect would probably be flattened!
Who knew, in front of the sect leader, it was well-behaved like a cat.
It seems, the sect leader is even more formidable!
For a moment, the disciples’ admiration for Jiang Cheng surged like a mighty river, feeling increasingly that his power was unfathomable.
"Alright, let’s talk business!"
"Set aside the Duanmu Family for now, let’s deal with the Red Sun Sect first!"
If this threat isn’t eliminated, no newcomers would dare come for the entry assessments.
"Sect Leader, how do you plan to deal with their attack?"
Now everyone was confident, eager and ready.
Jiang Cheng stood up and waved his hand.
"Deal with their attack? Does this sect leader need to defend? Of course, we should take the initiative to strike!"
"Ah? The sect leader plans to go to their doorstep?"
"Of course, I’m going to wipe out their Red Sun Sect, so they won’t cause trouble again!"
The disciples were immediately excited.
"Yes, we should take the initiative to attack!"
"Why should we wait for them to attack us?"
"With the sect leader and Master Tiger taking action, the Red Sun Sect will surely be destroyed!"
"When did I ever say I was going with you?" The Three-Eyed Tiger lazily lay on the ground.
"Kid, don’t blame me for not reminding you, I only agreed to be the sect guardian spirit beast, not your spirit pet."
The duty of a guardian spirit beast is to protect the sect’s safety.
When foreign enemies invade, it has to appear and resist.
There’s really no requirement to go on an expedition.
So that’s what it came down to?
Brother Cheng actually never planned to take it along.
He hadn’t used the three resurrections today yet.
Taking the Three-Eyed Tiger along would mean he wouldn’t get killed, then there’d be no system rewards, right?

chapters.title: Chapter 36: Duanmu Family’s Conspiracy
chapters.content:
Chapter 36: Chapter 36: Duanmu Family’s Conspiracy
Editor:
EndlessFantasy Translation
"Alright then, you stay and guard the house."
With that, he waved his sleeve and flew away just like that.
He’s gone just like that?
He actually didn’t ask this grandmaster for help?
The Three-Eyed Tiger couldn’t help but get up and, sensing carefully, Jiang Cheng was almost out of the mountain gate. He really wasn’t pretending.
How strange!
It suddenly understood.
The kid doesn’t need to bring me along at all. When the summoning talisman is activated, I have to go whether I want to or not!
Damn, thinking of this, it suddenly felt oppressed and frustrated.
The disciples in the hall were still praising the Sect Leader for his divine might and invincibility.
"Do you really think he’s that powerful?"
"To tell you the truth, he’s just a Soul Splitting Realm."
Even if I can’t defy the summons, I have to find ways to dismantle that kid’s show, make it hard for him!
"That’s impossible!"
Jiang Cheng’s closest disciple, Ji Linghan, immediately retorted loudly.
"The Sect Leader has lived for thousands of years, his power unfathomable, at least in the Celestial Fate Realm!"
The Three-Eyed Tiger sneered.
"Thousands of years?"
"He’s not even 20 years old. How can he fool grandmaster me?"
Regarding the Sect Leader’s prestige, the disciples suddenly felt that Master Tiger wasn’t as amiable or respectable as before.
Luo Yuan also stepped up to refute.
"The Sect Leader has annihilated four sects!"
"Exactly, how could a Soul Splitting Realm destroy four sects?"
"It’s obvious you, Little Brain Axe, are jealous of the Sect Leader, deliberately slandering him behind his back!"
What?
Little Brain Axe?
Weren’t they just calling me Master Tiger?
Just because I spoke a bit of truth, now I’m downgraded? What happened to respect?
Moreover, jealous of that kid?
I, a dignified Demon King, would be jealous of a Soul Splitting Realm ant?
The Three-Eyed Tiger jumped up in anger from its seat, baring its fangs and claws, itching to kill!
This is intolerable!
Were it not for the constraints of being the Sect Guardian Spirit Beast, it would probably attack these disciples.
"To tell you the truth, those four sects were wiped out by me, Master Tiger!"
"That kid did nothing but use a few summoning talismans!"
"Do you really think he’s that great?"
"If it weren’t for me, he would have been minced long ago!"
Its intense manner didn’t seem like lying, making the disciples half-skeptical.
In retrospect, there were rumors that a giant tiger demon illusion appeared in the sky when the Extreme Moon Sect was destroyed.
And the Sect Leader indeed always presented himself as a Soul Splitting Realm.
Could this be true?
"So, did you really destroy those four sects?"
The Three-Eyed Tiger raised its neck.
"Of course!"
Ji Linghan couldn’t help but worry.
"Then, why don’t you hurry to assist the Sect Leader?"
The Three-Eyed Tiger rolled its eyes, its small body on the high-backed chair became more relaxed.
"Why should I go? Let him show off, and I just do the work? Dream on!"
Ji Linghan quickly signaled, and the disciples hurriedly began serving tea and passing fruit.
"Master Tiger, with your immense power, it would be a breeze to eliminate the Red Sun Sect, right?"
"Hmm?"
"Why don’t you go one more time?"
Although enjoying the disciples’ service was pleasant, actively helping Jiang Cheng?
"Not happening!"
"Master Tiger, you’re world-renowned and invincible in battles; don’t you want to make a name for yourself?"
"Don’t want to."
While rejecting verbally, the Three-Eyed Tiger actually enjoyed being flattered, hoping the disciples would praise more strongly.
Alas, as a dignified Demon King, it had never been praised or lauded in the Celestial Demon Domain.
Even the Little Demons took it for granted as the Demon King, and now, being ranked at the end of the Twelve Demon Kings was a disgrace to the Tiger Race.
While the disciples were persuading, Jiang Cheng had already left the Feixian Sect.
Along the way, he didn’t hide at all, flying straight toward the Red Sun Sect openly.
So many people saw him along the way.
Jiang Cheng, now known throughout Qinglan Prefecture, was the most prominent figure!
In no time, the news of him heading alone toward the Red Sun Sect spread widely.
"What’s Jiang Cheng up to?"
"Isn’t he going to wipe out the Red Sun Sect too?"
"Crazy, just one person, how’s that possible?"
"You said the same about the Extreme Moon Sect and Profound Ice Sect before..."
"The Red Sun Sect is more than ten times stronger. They’re not on the same level!"
"I think he’s going to negotiate, right?"
"It’s possible, didn’t the Red Sun Sect ask Feixian Sect to surrender?"
Even with the glorious record of destroying four sects, everyone still believed Jiang Cheng was going to the Red Sun Sect to show goodwill.
And not to start a war.
No way, such an individual defeating a sect was hard to believe.
However, the distant Duanmu Family had a different view.
"The Red Sun Sect is doomed."
"Before that Three-Eyed Tiger Demon, the Red Sun Sect is bound to be a bloodbath."
The elders of the Duanmu Family gathered again to discuss significant matters.
Unlike others outside, they knew Jiang Cheng had an earth-shattering trump card—the Three-Eyed Tiger.
In front of that Three-Eyed Tiger, Duanmu Pool at the Spirit Platform Third Layer didn’t even make a sound before being wiped out completely.
It can be said that this Tiger Demon in Qinglan Prefecture is a Dimensional Reduction Strike.
The Red Sun Sect wouldn’t be able to withstand it.
Patriarch Duanmu Hong laughed heartily, gleeful.
"Hahaha, once the Red Sun Sect is destroyed, our Duanmu Family will..."
He originally wanted to say, once their arch-enemy, the Red Sun Sect, was destroyed, wouldn’t it be the Duanmu Family’s turn to be dominant?
But midway through laughing, he suddenly got stuck.
Because he thought of one thing, even if the Red Sun Sect was destroyed, it wouldn’t be the Duanmu Family that becomes dominant, right?
The Three-Eyed Tiger isn’t theirs.
Upon the Red Sun Sect’s destruction, the one strengthened is the Feixian Sect.
Moreover, Duanmu Pool had offended the Feixian Sect, so maybe the Duanmu Family would be next to be wiped out in the future.
So, what’s he so happy about?
"I wonder what kind of fortuitous encounter Jiang Cheng had, to have such a powerful Tiger Demon at his service."
"If we’d known, we should have taken the initiative to make good with him last time."
"Yes, the rise of Feixian Sect is unstoppable. Had we established ties earlier, we could have gotten a piece of the action!"
"What a pity..."
The elders of the Duanmu Family felt a bit regretful internally.
Also silently blaming the Feixian Sect, why didn’t you mention earlier that you had such a powerful Demon Beast backing?
If you’d said so, we wouldn’t have sent Duanmu Pool to show off!
"Hmph!"
Duanmu Hong snorted coldly, slamming the table heavily.
"What’s done is done, there’s no turning back!"
"Besides, this time, we are not without a chance to turn the tables!"
"Huh? Big brother, can you defeat that Tiger Demon?"
Second Patriarch, Duanmu Zhe, expressed confusion.
That Tiger Demon is at least Celestial Fate Realm, even if the Duanmu Clan’s direct and collateral lineages and family retainers, with thousands of clan members, all charged together, it would be suicide, right?
In the face of absolute strength, it seems that no strategy would work.
Facing the questionable and disbelieving looks of the elders, Duanmu Hong smiled proudly.
"Haven’t you noticed? That Tiger Demon didn’t follow Jiang Cheng this time!"
"According to reports from our spies, the Tiger Demon is still at the Feixian Sect and hasn’t moved."
Upon hearing this, the eyes of the elders lit up.

chapters.title: Chapter 37: How Did I Die?
chapters.content:
Chapter 37: Chapter 37: How Did I Die?
Editor:
EndlessFantasy Translation
"Last time when the four patriarchs were killed, everyone saw that the tiger demon only obeys Jiang Cheng."
"And Jiang Cheng himself is weak and insignificant."
Duanmu Hong’s eyes flashed with a killing intent, and he made a gesture of raising his hand to cut down.
"If we take advantage of the tiger demon’s absence to eliminate Jiang Cheng now..."
Duanmu Zhe clapped his hands heavily and said loudly, "Then the tiger demon will be leaderless!"
"Indeed!"
Duanmu Hong was full of confidence.
The other elders were also excited.
"If Jiang Cheng and the tiger demon share a life-and-death equal contract, then once Jiang Cheng dies, the tiger demon will also be erased by the rules simultaneously."
"If Jiang Cheng and the tiger demon have a master-servant contract, then after Jiang Cheng dies, the tiger demon will be free and certainly won’t stay in Qinglan Prefecture."
"In either case, we can eliminate this major threat of the Feixian Sect!"
"There’s no time to lose. Let’s quickly get rid of that kid!"
Just as everyone’s emotions were high, the third patriarch of the Duanmu family, Duanmu Yan, frowned and raised a question.
"Since the tiger demon isn’t with him, where does Jiang Cheng get the confidence to go to the Red Sun Sect alone?"
"This..."
"Could it be that he has an inside agent lying in ambush within the Red Sun Sect?"
The faces of the elders froze. Indeed, without the tiger demon backing him, isn’t Jiang Cheng courting death by going there?
"There’s nothing to hesitate about!"
Duanmu Hong slapped the table again.
"The fact is the tiger demon isn’t present!"
"The fact is Jiang Cheng’s power is weak!"
"I don’t care what schemes he has in mind, killing him with one sword will cleanly settle everything!"
With that said, he looked around at everyone and slowly raised the sword in his hand.
"For this battle, I’ve decided to go alone!"
"Big brother, we will go with you!"
Duanmu Hong waved his hand, refusing them.
"This trip must be secretive, the fewer people the better, and under no circumstances should there be any leaks, or else if that tiger demon finds out..."
If anyone saw, wouldn’t the tiger demon seek revenge even if he is freed after Jiang Cheng’s death?
Meow meow meow?
If the Three-Eyed Tiger knew of their plot and concerns, it would likely pat their shoulders and say, "Bro, don’t hold back, just go for it!"
If they succeed, could it owe them a favor?
It couldn’t wait for Jiang Cheng to die early so it could peacefully return to the Celestial Demon Domain.
"Big brother, if Jiang Cheng truly has a plot, isn’t your trip a certain death?" Duanmu Yan said worriedly.
Duanmu Hong stroked his long beard, saying calmly, "If by killing this kid, I can prolong the Duanmu family’s glory, my death is worthwhile."
With that, he took out a spiritual artifact and flew up to the sky, quickly disappearing from sight.
A tragic atmosphere pervaded the hall, and the elders of the Duanmu family looked at the vast sky, their eyes red.
It was as if they, who had always been conspiring against the Feixian Sect, were victims who bravely fought back.
At this moment, Jiang Cheng was flying along, constantly complaining in his heart about how vast Qinglan Prefecture was.
The direct distance between the Feixian Sect and the Red Sun Sect was over a hundred thousand miles. He felt that the Level 2 Teleportation Skill was indeed necessary to draw.
Otherwise, he would die of exhaustion just traveling.
Halfway through his flight, a red light, like a shooting star, suddenly attacked from the majestic mountains below.
It appeared and disappeared in an instant!
Jiang Cheng had no time to react and was hit right in the chest.
At the same time, his vision blurred, and his head buzzed.
His Sea of Consciousness and divine soul were attacked!
Duanmu Hong had been lying in ambush here for half an hour.
He chose this location because it was isolated and not easily discovered.
Besides, he disguised his appearance.
Before making his move, he suppressed his aura to the extreme. Not to mention being unseen, even if someone noticed, they would likely mistake him for a rock or dead object.
Once Jiang Cheng appeared, he struck decisively, like thunder shattering stone!
At first, he used all his trump cards.
He summoned the Duanmu family’s treasured Tier Seven Spiritual Artifact, Blood Transformation Blade, and unleashed a full-force attack with the Fifth Layer of Spirit Platform Realm’s spiritual power!
Simultaneously, his divine soul spirit platform also charged into Jiang Cheng’s Sea of Consciousness.
As the patriarch of the Duanmu family, Duanmu Hong rarely personally took action in recent years.
But that didn’t mean he wasn’t adept at combat.
On the contrary, he knew better than most cultivators how to leverage his full power.
Little probing, saving trump cards for last?
Saying a few pleasantries before striking?
No, no, no, that’s foolish behavior.
The lion fights the rabbit with all its might, not giving the opponent any chance to breathe, a fatal blow!
Only in this way can variables be minimized.
Thus, he succeeded.
The gap in realms was too vast; Jiang Cheng was instantly pierced through the heart by the Blood Transformation Blade.
The meridian and Qi Sea blood vessels around his body were destroyed completely by the accompanying destructive spiritual power at that moment.
The divine soul was crushed to pieces by the spirit platform...
Following that, he fell down.
There was no longer a trace of life.
"It’s done!"
"Wonderful!"
"Patriarch is mighty!"
In the distant hall of the Duanmu family, after seeing the images transmitted back by the spiritual artifact on Duanmu Hong, the elders cheered.
As if they had fought a long and arduous victorious battle.
During the half-hour wait earlier, they had been on edge, sweating bullets.
What if Jiang Cheng had trump cards?
What if Jiang Cheng’s apparent realm was fake?
What if an expert was secretly protecting Jiang Cheng?
If they failed, Duanmu Hong being counter-killed was secondary; the Duanmu family would be targeted.
But now, their worries were completely laid to rest.
"Jiang Cheng is dead, and the Feixian Sect is no longer a threat!"
"Hahaha, let’s gather the troops to annihilate the Feixian Sect now!"
"Wait a moment, let’s act after the tiger demon leaves!"
"Indeed, we still need to patiently wait for the opportunity."
The elders remained calm.
On the other side, Duanmu Hong was also very calm. After killing Jiang Cheng, he didn’t even reveal himself.
Instead, he retreated directly, disappearing into the endless mountains.
After striking, he immediately fled far away.
It was unnecessary to stay and check; lingering could create unexpected changes, like an outsider passing by.
He soon flew out over a thousand miles...
Huh, why am I dead?
Wasn’t I just happily traveling?
The soul-state Brother Cheng looked at his own corpse, utterly puzzled.
His first reaction was to look around, to see if there were any passersby.
This trip had been spectacularly attention-grabbing, wouldn’t it be embarrassing if people found out he inexplicably died?
Seeing no one around, he sighed in relief.
Luckily, the image of the brilliant and mighty King Bi was preserved.
Then, he finally had time to think about who killed him.
There’s no helping it; being able to resurrect allows such willfulness, making death a trivial matter.
But from the start, Duanmu Hong had already disappeared without a trace, impossible to find.
Brother Cheng thought for a while but couldn’t come to any conclusion.
Too many had motives to kill him, Red Sun Sect, Duanmu Family, internally in Qinglan Prefecture, and other surrounding sects...
"Ding, host killed, detecting the enemy’s strength..."
The system, too, deftly began arranging the resurrection plan.

chapters.title: Chapter 38: After Modification - 38 Divine-grade Spirit Platform
chapters.content:
Chapter 38: After Modification: Chapter 38 Divine-grade Spirit Platform
Editor:
EndlessFantasy Translation
Jiang Cheng speculated with some malice, could it be that he’s summoning the Three-Eyed Tiger again this time?
"Host has obtained the Divine-grade Spirit Platform, suppressing all Spirit Platforms below the divine level!"
"Host’s cultivation has been elevated to the Spirit Platform Realm Fourth Layer!"
"Host has achieved the Seventh Layer of the Water Cold Heart Technique!"
"Host has automatically comprehended the fifth floor of the Spirit Platform Illusion!"
"Host has automatically comprehended the Dark Spring Sealing Flame Sword’s Eighth Layer!"
"Host is about to resurrect!"
Ah, huh?
Brother Cheng could hardly resist laughing up to the sky, finally being able to enhance his power directly once again.
He was currently at the Soul Splitting Eighth Layer, and this time he advanced eight small realms at once.
The spiritual power required for each small realm in the Spirit Platform Realm is far greater than that for the entire progression from Soul Splitting First to Tenth Layers combined.
This saved him numerous troubles.
Moreover, cultivation techniques, Soul Capturing Techniques, and swordsmanship all upgraded several layers out of thin air.
Normally, these would require additional hard work and years upon years.
At this moment, he felt as if he had been in the Spirit Platform Realm for hundreds of years, fully comprehending the divine secret techniques of the Spirit Platform Sixth Layer.
The Spirit Platform Illusion was the secret technique that Duanmu Pool used when he descended upon the Feixian Sect last time.
Cultivating to the first layer allows one to entrust the divine soul onto the spirit platform, using it to protect and nurture the divine soul.
The second floor enables you to activate the spirit platform, carrying the divine soul across thousands of miles away from the body.
The third floor develops the spirit platform’s mighty power to directly attack distant opponents.
Duanmu Pool at the time was actually at this realm.
And now, Jiang Cheng had reached the Fourth Layer.
In this realm, the divine soul on the spirit platform grows to the size of the original body, with power magnified over tenfold.
Furthermore, during divine soul attacks, unique secret techniques can be formed with the spirit platform, unlike the straightforward and shallow assaults of the third floor.
Not to mention, his spirit platform is of the divine-grade.
The moment a spirit platform is nurtured into existence, it comes with a grade distinction.
Duanmu Pool’s spirit platform was only of the lowest mortal grade, while the highest quality within the Duanmu Family was owned by the patriarch, Duanmu Hong, reaching the profound grade.
Above the profound grade lies the saint grade, which simply doesn’t exist in the entire Qinglan Prefecture.
Not to mention the even higher immortal and divine grades.
When spirit platforms clash, high-grade ones naturally suppress those of lower grade.
Unless the opponent’s spirit platform secret techniques are significantly higher in realm, equal-grade spirit platforms are virtually invincible.
Of course, the greatest advantage of a high-quality spirit platform is the faster cultivation speed of the divine soul.
Divine-grade spirit platforms allow cultivation hundreds of times faster than mortal ones.
Where lifting Duanmu Pool’s divine soul by one realm might take a hundred years, Jiang Cheng would only need two or three months.
If word of this spirit platform got out, countless heads of sacred lands beyond the region would scramble to take him in as a disciple.
After all, divine-grade spirit platforms are extraordinarily rare.
Some sacred lands have endured for tens of thousands of years without fostering such a monstrous prodigy at this level.
Also, the Dark Spring Sealing Flame Sword and Water Cold Heart Technique boast quality several tiers above the Extreme Moon Sect’s Crescent Moon Swordsmanship and Moon Observation Heart Method.
The swordsmanship power and cultivation speed have been massively enhanced.
With such a tremendous boost in power, Jiang Cheng felt incredibly pleased, finally free from others instantly seeing through him and dismissively remarking that he was just a mere Soul Splitting Realm weakling.
Well, to be fair, the Soul Splitting Realm already counted as high-end combat power in Qinglan Prefecture, but he always ended up wiping out entire families.
With the Spirit Platform Sixth Layer, he finally had some credibility.
Clang!
Brother Cheng drew his sword and looked around, feeling bewildered.
No targets!
According to ’proper procedures,’ shouldn’t he slay his opponent once resurrected?
Yet now, who knows where the enemy went; how can he slay someone he can’t even find?
"Well, the system wouldn’t make an enemy stay put waiting for me to slay them."
"Come to think of it, I should thank that person for killing me once."
"Otherwise, where would I have garnered so much gain?"
After a brief moment of disappointment, he turned to delight, having quite a large heart.
"Hey buddy, why don’t you come out and let me stab you as a thank-you gift!"
After tidying himself up a bit, he continued heading toward the Red Sun Sect.
With his power surging, his flying speed increased sharply, becoming several times faster than before.
He boldly flew along, his style now even more flamboyant.
After slaying Jiang Cheng, Duanmu Hong returned to the Duanmu Family as quickly as possible.
"Big brother!"
"The patriarch’s returned!"
"Congratulations on a triumphant return, ridding the Duanmu Family of a formidable foe!"
Upon his arrival, the elders of the clan gathered around like welcoming a victorious hero coming back home.
"Hmm!"
Duanmu Hong responded indifferently and went straight to the family ancestral temple.
Then, he set forth his cultivation techniques, stretching his arms.
A small blood-red dagger floated up from his back, slowly flying to the jade frame at the center of the ancestral temple.
All the elders fell silent, intensely staring at the flying dagger!
This was the Duanmu Family’s treasured artifact, the Tier Seven Spiritual Artifact Blood Transformation Blade. It was rumored that an ancestor of the Duanmu Family obtained it from a secret realm in Feiyun State a thousand years ago.
The Blood Transformation Blade held immense power, helping the Duanmu Family withstand numerous crises over the millennium, making it a family heirloom.
Yet, possibly due to some damage before it was acquired by an ancestor of the Duanmu Family, the spiritual artifact suffers some loss each time it is used.
The Duanmu Family has kept a secret that when they first obtained the Blood Transformation Blade, it was actually a Tier Eight Spiritual Artifact, but it has gradually diminished to Tier Seven over the years.
Therefore, they would never use it unless facing a major crisis.
"If I’d known that kid was genuinely so weak, there was no need to employ the Blood Transformation Blade this time!"
"Indeed, our spirit platform could have just wiped him out directly."
"Without the protection of the Tiger Demon, he is nothing."
Even though they had slain Jiang Cheng, everyone felt it was a bit of an overkill, using a sledgehammer to crack a nut.
Duanmu Hong had a similar sentiment; the battle was too effortless.
If he’d known from the start he was just a weakling, why the tension and the long wait hidden in the mountains?
"Well, when Feixian Sect is annihilated, and Ji Linghan is captured, the depletion of the Blood Transformation Blade will barely be worth it."
The elders prepared eagerly, sharpening their knives.
At this moment, a young trusted clansman suddenly rushed in.
"Patriarch, elders..."
Duanmu Hong frowned with displeasure.
"Such imprudence, what decorum is this?"
The trusted clansman promptly apologized and hastily said, "That Jiang Cheng isn’t dead; he’s still alive."
"What did you say?"
Duanmu Hong wondered if he had misheard.
"What nonsense are you spouting?"
The other elders also expressed disbelief.
But within just a few dozen seconds, they were forced to believe it.
A Transmission Spirit Artifact image came through, sent back by a Duanmu Family scout posted somewhere.
And in that monotonous image, aside from the vast sky, there was a person flying at high speed.
With a flying posture as flamboyant as possible, who else could it be but Jiang Cheng?
"This, how is this possible?"
"How can he still be alive?"
"I personally killed him, utterly certain he was dead!"

chapters.title: Chapter 39: Coming Back?
chapters.content:
Chapter 39: Chapter 39: Coming Back?
Editor:
EndlessFantasy Translation
Duanmu Hong was somewhat doubting his life. Having been struck by the Blood Transformation Blade and simultaneously his Divine Soul crushed by the Spirit Platform, he should be dead beyond resurrection.
As for being resurrected by some Spirit Elixir?
Impossible!
In such a situation, even the Daluo Immortals couldn’t revive him!
"Indeed, we saw it too."
The Elders didn’t doubt Duanmu Hong, as they had witnessed the ’remote livestream’, seeing with their own eyes how Jiang Cheng died.
"What exactly happened?"
"Could it be that he was pretending to be dead?"
"If only we had stayed to check his corpse back then..."
Although the Elders did not directly say he did wrong, Duanmu Hong’s face couldn’t hold its composure, feeling the Patriarch’s authority challenged.
He even started to suspect himself, wondering if he had been too careless, leaving before killing the target.
If he had struck another blow at the time, there shouldn’t have been any issue.
"Since he’s still alive, then I shall kill him again!"
His face turned livid, his gaze seemed ready to devour someone.
"I refuse to believe he can’t be killed!"
"Huh?"
"Going again?"
This time, Duanmu Hong didn’t fetch the Blood Transformation Blade, he flew straight out.
Leaving behind a cold remark.
"Anyone I, Duanmu Hong, intend to kill, has never lived to see the second day!"
Jiang Cheng naturally couldn’t have imagined that the one who just killed him would still hold a grudge against him.
While flying until he was eight thousand miles from the Red Sun Sect, he was attacked again.
This time, Duanmu Hong hurriedly intercepted him, and the two practically collided head-on.
Though he didn’t have the Blood Transformation Blade, upon meeting, Duanmu Hong immediately unleashed the strongest killing move of the Duanmu Family’s Dark Spring Sealing Flame Sword.
Instantly, the realm turned dark.
Ghost Qi filled the air, the ice-cold aura seemed to grow from within, piercing deep into the Divine Soul, trying to extinguish its flames.
This swordsmanship was developed by the Duanmu Family specifically to counter the Great Sun Flame Sword of the Red Sun Sect.
Even the names of the sword techniques correspond to each other.
However, the current Jiang Cheng wasn’t the Jiang Cheng of one hour ago.
Spirit Platform Sixth Layer, which is a whole layer higher than Duanmu Hong’s Spirit Platform Fifth Layer.
More importantly, this swordsmanship of Duanmu Hong’s... he’s familiar with.
Exceedingly familiar.
Not long ago, among the resurrection rewards given by the system to him, wasn’t this very swordsmanship, the Dark Spring Sealing Flame Sword?
He skillfully summoned the Spirit Sword, rushing forward to meet it.
In this moment, the area turned into an even colder ghostly realm.
Truth be told, Duanmu Hong himself felt like he had seen a ghost.
He thought it would be a piece of cake, a single move and done.
Instead, Jiang Cheng withstood the attack, not only withstood it but was using the Duanmu Family’s swordsmanship.
Not only using the same swordsmanship, but his swordsmanship Realm wasn’t lower either!
How could this be?
The Duanmu Family possesses more than one sword technique, but this Dark Spring Sealing Flame Sword is taught only to direct lineage disciples, not even some branch elders have learned it.
Moreover, even within the direct lineage, no one has ever mastered this swordsmanship to the Sixth Layer!
And Jiang Cheng in front of him, had actually mastered the same Eighth Layer as him!
How could this be possible?
His surprise didn’t end there, he realized the opponent was also using the Duanmu Family’s Water Cold Heart Technique.
Indeed, without cultivating the Duanmu Family’s Heart Method, one cannot use the Dark Spring Sealing Flame Sword.
The opponent’s cultivation Realm being the same as his own was too absurd.
Jiang Cheng on the opposite side started to understand the situation.
Turns out this time the system had replicated him?
With this identical cultivation and swordsmanship, he almost thought he’d met a clone.
Fortunately, the system gave him Spirit Platform Sixth Layer, just one small Realm higher than the opponent, reliably securing an advantage.
As the fight continued, Duanmu Hong became more and more alarmed.
Who is this person?
How did he learn the Duanmu Family’s Heart Method and swordsmanship?
To achieve this Realm, it couldn’t be done in fewer than several hundred years, did he infiltrate the Duanmu Family centuries ago?
Does he have backing from other forces?
In these centuries, how much intelligence and resources have they stolen from the Duanmu Family?
What secret machinations have they conducted that were unfavorable to the Duanmu Family?
Those Elders watching the battle from afar, in the Duanmu Family, shared similar sentiments.
"How... how can he be this powerful?"
"This swordsmanship, this cultivation technique, could there be a mole in our Duanmu Family?"
"There must have been a high-ranking betrayal, otherwise the last few layers wouldn’t have leaked."}
"Indeed, without an inside accomplice, such a feat couldn’t be achieved."
"I remember now, two hundred years ago, the Fifth Elder perished, was there someone secretly causing trouble?"
"And eighty years ago, the mysterious disappearance of my grandson Duanmu Ziyue..."
In that moment, suspicions brewed among the Elders within the hall.
Suspicion and distrust filled their gazes as they glanced at each other.
Swish!
Duanmu Hong finally couldn’t hold back, risking injury, suddenly distanced himself.
"Hold! When did you steal our cultivation technique and swordsmanship?"
Watching him interrogate fiercely, Jiang Cheng inwardly scoffed.
You old scoundrel, weren’t you the one who killed me last time?
Otherwise, it wouldn’t be such a coincidence.
And you’re shamelessly self-righteous?
"Heh, I want to ask that question too, where did you steal learn it from?"
He deliberately reversed the charge, to irritate this old scoundrel.
Sure enough, Duanmu Hong was nearly furious enough to blow his top.
"I? Steal learn? This is our Patriarch’s cultivation technique, created by our ancestors, why would we need to steal learn it?"
Jiang Cheng disdainfully retorted, "Your Patriarch’s cultivation technique? How many years has it been inherited?"
"Fourteen thousand years, the technique enlightened by the ancestor is vast and never publicly revealed, you definitely must be..."
"Alright, alright, I understand now."
Jiang Cheng impatiently waved his hand, "More than ten thousand years ago, the cultivation technique of our Feixian Sect was once stolen, turns out it was your ancestor who stole it."
"Seems like your ancestor was nothing more than a petty thief..."
Dealing with people like Duanmu Hong, Brother Cheng was quite experienced.
"You!"
Only evil can deal with evil, Duanmu Hong nearly fainted from fury, his livid face turned pale.
Even the reputation of their ancestor was insulted, how could they tolerate it?
Within the hall, the Duanmu Family’s Elders turned red-eyed, gnashing their teeth, cursing relentlessly, wishing to immediately cross thousands of miles to hack Jiang Cheng to death.
"Die!"
Duanmu Hong had held back for too long, his heart was overwhelmed by anger, causing his speech functions to falter without retaliation.
In the end, he could only strike again.
This time, he unleashed his Spirit Platform right from the start.
"Patriarch’s Spirit Platform is of Profound Grade!"
"A Spirit Platform is impossible to steal, this kid is doomed..."
"Patriarch’s Spirit Platform Shadow Transformation Secret Techniques have also reached Fourth Layer!"
Then seen was a verdant square Spirit Platform above Feiling’s head, radiating like jade, smoke encircling slowly, resembling something from an Immortal Realm.
Beams of light emitted from the smoke, even viewed from afar would cause a ripple within the Divine Soul, seemingly threatening to swallow it entirely.
And upon that Spirit Platform, Duanmu Hong’s Divine Soul glared furiously, chanting True Words.

chapters.title: Chapter 40: Harvest Abundant
chapters.content:
Chapter 40: Chapter 40: Harvest Abundant
Editor:
EndlessFantasy Translation
"Chortle!"
With a single word, the mountains and forests bowed down, as if worshiping a god.
Unfortunately, Jiang Cheng felt nothing.
Seeing the old man summon his Spirit Platform, he seemed to remember that he was also a Spirit Platform Realm expert.
The next moment, he too summoned his own Spirit Platform.
The entire sky suddenly turned golden yellow, with radiant brilliance!
And at the convergence of that light, a golden high platform floated in the air, the sunlight seemingly taken away, making it impossible to discern its specific form.
All that could be seen were mysterious rivers surrounding the Spirit Platform, with flickering silhouettes of celestial birds and beasts, harmonious celestial sounds intertwining in vibrant colors, full of the mysterious charm of the Dao.
Under the glow of the Divine-grade Spirit Platform, Duanmu Hong’s Spirit Platform was revealed by the Demon-Revealing Mirror, losing all its luster, no longer dazzling at all.
"This!"
"Is this... a Divine-grade Spirit Platform?"
"According to ancient records, this is indeed a Divine-grade Spirit Platform!"
"Impossible, impossible! Isn’t a Divine-grade Spirit Platform a myth? How could it truly exist?"
"What other kind of Spirit Platform could suppress a Profound-grade to such an extent?"
Watching the scene within the hall, the Elders of the Duanmu Family nearly went mad, as if witnessing the descent of a True God.
This was too unbelievable.
In Qinglan Prefecture, there isn’t even a Saint-grade Spirit Platform, let alone a Divine-grade?
It’s imaginable how shocked Duanmu Hong, facing this Divine-grade Spirit Platform, must have been.
"You, you..."
"This is fake!"
"This is an illusion, don’t think of deceiving..."
He truly went mad, thinking that Jiang Cheng was just a weakling in the Soul Splitting Realm, easily wiped out in one move, but now he felt like the weakling himself.
When his Spirit Platform touched Jiang Cheng’s Spirit Platform, it was like a chick facing an eagle.
Swish!
The Spirit Platforms clashed, an invisible torrent of Divine Soul power washed over.
In an instant, Duanmu Hong’s Divine Soul flickered like a candle in the wind, on the verge of collapse.
Creeping cracks appeared on his originally blue Spirit Platform.
His own physical Divine Soul thus suffered a devastating foundational blow.
Thud!
A mouthful of blood spewed out, Duanmu Hong wanted to escape.
He tried to retreat, but at this moment, Jiang Cheng would give him no chance.
The Spirit Platform, like Mount Tai, smashed the blue Spirit Platform into pieces, and Duanmu Hong could no longer stand.
Zip!
The sword light flashed, and his head spun away.
This was how a rogue hero of Qinglan Prefecture met a swift end in a deserted valley.
If it weren’t for the Transmission Spirit Artifact he carried, allowing the Elders of the Duanmu Family to witness it firsthand, no one would have believed he was truly killed.
Within the hall, there was a dead silence.
After a long while, a loud wail echoed.
"The Patriarch... is dead!"
Jiang Cheng had no such thoughts, he still didn’t even know who this old man was.
After all, he hadn’t been in this world long and was still a newbie, unfamiliar with so many big shots.
As long as it was an enemy, that’s all that mattered.
Having already wiped out the Four Sects, he was now quite calm, rummaging through Duanmu Hong, almost stripping him to his skivvies.
"Wow, this old bastard is really rich!"
"So many top-grade Spirit Stones!"
"What’s this? Tier Six Spirit Armor? Tier Six Spirit Sword?"
"Spirit Platform Realm really has its flair!"
After checking, the Spirit Stones in Duanmu Hong’s ring were all top-grade Spirit Stones, enough to exchange for 4000 points, along with a dozen bottles of pills needed for the Spirit Platform Realm.
Apart from spiritual artifacts and spirit armor, there were also Tier Four Spirit Talismans.
Unfortunately, there wasn’t time to use them.
Additionally, the subsequent levels of Duanmu Family’s cultivation techniques and swordsmanship secret techniques were also in this ring.
This was expected, as Duanmu Hong was the Patriarch of the Duanmu Family.
Such important heart method mantras, as unspeakable secrets, were naturally kept closely by the Patriarch.
But who would have thought that one day the Patriarch would be alone, killed in the wilderness.
After accepting all this, Brother Cheng couldn’t help but sigh; killing this one enemy brought rewards comparable to wiping out an Extreme Moon Sect.
The last scene seen by the Elders of the Duanmu Family was Jiang Cheng placing the Transmission Spirit Artifact into his Storage Ring, severing the connection.
However, they didn’t need to guess what would happen next.
Thinking of the Patriarch’s death, with all his collections looted, their hearts bled.
Yet, none dared to clamor for revenge.
A Divine-grade Spirit Platform; going against it would be futile.
Now, they were more worried about Jiang Cheng coming to their door.
"What should we do?"
"The Duanmu Family is at a life and death crisis!"
With Duanmu Pool and Duanmu Hong killed in succession, the Duanmu Family now only had two Spirit Platform Realm members.
These Elders, now as flustered as headless flies, felt as if the sky was falling.
"Send the elite disciples away for refuge, and start contacting Feiyun State over there..."
"Are we asking them for help?"
"Fear they might extort us."
"Better extorted than annihilated!"
If Jiang Cheng knew what was happening here, he would be baffled.
He still didn’t know it was the Duanmu Family coming after him, nor did he intend to destroy the Duanmu Family.
His target was only the Red Sun Sect, little did he know before even arriving, the Duanmu Family had already fallen into chaos.
Finally arriving at the Red Sun Sect, the mountain gate was already crowded with people.
These people were loose cultivators here to watch the drama unfold.
Regardless of whether Jiang Cheng would wipe them out or seek peace, either would greatly impact the structure of Qinglan Prefecture.
"Is that Jiang Cheng?"
"Have to admit, he is indeed quite handsome!"
"Wasn’t it said he was only in the Soul Splitting Realm? Yet when I sense, his spiritual power is deep as the sea, far stronger than the Soul Splitting Ninth Layer?"
"Could he also be a Spirit Platform Realm expert?"
"Naturally, I tell you, I realized long ago, how could someone who wiped out Four Sects be merely Soul Splitting Realm?"
"So young and already in the Spirit Platform Realm? Truly a prodigy!"
Hearing these discussions, Brother Cheng felt secretly delighted.
He had no intention of hiding his cultivation because it wouldn’t be flashy enough.
Red Sun Sect had long been prepared for his arrival.
"Did he really come alone?"
The Sect Leader of Red Sun Sect, Master Guiyan, felt disbelief mixed with a sense of being underestimated.
Daring to charge in alone, making such a fuss, is he really so dismissive of Red Sun Sect?
Does he think it’s his backyard, where he can stroll as he pleases?
"He must be here to seek peace."
"Naturally, although he wiped out Four Sects, even if the forces behind him joined in, barging into our Red Sun Sect would be courting death."
Though unsure of the ’forces’ behind Jiang Cheng, they unanimously believed it was certainly several sects from other prefectures.
Even in a direct confrontation, Red Sun Sect didn’t fear them.
They hadn’t seen the Three-Eyed Tiger and didn’t know both Duanmu Pool and Duanmu Hong were killed.
Thinking it was still their home ground, they weren’t worried at all.
"Even if seeking peace, he must be given a show of strength first."

chapters.title: Chapter 41: Truly a warm-hearted good person
chapters.content:
Chapter 41: Chapter 41: Truly a warm-hearted good person
Master Guiyan waved his hand, and the elders below all shared knowing cold smiles.
"Give him a memorable lesson."
"Let everyone see the consequences of offending the Red Sun Sect."
With so many people watching outside, this was the perfect opportunity to demonstrate the power of the sect.
Outside, Jiang Cheng had been intending to fly straight in, but was suddenly stopped by a giant fiery gate ahead.
The giant gate stretched across the entrance of the Red Sun Sect, seemingly endless, with flames flickering within.
"This is the Flaming Netherworld Path of the Red Sun Sect! I saw it a few years ago during their disciple recruitment!"
"Yes, it’s used for newcomer assessments."
"Complete this Flaming Netherworld Path, and you’ll pass the first test to become an Inner Sect Disciple."
"This path is not easy to traverse; it’s scorching and the flames can harm a cultivator’s internal organs..."
"No matter, for an expert like Sect Leader Jiang, the trials for newcomers should be a breeze, right?"
"That’s true."
Hearing their discussion, Jiang Cheng finally understood the situation.
Why bother going through the formalities just to wipe out a sect?
"Jiang Cheng, our Sect Leader said only if you pass through this path do you have the right to negotiate peace!"
"Please!"
The disciples at the gate made a gesture of invitation, their eyes full of disdain.
As the hegemon of Qinglan Prefecture, they were used to arrogance. Even with Jiang Cheng’s previous achievements, their superior attitude was hard to shake.
Negotiate peace?
The guy’s here to annihilate the sect, okay?
Brother Cheng laughed.
He wasn’t stupid; he could see that this Flaming Netherworld Path was an array.
Though it was used to test new disciples, once he entered, the scale of the flames would likely not remain the same, since most arrays can have their power adjusted.
Even if he could pass it with his Spirit Platform Realm strength, getting burnt and ruined would obscure his handsome face...
Why bother?
"You think I’ll go in just because you tell me to?"
"What do you count for?"
He sneered disdainfully, then summoned his Flying Sword.
"How dare you!"
"What are you going to do?"
"If you don’t want the Feixian Sect to be destroyed, obey obediently!"
Just as those disciples finished speaking, Brother Cheng impatiently swept his Spirit Sword.
He was currently at the Spirit Platform Sixth Layer, while those disciples weren’t even in the Soul Splitting Realm.
Thump thump thump...
A dozen gatekeeper disciples all fell.
Even though everyone knew Jiang Cheng had wiped out four sects, the scattered cultivators present were terrified out of their wits.
Oh my god, this guy actually dares to kill!
He’s really going after the Red Sun Sect!
As the overlord of Qinglan Prefecture, the Red Sun Sect had been renowned for tens of thousands of years, a concept entirely different from those of the Extreme Moon Sect’s few factions.
For the cultivators present, this was tantamount to piercing the heavens.
Brother Cheng was still not satisfied. After easily dispatching a round of weaklings, he charged towards the Flaming Path.
He didn’t plan to enter the array but instead circled to the side and struck with his sword.
By not entering the array, the array couldn’t affect him and was instead continually damaged by his attacks from the outside.
Although he didn’t understand arrays, the indiscriminate coverage of a Spirit Platform Sixth Layer sweep eventually impacted some array foundation locations.
Watching as the giant fiery gate began to shake violently, cracks appeared within it.
Debris flew.
Rumble!
The giant gate trembled incessantly, and in the distance, Master Guiyan’s angry roar rang out.
"Stop!"
"You scoundrel, how dare you!"
The elders of the Red Sun Sect were furious. The Flaming Netherworld Path was a Tier Five Spirit Array, an essential path for disciple assessment and a treasure of the Red Sun Sect.
This array helped them filter out geniuses attuned to flame spiritual power.
If it were destroyed, it would be an immense loss.
Boom!
Accompanied by one final loud noise, the sky burst with flames, and the giant gate vanished into thin air.
Clang!
A broken array disc fell down, bouncing a few times on the ground before finally presenting itself to everyone.
That was the array hub—judging by its damage, it couldn’t be repaired.
"You, you did this!"
"Feixian Sect is finished, completely finished!"
"You destroyed your own path to peace!"
The elders were so furious they didn’t even care about the crowded onlookers, jumping up and down in rage.
Master Guiyan’s fury reached the peak, to the point where he couldn’t help but laugh in anger.
"Tell me, how do you want to die?"
He directly summoned his Spirit Platform and Flying Sword, exuding the momentum of Spirit Platform Sixth Layer, causing the distant observing cultivators to flee, unable to stand still.
His reaction made Jiang Cheng very satisfied, so satisfied that he was pleasantly surprised.
Having wiped out so many sects, it was the first time someone asked him how he wanted to die, rather than hesitating and not daring to strike, waiting for him to initiate the charge.
Moreover, they even let him choose how to be served.
This Sect Leader was warm-hearted, impressive indeed.
"I want to die as quickly as possible," he earnestly expressed his request.
But unfortunately, to Master Guiyan, it sounded like biting sarcasm.
Swoosh!
An overwhelming Sword Aura was his response!
Instantly, the front was filled with a sea of fire.
Thousands of loose cultivators who couldn’t escape in time were caught within, turning to ashes in an instant.
Screams filled the air, the scene turned chaotic for a moment.
The Profound Grade Spirit Platform seemed like a soul-reaping weapon, even without looking directly, everyone felt a chill down their spine, as if targeted by a primordial beast.
But Brother Cheng felt no pressure, he naturally faced it head-on.
If the system judged him to be passively fighting, it would consider it a suicide attempt.
So before getting killed, he needed to put on a show; fighting was necessary.
As soon as his swordsmanship was displayed, Master Guiyan’s eyes widened.
Isn’t this the Dark Spring Sealing Flame Sword of the Duanmu Family?
Isn’t this the heart technique of the Duanmu Family?
"You wretch, behind you are those scoundrels of the Duanmu Family!"
The Duanmu Family and the Red Sun Sect had been mortal enemies for millennia, and seeing this swordsmanship, the surrounding other elders got even angrier.
"So it was aimed at our Red Sun Sect from the start!"
"Destroy him, then attack the Duanmu Family!"
"They must give us an explanation!"
They were busy roaring and fuming, but soon found themselves silenced, as if their throats were gripped, words choked back.
Brother Cheng’s greatest display tool — the Divine-grade Spirit Platform appeared.
With this Spirit Platform out, Master Guiyan was directly driven to question his life.
Realistically speaking, his Spirit Platform Sixth Layer strength was quite evenly matched with Jiang Cheng.
But this Divine-grade Spirit Platform indeed upset the balance.
His cyan Spirit Platform was like floating ice illuminated by fierce flames, completely unable to resist, his Divine Soul took severe damage.
How is this possible?
How could this kid have a Divine-grade Spirit Platform?
It’s a Divine Grade!
How could the Duanmu Family bear to send such a peerless prodigy as a decoy?
He couldn’t figure it out, he just knew he was done for.
Opposite him, Jiang Cheng was actually very frustrated.
He gradually realized one thing, Master Guiyan couldn’t kill him!
This old man had the gall to come kill him, but his strength was lacking, totally inadequate!
Continuing like this, he’d be wiped out by him instead.

chapters.title: Chapter 42: Power of War Soul
chapters.content:
Chapter 42: Chapter 42: Power of War Soul
Even though he would eventually have to kill Master Guiyan, it didn’t conflict with exterminating the sect. But if he killed Master Guiyan now, and then took out a few elders, the others might just flee.
When dealing with enemies, one must pull the weed out by the roots.
Otherwise, if they harbor hatred around the Feixian Sect, it would be troublesome if Ji Linghan and Luo Yuan get ambushed as soon as they step out.
He couldn’t let them off easy, so what should he do?
Luckily, Master Guiyan soon resolved his dilemma with great understanding.
"Against such an extremely evil demon, there’s no need to talk about ethics, let’s gang up on him!"
With a wave of his hand, all the elders of the Red Sun Sect charged forward.
The Red Sun Sect had six Spirit Platform Realm elders; although Fei Tongzhuo was taken out in advance last time, there were still five left.
Along with over two hundred Soul Splitting Realm elders and true disciples, this lineup was still very formidable.
As they pounced, Brother Cheng immediately felt the profound beauty of death.
This feeling was quite overwhelming!
However, this Divine-grade Spirit Platform was indeed extraordinarily impressive.
Despite being besieged, he actually wasn’t able to die in a short time.
Currently at the Spirit Platform Sixth Layer, attacks below the Soul Splitting Realm couldn’t be fatal.
And those Spirit Platform Realm elders didn’t dare get too close, as the Spirit Platform would become unstable upon nearing the Divine Soul.
While fighting, he unexpectedly entered a blood-soaked War God mode.
One Soul Splitting Realm elder after another was casually slain by him, while those Spirit Platform Realm elders kept retreating.
Brother Cheng felt like crying but had no tears, he didn’t want to be this exhausted.
Thinking about how effortless it was to eliminate those Four Sects back then, just with a summoning talisman, and a single thought from the Three-Eyed Tiger.
He didn’t need to exert any effort, just had to watch the big shots perform and then go collect the spoils.
Now, after fighting for a quarter hour, he had been attacked hundreds of times, yet stubbornly hadn’t died.
At this rate, when would it end?
Was it wrong that his power had increased?
The previous joy of suddenly advancing to the Spirit Platform Sixth Layer vanished, he wished he was just a Body Tempering Realm weakling who would die with a touch.
Could it be that he would win just like this?
Did he really single-handedly overturn a sect, relying on the awe-inspiring Divine-grade Spirit Platform?
Thinking about it, it seemed... still quite heroic!
Perhaps tales would spread in the future of Sect Leader Jiang’s unparalleled might, making seven sorties solo to carve a bloody path and level the Red Sun Sect.
Brother Cheng imagined for a moment, and his thoughts quietly shifted.
He started to regret charging too far in, as he had already advanced into the depths of the enemy’s mountain gate, where those remaining loose cultivators dared not enter.
Such an epic battle without anyone recording it was truly imperfect.
"He’s in the heartland!"
"Activate the array!"
Suddenly, Master Guiyan’s shout echoed.
During the battle, he had deliberately lured Jiang Cheng deeper in.
Once within a thousand miles of the main peak, it was within the Sect Protection Array’s coverage.
In an instant, the Red Sun Sect’s Sect Protection Array activated, and the spirit arrays of various peaks and halls all lit up.
Jiang Cheng hadn’t yet reacted when the great array’s remote attacks struck.
The Red Sun Sect’s array was Tier Six, gathering the might of a vast sect’s spirit vein, something an individual cultivator couldn’t contend with.
Even if a Celestial Fate Realm intruded, they would suffer some injury.
The Divine-grade Spirit Platform was strong, but it blocked Divine Soul damage. It couldn’t withstand such inanimate array magic damage, and Jiang Cheng was, after all, at the Spirit Platform Realm.
Facing the endless Celestial Fire and the vast expanse of lava, with his spiritual power already severely depleted, he could no longer resist and was ultimately incinerated to nothing.
The array fell silent, and the already ravaged Red Sun Sect returned to calm.
Everyone was still in a state of shock; Jiang Cheng had been too valiant.
Gods stopped were God of Slaughtered, and Buddhas stopped were Buddha of Slaughtered, they had nearly fallen into despair.
If it weren’t for the great array, who knows how many would have died.
Only after confirming he was truly dead did they breathe a long sigh of relief.
Master Guiyan wiped the blood from his body, looking at the devastated landscape and corpses, unable to feel any joy.
The losses were too great, in just a quarter-hour of battle, the Red Sun Sect had suffered nearly a thousand casualties.
And most of these were elders and true intra-door disciples, the core figures of a sect.
"Damn Jiang Cheng!"
His eyes were bloodshot, and blood seeped from his clenched teeth.
"Damn Duanmu Family, blood debts must be repaid with blood!"
"And that Feixian Sect!"
"Kill! Kill! Kill!"
The remaining disciples howled like a pack of ferocious wolves, vowing to devour the enemy’s flesh and blood.
In a soul state, Jiang Cheng looked at them speechlessly.
He was obviously the one who attacked the Red Sun Sect, yet somehow they inexplicably turned their hatred towards the Duanmu Family.
If Jiang Cheng were a different kind of transmigrator, he would definitely stoke the flames, letting these two forces tear at each other, causing mutual destruction and ultimately reaping the benefits.
But the thing is, he didn’t need to be so troublesome right now.
After all, with the Undefeated System, attacking head-on himself was more efficient.
As expected, the system soon chimed in.
"Ding, host has been slain, detecting enemy strength..."
To Jiang Cheng, facing this lineup of tens of thousands with a Tier Six array, the system’s best choice would probably still be for the Three-Eyed Tiger to descend.
Even though he himself was reluctant to do the same thing every time, was there a better solution at present?
Could the system perhaps directly upgrade him to the Celestial Fate Realm?
"Ding, the host’s blood-soaked grandeur has moved the War Heroic Souls of the Nine Nether Demons, granting one-time Power of War Soul enhancement, duration 3 minutes."
"For 3 minutes, the damage of any of the host’s attacks is increased by 50 times, and defense by 10 times!"
What?
What’s the Power of War Soul?
Jiang Cheng had never heard of it; War Souls were too distant for his level, unreachable without reaching the Saint Realm.
Yet, how did he move the heroic souls of the Nine Nether Demons?
Blood-soaked battle?
Brother actually just wanted to show off, it wasn’t that glorious or heroic!
Nonetheless, the result was indeed good.
Because he had been so excessively convincing in his performance, he now had 3 minutes of enhanced show-off time.
"Ding, host resurrected!"
In a flash of light, Brother Cheng resurrected on the spot.
Putting on clothes, he felt an explosive surge of power coursing through his body.
Regardless of the shock and awe of Guiyan Master and the remaining Red Sun Sect disciples, he charged forward with his sword.
"You, how come..."
How come you’re not dead?
No time to explain, only three minutes!
If delayed, wouldn’t he regress and be killed again?
Jiang Cheng wasn’t sure what would happen if the system provided a winning strategy and he failed to capture it.
Whoosh, the Spirit Sword swung.
It was as if a colossal tsunami rose before him.
Being already at the Spirit Platform Sixth Layer, this attack power suddenly increased by 50 times, transcending the Celestial Fate Realm.
Guiyan Master across couldn’t even let out a cry, feeling like a plank in a hurricane, unable to withstand the tidal onslaught.
A sword sweep, and Guiyan Master was shattered on the spot.
Indeed, shattered.
The power of this sword qi was truly monstrous.

chapters.title: Chapter 43: Showing Muscles
chapters.content:
Chapter 43: Chapter 43: Showing Muscles
Jiang Cheng originally intended to wield the Dark Spring Sealing Flame Sword, but due to its overwhelming power, he couldn’t fully execute it, ultimately only sweeping a single sword strike.
But this single strike not only eliminated the intended target, Master Guiyan, but also annihilated over ten thousand disciples shrouded within the sword aura ahead.
Just like a sudden gale sweeping across the grassland, all the weeds fell simultaneously.
"No..."
Some elders with quick reflexes escaped far, saving their lives.
Witnessing this scene, they simply couldn’t believe their eyes.
How is such power possible?
At that moment, the great array autonomously attacked the intruding enemies again.
Yet this time, the attack of the array was blasted back by Jiang Cheng’s sword halfway through.
Rumble!
Distant mountain ranges collapsed consecutively, sonic booms echoed in midair, and the entire sky was filled with multi-colored sword aura and flames.
Subsequently, the Sect Protection Array came to a halt.
This time, it wasn’t because the target was killed, but because Jiang Cheng’s sword destroyed it completely.
Crash!
Due to the immense attack power, the Tier Six Spirit Sword in his hand couldn’t withstand the torrent of spiritual power and shattered into pieces on the spot.
"Escape!"
"Quick, flee!"
The remaining elders and disciples dared not stay any longer, fleeing wildly.
But it was already too late.
The Divine-grade Spirit Platform was summoned again, and this time its power increased fifty times!
Before Jiang Cheng even had a chance to unleash the Fourth Layer Spirit Platform Illusion secret technique, everyone present was struck by an invisible giant hammer on the head, plummeting from the sky.
And when he displayed the Spirit Platform secret technique...
The Divine-grade Spirit Platform brought a dark and eerie feast, obliterating the divine souls of everyone within the Red Sun Sect, rendering them completely silent.
The War Soul’s enhancement lasted less than a minute, yet the Red Sun Sect was already exterminated, leaving him as the sole survivor.
This left him with a curious sense of loneliness.
The victory plan offered by the system was overwhelmingly strong, even shocking him.
Mindful of the two minutes remaining to play the role of a big shot, it seemed such a waste not to make the most of it, adhering to his fine tradition of not wasting opportunities, Brother Cheng decided to seize it.
Surprisingly, instead of collecting spoils, he flew out of the Red Sun Sect gates.
Now his speed was dozens of times faster than before, arriving overhead of those loose cultivators outside in the blink of an eye.
Meanwhile, the outside world was awash in blood, with nearly ten thousand onlookers slaughtered here.
However, this wasn’t Jiang Cheng’s doing, but rather an unintended consequence of Master Guiyan’s previous strike.
Besides this, a multitude of cultivators were busy fleeing.
The scene was chaotic, and when Jiang Cheng soared into the sky, he immediately caught the attention of the remaining survivors.
"What’s going on?"
"Was Sect Leader Jiang driven out?"
"Damn Red Sun Sect is too ruthless; we didn’t even enter their gates, and they kill indiscriminately!"
"You better say less, this is the territory of the Red Sun Sect..."
"Everyone rest assured, the Red Sun Sect won’t be committing any more evil!"
Jiang Cheng raised his long sword high, and with spiritual power infused, his powerful voice resounded for hundreds of miles.
