"This sect leader has completely annihilated the Red Sun Sect just now!"
Amongst the mountain ranges, the sound continually echoed, causing everyone’s ears to buzz.
What?
The Red Sun Sect was wiped out?
So swiftly?
That was a major overlord entrenched in Qinglan Prefecture for tens of thousands of years!
No way, right?
Although they had witnessed the might of Jiang Cheng’s Divine-grade Spirit Platform outside the gates before, it still seemed too incredible to them.
Swish!
The long sword swung downward, pointing directly at the vast empty mountain range stretching thousands of miles ahead.
Soon after, everyone saw a soaring sword aura that covered the entire sky, storming out!
Boom!
Rumble!
A cacophony of massive explosions erupted among the mountains thousands of miles away.
Dust roared skyward, and even here the earth shook and the mountains swayed, a colossal earthquake!
Many cultivators couldn’t resist flying into the sky, and were almost shocked into falling.
Seeing among the mountains was a straight path carved, a hundred miles wide, penetrating thousands of miles of mountain ranges, the end of which couldn’t be seen.
This...
Is this something human power can accomplish?
This is simply godlike might!
Again looking at Jiang Cheng, he stood imperiously after retracting his sword, saying not a word but conveying more than a thousand.
No need for an explanation; with such strength, wouldn’t destroying the Red Sun Sect be a minute’s task?
"Sect Leader Jiang’s divine might!"
"Sect Leader Jiang is a celestial god among us!"
"Many thanks to Sect Leader Jiang for destroying the Red Sun Sect, avenging my master!"
The loose cultivators present were shattered in their perception by this strike, completely awed, many kneeling at once to pay homage.
In their eyes, Jiang Cheng was no different from the legendary gods.
Seeing this scene, Brother Cheng felt very satisfied, his desire for showing off being fulfilled like never before.
Such a display of strength, people won’t question whether I’m a weak chicken in the Soul Splitting Realm anymore, right?
Moreover, it could also serve as advertisement for Feixian Sect.
Wasn’t it that many once disregarded or feared joining Feixian Sect?
Now surely they won’t, right?
Thinking there’s still spoils uncollected and the showoff time ending soon, unable to continue with such magnitude, Brother Cheng hastily rode the cloud back to the Red Sun Sect.
"Ding, you have earned 1362 points."
What?
What’s going on?
Just started to harvest, how come there are points already?
He clicked the system to check the record and understood.
Just now that god-like sword strike had three thousand plus cultivators on site, whose hearts proclaimed allegiance to him due to overwhelming admiration.
Though they did not join Feixian Sect, for the system, these people counted as his own.
Besides, the host gained higher prestige, beneficial for the goal of unifying the Three Realms.
So, naturally, a point reward was given.
Most of them had weak strength and talent, hence the aggregate points from three thousand people only added up to a thousand plus.
Nevertheless, it was still an unexpected delight.
Brother Cheng’s mind became lively; the system was encouraging him to show off more openly.
Unfortunately, the boost from the Power of War Soul had passed, and his strength had returned to its original state; otherwise, he really intended to show off everywhere.
The resources of Red Sun Sect exceeded those of Extreme Moon Sect’s several sects, even dazzling Jiang Cheng.
After keeping some high-quality parts, he exchanged most of the Spirit Stone Elixirs and equipment temporarily unusable for points.
With that exchange, a full 55048 points were acquired.
And the Red Sun Sect’s Spirit Vein was higher by a rank too, a Tier Three Spirit Vein, directly exchangeable for 20000 points.
After traversing the Red Sun Sect, a total of 75048 points was obtained, reaching more than ten times of Extreme Moon Sect’s middle-class sect.
This pleasantly surprised Jiang Cheng, knowing Red Sun Sect had richer resources, but not expecting it to such an extent.
Counting the points previously earned, the total exceeded eighty thousand points, making the upgrade to one hundred thousand points soon within reach.

chapters.title: Chapter 44: Sect Leader Jiang Generously Offers Assistance
chapters.content:
Chapter 44: Chapter 44: Sect Leader Jiang Generously Offers Assistance
After finishing, he then flew into the sky and set off on his return journey to the Feixian Sect.
There’s still one resurrection remaining, so why not push on and attack the Duanmu Family?
He still didn’t know Duanmu Hong’s identity, nor that the Dark Spring Sealing Flame Sword was a Duanmu Family secret art. He wasn’t aware the Duanmu Family had already attacked him twice in the shadows.
Although Duanmu Pool had once come to provoke him, he had killed him.
In Jiang Cheng’s view, they were now even.
At least for now, he didn’t have any pressing hatred against the Duanmu Family.
While flying mid-air, he suddenly remembered something.
Recently, it seemed he’d heard many people saying he was too greedy during his carnage, sweeping away all materials, leaving not even a spirit stone for others.
As a result, there were complaints everywhere, seriously affecting his reputation.
As a King Bi, Brother Cheng still cared about his public image.
After pondering for a long time, he decided to part with some valuables to restore his image.
He rummaged in his storage ring for a while and found a lower-grade spirit stone, throwing it onto the ruined square.
He hesitated for a moment, then finally took out two middle-grade spirit stones.
This was his entire stock, as the rest were all top-grade spirit stones, which he absolutely couldn’t give away.
Feeling like the stones on the ground might go unnoticed among the debris, he lifted the three spirit stones and respectfully placed them on the central long table in front of the main hall of the square.
This way, those loose cultivators coming in should be able to spot them at a glance.
By then, they should realize that Sect Leader Jiang is indeed generous, even intentionally leaving a ’red packet’ for them.
When in Rome, do as the Romans do. Brother Cheng, being an old hand in society, naturally understood these conventional rules.
After doing all of this, he floated away, concealing his actions and name.
Not far along in his flight, he saw the canyon spanning a thousand miles that he had split open with a sword.
To be honest, he had opened a path, making this previously mountain-blocked region much more accessible.
Although, this wasn’t his original intention.
Admiring his masterpiece, Brother Cheng felt a strong sense of achievement.
"Huh, why do I sense a familiar aura?"
"Is Ah Huang here?"
He was highly sensitive to the aura of the World Heart Fragments. Last time when he subdued Ah Huang, he’d died once, and the system thereafter gave him a similar origin aura.
It was of the same type and origin, which is why Ah Huang acknowledged him.
And now, he sensed that same aura again.
Activating the Insight Skill, he quickly discovered a golden question mark under that newly opened path.
"World Heart Fragment..."
"It actually really is!"
Jiang Cheng was overjoyed; the value of this item was evident from how powerful Ah Huang was.
The key was this treasure’s rarity, finding it relied completely on luck.
"It must be the reward and compensation from the Heavenly Dao for my recent generous giveaway, right?"
He was relying on having one more resurrection, not afraid at all of being struck by lightning for his words.
After some excavation, he unearthed a glowing, finger-sized crystal fragment.
Cradled in his palm, the fragment floated, not touching the sky nor the ground, utterly magical.
"Has this fragment not developed its own consciousness?"
It truly came effortlessly.
"Whatever, let’s take it back for Ah Huang to look at!"
Not until half an hour after he left, when the Red Sun Sect welcomed new visitors—the group of loose cultivators from outside.
Not only them, but also some from nearby who rushed over upon hearing the news.
This time they didn’t hold much hope, after all, none of the four sects wiped out before had allowed anyone else to reap benefits.
"With Sect Leader Jiang’s style, we’re definitely making a pointless trip this time."
"Well, trying doesn’t cost anything."
"You don’t know, but Jiang Cheng somehow used magic to even scour away every single spirit stone, truly a divine technique of plucking feathers from flying geese."
"Let’s disperse..."
When they went in, besides being shocked by the ground full of dead people, they were simultaneously infuriated by the stark white ground, cleaned of all valuables.
They couldn’t help silently cursing Jiang Cheng with foul language.
Wishing they could curse him a hundred times.
"Huh, there’s something left here..."
"What?"
"There’s treasure still left?"
"Haha, Jiang Cheng actually slipped up and missed it? So he too has such a day?"
"What treasure is it?"
"Whatever it is, it’s mine!"
"All of you step aside, the treasure belongs to our Celestial Fierce Gang!"
"Who do you think you are, get lost!"
"Put the treasure down!"
"Alright, alright, all of you stop arguing, whoever wants it can take it."
The cultivator who first found the ’treasure’ looked speechless as he pointed at the three spirit stones on the table.
Silence fell across the room.
The groups fighting over it were suddenly awkward, expecting to find some rare treasure, only to see it was just three spirit stones.
And one of them being lower-grade...
They almost went to battle over three spirit stones, spilling blood like rivers.
If word got out, wouldn’t they become a laughingstock?
"Damn that stingy bastard!"
"What is he trying to say with this?"
"Leaving three spirit stones intentionally to humiliate us?"
"Do you think this trivial junk means anything to me?"
"Better watch what you say, Sect Leader Jiang has vast divine techniques, maybe he can hear you right now."
"Exactly, what’s wrong with a bit of humiliation? Why don’t you go find him at the Feixian Sect and settle the account?"
Even those cultivators who admired Jiang Cheng chimed in.
"Sect Leader Jiang left these three spirit stones, there must be some deeper meaning, right?"
Someone shook their head knowingly: "I think these three spirit stones represent the three talents of heaven, earth, and man. Once the mystery within is grasped, a significant breakthrough in cultivation is just around the corner!"
"Wrong, I think it represents the three lights of sun, moon, and star..."
"One small two big, does it symbolize two veins merging in the Sea of Qi?"
Suddenly, the scene turned into a Daoist symposium.
If Jiang Cheng were to witness this scene, he’d likely be quite bewildered.
Meanwhile, inside the Feixian Sect, the Three-Eyed Tiger lay on a soft chair, basking in the flattery of the disciples.
With good food and drinks and being well-attended, it even began to think that this remote and barren place wasn’t too bad after all.
"Master Tiger, you said the sect leader would summon you if he was in danger, so why is there still no sign?"
"Yeah, did the sect leader solve the crisis himself?"
The Three-Eyed Tiger squinted and glanced sideways at Luo Yuan’s third apprentice, Shan Tai.
"What, are you doubting Master Tiger’s authority?"
"Not at all, not at all."
Shan Tai hurriedly waved his hands with a smile.
"We’re just worried about the sect leader, hoping nothing unexpected happens?"
"That kid may have low power, but he’s clever with summoning talismans, don’t worry."
Although the Three-Eyed Tiger said this, it was thinking—it’s been over half a day, did he really die out there?
If that’s the case, then Master Tiger would be completely free.
Thinking of this, it excitedly wagged its little fluffy legs.
A few female disciples nearly couldn’t resist going up to cuddle it again.
This little thing was cuter than a kitten.
But thinking of its power and its vile language, they suddenly found it less adorable.

chapters.title: Chapter 45: Returning with a Full Load
chapters.content:
Chapter 45: Chapter 45: Returning with a Full Load
"Anyway, if he triggers the Summoning Talisman, you’ll see a white vortex."
"At that time, you’ll know who he relied on to destroy those sects."
"Without Master Tiger, he’s nothing."
The Three-Eyed Tiger closed its eyes, feeling quite pleased.
It was more than happy to take Jiang Cheng down a peg, happy enough to be active in doing so.
If it couldn’t defeat that kid, it could at least ruin his reputation, reveal his true form, and see if those disciples still admired him so much afterward.
What, you ask what benefits Master Tiger gains from doing this?
Does it need to gain anything?
It’s not like it hasn’t ever done something that harms others without benefiting itself.
It had just finished speaking when it was lifted by the nape of its neck.
Then it soared into the air, getting thrown out.
Who dared to treat Master Tiger like this?
Just as it was about to get angry, it heard Jiang Cheng’s familiar voice.
"Why are you back in my spot again? Pay attention to your position."
This kid is back?
The Three-Eyed Tiger was actually lazy; with its power, it could sense Jiang Cheng with just a single divine thought.
But it was enjoying its leisure and didn’t want to waste the energy.
"Sect Leader!"
"Ah, the Sect Leader is back!"
"Sect Leader, are you alright? Why didn’t you summon Brother Hu?"
As soon as Jiang Cheng returned, the disciples downgraded the Three-Eyed Tiger’s title from Master Tiger to Brother Hu.
Having someone to back you up makes all the difference.
"Why would I need to summon it?"
"Uh, well..."
Luo Yuan stammered; it really wasn’t easy to tell Jiang Cheng to his face that he only destroyed so many sects relying on the Three-Eyed Tiger.
Either way, those grudges were avenged by Jiang Cheng stepping in.
And the good treatment they received was all because of Jiang Cheng.
Ji Linghan gave a meaningful look, and the disciples tacitly played it off with laughter.
"It’s nothing, Sect Leader, even if you didn’t destroy the Red Sun Sect, it’s no big deal."
"Yeah, there’s no rush."
"No need to rush at the moment."
In their eyes, Brother Cheng was exaggerating a bit.
But that didn’t stop them from supporting and loving him.
Jiang Cheng felt very disappointed, quite disappointed.
After boasting so massively at the Red Sun Sect, they were completely unaware?
It seems the intelligence systems like voice transmissions and image projections in the Feixian Sect need an urgent upgrade.
"Who said I didn’t destroy the Red Sun Sect?"
This rhetorical question was an affirmation, and the disciples were astonished.
"Huh?"
"You destroyed them?"
"How did you do it?"
Jiang Cheng smirked and casually said, "How else? Of course, with my deep and profound power as Sect Leader."
The Three-Eyed Tiger sneered.
"With your so-called deep and profound power..."
It suddenly shut up because it just realized Jiang Cheng was no longer at the Soul Splitting Eighth Layer, but at the Spirit Platform Sixth Layer.
This discovery shocked it beyond belief.
Spirit Platform Sixth Layer was still an ant to the Three-Eyed Tiger.
But it shattered its understanding.
In just half a day, he jumped eight small realms, and one of them was across a great realm.
This kind of thing, it had heard of, but only at the most basic advancement from the Body Tempering Realm to Condensing Vein Realm.
Some absolute geniuses, along with serendipitous encounters, could indeed rise several minor levels within a few short hours.
But at the Soul Splitting and Spirit Platform levels, this was almost impossible.
However, this impossible thing happened right under its nose.
"How, how did you do that?"
"I told you, I’m an expert, isn’t that obvious?"
Brother Cheng was so adept at boasting that he didn’t even blush.
"Pah!"
The Three-Eyed Tiger couldn’t get an answer, so it continued to undermine him.
"Even with your current power, you couldn’t possibly destroy the Red Sun Sect."
"Whether they’re destroyed, can’t you just see for yourself?"
"Watch then!"
The Three-Eyed Tiger then extended its divine thought, spreading it across a hundred thousand miles.
Moments later, its eyes were as wide as saucers.
"How, how did you manage it?"
"You actually left not a single one?"
"Even in the Celestial Fate Realm, that’s not possible!"
The Celestial Fate Realm could wipe out the Red Sun Sect, but not so cleanly.
"I’ve said it eight hundred times already, I’m an unparalleled expert!"
"I clearly don’t want to brag, so why do you keep forcing me to prove how strong I really am?"
Brother Cheng felt aggrieved, the Three-Eyed Tiger was confused, and the disciples were all astonished.
Oh my, Sect Leader actually obliterated the Red Sun Sect single-handedly?
Instantly, all the disciples’ admiration for Jiang Cheng rose to a new level, nearly viewing him as a living immortal.
"Sect Leader is a divine being!"
"His power is indeed unfathomable!"
"Little Brain Axe said that Sect Leader relied on it to destroy four sects before, but that was just boasting without any basis."
"Exactly, Sect Leader can destroy the Red Sun Sect all by himself, let alone those sects."
"It just took advantage of the Sect Leader’s absence to flatter itself."
"Exactly, it’s not even one-thousandth of the Sect Leader."
These words deeply provoked the Three-Eyed Tiger.
It was so furious it gritted its teeth and stomped its feet, yet had no evidence to prove itself.
Jiang Cheng certainly wouldn’t explain or testify for it.
So this guy took advantage while he was gone to undermine him behind his back?
Did it want to fool his disciples into rebelling?
This was intolerable!
Not beating it up was Brother Cheng’s mercy.
"Alright, we can talk about celebrating later, but now we can start recruiting new members."
Mentioning this made everyone excited.
"Now that the Sect Leader has defeated the Red Sun Sect, new recruits can join without any concerns!"
"Exactly, this time many talents will surely come to join us."
"The growth of the Feixian Sect is within reach!"
"Finally, it will become lively again..."
Luo Yuan, excited, suddenly remembered that the Sect Leader only accepted true disciples, not inner and outer sect members.
So, even if many people applied, the Feixian Sect wouldn’t gain many new members.
It was still far from being lively.
"Sect Leader, can’t we accept a few more people?"
"No!"
Jiang Cheng answered decisively.
But then he changed his tone: "If they’re unparalleled beauties, we can slightly lower the standards."
Uh...
The disciples couldn’t bear to look.
Brother, though everyone’s aware of some preferences, isn’t voicing it so bluntly a bit damaging to your image?
Especially since you’re the esteemed Sect Leader.
"Ahem!"
Ji Linghan cleared her throat softly and gave Jiang Cheng a meaningful glance.
Then she solemnly told Luo Yuan: "The Sect Leader has said he’ll only accept true disciples, why ask more? Those without the talent for true discipleship will not be given exceptions!"
She then added, earnestly, "Don’t make things difficult for the Sect Leader, understood?"
Luo Yuan couldn’t help but break into a cold sweat, inwardly feeling wronged.
Clearly, it was the Sect Leader who mentioned beauties, not him. Why reprimand him?
Also, the senior sister seemed to be gaining more authority!
With Ji Linghan’s interference, Brother Cheng’s plan to recruit more beauties as maidservants couldn’t be mentioned again and had to be temporarily shelved.
"By the way, store these in the Library Pavilion."
After speaking, he swiped his ring, and an array of ancient books and jade talismans fell out.
"What are these?"
"Looted from the Red Sun Sect, all their Cultivation and Martial Techniques, Spirit Platform Secret Techniques, Pill Refining Artifact Talisman Arrays, and other classics..."

chapters.title: Chapter 46: After Modification - 46 Ah Huang Upgrades
chapters.content:
Chapter 46: After Modification: Chapter 46 Ah Huang Upgrades
"Wow!"
Before he could finish speaking, the disciples almost went crazy.
"These, these are treasures!"
"There’s even a Spirit Platform Secret Technique, a priceless treasure!"
"The alchemy problem that’s been bothering me is recorded in this classic, but I never had the chance to see it before..."
"Oh my god, the swordsmanship of the Red Sun Sect is several times superior to ours!"
For Cultivators, whether it’s cultivation and martial techniques or other classics, they are extremely important.
They’re like guiding lights for them.
The foundation and power of the Feixian Sect are there, and there are things they are destined never to touch.
Just like Ji Linghan, her talent is exceptional. But even if the Feixian Sect wasn’t destroyed, she would only reach the Spirit Platform Realm in her lifetime.
Because she didn’t have the follow-up cultivation techniques...
But now, with the classics of the Red Sun Sect, it’s different.
She can cultivate to the Celestial Fate Realm without a problem.
At this moment, she even disregarded her image, sitting on the floor of the great hall, engrossed in a certain classic.
Jiang Cheng couldn’t help but twitch his mouth, seeing how hard you’re all working makes me feel a bit guilty.
Does cultivation require such dedication?
He hadn’t even read a single cultivation technique.
"Put them all in the Library Pavilion. There’s plenty of time to read later."
He waved his hand.
"In the future, these classics will be our Feixian Sect’s sect cultivation techniques. You can all cultivate them, no need to rush."
Only then did everyone reluctantly put them down.
But from the looks of it, the Library Pavilion will be the busiest place in the sect in the future.
After making the arrangements, Jiang Cheng came to the spirit vein at the back mountain.
"Mom, I’m hungry, hungry!"
As soon as he saw him, Ah Huang eagerly rushed over.
This kid, a foodie huh?
Fortunately, he acquired Spirit Stones quickly; otherwise, ordinary Cultivators couldn’t afford to raise him.
Seeing tens of thousands of top-grade Spirit Stones, Ah Huang beamed with joy and gave him two smacks.
"Mommy is great."
Brother Cheng didn’t know whether to be happy or annoyed.
This kid, won’t you change the way you address?
The little girl absorbed Spirit Stones quickly, devouring them in the blink of an eye, although digestion took time.
Taking advantage of the moment, Jiang Cheng brought out the fragment he obtained this time.
"Ah, this is..."
Ah Huang’s black eyes almost froze, drooling at the sight of the fragment.
"Ahem, it’s a World Heart Fragment! It’s something Daddy acquired through untold hardships, using all his tricks, enduring numerous injuries, overcoming many challenges to obtain!"
The process of him acquiring this fragment was ridiculously simple.
He was now rambling just to make his daughter think her daddy was great.
If he could see two tears of touched emotion, that would be perfect.
Unfortunately, Ah Huang didn’t listen to any of it.
She grabbed the fragment in her hand and threw it into her mouth.
Crunch, crunch, she chewed a few times and then swallowed it down with a gulp.
Brother Cheng’s eyes were wide open, hey, you yourself are a World Heart Fragment, right?
Aren’t other fragments your kin?
You just eat it directly, so unconcerned?
He originally heard that fragments could fuse and thought there would be some complicated ritual, even needing the two fragments to discuss things.
Moreover, after the fusion, he thought Ah Huang might undergo a major personality change or something.
But it turned out the fragment was ground into powder and swallowed by her.
Then, Ah Huang really changed.
A golden light exploded, shooting straight into the sky.
The ground within a thousand-mile radius of the Feixian Sect seemed to be gilded, and even the people were illuminated to appear like immortals.
The golden light came quickly and disappeared just as swiftly.
When other disciples rushed over, she had already transformed into a little girl about ten years old.
Not to mention the disciples, even the Three-Eyed Tiger was dumbfounded.
What did she eat to grow faster than a demon beast?
However, it didn’t dare act rashly because it found this little girl seemed to have become more dangerous than before.
The previous scene of having its spiritual power drained was still vivid in its mind.
Jiang Cheng was equally astonished; he hadn’t expected his daughter to grow by fusing other fragments.
If she fused dozens of fragments, wouldn’t she turn into an old lady?
Thinking of that scenario, he shuddered.
"Mommy treats me so well!"
After leveling up, Ah Huang immediately rushed over to show affection.
"Oh right, my dear daughter, can you now upgrade the tier of the spirit vein here?"
"Of course I can!"
Ah Huang, freshly upgraded and in high spirits, directly jumped into the spirit vein.
Soon, a buzzing sound came from underground, and the earth trembled.
A moment later, everything returned to calm.
"It’s a Tier Four Spirit Vein now!"
"The concentration of spiritual qi is definitely Tier Four."
"It’s amazing, our Feixian Sect has become a Grotto Heaven Blessed Land!"
At this time, the spiritual qi in the mountain gate was so rich that even mortals from the Mortal World could easily sense it.
Just a casual breath of it, and the absorbed spiritual qi was over ten times what it used to be.
With such an environment for daily cultivation, who knows how much faster one’s progress would be.
Such a huge joy, the disciples were all dancing with happiness, even Ji Linghan couldn’t hide her excitement.
The Three-Eyed Tiger was bewildered once more.
Did that little girl just upgrade the spirit vein’s tier?
He honestly hadn’t heard of anyone capable of such a feat, not even as a Demon King.
To be honest, it had always looked down on the Feixian Sect, viewing it as some desolate place where birds wouldn’t even perch.
But now, it had to change its opinion.
If that little girl got stronger, couldn’t she upgrade the spirit vein to Tier Five or Six?
If it reaches Tier Six, the spiritual qi concentration wouldn’t be much different from its lair in the Celestial Demon Domain.
How on earth is this possible?
It racked its brains yet couldn’t figure it out.
Meanwhile, on the other side, the second patriarch of the Duanmu Family, Duanmu Zhe, personally arrived at the Eight Clouds Hall, the largest power in Feiyun State.
The Eight Clouds Hall hadn’t dominated over all the major family sects in the six prefectures of Feiyun State, not because they couldn’t, but because they weren’t interested.
A place like Qinglan Prefecture didn’t even catch their eyes.
Nothing here could produce a treasure that could impress them.
As for the internal and external battles between prefectures, they never intervened.
Their focus had always been on other states and higher levels.
Duanmu Zhe came here to seek reinforcements.
Jiang Cheng didn’t know it was Duanmu Hong who attempted to assassinate him, and he had no intention to destroy the Duanmu Family.
But the Duanmu Family didn’t think so; they assumed Jiang Cheng had his sights on their clan. Who knew, by tomorrow, he might wipe out their family like he did to the Red Sun Sect.
To them, this was a life-and-death crisis.
The entire Duanmu Family had entered a state of war readiness, and some elite members were sent away overnight as a precaution.
Just in case they were truly wiped out, leaving seeds of vengeance for the family.
Eight Clouds Hall, being the largest sect in Feiyun State, had more than one Celestial Fate Realm expert stationed within.
Here, his Spirit Platform Realm Fourth Layer was merely equivalent to an ordinary Outer Sect Elder, not noteworthy at all.
In Duanmu Zhe’s mind, if he could persuade Eight Clouds Hall to send troops, the Feixian Sect would face annihilation, such that even with the help of the Tiger Demon, it would be hopeless.
Yet, he had been here for three days and hadn’t even managed to see the Sect Leader of Eight Clouds Hall, let alone any Inner Sect Elder.

chapters.title: Chapter 47: Qi Cang’s Plot
chapters.content:
Chapter 47: Chapter 47: Qi Cang’s Plot
It’s not that there aren’t any people from the Eight Clouds Hall, it’s just that they can’t be bothered to see him.
Despite the Duanmu Family’s dominance in Qinglan Prefecture, they are nothing when it comes to Feiyun State.
It wasn’t until the fifth day, after bribing an elder with a large number of spirit stones, that Duanmu Zhe finally got a chance to meet the Eight Clouds Hall’s Young Master Qi Cang.
The Young Master of the Eight Clouds Hall is not equivalent to a crown prince of a country.
Although Qi Cang’s father is the Palace Master, his future as the next Palace Master depends on his own power.
His status is actually similar to that of a true disciple.
As for his realm, he is currently at the Spirit Platform Eighth Layer.
In the Eight Clouds Hall, this is not very outstanding, but Duanmu Zhe places great importance on this meeting.
As long as he can enlist this person, the threat from the Feixian Sect will be easily resolved.
If Qi Cang can’t handle it, wouldn’t his Palace Master father need to step in?
"Young Master, you must stand up for our Duanmu Family. That Feixian Sect is excessively tyrannical and hateful..."
As soon as he started, he burst into tears.
But Qi Cang wouldn’t have any of it.
"Speak quickly if you have something to say; if you ramble on, I’ll smack you to death!"
Duanmu Zhe could hardly believe his ears; the esteemed Young Master of the Eight Clouds Hall spoke so crudely.
However, the effect was quite good.
He immediately stopped his sobbing and succinctly recounted Jiang Cheng’s recent deeds.
Such as wiping out five sects, killing Duanmu Pool and Duanmu Hong, and the divine-grade Spirit Platform, among other things.
In addition, he also disclosed the existence of the Three-Eyed Tiger.
The Duanmu Family didn’t witness the battle where the Red Sun Sect was destroyed, so they assumed that the Three-Eyed Tiger secretly helped Jiang Cheng.
"You say he has a spirit pet at the Celestial Fate Realm level?"
Initially, Qi Cang didn’t take the Feixian Sect seriously.
He wasn’t even aware of the Extreme Moon Sect’s Four Sects being destroyed.
It wasn’t until the Red Sun Sect was also wiped out that he heard about it, but he still didn’t pay much attention.
Destroyed is destroyed, much like humans watching a cockfight; no matter which rooster wins, it doesn’t affect the humans’ dominant position.
But hearing the details now, he couldn’t help but feel a jolt of surprise.
He had assumed the Feixian Sect mobilized a large army, but it turned out it was accomplished by one person and one beast?
Jiang Cheng was acceptable, probably still at the Spirit Platform Realm.
But the Tiger Demon couldn’t be ignored; an existence at the Celestial Fate Realm level was already a threat to the Eight Clouds Hall.
"Yes, that Tiger Demon is formidable. My younger brother’s true form was killed from thousands of miles away by it..."
Qi Cang impatiently waved his hand.
"Alright, alright, you can leave now."
What?
Leave?
Is there no further comment after hearing all this?
Like saying you will back us up or something?
Duanmu Zhe felt wronged but dared not ask.
It was only after he left that Qi Cang spoke to the empty space in front of him.
"Master Lu, what do you think?"
A gaunt old man with gray hair and a gray robe slowly materialized in front of him.
If Duanmu Zhe were still there, he would have recognized that this was Lu Zhong, one of the Council Elders of the Eight Clouds Hall.
The Council Elders, in terms of both actual power and status, are above the Inner Sect Elders.
The Eight Clouds Hall has only 15 Council Elders, and Lu Zhong is a true power figure.
"The total annihilation of the Red Sun Sect is something that even the Palace Master himself could not easily achieve."
The Palace Master of the Eight Clouds Hall is naturally a Celestial Fate Expert; destroying the Red Sun Sect is not difficult for him, but leaving none alive is the challenge.
"Meaning, that Tiger Demon is even more formidable than we thought?"
"Precisely, this matter must be handled with caution!"
They both tacitly agreed that the Three-Eyed Tiger secretly assisted Jiang Cheng in destroying the Red Sun Sect.
Because according to Duanmu Zhe, Jiang Cheng was still showcasing the Spirit Platform.
Once cultivators reach the Celestial Fate Realm, the most notable feature is the transformation of the Spirit Platform into a Divine Mansion.
Even though the divine-grade Spirit Platform is exceptionally extraordinary, far surpassing Qi Cang’s saint-grade Spirit Platform, having revealed the Spirit Platform implies he hasn’t reached the Celestial Fate Realm.
Therefore, it’s certain that Jiang Cheng wasn’t the one who wiped out the Red Sun Sect, and there’s no need to bring him up.
If Jiang Cheng were present, he would surely be furious.
It was clearly my doing this time, what does this lazy old tiger have to do with it?
Moreover, I even made an effort to show off with a sweep across the thousand-mile ranges with a single sword. What was all the hard work for?
Fortune does indeed turn like a wheel.
In front of the sect disciples, he brazenly took credit for the Three-Eyed Tiger’s destruction of the Four Sects, and now others attribute his achievements to the Three-Eyed Tiger.
"This matter should best be reported to the Palace Master!"
Although Lu Zhong himself was at the Celestial Fate First Layer, he felt that this incident was somewhat dangerous, and that Tiger Demon was probably beyond his ability to handle.
But Qi Cang waved his hand in refusal.
"No worries, I have a clever plan to deal with the Feixian Sect."
He had his strategy.
The true disciples of the Eight Clouds Hall number in the hundreds, and the next Palace Master will be chosen from these individuals.
Qi Cang, as the current Palace Master’s son, possesses top-notch talent and ranks among the top three of those hundreds, but he is not first.
To increase his chances, he must either form alliances to gain more support or become stronger.
He was already forming alliances, and Lu Zhong as a Council Elder was now considered part of his faction.
As for becoming stronger, that relied on opportunities.
In his view, Jiang Cheng’s sudden rise and the Tiger Demon’s assistance must mean there are great adventures and opportunities behind it.
What he intended to do was seize all of Jiang Cheng’s opportunities.
In his eyes, the Feixian Sect was a place full of opportunities.
If he reported it, wouldn’t it mean more competitors?
Seeing through his intentions, Lu Zhong naturally didn’t interfere.
"What do you plan to do?"
"It’s simple, infiltrate them first."
A flash of cunning wisdom gleamed in Qi Cang’s deep eyes.
"The Feixian Sect is currently recruiting, which is a chance they willingly presented."
Lu Zhong pondered for a moment and couldn’t help but smile.
This was precisely why he chose to support Qi Cang in his bid for the next Palace Master.
Not only was this young man of noble origin and outstanding talent, but he also had a sharp mind.
If others had his background and power, they would probably already be arrogantly shouting threats and not taking anyone seriously.
In the end, either due to rashness or a misunderstanding of the enemy’s situation, they would rashly provoke and be killed by the enemy instead.
Why bother?
Being targeted by someone like Qi Cang, that’s the real danger.
...
A few days later, after a series of preparations, the recruitment assessment of the Feixian Sect began with great fanfare.
This time, there were tens of thousands of young cultivators from all over Qinglan Prefecture.
Some of them even came from the surrounding prefectures.
Such scale could only compare to the Eight Clouds Hall’s recruitment events in Feiyun State.
With the Red Sun Sect wiped out, the Feixian Sect was thriving and gaining widespread renown.
They had already overshadowed the Duanmu Family.
That’s only natural. The Duanmu Family had contended with the Red Sun Sect for tens of thousands of years without winning.
The Feixian Sect moved once, and the Red Sun Sect became history.
Who’s strong and who’s weak is obvious, isn’t it?
Who wouldn’t want to be part of such a strong sect?
Especially since the Feixian Sect had few members and plenty of resources. Even though they knew they were only recruiting true disciples this time, many still came with the hope of a lucky break.
Brother Cheng flew above the grand hall, overlooking the distant crowd, and couldn’t help but feel a surge of pride, wishing to recite a poem.
But after holding it in for a while, he couldn’t come up with a masterpiece and finally had to give up.
Meanwhile, in the distance below, Ji Linghan, Luo Yuan, Yin Xuer, and others were so busy with the newcomer assessment that their heads were spinning.

chapters.title: Chapter 48: Competing for Disciples
chapters.content:
Chapter 48: Chapter 48: Competing for Disciples
This kind of entry examination often consists of several stages.
It conducts a comprehensive assessment of a cultivator’s physique, talent, comprehension, and character.
Only by passing all the stages does one qualify for entry.
This time, only true disciples are being recruited, and the standards are raised significantly.
It’s almost an elimination of one for every entry, and very few can pass the first stage.
Brother Cheng initially wanted to personally oversee this grand event; he thought that such a large scene was very impressive, and the weather and attendance were perfect for showing off.
But Ji Linghan voluntarily took over the task, with a determined attitude, saying that the Sect Leader shouldn’t lower himself to handle such minor matters.
Jiang Cheng had no choice but to relent.
He’s not dumb; he actually knew Ji Linghan’s intent.
With her in charge of the selection, his hope of recruiting more beauties against the odds and turning the Feixian Sect into a yin-over-yang paradise would fall through.
Thinking of this, he felt a bit melancholic.
Although some stages of the entry examination involve arrays for automatic detection, due to the sheer number of participants, the process still seemed overwhelming long.
After three days and nights of work, out of hundreds of thousands of applicants, 55 people finally stood out.
These 55 individuals all excelled in physique, talent, comprehension, and character, reaching the level of true disciples in terms of talent.
Ji Linghan, Luo Yuan, and others were pleasantly surprised; this number far exceeded their expectations.
It’s known that in the past, recruiting one or two true disciples in one go was already very good.
The cultivation levels of these 55 varied.
Some were still young and in the Condensing Vein Realm.
Others had reached the Energy-Introducing Realm.
Jiang Cheng’s arrangement for these disciples was to make them third generation disciples.
With the reconstruction of the Feixian Sect, the first generation, of course, is him as the Sect Leader.
The second generation is Ji Linghan and her 21 members, all in the Gathering Yuan Realm.
After the recent surge in sect spiritual energy, everyone’s cultivation level increased even faster.
Currently, the weakest among the 21 has reached the Gathering Yuan Seventh Layer.
And Ji Linghan has even broken through to the Soul Splitting First Layer, on par with the previous elders’ cultivation level.
At this rate, it won’t be long before all 21 breakthrough to the Soul Splitting Realm is imminent.
Because of their continuous breakthroughs, Jiang Cheng received some points as rewards.
Other people’s breakthroughs were worth dozens of points, but when Ji Linghan broke through to the Soul Splitting Realm, the system unexpectedly awarded 3000 points.
The newly recruited third-generation disciples will become their apprentices.
What, you ask why Brother Cheng doesn’t personally take on disciples?
He’s busy showing off everywhere; where’s the time to nurture disciples like a hands-on parent?
Isn’t it wonderful to be an ancestor who worries about nothing?
After the 55 new disciples entered the core area of the sect, their faces were all filled with shock.
Then came the euphoria.
Before, they sensed during the assessment at the mountain gate that the concentration of spiritual energy there unexpectedly reached Tier Three.
Now, everyone suddenly realized that the spiritual energy concentration in this core area had increased another level.
It’s ridiculously high, making it hard for them to move, wishing they could sit down immediately to cultivate endlessly.
"This, this..."
A disciple asked tremblingly, "Elder Luo, is this possibly a Level 4 Spirit Vein?"
The apprenticeship ceremony hadn’t happened yet, so they couldn’t call anyone Master or Senior Uncle.
Before taking them in, Jiang Cheng promoted them all to elders.
Luo Yuan was not much older than them, but hearing himself called elder still made him feel wonderfully content.
Unexpectedly, he rose to senior status so quickly.
He lightly coughed, mimicking Brother Cheng’s typical pose of showing off, with hands behind his back, head held high, calmly stating, "Exactly Tier Four."
"Wow!"
"Oh my gosh, it’s truly a Tier Four Spirit Vein!"
"A Grotto Heaven Blessed Land, such a concentration of spiritual energy could probably only be found over at Feiyun State, right?"
"That’s right, I’ve heard that neither the Red Sun Sect nor the Duanmu Family has anything above a Tier Three Spirit Vein."
"Fortunately, I registered this time!"
"Training here, my cultivation will surely progress by leaps and bounds..."
The newcomers were extremely excited; at this moment, they wished they could always belong to the Feixian Sect.
However, there was always an exception among them.
Qi Cang stood in the middle of the 55 individuals, outwardly full of surprise, but inwardly sneering non-stop.
Yes, he had infiltrated successfully.
The Feixian Sect has a Three-Eyed Tiger of unknown power; attacking recklessly is clearly unwise.
Disguising as a newcomer and entering the Feixian Sect in a legitimate manner is a smarter strategy.
As for what to do once inside, he had plenty of methods.
First, he had to investigate what Jiang Cheng’s mysterious opportunity truly was, and find ways to seize it.
Secondly, how does he control that Three-Eyed Tiger?
Eliminating the Red Sun Sect suggests that the tiger demon’s power is at least at Celestial Fate Ninth Layer, possibly higher!
How could a tiger demon this strong be subdued by someone in the Spirit Platform Realm?
There must be a reason behind it.
If he could uncover the source, then—replacing Jiang Cheng as the new master of that tiger demon wasn’t impossible!
Once he had the tiger demon as a spirit pet helper, would the position of Master of the Eight Clouds Hall still be in question?
He left no room for error; before infiltrating, he had his confidants create a fake identity as a local cultivator from Qinglan Prefecture, eliminating any traceable issues.
And the entry process went quite smoothly.
With his talent, passing the true disciple assessment was a breeze, wasn’t it?
Originally at the Spirit Platform Eighth Layer, he used various means to suppress it to Energy-Introducing Sixth Layer.
Even so, among a group of talented disciples, he still stood out.
At this time, everyone gathered at the square in front of the hall.
The newcomers couldn’t contain their excitement, looking around in all directions.
Even the older members couldn’t remain calm.
So many promising seedlings, which would become their disciples?
Luo Yuan was the first to step forward, approaching a girl who looked about fifteen or sixteen years old.
"Lin Ning, I wish to take you as my disciple. Are you willing?"
The young girl’s name was Lin Ning; she had a delicate appearance and eyes like frosty mist, giving off a unique air of aloofness and pride.
Luo Yuan favored her, not because of her outstanding appearance and demeanor, but because of her talent.
This assessment consisted of four stages, and Lin Ning ranked first in each, remarkable enough to invoke envy in her peers.
Her talent was possibly not inferior to Ji Linghan’s.
Throughout the assessment, she constantly amazed everyone.
Though only fifteen years old, she was already past Energy Introduction, having reached Spirit Formation Ninth Layer, not far from Luo Yuan and others in the Gathering Yuan Realm.
Such a rare gem would excite anyone, eager to have her under their tutelage.
However, before Lin Ning could respond, others weren’t willing to accept it.
Yin Xiaoxue shoved Luo Yuan aside and then cheerfully squeezed over.
"Lin Ning, following him might not be convenient; we’re both women. With my guidance, you’ll progress rapidly!"
Luo Yuan, exasperated, glared at her through gritted teeth.
"Junior Sister Yin, are you trying to compete with me?"
Taking on a disciple means a lifelong teacher-student bond that cannot be changed, and he wasn’t going to back down.
"So what if I am?"
Yin Xiaoxue was equally determined.

chapters.title: Chapter 49 Qi Cang Goes Crazy
chapters.content:
Chapter 49: Chapter 49 Qi Cang Goes Crazy
When the two were arguing, the other ’Elders’ also looked for opportunities to recruit.
"Lin Ning, my cultivation is higher than hers, you should follow me instead!"
"Hehe, I have an excellent relationship with the Sect Leader. If you become my disciple, your future cultivation will be much more convenient..."
"Lin Ning, say it yourself, who do you want to follow?"
Nobody wanted to miss the chance to recruit this genius girl.
The sight made the other disciples incredibly envious.
They still had to wait for someone to choose them, but Lin Ning had the power to choose an Elder. This is the difference between an absolute genius and an ordinary talent.
"Thank you for your kindness, Elders, but Lin Ning already has someone in mind, apologies!"
This apology clearly meant that she did not want to acknowledge any of them as her master.
Feeling disappointed, Luo Yuan, Yin Xiaoxue, and the others could only sigh and shift their gazes to Ji Linghan.
It was clear; apart from Ji Linghan, who else in the sect was qualified to be her master?
Anyone else would likely be surpassed by her in less than two years.
However, this also sparked the competition for disciples.
Since they couldn’t recruit Lin Ning, they decided to select other outstanding seedlings.
Only the quick ones get them, the slow ones do not!
In an instant, the square became like a bustling market.
Even in front of Qi Cang appeared an ’Elder’.
"Young one, I am willing to take you as my disciple, you may now become my apprentice!"
The speaker was Shan Tai, and eyeing his plump body and sensing his mere Gathering Essence Seventh Layer strength, Qi Cang very much wanted to punch him flat in the nose.
Damn it, who are you calling young one?
I am the Young Master of the Eight Clouds Hall, a Spirit Platform Eighth Layer expert!
And yet, here you are, a mere ant not even qualified to meet me, daring to overestimate yourself by trying to take me as a disciple?
What kind of attitude is "you may become my apprentice"?
But, a play must be acted fully.
Thinking about his future plans, thinking about his grand scheme, he could only endure, continuing to play the role of a regular disciple.
"Thank you for your kindness, Elder, but I..."
Even if I really have to pretend to become an apprentice in the future, it won’t be to you, this waste of time.
I could either apprentice under Ji Linghan or Yin Xiaoxue, but you, this dead fat man, deserve no chance.
Before he finished speaking, he was interrupted.
"What now? You too want to be like Lin Ning, looking down on this and that, choosing your own master?"
Shan Tai sternly reprimanded with a serious face: "Young people shouldn’t aim too high; recognize your own capabilities!"
He actually dared to lecture me?
Teaching me how to live?
If it weren’t for Qi Cang’s deep scheming and patience, anyone else might have reacted by now.
"The Elder’s teachings are right."
He truly had no way to refute, for when he entered the sect, his test scores weren’t outstanding.
Though his disguised Energy-Introducing Realm cultivation was decent among the third-generation disciples, he was older.
To avoid attracting special attention, he deliberately kept his scores in the four assessments just above the standard for true disciples.
In Shan Tai’s eyes, this disciple was among the bottom five in talent among the 55 true disciples.
He wasn’t qualified to take Lin Ning as a disciple, but surely he could take you?
"Then hurry up and become my disciple!"
Qi Cang really wanted to just slap him to death on the spot.
But now was not the time to fall out; he could only find an excuse to delay.
"As far as I know, the apprenticeship ceremony is held after the entry ceremony."
Shan Tai only temporarily relented upon hearing this.
"Then we’ll wait until after the ceremony. Kid, your name is Yun Cang, right? Don’t worry, following me, you will have a future!"
This name was Qi Cang’s alias for this entry.
Qi Cang inwardly lamented, this guy actually targeted him.
Fine, you’ll have asked for it!
After joining, I’ll arrange an ’accident’ for you.
Just then, three long chimes spread throughout, signaling the start of the entry ceremony.
White robes fluttered in the wind, a figure descended from the clouds stepping on a Spirit Sword, appearing like an immortal.
The divine-grade Spirit Platform shone brilliantly, and celestial phenomena filled the sky.
Bai He and the Spirit Bird chirped in unison amidst swirling mist and immortal notes resounding.
At a glance, it seemed as though an immortal had descended upon the world.
Brother Cheng made a grand entrance.
This entrance he had meticulously planned, employing over a dozen array spirit talismans and specifically catching some Spirit Birds as temporary workers.
As for his purpose, it was purely to show off.
The effect was quite impressive.
The newly entered third-generation disciples looked up, their faces filled with awe.
Even Qi Cang’s pupils slightly constricted— a Divine-grade Spirit Platform was real!
When that Spirit Platform appeared, he felt as if his Divine Soul had encountered a mortal enemy, suppressed tightly.
The original hidden strength also became restless due to the instability of the Divine Soul, nearly revealing his true realm right then.
He quickly averted his gaze from the Divine-grade Spirit Platform, calming his mind to settle his emotions.
Although Jiang Cheng had seen great spectacles, he was unfamiliar with the ceremony’s steps.
Fortunately, Luo Yuan was experienced, so he was appointed as the ’Master of Ceremonies’.
"The entry ceremony begins!"
The entire ceremony wasn’t too complicated. It started with offerings to the heavens and earth, tributes to the ancestors, entry oaths, etc.
Having mentally prepared beforehand, Qi Cang could accept these steps.
But the last step, paying respects to the Sect Leader, truly made him want to go crazy.
According to customary rules, during entry, one must bow three times and kowtow nine times to the Sect Leader, and this was the same across major sects.
However, Jiang Cheng slightly altered this step. Originally, all disciples bowed together, but he changed it to individual bows.
The reason wasn’t that Jiang Cheng wanted to impress.
He wasn’t a dead person, if it weren’t for the rules of this world requiring three bows and nine kowtows, he wouldn’t have intended to have them kneel to him.
Changing to individual salutes was to use this opportunity to assess these disciples’ loyalty.
As the Sect Leader, he had the authority to tweak the details, and of course, Luo Yuan and others had no objections.
Nor did the newly entered third-generation disciples find anything amiss.
But Qi Cang was very frustrated.
As the dignified Young Master of the Eight Clouds Hall, he actually had to bow three times and kowtow nine times to the Sect Leader of a small sect?
To know, the previous Sect Leader of the Feixian Sect was not even qualified to meet him. Judging by how hard it is for Duanmu Zhe to see him, one could tell.
This was a great humiliation to him.
He could only take a deep breath, tirelessly telling himself to endure!
For the opportunity, for the Tiger Demon, for becoming the Master of the Eight Clouds Hall, temporary endurance and humiliation were worth it.
No one knew his thoughts. Meanwhile, the other disciples were lining up to pay respects to Jiang Cheng.
"Wei Miao pays respects to the Sect Leader!"
A thirteen-year-old boy knelt respectfully and performed a complete grand ceremony.
"Ding, you have gained a subordinate’s allegiance, earning 5 points."
This Wei Miao, whose cultivation is only at the Energy-Introducing Realm Fifth Layer, not even reaching the Spirit Formation Realm, had a decent talent to earn 5 points.
Jiang Cheng wasn’t focused on his current meager points— it was mainly for the future.
Each small realm advancement, each great realm breakthrough brought points rewards.
Moreover, his main purpose was to confirm if they truly joined sincerely.
Since the system chimed, it indicated Wei Miao was surely one of his own.
Brother Cheng, pleased with his achievement...
He casually raised his left hand; a wave of spiritual power slowly lifted Wei Miao.
"Rise! No need for formalities."
"Having just joined the sect, to show the Sect Leader’s welcome, I present you with a small gift!"

chapters.title: Chapter 50: Sending Red Envelopes
chapters.content:
Chapter 50: Chapter 50: Sending Red Envelopes
Brother Cheng is never stingy with his own people.
A shimmering silver storage ring floated out.
The eyes of all the third generation disciples in the venue froze!
No way, a storage ring as a reward on the first day of entry?
Although a storage ring is not an offensive spiritual artifact, it involves space, and even the lowest level is a Tier Three Spiritual Artifact.
This level of spiritual artifact is generally difficult for ordinary disciples to obtain.
Just like Luo Yuan, Yin Xuer, and others never had one before; it was only on the day of the Feixian Sect’s destruction that the elders gave them one each while fleeing.
It goes without saying how precious this item is.
And judging by the spiritual power fluctuations on the surface of this storage ring, it’s not a low-level one.
It could very well be a Tier Four Spiritual Artifact!
Wei Miao was shocked, he even forgot to reach out and take it.
Because he suspected the Sect Leader had given him the wrong treasure.
There is indeed a custom of preparing a welcome gift on entry, but generally, the Sect Leader only rewards the most outstanding one or two disciples.
His talent ranked only mid to low among these 55 people.
As for the others, they would receive a welcome gift from their master after officially taking one.
These welcome gifts would either be Tier Two Spirit Armor and Spirit Sword, or a few Tier Three Qi Gathering Pills, or a hundred middle-grade spirit stones and the like.
This is already considered a pleasant surprise for newly admitted disciples.
To get more, one has to rely on their efforts in the future.
Such as monthly stipends, contribution points, competition rewards, training outside to find heavenly and earthly treasures, etc.
"Is this... for me?"
He looked at the ring floating in front of him, a bit unsure.
"What else? Do you suspect I’ve hidden a bomb inside?"
Wei Miao couldn’t understand what the Sect Leader meant by a bomb, but he understood that it was indeed for him.
He quickly and joyfully received it into his palm.
Then, he released his divine sense to perceive the space inside the ring.
He actually held a bit of expectation; since the Sect Leader sent a ring, maybe there were a few spirit stones inside?
Soon, his expression froze.
He was almost so scared he would throw the ring away.
"Here, here, here..."
His hands trembled, and at this moment, the ring seemed as heavy as a thousand catties, exceeding his limit of endurance.
Jiang Cheng said blandly, "Check it; there should be a set of Tier Four Spirit Armor, a Tier Four Spirit Sword, a bundle of Spirit Talismans, and enough pills and spirit stones for you to break through to the Soul Splitting Realm."
These were all looted from the Red Sun Sect.
Just the Tier Five Spirit Armor and Spirit Swords numbered over a hundred sets, with millions of top-grade spirit stones, and hundreds of bottles of Spirit Platform Realm pills, most of which he exchanged for points.
In addition, there were a dozen Tier Six Spiritual Artifacts.
Giving these to Wei Miao was merely some trash of the Soul Splitting Realm tier.
top-grade spirit stones just equated to 1 point.
One Tier Four Spiritual Artifact was just 10 points, not to mention it’s not a consumable item.
In Jiang Cheng’s eyes, this was just a drop in the ocean, not even worth a hundred points in total.
When Wei Miao advances to the Soul Splitting Realm in the future, he could probably earn him back two or three hundred points, Brother Cheng cared about cultivation speed.
If spirit stones and pills could boost it, why slowly undergo ascetic cultivation?
This investment is quite cost-effective.
When they break through to the Spirit Platform Realm or Celestial Fate Realm in the future, those abundant rewards of sea-like quantities of points would be even more.
However, what he considered junk, others didn’t see that way.
The breath of these new third-generation disciples stalled, their entire beings becoming dumbfounded.
What did they just hear?
Tier Four Spirit Armor, Spirit Sword? Two bundles of Spirit Talismans?
And enough spirit stones and pills to reach the Soul Splitting Realm?
Wei Miao is still at the Energy-Introducing Fifth Layer; breaking through to Spirit Formation Realm, then Gathering Yuan Realm, then Soul Splitting Realm, would require at least thousands of spirit stones and dozens of bottles of pills, right?
These people hadn’t joined any sect before; before entering, they either cultivated within their families or as pure loose cultivators seeking opportunities in the mortal world.
The resources within this ring were too high-end for them, legendary treasures capable of inciting a bloodstorm.
And it was so easily bestowed?
Bestowed to Wei Miao, whose talent wasn’t even as good as theirs?
Honestly, even Qi Cang was a bit surprised.
The Eight Clouds Hall’s true disciples also received ’generous’ welcome gifts upon entry.
But those were generally just a few hundred top-grade spirit stones, or Tier Three Spiritual Artifacts at most.
No one has ever received such a reward upon entry; is this insanity?
But when you think about it more, it seems to make sense.
Despite Eight Clouds Hall’s wealth, it has tens of thousands of disciples, and resources are always insufficiently distributed.
Unlike the Feixian Sect, which currently has fewer than a hundred people.
"The cultivation realm is fraught with danger and peril. I give you Tier Four Spiritual Artifacts to better protect yourself. I give you pills and spirit stones, hoping you become a pillar of the sect as soon as possible."
Hearing Jiang Cheng’s courteous words, everyone’s hearts were burning with emotion and gratitude.
Wei Miao was in tears, his entire body trembling, and fell to his knees again with a thud.
He repeatedly kowtowed fervently.
"Sect Leader, I will never forget your nurturing! I shall never disappoint the Sect Leader’s expectations in the future and would readily go through fire and water for the sect! The direction of the Sect Leader’s sword is the goal I, Wei Miao, will pursue to the end of my life!"
He was already willing to die for the Sect Leader.
Brother Cheng felt a bit overwhelmed by the favor.
Seriously, brother, some trash is causing you to lose control?
But he was still very satisfied; who wouldn’t like loyal disciples?
After Wei Miao stepped down, the next disciple hurriedly stepped forward, eagerly bowing and kowtowing nine times.
"Du Yu pays respects to the Sect Leader!"
The system’s prompt sounded again, gaining 6 points.
Very good, another one of my people.
Reward!
Again it was a storage ring, again Tier Four Spiritual Artifacts accompanied by the resources to reach the Soul Splitting Realm.
Despite Wei Miao’s precedent, Du Yu was still overjoyed and moved beyond words.
Other disciples were green-eyed!
So it wasn’t Wei Miao who was singled out, but everyone had a share?
Heavens!
Joining the Feixian Sect was like entering a treasure cave!
Disciple after disciple stepped forward to bow to the Sect Leader, the system prompting again and again.
Brother Cheng was getting a little tired of ’handing out red envelopes.’
The entire hall buzzed with joy and excitement, these welcome gifts leaving a huge impact.
On the first day of joining, these disciples became loyal supporters of the Feixian Sect.
No choice, with resources in abundance, they could smash out death warriors.
Luo Yuan and Shan Tai, watching from the sidelines, weren’t jealous; after annihilating the Red Sun Sect, the Sect Leader upgraded their equipment again.
Now every elder used Tier Five, even Tier Six Spiritual Artifacts, higher than these disciples.
The talents of these true disciples varied, with some evaluated by the system at just 3 points, while others reached 25 points.
Achieving 20 points at the Energy-Introducing Realm indicated strong talent.
When Luo Yuan and Yin Xiaoxue’s group first met Jiang Cheng, the highest reached 60 points, but that was at the Gathering Yuan Realm.
The second-to-last to appear was Lin Ning.
When she also bowed, the system increased prompt notification again.
"Ding, you have received the allegiance of a subordinate with Hidden Phoenix Bloodline and gained 1600 point rewards."

chapters.title: Chapter 51: Infuriated
chapters.content:
Chapter 51: Chapter 51: Infuriated
What’s going on? Only at the Spirit Formation Realm and already received 1600 points?
This Lin Ning has incredibly amazing talent!
Jiang Cheng immediately perked up and couldn’t resist using the Insight Skill to take a look.
Sure enough, there was a gray exclamation mark above Lin Ning’s head.
"Hidden Phoenix Bloodline—one of the branches of the Ancient Four Divine Beasts Bloodline. If cultivating a Dark Attribute Technique, can gradually awaken Dark Talent."
What Dark Attribute, Jiang Cheng had never heard of.
Anyway, from the system’s description, this bloodline seemed to be really powerful.
Didn’t expect that in this recruitment, we actually found a prodigy.
Brother Cheng was immensely gratified, and immediately took back the ring that originally contained a Tier Four Spiritual Artifact, similar to what others would get.
"Hahaha, no need for formalities!"
He personally stood up, went forward and helped Lin Ning up.
Winning people’s hearts was something he mastered naturally.
Even though Lin Ning was already considered one of his own, it couldn’t hurt to deepen the bond!
"I heard you were first in the entry test?"
Brother Cheng’s handsome face wore a smile, kind and approachable.
Lin Ning was somewhat overwhelmed by the favor and quickly bowed again in salute.
"Yes."
"Very good! Being first deserves a special reward indeed!"
With that, Jiang Cheng swiped over another ring.
A Tier Five Spirit Sword and a Tier Five Spirit Armor floated in the air.
"This...is for me?"
Even Lin Ning, who was naturally calm, couldn’t help but be shocked.
That was a Tier Five Spiritual Artifact!
She came from a slightly higher background than the average cultivator; her family had three Gathering Yuan Realm experts, making it one of the top families in the local city.
The treasure of the family was a Tier Four Spirit Armor.
It was something she’d dreamed of since childhood.
Taking part in the test this time, the family had high hopes for her.
Before her departure, the clan leader and a dozen elders personally admonished her.
The Cultivation Realm is fraught with dangers and treacherous hearts, even among fellow disciples there’s ruthless competition.
For this reason, they gave her the Tier Four Spirit Armor for protection.
Hoping she would perform excellently, and one day, as she grows, to not forget to help elevate the Lin Family.
Who would have thought that on the first day of entry, that Tier Four Spirit Armor would become unnecessary?
Hiss...
The group of ecstatic third-generation disciples were all wide-eyed.
Not only a Tier Five Spirit Armor but also a Tier Five Spirit Sword...
The treatment for being first was simply maddening!
"Of course, it’s for you. You’ve joined the Feixian Sect; we’re all family now, no need to be a stranger."
Lin Ning’s eyes reddened.
Though she had humble talent since childhood, and coming from a collateral branch of the family, she wasn’t much valued.
The Lin Family was a cultivation family, where everything depended on strength.
Before awakening the Hidden Phoenix Bloodline at 12, she hadn’t felt noticed by elders or loved by peers; instead, she endured much scorn and ridicule.
Yet here was this young Sect Leader, powerful beyond measure, caring for her on the very first day.
"Thank you, Sect Leader!"
She wasn’t good with words, but these three words were spoken with unwavering determination.
After Lin Ning stepped back, only Qi Cang was left.
He truly didn’t want to kneel.
Those gifts that made other disciples dizzy were mere junk to him.
As the Young Master of the Eight Clouds Hall, he already had Tier Seven Spirit Armor and Spirit Sword by his side, and as for pills, he used ones at the Spirit Platform level.
Kneeling to Jiang Cheng was driving him mad.
But for the grand plan, he had to endure!
Endure for a vast, open future, endure for an ambition of grandeur!
In the end, he forced himself to kneel down.
Bang, bang, bang, he too made a three-kneel-nine-bow gesture.
"Yun Cang—greetings to the Sect Leader!"
His hands clenched into fists, knuckles turning white.
Hurry up and end it!
Quickly finish the gift-giving and end this humiliating ceremony.
However this time, it was different from the previous ones.
For this 54th consecutive token of respect, it didn’t appear.
Jiang Cheng’s smile faded, because the system didn’t chime.
No chime meant this wasn’t one of his own.
He wouldn’t consider those who didn’t chime as enemies; after all, between enemies and allies, there were many ordinary passersby who were indifferent to him.
But at the very least, disciples joining his sect must be his own.
To have sworn allegiance to the Sect Leader and not have the chime sound meant there’s no point in keeping him.
He wouldn’t raise ingrates, no matter how generous or wealthy he was.
"Alright, get lost!"
He didn’t recognize Qi Cang or know what his intentions were.
Just considered him to be one of those self-serving, cold-blooded, disloyal types.
Treating the Feixian Sect as a stepping stone, waiting until he was fully grown to change allegiances.
He really didn’t imagine this person was here to overthrow the Feixian Sect.
What?
The atmosphere inside the hall, which had been happy, suddenly stalled.
Everyone looked over incredulously.
Get lost?
What happened?
Didn’t Yun Cang also pass the entry test?
Why did he not only not receive a greeting gift but was also awarded a "get lost" by the Sect Leader?
"Why?"
Qi Cang felt as if he’d been dealt a blow to the head.
He couldn’t understand because he believed his disguise was flawless.
His actions hadn’t even begun, so he didn’t believe Jiang Cheng could see through his identity and intentions at a glance.
"No reason."
Jiang Cheng gave a cold smile.
"Just don’t like the look of you."
What kind of reason was that?
This kind of response was simply to show disdain and humiliation.
But no one present questioned it.
Joking, Jiang Cheng was now considered the most respected and revered person by the third-generation disciples.
If the Sect Leader said he didn’t like the look of someone, they would also immediately take a dislike to Qi Cang.
No need for a reason.
Lin Ning even held onto her sword hilt, considering whether to kill this person to please the Sect Leader.
As for the second-generation elders, they already regarded Jiang Cheng as a god.
Whatever he said was a decree.
"Please get lost!"
Luo Yuan stepped forward, pointing solemnly to the hall’s exit.
Inside, Qi Cang felt suffocated, resentful, humiliated, dissatisfied, and full of hatred!
I am the dignified Young Master of the Eight Clouds Hall, and you actually told me to get lost?
At that moment, he wished he could leap up, grab Jiang Cheng by the neck, and bellow his demands, tearing him to pieces.
Finally, he would kill everyone here cleanly.
However, he dared not.
This was the Feixian Sect, the Tiger Demon lay within.
If he tore his mask off here, he wouldn’t even make it back alive.
He could only obediently rise, leaving dejectedly under the eyes of everyone watching him.
After he left, Jiang Cheng’s lips curled.
"Alright, the annoying fly is gone, let’s continue the ceremony."
He waved at Ji Linghan and the other elders.
"You can now select your disciples."
The atmosphere of the ceremony soon became lively once more.
Several people had already made agreements back in the square, now it’s logical.
Soon, 53 people had found their respective masters.
Even Ji Linghan took in two female disciples.
The only exception in the whole hall was Lin Ning.
No matter who tried to recruit her, she refused.
Her gaze was firmly on Jiang Cheng, never wavering.
Being ogled so directly, Brother Cheng felt a bit smug, could it be his charm was too great, this young woman fell in love at first sight?
But the problem was, she was only fifteen, not even fully developed yet.
He was a man with principles.
Maybe he should advise her to hold herself back for a few more years?

chapters.title: Chapter 52: The Struggles Among Women
chapters.content:
Chapter 52: Chapter 52: The Struggles Among Women
As Jiang Cheng was thinking about how to phrase his words delicately, Lin Ning had already stepped forward and stood in front of him.
Then, she bowed respectfully.
"Sect Leader, I wish to become your disciple, may I?"
Her eyes were filled with a strong sense of expectation and admiration.
"You’re still young..."
Uh, huh?
Turns out it wasn’t a confession of love, but asking to be a disciple. Brother Cheng felt awkward.
He had to change his words quickly: "You want to be my disciple, this seems..."
He didn’t want to take on disciples.
Even though Lin Ning was very beautiful and talented, Jiang Cheng didn’t have time to teach disciples.
He was just a little conflicted about how to phrase it.
He cared about his own people, a little worried that directly refusing would hurt this girl’s feelings.
Fortunately, Ji Linghan also stood up immediately after.
"Lin Ning, if you become Sect Leader’s disciple, it would mess up the seniority!"
That’s right, if Lin Ning became Jiang Cheng’s disciple, she would become a Second Generation Elder too.
She would be a generation higher than the other 53 disciples who entered at the same time, which seemed inappropriate.
Jiang Cheng, who had been struggling for a reason, quickly agreed with this.
"That’s right, messing up the seniority wouldn’t be good. You should become Elder Ji Linghan’s disciple instead."
The Sect Leader personally said this, so Lin Ning could only comply.
But she seemed reluctant.
"I will surpass her sooner or later..."
Although she spoke quietly, everyone inside were cultivators and could hear clearly.
Jiang Cheng twitched his mouth, thinking, girl, you’re way too outspoken, aren’t you?
This clearly implied that Ji Linghan isn’t worthy to be her master.
Even someone as good-tempered as Ji Linghan was rather upset.
"When you truly surpass me, I will personally recommend you to the Sect Leader! Then, you can be the Senior Sister!"
Whoa, whoa, that’s too impulsive.
Luo Yuan and Yin Xiaoxue and the others were secretly laughing, not expecting Senior Sister Ji to be provoked.
Lin Ning even confirmed once more.
"Really?"
"When have I, Ji Linghan, ever gone back on my word? The Sect Leader will be our witness!"
"Alright, once I surpass you, I’ll become the Sect Leader’s disciple!"
"It’s a deal!"
Jiang Cheng was speechless.
Why are you dragging me into your feud?
And I didn’t agree to take her as a disciple in the future.
Why did this suddenly become a matter of fact without even asking my opinion?
This momentum is not good.
Brother Cheng suddenly felt a bit of crisis, thinking these two talented women might slowly undermine his position as Sect Leader in the future?
No way!
This must never happen.
Not because of power, but because... it’s embarrassing.
In the end, Lin Ning kneeled before Ji Linghan and temporarily became her disciple.
This newcomer entry ceremony finally ended formally.
The other Second Generation Elders took their disciples to get familiar with the sect’s terrain, filled with laughter and harmonious atmosphere along the way.
Only Ji Linghan and her four disciples felt slightly awkward.
After getting familiar briefly, Ji Linghan passed a cultivation technique to the other two female disciples Huo Nan and Han Wenruo, explaining its essence.
Afterward, she let them choose a cave mansion nearby rich in spiritual qi to cultivate for a while.
Sending off those two disciples, only she and Lin Ning were left on the mountain.
"This is the Purple Flame Heart Scripture the Sect Leader obtained from the Red Sun Sect, it’s the top cultivation technique of our Feixian Sect."
"And this sword technique, the Great Sun Flame Sword, is also our most powerful martial technique."
"If you don’t understand anything, you can always ask me."
Ji Linghan didn’t intentionally withhold anything because of the previous incident, she offered the best she had.
Her heart was always generous, never harboring any ill will against her disciples.
As a result, Lin Ning was somewhat surprised when she received the two jade scrolls.
"Aren’t you afraid I’ll surpass you?"
"With your current cultivation, doesn’t it make you blush to say such things?"
"Really? You did it on purpose today, didn’t you?"
Mentioning this made Lin Ning furious.
"If you hadn’t stepped out and interfered, I would’ve forcibly become his disciple with his half-hearted consent! Clearly, you just didn’t want me getting close to him!"
Ji Linghan’s response was unreserved: "That’s right, I did it intentionally. Don’t think I can’t see through your thoughts, don’t covet those that don’t belong to you!"
"Then just wait, because from today I’m set on him, no one can take him, including you, my temporary master!"
"Go on and keep dreaming."
Ji Linghan chuckled softly, then floated away.
Sis got a Tier Nine Spirit Armor, Gentle Mist Jade Immortal Robe, gifted by the Sect Leader, did I ever show off?
If Jiang Cheng were to hear the conversation between these two women, he would surely have a refreshed impression of them.
Too scheming, too scary, Brother Cheng shivers.
After the two women parted, they immediately entered a state of secluded cultivation.
On the other side, Jiang Cheng was also pondering what to do next.
According to the system’s initial task, he couldn’t stay confined to a small place like Qinglan Prefecture if he wanted to dominate the Three Realms.
In the Cultivation Realm, if you want to continue developing and gain more resources, you must expand.
"Kid, you were quite the sensation today!"
The Three-Eyed Tiger suddenly appeared.
Earlier, it had refused to attend that ceremony, unwilling to stand up for Jiang Cheng.
And Jiang Cheng wasn’t disappointed, even relieved.
He felt the Three-Eyed Tiger’s appearance wasn’t imposing now, too lame for a Sect Guardian Spirit Beast, introducing it to the new disciples would backfire instead.
"Just a small sensation, after all, I’m used to standing in the limelight every day."
The Three-Eyed Tiger swore, this was the most pretentious being it had ever seen in its life.
"If I tell you that the person you drove away today was from the Spirit Platform Eighth Layer, would you still be able to laugh?"
Qi Cang’s cultivation could fool others, but not it, being a Demon King, even if it wasn’t present at the time.
After saying this, it eagerly awaited Jiang Cheng’s reaction.
Jiang Cheng indeed became serious.
"You mean he was hiding his cultivation?"
"Of course, he must have some agenda. That person came to harm Feixian Sect, and you let him go, hahaha..."
The Three-Eyed Tiger shook its head smugly, after all, it commanded a clan, such a petty scheme couldn’t fool it.
It deliberately didn’t warn Jiang Cheng, just to see him suffer.
Regret it now?
Let go of such a dangerous enemy, you’re in for a hard time!
Jiang Cheng seemed genuinely anxious as he hastily inquired.
"Are you certain he truly intends to harm Feixian Sect?"
The Three-Eyed Tiger felt utterly vindicated.
"Kid, use your head and think, his cultivation was better than yours and he’s young. Why would he join Feixian Sect? Obviously, he was sent by an opposing force."
"So which force do you think it is?"

chapters.title: Chapter 53: What a Brilliant Plan
chapters.content:
Chapter 53: Chapter 53: What a Brilliant Plan
"How would I know? You’re such a troublemaker, you must have offended so many people."
The Three-Eyed Tiger was gloating.
Serves you right!
You’ve been smug for so long, and now you have a headache?
However, upon hearing its analysis, Jiang Cheng not only didn’t get a headache, he almost clapped his hands in excitement and nearly jumped for joy.
"That’s fantastic!"
"Haha, regret it... right... huh?"
The Three-Eyed Tiger was a bit dumbfounded.
What kind of reaction is this?
It seems completely opposite to what I anticipated.
"Kid, what are you pretending for? To be honest, he hasn’t run far. With my strength, Master Tiger, catching him is a piece of cake, but you have to agree to two conditions..."
It had already thought it through.
Taking this opportunity to blackmail Jiang Cheng, forcing him to hand over the ’remaining’ summoning talisman and terminate the Sect Guardian Spirit Beast contract.
Unfortunately, before it could finish stating its conditions, Jiang Cheng hurriedly stopped it.
"No, definitely don’t catch him back!"
"He’s come all the way here and didn’t commit any serious offense. Isn’t it rude to capture him?"
"We’re a prestigious sect now, how can we have such a barbaric way of entertaining guests?"
The Three-Eyed Tiger observed repeatedly and found that Jiang Cheng didn’t seem to be speaking sarcastically.
"Are you insane? There’s an enemy in the dark scheming against you, and you’re happy about it?"
"Why shouldn’t I be happy?"
Brother Cheng was almost ready to sing aloud to celebrate.
Finally, someone wants to come after me again.
He didn’t have a target to aim at, and now someone has willingly delivered themselves to him.
Without a doubt, there must be a significant force behind that Yun Cang, right?
He was so excited that he started rubbing his hands.
"How do you think they will deal with me? Oh, I hope they are as powerful as possible."
The more powerful the enemy, the more abundant the spoils.
As for how to defeat the enemy?
Is that something to think about?
With three daily opportunities of undying, Brother Cheng has long given up thinking about strategies to deal with enemies, just charges right in.
Why bother with plotting or scheming? That’s redundant, isn’t it?
"Really looking forward to it!"
Seeing the joyful figure of Jiang Cheng, the Three-Eyed Tiger was in disarray, and it started to question if the world had gone mad.
This shouldn’t be.
Something must be wrong somewhere!
Meanwhile, on the other side, filled with rage, Qi Cang, after leaving the Feixian Sect, flew thousands of miles and randomly found a small town to massacre in a frenzy.
Although Jiang Cheng was ruthless, he at least waited until someone provoked him before acting.
But Qi Cang needed no reason; being in a bad mood was reason enough.
Returning to the Eight Clouds Hall, his wrath gradually subsided, and he summoned Lu Zhong over.
