"The plan to infiltrate the Feixian Sect failed."
"You were discovered by them?"
Lu Zhong found it somewhat astounding. With Qi Cang’s cunning and ability, it shouldn’t have been possible to mess up in a small place like the Feixian Sect.
Qi Cang recalled carefully, shook his head, and replied with a sullen face.
"Probably not."
In his opinion, if Jiang Cheng had uncovered his identity, he should have summoned that Tiger Demon to capture him.
At the very least, with his Seventh Layer Spirit Platform cultivation and the backing of a Divine-grade Spirit Platform, he should have been able to fight him.
But he didn’t do that, he merely drove him away.
"Since he didn’t uncover your identity, we can still continue to strategize."
"How to strategize?"
"Replace the magpie’s nest and take over!"
"Explain in detail!"
"We can command the Duanmu Family and various prefectures to attack the Feixian Sect..."
Lu Zhong had barely started when Qi Cang interrupted him.
"With that Tiger Demon there, they can’t break in at all. It’s a death sentence."
The Duanmu Family, along with surrounding prefectures, probably had thirty or forty Spirit Platform Realm cultivators. This lineup looked strong, but compared to that Tiger Demon of at least Celestial Fate Ninth Layer, it was insufficient.
Lu Zhong waved his hand dismissively: "Young Master misunderstood, I didn’t expect them to directly capture the Feixian Sect."
"Hmm?"
"Just besiege them without attacking!"
Qi Cang’s eyes suddenly lit up, realizing what he meant.
"You mean, seize this opportunity to plant people in the Feixian Sect?"
With the Feixian Sect besieged by so many factions, it was in imminent danger.
At this point, the Eight Clouds Hall could disguise itself as the hero by sending a batch of experts in, under the guise of upholding justice and providing help.
An offer of help from the prestigious Eight Clouds Hall couldn’t be refused by Jiang Cheng, could it?
He would probably be very grateful!
And once those experts got inside and took control, who knew if the Feixian Sect would still belong to Jiang?
By then, perhaps even the Tiger Demon... might take sides with the Eight Clouds Hall!
"Brilliant plan, brilliant plan indeed!"
Qi Cang clapped and laughed heartily, as if he could already see Jiang Cheng’s miserable fate.
Days later, a bombshell announcement spread throughout the prefectures under Feiyun State.
The Duanmu Family of Qinglan Prefecture, the Qian Ning Castle of Qian Ning Prefecture, the Void Wind Sect and Celestial Nether Sect of Chongyan Prefecture, the Dragon-Surprised Family of White Dragon Prefecture, the Liuli Sect, Namo Sect, and Blood Killing Valley of Wuding Prefecture, all formed a temporary anti-Jiang alliance.
Eight Sects collectively issued a declaration.
The Sect Leader of Feixian Sect, Jiang Cheng, behaves atrociously, cruelly and unjustly, exterminating Five Sects and causing the people of Qinglan Prefecture to live in terror and desperation.
For the liberation of millions suffering in Qinglan Prefecture, the Five Mansions and Eight Sects have resolved to form an alliance to crush the Feixian Sect!
Effective immediately, any Feixian Sect disciple found outside will be killed unconditionally!
Any family or sect found associating with Feixian Sect will be destroyed without reason!
Upon the release of this declaration, Qinglan Prefecture was in an uproar.
Many cultivators, upon seeing this declaration, were a bit bewildered.
Oh, so we are living in such misery?
So we are all living in fear and can’t make ends meet?
How come we didn’t know about it?
The Feixian Sect hasn’t done much harm, really, aside from wiping out those Five Sects, they’ve been staying secluded behind their doors, hard to even catch a glimpse of.
Moreover, the destruction of those Five Sects actually improved the lives of many small families and loose cultivators in the surrounding areas.
After all, without those giant sects oppressing them and contesting for resources, these low-level cultivators have much more room to maneuver.
And the most significant point — many still regret not being able to join the Feixian Sect.
This is just bewildering.
At this time, Duanmu Zhe had already gathered with the Sect Leader Elders of the other sects.
The Eight Great Sects, in this endeavor, deployed as many as 31 Spirit Platform Realm cultivators.
The strongest among them was the Void Wind Sect’s Sect Leader, Master Jiuluo of Chongyan Prefecture, whose realm had reached the Eighth Layer Spirit Platform.
This kind of power, not even the Duanmu Family in the past, with Duanmu Hong and Duanmu Pool still alive, dared to provoke easily.
"Gentlemen, what do you think of this siege?"
As the local host in Qinglan Prefecture, Duanmu Zhe had to take the lead.
Master Jiuluo lifted his eyelids and said indifferently, "What else is there to think? The order from the Young Master of Eight Clouds Hall, who among us dares to defy?"
The Fortress Master of Qian Ning Castle, Dong Hai, said fiercely: "That Feixian Sect needs to be sanctioned indeed, they’ve been in the spotlight too much lately, even the talented disciples from our Qian Ning Prefecture have been heading over to take their assessment."

chapters.title: Chapter 54: The Frustrated Dragon-Surprised Family
chapters.content:
Chapter 54: Chapter 54: The Frustrated Dragon-Surprised Family
Other sect leaders and elders echoed.
"Exactly, Feixian Sect is poaching people across boundaries, they’re going too far."
"Don’t mention it, we had a genius named Lin Ning in White Dragon Prefecture, the Dragon-Surprised Family had been keeping an eye on her for some time, planning to marry her into our family by the end of the year, but unexpectedly, she joined Feixian Sect early!"
"Really not appreciating our kindness!"
"Even without Eight Clouds Hall’s command, I want an explanation from Feixian Sect!"
Hearing this from Patriarch Long Zhen Mountain of the Dragon-Surprised Family, everyone outwardly nodded in agreement while secretly rolling their eyes.
Old brother, since she doesn’t want to marry, this is clearly a forced marriage, is there a need to be so indignant?
In sitting here, who isn’t skilled in such crafty exploits?
You’re acting so aggrieved, do you think everyone else is clueless?
Duanmu Zhe stood up first, loudly supporting Long Zhen Mountain.
"Good! Since Patriarch Long hates Feixian Sect so much, I hereby wish the Dragon-Surprised Family victory!"
He spoke with great enthusiasm, but it was akin to saying nothing.
You lead the charge, we’ll watch from behind.
Other sect leaders and elders followed the rhythm promptly.
"Right, we are willing to back Patriarch Long!"
"We wish the Dragon-Surprised Family a triumphant return, we’ve prepared a celebratory feast here!"
"That Feixian Sect is merely a small sect, definitely no match for the Dragon-Surprised Family; it seems the credit for this victory will be snatched by Brother Long!"
Which of these people hasn’t lived for hundreds of years, with a heart full of schemes?
Feixian Sect may appear with few people like a handful of kittens, but obliterating the Red Sun Sect forcibly, that’s not something just anyone can do.
What Qi Cang and Lu Zhong could see, they too could see.
Feixian Sect must have a big killer, recklessly attacking could lead to being counter-killed.
Qi Cang’s intention, these old foxes saw clearly — he wants them to be cannon fodder.
Rather than that, better send a naive one to test the waters first.
Especially knowing the existence of the Three-Eyed Tiger, Duanmu Zhe would never foolishly charge forward.
"This..."
"You all?"
Long Zhen Mountain was frustrated. Weren’t we just venting together, jointly denouncing Feixian Sect?
How did it suddenly become my solo affair?
"I think this matter requires further deliberation; wiping out Feixian Sect isn’t just my Dragon-Surprised Family’s business..."
"Hmm?"
Master Jiuluo revealed a disdainful expression, "Patriarch Long, didn’t you just say you wanted an explanation from Feixian Sect? What, were you only talking?"
"Exactly, so Brother Long only dares boast, but doesn’t actually dare offend Feixian Sect?"
"Even White Dragon Prefecture’s ruler acts so timidly, it’s laughable."
"In my view, the Dragon-Surprised Family doesn’t care about Young Master Qi’s command, only pretending to comply?"
This alliance was forcibly grouped by Qi Cang, or else there’d be friction or even hatred among them.
This is both provocation and accusation, but Long Zhen Mountain still held it in.
"Do not slander me, I will definitely obey Young Master Qi’s commands, but the young master hasn’t ordered my Dragon-Surprised Family to attack immediately..."
Before he finished speaking, someone flew in from outside the hall; wasn’t it Qi Cang?
"In that case, Patriarch Long, lead the Dragon-Surprised Family and attack Feixian Sect!"
He thought about it, and figured it’s better to attack first to test the waters.
After all, he hadn’t even seen the Three-Eyed Tiger yet.
At least understand its true power?
As for whether the Dragon-Surprised Family might be counter-killed, it wasn’t in his concern.
All are just pawns, losing the Dragon-Surprised Family means nothing to him.
"Young Master!"
"Greetings, Young Master!"
Everyone in the hall stood and saluted, while Long Zhen Mountain’s expression looked like constipation.
How could he not see, he was sold out by Qi Cang.
Yet, he couldn’t resist.
Just Lu Zhong behind Qi Cang was enough to slaughter the seventy-plus experts from Dragon-Surprised Family present.
"This, what about Feixian Sect..."
Qi Cang’s face sank, "What, stalling and hesitating, are you trying to defy Eight Clouds Hall?"
Long Zhen Mountain cursed internally, but could only say, "I wouldn’t dare, I’ll go immediately..."
Defy orders now and die.
Carry out the attack, perhaps survival remains possible.
"Alright, hope you as the vanguard can achieve a triumphant battle!"
No chance for triumph, Long Zhen Mountain looked back step by step, regrettably seeing no change in command.
Other sect leaders felt gleeful but secretly relieved, thankful they weren’t named.
On the other hand, Jiang Cheng naturally received the news of being besieged by the Eight Sects.
Finally coming?
Eight Great Sects, how many points can they bring?
This time, not only is upgrading more than enough, a few rounds of lottery should be possible, right?
Thinking about it, kind of exciting.
"Sect Leader!"
"Heard Eight Great Sects intend to besiege us!"
"Yeah, what to do?"
All second and third-generation disciples gathered, even Ji Linghan and Lin Ning, just closed from retreat, were not exceptions.
Eight Great Sects, so many Spirit Platform Realms.
Though they had great confidence in Jiang Cheng, this array was a bit overwhelming.
Equivalent to eight Red Sun Sects.
If still calm and unruffled, now that would be abnormal.
"Sect Leader, tell us how to fend off the enemy!"
"Indeed, we shall not retreat!"
Looking at them, eyes filled with resolve and war spirit, Jiang Cheng was quite speechless.
Can’t you peacefully cultivate, upgrade soon, and earn more points for me?
"I didn’t call you here, why all the fuss?"
"Enemies are about to hit our doorstep; it’s the moment of life and death for the sect..."
Luo Yuan spoke hesitantly, suddenly realizing.
Right, they still didn’t know the true strength of the Sect Leader, Jiang Cheng.
He changed his tone, looking expectant, "Does the Sect Leader already have a strategy to defeat the enemy?"
Brother Cheng hadn’t replied yet, Shan Tai and others began competing to flatter.
"Sect Leader is truly a divine being, just eight sects are no more than mere rookies, easily defeated!"
"With Sect Leader’s actions, they aren’t even enough to kill."
"Though Sect Leader is always merciful, the Eight Sects seek their own doom; can’t blame him!"
"I bet the Sect Leader needs only an hour to wipe them out!"
"An hour? You underestimate the Sect Leader? I guess at most a quarter hour!"
"A quarter hour? It’s just a matter of one move!"
This flattery, even with Brother Cheng’s thick skin, was a bit too much.
Though he had the Undefeated System, was one move too high an expectation?
Third-generation disciples were bewildered, struggling to adapt to this absurd scene.
They began doubting if their master had gone mad.
By this time, people from Dragon-Surprised Family had also entered Feixian Sect’s mountain gate range.
Active entry, Feixian Sect had too few people, their sect protection array was destroyed last time, thus unobstructed passage.
Ah Huang transmitted a message to Jiang Cheng’s ears.
"Mommy, 74 strangers have entered, should I drain their spiritual power?"
"Draining their spiritual power, would you consume much?"
"Yes, the more people, the greater my consumption. But as long as mommy wishes, I can still do it."
"Such a dutiful daughter, but this time, let them come."

chapters.title: Chapter 55 Scared Peeless
chapters.content:
Chapter 55: Chapter 55 Scared Peeless
Only 74 people?
Brother Cheng was a bit displeased. What’s the deal with looking down on him with so few people?
"Let’s go see."
When everyone rushed to the entrance of the main hall, the enemies were already right in front of them.
"Damn, it’s Long Zhen Mountain, the Patriarch of the Dragon-Surprised Family!"
Lin Ning’s expression changed. The Dragon-Surprised Family had previously gone to the Lin Family to propose marriage.
Of course, the Lin Family did not want to send such a rare talent away. Once she’s married off, she wouldn’t belong to the Lin Family anymore.
But they couldn’t defy them.
This time, Lin Ning came to join the sect, actually also as a means of escape.
Who knew they’d come knocking so soon?
"Sect Leader, maybe he’s here because of me. How about I go back with him? That way, he might retreat the troops."
Jiang Cheng wasn’t interested in what had happened between them and didn’t bother to pry into the details.
He just gave Lin Ning a surprised glance.
Come on, little girl, we can just sweep them aside, no need for such self-sacrificing melodrama.
"This has nothing to do with you. Stand back."
He waved his hand.
"On the other side, who sent you guys?"
After Long Zhen Mountain arrived, he released his Divine Sense to investigate everywhere. He also felt that there must be some big killer in the Feixian Sect.
It’s best to be cautious.
After seeing Lin Ning, a hint of concealed killing intent flashed in his eyes, but he didn’t let it explode on the spot.
"So you are that Jiang Cheng? Your actions defy the natural order and rile up public anger..."
Enough!
Upon hearing his endless nonsense, Jiang Cheng realized he wouldn’t get anything out of him.
If no answers could be found, that was that.
"Sect Guardian Spirit Beast, come clean up this mess!"
Sect Guardian Spirit Beast?
The Second Generation Elders were quite expectant, while the Third Generation disciples looked at each other in confusion.
They didn’t even know the sect had a Guardian Spirit Beast.
"Kid, aren’t you very powerful?"
"What? At the crucial moment, you still need grandpa to step in personally?"
Jiang Cheng curled his lips.
To him, taking down these 74 people from the Dragon-Surprised Family was easy; getting killed once would do it.
But that would be far from elegant.
This is at the Feixian Sect, with so many disciples watching.
Getting killed on the spot by the opponent, wouldn’t that reduce his prestige?
Even if he could spin some nonsense and say the Sect Leader was just pretending to play dead afterward, the image points would still take a hit due to the bloodshed.
What if the disciples stopped idolizing him?
For Brother Cheng, who loved to show off and valued face, that was the most important thing.
So, this time he let the Three-Eyed Tiger take over.
"Alright, alright, get it done early and be done with it."
Thousands of miles away, Qi Cang, Lu Zhong, and others had their eyes widened.
As the cannon fodder testing the waters, Long Zhen Mountain was carrying a Transmission Spirit Artifact, so they could see real-time footage of the Feixian Sect.
They could even hear the sounds.
"There it is!"
"Is that the Tiger Demon?"
"That size, isn’t it a bit too small? Just this?"
Everyone couldn’t help but rub their eyes, full of doubt.
Even Qi Cang was no exception.
Is this the thing I’ve been wary of all along?
"It’s absolutely true, that’s the Tiger Demon! My fourth brother Duanmu Pool was killed by it!"
Duanmu Zhe had witnessed it firsthand. Seeing the Three-Eyed Tiger, he had an illusion—the Tiger Demon seemed to know he was spying on it!
This illusion made his hair stand on end, and he wished he could flee immediately.
Meanwhile, at Feixian Sect, the Third Generation disciples were utterly speechless.
So our Feixian Sect’s Guardian Spirit Beast is just this small?
This would barely suffice as a mascot, let alone scaring people.
And relying on it to slay enemies?
Long Zhen Mountain was still going on and on.
Of course, he wanted to destroy the Feixian Sect and take Lin Ning back.
But, like any old fox, he wouldn’t act thoroughly until he probed the truth, leaving some room for retreat.
If he found the Feixian Sect to be mediocre, he would then unleash a massacre.
At that time, he promised to be more brutal and ruthless than anyone else.
Then his head flew into the sky, and he saw his body under the neck spraying blood as it fell.
Meanwhile, he also saw the bodies of the other 73 elites of the Dragon-Surprised Family he brought all falling.
The Three-Eyed Tiger needed only one strike.
To it, does Spirit Platform Realm, Split Soul Realm, Gathering Yuan Realm really matter?
With a single swipe, everyone became headless bodies.
Blood sprayed wildly, an unsightly scene.
"Ah!"
Thousands of miles away, Qi Cang let out a startled cry and dropped the Transmission Spirit Artifact in fright.
He was scared.
It wasn’t the gory scene that frightened him; he’d created such scenes himself.
It was that among those killed, there were five in the Spirit Platform Realm, with Long Zhen Mountain being Spirit Platform Seventh Layer, only one layer less than him.
Meaning, if he had just been facing the Three-Eyed Tiger, the result would have been the same.
This mortally threatening psychological impact was different.
He glanced at Lu Zhong, who was also pale, clearly just as shocked.
Facing Qi Cang’s inquiry, he nodded solemnly.
Meaning, yes, this Tiger Demon is at least Celestial Fate Ninth Layer!
As for Master Jiuluo and others, they almost wet themselves in fright.
The Feixian Sect actually has such a terrifying Sect Guardian Spirit Beast? Why didn’t you say so earlier?
Are you kidding me?
Now, they had one thought—to escape from here.
Still attack the Feixian Sect?
Are you trying to die faster?
But leaving here required Qi Cang’s permission; otherwise, with Lu Zhong being Celestial Fate First Layer, they wouldn’t survive.
Even if they miraculously escaped, could they escape the Eight Clouds Hall’s punishment?
"Young Master, that Tiger Demon is something we absolutely cannot contend with!"
"Exactly, we can’t handle this at all."
"Please, Young Master, allow us to retreat..."
They all knelt down and begged; this wasn’t being cannon fodder; this was serving themselves up on a plate.
Qi Cang coldly swept a look across them. The stronger the Tiger Demon, the more determined he was to have it.
Once he got that Tiger Demon, even his father would have to step aside for him; no one would be able to challenge him!
"You don’t need to attack, just maintain the intimidation!"
As long as these sects kept the encirclement, they could use the pretext of supporting to enter the Feixian Sect and righteously replace Jiang Cheng.
Master Jiuluo was in tears: "We... intimidate the Tiger Demon? Is this a joke?"
"Agree and you might not die, disagree and you will die immediately!"
To Qi Cang, these people were merely tools; he didn’t care if they survived in the end.
For a moment, the top experts of the remaining four houses and seven sects were chilled to the bone.
On the other side, all present Third Generation disciples of Feixian Sect were also dumbfounded.
Seventy-four experts of the Dragon-Surprised Family, with the weakest already at Soul Splitting Sixth Layer.
To them, the Soul Splitting Realm was still quite distant.
And they were wiped out in a single move?
By that little cute pet?
Not just them, but even the second generation, like Ji Linghan and Luo Yuan, found it hard to believe.
They knew the Three-Eyed Tiger was formidable, but had no concrete idea how so.
They’d only seen it act once, when it destroyed Duanmu Pool’s Divine Soul.
Nowhere near as shocking as this time!
"Sect... Sect Leader..."
Quite a few female disciples timidly approached Jiang Cheng, as if only by being near him could they feel safe.
The Three-Eyed Tiger was too brutal, and during this shocking period, their minds were a bit blank, even worrying that the Tiger Demon might go berserk and attack them too.
Soon afterward, they heard Jiang Cheng’s discontented roar.
"What are you doing?"

chapters.title: Chapter 56 System Upgrade
chapters.content:
Chapter 56: Chapter 56 System Upgrade
He flew angrily to the Three-Eyed Tiger and kicked it.
The Three-Eyed Tiger deftly dodged, then pretended to be dumb.
"What are you doing?"
"Still pretending? Do you need to do this? You’ve scared my disciples!"
He remembered that this Three-Eyed Tiger could wipe out tens of thousands with just one divine thought, not even leaving a scratch on the surface.
"You’ve made the place bloody, are you crazy?"
This darn tiger must be doing it on purpose, making a mess on purpose to make it hard to clean up.
This is the hall entrance, an important place for Brother Cheng to show off. It must be kept clean and solemn.
Moreover, it’s inconvenient to pick up loot in such a mess.
"I enjoy it, what’s it to you?"
The Three-Eyed Tiger combed its soft fur on top of its head with its claw and felt secretly delighted seeing Jiang Cheng so frenzied.
Only the two of them understood their relationship.
Others didn’t know.
Seeing the Sect Leader dare kick and curse at the Three-Eyed Tiger, everyone held their breath, almost too scared to breathe.
Even Qi Cang and Lu Zhong, watching the projection from afar, had their mouths agape in an O-shape.
Is this guy crazy?
That’s at least a terrifying Celestial Fate Ninth Layer existence!
Even as a spirit beast, it’s a respected expert, okay?
The Eight Clouds Hall also has a Sect Guardian Spirit Beast, the Poison Spirit Red Deer. Its Celestial Fate Fourth Layer strength is actually weaker than Palace Master Qi Yuansheng’s Celestial Fate Fifth Layer.
But every time Qi Yuansheng approaches it, he does so with courtesy, and he has to request when he needs its help.
Otherwise, that Poison Spirit Red Deer would throw a tantrum.
The Tiger Demon is about to go wild, take him down!
But they were disappointed.
The Tiger Demon wasn’t the least bit furious, just bickered with Jiang Cheng a bit.
This made Qi Cang extremely jealous, why?
Meanwhile, over at Feixian Sect, once again having their perceptions refreshed, everyone’s admiration for Jiang Cheng rose another level.
Wow, the Sect Leader is so formidable.
Such a powerful Three-Eyed Tiger, not even having a temper in front of the Sect Leader.
Which shows the Sect Leader must be even more powerful!
For a moment, stars shone in the disciples’ eyes again.
The normally reticent and serene Lin Ning uncharacteristically pretended to be an innocent girl and leaned on Brother Cheng.
"Thank you, Sect Leader, for eliminating the Dragon-Surprised Family and relieving the great danger to our Lin Family! Sect Leader... what is your actual power?"
She blinked her big eyes.
The Three-Eyed Tiger was furious.
Obviously, it was my effort, why are you thanking him?
"No big deal." Jiang Cheng acted profoundly.
"Wow, the Sect Leader must be even more impressive than I imagined..."
Brother Cheng casually pushed her away.
Girl, I’m busy picking up loot to exchange for points now, save the flirting for later.
Then he got busy.
Seeing Lin Ning pushed away, Ji Linghan burst out laughing.
Misunderstood, didn’t you?
The first time I saw him looting Yao Yunxuan and others, I was also neglected.
The Sect Leader is a career-minded man; don’t disturb him when he’s busy with serious matters. That’s my sisterly advice, but I’m too lazy to share it with you all.
The Three-Eyed Tiger flew into the sky.
"Kid, I’m telling you beforehand, I only protect the sect’s territory."
"Additionally, I won’t deal with those enemies not invading, you’re on your own!"
And with a cackle, it flew off.
This move again caught everyone by surprise.
Turns out this Sect Guardian Spirit Beast isn’t that obedient?
Only protects, doesn’t attack?
From afar, Qi Cang was overjoyed!
"Hahaha, it’s truly the heavens assisting me!"
"I thought that Tiger Demon had become his slave, turns out it doesn’t have such a good relationship with Jiang Cheng!"
Everyone else sighed in relief.
Master Jiuluo stroked his long beard; moments ago, he was pleading, hoping to be let free, but now he’s brimming with righteousness.
"Young Master, we must ensure to hold our ground, maintaining the blockade around Feixian Sect!"
"Indeed, we will give our utmost!"
"Ensure the success of the Young Master’s plan!"
With the Three-Eyed Tiger not taking action, there’s nothing to fear.
Just keeping the external blockade to intimidate them, helping Qi Cang muster some prestige.
No need for them to attack inside, no danger involved.
Whatever Jiang Cheng says, the disciples of Feixian Sect believe, but these people won’t do that.
They don’t believe he could be stronger than the Three-Eyed Tiger; he’s just at the Spirit Platform Realm at most.
As for Long Zhen Mountain being killed before?
That was just bad luck for him.
"Hahaha, good!"
Qi Cang was immensely proud, waved his large hand: "Elder Lu, it’s our turn to take the stage!"
On the other side, the disciples of Feixian Sect were very uneasy.
"Sect Leader, is the Sect Guardian Spirit Beast really not going to help?"
If Three-Eyed Tiger won’t help, what about the other enemies outside?
"It’s alright, off with it then."
Just stripping the spirit armor and spiritual artifact off Long Zhen Mountain, Jiang Cheng didn’t even look back. After pocketing the spiritual artifacts, the screen from Qi Cang’s side cut off as well.
As for the enemies outside, Brother Cheng wasn’t worried in the least.
At worst, resurrect once and deal with them all.
The sect is outside, disciples wouldn’t see him being killed, and it wouldn’t affect his rating in their hearts.
"Exactly, why are you unnecessarily worried?"
Luo Yuan, Yin Xuer, Shan Tai, and others began educating their disciples.
"The Sect Leader is more formidable than the Little Brain Axe, don’t you know?"
"Have faith in the Sect Leader, see how calm we are?"
"With time, you’ll understand."
The third generation disciples could only nod repeatedly, expressing that the Sect Leader was truly profound and unfathomable.
This time’s loot was quite substantial. Jiang Cheng kept some Tier Six Spiritual Artifacts, intending to use them to re-equip disciples in the future.
The remaining portion was exchanged for 32,152 points.
No choice, the batch from the Dragon-Surprised Family were the most powerful and held the highest positions.
What they brought on their persons and inside their rings were the best resources.
Adding to the originally held 92,357 points, Jiang Cheng’s points now reached 124,509, already allowing for a system upgrade.
He opened the system panel and confirmed the upgrade.
Level: 4
Points: 0/1,000,000
Available Points: 24,509
Current Skills: Host can consume points to forcibly elevate another target by one great realm, target count is 1, cooldown is 1 month.
Subordinate Skills: Host can consume points to transform into any target, cooldown is 3 days.
Note: Transformation target must be one the Host has seen with their own eyes. Except for the target’s power, the transformation can perfectly emulate all other characteristics.
Damn, is this for real?
Seventy-Two Transformations, huh?
No, that’s not it, there’s no limit to how many transformations there are, as long as I’ve seen them before, I can transform.
Besides power, all traits can be mimicked.
For instance, if he transforms into the Three-Eyed Tiger, although he doesn’t possess the Demon King’s power, the Three-Eyed Tiger’s aura, pressure, and divine soul traits are exactly the same.
Even if the other party is strong, it’s hard to see through unless they strike.
This is the most formidable aspect.
Actually, at Saint Realm, whether cultivators or demon beasts, they already possess some transformation abilities.
But a Saint Tier Cultivator can at most alter appearance and body shape to look like someone else, not transform from human to another species.
Moreover, they can’t change internal traits like aura, pressure, etc.

chapters.title: Chapter 57: Add a Blessing for You
chapters.content:
Chapter 57: Chapter 57: Add a Blessing for You
As for demon beasts, their transformation is called shapeshifting.
They can transform from demon beasts to human form, but cannot become other species.
The Three-Eyed Tiger can now transform into human form, but with its mini version size, it would appear like a baby. It cares about its image, so it wouldn’t undermine its dignity.
Thinking about some things he could do after transforming, Brother Cheng chuckled with a bit of a glimmer.
All the disciples were watching him, each secretly having a thought arise in their hearts.
Why does it feel like the Sect Leader just became a bit sleazy for an instant?
Bah, bah, bah, this must be an illusion.
The Sect Leader is wise and mighty, how could he possibly be sleazy?
Looking at the one million points needed to advance to the next level, Brother Cheng turned his attention to the newly acquired skill.
Forcefully enhancing any target by a great realm, should he give it a try?
His gaze swept back and forth over the disciples before finally settling on Ji Linghan.
She’s the first person he met in this world, tender and considerate, obedient to him, she’s like the white moonlight in Brother Cheng’s heart.
Opening the enhancement skill, a string of glowing characters appeared above Ji Linghan’s head.
Target: Ji Linghan.
Current realm: Soul Splitting Second Layer.
Realm that can be enhanced to: Spirit Platform Second Layer (target automatically gains comprehension of this realm).
Point cost: 30000.
Damn, so expensive?
Brother only has a little over twenty thousand points, it’s really not enough.
He could only check the skill on other people.
Target: Luo Yuan.
Current realm: Gathering Yuan Ninth Layer.
Realm that can be enhanced to: Soul Splitting Ninth Layer.
Point cost: 3000.
Ten times less.
He also noticed a pattern—the lower the target’s great realm, the fewer points needed.
Once crossing a great realm, due to breaking through the great realm bottleneck and gaining new abilities of that realm, the points needed would increase tenfold!
Luo Yuan enhancing to Soul Splitting Ninth Layer merely enhances his divine soul ability a bit, whereas if Ji Linghan enhances to Spirit Platform Second Layer, she would gain the abilities of Spirit Platform out of nowhere.
Of course, it takes more points.
Thinking about it this way, if the Three-Eyed Tiger’s Demon King power wants to enhance a great realm, it probably won’t stop with a few billion points.
Better let it go.
Just when he planned to enhance Luo Yuan a bit to continue elevating his divine status in the disciples’ hearts,
he suddenly changed his mind.
It’s not that he was reluctant to spend three thousand points, but suddenly remembered, Luo Yuan is male.
Brother Cheng isn’t against men; brotherhood is fine, but he’s worried the disciples might misunderstand him.
With so many people, why are you so special to Elder Luo?
Only enhancing him alone while neglecting others?
Oh, you’re gay, it’s confirmed!
This skill can only enhance one person at a time, with a cooldown time of a month, so he couldn’t defend himself within that month.
Forget it, better switch target.
He finally set the target on Yin Xuer.
Why not choose someone more gifted like Lin Ning?
She joined late, while Yin Xuer has been with him for a long time; you can’t neglect the seniors.
On the other hand, Jiang Cheng still remembers Lin Ning’s bet with Ji Linghan.
Lin Ning has only joined for five days and has already broken through from Spirit Formation Eighth Layer to Gathering Yuan First Layer.
What if enhancing her too quickly makes her surpass Ji Linghan?
By then, according to the bet, she would have to acknowledge him as her master.
Target: Yin Xuer.
Current realm: Gathering Yuan Ninth Layer.
Realm that can be enhanced to: Soul Splitting Ninth Layer.
Point cost: 3000.
Enhance?
To fully elevate his status, Brother Cheng didn’t immediately click confirm but beckoned with his hand.
"Xuer, come over here!"
"Huh? Me?"
Yin Xuer didn’t understand what was about to happen and found it a bit strange.
The Sect Leader has always favored Senior Sister Ji alone. Recently, with Lin Ning joining, a portion of his favor has shifted.
Although she’s also a true disciple-level genius, she’s still a bit behind these two prodigies.
The Sect Leader is nice to her, but treats her just as well as others, with no special treatment.
So despite her beauty, she had long extinguished the desire to compete for favor.
"Yes!"
Jiang Cheng smilingly ruffled her hair.
"Xuer, you can be considered one of the first veterans. I’ve always noticed your silent dedication."
For the first time granting someone an enhancement, it’s better to make up some high-sounding reasons.
Silent dedication?
Have I silently dedicated anything?
Yin Xuer was bewildered, so she could only nod.
"Some efforts you haven’t spoken of, but they’re clear as day in my heart!"
Brother Cheng thumped his chest, making a mutually understanding face, even though he himself had no idea what he was saying.
In general, the sentiment is that Yin Xuer is quite deserving of a reward.
Yin Xuer was even more confounded.
What’s going on?
Is the Sect Leader about to confess to me?
Oh my god, really?
Could it be that I’ve magically defeated Senior Sister Ji and Lin Ning, capturing the Sect Leader’s heart?
At this moment, both Ji Linghan and Lin Ning’s breaths halted, almost fainting on the spot.
"So I’ve decided to bestow you with a blessing."
"Blessing?"
Yin Xuer couldn’t comprehend.
"Just consider it a reward."
Jiang Cheng lifted his head, gazing at the sky above a corner of the hall, and calmly said, "Actually, this Sect Leader masters an immortal technique!"
Immortal technique?
The crowd was in an uproar.
"An immortal technique!"
"Could the Sect Leader be an immortal?"
"He must be, otherwise how could Little Brain Axe, so powerful, submit to him?"
"I’ve long known the Sect Leader is a divine being!"
"What kind of immortal technique does the Sect Leader know?"
Jiang Cheng calmly smiled, "You’ll soon find out."
Then, he clicked confirm to enhance.
A white light suddenly surged from bottom to top over Yin Xuer’s body, lasting three seconds before disappearing.
Jiang Cheng’s right hand was still patting her head, and since he mentioned immortal technique, he had to at least put on a show.
This appearance indeed had a bit of an ’immortal touching my top, granting long life’ feeling!
When his right hand moved away, Yin Xuer’s eyes widened.
She suddenly realized her power surged dramatically!
The spiritual power within her had multiplied dozens of times compared to her previous Gathering Yuan Ninth Layer!
Her divine soul underwent a fundamental change, and she inexplicably mastered the divine technique of Soul Splitting.
Moreover, this divine technique was so refined, it felt like the next great realm wasn’t far.
Now, she seemed capable of defeating a hundred of her former selves!
Seeing her mix of astonishment and questioning gaze, Brother Cheng waved his sleeves, hands behind his back, and said freely, "I’ve helped you enhance by one great realm, you’re now Soul Splitting Ninth Layer."
Soul Splitting Ninth Layer!
These four words nearly knocked Yin Xuer to the ground in shock.
Everyone went crazy; is this even possible?
Ji Linghan and Luo Yuan immediately used their divine souls to perceive Yin Xuer, only to find they could no longer discern her power.
This...
After the initial shock, Yin Xuer was overjoyed.
She couldn’t wait to fly into the sky, her Spirit Sword gently trembling, channels of celestial fire spreading across the skies, blocking the sun!
With her divine soul split, the vast area around the plaza couldn’t escape her perception.
That power surpassed even the previous Sect Leader of Feixian Sect.
"Sect Leader!"
She flew down, like a fledgling swallowing into Jiang Cheng’s embrace, her profuse tears rubbing and smearing on his shoulder.
"Wuwuwu, Sect Leader, why are you so nice to me..."

chapters.title: Chapter 58: Is It Really Immortal Technique?
chapters.content:
Chapter 58: Chapter 58: Is It Really Immortal Technique?
"Stay calm, hold on!"
Brother Cheng patted the soft back of the girl, secretly pleased in his heart.
The pretentious effect was remarkable.
To be honest, even the Three-Eyed Tiger was shocked this time.
Although it flew far away, it couldn’t hide what was happening inside the Feixian Sect from it.
When it heard Jiang Cheng say he knew Immortal Techniques, it scoffed.
It had never even seen Immortal Techniques, yet he dared to boast.
This kid is really addicted to pretending, only deceives those ignorant juniors.
When Jiang Cheng really patted Xue’Er’s head, and a white light transformed her from the Ninth Layer of Gathering Essence to the Ninth Layer of Soul Splitting, its eyes almost popped out.
After carefully sensing countless times, that girl truly rose a whole Great Realm.
No mistake, it wasn’t an illusion!
How, how is this possible?
Could it be some power transfer Magic Technique?
Three-Eyed Tiger had heard legends of such techniques but never seen them.
Moreover, from what it knew about Jiang Cheng, this kid was proactive when it came to harming others for personal gain. As for harming himself for the benefit of others, to transfer his Spiritual Power to someone else?
He’d rather be killed than do that!
Even if such a Magic Technique existed, it could only transfer Spiritual Power, it couldn’t change the Divine Soul Realm.
So, could it really be "Immortal Technique"?
To be honest, right now it wanted to fly over and ask in person.
If he really knew such Immortal Techniques, and could enhance its own powers, wouldn’t it be even mightier than the Golden Dragon King?
By then, it would reign supreme in the Celestial Demon Domain, and that little Frost Rabbit King would cling to its thigh, begging it to favor her!
Imagining that scene, the Three-Eyed Tiger got excited.
But in the end, it suppressed this thought.
After just having a few arguments with Jiang Cheng, it would be too humiliating to go beg him.
Besides, it suspected this Immortal Technique could only enhance those weaker than Jiang Cheng, not those stronger, which would completely violate the Heavenly Dao rules!
Yes, that’s certainly it.
It must not easily bow before that kid!
Having discovered the "truth," it sneered and continued to pretend to be asleep.
Meanwhile, on the other side, Brother Cheng had finally parted with Yin Xuer.
A large group of disciples surrounded her, offering congratulations.
Both Second and Third Generation disciples expressed that their understanding had been shattered.
The Immortal Technique was too miraculous, upgrading without any cultivation, which defied common sense.
Now they truly regarded Jiang Cheng as an Immortal.
They had actually joined an Immortal’s Sect, wasn’t this a dream?
Luo Yuan, Shan Tai, and others squeezed over with difficulty, rubbing their hands flatteringly beside Brother Cheng.
"Hehe, well, our wise and mighty Sect Leader, we... you see... wouldn’t you..."
"The most handsome Sect Leader in history wouldn’t forget his most loyal disciple Shan Tai!"
"Actually, I’ve been chanting and praying for the Sect Leader ten thousand times every night lately..."
"I did it a hundred thousand times!"
"I did it a billion times!"
Damn, Jiang Cheng really wanted to mock on the spot, there are only tens of thousands of seconds in a night, how did you manage to chant a billion times?
Is it light-speed chanting?
He knew this would happen.
If it were him, he couldn’t stay calm either.
Boosting a whole Great Realm, who could resist such temptation.
But there’s no other way, this Skill’s cooldown is once a month.
Moreover, he just discovered, Yin Xuer’s upgrade this time did not get points reward.
Perhaps because she didn’t cultivate up on her own, so there’s no reward.
Indeed, if this had points, then Yin Xuer could gain several thousand points just by upgrading ten small realms, which would be without any cost.
The system wouldn’t leave such a loophole.
This kind of enhancement should be saved for when it’s really needed.
"This Sect Leader’s Immortal Technique, every use depletes Primordial Qi, it’s not as easy as you think."
After saying this, he even pretended to cough twice.
Although he didn’t expend any effort, burning points is also a depletion of Primordial Qi, at least Brother Cheng thought so.
"So, that’s how it is!"
"Sect Leader, please take care of yourself!"
"Yes, yes, if you fall, our Feixian Sect is finished."
Everyone was still very concerned about the Sect Leader, upon hearing that a price had to be paid, they immediately gave up.
Yin Xuer even flung herself into his arms again, hugging him tightly and crying out loud.
"Sect Leader! You sacrificed so much for me and don’t cherish your own body, besides offering my life, I really don’t know how to repay you..."
Ah, maybe I overacted a bit.
They seem to think I’m going to cough up blood and collapse the next second.
They were so moved.
While Jiang Cheng was gratified, he could only pat her trembling back again, comforting her for a while, saying he’d soon recover through self-care.
After consoling her, he saw Ji Linghan’s eyes filled with worry and hidden resentment.
Although the Senior Sister was outclassed by Yin Xuer out of nowhere, upon learning that this boost required a "significant" cost, she no longer wanted one for herself.
More than anything, she was concerned about Jiang Cheng’s health.
Why don’t you take care of yourself?
For Yin Xuer, you still used that Immortal Technique despite "severely wounding" yourself!
Do you like her that much?
Turns out your heart already belongs to someone else, all along I was thinking too much...
A girl’s thoughts can be sensitive at times.
That look made Jiang Cheng almost unwilling to meet her gaze directly.
Girl, I’m sorry, you were the first who came to mind.
But your initial level is too high, we didn’t have enough points.
You’ve really overthought it.
Girl, just wait, I’ll definitely restore your glory as Senior Sister next time!
After finishing the show, it was time to get down to business.
"Alright, I guess the enemies outside can’t wait any longer, I’ll be back soon."
After speaking, he was about to fly out.
This time everyone was unwilling, Ji Linghan was the first to step forward to stop him.
"Sect Leader, you were just severely injured, you should recuperate, how can you go out to meet the enemy!"
"Yes, although you are strong, wait until you recover to fight..."
"We will do everything to buy time for the Sect Leader!"
Jiang Cheng felt helpless, seeing the worry etched on everyone’s faces, he felt he had spun himself into a web.
I’m not severely injured, it was just 3000 point expenditure.
Yet he couldn’t explain.
He could only flick his robe sleeve, continue gazing at the sky at a 45-degree angle, and keep pretending.
What, you’re asking why no flicking of the robe sleeve with hands behind his back?
Right now both his hands are tightly held by Ji Linghan and Lin Ning.
"Do you all have so little faith in my strength?"
"No, mainly Sect Leader you..."
"There’s nothing mainly about it, to be truthful. Those bunch of undisciplined soldiers and inferior troops, this Sect Leader can easily annihilate them with one percent of my power."
Huh?
All the disciples’ mouths hung open wide, Ji Linghan and Lin Ning unconsciously released their grip.
If someone else said this, they would certainly scoff, how boastful without any preparation.
But coming from Jiang Cheng, it was different.
After all, they had just "confirmed" Jiang Cheng’s identity as an Immortal.
They didn’t know how powerful Immortals were, because they weren’t even sure if there were any in this world.
But they guessed it must be many levels higher than the Spirit Platform Realm?
"Then... Sect Leader, you must be careful!"
"And if it’s not feasible, remember to retreat early."
In a scene of reluctant farewell, Brother Cheng flew out of the mountain gate.
Soon after, he met Qi Cang and Lu Zhong’s group head-on.

chapters.title: Chapter 59: A Plan to Preach to the Deaf
chapters.content:
Chapter 59: Chapter 59: A Plan to Preach to the Deaf
Qi Cang and Lu Zhong’s group had only 13 people, but the lowest strength among them was the Spirit Platform Fifth Layer.
They were all Qi Cang’s trusted elites from the Eight Clouds Hall, here to infiltrate the Feixian Sect together.
Because he showed his face during the entry assessment before, Qi Cang specifically wore a spiritual artifact to change his appearance this time.
Additionally, he restored his original Spirit Platform Eighth Layer cultivation level.
In his view, with such differences, Brother Cheng couldn’t possibly recognize him.
"Sect Leader Jiang!"
"Where are you going?"
"It’s very dangerous outside, many sects are planning to besiege you!"
Speaking with utmost enthusiasm, as if coming to help, but actually, Qi Cang, Lu Zhong, and the others were quite surprised.
No way, is this guy planning to take on those Seven Great Sects all by himself?
Could it be that the Three-Eyed Tiger has come out too?
The group was suspicious and hurriedly released their divine sense to investigate, but even Lu Zhong couldn’t find a second living being nearby.
"Who are you?"
Jiang Cheng halted his cloud and stopped.
Qi Cang couldn’t have imagined in his dreams that he’d be recognized at first sight.
This strange group suddenly appearing led Brother Cheng to habitually use an Insight.
The Insight skill treats cultivators like heavenly and earthly treasures, scoring them, revealing their true state at a glance in front of this skill.
Qi Cang was scored 7500 points because he reached the Spirit Platform Eighth Layer.
If he was at the Gathering Yuan Realm, it shouldn’t reach 1000.
In this regard, his talent was significantly lower than Ji Linghan and Lin Ning.
The spirit sword and spirit armor he carried, including the spiritual artifact on his head for disguising his appearance, were all kindly marked out by the Insight skill.
Moreover, it also indicated how many points they could convert to.
This kid’s rich, with two Tier Seven Spiritual Artifacts and one Tier Six Spiritual Artifact on him.
One Tier Seven Spiritual Artifact alone can convert to 10,000 points!
How much more could be in his ring?
Brother Cheng almost drooled, thinking about how the system just upgraded, and the third-level lottery was also opened, but he hasn’t experienced even a second-level lottery yet.
So poor, it’s utterly tragic.
"Oh, we’re from the Eight Clouds Hall, I’m the Young Master Qi Cang from the Eight Clouds Hall!"
Qi Cang thought Jiang Cheng didn’t know who he was, faking a formal self-introduction.
Unbeknownst to him, Brother Cheng was secretly mocking him.
Come on, last time you disguised as Yun Cang, did you just change your surname and not even bother altering your name?
How unprofessional!
Jiang Cheng had heard a bit about the Eight Clouds Hall but wasn’t familiar with them.
"Oh, so it’s you, what brings you here? Are you also here to attack me?"
Just say you’re here to attack me, then show your fangs and surround me with a sinister grin like other villains!
To be honest, Qi Cang had actually thought of this.
Now Jiang Cheng had come alone; if they took him out, the Feixian Sect would be leaderless.
This plan of usurping the nest would become simpler and smoother.
For this, he even secretly transmitted a message to consult Lu Zhong’s opinion.
"How about we take him out while he’s alone?"
"No, he must have something to rely on!" Lu Zhong was relatively cautious.
Qi Cang found it hard to resist.
Not only because of the Three-Eyed Tiger and the series of tempting treasures but also the grudge from the last time when he was forced to kneel and retreat, he genuinely wanted to kill Jiang Cheng to vent his anger.
"What could he possibly rely on? You also heard, that Tiger Demon only guards the mountain, doesn’t attack. Killing him would end everything."
Lu Zhong shook his head: "His confidence is puzzling, I remember when he went to the Red Sun Sect back then, he also went alone on the surface."
"This... okay, let’s observe first."
Qi Cang pondered for a moment, feeling that this was indeed the case. Jiang Cheng’s behavior was too unusual, abnormalities always have something odd.
Ultimately, they decided to proceed according to the original plan.
"Sect Leader Jiang, you’re joking, we’re here to save you, how could we kill you?"
"Save me?"
Hearing that they weren’t here to kill him, Jiang Cheng was sorely disappointed, and his tone turned cold.
"Yes indeed, we at the Eight Clouds Hall, as the dominant power in Feiyun State, can’t just stand by as an innocent sect is besieged, right? Such atrocious acts must be stopped!"
Qi Cang spoke passionately, as though the Eight Clouds Hall had always taken it upon themselves to uphold the world.
"Come, Sect Leader Jiang, let’s go to the Feixian Sect together. With us here, those Seven Great Sects surely can’t break in!"
He approached smilingly, trying to get close to Jiang Cheng.
Regarding patience and acting, he was definitely skilled.
Unfortunately, Brother Cheng was very upset upon hearing this and extremely dissatisfied.
What do you mean?
Clearly, you’re here to fight me, wasn’t last time’s disguise tiring enough?
Why make it so complicated?
Needlessly playing convoluted schemes, which is annoying, why not just kill me directly?
If you don’t kill me now, how can I trigger resurrection invincibility?
He brushed Qi Cang aside irritably, saying, "No need, our Feixian Sect doesn’t require aid, you can leave."
Saying that, he intended to continue his journey.
What?
No need for aid?
This reaction was completely beyond Qi Cang, Lu Zhong, and the others’ expectations.
Before coming, they had envisaged several possible reactions, such as Jiang Cheng doubting their intentions, questioning why they were being so ’kind’, and had prepared responses for these.
But they never thought Jiang Cheng would refuse aid.
This goes against the script!
With a sect surrounded by seven others, at this point, a powerful reinforcements showing up, shouldn’t one cheerfully welcome them, supplying food and drink to reward and thank them?
Even if the Feixian Sect has a Three-Eyed Tiger seated, who would mind having more allies?
This reaction, how were they supposed to continue acting?
Lu Zhong chuckled awkwardly, leaning closer to persuade Jiang Cheng to accept the ’assistance’.
"Cough, Sect Leader Jiang, don’t underestimate those Seven Great Sects, they have over 20 in the Spirit Platform Realm. Could Sect Leader Jiang be a Celestial Fate Realm expert?"
"No."
"Then have you brought any hidden troops?"
"No."
"So is it that Sect Leader Jiang has some clever strategy to defeat those Seven Great Sects?"
This was both probing and indirect questioning, and Jiang Cheng was tired of it for him.
"Old man, are you done? My power’s just this little; I haven’t brought anyone along, no clever strategies, and no big killer moves, satisfied yet?"
"So, are you going to kill me or not, give a clear answer!"
"If not, I’m busy!"
He was genuinely impatient; this was his last time giving them a chance.
If you don’t kill me, I’ll go let the Seven Great Sects do it.
Lu Zhong was almost so choked that he spat blood.
He and Qi Cang exchanged a glance, and the two cunning people unanimously concluded, Jiang Cheng must be deliberately feigning weakness to tempt them into a trap.
Can’t fall for his tricks at all!
"Sect Leader Jiang really loves to joke, we’re here to help you, how could we kill you? Those Seven Great Sects are no joke, even with our strength, it’s challenging to upfront beat them. How about we return to the Feixian Sect and discuss..."
Before he could finish speaking, Jiang Cheng flew off.
From afar, he tossed two words.
"Disappointing!"
The remaining crowd stood looking at each other, dumbfounded.
"What does he mean?"
Qi Cang gritted his teeth, almost losing it again.
He had already revealed his true identity, yet Jiang Cheng was still so impolite, not taking him seriously at all.
"Could it be he’s seen through our true intentions?"
"No, if that were the case, he would either lack the strength and flee back to the Feixian Sect or have powerful measures and would just finish us off directly."
"Then what was he just now..."
"I also don’t understand his intention..."
Lu Zhong stated that in his eight hundred years, he had never seen such a strange maneuver.
Their schemes were like playing a lute to a cow.

chapters.title: Chapter 60: The King of Assassins
chapters.content:
Chapter 60: Chapter 60: The King of Assassins
When Jiang Cheng arrived at the encampment of the Seven Sects, he found them busy packing up to leave.
According to the plan, these Seven Great Sect Clans were supposed to maintain a surrounding posture around the Feixian Sect.
Encircle but do not attack, apply pressure, and provide a reasonable excuse for Qi Cang to enter the Feixian Sect.
To form a blockade, they couldn’t all gather in one place; the act needed to be convincing.
Jiang Cheng didn’t know what their plan was, but upon seeing this scene, he was still glad he arrived in time.
Otherwise, if they scattered, he would have to waste several more resurrections to defeat them one by one.
"Jiang Cheng!"
"Jiang Cheng is here!"
He came flying in openly, and naturally, he was spotted quickly.
"What?"
"Why did he come out to attack on his own initiative?"
"Is that Tiger Demon here?"
Upon hearing this news, the Sect Leaders and Clan Heads inside were so scared they nearly lost their composure, with some almost wanting to dig a hole and escape.
The reason why they dared to stay here was that they calculated the Tiger Demon would not appear, and the Feixian Sect would not dare to attack.
They thought encirclement without a fight posed no danger.
Now hearing that Jiang Cheng had come, they even thought an army was launching an assault.
"He’s alone!"
"Didn’t see the Tiger Demon."
"Really?"
"Absolutely true!"
"Let’s go, take a look!"
The strongest, Master Jiuluo, straightened his tangled beard and resumed an appearance of a high-ranking expert.
The top experts from the Four Mansions and Seven Sects were here on this occasion, though there weren’t many.
After excluding the recently eradicated Dragon-Surprised Family, there were more than five hundred people.
"This lineup is a bit shabby..."
Jiang Cheng rubbed his chin, expressing his disappointment.
It didn’t seem as impressive as those scenes with tens of thousands from prior sects.
Although these individuals were much stronger.
"Jiang Cheng, why did you come?"
The one who hated him the most here was undoubtedly Duanmu Zhe, given that both Duanmu Hong and Duanmu Pool had been killed.
Brother Cheng found such idle chatter amusing.
"Your question is really unique, you all are here to eliminate my Feixian Sect, can’t I come and take a look?"
This...
Could Duanmu Zhe say no?
"You’re here alone?"
Master Jiuluo was still cautious, his Spirit Sword gleaming vibrantly, his Spirit Platform was ready.
Not to kill Jiang Cheng, but ready to escape at the first sign of trouble.
"Where is that Tiger Demon?"
The Fortress Master of Qian Ning Castle, Dong Hai, couldn’t help but ask directly.
For those who could cultivate to the Spirit Platform Realm, what were they relying on?
Talent and diligent cultivation certainly played a role.
But most importantly, surviving multiple dangers and living longer than others.
No one is stupid, like Qi Cang, they also felt something unusual must be at play.
"It’s not here."
Jiang Cheng honestly admitted, silently puzzled about how they knew about the Three-Eyed Tiger.
Could it be that the reputation of the Three-Eyed Tiger was greater than his?
This left him very displeased, clearly, he was the Sect Leader.
"Are you sure?"
Jiang Cheng was really annoyed, why can’t these people attack decisively every time before killing him?
Can’t they just draw their swords without a word?
Like Master Guiyi who kindly asked how he wanted to die, why was that so rare?
"Surely certain, absolutely!"
"Could you please give me some face? I’m the one here now, and you keep asking where another demon beast is; isn’t this disrespecting me..."
Everyone was silent.
They had a hard time following Brother Cheng’s train of thought.
Is this person really a Sect Leader?
Swish!
A pitch-black Bone Spike emerged from Jiang Cheng’s chest, the tip of the spike enveloped in a faint black mist.
Other than that, there was dripping blood.
Jiang Cheng looked down, not knowing who was so eager to kill him.
In any case, he finally died again.
He then collapsed contentedly.
The Valley Master of Blood Killing Valley, Xuan Ci, shrouded in a cloak, emerged from behind him.
"You, you killed him?"
Master Jiuluo and Dong Hai, among others, nearly dropped their jaws; Jiang Cheng died just like that?
Xuan Ci withdrew the Bone Spike, he himself somewhat incredulous.
Such that his low, hoarse voice had a touch of awkwardness: "Instinct, the opportunity was too good, couldn’t resist..."
He was extremely skilled in assassination, with a past record of having defeated someone of the Spirit Platform Ninth Layer while being just Spirit Platform First Layer.
That battle solidified Blood Killing Valley’s fearsome reputation as a dark organization.
When Jiang Cheng arrived, he didn’t show himself, rather staying hidden.
Originally to flee at the first sign of trouble, but unnoticed, found Jiang Cheng, in his stance and posture, filled with openings.
This man seemed entirely unguarded towards his surroundings.
Is he a newcomer to the cultivation realm?
Even if he were just a regular Body Tempering Realm cultivator, he shouldn’t be so reckless?
The cultivation realm is perilous.
Xuan Ci was in disbelief, suspecting these openings were a deliberate ploy.
Yet after thorough consideration, it didn’t appear so.
Despite hesitating several times, his occupational hazard eventually got the better of him, and he made a move.
The regret followed immediately after, if he failed, the consequences would be unimaginable.
Who would have thought it would succeed?
Jiang Cheng was simply killed by him so easily!
Predictably, everyone present was stunned.
Was it really that simple?
Wasn’t it said he had wiped out five sects?
Could this Jiang Cheng be an impostor?
Shortly after the initial shock, the crowd erupted in cheers.
"Hahaha!"
"Well done, Brother Xuan Ci!"
"Indeed the number one assassin of Qinglan Prefecture."
"What assassin, he’s clearly an assassination king!"
With Jiang Cheng killed, should this mission be considered completed ahead of schedule?
As for that Tiger Demon, it seemed it really only guarded the mountain, otherwise it would have stopped Xuan Ci by now.
"He was too careless, and didn’t even wear Spirit Armor, basically a living target."
Xuan Ci, who was previously nervous, had now regained his aloof composure.
With arms crossed and holding the Bone Spike Spiritual Artifact, he scoffed, "I’ve never encountered such an easy target in my life. Full of power, but no defense."
"Hahaha, Brother Xuan Ci, that’s harsh."
As everyone was joyfully celebrating, Duanmu Zhe rushed over.
"Be careful of his feigned death!"
Swish swish!
He quickly delivered two more strikes to Jiang Cheng’s neck and abdomen.
The Duanmu family had past experiences, when Duanmu Hong first killed Jiang Cheng, they thought it was done too.
As a result, Jiang Cheng remained lively and even counter-killed Duanmu Hong.
Seeing him deliver the coup de grâce, Xuan Ci was slightly unhappy.
"Duanmu Zhe, do you not trust my skills?"
He felt his professional integrity was being insulted.
Duanmu Zhe dared not offend him and quickly explained, "Brother Xuan Ci misunderstands, this guy is exceptionally cunning, I was just being cautious."
In the distance, Qi Cang, Lu Zhong, and others who had quietly followed Jiang Cheng were also bewildered.
They had followed to see what trick Jiang Cheng had, what his trump card was.
Then they witnessed this scene.
"He was killed by Xuan Ci?"
"Xuan Ci is only Spirit Platform Sixth Layer, isn’t Jiang Cheng a layer higher with a Divine-grade Spirit Platform, how could it be?"
"Assassination is about killing beyond one’s level, when completely off guard, the chance of success still exists."
Lu Zhong, while explaining, himself felt it was all too absurd.
Had the formidable enemy they worried for so long just died like that?

chapters.title: Chapter 61 Angry Spirit Talisman
chapters.content:
Chapter 61: Chapter 61 Angry Spirit Talisman
"Since he’s dead, no need to hide anymore!"
Qi Cang stood up and intended to fly over.
He still felt a bit regretful for not killing Jiang Cheng with his own hands.
Thinking of the shame of kneeling back then that he couldn’t erase face to face, he felt unfulfilled.
Jiang Cheng might have some kind of opportunity or inheritance, so his storage ring must be obtained immediately.
"Wait a moment!"
Lu Zhong grabbed him.
"What?"
Qi Cang squinted his eyes. Was Lu Zhong planning to covet the treasure and compete with him?
Lu Zhong could not have imagined that in this split second, Qi Cang was already considering how to kill him and take the storage ring for himself.
"Young Master, this matter is too bizarre. It’s better to be cautious, waiting a little longer won’t hurt."
Meanwhile, Jiang Cheng unsurprisingly heard the system prompt.
"Ding, the host has been killed. Detecting the enemy’s power, arranging a winning strategy for the host."
"Ding, the host’s resentment from being killed lingers, the Tier Five Destruction Rune in the ring has been summoned, the Tier Five Spirit Talisman has mutated due to anger and automatically advanced to Tier Nine Spirit Talisman, vowing revenge for the host!"
Damn this resentment from being killed, I was clearly killed happily!
Damn being summoned by a Spirit Talisman!
Damn this mutation and advancement!
Damn vowing revenge for the host...
There are so many slots to ridicule, Jiang Cheng didn’t even know from which angle to start, could the system’s solution be any more ridiculous?
He also didn’t know how powerful the Tier Nine Spirit Talisman was, honestly, he had never even used the Tier Five Spirit Talisman in the ring.
But since the system said so, it should be able to wipe out the enemies.
Besides, there definitely won’t be a blunder where the host is also blown up by the Spirit Talisman.
"Ding, the host is resurrected!"
Subsequently, everyone saw the corpse on the ground suddenly fly into the sky with a swoosh.
Before the enemies of the Four Mansions and Seven Sects below could react, he swiped his ring to take out the advanced Destruction Rune.
"How did he come back to life?"
"What did he just take out from the ring?"
Qi Cang, spying from a distance, was startled; he really wasn’t dead?
"Watch on!"
Lu Zhong also felt a stroke of luck that he held his horses.
Knew that he wouldn’t be killed that easily.
A true Divine-grade Spirit Platform wouldn’t fall that easily.
He and Qi Cang’s group didn’t think of Jiang Cheng resurrecting since that notion was too far-fetched.
They assumed he was just faking his death or used some kind of magical puppet death substitution technique.
"Seems like Jiang Cheng really has a trump card, probably the Spirit Talisman he just took out from the ring."
He was a Celestial Fate Realm expert, even from so far away, he could see clearly.
The present Duanmu Zhe, Master Jiuluo, and Xuan Ci among others suddenly panicked.
Duanmu Zhe even frantically shouted, "I knew it, I knew he was faking his death again!"
He was a bit regretful, he should have cut Jiang Cheng’s head off when finishing him.
High in the sky, Jiang Cheng was about to throw the Spirit Talisman when he suddenly remembered something.
Hurriedly pulling out a Transmission Spirit Artifact from the ring and placing it on the nearby mountaintop.
Before coming here, he had already arranged for his disciples to prepare spirit artifacts to receive transmissions.
In the previous exterminations, he didn’t record any videos to let the disciples admire the mighty presence of the Sect Leader, but this time he couldn’t miss it.
The scenes before resurrection, of course, couldn’t be recorded, but after resurrection, they could be.
In the main hall of the distant Feixian Sect.
"It’s here, it’s here!"
The crowd gathered closely to watch, packed tightly together.
"It’s showing, I see the Sect Leader."
"Sect Leader is so handsome!"
"Wow, look, that’s Master Jiuluo down there, I’ve seen his portrait before."
"That guy is the second patriarch of the Duanmu Family, right?"
"So many experts, terrifying..."
"The Sect Leader is all alone, is it really okay?"
A female disciple expressed deep concern, looking at Jiang Cheng’s lone figure in the sky, almost tearing up.
"Have faith in the Sect Leader, the Sect Leader is always resourceful and has never fought a battle without confidence."
Luo Yuan lectured the disciples in an old-fashioned manner.
Admiring the Sect Leader’s impressive demeanor on the spirit artifact screen, everyone agreed in unison.
With the show-off props ready, Brother Cheng finally began his formal performance.
His right hand raised the long sword high, while his left hand gripped the Tier Nine Spirit Talisman tightly, and he began to deliver a pre-battle declaration with righteousness.
This was being recorded, naturally, he needed to keep a solemn tone and ritualistic feeling.
"You all unjustly invade my Feixian Sect, running wild, even the heavens and people fume with anger..."
"I, Jiang Cheng! Today will act on behalf of the heavens, eliminating you for all innocent cultivators in Qinglan Prefecture!"
"You mice, swiftly meet your death!"
The frightened crowd below, for a moment, didn’t know what scheme he was plotting.
Pre-battle speeches were normal, usually to establish a righteous position for oneself.
The key was, why didn’t he say it before when he first arrived?
Such a sudden impassioned speech seemed quite abrupt.
Especially when he had just been assassinated once just now, and he didn’t even mention it, giving the impression as if he traveled back in time, back to a moment earlier.
However, their puzzlement quickly ended.
"Behold my World-destroying Sword!"
Jiang Cheng slashed his sword, and boundless spiritual power of the Spirit Platform Seventh Layer surged from the blade.
At the same time, the Divine-grade Spirit Platform emerged!
The overwhelming Sword Aura and spirit platform phenomenon intertwined, causing heaven and earth to change color.
Taking advantage of this opportunity, he threw the Spirit Talisman with his left hand.
He did this not out of worry that the Spirit Talisman wouldn’t explode on people, but so disciples watching the live stream from afar would see this as the Sect Leader’s sword might.
From such a distance, plus the cover of Sword Aura and Spirit Platform, they probably wouldn’t notice the Spirit Talisman, right?
Seeing him suddenly swing the sword, the crowd below was startled.
This Sword Aura’s might and Divine-grade Spirit Platform, even Master Jiuluo wouldn’t dare face it directly.
But anyway, they were many in numbers.
All were experts who had lived for hundreds of years, their reactions top-class.
Before the Sword Aura even descended, everyone dispersed simultaneously.
Some maneuvered to flank and attack mid-air, while others, suspicious and paranoid, chose to flee.
But all this was futile before the Tier Nine Spirit Talisman.
Boom!
The first explosion sound occurred, as Xuan Ci, who had been hidden with divine techniques and was the first to attack Jiang Cheng from behind, suddenly burst.
The explosion was from the inside out.
His internal organs instantly pulverized, followed by the explosion of bones and flesh, turning his entire being into an empty shell.
Swaying gently, he fell down.
Boom boom boom boom...
A countless number of explosions echoed continuously.
All the cultivators present, even Duanmu Zhe who had already fled dozens of miles away in an instant, were blown into empty shells.
This miraculous Tier Nine Destruction Rune, after exploding, didn’t significantly affect the surrounding terrain.
But none of the cultivators present survived.
Even Qi Cang and others hiding on a mountain peak over a hundred miles away were affected.
Pfft!
Qi Cang suddenly felt excruciating pain in his heart and lungs, uncontrollably spewing a mouthful of blood.
His entire demeanor wilted instantly.
He knew that his Sea of Qi was severely injured.
The injury was manageable; Eight Clouds Hall had plenty of Spirit Medicine, rest and recovery were possible, but this time even his cultivation foundation had been shaken.

chapters.title: Chapter 62: Tier 3 Skills
chapters.content:
Chapter 62: Chapter 62: Tier 3 Skills
If Jiang Cheng were to use Insight on Qi Cang now, he would find that his value had dropped from 7500 points to 5500 points.
Of the dozen or so people he brought, 7 spewed blood and died on the spot.
The best off was Lu Zhong, who was in the First Layer of Celestial Fate.
He only looked pale, but his condition wasn’t good either.
"It must be a Tier Nine Spirit Talisman, something we can’t resist!"
Jiang Cheng could hide it from the disciples, but not from Lu Zhong.
He knew well that it was solely the effect of that Spirit Talisman just now.
At this moment, he was still in fear.
Luckily, he was far away. If he were within a dozen miles, he might not have survived.
"We can’t stay here any longer!"
"Return to the Eight Clouds Hall quickly!"
This time, Qi Cang did not refute, and he even fled earlier than Lu Zhong.
Who knows how many Tier Nine Spirit Talismans Jiang Cheng might have?
As they fled, Jiang Cheng had already finished the "battle."
Honestly, among the more than five hundred enemies present, only two from the Soul Splitting Realm were slain by his Sword Aura; the others were all killed by the Tier Nine Spirit Talisman explosion.
"Alas, Heaven values life; as a Sect Leader, I really did not want to kill them all."
"But you forced me."
Still recording, he spoke with a strong sense of flamboyance.
As for the other side, the Feixian Sect was already in a festive atmosphere.
"We won!"
"The Sect Leader won!"
"The Sect Leader is amazing, wiping out the crowd with a single sword..."
"What crowd? They’re just a bunch of thieves, but the Sect Leader was truly Celestial Power descending!"
"Absolutely, I bet the Sect Leader is definitely an Immortal!"
"I finally understand how the Sect Leader wiped out those five sects."
"That Little Brain Axe boasted about itself, but with the Sect Leader’s prowess, does it even need to meddle?"
The Three-Eyed Tiger randomly chimed in: Meow meow meow?
"I thought I had guessed the Sect Leader’s limits, but I never imagined it was only the tip of the iceberg."
"Hahaha, I bet right! I previously bet that the Sect Leader only needs one move, and it turned out to be just one!"
Everyone praised in unison.
"Amazing, amazing, Junior Brother Qin, you understand the Sect Leader the best."
"Junior Brother Qin has keen insight!"
Junior Brother Qin, who had just casually echoed in agreement earlier, was now brimming with pride.
At this time, the transmission screen turned off.
It was time to collect spoils of war, and Brother Cheng felt it was necessary to maintain his image.
This harvest was greater than all the previous ones combined.
More than twenty Spirit Platform Realm cultivators present were all using Tier Six Spiritual Artifacts.
In addition to the Spirit Stone, Elixir, Talisman, Array in their rings, and some rare materials and Cultivation Technique Manuals, Jiang Cheng felt he was rich.
He even had a strange feeling that handing out Tier Four Spiritual Artifacts to the disciples last time felt like giving scraps to beggars.
Forget it, the points are more important.
After a thorough search and selection, he got over 230,000 points from these 500-plus people.
Adding the previous remaining twenty thousand, the points now exceeded 250,000.
"The spoils come in quickly!"
Jiang Cheng couldn’t help but marvel; if he practiced diligently and searched for treasures, made elixirs, and spiritual artifacts himself, who knows when he would gather 100,000 points.
"It’s been a long time since I did a lottery, and now I can finally splurge a bit."
The next level requires 1 million points; he couldn’t hold back.
He opened the Level 3 Lottery, with the main goal to draw a Tier Three Skill.
Whether it’s Transmission or anything else, it would suffice.
"Do you want to consume 100,000 points for a Level 3 Lottery?"
It’s too expensive!
Jiang Cheng silently complained while pressing the lottery button.
"Ding, congratulations to the host for drawing a Xuanji Map Fragment."
What kind of junk is this, just a picture, and it’s a fragment?
Brother Cheng nearly choked; this cost him 100,000 points!
It took him a lot of effort!
However, after reading the description under the Xuanji Map, he regained his smile.
"The Xuanji Map is a Taichu Treasure, self-contained space, self-contained rules. The time flow within this Xuanji Map Fragment is 1000 times slower than outside."
"The fragment’s space is unstable and can accommodate three people."
"Collect all fragments to obtain the complete Xuanji Map, forming an Immortal Mansion. All rules within the Immortal Mansion are controlled by the host."
Jiang Cheng didn’t know what the Immortal Mansion looked like, but he knew this map was incredible.
If he collected all of them, wouldn’t it be a small world of his own?
And even just this fragment was already quite useful.
Select three disciples to go inside and cultivate for a day, which equals 1000 days outside. Isn’t this like a Time House treasure?
He extracted the fragment and probed the inside.
He found that the space inside was vast, and his Divine Soul searched for a long time without finding the boundary. The fragment’s environment was extremely harsh, with volcanic eruptions everywhere and poison gas spreading, making it unsuitable for any living being to enter.
He spent a great deal of effort refining this fragment before calming the raging fragment space.
Although the volcano stopped erupting and the poison gas was gradually dissipating, cultivators below the Soul Splitting Realm could not survive inside.
The fragment does not currently produce Spiritual Qi automatically, so one has to bring their own Spirit Stone and Spirit Pill when entering.
"Let’s go again!"
Once you start this lottery thing, it’s hard to stop.
"Ding, congratulations to the host for drawing a Tier Three Alchemy Technique."
Damn it!
If the system had a physical form, Brother Cheng might have lifted it, thrown it to the ground, and stomped on it brutally.
This is indeed a Tier Three Skill.
But when he copied all of Yao Qiulin’s abilities initially, he had already become a Tier Three Alchemist; isn’t this redundant?
And it’s 100,000 points, just for this?
His angry roars echoed among the mountains, signaling his bleeding heart.
After a long time, calming down, he finally looked at that damned Tier Three Alchemy Technique.
Upon seeing it, he noticed the difference.
The system’s alchemy levels were different from this world’s.
In this world, becoming a Tier Three Alchemist meant being able to produce Third Grade Spirit Pill.
But as everyone knows, alchemy comes with a very high failure rate.
So the wastage of materials is quite severe as well.
However, here, a Tier One Alchemy Technique can produce Fifth-grade Spirit Pill.
A Tier Two Alchemy Technique can produce Ninth-grade Spirit Pill, equivalent to this world’s Tier Nine Alchemist.
A Tier Three Alchemy Technique produces Treasure Pills that surpass Spirit Pills.
In this world, alchemists of this tier are known as Grandmasters.
So, now he’s already an Alchemy Grandmaster.
Moreover, system alchemy doesn’t require any Pill Furnace or Anomalous Fire.
Put the materials in, synthesize them in the system’s alchemy interface, and with a ding, it’s done, with a 100% success rate.
Except, those Treasure Pills require self-provision of Heavenly and Earthly Treasures.
This...
Brother Cheng didn’t know what to say.
Alchemy skills are particularly useful when showing off.
And with high-tier elixirs, disciples can improve their cultivation faster.
Displaying the identity of an Alchemy Grandmaster seems prestigious everywhere.
The system treated him well!
After a sincere "it’s really good," he quickly chose to extract and learn.
Soon, his mind was filled with a vast amount of alchemy knowledge.
As if he had been immersed in Alchemy Dao for thousands of years, compared to this, Yao Qiulin’s prior alchemy experience was utterly insignificant.
"Alas, it’s a pity the materials are lacking; otherwise, this Grandmaster really wants to show off on the spot."
Two Level 3 Lotteries and 200,000 points gone, looking at the remaining 50,000 points.
Brother Cheng gritted his teeth, deciding to go for 5 more Level 2 Lotteries, to use it all up!

chapters.title: Chapter 63 Annihilation
chapters.content:
Chapter 63: Chapter 63 Annihilation
After five quick clicks, he laughed up at the sky.
"Hahaha, finally got a Level 2 Skill!"
Inside the warehouse, there lay a Level 2 Teleportation and a Level 2 Invisibility.
Level 2 Teleportation: Teleportation distance of 100,000 miles, twice daily.
The distance increased tenfold, following this pattern, the next level should be 1,000,000 miles, three times a day.
Since coming to this world, the most frustrating thing for Jiang Cheng was that this place was too vast.
Over ten thousand miles had become inconspicuous small places, traveling without a Transmission Array was only possible by flying, which was extremely troublesome.
He hadn’t drawn any Array Grandmaster skills yet and couldn’t create Transmission Arrays out of thin air.
This type of array involving Space Rules is currently only owned by the Eight Clouds Hall in the entire Feiyun State.
Moreover, it’s said that each teleportation burns a large amount of Spirit Stones, with significant consumption.
With Level 2 Teleportation, it’d be much more convenient.
However, at the moment, his mind was more captivated by the Level 2 Invisibility Skill.
Level 2 Invisibility: In non-combat situations, can hide in the void for 10 minutes, even a Saint Tier Divine Soul cannot detect. Being attacked or if the host’s spiritual power fluctuations are too intense, it will automatically disable invisibility. Limited to twice daily.
Unquestionably miraculous, and beyond the conventions of the Cultivation Realm.
With an Invisibility Skill, even a Body Tempering Realm cultivator could approach a Three-Eyed Tiger undetected.
Compared to this unreasonable forced invisibility, the black mist hiding technique used by Xuan Ci of the Blood Killing Valley before assassination was like a beginner’s trick in Newbie Village.
Is the system encouraging me to be an assassin?
But that’s not my aspiration.
I’m the man who aspires to be killed a billion times.
Is there any skill to forcibly attract hatred, making others want to kill me as if they saw their father’s killer?
