Aside from these two skills, the other three draws were materials, usable to refine Treasure Pills and Treasures.
Brother Cheng casually glanced at them and temporarily stored them in the System Space.
He hadn’t even thought that those three materials were extremely precious, impossible to find even across Feiyun State.
Looking at the few thousand points left, he felt like he’d gone from riches to rags in just a few minutes.
Couldn’t help but feel sorrowful, regretting incessantly, once again entering the sage mode after the thrill.
If only I’d saved up, could have upgraded the system sooner in the future!
Thinking about that battle just wiped out a large group of sect leaders and elders, their sects now leaderless, can’t let it go to waste.
He decisively clicked teleportation, heading towards the Duanmu Family.
The Duanmu Family wasn’t built like the Red Sun Sect’s Feixian Sect in the mountains, but occupied a vast city spanning a thousand miles.
Within this city, tens of millions of cultivators lived, of course, not all were Duanmu Family members.
The inner city at the city center was filled with grand palaces and pavilions, with red walls and green tiles, small bridges, flowing water, gardens with rare birds everywhere, a hundred times more luxurious than any palace city Jiang Cheng knew from his past life.
Seeing this spectacle, he couldn’t help but feel a bit sour.
In comparison, Feixian Sect looked like a rural village, quite shabby.
The children of the Duanmu Family mainly lived here, and the concentration of Spiritual Qi here was far superior to the outer city.
For the cultivators of the outer city, the inner city was a Holy City they could yearn for but not reach.
The only sense of superiority Jiang Cheng could feel was the Spiritual Qi concentration at Feixian Sect, this place ultimately couldn’t match the Spirit Vein modified by Ah Huang.
He certainly wouldn’t be crazy enough to kill everyone here, at least the millions in the outer city had nothing to do with him.
Flying into the inner city, he couldn’t be bothered to talk, and directly said,
"Everyone from the Duanmu Family, come out and die!"
This family wanted him dead, he wasn’t a saint, so he wouldn’t be polite.
This shout, infused with spiritual power, echoed inside and outside, and the people of the Duanmu Family rushed out in anger upon hearing it.
"Jiang Cheng!"
"Jiang Cheng, how are you here?"
The old man leading them, dignified without anger, was the Ninth Elder of the Duanmu Family, Duanmu Ling, with a Split Soul Ninth Layer cultivation he was left by Duanmu Zhe to guard the house.
At this time, they still did not know that the elite of the Duanmu Family who went to besiege Feixian Sect had been wiped out.
Seeing Jiang Cheng suddenly appear here, they were naturally very surprised.
This guy shouldn’t be besieged and exhausted at the end of the road over by Feixian Mountain, how does he have time to come to the Duanmu Family?
Jiang Cheng couldn’t be bothered to answer them, directly summoning his Divine-grade Spirit Platform, slashing with a sword.
This time he didn’t expect to be killed, because his power far exceeded these people.
It was completely like a tiger among sheep, especially after the first sword wiped out Duanmu Ling and over a dozen surrounding Split Soul Elders, the rest of the scene posed no threat to him.
Originally thought the Duanmu Family would be smart enough to activate the Great Array, but they seemed to have no one to command them and didn’t do it.
This counterattack didn’t last very long.
Though there wasn’t an opponent who could withstand a single blow, some managed to escape.
Without the invincible system plan, or the Three-Eyed Tiger’s overwhelming advantage several Great Realms higher, total extermination was unrealistic.
After this battle, the Duanmu Family was considered eradicated.
From now on, in Qinglan Prefecture, only Feixian Sect was left standing dominant.
After ransacking the Duanmu Family, and collecting the Spirit Vein, Jiang Cheng gained more than 50,000 points.
In the following three days, he proceeded to raid several neighboring prefectures, collecting the Spirit Veins and reserves of the sects that had attacked Feixian Sect.
As for the sects that hadn’t participated, he wouldn’t touch them.
After this, his points finally totaled 320,000 again.
Seeing these points, Brother Cheng felt full of contentment once more.
For a while, he was tempted to head to Eight Clouds Hall right away.
There was the shadow of Qi Cang behind this action, and he also blew himself up as the Young Master of Eight Clouds Hall, so naturally, Eight Clouds Hall was an enemy.
Destroying Eight Clouds Hall might even lead to leveling up, right?
The temptation was great, but in the end, Jiang Cheng restrained himself.
He hadn’t lost his head, even though he had three daily chances of not losing, the scale and foundation of Eight Clouds Hall were not of the same magnitude as other sects.
For such a gigantic sect, trying to wipe them out with Resurrection Skill alone would only work if, like the Extreme Moon Sect and Red Sun Sect, all their disciples were gathered together, standing in one place, to be wiped out in line.
Obviously, that was impossible.
As the overlord of Feiyun State, with over a dozen Celestial Fate experts, they wouldn’t possibly dispatch a vast force of tens of thousands over a Spirit Platform Cultivator storming their door.
The other side would likely just send a few Elders to brush him off, and by that time, the system’s solution would only be to wipe out those few Elders in front of him.
Then when they see his prowess, they’d send the next batch of experts, who’d also be slain by his resurrection.
Such a self-satisfied oil-dripping tactic never considering their opponent would give free experience, but what Jiang Cheng feared most was precisely this.
A few more times, and once the resurrection attempts were used up, it’d be him who would die.
And the most important point, Celestial Fate is a whole Great Realm higher, the strength gap is too significant, they have the ability to restrain him.
If caught and not killed, it’d be truly troublesome.
After some thought, he ultimately decided to return to Feixian Sect first.
Since Qi Cang had his eye on him, failing twice already, surely he wouldn’t stop there.
He’d find a way to deal with himself.
Jiang Cheng was looking forward to what new moves this Young Master of Eight Clouds Hall would use to deliver himself.

chapters.title: Chapter 64: The Hardworking Qi Cang
chapters.content:
Chapter 64: Chapter 64: The Hardworking Qi Cang
Returning to Feixian Sect, after a solid round of flattery, Jiang Cheng distributed the various sects’ classics collected from this raid.
The range of cultivation techniques this time was varied, finally freeing them from solely practicing Red Sun Sect’s techniques like before.
Afterward, he summoned Ji Linghan and Yin Xuer.
The time flow within the Xuanji Map Fragment is a thousand times faster than the outside world.
One day outside is equivalent to a thousand days inside.
This is clearly a divine artifact for fast-track cultivation. Currently, the disciples’ cultivation is too low, hardly impressive compared to sects like the Eight Clouds Hall.
The method Jiang Cheng thought of is to let them enter for cultivation, rapidly increasing their power.
As they level up, he can also earn point rewards, why not?
However, the environment inside the fragment is too harsh to survive unless one is in the Soul Splitting Realm.
And currently, the only disciples in the Soul Splitting Realm in Feixian Sect are Ji Linghan and Yin Xuer.
Seeing the two girls called separately, the fire of gossip among the disciples burned fiercely.
"As expected, the Sect Leader favors Senior Sister Ji and Senior Sister Yin the most, probably going to confess to them!"
"Who do you think the Sect Leader will choose?"
"Are you stupid? A figure as gallant and extraordinary as the Sect Leader, of course, he will take both!"
"True, it seems Lin Ning has no hope."
"I also thought Lin Ning was a strong competitor, but it seems... the Sect Leader values figure more."
"Lin Ning’s disadvantage is her young age."
Hearing everyone’s discussion, Lin Ning’s heart broke, her pained gaze at Brother Cheng like looking at an unfaithful heartbreaker.
This made Brother Cheng feel very wronged; nothing happened between us, girl.
To clear his name, he could only explain the effect of the Xuanji Map in public.
Of course, to show off, he shamelessly claimed the Xuanji Map’s space was the Xuanji Dojo he created with his divine techniques.
For a moment, the disciples were both shocked, envious, and admiring.
"Such divine techniques exist!"
"The Sect Leader is truly immortal, confirmed!"
"Manipulating time flow, such an ability unheard of, too amazing!"
"If you practice inside for a year, wouldn’t it be like a thousand years?"
"Sect Leader, could you also set up something like this for your most loyal disciple Gan Ziyi?"
"Didn’t the Sect Leader just say? The dojo created by his Heaven and Earth Creation Divine Techniques is unstable, and below Soul Splitting Realm, survival is not feasible."
"Besides, the most loyal lapdog to the Sect Leader has always been me, Shan Tai. When did it become Junior Brother Gan’s turn?"
"Ah, I’m just one step away from the Soul Splitting Realm, what a pity." Luo Yuan slapped his thigh.
Lin Ning was also relieved, turned out to be for cultivation.
Almost thought the Sect Leader made a decision, and she was completely out.
She glanced at Elder Luo Yuan of the Gathering Essence Ninth Layer, secretly determined to challenge!
She also heard, that ’dojo’ could only accommodate three people now, and must wait for the Sect Leader’s divine techniques to advance to accommodate more.
The next ticket must be hers!
Ji Linghan and Yin Xuer were both thrilled yet disappointed.
Thrilled because of the time flow 1000 times faster, as cultivators, few wouldn’t want to enhance their power early.
As for the disappointment...
After countless inner battles in a short period, having decided with difficulty to accept serving one husband together with Senior Sister Ji, yet you tell me, I overthought it?
"Happy?"
"Surprised?"
Brother Cheng was still fishing for compliments.
Ji Linghan and Yin Xuer could only show joy, nodding repeatedly.
"Truly happy."
"Very surprised!"
But inside thinking, once they enter and are isolated, wouldn’t it be a long time without seeing the Sect Leader?
"Then prepare to head in early!"
Next, he gave each of the two girls a ring, filled with the top-grade spirit stones and fifth-grade pills collected this time.
Refining pills and absorbing spirit stones requires time for transformation.
The pills and spirit stones in the rings were enough for the two girls to last two to three hundred years.
He also worried about accidents, since only he could control entrance and exit from the Xuanji Map.
If anything happened to him, and he couldn’t release them in time, it would be troublesome.
With everything ready, he performed a spell in a pretentious manner, transforming the two girls into two streaks of red light, drawing them into the map.
Jiang Cheng immediately transferred the two into a stable area he’d created, then advised them to cultivate well.
"Alright, alright, disperse now."
"All of you better focus on cultivation, look at your skills, thinking about idle things all day."
"When will you reach Spirit Platform Realm or Celestial Fate Realm?"
"Does Feixian Sect’s prestige rely solely on me?"
Obviously just for points, yet the Sect Leader’s authoritative demeanor was intimidating.
Luo Yuan, Shan Tai, and others were rebuked like grandchildren, and quickly escaped to their respective cave mansions with disciples.
While things calmed down on Feixian Sect’s side, on the other side, Eight Clouds Hall was not at peace.
As expected, after two failures, how could Qi Cang let it rest?
Every day, his head is filled with one thing, how to put Jiang Cheng to death.
If Jiang Cheng knew how hard he was trying, he would surely be very moved.
To satisfy his desire to be killed, this guy could be described as exhausting all his efforts.
"Jiang Cheng’s true power is at most Spirit Platform Realm invincible, which is still due to that divine-grade Spirit Platform bringing it."
"Without the divine-grade Spirit Platform, he’s not even on par with you, Young Master!"
Lu Zhong calmly analyzed.
He was a professional, Qi Cang believed in his judgment.
"But who in Eight Clouds Hall can withstand his Tier Nine Spirit Talisman?"
Eight Clouds Hall has over ten Celestial Fate Realm experts, and tier seven spiritual artifacts, even two tier eight ones, all formidable weapons.
But a Tier Nine Spirit Talisman equates to a full-force strike from a Daoist Palace Realm expert.
That power...
No one in Eight Clouds Hall dared claim they could survive.
They didn’t know Jiang Cheng only had one talisman at the time, thinking he had a pile.
"His fortunes are too excessive, even having Tier Nine Spirit Talisman, how unfair the heavens are!"
In his anger, Qi Cang crushed the armrest of his chair into powder.
The Tier Nine Spirit Talisman first brought him fear, now back at Eight Clouds Hall, it turned into greed.
If everything in that ring belonged to him...
He’d heard of the news about Duanmu Family and several sects being completely destroyed by Jiang Cheng, but he simply didn’t care.
A few tougher ants, dead means dead.
"We must find a way to kill him, and take his ring and everything in it by grabbing!"
Lu Zhong frowned and shook his head, "This is easier said than done, even at the Celestial Fate Realm, there’s no guarantee to prevent him from pulling out talismans from his ring before his demise."
The opportunity of a Tier Nine Spirit Talisman, even he couldn’t remain composed.
Qi Cang pondered for a long time, suddenly getting an idea.
"I’ve got it!"
"You’ve thought of a way?"
"Indeed, a month from now is the 43,500th anniversary of founding Eight Clouds Hall, we can use this as a reason to invite him over."
In Qi Cang’s view, since he hasn’t had a direct conflict with Jiang Cheng, and even said he would support them last time, he shouldn’t be exposed yet.
Perhaps, Jiang Cheng still considers him one of his own.
This kind of invitation, he would surely be unguarded.
Lu Zhong also caught on.
"You mean, lure him to our territory, win him over first, then find a chance to seize the ring with the talismans?"
"Exactly, there will be plenty of opportunities then!"
Qi Cang clenched his fist, his expression slightly twisted from excitement.
"Once we secure that ring, he’s just fish on the chopping board, ready for us to cut!"

chapters.title: Chapter 65 Consecutive Upgrades
chapters.content:
Chapter 65: Chapter 65 Consecutive Upgrades
A thousand miles away from Qi Cang’s palace, there lies a vast, shimmering lake.
On the lakeside stands a skillfully crafted bamboo house.
Surrounded by mountains, their reflections in the lake blend the water and sky, adding an air of exquisite beauty.
A young man with long hair draping over his shoulders, dressed in a white robe, is leisurely fishing.
His appearance is handsome, yet he seems shrouded in a mist.
As if once you leave, you’ll forget what he looks like.
"Are you saying that recently Qi Cang’s plan for the Five Mansions to attack Feixian Sect is because Sect Leader Jiang Cheng has a remarkable opportunity?"
The young man slowly stood up, his spotless white robe cascading down like gentle waves.
"Yes!"
There was no one else visible nearby; the voice seemed to appear out of thin air.
"Tier Nine Spirit Talisman?"
"Yes!"
"Interesting."
The young man’s thin lips curled slightly.
"Qi Cang intends to seize Jiang Cheng’s ring during the grand ceremony?"
"Yes!"
"This so-called Young Master can sometimes really create some surprises, can’t he? This time, I actually need to thank him for the opportunity."
The young man’s smile took on a slightly mocking tone.
The person in the shadows deeply agreed.
Qi Cang, with a Spirit Platform Eighth Layer cultivation and as the Palace Master’s son, certainly has impressive conditions, but compared to the person before him, falls short.
Feixian Sect’s top true disciple Ling Yi, whose cultivation reached the Celestial Fate First Layer, equivalent to that of a council elder.
In terms of talent, Qi Cang is far behind him by more than a notch.
In terms of influence, Ling Yi already has five out of sixteen council elders from Eight Clouds Hall backing him.
Among the true disciples, half now follow him.
Qi Cang simply cannot compete with him.
This is also why the person in the shadows, although ostensibly serving Qi Cang, chose to secretly pledge allegiance to Ling Yi.
It’s normal to prepare in advance for the next Palace Master, isn’t it?
After the person in the shadows left, Ling Yi called upon a trusted aide to invite the Great Elder of Eight Clouds Hall.
For this planned seizure, he requires cooperation because he wants it to be foolproof!
Qi Cang’s efforts ultimately amount to just serving him.
As for Jiang Cheng, his biggest mistake was obtaining an opportunity he shouldn’t have.
In Ling Yi’s eyes, Jiang Cheng is already a dead man.
Meanwhile, over at the Feixian Sect, they indeed received an invitation from the Eight Clouds Hall.
Although they had recruited a batch of disciples, the sect’s total population hadn’t reached a hundred, usually remaining quite deserted.
It’s rare for outsiders to visit, so all the disciples rushed to see the commotion.
The one who came to invite Jiang Cheng was Lu Zhong himself.
As a Celestial Fate First Layer expert, he lowered himself to act as a messenger purely for the sake of the Tier Nine Spirit Talisman.
"You want me to attend your creation ceremony of however many hundreds of thousands of years?"
"Forty-three thousand five hundred years!" Lu Zhong earnestly repeated.
"Well, your sect really has endured long."
Lu Zhong was speechless...
Jiang Cheng was very clear in his mind about the situation; this invitation was the opponent’s move.
What are they planning?
To lure him into the core of Eight Clouds Hall and eliminate him?
Having confirmed that Eight Clouds Hall was indeed targeting him, their intention was fairly easy to guess.
To go or not to go?
In a place teeming with experts, would three resurrections be enough?
However, being invited does offer one advantage, which is direct access to the opponent’s core, facing all their top-tier experts.
This presents an opportunity to wipe them out in one fell swoop.
Thinking of the potential points for destroying Eight Clouds Hall, Brother Cheng was eager to act.
Eventually, he decided to go.
"All right, I accept."
So easily trapped?
The reason he personally came to invite was because he feared Jiang Cheng would refuse, having prepared a slew of reasons.
Lu Zhong was secretly pleased and disdainful.
This young man is utterly clueless; surviving until now is truly a divine blessing.
"This is our sect’s invitation; Sect Leader Jiang can use this Jade Talisman as a token to attend the ceremony!"
"Everyone in Eight Clouds Hall eagerly awaits!"
With those words, he hurriedly left.
Jiang Cheng was fiddling with the jade talisman invitation, while the disciples crowded around.
"Wow, Eight Clouds Hall actually invited Sect Leader to be a guest; it’s truly a miracle!"
"Yeah, that’s Eight Clouds Hall we’re talking about, even sects like Red Sun Sect and Duanmu Family never qualified to enter their gates."
"The Sect Leader’s King’s Dominating Aura couldn’t go unnoticed by Eight Clouds Hall, could it?"
"Exactly, being able to invite our Sect Leader is their honor."
Brother Cheng was speechless; you all are the ones with the ’King’s Dominating Aura.’
These disciples are so worrisome; they don’t even know Eight Clouds Hall has been dealing with Feixian Sect for a long time.
They think this is an honor.
But he’s too lazy to explain.
It’s not that he doesn’t trust them, but telling them wouldn’t help anyway.
Though their cultivation speed is fast, they’re still too far away from Eight Clouds Hall’s level.
Time flew by, and the month quickly passed.
During this period, Jiang Cheng was nearly bored out of his mind, he could only cultivate.
With the Celestial Desolation Indestructible Body combined with the Divine-grade Spirit Platform, plus the aid of Feixian Mountain’s spirit veins and various spirit pills, he broke through two levels in just ten days, reaching Spirit Platform Ninth Layer.
The next dozen days were spent intensely focusing on breaking through the Celestial Fate Realm’s barrier, and he finally succeeded, reaching Celestial Fate First Layer.
Now his Spirit Platform has turned into a Divine Mansion, its power ten times stronger than before.
And most importantly, upon progressing to the Divine Mansion, a radiant mansion formed, the most formidable type.
On the day of advancement, phenomena descended from the heavens, vibrant and colorful, enveloped by auspicious clouds, lasting a whole quarter hour.
As a result, the disciples gathered again to watch, thinking Brother Cheng was going to ascend.
Of course, Jiang Cheng didn’t tell them he had only reached Celestial Fate First Layer, casually making up that their sect leader was practicing a divine technique before releasing Ji Linghan and Yin Xuer from the Xuanji Map.
The two girls had been cultivating for one month, which equated to a thousand months within the Xuanji Map, totaling eighty-three years.
Upon emerging, their cultivation had transformed.
Ji Linghan rocketed from Soul Splitting Second Layer to Spirit Platform Ninth Layer.
If not for the difficult barrier of the Celestial Fate Realm, she might have surpassed Jiang Cheng already.
Yin Xuer, having slightly weaker talent, progressed from Soul Splitting Ninth Layer to Spirit Platform Fourth Layer, once again surpassed by Ji Linghan.
Looking at their exhausted and bewildered expressions, along with their worn-out appearances, Brother Cheng felt no envy.
Having to stay in Xuanji Map for more than eighty years, facing barren scenes daily without any entertainment, apart from cultivating, might as well be a death sentence.
He wouldn’t last even eighty days!
Checking the system records, he noted that the girls’ upgrades, being self-cultivation, earned him point rewards.
Especially with Ji Linghan, after entering Soul Splitting Realm, he gained 3000 points for each small realm elevated.
Upon reaching Spirit Platform Realm, each small realm advanced garnered 30,000 points.
This time, her rapid progression brought a total of 291,000 points.
Almost equaling the destruction of several sects similar to Red Sun Sect.
In Brother Cheng’s eyes, this girl is indeed a supreme treasure.
However, this too is due to her remarkable talent.
Like Yin Xuer, whose talent pales compared to Ji Linghan’s Seven-Aperture Exquisite Body, holds little value to the system. Even though progressing through Spirit Platform Realm, each small realm only earns 500 points.
This contrasts starkly with Ji Linghan’s 30,000—it’s 60 times less, so after investing so many Spirit Stones and Elixirs, it ended up being just a small profit.

chapters.title: Chapter 66 Next Time Not Necessarily
chapters.content:
Chapter 66: Chapter 66 Next Time Not Necessarily
Currently in the Feixian Sect, disciples as "valuable" as Ji Linghan include Lin Ning.
The rest generally have talent levels similar to Yin Xuer, not much difference.
Jiang Cheng also knows that such talent as Ji Linghan and Lin Ning is rare and hard to find.
Without any effort, he inexplicably received two, like starting the game by drawing two SSR cards, utterly lucky.
But they also need a system’s ding for verification to confirm their loyalty to him, otherwise no points are gained.
After not seeing each other for a month, the other disciples gathered around to ask about their well-being.
Upon learning of their realm levels, there was a collective wail among the crowd.
Luo Yuan was about to cling to Brother Cheng’s leg and throw a tantrum.
"Are you trying to make life impossible? Can we even have fun anymore?"
"Sect Leader, you can’t forget about me, right?"
Previously, Yin Xuer was slightly weaker than him, but now she quietly worked her way up to Soul Splitting First Layer, while she is already Spirit Platform Fourth Layer.
The two are almost in different planes.
This left Jiang Cheng a bit embarrassed; in fact, when he promoted one Great Realm back then, he almost chose him.
If he had, the one wailing now would have been Yin Xuer.
"Senior Sister Ji, what grade is your Spirit Platform now?"
Now the two girls were surrounded and crowded.
"Immortal Grade."
Upon reaching the Spirit Platform Realm, Ji Linghan’s temperament became even more Dustless.
Every smile and frown carried a unique charm, captivating everyone’s hearts and souls.
Among the crowd, there was another wave of astonishment.
"An Immortal Grade Spirit Platform, second only to the Sect Leader’s Divine Grade!"
"Yes, yes, probably the first in Feiyun State?"
Even Jiang Cheng couldn’t help but marvel, her talent is truly extraordinary.
Such an unparalleled genius unexpectedly wasn’t discovered by those top Holy Land Dynasties and instead joined a small place like the Feixian Sect, clearly showing this world’s talent discovery mechanism is lagging behind.
"Senior Sister Ji is now more powerful than Master Jiuluo, unbelievable."
"It’s been only two months since our sect was wiped out, and this change feels like a dream."
"The Sect Leader must have been sent by the heavens to save us!"
"The Sect Leader’s divine techniques are so powerful, not only can they promote one Great Realm, but also open a dojo with 1000 times temporal acceleration..."
When they mentioned promoting one Great Realm, Jiang Cheng recalled the decision he made secretly last time.
Next time, definitely help Ji Linghan advance one Great Realm.
But...
Back then, Ji Linghan was Soul Splitting Realm, advancing to Spirit Platform Realm only cost 30,000 points.
Now she has reached Spirit Platform Ninth Layer, advancing to Celestial Fate Ninth Layer would increase the cost tenfold.
300,000...
Jiang Cheng gritted his teeth and could still accept it.
The key is that once Ji Linghan advances to Celestial Fate Ninth Layer, her realm will surpass his as Sect Leader.
By then, with a casual sweep of her divine thought, Jiang Cheng’s true power would be laid bare.
"Oh, you’re only Celestial Fate First Layer?"
"Ha, such an adorable and mischievous little Sect Leader..."
Wouldn’t she no longer admire him?
For Brother Cheng, who has a strong sense of vanity, this would be the most fatal blow.
Especially at the thought of the scene he imagined, where Ji Linghan would look down at him with playful, teasing eyes, he found it unacceptable.
Better let her upgrade on her own, you get reward points for cultivation too.
According to the current pattern, advancing to Celestial Fate Realm gives her 300,000 points for each small realm she advances.
It’s a waste not to take advantage of it!
His gaze was sensed by Ji Linghan, surrounded by the crowd, who also turned back to look at him.
When their eyes met, the pool-like eyes not only showed gratitude but also a deep longing.
Finally, that spring of tears burst forth...
Indeed, for her, it was actually eight decades of separation.
That tearful gaze made Jiang Cheng reluctant to look away.
"Sorry, sis, next time definitely" actually means "next time, maybe not."
"Sect Leader, is it my turn to go in this time?"
Lin Ning was not pleased; she felt very dissatisfied.
The Sect Leader clearly knew about her bet with Ji Linghan, yet now he was "deliberately" widening the gap between them. When would she ever surpass that temporary master?
It was obviously favoritism!
This month she cultivated like crazy, sleepless and restless, and finally she advanced to Soul Splitting First Layer half an hour earlier than Luo Yuan.
Now, she was also qualified to enter the Xuanji Map for cultivation.
"Of course!"
Jiang Cheng was more than happy to fulfill her request.
When Lin Ning advanced to Soul Splitting First Layer, the system rewarded 5000 points, while for Ji Linghan at this realm it was still 3000 points.
This meant her Hidden Phoenix Bloodline was actually deemed more "valuable" by the system than Ji Linghan’s talent.
Advancing to Spirit Platform Realm would reward 50,000 points.
"Sect Leader, there’s still me, there’s still me!"
Luo Yuan eagerly came over, seeing Yin Xuer’s current realm, his eyes turned red.
"No problem."
With one spot left of the three, he looked towards Ji Linghan and Yin Xuer.
Both girls simultaneously shook their heads.
"I need to consolidate and sort out my realm, I’ll go in later."
Though she said this outwardly, Ji Linghan thought, wouldn’t going in again mean separating from the Sect Leader for another hundred years?
At least, she wanted to spend more time with him first.
As for Yin Xuer, she was even more fearful.
"I don’t want to go back in there, I was inside for 83 years, almost went crazy!"
Neither of them wanted to go back in for a while; the other disciples were eager, but their realms hadn’t reached Soul Splitting Realm and didn’t qualify.
With the principle of not wasting a spot, Brother Cheng decided to promote another disciple.
"Shan Tai, I heard you’ve always prided yourself on being my most loyal disciple?"
"Ah?"
Shan Tai was momentarily confused by the Sect Leader’s intent, did he mean to praise him or criticize him for being too sycophantic?
"Your loyalty deserves commendation, and since there’s still a spot available for entering the Xuanji Dojo, this Sect Leader decided to use an immortal technique to advance your realm once!"
It’s necessary to come up with a reason for advancing realms.
What? It’s my turn so soon?
Not Senior Sister Ji, nor Senior Brother Luo, but me, Shan Tai?
So my flattery was always remembered by the Sect Leader?
"Thank you, Sect Leader, thank you! I will certainly continue my efforts and flatter in a more refined manner..."
Which cultivator doesn’t want their power to rise rapidly? Shan Tai was so excited he cried tears of joy, almost having a seizure on the spot.
Jiang Cheng didn’t dawdle, he simply patted his head.
Activating the system upgrade skill in secret, a light descended, and Shan Tai went from Gathering Yuan Eighth Layer to Soul Splitting Eighth Layer.
The other disciples were green with envy.
Why him?
Shan Tai’s talent isn’t even top-notch in the sect.
Just because he flatters the most diligently?
If only I’d known, I’d have done more of it myself.
This time Ji Linghan and Lin Ning were quite composed, having seen a promotion before.
Moreover, Shan Tai wasn’t a beauty like Yin Xuer, so the two of them didn’t feel any sense of competition for favor, nor any disappointment.

chapters.title: Chapter 67: Rubbing Without Entering
chapters.content:
Chapter 67: Chapter 67: Rubbing Without Entering
"Junior Brother Shan, the Sect Leader’s Immortal Technique requires a significant cost. Once you go in, you must cultivate diligently and not let the Sect Leader down!"
Shan Tai, initially full of exuberance because of his advancement in Realm, almost had his tail wagging up to the sky.
Upon hearing Ji Linghan’s reminder, his expression turned serious, and he solemnly said, "I will heed Senior Sister’s teachings and certainly won’t let the Sect Leader’s sacrifice go in vain!"
Brother Cheng was speechless, "I haven’t sacrificed anything, I’m standing here perfectly fine, aren’t I?"
The reason for choosing you over Luo Yuan or Lin Ning is mainly because your Realm is low and the price is cheap; just 3000 points to level up.
But seeing the effect is quite good, he couldn’t be bothered to say anything more.
Once the three Soul Splitting Realm disciples had prepared all necessary resources, he quickly arranged for them to enter the Xuanji Map Fragment.
"Alright, this Sect Leader is going to visit Eight Clouds Hall, so stay and look after the house!"
"Huh? The Sect Leader is going where?"
Ji Linghan had just come out and wasn’t clear on what was happening.
After some explanation from the disciples, she realized Jiang Cheng was going to Eight Clouds Hall.
It’s been over eighty years since they last met, and now they have to part again?
"Sect Leader, may I go with you?"
She was hoping to spend more time with Jiang Cheng.
"I want to go too!"
Yin Xuer was not willing to fall behind.
Jiang Cheng, on the other hand, thought how romantic it would be to travel with beautiful women.
But this trip to Eight Clouds Hall was clearly a trap.
He was definitely going to die, possibly more than once.
He didn’t want them to be killed in the chaos, as that would be truly irreversible.
In the end, he could only painfully refuse with style.
"Why do you think I improved your cultivation?"
This question left the two women at a loss, not knowing how to answer.
"It’s so you can better defend our home!"
"Understand?"
Our home?
My and his home?
Both women were lost in thought, feeling as though they had received a grand mission, and immediately decided to defend the home to their death.
Even though there was actually the double insurance of Ah Huang and the Three-Eyed Tiger here.
A day later, Jiang Cheng entered the territory of the Eight Clouds Hall.
This operation was quite dangerous, and even though he had the chance to teleport twice daily for traveling, he still chose to fly honestly.
No choice, to be on the safe side.
Speaking of which, eliminating Eight Clouds Hall would be easy for the Feixian Sect if the Three-Eyed Tiger was willing to step in, not even breaking a sweat.
But the issue is, Brother Cheng had seen through that tiger’s heart and mind.
There’s no need to guess; it definitely wouldn’t be willing to help, and would rather mock sarcastically.
"Alas, the Dao of Cultivation ultimately still requires one to be down to earth; everything has to rely on oneself!"
Before entering the mountain gate, he was inspired and said a wise saying that could be struck by lightning.
If this is considered being down to earth, then what are others?
On the day of the celebration, outside the magnificent mountain gate, Spirit Beast Flying Vehicles came and went without end.
From time to time, guests would arrive and be warmly escorted inside.
Given the strength and status of Eight Clouds Hall, those invited this time were either Celestial Fate level experts or Level 7 and above Alchemy and Artifact Refining Masters.
Among these, the only one worthy of Great Elder Xu Yuancan personally greeting was the Eldest Prince Xiang Ba from the Qianxing Dynasty.
The nation within the cultivation realm, in fact, only managed mortal citizens and some loose cultivators, not having much constraint over the many cultivation sects within its territory.
Cultivation sects generally have no interest in competing with secular royal power; they only strive for cultivation resources. Eight Clouds Hall and the Qianxing Dynasty have little conflict of interest or interaction.
However, the area controlled by the Qianxing Dynasty is overwhelmingly vast, spanning several million miles.
The advantage of abundant resources and the number of talents are displayed, with their power still surpassing Eight Clouds Hall.
Just a single Blood Radiance Army composed entirely of Spirit Platform Realm cultivators, numbering as many as a hundred thousand, could annihilate Eight Clouds Hall several times over.
Furthermore, the Xiang Family is an Ancient Cultivation Family with profound heritage and numerous experts.
The Eldest Prince Xiang Ba had already reached Celestial Fate Ninth Layer, far surpassing Qi Yuansheng, not to mention the highest ruler of the dynasty.
His arrival surprised even the envoys from neighboring states.
It seems that Eight Clouds Hall is a key target for the Eldest Prince’s allegiance; otherwise, he wouldn’t deign to come in person.
"Halt, who goes there?"
Just as Brother Cheng was about to enter the mountain gate, he was stopped by the Outer Sect Elder responsible for greeting guests.
The guests invited this time, were either famous top talents from various states or the older generation with a millennium of reputation.
Even without Jade Talisman Invitations, he would recognize them.
But Jiang Cheng was just too unfamiliar.
Even though Brother Cheng had flattened Qinglan Prefecture, expanding to the Feiyun State hadn’t really made any waves.
"I am the Sect Leader of Feixian Sect!"
He puffed up his chest and handed over the Jade Talisman Invitation.
"Feixian Sect?"
The Outer Sect Elder searched through his memory carefully, having no impression.
No way, he’d heard of the Duanmu Family and the Red Sun Sect. As for Feixian Sect, their previous status was just too low.
But upon seeing the Jade Talisman Invitation, it was authentic.
Maybe it’s some junior picked up by a sect elder while traveling outside.
"You wait here!"
"Why wait?"
Your mountain gate is wide enough for tens of thousands to walk side by side, isn’t it?
Have to line up or what?
The Outer Sect Elder said expressionlessly, "Don’t you see the Great Elder is conversing with the Honored Guest?"
What?
They’re having their conversation, what’s it got to do with me?
Jiang Cheng looked over at Xu Yuancan and Xiang Ba; both sides were chatting below the mountain gate, exchanging formalities without knowing how long it would take.
Looking at the grand gathering over there, he could guess they must have significant backgrounds.
Is this implying that my status isn’t high enough to spoil the mood of the big shots?
Brother Cheng was instantly quite displeased.
Oh, you’ve set a plot trap to lure me here, and I’m already cooperating by coming over.
Isn’t this enough to repay your good intentions?
Now, still want me to obediently be a foil for your honored guests?
Don’t I deserve any face?
"Fine, goodbye then!"
After saying so, he waved his hand, decisively turning away.
The Outer Sect Elder was also taken aback; what’s this person’s situation?
Just a Sect Leader from a small sect, should be grateful to be able to enter Eight Clouds Hall.
What, waiting a bit makes you feel aggrieved? You think you’re being looked down on?
Do you think you deserve it?
"Not seeing you off!"
Watching Jiang Cheng’s distant figure, he disdainfully smirked, not taking it seriously.
"Wait!"
"Sect Leader Jiang... hold on!"
Lu Zhong, who had been waiting near the mountain gate, got anxious and couldn’t hide any longer.
He had cleared all secular matters early that morning, concentrating on waiting for Jiang Cheng’s arrival at the mountain gate.
Not only that, he sent other disciples to wait at several other entrances.
Having waited all morning, he could hardly contain his anticipation.
What if that kid doesn’t show up at the last minute?
What if he forgets today is the big celebration day?
Jiang Cheng is too important to them, and he was still worried.
Upon seeing that familiar figure finally appearing at the mountain gate, Lu Zhong almost couldn’t resist breaking into song to celebrate.
You’ve finally come; our plot’s plan has been rehearsed for so many days, just waiting for you, the main character, to fall into the net.
But then Jiang Cheng lingered at the mountain gate and instead turned around and left.
What’s going on?

chapters.title: Chapter 68 Lu Zhong in Trouble
chapters.content:
Chapter 68: Chapter 68 Lu Zhong in Trouble
Brother Cheng was not walking fast, and Lu Zhong quickly intercepted him.
"Sect Leader Jiang, why pass by without entering? Could it be that our hospitality has been lacking?"
He glanced at the storage ring on Jiang Cheng’s finger, identical to the one used the other day to fetch the Tier Nine Spirit Talisman; there was no mistake.
The treasure inheritance was right before his eyes. As long as they could trick him inside and stage a design, all those things could belong to him!
He couldn’t let the cooked duck fly away.
Truth be told, Jiang Cheng wasn’t planning to leave either.
Qi Cang and Lu Zhong wanted to seize his storage ring and all his opportunities, but he also saw Eight Clouds Hall as a massive heap of points.
It’s just that, if you plan to harm me with your designs, you ought to show some sincerity.
To spare not even the highest form of reception, what kind of scheming are you trying to play?
No sense of propriety!
He deliberately sneered coldly, "Lacking hospitality? I wouldn’t dare associate with your Eight Clouds Hall, farewell, farewell!"
Lu Zhong could see he was pretending, but the plan hadn’t succeeded yet, so he had to lower his voice and speak kindly.
"Sect Leader Jiang, what do you mean by this? You are, after all, our most important honored guest..."
Brother Cheng flipped his eyelids, "Most important, really? Just now your people wanted me to wait for others, is that the treatment for the most important honored guest?"
"What? Such a thing happened?"
Lu Zhong was so furious his liver hurt.
On one hand, he was angry at Jiang Cheng; you brat are just a sect leader of a small sect, being able to enter is good enough, and now you’re flaunting?
On the other hand, he was angry at that outer sect elder; why are you meddling?
The sect gate is wide enough, let him secretly follow in without drawing attention, why did you have to stop him?
He gestured to call that outer sect elder over with a transmission.
"Elder Lu, what is your command, could this perhaps be your old friend?"
This outer sect elder, although not high in position, was quick-witted. Seeing Lu Zhong standing beside Jiang Cheng, he immediately guessed he might’ve done something wrong.
But it was already too late.
Before he could make any clever argument, Lu Zhong slapped him heavily.
Pow!
The slap made the elder dizzy, and he collapsed to the ground right then.
"Blind as a bat, is Sect Leader Jiang someone you can stop?"
"How dare you make Sect Leader Jiang wait outside, do you want to die?"
The elder was struck dumb, but dared not say another word, only bowing repeatedly.
Lu Zhong was one of the dozen council elders, an important figure in the core power circle of Eight Clouds Hall.
He was just one of the thousands of ordinary outer sect elders, vastly differing in position and power, and couldn’t match up.
With a beaming smile, Lu Zhong continued, "Is Sect Leader Jiang satisfied now?"
Jiang Cheng was speechless; he knew this was staged for him to see. He criticized internally: Are these great sects really so devoid of human kindness?
Looking at it this way, Brother Cheng, who cares for his disciples, is truly a breath of fresh air.
He couldn’t help but feel a bit proud.
"Well, lead the way."
Lu Zhong’s forced smile almost froze; this brat was pushing his luck, using him like a guide servant?
But there was no other choice, for the ring, and for the opportunity, he had to endure!
"Sect Leader Jiang, please this way!"
The two quickly returned to the sect gate.
Great Elder Xu Yuancan and Eldest Prince Xiang Ba had finished their pleasantries and were about to enter. Lu Zhong and Jiang Cheng’s earlier commotion was distant enough not to attract their attention.
Lu Zhong didn’t want any more surprises, so he tried to sneak Jiang Cheng in from the side.
But who would’ve thought, Jiang Cheng stopped again.
Lu Zhong had to endure, lowering his voice as he turned back to complain, "Sect Leader Jiang, what’s wrong now?"
"Am I the most important honored guest?"
"Of course..."
Lu Zhong admitted with words but thought to himself, once you become fish on the chopping block, you’ll know just how ’important’ you really are.
Jiang Cheng glanced at Xiang Ba’s side, unsatisfied, "If I’m the most important, then why are they walking in the center while I have to walk on the side?"
You!
Lu Zhong almost wanted to point at him and curse furiously.
Then said dismissively, you actually took it seriously that you were the most important?
Are you worthy to compare with Qianxing Dynasty’s Eldest Prince who has reached Celestial Fate Ninth Layer?
Letting you enter with him is already high enough treatment, okay?
"Um... Sect Leader Jiang, the side entrance gets you in all the same, why fret over this superficial form?"
Jiang Cheng sternly, "That’s not acceptable. I am the Sect Leader of Feixian Sect, representing the face of Feixian Sect when I go out! Allowing me to walk on the side, to be someone’s backdrop, is tarnishing Feixian Sect’s reputation, this Sect Leader cannot accept it!"
In his heart, he was gleefully laughing out loud.
Since it’s you guys plotting against me, why not seize this chance to mess with you properly?
Lu Zhong’s expression seemed constipated.
If it wasn’t for the sake of the Tier Nine Spirit Talisman inside the ring, your Feixian Sect wouldn’t even qualify to enter; what’s with this face-saving nonsense?
Do you even wish for the Eldest Prince to make way for you?
"Sect Leader Jiang misunderstands. You are indeed our most important honored guest and should be the main focus, but letting you walk on the side is actually for your own good!"
"Why?"
Lu Zhong, worthy of being a cunning old fox, found an excuse in no time.
"Did you see the man in the golden crown and brocade robe? That’s the Eldest Prince of Qianxing Dynasty. If you walk in the center and displease him, even as an honored guest, we couldn’t protect you!"
For your own safety, it’s better to discreetly enter from the side gate.
"What Eldest Prince, this Sect Leader has never heard of him. Anyway, I want to walk in the center, or it’ll be a clean break!"
Brother Cheng put on a facade of arrogance and ignorance, his acting remarkably skilled.
He made the stance of ready to leave, looking earnest.
Lu Zhong was almost in tears; being at the gate, couldn’t he just calm down and cause less trouble?
He had to grab Jiang Cheng once more.
"Sect Leader Jiang, I’m begging you, more trouble leads to misfortune!"
"Since my debut, this Sect Leader has never feared trouble! The honor of the sect is as important as Mount Tai!" Jiang Cheng stuck out his chest, speaking righteously.
And he truly wasn’t boasting—resurrecting three times a day, there’s nothing to fear, even if the Emperor of Qianxing Dynasty came, he couldn’t scare him.
Therefore, it’s best to stir things up as big as possible.
As for any profound motives?
No motives...
Brother Cheng always prefers straightforward tactics, and this was just some mischievousness before the battle.
Lu Zhong didn’t know which Mount Tai was being referred to; he only knew the Eldest Prince was finally alerted and was looking over.
"Quickly, quickly..."
Holding Jiang Cheng, he was planning to sneak inside.
At this point, he wished to use invisibility on both himself and this brat.
Of course, Jiang Cheng wouldn’t cooperate; he fiercely flicked his sleeve to shake him off and darkened his face.
"Elder Lu, you have no sincerity at all, utterly disrespectful to this Sect Leader! Is this how Eight Clouds Hall treats honored guests?"
He intentionally raised his voice, attracting not only the Eldest Prince but surrounding people as well.
Lu Zhong was almost going mad; he couldn’t afford to offend the Eldest Prince, and he didn’t want to let Jiang Cheng leave.
"What’s happening?"
Xiang Ba was finally intrigued, and Great Elder Xu Yuancan quickly explained.
"It’s another guest of our sect, incomparable to your highness. There’s no need to pay attention."
He wanted to turn a big issue into a small one, acting as if nothing happened.
Because he also knew Jiang Cheng.

chapters.title: Chapter 69: Others are so much more on the Dao
chapters.content:
Chapter 69: Chapter 69: Others are so much more on the Dao
Although he had never met Jiang Cheng in person, the true disciple Ling Yi had secretly set his sights on Jiang Cheng.
As Ling Yi’s backing, Xu Yuancan naturally had also studied this person during this period.
They had learned about Jiang Cheng’s several sect exterminations and the existence of the Three-Eyed Tiger.
Their plan was for Qi Cang and Lu Zhong to lure Jiang Cheng in first, and when the Storage Ring and opportunities were in hand, they would intercept.
This was a standard case of one predator preying on another, and the mantis stalking the cicada unaware of the oriole behind.
So, in his heart, he really hoped Jiang Cheng would smoothly fall into Qi Cang’s trap.
But now, it seems the plan had a little deviation.
Jiang Cheng inexplicably wanted respect, and the Eldest Prince also seemed interested in him.
"Is that so? This guest seems unfamiliar, I would like to know him too. Elder Xu, could you introduce us?"
"This..."
Xu Yuancan was conflicted.
The command of the Eldest Prince was not easy to defy.
Yet he didn’t want the incident with Jiang Cheng to cause problems.
If the Eldest Prince learned the truth, then they wouldn’t have the chance to intercept the final opportunity.
"What? Elder Xu, are you unwilling?"
The Eldest Prince’s face darkened: "Or do you think I am unworthy of knowing this person?"
"How dare I, the Eldest Prince misunderstood..."
With words put this way, he could only brace himself and lead the Eldest Prince to meet Jiang Cheng.
Over here, Lu Zhong was also at his wit’s end.
Seeing the Eldest Prince really coming over, he inwardly wished he could kill Jiang Cheng, this troublemaker, a hundred times.
"Elder Lu, aren’t you going to introduce this guest to the Eldest Prince?"
Elder Xu had to pretend not to know Jiang Cheng, so naturally, he passed the task to Lu Zhong.
"Ah?"
Lu Zhong cautiously glanced at the Eldest Prince, whose expression was hard to read, and secretly lamented.
"This is Brother Cheng, the Sect Leader of Feixian Sect..."
"Feixian Sect? What sect is that?"
The Eldest Prince hadn’t heard this name; previously, he noticed Lu Zhong was very respectful to this person and thought he came from some super sect within another Imperial Dynasty Realm.
"Oh no, Your Highness misunderstood. Feixian Sect is a sect from Qinglan Prefecture of Feiyun State."
"Qinglan Prefecture?"
The Eldest Prince’s surprise flashed.
This was interesting.
As far as he knew, Qinglan Prefecture had no sect worth mentioning, they were all like ants.
Why was Lu Zhong placing such importance on this person?
While he was pondering, Jiang Cheng became impatient.
"Since you’ve heard of my Sect Leader’s great name, why not quickly clear the way? I need to walk in the middle!"
Lu Zhong and Xu Yuancan almost spat blood simultaneously.
Bro, you’re really strong, huh?
So straightforward?
Your famous name, what fame do you have? Do you know what strength the Eldest Prince possesses?
"Insol..."
Xu Yuancan habitually wanted to shout ’presumptuous’ and then apprehend him to let the Eldest Prince handle his anger.
But then remembered not to provoke Jiang Cheng and held back his words.
Jiang Cheng raised an eyebrow: "What boldness?"
"Oh, everyone’s getting along just fine, Sect Leader Jiang is really joking."
Everyone around was incredibly surprised.
What was going on?
This person said such disrespectful words to the Eldest Prince, yet the Great Elder wouldn’t put him down immediately?
Xiang Ba and several experts had a flash of murderous intent in their eyes, ready to act.
But in the next moment, Xiang Ba himself raised his right hand to stop them.
He found that things were getting more and more interesting.
What was so special about this Jiang Cheng?
"I’m not joking, I’m your most important guest, it’s only right I walk in the middle!"
Brother Cheng was both provoking and knowing that these two old fogeys feared it, he intentionally did what was inconvenient for them.
"Stop..."
"Sect Leader Jiang, how could you dismiss the Eldest Prince so?"
Lu Zhong and Xu Yuancan both tried to block him.
Truth be told, Xu Yuancan wanted to act on the spot to snatch Jiang Cheng’s ring.
As long as he got the ring, they could deal with Jiang Cheng however they wished afterward.
But with a casual probe of Divine Thought, Jiang Cheng had already reached Celestial Fate First Layer.
This was much stronger than their intelligence of Spirit Platform Seventh Layer, and he himself was only Celestial Fate Fourth Layer, having no confidence to get him before throwing out a Tier Nine Spirit Talisman.
"If it won’t work, I’ll leave."
"No, Sect Leader Jiang, you are our honored guest..."
The two Great Elders almost knelt before him.
"Honored your big uncle, is this how you treat honored guests?"
I came here to cooperate with your conspiracy and intrigue, and you don’t even want to provide me with a highly-anticipated status treatment, yet expect me to fall for your trick?
"We, we..."
Lu Zhong and Xu Yuancan certainly didn’t dare tell the Eldest Prince to wait while letting this one go first?
That would be courting death.
But not doing so couldn’t satisfy Jiang Cheng either.
At this moment, in the remote hinterland of the mountain gate, Qi Cang, who had been observing the situation through the Transmission Spirit Artifact, almost bit his lip.
And on the other side, Ling Yi couldn’t help but rub his temples.
This was an unsolvable situation.
To offend the Eldest Prince would incur thunderous wrath.
To offend Jiang Cheng would mean the conspiracy would be prematurely aborted.
Even with his intelligence, he couldn’t find a perfect solution.
"Alright, alright, move aside! Don’t block my path back home!"
Brother Cheng brushed past the two, even kicking them slightly.
The onlookers’ eyes glazed over, even the Eldest Prince felt as if time and space were warped.
The sect master of a small sect scolding two Great Elders like children, did he hear it wrong?
Yet the two had to feign a smile.
Within this lay an earth-shattering secret!
"Since Sect Leader Jiang wants to walk in the middle, please go ahead first!"
"Your Highness!"
The few palace experts behind the Eldest Prince couldn’t believe it, drawing their swords.
In their view, this not only insulted the Eldest Prince’s face but was also disregarding the Qianxing Dynasty.
"Stand down!"
Xiang Ba was cunning, discovering a secret behind this, and chose to go along with it.
"Did you see that, he’s quite savvy, isn’t he?"
Brother Cheng nudged Lu Zhong’s chest, swaggering right down the middle.
Everyone around was left dumbfounded, offering the most astonished salute of their lives.
What background did this guy have?
The Eldest Prince had to make way for him?
This reaction made Brother Cheng feel he’d gained something.
Was he making a name for himself on his first visit to Feiyun State?
His fronting was effective.
Unfortunately, his system was triggered by being killed, not by fronting. Otherwise, he’d be stronger, right?
Lu Zhong apologized to the Eldest Prince and quickly followed along.
He couldn’t feel happy.
The Eldest Prince’s uncharacteristic retreat indicated he saw something wrong and also focused on this guy.
This was trouble.
All the way, he couldn’t help but complain.
"Luckily the Eldest Prince was magnanimous, otherwise there would have been trouble..."
Jiang Cheng, floating on the cloud, stopped again, looking displeased.
"What, are you blaming me?"
Lu Zhong wished he could slap himself twice, why say anything unnecessary?
"No, no, you’re more magnanimous than him, let’s go quickly!"
The two soon entered the depths of the Eight Clouds Hall, with Lu Zhong leading the way and eventually bringing Jiang Cheng to a pavilion on the side of the main peak.
Only then did he finally begin to implement the plan.
"Sect Leader Jiang, according to our sect’s rules, one needs to bathe and change clothes before the grand ceremony."
"Your clothing, Spirit Sword, Spirit Armor, ring, and so on can be temporarily stored outside..."

chapters.title: Chapter 70 Entering the Fraud Group
chapters.content:
Chapter 70: Chapter 70 Entering the Fraud Group
"There’s also this rule?"
"Of course, this is to show respect to our sect’s predecessors—to worship them with a clean body."
Lu Zhong spoke with confidence, though in truth, the Eight Clouds Hall had no such rule.
The whole bathing and changing clothes idea was just an excuse to get Jiang Cheng to voluntarily remove his storage ring.
Outside the hall, Qi Cang had been waiting for a long time.
Meanwhile, within the surrounding mountains, Ling Yi and his trusted experts were also lying in ambush, ready to intercept.
Everyone was waiting for the moment the ring came off.
Once they got their hands on that storage ring containing the Tier Nine Spirit Talisman, they’d have accomplished their mission.
"Oh."
Jiang Cheng nodded in understanding, then said, "Then, I won’t need it."
"Huh?"
"Why?"
At this moment, not only Lu Zhong but even Qi Cang and Ling Yi wanted to directly ask him.
Don’t you understand, ’When in Rome, do as the Romans do’?
"I’m already perfectly clean, no need to wash."
Kidding, the Celestial Desolation Indestructible Body has an automatic dust-removing effect every day. Besides, Brother Cheng is always good with personal hygiene.
"But, the ritual of bathing and changing clothes is best to be observed..."
Brother Cheng impatiently interrupted him, "They’re your ancestors, not mine. If you love bathing, go ahead—what does it have to do with me?"
Lu Zhong had no words left.
He was angry, so angry he wanted to slam Jiang Cheng to the ground.
But he knew that if he kept pushing it, this kid would surely turn his back on everything and leave.
It seemed relying on such a small tactic to trick him into removing the ring wasn’t going to work.
They could only hope for the next step.
"Yes, yes, if Sect Leader Jiang does not wish to, then that’s that."
"It’s still early. As per tradition, guests usually wait in the Tongming Hall for the ceremony to start. I’ll lead Sect Leader Jiang there..."
This was indeed a genuine tradition.
It’s just that the waiting spot wasn’t in the Tongming Hall, but in the Everlasting Hall.
Anyway, there was no way that kid would know the truth.
Over at the Tongming Hall, Qi Cang’s trusted gang had already set the traps.
"Then lead the way."
Dammit, really treating this old man, a First Layer Celestial Fate, as a pathfinder!
Lu Zhong gritted his teeth, continuing to act with patience.
The two soon arrived at the Tongming Hall in the main peak hall complex.
Upon entering, Jiang Cheng saw dozens of people seated on both sides of the hall. Each was young, either handsome or beautiful.
As he walked in, these people stopped talking and looked over curiously.
"Elder Lu, who is this?"
"Oh, this is Jiang Cheng, the Sect Leader of Feixian Sect!"
Lu Zhong introduced him with great importance, then someone stood up to make small talk.
"So it’s Sect Leader Jiang, a pleasure to meet you!"
Lu Zhong discreetly nodded; their acting was decent.
This group consisted of 25 people, including 11 True Disciples and 14 Inner Sect Elite Disciples, all core members of Qi Cang’s faction.
They were waiting here entirely to cooperate with the plot, trying every means to trick the storage ring into their hands.
Brother Cheng was like a lone outsider in a fraud group, surrounded by swindlers.
"Come, come, let me introduce you, Sect Leader Jiang."
"This is Xu Xing, ranked eighth among our sect’s True Disciples!"
"And this is Li Yehong, ranked twelfth among our sect’s True Disciples..."
He blabbered on with the introductions, doing ample facade work.
Brother Cheng didn’t bother remembering their names, knowing they’d all be complicit at the Eight Clouds Hall’s final act against him.
"You are all young heroes of your generation, you should get closer to each other."
After Lu Zhong left, the atmosphere became awkward.
In their bones, this group looked down on a Sect Leader from a small place. While cooperating with the act for the plan, they still held airs of superiority.
They expected Jiang Cheng to lick up to them and initiate conversation.
Unaware, Brother Cheng was just here to watch the show in his mindset.
What conspiracy do you have? Quickly reveal it; Brother Cheng is a bit curious!
Let’s see your performance...
As it was growing awkwardly silent, Xu Xing had to break the ice himself.
"Sect Leader Jiang, just waiting around is quite dull, how about playing a little game with us?"
A little game?
Are they finally going to make a move? Jiang Cheng was a bit expectant.
"What game?"
"Including Sect Leader Jiang, there are 26 of us; everyone puts their storage rings on the table. The previous person guesses what’s in the next person’s storage ring."
This was a pre-rehearsed plan all along, aimed at tricking Jiang Cheng into handing over his storage ring.
"If they guess correctly, the next person must give that guessed item to the previous person. If they guess wrong, the previous person must give the said item to the next person."
"To be fair, I’ll act as an arbiter. Each round, I’ll check if the guessed item is truly in the storage ring; does anyone object?"
This game hinged on this point.
The rings would pass through Xu Xing’s hands.
Once he got Jiang Cheng’s storage ring, the plan would be considered successful.
Li Yehong quickly nodded and smiled, "Senior Brother Xu is known for his fairness. With you as arbiter, I fully support it."
The other disciples had rehearsed many times and eagerly got into their roles, expressing agreement.
"With Senior Brother Xu arbitrating, we couldn’t be more at ease."
"Indeed, start quickly!"
"Senior Brother Xu, you must check carefully!"
They said this while quickly placing their storage rings on the table.
Jiang Cheng couldn’t help but want to mock them on the spot, your acting is way too fake.
A group of cultivators inexplicably says they want to play a game, without any buildup—it’s extremely abrupt.
Then everyone responds unanimously, without the slightest doubt; could it be any more fake?
Can’t you have some dedication to acting quality?
The whole scene is full of insiders!
"Sect Leader Jiang, don’t you want to participate?"
Seeing Jiang Cheng not responding, Xu Xing was getting anxious.
The so-called game was designed to trap him; if he didn’t join, how could they proceed?
Before Brother Cheng could respond, Li Yehong and the others preemptively began using the Provocation Technique as per their backup plan.
"Is Sect Leader Jiang afraid to play? Afraid to lose?"
"A dignified Sect Leader afraid to lose? Seriously?"
"Understandable, Feixian Sect probably doesn’t produce much, Sect Leader Jiang might be worried his ring’s contents are too shabby..."
"No worries, Sect Leader Jiang, I’ll cover your losses, it’s just for fun!"
"If even with this you still dare not, then we have nothing more to say."
This Provocation Technique was so awkward it made Jiang Cheng cringe for them.
Not because of their snide remarks, mainly because their acting wasn’t good enough.
Too eager, too deliberate.
Brother Cheng hadn’t even refused yet, why provoke unnecessarily?
How could anyone fall into this trap with such bad acting—it left him mentally exhausted.
"Since you all insist, I’ll reluctantly join in."
It takes a truly honest and kind-hearted person like me to agree, right?
Xu Xing was overjoyed, giving Brother Cheng a thumbs-up.
"Great, Sect Leader Jiang is indeed magnanimous!"
Then, the gaze of him and everyone else turned blank.
Jiang Cheng reached into his pocket and pulled out another ring to place on the table.
This...
What they wanted was the ring on Jiang Cheng’s finger, identified by Lu Zhong himself, as the one containing the Tier Nine Spirit Talisman.
As for any other ring, it held no value at all!
"Come on, let’s start. Who goes first?"
Jiang Cheng still didn’t know they were after his storage ring, but the ring on his finger did contain quite a few spirit stones and spirit pills.
He wasn’t willing to lose it to this bunch.
So, he pulled out a different ring.
The ring fished from his pocket had earlier given a bunch of spirit stones and pills to Luo Yuan and others for cultivation. It’s empty now, with nothing inside it.

chapters.title: Chapter 71: Brother Cheng Is Quite the Yin Yang Person
chapters.content:
Chapter 71: Chapter 71: Brother Cheng Is Quite the Yin Yang Person
Brother Cheng’s idea was simple, just guess.
If you guess wrong, you compensate me.
If you guess right, I’ll give you a bunch of air at most.
Guaranteed profit with no loss, where else can you find such a deal?
"Sect Leader Jiang..."
Xu Xing was having a bit of trouble keeping up with the change.
"Hmm?"
"Why did you change your ring?"
"Does your gambling require me to use a specific ring?"
Facing Brother Cheng’s innocent and clear gaze, Xu Xing swallowed hard and shook his head with clenched teeth.
"Not really, use whatever you like."
Just hope this ring also contains a Tier Nine Spirit Talisman.
After clarifying some details, the ring guessing game began just like that.
"Senior Brother Zhang, I guess your ring contains a Tier Four Sword-shaped Spiritual Artifact, is that correct?"
The guessed Senior Brother Zhang laughed heartily.
"You really guessed it right, I’ll give it to you!"
With a swipe on his ring, he happily handed over a Tier Four Spirit Sword to the disciple who just guessed correctly.
It’s all acting anyway.
Besides, a Tier Four Spiritual Artifact means nothing to them.
Then, he guessed the next person.
"Junior Sister Song, I guess your ring contains a Fifth-Grade Water Spirit Talisman, is that so?"
Junior Sister Song covered her mouth and giggled, "Senior Brother Zhang guessed wrong, my ring doesn’t have one."
After speaking, she activated her spiritual power to send the ring to the arbitrator, Xu Xing, for inspection to ensure there really wasn’t a Fifth-Grade Water Spirit Talisman inside.
Jiang Cheng noticed that when passing the ring, everyone secretly glanced at him.
What does this mean, is it for me to see?
Are they worried I won’t cooperate with the inspection?
Do they look down on me or something?
"Junior Sister Song’s ring indeed doesn’t have a Fifth-Grade Water Spirit Talisman, Junior Brother Zhang, you lost again."
"Haha, I guess my luck is really bad!"
The Senior Brother Zhang laughed freely, swiped his ring, and pulled out a Fifth-Grade Spirit Talisman to compensate Junior Sister Song.
Next, it was Junior Sister Song’s turn to guess the next person on the right.
Like this, the game continued round after round.
Because they were collectively acting to deceive Jiang Cheng, they kept the stakes low, betting with Fourth and Fifth Grade pills or Fourth and Fifth Tier Spiritual Artifacts, keeping the atmosphere light and carefree.
In the Extreme Moon Sect, these things were considered treasures; in the Duanmu Family, they were eye-catching; in the Eight Clouds Hall, they were nothing special.
Everyone was secretly observing Jiang Cheng’s expressions and reactions.
Their biggest concern was that he might quit halfway through.
But after observing for a while, they found this guy was very interested, seemingly looking forward to his turn.
Everyone couldn’t help but secretly snicker, he’s fallen into the trap without knowing it!
Soon, it was Li Yehong’s turn, sitting to Brother Cheng’s left, to guess.
Having her positioned before Jiang Cheng was part of the plan from the beginning.
In this group, aside from Xu Xing, Li Yehong had the highest cultivation, so the important task naturally fell to an important person.
She frowned, pretending to scrutinize the rings on the table.
Each ring had restrictions, and unless one used spiritual power to touch it, one couldn’t discern anything from the outside.
For the moment, she really didn’t know what to guess.
According to the original plan, she was supposed to directly guess something like a Tier Nine Spirit Talisman or Spiritual Artifact.
If Jiang Cheng had it, he would have to give it to her.
If not, Xu Xing would inspect it; getting the ring in hand would mean success.
But with a different ring in play, the plan had gone awry.
Li Yehong was unsure now.
To be safe, guess a Tier Three or Four Spiritual Artifact, losing wouldn’t hurt?
But greed suddenly took hold of her...
Given Jiang Cheng’s extravagant display with a Ninth-Grade Spirit Talisman, even if he changed rings, there should be at least a Tier Seven Spiritual Artifact, right?
It’s said this person uses a sword too.
She happened to lack a Tier Seven Spirit Sword, so why not take this chance to profit from him?
With this thought, she decided to gamble.
"Sect Leader Jiang, I guess your ring contains a Tier Seven Spirit Sword, is that correct?"
Her eyes gleamed, staring straight into Jiang Cheng’s, as if trying to see through his heart.
The relaxed atmosphere in the hall vanished, everyone held their breath, waiting for Jiang Cheng to reveal the answer.
"You guessed wrong."
"What? I don’t believe you, you’re lying to me, aren’t you?" Li Yehong’s voice raised.
Jiang Cheng looked speechless, girl, you’re showing a bit too much here.
"Why is that hard to believe, isn’t there an arbitration?"
He casually tossed the ring to Xu Xing.
Did he really hand over the ring just like that?
So straightforward?
At this moment, in the side hall next to Tongming Hall, Qi Cang, who had been observing in secret, started breathing heavily.
Even if it’s a different ring, there might be treasures inside?
Xu Xing was also at a loss, picking up the ring, he infused it with spiritual power to probe inside, almost cursing out loud.
Damn, it’s actually an empty ring!
This ring guessing game was their invention; they hadn’t thought it through before.
Who would have known Brother Cheng would find a loophole to win without losing in their first game?
Facing Li Yehong’s anxious gaze, Xu Xing helplessly shook his head.
"There’s really nothing, Junior Sister Li, you lost."
"What?"
Li Yehong still didn’t want to accept it, secretly sending a message to Xu Xing to question, "Are you sure there’s really no Tier Seven Spirit Sword inside?"
Xu Xing also replied in secret, "There really isn’t."
The judge revealing the truth already constituted an undeniable breach of game fairness.
But since they were conspiring together, they couldn’t care too much.
"What’s inside then? If it’s filled with Tier Nine Spiritual Artifacts and Talismans, we can seize the ring and take him down!"
Li Yehong didn’t want to compensate Jiang Cheng with a Tier Seven Spirit Sword, she just wanted to end the game directly now.
"There’s nothing inside this ring, all his treasures should be in another ring on his finger. The Young Master also ordered that until we get the real Treasure Ring, we can’t turn on him!"
"Nothing at all?"
Li Yehong sat back down, dejected.
She really wanted to grab Jiang Cheng by the collar and angrily scold him, how can you be so despicable and shameless?
Using an empty ring to participate in the game, what kind of sect leader are you?
However, she couldn’t say it out loud.
Saying it would mean admitting to knowing what’s inside the ring, confirming collusion with the judge to cheat.
"Miss Li, as per our agreement, didn’t you guess wrong and owe me a Tier Seven Spirit Sword?"
Jiang Cheng was delighted inside, getting a Tier Seven Spirit Sword for free.
In Feixian Sect currently only Ji Linghan had a Tier Nine Spirit Armor, besides that there’s the Tier Seven Blood Transformation Blade seized from the Duanmu Family.
The rest of the Spiritual Artifacts weren’t even at Tier Seven.
This was a pleasant bonus for him seeing him rubbing his hands happily, everyone was extremely frustrated.
All their trickery had backfired on them and still, he was oblivious!
"I... I don’t believe it!"
Li Yehong muttered to herself as she sunk back into her seat. She so badly wanted to grab Jiang Cheng by the collar and say it out loud, but she couldn’t.
"Miss Li, according to the agreement, you guessed wrong, so aren’t you supposed to compensate me with a Tier Seven Spirit Sword?"
Anger boiled inside her as she watched Jiang Cheng with a smiling face rubbing his fingers together.
Her fellow juniors and sisters joined in supportively.
"Lady Jiang, are you really going to gamble away a Tier Seven Spirit Sword over this?"
"It’s just a game, really, you don’t have to take it so seriously, do you?"
"Considering Sect Leader Jiang’s wealth, a mere Tier Seven Spiritual Artifact shouldn’t be such a big deal, right?"
Seeing them starting to act true to their nature and growing, Jiang Cheng couldn’t help but smile.
"What’s this, you all can’t even come up with a Tier Seven Spiritual Artifact?"
At this, the entire hall fell silent.

chapters.title: Chapter 72: Will You Come Again
chapters.content:
Chapter 72: Chapter 72: Will You Come Again
The atmosphere was awkward, everyone’s expression turned quite uncomfortable.
These people are all darlings of heaven, used to mocking others, being mocked was a first for them.
And yet, they couldn’t retort.
Unless they could produce a Tier Seven Spiritual Artifact and were willing to give it to Jiang Cheng for free.
"I’ll compensate for her!"
A person flashed out from the side hall, it was Qi Cang.
If you don’t want to sacrifice the child, you won’t catch the wolf.
Now without getting Jiang Cheng’s ’Treasure Ring’, he couldn’t flip out and end things abruptly.
The act had to continue.
"Young Master!"
"Young Master, why should you..."
Li Yehong was still unwilling, thinking it unnecessary to really give it away.
Qi Cang smiled and waved, inwardly wanting to strangle her.
Damn it, I’m here to have you cooperate with the plan, not to sabotage it!
He brushed the ring, a beam of green light shot out from within, causing the hall’s light to sway.
A three-foot ancient sword sprinkled with star-like glints floated midair, at first glance, it was extraordinary.
"This sword is named Lu Feng, a genuine Tier Seven Spirit Sword, is Sect Leader Jiang satisfied?"
Speaking these words, his heart bled.
This sword was his personal sword, bestowed upon him by his Palace Master father.
But he was a person of great deeds, with a broad mind, understanding that to gain more, one must first invest.
Jiang Cheng, naturally, wouldn’t be polite, he accepted the Tier Seven Spirit Sword with a smile.
He couldn’t care less about the murderous gazes around him.
"Let’s continue, it’s my turn to guess now, isn’t it?"
After making a profit, his spirits soared, he turned and locked eyes with the disciple on his right.
Xu Xing glanced at Qi Cang, then nodded.
"Correct, Sect Leader Jiang, please!"
This time they weren’t worried, without any understanding or acquaintance, it was inherently difficult to guess the items within the other’s ring.
If Jiang Cheng guessed too high, he would have to compensate.
"Sect Leader Jiang, there really is a Tier Seven Spirit Sword in my ring, but I bet you can’t guess its attribute."
The elite Inner Sect disciple Zuo Yuankai flaunted with a hint of provocation.
According to the rules, no need to guess the specific item, but must mention which attribute.
He was not worried at all that Jiang Cheng could guess correctly because he didn’t even have a Tier Seven Spirit Sword, the statement was meant to mislead.
No one can directly use Spiritual Power to perceive the contents of a ring without touching it.
Once really guessed as a Tier Seven Spirit Sword, it would definitely be wrong, and then he would have to compensate a piece in return.
Playing the provocation technique again, aren’t these people tired?
Do they really take me as a fool?
Brother Cheng indeed couldn’t directly use Divine Thought to see through the ring, so...
He decisively activated the Insight Skill.
Using it once only costs 10 points, an affordable expense.
Thus, Zuo Yuankai’s ring appeared naked before him.
Tier Five Storage Ring - 100 points.
10,357 Top-grade Spirit Stones - 103.57 points.
Eight bottles of Sixth-grade Void Soul Pill - 800 points.
Two Tier Six Fire Spirit Swords - 2,000 points.
Tier Six Golden Rock Heavy Armor - 1,000 points.
Tier Seven Jade Crystal Silk Armor - 10,000 points.
As for other miscellaneous items, the system was too lazy to score.
Each item had a detailed introduction beneath it, not only attributes, even purpose and features were clearly outlined.
"Sect Leader Jiang, what attribute of Tier Seven Spirit Sword do you intend to guess?"
"If you’re afraid of losing, you can guess the Lower Grade Spirit Stones, you won’t lose much then."
Zuo Yuankai continued to exert himself in ridiculing.
You don’t have any Tier Seven Spirit Sword, isn’t your act exhausting?
However, this guy’s ring contained a Tier Seven Spirit Armor, which was quite a find.
Considering this point, Brother Cheng decided to be a good person and keep it safe for him.
"In your ring, there’s a green Tier Seven Jade Crystal Silk Armor."
He felt a bit regretful because he only could guess one item at a time, otherwise he would have cleaned out the entire ring.
"What did you say?"
Zuo Yuankai shot up like someone had punched him in the face.
How did he know that he had that Spirit Armor?
This Tier Seven Spirit Armor was his lifeline, a trump card that got him into the top thirty Inner Sect disciples this year.
He had toiled for decades for this armor, putting in few unknown efforts.
How could it just be given away so casually?
"You’re talking nonsense, what Jade Crystal Silk Armor, besides you didn’t even mention any attribute, random guesses don’t count..."
Brother Cheng looked at him like he was a stubborn fool.
"Water and Wood Dual Attributes."
How could he guess so accurately?
Zuo Yuankai was struck by lightning, almost going insane, he started to babble.
"No! You guessed wrong, you owe me a Tier Seven Spirit Armor, hahaha!"
"The armor body is also engraved with Sixth-grade Rejuvenation Array, Sixth-grade Soul Circle Array, and Seventh-grade Jade Wave Spirit Array."
Even the details were mentioned, stunning everyone present.
Even Qi Cang found it extremely unbelievable.
He even secretly suspected that perhaps Jiang Cheng had a mole in Eight Clouds Hall who had leaked the information?
Jiang Cheng didn’t bother to look at him but cast a glance at Xu Xing.
"Since there’s a dispute, then let’s trouble the arbiters to inspect."
Weren’t you rushing to be arbitrator?
Fine, now let your own people help me force another of your own, isn’t that delightful?
"Junior Brother Zuo, hand it over."
Xu Xing sighed heavily with a grim face, he too did not want his own to suffer.
But the problem was unless they wanted to break off immediately with Jiang Cheng, they had no choice but to continue.
That Tier Seven Spirit Armor he had seen during the sect competition, Jiang Cheng’s words were spot on, clearly ’prepared.’
Zuo Yuankai wouldn’t willingly give away his lifeline like that, he grasped the Storage Ring and flew straight out of the seat towards the hall’s exit.
"No! You guys teamed up to trap me, isn’t it just for show..."
Swish!
A streak of sword light exploded within the hall.
The next moment, a figure fell, silent evermore.
Qi Cang expressionlessly retrieved the sword, his cold gaze sweeping across everyone present.
"Anyone else who acts like him, will be killed without mercy!"
If Zuo Yuankai had merely escaped, that would have been tolerable, but fleeing with gossip nearly exposed the plan.
To Qi Cang, this was betrayal!
He wouldn’t obviously spare a traitor.
Everyone in the hall was silent as cicadas in winter, not daring to utter a word.
An elite Inner Sect disciple got killed, the matter could be trivial or significant.
Qi Cang was, after all, the son of the Palace Master, even if pursued for accountability, at most it’ll be a mild punishment.
Whereas if they were killed, it would genuinely mean their deaths.
With one stretch of the hand, Zuo Yuankai’s ring floated into Qi Cang’s palm.
A luminous light arose, revealing a gleaming, green, gelatinous Spirit Armor.
"Sect Leader Jiang, our Eight Clouds Hall can afford a loss."
"Good, Young Master Qi is quite bold!"
Brother Cheng gave a thumbs up, manually giving him a ’like,’ and then smilingly received the Spirit Armor.
Profits again, this trip was truly worth it!
"Onward, onward, let’s quickly start the next round!"
His spirits were high, he planned to keep winning and continue into glorious conquest.
