With Zuo Yuankai just wiped out, the disciple now in the line-up behind him trembled in fear.
As for Li Yehong, she was still sulking.
Seeing the defiant expressions among the crowd, Qi Cang realized if the game continued, people might alienate themselves from him.
Jiang Cheng’s ring was empty, the game would always lead him to win without losing, rendering it pointless.
"Sect Leader Jiang, it’s time to head to the main hall for the ceremony, how about ending this little ring-guessing game here?"
"Uh, alright then..."
Brother Cheng glanced at the rings on others, truly feeling unsatisfied.

chapters.title: Chapter 73: Bro, Why Are You Snatching My Ring
chapters.content:
Chapter 73: Chapter 73: Bro, Why Are You Snatching My Ring
Plop!
Inside the room, a person weakly collapsed, his eyes vacant, face drained of color just before he died.
A palace guard of the Celestial Fate Realm under Eldest Prince Xiang Ba withdrew his right hand, his gaze seemingly penetrating the layers of halls, directly seeing the Tongming Hall.
After entering the mountain gate, Xiang Ba was grandly escorted into the main hall.
He was a true honored guest, currently chatting leisurely, surrounded by Sect Leader Qi Yuansheng and other elders, like stars crowding the moon.
The two Celestial Fate Eighth Layer guards, on the other hand, were sent out by him.
Their purpose was simple, to probe into what secret Jiang Cheng held.
Their operation went exceedingly smooth, soon capturing two True Disciples.
One of them was Ling Yi’s trusted aide.
After a soul search, Jiang Cheng’s secret was also exposed.
"Tier Nine Spirit Talisman! At least a Celestial Fate Ninth Layer Tiger Demon! A great opportunity!"
"Quickly report to His Highness!"
The two swiftly dealt with the corpses and hurriedly made their way to the main hall.
Soon, the Eldest Prince also received the news through their sound transmission.
At this moment, Jiang Cheng also arrived at the square in front of the hall, accompanied personally by Qi Cang.
Even though the inside and outside of the hall were already packed with people.
At this moment, countless eyes focused on him.
Those unaware were still fervently discussing his ’feat’ of forcing the Eldest Prince to make way when entering the mountain gate.
While those in the know already considered him a moving treasure.
"He’s here."
"Is that Jiang Cheng?"
"Can’t deny his looks are excessively handsome..."
"The cultivation realm values power."
"Someone whom Young Master Qi Cang accompanies personally, do you think his strength could be lacking?"
Feeling the attention, Brother Cheng nodded with a smile in greeting to everyone.
That grandeur, as if he were the Master of the Eight Clouds Hall.
Beside him, Qi Cang secretly muttered, this guy really likes to show off, taking the main hall as some showcase event?
Moments later, the hour arrived, and the grand ceremony formally began!
The square was large enough that even with tens of thousands from the Eight Clouds Hall gathered, it didn’t feel crowded.
Beneath the Great Elder of the Eight Clouds Hall, the Council Elder, Inner Sect Elder, and Outer Sect Elder lined up on either side.
The True Disciples took the lead, the Inner Sect Disciples occupied the center of the square, while the Outer Sect Disciples were dispersed around the edges.
Magnificent and grand.
The other guests took their seats in the viewing area, led by the Eldest Prince.
Brother Cheng was in no mood to create extra trouble, calculating how he might die later.
Now that everyone in the Eight Clouds Hall was gathered together, as long as he was killed once, the system’s revival plan would be to annihilate everyone present.
Achieving everything in one stroke.
At this moment, Sect Leader Qi Yuansheng also ascended the high platform under the gaze of the crowd.
"Forty-three thousand five hundred years ago, the ancestor Venerable Ba Ji founded this establishment here... following the heavens above, reaching the earth below..."
The lengthy speech made Brother Cheng feel drowsy, forcing him to think about some deep questions.
For instance, who would ultimately be the one to kill him?
He glanced at Qi Cang standing as the third True Disciple, shaking his head silently.
This guy, after meeting three times, was still in the Spirit Platform Eighth Layer; this level of strength probably couldn’t kill him.
Really disappointing.
Lu Zhong?
Lu Zhong was at the same level, but his Divine Mansion couldn’t match a Radiant Divine Mansion, not durable either.
Seems he could only rely on others.
That Eldest Prince, he seemed quite formidable, even without Insight, his realm couldn’t be seen through.
Back at the mountain gate, he probably bore a grudge against him, now he must certainly be biding his time wanting to kill him.
Brother Cheng was impressed by his own foresight, even though back then he only aimed to make a statement without thinking so far ahead.
Finally, after two hours, the lengthy grand ceremony came to an end.
The final step was a grand banquet for the guests.
The seats on the square were filled with Spirit Fruits, Spirit Beasts, Delicious Dishes, and Nectar that could enhance cultivation, though the enhancement was limited, it sufficiently proved the wealth was extravagant.
If someone from the Body Tempering Realm came, they’d directly advance to the Condensing Vein Realm after one meal.
Qi Yuansheng personally flew over, inviting the Eldest Prince to enter the hall for the banquet.
There were eight seats inside the hall, naturally reserved for those of the highest status.
The Eldest Prince readily agreed; at this moment, Qi Cang also flew over, reaching out his hand to Jiang Cheng.
"Sect Leader Jiang, you are our honored guest. Come, come, join us inside the hall!"
Brother Cheng was fond of appearances and naturally wouldn’t refuse.
Only felt that this old brother was quite diligent, even wanting to hold his hand to go in together; he’s not into men’s affection!
Could it be he’s afraid of his escape?
The moment Qi Cang’s right hand touched Jiang Cheng’s left hand, time seemed to suddenly stand still.
Lu Zhong, who had been closely watching the situation, suddenly had his eyes light up!
This was the third step of their plan; after bathing and guessing the ring failed, Qi Cang would personally take action.
What’s the simplest method to get the ring?
Directly contact the other’s hand.
People in the cultivation realm didn’t have the habit of shaking hands, often keeping their distance, so there had been no opportunity.
But now, seizing the moment when the ceremony just ended, in the most lively atmosphere.
Using the excuse of inviting him to the seat, Qi Cang naturally grabbed Jiang Cheng’s hand.
Not far off, Ling Yi, who was smiling and chatting with an Alchemy Master from a nearby sect, also quietly closed his mouth, his gaze fixed on their hands.
The Great Elder Xu Yuan Can activated his spiritual power, his Divine Mansion was ready to go.
The invited Eldest Prince also inexplicably paused.
And all the True Disciples looked over in unison.
After all, Jiang Cheng was only at Celestial Fate First Layer; these sudden gazes and change in atmosphere, he could keenly sense.
But ultimately, he couldn’t predict the target was the ring, couldn’t match Qi Cang’s long-planned move.
The storage ring on the middle finger of his left hand suddenly slipped out, entering Qi Cang’s palm.
Immediately following, Qi Cang gave a fierce push, using the momentum to swiftly fly backward, creating distance between them.
Brother Cheng was utterly baffled.
Old brother, what do you mean?
Why did you snatch my storage ring?
Though that ring contained a hundred thousand top-grade Spirit Stones and fifty bottles of Fifth Grade Pills.
Oh, and a few sets of spare clothes.
Brother Cheng, engaged in a ’high-risk profession,’ dying was routine, so preparing a few sets of clothes was perfectly reasonable, wasn’t it?
But you’re the young master of the Eight Clouds Hall, shouldn’t this stuff mean nothing to you?
Spending half the day busy for just this junk?
Even if you fancied it, there’s no need to grab it in front of so many people, isn’t it shameful?
He couldn’t comprehend it at all.
Qi Cang’s sudden act shocked all the guests present.
Even many unknowing disciples were utterly confused.
This was a grand ceremony, in full view, outright robbing a guest’s belongings, wasn’t that...
Too disgraceful for the Eight Clouds Hall?
If word got out, it would probably be scorned for hundreds of years.
But Qi Cang didn’t care much anymore, with the ring in hand, the opportunity was also within reach!
Thinking about the Tier Nine Spirit Talisman and other equal-tier treasures inside the ring, he could hardly hold back the urge to laugh out loud.
With these ’treasures,’ even the Qianxing Dynasty couldn’t suppress him anymore, who cares about others’ opinions?
Jiang Cheng, inexplicably at Celestial Fate First Layer, to prevent pursuit, Qi Cang’s first thought was to escape.
"Block him!"
In this urgent situation, he didn’t even have time to probe with spiritual power divine thought, to see what was inside the ring.
Immediately, a swift attack came straight at him!

chapters.title: Chapter 74: A Great Show
chapters.content:
Chapter 74: Chapter 74: A Great Show
Above, the blue-green Divine Mansion resembled a celestial palace, exquisite and radiant.
Tidal waves of spiritual power pressed towards him!
Before he even arrived, his path forward was blocked.
Great Elder Xu Yuancan had made his move!
This ring must not fall into Qi Cang’s hands; otherwise, Ling Yi would have no standing to contend with him.
"Xu Yuancan!"
Qi Cang roared in fury.
"You old dog dare do this!"
He had been confident his plan had succeeded, not anticipating another competitor existed.
Xu Yuancan was at the Celestial Fate Fourth Layer; he couldn’t hope to defeat him.
Forced to retreat swiftly, several Celestial Fate Elders from Ling Yi’s faction attacked from the sides and rear.
In a desperate situation, Qi Cang took a gamble.
You forced my hand!
He decided swiftly, no longer caring what was inside the ring, he wiped it decisively and threw out an object!
"Die, all of you!"
"Hahaha..."
Seeing a chicken-egg-sized treasure emitting a green glow being thrown, Xu Yuancan and the other Elders were scared out of their wits.
They all knew Jiang Cheng’s ring contained a Tier Nine Spirit Talisman.
Throwing it is equivalent to a full-force attack from a Daoist Palace Realm.
Though Celestial Fate Realm, even they could not withstand it.
Even if they miraculously survived, they would surely be grievously injured.
"Qi Cang, you’re ruthless!"
Fearful, Xu Yuancan could only flee madly.
He desperately activated his Divine Mansion and Spirit Armor, forming a strong defense.
He never thought Qi Cang would be so determined!
He used such an uncontrollable killer in the core of the Eight Clouds Hall.
This strike would surely bury tens of thousands with it!
At that moment, all seats in the plaza were upended, fruits and vegetables scattered in the sky.
Shouts filled the air, plunging the scene into complete chaos.
Grumble...
The egg-sized ’treasure’ eventually landed, rolling on the ground for several turns before coming to a halt.
The crowd was terrified, yet the anticipated explosion didn’t occur.
Upon closer inspection, it was just a Top-grade Spirit Stone.
This...
Xu Yuancan and the others had already fled dozens of miles high in the sky.
Looking back, they were stupefied.
Had they been frightened into flight by a mere Spirit Stone?
Pfft!
Brother Cheng laughed aloud.
What were these people doing?
Was this a grand comedy performance?
An encore? Was this part of the ceremony?
If so, at least use a better prop; isn’t a Top-grade Spirit Stone lacking in persuasiveness?
Qi Cang, bewildered, began doubting reality.
This wasn’t the scene he expected; had he mistakenly grabbed the wrong object in haste?
Yes, that must be it!
He quickly searched with his divine thought, intent on finding the Tier Nine Spirit Talisman to stabilize the situation.
But it was too late.
In his moment of hesitation, his right arm holding the ring was sliced off by a flash of sword light.
The hand clutching the ring loosened, and the ring flew free.
A gray robe flashed by, seizing the ring and soaring skyward!
"Lu Zhong..."
"How dare you!"
Qi Cang, now with blood pouring from his lost arm, was livid and furious!
In this critical moment, the one who stabbed him in the back and seized the ring was his most trusted Lu Zhong.
Yet Lu Zhong disregarded Qi Cang’s fury entirely.
He indeed once supported Qi Cang, but that was in the past.
He had been merely a first-level Celestial Fate at the bottom among Council Elders, limited by his potential in this lifetime.
Supporting Qi Cang was a gamble on possibly improving his status should Qi Cang become Sect Leader.
But now, he was making a second gamble in his life.
Why should the ring stay with Qi Cang?
Why couldn’t he claim it for himself?
Getting this opportunity might overturn fate, allowing him to reach the Daoist Palace Realm, so why be others’ stepping stone?
No need to remain under anyone else!
Without lingering, he took advantage of the elders’ retreat-induced gap to escape through a flaw in the encirclement.
Transformed into a long arc of light, he fled beyond the mountain gates.
In that instant, everyone was too late to pursue.
Rumble!
Atop the distant sky, a burst of flames exploded.
A mighty Divine Mansion, swirling purple, gray, blue, and green, descended from above the clouds, knocking Lu Zhong down from the sky.
High above, a white-clad Ling Yi held the ring aloft, appearing like an immortal descending to the world.
Finally, he acted decisively.
"Ling Yi..."
Lu Zhong, who had been struck down, wore a bitter expression, knowing the ring would never belong to him now.
Had he known Ling Yi also eyed this opportunity, he wouldn’t have muddied the waters.
Qi Cang, with a severed arm, raged like a berserk beast, charging towards the sky.
He couldn’t accept this outcome.
How many efforts had he put into Jiang Cheng’s opportunity?
Ultimately to be intercepted by another?
But as soon as he ascended, Xu Yuancan and others, who had returned, blocked him; he couldn’t even approach Ling Yi.
"Qi Cang, thank you for the opportunity!"
Triumphant with the ring, Ling Yi felt on top of the world, as if even the Palace Master was beneath him.
With such a tremendous opportunity and his talent, he felt no need for concealment.
He could fully release his edge!
But in the next moment, his smile froze.
Bang!
A massive light beam, thousands of meters thick, shot up from the ground, arriving like lightning.
Ling Yi had no time to evade, hit directly, his entire being engulfed by the beam.
The Eight Clouds Hall’s Sect Protection Array—activated!
Generally, even natural operation of the array attacks wouldn’t target sect disciples.
But exceptions exist.
Like when someone manually manipulates the array’s core center.
In Eight Clouds Hall, only Sect Leader Qi Yuansheng could achieve this.
The importance of the Sect Protection Array is such that only the Sect Leader has direct control.
The rapid series of events left many still unclear; Ling Yi had already fallen.
His elegant white robe vanished, easily destroyed by the array’s attack.
The Eight Clouds Hall’s Sect Protection Array could resist even an expert of the Daoist Palace Realm for a moment.
What hope then against a mere Celestial Fate First Layer?
Even if Ling Yi was a top genius with extraordinary encounters, capable of defeating typical Celestial Fate Third Layer, it was futile.
Had he not worn Eighth Grade Spirit Armor, and reached Celestial Fate First Layer, with exceptional constitution, he would be utterly obliterated by this strike.
Even so, he suffered severe injuries.
His exposed skin beyond the Spirit Armor was unmarred.
Blood flowed freely, his appearance terrifying, his former splendor gone.
Qi Yuansheng stood over the ruins, the ring in his possession.
Below, Ling Yi moved weakly, fumbling for pills to shove into his mouth, blood unceasing from his throat.
Never in life had he been so wretched.
After striking down Lu Zhong, it was his life’s pinnacle moment.
Who knew life’s ups and downs could come so suddenly?
Reaching his highest, events struck him down.
Qi Yuansheng, holding the ring, didn’t spare him a glance.
As if this person wasn’t even a disciple.
"Have you all forgotten there’s a Palace Master in Eight Clouds Hall?"

chapters.title: Chapter 75: The Righteous and Dignified Eldest Prince
chapters.content:
Chapter 75: Chapter 75: The Righteous and Dignified Eldest Prince
His gaze swept over all the council elders and true disciples before landing on his son, Qi Cang.
But it only stayed there for a second.
Xu Yuancan and Lu Zhong and the others had bitter and gloomy expressions.
Qi Yuansheng’s simple words made them understand everything.
Yes, they forgot, the Palace Master of the Eight Clouds Hall is not just a mascot.
Qi Cang has factions, Ling Yi has followers, the Great Elder and Lu Zhong and others have disciples and connections.
But in this Eight Clouds Hall, whose influence could surpass the Palace Master?
None, neither openly nor covertly.
Qi Cang’s little schemes in Qinglan Prefecture could never have been hidden from him.
From that time onwards, Feixian Sect probably came under this Palace Master’s radar.
Ling Yi’s attempt to intercept also couldn’t escape his notice.
This deeply hidden hunter had always been silent, merely watching the two groups plan and scheme.
In his eyes, Qi Cang and Ling Yi’s conspiracies were just little tricks of the younger generation.
And now, the ring had finally fallen into his hands.
Brother Cheng stood there, feeling a sense of enlightenment while also a bit inexplicable.
What exactly happened?
Wasn’t it agreed that I’m the protagonist?
Why is no one trying to kill me?
Why are you fighting among yourselves?
Just for that ring?
A ring with some spirit stones, elixirs, and clothes?
Is Eight Clouds Hall really that poor?
Fighting endlessly for such a common storage ring, even deploying the sect protection array, almost crushing each other’s brains?
It’s a miracle this sect has survived for over 40,000 years!
Now I’m standing idle, not even considered a side character—just a background prop, and nobody cares about that, a bit awkward indeed.
Clap, clap, clap!
Amidst the silence, the clapping sound of the Eldest Prince Xiang Ba was exceptionally harsh.
"Eldest Prince, this is an internal affair of our Eight Clouds Hall, and I hope Your Highness will not interfere!"
Qi Yuansheng’s expression didn’t change, it was impossible that this matter wouldn’t alert the Eldest Prince.
This was always within his expectations.
"Internal affair?"
Xiang Ba floated in front of him, while the corner of his eye fell on Jiang Cheng.
"How come I remember that the ring in your hand initially belonged to Sect Leader Jiang?"
"What do you mean?"
By this point, Qi Yuansheng also knew that it was impossible to maintain a facade of respect with the Eldest Prince, so his tone naturally turned cold.
In the face of treasures, everything else is just an illusion.
"What do I mean?"
Xiang Ba raised his hand to point at Jiang Cheng, his tone turning righteous and indignant.
"I just can’t stand you prestigious sects bullying and robbing a young sect leader."
Pointed out like this, Brother Cheng felt a bit more aware.
Is it finally my turn to make an appearance?
But brother, isn’t calling me a young sect leader a bit too dismissive?
"If I hadn’t seen it, it could have been ignored, but seeing it, I can’t just let it go!"
His words were thunderous, filled with righteousness.
If someone saw this for the first time, they might really think he was here to uphold justice.
But those present weren’t new to the cultivation realm and wouldn’t be swayed by a few pretty words.
Qi Yuansheng even sneered.
"Heh, Xiang Ba, if you want the ring, just say so, why use such a lofty excuse?"
Does he take him for a three-year-old child?
Wanting to snatch it and still looking for a high-sounding reason, being a hypocrite while erecting a monument of virtue.
"It seems you don’t want to hand it over?"
As Xiang Ba finished speaking, his four Celestial Fate realm guards had already spread out, blocking Qi Yuansheng’s retreat.
On the Eight Clouds Hall’s side, the Elders were still hesitating.
It wasn’t that they didn’t want to support Qi Yuansheng, but the enemy was too powerful.
Among the Eldest Prince’s guards, the weakest was still Celestial Fate Sixth Layer, stronger than anyone here.
If a fight really broke out, the consequences would be disastrous.
"You seem to have forgotten, this is Eight Clouds Hall."
Qi Yuansheng chuckled quietly, in his palm, a floating transparent spirit crystal rotated slowly, serving as the control core of the sect protection array.
If he activated the sect protection array, then...
The chances of survival for the Eldest Prince’s group were grim, after all, as strong as they were, they were still within the Celestial Fate realm.
"Qi Yuansheng, dare you to activate it and see!"
Xiang Ba’s tone suddenly turned harsh, which was actually why he hadn’t immediately ordered his palace guards to act.
This was indeed Eight Clouds Hall, Qi Yuansheng’s home court advantage was too strong.
If he had known about the ring earlier, giving him ample time to prepare, there might have been a chance.
But he got the news too late, now he could only rely on intimidating them.
"Qi Yuansheng, you should know, our Qianxing Dynasty has a Daoist Palace Venerable stationed!"
"Unless the ring contains a world-class treasure beyond the limits of a Tier Nine Spiritual Artifact, handing it over is the wisest choice."
A Tier Nine Spirit Talisman equals a full strike of a Daoist Palace Realm, ultimately still less than a genuine Daoist Palace Realm expert.
"Xiang Ba, do you really think I dare not?"
Qi Yuansheng faced two choices before him.
Hand over the ring.
Or use the array to trap and kill the Eldest Prince’s group here.
Of course, he didn’t want to hand it over.
But the latter choice had a major flaw, there were too many people here.
Unless he silenced everyone, the news would eventually reach the Qianxing Dynasty, and by then the Daoist Palace Realm would intervene...
If this ring contained treasures beyond spiritual artifacts, he might gamble everything!
Even if he had to sacrifice the foundation of Eight Clouds Hall, he wouldn’t hesitate!
In the stalemate, he activated his spiritual power with great anticipation, breaking the ring’s restriction, probing inside for ’treasures.’
Then, in the next moment, his expression became extraordinarily wonderful.
There was shock, disbelief, confusion, daze...
The ups and downs of life were indeed too thrilling; he felt he had never experienced such intense emotional changes in his life.
Inside the ring were only a hundred thousand top-grade spirit stones, fifty bottles of fifth-grade pills, and a few sets of clothes.
No Tier Nine Spirit Talisman, no Tier Nine Spiritual Artifact, and not even any other dazzling rare treasures.
This was less than a percent of his personal collection.
He had just used the grand array for this, watched his son have an arm severed, activated an array to eliminate the sect’s top true disciple, and offended the Eldest Prince?
He suddenly looked towards Jiang Cheng in the distance, his gaze like the flames of hell, filled with uncontrollable rage!
Betrayed!
This ’cunning and treacherous’ kid used a fake ring to lure him in, fooling everyone completely!
A single fake ring caused internal strife within Eight Clouds Hall, truly vicious!
"You accursed little thief!"
Brother Cheng could feel the fiery gaze hot enough to melt rocks; he felt very innocent.
Is he out of his mind, someone stealing my ring and then staring at me like a patricidal enemy?
Isn’t that too unreasonable?
I haven’t even done anything.
"Qi Yuansheng, I’d advise you to think carefully..."
Xiang Ba still didn’t know there was nothing valuable in the ring and was still thinking of using intimidation.
Because he wasn’t sure whether Qi Yuansheng would activate the array to kill everyone here, he could only bring up the authority of the Daoist Palace Realm to suppress him.
"Ha..."
Qi Yuansheng suddenly seemed to have aged hundreds of years.
"Since you want it, then take it."
Under the eyes of the stunned, envious, or eager onlookers, he tossed the ring over.

chapters.title: Chapter 76: The 5-Colored Divine Mansion
chapters.content:
Chapter 76: Chapter 76: The 5-Colored Divine Mansion
The Eldest Prince didn’t expect him to "surrender" so easily.
Originally, he thought he’d need more means.
So much so that when the ring landed in his hand, it felt a bit unreal.
"Very well, Qi Yuansheng, you’ve made the right choice."
Having gained the advantage, he still wanted to play nice.
"Ha, hahaha..."
Qi Yuansheng suddenly threw his head back in laughter, the sound full of mockery.
"The right choice?"
"Take a look for yourself."
He suddenly didn’t feel so bad anymore.
After all, it wasn’t just him who fell for it; even the Eldest Prince was played by that kid.
"Hmm?"
Xiang Ba’s sword-like brows furrowed as he sent his divine thought into the storage ring.
Immediately, his expression became a bit dazed as well.
Where was the promised Tier Nine Spirit Talisman?
Where was the promised great opportunity, the rare treasure?
This was it?
The entire snatching process between Qi Cang, Lu Zhong, Ling Yi, and Qi Yuansheng had happened right under his nose, so there was no possibility of a swap.
He abruptly turned around, his piercing gaze locked onto Jiang Cheng.
"Hand over that ring."
Even without the use of his Divine Mansion’s pressure, the words carried a heavy oppression that made it hard to defy.
Unfortunately, this didn’t include Brother Cheng.
No one in this world could intimidate him; who did Xiang Ba think he was?
He just found it all quite amusing.
Damn, you guys stole my ring and then came to me asking for what I owed?
These maneuvers, you’re playing them well.
"What ring?"
Honestly, to this day, he still didn’t know what exactly this group of people was fighting over.
"It’s foolish to buy time with tricks."
"Hand over the Tier Nine Spirit Talisman and Spiritual Artifact, surrender all your chances!"
Xiang Ba walked through the air, his face sullen, pressing towards him step by step.
"Tier Nine Spirit Talisman?"
Brother Cheng finally understood.
It wasn’t that he was slow on the uptake; it was just that his system had given him a Tier Nine Spirit Talisman, which disappeared once used.
He knew this very well.
He naturally wouldn’t fantasize about having more Tier Nine Spirit Talismans, Spiritual Artifacts, and further opportunities.
But to his surprise, this group of self-conceited individuals was fantasizing on his behalf.
Realizing all this almost made him laugh out loud.
These people were truly skilled!
Each one was cunning and calculating, patient, and scheming, all for a ’chance’ that only existed in assumptions.
And now, they still believed he had that ring filled with Tier Nine Spirit Talismans.
They seemed foolish, but if it were indeed a fortunate cultivator who had gained an opportunity, they really might have been harmed under this group’s plotting.
Xiang Ba was already in front of him, ready to strike at any moment.
"Do you think you still have the chance to throw out a spirit talisman in front of me?"
Deep down, he didn’t fully trust his chances; he was using words to weaken Jiang Cheng’s psychological defenses.
Those four palace guards had already quietly shifted their positions, surrounding Jiang Cheng.
"Hand it over now, and I might spare your life. You don’t have much time."
Don’t, please don’t spare my life.
Brother Cheng indicated he wanted nothing more than to be killed.
"Weren’t you just righteously offering to stand up for me?"
"Didn’t you say you couldn’t tolerate a grand sect bullying a young sect leader?"
This deliberate sarcasm was blatant mockery.
Xiang Ba couldn’t maintain his composure, but his face showed no anger. His city mansion was extremely deep; in his eyes, Jiang Cheng was already a dead man.
"It seems you want to die."
His Divine Mansion ascended, spiritual qi draped down like waterfalls, with faint martial dao marks flowing within, atmospheric and majestic.
The grand Divine Mansion exuded a destructive aura, making all who beheld it fear it.
Everyone on the scene gasped in amazement, overwhelmed with shock.
Because that Divine Mansion was five-colored!
Similar to the Spirit Platform, after cultivating a Divine Mansion, celestial fate cultivators also had tiers.
The most intuitive difference was the color.
Each color represented a brand of a martial dao rule.
Lu Zhong and Ling Yi were both in the first layer of celestial fate, but because Lu Zhong’s Divine Mansion only had gray and cyan colors while Ling Yi had purple, gray, blue, and cyan four colors, there was a vast difference in power between them.
Though he was ambushed at that time, he was defeated in just one blow.
Ling Yi was the top true disciple of the Eight Clouds Hall and was recognized as the strongest talent in Feiyun State, and he had just shown a four-colored Divine Mansion.
A four-colored Divine Mansion was already quite rare, making many people sigh in admiration.
And now, Xiang Ba’s Divine Mansion had one more color than his!
The terrifying talent of this Eldest Prince from the Qianxing Dynasty was evident.
Jiang Cheng was finished.
This was the thought in everyone’s minds.
Although he wanted to die very much, Brother Cheng didn’t immediately summon his Divine Mansion to charge forward.
The reason was simple: if he charged forward now, and then got taken down by Xiang Ba, the system would only mark Xiang Ba and his four guards as enemies, as they were considered one faction.
As for the group from Eight Clouds Hall and the other guests who arrived, they belonged to two other groups.
These people didn’t have any designs on him; it was just that Xiang Ba was too overpowering, intimidating everyone, so they couldn’t show their faces.
So if he was resurrected and went on the attack, he’d only take down Xiang Ba and those four guards, but not the group from Eight Clouds Hall.
Therefore, he needed to draw some hatred to make the system mark everyone as enemies that wanted to kill him.
This... required acting skills!
So in the next moment, he began screaming as if he was in extreme fear.
"Master Qi, are you just going to watch?"
"I am your honored guest, invited here by you, aren’t you going to do something?"
"Does the dignified Eight Clouds Hall not take responsibility for guest safety?"
His cries sounded as miserable as could be, as heart-wrenching as could be.
It perfectly matched the reaction of someone desperately seeking a lifeline when pushed to the brink.
This kid still saw himself as an honored guest, leaving everyone speechless.
Don’t you know you’re just a fool who got caught in a trap?
Qi Yuansheng hated him to the core, even wishing to tear him to pieces himself; how could he possibly save him?
But on second thought, it was also an opportunity.
"Kid, if you hand over all the treasures to me, I can help you destroy Xiang Ba!"
If he got those treasures, activating the great array to destroy Xiang Ba would be a must.
At worst, he could just flee far away afterward.
He said this through a voice transmission, so Xiang Ba didn’t hear.
But now, worried that Jiang Cheng might toss out a spirit talisman at any moment, he was really reluctant to attack immediately.
Jiang Cheng hadn’t even had time to respond, and he already heard the voice transmission in his ear from Great Elder Xu Yuancan.
"Hand over your opportunity to me, and I have a way to keep you safe!"
It wasn’t just him; others also saw the opportunity and eagerly threw out olive branches.
"Choose me if you want to survive; Qi Yuansheng will definitely backstab you!"
"Give the opportunity to me, and I’ll escort you out of Eight Clouds Hall; I am a man of my word!"
"Our Celestial Pill Pavilion stands above all, unafraid of the Qianxing Dynasty, young friend, you can temporarily store that opportunity with me..."
There were too many voice transmissions, and Brother Cheng indicated he couldn’t respond to them all.
Glancing around, whether it was the elders of Eight Clouds Hall or the various major forces’ guests who had come, they all wore expressions of desire.
Each promised that as long as he handed over the ring, they would protect him.
Brother Cheng could only find it funny.
You old foxes don’t even dare to say it to Xiang Ba’s face; it’s clear you’re afraid of him. And you say you’ll protect me, who are you fooling?
Moreover, that wasn’t the result he wanted.
He wanted everyone to want to kill him, not for each one to insincerely claim they wanted to protect him.
Helplessly, he could only start taking off his outer robe.

chapters.title: Chapter 77: Brilliant 9 Colors
chapters.content:
Chapter 77: Chapter 77: Brilliant 9 Colors
Jiang Cheng wasn’t foolish; he could see that these people were all acting out of greed for the treasure.
Not to mention keeping himself safe, even if he could, they’d definitely turn on him afterward.
So while taking off his outer robe, he exposed all those old schemers who were secretly sending voice transmissions.
"Sigh, there’s no need to whisper, everyone. Let me be clear, I don’t have the treasure you’re talking about."
After removing the outer robe, he gave it a shake.
"If you don’t believe me, have a look."
He was going to die soon anyway, and the robe would be destroyed if not taken off.
"I really don’t have it. I don’t even know why you think I have a lot of Tier Nine Spirit Talismans."
"The one from last time was just a coincidence—it was only one!"
He looked innocent, desperately trying to prove his ’innocence.’
This time coming to Eight Clouds Hall, aside from an Empty Ring and a ring on his finger filled with some Spirit Stone Elixirs, along with two spiritual artifacts he’d won, he really didn’t have anything else related to cultivation.
He hadn’t even brought basic strategic resources like weapons and Spirit Talisman Array Discs.
The last time the system inexplicably upgraded the spirit talisman, Qi Cang, Lu Zhong, and the others were shocked, while Brother Cheng was rather annoyed.
Once again, it was a one-time show-off tool; once used, it was gone and couldn’t last.
So this time, he simply didn’t bring such things to see how the system would handle it.
Nobody could guess his thoughts.
Everyone’s expression was a bit stunned; what was this maneuver?
They finally believed that Jiang Cheng truly had no other treasures.
But now, they somewhat suspected that this person might be an idiot.
If someone says you have something, you better really have it. Even if you don’t, you should pretend to, otherwise you’re truly doomed.
Xiang Ba looked at him like a circus clown and suddenly regretted.
When entering the mountain gate, he was actually intimidated by such a minor character, and even ceded the way to him. He should’ve slapped him to death back then.
"You truly deserve to die."
He slowly summoned his spirit sword.
Jiang Cheng seemed ’terrified,’ quickly looking around for help.
"Sect Leader Qi, you just transmitted that you were willing to save me, save me quickly!"
"Elder Xu, you said you had a way to resist Xiang Ba..."
"Master Mo, you said you could take me all the way through the siege. I absolutely believe in you!"
"Master Tong, isn’t your Celestial Pill Pavilion known for not acknowledging the Qianxing Dynasty, just say a word..."
In the blink of an eye, he exposed all the prominent figures who had been transmitting secretly just now.
It enraged them.
This damned guy, some words are okay to say in a transmission, but not when laid bare.
When transmitting, to deceive him into giving a ring, of course, they boasted as much as they could.
In reality, how dare they truly offend the Qianxing Dynasty.
"Heh..."
"Hahaha!"
Xiang Ba was so angry he started laughing, his gaze like a blade as it swept over each person.
"You truly have the nerve!"
The crowd was scared out of their wits, quickly distancing themselves from Jiang Cheng.
"May the Eldest Prince discern clearly, this thief is spouting nonsense, I, Xu Yuancan, can’t kill him fast enough, how could I protect him?"
"Indeed, my Bai Fu Hall wouldn’t dare oppose the Eldest Prince!"
"As long as there’s a command, we three from Fire Cloud Peak are willing to help the Eldest Prince kill this filth!"
"This thief is still trying to splash my Celestial Pill Pavilion with dirt, it’s absolutely abhorrent. Please, Eldest Prince, kill him quickly, and I’ll be forever grateful!"
If Jiang Cheng truly had a ring, they might take the risk.
A great treasure is worth the risk.
Without a ring, they wouldn’t dare oppose the Eldest Prince.
In no time, Jiang Cheng became the public enemy.
However, he wasn’t satisfied yet.
"Do you all want me dead?"
Brother Cheng’s acting was on a different level from those disciples earlier.
That expression couldn’t be more tragic, couldn’t be more disappointed.
If you observed closely, you could even see the glistening light of sorrow in his eyes.
And all the people present didn’t disappoint him.
"Kill him!"
"Eldest Prince, quickly kill him!"
"He’s the source of this chaos. He must be removed to quell the public anger!"
Everyone was filled with righteous indignation, their attitudes unprecedentedly unified, as if Jiang Cheng had killed all their fathers.
Most were trying to curry favor with the Eldest Prince, and some were angry and embarrassed because their hope of obtaining a ring had been dashed.
As for the last part, they stood with Eight Clouds Hall, viewing Jiang Cheng as the enemy.
Great, great, Brother Cheng’s heart was elated.
Well, this is your choice, not something I forced or led you to do! Heaven and Earth bear witness!
Now everyone present wanted to kill him, and the moment he was killed, the system would determine all present as enemies.
"Truly pathetic..."
The Eldest Prince’s smile was mocking, like watching an insect struggle futilely in a spider’s web.
"Now killing you has become what everyone wants."
"Given the chance to seek help, you were useless, and you still face inescapable death."
Brother Cheng cheerfully watched him deliver his victor’s declaration, finally offering some encouragement.
"Well, you better give it your best shot."
Best shot at killing me soon.
After speaking, he revealed his Divine Mansion.
Suddenly, the sky changed color!
The Divine Mansion descended with a roar, surrounded by nine-colored radiance, with nine martial rivers hanging in the air.
Densely packed mysterious marks slowly flowed through the steaming mist, emitting mesmerizing brilliance!
The Divine Mansion flickered amidst the rivers and mist, even incomprehensible with Divine Thought.
However, everyone knew what this meant.
"Radiant Divine Mansion!"
Qi Yuansheng was full of disbelief, no longer as composed as before.
The Great Elder even shrieked.
"Nine colors! It’s actually nine colors!"
To them, that Divine Mansion in the sky was an impossible miracle, like the reversal of the star river.
"Heavens, such a tier of Divine Mansion truly exists beyond mere legend!"
"Nine is the ultimate number..."
"It’s said that the Nine-Colored Divine Mansion is revered as the Radiant Divine Mansion, encompassing all Martial Dao Marks, all-encompassing..."
"Whoever possesses the Radiant Divine Mansion will surely ascend to the Saint Tier in the future!"
No one could remain calm.
Some disciples with low cultivation even knelt on the spot due to their minds being captivated by that Divine Mansion.
It was the yearning and reverence for the pinnacle of Martial Dao...
In this moment, whether Qi Cang or Ling Yi, they lost their previous aura of genius, becoming utterly ordinary.
Xiang Ba’s Five-Colored Divine Mansion hadn’t even clashed with that Radiant Divine Mansion but was already teetering.
That was the natural chasm in Divine Mansion Tiers, an instinctive retreat!
When the Martial Dao Marks between the two Divine Mansions collided, the Five-Colored Divine Mansion faded as if its rivers were being drawn out.
He suddenly realized that the Radiant Divine Mansion was actually extracting his Martial Dao Enlightenment.
This person must not be allowed to remain!
"Kill!"
He was even grateful for encountering Jiang Cheng today, for otherwise, if this person grew smoothly, the Qianxing Dynasty would have to defer to him.
That was the Radiant Divine Mansion!
Even among the sons and daughters of Ancient Sacred Land’s emperors and saints, none possessed it.
In Jiang Cheng’s eyes, it was as if an entire sun had ignited; he could see nothing else, his vision, his Divine Sense, all were filled with blazing light.
The Eldest Prince’s first strike was the Qianxing Dynasty’s secret technique, the Emperor’s Extreme Shocking Sun Slash!
With his Ninth Layer Celestial Fate power, the secret technique’s might was sufficient to level the main peaks of Eight Clouds Hall within hundreds of miles with a single blow.

chapters.title: Chapter 78: Don’t even know about the siege?
chapters.content:
Chapter 78: Chapter 78: Don’t even know about the siege?
Jiang Cheng stepped forward.
He really wanted to stand still and be killed by this strike.
But there was no way, if he fought passively, the system would deem he wanted to commit suicide.
Compared to Xiang Ba, he had a major disadvantage: he didn’t have the ultimate cultivation technique or top-notch martial arts secret techniques.
Currently, all he knew was the Duanmu Family’s Dark Spring Sealing Flame Sword.
Even though he had cultivated this martial technique to the peak, its upper limit was just so.
The Duanmu Family is too low-end...
Moreover, his Celestial Fate First Layer was a full eight small realms lower than the opponent’s.
This battle seemed destined to be a crushing defeat.
However, the Radiant Divine Mansion was just too heaven-defying.
Just as he was engulfed by that blazing golden sun, the Divine Mansion shone brightly.
Everyone in the Eight Clouds Hall seemed to hear a bell toll.
Dong!
The bell sound was long and distant, and it felt like a misheard illusion.
It seemed to come from ancient times, yet also from the depth of the soul...
Subsequently, the vast golden sun faded away like melting ice and snow.
The sky became clear again.
Guided by the Divine Mansion, Xiang Ba’s figure once again appeared in front of his sword’s edge.
"This is impossible!"
Xiang Ba shouted in a hoarse voice, eight small realms apart, how could it be?
He suddenly had a mad thought.
The Radiant Divine Mansion should not exist in this world!
Boom!
The two finally clashed head-on.
The Dark Spring Sealing Flame Sword was far inferior to the Emperor’s Extreme Shocking Sun Slash, yet the result of the collision was evenly matched.
Countless icy black qi surged around that scorching sun, but it couldn’t break free.
All this, of course, was still due to the Radiant Divine Mansion.
With the Martial Dao Mark of the Divine Mansion’s blessing, the power of the Dark Spring Sealing Flame Sword had long surpassed its original limits.
If someone from the Duanmu Family revived and saw this scene, they wouldn’t know whether to feel depressed or proud.
Could their family’s swordsmanship have such a terrifying effect?
Boom boom boom...
The two fought from the ground to the sky!
Even the aftermath caused countless mountains around to collapse and rivers to flow backward!
If the Sect Protection Array of the Eight Clouds Hall weren’t still active, the main peak would have been destroyed by now.
Watching the two constantly shimmering and changing figures high in the sky, everyone felt a deep sense of powerlessness.
That was a level beyond their understanding...
Ling Yi felt an uncontrollable jealousy.
At first, he even thought casually disposing of Jiang Cheng after snatching the ring.
Now thinking about it, it’s simply a fool’s dream.
Qi Cang and Lu Zhong both felt fortunate that during the previous attack on the Feixian Sect, they hadn’t dealt a fatal blow to Jiang Cheng.
Otherwise, they would have died back then, right?
Qi Yuansheng had a somber face, internally in an intense struggle.
He had only one thought now: if the Eldest Prince couldn’t dispose of Jiang Cheng, then activate the Great Array to get rid of him!
The Eight Clouds Hall had already offended this peerless genius, he must not be allowed to remain!
The Jiang Cheng who was fighting in the sky, however, was rather displeased.
It was another instance of wasted time without a clear victor.
Given that he was eight small realms beneath Xiang Ba, winning was nearly impossible; managing this much was already a miracle.
If this continued, when would he finally be killed?
After yet another collision, he took the opportunity to shout.
"You idiot! With this little power, you insist on a one-on-one? Your brain must be full of shit?"
Suddenly hearing this, Xiang Ba almost doubted whether his ears were having auditory hallucinations due to the intense battle.
What?
Is this a hint for me to gang up on him?
He’s not satisfied fighting one-on-one?
And called him names with such vulgarity?
Utter nonsense!
He initially thought he could handle it alone, but as the fight dragged on and he couldn’t win, the thought of ganging up felt like it would disgrace the Qianxing Dynasty.
Now it seemed gang assaults were indeed necessary.
"All together!"
"Kill him!"
Upon receiving the order, four Palace Guards flew up into the sky to join the fight.
After being subtly prompted, this idiot finally realized the need to gang up, Brother Cheng was rather gratified.
Of the four guards, one was Celestial Fate Eighth Layer, two Seventh Layer, and one Sixth Layer.
Their combat strength wasn’t very different from Jiang Cheng’s.
With four joining in, the balance was immediately broken.
Under the assault of five, Jiang Cheng didn’t last long and was eventually killed as he wished.
Until his death, Xiang Ba finally let out a long breath.
Before the gang assault, he was under immense pressure; it was the toughest battle he had ever encountered in his life.
"Finally dead."
Countless people had this thought in their minds.
Since they were all standing in opposition to Jiang Cheng, they really couldn’t rest easy as long as he was alive.
"Sect Leader Qi, regarding today’s incident, you will need to personally go to the Qianxing Dynasty and provide an explanation."
Upon hearing this, Qi Yuansheng’s face turned very unpleasant.
Today’s ceremony was completely ruined.
What kind of situation is this? After a whole day of trouble, losing two true disciples and creating infighting among the higher-ups, in the end, they gained nothing and were left in a worse position.
Going to the Qianxing Dynasty to apologize, needless to say, would be exceedingly costly.
Looking at Jiang Cheng’s corpse on the ground, he wished he could stab it a thousand times more.
"Ding, host killed, assessing enemy strength, arranging resurrection plan."
"Ding, host acquired one drop of Ancient Cyan Dragon Essence Blood."
Azure Dragon Essence Blood?
What’s that?
Brother Cheng, now a spirit, was a bit confused.
Is this the plan devised by the system?
Is that Azure Dragon Essence Blood some kind of big killer?
And only giving a drop, isn’t that stingy?
"Ding, host resurrected."
Meanwhile, Xiang Ba was still lecturing.
"And as for that Feixian Sect of his, I shall personally dismantle it."
Since Jiang Cheng didn’t carry any treasures, he decided to visit his sect.
Perhaps his opportunities were left there?
The only concern was that Tiger Demon suspected to be in the Celestial Fate Ninth Layer.
Then he realized everyone’s eyes suddenly changed.
Everyone was looking in one direction.
Xiang Ba spread out his divine thought, abruptly turned around, full of disbelief.
Jiang Cheng’s corpse was gone!
"What?"
"Where did he go?"
For a moment, there was chaos among the crowd.
Xiang Ba and Qi Yuansheng, along with other experts, searched far and wide with their divine thoughts but found nothing.
This was simply like seeing a ghost.
Jiang Cheng’s disappearance made them a bit uneasy.
And at that moment, a long laugh came from behind.
"Your dad’s over here!"
On top of the hall in front, a newly dressed Jiang Cheng stood proudly with his hands behind him, a green robe fluttering in the wind.
That excessively handsome stature, coupled with the scene, gave a mistaken impression of an immortal.
Not to mention a wound, there wasn’t even any dirt on him.
How is this possible?
Even if there were an elixir that could bring the dead back to life, someone would have had to feed it to him, right?
Not to mention he died on the ground, so how could he suddenly appear at the top of the hall without anyone noticing?
Nobody could understand any of this...
Of course, they didn’t understand...
Brother Cheng deliberately made himself known after adjusting his appearance and changing clothes, to create this very effect.
And here’s what everyone was seeing as a result.

chapters.title: Chapter 79: Azure Dragon Essence Blood
chapters.content:
Chapter 79: Chapter 79: Azure Dragon Essence Blood
Can’t really blame Xiang Ba and the others for making a big fuss.
They can’t possibly guess out of thin air that there’s an invisibility divine skill in this world.
Even if they guessed it, who would think someone would use such a skill for showing off?
Such a precious invisibility, anyone else would definitely use it at critical moments.
Like stealth attacks, stealth reversals in battle outcomes, or even stealth escapes from desperate situations...
Unfortunately, Brother Cheng has different pursuits.
Besides, the showing-off effect of this skill is indeed astonishingly good.
So much so that Xiang Ba was dumbfounded and didn’t dare to make another move for a while.
However, Qi Yuansheng reacted the fastest and directly activated the Sect Protection Array.
But it was already too late.
The array did not attack as expected but was reflected by the sky, turning into a bright red hue.
The red clouds grew increasingly vivid, so much so that many present could no longer distinguish other colors.
"What’s this?"
"Is it an autonomous transformation of the array?"
Most people were still confused, but the elders of Eight Clouds Hall’s senior management knew this was definitely abnormal.
"Did you do this?"
"What did you do!"
With the core control of the array in hand, Qi Yuansheng glared at Jiang Cheng and harshly questioned.
Ah, is the showing-off package coming?
Looks like the effect is not bad at all.
Just a drop of dragon blood, and it can cause such a great spectacle.
He stood tall, raised his head, and proudly declared, "I divinely execute on behalf of the heavens!"
"Just you!"
Xiang Ba finally couldn’t hold back and charged over again with four palace guards.
Qi Yuansheng and Xu Yuancan of Eight Clouds Hall’s high ranks wouldn’t just sit and be killed; this red cloud obviously isn’t normal.
The urgent matter at hand now is to wipe out this kid first!
However, soon everyone’s expressions turned into shock.
They suddenly discovered they couldn’t summon their Divine Mansion.
This is different from Ah Huang emptying spiritual power.
Their spiritual power is still there, and their divine souls aren’t sealed.
Even the concentration of spiritual qi within Eight Clouds Hall’s range was still normal.
Yet they couldn’t use their Divine Mansion.
Not only the Divine Mansion, but even other divine secret techniques couldn’t be used.
The cultivators here were simply far too below the tier of the Ancient Cyan Dragon.
Even more exaggerated than dust compared to mountains.
Even just one drop of essence blood isn’t something the ranks of Xiang Ba and Qi Cang can withstand.
The essence blood hasn’t even descended, yet it had already suppressed them fiercely.
The tremors from deep within their souls made it impossible for them to mobilize their own power smoothly.
Xiang Ba and Qi Yuansheng, alongside other strong individuals, veins bulging, roared in rebellion.
They didn’t want to surrender nor serve.
Spiritual power burst forth uncontrollably, blasting enormous pits.
At this moment, the essence blood formally descended over Eight Clouds Hall.
The surrounding rules of heaven and earth were oppressed and displaced, spiritual qi stagnated, and no one could lift their heads.
The might of the Azure Dragon can easily suppress a region of heaven and earth.
The Celestial Fate cultivators present could no longer resist and fell.
And those below Celestial Fate fared even worse, many vomiting blood on the spot, their blood vessels and meridians burst by the heavy pressure.
"Ah!"
"No..."
The first to die were the disciples of the Gathering Yuan Realm.
Before they died, they didn’t feel much pain.
In an instant, a scene of mountains of corpses and a sea of blood emerged before them, countless ancient demons fell, presenting kaleidoscopic illusions.
The will contained within that drop of essence blood had shattered their divine soul, destroying it to pieces.
The essence blood continued to descend, and each true disciple from Eight Clouds Hall bled from seven orifices, showing eerie expressions as they fell.
"Jiang Cheng..."
"You’re so cruel!"
Bang!
Accompanied by the desperate screams, two elders from Celestial Pill Pavilion exploded and died.
Next, Qi Cang turned completely red, blood seeping through large areas of skin.
He gave one last look at Jiang Cheng standing leisurely in green robes atop the hall.
Opening his mouth, seeming to want to say something, but ultimately unable to voice.
Then, he also fell.
By now, only thirty-plus Celestial Fate tier cultivators remained.
They were still struggling to hold on.
To them, it felt like the sky was falling, and they were straining to bear it.
Yet no matter how they held, the pressure pushed their legs into the ground.
"Sect Leader Jiang..."
The Great Elder of Bai Fu Hall was on the verge of collapse, desperately begged.
"Please spare us, Bai Fu Hall has nothing to do with this..."
At this point, life was more important than anything.
"We were wrong; if you spare us, we will follow Sect Leader Jiang faithfully from now on!"
They thought he had unleashed a great move, little did they know that the dragon blood wasn’t under his control.
Even the prideful Ling Yi restrained his hatred, pretending to be harmless.
"Jiang Cheng... If you let me go, I would be willing to worship you as my master! To be at your service!"
Brother Cheng nearly let out a laugh hearing this.
Does Brother care about you?
Not to mention your treacherous nature, just by talent, you couldn’t compare to our Xiaohan and Xiaoning.
As for that bunch of guests from Bai Fu Hall and Fire Cloud Peak, he hadn’t forgotten their previous faces.
Despite loving to show off, Brother Cheng was never soft-hearted towards enemies.
"I already gave you guys a chance."
"Sadly, you’re just useless!"
He sighed, looking exasperated.
Now, everyone was in despair.
"You demon!"
"You’ll die horribly!"
"You’ll be killed eventually, and die worse than us!"
"We’ll be waiting for you underground!"
A barrage of curses made Brother Cheng burst out laughing.
"Thanks, thank you!"
Brother eagerly wished for the curses to come true, dying a few more times.
As Lu Zhong lay in blood, breathing his last, the glow of the essence blood also corroded the Sect Protection Array completely.
The remaining folks were like ice exposed to a blazing sun, showing signs of melting.
One by one, the Celestial Fate tier fell.
Ling Yi didn’t become an exception, and neither did Xiang Ba.
When that drop of essence blood finally landed in Jiang Cheng’s palm, there was no one alive in Eight Clouds Hall.
Looking at the drop continuously rolling and shining with azure dragon essence blood in his hand, Jiang Cheng couldn’t connect it with the previous sky of red clouds.
Just this little drop killed everyone present?
No need to touch?
This was too domineering, wasn’t it?
He activated Insight to see exactly what this treasure was.
The next second, he was stunned by the long sequence of zeros.
Azure Dragon Essence Blood—9800000000 points.
This thing is actually worth 9.8 billion points, are you kidding me?
Below was a long description.
Azure Dragon Essence Blood—contains the essential blood embodying the will and talent of the Ancient Cyan Dragon.
Can be fused—fusion grants part of the Azure Dragon bloodline and talent.
Can advance—more Azure Dragon essence blood will strengthen and enhance the bloodline talent.
This seems similar in significance to Lin Ning’s Hidden Phoenix Bloodline.
As a ’novice’ in the cultivation realm, he didn’t know which one’s more high-level.
Azure Dragon sounds like it should be more impressive than Hidden Phoenix, right?
Brother Cheng couldn’t remain calm.
He immediately opened the system panel and spent 500 points to ask a question.

chapters.title: Chapter 80 The Wonderful Feeling of Merging with Dragon Blood
chapters.content:
Chapter 80: Chapter 80 The Wonderful Feeling of Merging with Dragon Blood
"System, can I sell this drop of essence blood to you?"
If it were anyone else, they’d definitely fuse and absorb such a rare treasure without a second thought.
But who is Brother Cheng?
His first reaction in a ring guessing game is to find loopholes, could his thoughts be as mundane as everyone else’s?
That’s 9.8 billion points!
If he sold it to the system, how many levels could he zip up to?
Even without leveling up, with 9.8 billion points, he could do lucky draws until his hands got sore.
"The Azure Dragon Essence Blood is a system reward and cannot be recycled."
The system’s answer was concise, he couldn’t sell it.
Jiang Cheng was very disappointed; the system left no loophole, seems he reluctantly had to fuse this essence blood.
The blood quickly merged into his palm, a sharp pain from deep within his veins surged through his body.
The Azure Dragon Essence Blood is not something a cultivator can fuse.
This treasure, even for a Demon King like the Three-Eyed Tiger, would likely result in exploding and dying.
It’s not that the essence blood is poisonous but its tier is too high.
Low-tier beings simply cannot withstand the mighty power contained in the blood, let alone fuse with it.
Jiang Cheng has a Celestial Desolation Indestructible Body, so he was not an ordinary cultivator.
But his realm compared to the Ancient Cyan Dragon is very low, he couldn’t withstand the essence blood’s impact.
Just as he began merging, he magnificently died.
Damn, how did I die again?
As a soul, Brother Cheng felt it was so damn frustrating!
This essence blood was a reward from the system for him!
There must be some explanation!
If he couldn’t fuse it, why wasn’t he warned?
"Ding, the host was killed by Azure Dragon Essence Blood, a victory scheme is being arranged."
Victory scheme?
How to destroy this drop of blood?
After resurrection, should I throw it on the ground and stomp on it?
Jiang Cheng found himself speechless.
This resurrection was unusually fast, normally it takes over 10 seconds, and once it even took 30 seconds, but this time it only took 5 seconds.
"Ding, host resurrected."
Eh eh eh?
System, are you getting old and forgetful, missing crucial steps?
Where’s the victory plan?
No plan, just resurrected?
Upon resurrection, he hurriedly opened the system panel to ask questions.
To be precise, to question.
"What kind of lousy plan is this? That drop of essence blood was given by you, yet it killed me, what do you say?"
"The previous victory scheme was to obtain a drop of Azure Dragon Essence Blood, the host has acquired it and successfully killed the enemy. Fusion of Azure Dragon Essence Blood was not included."
Damn, Jiang Cheng was left speechless by the response.
So you’re blaming me?
Getting a drop of Azure Dragon Essence Blood and can’t recycle it, would anyone normal choose to fuse it?
Who knew this thing was a landmine not to be stepped on?
He spent another 500 points to ask the next question.
"Just now, I was killed by that essence blood, why was there no victory scheme?"
The system’s response remained emotionless.
"The host has defeated the Azure Dragon Essence Blood and successfully fused it."
Huh?
So it’s just successfully fused?
Turns out this was the victory scheme.
Brother Cheng’s mood suddenly brightened, a successful fusion is far more rewarding than stomping it on the ground twice.
He opened the system attribute panel to take a look.
Host: Jiang Cheng.
Race: Human Race.
Bloodline: Azure Dragon Bloodline, First Layer.
Realm: Celestial Fate Second Layer.
Divine Techniques: Radiant Divine Mansion.
Talent: Azure Dragon Suppression (Beginner), Stepping on Wind and Cloud (Beginner).
Cultivation Technique: Moon Observation Heart Method (Top), Water Cold Heart Technique (Top).
Martial Techniques: Crescent Moon Swordsmanship (Perfection), Dark Spring Sealing Flame Sword (Perfection).
Magical Treasure: None.
System Level: 4 (Three resurrections per day, can promote a target by one great realm)
The previous Soul Capturing Technique and Spirit Platform Illusion are no longer shown because after entering the Celestial Fate Realm, the Spirit Platform transformed into a Divine Mansion.
The Spirit Platform Secret Technique has advanced to a Divine Mansion Secret Technique.
Besides this, he also saw new attributes – talent and bloodline.
The Azure Dragon Essence Blood wasn’t meant to increase spiritual power cultivation, but after fusion and bloodline advancement, he leveled up a minor realm, reaching the Celestial Fate Second Layer.
And that talent, Stepping on Wind and Cloud, he initially thought it increased speed.
Upon checking, he found out he guessed wrong.
Stepping on Wind and Cloud (Beginner) – The sky is the Azure Dragon’s main battlefield, the host’s combat power receives a certain boost when in the sky. Every 1,000 miles above ground, combat power increases by 0.1 times, up to a maximum of 1 time.
The boost doesn’t seem much, but if it really doubles, originally evenly matched battles would turn into a crushing victory.
Moreover, at this realm, how many cultivators fight without flying?
The only drawback is that the maximum 1-time boost requires an ascent of 10,000 miles.
That’s quite high, an average cultivator would find flying even a hundred miles high difficult.
The other talent, Azure Dragon Suppression, has a suppressive effect on low-level dragon races.
Currently, he hasn’t encountered any dragon races, so this skill isn’t practical for now.
However, Jiang Cheng was quite satisfied, after acquiring the Azure Dragon Bloodline, his own divine soul suppression greatly enhanced.
If he fought Xiang Ba again, he probably wouldn’t even need a minute to win.
Additionally, bloodline advancement improved cultivation talent efficacy.
This can be seen from Lin Ning, who, after awakening her bloodline, immediately transformed from mediocrity to a prodigy girl.
His cultivation speed naturally increased as well.
In summary, this drop of blood truly is a priceless treasure, worthy of the 9.8 billion points value.
With power and talent both enhanced, Brother Cheng was in a great mood, immediately activating Insight to diligently search for treasures.
This time, the destruction of Eight Clouds Hall not only yielded all its stock but also the Eldest Prince’s group and those reckless guests’ storage rings.
Since Eight Clouds Hall was so massive and there were so many storage rings, he was nearly overwhelmed alone.
Suddenly he felt a bit regretful, he should have brought Ji Linghan over.
Let her wait outside without entering the sect.
Wait till he wins, then bring her in to help gather the spoils of war.
From dawn to dusk, he worked tirelessly like a diligent worker until the afternoon of the next day, finally clearing everyone and every peak and hall of Eight Clouds Hall.
In the end, to ensure nothing was missed, he flew around the mountain three times with Insight activated.
After such a sweep, any cultivators entering Eight Clouds Hall later would probably walk away empty-handed.
Eight Clouds Hall’s Tier Four Spirit Vein, valued at 200,000 points, was naturally not overlooked.
Besides that, it was mainly those storage rings.
Qi Yuansheng, Xu Yuancan, and Ling Yi each had a Tier Eight Spiritual Artifact, while the Eldest Prince had three Tier Eight Spiritual Artifacts on him.
Each Tier Eight Spiritual Artifact is worth 100,000 points.
Just these six valued at 600,000 points.
However, Jiang Cheng didn’t immediately exchange the Tier Eights because he got so many Tier Seven Spiritual Artifacts this time.
A total of 146 pieces, he exchanged 100 pieces, which directly brought him 1 million points.
For the remaining 46 pieces, he decided to bring them back to the Feixian Sect for inventory show-off.
His own sect should have some high-end goods to showcase, right?

chapters.title: Chapter 81: 10 Consecutive Draws
chapters.content:
Chapter 81: Chapter 81: 10 Consecutive Draws
Apart from the high-end goods, there are also over 110 million top-grade Spirit Stones, worth more than 1.1 million Points.
bottles of Sixth-grade Spirit Pills, worth 626,500 Points.
He exchanged 1 million Points from these Pills and Spirit Stones, leaving the rest as inventory.
To be honest, the remaining 720,000 Points worth of Spirit Stones and Pills are enough for all the disciples of Feixian Sect to cultivate within the Xuanji Map for thousands of years.
After all, their Realm is low, and their consumption is naturally less than that of high-tier Cultivators.
However, only three people can enter the Xuanji Map at a time.
As for the 127 bottles of Seventh-grade Spirit Pills, Ji Linghan and others could easily break through to the Celestial Fate Realm, or even the Daoist Palace Realm.
The remaining Spirit Talisman Array Discs, low-tier Spiritual Artifacts, and some materials were all chosen to be exchanged by him.
In the end, he obtained another 1.45 million Points.
This trip to the Eight Clouds Hall was extremely profitable. Coupled with the previous 600,000 or more Points, his Points have currently reached 4.28 million.
Far exceeding the 1 million needed for an upgrade.
Although Brother Cheng knew from the beginning that as the overlord of Feiyun State, the inventory of the Eight Clouds Hall must be more than the rest of the Sects combined, the quantity still far exceeded his expectations.
This Sect is simply filthy rich. No wonder they previously had no interest in the other Sects within their dominion.
To them, the forces like the Red Sun Sect and the Duanmu Family must seem like beggars, right?
Brother Cheng decisively clicked on the upgrade, and the system panel changed.
Level: 5
Points: 0/10,000,000
Available Points: 3,287,573
Current Skill: The Host can consume Points to transform into any target, cooldown time 3 days.
Note: The transformation target must have been seen with the host’s own eyes. This transformation can completely simulate all features of the target except for their power.
Subordinate Skill: The Host can consume Points to enhance the target’s talent by one class, cooldown time 1 day.
Note: The higher the target’s talent, the more Points consumed.
This...
Enhancing others’ talents seems like I didn’t get any benefits myself.
But soon after, Brother Cheng laughed again; he was thinking too narrowly.
The higher the talent of his group of disciples, the more valuable they are in the system’s eyes!
In the future, not only will their cultivation speed progress by leaps and bounds, but the Points rewarded for each upgrade will also multiply several times.
If they all reached the level of talent like Ji Linghan and Lin Ning, the return Points for Spirit Platform Realm and Celestial Fate Realm would be tens of thousands or even hundreds of thousands.
This is a Divine Technique for earning more Points!
Much more useful than the previous direct Great Realm upgrade.
Enhancing a Great Realm, aside from showing off, is just for show.
But enhancing talent can not only show off but also gain tangible benefits.
Think of Luo Yuan, Shan Tai, and others, who have followed for the longest, loyal old people, but because of slightly inferior talent, they gradually can’t keep up with his conquest footsteps and are almost marginalized.
Brother Cheng felt that he really needed to care for the empty nest elders a little more.
He originally wanted to blow the remaining 3 million plus Points on the lottery for once but changed his mind.
Better save more and upgrade to the next level soon.
This time, let’s just use 1 million Points for 10 Level 3 lotteries as an intention.
Let’s get a Level 3 Skill!
After praying a bit, accumulating some good karma, Brother Cheng opened the lottery panel and quickly clicked ten times.
"Congratulations to the Host for obtaining 1 Taisu Treasure Pill!"
"Congratulations to the Host for obtaining 1 Celestial Essence Nine Saints Treasure Pill!"
"Congratulations to the Host on a fortuitous burst, obtaining the Treasure ’Cyan Luo Breaking Sacred Sword’!"
"Congratulations to the Host for obtaining one Purple Patterned Flame Bright Bamboo!"
"Congratulations to the Host for obtaining one Xuanji Map Fragment!"
"Congratulations to the Host on a fortuitous burst, obtaining one strand of Daoist Celestial Immortal Rhyme!"
"Congratulations to the Host for obtaining one piece of Rainbow Jade!"
"Congratulations to the Host for obtaining the Tier Three Artifact Refining Technique!"
"Congratulations to the Host for obtaining three Red Pearl Dew Grass!"
"Congratulations to the Host for obtaining one Snow Net Profound Ice Talisman!"
After the ten consecutive draws, Brother Cheng only then carefully checked his gains.
This time, he didn’t get a Tier Three Skill, but the other gains are quite good.
With the Tier Three Artifact Refining Technique, he has since become an Artifact Refining Grandmaster capable of refining Treasures.
With another Xuanji Map Fragment obtained, it can be combined with the previous piece to enhance its power.
The two Treasure Pills, one enhances the Divine Soul Realm for 600 years, and the other increases Spiritual Power Cultivation for 800 years.
Cultivators, upon reaching a certain Realm, must pursue the complementary nature of the Divine Soul and Spiritual Power.
Merely absorbing Spiritual Qi to increase Spiritual Power without a concurrent Divine Soul Realm results in an unstable foundation, which can, in severe cases, lead to the complete destruction of cultivation.
Conversely, possessing only a Divine Soul without the support of Spiritual Power is like a tree without roots, unable to even guarantee lifespan.
Without thinking, he swallowed them all.
Thus, in the next moment, his cultivation advanced to the Fourth Layer of the Celestial Fate Realm.
This made Jiang Cheng a little disappointed.
These were Treasure Pills, and they only improved his small Realm by two layers?
It’s truly tough for me.
He doesn’t think, at the Celestial Fate Realm, a cultivator’s lifespan is calculated in millennia.
How many are limited by talent and potential, trapped in the First Layer of the Celestial Fate Realm their entire lives, unable to advance even an inch?
If it weren’t for the Celestial Desolation Indestructible Body coupled with the Radiant Divine Mansion dual enhancement, he couldn’t have ascended so smoothly after consuming the pills.
Purple Patterned Flame Bright Bamboo, Rainbow Jade, Red Pearl Dew Grass are all Heavenly and Earthly Treasures for refining Treasure Pills and Treasures.
If not for the system’s lottery, directly purchasing them would cost tens of millions of Spirit Stones.
Moreover, the crucial point is whether they are even available within the Qianxing Dynasty is another issue.
The Snow Net Profound Ice Talisman is a Treasure Talisman higher than the Tier Nine Spirit Talisman. Its power need not be mentioned, a Big Killer tier.
Unfortunately, it appeared a little late.
If Jiang Cheng had drawn it before coming to the Eight Clouds Hall and placed it in the Storage Ring, the subsequent grand ceremony would have been truly eventful.
No need for resurrection to use Dragon Blood, one Treasure Talisman would have blasted the Eight Clouds Hall to the heavens.
The Cyan Luo Breaking Sacred Sword is a Treasure, superior to a Tier Nine Spiritual Artifact.
The cyan spiritual aura encircles the blade, exuding a murderous intent in its hazy form, clearly not a mortal object.
The sword body is inscribed with two Treasure Arrays, which respectively amplify Sword Aura power by 3 times and Wind Swordsmanship power by 2 times!
Simple yet brutal.
Additionally, there are three Ninth Grade Spiritual Array inscriptions as support, comprehensively enhancing speed, sharpness, and sturdiness.
Even though it hasn’t completed refinement, just wielding it for a few casual attacks resulted in a momentum several times greater than during his previous battle with Xiang Ba.
Once fully refined, its power would probably reach half of what it was when he was possessed by the War Soul last time, nearly rivaling the Daoist Palace Realm.
Because a Treasure is not a one-time consumable, the system noted it as a fortuitous burst.
Playing with it in his hand, Brother Cheng felt a bit conflicted.
As a swordsman, this sword not only has extreme power but also looks exceedingly fierce and handsome, enhancing his image.
He truly feels reluctant to gift it to a disciple.
However, with this sword at his side, he might not die without encountering the Daoist Palace Realm.
Not dying means no triggering the system’s invincible counter-kill.
Don’t see the system’s plans often as one-time big moves, used and gone.
Sometimes, there are rewards for permanently upgrading in disguised forms, like this Dragon Blood.
Without being killed once, he couldn’t have obtained such an ancient Exotic Treasure.
So, being killed is very important.
After pondering for a moment, he figured out a solution that satisfied both aspects.
In the future, when in the Feixian Sect, this sword will be his sword for showing off. It’s still okay to fight off invaders.
As for when traveling, just deliberately forget to bring it.

chapters.title: Chapter 82: The Martial Dao River
chapters.content:
Chapter 82: Chapter 82: The Martial Dao River
Besides the Cyan Luo Breaking Sacred Sword, there was another instance of a stroke of luck.
It was the Daoist Celestial Immortal Rhyme, something Jiang Cheng had never heard of, and he could only read the introduction below.
Daoist Celestial Immortal Rhyme—an exotic treasure containing the immortal Daoist treasures, capable of elevating a Martial Dao Mark to the Immortal Level!
Jiang Cheng never dreamed that such a thing could also be enhanced with a treasure.
The Divine Mansion at the Celestial Fate Realm has Martial Dao Marks, and the level of these marks corresponds to the cultivator’s Martial Dao Enlightenment Realm.
Don’t be fooled by the fact that he got a Radiant Divine Mansion with nine Martial Dao Mark rivers shockingly spanning the sky, for in reality, the level of each of his Martial Dao Marks was not high.
This is understandable, as his time in this world has been short.
Becoming a Celestial Fate Realm cultivator mainly relied on two replications of cultivation.
His own training accounted for very little, and there was absolutely no serious investigation into Heart Method, Cultivation, and Martial Techniques.
In short, Jiang Cheng’s foundation was very thin.
If he hadn’t also acquired the Martial Dao Enlightenment from others during the cultivation replication, then his understanding and enlightenment of the Martial Dao wouldn’t be much higher than that of the Body Tempering Realm.
In the Radiant Divine Mansion, of the nine Martial Dao Mark rivers, three reached the True Level, four reached the Master Level, and another two reached the Sect Level.
Understand that the True Level is just one tier above the lowest Mortal Level.
And the Mortal Level is actually the Martial Dao Realm of those martial artists in the Mortal World.
Enlightenment at the True Level is considered the lowest standard for cultivators.
The Master Level is roughly equivalent to the levels from Gathering Essence to Split Soul.
Only the two rivers that reached the Sect Level have the Martial Dao Enlightenment that the Spirit Platform Celestial Mandate Level should have.
Above the Sect Level is the King Level.
The Eldest Prince’s five marks include four of the Sect Level, with the last one being a King Level.
Above King Level is Saint Level, and Immortal Level is a tier higher than Saint Level.
Once a Martial Dao Mark reaches the Immortal Level, Jiang Cheng’s Martial Dao Enlightenment in this lineage will surpass the vast majority of Saint Tier cultivators.
One can imagine how mystical this Daoist Celestial Immortal Rhyme is.
The only problem now before him was choosing which one.
The nine Martial Dao Mark rivers each represent Life and Death, Space-Time, Yin-Yang, Four Absolutes, Five Elements, Six Desires, Seven Emotions, Eight Desolates, and Nine Palaces.
Among them, Life and Death is the Dao of Life and Death.
Space-Time is the martial rules of time and space.
Yin-Yang represents light and darkness.
The Four Absolutes are Destruction, Devouring, Corrosion, and Creation.
The Five Elements naturally refer to Gold, Wood, Water, Fire, and Earth, with extensions like Ice, Thunder, Wind, etc.
The Seven Emotions and Six Desires are also closely related to the martial path, often a major opportunity for cultivators to break through in enlightenment.
The Eight Desolates refer to the extremes of heaven and earth.
And the Nine Palaces represent the fusion of Martial Dao with Array Dao, Talisman Dao, and other fields.
The nine marks encompass myriad aspects, embodying the essence of the martial path.
Each has its own mystical characteristics without superiority over others.
Pushing any to the extreme will surely lead to the level of an Ancestral Master Giant Fan.
Jiang Cheng pondered for a long time and ultimately chose the Five Elements.
The reason was simple: the Five Elements are the most versatile, with ready-made Cultivation and Martial Techniques.
If he chose others, like Life and Death, Yin-Yang, or the Four Absolutes, despite their power, they were too rare.
Without appropriate Cultivation Techniques and martial weaponry to match, he wouldn’t be able to wield their full potential.
Moreover, the Cyan Luo Breaking Sacred Sword is considered wind attribute, which belongs to the Five Elements.
If his understanding of the Five Elements rules surpassed that of Saint Level experts, refining most treasures, which used to take months, could be done in a day in the future.
Besides, his cultivation efficiency in Five Elements techniques would increase several times.
And the prowess of Five Elements martial techniques would also leap to a higher level of power.
With so many benefits, he no longer hesitated and extracted that thread of Daoist Celestial Immortal Rhyme, integrating it into his Divine Mansion.
The next moment, the Divine Mansion shone brightly, enveloping the surroundings!
The nine rivers of Martial Dao Marks hung from the sky, and the blue river representing the Five Elements gradually changed from gray to silver then gold in color at a visibly fast pace!
Furthermore, its luster became increasingly clear and brilliant!
Countless mysterious inscriptions glowed vibrantly, seemingly ready to pierce the heavens.
When the fusion of the Daoist Celestial Immortal Rhyme completed, the Five Elements river utterly dominated the other eight rivers.
The Immortal Level Mark was complete!
Jiang Cheng felt as though a multitude of Martial Dao Enlightenment insights, all related to the Five Elements, spontaneously emerged in his mind.
