In that brief instant, it was like he had witnessed countless cycles of the Five Elements’ perpetual interaction and opposition, and his understanding rapidly advanced.
When all was over, he even had the illusion he had lived for hundreds of thousands of years.
He raised his sword, and a gorge silently appeared on the ground.
The sides of the gorge were not soil, but gold and iron.
Within the gold and iron, a stream meandered, flowing.
Above the river, flames appeared like lotus seeds, abrupt yet seemingly rightful.
With a swing of the sword, a breeze lifted the fiery lotus gently from the stream.
Then, suspended in midair, it slowly condensed and instantly transformed into an ice lotus.
Sssssh!
Dozens of tiny, hair-like lightning bolts struck down, each hitting an ice lotus without harming the ground.
As all this faded into invisibility, Jiang Cheng sheathed his sword.
The frivolity in his eyes reduced, replaced by clarity and understanding.
However, in the next moment, he reverted to his old ways.
"Wow, what a great trick for showing off. I must perform this more often in front of the disciples later."
In his eyes, nothing was better than showing off.
Only then was he satisfied as he soared to the sky.
This time, the return journey was much faster with two transmissions.
Just as he returned to the familiar sect gates, he saw a pretty silhouette eagerly waiting below.
"Sect Leader!"
Ji Linghan’s voice carried unrestrained joy.
"You’re finally back!"
Like having been apart for decades, she ran and flew over to him.
Ultimately, due to her nature, she couldn’t boldly embrace him like Yin Xuer.
Brother Cheng was stunned; could it be an enemy invasion?
"Did something big happen?"
"Nope."
"Then have you been waiting here all this while?"
"Yeah!"
The two walked side by side, with Ji Linghan’s smile uncontainable.
Brother Cheng felt touched yet somewhat helpless.
Girl, with your extraordinary talent, you should focus on cultivation and not slack off.
You’re a major contributor to my point earnings, you know.
Back at the sect, unsurprisingly, all the other disciples hurried out upon hearing the news.
"It’s been two days; why is the Sect Leader back so late?"
"Right, the Eight Clouds Hall event was truly lengthy, huh."
"The Sect Leader must have received grand hospitality and was kept overnight."
"Sect Leader, was the Eight Clouds Hall event fun?"
Brother Cheng thought to himself that the event wasn’t fun at all, nor was it lengthy, and no one invited him overnight; rather, many wanted to kill him.
He would have returned yesterday if not for gathering war trophies.
He was planning to tell them that he had wiped out the Eight Clouds Hall.
This heavy news would certainly boost his prestige, making the disciples look up to him even more.
But when the words reached his lips, he held back.
Such big news will soon spread, and the disciples will naturally find out.
Rather than saying it himself, he should let them discover it.
Wow, after annihilating such a large sect, he returned unfazed, not mentioning a word.
Wouldn’t the show-off effect be doubled then?
This profitable opportunity couldn’t be missed.

chapters.title: Chapter 83: The Shocked Three-Eyed Tiger
chapters.content:
Chapter 83: Chapter 83: The Shocked Three-Eyed Tiger
Although he held back from boasting about his glorious battle achievements, there were other aspects he could show off.
Brother Cheng couldn’t resist his restless heart and performed the Five Elements Martial Dao once again.
The effect was extraordinary, leaving everyone present in shock.
Using spiritual power to form streams of fire lotus and ice lotus, this was something achievable in the Soul Splitting Realm.
The main difference lay in the skill of control and the level of power.
But what Jiang Cheng demonstrated was a seamless transition between the Five Elements, a level of skill they had never heard of before.
In the eyes of the disciples, this was surely some sort of Immortal Technique.
For a moment, exclamations of surprise and admiration filled the hall.
Not just them, even the Three-Eyed Tiger suddenly appeared within the hall.
Its eyes widened in utter disbelief.
"Kid, how did you do that?"
The disciples were baffled, unable to discern much, but it was different.
Even though it was a demon king living idly, it was still a Saint Tier existence.
It could clearly sense that Jiang Cheng was still using Martial Dao, not Immortal Arts.
But the level of that Martial Dao was so high, it surpassed not just the normal King Level of the Celestial Fate Realm, but even the Saint Level.
"Just did it, really, that’s just my power, you know."
Jiang Cheng shrugged, with a look of "I just did a trivial little thing."
"I understand you damn well!"
"With your little bit of power?"
The Three-Eyed Tiger cursed out loud.
Jiang Cheng was currently at Celestial Fate Fourth Layer, which it could see at a glance.
If a standard Celestial Fate Fourth Layer could do such a thing, then it had wasted its time as a demon king.
Although that performance just now wasn’t powerful, it wouldn’t be useful in battle, the significance behind it couldn’t be ignored.
"Yeah, just with me."
Seeing how even the mighty demon king was stunned, Jiang Cheng felt extremely satisfied inside.
Not easy at all.
"The strength of this sect leader is something a mere little demon like you cannot fathom."
"It must be some trickery, no way I’d buy into it!"
The Three-Eyed Tiger’s mouth was unyielding; it would never submit to Jiang Cheng.
Could it be an illusion technique?
Impossible, my eyes are fine.
Or perhaps achieved through some peculiar array or rune?
No, that wouldn’t bypass me either.
Honestly, its thoughts were indeed somewhat shaken.
From the start, it had never taken Jiang Cheng seriously, but during this time at Feixian Sect, it repeatedly encountered things that defied its understanding.
Like Jiang Cheng’s extraordinary breakthrough speed.
When they first met, he was only Soul Splitting Fourth Layer, now he was Celestial Fate Fourth Layer.
Like the ability to forcibly increase a disciple’s great realm, even if it were just Yin Xuer, it would pass, but even Shan Tai was promoted.
That couldn’t be explained as mere coincidence.
And now today...
Could it be, this kid actually knows some Immortal Technique?
It felt somewhat bewildered.
After it left, everyone started talking.
"Even Lord Tiger Demon can’t see through Sect Leader’s Immortal Technique?"
"Seems like Sect Leader’s realm is much higher than it!"
"Wasn’t that known from the start? Why are you all acting so surprised?"
"Little Brain Axe often badmouths the Sect Leader, turns out it’s just jealous that the Sect Leader is stronger."
"Jealousy won’t help; some people are just meant to look up to them!"
The Three-Eyed Tiger flying far away could still hear the discussions, almost making it fall from the sky out of anger.
Even Brother Cheng rarefied slightly blushed.
Enough, enough, everyone really overpraised.
The Three-Eyed Tiger is a demon king, several planes higher than him.
However, there’s still some hidden delight in his heart.
"By the way, Xiaohan, you’ve improved greatly in Xuanji Dojo last time; it’s worth rewarding."
This was said from the bottom of his heart.
Rewarding the disciples who advance quickly can motivate others to work harder in cultivation.
A qualified sect should have a system of rewards and punishments.
Brother Cheng was keen for them to advance quickly and earn him more points.
Saying this, he took out a Tier Eight Spirit Sword from his ring.
With the sword scabbard, everyone couldn’t see much, but they knew anything released by the Sect Leader should be at least Level 6.
They couldn’t help feeling extremely envious.
Luckily, Lin Ning was still in the Xuanji Map for ascetic cultivation, otherwise, even he might have turned green with envy.
Ji Linghan gazed at the spirit sword, her heart pounding like a little deer on the run.
Her focus wasn’t on the spirit sword, but entirely on the address.
What did Sect Leader just call her?
Xiaohan?
Such an intimate address, could it be...
Thinking to this point, her gentle cheeks flushed with two shades of red, a shy look that left Jiang Cheng a bit dazed.
What happened?
Why is this girl blushing over a sword?
Could it be that my handsome face is less appealing than a shabby sword?
"Ahem, here, take it."
After saying this, he somewhat dejectedly placed the sword in her hand.
"Thank you, Sect Leader!"
Happily accepting the sword, Ji Linghan bowed gracefully.
Later, under the envious eyes of other disciples, she drew the sword.
Spiritual power entered, and she was instantly stunned.
This sword... is a bit too strong.
Stronger than she could imagine.
She had used a Tier Five Spirit Sword before, and compared to this sword, it was like garbage among garbage.
This was definitely more than Tier Six!
"Sect... Sect Leader, this sword..."
Seeing her look of shock mixed with bewilderment, Brother Cheng’s pretense facade reached a new height.
He intentionally said with a calm expression: "Oh, it’s just a Tier Eight Spirit Sword, nothing worth mentioning."
Wha, what?
Tier Eight Spirit Sword?
Ji Linghan almost trembled, finding it hard to handle.
Soon after came an unprecedented sense of satisfaction and sweetness.
When others received a maximum of Tier Six Spiritual Artifacts, she first got a Tier Nine Mist Jade Light Immortal Robe, and now a Tier Eight Spirit Sword!
This was clearly a different treatment.
It clearly showed how much more she meant to him.
The other disciples went wild, the hall filled with strange cries and wails.
"Oh my god, it’s actually Tier Eight!"
"So envious, I can’t live like this."
"How many treasures does the Sect Leader have?"
"When I was bestowed a Tier Four Spiritual Artifact, I thought it was top-notch; now there’s nothing left of that."
"I’m not convinced! Sect Leader is being excessively good to Senior Sister Ji!"
"You have to hold it in, was Senior Sister Ji the first to meet the Sect Leader."
These reactions greatly pleased Brother Cheng.
No envy or jealousy, where’s the motivation?
"Alright, alright, don’t be jealous."
"As I said, these are rewards."
"From now on, I will periodically reward the fastest cultivating disciples!"
The other few Tier Eight Spiritual Artifacts and dozens of Tier Seven Spiritual Artifacts, he initially planned to give them out directly.
Now it seemed, wasn’t it better to use them as prizes?
Upon hearing this news, everyone cheered, gearing up with enthusiasm.
But soon someone timidly said: "However, everyone has different talents, no matter how hard we try, our cultivation speed can never match Elder Ji and Lin Ning."
Jiang Cheng waved his hand: "No worries, I’ll set standards according to each of your talents."
"Alright, disperse now, everyone go back to cultivating hard."
After the Xuanji Map’s synthesis this time, there were five more slots available; currently, besides Ji Linghan and Yin Xuer from last time, no other Split Soul Disciples could enter.
In his view, this was a sheer waste of space.

chapters.title: Chapter 84: Turmoil
chapters.content:
Chapter 84: Chapter 84: Turmoil
In the following period, Jiang Cheng arranged all the cultivation techniques, martial arts, and other classics obtained from the Eight Clouds Hall.
These cultivation and martial techniques were far more advanced than those of the Red Sun Sect.
At first, some of the disciples were puzzled about where these secret manuals originated from.
However, since the Eight Clouds Hall was so far away and had never been in contact with them, they couldn’t discern it.
Therefore, ultimately, they all assumed it was part of the Sect Leader’s original collection.
After all, the Sect Leader was an "Immortal"!
Soon, the entire Feixian Sect was swept up in a wave of intense cultivation.
All the disciples secluded themselves in their cave mansions, and many began closed-door training, deciding not to emerge until they reached the Soul Splitting Realm.
Of course, Jiang Cheng was not among them.
Without any sense of urgency, he was not inclined to train diligently, only engaging in a half-hearted manner.
The Feixian Sect was calm, but the outside world was anything but tranquil.
None of the guests who attended the Eight Clouds Hall’s grand ceremony managed to return on time.
Such a significant event quickly caught the attention of the outside world.
And as people entered to investigate, the news of the Eight Clouds Hall’s annihilation instantly caused a sensation.
It’s said that the first person to go inside was so frightened that they fell from the sky.
There was no other way; the scene was simply too horrific.
With most people being directly suppressed to death by the Azure Dragon Essence Blood, they didn’t look good in their final moments.
And Jiang Cheng hadn’t yet developed the noble trait of burying the bodies of his enemies...
Such a massive sect, with over a dozen Celestial Fate Realm experts stationed there, along with another dozen as guests and an expert of the Celestial Fate Ninth Layer like the Eldest Prince.
How was such a grand lineup annihilated?
For a time, all the regions surrounding Feiyun State were rife with speculation and shockwaves.
This even sparked a series of chain reactions.
For instance, some forces, no less significant than the Eight Clouds Hall, were suspected, and some sects experienced internal strife because their Sect Leaders, who were guests, were killed, and so on...
The disciples of various great sects were filled with panic.
They had no choice but to be afraid; to silently and unnoticeably wipe out so many Celestial Fate experts at once, how strong did one have to be?
Moreover, all the spirit veins of the Eight Clouds Hall had vanished.
All of this seemed to indicate that a powerful and terrifying force was behind it.
Once that dreadful force took action against their own sect, could they withstand it?
Compared to the fear among sects in other states, the interior of Feiyun State was filled with celebration.
It wasn’t that the Eight Clouds Hall was particularly evil, but they were one less competitor.
There’s only so much resources in the cultivation realm, and the cake is only so big.
With the disappearance of the massive entity that was the Eight Clouds Hall, life was naturally much better for others.
At the Qianxing Dynasty’s Longyue Imperial City, the atmosphere in the imperial study was extremely oppressive at the moment.
Three of the dynasty’s high-ranking officials kept their heads low, not daring to breathe heavily.
The Eldest Prince had died in the Eight Clouds Hall, and Emperor Xiang Gaoye was in a towering rage.
In the cultivation realm’s dynasties, imperial power is extremely stable and doesn’t need to consider the faces of noble families and clans.
Because power speaks here, and this emperor himself, having a cultivation of the Daoist Palace Sixth Layer, is the top expert of the Qianxing Dynasty.
"Who can tell Us how the enemy accomplished this?"
Just now, the Grand General, the Prime Minister, and the Commander of the Imperial Guard had all observed a ’recording.’
During the grand ceremony at the Eight Clouds Hall, some of the guests had activated their transmission spirit artifacts.
Although the transmission spirit artifacts were ultimately either destroyed or confiscated and exchanged for points by Jiang Cheng, the transmitted images remained.
Unfortunately, the images they saw only lasted until Ling Yi was knocked down by Qi Yuansheng.
At that time, Qi Yuansheng had activated the sect protection array.
With the array activated, the outside world was completely isolated, and naturally, the transmission spirit artifacts could not transmit any images out.
Prime Minister Yang Jie respectfully said, "Your Majesty, in this minister’s opinion, there was a treasure dispute at the Eight Clouds Hall at that time..."
"Do you think We have no eyes?"
Xiang Ba’s death had driven Xiang Gaoye into a fiery rage.
But in reality, Xiang Ba was not his son but his great-great-great-great-grandchild...
How many generations it truly had been, Xiang Gaoye himself may not remember.
He had lived for over ten thousand years, with descendants as numerous as cattle.
Most of the descendants with average talents and qualifications were given fiefdoms, and over generations, princes devolved into dukes, slowly declining, and eventually becoming commoners.
Those descendants with outstanding talent, on the other hand, were summoned back to be raised by his side, and Xiang Ba was one such outstanding figure.
Having reached the Celestial Fate Ninth Layer and possessing the Five-Colored Divine Mansion, he had great potential to become a new Daoist Palace Realm expert in the future, and Xiang Gaoye had always had high hopes for him.
Being a newcomer within the near 30 years, he was conferred the title of Eldest Prince.
Grand General Lu Ran pondered for a moment before saying, "Your Majesty, the five transmission spirit artifacts we collected all ended their footage at that moment..."
"And at that time, it appears that Qi Yuansheng made some sudden movement on the screen..."
"I speculate that the Eight Clouds Hall might have activated the sect protection array!"
"Hmm!"
Xiang Gaoye nodded and rubbed his temples.
"Qi Yuansheng indeed activated the array, but in the end, he himself also died."
If Qi Yuansheng hadn’t died, they might have directly considered him the culprit.
Even though it was unthinkable for Qi Yuansheng, as the Palace Master, to wipe out everyone in his own sect, the sect protection array could indeed accomplish such a thing.
"There must be another force lurking nearby that pitilessly slaughtered everyone inside the Eight Clouds Hall!"
Commander of the Imperial Guard Xiahou Jun concluded.
"What I want to know is, who are they? What methods did they use?"
"According to the reported information, the time of death for everyone inside the Eight Clouds Hall differed by no more than half a stick of incense."
"In half a stick of incense, to kill tens of thousands, including those of the Celestial Fate Ninth Layer, is something We cannot even accomplish!"
This was what Xiang Gaoye was most apprehensive about; the unknown enemy made him feel a strong sense of threat, like having a prickle on his back.
All three high-ranking officials were wrapped in worry.
Who could guess this out of thin air?
Yang Jie deliberated for a moment, then slowly said, "That Feixian Sect Sect Leader Jiang Cheng, very likely has problems."
Lu Ran’s eyes lit up, immediately agreeing, "Indeed, he had his ring taken by Qi Cang, and that ring caused a collective struggle among the high-ranking members of the Eight Clouds Hall..."
"There must be some hidden inside story that we are unaware of!"
"Even if that Jiang Cheng is dead, the investigation must be pursued!"
At that time, many people in the Eight Clouds Hall were killed to the point of being unrecognizable due to the suppression from the Azure Dragon Essence Blood.
In the midst of this, it couldn’t be confirmed whether Jiang Cheng was among them.
And since the Feixian Sect usually sealed its mountain gates and did not interact with the outside world, they surprisingly still didn’t know that Jiang Cheng was the sole ’survivor.’
Xiang Gaoye nodded, "Then send someone to the Feixian Sect to investigate this matter!"
"Lu Ran, you handle this!"
Grand General Lu Ran bowed to accept the order and then pondered for a moment, saying, "Your Majesty, if it turns out that the Feixian Sect is not involved..."
"Then that sect will have nothing to do with it..."
Feeling the emperor’s approval, Lu Ran hesitated momentarily but ultimately nodded and went on.
"In that case, we’ll send them help to resist the potential threat of that mysterious force, in case they target us..."
It made sense that there was a party involved capable of eliminating all those Celestial Fate experts in the Eight Clouds Hall without anyone noticing.
No wonder all the sects in the surrounding states were afraid. After all, who could stand against such a power if it came for them?
Compared to the fear of sects in neighboring states, Feiyun State, however, was in a celebratory mood.
It wasn’t that the Eight Clouds Hall was so evil but because there was one less competitor.
With only so many resources in the cultivation realm, the distribution of power was finite.
With the overwhelming presence of the Eight Clouds Hall gone, life naturally improved for everyone else.
"""

chapters.title: Chapter 85 Transformation Technique
chapters.content:
Chapter 85: Chapter 85 Transformation Technique
Xiang Gaoye is the ruler of a nation, and also a super strong expert of the Daoist Palace Sixth Layer, currently discussing major affairs.
Under such circumstances, anyone who burst in without notice would be killed on the spot.
They might even have their clan exterminated.
However, the young woman who barged in at this moment did not ignite his fury.
Even the three ministers found it justified.
"Haha, Ningti! Why aren’t you cultivating properly? Why have you come here?"
Xiang Gaoye rarely showed a smile.
"Greetings, Your Highness, the Princess!"
The other three also paid their respects.
Princess Ningti, in her long palace dress, had brows and eyes like a painting, and possessed a beauty unmatched in the kingdom.
Upon entering, her gaze carried a superior, imposing majesty.
Yet facing Xiang Gaoye, she revealed a hint of a young girl’s demeanor.
"Ancestral Emperor, I find this matter interesting, and cultivating all day is boring me to death. I want to go out and clear my mind."
Although she was a princess, she naturally couldn’t be Xiang Gaoye’s daughter.
Xiang Gaoye’s more than a hundred daughters had long perished over ten thousand years ago due to low cultivation and exhausted lifespan.
Princess Ningti and the Eldest Prince, Xiang Ba, were of the same generation, yet her talent far surpassed Xiang Ba.
Now she has reached Daoist Palace First Layer, with a Divine Mansion of six colors!
Such talent outshines all predecessors, and she very likely could advance to the Daoist Palace Ninth Layer in the future.
It’s even possible she could break through to the Ascending to Saint Realm.
If it weren’t due to her being female and unable to continue the lineage, Xiang Gaoye would have wanted to make her the heir while he retired behind the scenes for ascetic cultivation.
Even so, this woman assuredly could become a further safeguard for the Qianxing Dynasty’s advancement.
In Xiang Gaoye’s mind, she was an unparalleled supreme treasure.
So now Ningti sat directly on his lap, even tugging at his beard, and he just smiled wryly, not reacting.
"This event is very complicated and could likely attract an attack from that unknown force; if you go, you might..."
Xiang Gaoye didn’t regard Feixian Sect with concern; his true worry was the ’mastermind’ who had destroyed Feixian Sect.
That was an existence he himself feared.
"Does the Ancestral Emperor not trust my abilities? Besides, I have my own subordinates!"
"If not allowed, then I won’t see you again in the future!"
Ningti pouted and hammered him twice in defiance.
The three ministers below silently grumbled; discussing their own party before the Emperor was something only she dared to do.
Xiang Gaoye laughed helplessly, "You little girl, are you threatening me..."
"So, does the Ancestral Emperor agree?"
"Fine, fine, I agree, but Grand Commander Xiahou Jun must accompany you all the way!"
Xiahou Jun led the Imperial City Guard, a small army of barely three thousand.
But their lowest strength was all Spirit Platform Ninth Layer.
Moreover, all one hundred of this Imperial Guard’s Decurions had reached the Celestial Fate Realm.
Plus, they could amplify their power through formation battles, resisting them was not something normal sect experts could handle.
Xiahou Jun himself was also of Daoist Palace Second Layer.
With them guarding the way, Xiang Gaoye felt much more at ease.
Ningti was somewhat unhappy but ultimately acquiesced.
"Fine, but he must take orders from me this time!"
Xiang Gaoye doted on her deeply, laughing heartily, "Alright, alright, he’ll take orders from you."
With consent granted, Ningti finally smiled and retreated gracefully, leaving only a fragrant breeze.
Far away at Feixian Sect, Jiang Cheng had actually anticipated that someone would come sooner or later.
After such a major event as the destruction of Eight Clouds Hall, it’d be strange if he, as the ’survivor’, wasn’t investigated.
He merely didn’t know anyone from the Qianxing Dynasty, so he wouldn’t have known who would arrive.
To this, he wasn’t worried at all.
Kidding, with Ah Huang and the Three-Eyed Tiger here in his own territory, and himself with the capability to resurrect three times a day...
Even if the Celestial King came, he had nothing to fear.
Lately, he was quite perturbed.
Not that it was of any significant consequence; it’s just been over ten days, and within the sect, no one seemed to discuss the destruction of Eight Clouds Hall.
If no word spread, it naturally means no one knew he destroyed Eight Clouds Hall.
Such an impressive and bombastic news, unable to be revealed, of course Brother Cheng was smothered and uncomfortable.
He now deeply regretted not claiming credit in the first place.
He had hoped the disciples would discover it passively.
Truthfully, this was his self-imposed snare.
Feixian Sect inherently had little contact with the outside world; they could usually rely on communication spirit artifacts to learn of major external news, but recently the disciples were all crazily sealed in death for cultivation spurred by rewards.
No one had time to pay attention to external happenings.
Floating mid-air, looking down at the cold and desolate, empty mountains, he was so bored that even his eggs vaguely ached.
Advancing from Celestial Fate Realm was extremely challenging, even with his heaven-defying talent, there had been no progress in ten-plus days, not even a small realm.
"Cultivating is really too slow..."
He lamented, but there was no one to respond.
At the moment, he didn’t even have anyone to talk to.
Ah Huang was mostly asleep under the spirit vein’s nurturing, even if awakened, it would just babble ’mama mama’, purely adding vexation.
As for the Three-Eyed Tiger, forget it.
He suddenly recalled the transformation ability he had gained after the last upgrade which he hadn’t used yet.
Eyes rolling with a sparkle, an idea formed for fun.
In the next instant, a silver light flashed from bottom to top across his entire body.
Subsequently, he transformed into Lin Ning.
Not only did his appearance, build, and attire look identical, but even the spiritual power aura released was completely consistent.
Only Lin Ning’s Hidden Phoenix Bloodline, he could merely imitate the aura characteristic but couldn’t genuinely transform into the Hidden Phoenix Bloodline.
"Haha, it’s so alike!"
He kicked and stretched smoothly, his voice also turned feminine.
Seeing nothing problematic, he flew directly towards Ji Linghan’s cave mansion.
He wanted to see what the place was like when he wasn’t at Feixian Sect.
This was what’s called a discreet royal inspection!
Recently Ji Linghan was also in seclusion, striving to break through to the Celestial Fate Realm.
However, overcoming the major realm barrier couldn’t be achieved in a day or two, so there had been no progress yet.
Jiang Cheng’s arrival triggered the restriction of the cave mansion; she naturally sensed it.
Coming out to see, she was instantly amazed.
"Lin Ning? Weren’t you cultivating within the Xuanji Map? How did you come out so soon?"
Jiang Cheng giggled, recalling Lin Ning’s previous expressions, then feeling it ill-fitted her character, he put away the smile, maintaining sobriety.
"Oh, cultivation was too dull, I felt bored so I came out. What about you, when can you break through to the Celestial Fate Realm?"
Lin Ning had been in the Xuanji Map for over ten days, calculating the time, he deliberately adjusted his spiritual power fluctuation to Spirit Platform First Layer, roughly fitting the possible realm she could be in.
Ji Linghan’s lovely face tightened, showing dissatisfaction.
"How can you slack off in cultivation? You’re really disappointing me; are you worthy of the Sect Leader’s nurturing?"
Oh?
This girl being stern was indeed pretty convincing.
This was a side of Ji Linghan Jiang Cheng had never seen; in front of him, Ji Linghan was always as obedient and gentle as possible.
This discreet royal inspection, turns out, was quite rewarding.
"I have my own discretion!"

chapters.title: Chapter 86: The Parties Deeply Regret
chapters.content:
Chapter 86: Chapter 86: The Parties Deeply Regret
He replied casually, eyeing Ji Linghan’s cave mansion with interest.
The interior was simply furnished, with nothing but abundant spiritual qi, making it look quite plain.
"Sigh, I thought as a girl your cave mansion would have some pink decorations."
Upon hearing this, Ji Linghan’s beautiful big eyes narrowed.
Today, Lin Ning seemed particularly dismissive of her.
Although she and Lin Ning had a competitive relationship, there was usually basic respect.
After all, they’re from the same sect, and Lin Ning, though inherently competitive, was still outwardly courteous.
But now, entering her cave mansion like it’s her own home, speaking so imperiously, one would think she was the guest.
"How is your Great Sun Flame Sword practice going? What stage have you reached with the Purple Flame Heart Scripture?"
"Just so-so."
"Is that so?"
Ji Linghan became even more uncomfortable.
Although she and Lin Ning had a competitive relationship, this nonchalant attitude towards cultivation made her unhappy.
Especially since Lin Ning was still her disciple.
"Then practice it for me; if there are any mistakes, I can correct them for you."
Jiang Cheng could change his appearance and aura, but couldn’t replicate Lin Ning’s cultivation and martial techniques.
The Purple Flame Heart Scripture was from the Red Sun Sect, and he originally copied Duanmu Hong’s entire power and didn’t cultivate any other techniques.
He could only make an excuse: "Let’s not; I’m practicing well enough, no corrections needed."
"Are you being arrogant now?"
"Pfft..."
Seeing her serious demeanor, Brother Cheng burst into laughter. Compared to his impression of Ji Linghan, this was quite amusing.
"You’re taking your role as a master quite seriously, not bad!"
After saying this, he knew he was in trouble.
This wasn’t something Lin Ning was supposed to say.
"Hmph!"
As expected, Ji Linghan’s expression instantly turned cold like being covered in frost; the master’s authority fully displayed.
"You came today and didn’t even call out ’Master’ once!"
"Do we need to be so serious..."
Jiang Cheng felt helpless; I’m the sect leader, calling you Master would be too embarrassing.
"Although we made a promise, since you haven’t surpassed me yet, shouldn’t you still follow the etiquette of a disciple?"
Ji Linghan pressed harder.
This is a cultivation world; a cultivator without a master is as rare as a phoenix feather.
Thus, they hold the master-disciple relationship in high regard.
Ji Linghan was already lenient; if Jiang Cheng hadn’t changed to Lin Ning with such a flippant attitude, she wouldn’t have cared.
But now, she felt the need to discipline this unruly disciple, teaching her some manners.
Otherwise, if she eventually accepts the sect leader as her master, wouldn’t she upset the elder?
"I..."
Brother Cheng didn’t understand her good intentions; now he had beads of sweat on his forehead.
Am I seriously being scolded by this girl?
Her stern tone was no joke.
"What ’I’?"
Ji Linghan glared at him fiercely, her authority evident without anger.
Two cold words came out.
"Kneel!"
Damn...
Brother Cheng was truly unable to accept this.
As the person involved, he was really regretful, extremely regretful.
Should’ve chosen to become Luo Yuan instead.
At least I wouldn’t be getting scolded like this.
He couldn’t reveal his real identity.
The awkwardness was secondary; if the disciples misunderstood him having a feminine nature, there went his reputation.
"Um... Ah, the sect leader summoned me for something, I need to go..."
After saying this, he hurriedly escaped the cave mansion, darting away until he was out of sight.
Ji Linghan chased out after him.
The sect leader summoned?
Why didn’t I hear anything?
Could it be a transmission?
Is there something major happening?
On the other side, Jiang Cheng fled recklessly into the depths of a mountain.
After ensuring there’s no one within a thousand-mile radius, he patted his chest.
"Ji Linghan, Brother Cheng gave you Tier Nine Spiritual Artifacts and Tier Eight Spiritual Artifacts, treated you well, yet you want me to kneel..."
"Really spoiled you for nothing!"
"Better change back first."
The identity of Lin Ning is really hard to use.
Opening the system panel, he clicked on transformation skills, but it was unclickable.
"What’s going on, why is it gray?"
"System, come out!"
Spending 500 Points, he raised a crucial question.
"Why can’t I change back?"
"Transformation skills have a cooldown of three days. During the cooldown, the transformation button is gray and unclickable. Once three days are up, the host automatically returns to normal, and it doesn’t count towards transformation attempts."
"What the heck? Are you messing with me? Is this an undefeated system or a prank system?"
Without continuing to pay 500 Points to question, the system played dead, refusing to respond.
Brother Cheng was dumbfounded.
Is this transformation skill really so vexing?
Although reverting doesn’t count as the next transformation, three days cannot be changed back.
This means for these three days, he must maintain Lin Ning’s form for everyone.
This felt like a lightning strike, leaving him deeply troubled.
"Fine, just need to be careful avoiding Ji Linghan."
In his view, that girl should hopefully return to her cave mansion to cultivate.
Returning to the main hall, he discovered nearly all the disciples gathered there.
A sharp-eyed disciple spotted him immediately.
"Lin Ning!"
"Lin Ning is here!"
"Quick, ask her what’s going on!"
Before he had time to land, he was surrounded by a crowd of disciples, layer upon layer.
The person leading, none other than Ji Linghan.
"You finally appeared; tell us, where did the sect leader go?"
This...
What’s going on?
Little did he know that after he escaped, Ji Linghan thought the sect leader had urgent matters and rushed to the main hall.
After searching and not finding Jiang Cheng, she checked other disciples’ cave mansions.
Upon searching, everyone scoured several hundred miles nearby, actually finding the sect leader missing.
Feixian Sect’s current success is entirely dependent on Brother Cheng’s unparalleled influence.
If he’s missing, it’s like the sky falling.
Furthermore, though he rarely manages affairs as sect leader, he’s exceedingly kind to all disciples, viewing him like a reborn parent.
Learning he’s missing, some disciples even cried, and some initiated proposals to search outside.
Ji Linghan’s only clue was that Lin Ning might know the sect leader’s whereabouts.
"Lin Ning, where did the sect leader go?"
"Quickly tell us, so we can be at ease!"
Transforming into Lin Ning, Jiang Cheng was quite helpless, thinking, ’The sect leader is right before you, why the panic?’
But he couldn’t reveal the truth, or else the cross-dressing rumor would be solidified.
He could only grit his teeth and continue the act.
"The sect leader said he has urgent matters and left."
Ji Linghan immediately pursued the inquiry: "Where did he go?"
"I’m not sure; he just said not to worry."
"How can you prove your words are true?"
The speaker was the third generation disciple Wei Miao.
When entering the sect, he was the first to receive a welcome gift from Jiang Cheng.
From that day, he made an oath to brave life and death for the sect leader, and now, naturally, he was among the anxious ones.
Du Yu, also a third generation disciple, was equally relentless.
"Yeah, the sect leader usually gathers everyone and says a word when leaving; why only tell you this time?"

chapters.title: Chapter 87: "You Three-Eyed Tiger
chapters.content:
Chapter 87: Chapter 87: "You Three-Eyed Tiger
This kind of scenario is actually quite unlikely in other sects.
Lin Ning’s talent is firmly the first among the third generation. If she were in a sect like the Eight Clouds Hall of the Red Sun Sect, the status of other true disciples would be much lower than hers, and they wouldn’t dare speak to her like this.
But in the Feixian Sect, although Jiang Cheng values Lin Ning highly, he never elevated her status, so everyone interacts without any formality.
It’s one thing to be reprimanded by Ji Linghan, but do you third-generation dare to keep pestering too?
Brother Cheng almost got angry, his tone turning harsh.
"How would I know? Why don’t you ask him yourself?"
"If we could find him, would we need to ask you?"
"Since you can’t find him, then just go home and cultivate properly. Why get involved in so much nonsense?"
Seeing them stop cultivating again, Brother Cheng was quite displeased.
He just forgot for a moment that such words are meant for the Sect Leader to say.
"Hey, Lin Ning, what’s with this attitude?"
"Little girl, just reached the Spirit Platform Realm and your tail is already up in the air?"
The second-generation elders were also displeased.
Gan Ziyi frowned and said, "It seems your master hasn’t taught you how to speak to your elders?"
Yin Xuer shook her head, speaking earnestly, "Lin Ning, our Feixian Sect doesn’t require you to bow and salute every time you see your elders, but basic respect is necessary, don’t you agree?"
Jiang Cheng could only pinch his nose and nod, "Yes, yes, you’re right."
Qin Chang sternly asked, "Lin Ning, tell us honestly, where did the Sect Leader go and how long will he be gone?"
Jiang Cheng was so depressed his intestines ached.
In the past, whenever I showed up, everyone just showered me with flattery.
Today is different. Why is everyone so aggressive?
"I don’t know where he went, but he’ll definitely be back in three days."
Hearing three days, Ji Linghan was slightly relieved.
"Are you sure?"
"Of course."
"Did he tell you what he’s doing?"
"No, he just said it was confidential and not to inquire."
Gan Ziyi asked again, "Why did he only tell you?"
Jiang Cheng, posing as Lin Ning, replied naturally, "Because he thinks I’m the most important, obviously."
"What did you say?"
Yin Xuer and Ji Linghan both spoke simultaneously, their eyes sharp.
Seeing their expressions weren’t right, Brother Cheng was secretly puzzled. Was this something I shouldn’t have said?
"If there’s nothing else, I’ll be going."
With that, he pushed through the crowd, attempting to escape the troublesome place.
"Stop!"
"Clarify what you just said."
"Describe in detail the situation before the Sect Leader left."
"Indeed, don’t leave out a single word!"
Before he knew it, Jiang Cheng was surrounded again.
Facing their verbal attacks, he was so angry his teeth itched.
Okay, alright, just you wait.
After being criticized by the group a few times, he charged through the crowd again, quickly fleeing into the mountains.
"Don’t go!"
"You haven’t explained yourself yet!"
The crowd continued pursuing him.
Especially Yin Xuer and Ji Linghan, who were both in the Spirit Platform Realm.
Jiang Cheng, limited by the disguise as Lin Ning, couldn’t conveniently display the speed of the Celestial Fate Fourth Layer.
Circumventing a mountain, he activated invisibility and temporarily hid.
This farce didn’t subside until evening.
Hidden in a secret place, he decided to wait a few days until he reverted to his true form before showing up again, avoiding more trouble.
Now he deeply understood one principle, transformation skills are great, but shouldn’t be used recklessly.
Otherwise, it’s really asking for trouble.
With a touch to the storage ring, he pulled out a small notebook and jotted down names one by one.
"Wei Miao, just criticized me with two sentences."
"Gan Ziyi, just played big bad wolf in front of me, even blocked me and wouldn’t let me leave!"
"Yin Xuer, scolded me at least three times, pursued the most actively."
"Qin Chang, two sentences, really carried the elder demeanor..."
Actually, he also knew these disciples were worried about the Sect Leader, hence their urgency.
He should be comforted, yet still inexplicably unable to let it go.
After documenting, he felt relieved.
"First find a place to rest for two days."
"Having to hide within my own sect, what a thing, sigh..."
He found a cave outside and suddenly heard some movement inside.
Before he could spread his divine thought to check, boom, his head went blank, and then he died.
A small figure flew out from the cave, it was the Three-Eyed Tiger.
Seeing the fallen figure, it immediately shouted in panic.
"Damn, it’s Lin Ning, how did you kill her?"
Quickly, a black mist followed suit and flew out.
"Feixian Sect disciple?"
A hoarse, aged voice echoed from the mist.
"What do you think?"
The Three-Eyed Tiger was quite annoyed.
"This is big trouble now! Jiang Cheng is going to be furious!"
The black mist seemed indifferent, "Aren’t you a Demon King, are you really that afraid of that guy? He’s just a Celestial Fate Realm, why do I have to hide here to avoid him, what on earth are you worried about?"
The Three-Eyed Tiger jumped up, its tiger eyes full of irritation.
"That guy is wickedly strange, you’ll understand in due time. Besides, I agreed to be the Sect Guardian Spirit Beast for three years, you killed a disciple right under my watch, what do you want me to do?"
The black mist was silent for a moment before softly coughing.
"Alright, consider it my mistake. I’m used to casually disposing of eavesdroppers..."
Transformed into a spirit form, Jiang Cheng listened expressionlessly to their conversation, or rather, the dialogue between two mighty beings.
Initially, he was furious.
"Good job, Three-Eyed Tiger, colluding with demons right under my nose."
Alright then, seems like this ’private visit’ has yielded substantial findings!
But after listening a while, his perspective shifted. The Tiger Demon truly was unexpectedly keeping its promise, sincerely taking the Sect Guardian Spirit Beast role seriously.
However, the creature within the black mist must be held accountable!
If it were truly Lin Ning, or any other disciple accidentally straying here, they’d be genuinely dead.
He couldn’t tolerate such dangerous entities within his Feixian Sect.
"Ding, host has been killed, detecting opponent’s power, preparing resurrection plan."
"Ding, host has obtained a Main Soul Mark, opponent’s life and death lie at the host’s discretion."
The system is so powerful?
This was the first time, previously even encountering Gathering Yuan Realm or Soul Splitting Realm, it would only provide methods for me to kill the enemy.
This time, it directly handed the enemy’s life over to me?
He didn’t know that this time the situation was a bit special.
"Ding, host resurrection."
There was a flash of white light on the ground, instantly disappearing.
With the power of the Three-Eyed Tiger and the black mist, they couldn’t even see what happened in that instant.
Then Jiang Cheng, restored to his original form, stood up.
"I damn you, Three-Eyed Tiger, you traitor!"
Upon speaking, he realized his voice had returned to a male voice.
Looking down, his body had reverted too.
Hey, so resurrection after being killed restores the original form?
This could be considered an unexpected bonus discovery, yet it couldn’t mask his fury.
"Jiang Cheng!"
"How is it you?"
The Three-Eyed Tiger was taken aback, it was Lin Ning just now, how did it become Jiang Cheng, and even his clothes reverted too.

chapters.title: Chapter 88: Accepted an Immortal
chapters.content:
Chapter 88: Chapter 88: Accepted an Immortal
The black fog surged, seemingly finding it unbelievable as well.
The Transformation Technique was something both he and the Three-Eyed Tiger knew about.
But that was just a blinding technique, not something that could fool the two of them.
Moreover, they had just clearly killed that girl, how could she have come back to life?
Jiang Cheng coldly sneered, "I just used an illusion technique casually, what you killed was just an illusion."
"My power is beyond what you ants can fathom."
Of course, he wouldn’t give away his secrets and let others know about his transformation ability.
Habitually, he opened an Insight in secret while speaking, trying to figure out what the deal with this black fog was.
But unexpectedly, when he used the skill, the panel just showed three question marks.
Couldn’t find anything.
"System, what’s going on, why can’t I trace his origins? Is he more special than the World Heart Fragment?"
"Basic Insight can only explore things in this world. The World Heart Fragment was born here, but not this entity; the host’s current level of Insight is not enough to detect it."
Could there be a High-level Insight?
Is this black fog really that formidable?
Had it not been for the fact that he directly obtained that Main Soul Mark, Brother Cheng wouldn’t really have much confidence.
The Three-Eyed Tiger instinctively wanted to refute, clearly understanding Jiang Cheng’s power.
But thinking of the recent series of anomalies, it found itself somewhat uncertain.
"Jiang Cheng, this is all a misunderstanding, don’t get angry, he’s not an enemy..."
For the Three-Eyed Tiger, this was an exceptionally rare patient explanation.
But at this moment, Brother Cheng just couldn’t listen.
"Misunderstanding? It’s one thing for you to mingle with questionable friends, but bringing them to Feixian Sect to cause trouble..."
"He wasn’t causing trouble..."
"I’ll deal with you later; let me finish him first!"
The black fog churned again, followed by a hoarse, aged voice.
"Junior ant, do you really take yourself seriously?"
"You’re just at the Fourth Layer of Celestial Fate. Even when I’m not at my peak, killing you is but a thought."
"I’m not dealing with you now, back off!"
Upon hearing this, Jiang Cheng knew this guy was bluffing.
If he could really kill me, he wouldn’t just be talking.
"Oh, you don’t care? Then I care a little."
With that, he directly activated the mark.
The next moment, the black fog shook violently.
A mass of ghastly white mystical fire rose out of nowhere, with waves of heat emanating and dissipating from the fog.
Within the black fog, an illusory human face appeared, flickering in and out of view.
"Ah!"
"Spare me!"
"No..."
The black fog, unable to withstand the soul-deep pain of being burned, screamed in agony.
"Jiang Cheng, no, stop, don’t kill him!"
The Three-Eyed Tiger didn’t know how Jiang Cheng had achieved this, so it quickly pleaded, but Brother Cheng refused to listen.
"Thoroughly eradicate evil, and you’ll need to provide me with a reasonable explanation later!"
"He’s not a villain, nor did he ever intend to harm your Feixian Sect, he’s an Upper Immortal..."
What?
Upper Immortal?
And so what, ’Lin Ning’ was just killed by him, wasn’t he?
At this point, the black fog had already faded to gray, on the verge of vanishing completely.
The ’Upper Immortal’ within the black fog was no longer arrogant, miserably begging for mercy.
"Sect Leader Jiang, I was wrong..."
"Don’t kill me..."
"I’m willing to submit..."
Is this an Upper Immortal?
Didn’t seem much tougher than an ordinary cultivator’s backbone.
Is it true that the longer one lives, the more afraid of death they become?
Jiang Cheng then paused for the moment, as with the mark in hand, he could sense its position at any time and could kill it whenever he wished.
"Oh? Submit?"
The cessation allowed the black fog to gradually calm down.
Only from its color could one tell that it had been severely injured, much weaker than before.
"Cough, cough..."
"Yes, yes, yes, I submit, henceforth following Sect Leader Jiang’s lead."
"I don’t know how Sect Leader Jiang obtained my Main Soul Mark?"
This black fog was really aggrieved.
The Main Soul Mark is the core essence of the Divine Soul, the most important part.
It’s just that last time when something happened, its Main Soul Mark got knocked off, leaving only a residual soul in this black fog now.
Had he not possessed great power, any other cultivator losing their Main Soul would have died thoroughly.
He never imagined that the lost Main Soul Mark would end up with Jiang Cheng.
This thing is his lifeline; moving one part could affect the whole, and it indeed could kill him.
Must stall this guy, find a way to get that Main Soul Mark back...
Jiang Cheng didn’t know what he was thinking; he only realized the system hadn’t made the sound.
It says submission, but there’s no sound?
Looks like, just like with Qi Cang, it’s surface compliance while harboring malicious intent inside.
"Submission? You think I’m that easy to deceive? Just waiting for you to recover and plot against me, right!"
With that, he was about to activate the Main Soul Mark again.
The white flame had just risen when the black fog wailed in misery again.
"This is unjust..."
"I’m truly submitting..."
The system still hadn’t made a sound; Jiang Cheng was pondering whether to just deal with him once and for all.
Thinking about it, experts still held onto their pride.
The Three-Eyed Tiger didn’t really submit, only agreeing to collaborate as a Sect Guardian Spirit Beast for three years.
Let alone an immortal.
For those with ulterior motives, the more powerful they are, the greater the potential disaster they pose.
"Young one, hold on!"
"Did you acquire his Main Soul Mark?"
The Three-Eyed Tiger suddenly transmitted a message, filled with incredulity.
"That’s right, so what?"
"Wow, then it’s easy to make him submit!"
The Three-Eyed Tiger suddenly laughed, but its laughter carried a hint of lewdness, clearly not having good intentions.
"Oh? How do I do it?"
"You can completely use your Divine Soul to inscribe a Contract Array upon his Main Soul Mark, by then he won’t just submit, he won’t be able to defy you at all."
Being a Demon King, it had that much insight.
"Is there such a good thing?"
Brother Cheng really felt tempted, thinking that acquiring an immortal as a subordinate would elevate his status to unprecedented levels.
"Of course, such important stuff, I can’t believe you got your hands on it."
"How should I operate it?"
"I’ll teach you."
The secret plotting of the two big schemers was transmitted silently, the black fog heard nothing,
he was really grateful to the Three-Eyed Tiger, luckily this Tiger Demon pleaded for him, or he wouldn’t have made it through.
But the next moment, he couldn’t feel happy anymore.
He realized he seemed to have an extra layer of restraint.
That feeling came from the depths of the Divine Soul, impossible to defy. If he harbored any murderous intent towards Jiang Cheng, his soul would truly scatter!
"Ding, you have obtained the loyalty of a subordinate, earning 10,000 points."
The system finally acknowledged it, but Jiang Cheng was not very satisfied.
Wasn’t it supposed to be an Immortal?
An Immortal should be worth at least a billion points, right?
Just a mere ten thousand?
If this contract didn’t come at no cost, he would have regretted it.
"What did you do?"

chapters.title: Chapter 89 Tragic Mo Chen
chapters.content:
Chapter 89: Chapter 89 Tragic Mo Chen
The black mist continuously condensed, becoming even denser than before.
In the end, it even formed a humanoid shape.
"Oh, I just made a contract with your main soul."
The Three-Eyed Tiger groomed its white fur, now that this black mist had become Jiang Cheng’s subordinate, its status was even lower than its own, so it didn’t take it seriously.
"You, you damn Tiger Demon, and to think I trusted you so much!"
He wasn’t stupid; such a contract could never be understood by the Celestial Fate Realm.
It must have been taught to him by the Three-Eyed Tiger during the recent transmission.
"You betrayed me!"
The black mist was furious. If it weren’t currently far from its peak state and unable to beat this damned tiger, it would have probably rushed to destroy it.
"Don’t put it that way."
"You see, you haven’t lost out. By forming a contract with him, your Divine Soul received a significant supplement, and you’re not suppressed by the rules of the Lower Realm, so you’re in even better condition than before."
"From this angle, you should thank me."
"However, Master Tiger never seeks repayment for doing good deeds, you can just keep it in your heart."
As a King Bi who could stand shoulder to shoulder with Brother Cheng, the Three-Eyed Tiger’s words were infuriatingly smug.
"You, you..."
If it had a body, the black mist would probably be spitting blood in anger.
"Alright, alright, now you know your situation."
"You know what to do."
If it wasn’t completely subdued, Jiang Cheng certainly wouldn’t keep it around.
Even though he wasn’t afraid of death, other disciples were, and he wouldn’t leave a hidden danger unchecked within the Feixian Sect.
That black mist stayed silent for a long time, eventually heaving a deep sigh.
"Do I have any other choice?"
To become an Immortal required countless years of experience, far from the impulsive young lad, it knew how to adapt to circumstances.
Jiang Cheng was very satisfied with this change in attitude.
"Rest assured, as long as you behave and don’t cause trouble, I won’t make things difficult for you, and I’ll give you enough respect."
"Thank you!"
The humanoid figure condensed from the black mist slightly bowed, secretly relieved.
He knew Jiang Cheng basically had no need to offer this promise.
If someone else had obtained his Main Soul Mark, his fate afterward would have been extremely miserable.
Respect? Not possible.
"Alright, tell me about your origins."
"How did you come to my Feixian Sect?"
The black mist sighed once again, a sigh full of ancient sorrow.
"It all began with the Immortal Demon War from millions of years ago, when the Eastern Heaven Domain attempted to annex..."
Just the first sentence, and Jiang Cheng couldn’t listen anymore.
Can’t you talk about something people can understand, the Immortal Demon War is too far removed from him, he’s not interested, nor does he want to get involved.
"Stop, stop, highlight the main points. First, what’s your name?"
"Ahem, alright, I... I, the Immortal Venerable, am called Mo Chen, with a title of Dark Ji Immortal Venerable."
What nonsense Immortal Venerable, Jiang Cheng glanced at him, suspecting he was bragging.
Because this guy stammered, clearly trying to elevate his own standing, probably someone who cares about face.
"So how did an Immortal like you end up here?"
"Back then, the Immortal and Demon Dao were at war, countless deaths and injuries. I also participated and was severely injured by a group of demon cultivators, nearly perishing."
Mo Chen sighed deeply: "The war was so chaotic at the time, creating a small rift between the Immortal Realm and the Lower Realm, allowing my Primordial Spirit to escape down."
"Then what? It’s been millions of years, why are you still here?"
"After coming down from the Immortal Realm, my Primordial Spirit was suppressed by the rules, and the Main Soul Mark was lost at that time."
"The remaining Residual Soul continued to attach to the Companion Demon... uh, Companion Immortal Artifact, Blood Transformation Immortal Blade, otherwise, it would have long dissipated."
Brother Cheng and the Three-Eyed Tiger both looked at him meaningfully, expressions quite subtle.
Old man, it seems you just said ’demon,’ are you taking advantage of our listening?
The situation was awkward for a moment.
The black mist formed by Mo Chen’s Residual Soul floated there, remaining silent.
After a full minute of silence, he seemed to regain his composure.
"Do you think I’m a demon cultivator?"
Demon cultivators are often erratic and evil in actions; any normal cultivator would stay far away, even despise them upon hearing those words.
"Hahaha, how could that be, I’m an orthodox Righteous Cultivator, part of the Immortal Sect camp!"
"If you don’t believe me, you can inquire around in the Immortal Realm about my reputation as the Dark Ji Immortal Venerable, Mo Chen, people praise me everywhere!"
We can’t just go to the Immortal Realm, how are we supposed to ask? Can’t you just make it up?
Seeing that Jiang Cheng and the Three-Eyed Tiger still didn’t believe him, in his anxiety, he shouted to prove his innocence.
"I am irreconcilable with demon cultivators!"
The Three-Eyed Tiger rolled its eyes: "Really?"
"Indeed! I have always hated demon cultivators, kill one when I see one, kill a group when I see a group!"
"In my youth, I vowed to eradicate demon cultivators in this lifetime..."
Mo Chen spoke righteously, his determination clear.
Even Jiang Cheng couldn’t stand it; old man, you’ve already exposed yourself, yet in order to hide your identity, you completely betray your own camp.
Looks like you’ve done some shameless things before?
"Alright, alright, I don’t care if you’re a demon cultivator or an Immortal Cultivator. I only care about the Demon Artifact, the Blood Transformation Demon Blade, where is it?"
"That is an Immortal Blade, an Immortal Artifact..."
Mo Chen was still correcting it.
"In fact, you’ve already seen it, it’s the war trophy you got from the Duanmu Family, the Blood Transformation Blade."
Blood Transformation Blade?
That Tier Seven Spiritual Artifact? The Duanmu Family’s ancestral treasure?
To be honest, after Jiang Cheng grabbed it back, he didn’t pay much attention to it.
Firstly, he didn’t use a blade, and secondly, he found the blood-red blade somewhat unsettling.
Little did he expect, that this thing was actually an Immortal Artifact?
After a detailed explanation, he finally understood the whole story.
Back when he escaped into the Lower Realm, Mo Chen’s Residual Soul had been hiding within the Blood Transformation Demon Blade.
Due to the loss of the Main Soul Mark and the suppression from the Lower Realm’s rules, he couldn’t manifest outside, or he would risk disintegration.
He had to rely on absorbing the Blood Transformation Demon Blade’s Immortal Essence and essence to barely hang on to life.
Through the passage of time, countless years passed, the Blood Transformation Demon Blade continuously degraded in grade as Mo Chen absorbed its Immortal Essence.
Dropping from an Immortal Artifact to a Tier Eight Spiritual Artifact.
The Immortal Essence had long been exhausted, and originally he didn’t have many years left to live.
But then, at that moment, the Blood Transformation Demon Blade was accidentally discovered by the ancestor of the Duanmu Family.
The Duanmu Family, treating it as a Supreme Treasure, used the Spiritual Artifact as a foundation for the family’s rise.
Indeed, they grew from a non-prominent small family to one of the two dominators of Qinglan Prefecture.
Until the Spiritual Artifact dropped in grade again, they realized something was wrong.
The Duanmu Family thought the Spiritual Artifact degraded after use, unaware that an Immortal resided within, constantly absorbing the artifact’s last essence.
They then used the Blood Pool to nourish it, temporarily stabilizing it at Level 7.
But the Residual Soul within Mo Chen was too weak and couldn’t fight against the rules of the Lower Realm, so he didn’t bother to show up, letting them fiddle around.
The Blood Pool’s effects on him were extremely weak, only barely keeping him alive.
After Jiang Cheng brought the Blood Transformation Blade to the Feixian Sect, he casually left it in the Treasure Vault without any attention.
Originally, Mo Chen would not last long without the Blood Pool, but the Feixian Sect had a Demon King, the Three-Eyed Tiger.
Its power far exceeded the Duanmu Family, and the distinct aura of the Blood Transformation Demon Blade and its internal essence from above the Lower Realm was sharply sensed by it.
So it stole the Spiritual Artifact away, after an investigation, Mo Chen couldn’t hide anymore.

chapters.title: Chapter 90: Determined to Become a Personal Grandmaster
chapters.content:
Chapter 90: Chapter 90: Determined to Become a Personal Grandmaster
After the demon and the spirit met, they quickly hit it off.
The Three-Eyed Tiger took a liking to Mo Chen’s background, hoping that when Mo Chen restores his strength and status, he can give him a hand.
After all, he is an Upper Realm Immortal, much more formidable than the strongest in the Celestial Demon Domain, the Golden Dragon King.
With him backing, wouldn’t it mean he could walk sideways?
If lucky, he might even ascend with him.
On Mo Chen’s side, of course, he valued the current strength of the Three-Eyed Tiger.
A Demon King of this level was considered top-notch in the Lower Realm.
With the Three-Eyed Tiger’s protection, he needn’t worry about the Blood Transformation Demon Blade being taken by small fry or his Residual Soul being extracted.
So during this time, the two were scheming together in this deep mountain forest.
With the help of the Three-Eyed Tiger, Mo Chen’s Residual Soul restored to some extent, finally allowing him to part from the Blood Transformation Demon Blade and see the light of day again.
However, he was unlucky enough to be discovered by Jiang Cheng.
But because Jiang Cheng took him in and made a Contract, he won’t be suppressed by the Lower Realm’s Rules anymore.
"So now you only have this wisp of Residual Soul left, nothing else?"
Brother Cheng was not satisfied.
No wonder this guy only scored ten thousand; turns out he’s an extremely weakened, incomplete version of an Immortal.
"I still have a Companion Immortal Artifact, though it has fallen to the level of a Spiritual Artifact, as long as I properly nurture my Immortal Essence, it can be restored..."
The identity of Demon Cultivator was understood without saying, yet Mo Chen still called himself an Immortal with Immortal Artifact.
This guy cared about his face till the end.
"What are your plans moving forward? I warn you if you dare try to take over any of my Disciples, I will destroy you immediately!"
In Jiang Cheng’s view, what a Residual Soul wanted most was to take over a body.
But soon after, Mo Chen dispelled his doubts.
"You’re overthinking. My Immortal Soul, though broken, below the Saint Realm, no body can withstand the injection of a soul of this level; it would just collapse. So it’s impossible for me to take over a disciple of the Feixian Sect."
Otherwise, he would have taken over someone from the Duanmu Family long ago.
Jiang Cheng nodded; since there was no threat and he couldn’t resist anyway, he let him be.
"What’s your current strength? Who can you take down?"
Speaking of strength, Mo Chen said proudly, "Below Daoist Palace, I can kill with a thought."
"That’s it?" Jiang Cheng curled his lips.
Mo Chen immediately felt frustrated.
You yourself are only at Celestial Fate Fourth Layer, and the strongest disciple of the Feixian Sect is at Spirit Platform Ninth Layer.
Isn’t being able to instantly kill Celestial Fate Ninth Layer impressive enough for you?
"Below Ascending to Saint, if at the cost of damaging my Immortal Soul, I can also kill..."
"Alright, alright, just rest."
Brother Cheng immediately lost interest; what Immortal, this was not as good as the Three-Eyed Tiger.
This laissez-faire attitude made Mo Chen breathe a sigh of relief and silently thought this person was quite easy to get along with.
But on the other hand, the Immortal’s pride took a heavy hit.
So, he was somewhat unwilling to clear his name.
"If you could return my Main Soul Mark, I could instantly restore some strength!"
"By that time... I could easily obliterate the Three-Eyed Fierce Tiger!"
He still remembered how the Three-Eyed Tiger betrayed him just now, teaching Jiang Cheng how to control him.
These words made the Three-Eyed Tiger’s hair stand on end.
"Hey, hey, are you serious? Don’t forget who has been taking care of you these days!"
Jiang Cheng shook his head, showing no interest in this suggestion.
"Do you take me for a fool?"
Return his Main Soul Mark, this guy would undoubtedly backstab.
He wouldn’t add any inexplicable risks to himself.
"If you could find Saint Grade Soul Nourishing Spirit Medicine Treasures, allowing my Primordial Spirit to replenish, I could also recover a small portion of strength."
The Duanmu Family was really too weak before.
Don’t mention Saint Grade Elixir, they couldn’t even obtain Spirit Medicine above Tier Seven.
Above Spirit Medicine is Treasure Pill, Profound Pill, and Holy Pill.
There’s too much of a gap in level, so Mo Chen couldn’t be bothered to rely on them.
Saint Grade Spirit Elixirs are extremely rare in the Lower Realm, let alone finding a Pill Master of that grade even if they obtained those Heavenly and Earthly Treasures.
That level of elixir is hard even for the Three-Eyed Tiger to obtain.
With Jiang Cheng, he initially didn’t hold any hope either.
But this kid inexplicably got his Main Soul Mark and inexplicably got the Three-Eyed Tiger’s help...
This led Mo Chen to associate him with a specific identity—the Child of the Plane with deep fortune!
Such people typically have a tragic background, but a twist of fate reverses their fortune, leading to immense luck.
Although they may face small setbacks along the way, they can always miraculously turn danger into safety.
Their enemies, no matter how strong, would get countered by them.
They have another significant trait—an affinity for Treasures.
Wherever they go, they can easily obtain Heavenly and Earthly Treasures and Divine Weapons, even owning a dog could be the variant descendant of an Ancient Qilin, as if favored by the heavens.
In the Upper Realm Immortal Domain, such Children of the Plane exist.
Some exhaust their luck upon reaching the Immortal Domain, becoming ordinary immortals.
Some continue to sustain their luck, ultimately becoming a powerhouse in the Immortal Domain.
Could this child be such a person?
If he truly is, following him might actually be beneficial, maybe even reversing fate against the odds.
Right, when those Children of the Plane rise, some had a ’Personal Grandmaster’ or an injured ’Fairy Big Sister’ hidden in a weapon or ring, guiding them discreetly throughout.
Guiding the Child of the Plane’s growth as a mentor, a friend for life.
How similar is this to myself?
Also born extraordinary, once powerful, but suffered severe injuries...
Could it be that by some bizarre coincidence, I too have become someone’s ’Personal Grandmaster’?
He remembered two Children of the Plane whose ’Personal Grandmaster’ not only regained their original strength in the end but also gained from their flying star opportunities, becoming several times stronger than at their peak, their abundance of Treasures envied by all.
Thinking of this, he suddenly accepted his current situation.
Even considered it might be a good thing to follow Jiang Cheng.
But this thought transformation, Brother Cheng couldn’t sense.
Or even if he knew, he might not care.
Does he need a ’Personal Grandmaster’?
"Alright, alright, talking about Saint Grade Elixirs, dreaming of nonsense, just wash up and sleep. I don’t need your help; stop thinking about those unachievable things."
Ah?
What?
Isn’t this not how the script should play out?
Mo Chen was a bit at a loss.
Logically, having an Immortal submit to oneself, shouldn’t there be wild joy?
Even if this Immortal was heavily injured and not at a tenth thousandth of peak strength, his knowledge and experience were still there.
Especially if he truly ascended in the future, it would be like having an old hand in the unfamiliar Immortal Domain.
He would’ve already gotten connections and relationships in the Immortal Domain, saving countless detours!
Look at the Three-Eyed Tiger’s previous attitude, it’s clear no one in the Lower Realm could refuse a ’Personal Grandmaster’ like a five-star quality perk.
Even a Demon King Saint Tier is no exception!
Seeing Jiang Cheng about to leave, he couldn’t take it anymore.
It was too damaging to his self-esteem.
Dignified Upper Immortal offering his own assistance, yet met with a cold shoulder?
"Stop right there!"
He rushed forward, blocking the path.
Due to being overly emotional, he even roared loudly.
"Why look down on people?"
"Do you know what you’ve missed out on? You will regret it for life!"

chapters.title: Chapter 91 Elder Mo
chapters.content:
Chapter 91: Chapter 91 Elder Mo
Although the human-shaped black fog had no face, Jiang Cheng could still feel its intense emotions.
He felt quite baffled.
Old pal, what are you trying to do?
Is it that I didn’t use the main soul mark to torment you, making you feel unsatisfied? Or is it that I didn’t use the contract to enslave you, making you feel too bored?
What are you so excited about?
Can we be a bit reasonable here?
He turned around with a sympathetic look.
"Alright, alright, I shouldn’t have looked down on you, is that okay now?"
"Take care of yourself well in the future, eat more if you can, nourish your body, you’re in the twilight of life, you need to take good care of yourself."
Pfft...
The Three-Eyed Tiger directly burst into laughter.
It could understand Mo Chen’s feelings, so it knew how frustrated this Upper Immortal must be feeling right now.
This kid’s words always inadvertently cause critical strikes.
Back then, he nearly made me cough up blood too. Now that I’m just a bystander, it strangely feels satisfying.
"I, this Demon... oh no, I, this Immortal, have an unmatched understanding of the major powers in the Immortal Realm, and I’m well-versed in the rules and taboos of the Immortal Realm. I also have many old friends whose powers are sky-high and hold prestigious positions in the Immortal Realm!"
"If you are willing to help me find Saint Grade Spirit Medicine, then in the future if you have the chance to ascend, I can take you..."
Mo Chen couldn’t care for much else, and like a salesman, he laid out his advantages.
But before he finished speaking, Jiang Cheng interrupted him.
"Oh, you’re really amazing, but I don’t need to be led by others. I prefer to carry myself to supernatural levels."
Does he really need that?
Even if I truly enter the Immortal Realm in the future, having three invincible days each time, there’s no need to consider anything else at all.
"What, you actually don’t need it?"
Mo Chen was almost going crazy.
"Do you think ascending to Immortality is that simple? Without guidance, no matter how good your talent is, you might never have the chance to..."
"Then no chance it is."
Jiang Cheng had no worry at all that he wouldn’t be able to ascend in the future.
The Celestial Desolation Indestructible Body, as the system said at the beginning, is the number one cultivation physique.
If he can’t become an Immortal, he’d definitely give the system ten thousand negative reviews!
"You! If you are willing to help me, then if you encounter enemies you can’t resist, I can help you solve them, which is beneficial to both of us..."
Jiang Cheng interrupted again, seeming a bit anxious.
"No need, I thank you! Please don’t solve them for me, just take good care of yourself."
If you solve my enemies for me, then how am I supposed to be killed?
Mo Chen felt he had really seen a ghost; it was his first time encountering such a ’Child of the Plane’ who didn’t need anything.
He was so disheartened that he began to question life.
Why is it so hard to ’apply’ to be a Personal Grandmaster? Can’t even pass the interview?
The sense of superiority as an Immortal vanished without a trace.
"I also have rich cultivation experience; I can guide you..."
Even saying this himself felt pointless; this kid doesn’t need any help, what need is there for cultivation experience?
But this time, Brother Cheng’s eyes lit up.
He was lazy to cultivate, especially since the Five Elements Martial Dao had reached the Immortal Level, he didn’t need any guidance.
But he didn’t need it, whereas the other disciples of the Feixian Sect needed it!
As the Sect Leader, he never taught any disciple because he himself had no foundation.
Thinking about having an Immortal guiding cultivation within the sect, wouldn’t the disciples’ cultivation speed skyrocket?
What bottleneck problem can stump an Immortal?
This level of treatment is unique in the whole world!
By that time, the speed at which these disciples help him earn points would also increase.
This is a business transaction worth making.
"Alright then, seeing as you’re so eager, I’ll begrudgingly accept you as an Elder of our sect."
"Ah!"
Mo Chen was overjoyed.
"You agreed?"
His reaction was not hard to understand.
The ’application’ went through!
He finally gained the ’Child of the Plane’s’ approval, being regarded as an insider.
In his view, it was a major turning point significant enough to change one’s destiny.
"In the future, just help guide the disciples for me."
"No problem, it’s all on me, do you have any other needs?"
This was too overly enthusiastic, in stark contrast to the Three-Eyed Tiger.
Even Brother Cheng suspected if he had been holding it in too long, breaking his brain.
"Not for now, but in this form, how should I introduce you to the disciples?"
"That’s easy!"
As soon as Mo Chen finished speaking, the black fog drifted back to the cave, wrapping around the Blood Transformation Demon Blade.
The residual soul black fog seemed to be drawn by a vortex, entering the Demon Artifact.
Right under Jiang Cheng’s eyes, the Demon Artifact squirmed and expanded, and in the blink of an eye, it transformed into a human figure.
Tall and large, pale and beardless, he seemed no older than forty, even possessing the mature charm of a handsome middle-aged man.
"Wow, how did you do that?"
Isn’t this Demon Artifact demoted to a Spiritual Artifact?
Mo Chen, using the Demon Artifact to conjure a body, smiled slightly and bowed.
In every move, this body even emitted a faint sound of gold and jade scraping against each other.
"Reporting to Sect Leader, this is just a form of Puppetry. Although the Blood Transformation Immortal Blade fell to a Spiritual Artifact, its material is still at the Immortal Artifact level, and can temporarily be used as my puppet body."
Honestly, it was only now that Jiang Cheng truly believed he was an Immortal.
Until this point, he still harbored a little doubt.
Even thinking that, so what if he was an Immortal?
"Impressive! Congrats, congrats!"
The Three-Eyed Tiger flew over, loudly congratulating.
Seeing Mo Chen recover somewhat, become an Elder, and integrate into Jiang Cheng’s direct lineage, its attitude suddenly became more cordial.
"Hehe, Old Mo, tell me more about the few major forces in the Immortal Realm, and how our Demon Race is faring there, are there any of our Tiger Race’s seniors we can latch onto..."
Using the Blood Transformation Demon Blade as a puppet, Mo Chen gave it a sidelong glance.
Letting out a cold snort from his nose.
"Old Mo is something you can call?"
Although partly because of the Three-Eyed Tiger, he indirectly latched onto the ’Child of the Plane’s’ thigh.
But this shameless Tiger Demon couldn’t just let go of their previous betrayal.
He paid attention to Jiang Cheng, but had no good attitude towards this Tiger Demon.
However, the Three-Eyed Tiger itself had no principles, and even without attention, it could talk non-stop.
"Alright, then it’s Elder Mo!"
"Elder Mo, you promised before to support this brother in the future; it still counts, right?"
"Hehe, Elder Mo, wait up, you can’t forget to repay your brother for the meticulous care in past days..."
The demon and two people returned to the main hall, and Jiang Cheng sent word to gather all the disciples back.
"The Sect Leader is back!"
"Wow, that’s great!"
"Wuwuwu, Sect Leader, we finally see you!"
"Where did you go, you scared us to death..."
Before, thinking Jiang Cheng was missing, they had planned to go search separately.
Now seeing him, several female disciples clung to him, crying and refusing to let go.
This made Brother Cheng feel quite emotional; his care for these disciples didn’t go to waste.
But soon after, his moved heart was dampened by the next words.
"We can’t easily forgive that Lin Ning, she actually deceived us by saying the Sect Leader would return in three days!"
"Yes, the Sect Leader should punish her as an example to others!"
"No need for something too severe, at least scold her a few times to curb her arrogance!"
"Lin Ning, relying on the Sect Leader’s favor, has become arrogant, ignoring the Martial Uncles, please Sect Leader see the truth."
This blatant tattling stirred a righteous anger in Brother Cheng.
That ’Lin Ning’ was me in disguise!
How do you even have the nerve to bring this up?

chapters.title: Chapter 92: A Very Useful Immortal
chapters.content:
Chapter 92: Chapter 92: A Very Useful Immortal
"Looks like all my teachings have been forgotten by you!"
With this sudden change of face, everyone was left dumbfounded.
Teachings?
Has the Sect Leader ever taught anything before?
"I’ve said it a hundred times: fellow disciples must cherish and love each other. Complaining behind others’ backs like this, what kind of behavior is that?"
Everyone was left bewildered by the reprimand.
They secretly pondered, although it makes sense to cherish and love fellow disciples, it seems you’ve never said this before.
They racked their brains, but all they remembered were the Sect Leader’s acting cool and shocking everyone.
Besides that, nothing else came to mind.
"Lin Ning was acting under my orders, and it was a very urgent matter, which I instructed her not to disclose."
"This matter should not be mentioned again in the future, got it?"
If Lin Ning were to keep being questioned once she was out, then the secret might be revealed.
Gan Ziyi and others immediately echoed loudly, showering flattery.
"Yes, yes, yes, the Sect Leader’s reprimand was spot on!"
Qin Chang even took out a small notebook on the spot and began jotting down quickly.
"Everyone should note down what the Sect Leader says just like I do, didn’t you hear?"
Wei Miao shouted, "No need for Master Qin to remind us, I’ve already memorized the Sect Leader’s sayings by heart without missing a word!"
In their view, the reason Shan Tai received an advancement of a great realm last time was solely because he praised the Sect Leader the most vigorously in everyday life.
So of course, they were now imitating his example.
In fact, last time Jiang Cheng chose to boost Shan Tai simply because he frequented the scene and was most recognizable.
The nearby Three-Eyed Tiger had long grown accustomed to this exaggerated flattery, while Mo Chen found it quite eye-opening.
He secretly wondered, would he, too, have to go with the flow in the future?
After all, he was an Immortal, wasn’t it demeaning?
He thought it would be better to maintain some restraint.
Jiang Cheng wasn’t genuinely angry; naturally, he stopped there.
"Alright, alright, let me introduce you to someone."
"This is Mo Chen, Elder Mo. From now on, he’s one of us at the Feixian Sect."
Even though it was their first meeting, with Jiang Cheng’s personal introduction, everyone readily accepted the new elder without hesitation.
They stepped forward one by one to greet him.
"Greetings, Elder Mo!"
"Where did Elder Mo reside previously?"
"What is Elder Mo’s realm?"
They noticed that there wasn’t a trace of Spiritual Qi on Elder Mo’s body.
It was truly a mystery; could it be that his realm, like the Sect Leader’s, was too high to be perceived?
"Elder Mo was once an Upper Realm Immortal but unfortunately suffered a great calamity and was gravely injured. You should show him respect in the future."
These words moved Mo Chen deeply.
Had Jiang Cheng stated that Elder Mo was under his control, it would have been a loss of face, and the dignity of an Immortal would have vanished.
