From this perspective, Jiang Cheng had given him face.
"An Immortal indeed!"
The disciples were astounded; Immortals were far too far beyond their reach.
"Oh my god, a living Immortal!"
"The Sect Leader is truly extraordinary, isn’t he?"
"Did you forget? The Sect Leader himself is an Immortal, so having an Immortal friend is nothing surprising."
"Right, right, he must have been invited by the Sect Leader."
They accepted the existence of an Immortal quite naturally, which made Mo Chen find it unbelievable.
Were he to appear in another sect and establish his identity as an Immortal, that sect might experience an upheaval.
"Elder Mo will act as the instructor elder in our sect; if you have any issues in your cultivation, feel free to consult him."
Seeing Elder Mo nodding and smiling, the disciples were overjoyed.
The Feixian Sect’s biggest flaw was the lack of elderly figures.
Just months ago, the elders like Ji Linghan and Luo Yuan were merely other people’s disciples and were still young.
Though Jiang Cheng constantly performed miracles, he wasn’t involved in management or teaching cultivation.
Having an older person at home is truly like having a treasure; the experience of the older generation is invaluable.
Moreover, this elder is an Immortal, putting everyone’s minds more at ease.
Many disciples, including Ji Linghan, gathered around, greeting and consulting Elder Mo.
If it were the former Mo Chen, he would certainly ignore these people.
Just mere ants from the Lower Realm; are they worthy of even a glance?
But now he was determined to make a good impression before Jiang Cheng, to show how useful a "Personal Grandmaster" could be, so his demeanor became amicable and kind.
He answered every question the disciples asked.
As an Immortal, his cultivation experience was extremely rich.
The cultivation dilemmas the disciples faced were effortlessly solved with just a few words, enlightening them like a sudden awakening.
Three disciples even sat cross-legged on the spot, about to break through.
In an instant, all the disciples showed a look of admiration.
They repeatedly praised Elder Mo, calling him incredible and a divine being. Slowly, Mo Chen actually started to enjoy this kind of treatment.
He had never taken any disciples before, and even when forming connections, he only interacted with fellow Immortals of the same level.
Never had anyone praised him like this.
Oddly enough, he felt it wasn’t too bad after all.
Oh well, these disciples are part of the "Child of the Plane’s" direct lineage; building good relations with them is indeed within a "Personal Grandmaster’s" responsibilities.
With this thought, he worked even harder and gradually began revealing High-tier Techniques and Secret Techniques.
Seeing him so well-received, even Brother Cheng felt a bit unbalanced.
This guy, though very useful, might steal the spotlight, right?
After pondering, he decided to summon Lin Ning, Luo Yuan, and Shan Tai from the Xuanji Map.
Their cultivation techniques were still from the Red Sun Sect period, which were of too low a grade, making cultivation inefficient.
Now, with the techniques from the Eight Clouds Hall, and with Mo Chen’s guidance, their cultivation speed should be one or two times faster in future practice.
A flash of light, and the three silhouettes appeared out of thin air.
This nearly gave Mo Chen a scare from afar.
The appearance of the three was without any warning, and there was no sign of Spiritual Power fluctuation beforehand, as if it were a spatial transfer.
This method is indeed too sophisticated, right?
Truly worthy of being the "Child of the Plane," surely he has obtained some Marvels.
"Sect Leader!"
"Sect Leader, you finally remembered us."
"I was about to go mad inside."
After annihilating the Eight Clouds Hall, Jiang Cheng had obtained another piece of the Xuanji Map Fragment.
With the synthesis of two pieces, it not only allowed a total of eight people to be accommodated, but the flow of time also changed from 1000 times to 2000 times.
Therefore, even though it had only been ten days in there, it equated to seventy years outside.
As of now, among the three, Luo Yuan had reached Spirit Platform First Layer, and Shan Tai Spirit Platform Second Layer.
Luo Yuan had entered at Soul Splitting First Layer, and Shan Tai, having been boosted by Jiang Cheng once, was already Soul Splitting Eighth Layer upon entering, so their starting points were different.
And lastly, Lin Ning, who was Soul Splitting First Layer upon entering, had now reached Spirit Platform Fifth Layer, surpassing Jiang Cheng’s expectations.
This girl received 50,000 points from the system for each small realm breakthrough in the Spirit Platform Realm.
This time, she alone earned him nearly 300,000 points.
Efforts do lead to rewards, and Brother Cheng beamed with joy.
Not far away, Ji Linghan secretly harbored doubts.
She clearly remembered that ’Lin Ning’ had visited her cave mansion earlier in the day, right?
At that time, she said the Sect Leader had let her out of the Xuanji Map, so how had she appeared from the Xuanji Map again just now?
Moreover, she didn’t look like she had been out at all.

chapters.title: Chapter 93: Another Fragment?
chapters.content:
Chapter 93: Chapter 93: Another Fragment?
"Hidden Phoenix Bloodline!"
Elder Mo Chen, with his vast experience, could immediately discern Lin Ning’s origins.
"It’s actually the Hidden Phoenix Bloodline!"
He exclaimed twice in astonishment and swiftly rushed over.
Bloodline awakenings were quite common in the Immortal Realm.
However, there is a hierarchy in bloodlines.
The Hidden Phoenix Bloodline is clearly among the top tier, incredibly rare even in the Immortal Realm!
When he first saw Ji Linghan, he was secretly amazed. The Seven-Aperture Exquisite Body is also considered an upper-class talent in the Immortal Realm.
He couldn’t believe that the Sect Leader had such a disciple.
Truly worthy of being called the Child of the Plane, naturally attracting the followings of top talents.
Now seeing the Hidden Phoenix Bloodline, he was even more shocked.
The fortune of the ’Child of the Plane’ is astounding!
These two girls, even if they entered the Immortal Realm, would be contested by major forces.
And yet, they had been taken in while still in the Lower Realm.
"What, you know about the Hidden Phoenix Bloodline?"
"Of course, her bloodline hasn’t fully awakened, simply because she hasn’t practiced any Dark Element Techniques..."
Jiang Cheng silently agreed. When he used Insight to examine Lin Ning earlier, the system had a similar remark.
"Do you have any Dark Element Techniques?"
"Absolutely!"
Mo Chen rubbed his hands, his eyes fixed on Lin Ning as if looking at a treasure.
"Surely the Sect Leader hasn’t forgotten my title? Dark Urgency, Dark Urgency, my primary cultivation is actually in Dark Element Techniques."
"If the Sect Leader is willing, I would gladly take her as my disciple and teach her with dedication!"
His words were entirely sincere.
This was the Hidden Phoenix Bloodline! If she were trained and brought into the Immortal Realm, her future achievements would surpass that of her master.
It was like finding another strong support for his future!
Lin Ning would definitely have a better development if she became his disciple, and Jiang Cheng would have no objections.
"Alright, but we still need to ask Xiaohan’s opinion."
After all, she is Lin Ning’s current master.
"I have no objections either."
Ji Linghan nodded her agreement without hesitation as well.
She initially hurried to take Lin Ning as her disciple just to prevent her from becoming Jiang Cheng’s pupil.
As for Lin Ning becoming Mo Chen’s disciple, she had no issues with that.
"I do not agree!"
Lin Ning listened for a while and realized the Sect Leader intended to pass her off to someone else again, and she was not pleased.
"Do you not want me by your side, I’ve grown up now, I’m no less than them!"
She released Brother Cheng’s arm, patted her own chest, and her eyes reddened.
Having matured over seventy years within the Xuanji Map.
In the Soul Splitting Realm, she could maintain her youthful appearance, having fixed her state at the age of 20.
Brother Cheng felt helpless. Girl, it’s not like we’re parting ways for good, do we need to be this dramatic?
"This Elder Mo has also joined our sect, so we can still see each other every day."
Lin Ning was relentless: "But you promised me before that as long as I surpassed Ji Linghan, you’d take me as your disciple!"
Brother Cheng thought to himself, when did I promise that, wasn’t it all just your assumptions?
Moreover, you haven’t surpassed Ji Linghan yet.
Seeing Lin Ning still looking very aggrieved, he could only formally promise her something.
"How about this, if you can surpass Elder Mo Chen’s peak cultivation, I will certainly take you as my disciple, no going back on my word!"
"Really?"
"All disciples can testify!" Brother Cheng declared grandly.
The crowd secretly thought, you’re setting a trap here.
Lin Ning had just come out of the Xuanji Map and didn’t even know Elder Mo was an Immortal.
She probably thought with her talent, she could surpass him in a few years.
"Alright then!"
Lin Ning’s mood finally changed from worry to joy.
After meeting Mo Chen, she respectfully bowed and performed the disciple ceremony.
Mo Chen was beaming, having gained such a peerless talent, he was overjoyed.
At this moment, Ah Huang transmitted a message.
"Mom, mom, the Fragment! The Fragment is coming!"
"Huh? Sweetie, what did you say?"
"There’s another fragment, it’s already in the Feixian Sect, mom must get it!"
"Huh?"
Jiang Cheng was a bit confused. Could the World Heart Fragment have grown legs?
Could it have entered the Feixian Sect on its own?
Soon after, everyone heard the sounds of drumming and music coming from the distant sky.
Raising their eyes, they were nearly frightened to death.
They saw a spirit bird, wholly white, spanning several thousand meters, gracefully flying towards them.
Surrounding the spirit bird were hundreds of armored warriors.
Along the way, petals continually fell like gentle rain, resplendent and colorful.
The Feixian Sect didn’t have a Sect Protection Array or gatekeeper disciples, so their entry was unimpeded.
Mo Chen skillfully came over to provide the Sect Leader with a briefing.
"That’s a Li Luan, a Tier Six Spirit Beast, though it’s not adept in combat, which makes it easy to capture and use as a mount."
While he couldn’t bring himself to flatter like other disciples, he was adept at seizing chances to display his professional prowess.
Jiang Cheng nodded, unable to help feeling a bit envious.
No matter the spirit bird’s combat power, what mattered was the grandeur!
If used for showing off, it would easily score an extra 66 points at least.
As the Li Luan approached, it obscured the sky, darkening the heavens.
Only then did everyone notice that not just one person was on the back of the Li Luan, but over a hundred.
In the center was a young, beautiful lady, donned in vibrant attire, surrounded by colorful shades of veils. Her pink narcissus scattered floral dress, over which lay a gold-threaded thin veil.
With a pearl and jade hairpin inserted into her low-braided hair, her stunning face came into view as they closed in.
On the Li Luan’s back was a delicately designed open-air palace, where she calmly sat.
Eight graceful palace maids attended her, while behind, music played by flutes and zithers, all performed by palace maids.
A hundred palace guards in bright silver armor surrounded them as they escorted the convoy.
"These must be people from the Qianxing Dynasty!" Luo Yuan wasn’t very sure.
The others, as if reminded, immediately reacted.
"Indeed, this lady seems to be Princess Ningti."
"No way, is it really her?"
"Could she really visit our Feixian Sect? Are we not dreaming?"
"My goodness, she is the number one cultivation genius of the Qianxing Dynasty!"
Except for Ji Linghan, who was raised by the former Sect Leader, the other disciples of the Feixian Sect all hailed from nearby regions, and were part of the Qianxing Dynasty Realm.
Before entering the sect, they were under the dynasty’s jurisdiction in the Mortal World.
Therefore, even though they were unfamiliar with the Eight Clouds Hall, they were very knowledgeable about the more distant Qianxing Dynasty.
Princess Ningti was known as the dynasty’s most famous celestial prodigy, with unparalleled talent.
They had heard of her for many years, never forgetting.
Seeing her arrival filled them with shock, and they even felt flattered.
To describe it, it was like suddenly having a superstar you heard about in childhood show up in front of you.
However, this grand-entrance star soon encountered a bit of a situation.
The normally stable-flying Li Luan suddenly panicked before it could land.
It cried out repeatedly, shaking wildly, seemingly trying to flee the area. Even with Princess Ningti and surrounding guards trying to control it, they couldn’t calm it down.
And the palace maidens’ faces turned pale with fright, letting out delicate cries.
"It’s because of that tiger; its tier is too high, its aura is frightening the Li Luan."
No need for Jiang Cheng to ask, the ’Personal Grandmaster’ Mo Chen tactfully provided the explanation.

chapters.title: Chapter 94: Sect Leader Jiang, an Honest Person
chapters.content:
Chapter 94: Chapter 94: Sect Leader Jiang, an Honest Person
Jiang Cheng finally understood.
The Three-Eyed Tiger is a Demon King, and Li Luan also belongs to a kind of demon beast. It’s no wonder they’d be scared of a Demon King.
He turned his head to see the Three-Eyed Tiger grinning coldly at the spirit bird in the sky.
"Tone down your foul temper, don’t scare the guests."
As for why the Qianxing Dynasty has come, Jiang Cheng didn’t even need to guess.
He had taken out the Eldest Prince; the other party couldn’t remain indifferent.
For others, this situation would induce panic or a readiness for battle, but he didn’t think of it that way.
This was business knocking on his door.
Just like Qi Cang before, after relentless efforts, they brought him the Eight Clouds Hall extermination package.
The Qianxing Dynasty should be more valuable than Eight Clouds Hall, right?
Brother Cheng was looking forward to it.
"What a hassle."
The Three-Eyed Tiger found a shady spot to lie down, closed its eyes to rest, and restrained the aura that only demon beasts could sense.
Only then did the spirit bird in the sky gradually calm down.
A moment later, it landed in front of the main hall of the Feixian Sect.
Commander of the Imperial Guard, Xiahou Jun, holding a long spear, pointed diagonally to the sky and shouted loudly.
"Princess Ningti of the Qianxing Dynasty has arrived!"
"Why are you not welcoming her at once!"
Infused with the spiritual power of the Daoist Palace Realm, his voice traveled far, echoing endlessly among the mountains.
The pressure in his voice caused many disciples of the Feixian Sect to show fear on their faces.
If not for Jiang Cheng standing in front, giving them confidence, some might have knelt on the spot.
"If you have something to say, say it quickly!"
Brother Cheng wasn’t much impressed by any princess; he only cared about when they’d declare war.
Or when they’d involve the entire high command of the Qianxing Dynasty so he could take them all out at once.
"How bold!"
Xiahou Jun became furious. He feared the mysterious force that had destroyed the Eight Clouds Hall but didn’t regard the Feixian Sect.
Because he didn’t know that the Eight Clouds Hall was wiped out by Jiang Cheng.
The Tier Eight Spiritual Artifact spear aimed directly at Jiang Cheng, and a wisp of cyclone quickly expanded at the spearhead, forming a roaring tornado.
Just as Jiang Cheng planned to let the Three-Eyed Tiger handle it first, Princess Ningti finally spoke.
"Commander Xiahou, stop."
"Your Highness, he was disrespectful to you. He must be severely punished!"
Xiahou Jun was still angry, wanting to teach Jiang Cheng a big lesson.
Princess Ningti lightly parted her lips, her tone calm yet indisputable: "This journey is led by me; surely Commander Xiahou hasn’t forgotten."
Xiahou Jun’s face stiffened, but he eventually withdrew his spear.
This surprised Brother Cheng a bit. Who would’ve thought that this princess had such authority that even experts of the Daoist Palace Realm had to follow her orders.
"Are you Jiang Cheng?"
Princess Ningti carefully scrutinized the incredibly handsome man before her. Even she couldn’t help but take a few more glances.
"That’s me. Does the Princess have any advice?"
"Doesn’t Sect Leader Jiang plan to invite me in for a chat?"
Jiang Cheng thought, does your Qianxing Dynasty always like to complicate things before making a move, like the Eight Clouds Hall did?
Why not just say you want to kill me and be done with it?
I’m so tired of this.
"Of course, you can."
Since the other party hadn’t torn their pretenses yet, he thought there was no harm in showing some hospitality.
After both parties took seats inside the hall, Jiang Cheng activated his Insight.
Ah Huang mentioned the World Heart Fragment; could it be on this princess?
Under his Insight, Princess Ningti’s cultivation was laid bare.
This princess actually had a Daoist Palace First Layer Realm, surprising even him.
However, after a thorough inspection, besides finding a Tier Nine Spiritual Artifact and two Tier Eight Spiritual Artifacts on her, he didn’t see any exotic treasures.
Her storage ring also contained many good things, but no World Heart Fragment.
"Sect Leader Jiang, I come here for the calamity of the Eight Clouds Hall."
This statement left the disciples of the Feixian Sect looking at each other in surprise.
They didn’t even know what had happened at the Eight Clouds Hall.
Wasn’t it supposed to be a grand ceremony? How did it turn into a calamity?
"Oh."
Jiang Cheng responded perfunctorily, while continuing to use Insight on other targets.
He hadn’t sensed the fragment’s aura, but he was sure his beloved daughter wouldn’t be wrong.
"The entire Eight Clouds Hall, including guests, were all killed on the day of the ceremony."
"My royal brother Xiang Ba also died there!"
"As the only survivor of that calamity, surely Sect Leader Jiang knows some inside information?"
Princess Ningti’s manner was relatively polite, without being aggressive.
Unlike Xiahou Jun, who seemed intent on using force for interrogation.
However, her words nearly stopped the hearts of Ji Linghan, Luo Yuan, and others.
What?
The Eight Clouds Hall was wiped out?
The Sect Leader was the only ’survivor’?
Recalling Brother Cheng’s past actions, everyone immediately guessed something, and their eyes widened in disbelief.
No way, boss, did you also wipe out the Eight Clouds Hall?
And even killed the Eldest Prince of the Qianxing Dynasty?
That was the Eight Clouds Hall! How powerful are you planning on being?
No wonder after coming back last time, there were new cultivation techniques, classics, and even rewards of Tier Eight Spiritual Artifacts...
This is breaking the heavens!
"Yes, I know the insider story."
Brother Cheng’s next words almost made Ji Linghan and others spit blood.
Now that people have come to investigate, even if you really did it, you should pretend to know nothing and sever all connections.
The Qianxing Dynasty is not to be taken lightly, and even if you’re strong, there’s no need to invite trouble.
Better to avoid trouble than to create it!
Yet this straightforward sect leader answered everything...
"Oh?"
Princess Ningti’s eyes lit up. She was surprised, not expecting to get results after just a few questions.
She originally thought this journey would be difficult, like Jiang Cheng being too weak, knocked unconscious, and barely surviving without seeing the enemy, thus no useful information.
Or that Jiang Cheng might be connected to the enemy and refuse to speak at any cost.
But she didn’t expect him to be this cooperative.
"Then could Sect Leader Jiang tell me which force killed them?"
"Sure."
"Who was it?"
Princess Ningti stood up, her eyes fixed on Jiang Cheng’s face.
Brother Cheng proudly pointed to himself.
"It was me."
He was genuinely proud.
Wiping out the Eight Clouds Hall was his masterpiece, and he had kept such a powerful bragging right secret for over ten days without a chance to revel in it.
Now that someone had finally brought it up, he certainly wouldn’t hide it anymore and was eager to claim credit!
Thud!
Several Feixian Sect disciples collapsed on the spot.
Oh my gosh, how could you be so honest?
Someone asks, and you just admit it like that?
Couldn’t you have said you didn’t know?
Couldn’t you have just made up some faction?
Now it’s big trouble.
The temperature in the hall instantly drooped as Xiahou Jun sprang up, anger surging, and raised his spear once more.
But before he could speak, Princess Ningti raised her hand.
Her deep, phoenix-like eyes squinted slightly, flickering coldly, but ultimately returning to calm.
"Sect Leader Jiang, some words shouldn’t be said carelessly. Some crimes shouldn’t be admitted arbitrarily."
"I don’t have much patience."
"I hope you’re not joking!"
Jiang Cheng’s confession was too straightforward, making her not believe it.
His realm was apparent at a glance—Celestial Fate Fourth Layer.
Indeed, a place like the Feixian Sect having a Celestial Fate Fourth Layer was a miracle, which is why she thought Jiang Cheng was jesting with her.

chapters.title: Chapter 95: It Was Really Me Who Killed
chapters.content:
Chapter 95: Chapter 95: It Was Really Me Who Killed
"I’m not joking, it really was me."
Brother Cheng got anxious.
This bragging was clearly my doing, and you’re not believing it? How absurd.
Behind him, Ji Linghan, Yin Xuer, and the others completely broke down.
Since others don’t believe you, can’t you just laugh it off and go along with it?
But you insist on proving it was your doing?
If it weren’t for their respect for the Sect Leader, they would have rushed up to cover his mouth and make him stop showing off his divine techniques.
A hint of anger gradually appeared on Princess Ningti’s fair face.
"Sect Leader Jiang, are you not taking the Qianxing Dynasty seriously?"
"No, I’m just telling the truth. Isn’t your prince brother the owner of the Five-Colored Divine Mansion? I even fought with him!"
"He had four guards, all of whom I took down too."
Jiang Cheng was annoyed. This ’achievement’ was clearly his, and he was ready to get angry with anyone who dared to steal it.
To prove himself, he had a sudden inspiration.
"Oh right, I also got his spiritual artifact!"
After saying that, he rubbed his ring.
Two Tier Eight spiritual artifacts, shimmering with a golden light, floated out—exactly Xiang Ba’s spiritual blade and spirit armor.
Now, you must believe it, right?
Ji Linghan felt faint and nearly passed out.
Always idolizing the Sect Leader, usually gentle and charming in his presence, for the first time, she had the urge to pull his ear and scold him.
People originally firmly refused to believe it was you, yet you insisted on forcing them to believe.
Now this is great.
You even showed her brother’s weapons right in front of Princess Ningti.
It’s undeniable evidence, caught red-handed!
"Sect Leader Jiang, you need to give this princess a reasonable explanation!"
Princess Ningti’s face turned cold, with a hidden murderous aura surfacing.
To be honest, Jiang Cheng’s actions had left her bewildered.
Was it really him?
It didn’t look like it. Who in their right mind would so openly admit to such a thing?
Could this person have hidden his strength?
But no matter how she looked, Jiang Cheng was clearly at the Celestial Fate Fourth Layer, with nothing suspicious about it.
"What else is there to say, Your Highness?"
Xiahou Jun stepped forward with a spear.
"This person is the criminal. Allow me to capture him and take him to the Imperial City for a thousand cuts!"
The hundred forbidden guards behind him shouted in unison, taking a step forward.
The spears were like dragons; although the spiritual power was hidden, a surge of blood aura rushed forward.
It was as if the great hall suddenly turned into a battlefield littered with corpses.
Above the hundred guards, a blood-colored phantom appeared!
The phantom was both like a dragon and not a dragon, like a tiger and not a tiger, with a huge mouth seemingly ready to devour, exuding a majestic presence that invoked fear.
The considerate Elder Mo Chen quietly relayed information, timely explaining things to Brother Cheng.
"This is a type of spiritual array. If I’m not mistaken, it should be the Tier Eight Dragon Tiger Blood Killing Array. It consolidates the blood aura and battle will of each person into one, increasing combat power several times over. The more people, the greater the power."
"This array requires all participants to work together wholeheartedly. If even one person loses focus, the array will reveal a flaw. These hundred people must have been trained together from a young age, living and eating together, practicing the same cultivation and martial techniques."
"Don’t be fooled by their Realm, most of them are at the Spirit Platform Ninth Layer, with the highest at Celestial Fate Third Layer, but they could slay a Daoist Palace Fifth Layer."
"Does the Sect Leader need this old man to take action? At the cost of the residual soul’s depletion, I can annihilate their divine souls!"
He was indeed loyal to the core.
In order to show off in front of the ’Child of the Plane,’ he was ready to go all out.
Today’s efforts were an investment for future returns!
Jiang Cheng smiled and waved his hand, "No need to worry, Elder Mo, don’t forget we also have a Sect Guardian Spirit Beast."
"The Three-Eyed Fierce Tiger? Its strength may be formidable, but its wild nature makes it difficult to tame, and it’s not very respectful to the Sect Leader! I strongly recommend keeping a distance, otherwise it will become a calamity in the future!"
Mo Chen was very disdainful.
His mind was indeed deep.
In order to become the most favored person around the ’Child of the Plane’ as soon as possible, he had begun subtly marginalizing competitors.
The first target was the Three-Eyed Tiger.
This tiger demon that had once betrayed him had to be sidelined!
Jiang Cheng had no idea he was thinking that far ahead. He just thought it made sense to use the Three-Eyed Tiger if it was available.
The people in front of him could not be handled without dying once himself.
Before all the disciples, it would be better to leave it to the tiger.
"Elder Mo, you’re joking."
"Three-Eyed Tiger, get to work!"
The Three-Eyed Tiger, which was dozing outside, reluctantly flew in.
"Couldn’t handle it?"
"Need the big boss to step in again?"
After speaking, its gaze fell on the group opposite.
Xiahou Jun’s expression remained unchanged, and the hundred forbidden guards didn’t retreat either.
They had already learned that Feixian Sect had a ’Celestial Fate Ninth Level’ tiger demon.
This level might scare the Eight Clouds Hall, but it couldn’t intimidate them.
Princess Ningti also showed a hint of disdain.
"Sect Leader Jiang, is this your reliance?"
The reason she hadn’t taken action herself earlier was her suspicion that Jiang Cheng had a powerful force behind him.
If Jiang Cheng’s confidence came from this tiger demon, then she truly underestimated them.
"It seems you really are seeking death."
"Even if this tiger is at the Daoist Palace Realm, it cannot withstand our Imperial Guards!"
Jiang Cheng smiled again and waved toward the Three-Eyed Tiger.
The Three-Eyed Tiger turned its head, lazily asking, "Do you want them all wiped out, or leave the beauties alone?"
Brother Cheng thought this tiger demon was quite romantic and was about to speak when he saw Princess Ningti’s expression suddenly change.
She flew into the center, blocking the path between Xiahou Jun and the Three-Eyed Tiger.
"Stop!"
"Sect Leader Jiang, this is a misunderstanding, my apologies!"
"Commander Xiahou, quickly stand down!"
Even with all of Brother Cheng’s experience, he was a bit puzzled now.
The princess, who had just before been full of killing intent, was now apologizing. What’s going on?
Xiahou Jun couldn’t comprehend it at all.
He shouted sternly, "Princess, he is the murderer of the Eldest Prince..."
But Princess Ningti sharply interrupted him.
"He is not!"
"But he even took out the Eldest Prince’s spiritual artifacts. Even if he didn’t kill him himself, he must be involved!"
"Sect Leader Jiang is also a victim, he just happened to survive. Those spiritual artifacts of my brother were picked up by him after the battle ended."
After speaking, Princess Ningti nodded slightly at Jiang Cheng to show goodwill.
"Since Sect Leader Jiang has found those spiritual artifacts, they now belong to him. Our Qianxing Dynasty will not reclaim them. Please be at ease, Sect Leader Jiang!"
Her words left everyone present stunned.
Not only Jiang Cheng and the disciples of Feixian Sect, but everyone could tell she was trying to find an excuse to protect him.
Even a fool could see she was deliberately making up a reason to shield Jiang Cheng.
Looking closely, they too felt that Jiang Cheng was indeed quite something!
Overcome with confusion, Xiahou Jun couldn’t hold it any longer.
"What exactly are you doing, Princess?"
Unable to contain his temper, he shouted in a deep voice, "He is the very criminal. Let me capture him and take him to the Imperial City for a thousand cuts!"
Despite this, Princess Ningti flew into the fray, blocking his path to Jiang Cheng.
Whereupon a torrent of dragon-like energy surged, turning the atmosphere into one reminiscent of a mass grave.
The phantasm above the hundred guards, whether dragon or tiger, with its immense mouth seemed ready to devour. Its overwhelming presence intimidated the onlookers.
Mo Chen, always the considerate grandfather, quietly transmitted a message and began to explain things to Brother Cheng at the right time.
"This is a kind of spirit array. If I’m not mistaken, it should be a Tier Eight Dragon Tiger Blood Killing Array. It converges the bloodthirsty aura and battle spirit of each person and fuses them into one force, multiplying combat power several times over. Moreover, the more people there are, the stronger the power will be."
"This array requires everyone’s cohesive effort; as long as one person loses focus, a flaw will appear in the great array. These hundred people must have been cultivated together from childhood, living and eating together, practicing the same cultivation and martial techniques."
"Does the Sect Leader need this old man to take action? At the price of depleting the residual soul, I can wipe out their divine souls together!"
He was truly loyal.
Hoping to prove himself before the ’Child of the Plane,’ he was really giving it his all.
Today’s effort was just an investment for future gain!
Jiang Cheng, smiling, waved his hand: "No need to worry, Elder Mo. Let’s not forget we still have a Sect Guardian Spirit Beast."
"Three-Eyed Fierce Tiger? It’s powerful, but wild and not very respectful to the Sect Leader! I strongly suggest we keep our distance, or it will become a future calamity!"
Mo Chen was quite disdainful.
His scheming ran deep.
He was already covertly ostracizing his rivals to become the most favored person around the ’Child of the Plane.’
The first target was the Three-Eyed Tiger.
Jiang Cheng had no idea he was thinking so far ahead, he just felt that there was no harm in using the Three-Eyed Tiger if it was available.
The people in front of him could not be resolved without having to face death once.
Better to delegate it to the tiger in front of the disciples.
"Elder Mo, you are joking."
"Three-Eyed Tiger, time to work!"
The Three-Eyed Tiger, lounging outside, reluctantly flew in.
"Can’t handle it?"
"You need me to step in again, big boss?"
It spoke and then its gaze fell on the group of people in front of it.
Xiahou Jun, holding his spear, stepped forward.
"What more do you have to say, Your Highness?"
"He is indeed the culprit, let me capture him and take him to the Imperial City for a thousand cuts!"
The hundred Forbidden Guards behind him shouted in unison, stepping forward.
The spears were as imposing as dragons, and though their spiritual power wasn’t fully unleashed, a wave of bloodlust came rushing forward.
The grand hall seemed to have transformed suddenly into a battlefield covered with corpses.
Above the heads of the hundred Forbidden Guards appeared a scarlet phantom!
The phantom, part dragon and part tiger, seemed ready to devour men, with a terrifying presence that filled onlookers with awe.

chapters.title: Chapter 96: This Palace Maid is Somewhat Strong
chapters.content:
Chapter 96: Chapter 96: This Palace Maid is Somewhat Strong
Buzz!
A faint sonic boom echoed inside the grand hall.
Collisions at the Daoist Palace Realm usually create massive commotion, and without protection, not just this hall, but even the entire Feixian Sect would be devastated.
The reason this strike made such a small impact is because Princess Ningti was incredibly powerful, forcibly suppressing and controlling the ripple.
Even though she was a small realm lower than Xiahou Jun, her power was enough to crush this Grand Commander!
The Daoist Palace Realm is a continuation of the Celestial Fate Realm. At this level, the initially rudimentary Divine Mansion evolves into a magnificent palace, under the blessing of heavenly and earthly rules, harboring greater might and mysteries.
The cultivator can harness far more power.
When Princess Ningti’s Daoist Palace emerged, the entire hall was filled with phenomenon, with six rivers flowing through the palace, each shimmering with different hues, waves surging, countless marks floating on the water.
Even those who can’t cultivate felt the power to destroy the heavens and the earth coming from those Daoist Palace rivers!
Some disciples of the Feixian Sect, with lower realms, were lost in confusion just by glancing at it, their minds taken away.
If Mo Chen hadn’t shouted in the depths of their Divine Souls, they would likely have fallen into eternal slumber.
Bang!
With just one strike, Xiahou Jun was knocked flying, crashing into a group of Forbidden Guards.
Rattle!
The Forbidden Guards retreated several dozen steps before catching him.
"This princess is truly remarkable, having a six-colored Daoist Palace and a trace of Li Dragon bloodline. Though not pure, it’s impressive enough!"
Mo Chen’s sound transmission piqued Brother Cheng’s interest.
"Li Dragon bloodline? How does it compare to the Azure Dragon bloodline?"
Mo Chen chuckled, "Sect Leader, you jest. The Azure Dragon is one of the three giants of the Dragon Race alongside the Golden Dragon and Cyan Dragon. The Li Dragon is merely a branch of the Black Dragon lineage, incomparable by far. They are like heaven and earth, incomparable!"
So that’s how it is. It seems that the level of that Azure Dragon Essence Blood last time was indeed high!
"Commander Xiahou, I told you to step down."
Ningti said this calmly, but it carried an icy chill.
No one doubted that if Xiahou Jun acted again, this princess would personally cut him down.
After subduing Xiahou Jun, her icy demeanor thawed, showing a slightly apologetic smile.
"Sect Leader Jiang, I apologize, it’s my fault for not managing my people well!"
"I hope you can forgive us."
These words left everyone present in disbelief once again.
Some disciples of the Feixian Sect nearly became her fans.
Beautiful, strong, assertive, and also very reasonable, such a woman naturally doesn’t inspire animosity.
The Three-Eyed Tiger turned its head to look at Jiang Cheng.
"What do we do next?"
"Do we kill or not?"
Brother Cheng was also a bit dazed; this situation was really tricky.
The other side hadn’t caused any harm to the Feixian Sect and had even apologized; he had no reason to hold on.
He could only wave his hand, signaling the Three-Eyed Tiger to stand down.
Though he usually didn’t bother guessing the opponent’s intentions, preferring direct confrontation, this time he was genuinely curious.
But immediately, he made a significant discovery.
The World Heart Fragment had been found!
The Insight Skill locked onto one of the eight palace maids behind Ningti, showing an anomaly in the pearl hairpin on her head.
If not for the array engraved on the surface of the pearl at the head of the pin, he would have sensed it straight away.
The World Heart Fragment was inside that pearl, there was no mistake!
Moreover, there was another surprising discovery.
This palace maid’s power was actually far superior to Princess Ningti’s, reaching the Daoist Palace Eighth Layer!
It’s worth noting that the Emperor of the Qianxing Dynasty is only at the Daoist Palace Sixth Layer.
However, she also wore an array to conceal her cultivation, appearing no different from the other seven palace maids, seemingly only at the Spirit Platform Realm.
Besides this, her earrings also revealed concealment effects under Insight.
This meant her appearance was also hidden.
What the heck, what’s going on here?
What’s the origin of this palace maid, what is she up to?
After so many dull days at the mountain gate, Brother Cheng was a bit excited; there was a major conspiracy here!
"Sect Leader Jiang, since this matter is unrelated to you, I shall take my leave."
"But as it is getting late, may I and my entourage stay overnight at the Feixian Sect?"
The Feixian Sect had plenty of accommodation, but what exactly were they planning?
Jiang Cheng initially wanted to refuse, but thinking about the World Heart Fragment, he changed his mind.
"Staying one night is fine, but shouldn’t Princess Your Highness pay the lodging fee in advance?"
What lodging fee?
Everyone was speechless, fearing it would once again anger the princess.
Even Xiahou Jun clenched his fists.
Ultimately, he remained silent.
Princess Ningti was also quite surprised but then smiled slightly.
"Very well, what does Sect Leader Jiang want? Spirit Stones? Pills?"
Jiang Cheng shook his hand, "No, no, I couldn’t possibly want something so valuable."
He walked to Ningti with a beaming smile and slowly raised his right hand.
Just when Xiahou Jun thought the brat was reckless enough to be impolite to the princess, Brother Cheng extended his right arm, bypassing Ningti, and landed it on the head of one of the palace maids behind her.
Swish!
A silver pearl hairpin was pulled down by him.
"I’ll symbolically take this worthless pearl hairpin, Princess Your Highness doesn’t mind, right?"
He toyed with the hairpin in his hand, as if it was a casual move.
The palace maid with the concealed immense strength clearly didn’t expect this, her eyes flashed with a cold light, but she didn’t resist nor react immediately.
Princess Ningti was taken aback.
She gave Jiang Cheng a deep look and remained silent for a few seconds.
Then she smiled again, "Of course, as long as Sect Leader Jiang likes it."
"The princess is too kind."
Inside, Brother Cheng was overjoyed, surprised that it was this easy to acquire.
He even found Ningti and her party more agreeable.
Bringing gifts to the doorstep, the more the better.
"Luo Yuan, quickly escort our honored guests to rest!"
Not until Ningti and Xiahou Jun’s party left did Mo Chen step out.
"Sect Leader, the fluctuations in this woman’s demeanor are too significant; she must have deeper plans. We must remain cautious!"
Jiang Cheng waved his hand.
"No worries, everything is within my expectations."
He was just saying it casually, having thought of nothing and still confused.
But Mo Chen held him in high regard.
Indeed, the Child of the Plane is unfathomable, beyond one’s guess.
The disciples also began flattering him.
"Sect Leader is truly a genius strategist."
"Right, Sect Leader must have predicted that Princess Ningti wouldn’t pursue it."
They previously thought Jiang Cheng’s admission was unwise.
Now seeing nothing happened, they suddenly felt he was unfathomable, having anticipated the other party’s reaction early on.

chapters.title: Chapter 97: The Renown of the Three-eyed Tiger
chapters.content:
Chapter 97: Chapter 97: The Renown of the Three-eyed Tiger
"In my opinion, that Princess Ningti must be enamored by the Sect Leader."
"Exactly, otherwise it can’t be explained..."
This erroneous flattery had only just begun when Lin Ning interrupted.
"Master Zhang, Master Song, are the two of you quite idle? Could you please go outside and give me some pointers on my swordsmanship?"
She had reached the Spirit Platform Realm, clearly intending to beat someone up.
The two masters quickly declined.
"No, no!"
"We are busy; better find someone else..."
On the other side, Xiahou Jun finally couldn’t contain his doubts and approached Ningti.
"Why does Your Highness concede so much? Are you actually afraid of Jiang Cheng?"
"I have my own reasons."
Xiahou Jun was extremely displeased, coldly sneering, "I believe Your Highness has indeed lost your mind over Jiang Cheng..."
"Xiahou Jun, do you think I won’t kill you?"
Ningti, who had just shown unusual courtesy to Jiang Cheng, had no friendly demeanor towards him.
Xiahou Jun’s expression changed, cold sweat trickling down his back.
"I dare not!"
In this land far away from the emperor, Ningti stood above him in both personal strength and authority.
If she really killed him, there wouldn’t be much investigation afterward.
After he retreated, Ningti dismissed all the maids around her, shut the door with a flick of her hand, and set down a layer of restriction.
Now only she and the maid hiding her cultivation remained inside.
The maid slowly raised her head, straightened her back, no longer resembling the meek and gentle maid she had been.
She walked gracefully as if within her own domain.
Ningti quickly stood up, gave up her seat to her, and stood aside herself.
If someone else saw this scene, they might think they were dreaming.
The dignified princess of the Imperial Dynasty behaving like a servant in front of a maid, yet it seemed the two were quite accustomed to this interaction.
She volunteered to come to the Feixian Sect due to the command of this green skirt maid.
"Why did you stop me from killing Jiang Cheng today?"
In fact, Ningti herself didn’t know the reason.
Jiang Cheng was undeniably the culprit.
Although she had no feelings for Xiang Ba, from the perspective of the dynasty, she still had to kill this person.
Suddenly deciding to stop her actions, even beating Xiahou Jun back, was completely due to the maid secretly transmitting orders for her to do so.
The situation happened so abruptly that there was no time to ask why.
The maid’s thin red lips twitched slightly, with a touch of sarcastic amusement.
"If I hadn’t stopped you, you would all be dead by now."
"Ah!"
"Why?"
Ningti was shocked, followed by deep confusion.
"Jiang Cheng is only at Celestial Fate Fourth Layer, even with many encounters, he can’t shake the Daoist Palace. Could he also have a way to hide his cultivation?"
The maid shook her head.
"Jiang Cheng merely has extraordinary encounters, his strength is not yet a concern, the truly terrifying one is that tiger."
Mentioning the Three-Eyed Tiger, she also showed a deep fear.
Ningti had never seen fear in her eyes, so she was even more surprised.
"That Tiger Demon? Isn’t it only at Celestial Fate Ninth Layer?"
The maid scoffed, "You really are as dumb as a pig, who told you it’s at Celestial Fate Ninth Layer? Based on those external rumors, speculating?"
"Have you seen that Tiger Demon in action?"
"Or have you fought with it?"
Being scolded like this, the overwhelmingly noble Princess Ningti merely lowered her head, showing no signs of discontent.
This was clearly something she was used to.
"To be honest with you, if that Tiger Demon decides to destroy all of us, it would be a breeze."
"What? Including you? Could it have surpassed Daoist Palace Ninth Layer?"
"Daoist Palace Ninth Layer? You are underestimating it."
Princess Ningti gasped, her beautiful eyes filled with disbelief.
"Could it be Ascending to Saint..."
That level is only possible for some Sacred Land’s sect leaders or Supreme Elders to reach.
The maid didn’t directly answer her.
"About two months ago, the Purple Origin Sacred Land was attacked by a Three-Eyed Tiger Demon."
"What? Purple Origin Sacred Land?"
Princess Ningti’s face turned pale, finally exclaiming.
The Purple Origin Sacred Land was millions of miles away from the Qianxing Dynasty, but she had heard of it for a simple reason.
It was too strong, renowned far and wide.
It was said that the Purple Origin Sacred Land had three Ascending to Saint Realm presiding over it, and there were over one hundred Daoist Palace Ninth Layer practitioners under its wing, overwhelmingly powerful!
Within the Sacred Land, every Saint Heir and Saintess of extraordinary talent and encounters, made her hopeless to even think of comparing.
This giant sect in the cultivation realm has stood for millions of years without ever falling!
"What was the outcome? Did the Three-Eyed Tiger invade the Purple Origin Sacred Land and manage to get away unscathed?"
If true, not just their group, but the entire Qianxing Dynasty would be unable to stop it.
"Get away unscathed?"
The maid sneered, as if looking at a frog at the bottom of a well.
"If the Three-Eyed Tiger had not merely been passing through, the seven-million-year-old Purple Origin Sacred Land would have ended up a thing of the past, that was their greatest crisis since their founding."
"This..."
Princess Ningti was somewhat scattered in thought, unable to imagine such a scene, nor fathom its true might.
"Wasn’t the Sacred Land supposed to have three Ascending to Saint Realm?"
"Four!"
The maid corrected her.
"They also had an Ascending to Saint Ninth Layer Supreme Elder, since the day of founding, this ancient relic had been there, worthy of being called a Land Immortal!"
"Since they had him..."
"He wielded a Magical Treasure with full force, only to be easily repelled by the Three-Eyed Tiger. He was sent flying for thousands of miles, injured the foundation, and is still recovering from death sealing!"
Though the maid knew of this long ago, she couldn’t conceal her shock as she recounted the event.
"This matter isn’t much of a secret among the Thousand Spirit Realm’s upper echelons, it’s long since spread."
"The Purple Origin Sacred Land once issued a call for help, afterwards the top echelons of the Sacred Lands held secret meetings, discussing how to resist the Three-Eyed Tiger."
"Since then, it has disappeared into silence."
"Unexpectedly, it appears here..."
Princess Ningti’s mouth wouldn’t close.
This power is undoubtedly the legendary Saint Tier!
Now, recalling the scenes in the hall earlier, she felt cold sweat pouring, her whole body trembling.
In front of the Tiger Demon, had a word been spoken wrongly at the time, her corpse would have been cold by now.
Not only would she have died, the Qianxing Dynasty would have crumbled, ceasing to exist.
A Saint Tier Tiger Demon, who could stand against it?
"Why did it come here then, despite being so strong?"
"And follow Jiang Cheng’s orders."
The maid replied, "You’d have to ask them themselves."
Speaking of which, she seemed somewhat displeased.
"If it weren’t for fearing that Tiger Demon, would I have let Jiang Cheng take the Divine Brilliance Hairpin today?"
That Pearl Hairpin was a Treasure.
Its core was an unknown crystal, after wearing it, it had a strong auxiliary effect on cultivation.
Not only did it independently generate large amounts of Spiritual Qi, providing continuous assistance in cultivation.
It also had the effect of concentrating and calming the spirit, soothing the Divine Soul, even injuries could quickly heal.
It was a very rare Heavenly and Earthly Treasure.
If not out of fear of the Three-Eyed Tiger, she would absolutely not have given it to Jiang Cheng.

chapters.title: Chapter 98 Too Charming
chapters.content:
Chapter 98: Chapter 98 Too Charming
Princess Ningti suddenly became excited, causing two flushes to appear on her delicate cheeks.
"Do you think... we could find a way to make that Tiger Demon serve us?"
This was not much different from what Qi Cang and Ling Yi thought before.
Except, Qi Cang and Ling Yi didn’t know that the Three-Eyed Tiger was at the level of a Demon King then.
The thought of controlling such a powerful Demon King made her whole body tremble with excitement.
By that time, even those from the Sacred Lands would have to be extremely respectful to her.
"You really dare to dream."
The green skirt palace maid laughed coldly, her disdain and mockery undisguised.
"Do you think you’re worthy?"
Princess Ningti dared not argue on the surface, but she was actually quite unconvinced in her heart.
"Are you trying to say, Brother Cheng can control the Tiger Demon, so why can’t I?"
"I... I don’t dare."
"Hmph, I see you dare quite a bit!"
The green-skirted lady said coldly, "Some people’s fate is simply something you cannot contend with. What is meant to be his will be his; others who try to take it will only be met with backlash."
"I don’t know what happened between them."
"But that Three-Eyed Tiger is at the level of a Demon King, even if Jiang Cheng is truly dead, it’s not something you or I are qualified to command."
She was quite clear-headed and calm.
Not at all like Qi Cang, Ling Yi, and the others, greedy for things beyond their reach.
"Then, we..."
"Don’t worry, the Demon King is not something we can covet, but we can make use of its power."
"You mean..."
"Cooperation, alliances! As long as we obtain their power, your and my plans will become easier..."
Before she even finished speaking, the surroundings suddenly changed atmosphere.
The concentration of spiritual energy in the room suddenly increased, becoming at least twice as rich as before!
The spirit veins of the Feixian Sect were originally Tier Four, on par with Eight Clouds Hall.
When they arrived here, they were already amazed, wondering how such a small sect with less than a hundred people could occupy such spirit veins.
And now, the two women were even more shocked.
"What happened?"
"How could the concentration of spiritual energy suddenly increase, and by so much?"
Such advancement of spirit veins had never occurred in the cultivation realm.
They also felt completely puzzled.
"Come on, let’s go out and take a look!"
On the other side, Jiang Cheng had just dismantled the pearl hairpin he obtained.
After taking out the World Heart Fragment inside, he headed straight to Ah Huang’s place.
Following this, the fragment was swallowed by Ah Huang.
Just like last time, Ah Huang grew another two years, turning into the appearance of an eleven or twelve-year-old girl.
When she returned to the spirit veins, the grade of the Feixian Sect’s spirit veins was elevated to Level 5.
Being enveloped in such spiritual energy for long, some ordinary grasses and trees would eventually turn into spirit herbs and roots beneficial for cultivation.
And some of the wild beasts and birds in the mountains would eventually transform into low-tier demon beasts.
Even ordinary people living here who didn’t practice cultivation could extend their lifespan by hundreds of years.
From this moment on, the Feixian Sect had unquestionably become a treasured land.
The disciples who heard the news gathered with cheers, exclaiming how their cultivation speed could become much faster here.
"Congratulations, Sect Leader, felicitations, Sect Leader!"
Jiang Cheng didn’t hide the process of feeding the fragment to his daughter from Mo Chen.
However, the Upper Immortal had never heard of a World Heart Fragment, only knowing it must be a heaven-defying level treasure.
Because nothing in the Immortal Realm had ever been heard of that could enhance spirit veins.
Once again, he marveled at Brother Cheng’s extraordinary fate, truly the luck of the Child of the Plane!
Such an abundance of fortune was simply unimaginable.
As long as he followed him, he was sure to reach ever greater heights in the future!
He even had a bizarre thought.
Perhaps being knocked down thousands of years ago was preordained by heaven, just so he’d end up as his ’Personal Grandmaster’?
"Sect Leader Jiang!"
"I was unsure what happened, but I noticed a significant increase in the concentration of spiritual energy."
Such a commotion brought Ningti and Xiahou Jun over as well.
"Oh, I just used a minor technique to upgrade the spirit veins a bit."
To pretend once more, Brother Cheng shamelessly took the credit for himself.
After all, his daughter had already entered the spirit vein, and as a father, what his daughter did was as if he did it too.
As for letting outsiders know?
So what?
To be honest, apart from having the ability to resurrect three times a day, everything else didn’t matter if others found out.
"What, upgraded the spirit veins?"
Ningti and Xiahou Jun were all dumbfounded.
They initially thought it was just a temporary increase in spiritual energy, but it was actually the spirit veins, something permanent!
"Such an incredible phenomenon, Sect Leader Jiang truly has means beyond measure!"
Ningti was unwilling to believe it, but the evidence was undeniable.
It seemed that the green-skirted palace maid was right; some people’s fate truly defies the superficial appearances.
Brother Cheng purposely wore a calm expression, as if he had done something trivial.
"Just a minor scene, done casually, I didn’t expect it to alarm you all."
Mo Chen glanced at the sect leader once more, gaining a new understanding of him.
"Sect Leader Jiang, first for the offense, and then for lingering overnight, I apologize for the disturbance..."
"To express gratitude, this palace wishes to invite Sect Leader Jiang to visit our Longyue Imperial City in the Qianxing Dynasty. What do you say?"
Brother Cheng was taken aback, wondering why Ningti’s words sounded so familiar?
Sister, what are you planning?
Are you planning to do the same as Lu Zhong and Qi Cang of Eight Clouds Hall, inviting me over on the surface, but secretly plotting against me?
I’ve been through that scheme once, and the consequences were serious, are you sure you want to mess with fire too?
Seeing his strange expression, Ningti thought he had concerns.
"What, Sect Leader Jiang doesn’t want to, suspecting ill intentions from this palace?"
She suddenly chose to communicate secretly.
"To speak the truth, Sect Leader Jiang has unparalleled demeanor, graceful bearing, and immeasurable power... this palace was captivated at first sight and has developed admiration."
"Thinking of the separation tomorrow, not knowing when we might meet again, my heart becomes increasingly downcast..."
"Therefore, I wished to invite you over."
For the sake of grand cooperation, she threw all caution to the wind.
Wow!
Since coming to this world, it was the first time a girl had so openly confessed to him.
Brother Cheng admitted that he felt a bit flattered.
The only unsatisfactory thing was that Ningti’s confession was conveyed through secret voice, and others didn’t hear it.
Sigh, it failed to achieve the showy effect.
"Hahaha, Princess misunderstood, I was just contemplating how to arrange sect affairs after leaving."
"As you know, as the head of a sect, I’m inundated with daily affairs..."
Ji Linghan and the others whispered to themselves, there aren’t really any major sect affairs.
Moreover, have you ever managed affairs?
"However, with the Princess’s invitation, I feel greatly honored. I will certainly make time out of my busy schedule; I’m truly delighted!"
No matter what their purpose was, he only needed to confront it head-on without thinking too much.
Princess Ningti was overjoyed when he agreed.
"Then we have an agreement, you know my feelings..."
Her demeanor was ever-changing.
At this moment, she looked like an innocent young girl in love.
Then, in a fragrant breeze, she gracefully departed.
Leaving the audience wide-eyed and confused.
What agreement?
What feelings?
All eyes were fixed on Sect Leader Jiang.
Brother Cheng shrugged.
"There’s nothing I can do; sometimes excessive charm just leads to this."

chapters.title: Chapter 99: The One Who Knows My Heart Is Elder Mo
chapters.content:
Chapter 99: Chapter 99: The One Who Knows My Heart Is Elder Mo
"If you want to get the help of the Three-Eyed Tiger, you must first capture Jiang Cheng’s heart."
"You’ve done well."
The green skirt palace maid, unusually, praised Ningti once.
The two of them chose a path different from Qi Cang and Ling Yi—cooperative exploitation.
If you want to get the help of the Three-Eyed Tiger, you must win over Jiang Cheng.
Making Jiang Cheng fall for Ningti is indeed a good strategy.
Princess Ningti slightly raised her chin, her slender neck as proud as a swan’s.
"After all, he’s just a young sect leader. I’m confident I can enchant him and make him submit."
In this regard, the green skirt palace maid actually believed in her ability.
Over in the Imperial City, countless noble youths regarded the princess as a goddess, their souls haunted by her.
"Heh, then I wish you success."
Time quickly moved to the next day.
As departure neared, Mo Chen came over.
"Sect Leader, hold on. Last night, I stayed up late to make a small gift for the sect leader for entertainment."
"Gift?"
Jiang Cheng took a small blue bead the size of a pigeon egg, not knowing what significance it held.
"Sect Leader, infuse spiritual power into it for a bit of refinement, and you’ll discover its wonders."
"Really?"
Brother Cheng refined it slightly and then activated it, watching the bead suddenly crack open.
Then, dozens of figures jumped out!
They grew in the wind, becoming indistinguishable from ordinary people in an instant.
A total of sixteen people, eight men and eight women, the men were outstandingly strong and the women charmingly beautiful.
Jiang Cheng was startled but had no time to inquire before these sixteen people began their performance.
The eight men pulled out drums, lutes, zithers, flutes, and various instruments and started playing.
The music was powerful and stirring, enough to invoke a fighting spirit.
And the eight women began to dance.
Their dance was not only graceful but also wild.
"How was this done?" Jiang Cheng found it very novel.
"These are just small trinkets,"
Mo Chen said with a smile, "They are clay puppets, a type of puppetry. However, these puppets have no power and can only perform song and dance."
"Ahem, so what’s the use of it?"
Mo Chen laughed, "Sect Leader, as you are traveling alone, I made this to keep you from feeling lonely during battles..."
Some things are said sparingly.
Jiang Cheng’s eyes lit up suddenly.
This is like a personal cheer squad!
For someone who loves appearances so much, this thing is simply a must-have divine artifact for travel.
Imagine unleashing this during battles, making your swagger even more refreshing.
In his eyes, this was more useful than any treasure.
"Excellent!"
"Elder Mo, you know me well!"
He patted Mo Chen’s shoulder heavily.
Said in a deep voice, "I’ll keep the saint-grade elixir in mind!"
Mo Chen was instantly overjoyed.
Only one day of interaction, and he discovered the sect leader was particularly fond of showing off.
Small boasts lighten the mood, big boasts are beneficial—young people having a healthy hobby is understandable.
So he stayed up all night making something to cater to it.
Unexpectedly, the effect was surprisingly good!
Jiang Cheng’s promise solidified his peace of mind.
"Thank you, Sect Leader!"
Given the overwhelming fortune of the Child of the Plane, there was hope for the recovery of his residual soul.
"Once my divine soul restores, I will certainly make an even more refined advanced version in the future, ten times better than this."
"Good, very good! Thank you, Elder Mo, for your effort!"
"By the way, Sect Leader, do you truly not need us to accompany you?"
Valuing the puppets highly, carefully collecting them into the bead, Jiang Cheng shook his head.
"No need, I’m confident in this journey."
"Sect Leader is indeed a divine being, everything is under control..."
The two came to the front hall, where everyone was waiting.
"Sect Leader, can’t you take us out just once?"
Ji Linghan, Lin Ning, and others were reluctant to part, but mostly worried that once he left, he wouldn’t return.
Women have their instincts, not fearing his death, but fearing he’d be captivated by Princess Ningti’s charms.
So they all wanted to follow, personally keeping an eye on him.
"With Elder Mo’s guidance, aren’t you cherishing the opportunity?"
"Practice diligently, as laziness even for a moment would waste my training efforts!"
Although Brother Cheng didn’t like cultivation himself, urging others towards it, he certainly had a methodical approach.
The group quickly set out.
Jiang Cheng rode on the Li Luan and stayed in the palace on its back.
Li Luan was a demon beast of Daoist Palace level, its flying speed extremely fast, traveling thousands of miles with a single flap.
Throughout this journey, Princess Ningti accompanied him, exceedingly attentive.
However, Brother Cheng focused more on that green skirt palace maid.
She still kept her power concealed, appearing as a genuine maid, not knowing what plan she was brewing.
"Sect Leader Jiang, I didn’t seem to see that Three-Eyed Tiger on this trip?"
Ningti cared especially about the Three-Eyed Tiger’s power.
Jiang Cheng frowned. Why does that arrogant tiger keep getting mentioned everywhere?
As if it were the protagonist instead.
He couldn’t stand it.
He said unhappily, "Why bring it?"
"It looks very powerful, and having it accompany you would make things more convenient, wouldn’t it?"
"With my strength, what situation can’t I handle?"
Uh...
Ningti and the green skirt palace maid exchanged a subtle glance.
With your prowess, without that Three-Eyed Tiger, we wouldn’t even glance your way, okay?
"Sect Leader Jiang seems so confident. Could the Tiger Demon appear when needed?"
Ningti was still probing.
Brother Cheng gradually figured things out.
So this woman was so passionate about him only because of the Three-Eyed Tiger?
For its sake, she was even using seduction tactics on him.
This is unbearable!
Isn’t his charm better than that Tiger Demon? Where are your eyes?
Even if she doesn’t feel anything for Ningti, his heart felt uneasy.
Consequently, he couldn’t be bothered to chat throughout the journey.
The group quickly arrived at Longyue Imperial City.
Xiahou Jun returned first to report to the Emperor, while Ningti immediately brought Jiang Cheng into her palace.
Princess Ningti was already the most notable person in the Imperial Court, and her return was grandiose.
Moreover, Jiang Cheng didn’t hide or avoid people, so soon many learned of his existence.
News of this spread rapidly throughout Longyue Imperial City.
In recent years, many young nobles had been captivated by the princess, but due to Ningti’s talent and strength, none could catch her eye.
Because of this, no one had gained her favor over the years.
Often not even speaking a word, only watching from afar.
This was the first time someone managed to ride her Li Luan and accompany her.
That was fine, but it was rumored this person held hands with the princess throughout the journey, intimately.
Finally, he even stayed in her palace in Longyue City!
Though not sharing the same bedchamber, it was enough to drive many nobles in the Imperial City mad.
"Who is this Jiang Cheng?"
"In a quarter-hour, I want all the information about this person!"
"Only at the fourth layer of Celestial Fate?"
"Impossible, what right does this person have?"
"Is the princess someone he can approach?"
"Kill him, make the princess realize he’s utterly unworthy of her."
Brother Cheng might never imagine that just walking with Ningti would already stir up the hatred of a horde.
In a way, the attention-grabbing skill he once desired was now actualized.
In less than half an hour, he was already blocked at his door.

chapters.title: Chapter 100 Killed Too Quickly
chapters.content:
Chapter 100: Chapter 100 Killed Too Quickly
After entering the Imperial City, Jiang Cheng felt a mysterious power pervading the surroundings.
It didn’t belong to Spiritual Power, nor to Divine Thought.
It obviously had no effect on him, nor could he clearly perceive it, yet it truly existed.
He shook his head, not bothering to think too much about it, since there were bigger matters to consume his precious brain cells.
Like how to earn more points next.
Like how to show off.
Just then, he heard a loud boom.
The door of the side hall was directly broken open by someone.
Subsequent noisy sounds and curses erupted outside.
"Where is Jiang Cheng!"
"Get out here!"
Four palace maids rushed in, flustered.
"It’s bad, it’s bad..."
"What’s wrong?" Jiang Cheng raised his eyebrows.
"The Young Prince and the Young General have broken in!"
"You better hurry and hide!"
The panic on the palace maids’ faces didn’t seem feigned, it truly was an unexpected event.
"What Young Master and Young General, nonsense."
Brother Cheng was, of course, fearless; there was no one in the world he would avoid.
He strode out and immediately bumped into a group of young people.
The leading one wore a golden crown and a brocade robe, exuding an air of nobility and grace.
His Insight Skill swept over, Celestial Fate Eighth Layer.
Surprisingly, he was second only to Xiang Ba.
Beside him were two people, one of whom had a face like a jade crown, wore armor, and was a young general holding a long spear.
The Insight Skill showed that this person was also Celestial Fate Eighth Layer.
The other, with handsome features and slanted long brows, held a paper fan, having a scholarly demeanor.
But his cultivation had also reached Celestial Fate Seventh Layer.
Behind the three were about a dozen young people.
Each had a light of divine spark in their eyes, radiating energy, full of spirit.
All were above the Celestial Fate realm.
"Who are you? And what are you doing invading my residence?"
The silver-armored young general pointed with his long spear, emitting a sense of bloodthirsty aggression.
Though it was only one man, it was as if a thousand riders were charging upon him.
Behind Jiang Cheng were two palace maids who were also in the Spirit Platform Realm, but they were so scared that they shrieked and retreated several steps back.
"You are Jiang Cheng? The Sect Leader of the Feixian Sect?"
"Yes, you have heard of my great name?"
Brother Cheng nodded with a smile, shamelessly asking in return.
"Could it be that you admire my charm and came specifically to visit me?"
"Visit?"
The young general was momentarily stunned, then burst into laughter.
"Hahahahaha..."
The others also laughed, as if they had heard the funniest joke in the world.
"You really have no sense of danger!"
"How dare you get so close to Princess Ningti without our permission!"
"Do you know who we are?"
"I’m afraid you’d be scared to death if we told you..."
So they were Princess Ningti’s suitors, a bunch of foolish flies and bees.
To encounter such a cliché jealousy issue, Brother Cheng instantly lost interest.
He had thought that his reputation had spread so wide that even the Imperial City a few million miles away had heard of him.
Apparently not.
Meanwhile, Princess Ningti and the Green Skirt Palace Maid had already learned of the situation.
This was her palace, and even before these people arrived, she already knew.
"Aren’t you planning to step in and help Jiang Cheng out of the predicament?"
The Green Skirt Palace Maid knew that as long as the Princess stepped in, those aggressive noble youths would immediately become submissive lapdogs.
They would crawl out on all fours if she commanded it.
Standing beside her, Princess Ningti smiled and said, "I will step in, but now is not the best timing."
"Oh?"
The Green Skirt Palace Maid didn’t get annoyed at Ningti’s decision but rather became curious.
"Why is that?"
In her view, if Ningti went to help Jiang Cheng out now, she could possibly gain his favor.
That would be beneficial for their recruitment plan.
"In terms of strength, I’m nowhere near your level."
"In terms of strategy, I am also ashamed to be inferior."
"But when it comes to playing with the hearts of men, I do have some insights."
At this moment, Ningti was unexpectedly confident in front of the Green Skirt Palace Maid.
After all, though the latter was strong, she lacked experience in this area.
"If I went out to resolve the situation now, Jiang Cheng would at most just be scolded a bit, not facing any real danger."
The Green Skirt Palace Maid nodded, "Indeed."
Appearing later, letting Jiang Cheng feel greater pressure, Ningti’s intervention would then have a better effect, making a deeper impression on him.
"And on the other hand..."
"Another reason?"
"Value is created through comparison."
Ningti spoke eloquently.
"Let him experience how popular I am, so that even those nobler and stronger than him are all fawning over me. He will then see how precious I am, creating a sense of urgency in him..."
The Green Skirt Palace Maid nodded again.
She could not help but agree.
An object quietly placed there and an object fiercely fought over by many people are different.
The latter arouses greater desire for possession.
Once Jiang Cheng has a strong desire for Ningti, using him and leveraging the Three-Eyed Tiger’s power will be simple.
"It’s bad, really bad..."
A palace maid suddenly rushed in, flustered.
"Something big has happened!"
"Why the panic?"
Ningti’s pretty face sank as she quickly put on a dignified princess demeanor.
"Sect Leader Jiang, something big has happened on his side..."
I know, isn’t he just being besieged by those suitors?
Why the rush?
"Young Master, Young General, they..."
The palace maid was crying with urgency.
"They’ve all been killed!"
"What did you say!"
Ningti and the Green Skirt Palace Maid exclaimed simultaneously, their expressions like they’d seen a ghost.
"How is this possible?"
"Who dares to kill them?"
"Who could kill them?"
The palace maid reporting the news could hardly believe it herself.
"It’s, it’s that Jiang Cheng..."
"This is impossible!"
"I saw it with my own eyes!"
Ningti’s beautiful eyes widened, completely unable to believe it was true.
Wasn’t Jiang Cheng supposed to be under siege, in peril, waiting for me to save him?
How much time has even passed?
That group only entered Jiang Cheng’s side hall a few statements ago, right?
Yet he killed them all?
He is only in the Celestial Fate Fourth Layer, how could he accomplish this?
Just now she thought everything was under control, planning to make a grandiose entry later.
To lecture the lapdogs and leave an indelible sacred image in Jiang Cheng’s heart.
Now, her plans died prematurely.
Because she was no longer needed.
As she and the Green Skirt Palace Maid quickly arrived at the scene, it was lively here.
The drum and music echoed, and songs and dances were in full swing.
Although the battle was over, the puppet cheer squad sent by Mo Chen was still bustling.
Blood was everywhere in the courtyard and on the steps, with thirteen corpses lying sprawling.
The jubilant singing and dancing with the gruesome scene created an utterly contradictory spectacle, almost suffocating the two women.
Brother Cheng was zealously scavenging the spoils of war like a busy little bee.
"Not bad, not bad, another Tier Eight Spiritual Artifact."
"Impressive, more Tier Eight Spiritual Artifacts."
He quickly removed everyone’s storage rings, meticulously sorting the spoils.
Such was his focus that he didn’t even look up when they arrived.
As he finally finished up, Ningti took a deep breath, trying hard to sound calm.
"I’ll show myself now, and help alleviate the predicament for Jiang Cheng."
"Oh?"
The Green Skirt Palace Maid wasn’t angered by her decision to take matters into her own hands, but rather grew curious.
"What’s the reason?"
In her eyes, if Ningti went now to help Jiang Cheng, she should be able to win his favor, right?
This would aid in their plan to win him over.
"In terms of power, I am far inferior to you."
"In strategizing, I also feel quite inadequate."
"But when it comes to playing with a man’s heart, I have some insights."
At this moment, Ningti was rarely confident in front of the Green Skirt Palace Maid.
After all, the latter, though powerful, didn’t have much experience in this aspect.
"If I go out now and resolve the situation, Jiang Cheng will only be scolded a few times, hardly facing any danger."
The Green Skirt Palace Maid nodded: "Indeed."
Coming out a bit later, allowing Jiang Cheng to feel greater pressure before Ningti stepped in would yield a better resolution and leave a more profound impression on Jiang Cheng.
"On the other hand..."
"There’s more?"
"Value is established through comparison."
Ningti explained eloquently.
"Let him experience how sought after I am, that even those nobler and stronger than him are at my feet. Then he’ll understand how precious I am, and only then will he feel the urgency..."
The Green Skirt Palace Maid nodded again.
She couldn’t help but agree.
A quietly placed item is different from an item fiercely contested by many people.
The latter evokes a stronger desire for possession.
Once Jiang Cheng has a strong desire for this alluring Ningti, manipulating him, using the power of the Three-Eyed Tiger later will be much easier.
The palace maid did not dare to report again.
"""

chapters.title: Chapter 101: Big Trouble Happens
chapters.content:
Chapter 101: Chapter 101: Big Trouble Happens
"Yes, it was me."
Jiang Cheng might be the most honest person in the world.
He never denies or argues about what he has done.
"Why did you kill them?"
If she wasn’t trying to win him over, Ningti would have loved to grab him by the collar, slap him twice, and question him harshly.
She really didn’t think much of this group of nuisances.
But they couldn’t just be killed!
Young Master An Siyuan, his grandfather is An Deming, Duke Bei of the Qianxing Dynasty, Daoist Palace Second Layer.
Young General Lu Qing, his great-grandfather is Grand General Lu Ran, Daoist Palace Second Layer.
Mi Yun, his master is the strongest among the National Guardian Elders, Qiu He Sword Venerable, Daoist Palace Third Layer.
Liu Jing Platform, the most talented student of Baiyu Academy in the Imperial City, and the academy’s head, Su Qingshou, is Daoist Palace Fourth Layer.
Apart from these, the grandparents and relatives of the rest are all influential figures whose involvement can cause a great stir.
Moreover, this group of people themselves are exceptionally talented.
They hold extremely high value themselves and will become key figures of the dynasty in the future.
And now, they’re all dead.
Even Ningti didn’t know how to end this.
Even she wouldn’t dare to kill this group of people.
Jiang Cheng seemed unaware of the gravity of what he’d done.
Upon mentioning this, he even questioned it.
"I really don’t understand what’s wrong with the people here."
"I didn’t provoke them, and suddenly they barged in, yelling and threatening to kill."
"Is the security in the Imperial City really that poor, with no one managing such trespass?"
"No one has come to comfort my hurt soul till now."
"Is this how you treat guests?"
"If I didn’t have a bit of self-defense skills, I’d have died unjustly today!"
"Truly unlucky!"
You’ve killed them all, and it’s just considered a bit of self-defense?
And a hurt soul?
I saw how you were grinning ear-to-ear while picking up the spoils of war, not a trace of sadness on your face.
Ningti bit her lip, itching to pummel this person who was flipping the situation.
Yet, she couldn’t rebut.
That group did come to kill, so indeed they were in the wrong.
"Then how did you kill them?"
"Did the Three-Eyed Tiger intervene?"
"Where is it? Could it show itself?"
These 13 deceased were all of the Celestial Fate Realm, with 10 of them above the Celestial Fate Fourth Layer, stronger than Jiang Cheng.
Yet, in just a few moments, they were completely annihilated.
The only possible explanation they could think of was that the Three-Eyed Tiger acted in secret.
This made Brother Cheng burst with rage.
Bringing up that useless tiger again, and attributing his war achievements to it!
How long is this going to last?
"I killed them myself, got it?"
"This group of nobodies isn’t worth enough for me to even break a sweat."
This group was indeed killed by him.
Upon confirming that Young Master An, Young General, and others came to teach him a lesson, perhaps even to kill him...
He didn’t even bother asking their names and took the initiative to attack first.
When action is needed, he acts without hesitation.
Originally, he thought he might die once more and resurrect with his tricks, after all, Insight had shown their Realm.
Who knew the battle would go smoothly and be incredibly simple.
The first strike eliminated Young Master An, and the next took down Young General and Mi Yun, leaving them vomiting blood and severely injured.
He indeed forgot that his power was no longer the same as before.
With the Radiant Divine Mansion, last time he was Celestial Fate First Layer and fought Xiang Ba of the Celestial Fate Ninth Layer to a standstill, and now he was at Celestial Fate Fourth Layer.
Plus, he possessed the Five Elements Martial Dao Realm at Immortal Tier Level.
What did that mean?
A casual strike surpassed the limits of the Celestial Fate Level.
Lastly, he also had the Azure Dragon Bloodline’s augmentation.
This bloodline allowed his Divine Soul to carry a trace of Azure Dragon Suppression, and although this group wasn’t of the Dragon Race, there was still a certain suppressive effect.
This battle, he was like a tiger among sheep, with no enemies able to withstand him.
The 13 opponents didn’t even have a chance to escape.
Effortlessly, he left none alive, so much so that even he found it somewhat unbelievable after it ended.
This battle truly showcased his power.
Unfortunately, such a splendid battle was only witnessed by two palace maids.
And because he was inexperienced in this, he forgot to bring out his puppet cheering squad to boost morale before striking.
He only remembered after it ended.
"Sect Leader Jiang, this is no time for jokes."
"Do you know the consequences of killing those people?"
"I suggest you let Senior Three-Eyed Tiger come out and handle this matter personally."
Ningti naturally didn’t believe him.
She and the Green Skirt Palace Maid couldn’t care less now, they just wanted to meet with the Three-Eyed Tiger as soon as possible.
Jiang Cheng was very annoyed and couldn’t be bothered to continue talking with this ignorant woman.
"Believe it or not!"
With that, he returned to his sleeping quarters.
The two women left behind were not in a pleasant mood.
Ningti’s so-called plan to alleviate the situation by deepening their impression failed ahead of time.
And this group being killed, how to deal with the giants behind them?
This was enough to give them a headache.
On the other hand, Emperor Xiang Gaoye was meeting privately with Xiahou Jun.
"Are you sure Jiang Cheng is the killer of Ba’er?"
"There’s at least a 90% chance!"
Jiang Cheng had produced Xiang Ba’s Spiritual Artifact at the time, with conclusive evidence.
"Not only did Ningti not capture him, but she also treated him well?"
Xiang Gaoye’s face was frighteningly grim.
Xiahou Jun solemnly replied, "Yes, Your Highness. Even I can’t fathom the princess’s intentions."
Xiang Gaoye fell into deep thought.
After a long while, he slowly spoke, "With Ningti’s temperament, this can’t possibly be out of affection."
"In my view, she’s most likely seen something unusual in Jiang Cheng."
Xiahou Jun frowned and said, "Aside from his looks, I really can’t see anything special about Jiang Cheng."
Xiang Gaoye let out a cold laugh.
