"He dared to admit killing Xiang Ba in front of you all, don’t you wonder why?"
"This..."
Xiahou Jun suddenly understood.
Unless Jiang Cheng is a fool, he must have enough trump cards to ensure he wouldn’t die at that time.
The emperor’s wisdom runs deep, seeing further than anyone else despite not being present.
"That Jiang Cheng is not as simple as he appears, have him watched in secret."
"Yes!"
Just as Xiahou Jun was about to leave, he saw a stream of light gently float in from outside.
Finally, it settled on the emperor’s desk.
Xiang Gaoye reached out a finger to touch it, and moments later, his expression changed dramatically, and he stood up suddenly.
"He dared to kill so many people!"
"What’s wrong, Your Majesty?"
Xiahou Jun didn’t understand, only assuming that something monumental had occurred.
Otherwise, this emperor, who was typically inscrutable, wouldn’t exhibit such an extreme reaction.
It was already unnecessary for Xiang Gaoye to explain.
Outside, a large group of people was pounding on the palace gates, causing a commotion, even beating the Dragon-Surprised Drum!
Upon receiving the summons, Lu Ran, An Deming, Su Qingshou, Qiu He Sword Venerable and others all gathered.
"Your Majesty, please seek justice for us!"
"My grandson was killed by the friend Jiang Cheng brought back with the princess, it was so tragic..."
"Your Majesty, Jiang Cheng is too ruthless, please intervene personally!"
"Please allow me to mobilize troops to surround the princess’s mansion and tear Jiang Cheng to pieces!"
"Jiang Cheng must be eliminated to quell the public outrage!"

chapters.title: Chapter 102 You Need Help
chapters.content:
Chapter 102: Chapter 102 You Need Help
On his first day at Longyue Imperial City, Jiang Cheng became the most famous person here.
There’s no helping it; if anyone else killed so many noble descendants, they’d make everyone else stop talking about anything else, focusing solely on him.
Being able to take down so many at the Celestial Fate Realm, his power was speculated by many outsiders to be at the Daoist Palace Realm.
This level of power is top-tier in the Qianxing Dynasty.
Unfortunatley, he killed those who should not be killed.
And he killed more than just one.
"Can we talk?"
The knock on the door came from the Green Skirt Palace Maid.
Seeing her come alone, Jiang Cheng was a bit excited. Was this woman in hiding finally going to show her hand?
"Sure, sure, welcome, welcome."
Seeing his unsurprised expression, the young maid was a bit taken aback.
"Seems you already knew my true realm. It was the Three-Eyed Tiger senior who told you, wasn’t it?"
This confident assumption made Brother Cheng find it amusing.
Young lady, I actually saw through it with Insight.
But if you want to guess so, suit yourself.
"Just say what you want." He disliked beating around the bush.
"Before I speak my purpose, could the Demon King senior come out for a chat?"
"It didn’t come."
"Are you sure?" The Green Skirt Palace Maid seemed incredulous.
Jiang Cheng was quite speechless: "What is there to be uncertain about?"
"Then you’re done for."
"Oh?"
The Green Skirt Palace Maid spoke indifferent: "Xiang Gaoye decided to sit back and watch the tigers fight, letting those families make a move against you."
From a moral standpoint, An Siyuan and Lu Qing barging into others’ homes to fight and kill deserved death.
But there are some things in this world where reasoning doesn’t apply.
Xiang Gaoye, as the Emperor, should have given orders to protect Jiang Cheng, but doing so would incur the wrath of the Daoist Palace Realm experts from various families.
Coupled with the hatred of Xiang Ba being killed...
So he ultimately chose to stand by.
It could also be seen as using a knife to kill.
Using those families’ hands to take down Jiang Cheng.
"And then?"
Brother Cheng remained calm.
You’re kidding; having died so many times already, this is just a regular small scene, right?
This reaction once again surprised the Green Skirt Palace Maid; she had thought Jiang Cheng should be very panicked now.
Does this person not understand the seriousness of the situation?
So she could only continue to warn him, letting him understand how dangerous this dilemma was.
"You might be thinking of escaping Longyue City, but that’s impossible."
"There’s a super Great Array under the entire Longyue Imperial City. Once activated, even the Daoist Palace Ninth Layer couldn’t get out."
"Moreover, those few families have already deployed forces, surrounding the Princess’s Mansion."
"Now, you already have nowhere to fly."
Jiang Cheng clapped his hands in praise.
"Wow, that truly is an impressive array, worthy of the Qianxing Dynasty I have high regard for."
If not for being concerned about the Three-Eyed Tiger from the Feixian Sect, the Green Skirt Palace Maid would probably have slammed the door and left.
It was the first time she had encountered this kind of person.
Completely unable to communicate on the same wavelength, utterly unable to comprehend what was going on in his mind.
"Are you counting on Princess Ningti to protect you?"
"Unfortunately, she won’t be able to either."
"There are too many people wanting to kill you this time; she can’t hold them back."
Jiang Cheng knew that she kept painting a dire picture to put pressure on him, certainly with a follow-up.
"Alright, I’m very scared, so what next?"
Your tone and your expression have nothing to do with being scared!
She bit her lip, holding back the urge to curse.
"The only person who can help you now is me."
"You know my power; I can help you fend off these families."
Daoist Palace Eighth Layer indeed qualifies one to say this.
"However, you also know, this favor isn’t free..."
Her plan was to use this crisis to make a deal with Jiang Cheng.
I’m helping you this time, but you’ll have to let the Three-Eyed Tiger help me out twice in the future.
If it were someone else, they would definitely agree to this deal.
Unfortunately, she was dealing with Jiang Cheng, who constantly thought about how to die.
"Thank you, but how could I trouble you?"
"What do you mean?"
Brother Cheng slowly walked to the door, hands behind his back, gazed at the stars outside, and said calmly: "This incident started because of me; why should I involve others? That’s not my principle."
The Green Skirt Palace Maid didn’t know him well, for a moment unclear if he was pretending or truly having high morals.
"You’re not afraid of death?"
"What joy is there in living, what fear is there in dying!"
This unhesitant answer let her finally reach the conclusion—this person just doesn’t shed tears until he sees the coffin, pretending more than he is.
If he died, no problem; the subsequent cooperation with the Three-Eyed Tiger would be wasted.
With a wipe on her ring, she still took out a Jade Talisman.
"What’s this?"
Jiang Cheng accepted it, finding it was just a Tier Six Communication Spirit Talisman.
The Green Skirt Palace Maid turned her back to him, appearing deep and inscrutable.
"I left a wisp of True Spirit Thought in this talisman; when thrown, it can block a full-force attack from anything below Daoist Palace Fifth Layer. When the Spirit Talisman explodes, I will instantly come."
"Whether to use it, that’s up to you."
Once used, it means seeking her help, representing compromise with her.
After speaking, she disappeared into the night.
"Visit often!"
Brother Cheng warmly bade farewell.
He was still a bit curious; this woman hadn’t revealed her true face even now, could she be a hideous creature?
Shortly after the Green Skirt Palace Maid left, not only this side hall but the entire Princess’s Mansion became quiet.
Everyone except Jiang Cheng had withdrawn.
This place was about to become a battleground.
To appease various families, Xiang Gaoye tacitly approved of this hunt.
The Emperor even decreed that aside from the battling parties, no idle-by person shall step in.
Especially Princess Ningti, who had been summoned to the palace; the royal family could not get involved in this turbulent water.
This battle attracted attention throughout Longyue Imperial City.
This night, many were sleepless, knowing that beneath the surface peace lay swords drawn and ready.
As the party involved, Brother Cheng was left very bored.
He was so bored that he could only count his spoils.
This time he acquired three Tier Eight Spiritual Artifacts, in addition to more than 20 Tier Seven Spiritual Artifacts.
Because a great battle was imminent, he converted them all into points without leaving a single item.
There’s no help for it; even if he kept a single artifact or talisman, the system might ’play tricks’ on him.
For instance, getting killed and then the talisman inexplicably mutates and advances to conveniently avert the crisis.
He couldn’t give the system any chance to take advantage!
Along with miscellaneous Spirit Stone Elixirs, he gained another 1.02 million points this time.
"Only 13 people, yet they brought so many points."
"This trip to the Imperial City is truly worth anticipating!"
Moments later, thunderous sounds echoed outside the side hall.
Boom!
Like a tidal wave rolling in, it threatened to engulf the entire Princess’s Mansion.
The blood energy surged skyward, dyeing the heavens red.
There were at least over ten thousand people, truly forming a net to prevent his escape.
Stepping out of the bedroom, seven elderly figures of varying appearances stood in the sky, coldly staring down at him.

chapters.title: Chapter 103: Wandering Residual Spirit
chapters.content:
Chapter 103: Chapter 103: Wandering Residual Spirit
"You really didn’t escape after all."
Su Qingshou, the head of Baiyu Academy, was somewhat surprised.
His divine thought not only covered the entire Princess’s Mansion but also extended over hundreds of miles in the distance, leaving nothing unnoticed by his perception.
Jiang Cheng had no allies, no reinforcements.
Did he intend to sit and wait for death?
Qiu He Sword Venerable’s white beard trembled slightly, and his wrinkled eyelids gradually lifted, revealing cloudy, yellowish eyes.
"Mi Yun is my only disciple."
"If you had just injured him, I could have considered it as juvenile mischief."
"But you killed him."
He slowly drew his sword and sighed softly.
"You shouldn’t have killed him..."
The Grand General Lu Ran, clad in golden armor, remained expressionless.
"For just one person, the Blood Radiance Army mobilized ten thousand troops."
"If this was the way you hoped to make a name for yourself, then you’ve succeeded."
"But... the moment you become famous is also the day you regret being born."
"Do you think we would let you die easily?"
Looking at this group of Daoist Palace realm experts floating in the sky, Jiang Cheng deeply felt the difference in status and aura.
These old relics were indeed different.
Those years were not lived in vain.
Compared to them, Xiahou Jun, who shouted and threatened at first sight, seemed insufferably vulgar.
Only knowing how to say things like ’Prepare to die’ or ’Let me capture him’ were such mediocre lines.
If he were here tonight, it would definitely have been something like ’How dare you kill my grandson; you deserve a thousand deaths, prepare to die’...
Both are Daoist Palace experts, yet he was so unbearably rustic!
Looking again at these people’s demeanor, listening to their way of speaking, there were still too many things he needed to learn.
Clearly, they were also showing off, clearly aiming to kill, yet at every moment exuding an air of ’I am a seasoned senior’.
This feeling was indescribable.
Hard to articulate, yet it’s the difference between an artist and a craftsman.
Without sufficient experience and depth, it’s impossible to achieve.
"Hahaha, today, meeting all of you eminent seniors is truly a great pleasure in life!"
Brother Cheng tried hard to mimic their lofty manner, always feeling a bit too deliberate, not as natural as them.
"Please!"
"I, Jiang Cheng, have been eagerly awaiting for quite a while."
The seven Daoist Palace realm experts above couldn’t quite grasp his intentions for a moment.
This kid was surprisingly calm, what was going on?
Could it be that he had some heaven-defying trump card?
"Apparently, your encounters have been quite extraordinary."
"Which have given you the courage to be arrogant."
As Duke Bei An Deming waved his sleeve, the night sky grew even darker!
Immediately, all around Jiang Cheng was as if locked by countless arrows, with no room to evade.
Above, a sudden burst of light!
A Daoist Palace descended, and the entire Princess’s Mansion sank directly at this moment.
Within hundreds of miles, all buildings collapsed with a roar, as if made of clay.
Although An Deming’s target was solely Jiang Cheng, the power of a single strike by a Daoist Palace expert was simply too formidable.
For low-tier cultivators, this was a scene akin to a natural disaster.
Jiang Cheng didn’t even have a weapon prepared, but the battle still had to put up some semblance.
He could only deploy his Radiant Divine Mansion.
The dim arrows around were not illusions; they crashed into the Divine Mansion in an instant.
The Radiant Divine Mansion gleamed with divine brilliance, nine martial dao rivers shone brightly.
All the arrows melted and dissolved into black, sticky liquid.
Under the purging of the Five Elements rivers, not a trace remained.
Then, he charged upward, colliding head-on with the four-colored Daoist Palace in the sky.
Boom!
In the high sky, a nine-colored ripple quickly spread out.
A thousand miles away, the highest tower of the Imperial Palace suddenly trembled.
The spire fell.
The two figures separated, Jiang Cheng fell at a disadvantage, but he remained alive after all.
With a mere Celestial Fate Fourth Layer cultivation, without even a spiritual artifact, he actually managed to survive a second-layer Daoist Palace strike.
It was truly astonishing.
"Radiant Divine Mansion!"
"Indeed extraordinary!"
"What grade is that martial dao mark..."
The other six Daoist Palace realm experts in the sky couldn’t maintain their calm demeanor any longer.
That immortal-level martial dao mark, they couldn’t recognize it.
"Surpassing Saint level!"
"Definitely surpassing Saint level!"
"How is that possible?"
"No wonder my grandson was killed by him..."
"This person cannot be allowed to remain!"
Earlier, they still retained their lofty demeanor.
As the battle started, they let An Deming fight alone, seemingly disdainful to intervene.
But now...
"Brother An, allow me to assist!"
"Do not let him escape!"
"Blood Radiance Army, heed the command, attack!"
Six great experts simultaneously summoned their Daoist Palaces, alongside An Deming, forming a siege, trapping the already struggling Jiang Cheng in the center.
Meanwhile, the Blood Radiance Army on the outskirts charged over the ruins with an unstoppable momentum.
Roar!
Blood Evil Qi materialized, spanning across the center of the seven Daoist Palaces.
In the sky, a scarlet giant spear, seemingly endless, like the sun ripping through clouds, struck straight down!
Boom!
With a tremendous roar, the surrounding air twisted entirely.
In the void, black radiance rippled.
It was the combined attack of the seven great experts and the Blood Radiance Army, burning the void itself.
The Princess’s Mansion had completely disappeared.
Replaced by a bottomless giant pit.
It might not take many years before this turns into a new lake attraction in the Imperial City.
As for Jiang Cheng, not even a corpse or ashes were left to sense even the slightest trace of breath.
He died cleanly.
The only thing left was a storage ring that had reached a Tier Seven Spiritual Artifact level still remained.
"Ding, the host was killed; detecting enemy strength, arranging resurrection plan..."
The familiar system prompt sounded.
"Ding, the previous battle disturbed the last drifting residual spirit of the Li Dragon beneath Longyue Imperial City."
"The unconscious residual spirit was summoned by the host’s Azure Dragon Bloodline and actively fused with the host’s divine soul."
What was the situation with the Li Dragon’s residual spirit?
Brother Cheng appeared bewildered.
Did integrating this thing mean he could now dominate the entire scene?
"Ding, the host is resurrected."
At the moment of resurrection, he activated invisibility.
He had no choice; revealing himself now would mean being naked without any clothes.
Then, he noticed that his current state was a bit different from before.
His divine soul had become unprecedentedly robust.
Before this, his cultivation was at the Celestial Fate Fourth Layer.
This mainly referred to the spiritual power realm.
As for the divine soul aspect, it was more difficult to cultivate, so he was still at the Celestial Fate Third Layer.
This was already with his extraordinary talent.
Many cultivators, despite thousands of years of ascetic cultivation, were stuck at a realm without progress mainly because they couldn’t comprehend, and their divine soul comprehension couldn’t keep up.
Even after consuming many pills, it was all in vain.
And now, Jiang Cheng suddenly discovered that his divine soul realm had directly leaped past the Celestial Fate realm’s barrier, reaching the Daoist Palace level.
This leap was truly astonishing.

chapters.title: Chapter 104: The Might of the Great Array
chapters.content:
Chapter 104: Chapter 104: The Might of the Great Array
In terms of cultivation, he was still at the Fourth Layer of Celestial Fate.
But possessing a Divine Soul at the Daoist Palace level was of utmost significance.
It meant that he now had no bottleneck in advancing to the Daoist Palace Realm.
As long as his spiritual power reached the threshold, it would happen naturally.
Apart from this, his divine soul’s might had completely surpassed Celestial Fate.
The power he could wield in battle had become stronger.
However, this was still not enough to eliminate those seven experts and the myriad-strong Blood Radiance Army.
After all, those seven were true Daoist Palace Realm practitioners, their divine souls naturally at the Daoist Palace level too.
Jiang Cheng knew that absorbing the residual spirit must involve more than just elevating the divine soul realm.
His consciousness sank into the Divine Mansion, and he immediately discovered its mystery.
In his mind, a wondrous scene unfolded.
Beneath him, ten thousand miles deep within the earth, was a massive and expansive underground palace.
Though devoid of lights, it was not completely dark.
Because at its center lay a massive skeleton, several tens of thousands of meters long.
The skeleton was entirely light green, with many parts mottled and cracked, limbs shattered and incomplete, dead for countless years.
Glimmers of light shone through the gaps in the bones, bringing some illumination to the underground palace.
"Li Dragon?"
Jiang Cheng inexplicably recognized it, even though he had never seen it before.
He finally understood what he had gained.
Countless millennia ago, a Li Dragon that reached the Demon King Realm died here.
Many years later, its remains were discovered by the Xiang Family ancestors.
Being of the Demon King level, even its remains possessed incredible effects.
The Xiang Family used its dragon scales to forge treasures, its flesh to create treasure pills, and even extracted the last trace of bloodline to merge into themselves to enhance talent.
Meanwhile, they used its remnants as an array hub to construct a grand Dragon Spirit Array.
That was the Xiang Royal Race’s brightest period, during which they produced several at the Eighth and Ninth Layers of the Daoist Palace.
But as time passed, the benefits of the Li Dragon treasure were exhausted.
With no new treasure pills, coupled with the thinning Li Dragon bloodline in descendants, their talent steadily declined.
Until hundreds of thousands of years later, Xiang Family newborns could no longer inherit the Li Dragon bloodline, such was Xiang Gaoye’s fate.
The reason Princess Ningti’s talent far surpassed his was due to an unexpected ancestral inheritance of a trace of the Li Dragon bloodline.
And the Dragon Spirit Array, due to the gradual decay of the remnants, fell from a treasure array to a Tier Nine Spirit Array.
This encompassed everything Jiang Cheng knew.
He finally grasped the brilliance of the system’s plan.
The Xiang Royal Race would never dream that the deceased Li Dragon actually had a wisp of lingering spirit still threading about, yet not extinguished.
The residual spirit had no consciousness, merely the obsession of the Li Dragon before death, which would perhaps entirely extinguish in another million years.
And now, he merged with it.
He wiped his ring and released the puppet cheer squad.
Dong dong dong!
When the somewhat tacky drum music suddenly echoed from the ruins, both the seven experts and the Blood Radiance Army were dumbfounded.
Seeing the eight dancing female puppets almost made their eyes pop out.
"What is happening?"
They had savored numerous performances in their lives, but it was the first time amid post-battle ruins.
"Caution is wise."
"I knew Jiang Cheng wouldn’t be killed so easily."
The seven scanned around but failed to locate Jiang Cheng.
Until a long and loud laugh echoed from above them.
"Does this song and dance please you all?"
Jiang Cheng stood proudly in the void, his white robe spotless, not hinting at just having been in battle.
The seven, unlike prior adversaries, weren’t panicky.
They, expressionlessly, flew up, once again surrounding him.
Qiu He Sword Venerable gracefully plucked at his sword and asked, "Why are you still alive?"
"Because I’m stronger than all of you!"
Jiang Cheng didn’t give them time to react, activating the Dragon Spirit Array at once.
Indeed, this was the system’s real solution.
The Dragon Spirit Array, controllable only by the Xiang Royal Race.
Outsiders, even seizing the array’s control hub, found it to be useless, as the day this great array was devised, it was already imprinted with the Xiang Royal Race’s mark.
However, that did not preclude exceptions.
Besides the core array hub, the array could be triggered by itself.
The Li Dragon’s remnants formed the array hub, intrinsically part of the array itself.
Having merged with the residual spirit, Jiang Cheng now embodied the Li Dragon.
His activation equated to the array coming to life.
Even if Xiang Gaoye personally intervened, he couldn’t stop it.
In the next moment, the dim underground palace suddenly turned bright as day.
Centered on the remnants, the array’s markings on the ground all lit up, extending thousands of miles underground!
Each line resembled a burning line of fire, magnificently beautiful.
Within the imperial palace, Xiang Gaoye, waiting for news of Jiang Cheng’s demise, abruptly leapt up, rushing out incredulously.
Beside him, Princess Ningti was equally astounded.
The two came outside the palace, seeing in the distance a verdant barrier sealing off an area of several hundred miles.
And that location was the Princess’s Mansion!
"This is impossible!"
"How could the Dragon Spirit Array self-activate?"
Xiang Gaoye muttered, experiencing, for the first time, a situation spiraling out of control.
In that moment, countless people walked out of their homes, gazing at the shimmering, flowing barrier.
Many did not know what it was, but they knew it must be something terrifying.
As they, too, felt the tremors emanating from beneath the ground.
"This is impossible!"
Grand General Lu Ran echoed the same words.
"Xiang Gaoye..."
"Is Xiang Gaoye secretly helping you?"
The first thought of the seven great Daoist Palace Realm experts wasn’t that Jiang Cheng controlled the array, but that Xiang Gaoye was tricking them.
"Heh, enjoy it at your leisure,"
Brother Cheng had no obligation to explain. He merely activated the array, transforming the barrier into a terrestrial purgatory.
The ruins suddenly turned into a vast ocean!
If it were just ordinary water, even those in the Body Tempering Realm could survive.
But the sea within this grand array was far from simple.
The first to suffer was the Blood Radiance Army below.
Ten thousand soldiers, not quick enough to rise, were swept away by the seawater.
Soon, they were corroded and dissolved...
Thousands with quicker reactions flew swiftly into the sky.
But it was already too late.
The Dragon Spirit Array originally could envelop the entire imperial city, but that would have dispersed and weakened its power significantly.
Moreover, the city housed numerous civilians, with whom Jiang Cheng had no quarrel, so he naturally refrained from acting recklessly.
He significantly shrank the scope, covering only the Princess’s Mansion, thereby concentrating the barrier’s potency.
At this time, torrential elemental rain fell from the sky.
The Blood Radiance troops, merely touched by a few drops, quickly found it spreading over them, eventually also dissolving them completely.
Still, to the seven great Daoist Palace experts, it was manageable.
Their adversary was an extended Black Dragon Illusion tens of thousands of meters long.
Each breath of the illusion saw their spiritual power quickly corroded to nothing.
What utterly terrified them was their Dao Palace.
Even that gradually dissipated into void with each breath.
Suddenly without their Dao Palace, their foundation was ruined and scattered, left powerless to withstand the array’s erosion.
At this moment, Jiang Cheng crushed the Communication Spirit Talisman given by the Green Skirt Palace Maid.

chapters.title: Chapter 105: Crazy Advancement
chapters.content:
Chapter 105: Chapter 105: Crazy Advancement
In fact, the green-skirt palace maid was not far from the Princess’s Mansion at this moment.
She was always waiting for Jiang Cheng to crush the jade talisman and call for her help.
Just asking for help would mean he accepted the deal.
Upon seeing the giant spear formed by the Blood Radiance Army, she actually intended to step in.
This strike, even for her at the Daoist Palace Eighth Layer, was hard to ensure being unscathed.
Not to mention, there were seven other Daoist Palace experts attacking simultaneously.
Without her intervention, Jiang Cheng absolutely couldn’t survive.
But she ultimately restrained herself.
If she actively participated in the battle, it wouldn’t mean Jiang Cheng had yielded.
This was a game between them, at least she thought so.
After that strike, she thought Jiang Cheng was dead.
"Foolish man."
"No matter how great one’s fate, it can’t withstand recklessness."
With such an assessment, she didn’t wait long before seeing the barrier.
"Dragon Spirit Array?"
"Did Xiang Gaoye make a move?"
She was extremely puzzled, what is the Emperor trying to do?
Jiang Cheng should already be dead, so why activate the Great Array?
Then, she sensed Jiang Cheng had crushed the spirit talisman.
A wisp of her True Spirit consciousness instantly appeared within the barrier, witnessing the scene inside.
The entire Blood Radiance Army was annihilated.
The seven great experts were exhausted, struggling on the brink of death.
And Jiang Cheng was still perfectly fine.
Oh, aside from that, the puppet cheerleaders were still busy performing.
The singing and dancing never stopped.
The Great Array was completely controlled by Jiang Cheng, who thoughtfully cleared a small safe zone for the cheerleaders.
The green-skirt palace maid was speechless about his aesthetic and taste.
She was almost dazed by the utterly one-sided battle before her eyes.
"How did you do it?"
Xiang Gaoye couldn’t have opened the array for Jiang Cheng and killed the experts of his own dynasty.
"Just did it, a casual flick."
Brother Cheng shrugged, looking all nonchalant.
By this time, those seven great experts were all dead.
The seawater within the barrier receded quietly, the Black Dragon illusion dissipated, and tranquility returned inside the barrier.
The green-skirt palace maid’s beautiful eyes widened in shock; even she couldn’t achieve such a feat.
She didn’t believe Jiang Cheng was truly that powerful.
"How did you master the Dragon Spirit Array? You should be here for the first time."
"Secret."
Jiang Cheng smiled mysteriously.
The green-skirt palace maid’s True Spirit consciousness remained silent for a moment before finally asking, "Since you’ve already won, why did you crush the jade talisman?"
When the jade talisman shattered, she thought Jiang Cheng had finally sought help.
She immediately prepared to act, intending to shield him from a deadly strike.
Who would have guessed, upon entering, she wasn’t needed at all.
"Oh, just wanted you to witness it."
Brother Cheng shrugged; having someone observe while showing off sure felt more rewarding, right?
"You..."
The green-skirt palace maid’s heart raced like thousands of galloping horses; she was utterly defeated by this person.
As the barrier disappeared, the True Spirit consciousness, having only one strike worth of power, couldn’t exist long in the external world, soon dissipated.
Brother Cheng cheerfully began collecting the spoils.
Among the ten thousand Blood Radiance Army members, there was almost nothing valuable.
Though all of them were in the Spirit Platform Realm, none even had storage rings.
In other sects, Soul Splitting Realm practitioners generally had their collections.
"Such a cruel regime, risking lives for the Qianxing dynasty, with such poor compensations."
He complained while exchanging all the Tier Four battle armors and Tier Five weapons from these people into points.
The corrosion of the Dragon Spirit Array only targets flesh and blood creatures, so these spiritual artifacts remained intact.
From these people, he obtained 1.1 million points.
Then there were the seven top experts; they were the main attraction.
These seven were all within the Daoist Palace Realm, and each was either a family patriarch, a senior military giant fan, or a college dean.
Their assets were mostly stored in their personal storage rings.
Jiang Cheng almost cheered every time he opened a ring.
Each person possessed Tier Eight spiritual artifacts, and both Su Qingshou and Qiu He Sword Venerable had Tier Nine spirit swords.
The spirit stones, pills, and spirit talismans were in abundance.
As the journey through the Qianxing dynasty wasn’t over, and considering potential future threats and resurrections, he chose not to spare them and converted everything into points.
With this conversion, his total points directly reached 8.55 million.
The upgrade to 10 million was within reach.
Besides, there were over a dozen Heavenly and Earthly Treasures for crafting treasure pills and treasure artifacts.
Additionally, from the rings of these people, he gathered 21 Treasure Pills that increase spiritual power.
As for Divine Soul elixirs, they were too rare, and if any of them had such, they would have likely consumed it long ago.
Having recently elevated his Divine Soul due to Li Dragon’s residual spirit to the Daoist Palace level, now he lacked spiritual power accumulation, and these Treasure Pills were a timely help.
With the terrifying conversion speed of the Celestial Desolation Indestructible Body, as long as he consumed them, they could be refined into spiritual power to increase cultivation.
He immediately sat down cross-legged, taking the pills on the spot, practicing meditation.
For others, meditating during practice, the outdoors in the wild was the most taboo and dangerous.
Especially during breakthroughs, a little disturbance could cause major problems.
However, Jiang Cheng didn’t care; he had two resurrections left today, no problem even if he’s killed.
A graceful silhouette silently appeared behind him.
The body of the green-skirt palace maid still came over.
She quietly watched Jiang Cheng’s back as he cultivated, unsure of what to say.
She couldn’t evaluate this person at all.
Call him foolish? All the dead were enemies, and he was the one laughing at the end.
Call him smart? Look at this defenseless demeanor, what’s smart about it?
Soon, she saw Jiang Cheng become Celestial Fate Fifth Layer.
Improvement through pills?
For pills to be effective, one’s realm comprehension must keep up, along with their divine soul.
It seems he had an epiphany in the recent battle?
Then she watched as Jiang Cheng took more pills.
Can he continue to advance?
Merely a minute later, she was astonished to find his aura had already become Celestial Fate Sixth Layer.
How is that possible?
Advancement from Celestial Fate Fifth Layer to Sixth Layer requires a great deal of spiritual power.
Even though Treasure Pills contain massive spiritual qi, cultivators need a lengthy time to refine and convert it into spiritual power.
Refining a single Treasure Pill, ordinary Celestial Fate cultivators need two to three months or even longer.
For talented cultivators, due to special constitution and bloodline, the time is greatly shortened, often taking only a few days.
As for top-tier talents like her, it could be done within a few hours.
But now, what is she witnessing?
This person used a short moment to refine two Treasure Pills and succeeded in breaking through.
"You..."
She intended to say something.
Soon, she saw Jiang Cheng took two Treasure Pills again, refining them together.
He’s crazy, right?
Celestial Fate cultivators can handle the power of one Treasure Pill, which is already considered the limit.
Two could very likely explode the meridians!
Yet, two minutes later, she noticed Jiang Cheng had again consumed two Treasure Pills.
Moments later, he advanced again, successfully becoming a Celestial Fate Seventh Layer cultivator.
The green-skirt palace maid could swear she had never seen anyone improve so quickly in her life.
Right under her eyes, a small realm one moment, then another small realm the next.
The Novel will be updated first on this website. Come back and continue reading tomorrow, everyone!

chapters.title: Chapter 106: The 4-Sided Primordial Cauldron
chapters.content:
Chapter 106: Chapter 106: The 4-Sided Primordial Cauldron
The Green Skirt Palace Maid’s emotions grew increasingly complex.
She originally planned to act as his protector, after all, she was still counting on collaborating with the Three-Eyed Tiger.
Jiang Cheng mustn’t die.
But gradually, her mindset began to change.
This person’s talent is terrifying!
It even made her feel a hint of jealousy.
Does he not need to comprehend things?
Does he not need a Divine Soul Realm?
Her expression kept changing...
But in the end, she could only smile bitterly and shake her head.
Forget it, how many geniuses are there in the world.
If seeing someone surpass you and you think of annihilating them, then your worldview is just too narrow.
After calming down, she just watched him continue his breakthrough.
In the end, Jiang Cheng actually took five Treasure Pills in one go.
When all 21 pills were fully refined, his realm stabilized at the peak of the Celestial Fate Ninth Layer.
Only a step away from the Daoist Palace Realm.
It wasn’t until this moment that he completed his cultivation and stood up.
If this can be counted as cultivation...
"Congratulations on your significant advancement in cultivation!"
When he turned around, Brother Cheng was nearly startled.
"Damn, a fairy!"
The woman behind him was still wearing the same blue dress as before, but her face and aura were entirely different.
Her deep purple eyes seemed like a cool night sky, giving a very distant illusion.
Her snowy, delicate features were nothing short of the creator’s favored masterpiece — already beyond perfect.
Even someone as carefree as Jiang Cheng found it hard to look away.
Her long hair lightly floated in the night breeze, ethereal and elegant, as if there were spirits singing upon it.
Before this, the most beautiful woman Jiang Cheng had seen was Ji Linghan.
But compared to her delicate, home-like beauty, the woman before him exuded a distant, unreachable beauty, as though she shouldn’t belong to this world.
"It’s me."
"My real name is Lan Ti."
Upon hearing her familiar voice again, Jiang Cheng finally recognized her.
Damn, this beauty who doesn’t even look real is actually that Green Skirt Palace Maid?
Before, she was merely pleasant to look at, not someone with shockingly high beauty.
But now, wherever she went, she’d undoubtedly become the center of attention.
Although he knew from the start she used special earrings to change her appearance, wasn’t this change too extreme?
"Let me introduce myself, I am the current Clan Leader of the Witch Division of the Immortal Remnant Race."
Perhaps Jiang Cheng’s talent moved her.
Or maybe because Jiang Cheng survived the previous encirclement, proving how deep his fate was.
Lan Ti finally decided to reveal her identity.
Unfortunately, Brother Cheng was completely confused.
"What is the Immortal Remnant Race? And what is the Witch Division?"
"You mean you’ve never heard of the Immortal Remnant Race?"
She seemed a bit disappointed, as if this group should be well-known.
"The Immortal Remnant Race are the descendants of immortals."
After saying this, she awaited Jiang Cheng’s shocked expression.
However, much to her disappointment, Brother Cheng merely nodded.
"Oh."
Even upon hearing immortals, he showed no intense reaction.
Lan Ti really wanted to ask him, are you just pretending to be composed?
"In this world, immortals shouldn’t exist, as their power surpasses the plane’s limits."
"In front of immortals, even a Saint Tier is vulnerable, and numbers become meaningless."
"Therefore, the rules of heaven and earth don’t allow them to descend from the Immortal Realm, as that would disrupt the balance of the Lower Realm."
Brother Cheng expressed his understanding.
It’s something he could comprehend without thinking.
The Immortal Realm is full of immortals; if they could descend easily, where would mere cultivators find a place to survive?
Lan Ti told him this to help him realize the strength of immortals, but who knew this guy still just nodded, his expression remaining calm.
He showed no signs of being shocked.
She could only continue: "But every rule has its exception. A long time ago, nine immortals accidentally descended to the Lower Realm."
"And then?"
"They wanted to ascend back, but severely injured, they could only temporarily stay in the Lower Realm to recover. During that time, they left behind descendants."
"And those descendants are the Immortal Remnant Race?"
"Exactly. The Immortal Remnant Race are the descendants of those nine immortals, divided into nine divisions, now scattered across the major domains. The Witch Division is one of them, located in the Thousand Spirit Domain."
"Who are the other eight divisions?"
"The Thunder Division, Poison Division, Illusion Division, Fire Division, War Division, Painting Division, Heart Division, and Food Division."
Jiang Cheng could understand the first five divisions.
But the last three, he couldn’t quite grasp.
"What does the Painting Division do, are the Immortal Remnants training artists?"
"And the Food Division, is it about who can eat more? A group of foodies, ha ha ha ha ha..."
Lan Ti gritted her teeth, really wanting to kick him.
"There are thousands of paths in the Dao. As long as they align with the rules of heaven and earth, one can become immortal. You don’t even know this?"
If it weren’t for Jiang Cheng’s talents being evident, she would have suspected he was a cultivation newbie.
And is this even the point?
Shouldn’t he be asking where those nine immortals went?
"The nine immortals remained in the Lower Realm for only a century before returning to the Immortal Realm one after another."
"Due to the rule barriers between the Immortal Realm and the Lower Realm, they couldn’t come back down, and thus there are no immortals in the world anymore."
"And that was how the Immortal Remnant Race split into nine divisions..."
Jiang Cheng really wanted to tell her, girl, you’re mistaken. At least in my sect, there’s still someone claiming to be an Immortal Venerable.
That rule barrier isn’t as formidable as you think; there’re still those who slip through the cracks.
"Did you reveal your origins to lay all cards on the table?"
"Exactly, I want you to ask the Three-Eyed Tiger senior to help me acquire the Four Directions Yuan Cauldron of the Qianxing Dynasty."
Of course, Jiang Cheng wouldn’t agree right away.
He was just curious: "With your power wanting to seize the treasure, how could anyone in the Qianxing Dynasty stop you?"
Lan Ti slightly shook her head: "The Four Directions Yuan Cauldron is a magical treasure related to faith. With this treasure, Xiang Gaoye can receive the entire dynasty’s luck’s blessing, which even I can’t contend with."
"A magical treasure? What grade is it?"
Brother Cheng became interested.
Although he already had treasure weapons, he still didn’t possess a magical treasure.
Magical treasures are different from weapons and armor and aren’t crafted by artifact refiners.
They often possess effects beyond logical reasoning, like trapping souls, moving mountains, controlling seas, subduing, and suppressing.
Even if mortals obtained them, they could wield astonishing power.
"The Four Directions Yuan Cauldron is only considered a lower-grade magical treasure."
Lan Ti tucked a strand of hair behind her ear, looking down.
"An imperial dynasty differs from a sect. They also govern billions of mortal citizens. From the day it was established, a large amount of the power of faith appeared."
"The ancestors of the Xiang family somehow acquired a technique, forging the Four Directions Yuan Cauldron, extracting and gathering the intangible power of faith into the cauldron."
"Over time, the Four Directions Yuan Cauldron gradually transformed into a magical treasure."
"This item has a natural suppressive effect and can protect the imperial race’s luck, which is why the Xiang family has lasted for millions of years."
Her explanation left Jiang Cheng somewhat speechless.
"Won’t the people of the Qianxing Dynasty be in trouble if the Four Directions Yuan Cauldron is taken away?"
Although he had destroyed many sects, he had no desire to harm unrelated people.
"Of course not. This cauldron indirectly binds their faith and the luck of the imperial race together, instead imprisoning them."

chapters.title: Chapter 107: Is This Human Language?
chapters.content:
Chapter 107: Chapter 107: Is This Human Language?
Lan Ti said again, "But with that Magical Treasure gone, the Xiang royal family’s fortune will decrease by more than half, and may eventually be replaced by other families."
"As for the person who seizes the Four-direction Primordial Cauldron..."
"What will happen?"
"They will be protected by the Power of Faith."
Jiang Cheng was still waiting for more details.
But Lan Ti’s answer ended abruptly, with no follow-up.
"Is that all?"
What use is the Power of Faith, it can’t directly increase cultivation, nor can it enhance the divine soul.
That cauldron itself is just a lower-grade Magical Treasure.
Not being from the Xiang Family, he wouldn’t receive the royal fortune’s blessing either. Using it in battle wouldn’t yield much power.
And as for the protection from the Power of Faith, for someone like him who dies every so often, it was utterly useless.
Was it really worth all that effort?
"You stayed by Ningti’s side just to use her to get that cauldron?"
"That’s right."
"She’s of the Xiang royal family, how could she possibly help you?"
"There’s a reason for that."
Lan Ti sighed, "Unfortunately, even she couldn’t get close to the Four-direction Primordial Cauldron, and my plans have had no progress for three years."
"So you thought of me this time?"
"I thought of the Three-Eyed Tiger behind you. If it was willing to make a move, it would be easy."
"Why should I help you?"
They weren’t even acquaintances, why should he put in effort for someone else without any reason?
No matter how beautiful Lan Ti was, Brother Cheng wasn’t a simp.
Lan Ti naturally understood this logic.
"As long as you can help me obtain it, you can name your terms."
"Really?"
Brother Cheng’s eyebrows raised, his smile becoming a bit unscrupulous.
"Name my terms?"
Lan Ti’s cold eyes were full of determination, this Four-direction Primordial Cauldron seemed extremely important to her.
"As long as I can manage it."
"Alright, if you agree to become mine, I will definitely help you."
This woman looked young.
Yet her power had reached the Eighth Layer of the Daoist Palace, with heaven-defying level cultivation talent.
With her strength and talent, the system’s price for her would be very high.
If she were to become one of mine like Ji Linghan or Lin Ning, how many points would that bring instantly?
Eight million?
Ten million?
Twenty million?
Brother Cheng almost drooled!
"You..."
Lan Ti’s heart skipped a few beats.
Whenever a woman hears a man say ’be mine’, the first thought is ’be my woman’, in other words, marry?
To help just once and ask for her hand, this guy was too much.
"You’re taking advantage of the situation!"
"Won’t agree?"
Jiang Cheng shrugged, "Then forget it, goodbye."
Seeing him actually leave, Lan Ti took a deep breath.
"Wait!"
She ground her pearl-like teeth, wishing she could stomp this hateful man in front of her a thousand times, right on his face.
"I agree."
The Four-direction Primordial Cauldron was too important to her, without the protection of the Power of Faith, her lifelong pursuit would be impossible to fulfill.
Brother Cheng turned back with surprise.
"Really?"
These are vast points!
"That’s right!"
Lan Ti nodded firmly, having made up her mind.
Thinking carefully, this person, in terms of looks and talent, was the most outstanding she had ever seen.
Even among the young talents of other branches of the Immortal Remnant Race, there wasn’t a man like him.
Despite the lack of feelings, a temporary marriage didn’t seem to be a loss.
Anyway, when the plan succeeds in the future, she wouldn’t be in the Lower Realm anymore.
She had thought it through, but Jiang Cheng wasn’t happy.
Since you agreed to be part of my group, why hasn’t the system made that "ding" sound yet?
Without that "ding", you’re not one of mine.
This woman, did she think she could fool Brother Cheng with just empty words?
What nonsense!
"You really have no sincerity at all."
"A deceitful woman with false affections!"
He was expectantly preparing to embrace mass points, but now the disappointment almost broke his heart.
"Too much!"
Lan Ti, who was originally a bit flustered, was now confused by his words.
"What do you mean?"
Her exquisite face was instantly covered in frost.
I even agreed to the excessive condition of marriage; what more do you want?
Do you know how significant and difficult this decision is for a woman?
And yet you call me deceitful?
And cunning?
"What do I mean?"
Jiang Cheng sneered coldly, "Just reminding you, don’t take Brother Cheng for a fool."
"You, you go to hell!" Lan Ti stomped her feet angrily.
Just like that, the two parted on bad terms.
As soon as they separated, Brother Cheng started plotting.
Regarding the Four-direction Primordial Cauldron, he said it was just that, but he was honest in his heart.
After all, it was a Magical Treasure!
He didn’t even have something of that tier yet.
Even if he didn’t use it, bestowing it to disciples or converting it into points would be worthwhile.
What a pity, he should’ve asked more questions just now, like where the cauldron was kept.
Otherwise, should he really call over the Three-Eyed Tiger?
With its power, a single divine thought sweep should find it.
No, no, just thinking of that tiger’s boastful and smug face, he immediately dismissed the idea.
"The achievements I, Jiang Cheng, have today, are all earned through my own hard work, never relying on others!"
If relying on system exploits counts as hard work.
...
After killing seven great experts and over ten thousand Blood Radiance Army, it completely shook the entire Qianxing Dynasty.
For a time, Jiang Cheng’s name was mentioned by countless people.
In a certain sense, his boastful wish to make a name for himself was fulfilled.
Such is life’s irony.
Earlier, he killed a bunch of noble young lords and was besieged by various families, branded as a criminal.
Now that he killed even more people, no one pursued him anymore.
Killing those seven great experts, Emperor Xiang Gaoye knew what it meant.
He assigned someone overnight to arrange a new palace for Jiang Cheng, with even more grandeur than before.
Ningti, whose Princess’s Mansion was destroyed, also moved in, sharing the same roof once again.
Three nights later, this Princess quietly approached him.
"Sect Leader Jiang, please save this humble girl..."
As soon as she entered, she knelt down with a thud, crying her eyes out like a rainy flower.
Brother Cheng was startled; what was happening?
Previously, Ningti was always all ’I, the Princess’, ridiculously high-class and cold, he had never seen such a scene before, it almost felt like a complete style breakdown.
"Get up and talk."
"I won’t, if Sect Leader Jiang doesn’t save me, I won’t get up!"
Ningti started acting spoiled.
With her national beauty and tearful eyes, she was truly pitiful, few could resist.
Too bad, Jiang Cheng had recently seen the even more beautiful Lan Ti.
What’s more, Ji Linghan at home wasn’t any less than her.
"Alright, since you don’t want to get up, I won’t force you."
He initially planned to help her up, but sat back down instead.
Ningti, who was kneeling, was stunned.
Is this guy human?
Are these even human words?
However, she really couldn’t get up now, having decided to kneel, she could only continue acting out her role.
"Sob, sob, sob, I’m a dignified princess, Sect Leader Jiang must think I have everything and live worry-free, right?"

chapters.title: Chapter 108: If You Want to Kill, Do It Yourself
chapters.content:
Chapter 108: Chapter 108: If You Want to Kill, Do It Yourself
Jiang Cheng didn’t know why she suddenly started acting pitiful, so he could only go along with it.
"Yeah, yeah."
"Actually, I’ve been living in fear for these three years, my life hanging by a thread, sob sob sob..."
"Is there really such a thing?"
He said it with his mouth, but in reality, he immediately understood.
He already thought it was absurd that a more powerful palace maid could exist peacefully behind this princess.
Especially when Lan Ti said Ningti would cooperate, he couldn’t understand it at all.
No surprise, Ningti must have been controlled by Lan Ti for these three years.
"Sect Leader Jiang, did you know? I have a palace maid named Lan Ti beside me, and she’s actually not from the Qianxing Dynasty but a demoness from an evil Demon Sect!"
One says the Witch Division’s clan leader, another says demoness from a Demon Sect, who should I believe?
"Oh, that’s really shocking." He dryly made a remark.
Ningti thought he hadn’t interacted with Lan Ti yet, so she continued to sob, "That demoness is more powerful than my Ancestral Emperor, and she has a vicious curse technique."
"After being cursed by her, my life and death are entirely at her whim, I can only obey her, becoming her slave..."
"Please save me, Sect Leader Jiang!"
She banged her head against the ground with a thud, causing debris to scatter everywhere.
Hiss...
Jiang Cheng twitched the corners of his mouth, girl, are you crazy?
Doesn’t it hurt?
Oh right, you’re in the Daoist Palace First Layer, it’s the floor that should be feeling the pain.
"How do you want me to save you?"
"To lift the curse seal, there’s only one way, and that’s to kill her!"
Ningti lifted her reddened forehead and fiercely said.
"Sect Leader Jiang, you can kill those seven Daoist Palace experts and wipe out ten thousand Blood Radiance Army with a wave of your hand, with such power, killing her would definitely be effortless!"
"The only one who can save me now is you, I beg you..."
Brother Cheng was almost left speechless by her.
On the surface, she seemed pitiful, but in reality, she was forcing him to commit murder.
The problem is that we have no relationship, so why should I risk my life against someone in the Daoist Palace Eighth Layer for you?
"Helping you isn’t impossible, if you’re willing to become one of my own..."
"I am willing, of course, I am willing!"
Ningti didn’t even wait for him to finish before loudly expressing her willingness.
It was just a pity that Jiang Cheng didn’t hear the system notification chime.
Damn, none of these women can be trusted.
Ningti thought it was settled and broke into a smile.
"Sect Leader Jiang, we’ve agreed then. Tomorrow night, my Ancestral Emperor will host a banquet for you, and I will lure her there then."
"You’ll be able to make your move during the banquet!"
"The Ancestral Emperor will cooperate with you, don’t forget..."
After speaking, she left in a hurry.
Watching her leave, Brother Cheng secretly complained.
Girl, you really take me for a weapon, huh?
He’s not stupid, Ningti’s words actually had many holes.
Why didn’t Xiang Gaoye personally get rid of Lan Ti in these three years?
Although the Emperor Qianxing is only in the Daoist Palace Sixth Layer, two layers lower than Lan Ti, he should be able to handle it on his home turf.
For example, by using the Great Array or the Four-direction Primordial Cauldron.
Lan Ti herself said she couldn’t compete with that magical treasure of fortune.
If they wanted to save Ningti, there would have been countless chances in those three years, why did they have to wait until he appeared?
There must be a reason behind it.
Are they as a father and daughter trying to set up a trap, to have him and Lan Ti kill each other first, and then take them all out?
Brother Cheng didn’t know if his guess was the truth, he planned to personally witness it the next evening.
After all, with three resurrections, he had nothing to fear, right?
He’s also quite interested in the Four-direction Primordial Cauldron.
The next evening, a person indeed came to invite him to the palace banquet.
"Hahaha, is this Sect Leader Jiang?"
"Such an extraordinary presence, truly living up to the name!"
Even though he was certain they were enemies, Jiang Cheng still accepted Xiang Gaoye’s clichéd compliments.
"Truly worthy of His Majesty the Emperor, such a keen eye, recognized the uniqueness of this Sect Leader at a glance!"
"Impressive, impressive!"
The experts of the imperial dynasty in the hall all twitched their mouths simultaneously.
Brother, are you praising His Majesty or complimenting yourself?
Xiang Gaoye seemed not to expect him to be of such a style, this emperor who had long been in a high position almost couldn’t manage his expression.
"Come, come, take your seat!"
This seat was clearly arranged deliberately, the one next to Jiang Cheng was Princess Ningti.
And among the two palace maids standing behind her, one of them was indeed Lan Ti.
This woman had put on her earrings again, maintaining her previous image as the Green Skirt Palace Maid.
The banquet soon began.
Everything was normal, with drinks and congratulations flowing back and forth.
Occasionally, Celestial Fate and Daoist Palace experts raised their cups to chat and laugh, and he responded casually.
How long is this feast of the Hongmen Banquet going to last, anyway?
Soon, the banquet was cleared away, and song and dance performances began in the middle.
Such performances were naturally something everyone present was used to, but Brother Cheng became uncharacteristically serious.
This song and dance were obviously much more elegant than his puppet cheerleading team.
It seems he needs to have Old Mo improve it when he returns.
"Ningti, I heard your maids are in the Spirit Platform Realm, why not let them come on stage for a sword dance?"
Xiang Gaoye’s suggestion was naturally not opposed by anyone.
"This..."
Ningti showed a face of conflicted difficulty as she looked behind her.
Perhaps it was because Lan Ti gave her an affirmative answer that she finally smiled.
"Sure."
Soon after, Lan Ti and another palace maid came to the stage to perform a sword dance.
Watching her seriously dance, Jiang Cheng found it amusing.
This woman didn’t know tonight was a trap for her, still playing the role of a normal palace maid.
After a while, applause filled the air.
Xiang Gaoye ’seized the opportunity’ to suggest: "I heard Sect Leader Jiang is excellent in swordsmanship, would you enter the stage and teach these two palace maids?"
As soon as he said this, Ningti’s face turned tense.
This was precisely the ’opportunity’ they created for Jiang Cheng.
Lan Ti had no defenses and thought it was just a regular performance. If Jiang Cheng wanted to kill her during the sword dance, it was much easier than a frontal confrontation.
The others joined in the excitement.
"I have long wanted to see Sect Leader Jiang’s swordsmanship."
"Sect Leader Jiang wouldn’t look down on these two palace maids, would you?"
"It would be a blessing for them to receive guidance from Sect Leader Jiang."
Brother Cheng kept sneering inside.
Another crowd of stooges.
On the surface, they’re praising but in reality, they’re using a knife to kill, treating him as a monkey, really a wishful thinking.
"What sword dance, makes no sense, I’m not interested!"
He raised his eyelids, quite disdainfully.
The hall suddenly fell silent, even the two women performing sword dance stopped.
Everyone was stunned, incredibly surprised.
In such occasions, even with hidden enmity, people keep it courteous on the surface.
Who would speak such vulgar words like him?
"Sect Leader Jiang, what do you mean by this?"
Xiang Gaoye stood up with a gloomy face.
Princess Ningti’s eyes were filled with disappointment and sadness: "Sect Leader Jiang, you aren’t even willing to give this little face?"
The others started speaking too.
"Yeah, Sect Leader Jiang, it’s just a sword dance, why such a big reaction?"
"Sect Leader Jiang you..."
Brother Cheng chuckled and interrupted their whining.
"If you want to kill Lan Ti, do it yourselves, don’t count on me."
As soon as he finished speaking, a killing intent filled Lan Ti’s eyes in the middle, sweeping across the hall.

chapters.title: Chapter 109: Sacred Land Intervenes
chapters.content:
Chapter 109: Chapter 109: Sacred Land Intervenes
At this point, there’s no more meaning in hiding it.
Princess Ningti swiftly flew away, not to fight, but to hide behind Xiang Gaoye.
She was clever, knowing how to be the last one laughing.
Other experts in the hall, such as Xiahou Jun and others, all unleashed their Spiritual Artifacts, their Daoist Palace Divine Mansions competing in splendor.
Making this vast hall shine with extraordinary brilliance.
"What happened?"
Lan Ti still hadn’t figured out what was going on.
Now the whole scene pointed their weapons at her, the only one she could trust was Jiang Cheng, still seated at the table.
"Sister, take off the earrings. Your identity has been exposed, Ningti wants me to kill you."
Always honest, he continued to carry forward the excellent traditional virtues of not concealing or lying.
Princess Ningti, hidden behind Xiang Gaoye, screamed in anger.
"Jiang Cheng, you betrayed me, you will die miserably!"
Brother Cheng was not angry at all.
"Thank you for your blessing, make it stronger later."
Lan Ti was very angry, taking off her earrings and restoring her true appearance while gazing at Ningti with sorrow.
"Aren’t you afraid of dying?"
The eyes of countless people in the entire scene quietly solidified, that face was too beautiful.
It didn’t seem like it belonged to the mortal world, leaving people breathless.
Princess Ningti was already beautiful enough, but compared to her, it was like a sparrow compared to a swan.
Some cultivators with less firm willpower even let their weapons quietly drop down.
"Hahahahaha..."
Suddenly Ningti laughed, a laugh full of relief and vengeance.
"Did you still hope to use that Curse Seal to threaten me?"
"Sorry to disappoint you, it’s already been broken!"
"Now think about what fate awaits you!"
She no longer needed to pretend to be subservient in front of her.
"In fact, these three years I must thank you for your guidance, without you, I wouldn’t have easily entered the Daoist Palace Realm."
"Kikikiki..."
"So I assure you, even in death I won’t let you rest in peace."
Maybe she had held it in too long, the malice in her words was undisguised.
Lan Ti’s expression finally changed a little.
"How did you do it?"
With her Curse Seal, although one could still speak and write, mentioning any word related to the curse would immediately trigger the Curse Technique, resulting in instant death on the spot.
This was also why Xiang Gaoye had been indifferent all these years.
Because Ningti couldn’t tell anyone, he had no prior knowledge.
The Emperor on the high platform kept his gaze fixed on Jiang Cheng.
"You are really blind to the big picture."
"Speak, how did you trigger the Dragon Spirit Array that night."
It was a thorn in his heart, unable to rest easy without understanding.
After Jiang Cheng activated the array that day, he went to the Underground Palace to check carefully but found nothing amiss.
The array had no abnormalities and didn’t seem tampered with.
"As long as you tell, I will spare your life."
This kind of nonsense, of course Jiang Cheng didn’t believe.
Besides, did he need it?
"Ah, since you want to spare my life, then I really don’t want to say."
"You will speak."
Xiang Gaoye clapped his hands, and two white-clothed youths slowly walked forward from the back.
At first glance, they looked ordinary, but leisurely standing in this hall, it felt as if they had replaced Xiang Gaoye as the masters here.
An inexplicable, strange aura wafted over them.
"Yu Liang, Han Huayuan, it’s you!"
Seeing these two, Lan Ti’s expression immediately turned solemn.
Apart from that, there was a deep-seated hatred as well.
"Lan Ti, now you know how my Curse Seal was broken, right?"
Ningti proudly raised her long white neck: "In front of two Saint Heirs, your little ability is not worth mentioning!"
Lan Ti gave a scornful cold laugh.
"Just with those two pests from Silence Sacred Land, they’re not qualified to break my Curse Seal."
Before the two could speak, Xiahou Jun jumped out, clamoring first.
"Audacious, you demoness of only Daoist Palace Eighth Layer. The two Saint Heirs are both of Daoist Palace Ninth Layer, what qualifications do you have to disdain them?"
"Overreaching."
"Ridiculously laughable!"
Sure enough, not as impressive as the last seven masters, could only say some small fry lines.
While Brother Cheng was secretly complaining, blue-eyed Lan Ti urgently sent a voice transmission in Sea of Consciousness.
"Jiang Cheng, they won’t spare you either, both of us will be killed."
"Can you summon the Three-Eyed Tiger senior?"
To this point, girl, you’re still preoccupied with that tiger?
I am actually the most formidable big killer here, can’t you have some insight?
"Summoning is impossible, what should I do?"
He became mischievous, deliberately replied in voice transmission with a seemingly frightened tone.
Lan Ti looked at the group opposite, outwardly calm, but her transmission was tinged with exasperation.
"You fool! Wasting such a great opportunity, not even using the Demon King!"
"Yes, yes, then what next, little miss?"
"The only way now is to join forces and break through, I’ll handle those two while your main opponents are Xiang Gaoye and others."
So considerate?
Voluntarily tackling both strongest Daoist Palace Ninth Layer opponents there?
"This puts me in an awkward position..."
Brother Cheng had to admit he was moved.
Lan Ti added, "But you must be careful, these two have Verbal Magic."
"They also know Curse Techniques, are they from your Immortal Remnant Race Witch Division?"
"No..."
At this point, one of the two Saint Heirs from Silence Sacred Land spoke slowly.
"She’s right."
Just these five simple words, as if a truth, everyone instantaneously believed it completely.
Jiang Cheng even had an eerie sensation, as if whatever Lan Ti said next should be correct.
Darn, what is this Demon Technique, so miraculous?
"We indeed can’t break your Curse Seal, but Master can."
"Before departing, he bestowed us with a Curse-Breaking Talisman."
Lan Ti suddenly realized.
No wonder she didn’t sense anything for those days after Ningti’s Curse Seal was broken.
Turns out an Ascending to Saint Realm interfered.
"You Silence Sacred Land really are haunting!"
Han Huayuan slightly shook his head. "You must know, the Witch Division is long gone. Master greatly appreciates you. If you’re willing, there’s still time to become his disciple."
"Heh..."
"Isn’t it him wanting to be my disciple?"
Lan Ti continued to laugh coldly, secretly transmitting again.
"I’m about to make my move, you should still be able to activate the Dragon Spirit Array..."
Brother Cheng wanted to say, girl actually you don’t need to make a move, just watch the show.
Just see me getting killed, you can turn the tables immediately.
However, before he had time to reply, the woman boldly attacked the next second.
A long sword pointed directly at the two Saint Heirs.
In an instant, this palace seemed to transform into a different space.
Everyone’s sight involuntarily caught by that sword tip.
"Protect the Emperor!"
Several Daoist Palace experts sped forth with their Daoist Palaces.
But before their Daoist Palaces could unleash power, Lan Ti shot a glance their way.
Purple eyes like serene ancient wells, just a glance.
In the next instant, Xiahou Jun and Yang Jie were struck as if by lightning, their faces turning pale.

chapters.title: Chapter 110: The Magical Verbal Magic
chapters.content:
Chapter 110: Chapter 110: The Magical Verbal Magic
No one knows what kind of significance this glance held.
They saw the two Daoist Palaces teetering, almost falling from mid-air.
Xiang Gaoye was taken aback; this technique was beyond his imagination.
In front of him, Lan Ti’s Daoist Palace shocked everyone, reverberating deep within their Divine Souls.
It was an Eight-Colored Daoist Palace, with eight Martial Dao rivers surging with great waves.
Each wave contained profound martial power.
This was Jiang Cheng’s first time seeing Lan Ti in action.
He finally understood why she said she could help fend off seven top experts and over ten thousand Blood Radiance Army members last time.
Out of those eight rivers, six were at the King Level.
This was the level of Martial Dao Enlightenment that should exist at the Ascending to Saint stage of the Daoist Palace Realm.
And the remaining two were actually at the Saint Level!
She truly possessed that kind of power.
This woman should have no opponents below the Ascending to Saint Realm.
No wonder Silence Sacred Land sent two Daoist Palace Ninth Layer masters to deal with her. If there was only one, they probably couldn’t restrain her.
The Daoist Palace and Celestial Fate Realm are actually intertwined.
Because of the Radiant Divine Mansion, when reaching the Daoist Palace Realm, Jiang Cheng would automatically evolve into a Nine-Colored Daoist Palace.
This foundation sounded even more terrifying than Lan Ti’s.
However, Brother Cheng’s current state of the nine rivers was indeed a bit shabby.
Apart from the Five Elements Martial Dao being elevated by Daoist Celestial Immortal Rhyme to the dazzling Immortal Level.
The other eight rivers consisted of three at the True Level, four at the Master Level, and one at the Sect Level.
The two Saint Heirs certainly wouldn’t sit idle and await their doom.
The two simultaneously summoned their Daoist Palaces, seven glorious colors sparkling, seven King Level rivers rushing forward.
If it weren’t for seeing Lan Ti’s Daoist Palace, everyone on site would have been impressed by the two Saint Heirs.
But compared now, their Seven-Colored Daoist Palaces seemed rather ordinary.
"Sword."
Yu Liang whispered a single word.
Even amidst the chaotic battlefield, it reached everyone’s ears.
He was actually using a book-shaped treasure, but countless sword arrays appeared surrounding Lan Ti.
The sword arrays swept down like rains, streaks of light piercing through.
Yet before entering within three feet of Lan Ti, all swords suddenly ignited.
Then transformed into trails of smoke.
"Wall."
Han Huayuan held a small blue flag, suddenly shaking it.
Lan Ti’s relentless killing move was abruptly blocked by a high wall, seemingly not quite gold nor earth.
What kind of technique was this?
Jiang Cheng’s eyes almost popped out.
Just uttering a word made it happen?
Is this the legendary Verbal Magic?
Impossible, otherwise couldn’t they just say "die" and end it more easily?
Lan Ti’s sword tip jabbed into the wall but didn’t produce a booming clash, rather as if penetrating water.
The wall actually rippled like water waves.
Only she, being a witch, could handle this; if other Daoist Palace Realm faced such Verbal Magic, they’d likely struggle.
A line of blood leaked from Han Huayuan’s mouth as he stepped back.
Lan Ti’s long sword passed through the wall, once again approaching the two Saint Heirs.
"Vine."
Yu Liang frantically flipped the pages of his book, shouted sternly, suddenly covering the ground and void with countless tangled vines.
And in the center of Verbal Magic, Lan Ti halted.
She was enwrapped from head to toe by those vines.
"Hurry and activate the array, use the Four-direction Primordial Cauldron!"
Han Huayuan, just backfired by the Curse Technique, shouted sharply.
The Emperor, who was stunned by the Witchcraft Verbal Magic, woke up abruptly, hurriedly starting the Great Array and Magical Treasure.
Instantly, the hall was enveloped in a green barrier, forming its own space.
Dark sea water roared and surged, pouring down like heavy rain.
Shooting directly at the ensnared Lan Ti.
At the same time, a golden Four-direction Cauldron spun rapidly above Lan Ti’s head.
Originally, Lan Ti had turned all the wrapping vines into ashes using witchcraft.
Under the gold light, she suddenly appeared languid.
Using the faith power of the Qianxing Dynasty’s billions of citizens as the foundation, the Four-direction Primordial Cauldron condensed into national fortune, ultimately converting into the Xiang Family’s fate.
Under such incredible power, not to mention Daoist Palace Realm, even Ascending to Saint Realm would face a certain degree of suppression.
With this move, Lan Ti, who had been invincible, was immediately put into a dire predicament.
Finally, the two Saint Heirs could breathe a sigh of relief.
Xiahou Jun and Yang Jie laughed loudly.
But then, they couldn’t laugh any longer.
Jiang Cheng waited for this moment.
He’s not just here to watch.
Though he wished to be killed sooner, with Lan Ti valiantly blocking the two Daoist Palace Ninth Layer masters alone, he couldn’t sit idle.
With Brother Cheng’s reaction, originally he could have immediately activated the Great Array to aid this main carry teammate.
But he didn’t do so, for it wasn’t the perfect time to enter the battlefield.
He deliberately let Xiang Gaoye activate the Great Array first.
The opponent started the array, targeting him and Lan Ti.
All the sea water and storm only assailed the two, leaving everyone else unscathed.
This led all enemies to relax.
And right at this unguarded moment, Brother Cheng suddenly took control of the Great Array using Li Dragon’s Residual Spirit.
All of a sudden, the surging black water reversed, rushing towards other experts in the hall.
And the storm rained down on their heads.
Neither Xiahou Jun, Yang Jie, the Saint Heirs, nor Xiang Gaoye could respond in time.
"Ah..."
Xiahou Jun screamed miserably; a drop of rain hit his Spirit Armor, penetrating as if seeping into his shoulder’s flesh.
This rainwater contained Li Dragon’s Corrosion Rule, impossible for the Daoist Palace Realm to resist.
He vigorously surged his Spiritual Power, his Daoist Palace rapidly spinning, yet completely unable to halt the corrosion steps of the black water.
In just two breaths, he merged into the black water, leaving no trace.
It was only the Spirit Armor, due to not being flesh and blood, that remained intact.
With Xiahou Jun’s Daoist Palace Realm power, had he been more vigilant initially, he surely wouldn’t have been killed so easily.
But there was no way around it; Jiang Cheng’s timing for activating the Great Array was so skillful, catching them off guard psychologically.
Not only him; Yang Jie and several other Daoist Palace experts were also all killed.
Below Daoist Palace, not a single person survived.
Looking around, only the two Saint Heirs and the Imperial Princess were left alive among the four.
The combat results were incredibly brilliant.
The first three survived due to their significantly superior powers, while Ningti survived due to her crafty vigilance and ample means of self-preservation.
Even so, the four looked extremely ragged now.
The Imperial experts were wiped out; Xiang Gaoye was furious.
He wanted to regain control of the Great Array, but at this point, no matter how he operated the array’s central core, it showed no response.
Joking aside, Jiang Cheng had now become the incarnation of the array hub.
What central core would go through another layer, when he could do it directly?
Facing the Great Array’s Black Dragon Breath, Xiang Gaoye was utterly haggard, barely coping.
Ningti looked even more disheveled, teetering on the brink of defeat at any moment.
With no other option, he had to direct the Four-direction Primordial Cauldron against the Great Array.
Under the Imperial Race’s fortune cleansing and protection from the Square Cauldron, the Black Dragon Illusion’s breath finally failed to invade the four’s hidden area.
But changing the cauldron’s location relieved the earlier pressure on Lan Ti.

chapters.title: Chapter 111: Immortal Tier Trial Version
chapters.content:
Chapter 111: Chapter 111: Immortal Tier Trial Version
As soon as she escaped, she charged forward again.
Za!
The sword light clashed with the Four-direction Primordial Cauldron’s Power of Fortune.
It was like pouring oil on a raging fire, creating a screeching zila sound.
White mist rose in threads, like smoke and illusions.
Looking far into the distance, one could see illusionary mountains, rivers, and bizarre divine statues.
"Fire!"
"Thunder!"
The two Saint Heirs spoke simultaneously, once again casting Verbal Magic.
At that moment, the ground suddenly cracked open, endless lava burst forth, aiming straight at Jiang Cheng and Lan Ti.
Above the sky, thunder roared, deafening.
However, this kind of attack had very limited impact on the two of them.
Especially Jiang Cheng, with the Dragon Spirit Array in hand, the continuous corrosion of black water extinguished and weakened the lava and thunder bit by bit, causing no harm.
If it weren’t for the defense of the Four-direction Primordial Cauldron, the four of them wouldn’t have been able to withstand the internal and external pincer attack from Lan Ti and Jiang Cheng.
Xiang Gaoye frantically urged the Magical Treasure, the Power of Fortune gushing out.
At this moment, all the citizens of Longyue Imperial City inexplicably felt weak, their minds in a haze.
Even the cultivators felt a sense of discomfort.
They all turned their gaze to the center of the Imperial Palace.
There, a beam of golden light shot up into the sky, forming a golden cloud, continuously expanding.
"What happened...?"
"I don’t know..."
"Is the Imperial Palace being attacked?"
Xiang Gaoye, under the protection of the Four-direction Primordial Cauldron, felt a bit anxious.
What are these two Saint Heirs doing?
Aren’t they Daoist Palace Ninth Layer?
Aren’t they the top geniuses renowned in the Thousand Spirit Realm?
Why is it so difficult for the two of them to join forces and kill a Daoist Palace Eighth Layer? It’s really weak!
He misunderstood; these two’s trump card, Verbal Magic, is essentially a branch of Witchcraft.
If they were up against other Daoist Palace Ninth Layers, they would easily handle them.
But they happened to come across Lan Ti, the Clan Leader of the Witch Division, making it difficult to gain an advantage.
It can’t go on like this.
While fighting, Yu Liang quietly observed Jiang Cheng, who was controlling the Great Array.
In the short term, defeating Lan Ti seemed unlikely.
It would be better to make Jiang Cheng the breakthrough point.
Right, he is only Celestial Fate Ninth Layer!
A layer lower than a Great Realm, just perfect for using that Verbal Magic!
"Dream!"
He suddenly exhaled and spoke, two streams of misty flowing light immediately descended upon Lan Ti and Jiang Cheng.
"Heh..."
Lan Ti let out a cold laugh, and the shimmering light instantly dissipated.
Like an illusory bubble.
This kind of curse that directly affects the opponent was simply laughable to restrain her.
But Jiang Cheng was different.
He was a layer lower in the Great Realm and had no understanding of curse techniques...
Originally, while he was still manipulating the Great Array, his eyelids suddenly grew heavy, and he fell asleep.
He even had a dream.
In the dream, he sat atop a throne; below, countless people were reciting the Sect Leader’s scriptures in unison, orderly.
In a mist-covered pool, enchanting beauties were dancing.
He sat, embracing left and right, enjoying the soft warmth of jade, thoroughly indulging.
On the left was Ji Linghan, on the right was Lin Ning, with another woman massaging his legs.
Upon closer inspection, it was Lan Ti.
"Heh heh heh, Lan Ti, why have you become so obedient?"
"Have you finally succumbed to my handsome appearance?"
He laughed out loud...
Outside, Lan Ti, who was engaged in battle, also heard the mumbled dream talk, almost passing out from anger.
This guy really fell for it.
Moreover, her image in his dream seemed rather pitiful.
Damn it!
She forgot that this guy was Celestial Fate Ninth Layer.
Yu Liang’s Verbal Magic, which was previously never used directly on her, but rather through external attacks like the Vine Sword Array and Thunder, was because it’s challenging to have an effect when used directly on a target.
But if the target is a layer lower in the Great Realm, it becomes much easier.
As Jiang Cheng slept, the Great Array immediately lost control, returning to Xiang Gaoye’s hands.
Entangled by two experts, Lan Ti couldn’t rescue him, only watching helplessly as he was killed in his sleep.
Her heart sank completely.
It’s over.
With the Great Array changing hands again, Xiang Gaoye wasted no time using it against her.
And the Four-direction Primordial Cauldron, no longer needing to fend off the Great Array, once again enveloped her.
She could no longer escape.
Only able to hold on bitterly.
"Cage!"
"Chains!"
Yu Liang and Han Huayuan shouted simultaneously.
A White Jade Cage appeared out of thin air above Lan Ti’s head, enclosing her inside.
Besides that, chains like spirit snakes constantly swirled and wrapped around her.
If she were at her peak power, with witchcraft, this cage and chains wouldn’t trap her.
Unfortunately, under the suppression of the Power of Fortune from the Four-direction Primordial Cauldron, her power was severely restrained.
Moreover, the Black Dragon Illusion from the Dragon Spirit Array’s breath continued to attack and interfere from the side.
Defeat was only a matter of time.
"Hahahaha..."
Xiang Gaoye finally relaxed.
"Lan Ti, you’re finished!"
Princess Ningti, who had been mostly absent during the fight, emerged.
She sweetly requested the two Saint Heirs, "Immortal Masters, may I deal with her for three days?"
"One hour." Yu Liang replied indifferently.
One hour was already enough to vent.
"Thank you, two Immortal Masters..."
Ningti was overjoyed, looking at Lan Ti as if she were a cat with a fish under its paw.
Playful yet cruel.
Meanwhile, Brother Cheng, in his soul state, unsurprisingly heard the system prompt.
"Ding, Host has been killed, detecting enemy power and arranging resurrection plan."
"Ding, Host’s first joint combat journey, performed extremely poorly, causing teammates’ approval to drop sharply."
