Does this system know how to talk?
I’m asking you for a victory plan, not listening to your mockery.
And where exactly was it poor? Earlier, my entry into the battlefield was so exquisite, instantly killing all the small fries, why didn’t you mention that?
"To restore the host’s dignity and self-esteem, and to make teammates reevaluate, the host will be granted the Immortal Tier version of Verbal Magic for one minute."
Immortal Tier Verbal Magic?
What on earth is that?
Is it a more powerful magic than those two have?
But only for one minute, isn’t that a bit too short?
I need endurance!
Unfortunately, with the system plan given, there’s no room for change.
"Ding, Host resurrection."
With only a minute to show off, Brother Cheng didn’t have time to go invisible and change into clean clothes.
On revival, before the others could express shock, he immediately shouted.
"Stop!"
With that command.
Xiang Gaoye, Ningti, the two Saint Heirs all froze in their movements, as if under a body fixation spell.
Even their eyeballs’ gaze was frozen.
The only things still moving were their blood vessels and heartbeat...
Meanwhile, Lan Ti, who was bitterly contending with the White Jade Cage, chains, Four-direction Primordial Cauldron, and Dragon Spirit Array, also stopped.
The entire person looked like a highly realistic Fairy statue, motionless.
Most astonishingly, even the Dragon Spirit Array stopped.
The raindrops hung suspended in mid-air, the black water waves seemed to become solid, and shimmered with faint light.
The Four-direction Primordial Cauldron floated mid-air, no longer spinning, and even the light of fortune ceased to extend forward, becoming solid.

chapters.title: Chapter 112: What Can Be Done in 1 Minute
chapters.content:
Chapter 112: Chapter 112: What Can Be Done in 1 Minute
Damn!
In Brother Cheng’s mind right now, only two words were echoing—Epic!
With just one word to stop, everything in the entire venue came to a halt, whether alive or dead.
If it weren’t for the fact that the stopped people were still conscious, it would seem as if time had frozen.
The only exception was the chain cage.
Perhaps because they all belong to the realm of spell, once a stronger spell appeared, the previous one became ineffective.
So, with the spell, the cage and chains vanished into thin air.
This Immortal tier version of the Verbal Magic was amazing!
Brother Cheng was convinced.
He was even touched enough to be willing to give up his throne as King Bi, letting the system sit for a minute.
"Disperse!"
The Great Array vanished.
The Four-direction Primordial Cauldron, shining with golden light, fell down, transforming into a small bronze cauldron the size of a palm, which landed in his hand.
At the same time, even the Spiritual Qi within this hall was completely dispersed.
The remaining five finally regained their freedom.
"You..."
Xiang Gaoye was filled with shock, just about to ask how he was still alive.
"Kneel!"
Thud, thud, thud...
All four of them kneeled down with such force that their knees shattered the black stone floor.
The only exception was Lan Ti.
Jiang Cheng excluded her from the spell’s target.
"Release!"
"Dream!"
The two Saint Heirs were appalled, one trying to break the spell, the other to make Jiang Cheng enter a dream once more.
But these attempts were like mud cows entering the sea, having no effect whatsoever.
"How did you do that?"
Lan Ti was both surprised and delighted, unable to believe it was real.
She also knew a bit of Verbal Magic.
But even she couldn’t make same-level experts kneel at will.
Let alone Jiang Cheng, who was a realm lower than everyone present.
"Crawl!"
As the words fell, the Imperial Princess and the two Saint Heirs uncontrollably began crawling towards him.
"Jiang Cheng, what are you doing!"
Yu Liang couldn’t believe it and roared angrily, his neck veins bulged out and turned red.
"I shall kill you! Exterminate your family!"
Xiang Gaoye was furious enough to go mad; he was an emperor, after all, and had only ever had others kneel to him.
Never had he faced such a humiliating moment.
"You won’t die a good death!"
"Insulting the Saint Heir! The Sacred Land won’t spare you!"
Han Huayuan desperately tried to mobilize his Spiritual Power and Daoist Palace, but couldn’t resist the overpowering spell.
Ningti was the first to acknowledge the situation.
"Jiang Cheng... I was wrong..."
She immediately began pleading for mercy.
But Brother Cheng wasn’t falling for it.
The four of them now seemed to have received only one command—crawl.
Aside from that, they couldn’t fly, draw swords, or even commit suicide.
"Wretched beast, stop this at once!"
Suddenly, above Han Huayuan’s head, the phantom of an old man with white hair and beard appeared.
Lan Ti’s face changed color.
"The True Spirit Consciousness of Venerable Mirror Ring."
"Trouble, he’s Ascending to Saint, even a consciousness is something a Daoist Palace Realm can’t withstand!"
She had already found it suspicious; those two Saint Heirs alone wouldn’t definitely ensure victory.
So it turned out Silence Sacred Land had a final ace up their sleeve this time.
"Master, save me!"
"Kill him..."
The two Saint Heirs rekindled hope.
"Grind him to dust!"
Facing the phantom, who appeared wise and ethereal with an unfathomable aura, Jiang Cheng smiled.
Ascending to Saint Realm?
Sounds so scary.
"Roll!"
Before Venerable Mirror Ring could make a move, Jiang Cheng uttered another word.
The True Spirit Consciousness in the Ascending to Saint Realm changed expression.
It uncontrollably rolled in the void.
At times facing skyward, at other moments with its butt higher than its head, rolling neatly.
Jiang Cheng didn’t say stop, so it couldn’t stop.
"Wretched beast, you dare toy with me!"
"Stop!"
Venerable Mirror Ring’s True Spirit Consciousness almost went insane.
He couldn’t resist it.
This was the Immortal tier spell; if he were an Immortal, perhaps he could resist it, but certainly not at Ascending to Saint Realm.
The worldview of the two Saint Heirs and the Emperor shattered completely.
The lofty Ascending to Saint Venerable would receive endless reverence no matter where he went.
His appearance made people expect him to casually defeat everyone with a flick of his wrist.
Leaving behind the image of an expert departing and an unfathomable aura.
Yet now... he was rolling like a wheel, tirelessly dashing back and forth in this grand hall.
Lan Ti was dumbfounded.
She didn’t even know whether to cheer or gasp in shock.
An enemy so feared, being toyed with like this?
Could this also be a dream?
Bang!
The True Spirit Consciousness exploded.
In a secret chamber in the distant Silence Sacred Land, the true form of Venerable Mirror Ring roared in furious rage.
Surrounding mountains were shattered to powder!
To avoid further humiliation, he had to destroy his own strand of True Spirit Consciousness.
Yet the shame that just happened could never be forgotten.
On this side, Brother Cheng felt a bit regretful.
He had more tricks planned for that True Spirit Consciousness, but didn’t expect the old man couldn’t handle it.
With the disappearance of the True Spirit Consciousness, the remaining four were utterly hopeless.
Lan Ti jubilantly flashed to his side, her face full of disbelief: "How do you know spells?"
Jiang Cheng couldn’t answer.
He was currently in the minute-long state of the Immortal tier version, where anything he said turned into spell.
"Can you leave Ningti, I still have use for her, I don’t want her to be easily ended."
"Also, what level is your Verbal Magic, how is it more powerful than our Witch Division’s?"
Brother Cheng could only roll his eyes at her.
"Praise!"
Lan Ti’s expression changed, her purple eyes widened in disbelief, and she uncontrollably began to praise him.
"Jiang Cheng, you are the most handsome and charming man I’ve ever seen, unparalleled in the heavens and earth..."
"Your talent is incomparable..."
"Your aptitude astonishes ancient times and illuminates today..."
"Your brilliance is unsurpassed to the point the rules of the lower realm can’t contain it..."
"In comparison to you, I am like a firefly under the bright moon, it’s my life’s honor to bask in your light..."
"Your character is so noble and unparalleled throughout ten thousand ancient ages that no sage can compare..."
Lan Ti’s exquisite face almost twisted; she certainly didn’t want to flatter Jiang Cheng so cringingly.
If not for this crisis forcing them to join forces, she would have slightly despised this person.
After all, before this, they had argued once.
However, she couldn’t control it.
Faced with the Immortal tier version of the Verbal Magic, she couldn’t resist.
She could only glare murderously at him while gritting her teeth and continued to praise him.
Awesome!
Jiang Cheng expressed that he had never displayed such style with this much enjoyment.
The time was about up.
"Kill!"
He ordered once again.
Consequently, Xiang Gaoye and the two Saint Heirs began mutually slaughtering each other.
seconds later, with Xiang Gaoye and the two Saint Heirs engaged in a self-destructive battle.
Once Xiang Gaoye died, even if the spell’s effect wore off, victory was assured.
After his death, no one controlled the Four-direction Primordial Cauldron, and the Dragon Spirit Array returned to being under Jiang Cheng’s control.
After all, without the magical treasures and Great Array, the two Saint Heirs couldn’t withstand the combined forces of him and Lan Ti, even if they were in a normal state.
However, he didn’t plan on exerting that much effort.
Seeing that only a few moments remained before the spell’s effectiveness ended, he made his move.
"Kill!"
Without hesitation, he issued the command once more.
Thus, Xiang Gaoye and the two Saint Heirs began to slaughter each other.
Once Xiang Gaoye was dead, even when the spell eventually expired, they were sure to win.
Without Xiang Gaoye, nobody operated the Four-direction Primordial Cauldron, and the Dragon Spirit Array fell back under Jiang Cheng’s control.
No matter if those two Saint Heirs were in peak condition, they couldn’t withstand the combined attack of him and Lan Ti without their Magical Treasure and Great Array’s help.
But he had no intention of working that hard.
With a glance, only a few seconds left to spare.
"Destroy!"

chapters.title: Chapter 113: Great Perfection Swordsmanship
chapters.content:
Chapter 113: Chapter 113: Great Perfection Swordsmanship
Bang bang, two sounds.
The two great Saint Heirs simultaneously exploded on the spot, blown to smithereens.
Lan Ti was still automatically complimenting people there.
"Your looks make me intoxicated, tossing and turning, unable to sleep at night..."
"Ah! How could there be a person as perfect and maddening as Jiang Cheng... ah, ptooey!"
A minute passed, and the spell’s effect wore off.
She finally found relief.
"Go to hell!"
The peerless beauty instantly transformed into an angry lioness.
All her image was just ruined.
Thinking of those nauseating words she just said, she wished she could kill Jiang Cheng first and then herself.
"Do you want to try again?"
Brother Cheng, with his hands behind his back, slightly raised his chin, looking quite confident on the surface.
"You..."
Lan Ti was so angry her heart and liver hurt, but she still didn’t dare touch him, fearing another round might really happen.
"She’s escaping."
Jiang Cheng took the chance to point at Ningti, who was flying through a hole in the ceiling to escape.
In a flash, she was already outside.
Seeing this, Lan Ti quickly chased after her.
Brother Cheng let out a sigh of relief, that was close.
The act lasted only one minute; of course, he couldn’t go through it again.
Lan Ti had just raised her hand without gathering much spiritual power; she naturally didn’t really intend to kill him.
Without an Immortal Tier Spell, he couldn’t defeat her, so getting beaten for venting was highly likely.
Not having a penchant for getting beaten, Brother Cheng had no choice but to put on an act.
Now that he was the only one left, it was another great opportunity to pick up the spoils.
He first collected the Four-direction Primordial Cauldron into his storage ring and then went on a looting spree.
After taking all the spiritual artifacts and storage rings from everyone present, he turned on Insight and started looting everywhere.
This was the Imperial Palace of an Imperial Dynasty, after all.
Isn’t there always a treasure vault in the palace?
How could you enter a treasure mountain and leave empty-handed?
After a thorough search, he really found the royal treasure location.
Looking at the piles of Tier Five and Tier Six spiritual artifacts, and rows of Tier Six, Tier Seven, and even Tier Eight pills inside, Brother Cheng was almost suffocated.
How many points must that all be worth!
Even if he wanted to build a sect of ten thousand people right now, he could arm everyone to the teeth.
But the points are more important!
It took him two whole hours to organize all he had gained, deciding what to keep and what to exchange.
He kept a full 65 Treasure Pills, though none of them had the ability to enhance the Divine Soul Realm, only increased spiritual power.
The book and banner from Yu Liang and Han Huayuan were both treasures; Jiang Cheng examined them. Although he couldn’t use them for now, they could serve as the sect’s sacred treasures.
In addition, he kept three Tier Nine spiritual artifacts to fill up the sect’s treasure vault.
As for the rest, they were all exchanged.
After the exchange, his points increased from the previous 8.55 million to a whopping 31.63 million!
With points in hand, upgrading comes first!
He opened the system panel and spent ten million points, transforming his system.
Level: 6
Points: 0/100000000
Available Points: 21637893
Current skills: The Host can consume points to upgrade the target’s talent by one grade, cooldown period of one day.
Note: The higher the target’s talent, the more points consumed.
Subordinate Skills: The Host can resurrect any target once, with no cooldown time.
Note: The higher the target’s realm and the longer the death time, the more points consumed.
Damn, it even came up with a resurrection, the system is really damn impressive.
Brother Cheng now only has one word in mind: admire.
With the resurrection skill, he could take Ji Linghan, Lin Ning, and others out to show off... ah no, to experience adventuring together.
It’s not a good idea for them to be in the sect practicing ascetic cultivation all the time.
But going out adventuring is very dangerous, especially with Feixian Sect having quite a few potential enemies.
Being able to resurrect anytime would put his mind at ease a lot.
Just hoping the resurrection won’t cost too many points when needed.
After upgrading, he turned his attention to the lottery panel.
Having points in hand was making him itch.
Thinking about the huge boost from the last Daoist Celestial Immortal Rhyme, he couldn’t hold back the urge to gamble a bit.
One Level 4 lottery draw costs a million, really too expensive.
Clutching his hands, he decided to go with a Level 3 ten consecutive draws instead.
"Congratulations to the host for obtaining one Seven-Turn Soul Condensing Treasure Pill!"
"Congratulations to the host for obtaining one Celestial Fate Qi-Enhancing Treasure Pill!"
"Congratulations to the host for obtaining three drops of Cloud-Breaking Turtle Dew!"
"Congratulations to the host for obtaining one Thousand Mountain Thin Smoke Feather!"
"Congratulations to the host for obtaining one Treasure Fragment!"
"Congratulations to the host for obtaining one Treasure Fragment!"
"Congratulations to the host for obtaining one piece of Golden Flame Imperial Ancient Iron!"
"Congratulations to the host for obtaining one Earth-Splitting Seven Extremes Array Map!"
"Congratulations to the host for obtaining one Moon Orchid Flower!"
"Congratulations to the host for obtaining one Celestial Cloud Lunar Sword Technique!"
As soon as the ten consecutive draws ended, Jiang Cheng’s nose almost got twisted with anger.
No Xuanji Map Fragment, no treasure, no Daoist Celestial Immortal Rhyme, no skills.
Not even a single "luck burst" notification.
Twenty treasure fragments are needed to assemble a complete treasure, that’s just ridiculous.
He didn’t consider that such rare items as treasures, even in a Sacred Land, only those at the Saint Child level have a chance to own them.
Ordinary True Disciples still only used Tier Nine spiritual artifacts.
The Celestial Cloud Lunar Sword Technique was many levels better than the Duanmu Family’s previous Dark Spring Sealing Flame Sword, a top-notch martial technique at the Daoist Palace Realm level.
Also, the system’s sword technique was convenient, you could directly learn it after extraction, no cultivation needed.
That was the biggest gain from these ten consecutive draws.
Without hesitation, Jiang Cheng opted for extraction.
And then he had an extra sword technique in his mind, all its essence and techniques seamlessly fit into his original memory.
After extracting the sword technique, he directly practiced to the Great Perfection Realm, seeming quite simple.
But if word got out, it would possibly stun a lot of people.
Swordsmanship, as a martial art, is generally divided into several realms: Initial Glimpse, Slightly Accomplished, Refined Skill, Peak of Perfection, Small Perfection, and so forth; the power executed at each level varies significantly.
The power of Great Perfection Swordsmanship is usually twice as strong as that of the Small Perfection.
On the same level, most experts like Han Huayuan and even peak swordsmen are still at the stage of Refined Skill or Peak of Perfection.
Even the step to Small Perfection might seem near, but it’s likely they won’t ever reach it in their lifetime.
If that Daoist Palace Level sword technique was known earlier, even someone like Xiahou Jun, at Daoist Palace Second Layer, might not have defeated him.
Gazing upon the newly acquired swordsmanship essentials, capturing every bit, they became an integral part of his memory.
It felt like his lucky streak had run out after the last time.
The second batch of ten draws didn’t even give him a martial technique.
By the time he finished the tenth set of ten consecutive draws, using up 10 million points, it seemed his luck had been completely drained.

chapters.title: Chapter 114 Poison Heroic Soul
chapters.content:
Chapter 114: Chapter 114 Poison Heroic Soul
After ten rounds of ten-draws, he finally had several bursts of good luck.
He also obtained the Mountain and Sea Cloud-Piercing Spear, the Purple Sun Breaking Waves Sword, and the Moon-Rolling Demon Abyss Armor, these three Treasures.
Additionally, he gathered 20 pieces of other Treasure Fragments, which he combined to form an Azure Feathered Flying Rainbow Armor.
In the system’s eyes, directly obtaining a Treasure is definitely a streak of good fortune.
In the outside world, Treasures would cause bloody contention.
Even the Emperor Xiang Gaoye of the Qianxing Dynasty doesn’t have a single Treasure, which shows how valuable they are.
But for Jiang Cheng, who is determined to die multiple times and doesn’t even bring a Spirit Talisman when going out, these are really of no use.
The remaining two bursts of good luck were a Lower Grade Magical Treasure, the Thousand Star Soul-Protecting Crown.
This Magical Treasure is quite useful to him.
The Thousand Star Soul-Protecting Crown serves as armor for the Divine Soul. Wearing this Magical Treasure offers soul protection with Star Power, able to fend off Secret Techniques under the Saint Tier.
After obtaining the Li Dragon’s Residual Spirit, his Divine Soul Realm reached the Daoist Palace First Layer.
However, since his overall Realm hasn’t reached the Daoist Palace, and he’s never learned any Divine Soul Secret Techniques at the Daoist Palace Level, his Divine Soul defensive ability is quite weak.
During the previous battle, he was sent into a dream by the word ’dream’ from the two Saint Heirs, which was the reason.
Although that word did allow him to die once as he wished, just imagine if what the opponent said was ’kneel’ or ’crawl’ back then...
Even resurrection wouldn’t restore his lifetime of reputation.
This Treasure Crown is indeed very important, and he couldn’t wait to wear it.
The other one is the complete set of the Innate Thunder and Fire Treasure Array, including the Array Map, Array Hub, and other components.
This thing can be used as the Sect Protection Array for the Feixian Sect.
Before this, the Sect didn’t have any defense, relying solely on the Two Big Killers, the Three-Eyed Tiger, and Ah Huang.
Outsiders could come in whenever they wanted, which was quite embarrassing.
With this Innate Thunder and Fire Treasure Array, even when not fully activated for killing invaders, it can serve as a deterrent and barrier.
Aside from these few instances of good luck, there are also two Xuanji Map Fragments.
After combining them, the Immortal Map can now accommodate 48 people at one time.
He initially thought the time-flow rate was 1000 times per Fragment, only now does he realize that the effect diminishes progressively.
Currently, there are four Fragments in total, and the time-flow rate can reach a maximum of 3200 times.
Moreover, the internal environment has improved several times over.
Though it still lacks trees, water sources, and Spiritual Qi, the environment is stable, and at least there’s no more lava or poisonous gas.
He also acquired a skill, Level 3 Invisibility.
In non-combat situations, he can enter the void and remain invisible for 30 minutes. Even a Celestial Tier Divine Soul probe cannot detect him. Being attacked or the host causing an excessive Spiritual Power fluctuation will automatically cancel the invisibility. Usable three times a day.
It’s significantly stronger than Level 2 Invisibility; even Celestial Tier cannot detect it. The time has extended from 10 minutes to 30 minutes, and he can go invisible three times a day.
Brother really doesn’t want to be an assassin.
However, the ability to show off under an Immortal’s nose is quite nice.
Additionally, he automatically learned a Daoist Palace Realm Burning Void Secret Manual, a fire-element Martial Technique, and directly Great Perfection.
And a Cultivation Technique, the Great Yi Profound Dragon Technique, which far surpasses the previous one from the Duanmu Family.
However, he has yet to extract it.
The reason is simple; the system provides him the insights corresponding to his current Realm if he extracts the Cultivation Technique.
The Great Yi Profound Dragon Technique has eight layers in total, with the Celestial Fate Realm corresponding to the Sixth Layer.
In his current Celestial Fate Ninth Layer Realm, extraction would automatically provide all insights from the Sixth Layer.
Rather than that, it’s better to wait until reaching the Daoist Palace Realm to extract it, so he can get all the insights from the Seventh Layer.
What about the Ninth Layer representing the Ascending to Saint Realm?
Does Brother Cheng strike you as someone with the patience to wait?
As for the rest, they are mostly Heavenly and Earthly Treasures and Pills.
He received 5 Pills that enhance Divine Soul Realm, 8 for Spiritual Power Realm, and 4 Healing Treasure Pills.
This lottery result left him speechless.
If someone else obtained all these Cultivation Techniques, Martial Techniques, Treasures, and Pills...
It would be enough to defy fate.
But he only sighed, feeling that the third-level lottery was truly weak now.
Looking at the remaining 11,637,893 points, he gritted his teeth and decided to attempt a Tier Four Lottery ten-draw.
For a Level 4 Lottery, one attempt costs 1 million, and ten draws 10 million.
But now he’s all in, unable to hold back.
Consuming 10 million points for a ten-draw, he kept chanting for a luck burst.
"Congratulations to the host for obtaining 1 wisp of Daoist Celestial Immortal Rhyme!"
"Congratulations to the host for a luck burst, obtaining 1 Divine-grade Witch Seed!"
"Congratulations to the host for obtaining 1 Xuanji Map Fragment!"
"Congratulations to the host for obtaining 1 Celestial Secret Soul Reviving Pill!"
"Congratulations to the host for obtaining a Level 4 Teleportation Skill!"
"Congratulations to the host for obtaining 1 Saint Artifact Fragment!"
"Congratulations to the host for obtaining a Tier Four Alchemy Technique!"
"Congratulations to the host for a luck burst, obtaining a Poison Heroic Soul!"
"Congratulations to the host for obtaining 1 Void Purple Gold Holy Pill!"
"Congratulations to the host for obtaining 1 Nine Orifice Soul Revival Pill!"
Tier Four Lottery is truly distinctive; even Daoist Celestial Immortal Rhyme doesn’t count as a luck burst.
Almost everything in there is useful to him.
Another Xuanji Map Fragment acquired, after synthesis, can now accommodate 81 people, and the time-flow rate has increased to 3600 times.
He finally obtained the Daoist Celestial Immortal Rhyme, which can elevate his other Martial Dao river to the Immortal Tier.
The Celestial Secret Soul Reviving Pill and the Void Purple Gold Holy Pill are both to increase Divine Soul Cultivation.
The Nine Orifice Soul Revival Pill and is not for increasing cultivation but for repairing the Residual Soul, just right for Mo Chen, the down-and-out Immortal.
It’s also a gesture to win people over for Brother Cheng.
Tier Four Lottery is indeed extraordinary; even the Daoist Celestial Immortal Rhyme isn’t an instance of a luck burst.
The Divine-grade Witch Seed and Poison Heroic Soul were unfamiliar to him.
After taking a closer look at the descriptions, he finally understood them.
This level of talent means that if Witchcraft textbooks were laid before him, almost no cultivator would be able to comprehend them.
This talent level, they would stand as the future hope of the entire tribe.
As for the Poison Heroic Soul, while it grants enhancement in combat power and some defense like the War Heroic Soul he once got from decimating the Red Sun Sect, he realized that both had similar effects.
The only difference was that War Heroic Soul increased combat power and some defense, while Poison Heroic Soul dealt with toxicity.

chapters.title: Chapter 115: Finally Becoming a Daoist Palace
chapters.content:
Chapter 115: Chapter 115: Finally Becoming a Daoist Palace
After activating this Poison Heroic Soul, you possess it permanently.
In future battles, if you invoke this Heroic Soul, each attack will carry an additional 30% poison damage, and attack power will increase by 10% as well.
This poison damage is not ordinary poison from the Mortal World.
Instead, it directly applies poison to the enemy’s Spiritual Power, Sword Aura, and Daoist Palace, even afflicting their Divine Soul attacks. Once affected, it directly damages their foundation, with effects varying based on the opponent’s power.
That wisp of Daoist Celestial Immortal Rhyme, he ultimately used it on the Nine Palaces River.
Because the Nine Palaces is a combination of Martial Dao and other categories, such as the application of Array Rune Witchcraft Poison Technique and other techniques in Martial Dao, all fall within the Nine Palaces’ scope.
Once the Daoist Celestial Immortal Rhyme took effect, the originally True Level Nine Palaces River underwent significant changes.
Nine River Martial Dao Marks hung down from the sky.
On the green Nine Palaces River, the Martial Dao Inscriptions visibly changed from white to gray, then to silver, and finally turned golden, just like the Five Elements Inscriptions!
The color of the inscriptions became increasingly distinct and brilliant!
Countless mysterious inscription lights shone brightly as if suddenly coming to life.
When the Daoist Celestial Immortal Rhyme completely fused, the Nine Palaces River and the Five Elements River paralleled each other, utterly surpassing the other seven rivers.
The second Immortal Level mark has been established!
In Jiang Cheng’s mind, countless other pathways appeared out of thin air, whether it’s Array Runes, Pills, Artifact Refining, or medicine, divination, astrology, music, chess, calligraphy, painting, witchcraft, and poison...
He did not directly become a master in those fields.
But as long as he understands one of them in the future, he can combine the knowledge of that field with Martial Dao to form powerful techniques.
The Tier Four Alchemy Technique obtained from the lottery made him a Pill Venerable capable of crafting Saint Grade Elixirs, and he had a deep understanding of the Alchemy Dao.
So now, insights combining the Alchemy Dao and Martial Dao spontaneously emerged in his mind, such as Poison Pill, Pill Explosion, Pill-Transformed Sword Essence, Pill Formation Ban...
This insight was profoundly mysterious, even able to inversely promote the improvement of his original Alchemy Dao level.
After all, the great Dao is vast and often complementary, with interconnecting parts.
Just like the last Five Elements enhancement, this time he once again felt a sense of ancientness, as if he had undergone close to a million years of training.
"It’s really amazing!"
He exhaled a long breath, looking at the remaining 163 points, couldn’t help but feel sorrow.
With a swipe on the ring, he took out the two treasures he had previously obtained from the two Saint Heirs.
One flag and one book, he couldn’t use them either.
Originally intended as treasures to anchor the sect, but now without points...
"The sect’s treasure will have to wait for the future, for now, let’s exchange for some points to calm my nerves."
One treasure was worth 5 million points, after exchanging both, he finally had 10 million points again.
"If Lan Ti could pledge her loyalty, how wonderful that would be. I dare bet she’s worth at least 20 million."
But on second thought, it seemed unlikely.
After all, she’s a clan leader and at the Daoist Palace Eighth Layer, how could she agree to such a thing.
"First, let’s upgrade the realm."
The third-level lottery yielded many Treasure Pills, along with some Spirit Pills from before.
Once more, he sat cross-legged and improved through consuming pills.
Having the Divine Soul Realm of the Daoist Palace First Layer early on, the bottleneck barrier ceased to exist, and massive spiritual power burst through directly.
In that instant, the Divine Mansion automatically soared straight into the clouds.
Then, within those clouds began a wondrous transformation.
Magnificent palaces replaced the previous Divine Mansion, radiating light, making the clouds look like an Immortal Realm.
The city folks below stood still, gazing up, completely unaware of what was happening.
"Is this the descent of the Immortal Palace?"
"Could an Immortal have descended?"
Some cultivators flew to the sky to witness up close but simply couldn’t approach.
Under that Daoist Palace, ordinary cultivators lack the ability to soar.
They could only see the vast nine rivers ejecting, descending from the clouds, just like a reverse Star River.
This miraculous scene continued for a quarter hour before stopping.
Until then, Jiang Cheng formally became a Daoist Palace First Layer strong person.
Only then did he extract the Great Yi Profound Dragon Technique Cultivation Technique from before.
Upon reaching the Dao Palace realm, extracting this technique allowed him to attain the Seventh-Layer Realm.
Moreover, it met the Perfection Realm insight.
Instantly, his Daoist Palace foundation became unbelievably solid.
Due to the unique characteristics of the cultivation technique, his spiritual power formed into a dragon roar, grand and magnificent.
When upgrading power, he didn’t hesitate and consumed two Saint Pills that enhanced the Divine Soul Realm.
This privilege was uniquely his.
Saint Pills of this rank aren’t suited for use by Daoist Palace cultivators.
Even in Ascending to Saint Realm, using a Saint Pill once is considered a rare luxurious treat, like celebrating a holiday once every few hundred years.
The medicinal power contained within Saint Pills is terrifying, two pills rapidly expanded his Divine Soul, ceasing only at the Daoist Palace Seventh Layer.
Since the Divine Soul Realm was reached, there was no need to delay.
After his victory in battle, he had scavenged over 60 Treasure Pills, perfectly available for use now.
The spiritual power required for the Dao Palace realm exceeds the Celestial Fate realm by more than tenfold, upgrades can no longer be swift as before.
When Lan Ti hurriedly rushed back, she saw him once again consuming Treasure Pills for upgrading.
He was alone, sitting outside, not seeking a secluded spot nor a protector.
As if he feared no one would harm him.
Moreover, his pill consumption was even more exaggerated than last time.
Grabbing a handful without counting and stuffing into his mouth.
You think these are candies? Are you mad?
She was beyond words now.
Now she merely felt that anything happening around this guy was quite normal.
After all Treasure Pills were used, Jiang Cheng leveled up twice, reaching Daoist Palace Third Layer.
Although there were still many low-tier Spirit Pills, their potency was insignificant to him, not worth wasting.
"Have you finished upgrading?"
Lan Ti tried to make her tone more neutral.
Darn, when this guy arrived he was only Celestial Fate Fourth Layer, and now, right under her nose, he became Daoist Palace Third Layer.
How many days have passed?
Thinking of herself, thanks to the Witch Division’s inheritance and several heaven-defying opportunities and encounters, combined with her diligent cultivation and superb talent, she barely reached the Daoist Palace Eighth Layer.
Without sect nurturing, that was already a miracle.
Yet this guy seemed on the verge of surpassing her at any moment now.
Can people even live anymore?
"Finished upgrading."
Brother Cheng noticed she was alone, appearing a bit puzzled.
"Where’s Ningti?"
"Did you kill her?"
Lan Ti shook her head.
"You doubt me?"
Blue Yi wasn’t offended, just coolly said, "We were together for three years, and there was a time I even thought of her as my disciple. Much of what she learned I was the one who taught her. But she was always thinking only about making my death as embarrassing as possible."
Jiang Cheng looked speechless. "Blame you? Who would!"

chapters.title: Chapter 116: Void Immortal Realm
chapters.content:
Chapter 116: Chapter 116: Void Immortal Realm
"So you released Ningti?"
"No way, brother... uh sister, since she hates us so much, from our standpoint, that’s like letting a tiger back into the mountains!"
Lan Ti rolled her eyes at him, "Do you think I’m that stupid?"
"Then she..."
"I have my own plans. Keeping her is because only the Xiang family’s lineage can fully unleash the power of faith from the Four-direction Primordial Cauldron."
"When the time comes, she will naturally appear."
Jiang Cheng didn’t need to think to know that Ningti was once again under her control, and this time, it’s probably going to be difficult for her to turn things around.
"You got the Four-direction Primordial Cauldron, right?"
"Could you give it to me?"
Lan Ti wasn’t coy and directly stated her need.
Just now, that battle was eventually resolved by Jiang Cheng relying solely on his system hack.
But on the other hand, before he activated the hack, it was Lan Ti who led the way, which shouldn’t be denied.
No matter what, at that moment, they were teammates.
Brother Cheng didn’t mind giving her the cauldron he couldn’t use.
He just wanted to try harder.
"Are you really unwilling to become mine?"
"I’m so handsome, the Feixian Sect is picturesque, and people there are incredibly enthusiastic. Plus, the sect has great benefits, giving out bonuses periodically. You wouldn’t be at a loss..."
Lan Ti listened, frowning, filtering out those self-praising words.
What on earth is this guy trying to do?
Again with the ’become his woman’ thing?
Although currently, his realm is a few layers lower, with his talent and looks, he really wouldn’t be unworthy of me.
If we get married, it would also bring a super ally to the Witch Division, right?
Anyway, I don’t have anyone I like, so agreeing to him seems no harm.
But remembering last time she agreed only to be scolded, this time she was more cautious.
"Are you serious?"
Wow, there’s a chance!
Brother Cheng immediately straightened his face and said solemnly, "I’ve never been this serious!"
To win over Lan Ti, he could keep his attitude proper for an entire day and night.
"Are you kidding?"
"How could such a thing be a joke?"
"Hmph, who knows if you’re sincere. We’ve only met a few times and you’re saying such things, what exactly do you see in me?"
I see your talent and power.
That’s very valuable, okay?
Of course, he couldn’t say it like that.
Jiang Cheng skillfully used the formula, "I admire everything about you, whether it’s your beauty, strength, personality, or character. To me, all your strengths and flaws are precious."
This guy is this cheesy when confessing?
Lan Ti almost got goosebumps, but had to admit, the words were quite flattering.
"Alright, I agree."
Brother Cheng was first overjoyed, then his smile gradually faded.
The system still didn’t ding...
Without system recognition, it means she’s still not his.
But this woman doesn’t seem to be lying, with her expression, her eyes, her tone, they all look so genuine.
Unexpectedly, she acts so well, Jiang Cheng was genuinely a bit hurt this time.
I had such high hopes for you.
Since coming to this world, I haven’t put so much effort into recruiting anyone, only to be deceived twice.
He sighed, pulled out the Treasure Cauldron, and tossed it to her.
"Here, take it."
Forget it, no need to force it anymore.
Lan Ti quickly reached out to catch it.
In her perspective, Jiang Cheng giving her the cauldron was a response to her agreement to marry.
This cauldron was like an engagement token, making her feel a bit shy.
"Aren’t you going to ask what I actually want to use this cauldron for?"
Initially, she would have left with the cauldron, but now she saw Jiang Cheng as her fiancé, so they were like family now.
Her mindset naturally changed.
Jiang Cheng was indeed curious but felt a bit disinterested at the moment.
He casually responded, "Oh, what for?"
"To! Enter! The! Immortal! Realm!"
Lan Ti enunciated each word, staring intently at his face.
"What? Immortal Realm?"
Jiang Cheng, who was feeling down, was indeed stirred by these four words.
"Entering the Immortal Realm, isn’t it said that only upon reaching the peak of the Saint Tier can one ascend?"
"Relying solely on this Four-direction Primordial Cauldron, can one become an immortal?"
"Are you joking?"
Lan Ti shook her head.
"Becoming immortal through ascension was in the past."
"For the past million years, no Saint Tier from the lower realm has successfully ascended."
"No matter how monstrous their talent, no matter how powerful the sects behind them, they couldn’t become immortal."
Brother Cheng was baffled. He always thought that ascending to immortality would be a natural, even effortless, thing for him in the future.
With the Celestial Desolation Indestructible Body and the system’s protection, if that’s not becoming immortal, then there’s a ghost!
Now it seems, what was supposed to be a sure thing isn’t so certain!
"Why?"
In a low mood, Lan Ti replied, "Because of the appearance of the Void Immortal Realm."
"What’s the Void Immortal Realm?"
"The Void Immortal Realm is where our Immortal Remnant Race’s nine Immortal Ancestors first appeared. They fell from the Immortal Realm to the Void Immortal Realm and then came to the lower realm."
"So you’re saying the Void Immortal Realm appeared at that time?"
"Exactly."
Lan Ti nodded and continued, "A million years ago, the Void Immortal Realm suddenly stretched between the Immortal Domain and the lower realm, disrupting the original rules of the world and blocking the path of ascension."
"Did you know that in ancient times it wasn’t hard for a Daoist Palace to ascend to the Saint Realm? But now, when crossing this hurdle, there’s a Thunder Tribulation. And each layer of ascending to the Saint Realm comes with a Thunder Tribulation, which is a result of the changes in the rules of the world."
"Conversely, the Thunder Tribulation once encountered by Saint Tiers ascending to immortality in ancient times has now disappeared..."
Jiang Cheng was a bit confused, "Isn’t the absence of Thunder Tribulation a good thing?"
He knew that some cultivators couldn’t get past the Thunder Tribulation, ultimately getting struck dead.
All their Daoist practice, gone up in smoke.
Lan Ti looked at him twice, puzzled.
"Sometimes I really doubt if you’re a cultivation newbie."
"The Thunder Tribulation is indeed terrifying, but without its baptism, Saint Tiers cannot continue to break through and are confined to the lower realm."
Jiang Cheng suddenly realized.
"But didn’t the nine immortals of your Immortal Remnant Race successfully return to the Immortal Domain? That means there are exceptions."
"They were immortals to begin with, with power far beyond the limits of the lower realm plane. Even if they didn’t want to return to the Immortal Domain, the rules of the world would force them back."
"I see."
Jiang Cheng then asked, "So how do you know from the Void Immortal Realm you can enter the Immortal Domain? Has anyone entered these past millions of years?"
"No, the Void Immortal Realm is not so easily entered. But because the nine Immortal Ancestors came from there, we speculate there’s a passage connecting to the Immortal Domain."
"So it’s just speculation..."
"But it’s a hope of becoming immortal, so even a sliver of hope is worth a try."
Jiang Cheng had to admit, she made a good point.
But then he was curious again.
"Since the Void Immortal Realm has existed for millions of years, surely many have tried, right?"
"How come it’s still not certain if one could succeed?"
Lan Ti shook her head.
"No."
"It’s not easy to enter the Void Immortal Realm."

chapters.title: Chapter 117: Quota for Entering the Immortal Realm
chapters.content:
Chapter 117: Chapter 117: Quota for Entering the Immortal Realm
This response surprised Jiang Cheng.
"Is it hard to enter the Void Immortal Realm?"
"It’s not that it’s hard to enter, it’s that it’s impossible to find."
Lan Ti sighed, "The Void Immortal Realm is hidden within the void, its location constantly shifting, and even if found, specific magical treasures are needed to open the entrance."
"What kind of magical treasure? Could it be the Four-direction Primordial Cauldron?"
Lan Ti looked speechless.
"How could it be? If the Four-direction Primordial Cauldron were that powerful, it would have been taken by other sacred lands hundreds of years ago—it wouldn’t have come to us."
She continued, "To find the Void Immortal Realm, you need to gather the nine inheritance treasures of the Nine Tribes of the Immortal Remnant Race."
"And to open the entrance to the Void Immortal Realm, those nine treasures must also work together."
Jiang Cheng immediately understood: "Those nine magical treasures were left by the nine immortals who descended back then?"
"Exactly."
Lan Ti nodded.
"Before they left, each left behind an inheritance treasure, and the Bone Refining Banner of my Witch Division is one of them."
Jiang Cheng asked with interest, "What grade is this treasure?"
Lan Ti proudly said, "The Bone Refining Banner is a top-grade magical treasure that can forcibly plant a curse seal on an enemy across a great realm. If I could wield it, I would fear nothing even in the Ascending to Saint Realm!"
Although Jiang Cheng didn’t quite understand witchcraft, he knew what it meant to surpass a great realm.
Top-grade magical treasures are, indeed, different.
"Aren’t you the clan leader? You’re the highest in the Witch Division. Isn’t the Bone Refining Banner in your possession?"
Mentioning this, Lan Ti immediately became downcast.
"Three million years ago, the then clan leader of the Witch Division was swayed by outsiders, tricking the Bone Refining Banner away, and it has never been reclaimed since."
Acts of murder and treasure-snatching happen every day in the cultivation realm, leaving Jiang Cheng at a loss for words.
"My condolences."
My condolences, you say? Is that how you speak? Lan Ti, who was initially a bit sad, almost collapsed because of him.
"Without the Bone Refining Banner, our Witch Division lost not only a powerful weapon but also had its inheritance incomplete, causing our decline."
"So you keep mentioning the Three-Eyed Tiger, hoping it would help you reclaim the Bone Refining Banner?"
"No, the thief who took the Bone Refining Banner is now a Saint Tier existence..."
Lan Ti regretfully shook her head, "Senior Demon King, having crossed domains, is already suppressed by the rules and cannot reclaim it."
"I was initially hoping for Senior Three-Eyed Tiger to help me acquire the Four-direction Primordial Cauldron."
"Luckily, it’s already been obtained."
Jiang Cheng curiously said, "What use is the Four-direction Primordial Cauldron?"
Listening to her, it seemed the Four-direction Primordial Cauldron was of a lower tier and unrelated to the Void Immortal Realm.
"After the nine immortals ascended back, the Nine Tribes of the Immortal Remnant Race once jointly opened the Void Immortal Realm and entered it."
"And then? Did they ascend?"
"No, a lot of tribal members died during that entry."
Jiang Cheng was startled, "Was there an enemy inside?"
"No, it’s just that the Void Immortal Realm is between the Immortal Realm and the Lower Realm, with very unstable space and disordered rules. Without the protection of the nine great magical treasures, none might have survived."
Lan Ti added, "They only entered that once. After the departure of the nine immortal ancestors, the tribal members gradually developed conflicts, leading to different fates and never cooperating to open it again."
Jiang Cheng finally understood completely.
"You want the Four-direction Primordial Cauldron to rely on the power of faith inside it to protect you when entering the Void Immortal Realm?"
"Yes, the Four-direction Primordial Cauldron, with its bestowed fortune, can offset most of the erosion from the power of rules."
Now that she has obtained this Treasure Cauldron, her goal is fulfilled.
The next step is to wait for the Void Immortal Realm to open and then enter it.
"But didn’t you say the Bone Refining Banner was taken? How can the Immortal Remnant Race gather all nine magical treasures to open the Void Immortal Realm?"
According to her, without gathering the nine magical treasures, the Void Immortal Realm cannot even be located.
Mentioning this, Lan Ti coldly said, "The thief who took the Bone Refining Banner knows this secret. He has been secretly contacting the other eight tribes over the years, and they’ve already agreed."
"Counting the days, there’s less than a year left until they open the entrance."
Jiang Cheng wanted to say, if that person stole the treasure from your Witch Division, he should be an enemy, so how could the other tribes cooperate with him?
But then again, it’s an opportunity to become an immortal.
Without the Bone Refining Banner, the other eight tribes of the Immortal Remnant Race with their eight magical treasures are useless.
And without those eight magical treasures, holding the Bone Refining Banner is also useless.
People on both sides might have been stuck in the Saint Tier for millions of years, ultimately having no choice but to cooperate.
"You’re still in the Daoist Palace Realm, far from the Saint Tier. Even if you can enter the Immortal Realm, wouldn’t you still be at the bottom?"
"The Immortal Realm isn’t all immortals; those immortals have descendants. If they can survive, so can I!"
Lan Ti’s eyes were resolute.
In any case, cultivating in the Immortal Realm is certainly much better than in the Lower Realm.
"You tell me these things, are you inviting me to enter together?"
"Yes, this chance might be lost forever if missed. The Four-direction Primordial Cauldron is ultimately just a lower-grade magical treasure and can only protect three people at most. The power of fortune inside the Treasure Cauldron needs Ningti to activate, so there’s one spot left."
She smiled, "You can ascend with us."
Jiang Cheng couldn’t understand this girl.
She doesn’t want to be one of ’her own,’ but seems to treat him quite well.
If this third spot were offered to the public, many would go crazy for it, agreeing to any condition. And yet, she’s giving it to him?
Actually, Jiang Cheng might not need magical treasure protection to enter the Void Immortal Realm.
If worst comes to worst, he can die once after entering, and let the system solve the rest.
But he could still feel Lan Ti’s good intentions.
"So what are your plans next?"
He didn’t immediately decline her goodwill.
"I’ll go back to the Witch Division first, what about you?"
"I also need to return to the Feixian Sect; you know I’m the sect leader, and there are many things to handle."
"Alright, there’s still quite some time until the opening day; I’ll come find you then."
Watching her gradually disappearing figure, Jiang Cheng turned around.
Activating the transmission, with a flash, he appeared directly at the Feixian Sect.
Level 4 teleportation is unbelievably convenient.
"Sect Leader!"
"The Sect Leader is back!"
"He didn’t return with that Princess Ningti, did he?"
The disciples happily flew over.
Jiang Cheng noticed how much their realms had changed in just a few days.
All the Second Generation Elders had advanced to the Soul Splitting Realm.
All the Third Generation Disciples had reached the Gathering Yuan Realm.
Lin Ning had reached the Spirit Platform Eighth Layer, while Ji Linghan had broken through the bottleneck of the Celestial Fate Realm, reaching the First Layer.
Checking the system records, it was evident that they earned advancement points during this time.
Especially Ji Linghan, who gave 300,000 points upon breaking through.
Even with the support of the Feixian Sect’s Level 5 Spirit Vein and an abundance of pills and spirit stones, their progress was still a miracle.
Cultivation with only spiritual power and no realm comprehension would only be stagnant.
He glanced at Elder Mo Chen, who was smiling while stroking his smooth beard, realizing it was undoubtedly his doing.
Having an immortal guide a group of low-tier cultivators in the lower realm is truly a luxury."

chapters.title: Chapter 118: The Grateful and Tearful Mo Chen
chapters.content:
Chapter 118: Chapter 118: The Grateful and Tearful Mo Chen
It’s true that having an elder at home is like having a treasure, this Immortal Mo is quite handy.
Brother Cheng was overjoyed and thought of that sacred elixir.
"Elder Mo, I have seen your efforts with my own eyes and remembered them in my heart."
"Take this pill and see if it can be of use to you."
Mo Chen took the pill, sensed it carefully, and nearly jumped up.
"This, this is the Nine Orifice Soul Revival Pill!"
"It’s extremely useful for me!"
"As long as I refine this pill, my residual soul can stabilize, and I can restore part of my power."
He held the pill with reverence, overjoyed to the point of being tongue-tied.
"This, this, this, I wonder where the sect leader acquired it from."
Indeed, he had been hoping that Jiang Cheng could help him find a saint-grade elixir to restore his divine soul, but it was just a wishful thought.
This level of elixir is quite common in the Immortal Realm, but extremely rare in the Lower Realm.
Even a Saint Tier expert cannot simply obtain it at will.
Because he regarded Jiang Cheng as the "Child of the Plane," he had a little hope.
But honestly, he didn’t expect it to be this quick.
Even with boundless fortune and immense luck, it would usually take years or decades of gradual effort to touch upon treasures of this level, wouldn’t it?
Who would have thought it would return in just a few days?
With this in mind, even among the Children of the Plane, the sect leader belongs to the top-tier fortune holders!
With such a good opportunity, Brother Cheng naturally wanted to claim credit and enhance the effect of showing off.
"To be honest, the process of obtaining this pill was fraught with twists and dangers, and I won’t go into details."
"In any case, I went through countless hardships for it, almost losing my life."
"However, thinking of Elder Mo’s predicament, how could this sect leader retreat and give up? In the end, I managed to fulfill my mission..."
Though this pill was just one of the results of a lucky draw ten times over, even pressing the draw button counts as an effort, right?
He thought this as a matter of course.
"Sect Leader..."
As an immortal who has lived for millions of years, Mo Chen felt more touched in this lifetime than ever before.
How generous and admirable is this.
Which of those Children of the Plane isn’t extremely self-centered, after all, people are naturally selfish.
For someone to do this much for his subordinates is virtually unheard of.
He truly found the right person to follow.
"A man would die for a bosom friend!"
"How can this old man repay such kindness..."
The depth of this emotion made Brother Cheng blush slightly, pondering if he might have exaggerated too much.
"Elder Mo, you’re too kind."
"This is what a sect leader should do."
At this moment, other disciples gathered around, each wearing a cheeky grin.
"Sect Leader, you returned so quickly this time!"
"Yeah, we were all prepared for your long absence."
Jiang Cheng deliberately put on a stern face: "What, you don’t want to see me?"
"How could that be? We miss the sect leader day and night."
"Without the sect leader here, I couldn’t eat or sleep..."
Elder Gan Ziyi followed into the main hall with a smile: "But this time is different, the Qianxing Dynasty is so far away, and it was Princess Ningti’s invitation. Everyone thought you would stay there for a few months or even years."
Jiang Cheng appeared puzzled.
"I was just taking a look around, why stay so long? I’m not settling down there."
Qin Chang squeezed through the others to stay closest to Brother Cheng.
"Because it’s Princess Ningti, the stunningly beautiful royal princess. It wouldn’t be surprising if the sect leader got lost in her tenderness."
Gan Ziyi chimed in: "Exactly, everyone even placed bets on how long it would take for you to return."
Jiang Cheng stopped in his tracks.
He surveyed everyone with a dignified expression.
"Nonsense!"
"This sect leader is a person who achieves great things, how could I be swayed by mere beauty?"
The second-generation elders silently mocked themselves, thinking wasn’t it you who suggested lowering standards to recruit some beauties during the last recruitment?
However, everyone naturally refrained from interrupting Brother Cheng’s moment of showing off.
The many female disciples present also breathed a sigh of relief.
It seemed that the sect leader’s virtuous self was still intact.
Yin Xuer even scolded the others: "Junior Brother Gan and Junior Brother Qin, don’t you know what kind of person the sect leader is? Stop gossiping behind his back in the future!"
The two of them immediately looked constipated.
Weren’t you the one who gathered us for a meeting yesterday afternoon to discuss whether the sect leader really fell for Ningti?
"Alright, alright, this time while I was away, you all worked hard on your cultivation and made great progress."
"This sect leader is very pleased."
"As mentioned before, there will be rewards for those with exceptional performance."
As soon as the word "rewards" was mentioned, everyone craned their necks in anticipation.
Anything the sect leader gives must be top-notch, maybe even another Level Eight Spiritual Artifact.
"Tang Ru, you are the second third-generation disciple to advance to the Soul Splitting Realm, just after Lin Ning, so you deserve a reward!"
"I hereby bestow upon you this Purple Sun Mad Dragon Saber. Continue to strive hard in the future."
As he spoke, he brushed his ring, and an imposing spiritual blade floated out.
Though its appearance was too fierce and didn’t quite match Tang Ru’s temperament,
its grade was undeniably high.
Excitedly receiving it, Tang Ru probed it and nearly dropped the saber in shock.
"This, Sect Leader, what tier is this spiritual blade?"
Usually mild-mannered, she was now speaking a bit awkwardly.
Brother Cheng nonchalantly flipped his lips: "Just Tier Nine."
He truly had the qualification to say this now.
After all, having acquired several Treasures, Spiritual Artifacts really seemed trivial to him.
Taking it out to show off a bit, enjoying the astonished looks, and incidentally boosting their motivation to cultivate was well worth it.
"What?"
"Tier Nine!"
Everyone present nearly went crazy.
It was known that Eldest Prince Xiang Ba of the Celestial Fate Ninth Layer was still using a Tier Eight Spiritual Artifact.
Now suddenly gifting a Tier Nine Spiritual Artifact to a mere Soul Splitting Realm junior disciple was truly extravagant.
"This is too precious, I, I..."
Tang Ru really wanted to say she didn’t dare accept it, but her hands were more truthful than her little mouth, and she didn’t let go.
With this saber, she could be invincible in the Soul Splitting Realm phase.
What cultivator could resist the temptation of a skyrocketing combat power?
Everyone else’s eyes turned green with envy.
"Sect Leader, Sect Leader, my progress is also very fast!"
"I train 13 hours every day, please see the truth..."
"Get lost, there are only 12 hours in a day, Sect Leader, look at me!"
"Did the sect leader strike a treasure trove? How can he casually bring out such treasures?"
"Have you forgotten the sect leader is an Immortal?"
The only one who remained relatively calm was Mo Chen, for he had seen many Sacred Artifacts in the Immortal Realm.
A Tier Nine Spiritual Artifact in the Lower Realm was indeed rare, but who let the sect leader be the "Child of the Plane"?
He now found nothing Jiang Cheng brought out surprising anymore.
"Wait, why do Purple Sun Mad Dragon Saber, why do I seem to have heard of it somewhere?" Luo Yuan suddenly frowned in thought.
Yin Xuer also agreed: "I was just about to say, this name sounds familiar to me too..."
Shan Tai slapped his thigh: "I remembered, isn’t this His Majesty the Emperor Qianxing’s personal weapon?"
With his remark, everyone recalled.
After all, before they entered, in the Mortal World, they had all been in awe of the Qianxing Royal Race.

chapters.title: Chapter 119: The Gap in Talent
chapters.content:
Chapter 119: Chapter 119: The Gap in Talent
To consolidate the Dynasty and enhance the public’s reverence for the royal family, Xiang Gaoye has done quite a lot of propaganda.
How mighty and grand the Emperor is, what Spiritual Artifacts he uses, his past war achievements and merits—all of these still circulate among the people.
The Purple Sun Mad Dragon Saber is one of the iconic Spiritual Artifacts.
Legend has it that the Emperor wielded this saber to harness the power of the stars and blazing sun, annihilating tens of thousands of enemy troops with one strike...
Everyone suddenly fell silent, collectively looking toward Sect Leader Jiang.
How did this saber end up in your hands?
Brother, did you also destroy the Qianxing Dynasty?
No way?
Can’t be, right?
The Qianxing Dynasty is so big and so far away...
But considering this guy’s past style of wiping out sects whenever he left home, it seems quite possible.
"That’s right, the Qianxing Dynasty needs a change of surname."
Such a big opportunity to show off, Brother Cheng wouldn’t deny it, of course.
"As for what the new surname will be, I don’t know."
Without the Xiang Royal Race, the Li Royal Race and Zhang Royal Race will eventually appear in this vast region, sooner or later a new ruler will emerge.
As for Jiang Cheng himself, he has no interest in ruling the Mortal World.
Isn’t ascending to Immortality enticing?
"What?"
"It’s actually true?"
"This is insane, who would have thought a dynasty with millions of years of heritage would change its reign..."
"This is too aggressive, destroyed just like that?"
"Sect Leader, do you have a grudge with the Xiang clan?"
When in the Mortal World, they admired the royal family very much.
But now having become Outer World Cultivators, they don’t care, just shocked and amazed at how sudden it is.
"No grudge."
Jiang Cheng shrugged: "They’re courting death, I couldn’t help it and just did a little bit of insignificant work."
Though he deliberately downplayed it, creating a contrasting effect to show off, it wasn’t a lie either.
Before going to Longyue Imperial City, he did plan to score some Points.
But if Xiang Gaoye and Ningti, along with the seven Great Experts and the two Saint Heirs, had completely left him alone without any contact, perhaps he wouldn’t have done anything at all.
After all, he wasn’t there for revenge.
Top Flattery King Shan Tai immediately jumped out.
"Look, just some minor, insignificant work, Sect Leader has a remarkable aura!"
Others, unwilling to lag behind, vied to be advanced, aspiring to soon become Brother Cheng’s top confidants.
Luo Yuan took out a notebook and wrote frantically: "I’ve already noted it down, will certainly learn Sect Leader’s grand style in the future. Learning even just ten percent of its essence would be endlessly beneficial..."
"To the Sect Leader, this is just a minor scene, a trivial matter, everyone stay calm!"
Gan Ziyi smiled and waved at the crowd: "Basic operations, sit down, sit down!"
The scene was harmonious, with everyone being quite proactive, which made Brother Cheng very gratified about their growth.
He recalled that after the system upgrade this time, he could now enhance his disciples’ Talents.
He first scanned Ji Linghan.
Target: Ji Linghan.
Talent: Third-class.
Upgradable to: Second-class.
The system was exceedingly concise, didn’t even note what type of Talent she had, just categorized it by tier.
Given Ji Linghan’s great Talent, it was a surprise she was only Third-class.
Jiang Cheng was a bit surprised, then was stunned by the string of zeros.
Points cost: 120,000,000
To upgrade Ji Linghan’s Talent would actually cost 1.2 billion Points!
It’s absolutely nuts.
He then scanned Lin Ning.
Target: Lin Ning.
Talent: Third-class.
Upgradable to: Second-class.
Points cost: 190,000,000
1.9 billion, another amount he couldn’t afford.
He found it odd, isn’t Lin Ning supposed to be more valuable than Ji Linghan?
How is she also Third-class?
And both upgrade to Second-class, yet she’s more expensive.
Seems like the result differs for each person’s upgrade afterward.
Ji Linghan’s upgrade was to a Seven-Aperture Exquisite Body, while Lin Ning’s was to a Hidden Phoenix Bloodline, if both were upgraded, their corresponding projects would certainly be enhanced.
These two geniuses had to be temporarily abandoned.
He then scanned Yin Xuer.
Target: Yin Xuer.
Talent: Sixth-class.
Upgradable to: Fifth-class.
Points cost: 800
Just this small amount, so cheap?
Brother Cheng, who was taken aback by the huge Points cost earlier, doubted his own eyes now.
Is the cost that much lower for decreasing by three classes?
That was worth considering.
He then swept through Luo Yuan, Shan Tai, and the other disciples.
Discovered most of these people were also Sixth-class, with varying Points requirements for upgrade, but all under 2000 Points.
Among the disciples, Tang Ru and Lu Fan of the Third Generation reached Fifth-class.
These two needed 30,000 and 20,000 Points respectively to upgrade to Fourth-class.
For a millionaire like Sect Leader Jiang, this was still manageable.
Finally, he looked at Mo Chen, the Immortal.
The result surprised him greatly.
Target: Mo Chen.
Talent: Fourth-class.
Upgradable to: Third-class.
Points cost: 1,880,000
This guy, an Immortal, only had Fourth-class Talent?
So, Fourth-class could ascend to Immortality?
Then, genius cultivators with Third-class Talent like Lin Ning and Ji Linghan, how far could they cultivate, becoming geniuses in the Immortal Realm?
He suddenly realized that good Talent and high achievement were two different things.
The Cultivation Realm is indeed treacherous, especially over the long years, with all sorts of unexpected events possible.
No matter how good the Talent, it’s no match for longevity.
More than half of those peerless talents likely fell halfway.
And among those remaining, some like Ji Linghan simply joined the former Feixian Sect.
Not even the subsequent Cultivation Technique to reach Celestial Fate Realm, let alone High-tier Spiritual Vein Elixirs and Spirit Stones resources.
A significant number were buried that way.
What’s more, with the Lower Realm unable to ascend currently, everyone’s path is entirely blocked.
With Ji Linghan and Lin Ning’s prices too high, reluctantly had to give up on them for now.
As for the other disciples, they could all be upgraded once.
Anyway, it wouldn’t spend many Points.
The feedback brought in return, however, increased tenfold over.
This skill had a cooldown of just one day, give him a few months, he could elevate all these seventy or so people to Fourth-class.
Thinking of this, he smiled and beckoned.
"Luo Yuan, come here."
"Huh? Sect Leader, you need me for something?"
Luo Yuan dashed over happily, everyone else was insanely jealous, some secretly wished he’d trip and fall flat on his face.
No help for it, whenever Brother Cheng picked someone, it was always for something good.
This guy would also be rewarded, wouldn’t he? Why him?
"Your dedication to learning just now is commendable, this Sect Leader has decided to give you a buff."
Although he didn’t understand what a buff was, Luo Yuan was still ecstatic.
Nearby, Gan Ziyi, Wei Miao, and others crowded over immediately.
"Sect Leader, I was also very studious just now!"
"And me too, I’ll go home and engrave the Sect Leader’s words on my arm..."
"Damn, that’s intense, isn’t it?"
Jiang Cheng pouted, these guys really thought it was because of memorizing some Sect Leader’s words?
He’s quite vengeful, these guys had all ganged up on him during his transformation last time.
And at that time, Luo Yuan was inside the Xuanji Map, so he didn’t join in.
Just because of this little reason, he became the first one.
"Alright, alright, next time it’ll be your turn."
With that, he pressed the system upgrade button while pretending to pat Luo Yuan on the head.

chapters.title: Chapter 120: A Frenzy of Outdoing Each Other in Mediocrity
chapters.content:
Chapter 120: Chapter 120: A Frenzy of Outdoing Each Other in Mediocrity
After stroking a bit, nothing happened.
He could only stroke again, and the result was still the same.
He didn’t know that the skill to enhance talent didn’t have special effects.
Other disciples were also surprised.
Luo Yuan hasn’t improved his realm, it seems there’s no change at all.
The Sect Leader’s show-off usually works flawlessly, could it have failed this time?
The wise and heroic Sect Leader... it shouldn’t be possible, right?
What kind of expression should everyone make now?
Everyone felt a little awkward.
Shan Tai reacted the fastest, being the first to come forward to save face for Brother Cheng.
"Haha, nothing, the Sect Leader was just joking with everyone."
The others took the hint and similarly tried to save face.
"Yeah, yeah, the Sect Leader was just teasing Senior Brother Luo."
"Look at Senior Brother Luo, he really took it seriously."
However, suddenly, Luo Yuan jumped up.
"I, my root bone seems to have improved!"
As he carefully perceived, he murmured incredulously.
"It’s true, now I can convert at least twice as much spiritual power as before."
"It’s absolutely correct!"
"The Sect Leader just enhanced my talent!"
"Hahaha, I’ve become a real genius!"
He was so excited that he danced around, his face almost twisted from smiling, how many cultivators don’t wish to become geniuses?
But this fact is too rare and unusual.
Facing his excited yet questioning gaze, Brother Cheng nodded.
"That’s right, I used a bit of immortal technique."
"From now on, your cultivation speed will be faster."
He secretly wiped his sweat, thankfully, the system is indeed reliable, didn’t lose face.
Re-testing Luo Yuan, he discovered that his value in the system’s eyes had indeed increased.
Previously, when Luo Yuan’s Spirit Platform Realm increased by a small realm, it was only 500 points, now it’s 2200 points.
Although it’s not like he imagined it to increase tenfold, it’s already quite substantial.
In the future, if he enhances him to fourth-class talent, it might be around seven to eight thousand points.
Then, he can also become a major scorer.
"Thank you Sect Leader, thank you Sect Leader, you worked hard..."
Luo Yuan was extremely excited, his eyes filled with tears.
He was under a lot of pressure.
Before, Feixian Sect had a large number of inner sect and outer sect disciples, and as a true disciple, he was quite outstanding.
Now, the lowest in Feixian Sect is a true disciple, with rising stars like Lin Ning and Tang Ru among the third generation.
Lin Ning has already surpassed him, given time, it’s not surprising if he as an elder gets surpassed by more people.
Thinking of such a shameful scene, how could he not feel anything?
However, talent and aptitude are predestined, and he didn’t have the ability to defy the heavens and change fate.
Now with Jiang Cheng’s enhancement, his talent is no less than Ling Yi from the Eight Clouds Hall back then, how could he not be excited?
Mo Chen was smiling and observing with composure from the side.
As an immortal, he was knowledgeable and recently observing this group of juniors, he remained aloof.
But now he couldn’t remain aloof.
He scanned with his immortal soul, and truly Luo Yuan’s root bone had been changed.
No frills, not an illusion!
"This, Sect Leader, how did you do it?"
He was both shocked and bewildered.
This happened right before his eyes, he couldn’t help but believe it.
"Didn’t I say, immortal technique."
Mo Chen was somewhat confused: "But I’ve never heard of such immortal technique..."
Moreover, you’re not even an immortal.
Jiang Cheng patted his shoulder: "Old Mo, you need to understand the saying ’there’s always someone better’, can you possibly know all immortal techniques?"
Mo Chen opened his mouth, he indeed couldn’t know all immortal techniques.
But the problem is, even in the Immortal Realm, he hasn’t heard of any immortal technique that can change someone’s root bone.
Even those Child of the Plane couldn’t possibly accomplish this for their companions, right?
Unless they acquired some treasure to defy the heavens and change fate, but such opportunities are too rare. Even some prominent figures’ offspring in the Immortal Realm are limited by their talent, ending up as ordinary.
Who could do what Jiang Cheng did, just a wave of a hand to accomplish such a simple task?
It’s too outrageous, right?
Other disciples had long been stunned.
If it was just the enhancement of power, that’s one thing, though they are jealous, at least they could achieve that with hard work eventually.
This talent enhancement, is something that even with the greatest effort cannot be managed.
"Sect Leader’s immortal technique is too amazing, isn’t it?"
"Seems the Sect Leader is many times more powerful than Elder Mo..."
He’s not an immortal, Mo Chen wanted to retort but couldn’t.
"If only my talent could become like Senior Sister Ji’s, how terrifying would that be?"
"Senior Brother Luo is gonna shine now."
"Sect Leader, this... how exactly did you do it?"
Even Yin Xuer reached out: "You’re too partial to Senior Brother Luo, look at me too when you have time."
Even Ji Linghan and Lin Ning couldn’t remain calm.
"Sect Leader, have you forgotten me?"
"Yeah, you’ve never enhanced my realm nor my talent..."
Seeing their pitiful eyes, Brother Cheng was quite helpless.
Your starting prices are too high, I really don’t have that many points.
But for others, perhaps it’s worth considering.
He could only make an excuse to appease them: "This immortal technique of mine has limitations, if your talent is too high, it won’t have any effect."
Shan Tai and Gan Ziyi immediately jumped out.
"Sect Leader, my talent is very low, completely worthless, starving for your aid!"
"Yeah, my talent is the worst in the sect, urgently needing the Sect Leader’s nurturing!"
"Nonsense, I’m the one holding the sect back most, without a doubt!"
"Junior Brother Lu, last time when you listened to Elder Mo’s teachings, you had an epiphany and advanced a small realm on the spot. Your understanding is far better than me, who’s just a fool. What are you fussing about?"
"Nonsense, last time was merely coincidence. Senior Sister Liu, we entered together, yet you are one layer higher in realm, how can you push ahead?"
At this moment, Feixian Sect had become quite a sight.
Everyone was madly competing to be the worst.
In other sects, one would rather paint themselves as geniuses to get the attention and cultivation from the elders.
But now, everyone was trying hard to belittle themselves, wishing they could proclaim themselves as the greatest waste of all time.
Brother Cheng found it both amusing and exasperating.
"Alright, alright, Xiaohan, go and set an order for them, queue up tomorrow, one per day."
Ji Linghan, being a respected senior sister and not among the contenders, could maintain fairness.
As soon as he finished speaking, he immediately got a break.
Over there, Ji Linghan was surrounded tightly.
"Senior Sister Ji, look at me!"
"Senior Sister Ji, think about who in the Sect is closest to you!"
"Sister, I know you definitely won’t forget me, Shan Tai..."
"Master, but I’m your direct disciple..."
While everyone was flattering Ji Linghan, Mo Chen was once again stunned.
Doesn’t this group realize the astonishing meaning behind the Sect Leader’s words?
One per day, everyone gets a share.
This immortal technique can actually be performed daily, and seemingly without any cost, truly defying the heavens!
He deeply felt that the ’Child of the Plane’ is unbelievably terrifying!
Staying with him every day, it seems the common sense learned in the Immortal Realm is about to become outdated.

chapters.title: Chapter 121: Touch My Head
chapters.content:
Chapter 121: Chapter 121: Touch My Head
The next day, as expected, Jiang Cheng promoted Lu Fan, who was ranked first in sequence, right under everyone’s nose.
This raised his talent to fourth-class, putting him on par with Mo Chen, an Immortal.
This left Elder Mo on the verge of tears.
He had a premonition that if this group of people ascended to the Immortal Realm, his transcendent status in front of the Sect Leader would be threatened.
But considering that he was currently the one teaching these people, having the grace of imparting teachings...
It actually didn’t seem too bad.
After refining that Holy Pill, his residual soul became much more consolidated.
His power recovered significantly, though it was still far from his peak state.
Jiang Cheng also used the system to check, and it showed that he had increased from the initial 10,000 points to 150,000.
It seemed that as he recovered some of his state, the system would increase his value.
Over the coming period, the entire Feixian Sect entered a phase of rapidly advancing strength across the board.
Ji Linghan, Lin Ning, Luo Yuan, and others once again entered the Xuanji Map.
Other disciples, before their talents were elevated, remained outside listening to Elder Mo’s teachings.
After their talents were raised, they were also sent into the Xuanji Map by Jiang Cheng.
Mo Chen had become accustomed to it by now.
The Immortal Realm also possessed time-related treasures, but having a hundred-fold speed was considered top-tier, usually only possessed by those Immortal Realm peak experts.
And all these treasures had a characteristic: they required the burning of a large amount of Immortal Crystals to sustain each activation.
A Sect Leader who could accelerate time by thousands of times without any apparent cost simply didn’t exist.
But still, as they say,
the fortune of the Child of the Plane—it’s just basic maneuvers, stay calm...
Over two months later, with all the remaining disciples fully elevated, Jiang Cheng called Luo Yuan out.
This time, he startled even himself, as this kid had already reached the Celestial Fate Second Layer.
But thinking it through, it seemed normal.
Luo Yuan had been in there for about 70 days.
The current time flow rate in the Xuanji Map is 3600 times, equivalent to 690 years inside.
"Sect Leader!"
After not seeing each other for 690 years, Luo Yuan knelt down crying when they met.
"Finally, I see you again..."
"There are quite a few people inside now, aren’t you all bored?"
"Without the Sect Leader, everyone’s life is dull and boring."
Even after 690 years, Luo Yuan’s flattery skill remained intact.
"Alright, alright, I’m not into that."
"This time I called you out to undergo a second evolution."
Currently, it takes 22,000 points to elevate a level in the Celestial Fate Realm for Luo Yuan, but it’s still not enough in Jiang Cheng’s eyes; Ji Linghan can bring in 300,000 after all.
Lin Ning can bring in 500,000 as well.
"Second evolution, what’s that?"
"No need to worry, you’ll find out soon."
With that, he stroked Luo Yuan’s head.
As a result, Luo Yuan’s talent was promoted to fourth-class.
Checking with the system, now each level increase could bring in 75,000 points.
"My constitution has improved again?"
Even Luo Yuan began to doubt life itself.
It all seemed so surreal,
yet the enhanced perception of Spiritual Qi, the increased conversion speed of Spiritual Power, and even the profound understanding of rules—it was undeniable!
"Sect Leader..."
He intended to express his loyalty, to say something heartfelt.
However, Brother Cheng kicked him back into the Xuanji Map before he could finish, urging him to cultivate with his enhanced talent!
Mo Chen, having witnessed the entire process, had his understanding refreshed once more.
Turns out, this enhancement could occur more than once for the same person?
Well, yes, it’s the Child of the Plane...
Understandable, normal.
He had become completely numb by now.
Unexpectedly, the long-unseen Three-Eyed Tiger suddenly jumped out.
"Hey kid, how exactly are you doing this?"
It sidled up to Jiang Cheng, wearing a flattering smile.
"Can you set me up with the same treatment?"
Even though it hadn’t made an appearance recently, it was impossible for the happenings within the Feixian Sect to escape its notice.
At first, when Luo Yuan’s talent was promoted, it could still maintain its pride as a Demon King.
Now, seeing all the disciples elevated, especially with Luo Yuan receiving a second promotion, it couldn’t hold back anymore.
Jiang Cheng scanned it with the system.
Target: Three-Eyed Fierce Tiger.
Talent: Second-class.
Upgrade available: First-class.
Cost in points: 9,500,000,000
Damn, this shameless and audacious Tiger Demon actually had a second-class talent?
Jiang Cheng was a bit shocked.
If not for his own Celestial Desolation Indestructible Body being the best in the Three Realms, he might even feel envious.
This was far superior to Ji Linghan and Lin Ning.
Such excellent talent, yet it’s a pity it never pledged loyalty, thus not considered part of the group.
Otherwise, with its current realm, just the first ’ding’ would probably earn tens of billions of points.
Oh, what a pity indeed.
Little did he know, although the Three-Eyed Tiger was at the bottom among the Twelve Demon Kings of the Celestial Demon Domain, its indulgence in pleasure often rivaled his in cultivation laziness.
If not for its exceptional talent, how could it have reached the Demon King Realm in ten thousand years?
As for the 9.5 billion points required, Jiang Cheng didn’t even bother to complain.
"And you called yourself Master in front of me; go play somewhere else."
