```
In the past, the Three-Eyed Tiger would definitely have retorted.
But this time, it held back.
"Have some mercy, would it not make you look more impressive if your Sect Guardian Spirit Beast were mighty?"
Jiang Cheng chuckled coldly: "You initially agreed to just three years, not to be a permanent Sect Guardian Spirit Beast."
"Just a mere touch on the head, no need for any cost, don’t be so stingy."
Faced with potential benefits, the Three-Eyed Tiger cast aside any semblance of pride.
"Come, come, touch my head." It approached, continuously rubbing against Jiang Cheng’s palm.
"Hehe, if you like, my butt is available too."
On the side, Mo Chen secretly despised it, wasn’t it said that a tiger’s butt couldn’t be touched?
Jiang Cheng was almost amused to death.
That’s a whopping 9.5 billion points, and I don’t even have 95 million right now.
"Who told you there’s no cost? We’ll discuss when you become my Spirit Pet."
With a slap, he sent the pesky old tiger flying.
Seeing that soft tactics weren’t working, the Three-Eyed Tiger got angry.
"Kid, you’re making things difficult, how dare you want a Demon King to be your Spirit Pet, can you handle it?"
Jiang Cheng pouted: "If you’re unwilling, so be it, I’m not forcing you."
That sentence instantly deflated the Three-Eyed Tiger’s temper.
It thought long and hard, realizing it had nothing to threaten this kid with.
And reflecting on it, the previously reluctant Mo Chen now seemed to relish the arrangement every day.
Could it be that I need to learn from him?
As time quietly passed by.
During the following two months, Jiang Cheng gave a second round of enhancement to the remaining disciples.
Finally, all disciples were elevated to fourth-class talent by him.
In the future, as long as they survived, they could all eventually achieve immortality.
Following this phase, Feixian Sect experienced a calm spell.
The Three-Eyed Tiger was nowhere to be seen every day, and Ah Huang mostly slept within the Spirit Vein.
Jiang Cheng remembered his deal with Lan Ti and sought out Mo Chen, the former Immortal.
"I have a question for you, over these thousands of years, has the path to ascension been completely blocked?"

chapters.title: Chapter 122: Ascenders and Native Inhabitants
chapters.content:
Chapter 122: Chapter 122: Ascenders and Native Inhabitants
If ascension is truly impossible, then smuggling from the Void Immortal Realm to the Immortal Domain seems very necessary.
It’s not just for him, but for this group of disciples as well.
"What does the Sect Leader mean by this? I can’t understand."
Mo Chen was puzzled upon hearing this.
Jiang Cheng then explained the information Lan Ti had previously conveyed to him.
Anyway, Mo Chen was undoubtedly one of his own, so it didn’t matter if he told him.
Even so, this genuine Immortal still appeared confused after hearing it.
"Such things exist? I’ve never heard of this!"
"Aren’t you an Immortal? You seem quite ignorant."
Jiang Cheng was disappointed; he had hoped for some constructive opinions from this Immortal.
But it turned out they were both in the dark.
"Sect Leader might not know, I fell during a major war in the Immortal Domain over ten million years ago, and at that time, the Void Immortal Realm probably hadn’t appeared yet."
"After that, I lingered within the Blood Transformation Immortal Blade, unaware of the outside world."
"Alright."
Jiang Cheng sighed, it seemed he could only rely on himself to explore.
Mo Chen pondered for a long time, then suddenly remarked, "If the lower realms truly cannot ascend anymore, it might be great news for many in the Immortal Domain."
"What do you mean?"
"Sect Leader might not know, but the major forces in the Immortal Domain are not very welcoming to ascenders from the lower realms."
"Why?"
"It’s a long story."
Following Mo Chen’s explanation, Jiang Cheng slowly began to understand.
The first Immortals in the Immortal Domain ascended a countless number of epochs ago.
As more ascenders followed, numerous top forces gradually emerged.
Many people have rooted and flourished in the Immortal Domain, forming extensive noble families.
Though the Immortal Domain is vast, like the lower realms, there are power struggles and resource conflicts.
Even if it has abundant resources, that doesn’t change.
Because where there are people, there are comparisons, and there are conflicts.
New ascenders will find out that the best Grotto Heaven Blessed Lands are already taken, and all Heavenly and Earthly Treasures are controlled by major forces.
Even when traveling in the Immortal Domain, they must pay Immortal Crystals as tolls.
One could say that their initial situation is very difficult.
On the other hand, these ascenders are often far superior to most native inhabitants of the Immortal Domain in terms of conditions.
Most people in the Immortal Domain are descendants of early ascenders.
Passed down through generations, their population now accounts for at least ninety percent of the Immortal Domain.
These people have lived in the Immortal Domain since childhood, nurtured by Immortal Spirit Qi, using Immortal Crystals and Immortal Pills, essentially born with a silver spoon.
Even if they fell from grace, procurement of Sacred Artifacts and Holy Pills is not difficult.
According to Mo Chen, even with Luo Yuan’s talent before his enhancement, he would have eventually become an Immortal in the Immortal Domain.
Because their conditions were far too favorable.
There are top-tier geniuses among native inhabitants, but they are ultimately few.
In contrast, ascenders are the other extreme.
Those who manage to ascend are the top prodigies of regions in the lower realms.
Considering they could ascend with lower realm resources, it’s clear how outstanding their talent is.
From the Body Tempering Realm, they faced trials and broke through innumerable hardships, finally standing out among countless cultivators.
Those who could achieve this were undoubtedly tenacious and resilient individuals.
Moreover, they were mostly leading figures in the lower realms, either Sect Leaders or Supreme Elders.
They had sat at high positions for many years, possessing superior perspective, strategy, and ambition.
People like them, thrown anywhere, would eventually accomplish great things.
Though their starting point was low upon entry to the Immortal Domain, as long as they survived, most ascenders would experience a reverse in their fate.
"Three hundred and seventy million years ago, someone named Lin Xuan from the lower realms ascended, but luck did not favor him, and he landed in an Immortal Crystal Mine controlled by a cultivation family in the Southern Edge Celestial Realm."
"Do you know what happened after, Sect Leader?"
"What happened? Did he claim all the Immortal Crystals?"
"Ahem..."
Mo Chen, despite being the storyteller, struggled to follow Jiang Cheng’s line of thinking.
"Having just ascended, he was only a First Grade True Immortal; that cultivation family even had Third Grade Celestial Immortals, so he could not contend against them. Thus, they captured him, placed an Immortal Soul Lock on him, and forced him to become a miner slave, extracting ore day and night."
"Quite tragic?"
"Indeed, however, he was not one that the cultivation family could suppress. In just thirty thousand years, he became a Ninth-grade Celestial Immortal!"
"And then?"
"Then he secretly removed the Immortal Soul Lock, annihilated the entire cultivation family, and seized their resources."
Mo Chen continued slowly, "The incident caused an uproar at the time, and all neighboring noble sects and families mobilized, but they couldn’t find him anywhere."
"Until three million years later, a formidable person named Profound Luo Immortal King returned to the Southern Edge Celestial Realm and slew all those noble sects and families."
"What happened later?"
"Later, all major Immortal Kings pursued him, yet he still survived and grew stronger. Eventually, after thirty million years, he became an Immortal Emperor, no longer to be trifled with!"
"That’s impressive..."
Brother Cheng couldn’t help but applaud him from a distance.
He finally understood why native inhabitants of the Immortal Domain were not welcoming to ascenders.
For ascenders to develop, they would inevitably conflict with native inhabitants who have already divided the resources.
If only lower-level conflicts, let it be, but monstrous ascenders like the Profound Luo Immortal Emperor could even change the existing order of the Immortal Domain.
Let alone native inhabitants, even early ascenders who built their way up in the Immortal Domain wouldn’t want more competitors like themselves appearing.
Eventually, they too would join the natives’ ranks.
Suddenly, Jiang Cheng had an epiphany.
"Do you think... the emergence of the Void Immortal Realm was contrived by those in the Immortal Domain?"
Mo Chen froze.
He initially thought the suggestion was absurd.
But upon contemplating, it seemed quite possible.
The biggest beneficiaries of no new ascensions from the lower realms were the native inhabitants of the Immortal Domain.
Their lives became much more comfortable.
"Blocking the ascension channels from the Lower Realm Ten Thousand Realms is quite a grand undertaking."
"It wouldn’t have been enough with just a few Immortal Emperors or Celestial Domains."
Mo Chen slowly lifted his gaze to the vast skies.
"I’m afraid all the top powers in the Immortal Domain were involved in this."
"Sect Leader, we can’t miss the Void Immortal Realm; otherwise, we may never get another chance!"
Jiang Cheng also realized this; the agreement with Lan Ti was only five months away, and it was time to depart.
Moreover, he planned to take all his disciples with him this time.
"It seems our Feixian Sect should relocate as well."
The relocation of the Feixian Sect is quite simple.
All disciples are in the Xuanji Map and can be carried along.
Mo Chen could revert to the Blood Transformation Blade form and be taken with them.
The Three-Eyed Tiger is a Demon King and can easily follow along.
What he was more concerned about was his daughter Ah Huang, and whether she could be moved.

chapters.title: Chapter 123 Mingxin Sacred Land
chapters.content:
Chapter 123: Chapter 123 Mingxin Sacred Land
"My dear daughter, can you change your position?"
"This place is so much fun, Mom, I don’t want to leave."
Hearing this, Brother Cheng felt relieved.
Indeed, since Ah Huang managed to survive in the Forbidden Land initially, relocating is just a minor issue.
"We can move to a better place."
"The Spirit Vein there is better than this one."
He felt like he was some kind of shady uncle trying to lure an innocent girl, but he had no other choice.
He couldn’t possibly go to the Immortal Realm and leave her here alone.
"Really? Can Mom find a better Spirit Vein?"
"Of course!"
The current Fifth-Grade Spirit Vein of the Feixian Sect was purely elevated by Ah Huang’s own miraculous powers.
Before that, it was just a Second-Grade Spirit Vein, hardly a treasured land.
With Jiang Cheng’s current power, it wouldn’t be difficult to find a place better than a Second-Grade Spirit Vein, would it?
"Then let’s go quickly!"
The girl who didn’t want to leave just now was now urging him on.
As soon as she left the Spirit Vein, not even three miles away, the Spiritual Qi of the Feixian Sect began to plummet, and the Spirit Vein kept downgrading.
Very soon, it reverted back to Level 2.
"Kid, what happened?"
The Three-Eyed Tiger flew over.
The reason it had become accustomed to living in the Feixian Sect was largely because the concentration of Spiritual Qi was getting higher and higher.
"Nothing, we’re moving."
"Moving? Moving where?" The Three-Eyed Tiger curled its lips.
"Milo Mountain, Mingxin Sacred Land!"
It was the place he and Lan Ti had agreed on before parting.
As the date for the opening of the Void Immortal Realm approached, either Lan Ti would come to the Feixian Sect to find him, or he would go to the Mingxin Sacred Land to find Lan Ti.
Upon hearing this, the Three-Eyed Tiger immediately got cold feet.
"Kid, do you know what the two words ’Sacred Land’ signify?"
"What?"
"At least someone of the Ascending to Saint Realm is stationed there!"
Jiang Cheng was indifferent, "Aren’t you a Demon King? Ascending to Saint would be a piece of cake, right?"
"Ascending to Saint doesn’t scare me, but in such a place, if a fight breaks out, it’ll easily draw the attention of Saint Tier characters, and then it would be real trouble."
If it were somewhere else, the Three-Eyed Tiger wouldn’t care.
With its Demon King prowess, there weren’t many places in the Lower Realm it feared, but encountering someone of the Saint Tier was different.
They were on the same level as it was.
And because it had crossed realms, its power was somewhat suppressed by the rules, putting it at a disadvantage against peers.
That’s why when it previously snatched the Transmission Array from the Purple Origin Sacred Land, it didn’t dare to kill anyone.
A foreign Demon King crossing realms would easily result in everyone uniting against it.
"Are you scared?"
Brother Cheng chuckled.
The Three-Eyed Tiger raised its eyes, "I... I really am scared."
It was a seasoned old-timer, knowing when to act humble.
"Don’t worry, I have someone familiar in Mingxin Sacred Land, a fight won’t break out."
"Really?"
The Three-Eyed Tiger’s expression was filled with disbelief.
This kid, albeit now in the Daoist Palace Realm, hadn’t been acquainted for long.
He was merely in the Soul Splitting Realm back then, so where did he gain the influence to know someone in a Sacred Land?
"Naturally, my friend is quite a big deal in Mingxin Sacred Land!"
The Mingxin Sacred Land must be the headquarter of the Witch Division, right?
Lan Ti had mentioned it; she’s the Clan Leader of the Witch Division.
Clan Leader, that’s a really high position. If not the top, at least one of the top three.
"Don’t play tricks on me, kid."
"If you’re scared, stay. We’re leaving."
With that, Brother Cheng packed away the Blood Transformation Blade, which was Mo Chen’s illusion, and lifted his daughter onto his shoulder, ready to initiate the transmission.
There was no other way; to transport someone via transmission, they must make direct contact with him.
The Three-Eyed Tiger initially didn’t want to go, but thinking about the mysterious ’Immortal Technique’ that enhanced people’s talent, it became intrigued.
It genuinely didn’t want to part with Jiang Cheng now.
At least, getting some benefits from this kid before making a move wasn’t a bad idea, right?
"How do you plan on going? Let me be clear first, if you want me to ferry you, you have to agree to one condition..."
As a Demon King, it was incredibly fast.
Even without a Transmission Array, it could fly millions of miles in a day.
"Is that so? Then you can fly slowly on your own."
Before the Three-Eyed Tiger could finish speaking, Jiang Cheng whisked away with the transmission.
In a blink, he had traveled tens of millions of miles.
With the current Tier Four transmission, he could use it four times a day.
After he exhausted its uses, he was already near Milo Mountain.
The Three-Eyed Tiger, still at the Feixian Sect, was stunned.
No matter how far it extended its Divine Thought, it couldn’t find a trace of Jiang Cheng.
"Damn, did this kid actually learn Immortal Techniques?"
By the time it flew out of the Qianxing Dynasty’s territory, Jiang Cheng had already reached the Mingxin Sacred Land.
Yet, upon arriving, apart from sensing the richness of the Spiritual Qi, he didn’t discover any magnificent and grand mountain gates.
As he walked closer, two women suddenly flew down from the giant trees above.
"Halt, who are you?"
"This is Mingxin Sacred Land, unauthorized entry is forbidden!"
Turns out he hadn’t gotten lost.
Since this was Lan Ti’s place, Jiang Cheng was rather polite.
"Hello there, I’m here to see Lan Ti."
"Sister Lan Ti?"
"Who are you to her? What’s your purpose for seeking her?"
Jiang Cheng grinned, "I’m Jiang Cheng, her best friend. Go on, tell her to come out and welcome me, be good."
The two women, clearly unaccustomed to this style of speaking, instantly had cold expressions.
One of them chided, "Where did this thief come from, daring to act disrespectfully in the Sacred Land..."
However, the other woman raised her hand to stop her.
"Hold on!"
"He’s not lying; he’s indeed Sister Lan Ti’s good friend."
"Huh?"
"Sister Lan Ti has such a friend?"
"This person’s strength, you and I can’t decipher it, he must be formidable."
Their conversation wasn’t concealed from Jiang Cheng, which puzzled him greatly.
Initially, it seemed like the typical routine of little guards blocking the way, then suddenly, their attitude turned amicable.
Moreover, how did they know he wasn’t lying?
"You’re here to help Sister Lan Ti, right? Please come in!"
"Follow us!"
Both of them smiled warmly, as if turning Jiang Cheng into one of their own.
This left Brother Cheng clicking his tongue in wonder.
He thought he’d have to show off some prowess, a bit of muscle, just to get inside.
Following them flying all the way, he soon witnessed a grand sight.
Throughout the journey, there were no brick buildings to be seen, only trees.
Yet these trees were extraordinarily tall, with crowns spanning several miles, and on some, intricate villages had formed.
People could be seen living up there.
Every now and then, someone would poke their head out from the trees, waving to greet the two women.
Brother Cheng secretly critiqued that except for their attire and appearances, the atmosphere here seemed like the elves he’d heard of in the past.
After flying for dozens of miles, a colossal tree, several hundred thousand meters thick, suddenly appeared ahead, towering into the clouds.
"Please, go ahead!"
After speaking, the two women directly crashed into the giant tree.
Damn, what are they doing?
But shortly after, he realized they seemed to dive into water, entering the giant tree.
Upon careful inspection, Jiang Cheng found no Array here.
Following them in, he witnessed a bustling scene.

chapters.title: Chapter 124 How did you end up so miserable
chapters.content:
Chapter 124: Chapter 124 How did you end up so miserable
In front is a wide mountain valley.
The gentle breeze blows, the Spirit Grass is tender green, and the river meanders down, making one feel invigorated.
Above this valley, there are floating wooden houses like kites.
Some are grand, some are exquisite, some are hidden by clouds, and it’s impossible to count them all at a glance.
The spiritual qi concentration in this valley is incredibly high, even denser than the Feixian Sect’s Tier Five Spirit Vein from before.
As soon as they arrived here, Ah Huang jumped off his shoulder.
"Mom, I found it!"
Jiang Cheng didn’t even need to guess to know she was talking about the Spirit Vein.
This daughter ran faster than a rabbit, and he couldn’t grab her in time. In the blink of an eye, she was gone.
He could only let her go; after all, even if she did find the Spirit Vein, she wouldn’t do anything bad.
He initially thought the two girls would take him to the largest wooden palace in the air, but instead, they flew all the way and finally led him to a small bamboo house behind a mountain.
In front of this bamboo house was a flying waterfall and a flowing spring, the mountain flowers were blooming, and the scenery was quite beautiful, but it was too small.
Brother Cheng secretly complained, does the clan leader really live this simply? Isn’t it too lacking in grandeur?
"Lan Ti sis, your friend is here!"
Soon after, a familiar figure appeared before him.
"Jiang Cheng, it’s you!"
There was a strong sense of surprise in her eyes.
"Didn’t we agree to meet?"
"Yeah, come in quickly, be careful not to be seen by too many people."
This sentence greatly puzzled Jiang Cheng.
"Aren’t you the chief clan leader here? What’s there to be afraid of?"
"Well..."
Lan Ti awkwardly glanced at the backs of the two departing women, then whispered, "I’m the clan leader of the Witch Division, but this isn’t the Witch Division, it’s the Heart Division."
"Huh?"
Lan Ti gave a bitter smile: "The Witch Division has suffered successive blows in recent years, and I’m the only one left."
"Because the Witch Division and the Heart Division used to be quite close, I always stay here when I return."
Jiang Cheng couldn’t help but laugh.
No wonder the grand welcome he initially expected, with a grand ceremony and attention as a clan leader’s bosom friend, never happened.
Turns out she was just a lone figure.
Also, otherwise, how could she become a clan leader at such a young age.
"So you’ve been having such a hard time."
"Yes, I was actually planning to find you in a few days; I can’t stay here anymore."
"What’s wrong?"
"Silence Sacred Land has come to demand an explanation from me."
"Ha?"
Jiang Cheng looked incredulous.
He remembered Silence Sacred Land; last time during the great battle at the Qianxing Dynasty, didn’t he just wipe out two Saint Heirs?
In the end, even the True Spirit Consciousness of Venerable Mirror Ring was toyed with by him.
He didn’t attack them, and yet these people dared to come asking for an explanation?
"Is the face of Silence Sacred Land so large? Your Heart Division is also a Sacred Land. You shouldn’t be afraid of them, right?"
Lan Ti nodded: "The Heart Division has five Ascending to Saint Realm seniors holding the fort, with power still above Silence Sacred Land."
"Additionally, there’s the Inheritance Treasure, the Heart-Piercing Awl. With this treasure, even if a Saint Tier came, they could fight them."
"Then what’s there to be afraid of? Just take them down!" Brother Cheng was always so bold in his actions.
Lan Ti gave a wry smile: "Silence Sacred Land alone isn’t really scary, but they have allies, and behind this incident, there’s Saint Bi Feng’s instigation..."
"This Heart Division in the Mingxin Sacred Land only consists of their own people and is different from the other Sacred Lands out there."
With her explanation, Jiang Cheng understood.
The remaining Nine Great Sacred Lands in the Thousand Spirit Domain have intermarried over millions of years, entangled and interlinked.
Though there might be friction and conflicts at times, they still unite against external threats.
Just like last time, when the Purple Origin Sacred Land was troubled by the Three-Eyed Tiger, several Sacred Lands quickly convened.
And the Immortal Remnant Race’s Heart Division, this Mingxin Sacred Land, having no dealings with outsiders, is a standalone system, having little connection with the other Sacred Lands out there.
If they really fought Silence Sacred Land, the other Eight Great Sacred Lands would definitely assist Silence Sacred Land.
In that case, the Heart Division would be besieged.
"Your Immortal Remnant Race isn’t doing too well, is it?"
Brother Cheng couldn’t help but complain: "You started as the descendants of immortals, with inheritance and top-grade magical treasures, and this is where you end up?"
One can only focus on self-preservation, being pushed around by weaker Sacred Lands.
Another is just exterminated to the point of being a sole survivor.
"Don’t you have the other seven divisions?"
Lan Ti shook her head: "The other seven divisions aren’t in the Thousand Spirit Domain, and internally, the nine divisions of the Immortal Remnant Race aren’t harmonious either."
"Speaking of which, Silence Sacred Land is actually my enemy. Ten years ago, they wiped out the last 300 people of my Witch Division."
At this point, her purple eyes were filled with the flames of hatred.
"What, there’s actually such a thing? I haven’t read much; you better not be lying to me."
Jiang Cheng was truly amazed.
The enemy is at the door, and the Heart Division not only doesn’t help with revenge but treats them as honored guests?
This surpassed his realm of imagination.
"Why would I lie to you? The Curse Technique cultivated by Silence Sacred Land is considered a branch of Witchcraft. They also somehow learned about the existence of our Witch Division’s ’Earth Spirit Witch Manual’ and coveted it."
"The clan leader at the time refused to hand it over, and in the end, they were attacked...I was the only one who escaped."
Jiang Cheng suddenly understood; no wonder those two Saint Heirs seemed familiar with Lan Ti last time.
And that Venerable Mirror Ring said he wanted to take Lan Ti as a disciple, clearly under the guise of learning her authentic Witchcraft!
"And that Saint Bi Feng, what’s his background? A Saint Tier?"
Lan Ti reluctantly nodded: "Yes, millions of years ago, it was him who tricked away our Witch Division’s Bone Refining Banner."
"I am impressed..."
Jiang Cheng looked up and sighed.
He didn’t even know what to say anymore.
He’s seen many things ridiculous, but never this ridiculous.
"This Heart Division lacks strength. Let’s go, it’s meaningless."
He directly walked out the door.
Lan Ti followed him, softly sighing: "They are also powerless; surviving under the watchful eyes of the Nine Great Sacred Lands is not easy."
"Actually, if it weren’t for their protection over the years, I would have been captured by Silence Sacred Land long ago."
Once her words fell, the surroundings suddenly underwent dramatic changes.
Just like that, the valley seemed to come alive, beginning to expand rapidly in all directions.
The Spirit Grass on the ground grew wildly, quickly turning into more advanced Spirit Medicine, and it grew right before their eyes.
The stream also began to widen, and the water droplets inside were filled with a rich spiritual qi.
In the mortal world, this stream water could become Immortal Water that prolongs life with just a sip...
"Wh—what’s happening?"
Lan Ti felt a sense of déjà vu about this scene.
She suddenly recalled there was a spiritual qi enhancement once before at the Feixian Sect.
But that time, it didn’t reach this level.
The Spirit Vein of the Mingxin Sacred Land now probably upgraded from Level 6 to Level 8.
"That’s right, I had someone do it, meant to give you a meeting gift."
This time, Jiang Cheng didn’t take all the credit for Ah Huang’s work.
His casual words to curry favor worked quite well.
Hearing it was a specially prepared meeting gift for her, Lan Ti, who had been living desolately, was moved to the point of having reddened eyes.
"Thank you..."
She didn’t know Jiang Cheng was secretly mocking himself, dear daughter, this isn’t our home; you didn’t need to enhance their Spirit Vein for them.

chapters.title: Chapter 125: Self-Destruct Again?
chapters.content:
Chapter 125: Chapter 125: Self-Destruct Again?
From the wooden house, countless Heart Race People flew out.
Everyone was shocked by the scene.
"Wow, what’s going on?"
"Has this place become an Immortal Realm?"
"The Spiritual Qi is so dense, I can’t even absorb it all."
"It’s unbelievable, did the Clan Leader do this?"
"It must be, right..."
The sky was filled with countless people cheering excitedly.
Jiang Cheng glanced and noticed that the Heart Division was predominantly women, accounting for about seventy percent.
Immediately, those who speculated it was the Clan Leader’s doing were proven wrong.
"What happened?"
A beautiful woman who appeared over thirty flew out from the central wooden hall, followed by a group of experts.
"Clan Leader!"
"Greetings to the Clan Leader!"
"Was it not your doing?"
"No."
The beautiful woman extended her Divine Thought, scanning the surroundings, but could find nothing unusual, except Jiang Cheng, an outsider.
Lan Ti quickly sent a secret message.
"She is Clan Leader Qing Suo of the Heart Division, Ascending to Saint Ninth Layer, don’t provoke her."
Her heart was now wrapped in sweetness, indescribably blissful.
You all are still curious, not knowing this is something ’my man’ prepared just for me.
Before Qing Suo could arrive, a cold shout rang out from behind.
"Clan Leader Qing Suo, you still say Lan Ti is not here?"
"Hmph, you Mingxin Sacred Land need to explain this!"
"Trouble, those following the Clan Leader are from the Silence Sacred Land."
Lan Ti wanted to hide, but it was already too late.
Qing Suo could only lead a large group over.
The Silence Sacred Land had come to demand a person, and she had used the excuse that Lan Ti had not returned, hiding her in the forbidden area of the back mountain.
She intended to protect her, indeed.
Unexpectedly, she was still discovered.
"Lan Ti, you killed Yu Liang and Han Huayuan, two Saint Heirs, a crime punishable by death!"
"Clan Leader Qing Suo, what do you have to say now?"
Jiang Cheng scanned the three with Insight, seeing through their Realms clearly.
All were Daoist Palace Ninth Layer, not even reaching Ascending to Saint.
Daring to question in front of an Ascending to Saint Ninth Layer was indeed a spectacle.
Yet, Qing Suo didn’t flare up.
She just kept a calm face, frowning.
"The matter of Lan Ti killing those two Saint Heirs is quite strange. With her Power, how could she accomplish it?"
"This matter must be a misunderstanding."
"Misunderstanding?"
The Silence Sacred Land’s black-bearded Elder sneered coldly: "We went to suppress the rebellion because of the news of Lan Ti creating chaos in Qianxing Dynasty!"
"Afterwards, both Saint Heirs were dead, yet she stands here alive!"
"Clan Leader Qing Suo, we have shown great respect to your Mingxin Sacred Land, but this concerns the reputation of our Silence Sacred Land, there is no room for negotiation."
Brother Cheng almost wanted to laugh, you call this respect?
Well, I’d like to see how you act when disrespectful.
Some among the Heart Division people were indignant, wanting to say something, like the two women who led the way earlier.
But they had no say before the Clan Leader and Elders.
Others were indifferent, unconcerned as it didn’t affect them.
After all, Lan Ti wasn’t from their Heart Division, no need to protect her.
"Sirs, there is no concrete evidence for this matter, concluding it now is premature."
Qing Suo still argued reasonably.
This made Jiang Cheng shake his head secretly.
Some things can’t be solved by reasoning.
He was about to step forward but suddenly saw one of the Saint Heirs from Silence Sacred Land burst into laughter.
"You want evidence?"
"I forgot to tell you, actually an True Spirit Consciousness of our Great Elder, Venerable Mirror Ring was also at Qianxing Dynasty at that time, he witnessed the entire process!"
"What?"
Qing Suo was startled, and the rest of the Heart Division were also surprised, whispering.
"Mirror Ring was present at the time?"
"How did Lan Ti survive then?"
"Yes, with him there, how could the two Saint Heirs be killed?"
"Invite the True Spirit Consciousness of the Great Elder!"
With that, the three from Silence Sacred Land formed a circle.
One Saint Heir took out a transparent orb-like Treasure and tossed it into the air.
The three simultaneously activated their Daoist Palaces, the Treasure hung in the air, radiating light.
A wisp of smoke rose.
A phantom silhouette appeared above the smoke, it was Venerable Mirror Ring.
"Greetings, Great Elder!"
The three knelt simultaneously.
Even Qing Suo and the Heart Division Elders quickly greeted.
"Venerable Mirror Ring, you are here as well."
"Long time no see."
"Such a small matter, no need for you to personally intervene, Venerable."
Lan Ti wasn’t wrong, though Heart Division was stronger than Silence Sacred Land, outside the Nine Great Sacred Lands, with Saint Tiers backing, they lived cautiously in the Thousand Spirit Domain.
Venerable Mirror Ring snorted coldly.
"If I don’t show up, you might sneakily send Lan Ti away..."
Before Qing Suo and the others could continue ’reasoning’, they saw Venerable Mirror Ring’s expression change suddenly.
"You, you’re here too!"
His gaze shot straight at Jiang Cheng, intending to pierce him with a thousand wounds.
The battle in the Imperial Palace last time was his greatest shame of a lifetime.
As a dignified Ascending to Saint Venerable, rolling around because of a single word.
Honestly, if Yu Liang and Han Huayuan hadn’t died, he would have killed them himself upon returning to keep his disgrace from being witnessed.
This matter had become Mirror Ring Venerable’s Heart Demon, as long as it exists, he could not advance his Realm any further.
He pursued Lan Ti relentlessly to prevent her from ever seeing the sun again.
As for the instigator Jiang Cheng...
How could he let him off?
He longed day and night to feast on his flesh and peel his skin.
But, he didn’t know Jiang Cheng, having no clue who he was.
The Thousand Spirit Domain is vast and finding him wasn’t easy.
Unexpectedly, they met today by chance.
"You still dare appear!"
"Good, good! Very good!"
He activated the orb-like Treasure slowly drifting over, his Ascending to Saint Realm aura congealing, sealing the space around him.
Jiang Cheng felt he could no longer mobilize a bit of Spiritual Qi.
Ascending to Saint Realm can already form its own Domain, where the Rules differ greatly from the outside.
At this Realm, everything below Ascending to Saint is just an ant.
Even though this was only a True Spirit Consciousness, it could bring all Daoist Palace Ninth Layers to ruin.
"Lan Ti, leave him quickly."
"Venerable Mirror Ring, hold your hand, there must be a misunderstanding..."
Ready to act, Qing Suo and the others panicked.
They still hoped to resolve the matter peacefully, at least to protect Lan Ti.
What worried them more, Lan Ti didn’t escape, but drew her sword and stood closer to Jiang Cheng.
Brother Cheng was also very surprised, was this woman so righteous?
But girl, I don’t need it.
As long as I die once and resurrect, this old man can be beaten easily. What’s there to fear?
He stood out with a smile.
"What, you want to roll around again?"
He was deliberately taunting, knowing where Mirror Ring Venerable’s scars were and picking at them.
Originally seething with a drive to act, Mirror Ring Venerable suddenly halted.
He realized a serious issue—could he kill him?
Killing was a must, but this True Spirit Consciousness might not suffice.
If he managed to roll things over again this time...
With tens of thousands of Heart Division spectators around, the humiliating scene would be exposed.
Couldn’t bear the humiliation!
Bang!
In full view, the old man’s True Spirit Consciousness decisively self-destructed once more.

chapters.title: Chapter 126: True Power
chapters.content:
Chapter 126: Chapter 126: True Power
What happened?
Everyone present wanted to ask this question.
The true spirit consciousness of Venerable Mirror Ring had indeed self-destructed, and most people could see that.
But they still wanted to ask—what happened?
This Ascending to Saint powerhouse came with a menacing intent, looking unstoppable unless satisfied with bloodshed.
And yet, he just self-destructed immediately.
Why self-destruct?
Everyone was bewildered and couldn’t understand at all.
Pfft!
Lan Ti suddenly was the first to burst into laughter.
She realized the "troubles" of Venerable Mirror Ring, finding it quite amusing.
This esteemed Ascending to Saint Realm ended up being turned into a frightened bird by Jiang Cheng.
"By the way, how did you do it last time?"
"Do you really know such powerful verbal magic?"
She asked expectantly through voice transmission.
Jiang Cheng shrugged: "Last time, I just unintentionally got a one-time-use treasure, and it was gone after I used it. I didn’t expect him to be that timid."
He thought he would die once, but unexpectedly one sentence scared the opponent into self-destruction.
Am I currently so imposing that my domineering aura seeps out?
"Wow, if I had known it was a one-time thing, I would have beaten you up that time to relieve my anger!"
Lan Ti thought back to when she praised him that time, and lightly punched him twice, playfully like a flirting couple.
Brother Cheng enjoyed it immensely, as Lan Ti’s unparalleled beauty was unmatched even among thousands of beauties in the Heart Division.
He was just a bit puzzled, why this girl wouldn’t commit to him, yet her behavior towards him was becoming more and more affectionate.
Sister, if you keep this up, I’ll get the wrong idea!
With Venerable Mirror Ring’s self-destruction, the other three experts from Silence Sacred Land were dumbfounded.
They wanted to witness the Great Elder’s display of divine might and extermination of the petty ones.
What kind of act is this?
And without giving any reason, just self-destruct like that.
"What did you do?"
"It’s you all!"
"It must be you people from Mingxin Sacred Land who set a trap for the Great Elder, you’re audacious!"
The three, to save face, actually unanimously aimed the blame at Qingsuo and others.
After all, spreading the news of self-destruction isn’t that dignified.
If you didn’t even fight, why self-destruct?
Stating they were ambushed by a powerful Sacred Land would maintain some dignity.
This inexplicable blame thrown their way made the Heart Division people fluster.
"It wasn’t us!"
"We didn’t do anything."
"Maybe Venerable Mirror Ring had some urgent matter?"
"Please investigate clearly, there wasn’t even a slightest fluctuation of restriction just now..."
Among them, the Elder from Silence Sacred Land sneered coldly: "Saying more to us is useless, wait for our Sect Leader’s judgment, we will report truthfully!"
"Besides, we’re taking these two back."
"Anyone who resists will be an enemy to Silence Sacred Land!"
The three’s Daoist Palace was hovering in mid-air, filled with killing intent.
And those experts from the Heart Division really didn’t dare to resist.
Jiang Cheng found it amusing.
A clan composed of Immortal descendants, reduced to such a weak state in the Lower Realm, truly disgraceful.
"Alas, I thought I wouldn’t have to make a move this time."
"Unexpectedly, I have to go back to old habits again."
"Destined by heaven to show off, can’t help but show off!"
He summoned the treasure Cyan Luo Breaking Sacred Sword.
No choice, he really didn’t expect to engage in battle when coming to Mingxin Sacred Land this time.
Otherwise, while showing off, he wouldn’t have carried weapons and spirit talismans with him.
He initially thought Lan Ti was the boss here, just visiting a friend.
"Jiang Cheng, you..."
Lan Ti, seeing he was about to take action, became a bit worried.
"What, are you as soft as them?"
Leaving this remark, Brother Cheng summoned the Daoist Palace and charged forward fiercely.
The moment his Daoist Palace appeared, the entire audience was astonished.
"Nine-Colored Daoist Palace!"
Qingsuo gasped in shock: "Those two golden Martial Dao rivers, are they of Immortal Tier?"
A senior from Ascending to Saint Race murmured in disbelief: "Is such talent truly existent in this world?"
"Back then, the Nine Immortal Ancestors mentioned, the extreme of Daoist Palace is nine-colored, always thought it was a legend..."
"This person has Immortal Tier Martial Dao Enlightenment while still in the Lower Realm, in the future..."
"His prospects are limitless!"
"How could Lan Ti be acquainted with such a heaven-defying monster..."
Even Lan Ti herself was dumbfounded, her stunning face full of disbelief.
She had seen Jiang Cheng in action before, back when he was still in Celestial Fate Realm, wielding the Nine-Colored Divine Mansion.
Possessing the Nine-Colored Divine Mansion, it wasn’t surprising to have a Nine-Colored Daoist Palace after ascending.
But she distinctly remembered that at that time, he only had one Immortal Tier river.
The remaining eight were at most Sect Level, which was quite underwhelming.
And now, his Nine-Colored Daoist Palace had two Immortal Tier rivers, how did that extra Immortal Tier come about?
Even at Daoist Palace Realm, let alone at the Saint Tier, one would struggle to elevate any Martial Dao enlightenment to Immortal Tier despite a lifetime of effort.
The trio across didn’t initially regard Jiang Cheng highly.
His realm was easily discernible, Daoist Palace Fourth Layer.
The past few months at Feixian Sect, Sect Leader Jiang’s cultivation was sporadic, but his talent was outrageously good.
While others in the Daoist Palace Realm might need centuries of relentless cultivation to make progress, he inexplicably advanced a layer in just a few months leisurely.
Daoist Palace Fourth Layer up against three Daoist Palace Ninth Layer individuals, with two being Saint Child level geniuses.
There shouldn’t have been any suspense in this battle.
And in fact, there really wasn’t much suspense.
Except it was Jiang Cheng overwhelmingly crushing the three of them.
He had too many BUFFs.
The enhancement of Nine-Colored Daoist Palace already allowed each of his strikes to match Daoist Palace Ninth Layer.
The Immortal Tier Five Elements Martial Dao, alongside the Wind attribute enhanced treasure Cyan Luo Breaking Sacred Sword, broke past the upper limits of Daoist Palace level attack power.
The Poison Heroic Soul made each of his strikes extremely dangerous, corroding the opponent’s spiritual power, even divine thought, and Daoist Palace upon each clash, weakening them further.
Besides these, he had Great Perfection Swordsmanship and cultivation techniques acquired through a lottery.
Lastly, the innate intimidation from Azure Dragon Essence Blood was also significant.
This battle was simply unwinnable.
Within merely a few seconds of engagement, the leading Elder was instantly eradicated in spirit and form by a gale infused with Poisonous Soul.
The two remaining Saint Heirs were in grave danger, utterly shocked.
Hurriedly, they performed verbal magic.
"Ice!"
"Net!"
In an instant, the sky battlefield turned into a world of ice and snow, a vast blue net descended from above.
Just as Jiang Cheng was about to use sword control to sweep away everything, another sword slashed out from the flank.
When that sword touched the ice, the ice melted instantly, turning into a torrential rain.
As the sword tip struck the giant net, its threads turned to ashes.
Exclamations came from Qingsuo and others.
"Lan Ti!"
"Don’t be reckless!"
Ultimately, Lan Ti chose to fight alongside him, although Jiang Cheng could dispel the spell with one swing.
With her assistance, the rest was simpler.
Verbal magic was broken by witchcraft, and the two Saint Heirs faced backlash, leaving Brother Cheng to wreak havoc.
The two were obliterated into dust.
The battle started abruptly and ended extremely quickly.
It took less than 7 seconds for the three Daoist Palace Ninth Layers to meet their end. This was Jiang Cheng’s current real combat power.

chapters.title: Chapter 127: New Goal
chapters.content:
Chapter 127: Chapter 127: New Goal
Even Lan Ti was frightened.
When they first met, her power was far beyond Jiang Cheng’s.
Later, when the seven great experts attacked, she even gave him a Spirit Talisman to call for her help in danger.
It was imaginable how big the gap between their powers was at that time.
And now, she could no longer look down on him.
Just now, even without her intervention, Brother Cheng could have eliminated those three in less than 10 seconds.
This power already far exceeded her, the Daoist Palace Eighth Layer Witch Division Clan Leader.
Qingsuo and the others were also stunned.
It was as if they had already seen a future Saint Tier strong person, possibly even the strongest one.
Such talent, such combat power, exceeded their imagination.
However, the prerequisite is that this person can survive.
Killing those three meant completely making enemies with the Silence Sacred Land, a struggle to the death.
This matter became a big deal.
"Sir, you really shouldn’t have killed them."
"If there’s anything, we can sit down and talk slowly."
"Indeed, now it’s trouble, the Silence Sacred Land will surely launch a major attack."
"And Lan Ti, how could you also act impulsively?"
The Heart Division experts complained one after another, but Jiang Cheng did not listen at all, he was busy.
Victory in battle meant collecting spoils of war, of course.
These three were Daoist Palace Ninth Layer, their collections were very rich, with a large amount of Spirit Medicine, Spirit Stones, and four Tier Nine Spiritual Artifacts.
After checking, there were over 3 million points again accounted for.
But this was mainly because two of the three were Saint Heirs.
Only after he finished clearing up did he finally lift his head.
"Are you all afraid?"
Qingsuo and a few Ascending to Saint Elders’ faces did not look good.
And the other Heart Race People couldn’t help but retort.
"Sir, what kind of words are these?"
"This is clearly the disaster you caused, what does it have to do with us?"
"Exactly, what should we fear?"
Qingsuo waved his hand, stopping the people.
"Sir’s talent is rare in the world, if you can continue cultivating, you will surely become a Saint Tier in the future."
"But I’m afraid you don’t know, Silence Sacred Land has three Ascending to Saint patrons."
She spoke freely: "Additionally, there are alliances with the other Eight Great Sacred Lands. As long as you are in the Thousand Spirit Domain, you can’t escape their deadly hands."
"In my opinion, sir, you should escape the Thousand Spirit Domain, and return after achieving Great Success in Divine Skills in a few hundred thousand years."
Lan Ti hurriedly pleaded: "Clan Leader, if Jiang Cheng goes to other domains, he will be suppressed by the rules."
Just like Three-Eyed Tiger came across domains, it was also suppressed by the rules.
"This matter is originally monopolizing of Silence Sacred Land, why can’t we protect him, we don’t believe those enemies can block the Heart-Piercing Awl..."
"Shut up!"
A cold voice from an Ascending to Saint Elder behind Qingsuo: "This matter started because of you, yet you don’t reflect on it and want to break this rare peace?"
"Alright, I know you want to drive me away."
Jiang Cheng wasn’t dumb.
This group fears that he staying will invite trouble to them.
"Don’t worry, I’ll leave soon, won’t get you involved."
Saying his intent so bluntly, Qingsuo’s expression became somewhat embarrassed.
"Sir, your words are too serious, we’re also considering your situation. If staying here, the Silence Sacred Land will surely seek you, inescapable death."
"Rather than that, why not go elsewhere, so they can’t find you..."
"With the mountains preserved, fear not for lack of wood to burn, sir must understand this principle too."
Jiang Cheng was made almost temperless by this group of softies.
Speak well of them, they fearfully sought to please enemies.
Speak ill of them, they bore no harm towards him, merely wishing to keep themselves free from blame.
Simply put, they didn’t want to offend either side.
As for acting, that wasn’t happening.
"Alright alright, stop reciting, I’ll thank you for your kind intention, okay?"
"But I won’t leave the Thousand Spirit Domain."
Qingsuo hurriedly advised: "Sir, don’t ruin yourself..."
Jiang Cheng laughed: "No worries, you’ll soon hear of me again."
Now he officially eyed Silence Sacred Land, eager to get back to work.
"What about you? Are you waiting here, or coming along?"
Lan Ti said nothing, but her flying to his side, standing shoulder to shoulder with him, showed everything.
"Lan Ti, aren’t you planning to stay?"
Qingsuo’s tone was somehow nuanced, both worried and a bit delighted.
Other Heart Race People felt similarly.
They didn’t want the only survivor of the Witch Division to just die, but now Lan Ti was trouble; if she left, Heart Division wouldn’t be implicated.
"Thank you, Clan Leader, for years of refuge and grace."
Lan Ti smiled, her beautiful eyes all focused on Jiang Cheng.
"But I’ve now found someone I can rely on."
These words made Brother Cheng feel elated.
But couldn’t help suspecting, girl, are you purposely saying sweet words to cheat me again?
"Ah, alright then."
Qingsuo sighed: "Advise him, you two should best leave the Thousand Spirit Domain quickly..."
Though there wasn’t the welcome ceremony imagined when they arrived, the farewell scene on departure was unexpectedly grand.
All Heart Race People lined up on both sides, watching the pair stepping into the whirlpool in the sky.
They all secretly exhaled a breath.
Once stepping into that whirlpool exit, they would leave Heart Division territory, and whatever happens after doesn’t concern them.
Moreover, Qingsuo and the clan elders were currently most concerned with another matter.
Why did the concentration of Spiritual Qi here suddenly increase so much?
Could there be rare marvels descending?
If truly so, Heart Division’s prosperity is just around the corner.
With such Spiritual Qi concentration, how many top experts will emerge in Heart Division?
Even oneself might have a chance to break into Saint Tier!
Once advancing to Saint Tier, there’s no need to lower one’s head in the Thousand Spirit Domain!
Sending off a calamity, welcoming an expansion opportunity for the tribe, it was truly dual happiness worth celebrating!
Yet just as about to step into the whirlpool, Jiang Cheng finally remembered something.
"Ah Huang, Daddy’s leaving, aren’t you coming?"
From behind the waterfall deep in the valley ran out quickly a girl, eleven or twelve years old.
Waving her pink plump hands, barefoot steps staggering a bit.
"Ah, Mommy, why are you leaving, I was just getting comfortable."
Everyone looked surprised, discovering they couldn’t determine the little girl’s realm, only sensed an enigmatic and mysterious aura.
"Child, why are you arbitrarily enhancing others’ Spirit Veins?"
"Ah?"
Ah Huang flew to him with an innocent face and skillfully climbed back onto his shoulder.
"I thought this was our new home."
"It’s not, you got it wrong, let’s go."
With that said, the three disappeared within the whirlpool, leaving behind a crowd of Heart Race People baffled at the situation.
Just now, what did these two say?
Enhancing Spirit Veins?
Following that, they noticed the Spiritual Qi concentration inside the valley rapidly dropping.
The Spirit Grass turning into Spirit Medicine quickly wilted, and the creek water in the river no longer had the previous ethereal breath.
Even the size of the valley was shrinking, finally returning to its former standard.
"What, what is this..."
Qingsuo was shocked, her hope of advancing to Saint Tier was gone.
A few Ascending to Saint elders were extremely disappointed.
"Was it really, just now that girl’s doing?"
"If we’d known earlier it was his daughter..."
Silently, a heavy sense of regret surged in all the hearts present.

chapters.title: Chapter 128: Girl, Don’t Stop Me
chapters.content:
Chapter 128: Chapter 128: Girl, Don’t Stop Me
Leaving Milo Mountain, Jiang Cheng headed straight towards the direction of Silence Sacred Land.
This surprised Lan Ti a little.
"Where are you going?"
"Going to take down Silence Sacred Land to avenge you!"
Such words of flattery and boasting came out instinctively.
How about it, touched, aren’t you, girl?
Actually, he was only aiming for a massive amount of points; after all, it was a Sacred Land!
A vast force with Ascending to Saint Realm holding the fort, Daoist Palace Realm walking everywhere, and Celestial Fate as common as dogs.
Once it’s annihilated, you can well imagine how much the gains would be.
Originally, he was thinking about where to find a suitable Spirit Vein for Ah Huang.
Silence Sacred Land was simply a pillow delivered to a sleepy person, right at the doorstep.
Lan Ti was indeed touched.
This man, to stand up for her, was actually going to challenge such a terrifying force.
"You, you don’t have to go this far for me..."
"It’s necessary, absolutely necessary!"
Brother Cheng must tackle his skilled business of sect destruction, no one should even try to stop him now!
"But it’s too dangerous there. Besides Venerable Mirror Ring the Great Elder, there’s also Sect Leader Venerable Mirror Origin and Supreme Elder Venerable Yuqu."
"Especially Venerable Yuqu, just like Clan Leader Qingsuo, is also Ascending to Saint Ninth Layer, only one step away from the Saint Tier."
Jiang Cheng thought to himself, girl, you’re overthinking it. No need to worry about how strong they are, the system will handle it.
"So what, I’m laying it down today: for you, I’m willing to give my life!"
Anyway, what I want most is to die.
After saying these cost-free touching phrases, he sneakily glanced at Lan Ti.
How about it, girl, is this enough for you to be so moved as to pledge allegiance to me, become my subordinate?
Lan Ti was actually a bit puzzled.
This guy used to be so profit-driven; he even squeezed a Treasure out of her for one night’s lodging.
Why now would he dig his heart out for her, even to the point of willing to die for her, isn’t this too exaggerated?
Just because of the last ’confession’ and becoming ’a couple’ with her?
The problem is he hasn’t even completed the marriage ceremony with her, it’s not even officially being Daoist Companions.
Moreover, in the Cultivation Realm, some Daoist Companions are basically united due to power, benefits, sects, or similar reasons, usually each cultivating separately, with hardly any feelings.
Thinking about how she even took him as her man, treating him warmly much more, yet not to the point of willing to die for him, she couldn’t help but feel a bit embarrased.
"Oh dear, don’t be so impulsive, I don’t want you to die."
She shook Jiang Cheng’s hand a bit, both moved and anxious: "Can’t you be a bit more steady? With your talent, as long as you cultivate arduously, you will have chances in the future, no need to rush."
"No way, thinking of your enemy still alive makes me suffer indescribably, so upset I can’t sleep."
I want to show off, girl, don’t hold me back.
But Lan Ti blocked his way directly, preventing him from going further.
"Listen, how about we go back to Feixian Sect together? They don’t know about it there for now, it should still be safe."
"Can’t go back."
"Ah? Why?"
"I’ve cleared out Feixian Sect, now there’s no one there. Originally planning to seek refuge with you, since you’re also in such dire straits, we can only take down Silence Sacred Land and make it the new sect base for Feixian Sect."
"This..."
Lan Ti looked around with some curiosity: "Then what about your disciples?"
"They’re all cultivating in a secret place, they will appear when they should."
Those disciples are currently still inside the Xuanji Map, being carried with him.
Lan Ti didn’t know how this ’should appear’ thing could be done.
However, her eyes suddenly lit up.
"So, Three-Eyed Tiger senior is here too?"
No wonder he’s so confident, it turned out to have a Demon King taking the lead.
Then Silence Sacred Land indeed doesn’t have much pressure.
"It’s still behind us."
"Ah?"
Lan Ti was a little puzzled as to why the strongest was still behind.
Already near Silence Sacred Land, Jiang Cheng first put his daughter down from his shoulder, then took out the Blood Transformation Blade.
The Demon Blade squirmed and transformed into the human shape of Mo Chen.
As soon as it appeared, this fellow started flattering.
"Sect Leader mighty, I witnessed the battle just now, Sect Leader’s power is already unrivaled below Ascending to Saint!"
"Haha, just a small scene."
Brother Cheng seemed indifferent, but he hoped in his heart that the flattery would be a bit stronger.
Mo Chen did not disappoint him.
"No, no, no, this is not a small scene at all, Sect Leader might very well be the strongest Daoist Palace Realm in history. Witnessing such a miracle is the old one’s honor!"
Brother Cheng was so elated by the flattery, extremely satisfied, it seemed Elder Mo was increasingly adapting to Feixian Sect’s corporate culture.
He patted this former Immortal’s shoulder: "This Sect Leader is going to stroll around Silence Sacred Land, you stay here and watch my things."
Mo Chen had now restored some power, but facing three Ascending to Saint Realm across, dealing with it, probably even the Residual Soul would almost dissipate.
The daughter can clear spiritual energy and lock the Divine Soul, but more suitable for dueling fewer people.
The other side has too many people, she couldn’t manage.
As for Lan Ti, Daoist Palace Eighth Layer is far from enough.
So this time, it still needed him alone with the Resurrection Skill.
Since he would be killed, he certainly didn’t want to bring people along to spectate.
So he handed the ring full of Feixian Sect’s supplies wholesale to Mo Chen.
"You’ll keep it for me, until I return."
This was someone verified by the system, he could rest assured.
Mo Chen took the rings, his emotions surged.
He saw with his own eyes Jiang Cheng put several Treasures in there, besides, there were large quantities of Spirit Stone Elixir.
These things are extremely valuable in the Lower Realm.
Yet he so entrusted them to him now.
The Sect Leader is truly different from those other Childs of the Plane, this trust, made him incredibly touched.
"I will surely live up to the trust!"
"You’re not waiting for Three-Eyed Tiger senior, just going over by yourself?" Lan Ti became anxious again.
Jiang Cheng felt a bit helpless.
This girl worrying about him dying was a comforting matter.
But the problem was, it hindered his steps of showing off.
No choice, to reassure her, he could only deceive her.
"I’m just going to scout around, not sect extermination or anything, don’t worry."
"Oh, then I’ll go with you..."
"No, I’m more agile alone, you stay here and take care of Ah Huang."
On the road before, he also told her, this daughter is recognized, not birthed.
Lan Ti then nodded, still worriedly saying: "Then you have to come back soon, don’t linger in dangerous places. I’ll be waiting for you... Cheng."
Hearing this cheesy address, Brother Cheng almost stumbled and fell to the ground.
He was quite speechless, because the system hadn’t even given a ding.
Is this woman’s heart made of iron?
Already calling so affectionately, yet still not his own?
Flying up to the clouds, he rapidly moved towards Silence Sacred Land.
Quickly, he reached the outer perimeter of this vast force.
At this moment, the inside and outside of this sect was buzzing with war clouds, weapons were being sharpened.

chapters.title: Chapter 129: The Arrival of the Ancestor
chapters.content:
Chapter 129: Chapter 129: The Arrival of the Ancestor
When Jiang Cheng arrived, he saw thousands upon thousands of cultivators scattering in all directions.
The sky was densely packed with people, like a beehive that had exploded.
What’s the situation?
He casually stopped someone: "Brother, what happened?"
The Spirit Platform Cultivator was extremely anxious, and just as he was about to get angry at being blocked, he saw that the other party’s cultivation was unfathomable and quickly put on a smile.
"Reporting to senior, the Silence Sacred Land is going to war with the Mingxin Sacred Land!"
"This level of battle can easily spread to the innocent. If an Ascending to Saint Venerable attacks at will, we would be scattered to ashes, so we’re all fleeing for our lives."
Oh, the Silence Sacred Land is quite proactive.
Jiang Cheng planned to fly in but reconsidered and gave up on the idea.
Just like the Eight Clouds Hall back then, the foundations of such sects are too deep.
There are experts everywhere; going in alone would not allow one to see everyone and might lead to an early demise.
Therefore, it’s necessary to think of a way to capture them all in one go.
Looking around, in addition to the fleeing cultivators, there were also quite a number of experts flying towards the entrance of the Silence Sacred Land.
The Silence Sacred Land has over a hundred thousand disciples, of course not all stay in the sect all the time.
Many have already extended their branches, establishing subsidiary forces elsewhere or training abroad.
Over tens of millions of years, they have formed considerable forces.
This time, to attack the Heart Division, the Sacred Land issued a call, and of course, these sect experts scattered outside all rushed back to help.
This is the foundation of a Sacred Land; Feixian Sect cannot even begin to compare.
If it weren’t for Brother Cheng’s strong guidance, even given a billion years, they would not reach this height.
From the outside, the mountain gate looks like nothing out of the ordinary.
Everyone flew towards the void, then shouted "open" and vanished from sight.
Jiang Cheng knew this must be a verbal magic curse.
It’s a pity that although he has a divine-grade Witch Seed, he has never learned witchcraft and really doesn’t know this technique.
Unless he intended to forcefully break through the restriction and just charge in.
Thinking it over, he had a sudden inspiration, found a hidden place and transformed into the form of Venerable Mirror Ring.
Although he had never seen the Great Elder’s true form, he had encountered the True Spirit Consciousness twice and transformed into an exact likeness.
Except the aura was still at the level of Ascending to Saint True Spirit Consciousness.
This was enough, as none of the people outside had reached the Ascending to Saint level.
Using divine thought to probe would find it unfathomable.
Once he appeared, everyone stopped, panic-stricken, rolling and crawling, many directly falling from the sky.
It wasn’t because Jiang Cheng did anything, but because they dared not linger in the sky.
Venerable Mirror Ring was an old generation Ascending to Saint Fifth Layer strong person, whose fame had long spread throughout the Thousand Spirit Domain.
In the areas surrounding the Sacred Land, he was like a god; who didn’t know him?
In front of such a venerable figure, who dares to fly?
Who dares to fly above his head?
With a thud, a large group of people knelt down.
All rushing to support the Silence Sacred Land.
"Greetings, Ancestor!"
"Greetings, Great Elder!"
"Greetings, Uncle Master Ancestor, I am Wu Rong, Elder Wuzhen’s chief disciple. I had the honor of meeting you under his leadership five hundred thousand years ago. Do you still remember me?"
"Greetings, Grand Uncle Master Ancestor, I am Xue Ji, formerly of Feiyan Pavilion. Three hundred thousand years ago I established a family outside, these are my unworthy descendants..."
"Why aren’t you all bowing to your ancestor!"
"Ancestor, how come you are not in the sect but outside?"
Venerable Mirror Ring had been around for a million years; his disciples and grand-disciples were already important figures, and these were the disciples of their disciples.
Yet most of them were in the Daoist Palace Realm, now all powerful figures.
Among them were some at the Daoist Palace Ninth Layer, who could make Xiang Gaoye shiver a little in the Qianxing Dynasty.
Yet now they all knelt in droves at Jiang Cheng’s feet.
As for juniors in the Celestial Fate and Spirit Platform Realms, do they qualify to speak in such a setting?
Obediently prostrating, making intimate contact with the ground is all they need to do.
This made Brother Cheng extremely pleased.
Emma, this Transformation Technique is indeed very handy; it was just transformed into the wrong person last time.
He let out a cold snort, putting on a full display of grandeur.
"The ancestor’s actions, are they for you to guess?"
"No, we dare not!"
"Please forgive us, ancestor!"
"We deserve to die for our crimes!"
If the ancestor really wanted to kill them, it would only be a thought away.
"Alright, alright, you bunch of useless!"
No need for him to chant any entering verbal magic, even the disciples guarding the restrictions knelt, opening the restriction to welcome this ancestor in.
Stepping inside, it was indeed a whole new world.
Inside, mist swirled, the glow soared.
An endless expanse of palaces floated mid-air, similar to the Mingxin Sacred Land.
Only in terms of display and atmosphere, this place was much more advanced than Mingxin Sacred Land.
Flocks of spirit birds flew across the sky from time to time, making clear tones.
In peaks shrouded in clouds, amidst flying waterfalls and flowing springs, Tier Eight and Tier Nine spirit medicines could be seen everywhere, with even higher tier heavenly and earthly treasures growing among them.
The spiritual Qi was abundant, taking a breath was refreshing, it was simply a scene of an immortal realm.
Jiang Cheng was filled with joy.
This place was going to become the new home of the Feixian Sect, just thinking about it made him a little excited.
Glancing at the group of experts trailing behind him, he waved a big hand.
"Follow the ancestor!"
Upon hearing this, everyone was overjoyed.
Originally, they thought they’d be led by various peak elders after entering.
Unexpectedly, they could be personally commanded by the ancestor, it was like a great luck, what a fortune!
"Yes, yes!"
"Alright!"
"Stay close, don’t miss any order from the ancestor!"
Everyone was incredibly excited, wishing they could do an aerial split on the spot to please the ancestor.
A grand procession of several thousand headed straight to the heart of the mountain gate.
After flying a few hundred miles, another group of over a thousand cultivators appeared from the side.
Upon seeing Jiang Cheng, several leading elders and Saint Heir immediately stopped their clouds and tumbled to kneel.
"Greetings, Uncle Master Ancestor!"
"Greetings, Grand Uncle Master Ancestor, what brings you here?"
"We thought you were already at the Divine One Main Hall for discussions..."
Jiang Cheng now roughly understood the stature Venerable Mirror Ring commanded, meeting them was not intimidating at all, and instead, he put on a stern face.
"You imbeciles, do I need to report my whereabouts to you?"
"No, we dare not..."
"Disciple deserves to die..."
"Begging for the ancestor’s mercy..."
When these elders and Saint Heirs acted just as nervously as they did before, it made Brother Cheng extremely pleased.
Wow, this transformation technique is incredibly useful after all. Last time, I just transformed into the wrong person.
He snorted coldly, displaying his full majesty.
"Do you think you can guess what the ancestor intends to do?"
"No, no!"
"Please forgive us, ancestor!"
"We deserve ten thousand deaths!"
If the ancestor really wished to kill them with a thought, it would be done in an instant.
"Enough, enough, a bunch of trash!"
There was no need for him to recite any verbal magic to open the entrance when the disciples guarding the restrictions were prostrating on the ground, opening the way ahead of him.
The sight of Elder Wuzhen’s elders and the Saint Heir crawling and so fearful like they had been earlier filled Brother Cheng with immense satisfaction.
Damn, this Transformation Technique was really useful, it was just last time that he changed into the wrong person.
He coldly snorted, acting with full pomp.
"Do you think you can predict the actions of the ancestor?"
"No, we dare not!"
"Please forgive us, ancestor!"
"We are unworthy and deserve to die!"
The ancestor could simply kill them with a thought if he wished.
"Alright, alright, a bunch of useless fools!"
There was no need for him to recite any verbal magic for entrance as the disciples guarding the restriction were already kneeling all over the place, and opened the barrier to let him in.
```

chapters.title: Chapter 130: Dare to Disobey the Ancestor’s Command?
chapters.content:
Chapter 130: Chapter 130: Dare to Disobey the Ancestor’s Command?
On the journey spanning thousands of miles thereafter, Jiang Cheng gathered five more groups of people along the way.
At this point, the number of people behind him had grown to twenty thousand.
Among this group, there were as many as 272 cultivators of the Daoist Palace Realm, with 15 of them at the Daoist Palace Ninth Layer.
Among the remaining twenty thousand, over five thousand were in the Celestial Fate Realm.
If such a formation were to go out, it could easily wipe out an Imperial dynasty dozens of times over.
And now, Jiang Cheng was leading them grandly to the Divine One Main Hall at the very center.
From a distance, a large, dense crowd of people could already be seen standing outside the main hall.
These were all elders and disciples from various peaks who had arrived earlier, and their average strength was no less than the two thousand behind him.
High in the sky, numerous elders were riding spirit beasts to maintain order.
As for the Sect Leader and the Supreme Elders including the Great Elder, they were currently inside the hall discussing matters.
Attacking the Mingxin Sacred Land was a significant affair.
Truth be told, Silence Sacred Land had no intention of destroying the Mingxin Sacred Land.
It’s not that they didn’t want to, but they couldn’t.
Don’t be fooled by the fact that the Heart Division has just over ten thousand people there; their top combat power is stronger than Silence Sacred Land.
Three against five in the Ascending to Saint Realm, thinking about destroying Mingxin Sacred Land was just a pipe dream.
Their primary goal this time was still to capture Jiang Cheng and Lan Ti.
Especially Lan Ti, she possessed the Witch Division’s "Earth Spirit Witch Manual."
This manual was useless to most other cultivators, but it was a supreme treasure to Silence Sacred Land because their cultivation could be considered witchcraft.
Verbal Magic was just a small branch of witchcraft, yet it had already allowed them to develop into a massive Sacred Land step by step.
Getting the complete Earth Spirit Witch Manual would not only perfect Verbal Magic but also allow them to learn other witchcraft techniques.
The significance was too great for them.
This time, the entire sect attacking was more about showing a tough stance. Mingxin Sacred Land over there definitely wouldn’t dare to retaliate fully; in the end, they would still settle for compromise to calm things down.
That bunch of women was afraid the situation blowing up would lead to the major Sacred Lands joining forces.
At that time, they could seize the opportunity to demand a huge compensation.
Who wouldn’t want to squeeze a soft persimmon? Silence Sacred Land had been waiting for this excuse to send troops for many years.
The movement of those two thousand flying over was naturally sensed by these high-ups inside.
But they didn’t pay much attention.
They were all their own disciples; groups had flown in batch after batch before.
Yet they had no idea that the person leading them was their enemy.
Jiang Cheng raised his hand, stopping above the Divine One Main Hall.
The two thousand people behind him initially planned to fly down and stand with the other forces below, but since the ancestor hadn’t gone down, no one dared to act rashly.
"Alright, next, all of you will summon your Divine Mansion and Daoist Palace, bring out your strongest weapons, and unleash your best moves towards below."
Huh?
Attack below?
The ones standing below were all elders and fellow disciples from various peaks!
Not to mention the high-ups inside the main hall.
Attacking downwards would mean attacking their own people!
Seeing their hesitation, Jiang Cheng’s eyes squinted, shouting sternly, "What, you don’t even listen to the ancestor’s orders now?"
Wu Rong and the others quickly apologized, "We dare not, we dare not, it’s just that below..."
Before he could finish, Brother Cheng interrupted him.
"Fools!"
"Does the ancestor not know those below are his own people?"
"Do you really think with the ancestor here, you could actually harm them?"
"This is merely a test of your combat power."
"It’s a pre-war check to see if any of your skills have declined."
"The ancestor has spoken, anyone who holds back will be killed on the spot!"
The crowd thought it made sense too.
How could the ancestor possibly let them attack their own people.
With his Celestial Fate Realm’s heaven-reaching power, once he unleashed his domain, he could block all their attacks with a wave of his hand, even if all two thousand of them were to strike.
This had to be pre-arranged; nothing to worry about.
"Yes, yes, yes."
"We’re ready to attack, waiting for the ancestor’s command."
"Listen up, Xue Family disciples, put all your strength into this, don’t let the ancestor down!"
"Don’t worry, Grandpa, I’m taking out my long-cherished Tier Nine Spirit Talisman!"
"Disciples of Nether Fire Peak, don’t embarrass us, let them see what the Fifth Main Peak of the Sacred Land is all about!"
"Wu Family disciples, perk up, this is a chance to impress the ancestor."
"Whoever performs well may even get to stay under the ancestor as a Sword Attendant, achieving the Daoist Palace would be a piece of cake in the future!"
Instantly, the two thousand in the sky were so excited they howled, their battle intent soaring to the clouds.
The seventy to eighty thousand disciples who had arrived earlier below looked up puzzled, not knowing what was happening.
Why weren’t these people coming down?
Soon, they saw everyone in the air summoning their Daoist Palace and Spirit Platforms, weapons unsheathed, spiritual power surging.
Many even pointed and laughed.
After all, they were all from the same sect; they recognized many of them.
Who could have thought this was to attack them.
When Jiang Cheng gave the command, it was too late for all the experts to react as they launched their attacks downward.
Two thousand attacks shot straight down from the sky!
Instantly bombarding the hall and every corner around it.
Among these people, many were in the Celestial Fate and Daoist Palace Realms, and even if only one person struck with full force, it could cause tremendous destruction.
Let alone so many.
From above, no one could be seen anymore, only the multi-colored sword aura, knife aura, and the rivers of the Daoist Palace and Divine Mansion crisscrossing.
Rumbling sounds were incessant.
Accompanied by the explosions of spirit talismans and spirit arrays!
Many worked hard to impress the ancestor, putting in their utmost effort.
Not only did they use their strongest ultimate technique, but they also took out their prized treasures.
Some even cleverly launched a second and third attack amidst the chaos...
After this wave of attacks, the Divine One Main Hall was blasted apart.
The smoke and dust couldn’t even be seen anymore, only horrendous black mist rising all around, the void completely ignited, endlessly spreading like a coiling giant dragon.
If the Divine One Main Hall were invaded by external enemies, it would have many defensive measures.
Back then, never mind the Daoist Palace Realm, even Ascending to Saint experts would find it hard to break through here.
But the problem was, neither the great array nor the restrictions were activated at this time.
Who could have thought they would encounter a ’mass enemy attack’ on the eve of expedition.
The seventy to eighty thousand in the square were in a completely defenseless state.
They never dreamed their own people would attack their own.
Their spiritual power wasn’t gathered, spirit armor wasn’t activated, and they hadn’t even summoned their weapons.
Moreover, standing so densely was tantamount to standing still to be struck.
As a result, the casualties were extremely heavy.
In this wave of attacks, the seventy to eighty thousand nearly got wiped out, the vast majority left without a trace.
All spirit beast mounts perished completely.
Only over three thousand remained alive.
And these over three thousand were all wounded, in a very miserable state.
Even Jiang Cheng himself was stunned by this magnificent feat.
He initially only intended to disgust the Silence Sacred Land, cause some damage, and make them furious.
This Sacred Land eradicated the Witch Division with righteousness, forcing others to hand over people, completely unscrupulously.
It seemed fitting for him to handle it, bad ones have bad ones to fix them.
After all, it was a place full of experts, so he originally thought it would be amazing if a few thousand died.
Who knew he hadn’t even been killed and resurrected, and he had already wiped out the Sacred Land right ahead of time.

chapters.title: Chapter 131 Brothers, Charge!
chapters.content:
Chapter 131: Chapter 131 Brothers, Charge!
The people behind were dumbfounded.
Wu Rong, Xue Ji, and the remaining twenty thousand people all looked at the back of their ancestor.
The excitement and thrill faded away, replaced by panic and confusion.
What just happened?
What did I do?
Did I kill all those fellow disciples and elders with my own hands?
How could this happen?
They had a thousand questions buzzing in their heads, almost losing the ability to think.
Only their ancestor could provide them with answers to these questions.
If it weren’t for the ancestor’s lofty status, they would’ve put a sword to his throat to roar and question him.
Why?
Didn’t you say this was just a test to see if our strength had declined?
Didn’t you say we could attack with confidence since you’re here to back us up?
Why did it turn out like this?
However, there was no need for them to question any further.
"Who are you!"
"Damn it!"
"Invaders!"
More than fifty core high-ranking elders sitting in the main hall were all alive, as there were three Ascending to Saint experts seated there.
Although the attack came suddenly, they managed to block it.
But they couldn’t save those elders and disciples outside.
Now, only this single great hall remained on the main peak, everything else was turned to dust by that recent wave of volleys.
Sect Leader Venerable Mirror Origin was the first to rush out from the damaged hall, encapsulating thousands of miles in his Ascending to Saint Domain.
The other fifty or so elders, eyes raging with murderous intent, were all veteran Daoist Palace Ninth Layer experts, their might not any less than that of twenty thousand troops.
Venerable Mirror Ring and Supreme Elder Venerable Yuqu, both Ascending to Saint Realm, also opened their domains, trapping the ’invaders’ in the sky.
Everyone was on the brink of madness from the pain and hatred.
These people had lived for three million years, while younger ones had lived for hundreds of thousands of years.
Although they weren’t the founders of the sect from a million years ago, the Silence Sacred Land had been built little by little by them over the years.
The recent attack virtually destroyed the foundation of the Sacred Land.
Although the high ranks were still alive, more than seventy thousand disciples perished along with many young geniuses.
This sect has no future now.
This left them heartbroken, completely devastated.
But when they rushed outside, they were all stunned.
Most of the people before them were familiar.
Weren’t these their own disciples?
Were they responsible for this?
Why did they do it?
Seeing the Sect Leader and Supreme Elder charging out, each radiating fierce light with overflowing hatred, Wu Rong, Xue Ji, and others were scared stiff.
They were about to say something to explain when suddenly a thunderous shout interrupted them.
"Who are you!"
Venerable Mirror Ring angrily pointed at Jiang Cheng, both shocked and furious.
This person looked exactly like him, even possessing a nearly identical Ascending to Saint Realm aura.
He almost doubted his own existence, let alone others.
This Transformation Technique was undetectable, even by Immortals, let alone them.
"Who am I? I am your ancestor!"
Brother Cheng knew, upon performing this scene, the end was near; the other side wasn’t fools.
He didn’t give anyone a chance to speak, waving his hand and shouting to the twenty thousand behind him.
"Siblings of the Heart Division, the enemy is right in front!"
"No need to disguise, kill!"
Finally, Wu Rong, Xue Ji, and others realized.
So it was an imposter!
They had killed so many fellows under the command of a fake.
They were filled with regret and hatred.
They wanted to tear Jiang Cheng apart, no longer willing to listen to his commands.
Unfortunately, while they hesitated, someone moved.
Before the other side could make a move, Brother Cheng charged forward first.
It looked as though he was genuinely leading the so-called ’Heart Division’ army to attack.
