Faced with this scene, Venerable Mirror Origin, Venerable Mirror Ring, and Venerable Yuqu simultaneously launched attacks.
And the fifty or so core elders behind did not hesitate either.
Not only Jiang Cheng, but Wu Rong, Xue Ji, and others were also within their attack range.
Since Jiang Cheng, the ’Venerable Mirror Ring,’ was fake, the twenty thousand behind him must also be fake.
After all, they just killed those seventy thousand hands-on beneath them.
If they were indeed comrades, how could they do such heinous acts?
The evidence was clear!
Although they didn’t know how they transformed, even Ascending to Saint couldn’t see their true form. But the enemy was certain.
Damn Heart Division, too audacious!
Wu Rong, Xue Ji, and those twenty thousand didn’t have a chance to explain or prove themselves, as they were directly enveloped by the domains.
"Die!"
"Rend!"
"Slash!"
The three Ascending to Saint unleashed their Verbal Magic simultaneously.
Almost as soon as the first word was uttered, all cultivators under the Daoist Palace among those twenty thousand fell.
No resistance whatsoever, no exceptions.
The gap in realm was too vast.
And the few hundreds above the Daoist Palace didn’t fare well either.
Some had their arms fall off out of nowhere, some had hundreds of cracks and wounds appear all over.
Others had their Divine Souls severely wounded.
Even their Daoist Palaces couldn’t be summoned, let alone defend or counterattack to survive.
Then, the attacks from those fifty core elders arrived.
In the sky, colorful fireworks appeared once more.
Jiang Cheng, being the main target, naturally bore the brunt of the attacks.
However, those three words didn’t effectively impact him.
He didn’t carry Treasure, Spirit Talismans, or Spirit Arrays, but to avoid being controlled embarrassingly by Verbal Magic, he wore the Treasure Crown.
Under Saint Tier, all Divine Soul attacks were blocked by that lower-grade magical treasure.
Though Verbal Magic had some influence on him, it was negligible.
The major attack he faced came from the domains of the three Ascending to Saint experts.
Within this domain, the rules he was accustomed to had all changed.
Spiritual Power couldn’t flow freely, his whole body felt stuck in a spider’s web.
Yet under such circumstances, the Nine-Colored Daoist Palace still emerged strikingly.
The two Immortal Tier rivers surged like boiling water, crazily pushing the Martial Dao Marks, even attempting to break through the domain constraints.
The Poison Heroic Soul also operated unchecked, bit by bit corroding the opposing domain.
Although his attacks lacked enough power, and the corrosive effect was negligible, it was an absolute miracle.
This amazed Jiang Cheng immensely.
Damn, am I actually this powerful?
Isn’t it supposed to be that beneath Ascending to Saint, all are like ants?
He assumed a single hit would allow them to kill him effortlessly, without a peep from him.
With no choice, he couldn’t afford to fight passively, he had to keep pushing forward.
The three Ascending to Saint instantly focused all their attention on him.
The rules of the domain changed once more, cracks appeared in this part of the world.
The Nine-Colored Daoist Palace, after all, couldn’t withstand the realm difference, teetering, and rivers overturned.
Boom!
Finally, under the pressure and ripping of the domain, he exploded, cleanly disappearing.
It was only with his death that the battle finally wrapped up.
"Finally annihilated these fiends!"
"Damn Mingxin Sacred Land, daring to attack us proactively!"
"See who they really are after transformation!"

chapters.title: Chapter 132: 100,000 Fireflies Come to Pledge
chapters.content:
Chapter 132: Chapter 132: 100,000 Fireflies Come to Pledge
The twenty thousand people who were just killed, a small portion still left behind some remains.
Now that the battle was over, the elders, still seething with rage, rushed over to uncover their disguise in disbelief.
But soon, they realized something was amiss.
These deceased, each one showed their true appearance, with no disguise whatsoever.
Even if there were transformations, they should have been undone upon death.
Yet no matter what they did, the faces of these dead remained unchanged, not a single alteration.
How could this be?
Weren’t they from Mingxin Sacred Land?
Why are they still our own disciples?
Could it be that they killed the wrong ones?
Impossible!
They refused to believe this was true.
Yet the truth was right before their eyes, and soon they discovered even more unpleasant realities.
The spiritual artifacts these people used were also their own.
Some of them even had Holy Land’s cultivation and martial techniques secret arts inside their rings.
Lastly, upon checking their meridian and sea of qi, they found remnants of Holy Land techniques.
Everything pointed to one fact, the twenty thousand they just killed with their own hands were indeed their own disciples.
They were not invaders from Mingxin Sacred Land at all.
Venerable Mirror Origin stumbled towards a corpse and embraced it; it was his grand-disciple.
"Ah..."
"What on earth happened here?"
In retrospect, there were many strange points.
The Heart Division was not populous, merely over ten thousand in total, yet the opposing side had twenty thousand.
Moreover, how could so many people have infiltrated so easily?
And in the end, if it were indeed Mingxin Sacred Land attacking, how could they be so easily exterminated by them?
The Heart Division had five Ascending to Saint experts.
They were even stronger than them.
They were tricked.
First, they were deceived into fighting their own, and then they personally killed another batch of their own.
After two rounds of fratricidal slaughter, once with a hundred thousand disciples, Silence Sacred Land now had just over three thousand survivors.
Not to mention the inner and outer sect disciples, even among the 50 extraordinarily talented Saint Heirs, only two survived.
Silence Sacred Land truly collapsed entirely.
Not only the mountain gate, but even the peripheral affiliated forces went down with it.
"Revenge!"
"Blood for blood!"
Venerable Yuqu, who had maintained himself for many years without leaving the mountain, was now so agitated by the heart-wrenching pain that his aura became chaotic.
"Kill!"
"We must utterly exterminate the enemy!"
"I swear not to be human if this enmity is not avenged!"
All the survivors were ablaze with fury.
But now a problem lay before them.
Whom should they seek revenge upon?
They had no idea who was behind this.
The Heart Division?
Truthfully, they internally dismissed this possibility immediately.
Not to say that the Heart Division lacked such cunning and ruthlessness.
Even if they did, with their strength, they would have certainly wiped out all present Ascending to Saint realm individuals.
The only enemy they could confirm was the person who just impersonated Venerable Mirror Ring.
But Jiang Cheng was now completely dead and gone.
This anger had nowhere to vent, nearly driving them insane.
Poo!
Venerable Mirror Ring, overcome with rage and the previous heart demon, spat out a mouthful of blood on the spot.
The blow was too great for him.
"Mingxin Sacred Land!"
"We were about to attack them, so they must be connected to this somehow!"
"Whether they are or not, they must provide an explanation!"
His words immediately received a response from the other elders.
"We suffered heavy losses, why should they remain unscathed?"
"Contact the other major Sacred Lands and attack Mingxin Sacred Land!"
"Our sect has dwindled; only by exterminating Mingxin Sacred Land can we rid ourselves of the heart demon!"
The soul form of Brother Cheng listened silently to their words, feeling quite amused.
These people were truly top-grade.
If it hadn’t been for him, it would have been difficult to deal with them otherwise.
After all, their hearts were too black.
"Ding, host killed, detecting enemy strength, arranging resurrection plan."
The system’s prompt sounded as expected.
Brother Cheng kept chanting for a permanent upgrade, not wanting another one-minute trial version.
Although the previous verbal magic curse trial was thrilling and violent.
But it was too brief, not matching Brother Cheng’s style at all.
"Ding, a hundred thousand cultivators killed, unconscious lingering spirit with a lasting obsession, seeking the strongest being to avenge them..."
"Host’s Poison Heroic Soul is the highest tier soul body on the field, drawing the hundred thousand souls, voluntarily coming forward to awaken the host to wreak vengeance for them!"
Though Jiang Cheng was used to the system’s wicked humor, the resurrection plan still left him frantically wanting to complain.
Where did all those souls come from?
After wiping out so many sects before, never had he heard of any lingering spirit obsession!
And in essence, it was he who wiped out those hundred thousand people.
Yet they sought him for vengeance assistance?
Couldn’t the system be any more underhanded?
It would be better to just unleash a big move instead of toying with him!
But once the system’s plan started, he couldn’t stop it.
Soon, everyone present witnessed a wondrous spectacle.
From the bodies of those killed, one after another, little fireflies began to drift up, some light green, some dark green, some light blue, some pale purple...
The colors varied, yet it was breathtakingly beautiful.
Even those without any bodies left, similar fireflies floated up from different angles.
Handfuls of a hundred thousand fireflies slowly ascended into the sky.
Though small, the sheer number was incredibly grand and deeply awe-inspiring!
All the elders were taken aback.
"This, these are the souls of our deceased disciples?"
"Yes, they must be!"
"My apprentice, my apprentice is still here..."
"I can sense their aura..."
"Where are they going?"
The Soul Splitting Realm could accomplish divine soul detachment while alive.
But once dead, the soul perishes, unless one reaches Saint tier to possibly preserve a residual soul, forming a tangible existence.
And immortals like Mo Chen, even their residual souls have formidable attack power after death.
For those below Ascending to Saint, even if a soul survives after death, it wouldn’t transform into such a visually perceivable firefly state.
Jiang Cheng was well aware, this was again the system’s doing.
Before many witnesses, all the souls surged toward his soul position.
Because the Poison Heroic Soul was his.
He was floating in the air, so the souls also all drifted to him.
A hundred thousand firefly souls, gathering together, like the stars in the sky.
The man himself didn’t know what to say.
What kind of situation was this?
The enemy’s souls entering his body, seeking vengeance through him, sounded so bizarre.
Luckily these souls were unconscious, retaining only an obsession for revenge.
Otherwise, they’d probably come to gang up on him rather than join him.
Suddenly, he was taken aback.
Because he realized his Divine Soul Realm was rapidly soaring.
In the blink of an eye, he broke through Daoist Palace Fifth Layer.
A few seconds later, he broke through Daoist Palace Sixth Layer.
And it showed no signs of stopping.
Countless fragments rushed into the depths of his divine soul, almost causing him to pass out.

chapters.title: Chapter 133: Crazy Breakthrough
chapters.content:
Chapter 133: Chapter 133: Crazy Breakthrough
On the other side, the core leaders of Silence Sacred Land were quite excited.
They watched the firefly-like ghostly spirits continuously converging toward a specific location, not knowing what was happening.
"Where... are they going?"
"Below Ascending to Saint, the manifestation of spirits is a miracle!"
"They must be too unwilling, moved the heavens, hence such a miracle descended!"
"Heaven won’t forsake us Silence Sacred Land, this is a consolation from the heavens..."
"I hope that the junior can come back to life!"
Venerable Yuqu, who had seen all sorts of worldly matters, let two streams of turbid tears flow from his dim eyes.
Wasn’t this scene indeed quite touching for them?
The Supreme Elder suddenly made an astonishing move.
In the Void, he slowly knelt down and bowed three times toward the place where the spirits were converging.
As a Supreme Elder, it can be said that ninety-nine percent of the disciples couldn’t see him throughout their lives.
Even if they did see him, they wouldn’t dare to look up.
The gap in power and status was too immense between them.
Besides, even if the juniors died, the seniors wouldn’t need to pay their respects.
Now, he was bowing to them entirely because of the unending succession of changes causing an overwhelming stir in his emotions.
"Go on, all of you"
Sect Leader Venerable Mirror Origin also knelt down.
"I hope your spirits in the skies blessing us Silence Sacred Land to rise once again to glory!"
Great Elder Venerable Mirror Ring also knelt.
"Bless us in our first battle to achieve overwhelming victory, to slay Mingxin Sacred Land, and forever suppress that witch Lan Ti!"
Soon after, all of the remaining fifty senior leaders knelt down as well.
These ruthless old foxes, were unexpectedly sentimental this time.
And all of the surviving over three thousand disciples, without exception.
Everyone knelt before Jiang Cheng’s soul location, expressions incomparably solemn, emotions immensely heavy, gazes exceedingly reverent.
Unfortunately, Brother Cheng was currently overwhelmed, unable to savor this delightful moment.
He was amidst a world of ice and fire, in both pain and pleasure.
The pain was due to the influx of a hundred thousand spirits; although they lacked independent consciousness after death, they still retained a tremendous amount of pure experience.
What’s the concept of experiences from a hundred thousand people?
Some lived for hundreds of years, some for thousands or tens of thousands, and some even nearly a million years.
Most of their experiences were within these spirit fragments; even one person’s was enough for him to digest well, let alone a hundred thousand.
Within these experiences, there were trivial daily matters, secluded cultivation, and training past experiences.
If not for the system forcibly helping him absorb, he might not withstand three people’s worth before being overwhelmed to lose his self into an idiot.
Because his experiences were less rich than even the youngest among these people.
With the system’s help, this absorption disregarded common sense.
No matter how large, all were absorbed without omission.
His Divine Soul Realm quickly surpassed the Ascending to Saint Barrier, yet it didn’t stop.
Ascending to Saint First Layer!
Ascending to Saint Second Layer!
Ascending to Saint Third Layer!
A hundred thousand spirits were indeed too immense.
If they were ordinary people it’s fine, but the crux was that these were all cultivators.
Each had hundreds, thousands, tens of thousands, even hundreds of thousands of years of cultivation experience; their divine souls were already exceedingly powerful.
Thousands were in the Daoist Palace Realm.
While the spirits weren’t their entire divine soul, this staggering quantity piled together was ultimately unfathomable.
Ascending to Saint Fourth Layer!
Ascending to Saint Fifth Layer!
Ascending to Saint Sixth Layer!
Poor Brother Cheng had never even been an Ascending to Saint cultivator, completely bewildered by it all.
He only knew his divine soul was becoming increasingly large.
If before, his Daoist Palace Realm divine soul was a small lake, it now had become a vast ocean, still crazily expanding.
Ascending to Saint Seventh Layer!
Ascending to Saint Eighth Layer!
Ascending to Saint Ninth Layer!
Boom!
He seemed to see something explode open, a white emptiness before him.
The sensation was like entering an entirely new world suddenly.
Starting from Soul Splitting Realm, cultivators began to understand divine souls, and cultivation started to involve this domain.
All the way from Spirit Platform, Celestial Fate, Daoist Palace, Ascending to Saint...
By now, the divine soul finally underwent a qualitative transformation!
His divine soul realm had reached the Saint Tier level.
At this point, only a few thousand of those hundred thousand spirits were left.
When this final part fully merged, his divine soul realm thoroughly stabilized at Early-stage Saint Tier.
"Ding, Host has officially resurrected!"
This was indeed the most prolonged resurrection process yet.
Full two minutes, far beyond the 30 seconds resurrection the system initially mentioned.
But in truth, when those hundred thousand ghosts surged in, he was considered resurrected.
After resurrection, he saw the group of elders kneeling uniformly before him.
"What the hell, what are you doing?"
"Did you know I’m going to slaughter everywhere, kneeling early to beg for mercy?"
These two sentences startled everyone present.
Venerable Yuqu and Venerable Mirror Origin hurriedly stood, but did not recognize the young man before them.
"Who are you?"
"Could it be you are the embodiment of our hundred thousand disciples?"
At this time, Jiang Cheng had restored his true appearance, no longer the previous altered visage, which they had never seen, only feeling this lad really damn handsome.
His figure, his demeanor, that faintly discernible mysterious aura, all looked exceedingly extraordinary, far beyond all previous Saint Heirs!
Probably only the hundred thousand spirits converging could create such a unique existence, right?
Their fanciful thoughts were interrupted by Venerable Mirror Ring’s furious roar.
"It’s you!"
"It’s unexpectedly you, that scoundrel!"
He recognized Jiang Cheng.
This time attacking Mingxin Sacred Land, others were targeting Lan Ti; only he was wholly focused on figuring out how to kill that bastard.
"I should have guessed it; only you can be so cunning and ruthless!"
The old man’s eyes emitted fury, immediately deploying his domain again.
"What?"
"He’s an enemy?"
The remaining experts startled, quickly summoned their treasures and Daoist Palaces, surrounding Jiang Cheng.
Indeed, this conforms to the routine!
If pleading for mercy, wouldn’t I lose the chance to show off?
"You’re the one who turned into Venerable Mirror Ring just now?"
The Supreme Elder’s face was expressionless, even his tone devoid of emotion.
But the more so, the more it was a prelude to thunderous fury.
"Yes, it was me. I always leave my name when doing good deeds." Sect Leader Jiang remained honest.
"Why are you still alive?"
"Causing the death of our sect’s hundred thousand disciples, it seems even heaven doesn’t wish to receive you, intending us to punish you..."
This time, the show-off mode was permanent, Brother Cheng wasn’t in a hurry.
But towards Venerable Yuqu’s remark, he wished to voice an opinion.
"Hey, old man, you’re mistaken. Those two thousand were killed by your own hands just now."
"You want to avenge someone, right?"
"Then hurry and commit suicide; you’re the most direct culprits yourselves."
A set of words left the already furious group of elders fuming in pain.
Yet they couldn’t refute.
They were indeed the most direct culprits.
If they had asked a few more questions just now, been a bit more patient and careful, at least the last two thousand wouldn’t have died.
But everyone deliberately avoided this point.
Actually, this incident was a thorn in their hearts.
Now, Jiang Cheng openly pointed it out.

chapters.title: Chapter 134: Power Soars
chapters.content:
Chapter 134: Chapter 134: Power Soars
"What? When it’s your turn, you’re unwilling to die?"
"Weren’t you yelling for revenge just now?"
"Hurry up and do it..."
Brother Cheng knew they couldn’t possibly commit suicide, but it was still satisfying to disgust them a bit.
"Kill him!"
Venerable Mirror Ring could no longer bear it.
They were more powerful, so why bother wasting time arguing?
"He’s the culprit, kill him first!"
"Right, no matter what, the culprit must die first!"
"We can’t let him die so easily!"
Everyone acted as if they received a cue, attacking simultaneously.
The domains of three Ascending to Saint experts unfolded again, enveloping the sole target.
The rules changed once more...
Facing all this, Jiang Cheng calmly summoned his Daoist Palace.
The recent infusion of a hundred thousand souls enhanced his Divine Soul realm, but his Spiritual Power realm remained unchanged.
Still at the Fourth Layer of the Daoist Palace.
However, some things inevitably transformed.
For instance, the Nine-Colored Daoist Palace.
Initially, apart from two Immortal Tier rivers, the rest weren’t even King Level, just True Sect Level.
Brother Cheng wasn’t interested in experiencing or comprehending various Martial Dao.
So his Martial Dao realm, except for the Five Elements and Nine Palaces elevated by the Daoist Celestial Immortal Rhyme, was quite lacking and shallow.
Now that his Daoist Palace emerged, nine great rivers hung from the sky, and the remaining seven had all reached Saint Level!
It was the influx of a hundred thousand souls, encapsulating all their cultivation experiences.
All these people were below the Ascending to Saint, but their insights and Martial Dao were varied and rich.
Accumulating them all, even the Peak of Saint Tier couldn’t compare.
Especially the Martial Dao Mark of Seven Emotions and Six Desires, now just a step away from Immortal Tier.
Jiang Cheng couldn’t help wanting to hug and kiss the system.
I was wrong; I misunderstood you at first.
This resurrection skill was too powerful, compensating for his past lack of experience and shallow foundation.
It made this his strongest aspect among cultivators of the same tier.
Throughout the Lower Realm Ten Thousand Realms, including the Saint Tier, no one had his experiences, insights, or deep accumulation.
He still didn’t master any domains, but it was enough.
Because he possessed a Saint Tier Divine Soul.
Once his Divine Soul emerged, it swept through like a hurricane tsunami.
The three domains shattered simultaneously, unable to hold together.
The three Ascending to Saint experts turned pale as gold, like struck by lightning, spitting blood, and their spirits waned.
Domains were strong, but when broken, they suffered a backlash from the rules.
This backlash struck deep into their Martial Dao foundations, utterly indefensible!
The fifty or so Daoist Palace realm cultivators were similarly attacked.
Their Daoist Palaces were instantly broken by the Saint Tier Divine Soul, then their souls faced the direct wash of Saint Tier power.
Like weak flames snuffed out by a gust of wind.
Jiang Cheng didn’t need to wield a sword or use any technique; they perished instantly.
The remaining three thousand had no ability to resist.
They fell silently in unison.
With just a thought, only three Ascending to Saints were left alive on the battlefield.
Jiang Cheng finally understood how the Three-Eyed Tiger could annihilate everyone with a thought.
This was the gap in Divine Soul tier!
Especially at the Saint Tier, fundamentally different from Ascending to Saint.
Before the battle, he’d weaken the enemy, enjoying it; but during the fight, he never dawdled.
Seeing the three Ascending to Saints wounded by rule backlash, he attacked with his Divine Soul, targeting their innermost souls.
With that vast experience of a hundred thousand battles, he totally knew how to leverage his strengths and avoid weaknesses.
Since the Divine Soul could crush, there was no need to engage in Martial Techniques Secret Techniques or Magical Treasures.
Because in those areas, and Spiritual Power accumulation, he was far inferior to true Ascending to Saints.
Deliberately confining the battle to clashes of Divine Soul and rules was the best choice.
The three Ascending to Saints were utterly bewildered, unable to comprehend this.
Clearly just a Daoist Palace realm, yet giving them a dreadful sense of needing to look up, with no end in sight.
They couldn’t believe it, desperately reforming their domains, only to be easily destroyed again by Jiang Cheng.
Thus, they suffered another severe backlash.
At this moment, the Saint Tier Divine Soul charged deep into their consciousness.
Exterminate!
The word echoed simultaneously in their minds.
This was the Verbal Magic.
All disciples of the Silence Sacred Land had learned it, and nearly all of the hundred thousand souls had insights in this area.
Though the mastery and effect varied among individuals.
A Daoist Palace realm might utter a single word to extinguish a Spirit Platform Mirror, but against Celestial Fate realm, it wouldn’t instantly eliminate it.
However, Jiang Cheng now possessed a Saint Tier Divine Soul, one tier above the three Ascending to Saints.
Coupled with their extreme weakness from the backlash, riddled with vulnerabilities.
That word ’exterminate’ became the final mountain to crush them.
Their eyes simultaneously dimmed.
Their Divine Soul flames extinguished, then they fell from the sky, lifeless.
The battle of Silence Sacred Land came to a complete end!
Jiang Cheng slowly descended, his Saint Tier aura receded, the surroundings seeming more vibrant.
His power against a true Saint Tier was still lacking.
After all, he didn’t possess some abilities expected at the Ascending to Saint realm, let alone Saint Tier.
However, with just this Saint Tier Divine Soul, he could rank among the top experts in the Lower Realm.
"Had I known this power up would let me battle and sweep the field, I would’ve invited them to watch."
He regrettably shook his head.
Then began collecting the spoils of war.
The haul this time was tremendous.
Just the three Ascending to Saints possessed three Magical Treasures.
Though lower grade, they were still Magical Treasures.
Thinking of taking all his disciples into the Void Immortal Realm, he wondered if the Xuanji Map could protect them then.
He decided to keep these three Magical Treasures for now.
It’s good to have more Magical Treasures.
After collecting over ten thousand Storage Rings on site, he couldn’t be bothered to count them, as it was overwhelming.
Top-grade Spirit Stones and Spirit Pills were countless; he exchanged them mechanically, feeling numb.
Over fifty thousand Treasure Pills, far exceeding the 60-plus from the Qianxing Dynasty, which seemed bankrupt by comparison.
More than two thousand Tier Eight Spiritual Artifacts, and 345 Tier Nine Spiritual Artifacts.
All remaining were above Tier Six...
He suddenly felt that the previous rewards he gave his disciples were indeed trash.
Besides Spiritual Artifacts, there were 55 Treasures.
And stacks of Tier Seven and Tier Nine Spirit Talismans and Treasure Talismans, which unfortunately weren’t used before they died.
This time, unlike before, he didn’t rampage around the various peaks, as this place was to become the sect’s new base.
He didn’t exchange all the contents in the Storage Rings either.
He left plenty of Pills and Spirit Stones for the disciples’ cultivation.
After all, in the Xuanji Map, one day outside equals 3600 days inside, so they consumed Pills too fast.
If he, as Sect Leader, couldn’t earn enough, the sect would’ve gone bankrupt long ago.
Eventually, after careful exchange, his points settled at 358,740,000, over three hundred million!

chapters.title: Chapter 135: 10x Attack
chapters.content:
Chapter 135: Chapter 135: 10x Attack
This many points, already exceed the requirements for upgrading.
Opened the system panel, consumed one billion points, and the system upgraded once again.
Level: 7
Points: 0/1000000000
Available Points: 258746632
Current Skill: Host can resurrect any target once, with no cooldown time.
Note: The higher the target’s realm and the longer since death, the more points consumed.
Subordinate Skill: Host can consume points to make the next attack have a 10x critical strike effect, cooldown time one day.
Note: The higher the host’s realm, the more points consumed.
Brother Cheng opened his mouth, not knowing how to evaluate the new skill of the next level.
For someone else, they might be excited to the point of madness.
10x critical strike, if only his attack just now could have increased by 10 times power, then...
Then there’d be no point in fighting at all.
A divine soul sweep could have obliterated those three Ascending to Saint Realm cultivators instantly, without waiting for them to be backfired by the rules and then exploiting the loophole.
Oh, if the power increased 10 times, then Silence Sacred Land probably wouldn’t have many places left intact either.
The power is too overwhelming.
One could say, even if the Three-Eyed Tiger, this Demon King, stood in front of him, he might have to drink a few jars.
A 10x Divine Soul Attack would already reach the peak of Saint Tier level.
And the Three-Eyed Tiger, this Demon King, is merely at the early stage of Saint Tier.
Jiang Cheng is currently just at Daoist Palace Fourth Stage, and this is absolutely a divine technique for killing above one’s level, simple and brutal, directly breaking common sense!
But he wasn’t as excited as imagined.
Becoming stronger, doesn’t that mean it’s harder to die?
If it’s hard to die, then how would he activate the Resurrection skill?
Look at today’s gift from ten thousand souls, it suddenly pushed his power level up multiple times.
If he practiced cultivation himself, even with medicinal assistance, his divine soul wouldn’t reach this realm in thousands of years.
This is already rocket speed, considering his exceptional talent aptitude.
For an average Saint Heir, it might take ten thousand or even hundreds of thousands of years, even without considering the bottlenecks of comprehension.
Actually, there are many who are stuck for millions of years at a certain layer in the Ascending to Saint Realm.
Given Brother Cheng’s personality, how could he endure such exhausting ascetic cultivation.
His goal has always been to die more times, preferably dying his way into becoming a supreme powerhouse, so he wouldn’t have to sweat and toil.
Just like the disciples in the Xuanji Map, advancing by leaps and bounds, he doesn’t envy them at all.
Instead, he secretly sympathizes with them, how tiring, how boring!
Fortunately, this skill can be used only once per day at most.
For the first time, he felt grateful for the cooldown time.
Looking at the remaining more than 200 million points, he sighed and decided not to draw a lottery for now.
Level up sooner and see if there’s any stronger skills.
For instance, something to increase charm value, making all beauties fall head over heels to pounce on him and refusing to marry anyone else.
After flying a few circles, he roughly understood this Silence Sacred Land.
It spans a full hundred thousand miles in area.
The Spirit Vein is Tier Six, fully comparable to the Heart Division from before.
Various Heavenly and Earthly Treasures, rare outside, could be found everywhere here.
Within the sect, the cultivation treasure vault, classics, great array, trial, restrictions, and other facilities were all complete, making him overjoyed.
Here is actually considered a secret realm, developed by using mana by generations of Ascending to Saint Realm cultivators to such an extent.
After taking control of the great array and restrictions everywhere, he temporarily sealed the secret realm.
At this time, the cultivators outside had long fled without a trace.
No one knew the Silence Sacred Land has been destroyed, leaving Brother Cheng somewhat melancholic, with a sense of regret for having flaunted without any applause.
"Doing great deeds yet remaining so unknown, there really aren’t many low-key people like me."
He sighed, only then did he fly away.
On the other side, Lan Ti’s mood wasn’t as good as his.
"Why hasn’t he returned yet?"
"Could he have met with some accident?"
Mo Chen was squatting on the ground playing stones with Ah Huang, an old and a young enjoying themselves.
This immortal naturally didn’t have such ’elegant’ interests.
But even fools could see Ah Huang was not a mortal object, enhancing spirit vein quality wasn’t something that even existed in the Immortal Realm.
Especially this girl had the identity of a Sect Leader’s daughter.
Mo Chen, who considered himself a personal grandmaster, found it perfectly reasonable to get acquainted with his daughter to mix better in the inner circle around the Child of the Plane.
After mixing in the Immortal Realm for so many years, he was quite a worldly man.
Seeing Lan Ti anxious like ants on a hot pan, he couldn’t help but chuckle.
"The Sect Leader went out less than an hour ago, going back and forth naturally takes time, Miss Lan, please stay calm."
He easily accepted Lan Ti, this woman.
A Child of the Plane has a hallmark of great romantic fortune, attracting beauties from all walks of life effortlessly.
It seems she’s one of them?
But ultimately still a young person, unable to maintain composure.
"Aren’t you worried at all?"
"A blessed man like the Sect Leader will be safe, no need to worry needlessly."
Why worry about a Child of the Plane, even in deadly situations, they can turn danger into safety with the help of luck.
Especially the Sect Leader’s luck is stronger than any Child of the Plane he has ever heard of.
Silence Sacred Land, just a piece of cake.
This indifferent attitude was something Lan Ti could not accept at all.
Isn’t he an elder of the Feixian Sect? Why is he as indifferent as a bystander?
"After all, he’s only at Daoist Palace Fourth Stage, there are many at Daoist Palace over there, plus under the eyes of Ascending to Saint Realm, it’s hard for him to hide."
"No worries, no worries..."
With just a fan in Mo Chen’s hand, he could pull off the profound appearance with feather fan and silk bonnet.
"No, I must go and see!"
"He’s avenging me, I can’t sit by and do nothing!"
Oh-ho, this girl drawn to the Child of the Plane sticks to loyalty indeed.
Mo Chen secretly nodded approvingly.
Women like this are common in the Mortal World, but actually rare in the Cultivation Realm.
Everyone’s pursuing cultivation to become stronger and ascend, often taking a dim view of worldly matters, which is why cultivators tend to be cold and selfish.
"Miss Lan, hear an old me out, the Sect Leader won’t meet with any mishap on this journey."
In his eyes, any arrangement of the Child of the Plane, no matter how irrational it seems to ordinary folks, aligns with luck under the Heavenly Dao.
If an insider intervenes, even if to save, it disrupts luck.
"Hmm?"
Lan Ti was startled, already half in the sky, and stopped again.
"How can you say so definitively?"
Mo Chen pinched a seal: "Didn’t the Sect Leader tell you, this old one was an immortal descended to the mortal world, what’s a fortune telling?"
This woman is destined to be in the core circle of the Child of the Plane, he might even have to call her the mistress someday.
So he didn’t hide it.
"What, you’re an immortal?"
Lan Ti almost fell from mid-air.
Looking from every angle, she couldn’t see what part of Elder Mo seemed like an immortal.
And because of the Celestial Dao Rule’s existence, people from the Immortal Realm couldn’t come down, except those nine from the Void Immortal Realm who accidentally descended back then.
"Miss Lan seemingly doesn’t believe."
Mo Chen faintly smiled, releasing a wisp of his Immortal Soul aura.

chapters.title: Chapter 136: Already Destroyed
chapters.content:
Chapter 136: Chapter 136: Already Destroyed
Lan Ti had never seen an Immortal, nor did she know what an Immortal Soul looked like.
But at least she had seen a Divine Soul of Ascending to Saint Ninth Layer.
Mo Chen’s Immortal Soul, though weakened due to residual damage, still exuded a sacred and vast aura.
That was something utterly unattainable to Ascending to Saint.
It made her feel fear from the depths of her heart, as if she was facing not an ordinary old man, but a prehistoric giant beast.
"Are you... really an Immortal?"
"That’s right."
Mo Chen felt a bit amused in his heart.
Though he had no stature in front of Jiang Cheng, completely unable to show the superiority of his Immortal identity.
But in front of others, he could at least put on a show.
Lan Ti finally calmed down and asked, puzzled: "Then why don’t you help him eradicate the Silence Sacred Land?"
Mo Chen shrugged helplessly: "I am just in Residual Soul state, my power is not even a ten thousandth of my peak state."
Turns out he’s a fallen Immortal.
However, Lan Ti truly believed him.
"Will he really be okay?"
"Of course."
Mo Chen couldn’t really predict the future, but he could guess.
"If the old me is correct, the Sect Leader will not only come out unscathed but also gain some rewards this time."
According to those Child of the Plane patterns, when encountering perils, they often gain some treasures.
The Sect Leader’s fortune is strong, shouldn’t it be the same?
In light of his Immortal identity, Lan Ti took his word.
Moments later, Jiang Cheng really returned.
"See, the old me wasn’t wrong."
Mo Chen stroked his smooth chin with a leisurely smile.
Indeed, believing in the fortune of the Child of the Plane would never be wrong, casually spinning tales won’t ever backfire.
Lan Ti quickly greeted him.
"Jiang Cheng, that’s great, as long as you’re okay!"
The daughter also threw the stone aside and dashed over.
"Mom, where is our new home, I really want to go back to the Spirit Vein."
Brother Cheng felt helpless, this daughter was already with the physique of an eleven-year-old, yet always climbing on him, once again occupying his shoulder.
"Our new home has been found, let’s set off now."
As Mo Chen returned the previously entrusted rings to him, he asked: "Sect Leader, aren’t you waiting for that Three-eyed Demon Tiger?"
He purposely emphasized the word ’Demon’, intending to remind the Sect Leader that the relationship with the demon should still be kept at bay.
"Why wait for it?"
Brother Cheng rolled his eyes, carrying his daughter as he flew into the sky once more.
Lan Ti quickly and anxiously chased after him.
"Where are you going, you are about to reach the mountain gate of the Silence Sacred Land forward!"
"I know."
"I suggest you wait for the Three-eyed Tiger senior to arrive before planning, moving forward, there’s a high chance we might be discovered by them with so many of us."
This person was fine everywhere, just seemed a bit heedless, did he ever think before acting?
"Them? They no longer exist."
"What do you mean?"
Lan Ti was taken aback.
Brother Cheng was waiting for this question, holding it in along the way.
Once again, he raised his head to look at the sky, one hand clasped behind as the other had to hold his daughter on his shoulder.
Casually he said: "I just wiped out the Silence Sacred Land."
"What?"
"What did you say?"
Mo Chen and Lan Ti exclaimed at the same time.
Indeed, even Mo Chen, who was an Immortal, was shocked.
He had just guessed that not only would Jiang Cheng get through unscathed, but he might also gain some treasures, which was already an extremely high regard for the Power of Fortune of the Child of the Plane.
Who would have thought he actually wiped out such a massive Sacred Land.
How was that even possible?
After all, he was only at Daoist Palace Fourth Stage, even with hacks he couldn’t pull off such a feat!
Next, his eyes widened.
"S-Sect Leader, your Divine Soul..."
Lan Ti couldn’t detect Divine Soul Realm, she could only see Spiritual Power Realm. Mo Chen was different, after all, he was once an Immortal.
Going out and coming back, the Sect Leader had become early-stage Saint Tier Divine Soul!
This was insane!
How did he do it?
Cultivation required an accumulation process, didn’t it?
Was this fortune strong enough to disregard native rules of heaven and earth?
Even the Immortal himself had such a shocked reaction, Brother Cheng’s desire to show off was greatly satisfied.
He nodded lightly: "That’s right, it’s just as you see."
Mo Chen was convinced.
He now really wanted to thank the heavens, letting him fall to the Lower Realm millions of years ago.
Otherwise, how would he have the chance to become this man’s Personal Grandmaster?
He dared to bet, this man’s fortune was absolutely more exaggerated than anyone else in the Immortal Realm.
Even that Profound Luo Immortal Emperor back then couldn’t compare.
Riding this carriage, he was likely to become a dominion of the Immortal Realm in the future.
His thoughts, Lan Ti couldn’t guess, she was still doubting.
"Jiang Cheng, don’t joke like that."
"Can’t you be more down-to-earth?"
Although Jiang Cheng’s talent left her in awe, she never thought about exterminating the Silence Sacred Land.
Wasn’t he just scouting?
Did he eradicate the Silence Sacred Land during his scout?
Brother Cheng was eager for her skepticism.
If she easily believed him, wouldn’t it make his accomplishments seem ordinary and plain?
The satisfaction from showing off would be greatly diminished.
"We’ll see if it’s true, won’t we?"
Carrying his daughter, he streaked a stream of light across the Long Sky.
"Miss Lan, the old me suggests trusting the Sect Leader, some people are destined for miracles."
After saying this seemingly profound and actually hollow statement, the old fellow hurriedly chased after.
As if he had already seen through everything, it wasn’t him who almost dropped his jaw in shock just now.
With the Immortal’s words, Lan Ti hesitantly followed along.
The four soon arrived at the entrance to the Secret Realm.
"Huh, why is there no one?"
"Be careful of a trap!"
This place, Lan Ti had been here before.
However, previously she had always sneaked around in disguise.
The Silence Sacred Land wiped out the last batch of Witch Division clansmen ten years ago, she hated them tremendously, naturally, she would occasionally come to scout.
Yet each time she could only peek from the outside.
This Secret Realm, outsiders couldn’t get in.
Because it not only required specific Verbal Magic but also needed Holy Land Disciples’ unique Divine Soul fluctuations.
Only this way, could one gain entry from the restriction.
Then she saw Jiang Cheng casually whistle, and that restriction gate just opened like that.
"H-How did you do that?"
"I’ve already told you, I’ve wiped out this place, of course, I’m the new owner."
With those words, the restriction closed tight again.
Jiang Cheng casually snapped his fingers, and the restriction opened again.
"Aren’t you coming in?"
Seeing him tease this troublesome restriction that had troubled her for years like a dog, Lan Ti was completely numb.
Could it be, what he said was true?
Was the Silence Sacred Land really wiped out by him?
The four quickly entered inside.
She immediately prepared for battle.
However, this gesture was obviously unnecessary.
Flying all the way through, it was calm and quiet.
Aside from a few Spirit Birds occasionally flying above, she felt no trace of living beings.
The entire Silence Sacred Land seemed to have only the four of them.
Flying into the core depths, she finally saw the battlefield from the previous battle, and the wreckage and remains from the aftermath.
The Silence Sacred Land had indeed been eradicated.
Her vengeance had been completed.

chapters.title: Chapter 137: Earth-Shattering Transformation
chapters.content:
Chapter 137: Chapter 137: Earth-Shattering Transformation
"How did you accomplish this?"
She probed with her divine thought and instantly saw the corpses of Venerable Mirror Origin and Venerable Mirror Ring.
These two had been the culprits behind the invasion of the Witch Division back then, a memory she couldn’t forget.
Over the years, she would occasionally relive those gruesome scenes in her dreams.
Among the dead were also those top core figures.
She would recognize them even if they were turned to ashes.
These people had almost become her nightmare, and now, every single one of them was dead.
Even Supreme Elder Venerable Yuqu was no exception.
Jiang Cheng shrugged, "With power."
Lan Ti really wanted to say, "Just you?"
Anyone ascending to Saint could handle it.
Yet, the facts laid before her were undeniable, more convincing than anything.
Could other external forces have exterminated Silence Sacred Land, and Jiang Cheng picked up the fruits?
No, that’s impossible.
The battle was confined to the vicinity of the main hall and barely looked like it was ravaged by a large group.
Moreover, why would external forces leave the place intact waiting for them to come?
She refrained from asking Jiang Cheng about his methods further.
She just slowly walked up to him.
In Brother Cheng’s bewildering gaze, she opened her arms and tightly embraced him.
"Thank you!"
Holding soft jade in his embrace, it would be a lie to say he wasn’t intoxicated.
Feeling the tremble of the beauty in his arms, he noticed his shoulder was wet.
His flirtatious thoughts hence vanished.
Gently patting Lan Ti’s back, he sighed.
For the first time, he felt that aside from showing off, he had done a good deed.
But soon he became annoyed again.
Given all this, the system hadn’t even made a ding—a sign that Lan Ti still isn’t his?
Isn’t this too ridiculous?
Could it possibly be that she’s still acting now?
If so, Brother Cheng would willingly call her the strongest actress in history.
"Hey, how should these bodies be handled? Buried for peace?"
In the past, he’d leave after destroying a sect; now he truly lacked experience as he intended to make this place a base.
Lan Ti wiped her reddened eyes and separated from him.
"Leave it to me," she said.
Her gaze turned cold as she spoke.
The corpses and remains scattered around swiftly gathered under her command, then purple flames shoot to the sky, grinding bones and scattering ashes...
Damn, so ruthless?
Brother Cheng didn’t mind; if this woman was a saint, it would truly be a headache.
After the cleanup, he found his daughter missing again.
Soon, the concentration of spiritual qi here soared rapidly.
Perhaps she had suffered for too long in the Forbidden Land back then, this girl couldn’t move at all when seeing a Spirit Vein now.
But this was good, as her presence quickly elevated the Spirit Vein in the secret realm to a Tier Eight degree.
In the Lower Realm, this was almost unheard of in terms of Spirit Vein tiers.
Most Sacred Lands had Tier Six Spirit Veins, with only a few top Sacred Lands having a Saint Tier guardians, reaching Tier Seven.
With the formation of a Tier Eight Spirit Vein, changes occurred across the secret realm.
The sprawling vegetation mutated into spirit medicine, and the planted Tier Seven and Tier Eight spirit medicine began transforming towards Tier Nine or even higher levels.
The main peaks seemed to come alive, expanding vigorously.
Becoming increasingly towering and majestic, the scenery was vast and varied.
Some low-tier spirit beasts started to ascend as the surge of spiritual qi pushed them to break through.
Mo Chen couldn’t help but marvel, "Although there isn’t Immortal Yuan Qi, the cultivation here could nearly match some barren areas of the Immortal Realm."
Is the Immortal Realm really that awesome?
Even barren places have this level?
No wonder all cultivators in the Lower Realm are eager to rise up.
Suddenly, he recalled something; having changed the sect, he must let the disciples out to familiarize themselves.
He quickly released everyone from the Xuanji Map.
Upon releasing them, his points began to soar rapidly.
It surged a full 363 million before stopping.
Over 3 billion, even Brother Cheng, who had prepared himself mentally, was shocked.
This way of nurturing disciples to earn points was way faster than annihilating sects!
Compared to that, enhancing talent and the consumption of spirit stone elixirs were insignificant.
"Sect Leader!"
"Sect Leader, you’ve finally remembered us!"
"Boo hoo, I was going crazy inside, practicing every day."
As they were released, some clung to him, refusing to let go, and others had tearful eyes.
Ji Linghan, Lin Ning, and the other ladies had a deep resentment, seemingly blaming him for being away so long this time.
Jiang Cheng felt a bit embarrassed yet also gratified.
The disciples were still their old selves, but every realm had changed drastically.
Ji Linghan and Lin Ning had both reached Daoist Palace Ninth Layer!
As for other disciples, 55 were between Daoist Palace First, Second, and Third Layer.
The rest were at Celestial Fate Ninth Layer, evidently stuck at this bottleneck for a while.
This progress was truly astonishing, but upon reflection, it made sense.
Their minimum talent was Fourth-class, comparable to Mo Chen’s First-class Immortal talent.
No inferior to some Saint Heirs of major Sacred Lands.
Before entering, Mo Chen had guided them in cultivation techniques.
Inside, the longest stay had been 1500 years, while the shortest was 1000 years.
Coupled with ample pills and spirit stones, slow cultivation would be unreasonable.
This logic held, yet even Mo Chen, who understood the circumstances, felt it was a bit excessive.
Only several months had passed outside!
Such cultivation left the original inhabitants of the Immortal Realm behind in dust.
If even he thought this, much more did the uninformed Lan Ti.
She once disguised as a palace maid and had been to Feixian Sect, seeing these disciples.
At that time, the highest among them were merely at Spirit Platform Realm.
The rest were mostly at Gathering Yuan Realm.
If not for Jiang Cheng and the Three-Eyed Tiger, it would practically be an insignificant small sect.
Yet now over half a year had passed...
Most of them now stood at the same level as her.
Everyone was at the Daoist Palace Realm, especially with two even higher than her by one layer.
She almost suspected that the entire batch had been replaced.
"What’s exactly happening here?"
"How did they cultivate?"
With her resentment just avenged, she was feeling joyous.
But now, she couldn’t be happy anymore.
Seeing her shattered expression, Jiang Cheng felt greatly pleased.
Now she knew the benefits of becoming one of Brother Cheng’s people!
He gestured to Mo Chen for an explanation.
Meanwhile, Ji Linghan, Lin Ning, and other ladies were both curious and wary.
This unfamiliar woman was breathtakingly beautiful; where did the Sect Leader charm her from?
During the time in the Xuanji Map, what happened?
Who is she?
At last, other disciples noticed something was amiss.
This seemed unlike Feixian Sect.
"Why is the spiritual qi concentration here so high?"
"Did Ah Huang girl ascend again?"
"No, this isn’t Feixian Mountain!"
"It’s too vast!"
Now mostly at Daoist Palace Realm, their divine thought could reach far.
A thought stretched for thousands of miles, yet they still couldn’t see the boundary of the sect.
"Where have we arrived?"
"Could this be the Immortal Realm?"
"Oh my, compared to here, the previous Feixian Mountain was just a thatched hut!"
"Sect Leader, what’s going on?"
Faced with their questions, Brother Cheng’s lips curled slightly.
"Nothing much, just exterminated a Sacred Land and did some trivial things."

chapters.title: Chapter 138 Popular Figures
chapters.content:
Chapter 138: Chapter 138 Popular Figures
Upon learning that the Sect Leader had single-handedly destroyed a Sacred Land with three Ascending to Saint Realm experts and nearly a thousand Daoist Palace disciples not long ago,
all the disciples’ admiration for Brother Cheng rose to a new level.
Many disciples even felt secretly ashamed.
Having just emerged from the Xuanji Map, they thought their Divine Skills had reached great success and they could sweep all directions.
Now, compared to the Sect Leader, their wings were still too tender.
Especially Ji Linghan and Lin Ning, the two women who had reached the Ninth Layer of the Daoist Palace this time, their Spiritual Power Realm had surpassed Jiang Cheng’s.
Finding that Jiang Cheng was only at the Daoist Palace Fourth Stage, both women were doubting reality a bit.
This can’t be right, wasn’t he supposed to be an Immortal?
Could it be false, had they already surpassed the Sect Leader?
Now seeing...
Their thoughts were indeed overthinking.
Any two Ninth Layer Daoist Palace experts from the Silence Sacred Land could render them beyond redemption, let alone the presence of Ascending to Saint Level experts.
On the other side, Mo Chen was explaining the effects of the Xuanji Map to Lan Ti.
Upon hearing this, he looked over with a cheerful smile.
"Don’t just look at the Sect Leader’s apparent realm, he’s only hiding it to avoid overwhelming you."
"The Sect Leader’s true power far exceeds your imagination."
Brother Cheng couldn’t help but secretly give the old fellow a thumbs up.
No wonder he had become an Immortal. His mind was meticulous, knowing how to smooth over a situation and restore dignity.
"From now on, this place will be the new headquarters of our Feixian Sect."
The entire area erupted in cheers.
In his excitement, Brother Cheng, like a dragon flying and phoenix dancing, wrote down the three bold characters of Feixian Sect on paper on the spot.
Though the writing was average, it was ultimately the authentic work of the Sect Leader.
"Great calligraphy!"
"It has the style of a famous master!"
"You all lack insight, can’t you see the celestial aura emanating from these characters?"
"Indeed, indeed, seeing the Sect Leader’s calligraphy, I feel a vague sense of enlightenment coming on!"
Shan Tai, Qin Chang, Wei Miao, and others even fought fiercely over the rights to mount these three characters as a plaque.
Brother Cheng saw all this and felt more gratified at heart.
The disciples had grown thoughtful!
He then announced another matter.
"In seven days, we will hold the Grand Opening Ceremony. Spread the word!"
"At that time, Feixian Sect welcomes guests from all walks of life."
"Regardless of cultivation level or background, anyone who comes will be treated as a guest!"
All the disciples were delighted to receive the order and went to carry it out with joy.
After barely digesting the shocking news of the Xuanji Map, Lan Ti once again found it incomprehensible.
"Are you insane?"
"The news of Silence Sacred Land’s destruction is still unknown to them; if you seal off the Secret Realm, the outside world won’t find out so quickly!"
"Yet, you’re making a big fuss inviting people to the Grand Opening Ceremony?"
Brother Cheng seemed unconcerned, "Does it matter if people find out?"
"It matters, it matters a lot!"
Lan Ti, now considering him as her own man, cared deeply, even expressing a tone of exasperation.
"Do you know that Silence Sacred Land is intricately connected with several other major Sacred Lands in the Thousand Spirit Domain?"
"Even Saint Bi Feng counts as their ally."
"If they find out you destroyed Silence Sacred Land, they’ll definitely besiege you!"
She hoped Jiang Cheng could quietly build his fortune without attracting attention.
Anyway, in a few months, the Void Immortal Realm would open.
By then, entering the Void Immortal Realm would make matters in the Lower Realm insignificant and forgotten.
Unfortunately, she underestimated Brother Cheng’s flamboyance.
Having finally destroyed a Sacred Land, not making it known so that everyone was awed would never satisfy his urge to show off to the fullest.
To him, it was like wealth and splendor walked invisibly at night, too stifling.
If this world had trending searches, he’d certainly buy the headline every day.
He wished the entire Thousand Spirit Domain would discuss the fall of Silence Sacred Land.
Discuss the brilliance and martial prowess of Sect Leader Jiang.
"Cough, with my handsome and suave level, isn’t it enough to win the admiration and submission of those major Sacred Lands?"
"You... are serious?"
Lan Ti almost lost it.
If it weren’t for Jiang Cheng’s extraordinary battle achievements standing right before her, she’d doubt whether he was a fool.
"Of course, I’m serious. I’d even welcome them to come, they may find that Silence Sacred Land is truly beneath my stature."
Brother Cheng narcissistically flicked a lock of hair on his forehead and gave her a dashing silhouette as he turned around.
"This place is vast; feel free to choose a spot to reside, no need to be formal with me."
Mo Chen continued to explain privately.
"Miss Lan, every action the Sect Leader takes is deeply meaningful."
"His profoundness is beyond our mortal comprehension."
"We only need to appreciate his performance without overthinking it."
Was this Immortal under some spell from him? Lan Ti rolled her eyes helplessly and was left speechless.
The news of Silence Sacred Land being annihilated spread quickly, due in part to Jiang Cheng’s active promotion.
This news shook the entire Thousand Spirit Domain.
After all, it was a Sacred Land with a legacy spanning over two thousand million years.
Many people saw its existence as natural as the vicissitudes of the sea becoming mulberry fields.
And now, it vanished overnight?
Many who heard this news thought it was a joke.
How could a grand Sacred Land be decimated just like that?
Without any prior leaks, it’s impossible.
Moreover, what kind of entity is the Feixian Sect?
Who cares about Jiang Cheng, nobody’s ever heard of him.
But as time went on, they had to believe it.
Because nobody from Silence Sacred Land came out to clarify anything.
The invincible majesty of a Sacred Land was not to be lightly mocked, and with rumors running rampant, logically they should have dispatched their experts.
Having their Sect rumored to be annihilated was a great shame.
Not only should they clarify, but they should also hunt down the ’rumormongers’, preferring to err in punishment rather than let anyone escape, causing blood to flow and deterring all directions.
But three days passed, and nothing happened.
The ’rumor’ spread wider, and Silence Sacred Land seemed to have no response, as if it were dead.
So, gradually, people began to believe it was true.
Silence Sacred Land had indeed been replaced by a Sect called ’Feixian Sect’.
The one who annihilated the Sacred Land was their Sect Leader, Jiang Cheng.
For a time, throughout the Thousand Spirit Domain, everyone was inquiring about what kind of divine being Feixian Sect and Jiang Cheng were.
With many people, comes great power; soon, the outside world had information.
But this information left everyone bewildered.
The Feixian Sect was originally just an unremarkable small Sect within the Qianxing Dynasty, the strongest being merely at the Soul Splitting Realm.
They even suffered an extermination once.
As for Jiang Cheng, he only recently made a bit of a name for himself in the past year.
This felt like an ant overturning a giant whale, truly hard to believe.
But on the other hand, Jiang Cheng did seem quite remarkable.
After making his debut, he annihilated Sects consecutively, all the way through Feiyun State, and recently facilitated a regime change in the Qianxing Dynasty with unprecedented service.
At first glance, this person was unheard of.
But stringing all his experiences together, he exuded an aura of mystery from head to toe.
Like an unfathomable abyss, no one knew what he might accomplish next.
Brother Cheng’s wish to become famous and renowned truly materialized; he had become the undeniable headline figure in the Thousand Spirit Domain during this period.
Now, people everywhere talked about him, making him sound legendary, resulting in countless speculations.
It even included the Saint Tier Saint Bi Feng!

chapters.title: Chapter 139: This Time It’s Secured
chapters.content:
Chapter 139: Chapter 139: This Time It’s Secured
On Tongyou Island overseas, the leaders of the Eight Great Sacred Lands gathered.
They were discussing the recent incidents at the Silence Sacred Land.
"Feixian Sect cannot be let off."
With just one sentence from Venerable Wu Huan of the Purple Origin Sacred Land, the tone of the secret meeting was set.
The Supreme Elder of the Li Guang Sacred Land, Venerable Cangwu, with his long gray eyebrows slightly twitching, opened his wrinkled eyes, and his whole demeanor shifted from ancient dead wood to a sharp unsheathed blade.
"They broke the rules."
"Destroying a Sacred Land requires a price to be paid."
The Sect Leader of the White Rainbow Sacred Land, Venerable Zhonglang, nodded in agreement.
"Silence Sacred Land was as close as kin to us, this action shows they disregard the Eight Great Sacred Lands."
The leaders of all the major Sacred Lands present all agreed.
"There’s no need for Feixian Sect to exist."
"A force that rose so suddenly is too dangerous, better to erase it early."
"The Eight Great Sacred Lands can sweep away Feixian Sect without much effort."
Including the destroyed Silence Sacred Land, among the Nine Sacred Lands, although there was interaction, truth be told, there were more disputes and frictions daily.
After all, they were all in the Thousand Spirit Domain, and were forces of equal standing, how could there not be some conflicts.
Avenging Silence Sacred Land?
What a joke.
Everyone here has lived for millions of years—no one is that impulsive and hot-blooded, and their relationships aren’t strong enough.
Their righteous indignation had other reasons.
The cake of the Thousand Spirit Domain is only so big, and the nine families have already divided it up completely.
This is their sphere of influence, and they wouldn’t allow outsiders to touch this cake.
Any rising force would be attacked by them.
Back then, even the arrival of Mingxin Sacred Land made them uncomfortable.
However, Mingxin Sacred Land had up to five Ascending to Saint individuals, with overall power stronger than any single one of them. They also had the top-grade magical treasure Heart-Piercing Awl, capable of combatting Saint Tier beings.
Plus, Mingxin maintained extreme discretion and never competed for resources, thus they were tacitly allowed to remain.
But this time, Feixian Sect was different.
If we look back at Jiang Cheng’s rise, it’s clear he wouldn’t adhere to the ’game rules’ set by these Sacred Lands.
In their eyes, this instability was too dangerous.
It would certainly affect their domination over the Thousand Spirit Domain.
The secret meeting quickly reached a consensus; none of the Eight Great Sacred Lands wanted to see Feixian Sect continue.
However, the atmosphere then became strange.
"This Feixian Sect is going too far."
"Yes indeed, must be destroyed."
"The alliance of the Eight Great Sacred Lands is a must!"
"Indeed, indeed..."
"It’s said Feixian Sect only has a group of Gathering Yuan Realm disciples; they are weak and can be easily wiped out."
"It should be easy, a piece of cake."
"No need for all eight families to act, one alone can flatten them."
This unproductive conversation dragged on for hours, still without a resolution.
A fight is inevitable.
But how to fight?
No Sect Leader present stepped forth to say they’d lead an attack.
The expressions of everyone were quite subtle.
Having lived this long, who here is a fool?
If Feixian Sect and Silence Sacred Land had fought fiercely, they would’ve already led people to support Silence Sacred Land.
But the issue was, Silence Sacred Land was wiped out in just one day.
Completely annihilated without a trace left.
If it weren’t for Feixian Sect’s own announcement, the outside world would have known nothing.
And that was a vast Sacred Land with power equivalent to theirs!
Nobody knows how they were destroyed.
The implications behind this are terrifying.
Everyone present could guess—there’s a Saint Tier backing Feixian Sect.
Charging in recklessly would be courting death.
That’s why they gathered at Tongyou Sacred Land, because Saint Bi Feng is the Supreme Elder there.
To deal with a Saint Tier, a Saint Tier must be involved personally.
Seeing no progress in discussions, Venerable Cangwu had to speak up.
"I wonder if the honorable Saint could personally eradicate this evil?"
The Sect Leader of Tongyou Sacred Land, Venerable Xunguang, upon hearing this, closed his eyes to sense for a moment.
"The Supreme Elder’s Dharma Body is traveling and hasn’t returned; the main body remains in seclusion."
Upon reaching the peak of Saint Tier, one can form a Dharma Body, possessing one-tenth the power of the main body, though most cultivators refrain from doing so.
Forming a Dharma Body weakens the main body by one-tenth.
The Dharma Body can’t cultivate, having multiple Dharma Bodies doesn’t increase combat strength.
If the Dharma Body is destroyed, it damages the main body’s Dao practice.
The Dharma Body does have the benefit of being able to travel across domains.
Saint Tiers, due to their immense power, are suppressed by the rules when crossing domains, like Three-Eyed Tiger, who must tuck tail in the Thousand Spirit Domain.
If found by a local Saint Tier, it might be attacked.
The Dharma Body doesn’t have this worry.
Since it isn’t the main body, it isn’t suppressed by world rules when crossing domains.
And even if the Dharma Body is destroyed, the main body doesn’t perish, at least escaping a fate of complete annihilation.
"This..."
"What should we do?"
They dared not inquire where the Saint’s Dharma Body was traveling.
Everyone was only filled with worry.
"Without the Saint stepping in, it will be hard to resolve."
"Who knows when the honorable Saint will end the seclusion?"
Venerable Xunguang sighed: "The Supreme Elder is profoundly mysterious; even I cannot fathom his actions..."
Before he could finish, he suddenly closed his mouth.
He then slightly closed his eyes, nodding continuously.
As if conversing with someone.
A moment later, he stood up, beaming.
"Everyone, please return, Feixian Sect is no longer a concern."
Everyone was stunned: "Why is this?"
Venerable Xunguang cupped his hands in a certain direction, solemnly saying: "Our Supreme Elder has made arrangements."
"I see!"
"The Saint is finally intervening!"
"It’s secured!"
"Ha ha, Feixian Sect is finished for sure."
Everyone let out a long breath and departed.
Meanwhile, at Mingxin Sacred Land’s Heart Division, a ’distinguished’ guest had arrived.
This person, tall and slender, with a broad forehead and long nose, a slightly short chin, seemed ordinary at first glance, yet upon closer inspection, made others feel inadequate.
As if he was the center of the universe.
He stood there, with a subtle smile at the corner of his mouth. To others, he seemed like a towering mountain, an infinite sea, unfathomable.
Though appearing to be in his thirties, the members of the Heart Division dared not show any negligence.
Clan Leader Qingsuo connected a strand of Divine Thought with the Heart-Piercing Awl, cautiously asking.
"What brings Saint Bi Feng here?"
Recognizing it as a Dharma Body, but even so, it was still a manifestation of Saint Tier power.
Saint Bi Feng gave a slight smile: "The cooperation we discussed back then needs some changes."
He was referring to the plan regarding the nine magical treasures working together to open the Void Immortal Realm.
Eight of those nine magical treasures are with the Eight Tribes of the Immortal Remnant Race, with the Heart-Piercing Awl being one of them.
Meanwhile, the Bone Refining Banner from the Witch Division, fell into his hands millions of years ago.

chapters.title: Chapter 140: Must Impose Sanctions
chapters.content:
Chapter 140: Chapter 140: Must Impose Sanctions
"A change? What does the Saint mean by this? Are you saying your words mean nothing?"
The Heart Division experts all looked rather grim.
In this opening of the Void Immortal Realm, they were expected to send around five hundred clan members in.
This was due to the strong protection effect of the Heart-Piercing Awl, unlike Lan Ti with the Four-direction Primordial Cauldron, which could only protect three people at most.
Entering the Immortal Realm was an immense affair.
Once ascended successfully, it was akin to a carp leaping through the Dragon Gate, cultivating in the environment of Immortal Yuan Qi, transcending from mortal to immortal.
And they harbored an even greater hope—to rediscover the nine Immortal Ancestors of old in the Immortal Realm.
Led by them, the tribe would regain its former glory!
Due to the numerous Daoist Palace geniuses within the clan, even five hundred slots were insufficient, prompting the Heart Division to hastily conduct internal selection tournaments.
The competition was fierce.
At present, only three months remained until the agreed opening date.
If the partnership goes south at such a crucial moment, they might literally bleed.
"Clan Leader Qing Suo, you’ve misunderstood."
Saint Bi Feng swept his sleeve and smiled calmly.
"I certainly wish to collaborate with you in opening the Void Immortal Realm."
"I simply hope to add one restriction condition."
Qing Suo quickly asked, "What condition?"
"No member of the Feixian Sect is allowed to enter the Void Immortal Realm."
Once the Void Immortal Realm opened, nine entrances would exist.
These nine entrances were each manipulated by those nine magical treasures.
Those who controlled these nine magical treasures indeed had the power to deny entry to anyone.
The passage Lan Ti always wanted to enter naturally was also the Witch Division’s entrance.
Saint Bi Feng awaited Qing Suo’s response after stating this.
Unexpectedly, Qing Suo and the elders exchanged glances, bewildered.
"May I ask, Saint, what is the Feixian Sect?"
This...
Even Saint Bi Feng, with his cunning, couldn’t help but find it absurd.
The topic of the Feixian Sect had reached wide circulation; even the Mortal World was discussing it, truly making it widely known.
Yet they were completely uninformed.
After all, it was a force of Holy Land level; even without external contact, some level of intelligence should exist.
"The Feixian Sect is a sect, and their Sect Leader is Jiang Cheng, and also Lan Ti is over there."
"Ah? Jiang Cheng and Lan Ti?"
Mentioning these two, the Heart Division immediately had a recollection.
"Why did the Saint decide on this action?"
"Yes, but Lan Ti is the only hope of the Witch Division, having always awaited this chance."
"That Jiang Cheng can be disregarded, but at least let Lan Ti enter!"
Historically, the Heart Division had the best relationship with the Witch Division; both developed in the Thousand Spirit Domain, mutually supporting each other.
However, after the Witch Division lost their magical treasure, their decline was swift.
Regarding Lan Ti, they still wished she could accompany them to the Immortal Realm, perhaps aiding the Witch Division’s revival there.
Continuing as a powerful ally of the Heart Division.
Saint Bi Feng knew clearly what they were considering.
"They committed acts that outraged both gods and humans."
"Already, the Thousand Spirit Domain cannot tolerate them."
"I am not here to negotiate, but to declare a decision!"
"If you don’t punish them, then we’ll shelve the opening of the Void Immortal Realm."
His attitude was firm.
Clearly, with only one magical treasure, he somehow manipulated the initiative.
It seemed like the other Eight Tribes were seeking cooperation with him.
This decision was reached after meticulous consideration.
Effacing Silence Sacred Land silently indicates the Feixian Sect must have Saint Tier residing.
Without clarifying the enemy, he would not rashly confront them.
Better to force the Heart Division to deal with Jiang Cheng, using them as a scouting pawn.
Qing Suo found it hard to comprehend: "They merely have some minor disputes with Silence Sacred Land, is it weighty enough to disturb you?"
"Why bother with the juniors, Saint?"
"Yes, only a few Saint Heirs have died, we’re willing to mediate."
"It would be such a pity for Lan Ti to miss this chance."
Their intelligence still remained at the stage where Jiang Cheng killed those two Saint Heirs and one Elder.
This outdated information resulted from the incident occurring directly within the Heart Division, witnessed personally by them.
"Only a few Saint Heirs died?"
Saint Bi Feng was nearly speechless.
"Minor disputes?"
"To tell you the truth, Silence Sacred Land has been obliterated by them."
What?
Silence Sacred Land has been eradicated?
Furthermore, eradicated by Jiang Cheng?
The Heart Division was utterly astounded.
Had it not been the Saint saying this directly, they would have never believed it.
"Where are the three Venerables of Silence Sacred Land? Jiang Cheng is merely at the Daoist Palace Realm, correct?"
"Indeed, does the Feixian Sect have Saint Tier residing?"
"But I’ve never heard of a sect named Feixian Sect existing, could it be a reclusive Sacred Land?"
As their speculations spiraled further, their discussions endlessly prolonged, Saint Bi Feng grew slightly impatient.
"It is indeed the fact."
"If you disbelieve, you can send someone to investigate."
"In any event, Jiang Cheng obliterated Silence Sacred Land and violated the rules of the Thousand Spirit Domain."
"Such an action will absolutely not be tolerated by me!"
His expression turned stern.
"Two choices are available: either expel the Feixian Sect from the Thousand Spirit Domain or obstruct them, denying entry into the Void Immortal Realm!"
His true aim was actually the first result.
Exiling the Feixian Sect from the Thousand Spirit Domain seemed inconsequential.
However, at that time, the Feixian Sect would be inevitably crossing boundaries.
With potential Saint Tier residing in such a sect, once leaving the Thousand Spirit Domain, they would be suppressed by the cosmic rules.
Saint Bi Feng’s extensive connections would then readily enable him to annihilate the Feixian Sect.
"In just a few days, the opening ceremony for the Feixian Sect’s founding will occur. Time for your consideration is limited."
"I expect a satisfactory answer before that."
"Otherwise, cooperation ends!"
After speaking, his Dharma Body became ethereal, gradually disappearing from sight.
Following his departure, the Heart Division was silent for a full half-stick of incense.
Each one’s eyes were full of astonishment.
Many didn’t clearly hear Saint Bi Feng’s final words.
Their minds buzzed, echoing one statement—Silence Sacred Land was destroyed by Jiang Cheng.
Silence Sacred Land was close to the Heart Division.
This neighbor had interacted for millions of years; there was no way they could be unfamiliar.
Three formidable figures in Ascending to Saint, nearly a thousand Daoist Palaces, ten thousand disciples!
Though the top tier lacked the Heart Division’s level, they were indisputably a mighty presence, causing persistent headaches.
Gone just like that?
Suddenly, they recalled a departing phrase Jiang Cheng had said.
"Soon, you will hear my name once more."
At the time, they dismissed it as mere bravado, assigning it no extra thought.
Who could have anticipated its fulfillment today?
And delivered with explosive shock value.
How did he achieve it?
No matter how they dissected it, they couldn’t fathom it.
"Clan Leader, what... should we do?"
"If we don’t agree to Saint Bi Feng’s request, not only will cooperation end, but the other Tribes will also hold us accountable."
"Indeed, everyone is prepared to ascend to the Immortal Realm..."
"We cannot afford to lose this opportunity."
Qing Suo rubbed her brow, feeling deeply unsettled.
"Dispatch someone to investigate, also their founding ceremony."

chapters.title: Chapter 141 Ambassador Three-Eyed Tiger
chapters.content:
Chapter 141: Chapter 141 Ambassador Three-Eyed Tiger
The Three-Eyed Tiger also finally joined up with the Feixian Sect.
If it weren’t for everyone discussing it everywhere, it really couldn’t find the place.
"Kid, how did you wipe this place out?"
It really couldn’t figure it out more and more.
In this world, the one who understands Jiang Cheng the most is it.
Although Ji Linghan and others knew him earlier, they never understood Brother Cheng’s depth and always regarded him as a senior master from the beginning.
Only the Three-Eyed Tiger clearly knew he was only at the Soul Splitting Fourth Layer at first.
Every time he annihilated a sect, the disciples found it normal, after all, he was an Immortal.
But in its eyes, not once was reasonable.
How could this kid possibly do it?
Especially this time, he actually wiped out an entire Sacred Land.
This kind of thing, even it couldn’t guarantee to be able to do.
It immediately discovered that Jiang Cheng’s Divine Soul Realm had already reached the early-stage Saint Tier, standing on equal footing with it.
This startled it into jumping up.
"You, how could your Divine Soul improve so quickly?"
This languid Tiger Demon was even a bit stuttering when speaking.
At this rate, it wouldn’t be long before this kid surpassed it.
By that time, its sense of superiority would be completely gone.
Seeing its existential crisis expression, Brother Cheng felt immensely satisfied.
Even showing off requires choosing the right target, and when a Demon King is shocked, the sense of accomplishment increases by dozens of times.
"Convinced now?"
"Scared now?"
"Suddenly realized how majestic my figure is, and couldn’t help but want to worship it?"
"Worship your damn uncle!" The Three-Eyed Tiger habitually retorted back.
It could tell that no matter how strong this kid’s power, his essence of showing off hadn’t changed.
Do you think you can show off better than me?
"Let me show you what a true Saint Tier is all about!"
Finishing those words, it grew with the wind, its body expanding rapidly.
In the blink of an eye, it transformed from a palm-sized adorable tiger into a giant tiger a hundred thousand meters long.
Its figure, which blocked out the sky and sun, was incomparably mighty, every single strand of fur glittering brilliantly.
Its eyes exuded the majesty of a superior, its sharp teeth gleaming with a cold light, its whole body shrouded with a suffocatingly terrifying pressure.
All signs of cuteness have vanished.
The disciples gathered, looking up at the gigantic Tiger Demon, some turned pale.
"Is this the little brain axe?"
"No way, our Sect Guardian Spirit Beast has always been this mighty?"
"I always thought it didn’t have much presence..."
These discussions made the Three-Eyed Tiger feel a lot more comfortable.
Even Jiang Cheng’s eyes sparkled.
"Your strength has recovered?"
"Not yet."
The Three-Eyed Tiger snorted coldly: "But being close to the Celestial Demon Domain here means the suppressive force of the rules isn’t as strong."
"Impressive, impressive."
"Glad you know, show some respect to this grandpa in the future!"
Brother Cheng rubbed his hands together and chuckled: "Let’s make a deal, our sect’s inauguration ceremony is in a few days..."
The Three-Eyed Tiger, busy showing off its King Bi aura, became wary: "What do you want?"
"Ahem, it would boost our sect’s image if you could squat outside the mountain gate for a day, how about it?"
He thought of some opening ceremonies from his past life, with those red arches and balloons.
Just imagine, on the sect inauguration day, a hundred thousand-meter giant tiger floating above the secret realm entrance, how classy would that be!
"Go to your damn uncle, you want to make me a mascot?"
"Not a mascot, a symbol of our facade, you are the image ambassador of our Feixian Sect. This status, others couldn’t get even if they wanted to compete for it."
Brother Cheng spared no effort in persuading, but the Three-Eyed Tiger wasn’t that easy to fool.
"Screw you, still want me to stand support for you, why don’t you go look in the mirror!"
"Are you not giving any face at all?"
Being rejected in front of so many people, Sect Leader Jiang felt a bit awkward.
"Do you even have face?"
The Three-Eyed Tiger rarely seized the chance to belittle him once again.
It would rather all the disciples stop worshiping this kid and start worshiping it instead.
Jiang Cheng regretfully sighed.
"Alright, I initially planned to give you a set to enhance talent later, but now thinking about it, forget it."
The Three-Eyed Tiger, which had been so proud and complacent, instantly changed its expression, its attitude took a turn.
