Why did it come all the way here to reunite with Jiang Cheng? Wasn’t it because the talent enhancement was too enticing?
It quickly shrunk its body, turning into the size of a regular tiger, rolling like a whirlwind to Jiang Cheng’s feet.
"Bro, you really meant it, you’re gonna give me a set too?"
The crowd almost stumbled.
This was really the first time they heard this Tiger Demon call the Sect Leader "Bro", previously it always referred to itself as grandpa, right?
Brother Cheng lifted his chin, didn’t even glance at it, acting very haughtily: "No, no, you misheard."
The Three-Eyed Tiger stretched out its front limb and hugged his leg, rubbing against it hard, and began to grin ingratiatingly.
"Bro, I know I was wrong, being a mascot is no big deal, I’ll do it!"
Standing support for one day, talent enhancement by one rank, even a fool would rush to take this deal.
Sect Leader Jiang kicked it far away with one foot.
"Don’t, someone like me with no face doesn’t have the qualifications to have you do anything."
The Tiger Demon lunged again, sticking like glue, holding onto his leg.
"No difficulty, no difficulty, Bro you have the most face, if you tell me to go east, I dare not go west."
"I don’t want to force anyone."
"Really, really, I’m willing to do it, being an image ambassador sounds prestigious, I’m absolutely thrilled. If anyone tries to take it from me, I’ll get mad at them!"
"Okay then, since you’re strongly insisting, I’ll reluctantly agree to you."
"Thank you for giving me this opportunity to perform, Bro."
The worldviews of the other disciples were nearly shattered by these two odd creatures.
Especially the Three-Eyed Tiger, it wasn’t like this before.
"Let’s be clear, your talent is quite high, I can’t enhance it yet, have to wait until my Immortal Technique advances."
"Ah? Still have to wait until later?"
Jiang Cheng saw its skeptical look and knew it didn’t believe him.
"If you’re not willing to wait, then forget it."
"Willing, willing, of course, I’m willing."
At this moment, Mo Chen also joined in.
"Sect Leader, this Tiger Demon is indeed mighty, I’m just worried it might scare the guests. They might think it’s a Demon Race invasion and dare not come."
Having always had an unfavorable view towards the Three-Eyed Tiger, his eyes turned mischievous again.
"I suggest making a big sign for it to wear, with ’Sect Guardian Spirit Beast’ written on it."
"This way, guests can easily understand at a glance, avoiding many misunderstandings."
This was too wicked!
The other disciples almost wanted to rant crazily.
Having a sign made, those who didn’t know might think the Three-Eyed Tiger is being reprimanded.
"Mo Chen, you son of a bitch, I curse you to never recover in your life!"
Having received the promise of talent enhancement, with the added advantage of covertly moving into the Immortal Realm from the Void Immortal Realm, the Three-Eyed Tiger now had no further need for Mo Chen.
As a result, there was no respect left at all.
Mo Chen, looking like a traitorous minister, advised again: "Sect Leader, see how it is indeed uncontrollably aggressive, guests will definitely be terrified."
"It won’t only damage my Feixian Sect’s reputation but also tarnish the Sect Leader’s image!"
Jiang Cheng nodded in agreement: "Elder Mo has considered this thoroughly, this signage suggestion is good."
"Three-Eyed Tiger, if you don’t want to, then forget it."
Enhancing this guy’s talent once would cost 9.5 billion points, that’s such a huge price, putting a sign on it now is nothing.
One must bow under the roof, having requests, the Three-Eyed Tiger could only glare viciously at Mo Chen.
"Can I say I’m not willing?"

chapters.title: Chapter 142: The Founding Ceremony
chapters.content:
Chapter 142: Chapter 142: The Founding Ceremony
A few days later, the grand foundation ceremony of the Feixian Sect began with much fanfare.
It was said to be spectacular because the ceremony nearly captured the attention of the entire Thousand Spirit Domain.
Even a change of dynasties wouldn’t draw such attention.
However, on the day of the ceremony, it wasn’t all that crowded outside the Feixian Sect.
Jiang Cheng got up early, changed into a festive red robe, and felt invigorated.
As the Sect Leader, today he would announce to everyone in the Thousand Spirit Domain — he’s here, and he’s conquered!
From afar, a group of disciples saw him.
Shan Tai immediately started shouting.
"Wow, who is this person?"
"Why is he so handsome?"
Upon closer inspection, they were even more surprised.
"Oh! Turned out it was the Sect Leader!"
"I was wondering who could be so incredibly, earth-shatteringly handsome that people would be enthralled before he even arrived!"
The other disciples secretly critiqued, wondering if he could flatter any more excessively, even using an ode.
However, their reactions weren’t slow either.
"The Sect Leader has become even more handsome."
"I knew who it was at a glance, Senior Brother Shan, did you mean the Sect Leader isn’t usually handsome?"
"The Sect Leader always has a new look every day, you just aren’t observant enough to notice it."
This got Shan Tai quite annoyed.
These guys are mimicking him, even vying for his title of Flattery King, utterly unforgivable.
Especially Wei Miao, among the Third Generation Disciples, who spoke with such boldness.
"Without the Sect Leader, the night stretches on through eternity!"
It was clear from the reaction that Brother Cheng’s smile grew even broader at this statement.
He patted Wei Miao on the shoulder and praised, "You’ve got great insight, I have high hopes for you."
"Today’s a good day for our founding; here’s a little gift for you."
With that, he tossed a piece of Treasure Armor over.
Wei Miao caught it instantly.
Upon realizing it was Treasure Armor, he was so thrilled he almost fainted.
Everyone else’s eyes nearly popped out.
Damn, just a sentence, and you get a treasure?
Is this for real?
Previously, the rewards were Eighth Tier or Ninth Tier Spiritual Artifacts, especially for those with extremely fast cultivation speeds.
Everyone accepted it wholeheartedly.
This time...
In an instant, everyone’s noses were bent with anger, wishing to tear Wei Miao apart with a thousand blades.
Such a promising competitor, he must not remain!
On this day, the Feixian Sect directly lifted the restrictions on the Secret Realm, allowing everyone to freely enter and exit.
Jiang Cheng did this to ensure that any late-arriving guests wouldn’t be locked out.
He was indeed very hospitable.
At the time, guests began entering the Secret Realm one after another.
Zhao Hongde looked at the giant Tiger Demon floating above the entrance to the Secret Realm, both shocked and fearful, even a bit incredulous.
The massive body, stretching ten thousand meters, alone was enough to scare the wits out of anyone.
However, the Tiger Demon bore a sign on its body.
"Sect Guardian Spirit Beast!"
And it wore a sash with a line of text on it.
"Welcome to the Feixian Sect!"
Oh, it turns out it’s the Sect Guardian Spirit Beast, how terrifying this Feixian Sect is to have something so imposing.
Yet, why does this scene feel a bit peculiar?
About to step through the door, he felt awkward and anxious.
Zhao Hongde was the fourth steward of the Zhao Family in Zhuhai City, roughly three thousand miles from here.
Zhuhai City didn’t have any high-ranking powers, and the strongest Patriarch of the Zhao Family was only at the Spirit Platform First Layer, not even as strong as the former Duanmu Family.
Due to the previous Silence Sacred Land, no power exceeding the Celestial Fate Realm was allowed within a ten thousand miles radius.
They claimed it was to maintain local stability and security.
Before this Feixian Sect foundation ceremony, Jiang Cheng had sent out disciples to invite people to warm the stage.
The Zhao Family was nearby, so Luo Yuan went to invite them.
Regarding his visit, the Zhao Family’s Patriarch and Elders were exceedingly respectful on the surface, promising wholeheartedly.
But once he left, their expressions changed entirely.
The Feixian Sect wiped out the Silence Sacred Land, obviously very strong.
But the rest of the Eight Great Sacred Lands had yet to express their stance, no one knew when the Feixian Sect might be encircled.
Attending the banquet this time might get them considered accomplices by the Eight Great Sacred Lands, and be purged all together.
In front of such Sacred Lands, the Zhao Family didn’t even count as dust.
Thus, the family held an emergency meeting overnight and ultimately decided.
To have the fourth steward Zhao Hongde attend, saying he represented the Zhao Family if asked by the Feixian Sect.
If the Feixian Sect were destroyed in the future and accountability demanded, they would claim he wasn’t part of the Zhao Family and had gone on his own accord.
Zhao Hongde was very clear about his mission, hence, he felt uneasy at the moment.
After registering outside the Secret Realm.
A nearby young disciple announced loudly: "The Zhao Family from Zhuhai City has arrived!"
"Presenting a gift of 100 Middle-grade Spirit Stones!"
This little gift was just a formality to follow tradition.
A familiar figure emerged from the Secret Realm, Luo Yuan stepped out.
"Hm, you’re the Zhao Family? Didn’t see you there when I visited!"
This person was a Daoist Palace Realm Immortal Master, Zhao Hongde hurriedly and respectfully bowed: "Cough, cough, the Patriarch had urgent matters, I am here in his stead."
Luo Yuan was aware of the family’s concerns, just an excuse he knew.
But he didn’t make things difficult, even helped support him: "Good to have you, haha, please!"
Saying this, he personally led Zhao Hongde into the Secret Realm.
After entering, a Third Generation Disciple took Zhao Hongde and flew toward the Reception Hall.
After he left, Yin Xuer nudged Luo Yuan with her elbow.
"The person you invited is only Gathering Essence Sixth Layer, isn’t that a bit shabby?"
Luo Yuan helplessly shrugged: "Nothing I can do, even having someone come is a success."
"Hee hee, do you think the Sect Leader will be upset? He is an immortal, and yet you invited some low-power guests."
"Cough! Maybe, his lordship cares about face."
"Ha! You’re badmouthing him behind his back, I’m going to tell him!"
"You’re so wicked, aren’t you?"
At this moment, someone outside heralded again.
"The White Feather Sword Saint from the Gu Yan Dynasty has arrived!"
"With a gift... one hundred taels of gold!"
Hearing the word ’Sword Saint’, everyone couldn’t help but be taken aback and turned their gaze.
Titles bearing the word ’Saint’ meant they were Saint Tier experts.
No way, someone invited a Saint Tier expert to the feast?
Even Luo Yuan was startled and quickly flew out again.
Saw standing below, a middle-aged man around thirty, gaunt face, calm eyes, tall, with an ancient long sword on his back.
Among everyone present, only he remained unfazed upon seeing the Three-Eyed Tiger.
Steady as a mountain, extraordinary demeanor, evidently no ordinary person.
But a slight scan with Divine Thought left him half-amused.
This person was only at Nine Layers of Body Tempering.
Immediately afterward, Yin Xuer flew out swiftly to greet him.
"Ah, you’ve really come!"
"Welcome, welcome..."
In the Body Tempering Realm, one cannot fly; the White Feather Sword Saint soared up, a leap of a hundred meters, still far from the Secret Realm entrance in the void.
If Yin Xuer hadn’t appeared in time and pulled him in mid-air, he might have fallen.

chapters.title: Chapter 143: White Feather Sword Saint
chapters.content:
Chapter 143: Chapter 143: White Feather Sword Saint
"Hmm!"
White Feather Sword Saint’s expression remained unchanged, still composed.
"Please!"
Yin Xuer handed him over to another guiding disciple.
This time, it was Luo Yuan’s turn to laugh at her.
"Is this your guest?"
Yin Xuer put on a mournful face, "Isn’t it? When I walked through a village of the Gu Yan Dynasty, I heard someone mention the title of Sword Saint."
"I thought if the Saint Tier arrived, the Sect Leader would definitely be pleased, so I braced myself to invite him."
"Back then, his courtyard door was closed. I could only state my purpose outside. Afraid to upset the Saint Tier, I didn’t dare use Divine Thought to probe."
"He was quite straightforward and agreed from a distance immediately."
"Then I found out, he was just an Innate Expert of the Mortal World..."
Her explanation left Luo Yuan wide-eyed and stunned, and he then laughed maliciously.
"You’re done for; the Sect Leader might faint from anger because of you."
After entering the Secret Realm, Zhao Hongde immediately lost his calm.
If it wasn’t for a disciple leading the way ahead, he might have danced and shouted in excitement.
The Spiritual Qi here was just too concentrated, it was beyond his imagination.
Just taking a few breaths, he noticed his realm had loosened somewhat.
This, this, this, is this the Sacred Land?
This should be called an Immortal Realm!
Before coming, he was downcast because being selected to come here actually counted as a sacrifice for his family.
Before leaving, various stewards gave him sympathetic looks.
As if he was going to the execution ground.
Now, he suddenly felt that no matter how the future turned out, just being able to enter here once was worthwhile.
At this point, there were already more than three hundred guests in the Reception Hall, most, like him, were only in the Gathering Yuan Realm, Soul Splitting Realm.
The highest cultivation among them was only at the Spirit Platform realm.
Everyone was like Granny Liu entering the Grand View Garden, unable to remain calm, marveling at everything here.
Soon, they were surprised to see someone in the Body Tempering Realm being brought in.
Only upon reaching the Condensing Vein Realm do you truly enter the ranks of a Cultivator.
Body Tempering Realm can only be considered mortal.
No way, even mortals are eligible to be invited into such an Immortal Realm?
Suddenly, they all felt that their own status didn’t seem too bad.
White Feather Sword Saint entered, but he didn’t look around like them, his expression remained as calm as ever.
As soon as the guiding disciple left, he immediately sat cross-legged and began to meditate and cultivate.
Everyone chuckled softly.
How normal.
Several among them had just broken through their realm after entering, some even broke through two levels successively.
Because the Spiritual Qi here was just too abundant.
For this mortal in the Ninth Layer of Body Tempering, this should be the greatest opportunity of his life.
Suddenly, the mortal’s aura changed abruptly.
Ascending into the Condensing Vein Realm.
Zhao Hongde jokingly cupped his hands towards him, "Brother, congratulations, you’ve gained the most this time."
"Hahaha..."
"He’s really hit the jackpot."
Everyone in the hall burst into laughter.
Isn’t it, coming as a guest, breaking through to a great realm.
Though they spoke words of congratulations, they truly weren’t envious, as the realm was too low.
White Feather Sword Saint, however, paid them no mind, still immersed in cultivation.
"Seems he’s been holding back for long."
"Yes, with a low foundational realm, maybe he can break through two more levels."
"I bet on three!"
"Then I’ll be bold and set a big goal, bet he’ll ascend to Condensing Vein Fifth Layer in one go!"
The crowd became interested.
As time passed, the mortal’s realm indeed kept rising.
But gradually, they could no longer laugh.
Because this mortal kept breaking through to Condensing Vein Ninth Layer without stopping.
In just half a moment, he blasted through the barrier of Energy-Introducing Realm, becoming an Energy-Introducing First Layer Cultivator.
Moreover, he was still cultivating.
"This... does he not need realm comprehension?"
"Perhaps his previous cultivation conditions were too poor, just short of Spirit Stone Elixirs?"
"Even if that’s the case, breaking through two great realms in succession so smoothly is still too outrageous."
It’s known that realm comprehension, without reaching a certain level, cannot produce insights into the next realm.
White Feather Sword Saint finally stopped after breaking through to Energy-Introducing Third Layer.
Though his realm was still the lowest, he counted as a legitimate cultivator now.
By then, the Reception Hall had over two thousand guests.
Luo Yuan and Yin Xuer both appeared.
"The Immortal Sect’s grand opening ceremony is about to start."
"We kindly ask everyone to relocate."
"The Sect Leader has been waiting for a long time!"
In the guest reception hall, Brother Cheng was all smiles.
Seeing a large group of guests coming this way, he felt elated.
The grand opening ceremony was his big day to establish a reputation; boasting naturally required more people to sponsor it.
Though over two thousand might seem much fewer than he initially expected, he was still quite satisfied.
But once he saw their realms clearly, he felt less delighted.
What situation is this?
A dignified Sacred Land’s opening, no, an Immortal Sect’s grand opening, you’d expect some Saint Tier Ascending to Saint guests, at least a group from Daoist Palace?
Yet the highest attendee was only in Spirit Platform realm?
Among the remaining, there were Energy-Introducing Third Layer attendees, are you kidding me?
With a smile maintained outwardly, he discreetly tugged at the two girls standing by his side.
"What’s the situation?"
Ji Linghan looked innocent, "It was you, Sect Leader, who said, regardless of realm or origin..."
Jiang Cheng indeed said that.
He wanted as many people as possible; he wouldn’t look down on those with low realms.
Everyone enjoys together after all.
"Indeed I welcome even mortals, but you couldn’t invite even one from Daoist Palace realm, at least several should’ve attended?"
Lacking any powerful figures, the ceremony, when spread outside, would be a laughingstock?
Saying Feixian Sect lacked prestige, no one cared to come.
Lin Ning of Daoist Palace Ninth Layer felt a bit embarrassed, the Sect Leader had barely arranged a task for her, but she couldn’t satisfy him.
"I invited a sect with Daoist Palace realm the day before yesterday, and they agreed."
"Then what? Where’s the person?"
"They... today sent just an outer disciple, that Spirit Platform First Layer one."
Brother Cheng no longer needed asking.
He understood the reason, it seemed the external pressure from other Sacred Lands was too great, it wasn’t the fault of those families or sects.
"Alright, since they’re afraid to come, today’s ceremony must make those absent regret."
"Regret till their guts turn green!"
Ji Linghan and Lin Ning exchanged puzzled looks, not knowing what he intended.
The guests soon settled down.
Four per table, two thousand made a full five hundred tables, yet this reception hall still felt spacious.
After all, Sect Leader Jiang’s initial guest expectation was at least ten thousand people.
"Today marks the reestablishment of my Feixian Sect. As Sect Leader, I, Jiang Cheng, welcome everyone’s support!"
Everyone felt honored; this was the Sect Leader of Sacred Land, at least Ascended to Saint?
Some who’ve lived for tens of thousands of years might not qualify to meet such a person, let alone they.
They hurriedly stood, clasped their fists.
"Congratulations Sect Leader Jiang!"

chapters.title: Chapter 144: Tears of Excitement
chapters.content:
Chapter 144: Chapter 144: Tears of Excitement
The process of the inauguration ceremony was quite simple.
Brother Cheng was too lazy to bother with a speech; it was just about changing a plaque, after all.
Additionally, he personally designed a ribbon-cutting ceremony.
Everyone was in awe without knowing why but clapped regardless.
Afterward, it was time to eat and drink.
As the fruits, dishes, and drinks were served, the entire hall gasped.
Brother Cheng had attended the Eight Clouds Hall’s ceremony banquet before, so he followed their example, making this reception several levels more luxurious.
The White Feather Sword Saint, who had been maintaining his composure, suddenly stood up.
He held a small, purple fruit with grainy edges in his hand, staring at Jiang Cheng in shock.
"Is this perhaps the Purple Fragrant Divine Fruit, which increases one’s power by two hundred years with just one piece?"
Power?
Brother Cheng was a bit confused.
These were just fruits he picked from those mountain tops in the Secret Realm, and there were entire mountains full of these purple fruits.
Considered quite basic, really.
But compared to most Heavenly and Earthly Treasures, this fruit was great for being ready to eat; he had eaten one and found it quite tasty.
As for the cultivation effect, it was about the same as a fourth-grade Spirit Pill.
Smilingly, Luo Yuan explained for him, "Indeed, this is the Purple Fragrant Fruit, but what it increases is not power, but spiritual power."
"If you like it, feel free to help yourself."
The White Feather Sword Saint sat down half-understanding, carefully wiping the fruit instead of devouring it immediately, and tucked it into his bosom with precious care.
Others chuckled secretly, thinking he hailed from the Mortal World, unfamiliar with such things.
The two hundred years of power in the Mortal World didn’t translate to nearly as much spiritual power in the Cultivation Realm.
But soon after, they also started exclaiming.
On the first toast, four hundred out of two thousand people broke through a small realm on the spot.
The drinks here surprisingly contained profound mysteries.
Zhao Hongde held his empty cup with disbelief as he advanced from the Gathering Yuan Sixth Layer to the Gathering Yuan Seventh Layer.
He had thought he’d stay like that for life, never imagining a day when he could break through.
"Could this wine be the legendary Jade Dew?"
Someone murmured to themselves.
"It’s not just spiritual power; I even tasted a hint of Spirit Platform Mirror in this wine!"
Eyes widened.
"Can there truly be such miraculous wine in the world? Isn’t this Immortal Wine?"
"If I could have another cup, I could break through too..."
With the first cup emptied, everyone’s gaze locked onto the wine jug on the table.
They reached out towards it in unison, racing to pour themselves another.
The frantic scramble left them careless of appearances.
Some grabbed the jug, pouring directly into their mouths, while others nearly resorted to fists in the scuffle.
Even Brother Cheng couldn’t bear to see more of this.
This wine was just brewed from the nearby spring water.
But because Ah Huang elevated the spirit vein so much, the spring water and streams transformed.
Feixian Sect had as much of this wine as anyone could want; the first few drinks had miraculous effects.
Drinking more thereafter basically brought little to no improvement.
Since it was a good day for Feixian Sect, he didn’t want a laughing stock to arise.
So he raised a slight amount of Saint Tier Divine Soul, calming the crowd.
"There’s plenty of this wine. If any of you enjoy it, drink up without fixating on that one jug."
He followed this with a signal.
A few disciples waved, floating over a large barrel of wine to each table.
Seeing the enormous barrels, too massive for even two people to carry, the guests were stunned.
This was just too unbelievably extravagant!
And then, their shock and exclamations never ended.
Every type of fruit and dish on the table was linked to cultivation.
To Feixian Sect’s Celestial Fate Daoist Palace disciples, these delicacies had no enhancing effect.
But to these guests, they were nothing less than rare Spirit Elixirs.
By the end of the meal, many had broken through a Great Realm.
Zhao Hongde had even reached Soul Splitting First Layer.
Remembering starting the day as Gathering Yuan Sixth Layer, he felt the entire ordeal was like a dream.
At his age, he’d long been deemed out of potential, with no hope of advancement in life.
He never imagined a day where he could enter the Soul Splitting stage.
Breaking through this Great Realm extended his lifespan considerably, possibly altering his life’s destiny.
The guest with the highest realm, Spirit Platform First Layer, had now reached Spirit Platform Fifth Layer.
Originally a member of a sect akin to the Qianxing Dynasty and merely an Outer Disciple there.
He’d likely ascend to Inner Sect Disciple status upon returning.
Most of the two thousand present were in similar situations.
Everyone shared one thought—the decision to attend this banquet was the best they ever made!
Those who missed out really missed big time.
The banquet wasn’t even over yet, and many, amidst their excitement, were so moved tears flowed down their faces as they feasted recklessly.
"Thank you, Sect Leader Jiang, for inviting us!"
"This visit to Feixian Sect is our greatest honor!"
"Thanks for Sect Leader Jiang’s generous hospitality!"
"Only a Sacred Land like Feixian Sect wouldn’t look down upon us low-tier cultivators..."
"After returning, I must sculpt a Golden Body for Sect Leader Jiang, burn incense, pray, and show my never-ending gratitude for this life-changing grace!"
Ding, ding, ding, a system alert sounded repeatedly.
In just a short time, over three hundred people, out of gratitude and admiration, had pledged their loyalty to him in their hearts.
Adding several hundred points to his score.
Well...
Jiang Cheng was a bit speechless, though these points didn’t mean much to someone like him, yet didn’t they have sects and families originally?
Especially the person who mentioned sculpting a Golden Body, couldn’t it be more ridiculous, Brother’s not even dead!
He gave a sulking glance at Lan Ti not far beside him.
Others became part of me after a meal, but you!
I’ve even avenged you, yet not once have you added a single point for me.
While the banquet joyfully continued inside, elite experts from Heart Division arrived at the outskirts of Feixian Sect’s Secret Realm.
Not many came this time, just over twenty, but they were Heart Division’s most elite forces.
Four were of Ascending to Saint.
Clan Leader Qingsuo certainly didn’t wish to clash with Jiang Cheng, their policy had always been to maintain neutrality and avoid offending anyone.
Given Feixian Sect’s capability to wipe out Silence Sacred Land, it was clearly no simple entity.
But she had no choice this time, with Saint Bi Feng’s conditions laid out like this, a stance had to be taken regarding Feixian Sect.
Upon arrival at the periphery, they first noticed the Three-Eyed Tiger still floating in the air.
After a brief sensing, it almost frightened them senseless.
A Saint Tier!
A Demon King even!
Feixian Sect actually had a Demon King stationed here?
Its level surpassed that of all of them.
Even though the Three-Eyed Tiger was suppressed by rules, it was still Saint Tier...
Clan Leader Qingsuo’s face turned green; they couldn’t even pass the first hurdle.
The rest of the clan members looked at her, meaning what now?
Should they proceed to Feixian Sect or not?
Qingsuo was terribly torn and troubled.
Maybe, they should just forget it this time?
But just then, they heard the Three-Eyed Tiger’s raspy voice ring in their ears.
"What are you guys dawdling for out there?"
"Master is bored watching, hurry up and get in!"

chapters.title: Chapter 145: We Are Not Here to Congratulate
chapters.content:
Chapter 145: Chapter 145: We Are Not Here to Congratulate
Qingsuo and her companions broke out in a cold sweat.
They never thought the Tiger Demon would discover their spying ahead of time.
Normally, if a group of other sects’ experts were caught sneaking around by the Sect Guardian Spirit Beast, a fight would definitely break out.
Yet this Tiger Demon actually told them to hurry inside?
What’s going on?
Qingsuo was still cautiously trying to explain.
"Um, Senior Demon King, we didn’t mean to..."
"Alright, alright, hurry up and cut the nonsense!"
The Three-Eyed Tiger didn’t know who they were.
It just assumed these 20-plus people were also invited guests.
It even thought they were too late.
As for Qingsuo and the others hesitating, it could understand that too.
It was probably just because they were intimidated by its mighty presence.
Uh...
Is the Feixian Sect this casual?
They don’t even check identities?
What if they’re enemies?
For a moment, Qingsuo and the others didn’t know what to say, but since the Demon King had already let them in, they had no reason to retreat.
"Thank you, Senior!"
Thank for what, the Three-Eyed Tiger continued to lie in mid-air pretending to nap, too lazy to even acknowledge them.
Thus, this group from the Heart Division entered the Feixian Sect without any issues.
Upon entering, they could feel the rich Spiritual Qi.
Their eyes widened in disbelief.
"Is this a Tier Eight Spirit Vein?"
"I remember the Spirit Vein of Silence Sacred Land was the same Tier Six as ours before."
"So envious..."
"I’ve absolute confidence I could continue to improve if I cultivated here long-term!"
Regret appeared again on Qingsuo’s face.
"Looks like it was his daughter who did this."
If only they had kept Jiang Cheng in Mingxin Sacred Land that day, they could be enjoying such benefits every day now.
There was no one else along the way.
On the day of the grand ceremony, all who entered were guests, and Ah Huang had been notified in advance.
So there was no reaction from him either.
It wasn’t until they entered the bustling reception hall that they finally saw Jiang Cheng.
This man truly had a big heart.
Did he not know he was being watched by a Saint Tier, yet still boldly hosted a grand ceremony here?
"Eh?"
Sitting at the top, Jiang Cheng also spotted them.
He immediately greeted them with a beaming smile.
"What brought you all here."
"Welcome, welcome!"
Although their last meeting at the Heart Division was a bit unpleasant and he disapproved of their actions, there was no enmity between them.
He just assumed Qingsuo and the others came to attend the ceremony.
He was quite happy indeed.
He was worried there weren’t enough prestigious guests to give him a boost and make him look good; this group from the Heart Division was a godsend!
"Sect Leader Jiang, we..."
Before Qingsuo could finish her sentence, Jiang Cheng quickly came to her and pulled her to a seat.
"Come, come, sit down, sit down!"
"Clan Leader Qing, you’re late, you deserve three cups as penalty!"
I’m not surnamed Qing, Qingsuo was on the verge of tears.
At this moment, Lan Ti also came over to greet them.
After all, she was taken in by the Heart Division for a few years, and seeing them here made her genuinely happy.
The other disciples were unaware of the situation.
They only saw that this group seemed to know the Sect Leader, could it be they were invited by the Sect Leader?
Realizing this was no small matter if they felt their presence.
Whoa!
Each and every one of them seemed to be experts, all of them unfathomable!
Our Sect Leader really has connections!
Instantly, everyone enthusiastically gathered around them.
"Yes, yes, certainly, three penalty cups are a must!"
"Clan Leader Qing, right? You’re a guest here, please don’t stand on ceremony!"
"If you’re friends with the Sect Leader, then you’re friends of the entire Feixian Sect."
"We’re all cultivators, a little wine won’t get us drunk..."
The experts of the Heart Division were bewildered, two of whom in the Ascending to Saint Realm were forced by Yin Xuer and Wei Miao to drink down three cups each.
"Good!"
The whole hall erupted in cheers.
Sect Leader Jiang’s reputation had to be respected.
Qingsuo, unable to refuse, reluctantly drank the three cups and was just about to state her true intentions.
"Ladies and gentlemen, you might not recognize this group here!"
Jiang Cheng flew to the center, pointing at the group from the Heart Division.
"This here is Clan Leader Qingsuo of the renowned Mingxin Sacred Land, a master of the Ascending to Saint Ninth Layer!"
"And these few, are also in the Ascending to Saint Realm!"
He silently added in his heart—they all came to congratulate and support me!
"Wow!"
The entire crowd gasped in surprise.
"Ascending to Saint Realm!"
"Oh my, I never thought I’d see so many powerful beings in my lifetime!"
"Mingxin Sacred Land is one of the top ten Sacred Lands, second only to Tongyou Sacred Land, incredibly powerful!"
"I’ve heard tales saying they don’t like to associate with the outside world, always staying reclusive."
"Yes, yes, they even skipped the two millionth founding anniversary of Purple Cloud Sacred Land back then."
"Still, Feixian Sect has real influence, to have them come." "
"Certainly, if I were from Mingxin Sacred Land, I’d also want to be his best friend!"
"Absolutely!"
"It seems Mingxin Sacred Land has also sensed Sect Leader Jiang’s extraordinary aura."
Listening to the people talk like this, the group from the Heart Division was so ’moved’ they nearly cried.
We’re not here to congratulate!
We have no relationship with Sect Leader Jiang!
We came to clarify things, to notify that the Void Immortal Realm will no longer be open to you...
Moreover, even without that purpose, they didn’t want to get too involved with the Feixian Sect.
The Heart Division’s principle for years has been self-preservation.
They didn’t want to form any alliances, or be drawn into any grievances with any power.
This was partially to avoid getting into trouble and partially out of pride in their unique identity as the Immortal Remnant Race.
They hadn’t even attended the Purple Cloud Sacred Land’s two-million-year ceremony back then for this exact reason.
And now, look what’s happened.
Before they even said a word, the entire crowd already assumed they and Jiang Cheng were the best of friends.
As if they’ve been through thick and thin together.
We need to clarify this.
Otherwise, once word gets out, the Heart Division will be labeled as an ally of the Feixian Sect, giving them no peace ever again.
"Sect Leader Jiang, actually, this time we came to..."
Qingsuo didn’t get to finish her sentence as Jiang Cheng interrupted her again.
He patted his own chest, giving a ’I understand, I understand’ expression.
"Clan Leader Qing, there’s no need to say anything."
"Let bygones be bygones. I’m very magnanimous and have already forgotten all about it!"
"Let’s turn our swords into ploughshares!"
After saying that, he threw his head back and downed a cup.
The crowd cheered again.
"The fact that you came means you respect me."
"And to those who give me respect, I, Jiang Cheng, will never treat them poorly!"
With those words, Qingsuo was left utterly speechless.
She was defeated...
Because she suddenly realized she could no longer voice their true intentions.
How could she say it in this situation?
After being told to turn their swords into ploughshares, is she supposed to say they’re here to sever ties?
If she said that, they might end up as enemies right there and then, probably start a fight?
There’s a Demon King outside, could they even leave alive if a fight broke out?
They could only grit their teeth and continue to play the part of regular guests.
As for the consequences once word spreads, it was beyond their control by now.
It wasn’t until the afternoon that the banquet finally concluded.
Aside from those 20-plus from the Heart Division, everyone else seemed thoroughly satisfied, hosts and guests alike.
Jiang Cheng once again made his way to the center of the room, extending a hand towards the group from the Heart Division.
"""

chapters.title: Chapter 146: The Transformation of the Heart Division
chapters.content:
Chapter 146: Chapter 146: The Transformation of the Heart Division
"Ladies and gentlemen!"
"Thank you for taking time out of your busy schedules and traveling from afar to attend the founding ceremony of our Feixian Sect!"
As soon as the words were spoken, everyone stood up one after another.
"Not at all, Sect Leader Jiang, you’re too polite!"
"We should be the ones thanking you."
Today, all of them had more or less raised their realms; not to express gratitude would be strange.
"Indeed, seeing the Feixian Sect in person today, we finally understand how approachable Sect Leader Jiang truly is."
"Brother, you are absolutely right. I, who have cultivated for over three hundred years, have seen many so-called great figures. Those people have power that is a thousand times inferior to Sect Leader Jiang, yet they never deign to look us in the eye. The difference is like night and day!"
"All those rumors outside have demonized him. Someone even said Sect Leader Jiang is an evil demon, which is really infuriating!"
"Once we leave here, we’ll surely find a way to clear Sect Leader Jiang’s name!"
"That’s right; if all the great sects in the cultivation realm were like the Feixian Sect, it would be a blessing for the entire realm."
This flattery made Brother Cheng feel a bit as if he was floating on a cloud.
Could it be that someone like me, who has destroyed so many sects, is actually so noble?
Becoming a model in the cultivation realm—how is that possible?
"You’re too kind, too kind!"
"It’s the thought that counts."
"All of you came here and even went to the trouble of giving generous gifts."
"Before you leave, I also have some small gifts to return to you."
Was there really a surprise?
The guests present were at a loss for words.
Were they here to attend a banquet or an award ceremony?
Why did it feel like they had stumbled upon the greatest encounter of their lives?
They really wanted to say, Sect Leader Jiang, you don’t have to be so gracious, we truly feel embarrassed.
The little ’generous gifts’ we gave do not even match the value of a drink or a fruit here.
But these words were stuck in their throats, not a single person could bring themselves to say them.
After all, as cultivators, how many could resist the temptation of a power boost...
Jiang Cheng waved his robe sleeve, and over two thousand storage rings slowly flew around, landing in front of everyone present.
"Inside these storage rings, there are ten bottles of Fifth-grade Spirit Pills each, one bottle of Sixth-grade Spirit Pills, eight hundred Top-grade Spirit Stones, and one piece of Tier Five Spirit Armor."
"I hope it can be of help to everyone."
Originally, he had prepared Fourth-grade Spirit Pills and Tier Four Spirit Armor.
But upon learning that many who were invited did not come, he angrily decided to upgrade the red packet to a higher tier.
People fight for dignity; it’s to spite those who didn’t come!
After all, even if there were two thousand sets, totaling several tens of thousands, compared to the billions he now casually accumulates, it was just a drop in the bucket.
Moreover, they were useless for the current realm of Feixian Sect disciples.
If these could serve as living advertisements, enhancing his reputation, then he thought it was well worth it.
Hearing the contents of the gifts in the rings, the guests present were completely shocked, their mouths forming an "O" shape, unable to close.
Fifth-grade Pills, among them even the two cultivators with the highest Spirit Platform Realm cultivation rarely managed to enjoy them.
This time he had given ten bottles!
Among this group, many regularly used only Lower Grade Spirit Stones, and Middle-grade ones were for festive occasions.
Yet now, eight hundred Top-grade Spirit Stones had been given.
Not to mention there was a Tier Five Spirit Armor that they did not even dare to dream of.
And lastly, there was a bottle of Sixth-grade Spirit Pills.
With these resources, their future breakthrough to Spirit Platform Realm was almost a certainty. Some with decent talent might even have a chance to become Celestial Fate cultivators.
This— Is this real?
Are the items inside this ring really ours?
"Sect Leader Jiang!"
Thud, a cultivator suddenly knelt down emotionally with the ring in hand.
"Such great kindness from you, how could I possibly repay it!"
Can’t blame him for being too dramatic; this gift was nothing to Brother Cheng, but for these bottom-tier cultivators, it unequivocally changed their lives.
"Sect Leader Jiang, we may be weak and unworthy in your eyes. Still, today I swear, from now on, should you ever have need of us, we will lay down our lives to serve!"
"After returning home, no matter where we are or which sect we belong to, our loyalty will always lie with the Feixian Sect!"
Ding ding ding...
The system notified, at this moment, all guests in the crowd had become his own people.
This left Brother Cheng somewhat startled.
He meant only to show off a bit, and giving these gifts was just to refine this act further, letting those outside know how wrong it was not to come today.
Who knew, all these people pledged loyalty, every single one.
This truly was an unexpected harvest.
If he had known, he would have given a few more pills, and these people, once they elevated their realms, he could earn more points.
After sending these people out of the Secret Realm, only then did the Heart Division’s people step forward.
Qingsuo sincerely said, "Sect Leader Jiang, it is late; may we stay for the night?"
Jiang Cheng was a bit surprised.
What do cultivators care about being late?
However, he now regarded the Heart Division people as honored guests, naturally he would not refuse.
"Of course, you’re most welcome!"
"Xue’Er, find a place for the Heart Division experts to stay."
"No problem!"
After the Heart Division settled down, they quickly gathered together.
"Clan Leader, what should we do?"
"Yes, if we do not clarify our intentions soon, it may become too late."
Qingsuo gave a bitter laugh, "It’s already too late, now anyone would see us as Feixian Sect’s ally."
Having been ’ambushed’ by Jiang Cheng, they inexplicably became friends, even if they explained it afterward, it would change nothing.
Once those two thousand guests leave, they would spread it wide and far.
"What—what should we tell Saint Bi Feng?"
"What else can we say, the worst case is not to open the Void Immortal Realm," Qingsuo said flatly.
"Ah?"
"Then our million-year wait, the anticipation of our clansmen, it would all amount to nothing..."
Qingsuo sighed, "I cannot say it, how about you?"
The clan elder’s face froze, after a long time, he shook his head with a bitter smile.
"Ah, after today, I’ve realized Lan Ti had a far better insight than us, having chosen the right person."
"That Jiang Cheng is not only extraordinarily gifted and talented; his character is first-rate, even I am moved by it."
Everyone knew these were just face-saving words for respect; the true reason was clear to all— they were too afraid to speak.
This Jiang Cheng had a Demon King as his backer.
Would you openly tell him to either leave the Thousand Spirit Domain or forget about entering the Void Immortal Realm in the future?
What reaction would a normal person have?
Back then, it might be the Heart Division that gets attacked first.
"So what should we do next?"
They really did not want to miss the opportunity to enter the Void Immortal Realm.
"After all of talking round and round, the real issue is that Saint Bi Feng has gone too far!" an elder said severely.
The others nodded in agreement.
"Clearly, he grabbed the Witch Division’s Magical Treasure, yet still has the gall to force us!"
"If he wants to deal with Jiang Cheng, he should do it himself, instead of pushing us out to challenge him, putting us in a dilemma..."
"This is using us as pawns, as if we couldn’t see it."
Qingsuo pondered for a long while, her gaze gradually becoming resolute.
"Since the outside world will sooner or later see us as allies of the Feixian Sect."
"Why not just follow the flow...and simply become real allies!"
"The opportunity to enter the Void Immortal Realm is something Jiang Cheng himself certainly would not miss."
"Instead of worrying uselessly here, I’d rather lay everything on the table and toss this problem to him."
"This person is not only of exceptional talent and quality, but his disposition is first-rate, even I can’t help but admire him."

chapters.title: Chapter 147: Why not just snatch it directly?
chapters.content:
Chapter 147: Chapter 147: Why not just snatch it directly?
"Ah?"
The clan elders all expressed their lack of understanding.
"This doesn’t align with our Heart Division’s style of staying out of external grudges and entanglements."
"Alliancing with the Feixian Sect means facing their enemies together."
"Indeed, the Feixian Sect is quite a whirlpool..."
Qingsuo shook her head.
"As of now, there’s no way to have both choices; we must make a decision."
"Self-preservation is no longer possible."
"I bet, even if we break with Jiang Cheng this time, that Saint Bi Feng will come up with other troubles to threaten us next."
"Compared to that scoundrel, I’m more inclined to stand with Jiang Cheng."
The clan elders gradually fell silent.
They had to admit that Qingsuo made sense.
Back when Saint Bi Feng and the Eight Tribes discussed matters about entering the Void Immortal Realm, he made many excessive demands.
Seeing their eagerness to enter, he deliberately extorted them.
The high-ups of the Eight Tribes were made utterly exhausted by him.
Given this person’s style, more issues are bound to come up later.
The next day, Jiang Cheng saw the group from the Heart Division again.
"Sect Leader Jiang, to be honest, besides congratulating you, we are here to remind you to be cautious of that Saint Bi Feng."
Revealing everything also requires skill.
For instance, now Qingsuo’s words made it sound like yesterday they were sincerely congratulating him, sounding quite nice.
Jiang Cheng suspiciously glanced at her, is the Heart Division really this enthusiastic?
"Saint Bi Feng? The only Saint Tier in the Thousand Spirit Domain, what’s the deal with him?"
"Is he planning to attack me?"
He was a bit excited, hoping everyone would come against him, so he could earn more points.
"That’s not it..."
For some reason, after Qingsuo said the word ’not,’ Jiang Cheng on the other side seemed disappointed.
"After you guys destroyed the Silence Sacred Land, Saint Bi Feng came to our Heart Division."
"He asked us to cooperate in sanctioning you."
"Sanction?"
Brother Cheng frowned, feeling very discomforted.
Damn Saint, can’t you be a bit bolder and attack directly?
If you’re afraid, just call more people; what’s with this vague sanction?
"Correct!"
Qingsuo’s expression was heavy as she said, "He wants us to seal the entrance to the Void Immortal Realm after some time, preventing you and Lan Ti from entering."
"What?"
Before Jiang Cheng could speak, Lan Ti couldn’t hold back.
"How can he be so despicable and shameless?"
Her purplish eyes seemed to be on the verge of spewing fire: "That Bone Refining Banner was something he schemed to take from our Witch Division, how can he have the authority..."
The Witch Division now only has her left.
Even if she wanted to develop it, there’s no way to; her sole hope over the years was to ascend to the Immortal Realm someday.
To find the Witch Ancestor among the nine Immortal Ancestors of the past, and find other Immortal Realm clan members.
For this goal, she has been lurking in the Qianxing Dynasty for three years to acquire the Four-direction Primordial Cauldron.
Now an unforeseen event has occurred, it’s imaginable what her mood is.
"Clan Leader, did you... agree to his demands?"
Her tears began to spill over, filled with loss, disappointment, and heartache.
The Heart Division holds some significance in her heart.
"Lan Ti, don’t worry, we certainly won’t agree to such unreasonable demands."
Qingsuo sighed secretly; initially, they had agreed.
Other clan elders chimed in: "That’s right, how could we possibly abandon you?"
"We firmly rejected him at the time!"
"Then hurried here overnight just to inform Sect Leader Jiang about this."
"Indeed, we are willing to share fate with the Feixian Sect."
A slew of kind words filled Lan Ti’s heart with warmth and gratitude.
But Brother Cheng was unaffected.
"That’s it?"
"Ah?" Qingsuo was taken aback.
"I mean, is his so-called sanction just that?"
The members of the Heart Division were nearly speechless.
Isn’t this severe enough?
"Sect Leader Jiang, don’t take this lightly, unless you don’t want to enter the Void Immortal Realm, this concerns your entire life!"
"Yes, to enter the Void Immortal Realm, you need the combined power of nine Magical Treasures. The Bone Refining Banner is in his possession, which makes the matter extremely tricky."
"Missing this opportunity for entry might mean there will never be another chance."
Jiang Cheng nodded to show understanding.
"I do plan on entering the Void Immortal Realm, but isn’t this matter rather easy to resolve?"
Huh?
Easy?
They were all utterly exhausted, alright?
Could he actually have some clever plan?
"Saint Bi Feng is insidious and deceitful, extremely difficult to handle."
"Sect Leader Jiang, persuading him to agree to let you through is unlikely."
Jiang Cheng chuckled: "I never planned on wasting my breath with him; just snatching the Bone Refining Banner from his hands solves it, doesn’t it?"
He never quite understood why the Immortal Remnant Race’s Eight Tribes agreed to cooperate with Saint Bi Feng.
When this guy appears, if the Eight Tribes charged at him all together, wouldn’t it make sense to bash his brains out and take the Bone Refining Banner?
That way, no longer having to see the face of that so-called Saint.
Once all nine Magical Treasures are in hand, the Immortal Remnant Race can do whatever they want internally, how satisfying.
Since the Immortal Remnant Race doesn’t go snatching it, I’ll go snatch it.
By obtaining the Bone Refining Banner, controlling the initiative to enter the Void Immortal Realm is within grasp.
Choosing when to open becomes optional.
Qingsuo and the others wore bewildered expressions as if listening to dream talk.
She forced a smile: "Sect Leader Jiang makes things sound too simple."
"Although Saint Bi Feng’s character is poor, his strength is genuinely formidable. He’s reached the Peak of Saint Tier, among the top experts in all major domains."
Of course, this didn’t faze Brother Cheng; in front of the Resurrection Skill, is strength even meaningful?
"Could it be that your Eight Tribes combined can’t take him down?"
Qingsuo shook her head.
"Can’t take him down."
"He only came with a Dharma Body; the Bone Refining Banner is on his main body, killing the Dharma Body will completely eliminate the possibility of opening the Void Immortal Realm."
"Find his main body then. Isn’t he the Supreme Elder of the Tongyou Sacred Land? You tribes should band together and attack."
The clan elders of the Heart Division all shook their heads.
They suddenly doubted whether cooperating with Jiang Cheng was the right decision this time.
His talent is indeed extremely strong, but his words seem impulsively naive like a three-year-old.
Simply put, he appears to lack intelligence.
"It’s impossible to attack."
Qingsuo patiently explained: "The remaining Seven Tribes coming across domains will be oppressed by rules, making it hard to exert full strength."
"Moreover, Saint Tier experts have numerous means of survival. Even if defeated, they can escape, making them extremely hard to kill. Over nearly ten million years, no Saint Tier has been slain in the Lower Realm."
"Additionally, Bi Feng has vast connections and allies in other domains."
"The location of his main body is also unknown."
"Once we fail to kill him, both sides will be completely torn apart."
"Opening the Void Immortal Realm will become impossible."
What she said indeed posed challenges.
But to Jiang Cheng, it was hardly anything.
His only consideration now was the location of Saint Bi Feng’s main body.
If he could encounter it...
This so-called insidious, powerful, wide-networked individual could prematurely be declared with the lid on a coffin.

chapters.title: Chapter 148: Heartless Immortal Bone
chapters.content:
Chapter 148: Chapter 148: Heartless Immortal Bone
While Jiang Cheng and the members of the Heart Division were contemplating how to deal with Saint Bi Feng, the two thousand guests also returned to various places within the Thousand Spirit Domain.
The details of the grand ceremony quickly spread.
All two thousand participants of the banquet had significantly enhanced their strength.
It was as if they had collectively entered a Treasure Cave.
No, that wouldn’t do it justice.
Among these two thousand people, the least had advanced by three to four minor realms, and some had even advanced two major realms.
It was akin to changing one’s destiny and being reborn!
And this miraculous effect was entirely attributed to that banquet.
It was said that every fruit, vegetable, and beverage at the banquet greatly enhanced cultivation.
Not only that, before leaving, everyone was given a ring filled with cultivation resources.
The scene Jiang Cheng envisioned had come true.
Outsiders were not just envious now.
Many were so jealous their eyes turned red.
On what grounds?
These two thousand people didn’t pay a price; they merely took a jaunt to feast and drink.
It could be said they hardly put in any effort.
Yet they gained more than many who had spent hundreds of years in ascetic cultivation and trials.
Such comparisons are maddening.
Especially those who had been invited by the Feixian Sect before but deliberately declined.
For example, members of the Zhao family’s leaders and elders, genuinely regretful to the core.
This grand ceremony was actually a giant opportunity!
The opportunity had once been right in front of them, but they had pushed it away themselves, giving it to the steward Zhao Hongde for free.
When Zhao Hongde left, he was at the Gathering Yuan Sixth Layer; upon return, he was already at the Soul Splitting Third Layer.
Standing on par with some of the family elders...
There’s no reasoning this out.
Blame it on the generosity and grand gesture of the Feixian Sect.
Had they known they would have moved their entire family to participate!
If they had, the entire Zhao Family’s power would have increased dramatically, changing the fate of the family entirely.
Two elders of the Zhao Family grew more and more stifled with regret, to the extent that they unprecedentedly fell ill even at the Soul Splitting Realm.
Sadly, there is no medicine for regret in the world.
Now, besides envy, jealousy, and resentment, the outside world looks forward with eagerly stretched necks, hoping the Feixian Sect will host another joyous occasion.
Like an annual, ten-year, or hundred-year celebration, or perhaps achieving the Saint Tier, or the Sect Leader getting married...
Surely, they would hold another grand ceremony then, wouldn’t they?
Billions of cultivators in the Thousand Spirit Domain declared, if invited, they’d definitely attend.
Ah no, even if not invited, they would travel overnight, spontaneously arriving to offer congratulations.
Hands don’t strike a smiling face.
The focus of mid to lower-level cultivators was on the banquet, but for the apex experts and major powers, these things held no interest.
What concerned them were two other details of the ceremony.
The Mingxin Sacred Land, normally aloof from outside affairs, had shockingly sent all their experts to support the Feixian Sect.
Besides this strong ally, the Feixian Sect had a Demon King level Tiger Demon as a guardian!
This Tiger Demon was the ’culprit’ that had ravaged the Purple Cloud Sacred Land a year ago.
These two pieces of information forced all major powers to reevaluate the Feixian Sect’s strength.
Especially the latter; that was undoubtedly Saint Tier combat power!
Many suddenly understood why Silence Sacred Land was wiped out.
If Brother Cheng learned of this reaction from the outside world, he’d likely regret letting the Three-Eyed Tiger go on stage.
Once again, his glorious achievements were overshadowed.
The pilots of the Eight Great Sacred Lands felt secretly relieved, thankful they hadn’t impulsively launched an attack; it would have been seeking death.
The only hope they had now rested on Saint Bi Feng.
This Saint Tier not only possessed immense power but had many methods as well.
With him around, the order established by the Nine Venerable Sacred Lands could continue to hold.
Little did they know, Saint Bi Feng was currently very busy.
His Dharma Body traversed seven domains, arriving at the Ten Thousand Bones Domain, billions of miles away.
"Bi Feng, are you telling the truth?"
"There really is a Void Immortal Realm, with its entrance under your control?"
Amidst the void, there stood three altars as grand as mountains.
Golden bones stacked layer upon layer, radiating a holy light amongst the clouds.
Upon these three altars floated three skeletons of white jade.
The central skeleton resembled a human but was twice the height of a regular human, and had two golden bone wings behind its back.
When it spoke, a faint glow sliced across the top of its head.
Standing proudly amidst the three altars, Bi Feng had a carefree smile.
"How dare I deceive the Golden Wing Saint King; the matter of the Void Immortal Realm is entirely true!"
Outwardly calm, he was, in fact, very cautious.
These three white jade skeletons were Saint Tier experts equivalent to him.
However, in the Lower Realm of Ten Thousand Realms, cultivation systems varied.
The beings of the Ten Thousand Bones Domain did not cultivate meridians, Qi Sea, or Divine Soul, only skeletons.
Their cultivation process involved shedding skin and flesh, refining pure skeletal forms.
This cultivation method was determined by the natural environment and racial characteristics there, unreplicable in other domains.
The three skeletons remained silent, seemingly communicating privately.
After a moment, the Golden Wing Saint King spoke again.
"You aren’t so generous as to willingly inform us of this news."
Bi Feng gently smiled: "The Saint King’s words are accurate."
"Opening the Void Immortal Realm requires a significant cost, naturally, it won’t let people in for free."
This explained why his Dharma Body had been roaming various domains in recent years.
For the Heart Division, unlocking the Void Immortal Realm was a perfect chance to enter the Immortal Realm.
For Saint Bi Feng, it equally presented a business opportunity.
Possessing the Bone Refining Banner, he effectively controlled one of the Void Immortal Realm’s entrances, allowing him to sell ’tickets’ at exorbitant prices.
Especially as the other eight tribes of the Immortal Remnant Race lacked his entrepreneurial mindset, leaving him without competition.
Just like the three Saint Kings of the Ten Thousand Bones Domain, believing there was only one entrance and unaware there were actually nine.
"State your terms."
"My demands are modest, merely three complete sections of Heartless Immortal Bone!"
At these words, the void, spanning tens of thousands of miles, began to storm and thunder.
The hollow eye sockets of the three Saint Kings burned with divine light.
"How did you learn of the Heartless Immortal Bone?"
This Heartless Immortal Bone was their supreme treasure in the Ten Thousand Bones Domain.
Back when the Bone Race Saint King ascended to immortality, he encountered a Thunder Tribulation, some accidentally losing parts of their bodies.
Some parts, after being tempered by the Thunder Tribulation, had transitioned from Saint Bone to Immortal Bone.
These fallen parts were revered as supreme treasures by the lower Bone Race.
They could be refined into magical treasures, even Sacred Artifacts.
Whereas the Heartless Immortal Bone was a special existence among Immortal Bones, capable of being refined and merged into a part of the Bone Race’s body.
The Bone Race’s skeletons were already the strongest across the Ten Thousand Realms, exceeding even true immortals at Saint Tier strength.
What’s more, at Immortal Tier.
If successfully refined into a part of oneself, it would mean having a body part with strength surpassing Celestial Immortals.
Moreover, it might even impart a portion of the Bone Race’s unique divine techniques.
However, skeletons accidentally struck down were rare, and those that transitioned into Immortal Bones were even more precious.
The Heartless Immortal Bone was a rarity among rarities within Immortal Bones.
For thousands of millennia, not one within the Bone Race had ascended to immortality.
One could imagine its value, yet Bi Feng openly requested three sections.

chapters.title: Chapter 149 Brother Cheng Goes to War
chapters.content:
Chapter 149: Chapter 149 Brother Cheng Goes to War
"It’s not important how I found out."
"What matters is whether you’re willing to accept this deal."
Saint Bi Feng was not worried about their refusal.
No one can resist the chance to become immortal.
For millions of years, the Saint Tier Cultivators in the Lower Realm Ten Thousand Realms have been driven to madness.
Without Thunder Tribulation, unable to ascend, and without Advancement Space, most people have stagnated at the Peak of Saint Tier.
The lifespan at Saint Tier is ten million years, which is considered quite long.
But ultimately, it is limited, unable to withstand the wear of time.
Over these millions of years, many veteran Saint Tier Cultivators have passed away in resentment and despair due to their lifespan running out.
Sure enough, the three Saint Kings gradually calmed down.
"Your condition is too excessive."
"Not even one section is possible, yet you ask for three?"
"Change your condition."
The Heartless Immortal Bone is too precious, they don’t want to let it go.
But Bi Feng was not easy to dismiss.
He was skilled at extortion.
"Once you become immortal, the Heartless Immortal Bone won’t have any significance to you, will it?"
After the Bone Race ascends to immortality, their whole body becomes Immortal Bone.
By then, the embellishment of the Heartless Immortal Bone is indeed unnecessary.
It can even be said that after becoming immortal, they would actively remove the fused Heartless Immortal Bone.
Someone else’s bones, after all, don’t suit as well as one’s own.
But for other races, even if they ascend, the Heartless Immortal Bone still remains a big killer.
Imagine a Cultivator of the Spiritual Power Element just becoming a First Grade True Immortal, with a body part stronger than a Ninth-grade Celestial Immortal.
What concept is that in battle?
This is why Saint Bi Feng targeted the Immortal Bone.
After going to the Immortal Realm, everything must start anew, so the starting point is crucial.
His vision was far-reaching; he had already considered how to gain initial advantages in the Immortal Realm after ascending.
"But we haven’t ascended yet."
Golden Wing Saint King’s voice sounded like many bones being forcefully rubbed.
"Even if what you say about the Void Immortal Realm is true, it doesn’t mean one can definitely enter the Immortal Realm."
The Heartless Immortal Bone was indispensable for the achievements the three Saint Kings had gained today.
If they cannot ascend, losing the Heartless Immortal Bone would be a significant blow to their strength.
Saint Bi Feng smiled lightly, "Becoming immortal is a fight against heaven and earth. If you don’t have the courage to gamble even this much, then forget it."
After speaking, he turned straight away, ready to leave the Ten Thousand Bones Domain.
"Wait a moment!"
In the end, the three Saint Kings chased after him.
The corners of Bi Feng’s mouth slightly curved; he knew he had secured the Immortal Bones.
After profiting from the Ten Thousand Bones Domain, his next stop would be the Sword Domain.
That is a Domain where Spiritual Power isn’t cultivated, but Sword Essence Power is, ranked among the top three in terms of combat strength in the Lower Realm Ten Thousand Realms.
Using the ticket of the Void Immortal Realm to exchange for an Everlasting Sword Heart that can enhance the realm of understanding in Sword Dao shouldn’t be a problem, right?
The Bone Refining Banner, which was deceitfully acquired millions of years ago, has indeed brought him immense benefit.
Saint Bi Feng was complacent, yet unaware that Jiang Cheng was already eyeing him.
On the side of Feixian Sect, a swearing-in assembly was being held.
Brother Cheng was unaware of the whereabouts of Saint Bi Feng’s true body, so to force this rogue to appear, he chose the most direct and blunt way.
Destroy Tongyou Sacred Land!
Tongyou Sacred Land is Saint Bi Feng’s sect; millions of years ago, he was a disciple there.
He even served as the Sect Leader of the Sacred Land for two million years.
Only in recent hundreds of thousands of years did he retreat to the backdrop, assuming the role of Supreme Elder.
Since then, his whereabouts have become unpredictable.
Since this was his old nest, and Tongyou Sacred Land was also intending to deal with Feixian Sect, Sect Leader Jiang had no reason to hold back.
He’s nothing like the Immortal Remnant Race’s Eight Tribes, who are overly cautious before acting.
Destroying Tongyou Sacred Land, he doesn’t believe Saint Bi Feng can remain seated.
Instead of searching for him, why not let him come to me?
Currently, Tongyou Sacred Land only has four Ascending to Saint cultivators; with his Saint Tier Divine Soul, he might be able to sweep across them.
Therefore, he shouldn’t face death or resurrection.
Since he won’t be killed, he might as well bring more people.
He decided to make a full sect expedition.
The disciples should also train; only engaging in ascetic cultivation without practical training only results in a group of non-combat savvy clods.
Of course, his larger purpose was to allow more people to witness his impressive killing spree.
In the grand plaza, 70 disciples of Feixian Sect stood neatly arranged.
Sect Leader Jiang was conducting a pre-war mobilization.
"This is the first collective expedition of our sect!"
"Remember my previous all-victorious performance and don’t embarrass me!"
"I have only one demand: leave no blade of grass alive!"
All disciples responded energetically, as if injected with adrenaline.
"Yes!"
Qingsuo and others next to Jiang Cheng were about to collapse.
"Sect Leader Jiang, could you... reconsider?"
"Indeed, Tongyou Sacred Land’s disciples number in the tens of thousands, not easy to deal with."
"Your numbers are too few..."
"If Saint Bi Feng’s true body is there, this mission might end in complete destruction!"
They regretted forming an alliance with Jiang Cheng.
This guy is simply insane.
Wasn’t destroying Silence Sacred Land enough? He wants to wipe out Tongyou Sacred Land too.
That’s a sect of Saint Tier strong persons!
It’s not just impossible; even if surpassed, the consequences are unimaginable.
Jiang Cheng thought if Saint Bi Feng is there, then that’s perfect.
At most, it would use one resurrection, and then directly retrieve the Bone Refining Banner.
"Clan Leader Qingsuo, there’s no need to fear. This time the enemy is simple, you don’t need to act."
It’s not that Brother Cheng is generous, allowing Heart Division to stand aside; he just doesn’t want them to go and share the spoils.
"We don’t mean that."
"It’s just too reckless, at least gather information about the enemy..."
You have so few people, even some in the Celestial Fate Realm; aren’t you going to be cannon fodder?
Do you really think a Three-Eyed Tiger can completely shield everyone?
Qingsuo hadn’t finished speaking when Jiang Cheng already looked at Lan Ti next to him.
His gaze was deep and sincere, "Sister Lan’s Witch Division was harmed by that scoundrel Bi Feng back then; how can I remain indifferent?"
"As long as the Bone Refining Banner is in that scoundrel’s hand, the wound in her heart cannot heal."
"An uprising in anger for a beauty!"
"It must be done!"
Miss, these words should have moved you to tears of joy, right?
Even though my real purpose is just for points.
But you eat my food, live under my roof; so many days have passed yet not becoming one of us seems inconceivable?
Lan Ti was indeed moved to tears.
"Cheng..."
"You don’t need to go to such lengths for me."
The system still didn’t ding.
Brother Cheng was disappointed, alas, it seems this lady’s heart is truly made of iron.
And among the disciples below, Ji Linghan, Lin Ning, Yin Xuer, Tang Ru, and others suddenly lost much of their fighting spirit.
So this expedition is just to please Lan Ti?
You heartless scoundrel who neglects old affection for new!
Heart Division members shook their heads constantly, this man’s credibility was utterly low.
"Alright, each of you come up to receive battle supplies!"
After speaking, Sect Leader Jiang made a big wave with his hand, and over 70 Storage Rings floated in the air.
In each ring, there was one Treasure and two Tier Nine Spiritual Artifacts.
Besides that, there were ten Treasure Talismans and three bundles of Tier Nine Spirit Talismans, as well as ten bottles of combat supplements Pills.
"If you don’t use these things, you’ll have to return them after coming back."
Especially the Treasure, if useless in the future, it can be recycled and converted into points.
Brother Cheng is indeed a frugal and resourceful person.

chapters.title: Chapter 150 Our Heart Division Duty-Bound
chapters.content:
Chapter 150: Chapter 150 Our Heart Division Duty-Bound
Training the troops is one thing, but it wouldn’t be good if someone actually died.
For now, it’s unclear how many points the next resurrection will require, and Jiang Cheng is quite concerned about his disciples’ safety.
What can be provided are all the best.
Especially Ji Linghan, Lin Ning, and Luo Yuan, who were specially equipped with three stolen magical treasures.
No choice, they are the ones with the highest realm.
If they accidentally die, the future cost of resurrection will surely be high.
Seeing all the Feixian Sect disciples equipped with Tier Nine Spiritual Artifacts and Treasures, even having magical treasures, the Heart Division experts were wide-eyed.
This treatment made them extremely envious.
The Heart Division, although strong, was not well-managed and not wealthy.
Within the clan, only the five Ascending to Saint Realm individuals used treasures, while others still used spiritual artifacts.
Compared to the former Silence Sacred Land, it’s really shabby.
Now looking at these more than seventy Feixian Sect disciples, even the Celestial Fate Ninth Layer among them is more luxuriously equipped than theirs.
And those treasure talismans, they can cause devastating damage to the Daoist Palace Realm!
"Ahem!"
Qingsuo cleared her throat, feeling the need to say something.
"Sect Leader Jiang, in this battle, our Heart Division is also duty-bound!"
Other elders of the Heart Division quickly stood up.
Each one was eager to fight, full of battle intent.
"That’s right, we’re going into battle too!"
"Please, Sect Leader Jiang, take us with you."
"In this battle, we will surely not disappoint you."
Jiang Cheng wasn’t stupid, he could see right through these old women’s hearts and lungs.
Earlier they were dawdling, but now they’re so enthusiastic all of a sudden?
Damn it, they just want to get some treasures and talismans from me, right?
What a wishful thinking!
Besides, I originally didn’t plan to bring them along, otherwise, they’d all contribute, and we’d have to split the spoils in the end.
"There’s no need, this is a matter for our Feixian Sect, no need to trouble you."
"Sect Leader Jiang, you’re mistaken!"
Qingsuo immediately interrupted him.
She righteously said, "As allies, I believe we must advance and retreat together!"
"The Tongyou Sacred Land has always been domineering, we’ve suffered enough, and we’ve wanted to fight them for a long time."
"Exactly, we are at odds with the Tongyou Sacred Land!"
"That’s right!"
Damn, you’re really getting into character, huh?
Fine, this is what you asked for!
"Since Clan Leader Qing is so enthusiastic, then alright."
"Well... our sect’s war supplies have already been distributed, there’s no extra."
"But I believe, as Ascending to Saint experts, you must have better ones and wouldn’t care for this trash."
What? None left?
Trash?
Those aren’t trash!
Qingsuo’s face turned green.
The other Heart Division experts’ expressions looked as if they were constipated.
This is awkward.
"Clan Leader Qing, I think we should set off."
"Ah..."
Without ring supplies, they really didn’t want to go.
This trip to someone else’s territory for a major battle is extremely dangerous. Without luxurious supplies, it’s likely to result in injury or death.
But the words have already been spoken.
They had just been so righteous and heroic, so how could they change their tune now?
Seeing the Feixian Sect’s forces about to depart, their legs felt as if they were filled with lead, unable to move.
Luckily, Qingsuo, worthy of being the clan leader, reacted quickly.
"Well, Sect Leader Jiang, our treasures and talismans are at the Mingxin Sacred Land, we didn’t bring them."
Jiang Cheng was incredulous: "No way, do you really leave home without equipment, Clan Leader Qing?"
Why did he have to say "also"?
The lie she had told, Qingsuo had no choice but to continue fabricating it under pressure.
"It’s like this, we came specifically to congratulate you, not to fight, so we made no preparations."
Other clan elders quickly agreed.
"Yes, yes, exactly!"
"How about Sect Leader Jiang, you go ahead, and we’ll fetch the treasures and talismans, then meet you at the Tongyou Sacred Land?"
Jiang Cheng almost laughed at them.
It was obvious this was just an excuse to escape, meeting up, they’d leave and never come back.
He didn’t bother to expose them, purposely teasing: "We’re not in a rush; shall we wait for you here?"
Qingsuo was about to cry, this guy was such a nuisance.
"No, no, we know the way."
"Besides, with the battle imminent, it’s not good to delay the hour."
"Rest assured, Sect Leader Jiang, we will definitely catch up..."
Lan Ti at the side just wanted to bury her head in the ground; everyone actually understood each other, it was so embarrassing.
Jiang Cheng finally nodded with a smile.
"In that case, hurry up then."
With that said, he waved enthusiastically as he bid farewell to the Heart Division as they fled like it was a getaway.
The Feixian Sect members looked at him speechlessly.
Especially Mo Chen, once again refreshing his impression of the Child of the Plane.
This sect leader turned out to be quite cunning.
After sending off the Heart Division, Jiang Cheng summoned the Three-Eyed Tiger.
This time, if he didn’t bring disciples on the expedition, he could go alone.
Bringing so many disciples, he had to take as many protective measures as possible, so he had to bring this Demon King along.
In the past, the Three-Eyed Tiger would definitely roll its eyes.
As the sect guardian spirit beast, I’m only responsible for the sect’s safety, not fighting.
But now, enticed by the lure of enhancing talent, there was no choice but to agree.
"You really want me to be a mount?"
"Your speed is fast; carry them, and we’ll arrive quickly."
The Silence Sacred Land does have a long-distance transmission array, but it can’t directly reach the Tongyou Sacred Land; flying a long distance is still required.
With the Three-Eyed Tiger’s Demon King power, riding on clouds and mist, it won’t take long.
With a body of one hundred thousand meters, seventy or so people sitting on it are like seventy mosquitoes, having no effect.
It’s just this guy showing his status, deliberately putting on airs.
In tough circumstances, the Three-Eyed Tiger had no option but to agree.
"What about you?"
"I’ll go ahead and destroy the Tongyou Sacred Land’s sect protection array."
Destroying the great array makes it much safer for the disciples to rush in.
At least they won’t be nailed to the ground by an attack from the great array.
"Can you do that?"
The Three-Eyed Tiger was both surprised and skeptical.
A holy land level sect protection array could already cause significant harm to an Ascending to Saint, even it was somewhat apprehensive.
During that intrusion into the Purple Cloud Sacred Land for the transmission array, if it hadn’t caught them off guard and rushed into the Array Central Hall, it wouldn’t have been that smooth.
The sect protection array is the core of a sect; normally attacking it, even a Saint Tier expert would find it hard to accomplish such a feat.
Although Jiang Cheng now had a Saint Tier Divine Soul, his spiritual power was still at the Daoist Palace Realm.
"My abilities are beyond your comprehension."
After saying this, he first stepped onto the transmission array.
With his daughter at home, the headquarters’ safety could be assured for a short time.
After transmitting twenty million miles away, he activated his transmission skills.
Two transmissions later, he reached the outskirts of Tongyou Sacred Land.
Looking at the secret realm entrance of the sacred land, he fell into contemplation.
He had never seen this sacred place before, and a weird thought came to his mind.
If I turn into one of those loose cultivators outside the secret realm and kill my way inside, that person would definitely be hated to death by Saint Bi Feng, right?
It’s such a beautiful plan!
"""

chapters.title: Chapter 151: I’m Here to Destroy You
chapters.content:
Chapter 151: Chapter 151: I’m Here to Destroy You
At this moment, on the other side, all the experts of the Heart Division were on their way back to Mingxin Sacred Land.
"Clan Leader, are we really going to Tongyou Sacred Land later to meet up with them?"
There was indeed a mention of it when we found an excuse to come back earlier.
Once we got the equipment, we were supposed to head over to meet them.
Qingsuo didn’t even turn his head and spit out two words.
"Not going."
"Huh? Then aren’t we going back on our word?"
"So what?"
Thinking of Jiang Cheng’s mocking expression just now, all the clan elders were still seething.
"Who told him to be so petty."
"If they want to court death, it’s none of our business."
Another clan member whispered, "But we are now allied with them, ally’s heavy losses won’t be good for us either..."
"Alliance, I’m already regretting getting involved with him."
Qingsuo shook his head, somewhat disappointed, "Jiang Cheng, this person, has great fortune, but acts without any planning, too impulsively."
It’s not that no Sacred Land in the lower realm has been destroyed before.
But any force, before taking action against a Sacred Land, must go through prolonged planning.
Some even spend millions of years, cultivating spies to penetrate their enemy’s inner circle, gradually alienating their allies, and weakening their internal relationships.
And look at Jiang Cheng...
He slapped his thigh and did it on the very same day.
Without investigating any intelligence, not to mention any other preparatory work.
In their opinion, this was simply child’s play.
"That’s right, allying with such a person is too dangerous, our clan can’t stand the turmoil."
"If he self-destructs, fine, but our clan might also be dragged into the abyss."
"Anyway, this alliance wasn’t witnessed by any other forces, so once we return, we’ll continue to bide our time, maintaining our observation."
The Heart Division members whose attitudes had once again shifted wouldn’t even dream that this fire would eventually reach them.
Outside Tongyou Sacred Land, Brother Cheng had already transformed into Qingsuo’s guise, swaggering openly to the entrance of the Secret Realm.
The loose cultivators below had no idea what was happening.
Then they saw that ’female cultivator’ draw her sword, and without a word, fiercely strike at the entrance of the Secret Realm!
Although Jiang Cheng’s spiritual power was still at the Daoist Palace Realm, with the various BUFFs applied, his full-force attack had reached the standard of Ascending to Saint Second Layer.
Boom!
With a loud explosion, many cultivators below were directly knocked to the ground, ears buzzing, their divine sense scattered.
In the high sky, a visible ripple spread to the surroundings.
