The violent impact carried a terrifying might capable of destroying everything, and who knows how far it spread.
Fortunately, it was in the void; if it were on the ground, none of the cultivators below would likely have survived.
The disciples guarding the Secret Realm inside disintegrated instantly, having no power to resist, they were shaken to death alive.
Yet even so, the entrance to the Secret Realm still did not open.
After all, it was a crucial pass to a Sacred Land, naturally it wouldn’t be destroyed by just one Ascending to Saint attack.
Jiang Cheng wasn’t disappointed, continuing to fiercely swing his sword at the entrance.
Boom boom boom...
The originally hidden in the void Secret Realm, under this continuous bombardment, actually revealed large portions of its edges.
In the void, one could see the outlines of some mountains and oceans, magical beyond compare.
Yet at this moment, those edge-peaked mountains seemed to suffer an earthquake, collapsing one by one.
The sea surged and overturned, birds and beasts fell, a scene of apocalypse.
Facing such an attack, the people inside certainly wouldn’t sit by idly.
In just a few seconds, the Sect Leader of Tongyou Sacred Land and numerous experts charged out, filled with killing intent.
"Who dares to create havoc at the entrance of our Sacred Land!"
"Courting death!"
"Tear them limb from limb, annihilate their nine families!"
"The might of the Sacred Land shall be washed in blood!"
Tongyou Sacred Land, after all, was the number one Sacred Land in the Thousand Spirit Domain.
With Saint Bi Feng of the Saint Tier, they had always been suppressing others, when had anyone dared to provoke them.
Unforgivable.
Sect Leader Venerable Xunguang was furious, who’s got the audacity to do such a thing?
He took a closer look, almost doubting his eyesight.
"Qingsuo, it’s actually you!"
"You’re so bold, is your Mingxin Sacred Land tired of living?"
If it were Jiang Cheng, he would not be surprised, after all, this person had just destroyed Silence Sacred Land not long ago, inherently an unstable factor.
It’s normal for him to do anything.
If it were any other of the Seven Great Sacred Lands, he could also try to understand, after all, everyone had their own ulterior motives from the start.
But Qingsuo, he couldn’t comprehend.
Mingxin Sacred Land in terms of power, ranked firmly second in the Thousand Spirit Domain, but in terms of courage, always at the bottom.
Even some Imperial Families without a Saint Realm, usually acted more wildly than them.
This group of powerful women adhered to a principle of offending no one, their usual style was extraordinarily soft.
No matter which Sacred Land dared to provoke them, they guaranteed only to smile apologetically, not daring to argue loudly.
And now them?
They dared to initiate an attack?
And attacking the first Sacred Land at that?
It must be fake, right?
His first reaction was really that this Qingsuo was being impersonated by someone else?
But upon careful inspection, the realm aura, divine soul aura, and unique temperament of this woman in front of him were all the same as what he had seen before.
No deception at all, it was impossible to impersonate so accurately.
This was indeed Qingsuo!
"That’s right, it’s me..."
"It’s me, old woman!"
"Let me tell you, I’ve been displeased with you Tongyou Sacred Land for a long time!"
Sect Leader Jiang was originally here to destroy, he didn’t need to scruple too much.
"Coming here today is to do a good thing, which is to send you all to Western Heaven!"
"No need to thank me, this is what I, the old woman, ought to do."
Although they didn’t understand what going to Western Heaven meant, everyone knew it certainly wasn’t anything good.
"Qingsuo, you’ve gone mad!"
Venerable Xunguang almost gasped in anger.
This woman ate the wrong medicine?
Suddenly changing from soft to decisive.
No, this couldn’t just be described as decisive, she was all prickly.
The change in style was so hard for him to digest.
"Your Heart Division will pay a painful price for today’s deeds!"
"Mingxin Sacred Land, will become history from now on!"
As he bellowed, he unfolded his domain, while other experts also displayed their Daoist Palaces.
"Let your people come out and meet their fate!"
In his view, the Heart Division must have been mobilized as a whole, while others must be lurking in the shadows.
Brother Cheng laughed.
"You scraps really know how to flatter yourselves, to deal with you, does it need the entire Heart Division?"
"I, the old woman, alone can level all of you!"
Without waiting for a retort from the opposite, he rushed forward to kill.
Unless he intended to be killed, Jiang Cheng didn’t have the habit of waiting for others to make the first move and then counterattack.
An all-encompassing sweep of Saint Tier Divine Soul shattered the domain.
Large numbers of Daoist Palace Realm disciples fell from the sky.
Venerable Xunguang was stunned!
What kind of power was this?
Was Qingsuo ever this strong?
He had never fought with this woman, only knowing she was Ascending to Saint Ninth Layer.
Could it be, she had recently broken through to the Saint Tier?
If so, today’s situation could be dangerous.
He didn’t know, on the other side, Brother Cheng also silently exclaimed, overkill.
If he were to finish them off himself, the disciples would have come for nothing, what’s the point of training them?
Looks like he’ll have to pull back a bit.
"""

chapters.title: Chapter 152: Is Developing Quickly Not Allowed?
chapters.content:
Chapter 152: Chapter 152: Is Developing Quickly Not Allowed?
Just as Venerable Xunguang and a group of Sacred Land experts were in a state of panic, the opposite ’Qingsuo’ suddenly turned pale.
Even in the chaotic battlefield, you could see her head drenched in sweat.
Then she clutched her chest, swung her sword, and quickly flew away into the distance.
No one even hit her, why does she look like she’s in trouble?
Venerable Xunguang was startled, and his fighting spirit was reignited.
He ’understood’ it now.
Qingsuo must have just used some forbidden technique to stimulate her power.
Such forbidden techniques have severe side effects, and after a brief surge, they backlash.
Her power would drop to the bottom, perhaps not even one-tenth of usual.
No wonder, that last strike was odd.
Her Divine Soul was extremely terrifying, yet her Spiritual Power fluctuations seemed weak.
If that’s the case, then what are we afraid of?
"She’s done!"
"She’s even weaker now than before!"
You come here causing trouble, showing off, and now you’re in trouble, you want to leave?
Is there something so easily granted?
He shouted while being the first to chase and attack.
"Destroy her!"
The other Sacred Land experts followed suit in pursuit.
However, Jiang Cheng had started running early, quickly leaving them behind.
By the time they were out chasing, he was already nowhere to be found.
Venerable Xunguang expanded his Divine Soul Perception, leading people over thousands of miles of searching, yet didn’t find a single Heart Division individual.
Ultimately, he could only return to the Secret Realm in anger.
The strike just made by ’Qingsuo’ had already caused great casualties, with at least over two hundred Daoist Palace Divine Souls fallen.
"This debt, they won’t escape!"
"Report to the Supreme Elder, let him annihilate Mingxin Sacred Land in the future!"
"It must be destroyed, this hate is irreconcilable."
"None of those women from Mingxin Sacred Land should survive!"
Saint Bi Feng, who was cultivating in seclusion in the Thousand Spirit Domain, actually received the news.
His body was hidden far and deep, recently during transactions, it’s better to avoid showing up.
To avoid other Domain experts teaming up and robbing the Bone Refining Banner.
Upon hearing Qingsuo dared to attack his Tongyou Sacred Land, his first reaction was also disbelief.
With just this woman?
Does she have the courage?
But the news from Venerable Xunguang was true, those killed disciples could never come back.
Even for him, a Saint Tier expert with mastery in tempering, he couldn’t help but feel enraged.
Is this an intention not to cooperate?
Not cooperating is one thing, but also becoming an enemy?
Upon knowing the Sacred Land is currently safe, he didn’t move immediately.
Just planned to ask about the situation next time he visits Mingxin Sacred Land.
However, he couldn’t have imagined that the most dangerous person had already entered Tongyou Sacred Land.
Brother Cheng had left the crowd behind, hid himself, and circled back.
At this time, the large group was still outside looking for Qingsuo, the Secret Realm’s exit was completely unattended, just wide open, and he quietly sneaked in.
After entering, with one sweep of his Divine Soul, he could see almost the entire arrangement on Tongyou Island.
He quickly entered the Array Central Hall.
The hall was filled with restrictions, and guards, along with Daoist Palace Realm Elders.
Jiang Cheng didn’t hurry to strike but quietly snuck around.
Now Three-Eyed Tiger has not yet arrived, no need to act prematurely.
After waiting a long time, calculating the time was about right, he unleashed a Divine Soul Shock, instantly killing the guards in the Central Hall.
Then, he destroyed the restrictions within the hall.
At this point, the core Array Hub of the Sect Protection Array was exposed before him.
This core Array Hub cannot be destroyed in one strike.
If brute force is used, it may cause a chain reaction, triggering backlash from the array and other formations.
Fortunately, last time he gained fusion of ten thousand ghosts.
Among these ten thousand ghosts, some were skilled in restrictions and arrays.
Some were even responsible for the daily maintenance of the Silence Sacred Land’s Sect Protection Array, even if the Tongyou Sacred Land’s Array was slightly different, it was not more advanced.
With his Divine Soul Realm, in just two minutes, this Great Array was almost lifted.
At this time, violent vibrations and kill cries came from outside.
It seems Three-Eyed Tiger finally brought the disciples over.
Seeing the giant Tiger Demon outside, Venerable Xunguang was truly panicking.
This is the real Demon King, not the earlier Qingsuo.
"That Tiger Demon, dare to invade my Tongyou Sacred Land, aren’t you afraid of being attacked jointly?"
"Why so much nonsense, hurry and die."
Three-Eyed Tiger, tamed by Jiang Cheng, had no patience or respect for these guys.
Directly waved a paw in the air.
Jiang Cheng inside had just lifted the Great Array and all restrictions, the Secret Realm was already exposed outside.
With a swipe, the mountains split in half, akin to a natural disaster.
Four Ascending to Saint flew backward simultaneously, countless disciples retreated in panic.
Jiang Cheng also darted out from behind.
Just about to attack from both sides, he suddenly stopped again.
Because he thought of a very ’serious’ matter—he currently looks like Qingsuo!
If he flies out, he’s not worried about friendly fire but...
The disciples will all know he can transform.
The incident of transforming into Lin Ning before will be exposed, and the Sect Leader’s supreme image will collapse.
How can this happen?
He quickly rummaged in his ring, pulling out a necklace Treasure acquired from Silence Sacred Land last time and wore it.
This thing is actually similar to Lan Ti’s earring effect.
All are about changing appearance.
After changing his appearance to a man, he used Soul Power to form a barrier around himself, to prevent careful scrutiny.
Finally, he changed into his own clothes and took out his own weapon.
Then he rushed out.
Outside, the battlefield was already in full swing.
Three-Eyed Tiger directly confronted four Ascending to Saint, leaving the rest to the disciples.
But evidently, this isn’t enough.
Four Ascending to Saint, Three-Eyed Tiger can subdue.
The rest of the Tongyou Sacred Land Daoist Palace Realm, just relying on Lan Ti and the seventy disciples from Feixian Sect, isn’t sufficient.
Too many people, and a large group of Saint Heirs and Saintesses, all Daoist Palace.
The battle immediately became precarious.
Where did the Sect Leader go?
This question popped up in everyone’s mind.
They suddenly felt lost, becoming uneasy.
But fortunately, Brother Cheng finally arrived at this moment.
Upon arrival, a wave of Divine Soul Shock took out thousands of enemies, relieving the disciples’ encirclement.
Then he coordinated with Three-Eyed Tiger, madly bombarding the Divine Souls of the four Ascending to Saint.
Now, Venerable Xunguang was helpless.
He hurriedly wanted to activate the Great Array, but found nothing happened.
"Annihilate!"
Accompanied by Verbal Magic Curse, the four Ascending to Saint who were already beaten back and forth by Three-Eyed Tiger, successively fell.
With them gone, the remaining individuals on the field posed no threat.
"What’s next?"
Three-Eyed Tiger was very perceptive, knowing the remaining enemies were left for the disciples.
Jiang Cheng tossed a sentence: "Just don’t let our disciples get killed, let them handle the rest."
Anyway, Tongyou Sacred Land’s high-level figures were dead, he wasn’t obsessed with total annihilation, letting them escape was fine.
Unless they insist on resisting, fighting to the death.
Three-Eyed Tiger glanced around the battlefield, boredly shook his head, suddenly uttering a sentence.
"Changing your appearance is one thing, why did your chest muscles also grow bigger?"
"I grow fast, do I need to report early to you?"

chapters.title: Chapter 153 Surprisingly Cheap
chapters.content:
Chapter 153: Chapter 153 Surprisingly Cheap
The Three-Eyed Tiger was quite leisurely.
Jiang Cheng, however, was very busy.
Not for fighting, but for commanding the battle.
"Luo Yuan, what are you doing? Have you forgotten your swordsmanship?"
"Wei Miao, are you dumb? Don’t you know to throw a Treasure Talisman when you can’t win?"
"Shan Tai, do you even count as Daoist Palace Realm? Celestial Fate is more capable than you!"
"How many times have I emphasized, if you can’t win, throw a Talisman and take some pills!"
For the first time, he was so serious, switching to an unprecedented irritable mode.
No choice, actual combat is very important.
If they don’t train now, it will be too late when they really encounter a life-and-death battle.
For these disciples, he was truly heartbroken.
Due to too many and too fierce enemies, he occasionally had to step in to help out.
"Ji Linghan, you..."
The disciples who had just been scolded harshly suddenly felt a bit balanced; even Senior Sister Ji couldn’t escape this harsh scolding?
Immediately after, they heard the Sect Leader’s voice suddenly become much gentler.
"Ahem, Xiaohan, don’t be so soft-hearted. They are here to kill you, yet you can’t bear to strike..."
"Being merciful to the enemy is being cruel to yourself..."
"Be good, treat yourself better."
Pft!
Many disciples in the middle of a fight almost spat a mouthful of blood.
Indeed, the treatment is different.
Looking around the entire battlefield, most disciples performed below standard.
They completely failed to display the strength that should belong to the Celestial Fate Ninth Layer and Daoist Palace Realm.
Jiang Cheng wasn’t too disappointed though.
These disciples were practically fast-tracked; while their foundations weren’t weak, they had never experienced actual combat above the Soul Splitting Realm.
It would be strange if they performed well.
Only two showed outstanding performance: Lan Ti and Lin Ning.
Needless to say for Lan Ti, having trained alone from a young age, her Eighth Layer Daoist Palace could take down most Ninth Layer Daoist Palace foes.
Lin Ning, however, was a bit of a surprise.
Seeing his own disciple perform well, Mo Chen stroked his smooth chin, quite proud.
"This girl’s mind is calm, actions decisive; she’s a rare natural battle talent!"
"Moreover, I have specially honed her combat skills."
"It’s only natural she achieves today’s success."
Jiang Cheng pursed his lips, this old man was really flattering himself.
"Elder Mo, the other disciples are also your juniors, you can’t forget them."
The Child of the Plane was not very satisfied with their performance.
Mo Chen quickly replied, "What the Sect Leader said is correct, I will keep an eye out!"
This battle lasted a long time, a full day and night.
When most sects are attacked, they have a large number of loyal disciples who fight to the death, let alone a Sacred Land.
In the end, seeing no hope of victory, many disciples from Tongyou Sacred Land began to flee in all directions.
Meanwhile, the disciples of the Feixian Sect had almost run out of talismans.
Jian Suhan, Shu Yanglin, and Gong Qing, these three disciples of the Celestial Fate Ninth Layer, were unfortunately killed.
This was already a result of Jiang Cheng and the Three-Eyed Tiger secretly controlling the battlefield and protecting them.
Otherwise, all 70 people would have been wiped out from the start.
The entire Secret Realm was devastated, filled with ruins and devastation.
Looking at the disciples in the field, everyone was bloodied and injured, but their eyes and expressions were completely different from before.
Jiang Cheng was very satisfied; the training effect was still good.
"You did well, continue to strive harder in the future."
But the crowd couldn’t be happy.
They all leaned over the corpses of the three fallen disciples, wailing in grief.
The Feixian Sect had few people, and the disciples always loved each other, with no internal strife.
Now seeing three companions, who shared their days and nights, pass away, how could they not be heartbroken?
The Three-Eyed Tiger remained calm; it had seen many deaths and was not affected.
Mo Chen sighed deeply.
"My condolences."
"The path of cultivation is full of thorns, always accompanied by accidents."
"The friends I met when my power was low have long since left the world."
"This is a kind of mental training for you..."
He hadn’t even finished his motivational speech when Brother Cheng interrupted everyone.
"Move aside, heal your injuries first; it’s not time to be heartbroken yet."
He was still gratified that they cared so much for each other as fellow disciples.
"Sect Leader, Senior Sister Jian, Junior Brother Shu, Junior Sister Gong, they’ll never come back..."
The third-generation disciples like Wei Miao couldn’t stop their tears, with two female disciples almost fainting from crying, luckily supported by Lin Ning, who channeled spiritual power in time.
The second-generation elders, having experienced a sect massacre before, had greater endurance.
But everyone was still sorrowful and grieving.
Luo Yuan slapped himself hard; Shu Yanglin was his direct disciple.
"Sect Leader, it’s all my fault for not protecting my disciple!"
"Me too, I wish it was me who died in their place!"
These touching scenes deeply moved Lan Ti.
She, accustomed to the cruelty of the cultivation realm, found the camaraderie among the disciples particularly precious now.
"Alright, alright, put away your tears, or others will think the sky has fallen."
"Who said they can’t come back?"
Brother Cheng pushed through the crowd and went inside.
The system had a resurrection skill.
Even though he initially hoped no one would die to avoid wasting a lot of points,
he was determined to save them no matter how many points it cost when these situations did occur.
He was even secretly glad for this actual combat training today.
Otherwise, more would definitely die in the future.
"Huh?"
"Sect Leader, what did you just say?"
"Can our junior brothers and sisters really come back?"
The tearful disciples looked up, not quite processing what was said.
Once someone dies, they can’t be resurrected; even at the Saint Tier, if the body is destroyed, they face death and Dao dissolution.
This is an iron law in the cultivation realm.
Jiang Cheng stated proudly, "What do you think? Have you forgotten that your Sect Leader is an Immortal?"
The disciples were stunned, then overjoyed!
They didn’t quite understand how powerful an Immortal was, but they always believed that whatever an Immortal could do was normal.
Especially since the Sect Leader himself said it!
"Can the Sect Leader really resurrect them?"
"Definitely can!"
"The Sect Leader is omnipotent!"
"That’s fantastic!"
Everyone was ecstatic, showing extremely expectant expressions.
None noticed the puzzled and surprised looks from the Three-Eyed Tiger and Mo Chen.
Can an Immortal actually resurrect the dead?
Mo Chen, the old Immortal, expressed that he had never heard of such a thing.
In the Immortal Realm, there are some miraculous Techniques or Immortal Pills that can pull someone back from the Ghost Gate.
But they generally have requirements.
For example, there must be an intact body, and at least part of the Three Souls and Seven Spirits must remain, like how he currently has several Residual Souls; this gives hope.
But these three dead disciples had already had their souls scattered.
Especially Shu Yanglin and Gong Qing, when they died, they were already beheaded; even with an Immortal Emperor present, there’s no solution now.
Jiang Cheng squatted beside the three corpses and opened the system panel resurrection skill.
He shone a light on Jian Suhan, and a line of text immediately appeared.
Target: Jian Suhan.
Realm: Celestial Fate Ninth Layer.
Status: Deceased.
Time of death: 1 hour and 25 minutes ago.
Points required for resurrection: 86.

chapters.title: Chapter 154: The Furious Saint
chapters.content:
Chapter 154: Chapter 154: The Furious Saint
What the hell, so cheap?
Jiang Cheng couldn’t help but repeatedly check a few more times, carefully counting the mere two digits.
No mistake, it’s 86 points.
Not 860,000, let alone 8.6 billion.
This is just too strange, isn’t it?
Enhancing disciples’ talent or great realm can cost thousands, tens of thousands, or even billions.
Resurrection only costs a few dozen points?
This is resurrection after all!
Turning a dead person into a living one is such a big deal, yet in the system’s eyes, it’s so cheap?
Could it be that enhancing talent and realm in the system is actually complicated and costly?
While resurrection, on the other hand, might be very simple for the system, requiring no effort at all?
This was the only explanation he could think of.
He scanned the other two disciples again.
Shu Yanglin required 129 points, and Gong Qing needed 133 points, possibly because they were decapitated, so it cost a bit more.
Brother Cheng almost wanted to laugh aloud at the sky.
He was already prepared to bleed for the disciples, but it turned out to be a pleasant surprise.
A huge surprise!
If only he had known earlier, what was he struggling for just now?
Even if all the disciples were killed 100 times, it wouldn’t cost much.
The resurrection skill has no cooldown time and can be used unlimitedly every day.
He pretended, first conjuring a ball of spiritual power in the palm of his hand, stroking above Jian Suhan’s head.
Then he closed his eyes, silently chanting a non-existent spell.
Everyone else was extremely tense.
Their eyes followed his hand, their emotions fluctuating, afraid of failure.
Even the Three-Eyed Tiger and Mo Chen widened their eyes, watching intently.
Jiang Cheng had created too many miracles; they dared not view it with common sense.
Next, they saw a pale green light flow from Jian Suhan’s feet to her head, then disappear.
The person who was originally dead opened her eyes.
Not only did she come back to life, but even the injuries she had suffered disappeared.
Seeing everyone staring at her in astonishment, she felt a bit confused.
"Everyone..."
"Huh, wasn’t I dead?"
Wow!
The entire place erupted in cheers.
Everyone rushed over, hugging her until she was breathless.
"Senior Sister Jian, wuwuwu!"
"Dear disciple, Master was just scared to death by you."
"This is wonderful, Junior Sister Jian is alive again!"
Brother Cheng didn’t join in their cheers, but quickly resurrected the other two disciples as well.
Thus, the Feixian Sect was fully restored.
The place was already full of cheers.
And Brother Cheng effortlessly once again elevated his prestige, naturally gaining more astonishment and admiration from the disciples.
"Long live the Sect Leader!"
"So amazing!"
"Haha, made me cry for nothing, the Sect Leader is so wicked, not telling us sooner."
"Yeah, yeah, the Sect Leader must have done it on purpose."
"Immortal technique is so miraculous, wonder when we can become immortals."
"Yeah, if resurrection can be done..."
"Heh heh, with the Sect Leader around, we always have peace of mind."
In the eyes of the disciples, Sect Leader Jiang had once again demonstrated the means of an immortal.
But in Mo Chen’s eyes, this was nothing short of a miracle.
He wanted to grab those disciples’ ears and roar, who told you immortals can resurrect?
Even in the Immortal Realm, no one had ever heard of someone resurrecting three dead people as casually as this.
Yet the Sect Leader did it.
His fortune is absolutely higher than other children of the plane, and not just by a little!
Lan Ti on the side, had an expression of complete disbelief.
She couldn’t understand, even doubting if this was an illusion technique.
Unlike other disciples, who had at least experienced scenes of talent and great realm enhancement.
As for the Three-Eyed Tiger...
It had already shrunk its body, clinging onto Brother Cheng’s leg again.
"Bro, you’re truly amazing!"
"I’m starting to admire you a bit."
It was very clever.
This resurrection wasn’t useful to it now, but who could say it wouldn’t be in the future.
In the cultivation realm, who could guarantee never being killed?
With Jiang Cheng possessing the ’immortal technique’ of resurrection, as long as he was around, there was nothing to worry about.
It’s simply a protective umbrella, essential for home travel!
"Damn, why are you holding on so tight?"
With it clinging to his leg, Brother Cheng wanted to get closer to Ji Linghan, Lin Ning, and the others, but was blocked.
He tried hard to kick it away, but couldn’t.
"Bro, what’s our relationship? I’m just expressing my admiration for you."
"Forget it, in two years you’ll be free again, go wherever you want then."
In two years’ time, he’d be taking the disciples to ascend to the Immortal Realm.
There would be no need for the Demon King as a bodyguard for the disciples.
The Three-Eyed Tiger pretended to be confused: "Bro, you’re joking, didn’t we promise never to separate?"
Even if you wanted to drive it away now, it wouldn’t leave.
Who said it would only stay as a sect guardian spirit beast for three years, did Master Tiger say such a generous and heroic thing, isn’t it permanent?
"Get out of the way, I still have to gather the spoils."
"No need for you to do it yourself, I’ll do it, I’ll do it..."
Only then did the Three-Eyed Tiger let go, eagerly running to help collect the storage rings and spiritual treasures scattered all over the ground.
It had no need for these human-used items, so there was nothing to covet.
In the end, after a thorough check, heavenly and earthly treasures were kept, and part of the treasure talismans and magical treasures were retained as war materials, with the rest converted.
Points increased by another 3 billion.
Adding the previous points, he now had 9.2 billion.
The heavenly and earthly treasures were kept because most of these were materials for alchemy and artifact refining.
Once gathered, they could be used to refine higher level holy pills and sacred artifacts.
"Alright, pack up, we’re heading back to Feixian Sect!"
Soon after everyone returned to Feixian Sect, news of the annihilation of Tongyou Sacred Land finally reached Saint Bi Feng.
It wasn’t his fault for being out of the loop, he was in seclusion in a concealed place.
Except for Venerable Xunguang, no one else could contact him.
And when Venerable Xunguang was killed, attacked jointly by Jiang Cheng and the Three-Eyed Tiger, he had no chance to send out a distress signal.
Bi Feng only learned of the Sacred Land’s destruction due to his restless mind, pausing his cultivation to search for a perception.
What he discovered was that half of the life tokens had shattered, the high-level members wiped out.
This terrified him to the core, his divine soul and heart aching, nearly causing a qigong deviation.
The aura of Saint Tier could no longer be restrained, the domain extending tens of thousands of miles around went into chaos, causing a catastrophe for the beings there.
"Qingsuo!"
"So vicious of you!"
"You truly have made me reevaluate the Heart Division!"
He swiftly flew to Tongyou Sacred Land, upon seeing the ruins, almost vomited blood on the spot.
Bi Feng was cunning by nature; even under such circumstances, he retained a trace of sanity.
His divine thought spread out, quickly locating some disciples who had scattered during the previous battle.
The divine soul struck directly, their last memories appearing in his mind.
"So, the Feixian Sect was involved as well!"
"Jiang Cheng, oh Jiang Cheng, I haven’t crushed you yet, and you dare to fight back."
"Good, very good!"
"None of you should even think about escaping."

chapters.title: Chapter 155: A Calamity Without Cause
chapters.content:
Chapter 155: Chapter 155: A Calamity Without Cause
Saying ’don’t think about escaping’ with their mouths, but in reality, Jiang Cheng and the others had already returned to Feixian Sect.
However, Bi Feng did not immediately attack.
After all, a Demon King was stationed over there.
Bi Feng naturally wasn’t afraid of the Three-Eyed Tiger, but what he wanted now was to leave none alive.
Even a suppressed Demon King possesses many ways to save his life.
Not to mention the protection of the Great Array, he had to strategize a little.
In contrast, he couldn’t tolerate Qingsuo’s ’betrayal’ even more.
Indeed, in Bi Feng’s view, Jiang Cheng’s opposition was understandable, but the Heart Division had just agreed to the terms of cooperation, and now they dared to stab in the back.
This made him increasingly furious and unable to calm his emotions.
In the end, he first charged into the Mingxin Sacred Land!
"Qingsuo, come out!"
This shout echoed throughout all parts of the Heart Race, with all the tribesmen appearing upon hearing the news.
Qingsuo naturally was the first to fly over.
Her expression wasn’t looking good.
After all, as a clan leader of Ascending to Saint Ninth Layer, although she had always been forbearing, she couldn’t be insulted lightly, right?
"Bi Feng, what do you mean?"
"What do I mean?"
Saint Bi Feng sneered coldly, "Qingsuo, you’re really good at enduring, I truly didn’t see it before. So you had such deep scheming."
"Pretending to be weak on the surface, but more ruthless than anyone else behind backs!"
Qingsuo and the other clan elders frowned directly at hearing this.
This Saint Bi Feng must be sick, speaking so sarcastically, making it seem like they owed him or something.
"Saint Bi Feng, if you have something to say, just say it clearly, no need to beat around the bush."
Bi Feng looked around at them, coldly saying.
"Even now, you all are still pretending."
"Acting as if nothing ever happened."
"You think by doing so, the attack on my Tongyou Sacred Land will just be forgotten?"
"What are you talking about?"
Qingsuo and the others were shocked.
"Attack Tongyou Sacred Land? What does it have to do with us?"
"Still quibbling!"
Saint Bi Feng rebuked sharply, "You personally took action, countless people from both my sect and outside saw!"
How was this possible?
She hadn’t even been over there.
"Saint, there must be a misunderstanding in this, the one who attacked you was the Feixian Sect, we never participated."
"That’s right, we strictly refused back then."
"It was all Jiang Cheng acting on his own will."
To extricate themselves, the Ascending to Saint experts of the Heart Division didn’t care much and directly sold out Jiang Cheng, their ’ally.’
Unfortunately, it was worse for them to say this.
Saying this merely confirmed that they had indeed conspired with Feixian Sect.
"Ha!"
"Hahaha..."
Saint Bi Feng laughed in anger, the laughter echoed in the valley, lingering on and on.
"So you were involved!"
"How did you agree with me before? Not even distancing yourselves from Feixian Sect, but actually teaming up!"
"My Tongyou Sacred Land has been wiped out, and you still want to stay out of it?"
This declaration left Qingsuo and others even more shocked.
Tongyou Sacred Land had really been destroyed?
With just around 70 people, plus a Demon King suppressed by rules.
To break the restrictions, withstand the Great Array, and face thousands of enemies...
How was this done?
It was completely unimaginable.
"Saint Bi Feng, please listen to our explanation. This was all their doing, if you want revenge, you might as well go and find them..."
Bi Feng couldn’t listen anymore.
"Go die!"
The Saint Tier expert finally made a move!
In an instant, the entire Mingxin Sacred Land seemed to have arrived at a world where only wind existed.
No sky above, no ground below.
The Divine Soul swayed emptily, with nothing to rely on.
Countless Heart Race people lost control of their Spiritual Power and Divine Souls, also losing perception of external rules.
Just like insects blown by a hurricane, utterly powerless to resist.
Fortunately, Qingsuo and the others reacted quickly.
They were usually very meek, preferring peace whenever possible.
But when others raised the blade, they naturally wouldn’t stretch their necks to be slain.
The five Ascending to Saint of the Heart Division weren’t just for show.
Qingsuo raised her hand with a flick, and a white, awl-like Magical Treasure, about the length of an arm, flew into the air, expanding with the wind.
Beams of milky white light showered down.
Any Heart Race people illuminated by it found their Divine Souls stabilizing again.
In contrast, Bi Feng, also illuminated, showed a hint of pain.
The pain came from deep within his heart.
The Heart-Piercing Awl, as a Top-grade Magical Treasure, directly attacks the enemy’s inner willpower, with no suitable defensive measures even for a Saint Tier.
The world of wind gradually became less stable than before.
Simultaneously, the other four Ascending to Saint experts of the Heart Division made their moves.
The Great Array and restrictions within the Sacred Land were fully activated at this moment.
The entire valley seemed to suddenly come alive.
Bi Feng, under the joint suppression of the Great Array and Heart-Piercing Awl, charged left and right, sending out world-destroying attacks with his long sword.
He shattered the valley into pieces, but found it difficult to harm the five Ascending to Saint, only managing to kill a few lower realm tribesmen who couldn’t hide in time.
The combat power of Mingxin Sacred Land was even stronger than he initially expected.
He gained no advantage as a Peak of Saint Tier, and even his spirit was continuously eroded.
This was not because he, as a Peak of Saint Tier, was too weak, but because he had divided into five Dharma Bodies to various Great Domains for business.
His current body’s power was weakened by more than half.
This was also their home ground in Mingxin Sacred Land.
He had the Bone Refining Banner of the same tier as the Heart-Piercing Awl, but because he was not of the Witch Division and didn’t know orthodox witchcraft, he couldn’t wield much power.
"Within a month, the Heart Division will be annihilated."
He eventually opted to retreat.
However, this didn’t mean the matter was over.
After the battle, looking at the already utterly destroyed Secret Realm, the hearts of Qingsuo and others bled.
"Too much bullying! Bi Feng, you’ve gone too far!"
They had been so conciliatory, yet others wanted to turn against them, to kill whenever they felt like it.
"Clan Leader, what should we do now?"
At this moment, every person in the Heart Division wore a face of anguish.
Qingsuo took a deep breath, trying to calm her emotions.
As the clan leader, she had to find a way to let the remaining tribesmen survive.
"If Bi Feng comes again, he might recall all his Dharma Bodies, and by then his power won’t be the same."
"Also, he’ll surely bring other allies."
"We won’t be able to withstand it."
Looking at the destroyed Secret Realm, her heart was in disarray.
"How about we go to the Azure Thunder Realm to seek refuge with the Thunder Division? Our Heart Division has a fairly good relationship with them..."
The Thunder Division is also one of the nine divisions of the Immortal Remnant Race.
When the nine divisions split long ago, they scattered across various places, with the Thunder Division residing in the Azure Thunder Realm, primarily cultivating the Power of Thunder.
Qingsuo shook her head, "Their situation in the Azure Thunder Realm is also unfavorable, being ostracized by some local forces, their situation is no better than ours."
"Then we should look for the War Division in the Profound Void Domain; I heard they’ve unified the Profound Void Domain, with no one daring to defy!"

chapters.title: Chapter 156: Heart Division Completely Returns
chapters.content:
Chapter 156: Chapter 156: Heart Division Completely Returns
This proposal stirred excitement among the remaining clan members.
Among the nine tribes of the Immortal Remnant Race, the War Division is currently in the best position.
The War Division people are naturally adept at fighting, with experts aplenty within their ranks.
Not only do they have over a dozen individuals Ascending to Saint, but also two Saint Tier presiding, combined with the top-grade Magical Treasure, the Immortal Slayer Spear, their power is noteworthy even in the Lower Realm Ten Thousand Realms.
If they sought refuge there, Bi Feng would surely not dare provoke them.
Qingsuo shook her head again, sighing, "Have you forgotten? The War Division has always looked down on the other eight tribes, thinking we hold them back, never considering us one of their own."
"What about the Painting Division? Though their power isn’t as strong as the War Division, they are said to maintain good relations with many Domains."
Qingsuo sighed: "The Cyan Garden Domain where the Painting Division is located is too far from our Thousand Spirit Domain, separated by thousands of Domains. I’m afraid we’d be intercepted by Bi Feng before we even get there..."
Bi Feng is well-connected, with Saint Tier friends in many Domains.
This route might just be a dead end.
Distant water can’t quench a near thirst.
One day later, Jiang Cheng met Qingsuo and the others again.
Accompanying them were over ten thousand Heart Division people, not one missing.
"Sect Leader Jiang, we have come to seek refuge with you."
"We hope you can save us..."
Indeed, they ultimately chose Feixian Sect.
Here, with the Three-Eyed Tiger, the Demon King, capable of destroying Tongyou Sacred Land, the strength is evident.
Feixian Sect and they also share Bi Feng as a common enemy.
With Jiang Cheng, the Demon King, and their Heart Division’s five Ascending to Saint holding the Secret Realm as the home base, they might just withstand Bi Feng’s next wave of attack.
Moreover... it’s close by.
Besides, isn’t there the title of ’ally’?
"So... were you attacked?"
Jiang Cheng looked at their expressions and state and guessed a bit.
No way?
He turned into Qingsuo merely to irritate this fence-sitting ’ally’.
He didn’t expect them to actually be attacked nor did he anticipate the Heart Division would come to him collectively.
"Yes, it was all Bi Feng, that scoundrel!"
Mentioning this, Qingsuo gnashed her teeth in hatred.
"Our Secret Realm has been completely destroyed, leaving us homeless!"
"Also, 516 clan members were killed, such hatred cannot coexist!"
"Sect Leader Jiang, I know you must have had serious objections to our previous stance."
"Here, I swear, should we confront Bi Feng again, my tribe vows to fight at the forefront!"
Her words were resolute, with a very sincere attitude.
After all, the Sea of Blood hatred runs deep; even a cornered rabbit bites.
Jiang Cheng was even more surprised.
Not because of her statement, but because of the Heart Division’s combat power.
What the heck, this strong?
Peak of Saint Tier invaded, and yet over 90% of your people survived?
He felt disappointed again, for such powerful strength, they had been hiding all this time?
If they had expanded outward, collected cultivation resources, and tried every possible way to improve, the overall strength would probably be one or two times stronger than it is now.
"Are you serious?"
"Yes!"
Several Ascending to Saints from the back said heavily, "After this battle, we also realized that compromising only makes them view us as weak and easy to bully."
"Since that’s the case, don’t blame us for showcasing our talents!"
"Sect Leader Jiang, just point us in the direction for the next attack, and we will never retreat!"
In these hundreds of years, the other Seven Great Sacred Lands haven’t done any good deeds for them either, with long-standing grievances and grievances harbored.
Damn, these women now have more battle spirit than I do.
Are you kidding?
"Alright then, I’ll arrange accommodation for you."
Anyway, Silence Sacred Land’s Secret Realm is vast; housing ten thousand, let alone a hundred thousand, would still feel spacious.
The Heart Division controls one of the nine Magical Treasures, keeping them around is beneficial for the future opening of the Void Immortal Realm.
"Thank you, Sect Leader Jiang!"
Qingsuo solemnly said, "We will always remember your kindness in taking us in!"
Even with Brother Cheng’s thick-skin defense, he couldn’t help but feel a bit flustered.
He was still in Qingsuo’s form, unable to change back.
If not for the Treasure and Divine Soul concealing, he would have been exposed long ago.
Basically, if not for his one transformation, even if the Heart Division eventually got hammered by reality, it would be in the future, not today.
Thinking this, he sighed, still making up for it.
"Did you bring the corpses of those 516 tribesmen who died in battle?"
Qingsuo didn’t understand why he asked, but nodded nonetheless.
"Originally intended to bury them over there, but feared Bi Feng would bring people back to ravage again, disturbing their peace."
"So we brought them here, but if Sect Leader Jiang does not wish it, we will bury them outside."
Jiang Cheng waved his hand.
"I’m not that petty."
"Bring out their corpses."
"Ah?"
"What does Sect Leader Jiang mean?"
The Heart Division people were quite puzzled, but Mo Chen stood up as Brother Cheng’s spokesperson.
"Our sect leader can resurrect them. Your decision to ally with us today is the wisest choice!"
What?
Resurrection?
The Heart Division’s tribespeople felt like they had heard a joke.
How could such a thing happen?
But a quarter hour later, their understanding was completely refreshed.
All 516 tribesmen were resurrected by Jiang Cheng, even if only a fragment of a limb or a single hair remained, they were resurrected without fail.
This scene took place right under everyone’s eyes.
Those resurrected were lively and unharmed.
Among the ten thousand Heart Division tribespeople, some were crying tears of joy, some cheering with excitement.
After all, this was a sparsely populated tribe.
The lives of these 516 members were more important than anything to them.
Qingsuo and several tribal elders, overwhelmed, bowed deeply.
"Sect Leader Jiang, your great favor, we will never forget!"
Jiang Cheng pretended to cough lightly, then adjusted his complexion to appear a bit pale.
Mo Chen timely came over to support him.
"The sect leader’s resurrection Immortal Technique comes at a cost, mass resurrecting so many people exhausts him greatly."
Indeed, such a cost, it took me 120,000 points.
Sure enough, Qingsuo and others were deeply moved.
"Sect Leader Jiang! From now on, you will be our Heart Division’s most treasured friend, never to be betrayed!"
"If anyone means harm to you, they are our Heart Division’s life-and-death enemy!"
"If we ever part ways in the future, just one summon from Sect Leader Jiang, and our Heart Division will come to serve!"
Not just them, but all the other ten thousand Heart Division people also looked at him gratefully.
Their attitude towards him was intimate and friendly, treating him as one of their own.
This outcome delighted Jiang Cheng.
After all the back and forth, this group of previously indecisive but powerful fence-sitters was finally subdued by him.
Thus, the Heart Division officially settled in the Secret Realm.
This Secret Realm spans over a hundred thousand li, with Feixian Sect at the central main hall, and the Heart Division lodging in the southwest mountainous region.
There are tens of thousands of miles between their activity areas; in essence, they still function independently.
The cultivation of disciples on Jiang Cheng’s side has nothing to do with them.
And the Heart Division, having nothing to do, wouldn’t come over to interfere.
Both sides are awaiting the arrival of Saint Bi Feng.

chapters.title: Chapter 157: Fortunately, They Did Not Agree
chapters.content:
Chapter 157: Chapter 157: Fortunately, They Did Not Agree
During this time, the news of Tongyou Sacred Land’s destruction quickly spread.
Upon hearing the news, the outside world was naturally in an uproar once again.
The major sacred lands no longer had the arrogance they previously displayed, even calling all their disciples back and sealing their gates, not daring to venture out.
They wouldn’t dare oppose Jiang Cheng anymore.
Even the strongest sacred land with the Saint Tier has been wiped out; this is completely insane.
Moreover, he is an incredibly powerful madman.
Before Saint Bi Feng takes him down, they’re afraid they might be attacked prematurely.
Under such circumstances, there would truly be no place to reason.
Taking advantage of the lack of direct conflict between the parties, the Seven Great Sacred Lands sent people to Feixian Sect to express goodwill.
On the other hand, those smaller sects and loose cultivators were not afraid, but rather jubilant.
It’s not that they had any grudge against Tongyou Sacred Land.
But rather, Feixian Sect has wiped out another sect, isn’t this worth celebrating?
Hey, are you not planning to hold a grand ceremony to celebrate?
After the last banquet ended, a bunch who didn’t go regretted it so much; now they’re all eagerly waiting.
Unfortunately, although Brother Cheng is traditionally extravagant, he really didn’t consider this a big deal.
To him, annihilating sects has long been routine work.
Still need to celebrate?
Wouldn’t that be exhausting?
The envoys from the Seven Great Sacred Lands all arrived at the main hall.
"Sect Leader Jiang, I am commanded by the Purple Origin Sacred Land’s Sect Leader to come and seek goodwill with your sect, hoping to forge an everlasting brotherhood alliance!"
"Our Li Guang Sacred Land also wishes to express goodwill towards Feixian Sect..."
"I am from White Rainbow Sacred Land..."
Seeing the envoys from the Seven Great Sacred Lands bow and express themselves, Qingsuo and the Heart Division experts sitting and observing felt a myriad of emotions.
What does it mean to have prestige?
This is prestige!
Previously, when their Heart Division encountered the Seven Great Sacred Lands, they had to smile ingratiatingly, fearing being besieged and sanctioned by them.
If these sacred lands sent just two Saint Heirs, the Heart Division had to host them grandly, fearing they would find an excuse to cause trouble.
But now, in front of Jiang Cheng, the Seven Great Sacred Lands all lowered their stance.
Actively showing goodwill to Feixian Sect, fearing being attacked by them.
Even they couldn’t help but hold their heads high, feeling proud as allies.
Only, what surprised them was that Jiang Cheng didn’t seem very excited.
He simply gave a signal.
Then, Mo Chen smilingly dispersed seven pieces of paper filled with words, respectively handing them to the envoys of the Seven Great Sacred Lands.
The crowd didn’t understand and, upon unfolding them, immediately couldn’t remain calm.
These seven papers outlined seven lists.
They listed a long string of Heavenly and Earthly Treasures’ names, most of which were materials needed for refining Holy Pills.
Brother Cheng’s alchemy skills reached Tier Four after a system lottery and had long been capable of refining Holy Pills.
It’s just that the materials had been lacking.
Besides, the lists also included 30 Treasure items, two Magical Treasures, and a large number of Spirit Stones.
Don’t think it’s just a small piece of paper; it could almost drain half of these sacred lands’ top resources.
"Sect Leader Jiang, what do you mean by this?"
"Isn’t this a bit excessive?"
With such conditions, how could the Seven Great Sacred Lands possibly agree?
The envoys’ expressions changed, and their attitudes turned firm.
"We’ve come with friendly intentions, are you deliberately rejecting our friendship?"
"Feixian Sect is robbing us!"
"Do you really think the Seven Great Sacred Lands are afraid of you?"
"Sect Leader Jiang, I advise you to reconsider."----
"The Seven Great Sacred Lands are united, unlike Tongyou Sacred Land; it’s not so easy to deal with us!"
The envoys were well-versed in the art of negotiation.
It’s impossible to always be soft; when it’s time to make a strong statement, it has to be strong.
"Moreover, Sect Leader Jiang’s own situation isn’t good; Saint Bi Feng is looking for allies to deal with you."
"You’re already struggling to protect yourself, yet you want to push the Seven Great Sacred Lands to the opposing side; that’s not a wise decision."
Even Qingsuo couldn’t help but nod in agreement.
The current Feixian Sect should indeed avoid creating too many enemies.
She quietly transmitted her voice, "Sect Leader Jiang, do you think you could compromise a bit, at least pass the difficulty with Bi Feng first..."
Jiang Cheng had a helpless expression.
Despite this ally’s loyalty, they still lacked backbone.
If this attitude was brought out, it might even drop his prestige.
He stood up and waved to the envoys of the Seven Great Sacred Lands.
"You’re right, I am indeed rejecting your friendship."
"Who do you think you are to negotiate with me?"
"To be frank, this is an order."
The envoys all surged with anger, Qingsuo almost fainted in fright.
This would force even non-enemies into enemies!
"Go back and tell your Sect Leaders, if you want to fight, do it sooner, best if together; otherwise, I fear there won’t be enough for me to kill."
"Alright, off you go."
The words stirred an uproar in the hall.
The Feixian Sect disciples, on the other hand, looked at Sect Leader Jiang with admiration, wow, he’s so domineering.
Other people felt differently...
The sacred lands’ envoys were both shocked and furious.
But they dared not curse him directly; after all, he had already wiped out two major sacred lands and would do anything.
"Sect Leader Jiang, you will regret your decision today."
Leaving behind this meaningless cliché, the envoys reluctantly departed.
Once they left, the Heart Race elders sighed.
"Sect Leader Jiang, wasn’t it a bit too extreme?"
"Right, we haven’t actually made any conflict with the Seven Great Sacred Lands yet; we could stabilize them first."
"The Seven Great Sacred Lands are indeed potential enemies, but at this critical juncture, there’s no need to fall out with them!"
They naturally wouldn’t criticize Jiang Cheng, their ’benefactor,’ but hoped he would act more gently.
Even if not for them, for his own sake.
But Brother Cheng didn’t even listen; the elder was contemplating major matters.
He unexpectedly commented: "Actually, it’s fortunate they rejected my conditions."
"Huh? Sect Leader Jiang, what do you mean?"
Even Mo Chen expressed bewilderment.
Could the Sect Leader’s actions today hide some profound meaning?
Or perhaps a clever strategem?
Qingsuo and others rarely raised a thread of anticipation.
Then Jiang Cheng touched his chin and said, "I feel those conditions were too low. If they had accepted them, someone like me who values contracts wouldn’t be able to go back on my word."
Thankfully, the other party rejected them this time, so next time he could offer higher conditions.
Plop!
The crowd almost collapsed on the spot.
What is this guy thinking all day?
Can his train of thought be normal?
Can he not think about how to deal with the impending terrifying external enemies?
After the envoys from the Seven Great Sacred Lands returned, they brought back Jiang Cheng’s conditions and exacerbated his tough adversarial stance.
It infuriated the upper management of the sacred lands.
"He’s absolutely insane!"
"Who does he think he is?"
"The Green Tong Kongyun Soil doesn’t exist anywhere in the Thousand Spirit Domain, he dared ask for it. Even if there was, we wouldn’t give it!"
"I heard Saint Bi Feng has already gone to Minggui Mountain and Xunkong Sea!"
"Minggui Mountain and Xunkong Sea, are they possibly seeking those two as allies?"
"Hahaha, Jiang Cheng is as good as dead."
"We have nothing to worry about anymore..."

chapters.title: Chapter 158: The Son Repays the Father’s Debt
chapters.content:
Chapter 158: Chapter 158: The Son Repays the Father’s Debt
North of the Thousand Spirit Domain, the boundless black waters surged furiously.
Xunkong Sea, a legendary dead zone where even cultivators dared not fly overhead.
Because beneath this seabed dwelled the billions of formidable sea race demon beasts.
This was their territory.
Saint Bi Feng stood proudly above the sea.
Shortly, the water below surged and rose continuously.
Large swathes of seawater were pushed towards the edges, raising monstrous waves and storms.
The entire scene appeared as if it would overturn the world.
Then, a demon beast with a turtle-like form, eight legs, and spikes protruding around its shell emerged from the sea.
Its appearance made the sea domain seem as though a vast platform hundreds of miles high had appeared.
Large volumes of seawater cascaded down from the platform’s edges, forming countless waterfalls.
Spectacular and grand.
"Bi Feng, what are you here for?"
"We’ve always steered clear of each other’s affairs. Are you intending to break the agreement?"
Its voice buzzed, shaking the distant sea-bottom demon beasts into a frantic scattering.
Within the Thousand Spirit Domain, indeed, there is an agreement forbidding great demons and those ascending to saint level from crossing boundaries.
"Jade Qilin Xuan Turtle King, this saint harbors no ill intent by coming here."
In the Thousand Spirit Domain, besides Bi Feng, there are two other demon kings.
Profound Turtle King and Colorful Deer King.
The existence of these two demon kings predates Bi Feng significantly, especially the Profound Turtle King, who, by the advantage of its natural lifespan, has surpassed ten million years.
"You have no ill intent?"
The Profound Turtle King laughed angrily.
"Seven million years ago, when you were still a Daoist Palace cultivator, you secretly infiltrated my Xunkong Sea and stole the Feather Leaf Muddy Heart."
"Five million years ago, you led a group of human cultivators to hunt three of my clan’s great demons, excavated their demon pills, and refined them into arrays!"
"Two million years ago, you further united the Nine Great Sacred Lands to wage war on my Demon Race, causing nine more great demons to fall and forcing us to sign a non-invasion agreement!"
Each and every one of these instances is practically a blood-soaked indictment.
"A schemer who constantly plots, only caring for himself, how dare you say there’s no ill intent?"
"Can you claim that in recent years, the undersea entanglements have not been secretly instigated by you?"
"Without you, the bane of Thousand Spirit Domain, it would be much more peaceful, and there’d be two additional demon kings!"
If Brother Cheng were here, he might have to update his impression of Bi Feng.
This guy is quite a talent.
In the journey from weakness to greatness, every target he marked—be it the Witch Heart Division, the other sacred lands, or the demon race, and even other domains—none escaped his schemes.
In the end, all would be skinned alive.
The only setback was when Tongyou Sacred Land was annihilated.
Because of Sect Leader Jiang, who acted unpredictably and disregarded conventional methods.
"Profound Turtle King, stay calm. This saint is here today to join forces with you."
Bi Feng smiled subtly, holding wisdom in his grasp.
The Profound Turtle King snorted heavily, and the sea surface surged once more.
"You can leave. This king has no interest in joining forces with you!"
As a demon king, it wasn’t foolish.
What nonsense alliance, with Bi Feng’s way of doing things, there’s sure to be another nefarious motive to exploit him.
Not to mention, in the end, he might end up being betrayed to death.
Bi Feng did not leave; instead, he just smiled slightly towards the void.
"Colorful Deer King, you can come out now."
As soon as the words fell, a massive deer with four colorfully patterned horns descended from the nine heavens.
Nine-colored auspicious clouds surrounded its body, like a celestial deer descending to the earthly realm.
However, hidden within the clouds was a palpable sense of deathly aura.
"Colorful Deer King, why have you come here too?"
The Profound Turtle King seemed extremely disappointed, shouting fiercely: "Have you conspired with this thief?"
"Have you forgotten what he did in your Minggui Mountain in the past?"
"Brother Gui misunderstands!"
Colorful Deer King descended between him and Bi Feng, speaking slowly: "The Three-Eyed Fierce Tiger King from Celestial Demon Domain has arrived; will you remain indifferent?"
"What?"
"The Three-Eyed Fierce Tiger King dares to come here?"
The Profound Turtle King first raged, and then laughed heartily.
"I will repay the humiliation of the past a hundredfold!"
Its laughter carried a deep-seated hatred.
Celestial Demon Domain scarcely had any human cultivators, and it was essentially considered the territory of the demon race, where twelve demon kings presided.
Such power could easily rank in the top ten of the lower realm ten thousand realms.
The Profound Turtle King, also belonging to the demon race and born in the Thousand Spirit Domain, once yearned for this domain.
In its mind, the Celestial Demon Domain was the holy sanctuary for all demons under heaven!
Three million years ago, it and the Colorful Deer King entered the Celestial Demon Domain together with excitement at joining an organization.
But reality was a harsh, bone-chilling cold splash.
Within Celestial Demon Domain, the twelve demon kings were already embroiled in constant conflict; tiger race was tiger race, dragon race was dragon race, rabbit race was rabbit race, they never considered other groups as their kin.
The united concept of demon race simply wasn’t there in their heads.
Moreover, these were two demon kings from other domains.
When the Profound Turtle King and the Colorful Deer King first set foot, it was on the tiger race’s territory.
They didn’t even have time to explain; the two demon kings were brutally beaten by the Three-Eyed Fierce Tiger King, their faces bruised and battered, their daoist practice regressed.
If it weren’t for the Fierce Tiger King entertaining thoughts of subjugating them for his own use, the two demon kings would have fallen then and there.
However, it was precisely because of this that the two demon kings found an opportunity to escape back.
This incident was a deep shame and hatred for them.
As a result, both demon kings’ demon pills were haunted by heart demons.
Without slaying the Fierce Tiger King, they would never attain perfection in this lifetime.
Yet, seeking vengeance across domains would be suppressed by rules.
Furthermore, the battle prowess of the Three-Eyed Fierce Tiger King was among the top three in Celestial Demon Domain at the time.
Even without the power of rules suppressing them, in a fair duel, the Profound Turtle King and the Colorful Deer King combined would still be soundly defeated.
This pent-up grievance was something they couldn’t simply swallow.
Originally resigning to never fulfill their vengeance, they now hear of this news.
The Three-Eyed Fierce Tiger King came from Celestial Demon Domain to the Thousand Spirit Domain?
Then it would be suppressed by the power of rules!
Its peak demon king power would be reduced to mid-tier, even early-stage.
Then...
Hehe!
Revenge for grievances, vengeance for enmity!
"Where is it? Quickly tell this king!"
It already couldn’t wait!
Bi Feng’s smile grew more intense, all set.
"Profound Turtle King misunderstood, the former Three-Eyed Fierce Tiger King has already exhausted its lifespan; now here is its descendant, the new Three-Eyed Fierce Tiger King."
He often traversed among various domains, and his knowledge was far better informed than these two demon kings.
"New Three-Eyed Fierce Tiger King?"
The Profound Turtle King was a bit disappointed; it wasn’t the original, reducing the thrill of revenge considerably.
The key was that the Three-Eyed Tiger lineage were extremely fierce fighters; even suppressed by rules, a tough battle could still unfold.
"What is the power level of this new Three-Eyed Tiger?"
The Colorful Deer King scoffed: "It’s merely an early-stage demon king."
What, only early-stage?
Then, with the suppression by rules, wouldn’t it be reduced to the lowest of the saint tier?
They could crush it effortlessly.
"The debts of the father will be repaid by the son, it’s all the same!"
"Hahaha!"
"Take it down!"
The Profound Turtle King’s battle intent instantly soared to its peak.

chapters.title: Chapter 159 You Are the Resurrection Spring Water
chapters.content:
Chapter 159: Chapter 159 You Are the Resurrection Spring Water
When the Profound Turtle King and the Colorful Deer King grandly marched toward the Feixian Sect, the entire Thousand Spirit Domain was in an uproar.
The Demon Kings crossed the land, followed by more than a dozen Great Demons, covering the sky and casting a shadow over the city like a dark cloud.
Below, many mortals and cultivators looked up at the gigantic figures walking on air over the sea, trembling with fear.
It looked like a scene straight out of an impending apocalypse.
Upon hearing this news, the Seven Great Sacred Lands were exceptionally excited, celebrating with joy.
"Hahahaha, Feixian Sect is done for."
"As expected of Saint Bi Feng, he really invited both major Demon Kings out."
"With the Three Saints here, even the Celestial King couldn’t save Jiang Cheng!"
"That kid had the nerve to negotiate with us, completely oblivious to the situation."
"Should we take the initiative to volunteer and join the Saint in battle?"
"How can our Purple Cloud Sacred Land be left out of such a grand event!"
"Our Li Guang Sacred Land must play a part in eliminating evil for the Thousand Spirit Domain, it is our unshirkable duty!"
Originally, they weren’t so eager.
But this battle was clearly a guaranteed victory, where they didn’t even need to lift a finger as the Three Saint Realms could settle it directly.
All they had to do was show up, and they could end up sharing the resources of the Feixian Sect.
How could they fall behind in such a profitable venture?
The Seven Great Sacred Lands assembled their forces and officially declared war on the Feixian Sect.
This move once again shook the entire Thousand Spirit Domain.
The union of the Three Saint Realms, Demon Race, and Human Race, and the collective action of the Seven Great Sacred Lands, this kind of lineup was unprecedented in the Thousand Spirit Domain.
There was no way it wouldn’t cause a sensation.
Now the Feixian Sect’s doom was certain.
Countless cultivators across the Thousand Spirit Domain felt a deep sense of regret, wishing they could draft a million-strong petition, unitedly requesting the halt of the advance.
Please don’t attack the Feixian Sect!
Such a generous sect, how could you bear to destroy it?
We are still waiting for them to host another banquet!
Alas, the wishes of the lower-level cultivators were destined not to reach the upper echelons.
That day, the Demon Race and Human Race allied forces gathered outside the secret realm of the Feixian Sect, and the great battle was about to begin.
Facing the menacing enemies, the disciples within the secret realm and the Heart Race people were solemn and grave, their hearts heavy beyond measure.
Though they had always had immense faith in the Sect Leader, this time the enemy’s lineup was simply too vast.
Even a true Immortal would find it difficult to win, right?
A momentary air of tragic anticipation spread among everyone.
Everyone was waiting for the Sect Leader’s decision.
To attack or defend?
How to deploy the manpower?
However, the Sect Leader just sat there in a daze, as if his soul was wandering beyond the clouds.
Brother Cheng was pondering over a complicated math problem.
With such a massive enemy lineup, how many points could it bring?
The Demon Race seemed to have no storage rings, didn’t hold much value.
Facing so many enemies, is dying once enough?
Seeing him remain silent for so long, Qingsuo slowly stepped out from the crowd and approached him.
"Sect Leader Jiang, our clan is ready!"
"Ready for what?"
Looking at the resolute eyes filled with a determination to die and then at the tense faces of the Heart Division experts behind her, Brother Cheng was a bit confused about the situation.
"With the great enemy at our doorstep, we request Sect Leader Jiang to make arrangements early!"
Qingsuo clenched the Heart-Piercing Awl in her hand and spoke in a deep voice, "Our clan is willing to engage in a fight to the death against Bi Feng’s traitors, with no retreat and no rest!"
"Even if it means fighting to the last person, we will not fall back!"
With her words, the Heart Race people roared in unison.
"We will not fall back!"
Hey, is there a mistake?
Is this still the Heart Division that prefers self-preservation and fewer troubles?
How did they all suddenly turn into death warriors?
"Um, there’s no need for you to worry about this battle, I’ll go meet them alone."
With the enemy’s great strength, there’s no chance we can win with just our small band.
Even on home turf, with the great array and restrictions from the former Silence Sacred Land, they wouldn’t suffice.
Two major Demon Kings, dozens of Great Demons, as formidable as those Ascending to Saint, and the Seven Great Sacred Lands...
Qingsuo’s Heart Race people managing to hold off one Saint Bi Feng would be an achievement.
And the two major Demon Kings, any one of them could crush the cross-domain Three-Eyed Tiger.
For the rest, are we relying on these 70 disciples of the Feixian Sect?
Dealing with these enemies relies solely on the resurrection skill.
Since resurrection requires death, one has to be killed first.
Jiang Cheng’s usual principle is that being killed damages one’s image and should be avoided in front of one’s own people.
How could he agree to take the entire Heart Division of over ten thousand people to meet the enemy?
Being seen by so many people upon being killed, wouldn’t that lower his prestige?
"What?"
"Sect Leader Jiang, you want to face the enemy alone?"
Qingsuo was initially stunned, then firmly objected.
"This is absolutely not possible!"
The other Heart Race elders also stopped him in unison.
"Bi Feng is the mortal enemy of our Heart Race, we can’t let you face this alone!"
"It’s our duty to stand by you!"
"Sect Leader Jiang, if you wish, you can stay at the rear."
"Yes, you are of utmost importance, you must not risk dying a reckless death."
Brother Cheng finally understood.
So, these women regarded him as a resurrection spring water!
No wonder they were so unafraid of death this time.
Having a vendetta against Bi Feng was part of it, but more importantly, after death, he could revive them.
And if he dies, in their eyes, that would be the absolute end, with no hope of survival.
Dammit, that’s quite hurtful.
The dignified King Bi is treated as a mere tool for revival?
I’m the first-rate combat power, okay? You all are the resurrection spring water, your entire families are!
And repeatedly reviving, with tens of thousands of people, doesn’t this require points?
"Clan Leader Qing, everyone in the Heart Division, I appreciate your kindness."
"But we agreed last time, from now on, the actions will be under my full command, you only need to obey!"
Qingsuo’s expression froze, they indeed said so before.
"But, the enemy is formidable..."
Brother Cheng loudly interrupted her.
"Precisely because the enemy is formidable, I cannot let the Heart Division and my disciples take the risk!"
"The most dangerous task must be undertaken by the most important person!"
"This... is my duty as a Sect Leader!"
These touching words, delivered free of charge, made everyone feel as if they saw Sect Leader Jiang ascend to another level, shining brilliantly.
However, such empty words could only move ordinary disciples and clanspeople, those at the top were well-aware.
After all that talk, how are you solving the problem of the enemy?
Seeing Qingsuo and others trying to stop the ’Child of the Plane’ from showing off, Mo Chen had to step forward.
"Heh, my fellow Heart Division members needn’t worry."
"The Sect Leader already has a plan to defeat the enemy, everything is within his strategy."
"We just need to follow his arrangements!"
He actually didn’t know how Jiang Cheng was going to deal with those outside enemies.
But the Child of the Plane, endowed with a colossal destiny, even the most illogical decision would ultimately succeed in an unimaginable way.
This, having been an experienced hand in the Immortal Realm for many years, Mo Chen firmly believed.
"Elder Mo understands me."
Jiang Cheng looked at him approvingly, this old Immortal was worth recruiting, very considerate indeed.
Always capable of clearing the path for his displays of grandeur, allowing him to show off more smoothly and comfortably.
Even in the Immortal Realm, he’d have to continue extensively using his help.
"""

chapters.title: Chapter 160 They Want to Kill Your Dad
chapters.content:
Chapter 160: Chapter 160 They Want to Kill Your Dad
"Sect Leader Jiang, even if you plan to face the enemy alone, it’s better to stay within the secret realm."
Qingsuo was still making one last attempt to persuade him.
"After all, the secret realm has the help of the great array and restrictions."
"Facing the enemy outside, you won’t have these advantages."
Brother Cheng thought to himself, if the things inside get damaged, will you compensate?
Of course he had to go outside to fight.
Flying out of the secret realm alone, he couldn’t see the sky anymore.
The bodies of the Demon King and the Great Demons stretched endlessly, spanning a region, blocking the clouds with darkness.
People like Bi Feng had just arrived, discussing how to attack.
They made no attempt to hide on this journey, so it’s impossible that Feixian Sect didn’t receive the news. Inside, countless arrays and traps are probably already prepared, forming an iron fortress, right?
"Who will attack first?"
The Demon King and the leaders of the Seven Great Sacred Lands looked at each other, unwilling to be the first to make a move.
The first one to attack will surely face the fiercest resistance from those inside.
"The entrance to this secret realm requires special verbal magic to open, it seems we can only join forces and break through with power."
Having heard that Jiang Cheng and Heart Division did not escape, they must have some assurance to counter our side.
Bi Feng was pondering what might appear inside.
At this moment, Sect Leader Jiang flew out.
His emergence caused the higher-ups of the Seven Great Sacred Lands to retreat hastily by several miles.
Upon realizing there was only one person, even Bi Feng couldn’t help but deeply furrow his brow.
No matter, let’s stick to the normal process first.
"Jiang Cheng, did you ever think today would come when you annihilated two great sacred lands?"
Brother Cheng was observing the Demon King and Great Demons in the sky.
Wow, it was like entering a circus; all sorts of strange and bizarre demon beasts were present.
Compared to them, the Three-Eyed Tiger was actually quite attractive among these kinds.
Upon hearing this, he nodded: "I thought about it, knew today would come."
Bi Feng was taken aback, the first words effectively ended the conversation. What now?
"Let your people come out."
He had an expression of having seen through Jiang Cheng’s profound demeanor.
"Against absolute power, ambushes have no meaning anymore."
"Ambush what?"
To die early, Sect Leader Jiang could only spread his hands to show sincerity.
"It’s just me, feel free to come bravely!"
He didn’t even wear a storage ring, not carrying any weapons, completely bare-handed.
Bi Feng secretly scanned the surroundings with his divine soul countless times but found nothing.
Could it really be just him?
Of course, he wouldn’t be like previous enemies, scared into inaction.
Activating his divine soul, he silently attacked.
Clearly not using spiritual power, yet a tangible wind arose throughout the area.
Jiang Cheng couldn’t remain entirely defenseless, so he also mobilized his divine soul to confront.
In the sound of the wind, it seemed countless people roared and howled simultaneously, each voice directly attacking the depths of the divine soul.
At the same time, he recited verbal magic.
"Extinguish!"
Instantly, the forests on the four-direction mountains wilted rapidly at a visible speed, as if entering a harsh winter.
The Great Demons in the sky were in a mess.
This shock of saint-tier divine soul had certain effects on them.
As for the Seven Great Sacred Lands...
They were unaffected because they stationed themselves very far back, unwilling to exert effort.
"Ha..."
Bi Feng laughed loudly, seemingly having anticipated this.
"Early-stage Saint Tier! Your strength is indeed not as simple as it appears!"
In this attack on Feixian Sect, he recalled four of his Dharma Bodies, leaving only one outside.
Currently, his strength had recovered to ninety percent of its peak.
His divine soul realm far surpassed Jiang Cheng’s early-stage saint tier.
The two divine souls ultimately clashed on the field!
Neither person wielded weapons nor used any ultimate techniques.
Yet a series of sonic booms erupted in mid-air!
Boom boom boom...
At that moment, even those stationed at the back of the Seven Great Sacred Lands were affected.
A vast number of disciples below Daoist Palace Realm retained their original expressions as they silently fell.
The collision of divine souls may seem formless but is extremely dangerous.
Especially when it’s a collision between two saint-tier divine souls.
Just this single strike resulted in the demise of tens of thousands of disciples from the Seven Great Sacred Lands.
And the two vast Demon Kings in the sky opened their Holy Sanctuary at this moment, blocking all the Great Demons behind them.
The sonic booms rumbled dully within the Holy Sanctuary before finally dissipating into nothing.
Jiang Cheng still stood there, untouched...
This shouldn’t be. Even Brother Cheng himself was puzzled.
The clash between a peak saint tier and an early-stage saint tier should’ve resulted in his swift defeat.
However, in this divine soul collision, the two were evenly matched.
The opposite Bi Feng was even more amazed.
He took a deep breath as if seeing a freak.
"Your divine soul has actually surpassed the Ten Thousand Ancient level?"
To him, this was simply impossible.
Divine souls also vary in quality, with each level a world of difference.
Bi Feng had cultivated for millions of years, advancing from an ordinary soul through ten dimensions, finally refining his divine soul to Hundred Refinement quality.
This level of divine soul was already considered top-tier in the Lower Realm Ten Thousand Realms.
In battles, he had never suffered from divine soul issues.
To achieve the higher Thousand Layers Quality, ascension to Immortality was required.
Yet this time...
Though Jiang Cheng’s realm was lower than his, he resisted Bi Feng’s divine soul.
This surpasses the capabilities of the Thousand Layers level, definitely reaching the legendary Supreme Ancient Quality.
Only then could an early-stage saint tier resist a peak saint tier’s assault!
He had no idea that Jiang Cheng’s divine soul was formed from the active congregation of ten thousand ghosts, too unique to be duplicated.
Not something even the Ten Thousand Ancient Quality could represent.
"What’s all this about Ten Thousand Ancient?"
Brother Cheng hadn’t heard of it before, resulting in his confusion.
"Alright, alright, let’s continue."
Bi Feng didn’t continue attacking. Now he saw Jiang Cheng as an opponent equal to himself.
"No wonder you dare to stand alone."
"It seems one saint is not enough to deal with you."
"Fine, today isn’t a duel, but a vendetta, can’t concern ourselves with morality."
Once these words were spoken, the whole audience was in an uproar.
Is it a joke, that Saint Bi Feng at the peak tier admits he can’t subdue Jiang Cheng?
To deal with him, it takes gang fighting?
This person is that formidable?
Unbelievable!
The two Demon Kings exchanged a few words with Bi Feng, finally deciding the Three Saints would join forces to besiege Jiang Cheng.
"Kid, you’re strong, but you can’t protect that Three-Eyed Fierce Tiger King!"
"Don’t blame us for outnumbering you, it’s your own arrogance."
Looking at the three saint realms encircling him, Jiang Cheng was highly satisfied.
"Yes, yes, I’m arrogant, you’re right, come on."
He was just waiting to enjoy the next wave of more ferocious attacks when suddenly two figures emerged from the secret realm.
One person and one tiger.
The tiger was the Three-Eyed Tiger, and riding on its back was a little girl with a radiant complexion, barefoot. Who else but Ah Huang?
Once out, the Three-Eyed Tiger raised its paw to point at everyone opposite, loudly complaining.
"It’s them!"
"They want to kill your dad!"

chapters.title: Chapter 161: Beaten Too Badly
chapters.content:
Chapter 161: Chapter 161: Beaten Too Badly
This shout, not only stunned the opponent, but even confused Jiang Cheng.
He was just wondering why he hadn’t seen this damned tiger all day.
Even though it wasn’t needed for battle, this was too careless, wasn’t it?
After all, it carries the title of the Sect Guardian Spirit Beast.
So, it went to get some backup.
The reason the Three-Eyed Tiger was forced to become the Sect Guardian Spirit Beast was that when it first entered the Feixian Sect, it was subdued by Ah Huang.
Back then, it was dealt with perfectly...
In the whole Feixian Sect, it feared no one, except Ah Huang.
For a long time, it didn’t dare approach the spiritual vein in the back mountain.
However, as time went on, everyone became more familiar, and since Ah Huang never bothered it again, it gradually loosened up.
Sometimes, with nothing to do, it would even go to the back mountain to chat with that little girl, trying to get close.
Even though Ah Huang mostly ignored it, it kept doing it enthusiastically.
This is the biggest weapon of the Feixian Sect; making good connections now might just pay off in the future.
It learned of the two Great Demon Kings’ attack long before it happened.
It could certainly guess that these two Demon Kings were coming for it.
Jiang Cheng’s ability to keep creating miracles is uncertain. But it must take some protective measures for its own safety.
Therefore, it went to the spiritual vein early to call for a savior.
After much persuasion, along with some scheming and deceit, it finally used the excuse that "your father Jiang Cheng is being attacked" to bring this little ancestor out.
The little girl on the tiger’s back blinked with her round eyes, looking innocent.
