"Mommy, are they the ones trying to hit you?"
Jiang Cheng couldn’t help but glare at the Three-Eyed Tiger, recalling that he indeed had an awesome daughter.
He was mainly reluctant to let her act.
Every time Ah Huang acts, there is a price to pay, especially when there are more people involved, the cost is greater.
After she first wiped out the spiritual power of Yao Qiulin and those three Split Soul Realm cultivators, she slept for a while, and later consumed many spirit stones for recovery.
Brother Cheng still felt distressed.
"Good daughter, daddy can handle it, you go back."
If you come, the moment where I show off and overpower everyone will be gone.
Be good, go play with sand, don’t steal your father’s thunder.
Ah Huang shook her two braids vigorously, "No, there are so many bad people, I have to help mommy!"
Ah, this daughter was worth loving, she was really considerate of my safety.
Brother Cheng felt both gratified and helpless.
"Jiang Cheng, is this your last trump card?"
Since Ah Huang appeared, Bi Feng’s gaze never left her.
This little girl had no spiritual power aura at all, looking just like an ordinary person.
But she faced so many demon beasts without fear.
Moreover, no matter how he probed with his divine soul, he couldn’t detect this little girl’s divine soul fluctuations.
His probing seemed to catch Ah Huang’s attention.
Those pitch-black eyes locked onto him.
"Mommy, he seems to be the strongest one on the other side."
She extended her chubby little hand and pointed at Bi Feng opposite.
"Do you want me to help you subdue him?"
Brother Cheng was speechless, and Bi Feng opposite was even more speechless.
He had been a Saint for so many years, and it was the first time he had been looked down upon like this.
"Jiang Cheng, are you really going to let this little girl duel me, a Saint?"
Brother Cheng shrugged.
"I didn’t intend to."
"But it seems your luck isn’t very good."
My good daughter is eager to perform, so it seems there’s no chance for me to show off today.
"Really?"
"Then this Saint would really like to see her."
He was just about to make a move when the two Demon Kings on the opposite side excitedly unfolded their Holy Sanctuaries.
"Hahahaha, Three-Eyed Tiger, you finally dare to show up."
"The shame your father imposed on us will be returned doubly today!"
"Dare to cross realms, the Tiger Race will no longer have a Demon King!"
"Today we will beat the crap out of you!"
The Three-Eyed Tiger wasn’t stupid; it wouldn’t fight them.
Without hesitation, it pointed at the two Demon Kings and shouted loudly, "These two villains are the worst, they even said they would capture your dad and make you never see him again!"
What?
Ah Huang was immediately infuriated.
In the next moment, the Holy Sanctuary disappeared, and the two Demon Kings fell like two huge mountains.
Bang!
Bang!
The ground shook violently, cracking open with fissures, raising countless dust clouds.
Amidst the deafening sounds, a large number of cultivators hurriedly flew up.
With their power, they wouldn’t be knocked down by this quake.
But there was an exception, and that was Bi Feng.
This mighty Saint Tier expert, during the first moment of the quake, fell flat on his face and couldn’t get up for a long time.
"Jiang Cheng, what did you do!"
He was incredibly shocked and angry but found that his voice couldn’t travel far at all.
"Mommy, I’ve already sealed all their spiritual power and divine souls."
Ah Huang had an expression seeking praise.
Brother Cheng, suppressing his inner shock, patted her head, "Great job."
This is too powerful, isn’t it?
Before, when subduing the Three-Eyed Tiger, Ah Huang needed to touch it to seal its divine soul.
And now, facing three Saint Tiers, she could affect them from such a distance.
Unbeknownst to him, she had leveled up?
Thinking back, she did fuse two pieces afterward.
"Jiang Cheng, don’t think your demon technique illusions can fool me!"
Saint Bi Feng was frantic, he couldn’t believe this was real.
Suddenly, he turned from an omnipotent Saint Tier powerhouse into an ordinary person without spiritual power, unable to use his divine soul, Holy Sanctuary, or other methods.
Even the storage ring couldn’t open, and the sacred artifact in his hand couldn’t be activated.
The shock was too much, anyone would find it hard to accept.
Oh, he was still different from ordinary people.
After all, the body, meridians, and blood vessels of the Saint Realm still far exceeded those of other cultivators.
But that was all.
The two Demon Kings were no better; without the support of spiritual power and divine souls, they couldn’t even maintain their huge bodies, shrinking rapidly to just a few dozen meters.
It felt like they were suddenly reverted to their original forms.
"This can’t be!"
"What exactly happened?"
The one human and two beasts felt like they had been stripped naked and thrown into the spotlight.
Extreme fear and panic.
"Demon technique? Illusion?"
"Heh..."
Jiang Cheng flashed to Saint Bi Feng.
Then grabbed his neck and threw a ferocious punch.
Bang!
The fist hit Bi Feng’s face hard.
"Still an illusion?"
Bi Feng’s body was incredibly strong, this punch didn’t kill him, but it knocked out two of his teeth.
"You..."
Bi Feng was dumbfounded by the punch.
He had never been treated like this in his life.
Opening his mouth to spit out a mouthful of blood foam, he didn’t have time to retort before a barrage of punches landed on his face.
Bang bang bang.
Soon, this Saint Realm expert had several black circles under his eyes, his nose collapsed, his mouth broken, and his face swollen like a pig’s head.
Awesome!
Brother Cheng suddenly felt that this was more thrilling than killing with cheats.
Kills with cheats were usually instant, lacking the punch-to-the-flesh impact of the present.
And it was hitting a Saint Tier, such an exclusive experience, who would’ve dared to imagine?

chapters.title: Chapter 162: Three-Eyed Tiger Struts with Pride
chapters.content:
Chapter 162: Chapter 162: Three-Eyed Tiger Struts with Pride
The top dog of the Thousand Spirit Domain, Saint Bi Feng, is getting a brutal beating?
And it’s the kind of literal brutal beating?
At this moment, everyone from the Seven Great Sacred Lands is questioning life.
They were dumbfounded, completely unable to believe the scene they were witnessing.
Why is this happening?
Why is a mighty Saint Realm being beaten so badly?
With no power to fight back, looking no better than a Body Tempering Realm, he’s already being pinned to the ground by Jiang Cheng and getting hammered.
Could it be that this Saint Bi Feng is a fake?
No, that’s impossible.
Even if Bi Feng were fake, those two Demon Kings can’t be fake.
"Wow, that’s awesome, sis!"
The Three-Eyed Tiger almost wanted to worship Ah Huang, thinking what’s the big deal about being a little brother.
"The Three-Eyed Fierce Tiger King is joining the battle, continuing the grudges of the previous generation!"
After shamelessly declaring this pre-battle slogan, it directly lunged at the two struggling Demon Kings who were trying to escape.
It was another round of hammering.
With its strength, it could have instantly slain the two Demon Kings.
After all, the two Demon Kings now had no power to resist, their Divine Souls sealed.
Although they were thick-skinned, the Three-Eyed Tiger itself is also a Saint Tier, killing them was easy.
Yet it chose not to do so.
Because... it feels better to thrash them like this!
"Weren’t you two really cocky just now?"
Bang bang bang!
"Weren’t you going to beat the crap out of Master Tiger?"
Bang bang bang!
The two Demon Kings ended up exactly like Bi Feng, beaten black and blue, utterly wretched.
More than thirty Great Demons above watched wide-eyed, completely terrified to move.
If Jiang Cheng and the Three-Eyed Tiger had gone through a hard-fought battle to finally capture the Three Saints, that would be understandable.
The key is that the process of subduing the Three Saints was too sudden.
It looked like an adult beating a child, a complete wipeout!
What kind of power is this?
Could it already surpass the Saint Tier?
They were almost scared witless.
The two Demon Kings were beaten like this, wouldn’t the Great Demons below die even worse deaths?
Moreover, even if they rushed down, the natural tier gap meant they couldn’t possibly defeat the Three-Eyed Tiger, a Demon King.
"Didn’t they say the Tiger Race would no longer have a Demon King?"
Bang bang bang!
The Three-Eyed Tiger was beaming with pride, relishing the moment!
Old man, didn’t your boy do you proud?
Back in the day, when you fought these two Demon Kings, you weren’t as awe-inspiring as me!
This is called surpassing the predecessor...
"Hmm, why aren’t you fighting back?"
Bang bang bang!
"Are you looking down on the Three-Eyed Fierce Tiger King?"
Bang bang bang!
The two Demon Kings felt wronged, if we could fight back, we would have done it long ago.
"Damn it, not giving Master Tiger any face, keep beating them!"
On the other side, Jiang Cheng was also ’growing stronger with each battle.’
"Weren’t you so impressive?"
Bang bang bang!
"Hmm? Always cheating this, stealing that!"
Bang bang bang!
"Is this all you’ve got?"
"You still put on airs in front of me, I get angry just seeing that face of yours!"
Bang bang bang!
"Go ahead, show me the power of the Saint Realm!"
"Am I not worthy of you making a move?"
"I asked you to attack earlier, but you kept hesitating, why put yourself through this?"
Recalling earlier how even wanting to die was difficult, Brother Cheng’s anger surged, making him punch all the harder.
In no time, Bi Feng and the two Demon Kings were beaten to the point of silence.
The ground was covered in dust, it was that brutal.
Yet they were all quite durable, and wouldn’t die easily.
The Seven Great Sacred Lands and countless Great Demons trembled, too terrified to even think of escaping.
This is someone who can beat a Saint Realm like a punching bag.
Who knows what would happen if they tried to flee?
Right now in the Feixian Sect, everyone was anxiously waiting for news from outside.
"The Sect Leader has been out for so long, why is there no movement yet."
"Yes, it’s really worrisome..."
"The Senior Three-Eyed Tiger also went out, I wonder how it’s going."
Mo Chen smiled confidently: "Everyone calm down, just wait for the good news."
The Heart Division crowd silently complained.
Who is this guy?
They didn’t know Mo Chen used to be an Immortal; he looked more like a charlatan, totally untrustworthy.
"Oh no!"
Suddenly, Lan Ti exclaimed.
Mo Chen frowned: "What’s the panic?"
"Jiang Cheng forgot his Storage Ring!"
Lan Ti pointed to the desk next to the main seat, indeed seeing a Storage Ring, clearly belonging to Sect Leader Jiang.
"What?"
"He didn’t wear the Storage Ring?"
Now, even the Heart Division, along with the Feixian Sect disciples, panicked.
"I remember the Sect Leader’s weapons, talismans, and magical treasures were all in the Storage Ring..."
"This is bad, did he really forget?"
"Without the weapons and magical treasures, his power is reduced by at least thirty percent!"
You must be joking, how can someone be this careless?
Is this guy really a high-tier cultivator?
It’s so unprofessional!
Mo Chen laughed heartily: "In my humble opinion, the Sect Leader did this on purpose."
"He surely has his reasons, there’s no need for us to scare ourselves."
Even though he felt a bit unsettled inside, he maintained a confident facade.
The experts of the Heart Division were beyond speechless.
With things like this, you’re still finding excuses to fool yourself?
Where does this inexplicable confidence come from?
"Hurry and bring it to him!"
"Let’s all go out and take a look. If Sect Leader Jiang is in dire straits, there’s a better chance to save him with more people!"
Already burning with anxiety, Qingsuo and the others couldn’t wait any longer.
The Resurrection Spring Water cannot be wasted like this.
Lan Ti grabbed the ring and rushed out.
Ji Linghan and Lin Ning, unable to sit still either, summoned their weapons, joining the big troop heading towards the exit of the Secret Realm.
Soon, the large troops arrived outside the Secret Realm.
It was indeed a heated battle outside, but the situation was completely different from what they originally imagined.
They thought Jiang Cheng was either in a tough battle or possibly already killed.
But the scene before their eyes now made them question whether the world had gone mad...
The Peak of the Saint Tier, Saint Bi Feng, whom they both feared and hated, was already beaten to the point of merely breathing out.
Sitting atop him, Sect Leader Jiang still held his sand-bowl-sized fist, punching him repeatedly.
This scene looked like a Mortal World brawl, except it was a one-sided beating.
Meanwhile, the Three-Eyed Tiger was hopping over the heads of the two Demon Kings, joyfully delivering a dance-like pounding.
The two Demon Kings were also beaten to the point they couldn’t even beg for mercy.
Behind them, the Seven Great Sacred Lands and countless Great Demons wore faces of terror, too afraid to flee.
Seeing Bi Feng getting beaten, Lan Ti and the Heart Division should have been very happy.
After all, he was an enemy.
But now, everyone had countless question marks floating in their minds.
How is this possible?
How did this happen?
Is Jiang Cheng really that powerful?
The disciples of the Feixian Sect looked at him as if seeing a Divine Being.
The Sect Leader did say he was an Immortal, and they actually doubted an Immortal’s ability to deal with three Saint Realms, how inappropriate.
They should have more confidence in the Sect Leader from now on!
"Hahaha, as I said, the Sect Leader can defeat the enemy with a laugh, yet you didn’t believe it."
Mo Chen was extremely smug, having predicted correctly once again.
Though equally puzzled, he believed in trusting the Child of the Plane’s fortune could not be wrong.

chapters.title: Chapter 163: Great Revenge Accomplished
chapters.content:
Chapter 163: Chapter 163: Great Revenge Accomplished
"Weren’t you all supposed to wait inside, and I handle the fighting?"
"Why did you all come out?"
Though he complained outwardly, Jiang Cheng was actually delighted inside.
He had initially felt a bit regretful.
He hadn’t been killed this time, what a pity there was no one from his own side to witness him thrashing a Saint Realm expert.
Now that they suddenly came out, it was exactly what he wanted.
This act just became even more perfect.
"Sect Leader Jiang, you..."
Qingsuo and the others swallowed with difficulty, not knowing where to begin their questions.
The Saint Bi Feng lay motionless on the ground, almost at death’s door.
The formidable enemy they were most worried about seemingly no longer needed their concern.
Brother Cheng shrugged and casually said, "Oh, I heard these three guys were of the Saint Tier, so I just used a bit more force."
"I didn’t expect they couldn’t withstand it."
Brother, you’re shameless, aren’t you?
Clearly, it was your daughter who did it, yet you shamelessly take the credit without blinking?
Even the Three-Eyed Tiger couldn’t help but want to mock.
But after discovering that Ah Huang made no move to expose him, it jumped down from the two Great Demon Kings.
Boldly flying to the middle of the scene, it chimed in, "That’s right, these three losers couldn’t withstand Brother Cheng’s full force."
"Moreover, I was assisting from the side."
"In front of me and Brother Cheng, they were completely overwhelmed, really too weak."
"Pah, utterly overestimated them, if I had known, I wouldn’t have used so much force."
Since that little ancestor didn’t mind, this grandpa also shares a tiny bit of credit to boost my prestige, should be fine, right?
Sure enough, the entire scene was in shock.
Not to mention Qingsuo, even the Seven Great Sacred Lands and those Great Demons were gasping in surprise, shivering all over.
Ah Huang executed it without a ripple, leaving everyone convinced it was Jiang Cheng’s unfathomable power.
Was that really just using a bit more force?
How powerful exactly is Sect Leader Jiang?
"Do you want to avenge yourselves personally?"
He had already stripped Bi Feng of his storage ring and sacred artifact, so he naturally was generous.
"Let’s forget it..."
Looking at Bi Feng’s tragic state, Qingsuo didn’t know where to start.
A Saint Tier expert who had dominated for millions of years ended up in this sorry state, they weren’t even quite used to it.
Clang!
Lan Ti’s purple eyes were covered in icy fog as she drew her long sword.
She was not as merciful as the Heart Division.
If it wasn’t for Bi Feng’s deceit and robbery, causing the downfall of the Witch Division, things wouldn’t have degenerated like this.
To the clansmen’s tragic state for millions of years, this person was the main culprit!
The sword light flashed, and the head flew high up.
Even a Saint Tier can’t survive being decapitated.
Thus, a generation of heroic expert perished.
This scene left the people of the Seven Great Sacred Lands both terrified and sighing.
Too repressed.
The Saint Bi Feng couldn’t even display much power before being inexplicably killed like this.
And ultimately died at the hands of a Daoist Palace Realm woman.
Killing Bi Feng, million-year-old enmity was avenged.
Lan Ti could no longer hold back her turbulent emotions and threw herself into Jiang Cheng’s embrace, crying bitterly.
"Cheng..."
Her tears quickly soaked his clothes.
Brother Cheng thought, girl, you should be happy getting your revenge, why are you crying?
However, with such a peerless beauty in his arms, feeling that delicate and soft body, and smelling her faint fragrance and warmth.
He was more than happy to be a human pillow for a while, even wishing it could last longer.
Ding!
"Congratulations, you’ve gained the life-and-death allegiance of an Immortal Witch Seed subordinate, you earned 250,000,000 points!"
The sudden system notification startled him.
Damn, it wasn’t easy!
Girl, you’re finally one of my own.
Through this journey, do you know how much effort I put into you?
And, this score is just too much, isn’t it?
She’s only at the Daoist Palace Realm and has a full 250 million points!
Ji Linghan at the Gathering Yuan Realm was 3,000 points, if she became one of his own at the Daoist Palace Realm, it would be around 20 or 30 million.
Lan Ti’s nearly ten times that amount.
He had guessed that she was extraordinary to have reached Daoist Palace Eighth Layer at such a young age.
But he had always anticipated it might be around 10 or 20 million.
Who knew this would bring such a tenfold surprise.
He hurriedly pulled up the talent system to take a look.
Target: Lan Ti.
Talent: Second-class.
Upgradeable to: First-class.
Required Points: 11,800,000,000
She turned out to be the same as the Three-Eyed Tiger, achieving Second-class Talent.
However, the upgrade to First-class required even more than the Three-Eyed Tiger, a staggering 11.8 billion, utterly terrifying.
Brother Cheng could only pat her back as a token consolation.
As for upgrading, let’s forget about it.
At this moment, Mo Chen eagerly approached.
"Sect Leader, this old one has an impertinent request, may I ask if it would be possible?"
Brother Cheng, having acquired over 200 million points, was in an excellent mood.
"By all means, speak freely."
Mo Chen glanced at the two demon kings lying on the ground and secretly sent a message, "This old one wishes to possess one of them to get a body."
"Possess?"
If he hadn’t brought it up, Jiang Cheng almost forgot he was originally in a residual soul state.
After all, he showed up daily as a puppet.
"Indeed."
Mo Chen rubbed his hands excitedly, "A Saint Tier body is robust enough to withstand this old one’s residual soul infusion without collapsing. If successful, I will equate to a Saint Tier and better assist the Sect Leader."
Jiang Cheng gave him a sideways glance, thinking his words really sounded nice.
But this old guy could never have dreamed that Brother Cheng didn’t need his combat capabilities at all.
"Once you become Saint Tier, you’ll be able to make even better puppet cheerleaders... oh no, just puppet whatever, you get it."
Mo Chen eagerly nodded, "I understand, I understand, I can definitely make them more exquisite."
"They are demon kings, and you are human, can you possess them?"
"Ordinarily, other Saint Tiers cannot fuse with the demon race, but after all, I am an Immortal Soul, so I can naturally adapt perfectly."
"Alright, go ahead."
"Ah, thank you, Sect Leader!"
Mo Chen was happily overjoyed and enthusiastically ran over.
In the lower realm, a demon king is already considered the most perfect body.
In terms of toughness, the demon race surpasses the human race Saint Tier.
With this body, he could truly have a sense of security.
Even if he couldn’t ascend back to the Immortal Realm, at least he could roam freely in the lower realm.
After assessing the two dying demon kings, he decisively chose the Colorful Deer King, for no other reason than its appearance was far superior to the Profound Turtle King.
The possession was a million times simpler and smoother than he had anticipated.
Because Ah Huang restrained it, the Colorful Deer King was utterly powerless to resist, its divine soul consciousness was easily obliterated, becoming an empty shell.
Jiang Cheng gestured for his obedient daughter to release the restraint here, allowing the possessed Colorful Deer King to restore spiritual power and stand up.
Although severely scarred, they were just external wounds.
Given the demon king’s power, recovery was straightforward.
Upon standing up, many still hadn’t grasped what had happened until Mo Chen transformed the Colorful Deer King’s image back into his previous human form, finally clarifying the situation for them.
Those great demons in the sky were even more terrified.
The previous Colorful Deer King just vanished like that?
The Profound Turtle King lying powerless beside it was genuinely scared to death.
It didn’t want to be killed, nor be possessed.
Struggling, it begged and pleaded for mercy.
"Sect Leader Jiang, this little demon surrenders... willing to be at your service..."

chapters.title: Chapter 164 Assigning Mounts
chapters.content:
Chapter 164: Chapter 164 Assigning Mounts
What?
Submit?
Jiang Cheng was a bit taken aback, this is a Demon King after all.
One of the top three powers in the Thousand Spirit Domain, and yet so spineless?
Not even as brave as the Three-Eyed Tiger back then, who at least insisted on being killed rather than humiliated.
And keeping it around doesn’t seem to serve much purpose for me.
With the resurrection skill in fights, there’s no need for any help at all.
"Brother, keeping it is asking for trouble, better to kill it cleanly."
The Three-Eyed Tiger came over and advised Brother Cheng not to be soft-hearted, to just cut it down with one stroke.
It had its own motives.
The Profound Turtle King was its natural rival, keeping it around would certainly not lead to peace.
Plus, clinging to Brother Cheng’s leg that can enhance talent and resurrect people is one thing, but allowing more Demons to compete for business is not okay.
"Spare me!"
"I beg Sect Leader Jiang to spare my life, I’ll do anything..."
The Profound Turtle King, unable to escape, saw Jiang Cheng’s undecided attitude and could only plead madly.
"Brother, showing mercy will only get you harmed."
"If you don’t kill it, it’ll rise again like weeds in the spring!"
The Three-Eyed Tiger acted like a schemer, constantly whispering in his ear.
But the final decision was still up to Jiang Cheng here.
"Oh, shut up!"
Mo Chen, who had never liked it, also came over: "Sect Leader, don’t listen to this Tiger Demon. Just mark a contract on the Profound Turtle King’s Divine Soul."
"It can’t rebel against you in the future!"
He didn’t really care about subduing the Profound Turtle King, but since the Three-Eyed Tiger didn’t want to see it happen, he insisted on making it work.
"Think about it, Sect Leader. Having a Demon King as a mount would certainly enhance your status, wouldn’t it?"
"A mount at the Demon King Level, even some Upper Realm Immortals lack such a privilege."
Under his relentless ’persuasion’, Brother Cheng was indeed tempted.
Imagining the scene was indeed quite dazzling.
The ceiling of the Lower Realm is Saint Tier and Demon King, and I’ve got a Demon King underneath me.
Just thinking about it makes me feel leagues above others.
It definitely boosts my image!
"You’re making a good point."
The Three-Eyed Tiger panicked: "Brother, don’t listen to him..."
Jiang Cheng waved his hand: "My mind is made up. Profound Turtle King, are you willing to be my mount?"
Being a mount is quite undignified, and the Profound Turtle King naturally was unwilling.
But it was faced with just two options: die, or agree.
"I am willing..."
Following Mo Chen’s thoughtful guidance, Jiang Cheng imprinted a contract on its Divine Soul, and from then on, this Demon King became his mount.
After Ah Huang released the constraints, the Profound Turtle King’s Spiritual Power recovered, and its Divine Soul regained freedom.
The system’s prompt sounded again.
"Congratulations on gaining a loyal subordinate, you have earned a reward of 45,000,000 points."
With the system’s certification, there’s no running away from this.
But these points, didn’t the system forget to add another zero?
Lan Ti, at the Daoist Palace Realm, had 250 million, and this Demon King is at the Saint Tier, yet only gets 45 million, could there be a mistake?
Brother Cheng checked it out.
Target: Jade Qilin Xuan Turtle King
Talent: Fifth-class
Can be enhanced: Fourth-class
Points required: 21,000
Damn, a dignified Demon King with only Fifth-class talent, is this for real?
How did it cultivate to this point?
Just looking at those Seven Great Sacred Lands, there must be at least a hundred thousand people with better talent than it, right?
This guy becoming a Saint is an inspirational miracle in itself!
He glanced at those big demons standing dumbly in the sky and felt an instant burst of anger.
I’m standing here on the ground, and you all are still in the sky?
"Quite arrogant, aren’t you? Looks like you also need a good beating?"
This group of great demons numbered 34 in total, a vast number of targets, and Jiang Cheng calculated that even Ah Huang might struggle to lock them all down.
However, since the Profound Turtle King and ’Colorful Deer King’ are now part of his group, exterminating them isn’t impossible.
The group of great demons in the sky heard this and hurriedly shrank down and descended in fear.
"No, no!"
"We’re not arrogant in the slightest; we’re very obedient."
"We were blind and deserve to be punished, plead for forgiveness..."
"Yes, yes, Sect Leader Jiang, spare us a path."
"Sect Leader Jiang, I, this little demon, have never done evil. I don’t kill, I just eat grass, I’m a good demon..."
Spare a path?
Only eat grass?
Brother Cheng almost wanted to laugh.
Seeing them all pitiful now, would I feel the same without the system or Ah Huang?
This group of great demons voluntarily came to kill at his doorstep.
"If you want to live, then stay here and be mounts for my disciples."
"Huh?"
All the great demons looked at each other, clearly reluctant.
Great demons are on the same level as Ascending to Saint, and at this level, their intelligence is no less than that of Ascending to Saint humans.
Being made into mounts, of course, they were a hundred times unwilling.
Especially since none of Feixian Sect’s disciples have Ascended to Saint, their power was far inferior to theirs.
"Seems this Sect Leader is being overly demanding of you all."
"Alright then, I’ll kill you to save you from the hardship."
With a thud, immediately one of the great demons knelt down.
"I am willing, I am willing..."
The other great demons quickly followed suit, nodding their heads as well.
There was no other way, better to live disgracefully than to die a good death.
And thinking carefully, Jiang Cheng appeared omnipotent, so sticking with him could be promising.
Being a mount for his disciples might even lead to them gaining heavenly elevation as well.
Thinking of it this way, it seemed not so unacceptable.
"Elder Mo, you go arrange it."
To subdue them as mounts, a contract must be marked on their Divine Soul.
This complex operation was beyond the capabilities of Feixian Sect’s disciples.
If the demon beasts resisted, things could backfire, reversing master and servant roles.
This is also why high-tier demon beasts in the Cultivation Realm are rarely subdued as mounts.
Such a contract requires mutual consent.
Elder Mo nodded with great honor: "Certainly, Sect Leader!"
Feixian Sect had over 70 disciples, and with only 34 great demons here, more than half were bound to end up without mounts.
So how to choose these people?
The Sect Leader had now delegated this authority to him!
This was a hallmark of becoming the number one confidant beside the Child of the Plane, at least in his eyes.
All the Feixian Sect disciples surrounded him tightly.
An Ascending to Saint level mount means a powerful ally dozens of times stronger than oneself.
This is a great opportunity, who wouldn’t want it?
"Think, Elder Mo, I am Shan Tai... we just talked this morning. Don’t you think our relationship obligates you to give one to me?"
"Come on, with how we get along, you know I deserve one, right?"
Almost the moment he took on the task, Mo Chen had already picked a few candidates.
Ji Linghan, Sect Leader’s longest-serving disciple, exceptionally talented, and the one Sect Leader looks upon most favorably.
Even if there’s just one, it has to go to her!
Lin Ning, one of the standouts in the Third Generation, who only came second to Lin Ning in entering the Daoist Palace, was deserving as well.
Luo Yuan, Tang Ru, top among the Third Generation, next only to Lin Ning in talent, also suited for the position.
And for those dunderheads Shan Tai, Qin Chang, Gan Ziyi...
Fine, seeing how we usually get along, I guess I should give them one too.
As soon as he took on the task, before even a second had passed, Mo Chen had already made several selections.
Ji Linghan, being the woman who had followed the Sect Leader the longest, deserved one for sure!
Lin Ning, with his talent second only to Ji Linghan in entering the Daoist Palace, also deserving.
Luo Yuan, Tang Ru, outstanding among the Third Generation, just shy of Lin Ning, also deserving.
And these few goofballs, Shan Tai, Qin Chang, Wei Miao...
Alright, given our usual rapport, it’s only right to give one to these guys too, isn’t it?

chapters.title: Chapter 165: Subjugating 1,000 Spirit Domains
chapters.content:
Chapter 165: Chapter 165: Subjugating 1,000 Spirit Domains
It wasn’t long before thirty-four disciples of the Feixian Sect received their mounts.
This made the nearby people of the Heart Division green with envy.
The Heart Division actually also has spirit pet mounts, but they’re all at the Celestial Fate level, which are practically useless in a real battle.
As for the Daoist Palace level, only the top five Ascending to Saint possess them.
Looking at these disciples of the Feixian Sect, even the strongest are just at the Daoist Palace level, yet they possess mounts comparable to the strength of an Elder.
The likes of Qingsuo secretly eyed with jealousy. Last time they saw the distributation of Treasure Artifact Talismans, and now they’re distributing mounts in bulk.
Such generous treatment, isn’t it?
But there was nothing to be done, as even half of the disciples of the Feixian Sect hadn’t received theirs yet.
Let alone the fact that they weren’t members of the Feixian Sect.
After dealing with the Great Demons, Jiang Cheng turned his gaze towards the Seven Great Sacred Lands trembling in fear ahead.
This time, apart from some low-tier newcomers, the main force of the Seven Great Sacred Lands had almost emptied out their nests.
Nineteen Ascending to Saint Realm came, over six thousand Daoist Palace Realm, and over a hundred thousand Celestial Fate Realm.
Bi Feng had been killed, and the Demon Race had been subdued, how could these people dare to fight, let alone escape?
Now they deeply regretted their decisions.
Originally this matter had nothing to do with them, yet they had to join in the fun, thinking they could get a piece of the action.
If they’d known earlier, they would’ve just agreed to Jiang Cheng’s initial terms, and could’ve continued as the Holy Land Masters.
"Kill them."
Jiang Cheng waved his hand. These people came today to fight, there’s no need to even mention their identity.
Leaving them alive would be cruelty to himself.
Upon hearing these three words, Mo Chen, Three-Eyed Tiger, and Profound Turtle King, the three Saint Tier experts, soared into the sky, simultaneously deploying their Holy Sanctuary, enveloping the Seven Great Sacred Lands within.
The disciples of the Feixian Sect also mounted their rides and surrounded the Seven Great Sacred Lands members from all sides.
This scared the high-ranking officials of the Sacred Lands so much that they scrambled and crawled to kneel down.
"Sect Leader Jiang, spare our lives!"
"We were blinded by pig oil, we hope you can show mercy and leave us a small life."
"Sect Leader Jiang, we agree to your earlier terms!"
"Yes, yes, yes, we’ll immediately go collect the materials you requested..."
Now they couldn’t wait to agree to the previous terms.
"What were you doing earlier?"
"Still thinking about last time’s terms, huh?"
"I already said, if there’s a next time, the terms will double..."
Jiang Cheng hadn’t finished speaking when experts from the Seven Great Sacred Lands clung to these words like they were the last straw.
"Doubling is fine, doubling is acceptable!"
"Sect Leader Jiang, just name your terms, we agree to all and will never go back on our word!"
"As long as we can survive, we’ll do anything..."
Truth be told, Jiang Cheng was somewhat tempted.
The main issue was that some materials needed for refining Saint Pill had to be gathered everywhere, and without manpower it really was difficult.
Imagine tens of thousands of people around the world collecting materials for him, what a scene that would be.
Having them work for him was much more valuable than killing them.
But on the other hand, he wasn’t a three-year-old.
If he agreed now, these people would undoubtedly run away, and he would never find them again.
Understandably, Qingsuo seemed to have seen through his hesitation.
"Sect Leader Jiang, are you worried they might go back on their word?"
"Exactly."
"If you don’t mind, we can help manage these people for you."
"How would you do that?"
"Our Heart Division has a secret technique called the Heart Control Seal. Anyone who bears this seal cannot hide what they’re thinking. The caster, with just one thought, no matter how far apart, can make them wish for death."
What the hell?
Brother Cheng hurriedly leapt away, putting several meters between them.
You Immortal Remnants are too dangerous, aren’t you?
Lian Ti had used some Witch Race curse technique to dominate Ningti, and now the Heart Division had this Heart Control Seal.
If by any chance I get sealed too, and yet somehow I aren’t killed, wouldn’t I end up as your servant for life?
Seeing his reaction, Qingsuo and the others quickly explained.
"Sect Leader Jiang, you’re our great benefactor, even if we were mad we wouldn’t have any ill intentions towards you."
"And this Heart Control Seal has conditions. Unless it’s allowed by the other party, it is only possible if one surpasses the other by two Great Realms."
"Yes, yes, Sect Leader Jiang your Divine Soul Realm is definitely much higher than ours."
With their explanation, Jiang Cheng felt relieved.
Indeed, my Divine Soul is higher than theirs, besides, even if they progress fast, it’s impossible to exceed two Great Realms above my Divine Soul.
"Can anyone use this Heart Control Seal?"
Qingsuo shook her head: "Only our Heart Division people can use it, outsiders without the Heart Seed cannot learn it."
"Our tribe members can master it at the Celestial Fate Realm, and for each rise of a Great Realm, they can control one more person, Ascending to Saint can control three people."
Heart Seed?
Could it be similar to the Witch Seed I drew last time?
Activate it, and I’ll receive the talent of the sect?
If that’s the case, maybe I’ll draw it next time.
Acquiring more skills can’t be bad, can it?
This secret technique can know what others are thinking and can dominate life and death, that’s too overpowering.
With such an extraordinary secret technique, the Heart Division didn’t dominate the Thousand Spirit Domain, what a waste.
Even if they can’t control the high-ranking ones, forcibly controlling the Celestial Fate with Ascending to Saint should be possible, right? Controlling Spirit Platforms with Daoist Palace shouldn’t be a problem, right?
Millions of years ago, they could’ve turned a batch of the most talented new Saint Heirs from the major Sacred Lands into their own puppets.
Even if they do nothing further, no undercover, no sabotage, no assassinations, no betrayals...
When this batch of Saint Heirs ascends to high ranks in millions of years, the Thousand Spirit Domain would naturally be under Heart Division’s rule.
"Ahem, could you give me a copy of that Heart Control Seal?"
Qingsuo frankly didn’t know why he needed it, but naturally, they would oblige any of his requests.
"No problem, here’s the Jade Talisman of the Heart Control Seal, you can look it over yourself."
At this point, how could the high-ranking officials of the Seven Great Sacred Lands dare to rebel, they could only accept obediently.
At least they could keep living.
The Heart Division had over 7,000 people above Celestial Fate, and while they couldn’t control everyone in the Seven Great Sacred Lands, it wasn’t necessary.
In the Seven Great Sacred Lands, Elders above the Daoist Palace, and those Saint Heirs and Saintesses were all imprinted with the Heart Control Seal.
This is truly a reversal of fortune.
Previously, the Heart Division barely survived between the Nine Great Sacred Lands, being oppressed, and never daring to speak loudly.
Now, however, the high-ranking officials of the Seven Great Sacred Lands were all kneeling before the Heart Division people, not daring to even raise their heads.
In fact, Qingsuo was doing this with the future of the tribe in mind.
Otherwise, once the Void Immortal Realm opens and the five hundred elite high-rankers ascend, how could those left behind continue to survive in the Thousand Spirit Domain?
How could the Seven Great Sacred Lands not take advantage and oppress them?
Even if they didn’t destroy the Seven Great Sacred Lands, eventually other Sacred Lands would be replaced.
With this Heart Control Seal, the dynamics between them have reversed.
After subduing the Seven Great Sacred Lands, the system’s prompt sounded.
"Congratulations Host, you have subdued the Thousand Spirit Domain."
Another ten million points were added.

chapters.title: Chapter 166 Mahayana Long Departure Sword
chapters.content:
Chapter 166: Chapter 166 Mahayana Long Departure Sword
If it weren’t for this system reminder, Brother Cheng would have forgotten such an absurd main quest.
He honestly hadn’t given much thought to this task.
Otherwise, he would’ve been out conquering all sects in sight, with those who follow flourishing and those who oppose perishing.
Then, he would recruit people massively, continuously expand from Feixian Sect, spreading influence throughout the universe.
That’s the right way to unify some place.
But Sect Leader Jiang was too laid-back to bother with ruling this or that.
Besides, most sects hadn’t provoked him, so he had no reason to destroy others.
Unexpectedly, after subduing the Seven Great Sacred Lands, this task was mysteriously accomplished.
Thinking it over, now the top combat power in Thousand Spirit Domain is under his command.
Mingxin Sacred Land listens to him, two Demon Kings—one possessed, the other became a mount, and Bi Feng is gone.
It does indeed count as unifying the Thousand Spirit Domain.
These unexpected 1 billion points are a delightful surprise.
After the retreat of the Seven Great Sacred Lands, this grand battle that captivated most cultivators in Thousand Spirit Domain finally came to an end.
Assuming that previous one-sided beating counts as a grand battle.
In fact, any way you look at it, this battle seemed more like a collective home delivery of treasures and mounts.
Brother Cheng promptly and affectionately checked on his cherished daughter, the only hero of today’s battle, and couldn’t neglect her.
The Three-Eyed Tiger cheerfully carrying and Brother Cheng accompanying her, personally escorted her back to the Spiritual Vein at the back mountain.
"Darling daughter, do you feel uncomfortable anywhere?"
"Mommy, I’m very sleepy, want to sleep."
"Oh, alright, alright, sleep as long as you like, need any spirit stones?"
"Mmm mmm..."
Sect Leader Jiang waved his hand, heaps of spirit stones piled up like mountains.
Only then did Ah Huang beam with joy, in the blink of an eye she devoured that mountain of spirit stones.
Lucky no one else was there to witness, otherwise, they’d be scared to death.
"Tell me in advance if you need more next time!"
Feeling prosperous today, Brother Cheng was particularly generous.
After settling his daughter, he started sorting through his haul this time.
The resources scavenged from the Seven Great Sacred Lands, after some time categorizing, earned another 1 billion points.
Some resources were kept for disciples’ cultivation, while some Heavenly and Earthly Treasures were reserved for refining Holy Pills.
This time, Lan Ti’s allegiance yielded 250 million, Profound Turtle King’s submission brought 45 million, added to the original 920 million.
All together, he now had over 3.2 billion points.
Looking at that long chain of numbers, Brother Cheng felt immense satisfaction.
He clicked the upgrade button once more, and the system upgraded again.
Level: 8
Points: 0/10,000,000,000
Available Points: 2,215,878,460
Current Skill: Host can spend points to make the next attack 10x critical hit effect, cooldown one day.
Note: The higher the host realm, the more points consumed.
Subordinate Skill: Host can spend points to create inanimate objects out of thin air, no cooldown.
Note: Must be an object the host has seen before, the higher the item’s tier, the more points consumed.
What’s this?
Creation, is it?
Jiang Cheng was a bit confused; in his mind, creation should be a power only beings like the Creator God possess, right?
But thinking more carefully, it’s just inanimate objects being created.
Perhaps immortals at a certain level can also achieve this.
The first thing he thought of was creating a spirit vein to place inside the Xuanji Map.
That way, there would be spiritual qi inside the map too.
Then he could move Ah Huang in as well, and in the future, cultivating within the Xuanji Map would be a thousand times better environment.
But that has to wait for the next system upgrade, which requires a whopping 10 billion points, still a long way off.
As for the current 10x critical damage...
He opened the system interface.
Current Realm: Early-stage Saint Tier.
Points needed for 10x attack: 100,000,000
Gah, using it once actually costs 1 million?
Greedy system, I am clearly just at the Daoist Palace Realm!
Looks like the system isn’t stupid, directly calculating based on his Divine Soul Realm.
After leveling up, he opened the lottery button again, choosing Level 5 lottery.
It’s been a long time since he last drew.
The key is that he plans to expand the size of the Xuanji Map too.
Meanwhile, that Daoist Celestial Immortal Rhyme should be upgraded as well.
Especially considering that heart division’s heart seed, might as well get it in the draw?
The Level 5 lottery costs 10 million per draw, but Brother Cheng can afford it, so he decided to spend 1 billion for a 100 times draw.
A series of lights flashed, and the rewards from the first ten draws appeared before him.
"Congratulations host for obtaining 2 Xuanji Map Fragments."
"Congratulations host for an outbreak of good fortune, obtaining 1 strand of Mystic Immortal Rhyme!"
"Congratulations host for obtaining 1 strand of Daoist Celestial Immortal Rhyme."
"Congratulations host for obtaining 1 Immortal Artifact Fragment."
"Congratulations host for obtaining 1 Nine Flames Condensation Immortal Pill."
"Congratulations host for obtaining 1 Tai Xiao Life Soul Immortal Pill."
"Congratulations host for obtaining 1 Heroic Soul of the Prison."
"Congratulations host for an outbreak of good fortune, obtaining 1 Saint Artifact Mahayana Long Departure Sword!"
"Congratulations host for obtaining 2 Xuanji Map Fragments."
"Congratulations host for obtaining 1 Ling Xian Siluo Flower."
The Level 5 lottery is indeed different, even yielding Immortal Artifact Fragments and Immortal Pills that barely exist in the Lower Realm.
That Ling Xian Siluo Flower is also a Heavenly and Earthly Treasure from the Immortal Realm, used for refining Immortal Pills.
Overall, even if the Void Immortal Realm can’t bypass to the Immortal Realm, he’ll break the Lower Realm’s rule limits sooner or later.
After all, the rewards given by the system already exceed that plane.
In the Level 5 lottery, Xuanji Map Fragments only counted as ordinary rewards of giving 2 pieces at a time.
And the Daoist Celestial Immortal Rhyme appeared once, looking quite average.
The Saint Artifact Mahayana Long Departure Sword, attributed to fire, his Five Elements Martial Dao being at Immortal Tier already, he could naturally use it.
The previous Cyan Luo Breaking Sacred Sword was nothing compared to this sword.
The sword body inscribed with three Saint Grade amplifying arrays, fire element’s power amplified 5 times, Sword Aura’s power 5 times, Sword Intent’s power 2 times.
Additionally, there are three Treasure Arrays, fully enhancing this sword to its peak.
Rarely anyone in the Lower Realm can have a Saint Artifact.
Firstly, materials are hard to acquire, and even if obtained, there’s no one to find at this level of artifact refining master and inscriber array master.
This tier of weapons and Holy Armor isn’t something a single artifact refining master can craft.
Different field masters need mutual cooperation and collaboration, conditions are hard to meet.
Not to mention the scary failure rate.
Throughout the Thousand Spirit Domain, only Bi Feng previously had a similarly Saint Grade Silver Night Shadow Sword.
That sword wasn’t even Bi Feng’s forte wind attribute, but rather dark attribute.
But he had no choice.
It had been collected after countless hardships and serendipity from other domain planes over half a lifetime.
An ill-fitted Saint Artifact, still much more useful than the top-grade Treasure, merely considering its material.
Yet compared to the system’s reward sword, the Silver Night Shadow Sword is far inferior.
Only possessing two Holy Arrays and two Treasure Arrays.
Unlike the system, where products are top-grade without exception.
His focus primarily rested upon the Heroic Soul of the Prison and Mystic Immortal Rhyme.
The Heroic Soul of the Prison, similar to Poison Heroic Soul, directly adds a buff to his attacks.
Activating the Heroic Soul of the Prison, the host permanently possesses it.
In future battles, whenever this heroic soul is summoned, every attack automatically carries an effect of trapping the enemy, as if in a cage.
Whether Divine Soul or Spiritual Power Domain, there will be negative effects of imprisonment.
Of course, if the enemy’s strength is too high, they can naturally break the cage.

chapters.title: Chapter 167: Martial Dao at the Profound Immortal Level
chapters.content:
Chapter 167: Chapter 167: Martial Dao at the Profound Immortal Level
After absorbing a trace of Daoist Celestial Immortal Rhyme, his Four Extremes Martial Dao also reached the Immortal Tier Level.
Then, he began to study the Mystic Immortal Rhyme in detail.
Just from the name, one could surmise it was a similar treasure to the Daoist Celestial Immortal Rhyme.
Mystic Immortal Rhyme—an Exotic Treasure containing the profound meaning of Profound Immortal Dao Treasures, capable of elevating a Martial Dao Mark to the Profound Immortal Level!
This...
During this time spent with Mo Chen, Jiang Cheng had gained some understanding of the Immortal Realm.
Normally, after overcoming the Thunder Tribulation, an ascender would start at the First Grade True Immortal Realm upon reaching the Immortal Realm.
After the Ninth Grade True Immortal, comes the First Grade Celestial Immortal.
And above the Celestial Immortal, there is the Profound Immortal.
Previously, the Daoist Celestial Immortal Rhyme he acquired granted him Martial Dao Enlightenment at the True Immortal Level.
This had already broken the limits of the Lower Realm Plane.
Even if a Lower Realm Martial Artist had extraordinary talent, their Martial Dao would only reach the Saint Level.
Because there was simply no way to acquire Immortal Level enlightenment.
But now, while still in the Lower Realm, Jiang Cheng could obtain Martial Dao Enlightenment at the Profound Immortal Level.
If he ascended to the Immortal Realm, he would start as a significant expert.
Looking at the three Martial Daos that had reached the Immortal Level, he decided to use the Mystic Immortal Rhyme on other rivers, aiming for balanced development.
After a long consideration, he chose the Space-Time Martial Dao.
But the system immediately indicated that the foundation was insufficient and enhancements were impossible.
Damn, what kind of foundation is needed to use this Mystic Immortal Rhyme?
It meant that if the river hadn’t reached the Immortal Level, it couldn’t be elevated to the Profound Immortal Level out of thin air.
Reluctantly, he had to elevate the already True Immortal Level Five Elements Martial Dao to the Profound Immortal Level.
The next moment, the Daoist Palace autonomously soared into the void, radiating light as if an immortal had descended!
Nine great Martial Dao rivers hung in the air, the blue river representing the Five Elements swiftly expanded, and the golden vibrant mark inscriptions shone brilliantly, visibly transforming into a platinum hue!
The mark rippled through the river, densely packed and exuding an extremely mysterious aura, giving an inexplicable and surreal feeling, not belonging to this world.
The Profound Immortal Level mark was complete!
In Jiang Cheng’s mind, countless more Martial Dao enlightenment suddenly appeared, all related to the Five Elements.
But compared to last time, this enlightenment was deeper and more mysterious.
A gaze that encompassed millennia, when his consciousness returned, he realized there was a crowd standing in front of him.
No matter if it was experts like Qingsuo, the Three-Eyed Tiger, the Profound Turtle King, or disciples of the Feixian Sect like Lan Ti, Ji Linghan, and Lin Ning, they all stood gaping, forgetting to close their mouths.
Just staring at him, dumbfounded.
"What... is this?"
Qingsuo’s muttering broke the silence.
Of course, she knew it was a Martial Dao river in the Daoist Palace Realm.
As someone Ascending to Saint, she shouldn’t be surprised by a Daoist Palace.
But right now, aside from astonishment, she felt nothing else.
The Four Extremes and Nine Palaces at the Immortal Level were one thing, but what was with that Five Elements Martial Dao?
Why did it look scarier and more exalted than the Immortal Level?
What exactly is this?
It was the cultivator’s instinctual thirst for knowledge in unknown domains, yet there was also a sense telling her this was beyond her exploration.
Too far away...
"Profound Immortal Level Martial Dao Enlightenment!"
"This can’t be!"
The only one recognizing it, Mo Chen, couldn’t help holding his head in despair, his expression collapsed, filled with existential doubt.
He had once reached the Profound Immortal Level in his Martial Dao Realm.
But how many years had it been since he became an immortal, and how much of his life was spent striving for that Profound Immortal Level Martial Dao mark?
More than a billion years, at least.
Yet Jiang Cheng was still in the Lower Realm and already had a Martial Dao mark at that level.
What, Profound Immortal Level?
Legends from the Immortal Realm existed even in the Lower Realm, especially since the Immortal Remnant Race were descendants of immortals.
Everyone knew what the Profound Immortal level concept was.
And so, it was as if the place exploded.
"He hasn’t even ascended, how could this be possible?"
"It’s a miracle, an absolute miracle!"
"Such talent is unparalleled throughout time..."
"With Sect Leader Jiang’s Martial Dao Realm, even without the Void Immortal Realm, he could sooner or later forcibly break through the barriers of the Immortal Realm!"
"Stay calm, the Sect Leader always said he was an immortal, isn’t this normal?"
"Exactly, otherwise, how could he perform immortal techniques."
"Normal, my foot!"
Mo Chen suddenly roared; he was usually accepting of anything, yet this time, he was heavily struck.
Damn, you guys shouldn’t speak nonsense if you don’t understand.
Profound Immortal Level Martial Dao Enlightenment couldn’t be reached without being in the Immortal Realm, without Immortal Yuan Qi, without contact with that level of Martial Dao.
This was something utterly impossible.
Even if one somehow magically acquired a technique of that realm in the Lower Realm, it wouldn’t work.
Could the fate of a Child of the Plane alone achieve this?
He began to doubt for the first time.
Seeing everyone dumbfounded, Brother Cheng felt an urge to show off.
"You need not be amazed; this Sect Leader just had some insights after a bit of recent ascetic cultivation."
Could you still call this a random insight?
If it wasn’t for being the most loyal follower of the Sect Leader, the Personal Grandmaster, a core member of the Child of the Plane, the ultimate auxiliary for Brother Cheng’s showcasing, Mo Chen would have grabbed him by the collar to interrogate him.
Suddenly having direct enlightenment at the Profound Immortal Level?
Why don’t you tell me how you did it?
"With the Sect Leader’s talent, if he can’t become an Immortal Emperor in the Immortal Realm, I’ll write my name backwards!"
This high evaluation left everyone awestruck.
But Brother Cheng expressed that he found the compliment to be average, nothing new, and Elder Mo needed to try harder.
Under everyone’s watchful eyes, he again entered the system interface, busy with the remaining 90 draws.
After these 90 draws, he obtained 7 more threads of Daoist Celestial Immortal Rhyme and 1 more thread of Mystic Immortal Rhyme.
With six more rivers yet to reach the Immortal Level, he naturally elevated them all.
Whoosh!
The Daoist Palace once again autonomously drifted into the void, and the Life and Death Martial Dao river rapidly expanded, its mark leaped from Sect Level to King Level, then to Saint Level, reaching Immortal Level in the blink of an eye.
The sky shone with the golden inscription marks of that river, dazzling as if the Celestial River was inverted.
This...
The crowd was still present.
They witnessed another enhancement.
Although it wasn’t the Profound Immortal Level this time, only the True Immortal Level, it was still shocking enough.
They couldn’t see the system, only the transformation of the Daoist Palace.
"Another upgrade?"
"This, this, this, how could it be so fast?"
"How many realms did it skip?"
"Too terrifying!"
Facing the crowd’s utterly incredulous gazes, Brother Cheng shrugged.
"Happened to gain a bit of insight again."
Goddamn!
Could your words be any more fake?
The previous Profound Immortal Level was the Five Elements Martial Dao, now the Life and Death Martial Dao had risen to the True Immortal Level.
Completely different, separated by vast distances, did he just jump into another realm of insight?
And it only happened in a matter of minutes.
Soon after, another river rapidly transformed to the Immortal Tier, this time it was the Space-Time Martial Dao.
Don’t tell me you happened to have insights again.
Is the Immortal Level so easily reached?
Why aren’t there others in the Lower Realm with it?
Amidst their utterly collapsed state, everyone turned their questioning gaze again to Sect Leader Jiang.
"I just suddenly thought of space-time, insights flowed in, couldn’t help it."
They didn’t even bother to hide it anymore, not even making up other excuses.

chapters.title: Chapter 168 Too Discouraging
chapters.content:
Chapter 168: Chapter 168 Too Discouraging
Next, Jiang Cheng also elevated the remaining rivers of Yin and Yang, Six Desires, Seven Emotions, and Eight Desolates to the Immortal Tier.
With this, all nine of his Martial Dao Marks reached Immortal Level.
Each enhancement left the onlookers in utter awe.
Eventually, they all became numb.
What enlightenment? You’re kidding!
"Sect Leader’s Martial Dao Realm has already surpassed many Profound Immortals in the Immortal Realm."
Mo Chen felt quite helpless, realizing that his previous cultivation knowledge was greatly challenged.
"To elevate all nine Martial Dao to Immortal Level at the Daoist Palace Realm, such a thing has never happened before."
"Sect Leader’s foundation is so profound, there’s never been anyone like him before and likely none to come after..."
"Once he steps into the Ascending to Saint Realm, he’ll immediately be invincible in that realm."
Qingsuo nodded woodenly.
She is at the Ascending to Saint Ninth Layer.
If someone had said before that she could be defeated by someone at Ascending to Saint First Layer, she would have considered it a joke.
But now she couldn’t refute it at all.
To advance from Daoist Palace Ninth Layer to Ascending to Saint, one needs to smelt all nine Martial Daos into one.
Using Martial Dao Enlightenment as fuel, further refine the Daoist Palace to ultimately transform it into a domain unique to the martial artist.
In this process, the higher the Martial Dao Realm, the stronger the final domain will be.
Jiang Cheng’s Martial Dao Realm exceeds that of a Celestial Immortal; the level of the domain he can form might even surpass a Saint Tier Holy Sanctuary.
However, limited by the understanding of the rules, the precision of his control is not as high as Saint Tier.
Since arriving, the Three-Eyed Tiger and Profound Turtle King stood in dumbfounded reverence, gazing upwards.
They felt that their own Holy Sanctuaries were like dilapidated villages compared to a royal palace, with no sense of superiority at all.
Especially the Profound Turtle King, it finally felt a genuine sense of submission.
It couldn’t help but surrender.
Clearly, this was a future giant in the Immortal Realm; becoming his mount didn’t seem degrading at all.
"Once his Spiritual Power meets the requirement, it won’t even take an hour to form a domain."
Qingsuo recalled her own difficult experience in forming a domain back in the day, feeling quite emotional.
The refinement of the Daoist Palace into a domain does have requirements for the Martial Dao Realm.
The nine Martial Dao rivers need at least one at Saint Level, four at King Level.
The last four must not fall below Sect Level.
This is the minimum standard, yet it has stumped countless cultivators.
Moreover, the Ascending to Saint itself presents a bottleneck, and now with the advent of Thunder Tribulations, it has blocked countless genius cultivators.
When Qingsuo reached the Ascending to Saint, she had one at Saint Level and eight at King Level.
This was considered the most outstanding Martial Dao foundation in the Heart Division.
As a result, she was only stuck at Daoist Palace Ninth Layer for three thousand years before breaking through.
While some of the other elders in the Ascending to Saint Race were stuck for tens of thousands of years.
This is where the advantage of a genius lies.
"An hour?"
Mo Chen chuckled softly, saying, "You underestimate the Immortal Level Martial Dao; with foundations like Sect Leader’s, forming a domain will be a matter of moments."
A matter of moments?
Qingsuo and the elders of the Heart Division exchanged glances, feeling that their Martial Dao determination was being severely tested.
Comparing with others can be truly discouraging.
But soon, they were once again shocked.
Below, the great river representing the Nine Palaces on the Daoist Palace expanded and changed color once more, with countless vibrant platinum marks forming instantly.
"Another at Profound Immortal Level?"
Mo Chen’s eyes nearly popped out.
Is there no way for others to survive?
The rest could only look up as if viewing a towering peak.
His realm was too distant, leaving them with little but awe, simply remarkable.
Once this Nine Palaces River took shape, Jiang Cheng paused temporarily.
No help for it, the Mystic Immortal Rhyme was a stroke of luck, not easily drawn.
The next 90 times, only one appeared.
Mo Chen cautiously approached: "Sect Leader, is your enlightenment over?"
"I suppose so."
Sigh, my power has grown once more.
Life truly is as lonely as snow.
With the confirmation, everyone collectively breathed a sigh of relief.
At last, it was over.
If it continued, everyone truly would be struck down.
Martial Dao reaching Immortal Level in moments was too overwhelming.
Seeing everyone’s spirits slightly dampened, Brother Cheng kindly offered them some comfort.
"This is the result of my regular ascetic cultivation and the fruits of accumulated effort, you can achieve this too."
"As they say, the heavens reward the diligent!"
"Three years without flying, then a leap towards the heavens!"
Such words only made things worse.
Hearing this, everyone couldn’t help but twitch their mouths, fiercely wanting to retort.
Were you even practicing ascetic cultivation?
It’s hardly been seen that you cultivate, right?
Accumulated effort and sudden success might apply to others, but it’s truly unfitting for you.
"Haha, congratulations to Sect Leader, felicitations to Sect Leader!"
Mo Chen was the first to start flattering, followed swiftly by others offering their congratulations.
With a smiling nod, Sect Leader Jiang thought, all nine Martial Dao at Immortal Level, yet he merely advanced from Daoist Palace Fourth Stage to Daoist Palace Fifth Layer.
Can’t it just propel him directly into the Ascending to Saint Realm?
He now had three Saint Tier underlings, yet remained at Daoist Palace as the Sect Leader, lacking grandeur.
He glanced at the System Warehouse, noticing he still had one Daoist Celestial Immortal Rhyme left.
After elevating all nine rivers, this piece seemed redundant.
It was unfortunate that this intangible, formless item couldn’t be extracted or gifted, or he would have given it to Ji Linghan.
Regrettably, he tapped the Daoist Celestial Immortal Rhyme, only to discover a usage button.
It can still be used?
Driven by impulse, he pressed it.
Then, an extraordinary transformation occurred!
The Daoist Palace slowly soared, rising into the clouds.
Golden light radiated in all directions, like the blazing sun, dazzling to behold!
Mo Chen found that even with his Divine Soul, he couldn’t gaze directly at the Daoist Palace anymore, its form obscured.
He could only see an increasingly intense sphere of light...
In the apex of brilliance, darkness ensued.
At that moment, everyone on the scene seemed to experience a whirlwind of time and space, witnessing strange and magnificent vistas unfolding across the heavens.
All-encompassing, embracing creation and destruction, the Five Elements’ interactions, or the myriad conditions of worldly existence!
The sky seemed to unveil a scroll depicting all Martial Dao.
Except for Mo Chen, everyone was utterly captivated, unable to extricate themselves.
He watched in horror, surveying each person around him.
Though physically near, they seemed impossibly distant, not of this same realm.
"This..."
"What’s happening?"
"Why is this so?"
He could only look to Jiang Cheng for answers.
Jiang Cheng merely smiled.
With a casual wave of his right hand, the tumultuous Daoist Palace gradually calmed.
A jet-black river cascaded from the heart of the Daoist Palace, descending to coexist with the nine Martial Dao Marks, forming a stunning spectacle of ten Martial Dao rivers flowing in unison!
"The tenth one?"
"How could there be a tenth Martial Dao Mark?"

chapters.title: Chapter 169 Achieving the Immortal Body
chapters.content:
Chapter 169: Chapter 169 Achieving the Immortal Body
Mo Chen cried out in astonishment.
However, no one echoed him.
The rest of the crowd was still immersed in the state of martial arts, not yet awakened.
"The nine paths of Martial Dao encompass all, with every branch present..."
"It is impossible for a tenth path to exist!"
"What on earth is it?"
As an Immortal, his understanding was utterly shattered.
"Sect Leader..."
He hoped someone could enlighten him.
However, Jiang Cheng’s state at this moment was very mystical, and he had no time to respond.
Once the tenth black river was fully formed, the entire Daoist Palace was tinged with a mysterious dark hue.
As time passed, this line of Martial Dao gradually faded, seemingly retreating to the depths of the Daoist Palace.
But Mo Chen could swear that he definitely saw it.
That black Martial Dao Mark was definitely still there!
It just hid away, and no one knew what it truly was.
It was only then that the others finally woke up.
"What happened?"
"Yeah, what happened? Why does it feel like a very long time has passed?"
"It seems I have gained many insights into my Martial Dao Realm."
"Same here!"
"Could it be because of the Sect Leader?"
"Perhaps the Sect Leader’s Martial Dao Realm is so high that we were also inspired by his Daoist Palace?"
Mo Chen really wanted to tell them that it was indeed because of the Sect Leader.
But it was ten thousand times more complex than they imagined!
A Martial Dao Realm too high that it could inspire others?
It’s not that simple.
Just as everyone thought everything was over, the sky gradually darkened.
"What’s going on?"
"This is a Secret Realm."
More and more layers of dark clouds piled up, one on top of another, creating a terrifying sensation as if they were about to crush everything below.
"This sky is not normal!"
"Why does it feel like it’s a Thunder Tribulation?"
"Hahaha, but no one is about to Ascend to Saint..."
As soon as the words fell, Mo Chen’s face suddenly changed dramatically.
"Get out of the way!"
"Everyone leave here!"
"This is a Thunder Tribulation!"
"The Sect Leader is about to cross the tribulation!"
The others looked at him in surprise.
"Crossing the tribulation?"
"How could it be?"
"The Sect Leader is not even at Daoist Palace Ninth Layer."
At this moment, Jiang Cheng also faintly felt that an extremely dangerous power had locked onto him.
"It’s my Thunder Tribulation, you all should leave here quickly."
But many disciples of the Feixian Sect refused to leave.
"No, this Thunder Tribulation looks dangerous, I want to help the Sect Leader withstand the lightning!"
Mo Chen almost burst out laughing in anger.
"Are you all fools? Thunder Tribulation must be faced alone. The more people around, the fiercer the Thunder Tribulation becomes. You’re endangering him!"
This is basic common sense in cultivation.
Upon hearing this, the disciples hurriedly flew away from there.
They did not know that at this moment, the sky across the entire Lower Realm Ten Thousand Realms had darkened.
In various Great Domains, countless cultivators stepped out.
Whether Body Tempering or Saint Tier, they all looked towards the sky covered in dark clouds.
They didn’t know what was happening, only that a primal shiver ran through their very souls.
Countless cultivators knelt down, prostrating themselves and praying for mercy from the heavens and earth.
For it appeared as though the end of the world had come.
Watching Jiang Cheng fly into the sky alone from afar, Mo Chen was momentarily lost.
This scene surpassed any Thunder Tribulation he had heard of.
Even in the Immortal Realm, no such terrifying disturbance had been seen.
Yet the Sect Leader is only at the Daoist Palace Realm; no matter how exceptional the talent, it shouldn’t cause such a Thunder Tribulation!
Could it be...
It’s because of that tenth path of Martial Dao?
That path should not have existed, nor is it tolerable by this world, thus triggering the annihilation by the rules of heaven and earth?
This speculation only existed in his mind for a moment, then he dismissed it.
How could that be, that’s too outrageous.
The sky became completely dark, and without Divine Thought, one couldn’t see a single thing.
Until a light appeared within the clouds that nearly touched the mountain’s waist.
That light grew increasingly intense, illuminating Sect Leader Jiang, who was the only one suspended mid-air.
A golden dragon-shaped lightning stretching an unknown number of miles began to form, and this was only the beginning.
Soon, another fiery red dragon-shaped lightning appeared.
Mo Chen’s shock never ceased.
It wasn’t until nine massive dragon-shaped lightnings appeared in the sky, completely surrounding the one crossing the tribulation, that he murmured to himself in an extremely complex tone.
"Nine Heavens Dragon Tribulation..."
"How could someone at the Daoist Palace Realm face such a world-destroying tribulation..."
"Is this world in chaos?"
Thunder Tribulations come in varying degrees of strength.
When the Daoist Palace ascends to Saint, it usually encounters the Profound Celestial Thunder Tribulation.
A few slender red lightnings would typically conclude the process.
Of course, that lightning is vastly different from mundane world lightnings, able to obliterate both body and soul below the Daoist Palace, its power extraordinary.
Previously, when Saint Tier was ascending, the commonly encountered Thunder Tribulation was the Zixiao Thunder Tribulation, as thick as a barrel.
It was enough to obliterate many at the Peak of Saint Tier who lacked deep foundations and were unprepared, utterly destroying their Divine Soul.
In the Immortal Realm, even Immortals in their late stage need to cross tribulations.
At that time, they face world-destroying level Celestial Tribulations such as the White Emperor Thunder Tribulation, Myriad Manifestations Celestial Tribulation, Eight-Tone Celestial Ladder, Heart Slaying Tribulation, or the Nine Heavens Dragon Tribulation.
Facing such a Thunder Tribulation at the Daoist Palace stage, there’s simply no way to endure it.
Jiang Cheng did not know what this Thunder Tribulation meant.
He only knew that there was no avoiding it now, as if, no matter where he appeared, the Thunder Tribulation would follow him like a shadow.
When the nine giant dragons descended upon him simultaneously, he had no chance and was struck dead.
Then the system’s notification sounded.
"Ding, host has been killed, detecting enemy’s strength, arranging resurrection plan..."
What will it provide this time?
Will it grant immunity to Thunder Tribulation?
Jiang Cheng felt a bit expectant.
"Ding, host has been resurrected."
What?
Resurrected just like that?
Where’s the resolution plan?
Being brought back to life means getting struck down again, doesn’t it?
Brother Cheng wanted to curse.
But then he noticed that the dark clouds were dispersing, and the Thunder Tribulation had ended.
That’s right, the characteristics of Thunder Tribulations are like this: either you survive it successfully.
Or it strikes you down completely, at which point the Thunder Tribulation disappears, having lost its target.
When he was struck dead moments ago, the Thunder Tribulation dissipated.
A dispersed Thunder Tribulation was as good as defeated.
Thus, the system didn’t need to provide any resolution, and by resurrecting, it counted as having conquered this Thunder Tribulation.
And he didn’t walk away empty-handed.
Because he ’endured’ such a terrifying world-destroying Thunder Tribulation, he naturally gained the refinement effects of the tribulation.
Even if it was just for a moment, his body directly transformed from a mortal vessel to the level of an Immortal Body.
If it weren’t for his Spiritual Power Realm being too low, he could have immediately ascended to the Immortal Realm.
The sky brightened once more, and Mo Chen was the first to fly up.
"Immortal Body?"
"Sect Leader Jiang?"
Jiang Cheng looked back at the dumbfounded expression on Mo Chen’s face.
Although he had resurrected, it was only the start of a new story.
The journey of pursuing the Tenth Path of Dao had only just begun.
And the heavens, it seemed, would not forgive him.
"""

chapters.title: Chapter 170: Advancing to Ascending to Saint
chapters.content:
Chapter 170: Chapter 170: Advancing to Ascending to Saint
"Half and half."
Jiang Cheng was also rather speechless about his current condition.
According to logic, when achieving the Immortal Body, the spiritual power within the body should automatically convert into Immortal Yuan Power.
That signifies the formal shaping of an Immortal.
But because he’s not even close to Ascending to Saint, let alone Saint Tier, and his Domain isn’t formed, his Spiritual Power Realm is far too low.
So, the situation is quite unusual.
Currently, whether it’s his meridians or Sea of Qi within, they’ve all been restructured to Immortal specifications, and even his Divine Soul has features of an Immortal Soul.
Yet, the power he uses is still spiritual power, not Immortal Yuan Power.
And the Divine Soul is the same, still at the early-stage Saint Tier.
Clearly possessing an Immortal Body, but still using spiritual power—it must be said, this is indeed a rarity.
At this moment, other disciples finally arrived.
"Sect Leader, you’re alright, that’s great!"
"Scared me to death."
"The Sect Leader is truly amazing to make it through such a thunder tribulation."
"Yes, yes, I was so scared I nearly peed myself."
"If it was me, I’d be turned to ashes in an instant, there’s no way we could withstand it."
After enjoying a round of compliments, a satisfied Brother Cheng said, "Alright, alright, go cultivate now."
This time, the disciples didn’t complain.
Just now, when the tenth Martial Dao appeared, they all gained significant enlightenment, and truly needed to cultivate.
After everyone dispersed, Jiang Cheng busied himself with counting his previous lottery rewards.
This time, in a 100 draw, he got 22 Xuanji Map fragments.
This led Jiang Cheng to have an uneasy suspicion: just how many fragments does this Ghost Map have?
If it weren’t for each synthesis improving the effect, he would have been in despair.
His transmission and invisibility skills were also raised to Level 5 this time.
This greatly increased the transmission distance and invisibility duration.
Besides these two skills, his Alchemy, Artifact Refining, and Talisman Refining techniques also advanced to Level 5.
This is already the level capable of crafting Immortal Pills, Immortal Artifacts, and Immortal Talismans.
With these three crafts, even without much combat power, Brother Cheng could become very popular in the Immortal Realm, easily earning a living wherever he goes.
Because not every Immortal in the Immortal Realm can use Immortal Artifacts and Immortal Pills.
Such a master is welcomed anywhere.
He also received two sets of True Immortal Level cultivation techniques and three sets of True Immortal Level Martial Techniques.
He had not extracted these techniques and skills yet, planning to wait until he reaches Ascending to Saint or Saint Tier.
Extracting at that point, the cultivation techniques and martial skills would be perfect for his realm.
Currently ascending to Ascending to Saint is not difficult for him, as the Divine Soul and Martial Dao Enlightenment surpass it greatly; all he needs is enough pills.
Apart from those intangible rewards, the physical rewards were also plentiful.
He acquired a total of 4 Sacred Artifacts.
And also received 3 lower-grade Magical Treasures.
Finally, there were 25 Immortal Pills and some Heavenly and Earthly Treasures, along with Immortal Artifact fragments used as materials.
Without any delay, he began meditating on the spot, taking out Immortal Pills to use.
After the first Immortal Pill entered his body, under the effect of the Celestial Desolation Indestructible Body, it transformed rapidly.
Surging Immortal Yuan Qi washed through his meridians, immense power erupting from the pill.
Jiang Cheng felt no discomfort or pain, just a slight sense of regret.
These Immortal Yuan Qi, after entering his body, were forced to downgrade into spiritual power due to the Daoist Palace realm restriction.
Immortal Yuan Qi is inherently much higher than spiritual power, so disassembling it to spiritual power suggests the substantial force within.
With just one Immortal Pill, his realm skyrocketed from the Fifth Layer to Daoist Palace Ninth Layer.
Then, he consumed another one to start consolidating his domain and advancing towards Ascending to Saint.
The entire breakthrough process was quite smooth, with his Martial Dao realm being too high, facing no bottlenecks.
In the sky, thunder tribulation appeared once more.
But this time it was the Profound Celestial Thunder Tribulation, similar to other Ascending to Saints.
The lightning streaked down like strands of hair, striking his body and sparking dazzling fireworks.
Yet, that was all there was to it.
Brother Cheng already has an Immortal Body, okay?
In the past, the Zixiao Thunder Tribulation during the Saint Tier ascension had to be crossed to have an Immortal Body.
This Profound Celestial Thunder Tribulation was too low for him.
Like trying to attack a rock with a flyswatter—painless and without itch, he barely felt anything.
However, the disciples and people like Qingsuo heard the news and rushed over, afraid something might go wrong again.
Seeing the red clouds in the sky and the continuing descending thunder, everyone was on edge.
The thunder tribulation just passed—how is there a new one already?
Upon arriving at the scene, seeing the Sect Leader’s state, everyone was speechless.
Brother Cheng was just sitting cross-legged there continuing his cultivation, eyes closed, with no intention to resist the thunder tribulation.
Especially those like Qingsuo who ascended before, recalling their past struggles of donning full armor, surrounding themselves with defensive talismans and arrays, and using Magical Treasures for defense.
The state required peak adjustment without any distraction.
Yet this guy, people would think he fell asleep.
The Profound Celestial Thunder Tribulation continued sparsely, making a cursory appearance on him before fading away awkwardly.
Quite embarrassing.
Once the thunder tribulation passed, the Daoist Palace sublimated.
Transforming into a domain, grounded in the nine Martial Daos.
Simultaneously, the tenth Martial Dao quietly embedded itself at the domain’s center.
The moment it formed, the domain began expanding furiously, extending beyond the main peak’s range.
It continued stretching in all directions, encompassing a hundred-thousand-mile Secret Realm, and surprisingly still hadn’t stopped.
"This domain, truly worthy of Sect Leader Jiang!"
"Indeed, my domain spanned three thousand miles, which is already considered large."
"When I ascended to Saint, my domain was merely five hundred miles."
"Nine Immortal Level Martial Daos—the foundation is unimaginable."
Profound Turtle King silently sensed for a while, then shook his head with a bitter smile: "My Holy Sanctuary is only a hundred thousand miles; the Sect Leader’s domain is too vast."
Only when it expanded to a million miles did Jiang Cheng’s domain stop spreading.
Everyone witnessing this scene could only look up in admiration.
Mo Chen sighed: "This Ascending to Saint Domain is already peerless in the world!"
