He suddenly felt an odd sensation, that he was witnessing the birth of new history in the Cultivation Realm.
Qingsuo, however, sighed: "It’s just a pity, a domain this vast makes advancing very difficult for him."
Profound Turtle King agreed in a gruff voice: "Indeed, the larger the domain, the more spiritual power is needed for advancement; otherwise, sustaining it is impossible."
"For a million-mile domain, his advancement is ten times harder than my Holy Sanctuary’s advancements!"
Mo Chen didn’t argue with them this time.
Because it was the truth.
Although Jiang Cheng’s enlightenment and realm were so high that he had no bottleneck, the immense accumulation of spiritual power, ten times more than for Saint Tier advancement, was enough to deter anyone.
Even using all twenty thousand Treasure Pills acquired recently might only elevate him from Ascending to Saint First Layer to Ascending to Saint Third or Fourth Layer.
And there are so many realms beyond that?
"With the Sect Leader’s immense fortune, this should all be smoothly resolved in the future, right?"
"Besides, with the Void Immortal Realm about to open, once the Sect Leader enters the Immortal Realm and absorbs Immortal Yuan Qi for cultivation, the speed will increase."
Their discussion left other Feixian Sect disciples quite puzzled.
"Isn’t the Sect Leader already an Immortal?"
"Why does he have to break through the Daoist Palace again?"
"Exactly, are you sure you’re not mistaken?"
Mo Chen was speechless.
Did you really believe he was an Immortal?
Indeed, the Sect Leader possessed some abilities even Immortals found hard to match, but his actual realm was always low, okay?
As a capable Personal Grandmaster, he couldn’t embarrass the Sect Leader.
At this point, Brother Cheng, who had broken through to Ascending to Saint First Layer, opened his eyes.
"You’re overthinking it."

chapters.title: Chapter 171 Finally Finished Cultivation
chapters.content:
Chapter 171: Chapter 171 Finally Finished Cultivation
There are still 23 Immortal Pills left unused; these are not comparable to Treasure Pills or Holy Pills.
The only regret he had was that among these 23 Immortal Pills, 5 were related to the Divine Soul, used to enhance the Divine Soul Realm.
Under normal circumstances, pills that enhance the Divine Soul Realm are several times more precious than those that enhance Spiritual Power.
But now Jiang Cheng needed Spiritual Power the most.
"Luckily, back then I kept the last bit of Immortal Pills."
After saying this, he pretended to take out a Southern Dipper Jade Liquid Immortal Pill.
It seemed like he had been an Immortal for many years, and this was just a small part of his collection.
This time, not to mention others, even Mo Chen jumped up.
Woah, Immortal Pill?
Did they not hear wrong?
This is something impossible to appear in the Lower Realm!
"Is it really an Immortal Pill?"
"Absolutely, from that Immortal Pill, I can sense an extremely vast special power."
Everyone crowded over, just like country bumpkins who have never seen the world, gazing at the pill that emitted endless flows of light, as if it could break through the air at any moment.
"Is this the aura of Immortal Yuan Qi?"
Qingsuo and others shivered with their hands, desperately wanting to touch it personally.
The Three-Eyed Tiger and Profound Turtle King kept swallowing their saliva; as Demon Kings, they were closest to the Immortal Tier.
Their sense of that Immortal Yuan Qi was the keenest.
Their instincts told them this thing would be of unparalleled help to them!
On the contrary, the disciples from the Feixian Sect, having lower realms, did not feel it deeply.
"Sect Leader is an Immortal; it’s only natural for him to have Immortal Pills!"
"Of course, I wouldn’t be surprised if Sect Leader took out an Immortal Artifact."
"Ahem, when Sect Leader gave me a Tier Four Spiritual Artifact, I thought it was a big spend."
"Hahaha..."
Mo Chen was a bit disordered, he carefully sensed it, and indeed it was an Immortal Pill, with no tricks.
Moreover, its quality looked extraordinary, without a single defect.
The only thing that puzzled him was that this pill didn’t seem like it had been kept for long; instead, it looked freshly made.
This made him increasingly incredulous.
Even the Immortal Pill was brought out, the fortune of the Child of the Plane seemed hard to explain now.
Unexpectedly, even a pill can be a way to show off, Brother Cheng deeply felt the difference between himself and everyone else.
The aura of pretentiousness elevated too quickly, creating a Grand Canyon-like gap!
After throwing that Immortal Pill into his mouth, he began the delightful process of leveling up again.
The effects of the Immortal Pill were different; the pill turned into surging Spiritual Power upon entering his body.
Like a tide, endlessly pushing his realm forward rapidly.
A moment later, he reached Ascending to Saint Second Layer, and didn’t stop.
Only when he crashed through the barrier of Ascending to Saint Third Layer did it finally pause.
In front of all eyes, he broke through two small realms in just a few tens of seconds.
It seemed almost easier than breaking through the Body Tempering Realm.
"Immortal Pills are truly extraordinary!"
"This effect is too strong."
Wei Miao and others were envious beyond measure: "If I could eat an Immortal Pill now, could I jump directly from Celestial Fate Ninth Layer to Daoist Palace Ninth Layer?"
Mo Chen disdainfully glanced at them and snickered weirdly twice.
"You can try, if you don’t explode, I’d be willing to call you big brother from now on."
"The potency of Immortal Pills can’t be endured by ordinary Saint Tier, let alone refined."
"As for those at Celestial Fate Realm, Treasure Pill is the limit; Holy Pill can crush your meridian and Qi Sea."
He didn’t know what kind of talent Jiang Cheng had, but obviously, he had exceptional gift.
Soon after, he saw Jiang Cheng take out another handful of Immortal Pills, totaling more than ten.
"More, still more?"
"Wow, what realm can this elevate to?"
Before they could react, Brother Cheng directly put the remaining 17 Immortal Pills that increase Spiritual Power into his mouth.
The Immortal Pills dissolved upon entry, swiftly turned into potency.
Others didn’t have time to stop him, just watching with dumbstruck faces.
"Crazy, absolutely crazy!"
"Is Sect Leader committing suicide?"
"Just the potency of one Immortal Pill is so fierce, what about more than ten..."
The disciples were all frantic.
"It’s over, Sect Leader is showing off too much."
He acted impulsively, disregarding his life.
Mo Chen was also scared dumb; even a Profound Immortal might explode taking more than ten Immortal Pills at once.
Only Lan Ti remained calm.
It’s happening again, here we go again.
She had seen something similar before.
This guy fundamentally cannot be understood by common sense; eating pills like it’s as easy as eating jelly beans.
Up, up, up, the aura on Jiang Cheng’s body kept rising!
Every few seconds, a small realm was upgraded.
Ascending to Saint Fourth Layer!
Ascending to Saint Fifth Layer!
Ascending to Saint Sixth Layer!
Ascending to Saint Seventh Layer!
It finally stopped at Ascending to Saint Eighth Layer.
This was because his Domain was too vast; for a normal Ascending to Saint Realm, these more than ten Immortal Pills would be enough to push to the Peak of Saint Tier, just waiting for Ascension.
Of course, that’s assuming Martial Dao Enlightenment and Divine Soul Realm are sufficient.
After using up the Spiritual Power Immortal Pills, Jiang Cheng also consumed the remaining 5 Immortal Pills that enhance the Divine Soul in one go.
It was expected the Divine Soul Realm would soar, breaking through the Peak of Saint Tier wouldn’t be an issue.
After all, these were Immortal Pills!
To his surprise, after taking 5 Immortal Pills, it only elevated from Early-stage Saint Tier to Mid-stage Saint Tier.
Could it be also difficult to elevate his Divine Soul?
He remembered Bi Feng mentioning something about Ten Thousand Ancient Level Divine Soul before.
Maybe that’s the reason?
When he opened his eyes again, others didn’t know what to say anymore.
Others upgrade with thousands of years in calculation, but this one almost finished the Ascending to Saint process in a moment.
Mo Chen cleared his throat, breaking the unspeakable silence.
"Is Sect Leader finished?"
Jiang Cheng stood up and regretfully spread his hands.
"There’s nothing I can do, although I want to continue being an ascetic cultivator, the pills are used up, it seems it ends here this time."
He sighed lightly and added, "However, cultivation requires a balance between work and rest, cannot blindly indulge in mindless practice."
"Ahem, Sect Leader is absolutely right; it really is taxing."
Does this even slightly relate to ascetic cultivation?
Thank goodness it’s finished; otherwise, we thought you would directly eat your way to the Immortal layer.
"Alas, I just don’t have Immortal Pills that heal Divine Soul, otherwise I’d surely save them for you."
Brother Cheng didn’t know this old man was secretly grumbling about him, otherwise, he wouldn’t speak so pleasantly.
Mo Chen quickly piled on smiles: "Sect Leader is kind, that is sufficient, there’s no rush, no rush!"
The Child of the Plane is likely always busy with matters.
However, the Sect Leader kept this concern in mind, enough to deeply touch him.
"Oh right, Sister Lan, your Bone Refining Banner is claimed back, now returned to its rightful owner."
Bi Feng’s true form had been exterminated, naturally, the Bone Refining Banner was taken into hand.
Jiang Cheng hadn’t gotten a chance to look at it closely yet.
Lan Ti was now one of his own people; upgrades even have rewards of that kind.
Brother Cheng naturally wasn’t stingy, not to mention, this thing originally belonged to the Witch Division as an Inheritance Treasure, he didn’t intend to hoard it.

chapters.title: Chapter 172: The Movement of the Bone Refining Banner
chapters.content:
Chapter 172: Chapter 172: The Movement of the Bone Refining Banner
Lan Ti was overjoyed and wanted to express gratitude.
But considering that Jiang Cheng and she were in a ’Daoist Companions’ relationship, thanking him would seem too formal.
She could only suppress her excitement, fixating on the Magical Treasure emanating a violet light, adorned with intricate bone patterns, slowly emerging from the Storage Ring.
Others felt uncomfortable looking at the Bone Refining Banner, as if it invoked a strong discomfort deep in their Divine Souls.
It seemed as though just one more glance would plant a shadow within them.
Not even Mo Chen could avoid frowning silently.
But Lan Ti was different.
From the first moment she saw this top-grade Magical Treasure, she felt a synergy, like a fish finally reunited with the sea.
Even though she hadn’t touched it yet, her Realm began to loosen.
Her entire being, Spiritual Power and Divine Soul, became extraordinarily active at that moment.
And inside her, the Witch Seed continuously called out, forming a peculiar connection with the Bone Refining Banner.
This was hers; it was her destiny!
The other members of the Heart Division, including Qingsuo, couldn’t help but feel a mix of emotions and relief.
Millions of years had passed...
The Witch Division had finally regained their Inheritance Treasure.
Unfortunately, the clan that once shone brightly was now reduced to its last member.
Lan Ti’s tears streamed uncontrollably, her snow-white hand reaching out to summon the Bone Refining Banner.
Then...
The Bone Refining Banner swayed in the air and flew toward Jiang Cheng.
Everyone was stunned, Brother Cheng included, looking bewildered.
He hadn’t summoned the Bone Refining Banner nor refined it.
"This isn’t my doing!"
This Magical Treasure, he genuinely intended to return to Lan Ti.
Even though he didn’t have his own top-grade Magical Treasure, Sect Leader Jiang wasn’t narrow-minded.
To prove he hadn’t tampered with it, he purposely hid his hands behind his back.
Yet the Bone Refining Banner hovered in front of him, persistently nudging him.
Sometimes it brushed against his chest, sometimes it tapped his forehead, finally resting on his shoulder, refusing to leave.
This left Lan Ti feeling quite awkward.
The experts from the Heart Division were amused and confused, wondering what was happening.
Top-grade Magical Treasures have a spirit and know how to choose their master.
If everyone in the audience of a thousand simultaneously reached out to summon the Bone Refining Banner,
it would undoubtedly choose Lan Ti.
Because she possessed the Witch Seed and had cultivated the Witch Division’s secret classics.
The Bone Refining Banner would naturally favor her.
No matter how high other people’s realms were or how strong their power, they couldn’t pique its interest.
Unless someone like Bi Feng forcibly possessed it.
But in such a case, he would merely occupy the treasure, unable to unleash its true power.
They believed Jiang Cheng hadn’t interfered, so why did the Bone Refining Banner choose him over Lan Ti?
He wasn’t from the Witch Division and hadn’t practiced Witchcraft!
"Go over there."
"Be good, although brother is handsome, following that pretty sister is a better prospect!"
In good faith, Brother Cheng flew into the air, attempting to evade the Magical Treasure.
But the Bone Refining Banner chased him all the way.
Wherever Jiang Cheng went, it followed.
This scene left the disciples dumbfounded.
"Sect Leader’s charisma is really over the top, isn’t it?"
"Indeed, attracting girls is one thing, but even Magical Treasures are smitten?"
"Could it be that this Magical Treasure is female?"
"Gosh, Junior Brother Meng, you’re quite talented, truly grasping the essence of the Sect Leader’s teachings!"
Amidst laughter, the Bone Refining Banner seemed to grow impatient.
It suddenly began glowing by itself.
Even the golden bone patterns on the banner flew out and weaved through the ever-brightening violet aura.
Witnessing this, everyone involuntarily closed their eyes.
The shadow grew heavier, overwhelming enough to make them feel a mortal threat.
Only Lan Ti’s violet eyes were filled with delight.
Celestial Spirit Witch Manual!
Once those bone patterns manifested, they revealed the long-lost Witchcraft of the Witch Division!
The Witch Manual of the Witch Division has always been split into the Earth and Celestial sections, and she always possessed the "Earth Spirit Witch Manual."
The "Celestial Spirit Witch Manual" was originally contained within the Bone Refining Banner, accessible only to the most talented cultivators within the clan who might decipher part of its secrets.
These mysteries couldn’t be conveyed or documented as tangible classics; each person’s understanding was different.
Therefore, since the Bone Refining Banner was taken by Saint Bi Feng, the "Celestial Spirit Witch Manual" has been lost.
Bi Feng did not possess a Witch Seed and naturally couldn’t grasp any mysteries from it, causing the Witch Division to decline.
By the time Lan Ti was born, the "Celestial Spirit Witch Manual" had been lost for several million years, but she could still recognize it at a glance.
Some of those bone patterns enlightened her; others were too profound and obscure.
They required immense time to comprehend fully.
Yet one aspect puzzled her greatly.
The ancestral scenes of comprehending the Celestial Spirit Witch Manual didn’t seem like this.
She had never heard of the "Celestial Spirit Witch Manual" on the Bone Refining Banner coming alive and revealing itself.
Could it be because of Jiang Cheng?
When she again focused on Jiang Cheng, she couldn’t contain her shock.
"Divine-grade Witch Seed!"
"You actually possess a Divine-grade Witch Seed?"
With the Bone Refining Banner’s persistent activation, Brother Cheng’s Divine-grade Witch Seed, won from a past draw, finally responded.
The Witch Seed appeared like a tiny purple flame, flickering, seemingly tangible!
Lan Ti could hardly believe it was true.
Her Immortal Witch Seed was already considered a rare genius within the Witch Division.
When Silence Sacred Land attacked, the former clan leader wouldn’t have sacrificed to protect her alone and entrusted the "Earth Spirit Witch Manual" to her without it.
But Jiang Cheng possessed the top talent the Witch Division hadn’t seen in tens of millions of years—a Divine-grade Witch Seed!
She finally understood why the Bone Refining Banner chose Jiang Cheng.
Between Divine-grade and Immortal-grade, it would obviously choose the more talented one.
Even if this person had never practiced Witchcraft.
Jiang Cheng wouldn’t need to cultivate Witchcraft; the golden bone patterns soon flew from the purple mist, swirling around him before entering his body.
It seemed as though they had merged into one.
In his mind appeared a vast amount of cultivation knowledge related to Witchcraft.
This knowledge quickly integrated into his Realm through the Divine-grade Witch Seed’s stimulation, becoming another of his techniques.
He glanced at the distant mountain peak.
Upon that peak, a Spirit Tree seemed frostbitten, rapidly changing from blue to gray, and then to dazzling white.
Yet the Spirit Tree neither withered nor died, continuing to flourish, full of vitality.
Holding the Bone Refining Banner, he gave Lan Ti a wry smile.
"I didn’t expect this either."
Lan Ti smiled, her flawless face showed no hint of disappointment.
"No matter, the Bone Refining Banner voluntarily manifesting the bone patterns is the highest form of recognition, unprecedented in the Witch Division."
"It being in your hands is better than mine."

chapters.title: Chapter 173: You Are the Clan Leader
chapters.content:
Chapter 173: Chapter 173: You Are the Clan Leader
"Are you being sarcastic?"
Jiang Cheng was very aware of her obsession and care for the Bone Refining Banner.
That was almost like a totem of faith for her.
"No!"
Lan Ti shook her head with a smile, then naturally linked her arm with his.
"I’ve never been as happy as I am now."
Her head rested on his broad shoulder, and Jiang Cheng could already smell the fragrance of her hair, making him feel elated.
Wow, what is happening here?
Because I’ve gained the recognition of this magical treasure, you’re throwing yourself into my arms?
Feeling the warmth of the jade-like person in his arms, Brother Cheng had to admit he was a bit tempted.
But soon, he delved into deep philosophical thoughts.
Does she like me as a person?
Or does she like the magical treasure and just considers me a bonus?
Ah, whatever, as long as she’s pretty, it’s all good.
The entire scene was silent, everyone quietly watching the two embrace.
One was dazzlingly handsome, the other unbelievably beautiful.
This scene looked like a picturesque couple you wouldn’t want to disturb... or not.
Ji Linghan and Lin Ning, along with other female disciples, all felt a strong sense of threat.
This Lan Ti’s level is too high, seeing that the Sect Leader isn’t good at rejecting, she made a direct move?
Quietly taking the lead.
Too much!
"Ahem, it doesn’t seem cold here."
"Yeah, there’s no need to cuddle for warmth."
"I still have many cultivation questions for the Sect Leader."
The female disciples of the Feixian Sect spoke up, making the two separate.
Jiang Cheng glared at them fiercely, can’t you read the room a bit?
Do you know how to gauge the atmosphere?
"Congratulations, Sect Leader Jiang, for becoming the owner of the Bone Refining Banner!"
Qingsuo first led the members of the Heart Division over.
"From now on, the Witch Division can pass down its legacy again."
"With Sect Leader Jiang here, the Witch Division will eventually grow stronger than even our Heart Division."
They sincerely congratulated, but Jiang Cheng felt something was off.
"What are you all talking about?"
"When did I become part of the Witch Division?"
Lan Ti explained to him with a smile, "In our Witch Division, the person who controls the Bone Refining Banner is the Clan Leader."
"So from now on, you are the new Clan Leader of our clan."
"Lan Ti pays respect to the Clan Leader!"
She bowed gracefully, nearly making Brother Cheng dizzy from the respect.
What?
I somehow became the Clan Leader of the Witch Division?
No, no, I can’t agree to this.
A small Feixian Sect already had me as a hands-off leader, leaving all mundane affairs to Ji Linghan, Luo Yuan, and others.
It shows how much I dislike trouble.
As one of the nine Divisions of the Immortal Remnant Race, who knows what mission or goal the Witch Division holds after so many years of legacy?
Like leading the tribe to prosperity or something.
"In that case, I’ll return the Bone Refining Banner to you."
He was generous, but this time, Lan Ti, who obviously cared about the Bone Refining Banner, avoided it and didn’t take it.
"You were chosen as its rightful owner; I dare not go against fate."
Qingsuo and others echoed.
"Yes, Sect Leader Jiang, you can’t go against fate."
"Heaven has destined you to be the Clan Leader of the Witch Division."
Jiang Cheng waved his hands repeatedly, "What fate? This is just an accident!"
"It’s not an accident."
Lan Ti was in a good mood now.
"Over millions of years, it’s not like our clan didn’t have stray descendants outside. You might be a descendant of one of them. Why else would you have a divine-grade witch seed?"
"Moreover, you and I meeting by chance in this vast world must be the guidance of heaven."
Jiang Cheng was almost driven crazy by her. Girl, do you have to be so superstitious?
Even though we’re cultivators, we should still believe in science.
My divine-grade witch seed was won in a lottery, it has nothing to do with the Witch Division.
Seeing his concern, Lan Ti added, "Clan Leader, actually, you don’t have to worry. Right now, it’s just the two of us in the Witch Division, so there won’t be any mundane affairs affecting your cultivation."
This made Brother Cheng accept a little.
Thinking about it, a two-person clan can’t have much going on.
But girl, you changed your address too quickly, didn’t you?
"I’ll think about it..."
"Don’t think about it anymore, I’m still waiting for you, Clan Leader, to teach me the witchcraft in the Celestial Spirit Witch Manual."
Jiang Cheng almost spat out blood.
He never even guided the disciples of the Feixian Sect, and now they want him to teach witchcraft?
"You’d better take the Bone Refining Banner and comprehend it slowly."
After speaking, he stuffed the Bone Refining Banner into her hands, whether she wanted it or not.
For the next two days, Lan Ti frequently visited Jiang Cheng’s room.
On one hand, to consult him about some difficult parts of the Celestial Spirit Witch Manual from the Bone Refining Banner, since Jiang Cheng’s recognition allowed him to master this part fully.
On the other hand, to have him learn the Earth Spirit Witch Manual with her.
The Earth Spirit Witch Manual existed in text form, which Lan Ti had been studying.
It also contained many profound witchcrafts, greatly coveted by the Silence Sacred Land back in the day.
But unfortunately, was Brother Cheng someone who cultivates?
To this day, every martial arts secret technique and method he knew was never learned from a book.
They were either directly replicated or extracted and activated by the system, reaching full level.
Painfully cultivating and comprehending would be the death of him.
"I think we should forget it; I feel my current martial techniques are sufficient."
"No way!"
Lan Ti’s pretty face turned stern, "You are the Clan Leader, how can you not learn the Earth Spirit Witch Manual?"
I never wanted to be the Clan Leader, yet you’re forcing this upon me?
Brother Cheng reluctantly agreed, temporarily yielding.
"Ah, I just remembered, there are important matters in the sect that need addressing!"
He suddenly clapped his forehead and hurried towards the door.
"What important matters could you have?"
Lan Ti blocked the door; she’d been with him long enough to never see him involved in sect affairs even once.
"Focusing on the cultivation of the Earth Spirit Witch Manual is the priority."
Are you the Clan Leader, or am I?
Why do I feel like I have no freedom as this Clan Leader?
Sect Leader Jiang’s mind raced, and he thought of a justifiable excuse.
"I need to recruit new members!"
"Yes, that’s right, our Feixian Sect has become the first sect in the Thousand Spirit Domain, having so few people lacks impact. We must recruit newcomers!"
Lan Ti rolled her eyes, knowing this was a last-minute reason.
But she couldn’t help but let him pass as it’s the Feixian Sect.
Only then did Jiang Cheng feel relieved, quickly rushing to the main hall on the main peak, summoning all the disciples.
"Sect Leader, you finally showed up."
"We thought you were imprisoned for the past two days, not coming out to play."
Ji Linghan also asked with concern, "Lan Ti didn’t do anything to you, did she?"
Yin Xuer was more straightforward, getting right to the point, "Right, Sect Leader, you didn’t lose your chastity, did you?"
Brother Cheng thought, I wish I did.
How beautiful Lan Ti is; in terms of looks, she probably outshines most fairies in the Immortal Realm.
As a normal man, claiming he wasn’t tempted would be a lie.
But this girl had witchcraft on her mind all the time lately, without any such intentions.
"Alright, alright, let’s not talk about irrelevant things. This time, the reason I called you here is for recruitment."

chapters.title: Chapter 174: Unprecedented Recruitment Scale
chapters.content:
Chapter 174: Chapter 174: Unprecedented Recruitment Scale
"Recruit?"
The disciples looked at each other, wondering if this was too soon.
It hadn’t even been a year since the last recruitment.
"What, you guys don’t want to?"
Luo Yuan immediately laughed and said, "Of course not!"
"We really want to!"
"We couldn’t wish for it more."
Feixian Sect had too few people, it was quite desolate.
Although the recent arrival of the Heart Division brought some people, they were ultimately not part of the same sect.
Not to mention, they were usually far apart, rarely meeting each other.
"Sect Leader?"
Wei Miao asked, "The newcomers this time are the fourth generation disciples, right?"
Jiang Cheng nodded.
Immediately, the young man got excited, "Haha, I didn’t expect I’d become someone else’s master so soon after joining!"
Other third-generation disciples also began to laugh.
"That’s right, that’s right, suddenly I’m looking forward to it."
"Let me tell you, the most talented disciple this time must belong to my Shu Yanglin!"
"Get out of here, the best should belong to Senior Sister Lin Ning!"
"Finally, there’s going to be a disciple to keep company."
Seeing the disciples so enthusiastic, Sect Leader Jiang sighed internally that he should have recruited people earlier.
The more people, the more points.
Shan Tai also stepped out with a smile and said, "Sect Leader, what level are we looking for this time?"
Qin Chang proudly said, "Now that we’re the strongest sect in the Thousand Spirit Domain, we naturally need higher requirements for talent."
"That’s right, at least the Saint Heir or Saintess level from the major Sacred Lands!"
Jiang Cheng curled his lip, you all really have the nerve to say that.
If it weren’t for this Sect Leader raising your talent levels by two, only Lin Ning and Ji Linghan had passed the Saint Heir level of talent among you.
"This time for recruitment, there are no limits on talent."
The whole room fell silent, even the usually most understanding Ji Linghan felt puzzled.
"Without talent restrictions, what standard will we use to recruit people?"
Luo Yuan also said, "If there’s no limit on talent, then Feixian Sect will be overcrowded."
Jiang Cheng waved his hand, "Not only is there no limit on talent, but also no limit on background and cultivation. Whether it’s Body Tempering or Ascending to Saint, all can apply."
Ascending to Saint is just a saying, those at that level definitely already have a sect.
The reason he’s not limiting talent is not because talent is unimportant.
It’s because he can enhance talent, even if it’s a hopeless case, given a few days of head patting, they would eventually transform into third-class or even second-class talent.
The prerequisite is having points.
Upgrading to third-class doesn’t require many points.
With the current stash of over ten billion points Jiang Cheng has, it’s just a drop in the bucket.
The only sect in this world capable of ignoring talent conditions is none other than his Feixian Sect.
Mo Chen had previously explained to him when discussing the Immortal Realm situation that martial artists from the Lower Realm ascending usually accomplish something great.
It’s because these ascenders, besides talent, mostly excel in comprehension, temperament, willpower, strategy, finesse, and fortune.
And now, Jiang Cheng wants to select a group of such outstanding individuals.
Ascenders of the Saint Tier are the leaders of various domains, so he definitely can’t recruit them.
Therefore, he’ll recruit a batch with similar potential but limited by poor talent and weak strength.
He can help with the talent, but other attributes depend on the individual.
"So how many are we recruiting this time?"
"One thousand."
With the Xuanji Map having merged 22 more fragments, it can now accommodate 1,245 people, and the time flow rate has reached 8,100 times.
If nothing goes wrong, all disciples of Feixian Sect can enter the Void Immortal Realm with this map.
Once he can gather a batch of individuals with extraordinary comprehension, steadfast temperament, resilient will, and outstanding strategic skills, and then elevate their talents...
It would be far more efficient than recruiting in the Immortal Realm.
In recent days, the entire Thousand Spirit Domain has been abuzz with talk of Feixian Sect.
Everyone thought Feixian Sect was doomed under siege.
Little did they know that in the end, Saint Bi Feng was killed, the Demon King submitted, and the Seven Great Sacred Lands all became vassals!
This outcome left countless people in shock for days, unable to recover.
Feixian Sect is now undoubtedly the dominant force in the Thousand Spirit Domain, and Jiang Cheng’s name is mentioned continually.
Sect Leader Jiang, you’ve dominated the Thousand Spirit Domain, this is a tremendously joyous occasion.
Shouldn’t there be a grand celebration to commemorate it?
Everyone’s been waiting so long their necks are sore and hair turning white.
Just waiting for your command to rush to the feast!
They didn’t receive a notice for a celebration, but instead, got an even more sensational message.
Feixian Sect is recruiting new disciples.
No limitations on cultivation, background, or talent...
It’s said that even a Body Tempering Realm can apply.
But in the end, only a thousand will be selected.
Everyone hearing this news seriously doubted its authenticity.
Previously, when the Nine Great Sacred Lands recruited, the requirements for innate talent were extremely strict.
Feixian Sect is even more prestigious than those Sacred Lands, and it doesn’t consider cultivation and talent when recruiting?
How is that possible?
But this message was disseminated layer by layer.
Under Jiang Cheng’s orders, the major Sacred Lands and the sects and empires under them in the Thousand Spirit Domain spread this news throughout their territories.
This evaluation starts with an initial selection.
No need to go to Feixian Sect, as the Thousand Spirit Domain is too vast.
For Body Tempering Realm cultivators, they might never reach the end in their lifetime.
Jiang Cheng personally used system tools to quickly create a thousand sets of evaluation array discs.
Since the level of these array discs isn’t high, a thousand sets only cost a few tens of thousands of points in materials.
He entrusted the array discs to his disciples and Heart Division experts, having them take the discs to all corners of the Thousand Spirit Domain.
Each set of array discs is divided into five categories, testing comprehension, wisdom, temperament, willpower, and luck.
Though luck seems unreliable, in the cultivation realm, it often represents a person’s fortune.
Each great array allows a thousand people to enter at once.
A thousand assessment points, each of the top 100 scores at each location passes the initial selection.
In total, 100,000 people will be brought to Feixian Sect to participate in the final evaluation, selecting the last 1,000 disciples.
For those participating in the assessment, the local sects and empires must not obstruct and must fully cooperate.
Once the message was confirmed, the entire Thousand Spirit Domain, both cultivation and mortal realms, erupted.
Countless people spread the word, countless people prepared eagerly, and countless people gathered at the assessment points.
The grand occasion is unprecedented, truly a great migration of populations.
Jiang Cheng underestimated his fame and Feixian Sect’s current renown.
At each of the thousand assessment points, over a billion cultivators came to apply...
To maintain order, local sects and imperial powers had to dispatch personnel to keep peace.
This is only possible with cultivators; in an ordinary world, it might lead to massive famines and trampling disasters.
The grand recruitment event of Feixian Sect started like this.
Sect Leader Jiang, observing the images of the massive crowds transmitted back through the Transmission Spirit Artifacts while inside the Secret Realm, couldn’t help but wipe some virtual sweat, wondering if he might have overdone it.
Everyone’s call for another banquet he heard these past couple of days too.
He originally planned to respond to the call and hold a real one.
But seeing this now, he figured it best to forget about it, how could he possibly host such an event?

chapters.title: Chapter 175 Duan River
chapters.content:
Chapter 175: Chapter 175 Duan River
Donglan Dynasty, Pinghai State, Dingqu City, was crowded and bustling with people at this moment.
This place had become a recruiting assessment point for the Feixian Sect, and many cultivators nearby had rushed to come in the past two days.
Among them was the 15-year-old Duan River.
He couldn’t fly, so he could only lower his head and move forward little by little with the crowded crowd, looking very inconspicuous.
Only after squeezing to the registration office outside a large hall did the order gradually become orderly.
The Great Array could accommodate 1,000 people at a time, seeming very fast.
However, compared to this massive crowd, it was still too few.
Even after Jiang Cheng had hastily prepared tens of thousands of array discs, many people still had to wait several days for their turn.
Duan River’s assessment time was three days later, but unlike others, he didn’t leave first.
Instead, he looked at a group of high-spirited young people in front, talking and laughing, especially that figure dressed in white.
That was Bai Yuyang, once the top genius of Dingqu City, now an inner sect disciple of the Earth Element Sect.
He was also Duan River’s real target for today.
A few years ago, both were still studying at the Supreme Mysterious Martial Academy in Dingqu City.
In the entire Thousand Spirit Domain, martial academies named after Supreme Mysterious were as numerous as a thousand, if not eight hundred. These academies were generally for enlightenment purposes.
The students were still young, mostly only at the third to fifth layers of Body Tempering.
After three years of study, those with talent would each join a sect, while those without much talent would choose other livelihoods.
At the age of 12, Bai Yuyang had already reached the Condensing Vein Ninth Layer, and Duan River had also reached the Condensing Vein Eighth Layer, being recognized as the twin stars of the academy.
What was especially commendable was that the two did not become enemies because of this competitive relationship; instead, they called each other brothers, living and eating together closely.
They had both planned to go to the nearby Chixia Sect for the assessment and continue as senior and junior brothers in the same sect after graduation.
However, that plan was eventually disrupted by the Earth Element Sect.
One day, two Soul Splitting Realm immortal masters from the Earth Element Sect came to the vicinity on business and stayed at the Supreme Mysterious Martial Academy.
Learning of the names of these two young talents, the two Elders became interested and examined their roots and bones, being quite pleased.
They immediately offered a slot to join the Earth Element Sect directly without entry-level assessments.
The Earth Element Sect, guarded by Spirit Platform cultivators, was much more formidable than the Chixia Sect.
The two had never thought they could join such a sect, and naturally were ecstatic beyond measure.
But the two immortal masters then added a twist, stating that there was only one slot available.
The event ultimately descended into the cliched duel segment.
The two were to fight a match, with the winner directly becoming a sect member of the Earth Element Sect, while the loser had to find another opportunity.
"Since you’re interested in both, why not take both if it’s so difficult to choose?"
"Why insist on setting just one slot, forcing us into a fight?"
"I think they’re just looking for fun, treating us like monkeys!"
"It’s not worth joining such a place!"
While preparing, Duan River once piercingly expressed his thoughts to Bai Yuyang.
"Since the Earth Element Sect can value us, then other sects might also have opportunities."
But Bai Yuyang persuaded him.
"Even if they’re treating us like monkeys, we can only perform our best act for them."
"If we disappoint them and anger them, who knows what might happen next."
Thus, the duel eventually took place.
To the surprise of everyone, Duan River, who was a layer lower in realm, easily defeated Bai Yuyang under the watchful eyes of the crowd.
When the long sword stopped a foot away from Bai Yuyang’s neck, the whole audience was shocked.
"Grandmaster Swordsman!"
"At such a young age, he’s already become a Grandmaster Swordsman; that’s exceptional!"
The two Elders were quite surprised, and the teachers at the martial academy were even more incredulous.
Whether it was swordsmanship or Sword Dao, it was all about realms.
Before mastering sword control, wielding weapons in melee combat was the norm.
Mastery of the basics meant being a swordsman; to wield weapons at will indicated being a sword master, and to manifest one’s will as sword momentum signified being a grandmaster swordsman.
A realm higher allowed challenges beyond one’s level effortlessly, like eating or drinking.
Bai Yuyang, with his overflowing talent, had become a sword master a year ago, already on par with the academy teachers.
Duan River’s grandmaster swordsman realm, however, had not even been reached by many Energy-Introducing Realm cultivators.
His talent in Sword Dao was exceptionally outstanding, only his natural tendency was to not show his prowess.
But just when he retracted his sword and turned away, a long sword pierced into his Sea of Qi from behind his waist, breaking it to shreds.
"You really hid it well, bottling it up just to trample me today, huh?"
As Bai Yuyang thrust the sword, his hate-twisted expression was unbelievably unfamiliar.
The resulting resolution was both surprising yet very realistic.
Duan River’s Sea of Qi was destroyed, his Condensing Vein cultivation dissipated, leaving only a body with power equivalent to the peak of Body Tempering, ending any hope of cultivation this life.
He was of no value anymore.
While Bai Yuyang remained intact and talented, even after committing such a deed, he was still recruited into the Earth Element Sect.
The nightmare did not end.
After the immortal master left with Bai Yuyang, the Bai Family sent people to attack the small mountain village where Duan River was living to erase any trouble.
He escaped with his life, spending the next three years in vendetta killings.
Though his power was only akin to a peak Body Cultivator, his swordsmanship realm remained.
Recently, he even assassinated an Energy-Introducing Realm elder from the Bai Family.
Meanwhile, over three years, Bai Yuyang became an inner sect disciple of the Earth Element Sect, his cultivation advancing to the Gathering Yuan Realm.
Body Tempering compared to Gathering Essence, the gap was like clouds and mud, unworthy of comparison.
Nonetheless, if the Gathering Yuan Realm was struck fatally, they would die just the same, right?
The premise being that the defense could be breached.
Duan River, whose swordsmanship had already surpassed the grandmaster swordsman realm, was confident in breaking defenses.
As a local pride, Bai Yuyang was not particularly eye-catching in this gathering today.
After all, for this assessment, even Spirit Platform Celestial Mandate cultivators were not uncommon.
At that moment, he was conversing with several fellow brothers, all disciples of the Earth Element Sect.
Being a sect disciple, one couldn’t easily cast aside their allegiance to another sect.
But with the opportunity from the Feixian Sect at hand, what was loyalty worth?
When sharp pain suddenly came from behind his neck, the overly ambitious Bai Yuyang was still unsure about what had happened.
Before the incident, there wasn’t even the slightest fluctuation of spiritual power.
The moment it touched his skin, he felt as if he had been thrown into an ice cellar.
He personally saw the bloody tip of the dagger protruding through, and all the strength in his body drained away irreparably like a deflating balloon.
Bai Yuyang laboriously turned his head to look, as Duan River had already broken through the crowd, sprinting wildly towards that registration point.
"Someone’s been killed..."
"It’s him!"
"He actually dared to kill someone here?"
It was not only Bai Yuyang’s fellow brothers but even the Dingqu City’s first major sect, Broken Sea Hall, responsible for maintaining order, that was alarmed.
This was a major event assigned by the Feixian Sect, and no mishaps were allowed.
Several Celestial Fate Elders unleashed their Divine Mansion, directly targeting Duan River in the crowd.
This was the moment to act, yet they found themselves compelled to stop.
Duan River, his right hand stained with blood, held up a number tag high.
"I’ve already registered."
"Even though I’m just a 15-year-old who just got my revenge, I had already thought of my escape route."
A few Elders from the Broken Sea Hall seemed rather annoyed.
Bai Yuyang, though still an Inner Sect disciple of the Earth Element Sect and talented, had just been killed under their watch. This was a slap to their face.
One of the Elders said coldly, "You’d better be ready to face the consequences."

chapters.title: Chapter 176: Would You Like to Take Me as Your Master
chapters.content:
Chapter 176: Chapter 176: Would You Like to Take Me as Your Master
Duan River actually didn’t have much expectation about entering the Feixian Sect.
Even though they do not limit talent, the Sea of Qi being destroyed is excessively unfavorable.
However, this was his only chance to survive.
For three days, he stayed near the registration point.
Because this was the safest place, no matter how much the Bai Family Patriarch hated him, he didn’t dare to act here.
During these three days, he saw countless cultivators being eliminated and leaving.
Including many Celestial Fate and Spirit Platform cultivators who didn’t get selected.
The rigor of this trial exceeded expectations.
And today, it was finally his turn.
Before entering the Great Array, the Bai Family Patriarch’s hateful cold smile was still vivid in his mind.
The first test within the Great Array, Duan River didn’t see the other 999 people entering with him.
Nor did he see the imagined hellish trial of Sword Mountain and Fire Sea.
What appeared before him was a military tent.
A young soldier in light armor ran towards him.
"General Duan, the Right Wing Army is ambushed by the enemy and is in danger, General Shi sent someone to seek help!"
1. Immediately go to rescue.
2. General Shi has always been at odds with me, don’t rescue.
3. Go to rescue, but intentionally delay.
Facing the three options, Duan River was a bit stunned, what is this?
Am I supposed to lead troops to fight?
But I don’t know the military’s ways!
This is a disaster, surely can’t pass the trial.
He casually chose 1, immediately go to rescue.
After all, he was unaware of the background situation, didn’t know what the so-called discord was about, nor did he know what the response would be to delay time from the superiors.
Furthermore, he didn’t know if abandoning aid would result in his side being surrounded next.
The screen shifted, without showing the details of commanding a war, directly displayed success in breaking the siege.
Then that General Shi appeared, followed quickly by new options.
Just like this, he gradually adapted to the role of General Duan.
Afterward, sometimes he encountered enemy attacks, sometimes faced difficulties with superiors, sometimes confronted situations with subordinates, sometimes obstructed by eunuch military supervisors, sometimes faced accusations from imperial officials, and sometimes received foolish orders from the Emperor...
A series of choices made him rise and fall, sometimes in glory, sometimes in disgrace.
And in the final battle, he ultimately lost.
The screen interrupted.
Duan River felt a bit disappointed; this result likely meant failure and elimination, right?
But immediately, a phantom appeared within the Great Array.
With power similar to his current level, Peak of Nine Layers of Body Tempering.
The trial wasn’t finished yet.
The phantom attacked, and with a casual sword strike, he extinguished it.
Then, the enemy became two people.
He had to continue fighting.
Finally, when fighting the 95th phantom, he fell.
Then the array changed, presenting a series of inexplicable questions before him.
After answering these completely uncertain questions, he entered a new trial.
When Duan River was transmitted out of the Great Array, not much time had passed.
The other 999 people who had registered with him in the Great Array had already come out earlier; he was the last one.
A young and handsome man, escorted by two elders, walked out with a full smile.
Those 999 who had just emerged all looked over with admiration and surprise.
"Elder Luo Yuan!"
"Yes, that’s Elder Luo of the Feixian Sect!"
"Accompanying him are the Palace Master and Supreme Elder of Broken Sea Hall."
"Wow, he appeared; did someone among us pass the initial trial?"
"I heard those who pass will be brought into the hall, Elder Luo doesn’t personally come to greet!"
Everyone held endless expectations until Luo Yuan walked up to someone.
"Duan River, congratulations! You passed the initial trial, with top grades in all five assessments."
"The Sect Leader has said, anyone achieving top grades in all five assessments can circumvent the second round of trials and directly join our sect as a formal disciple."
"Are you willing to join our sect?"
The place erupted with excitement, even those two elders widened their eyes in disbelief.
"You got directly recruited?"
"It’s said this hasn’t happened at other trial points."
"Who exactly is this extraordinary person?"
"I remember him; he killed someone outside a few days ago."
"I’ve heard it too; they say his Sea of Qi was crippled, he can’t cultivate at all."
"Isn’t he a waste? How could he achieve top grades in all five areas?"
"The array must have made a mistake, right?"
Even Duan River himself questioned whether there was an error.
In each stage of the Great Array, he seemed to have failed; how was everything top grade?
How is it scored?
But his mind was extremely strong; no matter how impossible the circumstances seemed, he quickly settled himself.
"I am willing!"
Of course, he agreed.
As a former genius cultivator, he couldn’t refuse the top sect of the Thousand Spirit Domain.
"Good, hahaha!"
Luo Yuan laughed heartily, patting his shoulder, and with a mischievous look said, "A surprise, isn’t it? Your Sea of Qi is obviously abolished."
So he saw through it?
Duan River nodded honestly.
Let alone others, even he was extremely curious.
If it weren’t for the chance to assassinate Bai Yuyang, he wouldn’t have registered, it seemed impossible to succeed, right?
"If you agree to become my apprentice, I’ll tell you."
Luo Yuan actually didn’t know the true purpose of the trial, nor did he see what made Duan River outstanding.
But the Sect Leader’s actions have always been ’profound and inscrutable.’
Participating in his trial and becoming currently the only exceptional early recruit speaks volumes of rarity.
This is possibly the next Lin Ning!
Originally, Duan River was to become a Fourth Generation disciple, but who made him lucky enough to be encountered prematurely?
Well, sorry, buddy is going to cut in.
"Greetings, Master!"
Surrounded by immense joy, Duan River wasted no time, directly performing the disciple ceremony.
"Great disciple!"
Luo Yuan was jubilant.
Then grasping hands, he took him flying back to the rear hall.
Leaving behind a ground of envy and shock among the cultivators.
The news of Duan River being recruited out of turn quickly spread outside, and before long, not only Dingqu City but the entire Donglan Dynasty heard.
Luo Yuan didn’t deliberately act against the Bai Family.
But the Donglan Dynasty and Broken Sea Hall responded very swiftly.
Duan River already became a disciple of the Feixian Sect, so there was no need for the Bai Family and the two Earth Element Sect elders who recruited back then to exist.
A few days later, the trials surrounding Pinghai State concluded.
Duan River and another 99 cultivators who passed the initial trial stepped onto the Transmission Array together.
At this point, the initial trials everywhere had ended, and one hundred thousand cultivators gathered at the Feixian Sect.
Among them, only four achieved top grades in five areas, being pre-accepted as disciples.
The second round of trials was underway outside, competing for the remaining 996 spots.
Duan River and the other three were taken into the great hall on the main peak of the Secret Realm, where they met their beloved Sect Leader Jiang.
Even before the Sect Leader spoke, the surrounding disciples prematurely launched verbal attacks.
"Master Luo, this seems against the rules, right?"
"Exactly, it was agreed this batch would be our disciples; how could you recruit beforehand?"
"Doing this, aren’t they on par with us Third Generation disciples?"

chapters.title: Chapter 177: 4 Who Got the Protagonist Scripts
chapters.content:
Chapter 177: Chapter 177: 4 Who Got the Protagonist Scripts
In the eyes of these people, Duan River’s destroyed sea of qi wasn’t a big deal at all.
Being able to stand out among billions of cultivators in the Thousand Spirit Domain and passing the Sect Leader’s assessment, they clearly understood the significance.
This person is definitely a treasure worth snatching!
Luo Yuan sneered, "Wei Miao Shu Yanglin, are you all trying to rebel?"
"Anyway, I’ve already taken him, the matter is settled, do as you please."
"Besides, didn’t Junior Sister Yin also take one?"
"Luo Yuan, why are you dragging me into your mess?"
"Junior Sister Yin, now’s the time for us to present a united front, let’s not fight among ourselves."
Duan River watched all of this, a bit overwhelmed.
What is going on?
The Sect Leader is here, yet they dare to speak out of turn?
Third generation disciples speaking to second generation elders like this?
And they’re even attacking each other in front of the Sect Leader?
This would never happen even at the Supreme Mysterious Martial Academy.
Yet, the scene of the Sect Leader getting angry, as he imagined it, did not occur. Jiang Cheng above was busy reviewing the profiles of the four.
All five items were top-grade, which meant that in terms of mind, intention, and comprehension, these four were top-notch among billions.
That’s incredibly rare.
These four, one was a former genius whose sea of qi was ruined, one’s family had fallen, and was rejected from marriage, one was falsely accused by fellow sect members and expelled from the sect, and one had exceptionally poor talent but was a master of everything from blades and swords to music, chess, calligraphy, divination, astronomy, pill, artifact, and talisman array... truly a jack-of-all-trades master.
Wow, these are four individuals who’ve acquired the standard protagonist templates.
Even without me, as long as they encountered other opportunities, they are likely to soar to great heights.
Luckily, they’ve all been recruited into the Feixian Sect and become one of our own.
"Alright, alright, since Duan River and Miao Ye were taken as disciples by Luo Yuan and Yin Xuer early on, consider it fate."
"Thank you, Sect Leader!"
Luo Yuan and Yin Xuer exchanged glances, both seeing each other’s smugness.
This time it was luck, they took advantage of a loophole.
"Xu Zichuan and Yi Chen, since neither of you has taken a master, you’ll also be considered as third generation disciples from now on."
"As for your master, you may acknowledge Elder Mo Chen as your master."
Though Mo Chen was old, he held the status of a second generation elder in Feixian Sect.
"Elder Mo, is that alright?"
Mo Chen, standing aside, grinned from ear to ear, within the hall, besides Brother Cheng, he was the only one who understood the value of these four.
If brought to the Upper Immortal Realm, after a billion years, they might become future Immortal Kings or Immortal Emperors!
"I couldn’t be more eager!"
The two third generation disciples who brought back Xu Zichuan and Yi Chen were green with envy.
Damn it, if I’d known, I’d have followed Uncle Luo’s lead and taken disciples early on.
As soon as he finished speaking, the four of them knelt down together to thank the Sect Leader.
Ding ding ding ding, the system notification sounded; these four had been authenticated by the system, becoming true insiders.
Though their power and talent weren’t high, and points were few, for now, there was no need to worry about loyalty.
Jiang Cheng was delighted and personally stepped forward to help them up.
This gesture moved the four of them to tears.
His status now was, without exaggeration, practically divine in the Thousand Spirit Domain.
Even though Duan River had never entered a sect, he had heard those sect rules.
Generally, when disciples join a sect, they might catch a glimpse of the Sect Leader from afar on the first day, and unless there’s a grand ceremony, the Sect Leader is as elusive as a dragon.
Even true disciples, though favored by the Sect Leader, rarely have direct contact.
Duan River understood that sometimes the disparity in status, power, and rank required some artificial forms of distinction.
Creating deliberate distance makes it easier to nurture admiration.
And now, Jiang Cheng, a figure who lived in legend, was acting so warmly.
It made him feel surprisingly honored and flattered.
"You must be Duan River; with your sea of qi destroyed, you haven’t been able to cultivate recently. What on earth shall we do?"
The Sect Leader’s tone was mild and relaxed, like a senior gently teasing.
Duan River, who had already been through so much, felt a warmth in his heart, yet also a tinge of self-remorse.
"Yes, I..."
His words had just begun when he felt a pat on his head.
Then, his sea of qi was restored.
Not only that, but he even realized he was absorbing and converting spiritual qi faster than before!
Faced with his eyes filled with shock, joy, gratitude, and confusion, Brother Cheng smugly curled his lips.
"It’s nothing; I’ve used an immortal technique to restore your sea of qi and, incidentally, elevated your talent by a grade."
Duan River originally had fifth-class talent; now it was raised to fourth-class.
Not just Duan River, but even the three newcomers beside him began to doubt reality.
What?
Immortal technique?
Restoring the sea of qi is that easy?
And it can even enhance talent?
At this moment, they finally understood why Feixian Sect recruited without considering talent.
Thinking of the possibility of their talents being improved in the future, they trembled with excitement.
Duan River suddenly knelt with a thud.
Tears streamed down his face; he had endured so much these past three years, and now the hardships and nightmares had finally ended.
"Sect Leader..."
He wanted to say something, but he was already crying uncontrollably.
Inside the hall, no one laughed anymore.
Luo Yuan stepped forward to help him up.
"Disciple, consider this place your home from now on; the people here are unlike those outside."
"Yes!"
Duan River nodded vigorously with tears in his eyes, his heart completely devoted to the Feixian Sect, never to waver again.
Brother Cheng then looked towards the remaining three newcomers.
"This immortal technique consumes a lot; it can only be used once a day, so you three will have to wait for the following days."
The three initially only saw the possibility, but now hearing the Sect Leader say it himself, they couldn’t feel disappointment even if they tried; they were too busy being overjoyed.
"Thank you, Sect Leader!"
"Truly embarrassed..."
"It’s all my bad talent that causes the Sect Leader worry..."
Sect Leader Jiang smiled faintly; as expected from those who aced all five assessment categories, even their emotional intelligence was entirely present, and their words were remarkably pleasing.
"Since the four of you have joined, this Sect Leader will give you a little welcoming gift."
Once the words ’welcoming gift’ were uttered, both second and third-generation disciples couldn’t help but express envy.
The Sect Leader’s offerings are always treasures!
Receiving the ring, Duan River was still at a loss; his cultivation hadn’t yet recovered to the Condensing Vein Realm.
And a storage ring couldn’t be opened below the Energy-Introducing Realm.
The people beside him were anxious to know; Luo Yuan chuckled and said, "Disciple, why not let your Master take a look at what surprises the Sect Leader has prepared for you."
Duan River naturally wouldn’t refuse.
Immediately, he saw his master’s expression change dramatically upon receiving the ring.
"Sect Leader, aren’t you being too generous? His current cultivation is only so much!"
"Yet he receives a treasure, two tier-nine spiritual artifacts, a million top-grade spirit stones, and a hundred bottles of ninth-grade spirit pills..."
"My heavens, there’s also a treasure talisman..."
With the unveiling of the gift, the whole place erupted.
"Sect Leader, aren’t you playing favorites a bit too much?"
"This newcomer treatment directly surpasses ours!"
"Seeing this makes me green with envy and heartbroken..."
Last time, the supplies they received weren’t even at this level.
And Duan River himself almost fainted.
He was eager for the welcoming gift, but similar to Wei Miao and others before, he thought that at most, an entry-level tier-three or tier-four spiritual artifact would be delightful.

chapters.title: Chapter 178: New Alchemy Techniques
chapters.content:
Chapter 178: Chapter 178: New Alchemy Techniques
Back in the Supreme Mysterious Martial Academy, he was only using a Tier One Spirit Sword.
What is the concept of a Tier Nine Spiritual Artifact? He couldn’t even imagine, let alone the legendary Treasure Artifact.
The emperor of the Donglan Dynasty seemed to be using just a Tier Nine Spiritual Artifact.
And here he was, on his first day entering, having something better than him?
A million Top-grade Spirit Stones?
He used to only use Lower Grade Spirit Stones, and he had to be thrifty with them.
As for Spirit Pills, in three years at the Supreme Mysterious Martial Academy, he only received three First Grade ones, which he cherished like treasures.
And now, he was directly given 100 bottles of Ninth-grade ones.
If it weren’t for the strong-willed mind of these four, other newcomers might have gone into shock on the spot.
But even they weren’t doing much better.
After realizing the value of the items in the ring, they couldn’t manage their facial expressions anymore.
"Thank you, Sect Leader!"
"Such grace from the Sect Leader, it’s unforgettable in this life..."
"In the next life, even if I were to offer my life in gratitude, I would repay the Sect Leader..."
Jiang Cheng waved his hand, and it was just these four.
The batch of people outside, of course, would not get such a generous greeting gift.
These four were too special, most likely each holding a protagonist’s script.
Isn’t it only natural to give special treatment to the protagonists?
Especially since they’ll eventually be training in the Xuanji Map, at which point resources will be used up quickly.
"Their meridians currently can’t withstand Ninth-grade Spirit Pills, you three masters should keep an eye on them in the future."
Mo Chen, Luo Yuan, and Yin Xuer quickly agreed.
For the next three days, Jiang Cheng enhanced the talent of Miao Ye, Xu Zichuan, and Yi Chen each once.
Meanwhile, the second round of the outside assessment concluded as well.
selected cultivators were brought into the Secret Realm.
During their meeting with the Sect Leader, 45 people didn’t trigger the system’s notification sound and were ruthlessly expelled by Sect Leader Jiang.
Not yet being one of us at entry level doesn’t mean they won’t be loyal in the future.
But Brother Cheng didn’t have that patience.
Including the four from Duan River, this recruitment eventually brought in 955 new disciples.
After all of them took on a master, Sect Leader Jiang entered a busy phase.
Enhancing the talent of one disciple each day.
These disciples were very inexpensive; some had a talent of only seventh or eighth-class.
The first enhancement astonishingly only required 1 point.
Aside from enhancing talent, Jiang Cheng also had another task—Alchemy.
Under the influence of the Tier Eight Spirit Vein, Feixian Sect was rich with Spirit Herbs, Spirit Roots, and Spirit Medicines everywhere.
All these served as materials for Alchemy.
Plus, with various Heavenly and Earthly Treasures from the Nine Great Sacred Lands and those won through drawing lots, he indeed needed to conduct Alchemy now.
After all, many Spirit Herbs and Medicines cannot be directly consumed.
Even the Sect Leader would practice Alchemy?
The second and third generation disciples of Feixian Sect stated it was the first time they’d heard of this.
"When in Feixian Mountain, I remember the Sect Leader saying that doing Alchemy isn’t as fast as raiding others."
"No way, did the Sect Leader really say something like that?"
"Master Qin, aren’t you slandering the Sect Leader? I’m the most loyal disciple of the Sect Leader, and I’m going to report this."
"Gee, you’re ruthless! Did any of you see the Sect Leader doing Alchemy?"
"Never seen it, never even heard of it."
"Then why did he suddenly announce he’d be doing long-term Alchemy?"
"Yeah, given the Sect Leader’s nature, such a boring task as Alchemy, he surely wouldn’t put up with it."
"Could there be another reason?"
"I heard the Sect Leader resists practicing Witchcraft, could he be using this as an excuse to avoid Miss Lan Ti?"
"Oh, Miss Lan Ti, she is sure to become the Sect Leader’s wife, a whole generation above us."
"Ah, Senior Sister Liu, when did you get here?"
"Senior Sister, why are you hitting me?"
Whether the disciples believed it or not, Jiang Cheng indeed moved into Celestial Pill Peak, which had previously been the Alchemy site of Silence Sacred Land.
At the same time, he issued an order for everyone to quickly gather the Spirit Herbs and Elixirs from the various peaks and send them to Celestial Pill Peak.
This only made everyone more suspicious.
Due to the high-level Spirit Vein, there were Spirit Herbs and Elixirs everywhere in the Secret Realm, only differing in quality and tier.
The high-quality ones would naturally be rarer.
But this time, Jiang Cheng didn’t mention anything about the quality, asking for everything, regardless of the type.
That spanned over a hundred thousand miles of mountains, who knows how much there is.
Even if he could do Alchemy, how could one person possibly use up so many Spirit Herbs and Elixirs?
Let alone one person, even if a thousand Pill Masters gathered, they wouldn’t be able to keep up.
The main hall of Celestial Pill Peak was sealed off, and outsiders couldn’t enter.
He only knew that the Pill Fire there was burning every day.
And to everyone’s great surprise, the massive amount of Spirit Herbs and Elixirs sent on the first day were indeed all consumed.
On the second day, countless bottles of various tiers of Spirit Pills appeared in the finished pill Pool at the entrance.
From Third Grade to Ninth Grade, there was everything.
These pills, Brother Cheng specifically arranged for disciples to retrieve and distribute them down.
This left everyone stunned.
This was real, not just talk.
And it wasn’t merely the ability to do Alchemy that was notable.
Even Mo Chen couldn’t figure out how one person could achieve such a high output.
Such a feat, even for the top Alchemists in the Immortal Realm, although they could refine Immortal Pills, could not match such prolific production.
But the Sect Leader ordered that the Alchemy Hall should not be spied upon by anyone.
So everyone could only remain intensely curious.
Each day thereafter, every batch of Spirit Herbs and Elixirs sent would continue to be consumed in the same fashion, and a multitude of finished pills would continue to appear outside as normal.
"The Sect Leader has turned over a new leaf!"
"Unimaginable, to refine so many pills daily, how busy the Sect Leader must be."
"I admit, I feel a little sorry for him."
"Now, I’m worried the Sect Leader might become too engrossed and damage his own spirit."
"Indeed..."
Lying on a soft bed set up in the Alchemy Hall, Brother Cheng, hearing the song of a puppet doll nearby, was quite relaxed.
He hadn’t expected everyone to start worrying about his health at all.
For him, Alchemy didn’t even require a Pill Furnace.
The system’s alchemy skill only needed him to open the interface, select all the hundreds of pills he intended to refine.
Then to include all those Spirit Herbs and Roots from outside as material.
The final step was to click start Alchemy.
Oh, don’t forget to turn on automatic.
Once these steps were completed, he could lie down and take a nap.
The progress bar on the Alchemy interface ran multiple times per second, like it was going crazy with speed.
The success rate was a staggering one hundred percent.
Each bottle of pills would be automatically categorized and neatly organized in the System Warehouse.
All he needed to do was, on the next morning when he woke up, extract some Spirit Pills and place them outside.
As for Treasure Pills and Holy Pills, they were naturally stored in the System Warehouse first.
Oh, and he also had to enhance the talent of one disciple each morning.
That was his so-called busy daily routine.
"Lying down while doing Alchemy, I suppose this could be considered a new posture in the Alchemy Realm!"
"Anyone who can pioneer a new path can be called a great master."
"We’re too modest, not seeking that empty fame, sigh..."
He, sitting with legs crossed, glanced at the corner where the Pill Furnace used to deceive people sat lonely, suddenly feeling a bit sorry for it.
After several months of such Alchemy days, the Spirit Herbs and Elixirs within the Secret Realm had almost been exhausted.
Jiang Cheng himself hadn’t kept track of how many pills he had refined.
Each bottle containing 10 pills, but there should be a billion bottles by now, though the majority were Spirit Pills.
Around two million bottles of Treasure Pills.
And the Holy Pills were the least, only having refined 3000 bottles in total.
On this day, Lan Ti and Qingsuo came together to see him.
"Tomorrow is the scheduled day for the nine divisions of the Immortal Remnant Race to open the Void Immortal Realm!"

chapters.title: Chapter 179: Visitors from the Outer Domain
chapters.content:
Chapter 179: Chapter 179: Visitors from the Outer Domain
"How do we open it?"
This was a question that Jiang Cheng had always wanted to ask.
The divisions of the Immortal Remnant Race are very far apart, for example, the Painting Division is separated from the Thousand Spirit Domain by over a thousand domains.
Just traveling to gather together is very difficult.
Moreover, after crossing domains, the stronger the power, the more harshly one is suppressed by the rules. Generally, those who have ascended to Saint or are in Saint Tier will not risk crossing so many domains.
"There is a mutual sense among the nine Inheritance Treasures."
Lan Ti explained, "Over five treasures can decide to open the Void Immortal Realm, and all treasures will be activated."
"At that time, as long as no one opposes, it can be opened, even if separated by ten thousand realms."
Jiang Cheng curiously asked, "What if, at that time, one division changes their mind and doesn’t agree?"
"Then it can’t be opened."
Qingsuo interrupted, "But such a thing should not happen."
"After all, the nine divisions actually all want to go to the Immortal Realm, it’s just that there have been internal conflicts and grudges between the divisions, resulting in several divisions merely coexisting and ignoring each other. Thus, they haven’t been able to unify their opinions."
Jiang Cheng joked, "Looking at it this way, we really have Bi Feng to thank for threading the needle and connecting us."
Qingsuo couldn’t help but be silent.
Bi Feng is an enemy, but thinking carefully, without his running around, this grand event really wouldn’t have been achieved.
Simply put, even for the other seven divisions, she only knows the whereabouts of five, the location of the other two is completely unknown to her.
Only Bi Feng, with such extensive divine techniques, was able to find them out and persuade them.
Jiang Cheng soon gathered all the disciples together.
"I called you here today for the matter of the Void Immortal Realm opening."
"We are going to travel there as a sect."
During this time, the disciples had all heard about the Void Immortal Realm.
Second and Third Generation Disciples were all thrilled; that was the Immortal Realm!
What was their ultimate goal in cultivation, if not to become immortal?
"I’m only at Daoist Palace Second Layer; can I still become immortal?"
"Elder Mo said there are native inhabitants with Celestial Fate Daoist Palace in the Immortal Realm, there’s nothing to worry about."
"That’s right, with our talent, we can thrive in the Immortal Realm too."
"Haha, I’m not worried at all, with Sect Leader protecting us, what’s there to fear?"
"Exactly!"
Compared to them, Fourth Generation Disciples weren’t as optimistic.
"Sect Leader, I’ve heard that without the protection of a magical treasure, survival is impossible in the Void Immortal Realm."
"Right, we have more than a thousand disciples; we can’t all enter."
The Bone Refining Banner can only protect five hundred people, and that’s under the assumption everyone squeezes together.
Upon hearing this concern, Second and Third Generation Disciples laughed.
"You’re overthinking it."
"Since Sect Leader said we’d travel as a whole sect, surely everyone will be brought along."
"Don’t forget Sect Leader’s Xuanji Dojo!"
Jiang Cheng did not delay.
After distributing varying quantities of Treasure Pill and Spirit Stone to all disciples, he then ushered them all into the Xuanji Map.
Besides these disciples, the 34 Great Demon level mounts also entered, occupying part of the capacity.
This could truly be considered as chickens and dogs ascending to heaven; these Great Demons originally had no such opportunity.
The current Xuanji Map has a time flow of 8100 times faster, one day outside equates to 8100 days inside.
And the environment inside has improved significantly, not only with sources of water and air but also some moss-like plants.
At least it looks much more comfortable.
In addition, Jiang Cheng’s control over this treasure has also improved.
He can now sense the situation inside at any time.
Seeing over a thousand disciples disappear at once didn’t surprise Lan Ti, having seen it last time.
Yet Qingsuo was so astonished her jaw nearly dropped.
"Sect Leader Jiang, where did you send them?"
"Oh, that’s my Daoist Field, able to accommodate a number of people. Just a small trick, nothing worth mentioning."
Is this just a small trick?
Such a trick, Qingsuo had never heard of.
In her memory, it seemed even the nine Immortal Ancestors back then couldn’t do such a thing.
Just how extraordinary is this person?
"Um, Sect Leader Jiang, could your Daoist Field take all of our Heart Division inside too?"
The Heart Division’s Heart-Piercing Awl could only protect five hundred people, recently, after intense competition the quota was determined.
But who wouldn’t want to bring more clansmen up?
To this, Brother Cheng could only express helplessness.
The Xuanji Map is vast to the point of being nearly boundless, but currently can only accommodate 1245 people. Beyond this number, the Treasure Map would experience abnormal breakdowns.
Though there were about a hundred spots left, who could guarantee no accidents upon entering the Void Immortal Realm?
After settling them, all that’s left were Mo Chen, Three-Eyed Tiger, Profound Turtle King, Lan Ti, and Ah Huang.
The first three are all Saint Tier, protected by the Bone Refining Banner, they should be able to manage in the Void Immortal Realm.
Lan Ti recently cultivated with the Bone Refining Banner and has ascended to the Ascending to Saint Realm, plus the Witch Manual is complete, her power is considerable.
No need to worry.
Ah Huang posed a bit of trouble.
Upon hearing of another move, this girl was quite unwilling.
Brother Cheng had no choice but to promise her a place with Spirit Veins ten times more advanced than here, ultimately persuading this little ancestor.
This afternoon, visitors arrived outside the Feixian Sect.
Jiang Cheng exited the Secret Realm to see that outside, over three hundred impressive cultivators were flying in the air.
Among these three hundred, over a hundred wore uniform blue Daoist robes.
The remaining people had varied outfits, but all shared one common feature.
Each had a sword strapped to their back.
Jiang Cheng used the system to observe slightly and nearly jumped.
Among these three hundred people were 34 Saint Tier experts!
The rest were all Ascending to Saint.
Damn, where did these people pop up from?
A few of them could easily conquer the previous Thousand Spirit Domain.
"Who are you?"
The leading elder with three locks of white beard, crane hair, and youthful complexion, smiled and slowly flew out.
"Are you the Sect Leader of the Feixian Sect, Jiang Cheng?"
"That’s right."
"We are from the Sword Domain, I am Gui Cang Sword Saint."
He then pointed to the left towards a man dressed in white, seemingly very young but actually has lived for millions of years.
"This is Ling Xing Sword Saint!"
"And this is Sorrow Sword Saint!"
The middle-aged man on the right with drooping eyebrows and a haggard face slightly nodded to Jiang Cheng.
Sword Domain?
Jiang Cheng had never heard of it, though Profound Turtle King had.
"Master, Sword Domain ranks among the top three in the Lower Realm Ten Thousand Realms, it’s no small matter!"
This is only one domain?
One domain housing 34 Saint Tiers, that’s too impressive!
Three-Eyed Tiger also secretly transmitted, "You better be careful, even if they are suppressed by cross-domain rules, they’re not to be trifled with."
"Why have you come here?"
Brother Cheng, of course, wasn’t afraid, he’s got the Resurrection Skill.
However, the other side wasn’t shouting to fight or kill, nor did they attack, seeming not to come with malicious intent.
In fact, the opposite group was also secretly amazed.
Though the Thousand Spirit Domain is weak, this Sect Leader Jiang is clearly only at the Ascending to Saint Eighth Layer, yet owns a Demon King-level mount and can subdue another Demon King.
None of them had managed that in their Sword Domain.
And Mo Chen’s aura beside him gave them a profound sense of threat from the depths of their Divine Soul.
That threat was akin to low-level creatures encountering high-level ones.

chapters.title: Chapter 180: Opening the Void Immortal Realm
chapters.content:
Gui Cang Sword Saint stroked his beard with a smile, "Sect Leader Jiang, please don't mind, we have come for the opening of the Void Immortal Realm."
"Recently, Saint Bi Feng's Dharma Body visited the Sword Domain and promised us. On the day of opening, we would gather in the Thousand Spirit Domain and enter together."
"It was only upon arriving here that we heard he had been killed by Sect Leader Jiang."
"So, I suppose the Bone Refining Banner is now in Sect Leader Jiang's hands?"
Jiang Cheng nodded, "That's right, it's with me."
Bi Feng was even going around inviting people to enter the Void Immortal Realm?
Goodness, this guy was really busy back then.
"I have an unreasonable request, could Sect Leader Jiang allow us to follow along once the Void Immortal Realm is opened?"
Gui Cang Sword Saint spoke very politely.
Jiang Cheng wondered if they would draw their swords if he refused.
But no matter what, given the overwhelming advantage in power, the willingness to negotiate was already rare.
In Brother Cheng's words, this is called understanding the Dao and showing respect.
Letting them go in together costs him nothing extra and has no impact, so there's no reason to refuse.
"Of course, but we'll have to wait until tomorrow."
"The nine Magical Treasures must gather to open it, as you all know."
He spread his hands and intended to return to the Secret Realm first.
However, Ling Xing Sword Saint suddenly spoke up, "Nine Magical Treasures? Which nine? Isn't it just one?"
"Huh?"
Brother Cheng sensed something amiss, "Who told you it's only one, Bi Feng?"
"Indeed!"
"Then you've been deceived, opening the Void Immortal Realm requires the combined power of nine Inheritance Treasures. The Bone Refining Banner is just one of them."
Ling Xing Sword Saint raised his sword-like eyebrows in surprise and asked, "Then are there also nine entrances?"
"Exactly."
Lan Ti stepped forward and gave a brief introduction of the nine treasures of the Immortal Remnant Race and the Void Immortal Realm.
The people of the Sword Domain looked at each other, their expressions quite vibrant.
"Bi Feng is despicable."
"We've been deceived!"
"If he were still alive, I would surely hunt him down."
Jiang Cheng curiously asked, "What did he deceive you about? Did he say there was only one entrance?"
Ling Xing Sword Saint replied in a deep voice, "Indeed. He also demanded an Everlasting Sword Heart from us as the entry condition to the Void Immortal Realm!"
Oh dear, this guy is really a talent.
Jiang Cheng was also bewildered by Bi Feng's astonishing operations.
No wonder he was always running around, he was doing business so skillfully.
But what about the Everlasting Sword Heart?
Where did it go?
Last time, after killing him, apart from the Bone Refining Banner and some regular resources, there were no special treasures in the ring.
Brother Cheng felt he had lost out, had he known, he would have set up this business in advance.
The people of Sword Domain temporarily stayed outside the Secret Realm.
Throughout the night, more experts from the Outer Domain arrived.
Three Bone Kings from the Ten Thousand Bones Domain, two Artifact Saints from the Hundred Refinement Domain, five Ghost Kings from the Cold Nether Domain, three Spirit Venerables from the Profound Spirit Domain, two Dream Gods from the Great Dream Domain, 14 Book Saints from the Celestial Book Domain...
