Although their cultivation systems were different, granting various titles, they all possessed Saint Tier combat power.
These people also brought more or fewer juniors of the Ascending to Saint Realm or Daoist Palace Realm.Find the newest release on noᴠelfire.net
Numbers ranging from a few to over a hundred.
Brother Cheng broadened his horizons, realizing that so many dominator beings from the domains were not human.
Those two Artifact Saints were in the form of Saint Tier weapons, and all five Ghost Kings were shrouded in smoke.
The three Spirit Venerables from the Profound Spirit Domain had humanoid lower halves, but their heads were a dragon, a wolf, and a bull respectively.
According to Mo Chen's explanation, this is because they practice Beast Soul Power from a young age.
The Dream Gods of the Great Dream Domain simply slept their way here, speaking without opening their eyes.
And the 14 Book Saints from the Celestial Book Domain all carried boxes, holding either jade and bamboo slips or paper scrolls...
This style is truly peculiar.
Luckily, Brother Cheng first descended upon the Thousand Spirit Domain, otherwise, it truly would be hard to adapt.
Perhaps due to the cross-domain arrival, they were suppressed by rules.
Or maybe because there was a more powerful Sword Domain present, they all behaved quite orderly after arriving.
Of course, after learning of Bi Feng's deception, they all wished to tear him apart.
These who gathered early in the Thousand Spirit Domain were all previously visited by Bi Feng.
By the second day, even Jiang Cheng couldn't help but complain again.
"Blimey, there are a total of 16 domains represented here. Bi Feng's business really reached far, didn't it?"
"So odd, the Celestial Demon Domain and Thousand Spirit Domain are neighbors, yet not one from there has come."
The Three-Eyed Tiger had never been so well-behaved.
With so many Saint Tier entities, most being at late-stage and peak Saint Tier, it felt quite insecure.
Though the 12 Demon Kings of the Celestial Demon Domain were not usually harmonious, facing other domains now, it dearly wished to see a few of its kind.
Somehow, that would make it feel more secure.
Mo Chen teasingly remarked, "Perhaps Bi Feng didn't notify them, don't think about leaning on them."
"You old geezer, stop being a jinx, Brother Golden Dragon must be on the way."
But this time, it was destined to be disappointed.
Bi Feng really considered going to the Celestial Demon Domain for business, but the local 'customs' were too fierce.
Unable to communicate upon entering, before he could explain his purpose, he was chased out by the War Monkey King.
If not for his quick escape, even that Dharma Body would not have been preserved.
The time quickly came as agreed, and Jiang Cheng, along with Qingsuo and other Heart Race People, arrived outside the Secret Realm.
And outside, the super experts from 16 domains had all been waiting for quite some time.
Upon seeing them emerge, Ghost Kings from the Cold Nether Domain and Spirit Venerables from the Profound Spirit Domain surrounded them.
"You've finally come out…"
Their words were interrupted by Gui Cang Sword Saint from behind.
"Sect Leader Jiang, we leave it to you!"
That Old Sword Saint still wore a smile, his manner was amiable.
Once he spoke, the Ghost Kings and Spirit Venerables hurriedly backed down, not daring to say more.
Brother Cheng felt a bit disappointed.
These Ghost Kings and Spirit Venerables clearly wanted to do something unfriendly, Old Sword Saint, why did you stop them?
Brother Cheng was waiting to show off, counterattack, and earn some points.
Now he desperately needed points.
Ascending to the next level would allow him to create a Spirit Vein within the Xuanji Map, then he could move Ah Huang in to reside there.
Instead of having it settle on his shoulder as it was now.
When the hour arrived, the Bone Refining Banner held by Jiang Cheng and the Heart-Piercing Awl held by Qingsuo both emitted dazzling light.
Violet and white light shone more brightly, chains of illusions slowly revolved on the two treasures.
No one present could discern how far the chains had extended.
In the distant void, a silver vortex began to form.
It appeared just before their eyes, yet in actuality, a Saint Tier entity might fly for days and still not reach it.
For it was not a view of the Thousand Spirit Domain but rather from another domain.
"That's the Cloud-Splitting Hammer from the Thunder Division, they've already initiated!"
As Qingsuo's words fell, Jiang Cheng nodded and then released the treasure in his hand.

chapters.title: Chapter 181: What You Say is Really Captivating
chapters.content:
The Bone Refining Banner and the Heart-Piercing Awl swiftly transformed into two streaks of light, disappearing into the void.
Soon after, a white and a purple vortex swiftly formed above everyone's heads.
"Can we enter now?"
Below, some of the experts from the Human Domain couldn't wait any longer and flew up into the sky.
They rushed toward the center of the two vortices, but were immediately struck down as if hit by a hammer, falling straight down.
Qingsuo hurriedly said, "Not yet, there are still tribes that haven't activated their magical treasures."
As soon as her words fell, a misty illusion appeared in the distant high sky.
Like a mirage, stretching for countless miles.
"It's ready!" Qingsuo and Lan Ti shouted in surprise simultaneously.
The two vortices stopped spinning, turning into two massive entrances.
As the owner of the Bone Refining Banner, Jiang Cheng had already seen the inside of the Void Immortal Realm.
The entrance was right there.
At this moment, above the Lower Realm Ten Thousand Realms, similar illusions appeared everywhere.
The Void Immortal Realm was so vast.
So much so that many cultivators from various domains flew up high, trying to explore.
Though they couldn't rush into the illusion, they saw the light of the entrance to other domains in the distance.
Without knowing what it was, their instincts led them toward it.
In no time, all major domains were stirred into action.
This grand event of the Void Immortal Realm opening finally moved the entire Lower Realm Ten Thousand Realms.
Jiang Cheng no longer hesitated and flew toward the purple entrance on the Profound Turtle King, accompanied by Ah Huang, Lan Ti, Mo Chen, and the Three-Eyed Tiger.
On the other side, five hundred members of the Heart Division flew toward the white entrance.
Naturally, the experts from the other ten or so domains below were not lagging behind and flew in one after another.
The process of entering the Void Immortal Realm went smoothly; as soon as he entered, the Bone Refining Banner reappeared, transforming into a purple streak of light that returned to his hand.
Shielding him and everyone around him.
Looking back, the entrance was still there.
"How long will the entrance last?"
Lan Ti shook her head, "I don't know either, there's no record of this within our tribe."
At this moment, Jiang Cheng finally had time to assess the surroundings.
This place is not suitable for ordinary people to linger.
Sand and stones flew on all sides, without the Divine Soul, it was difficult to see, the Gang Feng gusted, like weeping and complaining.
Thunder occasionally emerged from the ground, burning Profound Ice carried an extremely dangerous aura, faintly visible within the Gang Feng.
Lan Ti was right, the rules here were chaotic, completely different from the outside world.
The Saint Tier experts from various domains who rushed in managed fairly well, all relying on their formidable Sacred Bodies to withstand the invasion.
Those in the Ascending to Saint Realm were much worse off, each exclaiming in surprise and scrambling frantically.
Their domains weren't as stable as those of Saint Tier; once deployed, they were blown apart by the Gang Feng.
Cracks appeared in their Treasure Armor in the blink of an eye.
As for those Daoist Palace Realm cultivators, their fate was even more miserable.
Some had just entered, not even having time to cry out, already shredded to pieces.
Their Divine Souls, once touched by the burning Profound Ice, dissipated without a trace.
This scene left Lan Ti feeling deeply uneasy.
If she hadn't used her magical treasures back then, any Daoist Palace Realm storming in would be certain death.
But now, with the Bone Refining Banner's protection, she had no need for the Four-direction Primordial Cauldron.
"Use magical treasures to protect yourself!"
Gui Cang Sword Saint's aged voice could still be heard steadily amidst the Gang Feng.
Many Sword Cultivators among the three hundred from the Sword Domain took out protective magical treasures.
With those lower-grade magical treasures for protection, the Gang Feng was kept at bay.
Other domains followed suit, bringing out their magical treasures.
The Saints from the Celestial Book Domain jointly summoned a shimmering golden page.
That page expanded in the wind, soon reaching more than ten thousand meters in diameter.
Everyone from the Celestial Book Domain flew onto the golden page, no longer affected by the Gang Feng and chaotic rules.
Wow, a flying carpet?
Brother Cheng felt a bit envious.
And the most remarkable performance in the entire scene came from the Cold Nether Domain and Ten Thousand Bones Domain.
The Ghost Kings and Ghost Generals of the Cold Nether Domain were all in vapor form.
In this Gang Feng, they should have been the most vulnerable, yet none were dispersed, remaining unscathed.
As for the Ten Thousand Bones Domain, it was even more exaggerated.
The Gang Feng struck them, resulting in sounds of metal clashing, yet unable to shake them in the slightest.
However, some domains fared rather poorly, like the Profound Spirit Domain cultivating Beast Soul Power, where they had no concept of magical treasures.
The three Spirit Venerables managed, but their hundred subordinates did not survive.
Filled with pain and anger, the three immediately rushed into the Bone Refining Banner's coverage, pointing at Jiang Cheng and roaring.
"Good job making this happen!"ᴛʜɪs ᴄʜᴀᴘᴛᴇʀ ɪs ᴜᴘᴅᴀᴛᴇ ʙʏ novelFirｅ.net
"The lives of my people must be compensated with your blood!"
What the hell does this have to do with me?
Although Brother Cheng was eager for someone to provoke him, he still felt baffled.
"You really have a way with words, making it sound like I eliminated those weaklings, adding a trivial mark to my achievements."
Sitting on the turtle's back, Lan Ti couldn't help but roll her eyes.
Are you defending yourself or deliberately provoking them?
Sure enough, the three Spirit Venerables became enraged, three beast shadows simultaneously appearing above their heads.
Once the mighty beast shadows appeared, the atmosphere within the Bone Refining Banner grew turbulent, as if suddenly in a perilous jungle full of beasts.
"Why didn't you warn us it was dangerous inside, needing magical treasures for protection?"
"Did I invite you here?"
"Bi Feng is from the same domain as you, you bear his guilt!"
The logic for pressing charges is rather peculiar.
The dragon-headed Spirit Venerable among them had a massive dragon illusion almost reach Brother Cheng.
"Hand over the Bone Refining Banner, or die!"
This magical treasure, used to open the Void Immortal Realm, was definitely extraordinary, long coveted by them.
In fact, not just them, many others from different domains were restless.
Although the environment of the Void Immortal Realm was extreme, one thing was certain—Saint Tier was no longer suppressed by cross-domain rules.
Here, actions from various domains were unrestricted.
The Profound Spirit Domain's sudden aggressiveness drew the attention of other domains.
Everyone knew that once inside the Void Immortal Realm, things wouldn't remain peaceful for long, but this conflict erupted unexpectedly.
Many domains watched with schadenfreude.
Others looked on coldly.
Some observed closely, as no conflict had arisen before among the domains.
Taking this opportunity to assess others' tactics wasn't a bad idea.
Only Ling Xing Sword Saint from the Sword Domain slightly squinted his eyes, as the sword on his back slowly drew from its sheath.
"Holding off might be wise."
Gui Cang Sword Saint stopped him.
"Sect Leader Jiang may not be intimidated by them."
Brother Cheng indeed didn't regard these three Spirit Venerables seriously.
"Mama, shall I help you immobilize them?"
His darling daughter was quite concerned for his safety, but Brother Cheng waved it off, signaling it wasn't necessary.
This was a first-time chance to flaunt right after entering, quite an event to commemorate.
Moreover, whenever Ah Huang acted, massive amounts of Spirit Stones were needed for recharging afterward—there was no need for waste.

chapters.title: Chapter 182: One Against Three
chapters.content:
"Sigh, what you said makes so much sense, I'm embarrassed to refute it."
As he spoke, he took out the Mahayana Long Departure Sword from the ring and flew down from the tortoise's back with a smile.
"In order to make up for my mistakes, let me play the good guy."
The three Spirit Venerables opposite him thought he was going to compromise.
The experts from other Domains nearby couldn't help but show looks of disdain.
But the latter two sentences weren't quite what they expected.
"Bi Feng deceived you, I'll send you to meet him now."
"Let you confront him and question him face-to-face."
Even Brother Jiang himself wasn't sure of his current combat strength.
Anyway, standing together with these three Spirit Venerables didn't make him feel any sense of danger.
"Courting death."
Originally, the three Spirit Venerables thought Brother Jiang would send the Three-Eyed Tiger, Profound Turtle King, and Mo Chen to face them.
Who would have thought that he'd take action himself?
Ascending to Saint Eighth Layer Realm, everyone saw it clearly.
The three Spirit Venerables never took him seriously from the start.
Now seeing him personally take action, they were overjoyed.
Capturing him would bring the Bone Refining Banner into their hands!
The three simultaneously activated their Holy Sanctuaries, with the savage beast souls covering the area.
Instantly, the rules around them changed, the biggest difference between Saint Tier Holy Sanctuary and Ascending to Saint Domain is the level of control.
A Saint Tier expert can command the rules within their domain like extensions of their limbs.
Ordinary cultivators battling within a Holy Sanctuary are practically fighting against gods, with no chance of victory.
Seeing Brother Jiang enveloped by the three Holy Sanctuaries, many present shook their heads in secret, thinking he was too overconfident.
Had he retreated swiftly before the sanctuary attack, avoiding the coverage, he could have held on a bit longer.
Then, they heard thundering sounds of rupture.
Crash...
It was like three mirrors shattering.
The sound wasn't heard with the ears but directly transmitted to the depths of consciousness through the collision of rules.
Brother Jiang, with a wave of his hand, unleashed his Ascending to Saint Eighth Layer domain with a destructive force upon the three Holy Sanctuaries!
The outcome was opposite to everyone's expectations.
His domain remained unscathed.
But the three Holy Sanctuaries were directly crushed in this round of rule confrontation.
The three Holy Sanctuaries were forcibly ground down like mountains, shattered beyond any means of maintenance.
In the void, countless images of rules flickered rapidly.
An endless series of explosions turned the space under the Bone Refining Banner into chaos, the faces of the three Spirit Venerables turned pale simultaneously, suffering backlash from the Power of Rules!
"This..."
"How could this be?"
"Using one domain to defeat three Holy Sanctuaries?"
Experts from various Great Domains exclaimed, even the three leaders of the Sword Domain were startled with bright eyes, shocked and uncertain.
It's common knowledge that Holy Sanctuary is more stable than the domain, and its Power of Rules is thicker.
When Holy Sanctuary and domain clash, the latter's defeat shouldn't hold any suspense.
Thus, this result left them confused.
Only Mo Chen, sitting on the tortoise's back, smiled and quietly transmitted to Lan Ti.
"I told you, there's nothing to worry about."
"The Sect Leader's domain, although chaotic in Power of Rules, not yet at heart's command, has a foundation in True Immortal and Profound Immortal Level Martial Dao, with deep roots, not something ordinary Holy Sanctuary can withstand."
"Those three are completely like ants attempting to move a tree!"
Lan Ti exclaimed: "Isn't he invincible even in the Saint Tier?"
Mo Chen shook his head: "These three, one is Early-stage Saint Tier, one Mid-stage, and one Late-stage, weren't strong enough."
He glanced at the group of people from the Sword Domain in the distance.
"If it were those peak Saint Tier ones, the outcome would be uncertain."
Brother Jiang's advantage lies in his exceedingly deep Martial Dao foundation, his domain's inherent power is enormously vast.
The peak Saint Tier may not have such vast power, but their Power of Rules exceeds his by many times.ʀᴇᴀᴅ ʟᴀᴛᴇsᴛ ᴄʜᴀᴘᴛᴇʀs ᴀᴛ Nove1Fire.net
Which side wins depends on which side can tip the balance.
With the Holy Sanctuary broken, Brother Jiang forged ahead, unleashing the full power of the Mahayana Long Departure Sword!
This is a Saint Tier weapon, offering immense amplification.
Sweeping with one sword, Celestial Fire tore through the void, bringing countless twisted and dangerous turbulent streams.
"This sword has already posed a threat to us."
"He actually has a Saint Tier weapon?"
"Not only a Saint Tier weapon, he himself has perfected this swordsmanship to the Perfection Realm."
"Can't believe there's such a sword cultivator even in Outer Domain!"
The people of the Sword Domain showed endless excitement in their eyes.
While they discussed using Divine Soul, the three Spirit Venerables simultaneously activated their beast souls, targeting Brother Jiang directly.
In the void, dragon head illusions fiercely breathed, covering the entire sky, cleansing the surrounding Celestial Fire.
The wolf beast's howl made many Ascending to Saint Realm Divine Souls unease, external Gang Feng surged as a result, threatening to swallow their Divine Souls at any moment.
And the bull head illusion was like an indestructible giant war chariot, all Sword Aura and Celestial Fire shattered upon contact, completely unable to resist.
Even without reaching, it was enough to inspire dread!
These three terrifying beast souls, before they were about to touch Brother Jiang, suddenly had to halt.
Brother Jiang's Divine Soul emerged, transforming into three gigantic hands across the void!
A fist struck from the zenith, with the pressure power from the Azure Dragon Essence Blood descending, forcibly subduing the dragon head beast soul, its breath was forced to stop.
Yet that dragon head beast soul struggled and twisted continuously, unable to turn the tide!
A palm intercepted head-on from the front, the bull head beast soul that could penetrate all obstacles was sent flying back with a roar.
The giant hand suddenly clenched into a fist, a gigantic black cage like summoned from an abyss rose triumphantly beneath!
The bull head beast soul roared and charged, yet could not break the cage's confinement, futilely striking wildly.
One finger pointed, emerald mist spread widely, enveloping the entire wolf beast soul.
Then everyone was shocked to find the wolf beast soul weakening rapidly visibly, even its howl lost its previous strength.
The confrontation between Ascending and Saint Tier Divine Souls, with Ascending firmly holding the upper hand?
Furthermore, against three opponents!
Not only experts from various Great Domains, even Mo Chen was amazed this time.
The Sect Leader's improvement was merely in the Martial Dao Realm, how come the Divine Soul was also so extraordinary?
How could he know, the Saint Soul forged by ten thousand ghosts was of such high quality, transcending the Ten Thousand Ancient Level, even to the extent that it couldn't be suppressed by the peak, Bi Feng.
And now Brother Jiang had elevated this Saint Soul to Mid-stage Saint Tier.
Adding the Azure Dragon Essence Blood, Poison Heroic Soul, and Heroic Soul of the Prison together.
With tier level, there is tier level, with pressure, there is pressure, with methods, there are methods...
Not to mention these three Spirit Venerables, even peak Saint Tier couldn't compete with Brother Cheng on the Divine Soul level!
They cultivated beast soul power, once their beast souls had issues, their strength would plummet to the bottom.
The three were shocked and could only attack Brother Jiang at close range.
Yet, Brother Jiang showed no intention to avoid the edge, instead wielding his sword head-on.
This was too reckless, wasn't it?
Many people simultaneously had this thought.
Saint Tier is ultimately Saint Tier, just the strength of the Sacred Body alone and the vast power contained within is far beyond Ascending to Saint.

chapters.title: Chapter 183: The Sword Domain's Invitation
chapters.content:
If they were Jiang Cheng, since both the domain and divine soul hold the advantage, they should fully utilize these advantages.
Avoid direct martial techniques conflict as much as possible.
That's what it means to leverage strengths and avoid weaknesses!
However, the result was once again unexpected to them.
In the first clash of the four, the three Spirit Venerables seemed to have encountered a hurricane tsunami.
They not only failed to shake Jiang Cheng, but were swept back by his sword.
Only the first strike, the three simultaneously spat blood, suffering severe injuries.
For the Saint Tier who rarely gets injured, spitting blood is a serious matter damaging the foundation.
"How is this possible?"
"In martial techniques, can they not defeat Ascending to Saint?"
"Isn't the Profound Spirit Domain too weak?"
"No, the rules and power fluctuations displayed by the three together even threaten me."
"It's Jiang Cheng who's too bizarre, seemingly more formidable than a Sacred Body."
That's for sure, because last time's inexplicable Thunder Tribulation, Brother Cheng prematurely achieved the Immortal Body!
Even if he's only Ascending to Saint Eighth Layer, for a Sacred Body to challenge Immortal Body in martial techniques, isn't it courting discomfort?
He won't give those three a chance to catch their breath.
Fee the illness, seize the life!
At that moment, the three Spirit Venerables were beaten into a defensive position, utterly disheveled.
In Saint Domain, they cannot compete; in divine soul, they cannot compete; in physicality, they still cannot compete...
The Mahayana Long Departure Sword resembling countless fire dragons, roared and rampaged within that domain, carving numerous fissures in the Void Immortal Realm's space!
Three Spirit Venerables were terrified, increasingly weak, finally regretting provoking Jiang Cheng.
This person was a steel plate, and they thought they had seized a soft persimmon.
Yet, at this point, even if they want to escape, they cannot.
The upper divine soul clash had already determined victory.
Three beast souls under the Azure Dragon Suppression were ravaged by the Poison Heroic Soul, barely surviving.
Jiang Cheng unknowingly trapped the three's true bodies within his domain using the Heroic Soul of the Prison.
Denying them any chance of escape.
The Ascending to Saint Eighth Layer domain opened again, chaotic Power of Rules surged rampantly, the Immortal Tier Martial Dao's mighty force continuously washed over the last defense line of the three.
They finally smelled the scent of death, terrified.
"Spare us..."
"We dare not anymore!"
Having cultivated to Saint Tier with hopes of ascension, who wishes to die like this?
Damn, having fought to this stage, you ask me to cease? Do you not know some things done at the moment cannot be stopped?
Bang!
With a loud explosion, the space trembled.
The three Spirit Venerables were killed one after another, divine souls extinguished, no longer having any vitality.
No one uttered a sound across the venue.
Sect Leader Jiang's power deeply shocked everyone present.
Ascending to Saint Eighth Layer, singlehandedly slaughtering three Saint Tier!
Including one late-stage Saint Tier...
At that moment, they finally understood why Bi Feng died by this person's hands.
As Saint Tier, it's not unheard of to challenge across levels by monstrous talents.
Such talents often encounter extraordinary circumstances, endless cards and abundant means.
But regardless, cross-level has limits.
Especially at Saint Tier, under the threefold natural suppression of Saint Domain, Holy Soul, Sacred Body, excess cards and means are futile.
Jiang Cheng's unprecedented battle record made them inexplicably feel expanded horizons.This content belongs to .net
Ascending to Saint Eighth Layer, possessing combat power entirely not inferior to the Peak of Saint Tier.
Is Thousand Spirit Domain really this terrifying?
Always traversing this realm, it seems I've been too narrow-minded.
The various Great Realms remained silent.
Meanwhile, Mo Chen and the Three-Eyed Tiger excitedly ran over.
"Congratulations, Sect Leader, for yet another classic battle worthy of entering the Cultivation Realm chronicles!"
Their flattery had technicality, especially the three "again" with rising pitch, making Brother Cheng nod approvingly at Immortal Mo.
On the surface, naturally needed to act formidable, raising the level a bit.
"Elder Mo, you're too kind. To this sect leader, it's merely a small skirmish for amusement, not worth mentioning."
Mo Chen expressed heartfelt admiration: "The Sect Leader's magnitude, I am far beneath, no match!"
In contrast, Three-Eyed Tiger's flattery was much more clichéd.
"Bro, you're really powerful; following you sure wasn't wrong!"
This old tiger upon entering the Void Immortal Realm discovered that the streets were full of beings stronger than itself, feeling unsure.
Even its form cautiously reverted to a mini version, afraid of drawing strong entities' attention.
Now, Brother Cheng's formidable combat power made it regain a sense of security.
"Bro, your leg hair is really robust."
"Damn it, release your claws, I'm collecting spoils."
"Bro, let me, let me; no need for you to personally do it..."
The Three-Eyed Tiger darted over to the three Spirit Venerables' corpses, striving for prominence, even stripped off their underwear.
At the back, Lan Ti unconsciously covered her face with both hands.
Clearly, a battle shook other realms, why now feel ashamed to associate with these odd individuals?
So embarrassing!
The peculiar style of the Feixian Sect baffled other realm experts as well.
No one during this moment laughed.
Concerning Jiang Cheng's power on one hand.
On the other hand, Void Immortal Realm just opened minutes ago, already one realm annihilated.
At this moment, they fully realized another side of this operation.
Both an opportunity and a calamity!
Previously, due to the Power of Rules suppression, even the weakest realms need not worry about other realms attacking.
Now within Void Immortal Realm, rules treat all equally.
Those realms with powerful strength, like Sword Domain, Celestial Book Domain, can unleash fully...
Just as Jiang Cheng eliminated the final Spirit Venerable, people from Great Dream Domain and Ten Thousand Bones Domain quietly left the scene.
These two realms are scarce in Saint Tier, only having two and three individuals respectively.
They dare not walk together with other realms anymore.
And those realms coveting the Bone Refining Banner quietly extinguished their thoughts.
Jiang Cheng's combat power was clear, alongside Profound Turtle King, Three-Eyed Tiger, Mo Chen, the three Saints hadn't participated.
Thousand Spirit Domain's lineup is not a soft persimmon.
"Ascending to Saint slaying three Saint Tier, I've only ever seen!"
"Sect Leader Jiang is indeed extraordinary; Soul Body Domain enjoys exceptional fortune."
The Gui Cang Sword Saint first broke the silence, his white beard slightly trembling, approaching with a smile.
"Old Sword Saint surely knows worth, haha!"
Brother Cheng's fame finally about to break through Thousand Spirit Domain, reaching the outside?
Thinking of it even slightly excites.
"I have an unworthy request; may we proceed together, form an alliance, and mutually watch over each other?"
Upon these words, experts from other realms revealed envy.
That's Sword Domain!
Among the Lower Realm Ten Thousand Realms, combat power ranking in the top three as a formidable presence.
Within Void Immortal Realm, dangers lurk not only with environmental challenges but also need to guard against attacks from other realms.
If able to walk together with Sword Domain, much safer indeed.
Just because you want to be together doesn't mean others will pay heed.

chapters.title: Chapter 184: Here Lies a Tremendous Opportunity
chapters.content:
Sword cultivators are inherently proud.
Even the Celestial Book Domain, boasting 14 Book Saints, couldn't exchange a word with them despite ranking high in the Lower Realm Ten Thousand Realms.
Yet now, Jiang Cheng had received an invitation directly from the Sword Domain's leaders.
This treatment was indeed unique.
However, Brother Cheng refused without a second thought.
"Thanks for the Old Sword Saint's kindness, but the situation in the Void Immortal Realm is unclear; I'd like to explore on my own."
Not clinging to such a significant support, many couldn't understand.
But Brother Cheng had his plans.
He had to summon a disciple every day from the Xuanji Map to enhance their talent, and such matters were best kept away from outsiders.
Gui Cang Sword Saint didn't insist either.
"Then, until we meet again, may we reunite in the Immortal Realm in the future!"
With that, he led 300 people from the Sword Domain and quickly departed.
After they left, the other domains also set off in various directions.
No one, not even Lan Ti, was familiar with the Void Immortal Realm, and no one knew the path to the Immortal Realm.
This was the greatest challenge facing everyone.
For now, it was all about relying on intuition and chance.
Jiang Cheng didn't think too much and busied himself with accounting the spoils.
The results were a bit disappointing; there were no Spirit Stones or pills, though there were some Heavenly and Earthly Treasures.
Aside from that, most resources were used for Profound Spirit Domain's cultivation of beast souls, which were useless to him.
Luckily, the system could exchange them, and what was useless could be converted into points.
After all, being Saint Tier experts, the collections were the top-tier treasures of a domain.
After a round of exchanges, there were 1.2 billion points added to his account.
Once Jiang Cheng finished his tasks, Mo Chen suddenly revealed shocking news.
"I've been here before."
What?
Upon hearing these words, everyone was utterly shocked.
Three-Eyed Tiger couldn't believe it at all.
"Old Mo, don't brag. You used to be sealed in the Blood Transformation Blade. How could you have been to the Void Immortal Realm?"
"What would you, a Tiger Demon, know?"
Mo Chen gave it a disdainful glance before shifting to another expression.
"Does the Sect Leader remember the Immortal Demon War I mentioned?"
Jiang Cheng recalled when he subdued this old man, he did mention that when talking about his origins.
Though at the time, Jiang Cheng wasn't interested and didn't inquire further.
"Immortal cultivation and demonic cultivation were originally two different paths, but in the end, they became irreconcilable."
"This place was the battlefield back then."
"Such a coincidence?"
Out of everyone, Lan Ti was the most reluctant to accept this.
"How could the Void Immortal Realm be a battlefield?"
"Then why did our nine Immortal Ancestors descend from here back then?"
"Wasn't your war in the Immortal Realm?"
Mo Chen calmly said, "Our battlefield back then was indeed in the Immortal Realm, at the very chaotic center of the Immortal Realm."
The Profound Turtle King curiously asked, "What is the Chaotic Ruins?"
"A blank area with chaotic rules where even immortals cannot reside for long."
Jiang Cheng was surprised. "How could the most central area of the Immortal Realm fall to the Lower Realm?"
Mo Chen furrowed his eyebrows tightly, his eyes flickering with different expressions as if carefully pondering something.
After a long while, he sighed deeply.
"The only thing I can confirm is that the Void Immortal Realm was created by the top forces up there working together."
"They sank the Chaotic Ruins, placing it as a barrier between the Immortal and Lower Realms, disrupting the original Heaven and Earth Laws, blocking the ascension path of Lower Realm cultivators."
"Perhaps this was due to some changes after the Immortal Demon War."
Three-Eyed Tiger scratched its fur and casually asked, "So, do you know how to get up from the Void Immortal Realm?"
"I don't."
"Then what's the use of saying all this?"
Mo Chen was almost infuriated by the Tiger Demon and said angrily, "The Chaotic Ruins isn't an ascension passage. How could there be a way up?"
Jiang Cheng frowned, "So we're on a wild goose chase then?"The source of thɪs content is novel⸺fire.net
"Not necessarily."
Mo Chen shifted his tone: "Although it isn't an ascension passage, it doesn't rule out the chance of entering the Immortal Realm."
"Back then, the two armies of immortals and demons both built altars in the ruins. Finding those altars from that time might offer a turnaround."
Three-Eyed Tiger poured cold water again: "It's been tens of thousands of years; the altars in the ruins would have long disappeared."
Mo Chen couldn't help but roar, "If you don't understand, just shut up. The methods of the Immortal Emperor and Demon Emperor aren't something an ant like you can comprehend!"
Jiang Cheng waved his hand: "Do you know the location of the altars?"
"I need to first determine our current position and then calculate."
"Alright, take your time to calculate."
Having arrived in the Void Immortal Realm and fought a battle, Brother Cheng felt he really worked too hard and planned to take a nap on the turtle's back.
Mo Chen added, "In fact, for the entire Feixian Sect, this Void Immortal Realm is a great opportunity."
"Oh? What opportunity, Elder Mo, please tell us."
Three-Eyed Tiger immediately perked up, even switching back to addressing him as Elder Mo.
Mo Chen glanced at this fellow, suddenly regretting letting it listen in.
But performing well in front of the Sect Leader was more important.
"During the Immortal Demon War, countless immortals and demons died in the ruins, and their Blood Evil Qi still lingers here."
"If someone can withstand the cleansing of this Blood Evil Qi, there's a great chance to achieve a Demon Body without a Thunder Tribulation."
The Demon Body and Immortal Body are on par; achieving a Demon Body is equivalent to becoming half an immortal.
"In fact, ancient battlegrounds like this were often the favorite cultivation grounds for ancient demon cultivators."
"And no battlefield from back then could match the scale of this one. The Demon Body refined here would have exceptionally high quality."
Jiang Cheng and Three-Eyed Tiger, on the turtle's back, exchanged looks.
Damn, are you a demon cultivator?
Otherwise, why would you know this?
"What's the difference between a Demon Body and an Immortal Body?"
Jiang Cheng didn't have any particular preference for becoming an immortal cultivator or a demon cultivator.
It was just a difference in cultivation paths.
Looking at Mo Chen, this demon cultivator seemed more normal than many people from the Sacred Land.
"Immortal cultivation emphasizes the Divine Soul, while demon cultivation focuses on refining the physique. Achieving an Immortal Body makes one more outstanding in soul cultivation, whereas achieving a Demon Body provides an advantage in close combat."
"Then what are we waiting for? Hurry up!"
Three-Eyed Tiger exclaimed and flew out of the Bone Refining Banner's range.
From Sacred Body to Demon Body would be a tremendous leap.
Look at Jiang Cheng's recent battle with those three Saint Tier experts; his complete dominance in the final martial techniques was mainly because the Immortal Body surpassed the Sacred Body.
Thinking it had this opportunity too, Three-Eyed Tiger was so excited it howled.
However, that quickly turned into a wail of misery.
As a Saint Tier, Three-Eyed Tiger's Holy Sanctuary could keep out the Chaos Rule and Blood Evil Power.
But now, to accept the cleansing and refinement of the Blood Evil Qi, it had to retract its Holy Sanctuary and face the most brutal environment of the Void Immortal Realm head-on.
In the Void Immortal Realm, entering the Daoist Palace led to instant death.
Ascending to Saint level could hold off for a while, but now, having completely given up resistance, one could imagine the suffering.
Seeing it rolling on the ground, bleeding continuously, and its once white fur completely stained red, Brother Cheng was pained at the sight.
The originally eager Profound Turtle King immediately gave up.

chapters.title: Chapter 185 - 185 Dark Gold Demon Body
chapters.content:
"Isn't this too cruel?"
"Going all out just for a Demon Body."
Mo Chen gloated, "Sect Leader, normal Demon Body can only be obtained by passing the Ascension Tribulation. It can get this opportunity ahead of time now, paying such a small price is already considered a bargain."
Jiang Cheng's mouth twitched, somewhat suspecting this old man was deliberately messing with the Three-Eyed Tiger.
A quarter hour later, the screams of the Three-Eyed Tiger disappeared.
Not only were the screams gone, but even its aura had disappeared.
"No way, did it die?"
"Died too mysteriously, didn't it?"
Mo Chen spread his hands, "Really overestimated it, thought it could pull through."
Listening to the two's conversation, the Profound Turtle King's heart was chilled.
Hey, hey, are you kidding me?
A Demon King died, ah, it's one of our own, the Sect Guardian Spirit Beast!
Can't you show some sadness and shock?
Just this indifferent?
Soon after, it saw Jiang Cheng also flew outside the Bone Refining Banner.
He illuminated above the Three-Eyed Tiger's head; this guy is a Demon King, resurrecting actually costs 12,000 points, a hundred times more than some disciples before.
This is still when the death occurred very recently, while keeping the whole corpse intact.
After using Resurrection, the Three-Eyed Tiger came back to life and the whole body became perfectly intact.
Brother Cheng quickly flew back to the turtle's back, giving it a thumbs up.
"Keep up the good work."
"Better forget it, it's too painful."
The Three-Eyed Tiger backed down, although with Jiang Cheng present, it couldn't die, the pain was simply worse than death.
It wasn't a diligent Demon King who loved cultivation in the first place.
At this time, Mo Chen suddenly said, "Your Demon Body has been tempered halfway, if you stop and give up now, in the future you might neither become an Immortal nor a Demon."
Upon hearing this, the Three-Eyed Tiger was furious.
"You old bastard, didn't tell me it was this tough earlier."
"Old me is also doing it for your good, consider that there's been no Ascension Tribulation in the Saint Tier for the last ten million years."
If there really was no tempering from the Ascension Tribulation, even if one really successfully smuggled to the Immortal Realm, the Sacred Body couldn't transform into an Immortal Body.
This tempering of Blood Evil Qi is indeed a colossal opportunity.
The Three-Eyed Tiger wrestled with indecision for a while and finally withdrew its Domain again, continuing to accept the wash and tempering of the Blood Evil Qi.
After two quarter hours, it hung up again, and then Jiang Cheng resurrected it once more.
"Didn't you say it was tempered halfway? How is it not done yet?"
Upon resurrection, the Three-Eyed Tiger started cursing Mo Chen with no restraint.
Mo Chen chuckled coldly, "Old me didn't know you were this useless, overestimated you."
The Three-Eyed Tiger directly extended its claw, making a gesture of destroying his whole family, and then continued the ongoing painful journey.
The Profound Turtle King's eyes were about to pop out.
What just happened?
Can someone explain it to me?
Was that resurrection?
That must be resurrection, right?
How was it done, why aren't you even a bit surprised, as if very accustomed?
Is there such an operation?
This time, after half a quarter hour, the bleeding on the Three-Eyed Tiger stopped.
Its fur, though still white, seemed to be coated with a layer of dark light.
And in those three tiger eyes, there was an even more mesmerizing divine light.
Its aura had become much more restrained than before, yet the feeling it gave was at least ten times more dangerous!
Obviously, it hadn't released its Holy Sanctuary, and yet the chaotic flow of rules struck against its body, making a sound like metal, no longer able to shake it at all.
"Hahahaha..."
"I have finally achieved Great Success in Divine Skills!"
Its voice pierced through gold and cracked stone, shaking the surrounding chaotic rule stream to form a circle of ripples, rippling far away.
"Wow, such a big improvement?"
Brother Cheng was incredibly surprised, this Demon Body was even more amazing than he imagined.
Mo Chen's eyes flashed with jealousy, and he harshly said, "This Tiger Demon's talent seems very high, really lucky crap, directly achieved the Dark Gold Demon Body."
Lan Ti curiously asked, "What is the Dark Gold Demon Body?"
Mo Chen began explaining again, "Demon Body is divided into tiers; the higher the tier, the greater the power that can be wielded in the same realm."
"The lowest is the Withered Wood Demon Body, above it are the Cyan Wood, Iron Wood and several other levels..."This update is available on novel✦fire.net
"The Wood Body is the lowest tier among Demon Cultivators, often belonging to those with poor talent, not becoming a force to be reckoned with as Scattered Demons."
"Above Wood Body, there are Stone Body, Jade Body, Silver Body, each divided into several tiers."
Mo Chen didn't say one thing, he himself was once the highest Flowing Silver Demon Body among Silver Bodies.
This level in the Immortal Realm's Demon Cultivators is already considered quite rare.
Originally intended to wait until entering the Immortal Realm, and once these guys slowly understood the common sense of the Immortal Realm, then suddenly show it off to shock everyone.
But now it's good, the Three-Eyed Tiger directly became higher than the Silver Body to the Golden Body.
If it were someone else it might be okay, but this dead tiger he always disliked, it's extremely infuriating.
He could only sulkily say, "Above Silver Body is Golden Body. It is divided into Platinum, Dark Gold, Purple Gold three tiers."
Dark Gold Demon Body is like a rare existence in the Immortal Realm's Demon Cultivators, too exceptional.
Those who have such a Demon Body, most often end up becoming big influential figures among Demon Cultivators.
The quality of Immortal Body and Demon Body is fixed at the moment of becoming an Immortal.
It's almost impossible to change later, even like now finding a perfect place to temper, can only make improvements within the same tier.
Cannot be elevated from Wood Body to Stone Body, nor from Silver Body to Golden Body.
But these words he no longer wanted to speak, because the Three-Eyed Tiger now had its tail already raised to heaven.
"Wakaka, I am indeed the chosen demon, just a bit of effort, became a peerless genius among Demon Cultivators."
It flopped beside Mo Chen, extended its paw patted his shoulder, maliciously asked, "Old Mo, what body did you have before?"
"Can you tell your buddy? Let him worship a bit?"
Bringing up the subject he least wanted to discuss, and calling him 'buddy' to his face, Immortal Mo wished he could strangle it.
The little issue between them was no longer a concern for the Profound Turtle King.
This Dark Gold Demon Body of the Three-Eyed Tiger had completely captivated it.
And with resurrection, there was no risk of dying.
Missing such an opportunity means deserving to never become an Immortal.
"Master, I want to try too."
"Jiang Cheng, I also want..."
For the moment, Profound Turtle King and Lan Ti spoke up simultaneously.
Having a Demon Body is equivalent to becoming half an Immortal in advance, who could resist this temptation.
"No problem, go ahead."
They are all his kin, Jiang Cheng certainly hoped they would become stronger.
He was already planning whether to release the 1,000 plus disciples in the Xuanji Map and let them all become Demon Bodies.
Afterwards, the Profound Turtle King got resurrected once, it also achieved a Demon Body.
However, it was only the Silver Demon Body, several tiers below the Dark Gold Demon Body.
And Lan Ti resurrected four times.
Seeing this made Jiang Cheng feel terribly distressed, the beauty was soaked in blood and looked miserable, too cruel.
It was only because she had very strong willpower, during the entire process she actually endured without letting out a scream.

chapters.title: Chapter 186: Immortal Demon Body
chapters.content:
Mo Chen whispered, "The Profound Turtle King is already in the late-stage Saint Tier, and the Profound Turtle is renowned for its strong defenses. Even a Celestial Tribulation is easier for it than for others at the peak of Saint Tier."
"Whereas Miss Lan Ti is merely Ascending to Saint, this Blood Evil Qi is too destructive for her, too overwhelming."
To be honest, this opportunity wasn't meant for cultivators from the Lower Realm.
If it were any other peak Saint Tier cultivator, they might have ended up dead as well.
The Three-Eyed Tiger and Profound Turtle King succeeded only because Jiang Cheng could use resurrection to continually renew them, forcibly reversing a suicidal outcome into an opportunity.
Besides, Saint Tier experts from other domains wouldn't even know about Blood Evil Qi and Demon Body.
Who would stuff themselves with trivia, run out of the protective range of their magical treasures, put away their domain, and endure such intense pain with their bodies?
The Bone King of Ten Thousand Bones Domain could withstand it, but the issue is the Bone Race lacks blood, flesh, the Blood Evil Qi is ineffective against them…
After the last resurrection, Lan Ti finally succeeded in achieving the Demon Body.
"Turns out it's also a Dark Gold Demon Body?"
"Miss Lan's talent is extraordinary!"
Mo Chen, while flattering the future wife of the sect leader, also picked up the shattered pieces of understanding.
Is Dark Gold Demon Body this easy to acquire?
Feels like my previous cultivation was all wasted.
The power of one person and two beasts surged greatly after achieving Demon Body, feeling high-spirited.For original chapters go to novel※fire.net
Brother Cheng felt a burning desire in his heart.
"I want to try too!"
Mo Chen quickly stopped him.
"Hold on, Sect Leader!"
"You've already achieved an Immortal Body; Immortal and Demon are mutually exclusive. No one can have both an Immortal Body and Demon Body simultaneously."
Jiang Cheng was immediately disappointed.
"Then can you tell what rank my Immortal Body is?"
"Is it as formidable as their Dark Gold Demon Body?"
"Cough, I can't tell."
Mo Chen said awkwardly, "I'm not very familiar with Immortal Bodies, only seen some of lower rank. Sect Leader, your Immortal Body is of a type I've never seen, it surely isn't low!"
Brother Cheng felt slightly comforted.
No, as the Sect Leader, how can I be worse than my subordinates?
"I'll try anyway, there's no real cost involved."
"Think carefully, Sect Leader. If you die, there'll be no one to resurrect you."
Lan Ti also urged him anxiously, "Cheng... don't be rash, I don't want to see you dead."
The girl cared so much about him, Brother Cheng felt rather comforted.
But if I die, there's the system to resurrect me.
"Don't worry, I know what I'm doing."
After saying that, he leaped outside, retracted the domain, and directly faced the impact of Blood Evil Qi.
Buzz!
At that moment, his Divine Soul became chaotic; the scenes of mountains of corpses and seas of blood made his consciousness scattered.
Just before losing consciousness, a thought flickered in him.
The Three-Eyed Tiger and Lan Ti didn't seem to have lost consciousness before.
Aren't I an Immortal Soul, shouldn't I endure better than them?
Why can't I withstand this impact?
His whole body swelled up and shrank, as if being bitten by thousands of insects, as if pierced by countless needles, as if every bone was crushed…
The pain twisted his entire being.
The few observers were already terrified.
After the impact of Blood Evil Qi, Jiang Cheng's body shattered instantly, continued to split and disintegrate, way worse than the others had.
"This is impossible!"
Mo Chen screamed while charging out.
The Sect Leader has an Immortal Body, even if unable to achieve Demon Body, shouldn't suffer such impact from Blood Evil Qi.
If Blood Evil Qi was this powerful, during the Immortal Demon War, how would the Immortal Race dare enter the battlefield?
But, it was too late.
When Mo Chen, Lan Ti, Three-Eyed Tiger Profound Turtle King, and Ah Huang hurried over to Jiang Cheng, he had already disintegrated countless times, died without a trace.
"No…"
Lan Ti cried out in despair, nearly fainting.
The Three-Eyed Tiger looked bewildered, like a lost soul.
Mo Chen murmured to himself, "Shouldn't be like this, shouldn't be…"
But Ah Huang was calm, his jet-black eyes darting around, seemingly looking for something.
"Ding, the host is killed, detecting enemy power, arranging resurrection plan."
"Ding, host has achieved Chaos Demon Body."
"Ding, host resurrected."
The system gave no explanation for this death.
As for the solution, unlike with Dragon Blood and Thunder Tribulation those times, it wasn't merely resurrecting.
But forcefully granted him a Demon Body that should be impossible to coexist with Immortal Body.
It seems only granting this Chaos Demon Body could resolve this crisis.
Under everyone's watchful eyes, the dissipated body reassembled back into Jiang Cheng, alive once more.
Not only alive but with Demon Body successfully.
"Cheng…"
Lan Ti rushed over first, tightly hugged him.
"You're not dead, that's great!"
"Haha, I was just joking with everyone."
Having hung in front of his own people once, Brother Cheng could only awkwardly act cool to cover.
Lan Ti broke into a smile and faux punched his chest, scolded, "You went way too far."
The Three-Eyed Tiger looked speechless, "Bro, you seriously scare people like this."
Mo Chen also shook his head with a bitter smile.
But soon after, his eyes widened.
"Sect Leader, you achieved Demon Body?"
His sensing of Demon Cultivator aura was sharp, on Jiang Cheng he already saw Demon Body traits.
But how could this be?
Clearly having an Immortal Body, yet achieved Demon Body?
Does this count as Immortal Cultivator or Demon Cultivator?
This Child of the Plane is too miraculous, disregards common sense entirely!
Brother Cheng nodded, "Right, help me check what rank this Demon Body is?"
Mo Chen promptly sensed carefully, after a long while, still looked puzzled.
The Three-Eyed Tiger impatiently urged him, "What rank is it, stop keeping us in suspense."
He arrogantly flicked his tail.
"Is it more powerful than Bro's Dark Gold Demon Body?"
Mo Chen remained silent, after a while, finally spoke with effort.
"I've never seen this type; however, the aura is more dangerous, should be higher than Dark Gold Demon Body."
"Have you heard of Chaos Demon Body?"
"Never heard of it."
Brother Cheng felt a bit helpless; the Immortal's knowledge reserve is lacking, seems he didn't study well before.
"Since we've all successfully obtained Demon Body, shall we call other disciples to have them receive the nourishment of Blood Evil Qi as well."
Imagine if all my disciples possess Demon Bodies, how would that look?
His only concern is that acquiring the Demon Body rank seems related to everyone's talent.
And most of his disciples haven't had the chance to enhance their talent.
"Elder Mo, once a Demon Body is obtained, is it fixed and cannot be changed later?"
If that's the case, then prematurely acquiring a low-rank Demon Body isn't a good thing.

chapters.title: Chapter 187 - 187 Busy Brother Cheng
chapters.content:
"Not bad."
Mo Chen nodded and continued, "But Sect Leader, since you can enhance talents, maybe you can break this iron law."
He dared not use common sense to guess the range of Brother Cheng's abilities now.
"Once they all obtain Demon Bodies, it will be many times easier for them to break through to the Daoist Palace and ascend to the Saint Tier."
It's only natural; using a body comparable to an Immortal to cultivate through the earlier stages is bound to be easy.
Jiang Cheng pondered for a moment, deciding to test this on a target first.
"Profound Turtle King, let me enhance your talent now and see if your Demon Body changes."
The Profound Turtle King currently had only Fifth-class Talent and had just obtained the Silver Demon Body.
Although obtaining a Demon Body was a great joy, compared to Lan Ti and the Three-Eyed Tiger's Dark Gold Demon Bodies, the excitement was somewhat diminished.
Happiness is indeed a relative feeling.
"Great, great, thank you, Master!"
It had long envied the disciples for having their talents enhanced by Jiang Cheng.
Even the likes of Three-Eyed Tiger hadn't had their turn, so it had nothing to complain about.
Suddenly hearing about its enhancement, it spun around in excitement, nearly losing its bearings.
"Brother, there ought to be a first-come, first-served basis!"
"I've toiled for you, achieving great victories and tirelessly contributing!"
Three-Eyed Tiger couldn't accept this, looking like it was making a tearful complaint.
"The Profound Turtle King just arrived and hasn't contributed at all; why does it get this?"
"Do you have an issue with me? If you do, you can speak up!"
Brother Cheng thought to himself enhancing you requires 9.5 billion points, while enhancing the Profound Turtle King requires only a few ten thousand, can that even be compared?
Besides, directly trying to sow discord in front of the Profound Turtle King isn't a bit inconsiderate?
"Alright, alright, you already have the Dark Gold Demon Body; what more do you want?"
With that, he patted the Profound Turtle King on the head.
In an instant, the Profound Turtle King's talent was enhanced to Fourth-class.
Soon, the white-silver light faintly emanating from its turtle shell quietly changed.
Waves of iridescent light danced across the surface of the shell, appearing quite magical.
When the Profound Turtle King suppressed its aura, the glowing streaks disappeared.
In the next moment, its entire body turned into a pool of liquid.
The liquid shivered continuously, morphing into various shapes before ultimately reverting back to the form of the turtle.
"This is the Flowing Silver Demon Body!"
"The Demon Body really upgraded!"
Even though it was anticipated, Mo Chen couldn't help jumping up in excitement.
This was incredible.
This was probably the first time to witness a Demon Body forcibly changing shapes after being set.
If this news reached the Immortal Realm, it would cause a titanic upheaval!
Even the Immortal Kings and Demon Emperors would be restless.
"Thank you, Master, thank you, Master!"
The Profound Turtle King repeatedly expressed gratitude, not only for the upgrade in its Demon Body but also because its talent increased to Fourth-class; its speed of cultivation skyrocketed.
To it, this was akin to defying fate.
At this moment, all it felt lucky about was becoming Jiang Cheng's mount.
Thinking there might be more opportunities for future enhancement, it had only one thought.
This powerful patron must be hugged tightly, never to be let go!
If one can enhance the demon body's tier in the future by continuously enhancing talents, there's no reason for hesitation.
Jiang Cheng first summoned 300 disciples from the Xuanji Map.
Among them were Ji Linghan, Lin Ning, Luo Yuan, and others.
"Is this the Void Immortal Realm?"
"It's so barren!"
"Looks quite dangerous."
"Why did the Sect Leader summon us, is there something major?"
Jiang Cheng explained the situation about Blood Evil Qi and Demon Bodies.
Upon hearing they could acquire bodies equal to Immortals, everyone was incredibly excited, their eyes brimming with eagerness.
Everyone was raring to go.
"Let's begin, Sect Leader!"
"Let's do this!"
"I can't wait any longer."
But Jiang Cheng immediately changed the tone.
"I must forewarn you, the scourge of Blood Evil Qi is extremely painful, and you will definitely die more than once."
"Moreover, if you do not wish to become a Demon Cultivator, you can opt-out."
"The choice is yours now."
Although he hoped they'd all gain Demon Bodies, Jiang Cheng had no intention of forcing anyone.
He cared a lot about how these disciples felt about themselves.
The group exchanged glances and then made their decisions collectively.
"There's nothing to hesitate about!"
"How could one miss such an opportunity?"
"I want to have a Demon Body!"
None of the three hundred disciples opted out, making Jiang Cheng very pleased.
Then, he led them out of the Bone Refining Banner's protection.
What ensued was outright carnage.
All Fourth Generation Disciples instantly perished without exception.
Among the Third Generation and Second Generation Disciples, half survived only two seconds.Thᴇ link to the origɪn of this information rᴇsts ɪn NovєlFіre.net
Yet among the remaining Second Generation Disciples, Ji Linghan and Lin Ning, possibly due to their solid foundations, managed to last several minutes.
Without Brother Cheng, this operation would have been suicidal.
But now, he had no time to reflect on the cruelty; he was busy with resurrections.
With 300 continuously dying and resurrecting one after another.
Although the Fourth Generation Disciples died quickly, due to their low cultivation, their resurrection required very few points, mostly just single digits.
Sect Leader Jiang had abandoned the pre-resurrection 'spell' routine used to conceal the procedure; it was too time-consuming.
By the end, some Fourth Generation Disciples had been resurrected over a hundred times.
Mo Chen, Lan Ti, and the Three-Eyed Tiger Profound Turtle King all watched slack-jawed, resting their chins on their hands.
Was resurrection this simple for the Sect Leader?
No ceremony is needed; hundreds resuscitated at a flick of the wrist.
Is he even human?
After three full hours, this batch of disciples finally achieved their transformation; uniformly, all had gained Demon Bodies.
However, their achievements varied widely.
Most Fourth Generation Disciples only achieved Stone Bodies, some even just Wood Bodies.
Meanwhile, Third Generation Disciples generally had Flowing Silver Demon Bodies, with a few reaching Platinum Demon Bodies.
Among the Second Generation, Ji Linghan and Luo Yuan also obtained Platinum Demon Bodies.
As for Lin Ning, she reached the Dark Gold Demon Body.
This overturned some of Jiang Cheng's previous assumptions.
It seems that while Demon Body level is directly linked to the Talent Level, they are not entirely consistent.
Everyone's talent variety differs; some have excellent roots, others superior lineage, or noteworthy Divine Souls, and coupled with factors like willpower, which differently affect the formation of Demon Bodies.
Thus, Lin Ning, with a Third-class Talent, achieved a Dark Gold Demon Body, on par with Lan Ti and the Three-Eyed Tiger.
Moreover, some with Fourth-class Talent in the Third Generation also reached the Platinum Demon Body.
With the Demon Body, some disciples, though merely in the Energy-Introducing Realm, could walk freely in the Void Immortal Realm.
If this spreads, it would likely shock the other domains.
Yet they were cautiously hiding under magical treasures.
Their power had greatly leaped forward, and cultivation had become easier, so the disciples cheered joyfully.
Mo Chen was all the more gratified, feeling proud that disciple Lin Ning turned out to have a Dark Gold Demon Body.
As a master, he could once again hold his head high in front of the Three-Eyed Tiger.
"Xiaohan, you stay, the rest return to the Xuanji Dojo first."
Brother Cheng decided to rectify the Second Generation's Big Sister's status.

chapters.title: Chapter 188: Arrival of the Celestial Demon Domain
chapters.content:
Since the first time he helped Luo Yuan enhance his talent, Sect Leader Jiang had added BUFFs for many people.
Even a hundred or more fourth-generation disciples were enhanced.
Only the second-generation Ji Linghan and Lin Ning had not been enhanced by him so far.
Neither in realm nor in talent.
It's fortunate these two women had good mindsets; if it were others, they might have become unbalanced early on.
Ji Linghan needed 1.2 billion points to enhance from second-class talent to first-class.
Before, Brother Cheng was too poor, so he could only leave it be.
Now he holds billions, and sooner or later more points can be gathered from the Void Immortal Realm and the future Immortal Realm, so he can afford 1.2 billion now.
"Sect Leader, do you have something for me?"
Being left alone, could it be...
Brother Cheng didn't drag it out and pretentiously patted her head.
"Alright, I've raised you to first-class talent."
Subsequently, Ji Linghan's Platinum Demon Body rapidly underwent transformation.
First, her surface slowly darkened, then that dark stream of light turned to a light purple.
Finally, that light purple gradually faded, but a very faint purple pattern appeared on her forehead.
The pattern was very small, not visible unless looked at closely.
"Purple Gold Demon Body!"
"It skipped Dark Gold Demon Body and directly achieved Purple Gold Demon Body!"
Mo Chen jumped up, completely at a loss for words.
"Damn, Magical Cultivators in the Immortal Realm with Purple Gold Demon Body mostly end up becoming a Demon Emperor!"
"Oh my God..."
His knees went weak.
Looking at Ji Linghan in front of him, still at Daoist Palace Ninth Layer, this former Immortal was sweating profusely.
His waist involuntarily bent, his body lowered a lot, almost kneeling directly before her.
Even if she can't become a Demon Emperor in the future, it's a guarantee she'll be at the Demon King level!
Provided she survives in the Immortal Realm until then.
With Sect Leader Jiang around, is it that hard to survive?
A Demon Emperor!
On the eve of the Immortal Demon War, he'd caught a glimpse from afar, but couldn't see clearly because Immortal Soul peeking was forbidden.
Moreover, he was then kneeling with thousands of other Demon Cultivators.
Others didn't have this feeling though.
The Three-Eyed Tiger was still quite unconvinced.
"Is my Dark Gold Demon Body not impressive anymore so soon?"
"Brother, when will you boost me as well?"
"Just pat my head, it's such a simple thing, just raise your noble hand once!"
You want 9.5 billion points, dream on somewhere else for now.
Jiang Cheng also realized that the relationship between Demon Body and talent is not directly proportional; each person's circumstances are unique.
Currently, Ji Linghan's second-class talent should be considered top-tier among the second-class.
With a glance through the system, her current points had directly risen from the previous 3 million per level to 40 million.
The increase was substantial.
And the points needed for her next level had reached a terrifying 18 billion.
"Alright, you go back to cultivation now."
Girl, you're now my most valuable card, he pondered about spending a bit tomorrow to also upgrade Lin Ning to the Dark Gold Demon Body.
After all, her master, Immortal Mo, is now eagerly watching him, and she's been meritorious in her work.
With her talent enhanced and Demon Body advanced, Ji Linghan was naturally joyful.
But inexplicably, she felt a bit of loss.
It wasn't as she'd imagined.
After that, Jiang Cheng summoned the remaining 700 disciples in two batches, enhancing all of them to Demon Body.
These 700-plus were all fourth-generation disciples, and their Demon Bodies were generally Wood Body or Stone Body.
For the Demon Bodies of these over 1,000 disciples, he was thoroughly busy, having lost count of his revivals.
But in the final tally, it was only a bit over a million points, which was nothing.
After all the disciples returned to the Xuanji Map, the Profound Turtle King carried a few people and officially set off towards the altar direction Mo Chen mentioned.
Not long after they set out, a giant dragon shining with golden light flew into the entrance below.
A massive ape, eyes blood-red and exuding a violent aura, followed, slowly observing the surroundings of the Void Immortal Realm.
Once the Void Immortal Realm appeared, the nearby Celestial Demon Domain soon discovered the entrance.
The eleven Demon Kings successively stepped into this dangerous land.
"What is this place?"
Upon entering, the Frost Rabbit King immediately expanded its Holy Sanctuary.
"Not sure, but this thing above us does make me think of something."
The Yashu King, the smartest among the Twelve Demon Kings, peered with sharp, clever eyes.
"What have you thought of?"
The Golden Dragon King's majestic voice echoed around, the Dragon Breath expelled all disorderly currents and Blood Evil Qi to the distance.
The Yashu King let out a strange chuckle.
"Could it be that the inability to ascend for millions of years is because of it?"
Upon hearing this, the other Demon Kings were astounded.
"If that's the case, we really need to venture here!"
"Indeed, this opportunity must not be missed!"
"But, it's still just speculation."
"Yeah, it seems too dangerous here, what if it's a trap..."
If the Outer Domain overheard this conversation, it would probably refresh its impression of the Celestial Demon Domain.
These Twelve Demon Kings are not all battle-crazed lunatics incapable of dialogue.
"No, it should be real."
The Dog-devouring King, the one with the keenest senses among the Twelve Demon Kings, made the judgment.
"Before entering, I detected some lingering powerful auras."
"Powerful?"
The War Monkey King's blood-red eyes suddenly turned, like two arrows of blood shot out.
The Dog-devouring King slowly bared its sharp white fangs, being cautious as the War Monkey King could start a fight at any moment.
"Yes, among them, two auras are no less than Brother Golden Dragon!"The rightful source is ɴovelfire.net
"And dozens of other auras are at our same level."
"Furthermore, I've noticed there are no more Saint-tier beings within the Thousand Spirit Domain."
Its observations were very meticulous.
Despite the vastness of the Thousand Spirit Domain, seemingly nothing escaped its notice.
"Where are they?"
The Golden Dragon King's dragon head slowly lowered, interested in these details.
The Dog-devouring King, still maintaining battle spirit facing the War Monkey King, quickly responded respectfully: "I do not know either."
"It's too chaotic here, all auras are fleeting."
The elaborately dressed Female Chicken King laughed coquettishly: "Looks like we nearly missed a grand event."
At this moment, they had confirmed the place is indeed related to ascension.
Otherwise, there wouldn't suddenly be so many strong individuals gathered here.
"No matter where they've gone, as long as they're here, we'll run into them sooner or later."
The War Monkey King waved the stone rod in its hand, with emotions completely heightened.
"Becoming Immortal doesn't matter, I just know there's no more suppression by inter-domain rules here."
"Let's find them quickly and have a great fight!"
The other Demon Kings couldn't be bothered to respond, or even look at it.
The Yashu King's eyes rolled, suddenly chuckling: "It seems the Tiger Race is truly in decline, with the Three-Eyed Tiger even missing this grand event."
"Heard it's been missing for a long time, the Chang Ghost even came to me looking for it."
"Could it really have perished in another Domain?"
"Such a pity, the previous Fierce Tiger King was so formidable..."
The Frost Rabbit King, with a cold face and paws exuding a chilling aura: "Even if that guy appears, I'll skin it first!"

chapters.title: Chapter 189: Narrow Encounter
chapters.content:
As soon as the Celestial Demon Domain entered the Void Immortal Realm, many domains in the Lower Realm also discovered nearby entrances.
The nine entrances of the nine divisions of the Immortal Remnant Race were incessantly visited over a period of time.
The temptation of becoming an immortal was not something many cultivators could resist.
This quickly evolved into a grand event affecting the entire Lower Realm.
Upon entering, Saint-level cultivators could freely move around after expanding their Holy Sanctuary, while those below needed to prepare magical treasures for protection.
Many domains even became rivers of blood in their search for and competition over magical treasures.
Within the Void Immortal Realm, Saint-level experts from various domains would frequently encounter each other.
Some solitary Saint-level experts, upon meeting powerful domains, were unfortunately targeted and perished.
Those powerful domains did not have smooth sailing either.
The rules within the Void Immortal Realm were ever-changing, and an unexpected mishap could easily occur if one wasn't careful.
The process of searching for the passage to the Immortal Realm was also fraught with difficulties.
On the other side, the Feixian Sect's approach was rather unusual.
Amidst thunder and lightning, flying sand and stones, the area covered by the Bone Refining Banner became a mobile Pure Land as the Profound Turtle King continued on.
On the turtle's back, Mo Chen occasionally checked their location and adjusted their direction.
Lan Ti also entered the Xuanji Map for ascetic cultivation.
The Three-Eyed Tiger, Ah Huang, and Jiang Cheng sat together, eating fruits and playing Dou Dizhu.
Of course, it was Brother Cheng who introduced the card game.
The Three-Eyed Tiger, having developed the Dark Gold Demon Body, initially intended to turn over a new leaf and cultivate diligently for a couple of days.
But once Brother Cheng taught Ah Huang the rules of card games, the three became endlessly engrossed, soon forgetting all about cultivation.
This round, the Three-Eyed Tiger was the landlord, and Jiang Cheng gave his obedient daughter a knowing look.
Ah Huang grasped the signal and soon transmitted a message.ᴛhis ᴜpdated by ɴovelfire.net
"It has two bombs and a six-card consecutive straight, no single low cards..."
When playing cards, they had agreed not to use divine thought to peek.
Moreover, the Three-Eyed Tiger had long been guarding its cards using its divine soul and Holy Sanctuary, but Ah Huang simply disregarded these measures.
And there was no perceptible disturbance at all.
After losing numerous times, it naturally sensed something amiss.
"Why are the two of you looking so cunning and unscrupulous?"
Ah Huang was snickering, while Sect Leader Jiang remained serious and unperturbed.
"You're overthinking it."
"But I always feel like my cards have been seen countless times."
"With your intelligence, who could play tricks right under your nose?"
"True enough..."
The Three-Eyed Tiger shook its head, accepting this 'compliment' with a smile.
Three hours later, exhausted from playing, the three of them found places to sleep.
After resting for a while, they got up and ate something.
Mo Chen released the puppet song and dance ensemble to perform an entertainment program for a bit.
Brother Cheng, figuring that nearly a day had passed, summoned a disciple from the Xuanji Map and enhanced their talent once.
After enhancing Ji Linghan's last time, he enhanced Lin Ning's talent once more.
Now, both of these women possessed the Purple Gold Demon Body, with second-class talent.
By his reckoning, he had quite a few trump cards on hand now.
At this point, he retrieved the Holy Pills he'd refined a while ago, deciding to undergo rigorous cultivation once more.
Treasure Pills had long been disregarded by him.
Recently, he had refined more than 3000 bottles of Holy Pills, with up to two thousand bottles used for enhancing spiritual power.
Originally, he thought that with so many pills, ascending to the peak of Saint Tier would be no problem.
But when he actually started using them, he found the domain overly strong, which could often be quite a headache.
The medicinal power of a hundred Holy Pills couldn't even match a single Immortal Pill from before.
In breaking through from the Ascending to Saint Ninth Layer to Saint Tier, he used over a thousand bottles, totaling well over ten thousand Holy Pills.
For other cultivators, if not restricted by bottlenecks, a few dozens of Holy Pills would suffice to clear this stage.
The terrifying disparity in quantity left Mo Chen and the Three-Eyed Tiger Profound Turtle King stunned.
"Sect Leader, your breakthrough seems even harder than a True Immortal advancing to Celestial Immortal."
"There's no helping it, talented people are always envied by the heavens."
Three-Eyed Tiger spared no effort in flattery: "Brother, only geniuses like you can achieve such feats. Others, even if they had ten thousand Holy Pills, would take millennia to refine their medicinal power into spiritual power."
Satisfied by the flattering, Brother Cheng praised, "You surely have insightful perspective, sharply pinpointing the essence of the matter."
The Profound Turtle King also tried hard to join with some praise but ultimately only managed a dry comment: "The master's talent is truly remarkable."
This unimaginative flattery failed to stir any waves.
Finally achieving the status of a Saint-level expert and transforming his domain into a Holy Sanctuary, Jiang Cheng consumed a few hundred bottles of Divine Soul Elixir to elevate his divine soul to the late-stage Saint Tier.
He only stopped because there were just over five hundred bottles of Holy Pills left.
He decided to save these for his disciples.
The Void Immortal Realm was enormous, and at the Profound Turtle King's pace, it would take at least a year to approach the altar.
During this lengthy period, the disciples within the Xuanji Map would experience over eight thousand years.
Lest they run out of medicines in the end.
Along the way, the journey remained relaxing and enjoyable.
Initially, he intended to rendezvous with Heart Division's Qingsuo and the others, but perhaps due to different entrances, he hadn't seen any trace of them since entering.
Thus, the days passed monotonously one by one, as if they were on a leisurely excursion.
On this day, the three playing mahjong on the turtle's back stopped.
Because a massive battle unfolded ahead.
In the high sky, four Demon Kings surrounded and fiercely bombarded two Saint-level experts and over a dozen Ascending to Saint cultivators below.
In an instant, the opponents' magical treasures dimmed.
Subsequently, more than a dozen Ascending to Saint cultivators were swiftly killed, and the two Saint-level experts were completely overwhelmed, their Holy Sanctuaries soon shattered.
Though the number of experts halved, this was still an incredibly swift slaughter.
The two Saint-level experts, one at a late-stage and the other mid-stage, didn't even have a chance to escape.
Jiang Cheng scanned with his system and saw the four Demon Kings consisted of a snake and a sheep, both mid-stage Demon Kings.
And additionally, a pig and a rabbit, both early-stage Demon Kings.
Under normal circumstances, the opposing side shouldn't have fared so poorly and should've even won.
But the combat effectiveness of these Four Great Demon Kings seemed to surpass most Saint-level experts of the same tier.
Just the Sheep Demon alone could keep pushing back the late-stage Saint-level opponent.
However, Brother Cheng's attention was entirely focused on the Rabbit Demon.
For no other reason than that this Rabbit Demon was quite pretty, very human-like in appearance, matching his aesthetic well.
High in the sky, a slim woman with lovely features but two furry long ears on her head wielded sharp claws, sending pink light beams like raindrops below.
Beside him, the Three-Eyed Tiger rubbed its eyes.
"Wow, isn't that the Frost Rabbit King, that little fox?"
Jiang Cheng couldn't help but turn his head: "You know her?"
The Three-Eyed Tiger clenched its fists, smiling maliciously.
"Of course I know them. All four of them are from our Celestial Demon Domain, didn't expect to run into old acquaintances."
While they were speaking, the Four Great Demon Kings had already concluded the battle, taking out the two Saint-level experts from who knows which domain.
Afterward, they looted all their magical treasures and storage rings.
This maneuver seemed very familiar to Brother Cheng.
This group of Demon Kings was no easy matter.

chapters.title: Chapter 190: The Three-Eyed Tiger Is Not What It Used to Be
chapters.content:
"Three-Eyed Tiger, it's actually you!"
The battle had just ended when the Four Great Demon Kings flew over.
Upon seeing Three-Eyed Tiger, Frost Rabbit King showed intense battle intent.
Looks like Three-Eyed Tiger caused no small trouble for her Rabbit Race back in the day.
"You're still alive? Thought you were dead!"
Pig Demon King stuck out a scarlet long tongue, licking his long nose.
"Who's that beside you?"
"Your magical treasure is quite high level."
Snake Demon King's cold gaze flashed with a hint of greed.
"Yo, how's everyone doing!"
Three-Eyed Tiger shook his white fur, raised his paw, and greeted.
"Long time no see, Frost Rabbit King, you old woman! Your figure is even hotter than before."
Even Brother Cheng couldn't help but want to rant.
No wonder this Rabbit Demon is full of hostility when she sees you. With that mouth, you must get beaten wherever you go.
Sheep Demon King, aside from the horns atop his head, looked like an old man.
He hunched his back, stroked his white mountain goat beard, and chuckled, "Little grandson, how did you mix with the Human Race?"
"Are you also like grandpa, yearning for the human world?"
Three-Eyed Tiger curled his lips, disdainful, "Grandpa my ass, you're still calling yourself grandpa? Go take a look at yourself in a mirror!"
That sentence instantly made Sheep Demon King's expression turn constipated.
The other three Demon Kings also looked stunned.
Pig Demon King took two steps back, full of admiration, "Brother, haven't seen you in years, your skill hasn't grown, but your arrogance sure has."
Snake Demon King said softly, "Back then, wasn't it you who got beaten and cried for mercy while escaping all over the mountains?"For more chapters visit Novᴇl_Firenet
"Seems like you weren't beaten enough before."
Sheep Demon King was also enraged, releasing a mid-stage Saint Tier domain full of aggressive aura.
He was about to make a move but was intercepted by Frost Rabbit King.
"He's my target, could you let me have him?"
Sheep Demon King chuckled and truly stepped back.
Brother Cheng, watching the drama, couldn't help but shake his head secretly.
"Turns out you were mixed up so poorly before, no Demon King even saw you in their eyes?"
Three-Eyed Tiger suddenly felt embarrassed.
Back then, it was all black history, unbearable to recall.
"Brother, today don't make a move, let me show off for once!"
Now it's in a dark gold demon body, its power has grown over tenfold compared to before, quite confident.
Jiang Cheng nodded, "Quick battle and quick decision, we need to keep on the road."
"Got it!"
With Brother Cheng's approval, Three-Eyed Tiger confidently flew outside.
"Three-Eyed Tiger, you've really gone backward, need to ask a human before making a move?"
