"That guy is just early-stage Saint Tier, you really are useless."
"Being a human's lackey truly disgraces the Celestial Demon Domain."
"And that Profound Turtle, tsk tsk, being a human's mount, you dare to call yourself a demon?"
The Four Demon Kings expressed disdain, Profound Turtle King casually gave them a foolish look, and couldn't be bothered.
Three-Eyed Tiger showed a frog-in-the-well expression.
"Okay, okay, a bunch of ignorant dullards, how did Master Tiger mix with you country bumpkins before, wasted good youth."
"You four get together, I'm in a hurry."
Once those words were out, the Four Demon Kings were dumbfounded.
Soon they burst into laughter.
"Really insane."
"Probably followed the weak humans too long, forgot about the scent of the Celestial Demon Domain..."
Before Snake Demon King could finish his sentence, a black shadow suddenly approached closely.
Whoosh!
Amidst the strong winds, a piercing sonic boom sounded, like instant teleportation.
Three-Eyed Tiger punched down!
The chaotic rules around shook like a lake struck by a giant mountain, violently, then exploded.
Snake Demon King's reaction was extremely quick, his extended form like a mountain range swiftly coiled, slicing through the air leaving circles of illusion.
Along with it was the vast and chilling Power of the Holy Sanctuary.
But now, it's completely futile against Three-Eyed Tiger.
The illusion had barely spread when a massive sharp claw spanned the skies, covering the sun, suddenly grasping Snake Demon's physical form.
Snake Demon struggled fiercely, the Power of the Holy Sanctuary froze all the blowing sand and even turned the void into a snowy world.
Bang!
The frost shattered easily like drifting snowflakes, that huge claw seemed cast from a hundred refined immortal stones, rules within the domain hit against it, like an ant trying to shake a tree, unable to move it.
Boom!
Three-Eyed Tiger grabbed its form, just like swinging a whip towards the ground hard.
The ground of the Void Immortal Realm was incredibly solid, there was a loud noise, followed by streaks of bright green blood splattering!
Snake Demon King was beaten dizzy, hadn't even had a chance to break free when Three-Eyed Tiger smacked it again!
This time, Snake Demon King's skeleton was left scattered, fainting right on the spot.
The other three Great Demon Kings were almost stunned.
Is this Three-Eyed Tiger?
The one ranked last among the Twelve Demon Kings, usually only daring to bully little demons, running back to the cave mansion upon encountering Demon Kings?
This combat power, almost matches late-stage Demon King!
"Go together!"
Sheep Demon King was the first to charge, Pig Demon King and Rabbit Demon King's reactions weren't slow either.
A big battle erupted.
Domains of the Four Demon Kings interlaced and crisscrossed, fighting from sky to ground, turning day into night.
Large parts of the space were destabilized, rules around got scattered long ago, drifting afar.
The booming noise shook heavens and earth, far surpassing lightning and thunder.
Mo Chen thoughtfully set up a barrier around to block out the sounds and waves, for Sect Leader Jiang to enjoy the show.
The battle ended quickly.
Three-Eyed Tiger's domain wasn't strong, but that dark gold demon body was too miraculous.
Other demon races were still Sacred Bodies, while it stood atop the pyramid of Demon Bodies, the gap was too large.
Demon races, in fights, like to rely on physical forms.
The three other Demon Kings soon found they couldn't engage in hard clashes with Three-Eyed Tiger.
Every collision was like an egg hitting a stone.
Three-Eyed Tiger's casual strike could make their skeletals scream, bodies in intense pain.
Yet their full-force attacks on Three-Eyed Tiger were like having no effect at all, barely scratching.
The dark golden fur exuding the aura of a superior, made them feel terror deep within.
Sheep Demon King's heart was in shock.
Wasn't this late-stage Demon King combat power, it could already match War Monkey King and Golden Dragon King!
Not something they could compete with!
How can Three-Eyed Tiger be so strong?
Boom!
It fell to the ground, reverting to form, even broke one of its massive intertwining sheep horns.
Ugh ugh...
Pig Demon King was beaten and kept vomiting blood, that standout nose got flattened, couldn't even speak to beg for mercy.
"Ah..."
"Get lost!"
On the other side, Frost Rabbit King screamed incessantly, utterly embarrassed, no longer having the previous imposing manner.
Her clothes were torn to shreds, in the end, directly clamped by Three-Eyed Tiger by the waist, faintly passed out.
As the smoke cleared, only Three-Eyed Tiger was left flying in mid-air.

chapters.title: Chapter 192 The Name They Called Was Yours
chapters.content:
Chapter 192: Chapter 192 The Name They Called Was Yours
After a full ten days, Frost Rabbit King finally couldn’t hold back.
"Aren’t you planning to find the entrance to the Immortal Realm?"
Though forced into submission, her longing for the Immortal Realm hadn’t diminished, still hoping to become an immortal.
Following them daily seemed like drifting further from that goal.
Three-Eyed Tiger, just finished playing cards, glared at her.
"Are you stupid?"
"If we weren’t looking for the Immortal Realm entrance, why would we come here to suffer?"
"Really, such a redundant question!"
Frost Rabbit King almost choked on its words.
Do you guys have a misunderstanding of the word ’suffer’?
"But I don’t see any intention of searching from you all."
"We’ve been tirelessly searching, you just can’t see it."
Where have you searched?
Aren’t you just eating, drinking, and having fun all day?
Under the roof of a monster, she had to be patient, forcing a smile to probe indirectly.
"So when will you find it?"
Three-Eyed Tiger’s eyes widened: "Such a major secret, is it something a maid like you can inquire about? Mind your status!"
Frost Rabbit King turned pale with rage.
She swore that when she became an immortal, she would absolutely crush this shameless and detestable tiger demon!
At this moment, Jiang Cheng, on the side, spoke up.
"All right, all right, quiet down, my daughter needs to sleep."
Ah Huang fell asleep quickly.
Once she was asleep, Brother Cheng, noticing another day had passed, called forth a disciple from the Xuanji Map, enhancing some talent.
During this time, he prioritized enhancing the Second and Third Generation Disciples.
He upgraded all of them from Fourth-class Talent to Third-class.
After all, this group had already surpassed the Daoist Palace, and the points given later increased more and more, losing out if not upgraded early.
Frost Rabbit King couldn’t understand what was happening, as enhancing talent showed no special effects.
Meanwhile, Three-Eyed Tiger and Profound Turtle King surely wouldn’t kindly explain to prevent adding another competitor for flattering.
The first time she saw humans with low realm appear out of nowhere, Frost Rabbit King was extremely surprised.
But over time, she grew accustomed to it.
She only knew that these people were disciples of that Jiang Cheng, maybe he had a special Magical Treasure capable of accommodating people?
Boom!
Ahead, a violent roaring sound suddenly erupted, deafening.
Given the sturdiness of the Void Immortal Realm, it wasn’t blown open, but the ground shook incessantly.
Smoke and dust soared, surrounding sand and currents swiftly rotated circle after circle.
In the center, a gigantic ape, surrounded by a blood-colored light mass, tens of thousands of meters tall, descended from the sky!
The recent strike was caused by the stone rod riddled with cracks and patterns in its hand.
"War Monkey King!"
"And the Female Chicken King..."
Behind the giant ape, the flamboyantly colorful, somewhat seductively charming figure was indeed the Female Chicken King.
However, the Female Chicken King didn’t seem overly enthusiastic, instead lowering her head as if in distress.
Frost Rabbit King truly hoped other Demon Kings would come to rescue her.
Such as Golden Dragon King, Yashu King, Dog-devouring King, all super strong figures at peak Demon King levels.
But seeing these two Demon Kings before her, she showed no hint of joy.
Because leading was the War Monkey King.
In terms of combat power, the War Monkey King was second only to the Golden Dragon King.
But it was overly combative, often storming in to beat up other Demon Kings.
Even that would be tolerable, it was terribly temperamental, completely unapproachable, an utter lunatic.
Just look at the Female Chicken King behind it, who likely suffered not a few hardships teaming up all the way here.
"Three-Eyed Tiger, come out and fight!"
Upon appearance, the War Monkey King’s crimson eyes showed only violent madness.
If refused, it seemed like it would pummel everyone together next moment.
As for Three-Eyed Tiger’s previous actions, it didn’t even mention.
Maybe the previous fear was too deep, even Three-Eyed Tiger, possessing a Purple Gold Demon Body, couldn’t help but try hiding.
When the previous Fierce Tiger King was in power, it could face off with War Monkey King evenly.
Due to this, after the old Fierce Tiger King passed from depleted lifespan, it came several times to the Tiger Race for decisive battle with Three-Eyed Tiger.
Every time before, Three-Eyed Tiger would catch wind and escape for shelter, returning when the heat passed.
It’s become a habit.
War Monkey King was an outstanding figure amid peak Demon Kings, far stronger than the previous Sheep King and Snake King.
It had absolutely no confidence.
"Brother..."
"This guy brazenly appears, clearly disregarding you."
"Don’t spare any effort, smack it hard!"
Sect Leader Jiang shot this shameless tiger a glance, do you think I’m dumb?
That lunatic monkey ahead was displeasing to him, but this damned tiger was more hateful.
Actually instigating, using him as a pawn?
"Aren’t you going to show off?"
"Then just show off thoroughly..."
"Brother, I, this... it’s War Monkey King."
"So what, it called your name, not mine."
Brother Cheng smirked: "I wouldn’t dare steal your thunder."
Three-Eyed Tiger’s mouth went dry, wearing a forlorn expression.
With Jiang Cheng not helping, it could only rely on others.
Forget Frost Rabbit King, this female demon may wish nothing more than to beat it.
Profound Turtle King?
Forget it, its power wasn’t even as great as its own.
It turned a pleading gaze towards Mo Chen.
Forget it, this old codger was gloating over its misfortune, don’t count on him for help.
Ultimately, it could only cling to Ah Huang’s thigh once more.
"Miss, you have to save me, that monkey outside is bad, when it goes crazy it even hits your dad..."
Brother Cheng felt hot-tempered, damn it, lucky it wasn’t made a Spirit Pet, taking it out would’ve lost face.
"Don’t corrupt the little one!"
He kicked, sending Three-Eyed Tiger before War Monkey King.
"Three-Eyed Tiger, don’t be a coward, I promise not to kill you, what are you afraid of?"
War Monkey King’s voice was like sharp nails, its low laugh chilling.
With nowhere to retreat, Three-Eyed Tiger gritted its teeth.
"I, I’m afraid your sister isn’t strong enough, unable to satisfy Master Tiger!"
As soon as this was said, Frost Rabbit King and Female Chicken King secretly gave it a thumbs up.
Brother, you’re fierce!
War Monkey King truly had a sister, but her talent wasn’t very high, currently still just a Great Demon.
This was considered its reverse scale.
"Hehehe..."
"Hahahahaha..."
"You’re finally standing up to it!"
Boom!
The stone rod tens of thousands of meters long swept down like a dark lightning bolt.
Three-Eyed Tiger hurriedly dodged, the stone rod striking the ground.
The earth trembled, waves of destructive energy evaporated countless sands into dust in mid-air!
Heat surged, forming rings of blood-red patterns!
The Martial Dao realm attained by Brother Cheng was already Immortal Level, recognizing that this was Destruction Martial Dao!
This War Monkey King’s Destruction Martial Dao was only a step away from Immortal Tier.
No wonder Three-Eyed Tiger feared it so greatly.
Two Holy Sanctuaries unfolded, Three-Eyed Tiger’s Holy Sanctuary rapidly disintegrated.
The vast Holy Sanctuary seemed to evaporate under a scorching sun, growing weaker and weaker.
Meanwhile, on the other side, the two Demon Kings clashed closely together.

chapters.title: Chapter 193: Powerful Combat Power
chapters.content:
Chapter 193: Chapter 193: Powerful Combat Power
This is Three-Eyed Tiger’s only chance to turn the tables by relying on its physical prowess.
The Dark Gold Demon Body shone brilliantly as the White Tiger slashed the void with black shadows, then collided fiercely with the blood-red giant ape!
Boom! Boom! Boom!
The sharp claws struck the stone rod repeatedly, causing more and more cracks to appear.
Bang!
Crash!
Chunks of broken stone fell to the ground!
The stone rod was shattered by the Three-Eyed Tiger!
This scene shocked the Female Chicken King immensely.
From the beginning of the battle, she had retreated far away, with no intention of helping the War Monkey King in the fight.
She honestly became a spectator.
She thought she would see the War Monkey King thrashing other Demon Kings again.
Who knew that the Three-Eyed Tiger, when it truly fought, would be this fierce.
Although the War Monkey King’s stone rod wasn’t an Immortal Artifact, it wasn’t an ordinary stone either, having lasted millions of years without breaking.
Yet today, the Three-Eyed Tiger had destroyed it with its sharp claws!
If this is reported back, even the Golden Dragon King might be surprised.
The Three-Eyed Tiger was rising indeed!
"Awesome!"
Instead of being angry, the War Monkey King howled in excitement.
"Your grandpa is even more awesome!"
The Three-Eyed Tiger was also getting fired up, and after destroying the stone rod, it gradually gained confidence.
So the brother’s Demon Body is this strong?
The once-nightmarish War Monkey King wasn’t unbeatable after all.
Heck, what was there to fear?
Bang! Bang! Bang!
Two massive bodies fiercely clashed in the void, each punch landing with a resounding blow, making it hard to determine a clear winner, flesh and blood flying!
Mo Chen, while setting up the Restriction Barrier, shook his head.
"Using the Dark Gold Demon Body like this, this Tiger Demon is really wasting it."
Jiang Cheng said calmly, "That monkey’s Domain, Spiritual Power Realm, and combat techniques are all much stronger, can’t help it."
"The Sect Leader is right, for the monkey to compete with both a Sacred Body and a Demon Body, it has to be said that it has extraordinary talent."
This battle lasted a full hour.
Both Great Demons were covered in wounds, blood flowing freely, with white bones exposed, staining the land below for miles with a gruesome red.
The War Monkey King’s breath gradually weakened.
No longer did it possess the imposing and blood-filled aura it had when it first appeared.
The limits of the Sacred Body ultimately couldn’t match the Dark Gold Demon Body.
Though also injured, the Three-Eyed Tiger became more courageous the longer it fought, showing no sign of exhaustion even at this point.
"Come on!"
"Weren’t you arrogant?"
"Didn’t you love to fight?"
Boom! Boom! Boom!
The War Monkey King didn’t retreat, stubbornly withstanding the assaults.
Another half hour passed, and the gigantic ape body finally fell with a loud crash.
Like a sprawling mountain collapsing to the ground, the sky brightened significantly.
"Ugh!"
The Three-Eyed Tiger kicked out, sending the War Monkey King on the ground flying far away, motionless like a corpse.
The Female Chicken King was truly stupefied.
She didn’t dare move an inch.
The Frost Rabbit King was also in a daze.
The War Monkey King, who had dominated the Celestial Demon Domain for nearly ten million years and was unchallenged by anyone except the Golden Dragon King, was dead?
Killed by the disgrace of the Demon Race, the Three-Eyed Tiger?
Even though she witnessed the whole process with her own eyes, she still couldn’t believe it.
Their reactions were noticed by the Three-Eyed Tiger, which couldn’t help but shiver.
"With this battle, I declare the mighty rise of the Tiger Race!"
"My journey has never been limited to the Celestial Demon Domain but to all Immortals and Demons!"
This cringe-worthy declaration made Brother Cheng want to roll his eyes.
"Wow, Brother Hu is so cool!"
The Female Chicken King sashayed her sexy figure over: "You’re amazing, I’ve been utterly captivated by your heroic presence."
The Three-Eyed Tiger raised its chin and proudly said, "Since you’ve been conquered, then stay as a maid."
"Huh?"
The Female Chicken King looked dumbfounded.
Maid, what does that mean?
"What, you don’t want to?"
"Fine then, I’ll pluck your feathers right now, I’ve never liked them anyway."
In the Celestial Demon Domain, the Female Chicken King had often mocked it before.
It didn’t have a good impression of her.
"I agree, Brother Hu is so strong, of course, I would be willing to be your maid."
She understood the wisdom of being adaptable, realizing there was no way she could win, and escape was impossible.
Surrender was her only option.
"Not just me, but my Brother Jiang!"
The Female Chicken King was confused again, what brother?
"That Human?"
"Brother Hu, you’re so powerful, why be someone else’s sidekick?"
The Three-Eyed Tiger glared: "Just do your job as a maid, talk less, work more!"
"Oh oh..."
The Female Chicken King was more accepting of her situation than the Frost Rabbit King.
Afterwards, the Three-Eyed Tiger rummaged through, looting all the spoils the War Monkey King had collected along the way.
It left resources usable by the Demon Race, and the rest were submitted to upper management under Sect Leader Jiang.
Brother Cheng was quite satisfied, this tiger offered just the right touches.
Taking down all the male demons and making use of all the female demons, it was very professional and knowledgeable.
The War Monkey King’s group, though just two Great Demons strong, had gained a lot.
From him, they found 25 rings, leaving a portion of pills, spirit stones, and sacred artifacts. After exchanging the rest, they gained an additional 3.6 billion points.
Brother Cheng cast a meaningful glance at the War Monkey King’s ’corpse’ in the distance, suddenly feeling that the Demon Kings of the Celestial Demon Domain were indeed kind-hearted.
Journeying from miles away to deliver treasures and female demons.
He felt a bit guilty not saying thank you.
After taking in the Female Chicken King, the group continued on their journey.
It wasn’t until they had gone far that the War Monkey King’s ’corpse’ began to wriggle, eventually turning into a normal-sized monkey.
Then, it sat back up.
The redness in its eyes had faded, no longer exuding its usual violent aura, but instead gleamed intelligently.
If those Demon Kings of the Celestial Demon Domain saw it again, they might doubt its identity.
"I had to fake death to escape this time."
It shook its nearly broken body and looked toward the distance puzzled.
"What’s with the Three-Eyed Tiger’s body?"
"Why is it so strong?"
On the other side, the Female Chicken King was diligently pouring wine for Jiang Cheng, while secretly transmitting a message.
"Frost Rabbit King, you arrived earlier than I did. What special qualities does this Jiang Cheng have?"
Though forced to become a maid, she was not a mindless puppet.
She still had her thoughts.
"The Three-Eyed Tiger is already so powerful, why would it still submit to him?"
The Frost Rabbit King, who was massaging Three-Eyed Tiger’s shoulders, replied coldly: "How would I know?"
"That Jiang Cheng and he are of the same ilk. I’ve been here for so many days and I’ve never seen the two of them cultivate."
"Could it be because they’re two of a kind?"
The Female Chicken King was puzzled.
Jiang Cheng’s Realm wasn’t even higher than her mid-stage Demon King level; he was only in the early-stage Saint Tier.
Aside from being able to suddenly summon a disciple every day inexplicably, there wasn’t much remarkable about him.
Yet the Three-Eyed Tiger respected him greatly, calling him big brother every day without any apparent reason.
"If only the Golden Dragon King would come, then we could be saved."
The Female Chicken King didn’t argue with the Frost Rabbit King on this point.
Also one of the Twelve Demon Kings, the combat power of the Golden Dragon King was far superior to that of the War Monkey King.
It was even said that even if the other eleven Demon Kings joined forces, they might not be able to defeat it.
It’s because of its presence that the Celestial Demon Domain remains safe.

chapters.title: Chapter 194: The Sect Leader’s Profound Intent
chapters.content:
Chapter 194: Chapter 194: The Sect Leader’s Profound Intent
The team traveled for another three months, during which time everything remained calm.
The Void Immortal Realm is so vast that it’s hard to encounter other domain experts unless you deliberately seek them out.
Jiang Cheng was not like the Celestial Demon Domain and some large domains, thinking about attacking others everywhere.
As long as others haven’t offended him first, he actually has no aggressive desire.
It’s not because he’s merciful, but... how exhausting it would be.
Isn’t it nice to lie down every day?
Meanwhile, the Female Chicken King and the Frost Rabbit King tried several times to secretly win over the Three-Eyed Tiger.
"You’re so powerful, why demean yourself by serving others?"
"Brother Hu, as long as you leave this human race, we’ll stick with you even if we go to the Immortal Realm!"
"They like formidable strong people who stand tall, not someone else’s lackey."
"Brother Hu, you have the strength but lack ambition..."
Unfortunately, ’loyal advice is hard to hear’.
The Three-Eyed Tiger not only didn’t listen but got so angry that it started beating up the two demons.
"I’ll teach you to rebel!"
"I’ll teach you to spread rumors!"
"You’re always thinking about harming me!"
It didn’t want to let go of Sect Leader Jiang’s leg.
Not to mention the potential talent enhancement in the future, just the Dark Gold Demon Body, a show-off weapon it got this time, would have been impossible without Jiang Cheng.
Moreover, following Brother Cheng, there’s no worry about being killed.
Now no one can drive it away, and yet these two demons are trying to convince it to go independent, which is simply going against it.
After being beaten up twice, the Female Chicken King and the Frost Rabbit King finally calmed down for a while.
That day, the Bone Refining Banner above suddenly showed a reaction.
The banner radiated intensely with purple light, pointing to the right front as if ready to fly off that way.
"What’s going on?"
"Why is this Magical Treasure reacting?"
"Could it be pointing to the road to the Immortal Realm?"
Mo Chen was somewhat doubtful and uncertain.
The Void Immortal Realm was opened by the nine Inheritance Treasures, so when it comes to clues to the Immortal Realm, they are certainly the most likely.
"Should we change direction?"
The direction to the altar was pretty clear, but it was a different road from where the Bone Refining Banner pointed.
"Let’s head to the altar first."
Brother Cheng waved his hand, deciding to ignore the guidance of the Bone Refining Banner.
"Brother, why?"
The Three-Eyed Tiger was a bit puzzled.
Instead, Mo Chen caught on quickly.
"You stupid tiger, how can you understand the Sect Leader’s profound intentions?"
"The Void Immortal Realm was obviously created by the Immortal Emperors of the Upper Realm, and the nine Inheritance Treasures were likely left behind intentionally."
"Everything is within the calculations of those Immortal Emperors."
"Choosing the direction of the Bone Refining Banner is to follow the route arranged by others. Who knows what conspiracy might be there in the end."
"In contrast, choosing the altar is something the Upper Realm wouldn’t foresee, which might break the situation!"
Hearing this analysis, Sect Leader Jiang felt slightly embarrassed.
Was my random point so profound?
In fact, he wasn’t thinking much, just felt uncomfortable if he didn’t visit the altar after walking so long.
Who knew Mo Chen would come up with such a profound reason for him?
"Indeed, Elder Mo understands me well. How could this Sect Leader be manipulated by others?"
"Sect Leader is wise!"
Mo Chen sincerely praised aloud, "If not for the Sect Leader’s guidance, even this old man couldn’t have thought of this, and might have chosen the Bone Refining Banner route."
As they continued towards the altar, the War Division of the Immortal Remnant Race, which possessed the Immortal Slayer Spear, also received a similar signal.
The Immortal Slayer Spear pointed in some unknown direction.
Since they originally had no goal, they naturally rushed there without hesitation.
Meanwhile, Qingsuo and other Heart Race People traveled with another group, facing numerous hardships along the way.
Despite neighboring entrances, after entering, they and Jiang Cheng ended up far apart and weren’t able to reunite.
Along the way, they faced many challenges.
If it weren’t for the Heart-Piercing Awl allowing them to battle against Saint Tier, they might have been wiped out long ago.
They were fortunate to eventually join with the Water Tribe, gaining a Saint Tier expert, which finally brought them security.
"I wonder how Jiang Cheng’s side is doing."
"With Sect Leader Jiang’s capabilities, he probably still dominates the Void Immortal Realm effortlessly."
"Yes, it would be even better if we could join him."
Though also one of the nine divisions of the Immortal Remnant Race, the Water Tribe hadn’t had much past conflict with the Heart Division, they weren’t particularly close now either.
They hadn’t communicated for millions of years, and there was a sense of unfamiliarity. The others didn’t really consider them as their own.
They just reluctantly allowed them to travel together, and due to their lack of strength, they faced a lot of disdain along the way.
Thinking back, it was far more comfortable when allied with Jiang Cheng, with no worries and the promise of resurrection even in death, solidly assured.
As the group communicated via transmission,
the Heart-Piercing Awl and the Water Control Bead of the Water Tribe simultaneously lit up.
One pointed left, the other right, both seemingly about to burst through the void.
"Does this mean we’ve finally found the entrance to the Immortal Realm?"
"It must be!"
"Finally, there’s a reaction!"
Everyone from the two teams cheered joyfully at the same time.
However, the two Inheritance Treasures pointed in completely opposite directions.
This left everyone somewhat doubtful and uncertain, not knowing which way to choose for the moment.
The Clan Leader of the Water Tribe, Tu Gu, quickly made a decision, splitting into two parts, each going their own way.
Qingsuo felt a bit uneasy, as splitting up would make the Heart Division vulnerable to other domains again.
But her opinion didn’t matter much, and after Tu Gu’s order, many of the Water Tribe people even privately said they were glad to have thrown off the burden.
This left Qingsuo and others with mixed emotions in their hearts.
They began to question the meaning behind the collective term Immortal Remnant Race.
"Let’s set off too!"
"Once we reach the Immortal Realm, everything will get better."
The Heart Race People nodded silently, embarking once more on an unknown and perilous quest.
However, this journey was much smoother than they imagined.
Guided by the Heart-Piercing Awl, they arrived on an empty grassland in just ten days.
The lush green grassland wasn’t large, only about a mile in area.
But in the sandstorm-ridden, rule-chaotic Void Immortal Realm, it was simply miraculous!
"Ah!"
"Where is this place? The Spiritual Qi is so dense!"
"Entering here, I feel my mind gaining so much insight!"
"Oh my god, could this already be the Immortal Realm?"
They excitedly jumped on the small grassland, having endured months of monotony, this rare pure land was a delight.
Qingsuo also showed a long-awaited smile, soon followed by more good news.
In the center of the grassland, they discovered an unknown Jade Platform.
At the center of the Jade Platform was a groove, shaped exactly like the Heart-Piercing Awl.
"What a coincidence!"
"This must be part of the arrangement by the nine Immortal Ancestors from back in the day."
No wonder their direction and the Water Tribe’s were different, the Water Tribe should have something similar on their side.
"There’s no doubt about it, Clan Leader, quickly put the Heart-Piercing Awl in and see!"
"I bet once you place it, it’ll directly transport us to the Immortal Realm."
"Hahaha, can’t wait."

chapters.title: Chapter 195: 9-Treasure Absolute Immortal Array
chapters.content:
Chapter 195: Chapter 195: 9-Treasure Absolute Immortal Array
Under the urging of her fellow tribespeople, Qingsuo, equally overwhelmed with excitement, with a heart pounding unusually fast, carefully placed the Heart-Piercing Awl into the groove of the Jade Platform.
A beam of white light shot into the sky, then vanished in an instant.
Immediately following that, the Heart-Piercing Awl seemed to merge with the Jade Platform.
Qingsuo suddenly realized she couldn’t move anymore.
Not only her, all the Heart Race People present turned into statues.
They all remained in their ecstatic poses, frozen there.
Qingsuo was still conscious, but her Divine Soul seemed to be sealed away, unable to connect with anyone else.
Looking again at the patterns on the Jade Platform, she only felt an immense strangeness, causing a dizzy spell.
It was as if an unknown thread extended from it, connecting to her heart, slowly drawing the vitality from her body.
Why is this happening?
Weren’t they supposed to appear in the Immortal Realm?
Why did they end up with this conclusion?
She had countless questions she wanted to ask, but she couldn’t open her mouth, nor did she know who to ask.
At the same time, five hundred Water Tribe People at the center of a small lake also turned into statues.
As several Magical Treasures of the Immortal Remnant Race were placed into their respective grooves, everyone in the Void Immortal Realm saw chains spanning the void.
The chains were within reach but had no tangible form, like mere illusions.
Some flew along the chains seeking their origin, but could never find where they led.
"What happened?"
"Did some change occur in the Void Immortal Realm?"
"Is the passage to the Immortal Realm about to appear?"
"Why can I sense an ominous aura from these chains?"
The experts from various Domains responded differently, some were ecstatic, others frowned deeply.
In the distant Upper Realm, within the Immortal Palace.
A Great Power exuding golden light, so bright that even an Immortal Soul couldn’t discern his true form, slowly opened his eyes.
Before him were nine immortals of varied appearances, kneeling.
"Reporting to the Master Ancestor, the Nine Treasures Immortal Extinction Array has finally responded."
The golden immortal shadow slowly spoke, his voice emanating from all directions, "That’s good."
A disciple below respectfully said, "Currently, four Magical Treasures have been positioned."
"Once all Nine Treasures are in place, all living beings in the Void Immortal Realm will be instantly annihilated!"
"After this battle, the millennium’s essence of the Lower Realm will be exhausted."
This plan had been set in motion millennia ago.
Sinking the Chaotic Ruins below to disrupt the Heavens’ Ascension Laws and block Ascenders from the Lower Realm was just the first step.
This step actually had loopholes.
In the Lower Realm’s Ten Thousand Realms, anyone of Demon Level might emerge, especially those with the fortune of a Child of the Plane.
Over tens of millennia, they even might cultivate to transcendental Saint Tier levels.
Eventually, causing rejection by the Heaven and Earth Rules, forcibly expelling them from the Lower Realm Plane.
Back then, the nine Immortals of the Immortal Remnant Race returned to the Immortal Realm for this reason.
To prevent such a situation, the Great Powers of the Immortal Realm laid out the Nine Treasures Immortal Extinction Array in the Void Immortal Realm.
When this array activates, it must absorb the life force of beings within its range as nourishment.
Simultaneously, someone carrying the Nine Magical Treasures must willingly face the tribulation.
Thus, the Great Powers of the Immortal Realm joined forces to obscure the Heavens’ mechanism, sending nine Celestial Immortals to the Lower Realm.
Originally, they intended to send Immortal Kings down, but the aura of the Immortal Kings was too strong, triggering the Heaven and Earth Rules as soon as they entered the Lower Realm, resulting in the death and Dao dissolution of all nine Immortal Kings.
It wasn’t until they lowered the candidates to Celestial Immortals that they finally narrowly escaped the erasure of rules.
The nine Celestial Immortals created the Immortal Remnant Race in the Lower Realm.
They left the nine Magical Treasures with them and revealed the existence of the Void Immortal Realm.
When the Immortal Remnant Race later opened the Void Immortal Realm, how could the experts from various Domains remain indifferent in front of nine entrances? They would follow to explore.
Regardless of who holds the Nine Treasures, even if someone like Bi Feng seizes them, they will eventually return to their respective Array Hub positions according to the guide.
This is a catastrophe destined to happen.
When the destined tribulation beings are exhausted and perish, the Great Array will stop.
At that time, the Void Immortal Realm will close, and the nine masterless Magical Treasures will scatter back to the Lower Realm to be obtained by those ’fated’.
In millennia, when the top experts of the Lower Realm’s Ten Thousand Realms thrive again, new possessors of the Nine Treasures will reopen the Void Immortal Realm sooner or later.
A new round of calamity will sweep through the elite of the Ten Thousand Realms once more, like reincarnation.
Cycling perpetually, not giving the Lower Realm even a slight chance to rise.
Why don’t the nine Celestial Immortals simply destroy the Lower Realm?
Because it’s impossible.
Forget about the Lower Realm with its Ten Thousand Realms, even exterminating a single Realm’s billions of lives would cause them to be prematurely devoured by that boundless Karmic Force and die.
Even the Great Powers of the Immortal Realm involved in the plan would be entangled by that Karmic Force, leading to their gradual decline.
Originally, they thought the Nine Treasures would return to position within a millennium.
But unexpectedly, when the Immortal Remnant Race’s first expedition went up, many tribespeople were prematurely killed by chaotic currents and Blood Evil Qi and withdrew hurriedly.
Even more unexpectedly, increasing conflicts emerged among the nine divisions, and they haven’t cooperated to open it again for nearly ten million years, each dying without communicating.
Thankfully, it finally opened now.
After waiting a few more days, eight Magical Treasures have returned to position.
Just one more, and the Great Array will activate!
In these days, many top Great Powers in the Immortal Realm were waiting for this historic moment to arrive.
However, after waiting three more months, the Great Array remained unchanged and did not activate.
"Which one hasn’t returned to position?"
"It’s the Bone Refining Banner!"
Although these Great Powers have millions of years of cultivation, a few months is but a blink, yet they couldn’t help feeling a rare impatience.
During these millions of years without Ascension, the Lower Realm’s Ten Thousand Realms surely have produced a bunch of Demon Level Saint Tier prodigies.
If these talents successfully reach the Immortal Realm, it would be troublesome.
Who knows how many of them are Children of the Plane?
Perhaps several Profound Luo Immortal Emperors could emerge.
They don’t want to see this happen.
They would rather eliminate any potential threats early.
If they could, they’d even want to send someone to hasten the process.
Hurry up, stop dawdling!
You’ve been given the Bone Refining Banner to complete your current mission, put more effort into it!
Obscuring the Heaven’s mechanism and sending people down isn’t so simple, they can’t interfere with the Void Immortal Realm and can only wait.
Unfortunately, Sect Leader Jiang can’t sense the close attention of so many Great Powers of the Immortal Realm.
Their inner cries go unheard by Sect Leader Jiang.
He sees the sky-filled chains.
But remains indifferent, resolutely advancing towards the Altar.
If the Great Powers of the Immortal Realm saw this scene, they’d probably jump with urgency.
The Altar is the key to keeping the Void Immortal Realm submerged.
Because of the Altar’s suppression, the Chaotic Ruins remain docilely between the Immortal Realm and the Lower Realm.
If something happens to the Altar, what would occur?
No one can predict.

chapters.title: Chapter 196 What Is This All About?
chapters.content:
Chapter 196: Chapter 196 What Is This All About?
That day, Jiang Cheng and the others finally arrived near the altar.
Looking at the seemingly endless Black Jade platform ahead, stretching high into the sky, everyone felt waves of terrifying pressure.
"Old Mo, do you call this an altar?"
The platform ahead was layered, seemingly like towering mountains.
As for its size, it was probably no less than tens of thousands of miles.
Not to mention an altar, even a city in the Lower Realm isn’t this large.
"It is indeed an altar; back then we launched our attack from here to the other side."
Looking at the familiar platform, Mo Chen couldn’t help feeling a myriad of emotions.
"After millions of years, I didn’t expect the altar to remain undamaged, just like it was back then."
"Yet, the billions of Immortal Demons that died here back then can never resurrect."
Suddenly, from behind came a chilling laugh.
"Thank you all for leading the way."
"Following you for a year indeed wasn’t a waste of effort."
"We’ll be the first to lay claim to this treasure land!"
Before anyone could react, five colored fumes rose from the dust behind.
"The five Ghost Kings from the Cold Nether Domain?"
The Three-Eyed Tiger and Mo Chen were both shocked, never imagining that for a year someone was constantly spying on them.
These people hid too deep, didn’t they?
The five Ghost Kings initially explored the entrance to the Immortal Realm themselves, but after several days with no clue,
they returned and found Jiang Cheng’s group anew.
Brother Cheng’s Bone Refining Banner was one of the tools to open the Void Immortal Realm, an obvious clue.
Rather than aimlessly searching, it was better to follow him.
Such a thing can’t be accomplished by others in the Saint Realm, as regardless of Holy Sanctuary or Divine Soul Treasure, they can easily be sensed.
Only the five of them could survive here without needing treasures or emanating any fluctuations.
They truly remained undiscovered.
They didn’t witness the disciples of Feixian Sect attaining Demon Body but saw the Three-Eyed Tiger fiercely battling the Demon Kings.
This mighty combat power forced them to extinguish the thought of snatching the Bone Refining Banner.
They continued to hide and track from behind.
Watching those few guys indulging in pleasure every night while they could only hide and suffer, the five Ghost Kings were extremely annoyed.
But fortunately, today their tough times have finally come to an end.
In a barren land that never changed, suddenly appeared an overwhelmingly magnificent ’city’; even thinking calmly, they could tell there must be treasures inside.
This is something to seize first, of course!
Before anyone could react, the five fumes instantly dissipated into the Void.
The Ghost Kings had already charged into the altar’s area.
Immediately, cries of misery echoed from inside.
"Ah..."
"No!"
"Let go of me!"
Accompanied by five crisp bursting sounds, five patches of colored dust fell to the ground ahead.
That seemed to be the bodies of the five Ghost Kings.
With a gust of wind, not a trace remained.
Brother Cheng and the others looked at each other, somewhat dazed.
What just happened?
They only knew it seemed they were deceived, the opponents’ plot succeeded, and then nothing more.
"Are the five Ghost Kings dead?"
"Cough, they should be."
What is going on here?
Aren’t they supposed to be grateful for them using their lives to identify danger?
"They were too impulsive."
"People die for wealth, treasures captivate people’s hearts..."
The Frost Rabbit King and Female Chicken King, who initially wanted to dash forward and explore, were instantly chilled halfway.
"It’s too dangerous here; who can survive reaching the altar?"
The Three-Eyed Tiger couldn’t help but complain.
"Old Mo, what the hell did you point to? Wasting our time for nothing."
Mo Chen was also somewhat helpless.
"Seems I was mistaken; after all, this was crafted by the collective efforts of various Demon Emperors, leaving behind their methods. And in the Lower Realm, even reaching True Immortal is impossible, let alone getting here."
The outside Blood Evil Qi was about to solidify.
Perhaps due to the altar, even the rule turbulence was more intense here.
The Bone Refining Banner floated in mid-air, reluctant to advance, seemingly afraid of the Black Jade Altar.
Even the Profound Turtle King couldn’t stabilize itself.
The group was like a lone boat in the ocean, always at risk of overturning.
A slight probe outside, and everyone’s Divine Thought was instantly obliterated!
Frankly, this altar was too high-end.
High-end enough that creatures from the Lower Realm couldn’t even approach, even if they had nine Inheritance Treasures it would be useless, only able to glance from afar.
"Bro, if it’s really impossible, why don’t we follow the Bone Refining Banner’s guidance and head in another direction?"
Sect Leader Jiang shook his head: "Retreat isn’t in my dictionary!"
"Bro, so heroic! Even a casual word of yours is philosophical."
While flattering, the Three-Eyed Tiger suggested: "How about this, let these two maidservants explore the road first."
"If they die, it means nothing to us."
"If they die a few hundred times, maybe they’ll find a safe path in."
Upon hearing this, the Female Chicken King and Frost Rabbit King simultaneously cursed aloud.
"Three-Eyed Tiger, you despicable thing!"
"We are irreconcilable with you!"
"If I survive and return, I’ll definitely wipe out your tribe to prevent the likes of you from cropping up again!"
"Sect Leader Jiang, please don’t listen to him..."
The two still had no idea Brother Cheng could resurrect and didn’t want to die in vain.
Jiang Cheng gave this shameless tiger a faint look, realizing these two female Demon Kings were mere tools to test paths in its eyes?
Even though these Demon Kings weren’t his own people, they had been together for half a year.
Served well every day, even if forced, it at least made them familiar.
Even he couldn’t be so ruthless, and the tiger was their fellow from the same domain.
Can’t it have a bit of decency?
"Enough, how can I let others face danger?"
Brother Cheng stood alone on the head of the Profound Turtle King, boldly looking at the towering altar ahead.
Chest muscles firm: "As Sect Leader, in times of crisis, I must charge to the front line!"
For others it’s a place of death; for him, what does it matter?
With the system’s Resurrection Skill, fearing nothing.
The Three-Eyed Tiger looked suspicious; it didn’t believe Jiang Cheng was that noble.
"Bro, are you serious?"
Mo Chen, rare for him, advised: "Sect Leader, think twice; the altar embodies the methods of an Immortal Emperor, and the surrounding rule turbulence is ten times more dangerous than elsewhere!"
"It’s really too risky."
He always trusted a Child of the Plane’s luck, that even impossible tasks could succeed.
But can luck withstand the methods of an Immortal Emperor, plus rule turbulence?
He couldn’t guarantee this time.
But Jiang Cheng’s mind was made up.
After intentionally turning back to show a dignified smile, he flew forward, leaving the Bone Refining Banner’s range.
In an instant, he was locked by the rule turbulence and the altar’s attacks.
He didn’t have any chance to react.
No chance to resist.
The methods of the Demon Emperor were far beyond his current realm, not to mention those left by the combined efforts of many Demon Emperors.
In less than a second, he was utterly killed.
The group behind hadn’t even had the chance to look closely when they found Sect Leader Jiang missing.

chapters.title: Chapter 197: The Handsome Hero
chapters.content:
Chapter 197: Chapter 197: The Handsome Hero
"Ding, the host has been killed, evaluating the enemy’s power and preparing a resurrection plan."
The system notification sounded as expected.
Then, it fell into a long silence.
It seemed like the situation was complicated this time, and the system needed some effort to resolve it.
After all, it wasn’t just the altar that killed him this time, but also the turbulent rules, making it difficult to apply a one-time fix.
Brother Cheng grew a little impatient waiting; hey, it’s almost 30 seconds now.
System bro, are you going to break the rules?
Feeling a bit underwhelming.
"Ding, the host’s spirit of bravely challenging the Wàn Mó Forbidden Altar has finally moved the Ruins Essence, and it has decided to lend a helping hand!"
What?
What Ruins Essence?
Could it be that the Void Immortal Realm has its own consciousness?
"Ding, host resurrected."
As soon as he came back to life, Brother Cheng noticed something different.
The turbulent rules that tore him apart instantly were now keeping a distance, not harming him at all.
Not only that, but the altar’s deadly attacks were also forcibly kept out by the turbulent rules.
The range wasn’t large, only three feet around him.
However, these three feet became the safest blank space in the entire Void Immortal Realm.
"Young hero, welcome to your arrival!"
An old voice echoed in his mind.
Brother Cheng’s lips twitched; what hero fancy is this?
Hit with a wave of cringe?
"Who’s talking?"
"I am the Ruins Essence, thank you for coming to save me."
When did I save you?
Brother Cheng looked around: "Where are you?"
"I am everywhere, the entire ruins are my embodiment."
"So awesome?" Brother Cheng was a little taken aback.
"Alright, young hero, time is short. Please follow my guidance and destroy that damned altar!"
What’s with this way of speaking?
Brother Cheng suspected it might be some NPC?
Nevertheless, the altar looked highly unsettling, and it was the culprit for his death; it did need to be destroyed.
"Destroying the altar is fine, but can I make a request?"
The Ruins Essence apparently didn’t expect the ’hero’ to make demands, so it paused for a moment.
"What is your request?"
"Please call me the handsome hero!"
The Ruins Essence was taken aback once more and only after a long while did it say, "Very well, handsome hero."
"We should head out now."
"I will help shield you from the altar’s attacks."
"Please give your all to destroy it!"
Everyone still on the turtle’s back then saw Sect Leader Jiang’s figure suddenly reappear, flying towards the altar without saying a word of greeting.
"As expected of the master, being able to survive, amazing, amazing!"
"The Sect Leader indeed is a person protected by great fortune, to emerge unscathed from a sure-death scenario!"
The Three-Eyed Tiger looked at the shocked faces of the Frost Rabbit King and Female Chicken King, and said enviously, "Once again, Brother Cheng steals the spotlight."
Amidst their chatter, Brother Cheng had already flown above the altar.
"Handsome hero, come with me to the top of the altar."
"Lead the way!"
Jiang Cheng continued flying upward, flying countless miles until finally reaching the top of the altar.
Above the altar was a pure white small tower.
The tower stood just three meters tall, forming a stark contrast with the jet-black altar.
The surfaces of the tower were engraved with intricate and bizarre patterns that made one extremely uncomfortable just to look at.
"This is the core of the altar and the weakest part, quickly destroy this tower."
Brother Cheng felt a bit annoyed; what’s with this tone?
"Who are you talking to?"
"..."
The Ruins Essence was momentarily speechless and had to rephrase.
"Handsome hero, I beseech you to destroy this tower!"
Only then was Brother Cheng satisfied and he drew his Saint Artifact Mahayana Long Departure Sword.
Gathering all his spiritual power, he struck it down fiercely.
Clang!
The Holy Sword carried an imposing force of sky-shattering might, colliding violently with the tower’s base, finally making a metal clashing sound.
Sparks flew, and a shallow notch appeared on the base, as small as a grain of rice.
"Damn, is this tower so hard?"
He had guessed the tower wouldn’t be easy to destroy, given the handiwork of Immortal Emperor of the Immortal Realm.
Otherwise, he wouldn’t have brought out the Saint Artifact.
But he never expected it to be this difficult.
This is supposed to be the altar’s weakest spot?
Mind you, just in terms of attack power, Jiang Cheng had long surpassed the Saint Tier’s limits.
With the backing of the Chaos Demon Body, coupled with the Immortal Body, and the unprecedented formidable Holy Sanctuary, and the system-drawn Great Perfection Swordsmanship.
Though still in the early-stage Saint Tier, truth be told, in close combat, even Celestial Immortals wouldn’t stand a chance against him.
The force of this sword, if placed outside, could cause natural disasters to alter landscapes.
Yet here, it only resulted in this minimal damage.
If it were other Saint Tier experts within the Void Immortal Realm, they probably wouldn’t even manage to leave a scratch.
The Ruins Essence wasn’t disappointed, feeling instead quite thrilled.
Excitedly, it said: "Handsome hero, you truly are the one sent by heaven to break this calamity, to be able to damage this altar."
The title of the catastrophe-breaker made Brother Cheng deeply reflect.
Why does it feel like my character is now similar to some Eastern monk who broke a seal and released a monkey from under the mountain?
Clang, clang, clang...
He struck dozens more times, with dozens of grain-sized notches now on the base.
Compared to that base, it was a mere drop in the ocean.
Seeing his Holy Sword even chip a little, he was heartbroken and tossed the sword aside.
"No more chopping, dead tired, by the year of the monkey, will this be done?"
The Ruins Essence panicked: "Handsome hero, please continue, as long as you persist, you will eventually slice through this tower!"
"How long?"
"A year? Three years? Or ten years?"
Brother Cheng rolled his eyes, sat down directly, and even rubbed his fingers.
"Do you think I’m here for hard labor?"
Is this truly the catastrophe breaker prompted by heavens?
The Ruins Essence suddenly felt doubtful of life itself, this is not following the script!
Heroes are supposed to go crazy, toiling tirelessly to complete guidance tasks after receiving a mission, no?
"Handsome hero, this is heaven testing your perseverance!"
Bah, Brother Cheng snorted in disdain at this.
"Are you fooling a child?"
"Alright, be honest, if this tower’s broken, what do you get?"
The Ruins Essence didn’t want to say, but looking at Sect Leader Jiang’s stance, he was ready to drop everything any second.
In the end, it could only narrate the story.
"I would gain freedom."
"A million years ago, those Immortal Emperors and Demon Emperors in the Immortal Realm suppressed me with two altars, knocking me down from the Immortal Realm to here, unable to break free."
Jiang Cheng casually remarked, "Are you that weak? Can’t move with only two altars?"
"These two altars engaged in a blood sacrifice of billions of Immortal Demons, and the immense Blood Evil Qi eroded my qi, leaving me extremely weakened, hence unable to resist."
This simple sentence made Brother Cheng shuddered in surprise.
He previously wondered why the timeline between the Immortal Demon War Mo Chen mentioned and the appearance of the Void Immortal Realm were so close, and the places so coincidental.
Now he finally understood.
That so-called Immortal Demon War was actually just to suppress the Void Immortal Realm.
Immortal Mo also met a tragic end, joining the battle only to be used as a sacrifice back then.

chapters.title: Chapter 198: Do Favors Before Handling Affairs
chapters.content:
Chapter 198: Chapter 198: Do Favors Before Handling Affairs
"So after destroying this tower, do I have to go destroy another altar of the Immortal Race?"
The Ruins Essence knew just from Jiang Cheng’s impatient tone that this kid might drop everything and ditch at any moment.
"Not necessary, once you destroy one, I can recover part of my power."
"As for the other, I can manage to break free myself by then."
Finally, Sect Leader Jiang breathed a sigh of relief. One tower was already annoying enough; if there was another, wouldn’t he be endlessly bothered?
"So according to you, I’m rescuing you then."
"Yes, handsome Hero, I will always remember your kindness."
Oh, come on, can’t you offer something tangible?
Always talking about remembering kindness, it’s all fluff.
He chuckled, rubbed his fingers together, and said, "Isn’t there some tangible benefit?"
"You’ve lived for so many years, surely you have quite a few collections, right?"
The Ruins Essence struggled to resist swearing, and sulkily said, "No..."
This guy really wants me to work for nothing?
"I’m rescuing you, yet you haven’t put in any effort and just stand by watching the show?"
"And you aren’t offering any reward at all?"
"That’s deeply disheartening."
Brother Cheng stood up directly, pretending to walk away.
"Handsome Hero, please stop!"
The Ruins Essence quickly tried to keep him; the hero’s style greatly differed from what he expected, forcing him to appeal emotionally and logically.
"Once I break free and leave here, the Ascension Rules will return to normal."
"This is a monumental act benefiting billions of beings in the Lower Realm!"
Such talk couldn’t fool Sect Leader Jiang; he scoffed, dismissively saying, "Their ascension doesn’t concern me, what do I gain?"
"You can ascend to become an Immortal too in the future..."
Jiang Cheng calmly responded, "Do you think with my handsome looks, I won’t become an Immortal?"
The Ruins Essence found it hard to refute.
Given Jiang Cheng’s Immortal Demon Body continued cultivation, surpassing the Lower Realm Plane’s limits, eventually causing plane rejection and being forced into the Immortal Realm was inevitable.
His keen interest in the Void Immortal Realm was just to get to the Immortal Realm sooner.
After a long struggle, the Ruins Essence finally had to reluctantly make some concessions.
"I can gift your Holy Sanctuary with a new Main Rule."
What, there’s such a benefit?
The moment a Holy Sanctuary forms, several rules are generated.
These rules, birthed from the cultivator’s own Holy Sanctuary, are the closest and easiest to control, hence called Main Rules.
The potential number of Main Rules is determined right then.
Even if one becomes an Immortal in the future, they continue refining those Main Rules.
Rules learned via other paths can only be considered Secondary Rules.
Secondary Rules aren’t birthed from one’s own Holy Sanctuary; even if somewhat mastered, they still fall short.
Thus, the more Main Rules, the mightier one becomes.
Typically, a Saint Tier Expert’s Holy Sanctuary has three to five different Main Rules.
Brother Cheng never studied rules, but due to his profound Martial Dao foundation, he directly obtained nine rules upon forming his Holy Sanctuary.
That was already quite outstanding.
Exceeding nine rules in the Saint Realm is rare indeed.
"You can do such a thing?"
According to Mo Chen, gifting another’s Holy Sanctuary with a Main Rule was simply unheard of and even Immortal Emperors couldn’t do it.
"Of course, upon entering the Ruins, you should have seen rampant Rule flows everywhere, right?"
"Rules are my greatest specialty."
The Ruins Essence uncharacteristically indulged in some pride.
"Impressive, impressive."
Brother Cheng gave him a thumbs-up, then asked with a cheerful grin, "So you have lots of rules, how many in total?"
The Ruins Essence proudly stated, "Nine hundred ninety-nine!"
"What?"
Jiang Cheng immediately jumped up.
"You have 999 rules, yet you only gift me one?"
"Why are you so stingy?"
"Tsk tsk tsk, where’s your conscience?"
Looking at his heartbroken expression, the Ruins Essence was puzzled; what does this have to do with conscience?
"It’s not that I’m stingy; too many Main Rules would overwhelm the Holy Sanctuary."
"Moreover, with so many Main Rules, once you become an Immortal later, you simply can’t refine them all; instead, they’d hinder your progress."
"Even if I provided them, you couldn’t handle it."
Sect Leader Jiang wasn’t interested in all that; he just knew that more was better.
rules, laid out, would be prestigious.
The Immortal Realm would have none to compare!
"That’s my problem; it depends on whether you’re willing to give them."
The Ruins Essence was stuck for words.
The main reason for his reluctance was that offering rules to others was akin to draining himself, requiring at least hundreds of billions of years to recover.
If it wasn’t for his desperation, he wouldn’t have given such compensation.
Since the first day the Immortal Realm appeared, he’s existed, yet no cultivator obtained a single rule from him.
Seeing his demeanor softening, Sect Leader Jiang promptly seized the opportunity.
"You really are stubborn."
"Providing more Main Rules would strengthen my Holy Sanctuary significantly, increase my power, and speed up my attacks!"
"See, I’m not just doing this for myself; it’s also to help you break free sooner."
Appealing emotionally and logically was something Brother Cheng was well-versed in.
"To think I care so much, yet you, the one being rescued, dawdle around, is disappointing!"
The Ruins Essence didn’t believe this guy was doing it for him.
Clearly, he wasn’t going to act unless he gained something.
However, Jiang Cheng’s argument wasn’t entirely false.
Even if he couldn’t refine those Main Rules immediately, merely increasing the number was enough to bring monumental changes to his Holy Sanctuary.
His power would indeed grow stronger.
"Alright, since you demand it!"
"Reveal your Holy Sanctuary!"
Without hesitation, Sect Leader Jiang unleashed his Holy Sanctuary that spanned over a million miles.
Although anything beyond three feet was quickly obliterated by the altar, the area within three feet remained intact.
The Ruins Essence was even more astonished.
"Your Holy Sanctuary is this large? How did you manage that?"
Brother Cheng feigned confusion: "Isn’t it a normal setup for a unique handsome hero?"
The Ruins Essence finally recognized that this guy indeed was a King Bi.
"I’m starting to grant rules; if it becomes unbearable, let me know early."
He didn’t plan to give away all 990 rules. Estimating, even for such a large domain, a hundred rules might be the limit.
"My biggest trait is having a huge appetite, go ahead!"
Immediately, a fiery red line appeared in Jiang Cheng’s domain.
He felt the heat and warmth at once; this was the Fire Rule.
As soon as it entered his domain, he felt incredibly close to it, as though it was born within his domain.
This rule was still very weak for now, given he just obtained it.
Thinking ahead to mastering it completely required immense effort.
Refining it to Great Perfection would demand a particularly lengthy time.
However, this rule became his Main Rule right from the beginning.
Hence, his domain rules were now more complete, and his Holy Sanctuary’s power was strengthened further.
This was merely the beginning.

chapters.title: Chapter 199: Are You Kidding Me?
chapters.content:
Chapter 199: Chapter 199: Are You Kidding Me?
Immediately, colorful threads of other rules appeared within his Holy Sanctuary.
As soon as they entered, they quickly drilled deep into the Holy Sanctuary.
And naturally swam beneath the corresponding Martial Dao foundation and fused with it.
After imparting over a hundred threads, the Ruins Essence stopped.
"Is it done?"
"There are too many Main Rules; you can’t master them all. Haven’t you felt the instability of the Holy Sanctuary yet?"
Brother Cheng looked bewildered: "What are you talking about? I feel great."
"Hurry up and continue! Bring it on, exhaust me!"
The Ruins Essence was speechless and could only continue.
Just like that, until the final 990 threads, Brother Cheng never said to stop.
When all 990 Main Rules were integrated into the Holy Sanctuary, Jiang Cheng now had a total of 992 Main Rules.
This was because several of the 9 Main Rules he originally had overlapped with those 990 wires.
These 992 Main Rules were fused with the nine major Martial Dao foundations, greatly advancing his understanding of the Holy Sanctuary.
But correspondingly, his Holy Sanctuary indeed became several times more chaotic.
Unlike other Saint Tier experts, whose Main Rules in their Holy Sanctuary were well-ordered and easily controlled.
The bleeding Ruins Essence gloated: "Your current Holy Sanctuary is not even as clear as an Ascending to Saint realm. All 992 rules are at Chaos Level."
"Before these rules are practiced to the Entry Realm, you can’t condense the Holy Sanctuary into a Daoist Heart."
Having the Daoist Heart is the mark of becoming an Immortal.
At that time, all rules reside within the Daoist Heart.
The power is many times stronger than at the Saint Tier.
After becoming an Immortal, to continue improving mainly involves cultivating that Daoist Heart to make it increasingly strong.
But condensing the Holy Sanctuary into a Daoist Heart requires all Main Rules to be honed to the Entry Realm as a basic condition.
This needs a deep understanding of the rules, requiring extensive insight and countless years.
In the eyes of the Ruins Essence, this kid never seemed hopeful of becoming a true Immortal in this lifetime.
Raising 992 Main Rules from Chaos Level to Entry Level would take eons, probably not even achieving a tenth before exhausting his lifespan.
I’d like to see how you handle this in the future!
After all, he just wanted to escape now, couldn’t care less about Jiang Cheng’s future ascension to Immortality.
"That’s for others. With my unparalleled Ten Thousand Ancient talent, do you think this is a difficult task for me?"
Brother Cheng couldn’t be bothered to overthink it.
He only knew that despite his Holy Sanctuary’s chaos, its overall strength was at least ten times greater than before!
No choice, the Main Rules had increased a hundredfold.
Even if he couldn’t control them well, the total amount was there.
"Can we continue destroying this tower now?"
"Of course, we agreed, we have the most contract spirit."
Brother Cheng picked up the sword he had just thrown away, then released the Holy Sanctuary and directed a full-force strike at the tower’s base.
Bam!
A dull sound, this time the tower was chopped with a dove egg-sized gap.
Its power was vastly increased from before.
The 992 Main Rules empowered Holy Sanctuary was indeed formidable.
Small fragments flew off, and a plume of white smoke rose lazily.
"Great!"
Seeing this result, the Ruins Essence cheered.
"At this rate, you won’t need a million years to succeed!"
Brother Cheng thought to himself, are you bad at math? The tower’s base is only half a meter long and wide. Cutting a dove egg-sized gap at a time, you could cut through it in less than a day, right?
Need a million years?
Suddenly, his gaze froze.
He saw the small gap he had just cut was slowly smoothing out, as if it had the ability to self-heal.
Looking at the smaller previous gaps, they had already healed completely, as good as new.
"What the hell is going on?"
"Come, explain it to me."
"Cough..."
The Ruins Essence coughed awkwardly before reluctantly explaining, "This tower is connected to the entire altar."
"So?"
"So any external damage here is compensated and repaired by the altar’s power."
"But you don’t need to worry, the altar doesn’t repair that quickly. As long as you cut faster, a million years should roughly do it."
Damn!
It’s no wonder the Ruins Essence had been trapped for tens of millions of years without escaping.
"Are you kidding me?"
Spend a million years swinging a sword here?
Brother Cheng said he’d rather die than live like that, even if he couldn’t resurrect.
He couldn’t bear it for a million years, let alone just one year.
"Handsome hero, you took my rules, and you said you’re most contract-bound."
For an entity like the Ruins Essence, who has existed since the Immortal Realm’s birth, a million years was nothing.
He didn’t want Jiang Cheng to give up.
"Damn it, so this was your plan all along."
Brother Cheng gritted his teeth: "So those 990 rules were given so readily, you dug a pit for me!"
"Hehehe, handsome hero, you’ve misunderstood..."
The Ruins Essence rarely tricked him, now secretly laughing on the side.
"Looks like I have to show some real skills."
Brother Cheng sighed; for these Main Rules, it was inevitable to suffer a bit.
"Oh?"
The Ruins Essence was surprised: "Do you have other means?"
He was skeptical.
A Saint Tier, no matter how strong, is limited.
Brother Cheng was already breaking that limit.
Truthfully, encountering a Saint Tier with such attack power in the Lower Realm, the Ruins Essence was secretly grateful to the heavens.
To grant him such a... oh no, strong and powerful helper.
Jiang Cheng did not reply; he opened the system panel and activated the Critical Strike Skill.
Critical Strike: The host can consume points to make the next attack have a 10x critical effect, with a cooldown of one day.
Opening the Critical Strike, the panel showed he was now at late-stage Saint Tier.
This was calculated according to his Divine Soul Level.
It consumed one billion points at early-stage Saint Tier, and now, at late-stage Saint Tier, it required three billion points per use!
To avoid swinging a sword for a million years continuously, Brother Cheng had no other choice.
He unleashed his Domain with full force, using Azure Dragon Suppression, Poison Heroic Soul, Heroic Soul of the Prison, and the like.
Simultaneously activated his Immortal Body and Demon Body!
He used several Holy Pills to recover and adjust his state.
Finally, he activated the Critical Strike Skill.
Using a move from the Great Perfection Saint Tier Swordsmanship "Primordial White Sun Sword" that could triple attack power, but required burning all his Spiritual Power, with severe side effects.
He swung powerfully downwards!
In the void, nothing was visible.
With that sword, the altar, stretching tens of thousands of miles, was instantly enveloped in a white glow!
The surrounding chaotic rule flow and altar’s power couldn’t overshadow its brilliance!
Although, in an instant, it was dispersed by the chaotic rule flow and the altar.
Yet that instant of light was incomparably dazzling!
Even the group waiting far below was deeply shaken.
"What kind of power is this?"
"Who wielded it?"
Even Mo Chen was perplexed: "Could another Immortal have descended?"
Boom!
With a loud noise, the three-meter-high white Treasure Tower was cleaved and sent soaring through the air!
The entire base of the tower was completely severed, and endless black gas soared into the sky!

chapters.title: Chapter 200 Why Not Use It Sooner
chapters.content:
Chapter 200: Chapter 200 Why Not Use It Sooner
When the White Tower was knocked away, black qi soared skyward from the altar.
Immediately afterward, the blood fiend qi within the altar, far denser than that outside by thousands of times, also surged upwards!
Fortunately, Jiang Cheng had already achieved the Chaos Demon Body.
This blood fiend qi no longer affected him; otherwise, he would have surely died again.
At the same time, the surrounding region’s blood fiend qi also rapidly evaporated.
As if suddenly freed from some kind of constraint.
The indestructible altar below was collapsing swiftly, dust billowing!
In the distance, the Profound Turtle King and everyone on its back were all hit by the violent impact, thrown thousands of miles away.
"What the hell happened?"
"The altar was destroyed?"
"Could it be the Lord’s doing?"
The Profound Turtle King was somewhat puzzled, and the Three-Eyed Tiger enviously said, "Such a big scene, Brother Cheng probably wasn’t that extravagant, right?"
"And weren’t we supposed to find the Celestial Realm connection in the altar?"
"Now that the altar is destroyed, what do we do..."
Its complaint wasn’t finished before Mo Chen suddenly roared.
"Well done!"
"Old Mo, you startled me..."
The Three-Eyed Tiger turned to look, only to find the face of the world-weary old immortal extremely solemn.
He stared at the blood shadows soaring above the altar, which finally dissipated, suddenly comprehending many things.
In them, he saw some familiar figures.
Those were comrades who had fought alongside him in the ancient ’Immortal Demon War’.
When this sealed altar was destroyed, numerous great powers in the Celestial Realm were utterly shocked.
"The altar was destroyed?"
"Who did this?"
"Something has happened in the Void Immortal Realm."
"Can a person from the Lower Realm break that altar?"
"The Ruins have been freed!"
"The seal on the Lower Realm is about to be broken, and the Ascension rules will soon be restored..."
"Time to activate the Fake Immortal Realm!"
When this altar was demolished, at the far end of the Void Immortal Realm, another great array sealing myriad immortals also collapsed!
With the destruction of both altars, the blood fiend qi throughout the Ruins quickly dissipated.
Experts exploring various domains of the Void Immortal Realm, at this moment, all sensed something different.
"What happened?"
"Why does everything around here seem much clearer, as if a layer of constraint has been removed."
"I feel the same way!"
"A dramatic change has occurred in the Void Immortal Realm..."
"Could the entrance to the Celestial Realm truly appear?"
The wild laughter of the Ruins Essence echoed in the sky above the altar!
"Hahaha..."
"Finally destroyed!"
"I have freed myself from them!"
Brother Cheng understood this.
After being suppressed for so many years, anyone would go mad.
He took out a pill and swallowed it. The last strike had entirely drained his spiritual power and required some replenishing for calm.
"Brother, are you free now?"
The Ruins Essence was in a very good mood and immediately said, "That’s right, that’s right, haha, thank you."
"Then when will you take us to the Celestial Realm?"
Sect Leader Jiang spoke as if it was their initial agreement.
The excited Ruins Essence was also bewildered by him.
"Well... if you want to go to the Celestial Realm, you must rely on your own strength for ascension."
Brother Cheng hoped to hitch a ride and was greatly disappointed by the answer.
"So, I still need to reach the Peak of Saint Tier, then cross the tribulation and ascend?"
"Indeed, but to cultivate all your 992 main rules to entry-level, the journey is still long!"
At the mention of this, the Ruins Essence chuckled to itself.
"Besides, I don’t intend to return to the Celestial Realm."
"Huh?"
Jiang Cheng was stunned: "Why don’t you go back?"
"The group of Immortal Emperors and Demon Emperors in the Celestial Realm is too troublesome, I’d rather find a quiet place to stay to avoid being targeted by them again."
So timid?
"Where will you go? You won’t stay here, will you?"
If the Void Immortal Realm continued to block, then the Lower Realm still couldn’t ascend.
"Once the blood fiend qi is completely cleared, I will leave here."
The Ruins Essence added, "However, even if I leave, the restoration of the ascension rules will still take some time."
"Before I leave, there is something I need to ask."
Sect Leader Jiang raised an eyebrow: "What to ask?"
"You were able to use that strike from the start, weren’t you?"
The last strike quickly destroyed the White Tower, its power far greater than anything before, saving hundreds of thousands of years of effort.
The Ruins Essence, calm now, thought this brat did it deliberately!
If he had such a move, why didn’t he use it earlier?
He worked hard to put on a show and extracted 990 main rules from him...
Thinking back, he still felt the pain.
"No, no, you misunderstood, am I that kind of person?"
Sect Leader Jiang denied flatly.
"It was precisely because I gained those 990 new rules that I suddenly had an epiphany and realized that strike."
"Without your rules, I couldn’t have done it."
Make up your stories, the Ruins Essence would never believe him again.
"If there’s nothing else, I’m leaving, we’ll meet again someday."
Saying ’meet again’, he actually never wanted to meet again.
Although Jiang Cheng saved him, making him quite grateful.
Yet he didn’t know that Brother Cheng was secretly frustrated, thinking that after saving him, he wasn’t called a handsome hero.
Too realistic.
"Wait a minute, your avatars are everywhere in the Ruins, right?"
"So what if they are?"
The Ruins Spirit now only wanted to stay away from him to avoid being fooled again.
"Could you help me find where the Heart Race people are?"
By now, Jiang Cheng finally remembered Qingsuo and the others from the Heart Division, so he casually mentioned it.
"What Heart Division?"
"A group of women using the Heart-Piercing Awl magical treasure..."
"Oh, them? They were deceived into the Nine Treasures Immortal Extinction Array. Luckily, you didn’t bring the Bone Refining Banner back, or they would all be dead."
The Ruins Essence did indeed know everything inside.
"Now that I’m free, that Nine Treasures Immortal Extinction Array was just destroyed by me, they’re fine now."
With his casual introduction, Jiang Cheng finally knew the ultimate mission of the nine magical treasures of the Immortal Remnant Race.
What the hell, those old fellows in the Celestial Realm were so deceitful.
If he had really brought the Bone Refining Banner there...
Then there would be no living soul in the Void Immortal Realm now.
The Ruins Essence volunteered, "Would you like me to bring them over to you?"
As long as it didn’t involve a big loss, he was still willing to help with such small favors.
"Sure..."
As soon as the words fell, Qingsuo and the Heart Race people suddenly appeared beside him.
"Where is this?"
"What happened to us before?"
"That place earlier was too terrifying!"
"Why did the Heart-Piercing Awl lead us there?"
All the chatter turned into joy when they saw Jiang Cheng!
"Sect Leader Jiang!"
"Finally seeing you!"
"Great, we finally reunite with Sect Leader Jiang..."
"Sect Leader Jiang, where have you been all this time? We had such a hard time searching."
Qingsuo and others were in tears of joy, seeing him as if seeing their family, finding their organization.
Their enthusiasm even left Brother Cheng a bit caught off guard.

chapters.title: Chapter 201: Reception Golden Light
chapters.content:
Chapter 201: Chapter 201: Reception Golden Light
The Heart Division group has had a rough time.
First, they were attacked by other domains, living in constant fear for their safety.
Then, they teamed up with the Water Tribe, enduring gossip and disdain every day.
Finally, they stumbled into a trap, nearly meeting total destruction.
This journey has truly been heart-wrenching and tear-jerking.
After joining with Mo Chen and the Profound Turtle King, Qingsuo stared wide-eyed at the fine wines, delicious foods, puppet song and dance ensemble, and other obviously entertainment-focused facilities on the turtle’s back.
Even Brother Cheng felt a little guilty.
He had been enjoying a carefree life, playing mahjong and sleeping, while casually amassing a heap of points and two attendants, which starkly contrasted with their plight.
"By the way, Sect Leader Jiang, was it your doing that we suddenly got transported here?"
Jiang Cheng nodded without hesitation.
"That’s right!"
"I unexpectedly befriended a powerful native here and learned that you had fallen into a trap, in grave danger!"
He clenched his fist and declared passionately, "I couldn’t stay still then!"
"All the Heart Division members are my good friends; how could I ignore friends in trouble?"
"After much persuasion and paying a heavy price, I finally convinced that mighty power to free you from your crisis."
Even though Brother Cheng didn’t know the purpose of increasing goodwill with the Heart Division, this kind of win-over operation had become second nature to him.
He habitually embellished his achievements.
After all, with the Ruins Essence long gone, he could spin his stories as he wished.
Besides, if it weren’t for him saving the Ruins Essence, Qingsuo and the others would indeed have been unable to escape.
Learning of his tireless efforts on behalf of the Heart Division, Qingsuo and the others were moved to tears once again.
"Sect Leader Jiang, how can we ever repay you..."
"This time again you saved us; truly, you are the rebirth parent of our Heart Division!"
Oh, come on, you’re all older than me by millions of years.
"As allies, this small matter is simply my duty."
The Heart Race people, now settled, finally felt free of all pressure.
After joining Sect Leader Jiang, they inexplicably felt fearless.
Mo Chen came over, "Sect Leader, do you have any leads on the entrance to the Immortal Realm?"
At these words, everyone’s ears perked up.
"Rest assured, the Void Immortal Realm will soon vanish. Then the ascension rules will return to normal, and you’ll be able to ascend again."
"Really?"
"That’s wonderful!"
Although they couldn’t sneak into the Immortal Realm as they intended before, everyone was still elated.
At least there’s real hope now, isn’t it?
But just as they cheered, the endlessly gray sky above suddenly brightened.
Large patches of golden light grew increasingly bright, illuminating the entire Void Immortal Realm as if in broad daylight.
"What’s this?"
Jiang Cheng was also curious.
He was just planning to ask the Ruins Essence about it when he felt an inexplicable attraction coming from the golden light.
Not just him; everyone in the Void Immortal Realm felt it.
The faint allure in that golden light seemed to beckon them towards another world.
"This scene, I’ve seen it in an ancient sect manuscript..."
"Millions of years ago, after our sect’s ancestor crossed the tribulation, golden light descended from the heavens to lead him into the Immortal Realm!"
"Could this be the Reception Golden Light?"
"But, we haven’t crossed the tribulation yet!"
"Yeah, I’m not even at the Peak of Saint Tier. How could the Reception Golden Light appear?"
"With the rules in chaos now, what’s impossible about becoming an immortal without crossing the tribulation?"
"This opportunity cannot be missed!"
Someone rushed directly into the area surrounded by one of the golden beams.
Soon after, the person floated upwards and towards the sky.
Before long, they disappeared from the Void Immortal Realm!
"Did they become immortal?"
"No way, so easily?"
Countless people went wild, rushing towards the Reception Golden Light...
And soon, more and more people disappeared from the Void Immortal Realm.
The same was true on Jiang Cheng’s side.
Qingsuo and the Profound Turtle King quickly recognized it was the Reception Golden Light.
"Sect Leader Jiang, should we go up?"
Despite their impatience, everyone still waited for Jiang Cheng’s word.
"Then let’s go!"
With such an opportunity before them, there was no reason to refuse.
Think about his 992 chaos-level main rules — when could he reach entry level?
Now he could directly go to the Immortal Realm; of course, he was willing.
