Including the Frost Rabbit King and Female Chicken King, everyone stepped into one of the golden beams.
Soon after, they felt a gentle pull, slowly lifting them.
They rose higher and higher; soon, a new world appeared above them.
Although they hadn’t arrived yet, they could already see the blue skies, white clouds, and lush landscapes of this world.
Compared with the harsh environment of the Void Immortal Realm, it was simply paradise!
"Is that the Immortal Realm?"
"It must be!"
"Quick, enter..."
Without hesitation, everyone actively flew towards this paradise.
When they finally entered and stood firm on this land, they felt a peace unlike any other before.
A gentle breeze brushed by, making everyone feel at ease and joyful.
People exclaimed in delight and cheer.
"Ahhh, I finally reached the Immortal Realm..."
"Is this the legendary Immortal Yuan Qi?"
The surrounding atmosphere was dozens of times more potent than Spiritual Qi of the Lower Realm.
Many Heart Race people, just as they landed, sat cross-legged immediately, ready to break through under the stimulation of Immortal Yuan Qi.
It’s not just them; everyone who entered via the golden light was immersed in joy.
Some were moved to tears, some knelt down to kiss the soil here.
Many more were busy cultivating and breaking through as soon as they arrived.
Mo Chen wasn’t wrong; ascenders coming from the ’tough lands’ of the Lower Realm inherently have more drive than the native inhabitants of the Upper Realm.
Give them even a minor chance to rise, and they’ll most likely seize it.
The masters of each domain quickly settled, and Jiang Cheng was no exception.
He released all the disciples from the Xuanji Map.
"Hey, where are we?"
"Isn’t this the Void Immortal Realm?"
"Sect Leader, did we enter the Immortal Realm?"
Jiang Cheng already didn’t have time to answer them.
As soon as everyone emerged, the system started crazily calculating his scores.
After all, in the past year, 8,100 years had passed in the Xuanji Map.
Ji Linghan and Lin Ning had both broken through to the Ascending to Saint Ninth Layer.
Meanwhile, Luo Yuan, Wei Miao, and the others had progressed to the Ascending to Saint First and Second Layers.
As for the Fourth Generation Disciples, they all uniformly reached the Daoist Palace Realm.
There’s no help for it; although most Fourth Gen Disciples hadn’t yet improved their talent, plenty of pills and spirit stones were available.
Plus, there were always Ascending to Saint Experts to consult; Mo Chen had even passed on his experiences before. They found it hard not to improve.
Brother Cheng finally did the calculations and discovered he’d gained 17.2 billion points this time!
Adding to the 7.5 billion he already had, his total now reached 24.7 billion points.

chapters.title: Chapter 202 Creating something out of nothing
chapters.content:
Chapter 202: Chapter 202 Creating something out of nothing
He opened the system panel and clicked upgrade again.
Level: 9
Points: 0/100000000000
Available Points: 14776855463
Current Skills: The host can consume points to create dead objects out of thin air, with no cooldown time.
Note: The objects must be something the host has seen before; the higher the object’s tier, the more points are consumed.
Subordinate Skills: The host can consume points to reverse time, with no cooldown time.
Note: After reversing time, the host’s own state remains unchanged. The larger the time span reversed, the more points consumed.
Well, even time reversal is available now.
Jiang Cheng was not surprised by this, after all, with resurrection available, what’s the big deal about time reversal?
After reversing, his state remains unchanged, which means no matter how high his realm is now, it will remain the same after going back.
Of course, if he’s seriously injured now, reversing back to the day before will still leave him in today’s injured state.
It’s not about returning to yesterday’s state.
This is neither good nor bad, it depends on how it’s used.
What he’s more interested in is the skill of creating objects out of nothing.
He opened the panel and imagined the main hall of the Feixian Sect in his mind.
The system panel immediately popped up a dialog box, requiring the consumption of 100 points, asking whether to create it.
The grand hall of the Feixian Sect was very magnificent, after all, it was built by the Silence Sacred Land before, stretching over ten miles, both imposing and luxurious.
Such a large palace, yet it only requires 100 points?
Isn’t that way too cheap?
Has the system finally shown some conscience?
Actually, this price is quite reasonable.
points are already equivalent to 10,000 top-grade Spirit Stones.
And a palace is just an ordinary building, compared to 10,000 Spirit Stones, its value can’t even be compared?
Spirit Stones are like rare treasures compared to gold and silver in the mortal world.
This is just the former main hall of the Silence Sacred Land, which also has some facilities related to cultivation, otherwise, an estimate of just 1 point would suffice.
Looking at everyone cultivating and observing on the grass by the river, his urge to show off was stirring again.
"Alas, is this place really the legendary Immortal Realm?"
"There’s not even a place to stay, it’s too run down, really disappointing."
His words left everyone bewildered.
Having reached the Immortal Realm, who would still care about accommodation when there’s cultivation to do?
The Heart Race people all laughed and said, "Sect Leader Jiang is joking, the conditions here have already reached the pinnacle."
"Indeed, the Immortal Yuan Qi here is beyond what one could ever dream of."
"We should seize the opportunity to cultivate now, lest we are arbitrarily killed after leaving here and encountering real immortals in the future..."
"Right, right, the accommodations don’t matter, they’ll come eventually."
"The most important thing now is to have the ability to protect ourselves."
The 500 people of the Heart Division were at least at the Daoist Palace Realm.
Experts of this level could survive in a barren desert, let alone in such a beautiful place with beautiful scenery and bird songs.
Especially in comparison to the previous Void Immortal Realm, this is a paradise.
As cultivators from the Lower Realm, they aren’t impulsive newcomers.
They wouldn’t wander around aimlessly but rather plan to cultivate in place, biding their time until reaching the True Immortal Level before slowly exploring around.
This made Brother Cheng quite depressed.
Seeing that you guys have no ambition, how am I supposed to create a bunch of palaces to show off?
Luckily, he still had a group of disciples.
Shan Tai was the first to jump out.
"No way, how can we let the Sect Leader sleep in the wild?"
"The Sect Leader’s suffering pains my heart!"
"I’ll go chop wood and build a house immediately!"
He thought this was a test by the Sect Leader to see his bootlicking skills and flew towards the nearby forest enthusiastically.
Other disciples also followed suit, unwilling to be left behind.
"Junior Brother Shan, you should go back; let your Senior Brother handle this!"
"No, no, Senior Brother Zhang, you’re wrong. I minor in artifact refining, I’m much better at building houses than you."
"But I minor in array formations, surely I can make the Sect Leader’s house warm in winter and cool in summer, incomparably comfortable..."
Seeing all the disciples interrupt their cultivation and rush to the forest, ready to embark on a grand construction project, the Heart Division people weren’t surprised.
After all, the Feixian Sect has always had this style.
Brother Cheng felt both gratified and helpless.
Gratified that all the disciples had good intentions, showing their admiration for him.
Helpless because... this wasn’t the script he wanted.
"Alright, you all stop now."
"For such a small matter as building a house, why make it so complicated?"
After saying this, he waved his hand and simultaneously clicked the create button.
An enormous palace occupying more than ten miles appeared out of thin air on the grass not far away.
Red walls, green tiles, carved beams, and painted rafters, the entire palace was magnificent and resplendent, glittering like pearls.
Everyone stopped in their tracks, and seeing the palace, they were all left agape.
"Isn’t this our previous main hall?"
"How did it appear here?"
"My God, how is this done?"
"Wow, the Sect Leader is incredibly powerful, isn’t he?"
Even the Heart Race people who were cultivating, and Mo Chen, the Three-Eyed Tiger, Frost Rabbit King, and others fell into shock.
Indeed, they had no need for a house.
But conjuring such a massive palace out of thin air was simply too miraculous.
It completely defies common sense.
Moreover, given a better place, who would want to sit on the ground?
Many disciples flew in and discovered that it was indeed identical to their previous main hall inside.
This showed it was no illusion or blinding technique, but real.
"Sect Leader, how on earth is this done?"
"Bro, I admit it, you really know how to enjoy life."
"Sect Leader Jiang, what kind of magic is this?"
"Could it be you have a magical treasure for transferring and storing objects, and moved the hall over?"
Qingsuo and others swallowed with difficulty, their eyes wide open.
This reaction finally gave Brother Cheng a sense of satisfaction for his urge to show off.
"A magical treasure for transferring and storing objects?"
He waved his hand repeatedly, and between the mountains, one palace after another rose out of the ground.
Meanwhile, waterfalls, streams, gardens, pavilions, and plazas...
In just a few moments, the mountain-enclosed area was utterly transformed, with many places’ topography changed.
The basic infrastructure of a sect took shape in a matter of seconds.
If a single palace could still be considered as being moved out of Feixian Sect, then everything now was inexplicable.
Even waterfalls and lakes were created, certainly not through object moving.
Everyone was dumbfounded.
"Is this also Immortal Technique?"
"A miracle, truly a miracle!"
Even Immortal Mo’s eyes were almost popping out. He touched here and there, finding everything just as real.
"As long as you know it’s Immortal Technique."
"I’ve long said that this Sect Leader is an Immortal, I don’t know what you’re all so surprised about."
Brother Cheng spent 1 point to create a cigarette, lit it, and took a puff, continuing to enjoy everyone’s worshipful expressions.
After creating a mountain gate out of thin air, everyone’s conditions improved many times over.
It’s a pity this skill can’t create living beings; otherwise, Jiang Cheng also planned to bring out some birds and beasts sooner or later.
At this moment, his obedient daughter tugged at his clothing.
"Mommy, aren’t we at our new home yet?"
"Why haven’t we seen the Spirit Vein yet?"
This long journey of a year suffocated her thoroughly.

chapters.title: Chapter 203 Rule Fragment
chapters.content:
Chapter 203: Chapter 203 Rule Fragment
This made Jiang Cheng a bit puzzled.
"My dear daughter, haven’t you found any spirit veins or immortal veins here?"
There’s already Immortal Yuan Qi here, the conditions are much better than back at the Feixian Sect.
"No, no!"
Ah Huang pouted, a displeased expression covering her face.
Before they left, Brother Cheng had promised to find her a better spirit vein.
It’s a bit awkward now.
Could it be because this place is too remote, just a barren land in the Immortal Realm?
So, there are simply no immortal veins?
According to what Mo Chen said earlier, the resources of the Immortal Realm have long been claimed, and immortal veins are no exception.
He rubbed his chin, wondering if he should repeat what he did in the Lower Realm.
Like taking down an immortal sect first and seizing their immortal vein.
But they have no enmity with him, it seems a bit inappropriate.
Actually, the main reason is that he’s unsure about the means of immortals.
The Feixian Sect plus the Heart Division seemed crowded, but there wasn’t a single true immortal.
If a large group of immortals is on the opposite side, and they casually subdue and capture him, the resurrection skill would be useless at that point.
Better to wait a while, let overall strength here improve another notch, and gather intel on the surrounding environment and situation before making a move.
Then he opened the Xuanji Map and started researching how to build a spirit vein inside it.
The system showed that it’s indeed possible to create objects within the Xuanji Map.
However, the price of a spirit vein is indeed steep.
Level 6 costs ten million.
Level 9 costs as much as ten billion!
The previous spirit vein of the Feixian Sect was Level 6, but Ah Huang had enhanced it to Level 8.
Thinking about the previous promise to his daughter to provide her with a higher-grade spirit vein.
He gritted his teeth and spent ten billion points to create an Level 8 spirit vein for Ah Huang inside the Xuanji Map!
Then, he moved his beloved daughter into it.
Upon seeing that Level 8 spirit vein, Ah Huang cheered with excitement and dived right in.
To her, the spirit vein inside seemed more valuable than the Immortal Yuan Qi outside.
In no time, the level of that spirit vein rose rapidly.
Quickly reaching Level 9, and it didn’t stop there.
It wasn’t long before it broke through the Level 9 barrier.
Jiang Cheng sensed for a moment and found that inside, Immortal Yuan Qi like that outside had already appeared.
Because of her presence, the area within tens of thousands of miles around the spirit vein became vibrant and thriving.
Moss-like plants grew rapidly, soon surpassing a person’s height, as if they had become refined spirits.
Wow, this daughter is really incredible!
If he had known how to create objects earlier, he could have conjured up a little Immortal Realm out of thin air within the Xuanji Map while in the Lower Realm!
"Dear daughter, do you like it here?"
"I love it so much!"
"Isn’t Daddy amazing?"
"..."
He didn’t get a response for a long time, only to sense carefully and find that his daughter had already fallen asleep within the spirit vein.
Not getting his daughter’s praise, Brother Cheng felt a bit wistful.
In the following period, everyone settled down here.
Every day, Jiang Cheng still improved one disciple’s talent.
Of course, he didn’t neglect his own cultivation.
Let’s start with 100 draws at Level 5!
Counting, these 100 draws yielded 24 Immortal Pills.
After consuming them, his Divine Soul reached the Peak of Saint Tier, but his Spiritual Power Realm remained at the Early-stage Saint Tier.
Upgrading in the Saint Tier is too difficult.
No matter, let’s use another ten billion.
If he still can’t level up, then try again.
Using 100 draws five times, his Spiritual Power Realm finally reached the Mid-stage Saint Tier.
Besides the Immortal Pills and some Heavenly and Earthly Treasures used as materials, the five 100-draws also yielded six strands of Mystic Immortal Rhyme.
Brother Cheng didn’t procrastinate; he quickly used what he could to enhance his power.
Keeping them would only let them collect dust.
Under the helpless gaze of everyone, he upgraded six of his Martial Techniques to the Profound Immortal Level.
Furthermore, he obtained 21 Sacred Artifacts and 18 Lower Grade Magical Treasures this time.
The Mahayana Long Departure Sword, which broke when it struck the White Tower last time, he was too lazy to repair — now he can simply replace it with a new one.
As for the True Immortal Level martial techniques and cultivation techniques, he didn’t bother extracting them this time.
He would wait until he became an immortal, then click to learn them, reaching Full Level automatically.
Besides these, he also obtained the Divine-grade Poison Seed, Heart Seed, and Medical Seed, gaining top-level talents in these three paths as well.
With the Divine-grade Heart Seed, he could finally learn the Heart Division’s Heart Control Seal.
Regarding Heroic Souls, from these 500 draws, he obtained the Thunder Heroic Soul and Destructive Heroic Soul.
From now on, every attack of his could gain the dual Buffs of Thunder and Power of Destruction, further enhancing his combat power.
He collected 105 Xuanji Map fragments, and after merging them, the time flow rate reached 19,500 times.
Although the increase in time flow rate is getting smaller, and progresses very slowly, the population limit has increased rapidly.
Now, the number of people it can accommodate has surged from over 1,200 to 153,010.
And the landscape within the Xuanji Map has undergone a massive transformation.
A series of lush and verdant mountains rose from the ground while rushing rivers wound endlessly through the mountains.
Towering trees thrived, forming the budding shape of a genuine world.
This made Brother Cheng ever more delighted, deciding to celebrate with a 10-spin draw at Level 6.
A Level 6 draw costs a million points, and a 10-spin draw would use ten billion.
With a flash of light, the rewards appeared on the system interface.
This 10-spin draw brought forth a second-grade Immortal Pill.
In addition, another strand of Mystic Immortal Rhyme.
Which he used to upgrade his last Martial Dao to the Profound Immortal Level.
A Celestial Immortal Level cultivation technique.
Along with several Heavenly and Earthly Treasures only found in the Immortal Realm.
If it were only this, Brother Cheng would certainly be dissatisfied.
The crucial point was that this time the draw also yielded a new item — Rule Fragment.
Opening the panel, the system came with a manual.
Rule Fragment — can upgrade any ten main rules to the Entry Level, or elevate one main rule to the Small Success Level.
If this treasure were spread, it would drive countless Saint Tier experts insane.
Advancing rule levels could only rely on comprehension and time honing.
Those Saint Tier experts who had lived for millions of years spent more than half their long lifetimes doing this.
After all, the higher the main rule level, the stronger the Holy Sanctuary, which naturally increases power.
Their Holy Sanctuaries usually contain only three to five main rules, and some, limited by talent, haven’t refined them all by the time their life ends.
Of course, there are some exceptional geniuses.
Not only do their Holy Sanctuaries have more than a dozen main rules, but they can refine them all to Entry Level within a mere 100,000 years.
However, compared to the Rule Fragment in front of him, they quickly become insignificant.
One Rule Fragment could save them countless painstaking efforts.
To Brother Cheng, this was simply a rain in a long drought, invigorating him tremendously!
Now, his biggest obstacle to becoming an immortal is those 992 main rules.
Making him cultivate arduously for hundreds of millions of years to gradually comprehend the rules would be torturous.
"I always said, refining main rules isn’t difficult for a genius like this handsome brother!"
"""

chapters.title: Chapter 204: Purifying Dust Immortal Lotus
chapters.content:
Chapter 204: Chapter 204: Purifying Dust Immortal Lotus
This time, the ten consecutive draws yielded two rule fragments.
He quickly elevated 20 main rules directly from Chaos Level to Entry Level.
Then, he persevered and continued with ten more consecutive draws.
After using up his remaining points, leaving only over two billion, he obtained nine more rule fragments.
In just a few minutes, he had 110 rules reach Entry Level.
"Looking at it this way, 992 rules don’t seem so far away!"
After using up all the second-level Immortal Pills he just drew, his realm officially reached the Peak of Saint Tier, only one step away from becoming a True Immortal.
After that came a long and tedious period.
At least, that’s how it was for Brother Cheng.
Everyone around him was cultivating diligently, even the Frost Rabbit King and Female Chicken King were no exceptions.
The only two exceptions were Mo Chen and the Three-Eyed Tiger.
The former hadn’t found a suitable body while the latter was simply lazy.
As time gradually passed, everyone began to notice something strange.
The Immortal Yuan Qi here was growing increasingly thin.
Moreover, it hadn’t been able to recover.
"This is very strange."
Mo Chen frowned deeply and slowly said, "I’ve felt something was off about this Immortal Realm since the first day."
"It seems to be missing something."
Just like the Spiritual Qi in the Lower Realm, if too many people absorb it, it might temporarily become thin.
But due to the continuously generated new Spiritual Qi and the surrounding replenishing Spiritual Qi, the Spiritual Qi in a region should quickly return to normal levels.
It shouldn’t remain persistently thin and continue to decrease.
The Immortal Yuan Qi is the same way.
Now the concentration of Immortal Yuan Qi outside is even less than the Spirit Vein enhanced by Ah Huang within the Xuanji Map.
Forced by circumstances, Brother Cheng could only transfer his disciples back into the Xuanji Map.
On this day, the Feixian Sect welcomed a group of outsiders.
"Where is this?"
"Such a majestic mountain gate!"
"Is this an Immortal Sect in the Immortal Realm?"
"Everyone, be careful..."
Having been here for a short time, everyone hadn’t seen such impressive architecture before, let alone a formal mountain gate.
The group instantly became cautious.
Then, this group of people saw Jiang Cheng and Mo Chen, Qingsuo, and others.
"Sect Leader Jiang!"
"Gui Cang Sword Saint, you are here too?"
Upon meeting, it turned out to be acquaintances.
Among the three hundred sword cultivators from the Sword Domain, two hundred remained.
And aside from them, there were over a thousand experts from various domains.
But their current state seemed not too good, with many of them carrying injuries, clearly having gone through battles.
After discovering that this was Jiang Cheng’s base, they were all extremely surprised.
"How did Sect Leader Jiang achieve this?"
"Building a mountain gate here is truly a marvel!"
"Could it be that you found the dwelling left by an Immortal?"
Brother Cheng didn’t expect to show off again.
He calmly replied, "Oh, I built it casually, not worth mentioning."
Thus, the Sword Domain group looked up in awe.
This was built by him?
How was it done?
Even though these buildings weren’t of high value themselves, specialization matters.
Even with their skills, they couldn’t have built such a mountain gate in a few short years.
"Sect Leader Jiang is indeed extraordinary!"
"Such techniques, I admire..."
"Old Sword Saint, you are too kind. May I ask why you suddenly came here?"
Upon hearing this question, Gui Cang Sword Saint’s expression turned serious.
"To be honest, we just came to avoid turmoil and find a quiet place to cultivate peacefully."
He sighed and shook his head.
This statement greatly surprised Jiang Cheng.
This is the Sword Domain, ranked among the top three domains in the Lower Realm Ten Thousand Realms, with remarkable combat power.
Others fear them; why would they avoid others?
"What happened?"
Ling Xing Sword Saint spoke in a deep voice, "Sect Leader Jiang, you know our ascendancy this time is unusual."
"We all entered the same place!"
Jiang Cheng was even more surprised.
"You mean we, the Lower Realm Ten Thousand Realms, entered the Void Immortal Realm this time and are all together now?"
This is definitely unusual.
He had also heard Mo Chen say before that upon ascension, the location is random.
In the vast Immortal Realm, they may never meet again.
Originally, he was puzzled about how he ended up with the Heart Division upon arrival.
Now, hearing that at least tens of thousands of experts from the Lower Realm Ten Thousand Realms are still all together, he found it even harder to understand.
The Sword Domain group seemed to have some understanding of these rules.
Gui Cang Sword Saint slowly speculated, "We have yet to become true Immortals, so having not undergone Thunder Tribulation, we did not scatter randomly according to normal ascension rules."
"Then where are we now?"
"Rootless Island. This place is said to be a dead zone in the Immortal Realm, its periphery surrounded by the Devouring Immortal Mist Sea. Not to mention the Saint Tier, even True Immortals perish upon contact!"
"What?"
"How could it be?"
Qingsuo, Frost Rabbit King, and others exclaimed from the back.
Upon ascending to the Immortal Realm, they were still immersed in joy.
According to the Sword Domain group, they had entered a dead-end from which they couldn’t escape!
It would have been better to remain in the Lower Realm.
Sect Leader Jiang secretly transmitted a message to his ’encyclopedia old elf.’
"What’s the situation with Rootless Island and the Devouring Immortal Mist Sea?"
Mo Chen looked equally puzzled: "Embarrassingly, I’ve never heard of this place. But the Immortal Realm is too vast, what I know amounts to less than a tenth."
Apparently, this old Immortal is not a Master of All Things either.
Sect Leader Jiang sighed and asked the Sword Domain group across, "How do you know these names?"
The Sword Domain group were all from the Lower Realm and logically shouldn’t know these secrets of the Immortal Realm.
Gui Cang Sword Saint said solemnly, "There are five real Immortals on this Rootless Island!"
"Immortals are also trapped on this island?"
"Indeed, those five are True Immortals; they were swept into this place years ago."
Ling Xing Sword Saint said, "According to them, there are only two ways to leave."
"What are the ways?"
"One way is to cultivate to the Celestial Immortal Realm, but the resources here are scarce; the generation of Immortal Yuan Qi is extremely slow, nearly impossible."
What, Celestial Immortal Realm?
Brother Cheng hasn’t even reached the True Immortal Realm yet.
How many years would it take to cultivate to that level?
"What is the other way?"
"Every million years, the Devouring Immortal Mist Sea will produce a Purifying Dust Immortal Lotus. Using this lotus as a vessel, one can safely cross the Mist Sea and enter the Immortal Realm Continent."
"Do we have to wait that long?"
Sect Leader Jiang felt extremely frustrated; how could it be millions of years? He’s only been in this world for a few years, really unbearable.
Still, Mo Chen again transmitted a message: "Purifying Dust Immortal Lotus? I haven’t heard of that either."
Brother Cheng replied irritably, "You know too little. The Sword Domain people are more informed, not to mention Upper Realm Immortals."
Mo Chen felt very ashamed hearing this.
He felt that his position as the core confidant of the Child of the Plane in the inner circle wasn’t so stable.
"Are you all planning to wait a million years?"
Gui Cang Sword Saint bitterly shook his head, "But the Purifying Dust Immortal Lotus blossoms only once, and can only carry ten thousand people. With Immortals present, we’re unlikely to get that opportunity then."
"What? There’s a seat limit?"
Brother Cheng gritted his teeth; if it really takes millions of years, he’ll have to snatch that Purifying Dust Immortal Lotus for himself!

chapters.title: Chapter 205: Facing the Enemy Together
chapters.content:
Chapter 205: Chapter 205: Facing the Enemy Together
He asked once more, "Are those five True Immortals really so kind-hearted as to offer you so much information?"
Upon hearing this, almost all of the two hundred sword cultivators of the Sword Domain, along with over a thousand experts from various domains, displayed expressions of indignation.
"What Sect Leader Jiang says is very true."
Gui Cang Sword Saint sighed leisurely, "How could they be so kind? This Rootless Island has already become a battlefield of three forces because of their presence..."
Through his recounting, Jiang Cheng finally understood the current situation on the island.
After the appearance of the five True Immortals, they began to subjugate experts from various major domains for their own use.
They possess Immortal Bodies, Immortal Souls, and Immortal Power, as well as Immortal Artifacts, and their usage of rules far exceeds that of Saint Tier, naturally overpowering Saint Tier experts.
Plus, by following them, in the future, they will be able to ride the Purifying Dust Immortal Lotus together.
Some domains gradually submitted to them, becoming their vassals.
"These five are Huan Cong True Immortal, Ning Wu True Immortal, Immortal Shao Chong, Xinquan True Immortal, and Zhongtai True Immortal. They’re not of one faction; Huan Cong True Immortal and Ning Wu True Immortal are together."
"Immortal Shao Chong and Xinquan True Immortal are companions."
"And Zhongtai True Immortal is alone."
"They have gathered a group of domains, and now the three sides are constantly fighting."
Brother Cheng’s head felt like it was spinning.
What are they up to?
Are they trying to stage a version of the Three Kingdoms here on this island?
"Why are they fighting?"
Ling Xing Sword Saint said coolly, "For resources. Killing experts from other domains allows them to obtain their collections."
"Also, it’s considered eliminating competitors in advance. Since the quota for the Purifying Dust Immortal Lotus is limited, if all others are killed, those remaining can directly board the lotus to leave in the future."
Brother Cheng casually asked, "Which side have you joined?"
The Sorrow Sword Saint, who had not lifted his gaze until now, slowly raised his eyes, which gradually became incredibly sharp.
"We sword cultivators... will never become vassals!"
As his words settled, the two hundred sword cultivators and over a thousand experts behind him all echoed with fervor.
"Indeed, becoming an Immortal was meant for freedom; how could one be enslaved by others?"
"If that’s the case, I’d rather die and have my Dao extinguished!"
"So what if they are True Immortals? Even if an Immortal Emperor came, they could only crush my bones, but never bend my knees!"
These declarations inspired Jiang Cheng to feel a rush of fervor.
Indeed, among these elite experts of the Lower Realm, many of them are leaders and heroes in their own right.
They’d listen to the elders of their sects willingly enough.
But to be subordinate to outsiders, to be someone else’s lackey, is impossible.
Even if their power isn’t equal to that of Upper Realm Immortals, subduing them would be far more difficult than subduing numerous Immortals!
Even among those Lower Realm experts who have already pledged allegiance to the five True Immortals, surely they have their own plans.
After all, aside from preferring to break rather than bend, there’s also subdued calculation at play.
"What are you planning now?"
"These three factions aren’t just attacking each other; they’re also hunting and purging domains that haven’t joined them everywhere."
Gui Cang Sword Saint sighed deeply, "The Desolate Domain, ranked first among the Ten Thousand Realms, suffered a surprise attack from Ning Wu and Immortal Shao Chong’s True Immortals, resulting in the death of over ten Desolate Ancestors in combat..."
"The Demon Realm suffered also very severely, even the Soul-Fallen Demon Saint with power equal to mine self-destructed and fell..."
"Our Sword Domain was attacked by Zhongtai True Immortal’s forces, resulting in the death of seven Saint Tier, 45 Ascending to Saint, and 70 Daoist Palace members..."
Qingsuo and Profound Turtle King gasped.
Desolate Domain, Demon Realm, and Sword Domain are among the top three formidable domains of the Lower Realm Ten Thousand Realms.
Especially the Desolate Domain, it firmly occupies the top position.
It’s said that over a hundred Saint Tier members from Desolate Domain entered the Void Immortal Realm, surpassingly powerful.
And the overall strength of the Demon Realm closely matches the Sword Domain.
If even they suffer this much, what path remains for other domains besides submission?
In the future, the experts of these three major domains will surely achieve greater success; of course, they won’t willingly submit to mere True Immortals now.
Therefore, they were all targeted for being the prominent ones, heavily struck.
As for the thousand-plus members from other domains behind them, they were gathered along the way.
Brother Cheng was more astonished by the combat prowess of these three major domains.
Under the siege of True Immortals and their large groups of followers, none of these three domains were entirely annihilated.
That’s remarkable!
Consider that True Immortals and Saint Tier are separated by a plane, it’s practically a Dimensional Reduction Strike.
It seems the top experts of these three major domains are all extraordinary encounters, freaks that surpass Saint Tier limits in certain aspects.
What a pity they can’t be subdued; otherwise, if they became allies, the Points would sky-rocket.
"What are your plans now?"
"We intend to lay low for a while, restore our Primordial Qi, contact the Desolate Domain and Demon Realm, then make a decision."
Gui Cang Sword Saint’s smile reappeared, and he extended an invitation to Jiang Cheng once more, "If Sect Leader Jiang is willing, you can join us. More allies mean more strength."
Qingsuo was clearly moved by these words.
In light of having fewer experts and manpower, it is indeed very risky.
However, Brother Cheng had other plans.
Upon hearing the chaotic battles and strong enemies, with danger looming hourly, he felt...so delighted he almost jumped with joy.
Rule Fragments can only be acquired through Level 6 lottery.
One Level 6 draw costs one billion points; he currently needs points so desperately it’s unbearable.
He’s constantly pondering where to gather a fortune.
The quickest way to amass points is through combat and looting war spoils.
After carefully considering all the hacks and buffs he can activate, he concluded that True Immortals probably can’t suppress him.
Besides, even if he dies, resurrection is there.
"I don’t plan to flee; I’ll go and fight them head-on!"
Gui Cang Sword Saint was taken aback.
What does this mean, having learned there are True Immortals opposite, not fleeing, but instead intending to confront them?
"Sect Leader Jiang mustn’t act impulsively!"
"Indeed, the power of True Immortals...is beyond our reach."
He and Sorrow Sword Saint spoke with subtle caution.
The implication being, don’t recklessly go to your death.
And other cultivators shook their heads, disappointment flashing in their eyes.
Most of them had never heard of Jiang Cheng’s name.
Though they had heard of Thousand Spirit Domain, it’s considered a less remarkable, mid-to-low-power domain.
Given Gui Cang Sword Saint’s esteemed status, his high regard for this person already seemed perplexing to them.
Now they believed even more that this person is overly impulsive and lacks judgment.
Simply not worth such esteem.
Jiang Cheng didn’t care about their thoughts at all; his mind was consumed with the idea of gaining points.
No one could hold him back.
"We cultivators are meant to struggle against Heaven and Earth!"
"After years of ascetic cultivation, cutting through thorns and brambles, when have I ever feared adversity?"
"Avoidance is not the style of this sect leader; mere True Immortals, how can they be worth mentioning?"
Upon finishing these words, his Holy Sword rang out of its sheath, pointing straight forward!
Behind him, Mo Chen, Three-Eyed Tiger, and others secretly ridiculed; those words might suit others, but they sound rather jarring from you, don’t they?
When have you ever cultivated ascetically?
When have you faced adversity, or cut through thorns and brambles?
However, Gui Cang Sword Saint was moved.
After a moment of silence, he suddenly laughed aloud.
"Such a Sect Leader Jiang, shaming us, this old one is willing to join you in facing the enemy!"

chapters.title: Chapter 206: I’m the Protagonist
chapters.content:
Chapter 206: Chapter 206: I’m the Protagonist
Under the call of the Gui Cang Sword Saint, the two hundred Sword Cultivators from the Sword Domain all turned around, deciding to fight alongside Jiang Cheng.
Brother Cheng originally wanted to refuse.
But thinking that he probably wouldn’t die this time, he might even have a chance to showcase his powers.
If such a scene had no witnesses, it would be like cooking without salt, tasteless.
So, he not only agreed but also brought everyone around him along.
"Where are those True Immortals?"
"We only know the location of Zhongtai True Immortal..."
Brother Cheng waved his big hand: "Lead the way ahead!"
He acted as if he had already become the leader of the group.
The more than a thousand experts following from the Sword Domain couldn’t understand this decision to counterattack at all.
In their view, this was simply sending themselves to die, which was incredibly foolish.
But there was no choice, the Sword Domain had the strongest backer here.
In the end, more than 300 people chose to join, while the other more than 700 continued to flee into the distance.
With these people, Brother Cheng flew all the way.
Taking a large group out to battle, he suddenly felt it was quite grand.
However, he didn’t know that many of the experts behind him were secretly disgruntled.
Who does this kid think he is?
The Sword Domain is so strong, it should be the rightful leader.
If it weren’t for the face of Gui Cang Sword Saint, who would follow behind?
The Old Sword Saint showed you favor, but you really took yourself as the leader, thinking you’re important?
After the team flew over twenty million miles, another team came flying towards them from high up ahead.
Leading was a giant dragon, immense in size, covering the sky and glowing with golden light!
Behind it was the War Monkey King, clearly among them.
In addition, there were more than thirty other Demon Kings and over a hundred Great Demons.
"Wow, Brother Golden Dragon?"
Seeing those golden eyes, as if they could pierce through spatial barriers, the Three-Eyed Tiger couldn’t help but shiver.
Although it had defeated the War Monkey King, it still felt very intimidated facing the Golden Dragon King.
Meanwhile, the Frost Rabbit King and Female Chicken King exclaimed in delight.
"Brother Golden Dragon, we’re here!"
"Haha, Three-Eyed Tiger, you’re doomed!"
They seemed afraid that Brother Golden Dragon wouldn’t see them.
The two teams quickly met.
However, the Golden Dragon King didn’t act immediately; its condition didn’t look too good.
Several dragon scales had fallen off, stained with blood.
And all the Demon Kings behind it were scarred, looking like they had also gone through a massive battle.
"Ahead, is it His Excellency the Golden Dragon King from the Celestial Demon Domain?"
The Gui Cang Sword Saint took the lead to meet them.
This Old Sword Saint, with his broad knowledge, seemed to have some understanding of the Celestial Demon Domain.
"That’s right, who are you?"
The Golden Dragon King halted on a cloud, eyes sweeping across the crowd, quickly landing on the head of the Three-Eyed Tiger.
The Three-Eyed Tiger broke out in a cold sweat, hurriedly transmitting sound to Sect Leader Jiang.
"Bro, if it causes trouble for me later, you must back me up!"
The Gui Cang Sword Saint, having flown forward, smiled slightly.
"We hail from the Sword Domain, I am Gui Cang, and this is Jiang Cheng, Sect Leader Jiang from the Thousand Spirit Domain!"
This made Brother Cheng feel very comfortable.
The Old Sword Saint was considerate, remembering to introduce him by name.
However, the reaction of the Golden Dragon King left Sect Leader Jiang a bit disappointed.
"Gui Cang Sword Saint?"
It withdrew its gaze from the Three-Eyed Tiger and became solemn.
"Are you the Gui Cang Sword Saint who, eighty thousand years ago, ventured alone into the Broken Blood Domain and defeated the Three Saints with one sword?"
With these words, Qingsuo and the Three-Eyed Tiger, Frost Rabbit King, and others almost dropped their jaws in shock.
Cross-domain battle would be suppressed by the world’s rules, yet this old man could take on three opponents in another’s domain; truly formidable!
No wonder these people from the Sword Domain adhered to him so faithfully.
"Indeed, it’s me, didn’t expect a trivial past experience would be known by Your Excellency the Golden Dragon King!"
"Gui Cang Sword Saint is too modest; your strength is something this king admires!"
The Golden Dragon King’s style was distinctly different from other Demon Kings; it seemed quite familiar with human customs and even showed a bit of elegance.
"Has Your Excellency the Golden Dragon King also been attacked?"
"Yes, I encountered that Zhongtai True Immortal, fought a battle, and got slightly injured."
The people behind him were all shocked.
To fight a True Immortal and survive is such formidable strength!
No wonder the Gui Cang Sword Saint valued the Golden Dragon King so highly; it turns out it deserved it.
On the side, Brother Cheng felt a little bored, as these two guys were flattering each other, almost as if they were the main characters, which was quite unpleasant.
Besides the Demon Kings from the Celestial Demon Domain, there were also some other major demon folks behind the Golden Dragon King.
Upon learning that the Gui Cang Sword Saint and others intended to take the initiative to attack, they immediately yelled in response, having just been attacked themselves.
The demons were mostly warlike, and those like the Three-Eyed Tiger and Profound Turtle King who cherished life were exceptions.
The two teams merged into one, and with two superpowers, Gui Cang Sword Saint and Golden Dragon King, everyone finally gained some confidence.
And quietly, these two also became the leaders of this team.
As for the initially leading Jiang Cheng, he was elegantly ignored by others.
But the Golden Dragon King gave Jiang Cheng a deep look.
"Has the Three-Eyed Tiger been with you these past few years?"
"That’s right."
"Although it’s lazy, there are very few it truly submits to."
The Golden Dragon King commented meaningfully, "Seems like, there will be a chance in the future to weigh your worth."
Brother Cheng was quite indifferent to this, even quite welcoming.
He even asked, "Do you have many treasures?"
If there were many treasures, then winning would yield many spoils.
The Golden Dragon King was momentarily surprised, not understanding what he meant.
Soon they arrived near the enemy’s stationed area.
Everyone restrains their aura, descends from the clouds, and even the demon folks shrink their size to find a place to hide first.
Preparation is needed before battle.
How to attack, how to cooperate, what timing and formation to choose, all are very particular.
This group had lived for so many years and naturally were familiar with such things.
So, after landing, they began discussing tactics.
"The opposition is currently unaware of our arrival; with a surprise attack, we can achieve some results initially."
"Indeed, a surprise attack would catch them unprepared!"
"Zhongtai True Immortal will be mainly attacked by the old me and the Golden Dragon King, while Sect Leader Jiang and Sorrow Sword Saint assist and contain from the side."
Gui Cang had seen Jiang Cheng slay the Three Beast Soul Saints and valued his combat power greatly.
Otherwise, he wouldn’t have placed him in such an important battle.
"But Zhongtai True Immortal has over twenty thousand subordinates, many experts among them, far more than us."
The War Monkey King, Dog-devouring King, and Ling Xing Sword Saint stood out together as Peak of Saint Tier experts.
"Those cowardly ones, I can handle ten alone!"
"But they are too many to underestimate."
Others also voiced their opinions.
"Indeed, I suggest focusing all efforts on attacking Zhongtai True Immortal. The others only need to be held back; once the Immortal is dead, they will naturally collapse."
"Immortals aren’t that easy to kill; we could actually split up, attacking secretly and constantly to drain them, turning small victories into a large one."

chapters.title: Chapter 207: Do It Yourself
chapters.content:
Chapter 207: Chapter 207: Do It Yourself
The experts from the Great Domains were gathered, and the discussion was buzzing with excitement.
This scene can be considered a grand event never before seen in the cultivation realm through the ages.
After all, usually, they couldn’t come together in any way, and once ascended, they scattered in various places.
But Jiang Cheng couldn’t stand to listen anymore.
Hey, hey, are you guys forgetting who’s the most dashing and dazzling?
Especially Gui Cang, what kind of lousy proposal is that?
To deal with just a True Immortal, you’re suggesting four against one, and having me play support?
Are you kidding me?
As the protagonist, how could I possibly play support for you?
He stood up, stretching his long figure, and directly walked outside.
"Sect Leader Jiang, where are you going?"
"Oh, nothing, you guys continue your chat, I’m just stepping out for some air."
Watching him leave, Mo Chen and the Profound Turtle King, along with Qingsuo, quickly followed.
The Three-Eyed Tiger glanced at the Golden Dragon King but ultimately chose to keep relying on Brother Cheng.
No choice, compared to the invincible Golden Dragon King from the Celestial Demon Domain, Brother Cheng was more miraculous, having created countless wonders right under its nose.
Outside, he saw Brother Cheng puffing smoke again.
The Three-Eyed Tiger quickly approached, "Bro, give me one too, the atmosphere inside is too stifling, making me restless and anxious."
Brother Cheng then conjured another cigarette for it, and the Three-Eyed Tiger skillfully flicked a spark to light it.
This time spent with Jiang Cheng had already influenced him greatly.
"Sect Leader, do you have any plans?"
Mo Chen instantly realized that the Child of the Plane was unwilling to be a sidekick to anyone.
That’s only natural.
Jiang Cheng’s expression was more serious and solemn than ever, "I’ve suddenly realized something very serious."
"What’s that?"
Mo Chen and Qingsuo both watched him, thinking inwardly, has there been a major flaw in this mission?
Then they saw Sect Leader Jiang blow a smoke ring and say, "With so many people vying for credit, dividing the spoils later will be troublesome."
Uh, this...
So this is what you consider a very serious issue?
"And Sect Leader plans to..."
"While they’re still in a meeting, let’s rush over first, grab all the enemy’s storage rings in advance, and avoid trouble later."
The two humans and two beasts all fell silent.
"Bro, the opponents are Immortals!"
"Exactly, Master, this battle is not like the lower realm!"
"Sect Leader Jiang, please don’t act impulsively!"
Unlike them, Mo Chen didn’t try to dissuade.
In his eyes, the decisions of the Child of the Plane, no matter how ridiculous, always had a certain rationale.
"Sect Leader really decided?"
"Yes, I’m ready to set off, you can come along too, help me gather the spoils later."
Finishing his words, Brother Cheng transformed into a streak of light, flying into the distance.
Mo Chen immediately followed him without hesitation.
The Three-Eyed Tiger and the Profound Turtle King hesitated for a moment but also chose to continue their faith in Brother Cheng.
Left behind, Qingsuo was extremely conflicted; her reason told her this was suicidal, as the disparity in individual combat power and numbers was too vast.
But Jiang Cheng had saved the Heart Division several times...
In the end, she chose to go alone, without bringing others from the Heart Division.
When Qingsuo set off, Sect Leader Jiang had already charged into the enemy’s encampment.
Just as the experts had discussed before, Zhongtai True Immortal had gathered over twenty thousand experts from various domains.
Among them, at least a thousand were of Saint Tier!
Jiang Cheng suddenly charging in startled them.
"Who!"
"Your grandpa!"
Brother Cheng wielded the Holy Sword, slashing at everyone he saw.
He feared he might kill too slowly, and once Gui Cang Sword Saint and the Golden Dragon King finished their discussion, they might come over to snatch the spoils with him.
"Daring to attack boldly?"
"Simply courting death!"
"Destroy him!"
The enemy was about to strike, but Sect Leader Jiang had already swung his sword.
The Holy Sword swept across, the sky ahead was filled with lightning, becoming a purple ocean.
This new Holy Sword belonged to the Thunder Element, and with Jiang Cheng having reached the Profound Immortal Level in Five Elements Martial Dao, he could easily unleash its full power.
With a loud boom, hundreds of enemies turned into charred bodies, falling down, silent forever.
The power of this attack almost frightened everyone on the opposing side into a standstill.
Among the hundreds of people, although a majority were Ascending to Saint and Daoist Palace, there were still dozens of Saint Tiers.
And just like that, all wiped out with one sword?
Clearing them out like cutting grass?
Even Gui Cang Sword Saint and the Golden Dragon King couldn’t achieve such a feat.
In an instant, all Saint Tier experts simultaneously unleashed their Holy Sanctuaries, while the domains of those Ascending to Saint made the area impenetrable.
In the void, colorful Holy Sanctuaries dazzled in competition.
Within each, the circulating rules carried an earth-shattering presence, hiding terrifying power!
When over a thousand Holy Sanctuaries simultaneously attacked, Brother Cheng decisively activated his own Holy Sanctuary, brazenly confronting them!
His Holy Sanctuary was truly unparalleled.
Based on the Profound Immortal Level Martial Dao as foundation, coupled with 992 Main Rules, other Saint Tier domains in front of him were like fragile bubbles, bursting with a touch!
In the next moment, violent sounds of breaking and explosions filled the sky.
A chaotic flux of rules arose from the destruction of Holy Sanctuaries, wreaking havoc across tens of thousands of miles, leaving it in ruins!
Those Ascending to Saint and Daoist Palace Cultivators stood no chance, directly shredded by the residual impacts from the clash of rules and Holy Sanctuaries!
The Saint Tier experts shattered by the saint domain force immediately suffered backlash.
In this scenario, Jiang Cheng certainly wouldn’t let them escape.
The Holy Sword turned into streaks of lightning, continuously harvesting through the crowd!
One Saint Tier expert after another fell, the skies teeming like dumplings.
When Mo Chen and the Three-Eyed Tiger Profound Turtle King arrived, what they saw was Brother Cheng alone slaughtering the opposing side into disarray.
"Damn, our bro is so fierce?"
After obtaining the Dark Gold Demon Body, the Three-Eyed Tiger had thought the gap between him and Jiang Cheng was not that big.
Now, he realized Brother Cheng could easily kill him in an instant!
This advantage was far more formidable than the Golden Dragon King.
"Sect Leader is valiant!"
"Master’s power isn’t just Saint Tier, right?"
"Seems he’s truly an Immortal..."
They intended to help, but realized they couldn’t intervene in the battlefield at all.
The rules were too chaotic, not only because of the shattered Holy Sanctuaries, but Brother Cheng’s domain contained mostly Chaos Level rules.
In the midst of battle, Brother Cheng noticed them and quickly issued an order.
"Quickly gather the rings!"
"Don’t let anyone snatch the spoils!"
Bringing them along was precisely for this purpose.
"Oh, oh..."
"Alright..."
Mo Chen and the Three-Eyed Tiger were first stunned, then obediently nodded, not at all feeling overlooked due to lack of combat strength.
Gathering spoils was also contributing to the battle.
And by this time, Zhongtai True Immortal was finally alerted!
Initially, he was filled with murderous intent, but upon seeing Jiang Cheng’s achievements, he suddenly paused.
This achievement seemed like something he couldn’t do alone.
Otherwise, he’d have killed Gui Cang and the Golden Dragon King earlier.
"Who are you?"
"Which domain are you from? If you submit to this Immortal, in the future..."
Attempting to make the protagonist submit, what an audacious face!
Sect Leader Jiang had no patience for his nonsense, charging directly at him.
"Finally, you come out!"
After eliminating an Immortal, there should be a bounty of points, right?

chapters.title: Chapter 208: Just Died Like That?
chapters.content:
Chapter 208: Chapter 208: Just Died Like That?
When Jiang Cheng and Zhongtai True Immortal engaged, the vast waves of battle and the tremors of the Holy Sanctuary’s rules spread far and wide.
The Golden Dragon King, Gui Cang Sword Saint, and others hurried out.
"What’s happening?"
The distance was too great; it was naturally impossible to see the specifics.
Yet the terrifying aura faintly emanating from there made everyone instinctively feel an extreme sense of danger deep within.
"Over there... Seems to be Zhongtai True Immortal’s territory, right?"
"Is someone fighting them?"
"What about us?"
Such a terrifying momentum, able to be sensed from such a great distance, made many Saint Tier members and those Ascending to Saint want to retreat involuntarily.
Even the Demon Kings of the Celestial Demon Domain quietly restrained their ferocity.
"Could it be other immortals fighting Zhongtai?"
"It must be!"
Who else could fight Zhongtai on such terms but immortals?
"Are we still attacking?"
"Whatever may come, let’s go and see; perhaps we can seize an advantage while they’re both weakened!"
With a command from the Golden Dragon King, the group then set out.
But just as they flew out, Gui Cang Sword Saint suddenly remembered that Jiang Cheng was missing.
"Where did Sect Leader Jiang go?"
This was a significant combat power he valued; if absent, it would have some impact on the upcoming attack plan.
Everyone looked around.
"The Three-Eyed Tiger is missing too."
"Could they have fled back?"
"I knew this person was unreliable; initially, he claimed true immortals weren’t worth mentioning, which was truly laughable!"
"This kind of person, who loves to boast, is the most unreliable at critical moments..."
Just as they discussed while flying forward, the battle between Jiang Cheng and Zhongtai True Immortal had reached a feverish level.
In the void, a faint image of a gigantic millstone appeared.
It covered the sky, concealing all brightness beneath it.
Countless main rules swirled and danced, continually launching assaults towards a central light cluster.
That light cluster was Zhongtai’s Daoist Heart!
The Daoist Heart is formed and refined from the Holy Sanctuary, naturally possessing greater power.
When Zhongtai True Immortal first invoked the Daoist Heart, everything was under his control.
Compared to the Holy Sanctuary, the Daoist Heart was much more flexible.
Moreover, the Daoist Heart could directly devour the main rules within the Holy Sanctuary, dismantling its foundation.
Under this natural suppression, other Saint Tier experts could only be passively battered when encountering him.
Only Gui Cang and the Golden Dragon King, a few whose Holy Sanctuaries were exceptionally stable, had some main rules cultivated to the Small Success realm, could slightly resist.
Yet before Jiang Cheng, this Daoist Heart couldn’t maintain even a second of advantage.
Just at the start, it was completely surrounded by 992 main rules, unable to move flexibly.
Instantly, it was enveloped in a sea of rules.
There was no need for it to devour; the 992 rules continuously launched active assaults on that Daoist Heart.
Brother Cheng’s rules were mostly at the Chaos Level, unable to conduct any intricate controls, thus choosing a simple and brutal collision.
The enormous millstone kept spinning and crushing, and under the continuous bombardment of vast rules, Zhongtai True Immortal’s Daoist Heart wavered and tottered.
Once akin to a blazing sun, it now resembled a setting sun.
Meanwhile, the two had long been engaged in countless clashes on the Divine Soul.
The Immortal Soul had been condensed into substance, yet it could not penetrate Brother Cheng’s Holy Soul, as the quality of the Holy Soul forged by a hundred thousand Ghosts was far superior.
At the peak of the Saint Tier, confronting a True Immortal posed no issue.
If his control of the Holy Soul was as refined as a True Immortal, he could perhaps crush that True Immortal Level Divine Soul.
As the Daoist Heart was about to crumble, Zhongtai True Immortal was terrified.
He could not fathom...
How could such a heaven-defying Saint Tier appear in the Lower Realm?
Is this even Saint Tier?
True Immortals being trampled; is this not Celestial Immortal level combat strength?
Simply not something he could resist.
Finally, he opted for close combat with the Immortal Body!
Then, he encountered Brother Cheng’s Immortal Demon Body.
The moment their close combat contact occurred, Zhongtai True Immortal was instantly struck down from the high sky.
Boom!
The ground split with countless crevices, and within those depths, Zhongtai True Immortal’s Immortal Body was breaking apart...
He dared not continue fighting.
Bear in mind, he had just used an Immortal Sword!
After millions of years sealed, the Lower Realm unexpectedly birthed such a prodigy!
Too terrifying!
Immortals themselves, facing Lower Realm’s Saint Tier, chose to flee.
Yet at this moment, his sealed Daoist Heart finally shattered entirely under the continuous pounding of 992 rules!
Splat!
Zhongtai True Immortal spat out a mouthful of blood tinged with gold, his state weakening once more.
How could Brother Cheng miss such an opportunity.
The Holy Sword swept swiftly, and Zhongtai True Immortal’s head soared high.
The Holy Soul and Domain furiously assaulted, obliterating body and soul!
A true immortal thus fell!
At this time, Qingsuo had just arrived at the devastated battleground.
Looking at Jiang Cheng, descending slowly from the high sky, then at Three-Eyed Tiger and Mo Chen Profound Turtle King busying themselves with collecting spoils, she fell into total shock.
Was that immortal dead?
Dealt with effortlessly by Jiang Cheng single-handedly?
And... so quickly?
When Gui Cang Sword Saint and Golden Dragon King arrived with their main force, all spoils of war were already cleaned up.
Especially the Three-Eyed Tiger, having done such work for Brother Cheng more than once, was a practiced hand.
They didn’t let off even the storage rings, or the intact Holy Armor and Immortal Swords, all stripped off.
"This..."
"What happened?"
"Seems like the enemies were all slain?"
"Zhongtai True Immortal!"
"His head is here..."
Everyone gasped, completely unable to believe their eyes.
Zhongtai True Immortal was killed?
Their fear, the formidable foe they struggled to be confident against even when sieging together, simply gone?
"Who could accomplish this?"
This question was almost redundant.
Didn’t they notice the few survivors on site?
"Sect Leader Jiang!"
Gui Cang Sword Saint’s white beard trembled, pointing at the ruins, his hand quivered.
"Did you do all this?"
Brother Cheng spread his hands, wearing an easy-going smile: "Yeah, didn’t I already say I would attack these enemies?"
No one knew what to say.
You did say, but who knew you’d be this fierce.
Single-handedly, you smashed everyone.
Golden Dragon King also got lost in amazement.
Looking at the Three-Eyed Tiger tagging along behind Jiang Cheng, he suddenly understood why it would follow this person.
"Zhongtai True Immortal, you killed too?"
"What else could it be?"
"I saw you all describing him as unmatched, so I decided to meet him first."
Sect Leader Jiang shrugged: "This guy finally showed some power, made me exert a bit more effort."
Only a bit more effort?
Everyone was speechless.
Those who previously thought Jiang Cheng was boasting now felt utterly embarrassed, their faces metaphorically swollen from being slapped.
Despite showing off, his prowess was indeed impressive!
This combat power, capable of taking down immortals.
So much so that they dared not even approach Sect Leader Jiang now, as if he was more dangerous than those Upper Realm immortals.

chapters.title: Chapter 210: Gu Yang Immortal Sword
chapters.content:
Chapter 210: Chapter 210: Gu Yang Immortal Sword
The news of Jiang Cheng killing Zhongtai True Immortal in the Thousand Spirit Domain quickly spread across the island.
Unseen, a flag capable of resisting True Immortal’s rule quietly rose up.
Brother Cheng inexplicably became the leader of the rebellion.
Within a few days, other expert fugitives started to come in droves.
Or rather, to seek his protection.
Groups from various domains arrived at the Feixian Sect, some singly, some in groups.
Jiang Sect Leader welcomed all of them without exception.
Although he didn’t need these people’s combat power, he needed cheerleaders!
These people neither ate his food nor required him to manage them.
He could also continue to enjoy the treatment of being surrounded by stars, why not?
As for using these people to do something significant, he never even considered it.
On this day, even the Demon Realm came to seek refuge.
Void Abyss Demon Saint, the leader of the Demon Realm, appeared at the Feixian Sect with more than two hundred demon cultivators.
Gui Cang Sword Saint and Golden Dragon King both came to greet them.
This Demon Saint was also a major figure in the Lower Realm, undefeated for years, with power comparable to them.
"Gui Cang Sword Saint, is the rumor true?"
"Did Jiang Cheng, Jiang Sect Leader, really kill Zhongtai True Immortal with his own hands?"
Gui Cang Sword Saint replied, "Absolutely true!"
Void Abyss Demon Saint asked again, "Did you witness it with your own eyes?"
Golden Dragon King and Gui Cang Sword Saint shook their heads simultaneously.
"No, we didn’t. The battle was already over when we arrived."
"However, aside from being Jiang Sect Leader’s doing, there’s no other possibility."
Surely, no other True Immortal defeated Zhongtai and then left the battlefield, leaving all spoils to Jiang Cheng?
Void Abyss Demon Saint glanced at the demon cultivators behind him.
"Gui Cang Sword Saint, Lord Golden Dragon King. We have all fought against True Immortals and are well aware of their power."
"Honestly, the Lower Realm simply does not have means to resist True Immortals."
"This..."
Gui Cang Sword Saint and Golden Dragon King were unsure how to respond.
They had no doubt about Jiang Cheng’s accomplishments.
Having witnessed the ruins after the battle, and given the brief window between the pre-battle meeting and the fight, they were practically eyewitnesses.
But for the experts who arrived from elsewhere these days, the situation was different.
They would naturally infer from ’reasonable’ perspectives.
"Where might Jiang Sect Leader be? Why hasn’t he come out to meet us?"
Void Abyss Demon Saint thought Jiang Cheng should have been here waiting to meet him first, given he brought so many people to seek refuge.
After all, the gathering of experts from the Demon Realm was substantial.
Facing the pressure from the Four True Immortals, with such strong reinforcements coming, shouldn’t he be ecstatic to greet them?
But despite coming here in such force, not even Mo Chen, let alone Jiang Cheng, had appeared.
This made him a bit displeased.
At this time, Jiang Sect Leader was busy exchanging points.
The spoils from this battle were vast.
Zhongtai True Immortal’s weapon, the Gu Yang Sword, was a fire-element Immortal Sword inscribed with two Immortal-tier enhancing arrays and three holy arrays.
Upon obtaining this sword, he immediately tossed aside the Thunder-element Holy Sword he had used before into the Storage Ring.
And naturally, his combat power soared to new heights.
This made Brother Cheng a bit wistful: "Feels like it’s been ages since I’ve been killed."
"The enemies are weak, really nothing to be done."
Inside Zhongtai True Immortal’s ring were massive resources.
Just the First Grade Immortal Pills numbered around a hundred.
Included were over a thousand lower grade Immortal Crystals.
Now, of course, all of these became Jiang Cheng’s fortune.
In addition to the Immortal’s collection, there were two thousand rings from various domain experts, as well as over a thousand sets of Sacred Artifacts...
Jiang Cheng kept half of those Sacred Artifacts and Treasure Pills, and exchanged the rest for points.
All other treasures he couldn’t use were exchanged as well.
In the end, his points skyrocketed to 68.5 billion.
Though the upgrade to the next level was close, Brother Cheng didn’t plan to level up this time; he intended to first master all main rules.
Thus, a swift 500 consecutive draws for level 6 were initiated.
Spending 50 billion points, he acquired 48 Rule Fragments, raising 480 main rules to entry level.
His power soared once again.
He obtained over 300 Xuanji Map fragments, which, after merging, once again enhanced the Xuanji Map’s power.
The flow of time accelerated to 22,500 times.
Besides that, there were numerous Heavenly and Earthly Treasures and other valuables.
Among them, transmission and invisibility were upgraded to level 6.
Not only did the duration of level 6 invisibility increase, but it also allowed attacks below Ascending to Saint without automatically canceling invisibility.
Unless hit by enemy attacks.
This skill was becoming increasingly perverse, perfectly tailored for assassins.
And level 6 transmission could even cross domains directly.
From 500 draws, the level 6 alchemy, artifact refining, talisman making, and array refining techniques were all obtained.
At level 5, alchemy already allowed producing First Grade Immortal Pills.
But level 6 alchemy enabled the creation of Fifth Grade Immortal Pills, which were treasures many Immortals in the Immortal Realm couldn’t even approach.
In addition, there were over a dozen divine-grade talent seeds.
The system was deliberately shaping him towards complete mastery of all elements, with an array of diverse rewards.
It’s just a pity that Brother Cheng was too lazy and laid-back.
Even when possessing abundant divine-level talents, he had no intention of diligently exploring and cultivating in other areas.
Even the earliest obtained Witch Seed, he hadn’t studied the Earth Spirit Witch Manual much, only learning a little under Lan Ti’s pressure.
The Heart Seed, he merely learned the Heart Control Seal.
As for other Talent Seeds, they entirely served as decoration, with no intention of further examination.
Unless the system directly provided him with a skill book, which could instantly activate to full level.
Otherwise, he’d never develop these talents in his lifetime.
"Why learn so much? My energy and time are limited, I can’t afford distractions."
"Should focus on one to avoid scattering effort."
He said it as if he were truly devoted to any particular field.
After using half of the pills on hand, he finally reached the peak of Saint Tier.
So close to becoming an Immortal, just one step away.
main rules reached entry level, plus having the Immortal Sword in hand, his power increased once again.
When he ’came out of seclusion’, he happened to meet Qingsuo.
"Ah, Jiang Sect Leader, have you finally finished your ascetic cultivation?"
Seeing her hurried expression as if something major had happened, Brother Cheng thought the Four Great True Immortals were attacking.
But upon slight awareness, he found no battle fluctuations.
"The War Division and other six divisions have come!"
War Division? What’s that?
Initially, Jiang Cheng didn’t understand, then realized it referred to another group from the Immortal Remnant Race.
Previously, Lan Ti had mentioned to him that the War Division was said to be the strongest among the nine divisions of the Immortal Remnant Race.
"Why are they here?"
"Could it be that they also admire this Sect Leader’s handsome and graceful demeanor and came to seek refuge?"
So many had come seeking refuge during this period; Jiang Sect Leader hadn’t inquired much.
Let them come, after all, the more cheerleaders the better.
"Ahem..."
Qingsuo’s expression was a bit constipated, unsure of how to match his train of thought.
"No, that’s not it."
"They’re here to demand we hand over the Heart-Piercing Awl and Bone Refining Banner."
What?
Brother Cheng almost chuckled.

chapters.title: Chapter 211 Immortal Slayer Spear
chapters.content:
Chapter 211: Chapter 211 Immortal Slayer Spear
Arriving outside, Jiang Cheng saw that everyone was already present.
Experts from the Sword Domain, Demon Realm, and Celestial Demon Domain were all there, confronting a group in front of them.
Seeing Jiang Cheng arrive, people from all domains shouted out for Sect Leader Jiang.
The scene was quite spectacular, just like a superstar’s grand entrance.
Brother Cheng waved his hand with satisfaction; this batch of supporters wasn’t bad.
He didn’t know that many were secretly observing and judging him.
For example, the Void Abyss Demon Saint, who hadn’t been received since arriving here, was quite displeased.
The group opposite them was from the other seven divisions of the Immortal Remnant Race.
"Qingsuo, to escape, are you going to seek outsiders for help?"
The tall man in armor, resembling a war god descending, stood proud in the air.
"Your Heart Division is truly getting more and more degenerate."
"To be in the same ranks as your Immortal Legacy Nine Divisions is a disgrace."
Upon hearing this, the clansmen of the Heart Division were outraged.
Brother Cheng was also speechless. Such inexplicable humiliation was of kindergarten level.
Too shallow.
Qingsuo held the Heart-Piercing Awl, her face tense.
"Zhan Ying, since you look down on our Heart Division, then let’s go our separate ways. How we act is none of your business!"
She was now determined to follow Jiang Cheng and didn’t care about the Nine Divisions at all.
"How bold!"
The elders and clansmen of the War Division were enraged, scolding loudly.
"Qingsuo, what do you mean?"
"Does your Heart Division want to leave the Immortal Remnant Race?"
"It seems your Heart Division is deteriorating further, truly the shame of the Immortal Remnant Race!"
"Expel them and reclaim the Heart-Piercing Awl!"
The leader of the War Division, Zhan Ying, pointed a golden spear forward, giving not only Qingsuo but also others the feeling of imminent danger.
Within that spear seemed to be a terrifying power capable of destroying them.
"The Immortal Slayer Spear!"
Gui Cang Sword Saint Bai Mei trembled; he had long heard of this top-grade magical treasure.
The Golden Dragon King curiously asked, "What is the Immortal Slayer Spear? Could it be an ancient lost immortal artifact?"
The Void Abyss Demon Saint beside him shook his head, staring intently at the golden spear, his gaze serious.
"It’s not an immortal artifact, but a top-grade magical treasure!"
"A top-grade one?"
Everyone nearby was incredibly surprised.
Some among them had serendipitously obtained magical treasures, but most were lower grade, with the highest being middle-grade.
Top-grade magical treasures shouldn’t even exist in the lower realm.
"The Immortal Remnant Race has nine inheritance treasures, all top-grade, each with miraculous powers."
Gui Cang Sword Saint slowly said, "Among them, the Immortal Slayer Spear is the most dangerous of the Nine Treasures!"
"This treasure can directly attack the divine soul; an Ascended to Saint tier holding it can slay Saint tier foes!"
"So powerful?"
Everyone exclaimed in surprise.
"The Old Sword Saint is right."
The Void Abyss Demon Saint said solemnly, "Seven million years ago, a clan leader from the War Division invaded my Demon Realm with the Immortal Slayer Spear."
"At that time, he was only early-stage Saint tier, yet he slew five demon saints, including one late-stage Demon Saint!"
"Due to him, the previously chaotic and warring Demon Realm united for the first time, finally killing him."
"But the Immortal Slayer Spear was taken back by the fleeing War Division clansmen."
Domain experts collectively gasped, stunned by this combat achievement.
Early-stage Saint tier, killing late-stage Demon Saints?
And, under the premise of being domain suppressed?
This Immortal Slayer Spear is too fierce!
Many people hadn’t really heard about the War Division.
Only now did they know that there was such a powerful clan in the lower realm.
With no cross-domain rule suppression on Rootless Island now, wouldn’t they be invincible in the lower realm?
Brother Cheng finally realized why Bi Feng had to create so many dharma bodies and run around various domains back then.
It turned out to be a last resort.
The discussions and astonishment from the major domains reached Zhan Ying’s ears, making his demeanor even more arrogant.
"A few days ago, I battled Huan Cong True Immortal and Ning Wu True Immortal. It was just one against two, outnumbered, and narrowly defeated!"
The crowd was in an uproar.
Had they also fought those true immortals?
Moreover, it was one against two and only narrowly lost?
This combat power already surpassed several heads of the Sword Domain and Demon Realm, as they barely survived by joining forces against the true immortals.
"Now, only with the Nine Treasures together!"
Zhan Ying shouted, "Deploy the Nine Immortals Killing Array to defeat the enemy!"
As the nine array hubs of the Nine Treasures Immortal Extinction Array, if these nine magical treasures joined forces, they could form a smaller version of the array.
Although its power would be far less than the full Nine Treasures Immortal Extinction Array, it still harnessed the power of nine top-grade magical treasures.
With the eight other magical treasures as auxiliary, the power of the Immortal Slayer Spear would increase several times.
Facing two true immortals, there really would be some hope.
As his words fell, the Void Abyss Demon Saint and others’ eyes lit up.
"If this array could truly be set up, perhaps this crisis could truly be resolved!"
"Indeed, with just one Immortal Slayer Spear being so strong, wouldn’t all nine together sweep away the True Immortal Realm?"
The golden flames on Zhan Ying’s spear were menacing.
"Qingsuo, you have two choices."
"Bring the Heart-Piercing Awl and join me in battle!"
"If not, then your Heart Division is unworthy of the Heart-Piercing Awl!"
All eyes focused on Qingsuo.
In their view, this was a heroic act to resist the upper realm’s threat, with no reason to refuse.
However, Qingsuo shook her head.
"Our Heart Division now only follows Sect Leader Jiang, obeying his orders alone."
"Sect Leader Jiang has the ability to defeat the enemy without an array."
She wasn’t foolish.
The Nine Immortals Killing Array’s core was the Immortal Slayer Spear, and the essence of the array was to gather the power of other treasures into one.
Essentially, it would burn the essence of the eight other treasures to temporarily boost the Immortal Slayer Spear’s power several times.
Even if victorious in this battle, the Heart-Piercing Awl would be damaged, greatly reducing its future power.
Moreover, with the domineering style of the War Division, it was uncertain if she could reclaim the Heart-Piercing Awl after the battle.
Just look at how the other divisions behind the War Division were silent.
They were merely subdued, unwilling in their hearts.
"In the face of the great cause of resisting external enemies, you actually disregard the greater good, preferring to follow an outsider and betray the entire Immortal Remnant Race!"
"Qingsuo, you and the Heart Division have let us down."
The golden flames on the Immortal Slayer Spear grew stronger, as if ready to devour.
Qingsuo wanted to argue but was stopped by Jiang Cheng.
"Alright, alright, you’ve shown off enough, it’s time to stop."
"And it’s getting endless."
As he appeared, the previously furious Zhan Ying squinted his eyes.
"Are you Jiang Cheng?"
"This is our Immortal Remnant Race’s internal matter, unrelated to you."
Zhan Ying was not as reckless as he appeared; he had heard of Jiang Cheng’s feat of slaying Zhongtai True Immortal.
Honestly, even with the Immortal Slayer Spear, he wasn’t sure he could do the same.
Although, like the Void Abyss Demon Saint, he was reluctant to believe it, he prudently did not attack Jiang Cheng directly at first, instead focusing on Qingsuo.
Especially with Gui Cang Sword Saint, the Golden Dragon King, and many other experts behind Jiang Cheng.
Before the Nine Treasures could combine, he dared not provoke so many powerful figures excessively.

chapters.title: Chapter 212 Jiang Cheng’s Plan
chapters.content:
Chapter 212: Chapter 212 Jiang Cheng’s Plan
Zhan Ying is actually a clever person.
So from the start, he brought up the great cause of opposing the True Immortals, saying, "I am gathering the nine Magical Treasures to slay those few True Immortals."
"I’m doing this for everyone’s sake."
Qingsuo’s refusal to hand over the Heart-Piercing Awl is tantamount to opposing everyone.
This invisible big hat put on her instantly isolated Qingsuo, making these tens of thousands of experts no longer support her.
In fact, after learning that the Nine Treasures together were so powerful, having the chance to kill those few True Immortals, many onlookers indeed thought so.
They also hoped Qingsuo would listen to the War Division.
Quickly unite the Nine Treasures, take down those True Immortals, and resolve everyone’s crisis.
It’s just a pity that he miscalculated one thing.
Then they saw Brother Cheng wipe the ring, and the Bone Refining Banner with a scintillating purple glow flew up into the air, fluttering in the wind!
"Internal affairs?"
"You want the Nine Treasures to unite, did you get my consent?"
Zhan Ying’s face changed, and there was an uproar behind him from various tribespeople.
"How come the Bone Refining Banner is in your hands?"
"What else? Who did you think had it, Saint Bi Feng?"
Zhan Ying gradually calmed down.
Their information was outdated, not even knowing that Bi Feng had already been killed.
Originally, they were indeed looking for Bi Feng to retrieve the Bone Refining Banner, but they hadn’t found him.
"Did you snatch it from Bi Feng’s hands?"
"Yeah, do you have a problem with that?"
Zhan Ying took a deep breath and extended his left hand.
"Then hand it over."
Brother Cheng almost burst out laughing.
"You talk as if the Bone Refining Banner belongs to you guys."
"The Bone Refining Banner is originally our Immortal Remnant Race’s Magical Treasure, you, an outsider, have no right to possess it..."
Zhan Ying was interrupted impatiently by Brother Cheng before he could finish.
"Isn’t the Bone Refining Banner the Witch Division’s? When did it become the entire Immortal Remnant Race’s?"
"The Witch Division is one of my Nine Divisions of the Immortal Legacy, and with Clan Leader Lan Ti not present, our War Division has the right to keep it on behalf!"
This so-called keeping it on behalf essentially meant it belonged to the War Division.
The name Lan Ti, Zhan Ying had indeed heard a little.
She was the last remnant of the Witch Division when it was exterminated years ago, still young and not very powerful.
Even if she did show up one day, she couldn’t resist the War Division.
"Who told you Lan Ti wasn’t around?"
Brother Cheng summoned once with the Xuanji Map, and the next moment, Lan Ti appeared in front of everyone.
"Brother Cheng, what’s going on? Why are there so many people?"
She had been in the map practicing ascetic cultivation lately, completely unaware of what had happened in the outside world during this time.
But seeing Jiang Cheng again, she was quite excited, and if it weren’t for so many people, she might have embraced him specifically once more.
Her power had astonishingly reached the early-stage Saint Tier.
Upon her appearance, Brother Cheng gained over three billion points again.
Qingsuo was startled, "Lan Ti, how did your progression become so fast?"
She used to be just a junior, but now she’s actually stronger than her.
Brother Cheng couldn’t be bothered to explain and instead started to find amusement in the situation.
