"Sister Lan, he’s trying to snatch our Bone Refining Banner, and even claims this Magical Treasure belongs to their War Division, please uphold justice for me!"
Sister Lan was indeed enraged.
"What?"
"Zhan Ying, when did my Witch Division’s Bone Refining Banner become yours?"
Seeing Lan Ti’s power had reached Saint Tier startled Zhan Ying.
This matter was truly troublesome now.
An early-stage Saint Tier holding the Bone Refining Banner carries immense power.
Originally thought the Witch Division had only one last remnant, easily manipulated, but now it seems to fall short.
His mind turned quickly, immediately starting to argue back.
"Lan Ti, you’re quite bold, daring to hand an Inheritance Treasure to an outsider?"
Lan Ti immediately retorted, "Jiang Cheng is my person, he possesses a Divine-grade Witch Seed, and I’ve appointed him as the new Clan Leader. Didn’t see the Bone Refining Banner automatically recognizing him as its owner?"
Various tribespeople exchanged glances, Divine-grade Witch Seed?
Divine Talent, they’ve never had that among any of these tribes.
A Witch Division almost declared extinct, how could such an extraordinary genius appear?
A talent of this level, it’s indeed logical for him to be the Clan Leader.
Since Jiang Cheng is the Witch Division’s Clan Leader, he indeed has the qualification to intervene in this affair.
Yet Brother Cheng found it difficult to laugh.
Girl, what do you mean by I’m your person?
That sentence sounds like I’m under your protection, how embarrassing.
"Alright then! Since you’re the Witch Division’s Clan Leader, hand over the Bone Refining Banner!"
Zhan Ying extended his hand yet again.
"To resist the True Immortals, surely you won’t refuse, right?"
"Unless you want to disregard the safety of all cultivators in the Lower Realm and only think about internal strife!"
Another big hat was pushed down.
If you don’t agree, you’re ungracious and disregarding the big picture.
"Despicable!"
Qingsuo and Lan Ti were inwardly resentful, clearly seeing through his intentions but unable to refute him.
Then they heard Sect Leader Jiang say something unexpected.
"You’re absolutely right."
"I also think the Nine Treasures uniting is a brilliant proposal."
Hey, which side are you on?
Why are you speaking for the opposite side?
Lan Ti, both angry and anxious, quickly used a sound transmission to him secretly.
"You must not be deceived, the so-called Nine Treasures uniting is just to accomplish the Immortal Slayer Spear!"
"Afterward, the Bone Refining Banner and Heart-Piercing Awl will both be damaged, and he very likely won’t return them to you either."
Brother Cheng nodded to indicate he received the message.
"Hahaha, Sect Leader Jiang truly understands the greater good!"
Zhan Ying also discreetly breathed a sigh of relief.
He was worried this kid would be opposed to him.
"Since you also agree with the Nine Treasures uniting, quickly hand over the Bone Refining Banner then."
Brother Cheng looked bewildered, "Why should I hand it over?"
Zhan Ying’s face darkened, "Sect Leader Jiang, what do you mean by this? Are you planning to go back on your word?"
"Go back on what?"
Jiang Cheng put the Bone Refining Banner away, pointing at his Immortal Slayer Spear, "Aren’t you going to fast hand over the Immortal Slayer Spear and the other Magical Treasures to me? Let me host this Trapping and Killing Array?"
Everyone was momentarily stunned.
Indeed, they had nothing to say.
The uniting of the Nine Treasures isn’t necessarily limited to being under the War Division.
Under the Witch Division, it also makes sense.
The reason everyone defaulted to handing it over to Zhan Ying was just because he was the strongest among the Nine Divisions.
If Jiang Cheng was stronger...
As soon as he finished speaking, Qingsuo immediately declared,
"Our Heart Division fully supports Sect Leader Jiang!"
"Willing to hand over the Heart-Piercing Awl for him to use!"
Zhan Ying almost spat out blood from anger.
I asked you to hand it over, and you were being so obstructive.
Jiang Cheng hadn’t even asked you to hand it over, yet you’re proactively offering it to him?
"Outrageous, thinking of having me hand over the Immortal Slayer Spear, you’re dreaming!"
Brother Cheng was surprised, "So, you plan to disregard the big picture? Go against everyone?"
"When asking others to hand over their Magical Treasures, you said it so smoothly. Now when it’s your turn to hand it over, you can’t take it?"
You’re good at using the greater good to put a hat on others, so now I’m giving it back, why don’t you take it well.
At that moment, no matter the experts from each Great Domain or other tribe members, when looking at the War Division, their perspectives carried a bit of subtlety.
Zhan Ying could no longer bear it, and the golden glow of the Immortal Slayer Spear suddenly swelled at that moment!

chapters.title: Chapter 213: This Is What You Said
chapters.content:
Chapter 213: Chapter 213: This Is What You Said
"You want my Immortal Slayer Spear, and yet you don’t weigh up your own power?"
"Do you really think I’m afraid of you?"
Zhan Ying pointed directly at Jiang Cheng and said coldly, "Since you’re unwilling to hand it over, let’s speak through strength!"
"Whoever wins will receive the Nine Treasures!"
Brother Cheng happily laughed.
"That’s what you said."
He had been waiting for this sentence!
Originally, he had no interest in the Nine Treasures of the Immortal Remnant Race.
Otherwise, given his relationship with the Heart Division, he could have already found a way to seize the Heart-Piercing Awl.
It’s just that he didn’t want it personally, but some people just insisted on delivering it across thousands of miles.
Having heard that the Immortal Slayer Spear can kill beyond tiers, he indeed became a bit interested.
However, the Lan Ti beside him couldn’t be happy about it.
She anxiously grabbed Jiang Cheng, "The Immortal Slayer Spear is the foremost of the Nine Treasures, capable of attacking both the body and the divine soul simultaneously!"
"Zhan Ying is already in the late-stage Saint Tier. With this magical treasure in his hand, no one can probably defeat him in the Lower Realm solo fight."
She still wasn’t aware that Sect Leader Jiang had already defeated a True Immortal.
"Lan Ti, it’s too late!"
Zhan Ying saw her trying to dissuade Jiang Cheng and felt confident.
"The words have already been spoken."
"The peers from various great domains have heard it, and I invite everyone to bear witness!"
He looked around and said loudly, "This duel is a confrontation between Jiang Cheng and me. If I win, the Bone Refining Banner remains mine forever!"
"If he wins, the Immortal Slayer Spear remains his forever!"
"The loser shall have no objections!"
"Our act is also to jointly resist the True Immortal. If anyone regrets, we will strike together!"
All the experts around nodded.
Even Gui Cang Sword Saint had nothing to say and had no reason to stop it.
Brother Cheng almost laughed aloud.
This guy was digging a deeper pit himself, secretly changing it to permanent possession and finding witnesses.
"Then let’s go."
With that said, he pulled out the Gu Yang Immortal Sword.
Not clear of the Immortal Slayer Spear’s power, he decided to be a bit serious.
A spear and a sword, facing each other from afar!
Under the gaze of tens of thousands of experts from various great domains, the two simultaneously launched their attacks!
Then, they saw nothing.
As Jiang Cheng’s Holy Sanctuary unfolded and 992 Main Rules went up, the space was completely disrupted.
Including Gui Cang Sword Saint and Void Abyss Demon Saint, no one could see clearly what was happening inside.
They could only see a massive golden spear light thrusting out, only to be crushed by an even grander millstone.
The blazing sun of Gu Yang Immortal Sword instantly engulfed the spear light, then swallowed Zhan Ying’s body as well.
The spear light turned into countless points of light and mostly dissipated.
Jiang Cheng’s Immortal Demon Body didn’t even have a chance to unleash its power, but his divine soul received unprecedented fierce attacks.
The attack was even more direct than Zhongtai True Immortal’s Immortal Soul assault, directly bypassing magical treasure defenses and penetrating deep into his divine soul.
Immediately, storms erupted within his Holy Soul.
Countless golden fires attacked wildly, like meteors falling from the sky, nearly causing chaos in his consciousness.
If it were another Saint Tier expert, his Holy Soul would be shattered on the spot.
He finally understood why that expert from the War Division could, under cross-domain rule suppression, still slaughter so many Demon Saints back then.
The power of this spear was indeed extraordinary!
Fortunately, his Holy Soul quality was exceptional, surpassing Ten Thousand Ancients.
In an instant, the boundless ocean surged with greater waves, extinguishing all incoming flames.
When the crowd looked at the battlefield again, the battle was over.
On the ground lay the golden Immortal Slayer Spear.
Zhan Ying had been obliterated by a single strike from Gu Yang Immortal Sword, without even leaving ashes.
No way, the Immortal Slayer Spear is focused on attack, not defense.
Both attacked simultaneously, Jiang Cheng blocked it.
He couldn’t block it.
So he died, just like that.
Brother Cheng found this outcome quite natural.
After all, his attack couldn’t be blocked even by Zhongtai True Immortal.
What’s more, after drawing a prize, his Main Rules increased by 480, multiplying the strength of the Holy Sanctuary several times.
An instant kill of a late-stage Saint Tier is reasonable indeed.
But others didn’t see it this way.
What happened?
Where’s Zhan Ying?
They searched for his traces with their divine souls.
But how could they find him?
While they were dazed, Jiang Cheng was unceremonious, raising his hand to grasp the Immortal Slayer Spear.
"You’ve heard it, winner takes all, permanently!"
With that, he gleefully placed the top-grade magical treasure into his Storage Ring.
Yet again, someone sent a treasure; people in this world are really generous.
The other members of the War Division couldn’t accept such a result.
"No way!"
"The Clan Leader didn’t lose!"
"He must still be here, the battle hasn’t ended!"
The former glory of the War Division prevented them from facing such reality.
Jiang Cheng shrugged, "Then let him come out, or you go look for him? Maybe he’s lost his way?"
"There’s no way the Clan Leader just died like that!"
"What kind of demon technique did you use?"
"Give us back our Immortal Slayer Spear!"
Sect Leader Jiang impatiently swung the sword.
"You’ve really been given face, want to accompany him underground?"
In an instant, all accusations stopped.
The members of the War Division broke out in a cold sweat, suddenly regaining clarity.
The Clan Leader was dead, the Immortal Slayer Spear was gone, and they used sheer will?
"I’ll go find the Clan Leader!"
"I’m going too!"
With a rustle, within seconds, all the War Division members withdrew entirely, faster than rabbits.
Leaving people looking at each other.
What exactly happened just now?
They thought it would be a thrilling and dramatic battle.
Especially after hearing about the Immortal Slayer Spear’s former prestige, many even thought Jiang Cheng would be severely beaten.
Who knew, it happened in an instant.
In less than a second, Zhan Ying died, and the battle was over.
What is this?
Crushing?
Or did he really use some demon technique?
Could it be the two of them teamed up to act?
Those top experts in attendance, like Gui Cang Sword Saint, Ling Xing Sword Saint, Golden Dragon King, Void Abyss Demon Saint, and others naturally wouldn’t think so.
Although they didn’t see the details clearly, the terrifying power that erupted in that instant made them deeply understand its significance.
If they had rushed into the center of the battlefield then, they might have perished as well.
That alone was enough!
"Sect Leader Jiang..."
Gui Cang Sword Saint couldn’t suppress the urge to praise Brother Cheng.
"Your power may very well be the first in the history of the Lower Realm!"
This recognition immediately received everyone’s approval.
They hadn’t seen the battle where Zhongtai True Immortal was slain, but this battle had happened right before their eyes.
Though they didn’t know how it was accomplished, Zhan Ying’s death and acquiring the Immortal Slayer Spear were facts.
"Sect Leader Jiang is mighty!"
"With Sect Leader Jiang leading, what do True Immortals count for?"
"Too strong, he is truly the light of our Lower Realm Ten Thousand Realms!"
Void Abyss Demon Saint had nothing to say either.
This power was completely above his, and there was nothing to be dissatisfied with.
"This person has already broken the limits of the Plane!"
"It seems that following him is truly a wise choice."

chapters.title: Chapter 214: There Must Be a Trick
chapters.content:
Chapter 214: Chapter 214: There Must Be a Trick
After killing Zhan Ying and obtaining the Immortal Slayer Spear, Jiang Cheng’s prestige rose once more.
At this time, even those masters from various domains being hunted down, as well as the subordinates of the Four Great True Immortals, were continuously defecting.
They then turned to the Feixian Sect.
After all, Jiang Cheng and they belonged to the same category of Ascenders from the Lower Realm.
Moreover, there were no restrictions here; under the Four Great True Immortals, it was like being a servant, stricter than joining a Sect, with no freedom at all.
In just a few days, 120,000 people gathered on the side of the Feixian Sect.
After accounting for those who died in the Void Immortal Realm, and those absorbed or killed by the teams of several True Immortals during this time, this was almost all the Cultivators remaining on the island from the Lower Realm.
Among these people, there were as many as ten thousand at the Saint Tier.
The only one who hadn’t appeared all along was the strongest, the Desolate Domain.
However, Brother Cheng didn’t care too much, he just knew that his cheerleading squad had become stronger.
"Currently, under the remaining Four Great True Immortals, there are still more than 100,000 people."
"In terms of Saint Tier combat power, our side has already surpassed them!"
"The only thing to be concerned about is those Four Great True Immortals."
In the main hall for discussions, over a hundred peak Saint Tier experts gathered.
On the left were experts from Sword Domain, Celestial Demon Domain, and others, while on the right were strong figures from Demon Realm, Celestial Book Domain, and other domains.
Of the top twenty domains in the Lower Realm Ten Thousand Realms, fifteen were represented here.
This scene even made Mo Chen, an Immortal, sigh in admiration.
Each person in this group had outstanding talent and extraordinary encounters; they were all dragons and phoenixes among people.
Some of them might even be the level of a Child of the Plane.
Otherwise, they couldn’t stand out among the countless Cultivators in the Lower Realm Ten Thousand Realms.
If they succeed in surviving in the Immortal Realm in the future, at least half will become major figures.
And now, the Sect Leader was sitting in the main seat, surrounded by this group like stars around the moon.
Indeed, his Personal Grandmaster had chosen the most extraordinary one to follow!
He couldn’t help but admire his own foresight.
"Sect Leader Jiang, do you know the Nine Immortals Killing Array?"
"Indeed, in the fight against those Four Great True Immortals, this array is crucial!"
Hearing their inquiry, Brother Cheng felt a bit troubled.
After eliminating Zhan Ying, the remaining six divisions were also staying here. If he wanted to claim those six Magical Treasures, the six divisions would have no way to refuse.
As long as he spoke, for the sake of the overall situation, the other domains would also help him seize them.
But in fact, Jiang Cheng hadn’t gone to take those six Magical Treasures.
"Actually, even without that Trapping and Killing Array, it’s not as if we can’t defeat those Four Great True Immortals..."
His power was strong now; it’s just that he couldn’t find those Four Great True Immortals.
Gui Cang Sword Saint hurriedly said, "Sect Leader Jiang mustn’t be overconfident!"
Golden Dragon King also said, "My greatest concern is those Four Great True Immortals joining forces!"
"Sect Leader Jiang is extremely powerful, and I do believe you can defeat one True Immortal, but when facing four, without the Nine Immortals Killing Array, it is definitely not feasible!"
Others nodded repeatedly.
"Indeed, familiarizing yourself with the Nine Immortals Killing Array is urgent!"
"Sect Leader Jiang must not delay."
Void Abyss Demon Saint’s eyes flashed with a sinister light, coldly saying, "Sect Leader Jiang, are you unwilling to seize the Magical Treasures from those six divisions? Now is not the time for mercy!"
"If you truly cannot bear to, this Saint can deal with them for you."
The Demon Saints from the Demon Realm immediately exuded a faint murderous aura.
"We will handle it cleanly."
"After the fact, we will take the blame in the Demon Realm; Sect Leader Jiang can rest assured."
Jiang Cheng was quite speechless.
No wonder you are called Demon Cultivators; your way of doing things is truly indiscriminate.
He hadn’t taken those six Magical Treasures because he didn’t want to set up any Nine Immortals Killing Array.
The core of that Killing Array could only be the Immortal Slayer Spear; the other eight Magical Treasures, by then, would be drained of a large amount of their internal essence, greatly damaged, and might even drop in tier.
And the several times increased power the Immortal Slayer Spear would gain would only be temporary.
It wouldn’t enhance permanently.
This was clearly not a profitable deal.
Especially since the Bone Refining Banner belonged to the Witch Division, he didn’t want to destroy Lan Ti’s treasured object over a single battle.
"No need!"
He waved his hand slightly, and said indifferently, "I already have a strategy to defeat the enemy."
"Don’t complicate matters."
Everyone was stunned, then asked in surprise, "We wonder what brilliant plan Sect Leader Jiang has?"
"This old one is all ears!"
Brother Cheng had no brilliant plan; it was just an excuse to brush them off.
What frustrated him most now was why the enemy hadn’t attacked yet.
Could it be they were expecting him to search the whole world for them?
Wasn’t it agreed that the True Immortals would be formidable, why so cowardly?
But just at this moment, someone hurriedly burst in from outside.
"Urgent report!"
"The two True Immortals, Huan Congning Wu, are in an intense battle with the two True Immortals, Shao Chong and Xin Quan, five million miles away!"
"What?"
Everyone stood up simultaneously.
"They started fighting among themselves?"
"This is a perfect opportunity!"
"Indeed, while the two tigers fight, both will get hurt. We can seize the chance to pounce and destroy them all in one go!"
Many people were exceptionally excited, and Brother Cheng let out a long breath; finally, they revealed themselves.
Being dragged to discuss matters by this group every day had him thoroughly frustrated.
"Then let’s hurry and set off."
"Not advisable!"
Gui Cang Sword Saint blocked his way.
"Sect Leader Jiang, this matter is too suspicious."
Void Abyss Demon Saint also nodded deeply, "Indeed, with my eight million years of roaming experience, this is likely a trap."
Yashu King stroked his beard with a chilling smile, "Not likely, it’s certain. This is a ploy to lure us into the trap!"
Dog-devouring King wondered, "How can you be so sure?"
Taichang Book Saint from Celestial Book Domain said flatly, "If you were those True Immortals and knew someone could slay True Immortals and obtained the Immortal Slayer Spear, what would you think?"
This...
Some who initially called out to attack calmed down.
After thinking it over, indeed something felt off.
Under normal circumstances, those True Immortals should see Jiang Cheng as their top enemy now.
Especially since 120,000 had gathered here, making it faintly the strongest force.
Even if those four Great True Immortals were in two camps and could not see eye to eye, they shouldn’t start biting each other at this crucial moment.
"But not seizing such a rare opportunity seems a bit regretful."
Brother Cheng actually understood the reason in their words.
Just like the Sun-Liu Alliance against Prime Minister Cao, when three stand in a stalemate, the normal maneuver is for the weaker two to team up against the strongest one.
But he still wanted to go into battle immediately.
Because he was strong enough!
No matter what ambush, as long as he saw people, it would be manageable.
Even if it turned out unbeatable, there was still the Resurrection Skill.
Unfortunately, his internal thoughts couldn’t be heard by others.
"Sect Leader Jiang must not act impulsively; we can just wait and see, with our stable position, the enemy will lose their footing and reveal their true intentions..."
"Yeah, confronting changes with constancy will make the enemy lose their advantage and reveal real weaknesses..."
Listening to these Lower Realm bigwigs talking one after another, Brother Cheng was about to break down.
Do you all really have to be this clever?
How long are we going to be in a standoff like this until the year of the monkey?

chapters.title: Chapter 215: These people are too capable
chapters.content:
Chapter 215: Chapter 215: These people are too capable
Jiang Cheng couldn’t wait any longer, he now discovered something.
A massive cheer squad is quite a spectacle, but sometimes it holds him back, making his actions less free.
Forget it, it’s better to go alone.
With that thought, he stood up once more and headed outside.
"Sect Leader Jiang, what is this..."
"Oh, I feel a bit stuffy, planning to go out for some fresh air."
Gui Cang Sword Saint, the Golden Dragon King, and other experts were stunned, finding this line quite familiar.
Back when he went to deal with Zhongtai True Immortal alone, it seemed to be the same excuse.
Not again, boss, are you planning to go solo again?
"Sect Leader Jiang, please don’t be impulsive!"
"This time the situation is different!"
"Indeed, last time we launched a surprise attack, they were completely unprepared."
"This time they’re the ones setting the trap..."
"And last time it was one True Immortal, this time there are four!"
Brother Cheng was once again surrounded tightly.
This group of experts now regarded him as a savior and didn’t want to see him getting surrounded and killed prematurely.
They all treated him as a treasure, how could they just watch him head to his death?
Brother Cheng was exasperated.
Can’t you all drop your IQ for a moment?
"I really am just going for a walk, can’t I, as the sect leader, have even a little freedom?"
Seeing him almost in a fit of rage, the crowd slowly made way for him.
Only then did Sect Leader Jiang briskly walk out of the main hall, planning to go wherever his wings would take him, to charge straight ahead.
But the discussions behind him still sounded so close.
He turned his head and was devastated.
Damn, this group of experts was trailing him closely, never straying more than five meters away.
Wherever he went, they followed.
It was as if they were determined to watch over him.
He wore a bitter smile and spread his hands helplessly, "I’m just getting some air, you all tend to your business, no need to follow me."
Gui Cang Sword Saint’s old wrinkled face surfaced a smile, "Ah, we are also getting some fresh air."
Void Abyss Demon Saint said casually, "Indeed, this Saint suddenly feels stuffy and particularly wants some fresh air."
"What a coincidence, everyone wants some fresh air."
"Haha, yes, yes, accompanying Sect Leader Jiang on a tour here is not bad either."
Jiang Cheng was totally bewildered, do you really need to be this concerned about my safety?
I’m just going out to show off and fall into a trap.
If worst comes to worst, just perish and be done with it.
Where are the pig-like teammates in legends who are slow to react and never save?
Why are all my teammates sharper than foxes?
Next, an odd scene unfolded at Feixian Sect.
Sect Leader Jiang wandered around Feixian Sect, seeking an opportunity to slip away.
But behind him, a group of experts followed closely, refusing to let go.
Moreover, the crowd kept growing.
The sky above was densely packed, and those not in the know might think this group was playing a game of Snake.
Finally, with no other choice, Jiang Cheng steeled his heart.
I’ll just use my speed, at worst, I’ll fly away.
After all, you can’t stop me!
With that thought, he hesitated no longer and suddenly transformed into a stream of light, disappearing into the sky.
This caused an uproar behind him.
"Sect Leader Jiang has escaped!"
"Quick, chase him!"
"We cannot let Sect Leader Jiang go to his death!"
"Hurry, hurry, he’s all alone, he definitely can’t do it..."
Gui Cang Sword Saint and Void Abyss Demon Saint immediately commanded the others to pursue.
Soon, all 120,000 cultivators from Feixian Sect chased out.
They had no choice but to go all out.
Splitting into two groups, in case the enemy was merely luring them away, those left behind would surely perish.
Flying in the high skies, the crowd felt quite frustrated.
This Sect Leader Jiang, although super powerful, doesn’t use his brain, really making them worry themselves sick.
"The opposite side must have set up traps, flying over like this, aren’t we going to fall into an ambush?"
"But we can’t just watch as Sect Leader Jiang heads to his death."
"If he dies, we won’t have the means to kill a True Immortal anymore."
"Yes, and if his banner falls, morale on our side will disperse..."
"Ah, truly a cause for endless worry."
"We’ll take it step by step, hopefully, persuade him back. If we can’t, we’ll have a decisive battle with the enemy."
"When that happens, we hope the experts of Hundred Battle Domain will showcase their talents and command these 120,000 people properly!"
These people hailed from different domains, with diverse paths to sainthood. Besides being experts, each had their specialties.
The Hundred Battle Domain had been at war for years, and several War Saints had attained sainthood through military formations, excelling in military strategy and tactics.
When everyone had their own expertise, now was the time to display their strengths.
"Rest assured, Old Sword Saint, we will give our utmost!"
"Since we know the other side has set traps, we have precautions, and can turn the tables!"
"Sect Leader Jiang charging in alone may be reckless, but it can still be turned to our advantage."
"Oh?"
Void Abyss Demon Saint got interested, "How to turn the tables?"
Then the peak Saint Tier of Hundred Battle Domain, with a light shake of the military talisman, said calmly, "Traps and ambushes fear not that the opponent doesn’t fall for them, but that someone steps in prematurely."
"Sect Leader Jiang stepping into the trap first can leave the opponent at a dilemma."
"If they spring the ambush ahead of time, they’ll only trap him, exposing their setup. If they don’t, Sect Leader Jiang will break and destroy it."
"At that moment, we can make a surprise attack from the periphery, achieving unexpected results!"
Three Chess Saints from Great Yi Domain stroked their beards in praise, "This is indeed turning danger into opportunity, seemingly a deadlock, yet hiding a chance for reversal!"
"Indeed, on the battlefield, nothing cannot be utilized."
"Even a mistake on our side can be transformed into an opportunity!"
Everyone was convinced and their fighting spirit soared.
If Sect Leader Jiang were here, he might vomit blood.
Are you guys still human?
Clearly, I’m headed into a trap, yet you can reverse it to victory?
There are just too many talents, right?
Lingering with this exceptionally capable group every day, where’s the chance to show off?
But, fortunately, he didn’t witness this scene.
At this time, he had already rushed to the location where the Four Great True Immortals were battling.
Upon a closer look, he found the situation wasn’t quite what he expected.
The Four Great True Immortals indeed fought in pairs, but besides these two sides, another party also joined the fray.
That party, though numbering only a thousand, dressed with bare chests and rolled-up pants, looked like primitive people, and even their weapons were stone rods and forks.
However, their stature was far larger than normal humans, almost all reaching over ten meters tall.
Their bronze muscles shimmered with a faint glow, their blows devoid of ordinary sword aura or dao aura, and they even showed no trace of the Holy Sanctuary’s aura.
Their attack style was equally primitive, simple chopping and smashing, yet one Saint Tier expert after another fell to their crude weapons.
Within the Holy Sanctuary, they roamed as if no one was there.
Every strike shook heaven and earth.
Only the Four Great True Immortals’ Daoist Heart attacks could injure them, causing their flesh to split and blood to flow profusely.
Gazing upon the fierce battle ahead, Jiang Cheng instantly recognized the origin of these giants.
This is the Desolate Race, ranked first in the Lower Realm Ten Thousand Realms.
He didn’t expect this conspiracy trap, they’d rushed in first.

chapters.title: Chapter 216: Don’t Disgrace Our Desolate Domain
chapters.content:
Chapter 216: Chapter 216: Don’t Disgrace Our Desolate Domain
Looking at the Desolate Race entangled with the Four Great True Immortals, Jiang Cheng shook his head secretly.
The combat strength of the Desolate Domain is indeed strong, but after all, it’s just from the Lower Realm.
Not to mention taking down the Four Great True Immortals, they can’t even take down two.
Especially since there are still a hundred thousand cultivators under the Four Great True Immortals.
The reason the Desolate Race has lasted until now is simply because the Four Great True Immortals are still pretending, not joining forces against them.
Instead, they deliberately created a three-sided skirmish situation.
"It seems it’s still to await my appearance!"
Brother Cheng confidently shook his smooth hair, then drew the Gu Yang Immortal Sword, brandished the Immortal Slayer Spear, and charged down.
"Brothers of the Desolate Domain, I am here to save you!"
How fierce was his attack power, even before he arrived, a large number of cultivators below were already smashed to pieces by his Holy Sanctuary.
Swinging the Gu Yang Immortal Sword, the ground turned into a purgatory of flames!
With the support of the rules of the Holy Sanctuary, a world constituted by flames was formed.
Those below the Saint Tier couldn’t resist this direct attack of the rules at all, and in an instant turned to ashes.
Even those above the Saint Tier couldn’t hold on for long.
The people of the Desolate Race didn’t even recognize him.
Hearing this, they felt baffled—save us?
But the Four Great True Immortals were not so behind in intelligence.
As expected by the likes of Gui Cang Sword Saint and Void Abyss Demon Saint, the Four Great True Immortals had long listed Sect Leader Jiang as their number one enemy, and had studied him many times.
"Jiang Cheng!"
"Jiang Cheng has finally arrived!"
"He fell into our trap!"
The Four Great True Immortals were overjoyed.
They had indeed been deliberately fighting, setting a trap, waiting for Jiang Cheng and his party to fall for it.
Unexpectedly, the side of the Desolate Domain came first.
Jiang Cheng, who can slay immortals, was obviously more important.
So to catch a bigger fish, they had been stalling with the Desolate Race.
Now that Jiang Cheng had arrived, they could finally close the net.
But immediately, they hesitated again.
"Why is he alone?"
"Where are the Sword Domain and Demon Domain?"
"This... it’s not yet time to close the net!"
On the surface, the Four Great True Immortals were still fighting each other, but in fact, they were secretly discussing through sound transmission.
They decided to wait a bit more.
Wait until the Gui Cang Sword Saint, Golden Dragon King, and other armies also arrived, then reveal their true arrangement.
Immediately, they were attacked by Brother Cheng.
As the Holy Sanctuary emerged, the Daoist Hearts of the four were simultaneously suppressed.
The Gu Yang Immortal Sword cut through the sky with countless flames, with the Immortal Demon Body and Heroic Soul, attacking the four by surprise and forcing them into retreat!
Even the masters of the Desolate Domain beside were dumbfounded and stopped in their tracks.
Seeing Jiang Cheng appear, they wondered who he was.
Now seeing how fierce this guy was, being able to contend with the Four Great True Immortals alone, they were almost scared witless.
"No way!"
"Launch it early!"
The Four Great True Immortals couldn’t wait any longer; if they continued to delay, not to mention the remaining tens of thousands of cultivators, even their lives would be in danger.
Jiang Cheng’s fighting strength was just too strong, far beyond their estimation.
The Four Great True Immortals simultaneously swung out differently colored beads.
As the four beads flew into the sky, they instantly vanished, and then the entire sky suddenly turned gray and hazy.
A huge gray light film covered down, encircling an area of tens of thousands of miles.
The people of the Desolate Race saw things were amiss and rushed to break out.
But they found they couldn’t break through the gray mist’s barrier, instead growing weaker from its erosion.
"What is this?"
"Damn, those Four Great True Immortals are in cahoots!"
"We’ve walked into an ambush!"
Only now did this group of fellows react.
But it seemed too late already.
Nearly a thousand members of the Desolate Domain were all trapped inside the Barrier Array, including Brother Cheng.
"Hahahahaha!"
"Jiang Cheng, you’re done for!"
"This Four-direction Qiless Array is enough to end your life right here!"
"In the Immortal Realm, this array can easily slay Celestial Immortals."
"For a mere Lower Realm cultivator, to receive such a grand treatment, you should feel honored!"
As their voices fell, the gray mist within the big array grew increasingly dense.
The Desolate Race warriors frantically attacked the gray mist around them.
But the gray mist showed no damage, only growing denser.
Their fists touching the gray mist would immediately be corroded.
Their weapons touching the gray mist would immediately become mottled.
Brother Cheng also swung a few swords, but the overwhelming flames were quickly extinguished in the gray mist.
All he could see was the gray mist slowly closing in on him.
Some of the Desolate Race warriors on the periphery were accidentally enveloped by the gray mist, their bodies rapidly corroded, not just flesh and skin, but even bones softened, turning into bloody water.
Whoa, this array is that fierce?
Looks like I’ll have to die once this time.
Sect Leader Jiang was not in a hurry.
"Hahahaha..."
The four True Immortals above who were controlling the array burst into endless laughter upon seeing their plan succeed.
"We forgot to tell you, this Four-direction Qiless Array cannot be attacked; it absorbs the energy of your attacks, becoming even more dangerous!"
What?
The experts of the Desolate Domain were utterly distraught.
So their rampant attacks only fueled the array’s arrogance.
Outside, tens of thousands of cultivators loyal to the Four Great True Immortals were diligently attacking the array.
Not to save anyone, but to ’charge’ the array, making the gray mist inside even fiercer.
"You’re too vicious, aren’t you?"
Being ambushed was one thing, but having an array like this was truly deceitful.
The experts of the Desolate Domain were straightforward and had never encountered such complicated tactics.
While waiting for death, Brother Cheng, bored, smilingly retorted to the four True Immortals above, "Then isn’t your array invincible?"
The people of the Desolate Domain felt a pang of guilt seeing he could still laugh.
Look at that courage.
Trapped in a hopeless situation, facing the relentless gray mist, yet still able to smile.
And then look at ourselves, the warriors of the Desolate Domain, always proud of our resilient willpower, yet now in disarray.
Compared to him, it was clear who was stronger.
"Don’t disgrace our Desolate Domain!"
The Desolate Race Clan Leader Bi Chang raised his stone fork high and furiously ordered, "Everyone laugh!"
The warriors of the Desolate Race were initially stunned, then burst into wild laughter.
"Hahahahaha..."
"Hahahahahaha..."
Bi Chang then looked slightly smug and defiant at Jiang Cheng.
How about that?
We’re laughing louder, more fearlessly.
The Desolate Domain is always number one!
Brother Cheng was dumbfounded. What were these people doing?
So this was the style of the Desolate Domain?
So different from the calculating bunch from the Sword Domain and Demon Domain.
Even in this, they had to compete?
Alright then, I concede to you guys!
The Four Great True Immortals above were also bewildered by this scene.
After a moment of staring blankly, they finally sneered coldly, "The Four-direction Qiless Array has no so-called path or hub flaw."
"The only way to escape is to break the array by force!"
"But this array can’t be broken without the power of the Profound Immortal Level!"
"You have only one path now, and that is death!"
In their view, this was secure.
For cultivators from the Lower Realm to have attack power reaching True Immortal level, that was already heaven-defying.
Like Bi Chang, Gui Cang, Void Abyss, and Golden Dragon King, there were just a dozen or so top experts. Other Peak of Saint Tiers at most broke through the limit of the Saint Tier but hadn’t reached the True Immortal level.
The distance to Profound Immortal level attacks was still far off.
Indeed, though the people of the Desolate Race were still fake smiling, hearing that it required Profound Immortal power to break this array, their eyes all turned despairing.

chapters.title: Chapter 217: Bro, You’re Too Strong
chapters.content:
Chapter 217: Chapter 217: Bro, You’re Too Strong
"Could you talk about that a little later!"
Brother Cheng felt very disenchanted and disappointed after hearing that the great array could be forcefully broken.
"I thought I could finally die smoothly for once."
"Oh, what a bother, gotta waste a few hundred million points again."
He had a tenfold critical strike skill.
With his current attack power capable of easily slaying a True Immortal, plus the blessing of the Immortal Slayer Spear, a top-grade magical treasure, he already reached the Celestial Immortal level.
If he added a critical strike buff, it might really reach the Profound Immortal level.
What a pity!
If the opposition hadn’t mentioned it, he wouldn’t have known, he would have thought that the attack was boosting the array’s arrogance.
Lying down to be killed by the grey mist then, he could resurrect smoothly.
But now, the opponent spoke of the method to break the array.
If he deliberately waited to die, it would mean not using his power.
The system might very well judge it as a suicide attempt.
"Friends from the Desolate Domain, please make way."
He sighed again as he brought out the Immortal Slayer Spear and Gu Yang Immortal Sword.
The people from the Desolate Domain, seeing his actions, were completely baffled.
"If you attack like that, it will boost the grey mist’s arrogance."
"Exactly. Doing that will cause you to die faster."
It was only Jiang Cheng’s strength that gained their respect, along with his fearless courage that had earned their approval.
If it were someone else, even if the Gui Cang Sword Saint came over, they wouldn’t bother to look twice.
Bi Chang even patted his shoulder earnestly and said, "Brother, you can’t just use brute force recklessly. You have to use your mind!"
In his eyes, Jiang Cheng had already become a brother in arms.
But Brother Cheng couldn’t be comforted.
Come on, you guys who don’t even carry any brains with you, rushing straight into the trap, have the nerve to tell me to use brainpower?
What’s that supposed to mean, did you find a sense of intellectual superiority here with me?
"Old brother, don’t worry, I can take care of this great array."
Bi Chang shook his head, his square face with thick brows and big eyes full of sympathy.
"Brother, I know you want to go all out before you die."
"But doing that falls right into the enemy’s trap, making them laugh at us."
"Even if we die, we must not collapse and lose composure; only then can we reach a scornful effect on them, making them gain no sense of achievement even if they kill us."
What logic is this?
Even someone like Brother Cheng couldn’t keep up with their thought processes.
Helplessly, he could only keep quiet.
Silently, he opened the system panel’s critical strike, released the Holy Sanctuary and Heroic Soul, swallowed the pill, and stacked all possible buffs.
Then, adjusted his attack direction vertically upwards.
At this time, the grand army of Gui Cang Sword Saint and Void Abyss Demon Saint finally arrived.
Seeing that gray great array, everyone’s hearts skipped a beat.
Sect Leader Jiang had indeed fallen for it.
"The Desolate Race is inside!"
"The Four Great True Immortals are right above..."
"They have truly teamed up, this is indeed a trap."
"What should we do?"
"Break the great array, rescue Sect Leader Jiang, and fight them to the end!"
"Indeed, with the Desolate Race around, our chances of victory are greater."
A few War Saints from the Hundred Battle Domain were about to arrange an attack formation, but two saints from the Celestial Array Domain quickly flew forward to block everyone.
"No!"
"Under no circumstances should you attack that great array!"
"Why?"
The Array Saint, Gu Ping of the Celestial Array Domain, fixed his gaze on the great array, speaking in a low tone, "If my perception is correct, this is the Four-direction Qiless Array; I have seen it in an ancient book before!"
Void Abyss Demon Saint quickly asked, "What’s special about this array?"
"Anyone touched by the grey mist within this array will certainly die; the array itself can absorb attacks, growing even larger, both from inside and out!"
Everyone realized.
"No wonder the soft-boned people outside are attacking the array; they’re fueling the array’s arrogance!"
"What can be done about this?"
"Is there a way to break this array?"
Gu Ping took a deep breath, "Kill those four True Immortals, grab the Profound Origin Beads they hold; those are the magical treasures used for the array!"
"But our attacks must not touch the great array, or we’ll harm Sect Leader Jiang!"
The War Saints from the Hundred Battle Domain listened and nodded heavily.
Then, they began dividing the manpower.
"Gui Cang Sword Saint, you lead the Sword Domain team as the vanguard. Taichang Book Saint of Celestial Book Domain, you lead as Sword Domain’s flank..."
Their tactical arrangement had just started, the first group hadn’t been fully assigned yet when Brother Cheng inside the array sent forth a sword strike.
A tenfold critical strike!
Along with the auxiliary attack from the Immortal Slayer Spear, counted in this hit.
The four True Immortals above originally found it laughable, considering it like a mantis trying to stop a carriage before death.
Soon, they lost consciousness.
The conglomerate gray array suddenly seemed ignited, turning flaming red!
Following that, a violent explosion echoed across the land!
The ground shook, mountains crumbled, the air in the sky instantly twisted.
The figures of the conforming cultivators around the array disappeared rapidly, all turned to ashes.
In the high sky, a giant fiery dragon charged towards the heavens, numerous chaotic streams of rules swirling and intersecting, like countless arrows choosing prey!
Piercing through the void with countless pitch-black holes!
The great array broke in an instant!
The Four Great True Immortals bore the brunt.
Xinquan True Immortal was the only one who held on, thanks to wearing Tier Two Immortal Armor, slightly stronger in resistance.
But it could only guarantee him not being utterly obliterated.
His Daoist Heart was similarly utterly destroyed, crashing heavily onto the ground, falling into unconsciousness.
Brother Cheng wouldn’t spare any loose ends as he swiftly flew out, completely destroying Xinquan True Immortal’s meridian and Sea of Qi, before lifting him up.
Then he began frantically stuffing his mouth with pills.
This tenfold attack not only consumed 5 billion points but also depleted his Spiritual Power.
Until everything settled, everyone stared at the miles-wide black pit on the ground and the void above that seemed to have emptied, jaws nearly dropping.
Was it over?
What just happened?
Wasn’t the Four-direction Qiless Array incredibly dangerous and utterly unbreakable?
Weren’t they needing to grab the Profound Origin Bead?
Weren’t there still Four Great True Immortals?
How suddenly did they completely perish?
They were planning to mobilize a 120,000-strong army, then charge forward to crush them.
Not needed now?
After traveling five million miles anxiously just to see such a grand firework show?
Everyone’s minds galloped tumultuously, momentarily losing the ability to speak.
Even the people from the Desolate Race below stood dumbfounded on the spot.
Was that strike Profound Immortal level?
Probably, right?
If they had been in front of it, they would have died swiftly as well.
Thus, Bi Chang looked at Jiang Cheng with eyes filled with reverence.
Old brother, your strength is formidable!
Such a fierce character, truly unimaginable.
Until Sect Leader Jiang’s Spiritual Power rapidly recovered over half, did others finally come around, hastily gathering.
"Sect Leader Jiang... Just how strong are you?"
"The Four Great True Immortals, unexpectedly annihilated in one move by you alone..."
"I, this saint, am completely convinced."
"That move far exceeds our current level, truly terrifying!"

chapters.title: Chapter 218 Myriad Phenomena Illusion Immortal Bottle
chapters.content:
Chapter 218: Chapter 218 Myriad Phenomena Illusion Immortal Bottle
They finally understood why Jiang Cheng insisted on coming despite knowing there was an ambush.
With such strength, why fear a mere ambush?
They also understood why he was too lazy to gather the Nine Treasures and set up the Nine Immortals Killing Array.
It was completely unnecessary.
He simply annihilated those Four Great True Immortals along with the Great Array, leaving nothing behind.
What kind of power is this?
The leader of the Lower Realm!
After the intense shock, the crowd erupted in cheers.
"Sect Leader Jiang is mighty!"
"Finally, those True Immortals have all been overthrown."
"We’re not just lambs to be slaughtered in the Lower Realm!"
"With Sect Leader Jiang here, True Immortals are nothing..."
To them, the Five Great True Immortals were like five enormous mountains.
The ultimate goal of cultivation was to become an immortal, so it’s imaginable how much pressure the arrival of the Five Great True Immortals brought them.
Now they finally see the light of day, free from threats.
"Now before us lies the challenge of how to leave this Rootless Island."
"Indeed, the Purifying Dust Immortal Lotus can only carry ten thousand people..."
"It seems we still need to reach Celestial Immortal soon."
With Jiang Cheng present, the crowd had no further thoughts of internal strife or competing for spots to ascend with the Immortal Lotus.
Having been praised fiercely, Brother Cheng was quite satisfied.
"Everyone, calm down for a moment. This Sect Leader has some questions for this destitute immortal!"
After speaking, he lifted the half-dead Xinquan True Immortal.
The crowd hurriedly gathered around.
"Indeed, these Five True Immortals have a problem!"
"Just now, they combined to use the Four-direction Qiless Array, clearly working together. Otherwise, it wouldn’t be such a coincidence!"
"Why did they intentionally split into three factions before?"
"I suspect they deliberately pulled us into factions to make us kill each other."
"The more of us die, the better it benefits them?"
"So what do they gain from it?"
"There must be an earth-shattering conspiracy behind this."
"We’ll know by asking!"
Except for the straightforward folks from the Desolate Domain, anyone who has reached the top in a domain isn’t simple-minded.
This made Brother Cheng want to cry, thinking he was the only one who noticed the problem.
He planned to enlighten them and show off his skills once more, but it turns out this group is incredibly smart.
They even thought of things he hadn’t yet considered.
Can’t you guys be clueless just once, even once would suffice!
"I have a skill in mind-reading and guarantee he will reveal the True Words!"
As soon as the Void Abyss Demon Saint spoke, three Holy Spirits from Spiritual Void Domain drifted over.
The glowing Spirit Bodies emitted waves: "Demon Saint, these words are incorrect. When it comes to souls, none surpasses our Spiritual Void Domain."
"Why not let us delve into his Immortal Soul internally and know everything instantly."
"No, no, let us from the Illusion Division handle it."
Even the Immortal Remnant Race joined the crowd.
"Within our Illusionary Map, he will lose himself and reveal everything thoroughly..."
"Why bother, let us handle it instead..."
All at once, every domain competed fiercely.
No choice, during the recent battle, they played no role making them quite awkward.
Now everyone wants to put on a performance.
Just controlling the enemy to reveal True Words brought forth a variety of methods.
Brother Cheng almost cursed in anger.
Damn, you guys are so capable!
Are you deliberately taking my chance to perform?
A group of ill-intentioned folks, always coveting my King Bi position!
"Enough, enough, this Sect Leader has his methods!"
"Clan Leader Qing, lend me your Heart-Piercing Awl for a moment."
The Heart-Piercing Awl can influence one’s mind beyond its level, and at his current realm, it wouldn’t be difficult to make a crippled True Immortal obedient.
"No problem!"
Upon Sect Leader Jiang’s words, Qingsuo didn’t hesitate to offer their clan treasure with both hands.
At the end, Qingsuo even asked thoughtfully if they needed her and several clan elders to simultaneously use Heart Secret Technique for support.
"No need, no need!"
After saying this, Jiang Cheng summoned the Heart-Piercing Awl, instantly a white glow from the Divine-grade Heart Seed erupted.
Qingsuo and the Heart Race People were astonished!
"Divine-grade Heart Seed!"
"Sect Leader Jiang, you actually possess a Divine-grade Heart Seed?"
"Heavens, are you also from our Heart Division?"
The Heart Race was both surprised and delighted!
They had followed Jiang Cheng for so long, now troubled not by being assimilated by the Feixian Sect, but by the inability to advance their relationship further.
Following Sect Leader Jiang leads to a promising future!
Looking at his disciples’ treatment, it’s clear, even upon reaching the Immortal Realm they can continue to be uplifted.
"Sect Leader Jiang surely is a descendant of our Heart Race, it’s confirmed!"
"Turns out we’re family!"
"Haha, I’ve always felt Sect Leader Jiang was close, and this is the reason."
Fortunately Lan Ti wasn’t present, otherwise, she would’ve argued with them.
He’s clearly a descendant of my Witch Division, alright?
Under the Heart-Piercing Awl’s effect, the gradually awakening Xinquan True Immortal’s eyes became confused, then empty as though soulless.
At this moment, whatever he thinks Jiang Cheng could directly know.
"I ask you, are the Five Great True Immortals all in cahoots?"
Xinquan True Immortal said mechanically, "Yes, we’re all sent by the Great Derivation Immortal Emperor."
"What did he send you here for?"
"To provoke internal strife among you, and kill all Lower Realm Ascenders."
"What?"
Next to them, everyone erupted in anger, cursing instantly.
"That damn Immortal Emperor, what’s he trying to do?"
"Do we know him?"
"Alright, this Saint shall remember the name of Great Derivation Immortal Emperor, once this Saint becomes an Emperor, he shall be destroyed!"
"Count me in!"
Brother Cheng waved his hand and asked again, "Is it just him?"
Mo Chen had introduced him to the Immortal Realm situation, so he was aware the Immortal Realm wasn’t welcoming ascenders.
"It’s not only him, this time there’s also Cangxu Immortal Emperor, Nine Flames Immortal Emperor, Heartless Sword Emperor, Li Yue Immortal Emperor, You Xue Demon Emperor, Wanshi Demon Emperor, Void Splitting Demon Emperor..."
Xinquan True Immortal listed dozens of names in one breath, all top-tier experts at the Emperor level.
This shocked everyone.
Turns out before even reaching the Immortal Realm, they’ve become public enemy number one?
"Why are they targeting us?"
"Because the Immortal Realm doesn’t want to see ascenders. You all will eventually disrupt the Immortal Realm’s dynamics..."
With Xinquan True Immortal’s revelations, the grand conspiracy began to reveal a glimpse of itself.
Once the Void Immortal Realm breaks free of its restraints, the ascension rules will soon be restored.
Whether from Sword Domain, Demon Realm, Illusion Division, Water Tribe, or other domains, all Great Realm talents and Saint Tier cultivators will naturally ascend.
After crossing the tribulation and ascending to the Immortal Realm, their arrival location is random.
And the Immortal Realm is vast, ascenders will be like drops of water, merging into the Immortal Realm’s ocean, who could possibly find them.
When that time comes, though those Demon Emperors and Immortal Emperors are powerful, they can’t stop their rise.
To prevent such events from happening, when the Void Immortal Realm broke free from its seal, Immortal Realm experts acted again.
A group of top-tier powers jointly obscured the heavenly plan and sent down the Immortal Treasure, Myriad Phenomena Illusion Immortal Bottle.

chapters.title: Chapter 219: Not Following the Rules
chapters.content:
Chapter 219: Chapter 219: Not Following the Rules
Inside the Myriad Phenomena Illusion Immortal Bottle, the natural flow of Five Elements rules is ceaseless, with mountains, rivers, and streams all present, and the Immortal Treasure inherently contains a certain amount of Immortal Yuan Qi.
In the end, some birds and beasts were deliberately taken in, making it extremely vast, like a real world.
It misleads people into believing it is the Immortal Realm, provoking them to enter willingly drawn by golden light.
After the Immortal Treasure was jointly sent down, it isolated the plane barrier, so the great powers of the Upper Realm could no longer manipulate it.
But it’s already enough.
The Immortal Yuan Qi here is merely carried by the Immortal Treasure itself, and its quality is far inferior to the normal Immortal Realm’s Immortal Yuan Qi.
Moreover, the number of people is too large, so it will quickly become increasingly thin, exhausting within a few years.
This Immortal Treasure is far less miraculous than the Xuanji Map.
The Xuanji Map constitutes a world of its own, possessing a complete system of rules, allowing continued comprehension of realms and communication with the rules of heaven and earth within.
Whereas the Myriad Phenomena Illusion Immortal Bottle is just an Immortal Treasure space, isolated from the outside world.
Here, everyone is unable to cultivate the rules of heaven and earth outside.
They will no longer have new realm enlightenment.
Many cultivators are diligently cultivating now just due to the temporary stimulant of Immortal Yuan Qi.
After a while, they will encounter realm barriers, and these barriers may remain unbroken for life.
Their cultivation will stagnate until the day their lifespan is exhausted.
As for going out?
Not even the Saint Tier from the Lower Realm, let alone the Profound Immortal and Golden Immortal from the Immortal Realm, has the ability to unravel this Immortal Treasure.
In fact, the Upper Realm’s great powers originally intended to send some aggressive Immortal Treasures down.
However, such Immortal Treasures rarely entice people to fall for them.
The only thing that can make people voluntarily enter and eagerly dive inside is the Myriad Phenomena Illusion Immortal Bottle.
Trapping them till they die naturally or killing them results essentially in the same.
Moreover, the Upper Realm arranged for five True Immortals to enter the Immortal Treasure space, sending them down together to stir chaos inside.
This, actually, is unavoidable.
Five True Immortals is the maximum the Immortal Treasure can carry down to the Lower Realm.
But with their instigation, people inside won’t survive to die naturally; they’ll end up mutually slaughtering each other.
The five True Immortals aren’t foolish; they know indiscriminate killing will incite everyone to attack them.
The Lower Realm has too many skilled individuals; these five cannot suppress them.
That’s why they purposely divided into three major camps, playing out a Three Kingdoms strategy, recruiting one faction and suppressing another.
First, eliminating the rebellious faction in the Domain.
Then, having the three True Immortal camps battle, depleting those who surrendered.
One cannot say it wasn’t vicious!
"So this is not Rootless Island here?"
"No, the Immortal Realm doesn’t actually have Rootless Island; we just deceive the Lower Realm who are less knowledgeable."
"And the mist surrounding..."
"That’s the toxic mist carried by the Immortal Treasure. Because it’s isolated from the plane, the treasure has no master, no one to control it, or it could directly refine everyone inside."
"And the Purifying Dust Immortal Lotus, doesn’t exist either?"
"Correct."
Upon hearing this, the people from the Lower Realm were on the verge of exploding with anger.
Even the extremely dignified Gui Cang Sword Saint’s white beard trembled.
"Such outrage!"
"This is sheer bullying!"
"My serene thoughts have been provoked; sin, sin!"
"Damn, they’re treating us like fools here!"
We thought we had really ascended to the Immortal Realm, only to find we’d been spinning within another’s Immortal Treasure all along?
Utter humiliation and disgrace!
"How can one escape from this Immortal Treasure?"
"Only at the Immortal Venerable Realm can it be broken."
"Is there no other way then?"
"None."
This outcome nearly suffocates everyone’s last strand of hope for leaving.
"Above the Profound Immortal is the Golden Immortal, and above the Golden Immortal, one becomes Immortal Venerable."
Mo Chen shook his head, sighed, "It’s far beyond your current realm."
The Child of the Plane’s fortune is extraordinarily defying, but currently, it’s a trap set by dozens of Immortal Emperors and Demon Emperors.
This former Immortal was exasperated too.
This is absolutely not playing by any norm!
Under normal circumstances, shouldn’t those Children of the Plane at most face Celestial Immortal enemies when they are True Immortal, and face Profound Immortal enemies when they are Celestial Immortal, defeating them step by step?
Shouldn’t enemies come from weak to strong, lining up in a very orderly manner to provide experience points?
How could a Child of the Plane be targeted by Immortal Emperors even before ascending to the Immortal Realm?
And they’re dozens of Immortal Emperors at that.
No way to survive!
The fiery atmosphere in the scene gradually quieted down.
Thinking that the rest of their lives would be trapped within this Immortal Treasure, unable to ascend, no one could cheer for the previous victory anymore.
"Alas, never did I imagine that we, having cultivated half a lifetime in hardship, would end up like this."
"The Immortal Realm is indeed too oppressive!"
"It’s not time to give up yet, this Saint has never experienced despair in my life."
"If one day I can escape, I will definitely vow to oppose the Immortal Realm to the death!"
"Escape is easier said than done..."
"Even a prodigy like Sect Leader Jiang may end up old here; such a pity."
Only these elite masters from the Lower Realm, experienced in countless trials, could still maintain a surface calm.
Another group of people would have long since lost composure, going insane right now.
Yet in their eyes, presumably the most tormented Sect Leader Jiang remained quite busy.
Before the questioning began, he already instructed Three-Eyed Tiger and Mo Chen to hurry and collect a field of spoils.
After finishing the inquiry, he didn’t dwell on the predicament at all.
He was busy with tallying spoils and then exchanging for points.
He truly wasn’t anxious.
Even if there’s really no way out, he still has the Xuanji Map.
Inside the Treasure Map, he can continue cultivating and advancing his realm; even if the pills are all used up, it’s not a problem, because there’s Immortal Yuan Qi-level Spirit Vein upgraded by Ah Huang inside.
If it really doesn’t work, just wait for the disciples inside to cultivate to the Immortal Venerable.
Besides, he’s not without a chance to escape.
Indeed, his current power, even with a tenfold critical strike, is far from reaching the Immortal Venerable level.
It’s absolutely impossible to forcefully break this Immortal Treasure from within.
But he can directly enter that toxic mist around the Immortal Treasure and pass through it!
That toxic mist can even annihilate Immortal Venerables, but the issue is...
Dying just happens to be Brother Cheng’s specialty, isn’t it?
After collecting all the spoils, while people were still discussing the predicament.
Most people were unsatisfied with the current situation, seeking ways to leave here.
But after discussing for a long time, they couldn’t find a solution.
A small portion of people, on the other hand, decided to give up.
Some were already tidying up, planning to find a secluded scenic place inside to spend the rest of their lives.
The most absurd was that someone even started considering perpetuating their lineage within the Treasure Bottle, casting glances at female cultivators.
"Ahem!"
Brother Cheng coughed lightly and stepped forward.
"Actually, there’s not completely no chance of leaving."
As these words fell, the entire scene fell silent!
Even those who planned to leave and find a place to retire, turned back excitedly.
This sentence, if spoken by anyone else, would be deemed as boasting.
How to break the means of the Immortal Emperors?
But Jiang Cheng is different, he created too many miracles.
"Sect Leader Jiang, do you truly have a way to leave?"
Gui Cang Sword Saint excitedly gripped his hand.

chapters.title: Chapter 220 Self-Sacrifice for Others: Sect Leader Jiang
chapters.content:
Chapter 220: Chapter 220 Self-Sacrifice for Others: Sect Leader Jiang
Who wouldn’t want to leave here if they could?
For a moment, Jiang Cheng was surrounded by people again.
Whether from the Desolate Domain or the Demon Realm, everyone looked at him with hopeful eyes.
"Sect Leader Jiang, if you can lead us out, there will surely be rewards in the future!"
"No need for more words, if you can indeed get us out, Sect Leader Jiang, with one word, we’ll go through storm and rain for you!"
"If this succeeds, Sect Leader Jiang will be the best friend of everyone in the Demon Realm."
The Desolate Domain folks were more sincere, Clan Leader Bi Chang just said, "Brother, if in the future you want to beat someone up, just let us know!"
If it were anyone else, they’d probably be overjoyed.
So many favors from the lower realm’s prodigies, even an Immortal Emperor couldn’t entirely gain them all.
When they eventually ascend to the Immortal Realm, once these people start cultivating, what a formidable force that would be?
Unfortunately, Brother Cheng doesn’t need it.
He doesn’t want to join these guys, constantly vying for an opportunity to show off.
Because they are overly capable.
Turning them into subordinates to gain points is impossible.
Some people are destined not to be subdued.
So he’s quite uninterested.
"Alright, I’m just giving it a try, whether it succeeds or not is still uncertain."
"Sect Leader Jiang, do you have a plan?"
"Perhaps we can also offer suggestions!"
Give it a rest, can you stop showing off your divine techniques?
"My plan is simple, I’ll charge through the edge poison mist. Cross the poison mist, and leave this Immortal Treasure."
As soon as the words fell, everyone was shocked.
"What?"
"Charge through the edge poison mist?"
"Absolutely not!"
"This poison mist can turn even an Immortal Venerable into a pool of blood, Sect Leader Jiang, you mustn’t be impulsive!"
"Indeed, it’s a path to certain death!"
That edge poison mist, shortly after they first arrived, they saw people exploring it.
Anyone touching even a wisp would immediately have their body and soul obliterated, leaving no trace.
Too dangerous.
Brother Cheng couldn’t tell them he can resurrect.
"Everyone need not persuade further!"
"Although I, as sect leader, only have... a ten percent chance."
With a clang, he withdrew the Gu Yang Immortal Sword, raising it high towards the sky.
"But for everyone to see the sun again, to gain freedom, why not give it a chance?"
Brother Cheng habitually fostered goodwill again.
"Not just a ten percent chance, even if there’s only a glimmer of hope, it’s worth a try!"
"For everyone, I am willing to take this risk!"
His words were heroic and magnanimous, a true disregard for his own life.
Instantly, everyone present was moved, even Mo Chen wasn’t an exception.
Isn’t this too noble?
Is there actually such high-minded people in the Cultivation Realm?
To be honest, among these 120,000 people, most are not members of the Righteous Dao.
There are many Demon Cultivators of the wicked path, and even among prestigious sects, not all are paragons of virtue.
Yet facing the successive predicaments, they knew heartfelt cooperation was the best choice, thus appearing harmonious and united.
Now suddenly someone like this appears, everyone’s caught off guard.
"Sect Leader Jiang, you... need not go to such lengths for us!"
"Truly ashamed of myself..."
"Sect Leader Jiang... you should reconsider!"
Everyone wanted to leave.
But Jiang Cheng’s self-sacrificing spirit was truly rare in the Cultivation Realm.
If it were them, with only a ten percent chance, there’s no way they’d risk death.
These old ancient beings, who have lived for millions of years, haven’t been touched like this for such a long time.
Clearly, such actions in their eyes count as foolish.
Yet deep inside, they can’t help but feel moved.
Some young geniuses with not too long cultivation ages clenched their fists, tiger eyes brimming with tears.
Bi Chang squatted his tall frame, heavily patted Brother Cheng on the shoulder, and said earnestly, "Brother, you put us Desert People to shame!"
"I’ve decided, I’ll follow you inside, paving the way for you!"
Damn, old brother, do you really have to be so sincere?
I’m not going to truly die, you charge in there and you will truly be dead.
Besides, this opportunity to display prowess is mine alone, don’t steal it from me!
"No, you absolutely mustn’t do that!"
"Although I have a ten percent chance, what if it actually succeeds?"
"I can try alone, but I can’t let more people die in vain!"
With that, he let go of Bi Chang’s big hand and resolutely flew towards the sky.
The only one expressing skepticism was the Three-Eyed Tiger.
This fellow and Brother Cheng were cut from the same cloth, it deeply suspected this was yet another prelude to showing off.
However, it dared not say it out loud.
Otherwise, the others would certainly rage and kill this ’villainously speculating’ hero’s vile Little Demon.
Flying swiftly all the way, flying for a full two hours, not knowing how many miles were covered, eventually heavy gray mist appeared above.
The others also caught up.
"Sect Leader Jiang, have you truly decided?"
"Even if you regret, now is still not too late..."
"You are undoubtedly the top prodigy of the Lower Realm Ten Thousand Realms, if you fall like this, it’s such a pity!"
Brother Cheng would never hesitate.
He turned around, displayed a faint smile.
"Everyone rest assured, as long as I can leave, I can take the Immortal Treasure into the true Immortal Realm."
"At that time, there will inevitably be opportunities to help you escape!"
With that said, he charged headlong into the toxic mist.
"Sect Leader Jiang!"
Qingsuo and other Heart Race people cried out, both moved and sorrowful.
"Sect Leader Jiang is so noble!"
"Regrettable, painful..."
"No matter the outcome, this old man will remember Sect Leader Jiang’s benevolence today!"
"In all my 9 million years of roaming, I’ve never truly respected anyone. From today, Sect Leader Jiang is the only exception."
"If we truly escape to the Immortal Realm, I will certainly support future generations ascending from the Thousand Spirit Domain!"
Everyone gazed at the gray mist, inside there was no longer a trace or hint of movement.
None knew what the result was.
Whether he truly went through or perished.
If they knew the truth, they’d likely be rendered speechless collectively.
After entering the poison mist, unsurprisingly, Brother Cheng died.
Afterwards, the system prompt sound unsurprisingly rang out.
"Ding, host has been killed, detecting enemy power, arranging resurrection plan."
"Ding, host has successfully refined the Myriad Phenomena Illusion Immortal Bottle!"
"Ding, host resurrected!"
Damn, that was simple?
Initially, Jiang Cheng thought the system would bestow him with an immunity to the poison, then force him through the mist, reaching salvation.
Unexpectedly, the system was so straightforward, directly making him the master of this Immortal Treasure.
That made things a lot easier.
Originally, he didn’t know the extent of the poison mist, nor how long he’d have to fly to escape it.
Now it’s different.
A single thought, and he appeared outside the Immortal Treasure.
Before him floated a treasure bottle entirely green in color, suspended alone in mid-air.
Beneath were layers upon layers of clouds.
Below them, so far away, was the Lower Realm Ten Thousand Realms.
The Void Immortal Realm had disappeared, and the ascension rules had resumed.
Feeling the external rules’ aura anew, he discovered his realm loosening, truly sensing the imminent breakthrough intuition towards ascension.

chapters.title: Chapter 221: Ascension to the Immortal Realm
chapters.content:
Chapter 221: Chapter 221: Ascension to the Immortal Realm
Taking the treasure bottle into his hand, Brother Cheng was about to release everyone inside immediately.
Now that he had become the master of the Immortal Treasure, he could control this treasure.
But just before he acted, he stopped again.
He wasn’t having second thoughts; instead, a different idea suddenly struck him.
This place was still part of the Lower Realm.
If he released them now, even if the Ascension Rules were restored, only a few thousand late-stage and peak Saint Tier experts could immediately break through and become immortals.
Moreover, whether these people could all make it into the Immortal Realm alive was still a question.
After all, there was the Thunder Tribulation, and some might even be struck dead.
As for the remaining over one hundred thousand people, they would have to continue their ascetic cultivation in the Lower Realm.
This included everyone from the Heart Division, as well as the Three-Eyed Tiger.
If Jiang Cheng himself crossed the tribulation and ascended early, that treasure bottle would be taken into the Immortal Realm with him.
It would be different if he released people then...
Thinking of this, he immediately opened the system lottery interface.
After this great battle, his points had already reached 153.6 billion.
He went for a 400 consecutive draw.
This time, he got two more Heroic Souls, namely the Speed Heroic Soul and the Mire Heroic Soul.
The former could increase his attack and flying speed by 50%, while the latter could slow down the enemy’s actions.
They were two very practical Heroic Souls.
Besides these, there were dozens of Second-grade Immortal Pills and a dozen or so Divine-grade Talent Seeds.
The Xuanji Map had once again obtained a pile of fragments.
After synthesizing, the Treasure Map could now accommodate up to 500,000 people.
The time flow rate had also reached 25,000 times.
In addition, there were Rule Fragments.
After 400 consecutive draws, all his Main Rules finally advanced to the Entry Level.
The extra fragments also elevated 5 rules to the Small Success Level.
At this point, he had completed the final step of the Saint Tier.
His Spiritual Power and Divine Soul were all at the peak of the Saint Tier, and his Domain Main Rules were all at the Entry Level.
As for other thresholds like the Martial Dao Realm, he had surpassed them by a large margin long ago.
Therefore, when all the rules were enhanced and he activated his cultivation technique, his Ascension Tribulation finally arrived!
The sky within ten thousand miles turned pitch black, and purple electric light flickered intermittently in the clouds, emitting an aura of destruction.
For other cultivators, crossing the tribulation would require full preparation.
Stock up on Magical Treasures, pile up as much armor as you can, carry as many talismans as possible.
Adjust your state, choose a suitable location, and ideally arrange a Defense Array.
Finally, only then would they cautiously plead for the Thunder Tribulation, hoping to pass it by luck.
But Brother Cheng was different; he wasn’t even bothered to prepare anything.
He lay down under the Thunder Tribulation with the treasure bottle in hand.
There was no helping it; this was already just a minor scene for him.
His own full strength attack was even stronger than this Thunder Tribulation.
Not to mention, he had an Immortal Body and a Demon Body, both more advanced than the Thunder Tribulation.
"Hurry up, bro’s in a rush!"
After making a small request to the Thunder Tribulation, he simply closed his eyes.
Then the first Thunder Tribulation descended.
The bucket-thick Zixiao Thunder Tribulation struck his body accurately, but unfortunately, Brother Cheng was still wearing the Immortal Armor he had just captured.
Even though he was engulfed head to toe by the Zidian, to the point that his figure couldn’t be seen, he didn’t lose a single hair.
After the first Thunder Tribulation, the black clouds above rumbled, brewing a larger wave of onslaught.
After a while, the next Thunder Tribulation arrived.
It was twice as large as the previous one, and its momentum was even more terrifying.
But sadly, it still couldn’t bring any harm to Brother Cheng.
As one wave of more intense Thunder Tribulation fell after another, some cultivators in the Lower Realm were alarmed, looking fearfully into the distant sky.
"What happened?"
"This thunder and lightning doesn’t seem like normal rain and thunder."
"It actually looks like the Thunder Tribulation recorded in ancient texts..."
"Wasn’t it said that no one has been able to ascend to become an immortal for millions of years?"
"Could it be that the Ascension Rules have finally been restored?"
"I wonder which great power is crossing the tribulation; this is the first one in millions of years!"
Many people even flew into the sky, wanting to see the excitement and witness this historic moment.
However, they were quickly stopped by other old cultivators.
During the Thunder Tribulation, approaching would also attract attacks, which was purely a suicidal move.
Some sects gazed reverently at the scene as a whole.
"Looking at the scale of this Thunder Tribulation, it’s already down to the last two strikes."
"As long as they endure, they’ll be an Immortal!"
Until the last Thunder Tribulation ended, the true Reception Golden Light shone on the earth, dispersing the overwhelming clouds.
At the moment the Reception Golden Light appeared, some top powerful figures in the Upper Realm Celestial Palace were finally alarmed.
"Someone from the Lower Realm is coming up."
"The life tokens of the last five True Immortals have all shattered; it seems the treasure bottle failed to trap them."
"The Immortal Realm is about to enter a tumultuous time."
"No need to worry, send people to investigate everywhere; if found, simply kill them."
"There’s no difference in appearance between the Ascender and the Immortal Realm immortals..."
Sect Leader Jiang, who had been sleeping half the day, was awakened by the intense bright light and found it extremely dazzling.
Then the light flashed and disappeared, and he vanished from where he was.
When he reappeared, he was already in a strange area.
"Ding, Plane change detected, the system needs to upgrade."
"Do you wish to upgrade immediately? A reboot is required during the upgrade process."
Brother Cheng was so stunned by the string of system prompt tones that he didn’t even have time to survey his surroundings.
Is this like a cellphone or computer system?
Requires upgrading and rebooting?
He hurriedly spent some points to ask questions.
"What’s the use of upgrading?"
"After upgrading, the system will be able to develop new features for the current plane."
"How long will the upgrade take?"
"Unknown."
Damn, this seems like a trap.
Might take several months?
"What happens if I don’t upgrade?"
"Not upgrading won’t affect the current invincible features; the skills and rewards currently gained by the host remain valid."
"In that case, I’ll wait to upgrade later when I have free time."
Now he could perceive that the Immortal Yuan Qi was ten times more abundant than inside that treasure bottle before.
Needless to say, he had arrived at the true Immortal Realm.
Apart from the Immortal Yuan Qi, what gave him the greatest impression here was the increased pressure.
The space had also become more stable.
Brother Cheng expressed his understanding of this.
The Upper Realm Plane, after all, would certainly have some differences.
All around was an uninhabited mountain forest, occasionally hearing the cries of birds and sparrows in the distance.
"Oh well, the spawn point is unremarkable."
Brother Cheng was slightly disappointed.
If only he could land in someone else’s Immortal Crystal Mine like that Profound Luo Immortal Emperor did back in the day.
That way, he would start the Immortal Realm with a mine of his own.
As for being enslaved, being made a miner?
Not possible, okay?
He summoned the treasure bottle, and immediately this forest became lively.
From the Lower Realm Ten Thousand Realms, 120,000 cultivators extracted themselves from the treasure bottle and appeared all over the forest.
As soon as they appeared, they felt the abundance of the Immortal Yuan Qi.
"We’ve escaped!"
"Sect Leader Jiang succeeded!"
"Where is this place?"
"This is the Immortal Realm, for sure!"
"Hahaha, we’ve finally made it here!"

chapters.title: Chapter 222: Collective Crossing the Tribulation
chapters.content:
Chapter 222: Chapter 222: Collective Crossing the Tribulation
To be honest, during the time waiting in the Treasure Bottle, everyone had lost hope.
Breaking into the poison mist was entirely a situation of certain death.
Now being truly rescued, one can well imagine the surprise.
Bi Chang, Gui Cang Sword Saint, Golden Dragon King, Void Abyss Demon Saint, and others all came forward to express their gratitude.
Especially when they learned that Jiang Cheng had deliberately ascended first and then opened the Treasure Bottle to bring everyone up together, many were moved to tears.
"Truly a painstaking effort."
"We owe our survival to Sect Leader Jiang turning the tide!"
"Such grace as giving a second life is not an exaggeration!"
"Indeed, not only saving us but also bringing us to the Immortal Realm."
"Many thanks to Sect Leader Jiang!"
All cultivators present bowed deeply; this gratitude came from the heart.
Even those with evil dispositions were no exception.
