They could not deny this favor since the previous goal of cultivation was entering the Immortal Realm, which Brother Cheng helped them achieve sooner.
Not a single sound of alert.
Brother Cheng scornfully pursed his lips.
Just as he was about to say something, the sky darkened again.
Then, purple lightning appeared again within the thick clouds.
What the heck is going on?
"Ahem, this old man is about to cross the tribulation."
Gui Cang Sword Saint awkwardly flew into the sky.
Although he entered the Immortal Realm, he has yet to possess an immortal body.
The process of crossing the tribulation to become a True Immortal will still occur.
He also dislikes crossing the tribulation at this time, primarily due to the great commotion it would cause, given that he is unfamiliar with the surrounding environment.
But there was no choice; he had been a half-step away from becoming an immortal for a long time.
Upon entering the Immortal Realm, the stimulation from the Immortal Yuan Qi and Immortal Realm Rules was unstoppable.
Not only him, but Bi Chang, Void Abyss Demon Saint, Golden Dragon King, and over thirty Peak of Saint Tier cultivators were too perfect in their realm to suppress their steps towards immortality.
All faced the tribulation clouds.
"Quickly scatter!"
"Don’t crowd too close!"
"That’s right, if you’re too close, the Tribulation Thunder will be magnified!"
The thirty-some Peak Saint Tier in the sky naturally understood this principle, and now all dispersed.
When the Tribulation Thunder descended, more than ten Peak of Saint Tier experts below flew off.
"No good, I can’t suppress it either!"
"Quickly move aside, I’m about to cross the tribulation too!"
Not just them but dozens of Peak of Saint Tier experts were struggling to suppress it.
They didn’t want to cross the tribulation simultaneously.
But there was no choice; many had been suppressed for eight million, even nearly ten million years.
Their accumulation was too profound.
Brother Cheng was rather speechless, could you respect the sacred and glorious life event of becoming an immortal, instead of behaving as if waiting in line for the restroom?
After a long half-day, the continuous tribulation finally gradually dispersed.
Looking again, among the 120,000 people, 235 had become immortals.
Though all became True Immortals, it still set several records.
In one day, 235 people together became immortals; even in the Immortal Realm, such splendor does not exist.
Moreover, 235 people successfully crossed the tribulation, none failing, and they all possessed immortal bodies.
There was no choice; previously, even late-stage Saint Tier could attract Thunder Tribulation.
Due to the ascension rules being interrupted for ten million years, they had forcibly accumulated to the limit of the Saint Tier, a realm that had not existed before.
Their foundation and accumulation were too profound.
However, as the crossing tribulation location was within the Immortal Realm, upon crossing, these people did not randomly appear across the Immortal Realm but remained in place.
Before the crowd could celebrate, outsiders appeared above.
"Where do you come from?"
Such a vast number of people crossing the tribulation naturally attracted the attention of native inhabitants of the Immortal Realm.
Thousands of immortals appeared in the sky, making everyone tense.
Now they know the Upper Realm’s attitude towards ascenders; if their identities were exposed, they might become public enemies of the Immortal Realm.
In such a scenario, even an Immortal Emperor might be drawn here.
What they most desired now was to swiftly integrate into the vast sea of the Immortal Realm, escaping noticeable attention.
Then cultivate step by step upwards.
Gui Cang Sword Saint and Void Abyss Demon Saint quickly transmitted their voices to Brother Cheng.
"Sect Leader Jiang, the opponent is strong; do not act impulsively!"
"Among them, there are 105 whose auras are far above ours, likely Celestial Immortals; such a lineup cannot be resisted."
As they transmitted, a middle-aged man with a silver helmet stepped out from the immortals above.
His aura was as deep as an abyss, clearly above the over a hundred Celestial Immortals.
With dozens of guards around him, he slowly spoke.
"What were you just doing?"
"Who is crossing the tribulation? Has my city granted permission?"
The crowd stared at each other.
What?
Crossing a tribulation requires permission?
What business is it of yours if we cross a tribulation?
Mo Chen, that Immortal Realm veteran, immediately stepped forward.
"We come from Milo Celestial Realm and were unexpectedly transmitted here due to a sudden whirlwind storm."
"Newly arrived, much disturbance has been caused; we hope you will forgive us."
"We will immediately withdraw from here, not causing any trouble for you."
Mo Chen’s words left Gui Cang, Void Abyss, and other veterans surprised.
How did this person beside Sect Leader Jiang know the names of Immortal Realm regions?
However, his reaction won their secret nods.
Well spoken, with a low profile, appearing harmless and giving plenty of face.
Unless exceedingly troublesome, they should easily resolve this mishap.
However, the Profound Immortal leader seemed less accommodating.
"Milo Celestial Realm?"
"Why has this City Lord never heard of it?"
He scrutinized the crowd.
His gaze lingered on over two hundred True Immortals, with an unclear expression.
The two experts from Earth Divination Domain quickly transmitted their voices: "It’s bad; his gaze contains greed, surely not a good person!"
"This old man divined and found unclear fortunes ahead, with impending bloodshed disaster!"
Void Abyss frowned: "We’re merely True Immortals, our items merely Lower Realm possessions; what could he covet?"
Then that Profound Immortal City Lord waved his hand, and behind him, the thousands of immortals rapidly spread out, indeed encircling everyone.
Everyone’s hearts sank.
"Doomed..."
"If a fight breaks out, we can’t resist..."
"Could it be that just upon arriving in the Immortal Realm, we will perish here?"
Then the City Lord coldly spoke: "This City Lord cares not where you come from, now you are within my Dingtian City’s territory!"
"Celestial Palace commands: during the Immortal City Ascension Battle, surrounding hundreds of miles of cultivators must comply unconditionally!"
"From now on, all of you are conscripted into my Dingtian City’s Immortal Martial Army fourth battalion!"
"If you disobey, you will be killed on the spot!"
This speech left everyone confused.
What Immortal City Ascension Battle?
They had already ascended to the Immortal Realm, why ascension again?
Moreover, does the Immortal Realm engage in warfare?
What is this Immortal Martial Army fourth battalion, resembling the Mortal World?

chapters.title: Chapter 223: Brother Cheng’s Fiery Temper
chapters.content:
Chapter 223: Chapter 223: Brother Cheng’s Fiery Temper
Jiang Cheng didn’t understand either.
"Old Mo, what’s this Ascension Battle about, and why haven’t you ever mentioned it?"
Mo Chen looked troubled; he felt that his identity as an immortal was somehow useless.
For someone who’s traveled far and wide, he surprisingly couldn’t provide an answer.
"I also don’t know. I’ve never heard of it before. It must have appeared sometime in these millions of years."
Brother Cheng couldn’t even be bothered to be disappointed.
He could only directly ask the City Lord on the other side.
"What is the Ascension Battle? Are we supposed to go to war?"
This question shocked Gui Cang, Void Abyss, and the others.
To conceal their identity as Ascenders, these old foxes acted like they understood everything, hiding their confusion and waiting to subtly probe for answers later.
Who would have thought Brother Cheng would ask so directly?
Boss, benefactor, doesn’t this question expose that you know nothing?
The other side might start questioning your origin!
However, the City Lord didn’t seem to consider this and didn’t doubt their identities.
Instead, he coldly said, "You have no right to ask questions; your only job is to obey!"
After saying this, he waved his hand, and those thousand immortals started herding everyone like prisoners towards the city.
What the hell?
Brother Cheng couldn’t take it anymore.
What’s this nonsense?
Do they not know what death looks like when putting on airs in front of the protagonist?
He had just rolled up his sleeves when Void Abyss and Gui Cang hurriedly grabbed him.
"Benefactor, now’s not the time to make a move!"
"Yeah, their forces are strong; let’s endure for now!"
"We don’t know anything yet; better to understand the surroundings first before deciding."
Everyone, like loyal ministers advising a tyrant, struggled to persuade him.
Actually, Jiang the Tyrant suddenly realized he didn’t even know where the city was; letting them lead the way wasn’t a bad idea.
Thus, 120,000 Ascenders, ’escorted’ by a thousand immortals, flew toward Dingtian City.
Along the way, many seasoned old timers from the lower realm began playing to their strengths, trying to extract information from those native immortals.
Especially those who were socially adept, they kept themselves busy.
However, the results were minimal.
Though some of the thousand immortals showed interest, most still didn’t engage much.
The Celestial Immortal Commanders looked particularly authoritative.
"Behave yourselves!"
"If you disobey orders, you will be executed without mercy!"
Brother Cheng started losing his temper again.
"Damn it, do they really think they’re something special?"
Void Abyss and Gui Cang quickly stepped in to persuade him again.
"Benefactor, just endure a bit longer!"
"Now isn’t the time to break free, they’re watching closely..."
"At least figure out where this is!"
Brother, stand down with your Divine Techniques, don’t argue with them.
If a fight breaks out, we would be annihilated!
Naturally, they didn’t want to submit.
People from the lower realm were used to being in charge and wouldn’t easily accept being ordered around.
But when they couldn’t resist, they chose to endure.
Especially when the situation was unclear.
Just like back when the Profound Luo Immortal Emperor worked in someone else’s mine for over ten thousand years.
Finally, after flying for some time, they arrived at Dingtian Immortal City.
A vast, expansive city floated mid-air ahead in the void.
From time to time, people rode immortal birds and strange beasts, entering and exiting the city, creating a dazzling spectacle.
As the City Lord returned, a large group of people from the city came out to welcome him.
"Welcome back, City Lord!"
One General, dressed in Immortal Armor, quickly approached while the others bowed in greeting.
Seeing the thousand True Immortals and tens of thousands of Saint Tier soldiers behind the General, the Ascenders sank into despair.
The opposing force’s power was too overwhelming, far beyond their own.
The City Lord gave a cold snort and entered the city amidst the throng of people.
Along the way, many cultivators within the city cast glances their way.
Soon, everyone realized that the Immortal Realm also had many whose cultivation wasn’t higher than theirs.
Among these passersby, many hadn’t even Ascended to Saint, no different from the lower realm.
However, being born in the Immortal Realm allowed them to absorb Immortal Yuan Qi from a young age, so none were below the Celestial Fate Realm.
Upon reaching a floating platform ahead, the City Lord waved his hand.
"These people are outsiders. Among them are over two hundred True Immortals, making them a formidable force. From today, they will be assigned to the Fourth Battalion!"
"As you command!"
The General didn’t care about what the others thought and began assigning personnel.
"He Quan, you’re the Fourth Battalion’s Commander; these people are now under your training."
An apparently youthful Celestial Immortal Commander quickly accepted the order.
He then, with several other Celestial Immortals, started picking and choosing among them.
Domains like the Desolate Domain, Sword Domain, Demon Realm, and Celestial Demon Domain were soon scattered and redistributed among different teams.
They were even assigned different Captain superiors.
Gui Cang, Void Abyss, and the others, though proud, knew when to bow and submit.
For now, blending in with this Immortal Martial Army was the best option.
At least it was a force in the Immortal Realm, wasn’t it?
This was far better than the innocents who had ascended before, only to be killed or made to mine as slaves.
In the future, they might even climb to a higher position and develop themselves further.
But that wasn’t how Brother Cheng thought.
Being ordered around like this, did they think they were sheep in a pen?
The squad led by his team Captain consisted of 10,000 people, including Brother Cheng and 15 True Immortals, along with over a thousand Saint Tier individuals.
"Listen well, no matter what you did before, now in Dingtian City, you follow orders!"
"During the Ascension Battle, there’s no such thing as Carefree Immortals, only soldiers who follow orders!"
"Anyone who defies orders will be executed without mercy!"
"Now, put your hands on your heads and squat down!"
Immediately, over a thousand people squatted down obediently.
But the remaining people couldn’t accept it psychologically.
The same was true for the other teams.
People like Gui Cang and Void Abyss, although deciding to endure, understood that their intent was to break the spirits of the newcomers.
But the posture, like that of a prisoner, was too humiliating.
The City Lord hadn’t left and was still watching coldly from above.
He Quan, the Fourth Battalion Commander, was embarrassed, sneering.
"Very good, very good, you all have pride, and you’re all tough."
"But here, I’m best at breaking bones!"
Before he could finish, Brother Cheng impatiently interrupted.
"Cut the bullshit with your big bad wolf act."
He couldn’t hold it any longer.
Anyway, they’re at their destination; if they need to know something, they can finish them off and perform a soul search.
The atmosphere was tense, and Cheng’s sudden outburst was startling.
No need to search around; all eyes were on Jiang Cheng.
The City Lord’s gaze showed no change, as if watching an ant resist.
The General wore an indifferent expression, treating it as a minor disturbance.
Encountering rebels was normal; they’d faced them before.
It was even better to have rebels, as they could be examples to frighten others.
The squad leader of Jiang Cheng’s team flew over, fuming.
"Was that you who just spoke?"
Before he could finish speaking, the fire glow of the Gu Yang Immortal Sword lit up.

chapters.title: Chapter 224: The 1st Battle of the Immortal Realm
chapters.content:
Chapter 224: Chapter 224: The 1st Battle of the Immortal Realm
Screech!
Blood splattered, the head parted from the body.
Brother Cheng’s strike was clean and efficient, without a hint of hesitation.
When he was at the peak of Saint Tier, his normal attack power could already crush a True Immortal.
And now he was a True Immortal.
The Holy Soul had transformed into an Immortal Soul.
After ascending, he directly extracted one Immortal-tier Technique and three Immortal Tier Martial Techniques from the system warehouse.
Once activated, these reached full level for the current realm.
Though his cultivation realm was still at True Immortal First Layer, the martial techniques and cultivation technique realms were at Great Perfection of the True Immortal Level.
And just like that, he could instantly eliminate ninety-nine percent of True Immortal Ninth Layer individuals.
Most importantly, the Holy Sanctuary containing 992 main rules had elevated into a Daoist Heart infused with 992 main rules.
This was truly lethal.
To be honest, even without a surprise attack, he could easily annihilate a Celestial Immortal.
As the headless body slumped down, the whole scene fell into silence.
Not to mention those Celestial Immortal Commanders, even the City Lord of Dingtian City looked utterly shocked, unable to fathom such an occurrence.
He had seen rebellious immortals before.
But never ones like this.
They had just arrived, yet even before the subsequent pressures and trials began, they started killing?
Gui Cang, Void Abyss, and others were also stunned.
Not because of Brother Cheng’s battle prowess, but because...he actually did it.
He still couldn’t hold back!
He struck after all!
There’s no turning back anymore...
"He did it!"
Bi Chang, the Clan Leader of the Desolate Race, was the first to respond.
"I’ve been unsatisfied for ages!"
"Follow Brother Jiang, kill!"
Swinging a stone rod, he attacked the Celestial Immortal Captain of his squad.
Following his lead, the others from the Desolate Domain, who had been holding in their anger, also joined the fray.
"Alas!"
Gui Cang sighed deeply.
This was an unmistakably doomed rebellion.
Yet, on the other hand, Sect Leader Jiang had saved his life multiple times.
"Sword Domain members, follow this old man to charge out!"
Upon the command, Ling Xing, Sorrow, and other experts in the Sword Domain activated their Daoist Hearts, controlling swords to directly assault the Celestial Immortal Commander in front of them.
On the Celestial Demon Domain side, the Golden Dragon King didn’t even need to give an order.
War Monkey King’s eyes turned blood-red, his body swelled, with one foot on the Cangqiong and the other on the high platform, violently punching downward.
Beside him, two blood shadows moved left and right, claws slicing through beams of light.
It was the Dog-devouring King and the Yashu King.
As the Golden Dragon King breathed towards the large group of immortals, Void Abyss and the crowd of experts from the Demon Realm were engulfed in a black mist.
Soon, the black mist rapidly swept into the crowd.
In the 2,000-strong True Immortal formation, sounds of bodies breaking continuously echoed, yet no figures could be seen, eerily strange.
With 120,000 Ascenders showcasing their skills, Immortal Cultivators, Demon Cultivators, and the techniques of the Demon Level, the scene swiftly turned into a gruesome battlefield.
This sight utterly terrified the residents of Immortal City watching from outside.
They had never seen anything like this before.
This group of newcomers consisted of just over two hundred True Immortals.
In terms of numbers, they were nine times fewer than the Immortal Martial Army alone.
Moreover, there were no Celestial Immortals or Profound Immortals among them.
Despite the vast numbers, isn’t such rebellion courting death?
The City Lord’s face instantly filled with dark anger.
"Kill them all."
The rebellious cannot be utilized.
Even if those over two hundred True Immortals could enhance combat power, he had no intention of keeping them.
Infuriated, the Profound Immortal General naturally wouldn’t slack off.
"Form arrays, encircle, and crush..."
Their team of two thousand True Immortals and fifty thousand from the Saint Tier who made up the Immortal Martial Army had collaborated before.
They had shared tactics and coordination.
The disparity in power between the two sides was already extremely profound; crushing these rebels wouldn’t be difficult.
However, before his command was completed, he was suddenly devoured by a towering Fire Dragon.
Brother Cheng activated the Critical Strike Skill.
As he unleashed this strike, he cursed through gritted teeth.
"Damn it, it costs ten billion points!"
"A huge loss!"
With a single strike, this Profound Immortal level captain was instantly obliterated.
Not a sound was uttered, let alone counteracted.
Not only him, but on the path ahead, countless True Immortals and over a hundred Celestial Immortals who were about to form an array were simultaneously annihilated, leaving no trace.
Like a flood pouring down the mountains, a charred passage several miles long appeared at the scene.
Everyone and all Immortal City buildings within were completely annihilated without a trace.
In the molten lava, the forces of flames, destruction, poison intertwined and exploded, triggering a series of chain reactions.
The residents watching from the outside of Immortal City nearly wet themselves in fear.
The space in the Immortal Realm was more stable and rarely caused large-scale topographical changes like in the Lower Realm.
Especially an Immortal City, which was exceedingly difficult to destroy.
The ability to cause such massive destruction with a single strike was astonishing.
This strike greatly boosted the morale of the Lower Realm camp!
"Holy crap, is Brother Cheng this fierce now?"
The Three-Eyed Tiger had been following him, nearly dropping its eyes from shock at the strike.
This was tens of times fiercer than the last time he killed Zhongtai True Immortal!
Back then, it took some effort to kill a True Immortal, but now, it’s wiping out Profound Immortals and Celestial Immortals in swathes with a single strike.
"Sect Leader Jiang is divine and mighty!"
Gui Cang Sword Immortal, Ling Xing, Sorrow, and other Sword Immortals were assaulting a Celestial Immortal.
Still, they couldn’t resist giving him a big thumbs-up from afar.
"Brother, you rock!"
"Wait for us to join you!"
Bi Chang and other Desert People were so excited they howled loudly, crazily waving their weapons and attacking fiercely.
"The benefactor truly can face thousands alone!"
The experts from the Demon Realm, who were executing powerful attacks amidst the crowd, were even more joyful in their slaughter.
"This battle can be won!"
The experts from the Hundred Battle Domain and other Domains all had their eyes lit up.
With this strike from Jiang Cheng, the enemy’s commander was directly incapacitated.
And it also incapacitated over a hundred Celestial Immortal commanders and captains, effectively dismantling the enemy’s command system.
Leaving the rest in complete disarray.
The City Lord, who initially planned to coldly observe a massacre, was now bewildered.
The battle prowess of Jiang Cheng had surpassed the limits of his imagination.
Wasn’t he supposed to be just a First Grade True Immortal?
Facing a Profound Immortal should result in immediate destruction; even if he had some means, he shouldn’t cause a stir.
Yet the results were reversed.
The Profound Immortal was annihilated with a single stroke.
That general was a Third Grade Profound Immortal, and he himself was only a Fifth-Grade Profound Immortal.
This means, had it not been for his arrogance and refusal to intervene personally, he too would be dead now.
Examining the various battle zones within, though other rebels weren’t as heaven-defying as Jiang Cheng, they still astonished him.
The combat effectiveness of those over two hundred True Immortals was drastically beyond his expectations.
The first fifty-plus Celestial Immortal they encircled and attacked surprisingly didn’t last long before all fell.
How could this be?
Even though it was two hundred against fifty, they had a numerical advantage, but the gap between True Immortal and Celestial Immortal was like a Grand Canyon!
The difference of a Great Realm, if word of this battle were to spread, would surely shock countless immortals.
And although the Saint Tiers hadn’t ascended yet, they surprisingly managed to hold their own against the True Immortals of the Immortal Martial Army.
Their tactics were bizarre, and their combat style was both seasoned and cunning.
At a glance, not a single one of these 120,000 individuals appeared normal.
Could it be that they were all Demon Level figures capable of challenging beyond their levels?
If the high-level figures of Immortal and Demon Emperor realms were here, they would surely tell him – yes.
After tens of millions of years, the Lower Realm finally commenced the first battle of the Immortal Realm.

chapters.title: Chapter 225: Becoming a Dad Again?
chapters.content:
Chapter 225: Chapter 225: Becoming a Dad Again?
The City Lord of Dingtian City didn’t dare to battle Jiang Cheng at all.
He wasn’t stupid. Anyone who could instantly kill that General was definitely beyond his ability to handle.
If he knew Brother Cheng could only use that strike once a day, he’d probably spit blood.
Seeing the City Lord vanish with a flicker, Brother Cheng was infuriated.
"Damn it, why are you running?"
"Come and kill me already!"
This battle was destined to be one that couldn’t be won through sheer power alone.
After all, there were two Profound Immortals on the other side.
His original plan was to use a Critical Strike to kill one and relieve the fighting pressure on everyone else.
Then get killed by the other to trigger the Resurrection Skill.
And then wipe out the whole field.
But who could’ve imagined that such a pompous City Lord would be so cowardly.
Left with no other options, Brother Cheng had to take some Immortal Pills to recover some Spiritual Power, then joined the other battle zones.
Once he joined, the remaining Celestial Immortal Commanders and Captains were completely crushed.
With a series of plugins, Sect Leader Jiang’s normal Attack Power already almost broke through the Celestial Immortal limit, with almost every strike taking the life of a Celestial Immortal.
Only a few dozen seconds into the battle, all the Celestial Immortals present were slaughtered by him.
Afterward, everyone charged into the True Immortals who were locked in combat.
Most of these True Immortals from the Immortal Realm didn’t even have Immortal Artifacts, only Sacred Artifacts, making them defenseless against this crowd.
In no time at all, the entire Immortal Martial Army was annihilated.
But just at that moment, Dingtian City underwent an earth-shattering transformation.
Above, the sky magically revealed a multi-colored glazed cover with radiant lights flowing endlessly.
The area previously destroyed by Jiang Cheng’s strike began rapidly healing and restoring.
Soon it was as if there had never been any damage.
All around, anomalies of Immortal Demon Fiends circled the Void, and a throne slowly rose from beneath the high platform.
Immortal mist curled about, not only blocking everyone’s view, but even Divine Thought couldn’t penetrate it.
The City Lord, glowing in golden light, sat high above with a pristine Jade Ruler rotating above his head, looking like a helicopter rotor blade.
Though comparing his stern expression with this scene was quite funny, the effect produced was anything but amusing.
Everyone present suddenly found it extremely difficult to move a muscle.
It was as if an invisible mysterious power had rooted them in place.
Neither on the ground nor in the sky.
They were instantly filled with panic and could only look at Sect Leader Jiang, who constantly accomplished miracles.
Fortunately, the old man could still move.
In the distance, residents who had been watching were now fleeing in all directions, too scared to witness any more excitement.
"Forcing this City Lord to unleash the Essence Core of Dingtian City, you should be proud!"
Jiang Cheng and the others didn’t know what this so-called city Essence Core was, but it sounded like the city was alive.
"But this is where you end."
The Jade Ruler swung down, and Brother Cheng was instantly engulfed by the illusions of those Immortal Demon Fiends.
Though he intended to die, he hadn’t expected to have no chance to dodge.
A pitch-black fire erupted from his body, rapidly spreading over him.
The Immortal Demon Body managed to temporarily fend off this bizarre flame, but the Immortal Soul ultimately couldn’t hold.
After all, this city Essence Core was originally meant for Ascension battles...
He was eventually burned to death.
With his death, the City Lord of Dingtian City secretly breathed a sigh of relief.
Fortunately, he managed to kill him.
If even this last resort hadn’t worked, he really would’ve had no choice but to run away.
"Sect Leader Jiang..."
"Benefactor!"
"Brother!"
Seeing this, the Ascenders fixed in various positions felt like the sky had collapsed.
When they first entered the Fake Immortal Realm, everyone was at odds with each other.
But as time passed, Jiang Cheng became the only one everyone respected and admired.
Countless times he led them to break through the Immortal Realm’s blockade, escape from the Treasure Bottle, and enter the Immortal Realm; he was the pillar and cornerstone.
Including the recent battle, without him, everyone would have been wiped out by the Immortal Martial Army.
And now, he was dead...
The strongest genius of the Lower Realm actually died?
Even the Immortal Emperor’s Treasure Bottle couldn’t trap him, how could he die?
They couldn’t believe this was real.
"Sect Leader..."
Mo Chen cried out mournfully, suddenly realizing this scene seemed familiar.
"Ding! Host has gained 100% favorability of Dingtian City Essence Core!"
With just this short sentence, Brother Cheng came back to life.
What the heck?
Weren’t there a few more lines to it?
Something about the host killed, assessing enemy strength, arranging resurrection plan, etc.
What’s going on?
Could it be because my system hasn’t been upgraded?
So after entering the Immortal Realm, some anomalies occurred?
Given that, I really need to find an opportunity to update this system when I have time.
Thankfully, the Resurrection Skill is still there.
Once revived, he immediately began to save face.
"Everyone, please remain calm. I just thought the City Lord must be very sorrowful having lost so many people."
"So I pretended to be dead to comfort him a bit, lest he go crazy from the blow."
Seeing him alive and kicking again, everyone was overjoyed.
They didn’t mind how infuriating those words sounded.
"Sect Leader Jiang, you nearly scared this old man to death."
"Haha, I knew my brother wouldn’t die so easily."
"The benefactor is truly blessed; that monstrous fire seemed extremely dangerous, yet you’re completely unharmed!"
Revived and brimming with spirits, Brother Cheng, after bluffing through being killed, heard a child’s voice in his ear.
"Hello there!"
Huh?
Brother Cheng was taken aback, who was calling him?
"Look at me, I’m right here!"
Following the source of that urgent voice, Brother Cheng’s gaze gradually shifted until it settled on the City Lord’s head opposite him.
There, his eyes fixed on the spot.
Atop the City Lord’s head, the Jade Ruler spun like an electric fan, and now on top of the ruler stood the illusion of a chubby little boy.
"Are you talking to me?"
Sect Leader Jiang realized: "You’re the Essence Core of this Dingtian City?"
Could it be yet another magical creature like Ah Huang?
"I am, I am! Why do I find you so familiar, who are you?"
Because the system maxed out your favorability towards me, of course, you feel familiar.
"Because I’m your long-lost dad!"
With the previous experience with Ah Huang, Brother Cheng decided to start addressing from an early age.
The little boy eagerly flew over, extending his chubby little hands towards him.
But since he had no physical body, there was no real contact.
"You’re my dad?"
"Exactly, exactly. You’re my son Xiaobai, my good son, I’ve finally found you!"
"So my name is Xiaobai, hehe..."
He gleefully spun in circles, utterly delighted.
Brother Cheng felt a momentary pang of guilt for deceiving a child, but it quickly dissipated.
You just killed me, kid!
It’s really tragic; both kids experienced ’patricide’ before they were even born. Is this some kind of rite of passage?
"Do you control this entire city?"
"Yes!"
"Then can you help dad take down the bad guy over there?"
"Of course I can! How does dad want him to die?" The boy’s shiny black eyes sparkled with innocence.
Damn, is he that strong?
Way more straightforward than Ah Huang!

chapters.title: Chapter 226: The road you have to walk is still very long
chapters.content:
Chapter 226: Chapter 226: The road you have to walk is still very long
This is so absurdly cautious, asking directly how to die!
Brother Cheng’s eyes twinkled, his mischievous side emerged.
"Can you crap on his head?"
Imagine the esteemed Profound Immortal, thinking he’s got victory in hand, suddenly a pile of poop falls on his head.
What a thrill that would be.
Xiaobai was patting his chest, claiming he could do anything.
Upon hearing this, he froze instantly.
He could only shake his head in shame: "Can’t do it."
He’s not a normal spirit, let alone he doesn’t even have a physical form now.
Such a high difficulty maneuver as crapping, he might never achieve it in his life.
No way, it’s a racial disadvantage.
"Alas!"
Brother Cheng sighed and said earnestly: "That’s why I said long ago, don’t talk too big."
When did you ever say that?
Xiaobai was a bit puzzled.
But it seemed his dad was indeed stronger than himself, he didn’t dare to refute.
"Not knowing how to crap, you still have a long way to go, a lot to learn from Dad."
Sect Leader Jiang deeply learned from the lesson of the previous rebellious kid.
From the start, he must establish an all-powerful father image, to avoid being disregarded by his son.
The effect seemed pretty good, Xiaobai was bluffed in disbelief.
Although their secret conversation couldn’t be heard by others, nor could they see Xiaobai, Brother Cheng’s revival still stunned everyone.
The opposite City Lord finally came back to his senses.
"Why didn’t you die?"
He pointed at Jiang Cheng, utterly incredulous.
If he merely survived, it would be alright, the key was Jiang Cheng didn’t seem hurt at all.
As if the attack never existed, it was so bizarre.
"Oh, everyone has this line."
"Just teasing you, and you fell for it."
As Jiang Cheng’s words just fell, the City Lord activated the Essence Core again.
Since Jiang Cheng couldn’t be killed, then let’s wipe out the others first.
He didn’t believe this unstoppable Essence Core would be ineffective against other people.
Instantly, all the Ascenders who were immobilized felt a chill surge through their hearts.
Deep within their Daoist Hearts, Holy Sanctuary, Domain, Daoist Palace, appeared a black lotus fire.
Once ignited, the destruction of both form and spirit would be inevitable.
"Dad, he wants me to kill the others." Xiaobai immediately reported the situation.
Brother Cheng hurriedly said: "Those people are Dad’s friends, don’t make a move."
While relaying it in secret, he flew into the sky, waving to everyone present.
With Xiaobai’s cooperation, the black lotus fire on everyone quietly extinguished, and the chill dissipated.
"Petty tricks dare to boast before me?"
He put his left hand behind, waved his right hand sleeve again.
"Disperse!"
Then the binds on everyone vanished, restoring their freedom.
This technique was quite impressive.
The pretentious effect was extraordinarily outstanding.
It seemed like he just lightly flicked, and rescued everyone.
"Sect Leader Jiang is simply a divine being..."
"Breaking evil magic with a wave of hand, what kind of power is this?"
Everyone looked up in admiration, inevitably having some worship.
"This is impossible!"
The opposite City Lord cried out.
This city’s Essence Core was the key lethal weapon in the Ascension Battle!
Yet such powerful force required burning a large amount of Immortal Crystal, sacrificing some of the Immortal Soul as the cost, so he wouldn’t bring it out unless absolutely necessary.
Facing the power of this Essence Core, let alone a Profound Immortal, even a slightly weaker Golden Immortal wouldn’t escape.
After all, it was the core of an Immortal City.
"I don’t believe it!"
"Kill!"
"Kill them!"
He desperately activated the Essence Core, his own Immortal Soul and Daoist Heart overburned.
The Jade Ruler spun faster and faster, eventually becoming invisible, truly like a propeller.
Wind roared, illusions layered on top!
The newly freed crowd had wary and guarded expressions because they again sensed a dangerous aura capable of flattening everyone from that Jade Ruler.
Then, they heard a crisp snapping sound.
Snap!
Unlike the City Lord’s frenzied, desperate posture, Sect Leader Jiang was relaxed.
With a casual snap of his fingers, the obedient son immediately cooperated again.
Thus, the City Lord’s Immortal Armor and clothes instantly turned to ash.
Then this dignified and imposing City Lord appeared naked before everyone.
"Whoa!"
Three-Eyed Tiger jumped over, full of admiration: "Bro how did you do this undressing technique, it’s divine, can you teach me!"
"He burned himself?"
Not to mention the City Lord, even everyone else found it incredibly inexplicable.
This Essence Core was activated by him, how did it backfire on him?
"Hahahaha!"
"Does he have a naked fetish?"
"Tsk tsk tsk, the esteemed Profound Immortal, truly shameless."
"It must be Sect Leader Jiang doing it again!"
"Hahaha, look at the City Lord panicking..."
Everyone completely relaxed, pointing at the City Lord laughing heartily.
Previously, this person had the posture of dominating ants, now seeing his disgraceful scene, it suddenly felt utterly refreshing.
Not just them, even the other residents in the Immortal City spectating from afar were shocked.
This is too bizarre, right?
Even if he can wipe out the audience, the City Lord’s lifelong reputation is completely ruined!
Wouldn’t he want to silence us?
"You, how dare you humiliate me like this!"
"Die!"
The imposing City Lord went mad, completely mad!
"Die for me!"
His eyes filled with blood, continuing desperately to activate the Jade Ruler, Brother Cheng wondered if he would be taken off by the ’propeller’ on site.
Too bad, the Essence Core already belonged to Jiang, he was simply wasting his effort.
"Alright, it’s time to end this."
He winked at the obedient son, and snapped his fingers again.
Xiaobai understood the signal.
At the next moment, in the depths of the City Lord’s Daoist Heart, a black lotus fire surged.
Quickly spreading throughout his body...
"No..."
Amidst the heartrending screams, smoke rose, and this Fifth-Grade Profound Immortal perished body and soul.
Is he really dead?
Everyone felt a bit dazed.
Initially when Sect Leader Jiang prepared to act, everyone advised him to be patient, keep a green mountain, and not fear lack of firewood.
Do not provoke the opponent.
The enemy is strong, go slowly with a subtle plan!
Who knew, he was this fierce.
From the City Lord and General downwards, all enemies were wiped out!
Had known he was this strong, wouldn’t have acted cowardly at first, should’ve dealt with them immediately!
At once, experts like Gui Cang, Void Abyss, Golden Dragon King deeply reflected on themselves.
Looking back, whenever Sect Leader Jiang acted, seemed reckless, stupid, impulsive, but every time easily won, didn’t he?
He’s truly a master!
From now on, more trust must be placed in him, his decisions should never be doubted.
"Congratulations to Sect Leader on another great victory!"
Mo Chen eagerly rushed over to flatter.
Brother Cheng didn’t appreciate it, instead pointed to the other side.
Over there, Three-Eyed Tiger was busy collecting the spoils.
Immortal Mo was deeply hit, his heartached, realizing he was not as clever as the Tiger Demon, didn’t know what to do first.
So he also hurried to collect the spoils.

chapters.title: Chapter 227: The Immortal Realm Today
chapters.content:
Chapter 227: Chapter 227: The Immortal Realm Today
After slaying the City Lord whose name remained unknown until the end, Dingtian Immortal City fell into Jiang Cheng’s hands.
"As newcomers, we were originally worried about having no place to settle."
"Now it seems heaven has bestowed a city upon us."
His words made everyone exuberant with excitement.
"Sect Leader Jiang is absolutely right!"
"Only a benefactor like him could have achieved this."
"Indeed, without Brother Jiang, this would have been a calamity."
"Who would have thought that on the first day of ascension, we’d own an Immortal City? This start must be hundreds of times better than any previous ascenders."
That was indeed the truth.
In the past, ascenders who arrived up here faced the worst fate of being inadvertently killed or enslaved.
Under normal circumstances, one starts as a bottom-tier Loose Cultivator and rises slowly.
The most fortunate are those who coincidentally find their sect elders from the lower realm nearby, and may have even established a power base here.
At that point, they could feasibly become an Inner Sect Disciple or True Disciple.
But compared to this batch of ascenders, the treatment was worlds apart.
Sect Leader Jiang waved his hand, decreeing that the inner city of Dingtian City would from now on be stationed by the Feixian Sect, while the outer city would be jointly governed by various Great Domains.
After all, the city was incredibly vast, and it would be easy to accommodate 120,000 people.
Moreover, they came here to become rulers, not ordinary residents.
The majority of these 120,000 ascenders were already Sect Leader Elders or even Domain Lords, extremely experienced.
Sect Leader Jiang need not worry, as they could manage this place in an orderly fashion on their own.
Soon, the leaders of the various Great Domains demarcated their respective activity areas.
The Immortal Yuan Qi within the city was much denser than outside, and they were reluctant to leave.
Subsequently, they summoned the native inhabitants of the city to inquire about the local situation.
Up until now, their understanding of the Immortal Realm was essentially a blank slate.
The city residents, unaware that these newcomers who seized the city came from the Lower Realm, did not suspect their origins.
It had been ten million years since an ascender appeared, and many residents of the Immortal City were born in the last ten thousand years, completely unaware of the phenomenon of ascenders from the Lower Realm.
They simply thought of them as a group of powerful newcomers.
After all, the capture of an Immortal City was not uncommon in the Immortal Realm.
The previous City Lord himself seized the position by force.
Now, it’s merely a change of banners on the city wall.
The native inhabitants, mostly not even True Immortals, were very cooperative with these newly arrived influential figures, answering every query.
Soon, they learned much about the basic situation of the Immortal Realm.
The present Immortal Realm was no longer a singular plane as before.
Since the Chaotic Ruins fell millions of years ago, the Immortal Realm split into three pieces.
With interventions from top-tier Great Powers, the three Immortal Realm continents either rose or sank, eventually forming the Upper, Middle, and Lower Three Immortal Realms.
The Upper Immortal Realm gathered all the Immortal Vein’s fortune from the entire Immortal Realm, making Immortal Yuan Power the most concentrated and insight into the Rules much easier.
The Middle Immortal Realm and Lower Immortal Realm fell far behind in comparison.
In the past, Immortal Emperors, Immortal Kings, and True Immortals lived in the same Immortal Realm, but now all the Great Powers have moved to the Upper Immortal Realm.
The lower-tier immortals were left in the Lower Immortal Realm.
Thus, the Immortal Realm became strictly hierarchical and stratified.
Immortal Emperors from the Upper Immortal Realm can still descend to the Lower Immortal Realm, but those from the Lower Immortal Realm can’t enter the Middle Immortal Realm, not to mention the Upper Immortal Realm.
This change made Mo Chen, who was once an immortal, extremely uncomfortable.
The Immortal Realm he remembered was not much different from the Lower Realm.
It also had many Noble Sects scattered everywhere, just with much greater power than the Lower Realm.
Now, it was replaced by Immortal Cities.
In the past, a place in the Immortal Realm might have a Daoist Palace Realm or even an Immortal Emperor, not distinctly separate as it is now.
"So in this layer, the strongest are just Profound Immortals?"
"And in the Middle Immortal Realm above, even the weakest are Golden Immortals?"
"No, it’s not divided like that."
The native inhabitants queried waved their hands repeatedly.
"If one is born in the Middle Immortal Realm, the chances of staying there are high."
"Unless one’s talent is particularly poor, they’ll be sent down to the Lower Immortal Realm."
"Yes, some sects are in the Middle Immortal Realm, so their disciples naturally remain there."
"There are also Golden Immortals who have been demoted to the Lower Immortal Realm as punishment."
Everyone looked at each other, realizing that the outlook of the Immortal Realm was vastly different from their imagination.
Is there really such a thing as being demoted?
They originally thought ascending here was the end of their journey and were cheering for the Immortal Yuan Qi they found here. Little did they know it was the worst place in the Immortal Realm.
"Is there any way to ascend to the Upper Immortal Realm?"
Being ascenders, most of them were ambitious and naturally would not be content with the status quo.
"Yes, the Immortal City Ascension Battle."
Through their introduction, everyone gradually understood this only pathway into the Middle Immortal Realm.
Ten million years ago, the Immortal Realm split into three.
At the same time, numerous Immortal Cities rose majestically.
Centered around local Immortal Crystal Veins, they eventually formed the Essence Core of Immortal Cities.
Apart from a few mountain sects and Loose Cultivators, most native inhabitants of the Immortal Realm made an effort to reside inside Immortal Cities.
On usual days, Immortal Cities must not attack each other.
Once every million years, there would be an Immortal City Ascension Battle.
Every Ascension Battle lasts a century, during which Immortal Cities can challenge each other.
Winning increases the score by one, losing decreases it by one, simply and straightforwardly.
The more victories accumulated, the higher the ranking in the entire Lower Immortal Realm.
By the final day, the top ten Immortal Cities in battle scores, along with all their residents, will ascend entirely into the Middle Immortal Realm.
Meanwhile, the last ten in the Middle Immortal Realm’s Ascension Battle will fall to the Lower Immortal Realm.
This cycle repeats every million years.
Everyone suddenly understood.
"So there is indeed a chance for promotion, no wonder the previous City Lord wanted us to join the Immortal Martial Army to serve him."
"Looks like he considered us as new blood for his cause."
"How many Immortal Cities are there in the Lower Immortal Realm?"
"There are a total of eighteen million Immortal Cities!"
"What!"
Even Brother Cheng nearly dropped his jaw in astonishment.
"So many?"
And this is just the Lower Immortal Realm.
Just one city alone could govern an area spanning a billion miles.
Eighteen million Immortal Cities, it was unimaginable for them.
Immediately, anger surged within them.
Darn it, the Immortal Realm is so vast, yet it restricts ascenders from the Lower Realm.
Is this necessary?
We only occupy a tiny fraction of the Immortal Realm’s space.
On the other hand, they felt a sense of relief.
They initially worried that an Immortal Emperor could descend at any moment to obliterate them.
Now they realized that in such a large place, it would be virtually impossible to find them.
"How many years are left in the current Ascension Battle?"
"Only ten years remain."
"Only ten years? How many victories does the city currently in the first place have?"
"Currently, the top city is Five Seas City, and they have accumulated 157 victories."
"That impressive?"
"Yes, they were relegated from the Middle Immortal Realm last round, so their foundation is much deeper than other Immortal Cities, with as many as 15 Golden Immortals stationed, along with hundreds of Profound Immortals."

chapters.title: Chapter 228: 10000 Slots
chapters.content:
Chapter 228: Chapter 228: 10000 Slots
Hearing that there are 15 Golden Immortals guarding, everyone’s hearts sank.
The power gap is too big.
"That doesn’t make sense."
The Yashu King said in surprise, "If they are so strong, challenging here and there over a hundred years, not to mention 157 victories, even 15700 victories should be doable, right?"
After some thought, everyone realized it was indeed the case.
For Five Seas City to attack a city like Dingtian City should be a breeze, shouldn’t it?
A hundred years is actually quite long, more than ten thousand battles if they fight once every two days.
The native inhabitants shook their heads.
"One cannot challenge a city with a victory count at least three less than their own, such as our Dingtian City, they cannot come to challenge us."
"And the city that loses has a one-year truce period, not to be challenged."
Sect Leader Jiang pouted, "The competition rules set by those Immortal Emperors are quite detailed, there’s no loophole to exploit."
In his eyes, there’s not much difference with a competition.
Defeating reduces battle records, and combined with the three victory difference rule, it essentially eliminates the possibility of collusion to rake up wins crazily.
"What about our Immortal City? What’s our ranking?"
"Our Immortal City has undergone 16 challenges in the past 90 years, with an accumulated 2 victories, ranking 5,958,795."
"What? We’re ranked almost 6 millionth?"
Everyone nearly spat blood.
And after 16 battles, only accumulating 2 victories, clearly indicating a lot of losses.
How long until we catch up to the top ten?
"What’s the current victory count for the tenth place?"
"The tenth place is Qiansi City, with six Golden Immortals guarding it, currently having 98 victories."
Everyone, who had been eager and ready, suddenly became silent.
After a while, Gui Cang Sword Immortal let out a long sigh.
"Seems like we’ll have to wait for the next million years."
Void Abyss Demon Saint could only accept their fate, "Indeed, the next million years for another battle!"
The power gap is too huge.
Among them, except for Brother Cheng, no one else has combat power that reaches even Celestial Immortal.
Not to mention Profound Immortal or Golden Immortal, it’s impossible to fight.
Moreover, time is not enough, with only ten years left, and still lacking 96 victories.
That’s assuming the victory count for the tenth place doesn’t increase.
"In the next million years, we’ll surely have the power to fight!"
"That’s right, with Immortal Yuan Qi here, I’m confident in making rapid progress!"
"A million years is enough to turn the situation around!"
These talents are all extremely gifted, confident that in the next million-year cycle of ascension, they can shake the Lower Immortal Realm.
Brother Cheng’s thoughts differed from theirs; he was now thinking about whether there were more benefits.
"Since there are only ten ascension slots, and our power is so vastly different, why was the previous City Lord so busy?"
With Dingtian City’s power, not to mention getting into the top ten, even the top hundred thousand can’t be reached.
So why bother with challenges?
Isn’t that futile?
"Each time a challenge is won, a portion of the ascension platform’s rule aura of the opponent can be deprived to enhance our Immortal City’s ascension platform’s rule aura."
"The stronger the rule aura of the ascension platform, the more beneficial it is for people in our Immortal City to cultivate."
Such a nice benefit?
At the Immortal Tier, cultivation primarily revolves around rules.
"Where is the Ascension Platform?"
This question left the native inhabitants dumbfounded.
They increasingly felt that this group of crossing dragons seemed like uncultured savages.
Like they knew nothing about common knowledge.
However, their power was evident, and in the Immortal Realm, power speaks volumes.
"The ascension platform is right there."
They pointed to the distance, as it turned out to be the high platform where the former City Lord summoned the essence core.
"The rule aura inside the ascension platform is the thickest, and the Immortal Yuan Qi is also the most abundant. If one can cultivate inside, the effect would be even better."
The native inhabitants, upon speaking of this, couldn’t help but feel envious and yearn for it.
"But the inside of the ascension platform only accommodates ten thousand people at a time, so we’ve only heard about it."
At this point, everyone was completely moved.
Since ascending to Saint and having their Domains, everyone had already begun dealing with rules.
But they never thought of a place with such dense rule aura, where they could directly face rule aura closely.
Previously, those cultivating Flame Rule would only go to the volcano, and those cultivating Water Rule would only go to oceans or lakes.
"Uh, Sect Leader Jiang..."
"The ascension platform, could it be..."
Even Gui Cang Sword Immortal couldn’t help rubbing his hands, with a grin plastered on his old face, smiling like a fawning chrysanthemum.
Others all looked at Brother Cheng with eager eyes.
No choice, the temptation to enhance strength is too great.
This is still outside the ascension platform, and many people’s realms had already become unstable again.
Not to mention inside.
But inside only has ten thousand slots, the distribution of these slots is, of course, up to Sect Leader Jiang, their benefactor and the strongest.
"Ahem, let me make a statement upfront, I have over a thousand disciples who came up this time as well."
"I want to preemptively take 1100 slots, as for the rest, you can divide among yourselves."
Brother Cheng wouldn’t be reserved. His own people must have the best conditions, even if many disciples are only at the Daoist Palace Realm.
After all, others are still a layer removed.
Upon hearing he took 1100 slots, the others were not disappointed but rather overjoyed.
"Sect Leader Jiang is so generous!"
"No problem, no problem, there are still 8900 slots, enough for us!"
"Haha, thank you Sect Leader Jiang!"
"As expected of our benefactor, how magnanimous!"
They were understanding and appreciative; without Jiang Cheng, everyone wouldn’t have survived, let alone talking about positions at the ascension platform.
Besides, this place was conquered by Brother Cheng.
Even if he wanted to take them all, others couldn’t utter a peep.
Under such circumstances, he was willing to leave a solid 8900 slots for others, which was very considerate.
While the others were busy distributing the position slots, Brother Cheng was also busy tallying the spoils of the earlier battle.
Just in that battle alone, they obtained hundreds of Immortal Artifacts.
Especially that anonymous, generous City Lord, who even had a Tier Three Immortal Sword and Tier Two Immortal Armor.
Besides, there was a top-grade Magical Treasure, the Celestial Dance Spirit Radiance Shield, used to gather Immortal Yuan Qi to assist in cultivation.
It can triple the concentration of Immortal Yuan Qi within its range.
Brother Cheng again swapped for upgraded gear.
Besides Immortal Pills and Immortal Crystals, there were also numerous strategic materials like Immortal Talismans and Immortal Arrays.
Exchanging a batch that was temporarily not useful, his points reached 313.5 billion.
Thinking that the system hadn’t been upgraded for a long time, he clicked the upgrade button once more.
Subsequently, the system panel changed.
Level: 10
Points: 0/1,000,000,000,000
Available Points: 213,566,755,458
Current Skill: The host can consume points to reverse time, with no cooldown time.
Note: After reversing, the host’s state remains unchanged. The larger the span of reversal, the more points consumed.
Subordinate Skill: The host can consume points to upgrade inanimate objects.
Note: The higher the target’s value, the more points consumed.
Currently, Brother Cheng doesn’t have any need for time reversal.
He doesn’t have any regrets to go back and fix; everything has been smooth sailing.
After a glance, going back one day would already cost one billion points, so he didn’t bother to waste it.
As for the next level’s new skill to upgrade inanimate objects, his first thought was of the Spirit Vein and Ascension Platform.
If he could upgrade the Ascension Platform himself, would the rule aura also elevate by a level out of thin air?

chapters.title: Chapter 229: The Sect Leader Has Such Prestige
chapters.content:
Chapter 229: Chapter 229: The Sect Leader Has Such Prestige
After the system upgraded to level 10, he drew 10 times from the level 7 lottery.
The level 7 lottery costs 1 billion points each time, so 10 times would consume 10 billion points.
However, the level 7 lottery is really worthwhile.
Among the 10 rewards, there are three Third Grade Immortal Pills, which are actually meant for Profound Immortal cultivation.
But for Brother Cheng, he can directly absorb them even if they are Ninth Grade Immortal Pills.
There is also a complete Tier Two Immortal Artifact, the Earth Spirit Binding Dust Bow, but it’s a pity that Brother Cheng has no plans to be a shooter.
His main objective is still the rule fragments.
And sure enough, the level 7 lottery produced a Second-level Rule Fragment.
Second-level Rule Fragment: Can upgrade any main rule to the Mastery Realm, or can upgrade any 10 main rules to the Small Success Realm.
This is exactly what he currently needs the most.
As long as the 992 main rules in his Daoist Heart are all upgraded to the Small Success Level, he will directly skip the Celestial Immortal level to become a Profound Immortal.
Because to achieve Profound Immortal, what is required is for all main rules to be upgraded to the Small Success Level.
As for Celestial Immortal, there are no main rule realm requirements.
Of course, the premise is that the Spiritual Power and Immortal Soul Realm must also catch up.
These things, Brother Cheng will not cultivate. He only plans to ascend by eating Immortal Pills all the way.
He is just that unambitious.
Since the level 7 lottery can produce what he needs the most, there was nothing to hesitate about.
He spent another 100 billion and did another 100 draws in a row.
Ultimately, he obtained 12 Second-level Rule Fragments, upgrading 120 main rules to the Small Success Level.
As for other things like Divine-grade Talent Seeds, he didn’t even bother to look at them.
Additionally, he obtained two sets of Profound Immortal level Cultivation Techniques and four sets of Profound Immortal level Martial Techniques.
He plans to unseal these things later on.
After finishing these tasks, he opened the Xuanji Map and released all his disciples.
This time in the Treasure Bottle False Immortal Realm, he spent an entire year there, and now as the disciples came out, their cultivation levels have improved remarkably.
Inside, it was equivalent to over twenty thousand years passing.
Coupled with Ah Huang’s upgrade to a Spirit Vein of Immortal Yuan Qi level and the originally improved talent, their cultivation advanced by leaps and bounds.
Ji Linghan, Lin Ning, and Lan Ti, these three with second-class talent, all reached Late-stage Saint Tier, while Luo Yuan, Wei Miao, and other second and third generation disciples also all reached the Saint Tier.
However, the fourth generation disciples were lacking quite a bit.
Since most of their talents are still only fourth-class, currently, out of over 900, only three have reached the Ascending to Saint Realm, and the others are still in the Daoist Palace Realm.
Coming out again increased Brother Cheng’s points by 75.2 billion.
But also because of the long time, the pills inside were almost used up.
"Sect Leader! This time took so long!"
"Yeah, have we changed places again?"
What everyone remembered was still the Fake Immortal Realm inside the Treasure Bottle, but now looking around, it seems like a city.
"The Immortal Yuan Qi here is many times more concentrated than before!"
"No way? Did Sect Leader destroy someone’s sect again?"
"That place before was just a Fake Immortal Realm, and now here is the True Immortal Realm."
Brother Cheng was too lazy to waste his breath, directly letting Elder Mo explain to them.
Everyone quickly learned what had happened recently amid uninterrupted surprise, amazement, and shock.
"The Sect Leader reached the Immortal Realm and is as flamboyant as ever!"
"Of course, whenever Sect Leader goes into battle, he is always victorious!"
"I bet that even in the Immortal Realm, the Sect Leader can be considered a top expert!"
"Truly befitting of the Sect Leader..."
Having not seen each other in a long time, the disciples’ bootlicking skills had not diminished.
Though they had little understanding of the Immortal Realm, it did not stop them from singing praises to the heavens.
Brother Cheng enjoyed it very much, so he began to distribute rewards generously again.
After consecutive battles during this period, the Immortal Pills and Immortal Crystals collected were used for himself, while the Holy Pills, Treasure Pills, and Spirit Stones were left for the disciples.
Looking at the rings once more filled to the brim, the disciples were at a loss for words.
In cultivation, resources are the most precious and the hardest to obtain.
They should be happy, but thinking about it now, it seems like they’re on pace to be sent into the Xuanji Dojo for tens of thousands of years of cultivation again.
"Sect Leader, can we get some fresh air outside?"
"Yes, we just arrived in the Immortal Realm and haven’t had a chance to experience it yet..."
"I also want to stay close to the Sect Leader!"
Brother Cheng shook his head and smiled: "This time, you’re not going into the Xuanji Dojo, but to the Ascension Platform to sense the rules with experts from other realms."
"With experts from other realms?"
"Are they easy to get along with?"
"Yes, they are all senior experts from various Great Realms, I am quite nervous about being with them..."
Accompanied by Jiang Cheng, everyone quickly entered the interior of the Ascension Platform.
Inside, it actually appeared very spacious, enough to accommodate over a million people.
But there were only 10,050 naturally formed futons inside, suspended in various formations.
Clearly, only by sitting on a futon can one be favored by the rule aura.
All the futons guarded a central tallest throne.
It was exactly where the former City Lord charged out from, considered the core of the Ascension Platform.
At this time, each Great Realm had already chosen their candidates to cultivate inside.
The leaders like Bi Chang, Gui Cang, Void Abyss, Golden Dragon King were all certainly inside.
Besides them, the minimum qualification for being selected was Mid-stage Saint Tier.
The only exceptions were Qingsuo and the other four elders from the Heart Division, who were selected because they were close to Jiang Cheng.
This added a lot of pressure on Feixian Sect’s disciples.
According to this standard, only Ji Linghan, Lin Ning, and Lan Ti among them met the criteria, while other second and third generation disciples were not qualified.
Not to mention the fourth generation disciples only at the Daoist Palace level.
Especially with a large group of Early-stage Saint Tier and Ascending to Saint Ninth Layer looking eagerly outside, it made everyone feel inferior, like they were undeserving.
However, after coming in, the exclusion they anticipated did not appear.
Seeing the Feixian Sect disciples appear, Gui Cang, Void Abyss, Bi Chang, and others quickly stood up from their futons, smiling broadly and cupping their hands in salute.
"Sect Leader Jiang is here!"
"Are these the members of your Feixian Sect? Truly each one is a dragon or phoenix among men, with limitless potential!"
"Hahaha, young friends, come sit over here by this old one!"
"If there are any parts you don’t understand when sensing the rules, feel free to ask me."
"Welcome, welcome, quickly have a seat!"
This level of enthusiasm caught the disciples off guard, leaving them as if in a fog.
These seniors from other realms not only welcomed them, but also left the top tier of futons for them, simply treating them so kindly that they were flattered.
They were not fools and naturally understood that it was again because of the Sect Leader.
The Sect Leader truly commanded great respect, being able to make experts from various realms submit wholeheartedly.
After taking their seats, everyone quickly entered a state of cultivation.
Brother Cheng also deservedly sat on that throne.
He immediately felt the rich rule aura, and his Daoist Heart became active at once.
The 992 main rules within his Daoist Heart, like seedlings nourished by rain, grew at a speed five times faster than usual cultivation.

chapters.title: Chapter 230 Returning the Main Soul
chapters.content:
Chapter 230: Chapter 230 Returning the Main Soul
Brother Cheng cultivated for a while, and various insights came rushing in.
Different rules were like fine rain, silently nourishing the surroundings.
Besides that, the Immortal Yuan Qi here was much richer than outside.
In just a short quarter hour, two late-stage Saint Tier beings flew up and went to the outside world.
They had grasped their insights, and the Immortal Ascension Celestial Tribulation was approaching.
Outside, thunder rumbled, but Brother Cheng was somewhat impatient.
Such a cultivation speed, though seen by others as incredibly fast and unattainable, was unfortunately unsatisfactory to him.
Under normal cultivation circumstances, in the Immortal Realm, advancing a Main Rule from entry level to small success would take at least ten thousand years, even with decent talent.
The talents from the Lower Realm, roughly, followed this speed.
An average immortal might not be able to achieve it in ten thousand years or even one million.
Brother Cheng’s talent was at its peak, perhaps he could accomplish it in a thousand years.
Even with a fivefold speed increase based on this, it would still take hundreds of years.
Altogether 992 Main Rules, when will they be fully cultivated?
He couldn’t wait for that.
"I thought this Ascension Platform was impressive, but after all, you still have to arduously cultivate?"
"Really just a flashy show!"
He got up sulkily, unwilling to continue with his insights.
No matter how fast, it’s not as fast as drawing lottery!
Does he have to sit here for tens of thousands of years like an old man?
"Xiaohan, come here."
He woke Ji Linghan who had just entered cultivation state, then pointed at the throne.
"You should cultivate over there."
The aura of the rules was densest at the center throne, offering the best cultivation effect, and since he didn’t need it, it wouldn’t be wasted.
"Ah?"
Ji Linghan’s soft and lovely eyes widened slightly, then she waved her hands repeatedly: "No, no, that’s Sect Leader’s seat, I can’t sit there."
"I don’t need to cultivate here; you’re the senior sister of our sect, so you can take my place to guard it."
After saying this, Brother Cheng forcibly moved her to the throne.
This movement finally awakened the others.
In an instant, all eyes focused on the two of them.
This made Ji Linghan a bit at a loss, her face almost blushing.
Gui Cang Sword Immortal in surprise said: "Sect Leader Jiang, this is..."
"Oh, my cultivation is a bit different from yours, so I give this place to her."
"I see!"
Gui Cang stroked his beard with a smile, praising him: "Sect Leader Jiang is indeed an extraordinary person, acting unlike the rest of us."
The others also nodded with smiles, continuing to close their eyes to cultivate, without asking more.
Now they had come to ’understand’, whatever extraordinary decision Jiang Cheng made, it always carried deep meaning.
If one didn’t understand it, it was due to one’s limited vision.
So, supporting him was enough.
The throne was surrounded by an aura of dominion over all directions.
If it were Bi Chang, Gui Cang, or Void Abyss sitting there, it would trigger strong discontent among others.
But the choice was someone from Sect Leader Jiang’s own group.
If he wanted a female disciple to sit on the throne, managing a large crew of Immortal Demon Fiends and other varied race leaders, then let it be.
Seeing everyone didn’t object, Ji Linghan finally set her heart at ease.
Brother Cheng was about to leave, and then sensed several resentful gazes.
Foremost among them were Lan Ti and Lin Ning.
What was this about?
He had to send a transmission: "Everyone cultivate well, don’t get lost in my handsome appearance!"
Yin Xuer said sourly: "Sect Leader truly cares most about Senior Sister Ji."
Lan Ti also sullenly said: "Brother Cheng, have you changed your mind?"
Lin Ning bluntly asked: "Sect Leader, why her? Have you already decided?"
"Decided what? What are you talking about that has nothing to do with this?"
"Ridiculously absurd!"
He corrected his expression and lectured: "There’s just one seat, you should understand and be considerate among fellow disciples, don’t get jealous when there’s benefit, understand?"
The girls were speechless.
Are we vying for benefits?
After leaving the Ascension Platform, Jiang Cheng summoned Mo Chen.
"Why haven’t you gone in to cultivate rules?"
"Sect Leader, you might not know; this old body of mine is after all stolen, unable to continue advancing. And the rules of the Ascension Platform offer me limited improvement."
Mo Chen’s original realm was higher even than Profound Immortal.
So that’s how it was?
Jiang Cheng pondered for a moment and eventually made a decision.
"Originally, I carved a contract on your Main Soul Mark, now I’ll return it to you."
Everyone has become so familiar now, there’s no need to continue using the contract as a constraint.
Returning his Main Soul, it would allow his Immortal Soul to be much more complete and his strength to increase a bit.
"Ah?"
Mo Chen was first filled with joy; no one wants to always have an incomplete soul.
But then he panicked again.
"Sect Leader, is this, you don’t need this old one’s help anymore?"
Thinking back to those years idling in the Duanmu Family, with no improvements at all, only barely surviving.
Since joining this ’Child of the Plane’, he’s been practically carried to success.
In just two or three years, he returned to the Immortal Realm.
The contrast was too stark.
The ’Personal Grandmaster’s’ mission isn’t finished yet; he doesn’t want to let go!
Jiang Cheng shook his head and laughed: "Elder Mo is joking, you are the one I value most."
He’s the most considerate show-off assistant; he’d take him over an Immortal Emperor.
The most important person?
The core insider position of the Child of the Plane was officially endorsed!
Mo Chen, immensely moved, finally accepted the Main Soul infusion.
Once Main Soul and Residual Soul made contact, they quickly merged into one, as after all, they both originally belonged to him.
Instantly, even Jiang Cheng felt the person before him renewed.
The whole person’s aura changed significantly, turning from that inconspicuous old man to someone sharp and overwhelmingly powerful.
That aura gave him a feeling like a boundless ocean, even stronger than the previous Profound Immortal City Lord.
Could he have truly been an Immortal Venerable?
No, a Demon Venerable.
One should know, after Golden Immortal, comes Immortal Venerable.
After some adjustments, Mo Chen subdued his entire aura, outwardly appearing harmless and innocuous once more.
The system chimed again, notifying him he received 5 billion points.
Clearly, in the system’s eyes, his value had increased significantly.
"Thank you, Sect Leader. My Immortal Soul is finally complete. As long as it’s repaired in the future, it can recover one-tenth of its peak strength."
After all, he still didn’t have his former Immortal Body, only an Immortal Soul.
And the Immortal Soul was still limited by the current body vessel.
"Why wait for future repairs."
Brother Cheng wasn’t stingy, directly giving him over a dozen Immortal Pills for soul restoration, including one Third Grade Immortal Pill.
Receiving these pills, Mo Chen was moved to tears.
These pills were of great help to him.
Where can one find such a wonderful Child of the Plane?
"Rest assured Sect Leader, during the Immortal City Ascension Battle, this old one will fight at the front line!"
Everyone else was thinking of waiting for the next round of Ascension Battles after millions of years, but Mo Chen knew too well, the Sect Leader couldn’t possibly contentedly wait that long.
How could the Child of the Plane walk a common path?
It won’t be long before he’ll definitely start the challenge.
His statement left Brother Cheng utterly baffled.
Fight at the front line?
Old man, have you misunderstood?
I never intended to give away the chance to show off to you!

chapters.title: Chapter 231: The Harmonious Siblings
chapters.content:
Chapter 231: Chapter 231: The Harmonious Siblings
After Mo Chen went to repair the Immortal Soul, Jiang Cheng called out Ah Huang.
Once she emerged, his daughter chattered like a curious child.
"Huh, where is this place?"
"Mom, where is this?"
"It feels so comfortable, but why can’t I find a Spirit Vein..."
"Is this our new home?"
Calling me mom?
Brother Cheng tilted his chin, looking at her like a clueless country bumpkin.
"This is the Immortal Realm, of course, there are no Spirit Veins!"
"So we’re in the Immortal Realm, huh, mom you’re really something, always moving house."
The little girl could come out anytime in the Xuanji Map, but she preferred staying in the Spirit Vein.
In the Xuanji Map, everyone else felt time dragging on, but only she slept through it all.
"I got you a little brother, today you two should meet."
"A little brother?"
Ah Huang fluttered her long eyelashes, surprised, "Did mom have a baby with someone?"
"Was it Ji Linghan or Lan Ti?"
Damn, you know quite a lot, huh?
I’m amazed I thought you were so pure and innocent all this time...
Jiang Cheng waved his hand and summoned Xiaobai.
"This is Ah Huang, your big sister."
"This is Xiaobai."
"You two should get to know each other well."
Both were not normal beings, he didn’t know what would happen.
The two just stared at each other steadily after meeting.
They didn’t react for a long while.
The scene was quiet to the point of awkwardness.
As the father, Brother Cheng was a bit anxious, hoping they’d joyfully get along like family.
"What’s the matter with you two?"
"Why are you acting like enemies the first time you meet?"
"No, Dad you misunderstood!"
Xiaobai’s cute little face broke into a sweet smile, then she went over boldly and hugged Ah Huang.
"I was just too excited to see Sister."
"Sister, give me a hug!"
"Good little brother!"
Ah Huang’s slightly chubby face was also full of smiles as she patted Xiaobai on his small back.
"Knowing I have a little brother makes me so happy!"
"Is that so, then that’s good."
Brother Cheng nodded, relieved.
But watching Ah Huang pat Xiaobai’s back, he was a bit skeptical whether the strength was too much.
"Dad, can I take sister out to bond a bit?"
"Mom, I want to play well with my brother."
"Go on, go on!"
Seeing the two kids ’hitting it off,’ Brother Cheng dispelled the bit of doubt in his heart.
He even waved at their departing backs.
Later, he began his ’ascetic cultivation.’
During this time, with the lotteries and spoils of war, he gained a lot of Immortal Pills and Immortal Crystals.
He pulled a handful from his ring and stuffed it into his mouth, starting his usual leveling routine.
Outside, thunder roared, and people occasionally emerged from the Ascension Platform to Cross the Tribulation.
Under the Ascension Platform, everyone’s power was advancing by leaps and bounds.
In the rear hall, Mo Chen was quickly repairing the Immortal Soul.
Below the Ascension Platform, a yellow and white light group collided fiercely...
Everything seemed so thriving.
After consuming all the Pills, Brother Cheng directly leaped from a First Grade True Immortal to a Ninth Grade True Immortal.
Although he faced no bottleneck due to his Profound Immortal Level Martial Dao Realm.
And the absorption and conversion speed of the Celestial Desolation Indestructible Body was extremely fast, increasing upon taking Pills.
But the main reason for his rapid advancement was the sheer quantity of Pills.
It’s known his Martial Dao foundation was too deep, requiring many times the Pills of other Cultivators.
Regarding the Immortal Soul, it was also difficult for him to improve it.
Fortunately, having destroyed two Profound Immortals, their collections were enough to stack up several Celestial Immortals.
Plus, he had slain around two hundred Celestial Immortals.
Only then did he finally raise his Realm.
Reaching the True Immortal Ninth Layer in Cultivation, Brother Cheng was full of spirit and decided to get some Points.
He pulled out the Jade Ruler from the previous City Lord.
This item was actually a Magical Treasure controlling the Ascension Platform and summoning the Essence Core.
Upon refining the Jade Ruler, numerous inscriptions appeared on it, incredibly mystical.
Additionally, a huge golden list appeared atop the Ascension Platform, attracting many spectators from the city.
"The Ascension Chart!"
"As expected, Five Seas City is still in first place with 158 victories now!"
"The top three haven’t changed!"
"Yin Yue City, previously fourth, is now sixth, the competition is fierce."
"Shuangdeng City broke into the top ten with exactly 100 victories, impressive!"
"I knew they’d make it, after all, they have six Golden Immortals."
"Do you think our City Lord is a Golden Immortal?"
"I don’t know, but if he can take down the former City Lord, maybe he is..."
The residents of the Immortal City felt no sadness over the former City Lord’s death.
There was no room for hatred or anger either.
Since they weren’t the City Lord’s descendants, it didn’t matter who was City Lord as long as Brother Cheng wasn’t slaughtering them.
They even hoped for a stronger City Lord.
That way, Dingtian City’s performance would improve, and the Power of Rules from the Ascension Platform would be stronger, benefiting them too.
As for entering the top ten, they had never considered it.
It was simply unrealistic!
Then they saw a name on the densely packed list suddenly light up intensely at the bottom.
"Damn, did the City Lord issue a challenge?"
"Let me see, which city did he challenge?"
"Zhanxiao City!"
As Brother Cheng initiated the challenge, the entire Ascension Platform seemed to warp into another space.
Without experiencing any tremors or movement, they found themselves in another scene, incredibly mysterious.
In the distant front, another Ascension Platform rose slowly in the mist.
Shadowy figures appeared on the opposite high platform.
Various Immortal Artifacts and Magical Treasures gleamed with dazzling light.
Everyone from Dingtian City looked at the now-empty spot on the Ascension Platform, their faces full of disbelief.
"My God, Zhanxiao City is a four-victory city, with four Profound Immortals, far stronger than us!"
"This is trouble, we’re sure to lose!"
"If we lose, our Power of Rules will decrease by a level."
"Ugh, why provoke a four-victory city..."
The victories in the Immortal City Ascension Battle perfectly reflect the power of a city.
The difference between four and two victories is significant.
Though there are only two victory gaps, due to numerous cities with the same victories, their rankings differ by 4 million.
Why challenge such a strong city?
If he had challenged a city with zero or one victory, there’d be some hope, right?
"Not necessarily, what if the City Lord truly is a Golden Immortal?"
"Well, let’s hope so..."
Meanwhile, Brother Cheng finally faced his opponents for this challenge.
On the opposite Ascension Platform, four Profound Immortals simultaneously brandished Immortal Swords.
Over five hundred Celestial Immortals lined up, with more than twenty thousand True Immortals behind.
This was due to the Ascension Battle’s rule limit of only thirty thousand participants.
"A mere two-victory city dares to challenge us?"
"Truly courting death!"
As the opposing City Lord finished speaking, Celestial and True Immortals behind him laughed uproariously.

chapters.title: Chapter 232: Clicked the Wrong Button
chapters.content:
