Chapter 232: Chapter 232: Clicked the Wrong Button
Facing the other party’s ridicule, Brother Cheng seemed very annoyed.
"Sigh, I clicked the wrong one."
Upon hearing this, the laughter from the other side grew even louder.
"Hahaha, once the Immortal City challenge starts, a winner must be decided!"
"There’s no turning back for you now!"
"Clicked the wrong one? That’s really a ridiculous mistake."
"Do you still want to click on a 1-win or 0-win Immortal City?"
"We’ll gladly accept the Power of Rules from your Ascension Platform without hesitation."
After hearing their words, Brother Cheng looked utterly baffled.
"What I meant was, I originally wanted to click on a 5-win city."
The opponent for each challenge must be within 3 wins of yourself.
Currently, Dingtian City has 2 wins, so it can challenge up to a 5-win city.
Brother Cheng, being such a flamboyant person, of course, chose the most formidable opponent to suit his protagonist status.
0-win or 1-win wasn’t considered at all.
But because the ranking list was too long, he was dazzled, and Zhanxiao City’s rank wasn’t far from those 5-win cities, so he accidentally clicked on it.
This made him feel quite embarrassed.
"What did you say?"
"You originally wanted to click on a 5-win city?"
The people on the other side looked at each other, suspecting they might have encountered a madman.
The city lord felt inexplicably annoyed, feeling his intelligence was being insulted.
What, do you think Zhanxiao City doesn’t have a reputation?
"It’s really a miracle that you’re still alive today!"
"Looks like you don’t know it’s common for people to die in an Ascension Battle."
"Get all your people out here!"
Sect Leader Jiang had a force of over a hundred thousand men.
But most of them were cultivating outside the Ascension Platform and hadn’t reacted yet when the platform disappeared.
That group was currently in Dingtian City, staring blankly at the sky.
As for the over ten thousand who were cultivating inside the Ascension Platform, they all came along.
However, they were immersed in cultivation, completely unaware they’d been transported to the battlefield.
And Brother Cheng didn’t plan to let them out to steal his glory.
"To deal with you, I alone as the City Lord am enough!"
"Hurry up and start, stop dawdling."
He actually didn’t know how the Ascension Battle was fought, since he’d never experienced it before.
To appear like an old hand, he decided to let the other side make the first move.
To avoid making a fool of himself due to mistakes.
"What?"
"All by yourself?"
"Do you look down on us like that?"
The thirty thousand on the opposite side were all infuriated.
A 4-win Immortal City being despised by a 2-win Immortal City was a humiliation beyond measure.
"Do it!"
"Kill him!"
"Wipe him out!"
The other side was hopping mad, and the city lord flew into the arena with great momentum. With a swing of the Immortal Long Saber in his hand, golden flames covered the sky, forming a massive Fire Phoenix’s shadow.
In the sky, it flexed its claws and fangs as if to incinerate everything.
Brother Cheng originally used Fire Martial Techniques as well, but after slaying the City Lord of Dingtian City last time, he obtained the Tier Three Immortal Sword Xuan Yu, which was water attribute.
So the previous Tier One Immortal Sword Gu Yang was naturally neglected, turned into points.
When the city lord entered the arena, a Black Jade Platform, just a few miles in diameter, appeared beneath him, emanating a deep glow.
"Enter the Challenge Platform and meet your death!"
Challenge Platform?
So formal?
Brother Cheng felt a bit confused.
At both ends of the Black Jade Platform, three flags appeared on each side.
His side was red, representing the challenger.
The other side was blue, representing the challenged.
The strangest thing to him was that the remaining 29,999 opponents stayed in place without one stepping into the arena.
Jiang Cheng didn’t believe they had such ’knightly spirit’, opting not to use their numerical advantage for a showdown against him.
Wouldn’t mobbing him be much more satisfying?
Looking again at the sky above the Black Jade Platform, a countdown appeared directly.
He finally realized.
Could the Ascension Battle be divided into multiple rounds?
And the first round is the city lord duel mode?
"Sigh, what a hassle."
If it was an all-in chaotic battle, he could be easily killed and then resurrected by the system and start cheating.
Simplicity itself would fix everything.
Now that it’s changed to this, it’s hard to say.
Holding the Xuan Yu Immortal Sword, he flew into the arena.
As soon as he entered, the countdown above stopped.
It seems if you don’t enter on time, it counts as a forfeit.
As soon as he came in, the opposing city lord launched an attack without any unnecessary words.
No choice, Brother Cheng’s previous ’provoking humiliation’ was too much; he couldn’t wait to tear him limb from limb.
Boom! Boom!
The gigantic Fire Phoenix spewed golden fire all over the sky.
And around the Fire Phoenix, a rain curtain descended from the sky.
Like numerous tiny chains, it locked the scattered fire in different regions.
Subsequently, grinding it down to nothing.
The sky and ground were filled with the hateful and pungent smell of singeing and burning.
The Black Jade Platform below appeared just a few miles in size, but the duel of these two Immortals, capable of colossal destruction, precisely confined within the challenge platform’s range.
This bizarre sensation of space displacement was undoubtedly caused by those Upper Realm Immortal Emperors and Demon Emperors.
After all, the Immortal City Ascension Battle was their brainchild.
And they set the rules of the competition.
As soon as the two began to clash, they were evenly matched.
This left the opposing city lord utterly incredulous.
Jiang Cheng’s realm was clear, only at the True Immortal Ninth Layer.
Were it not for the rule that the first match must be fought by city lords, he wouldn’t even bother appearing personally and would just send a Celestial Immortal subordinate to settle it.
But now, after engaging in combat, he was shocked to discover this True Immortal was unstoppable.
Although the Immortal Yuan Cultivation was indeed at the True Immortal Ninth Layer level, the strength of that Daoist Heart was no less than his at the Profound Immortal Sixth Layer!
Even stranger was the Immortal Soul, which even under his strikes remained unyielding.
The hardest thing for him to accept was Brother Cheng’s attack power.
The attack carried the bonus effects of seven Heroic Souls, the Azure Dragon Essence Blood’s coercion, added in the Martial Dao support at a Profound Immortal Level, plus the assistance of the Immortal Slayer Spear overhead.
It actually...was not inferior to an average Profound Immortal.
How was that possible?
The two clashed and separated.
The opposing city lord angrily swallowed several pills to temporarily boost his combat power; he couldn’t afford to lose!
"Come face your death!"
He swung the Immortal Artifact, at the same time activating his Magical Treasure.
The Fire Phoenix’s shadow grew larger and more fierce—no gaps were visible in the void.
The rain curtain completely turned to smoke, rising gently.
Subsequently, the Fire Phoenix charged at Sect Leader Jiang.
On the dueling platform, a brilliant blaze erupted.
Then Long Sky was bloodied, a tiny figure, negligible to their attacks, swiftly annihilated!
Clang!
The Xuan Yu Immortal Sword sheathed!
Brother Cheng raised his hand, and the ring, Immortal Armor, and Immortal Sword from the enemy city lord’s corpse all fell into his hand.
He immediately checked the contents inside, finally letting out a long sigh of relief.
Thankfully, just the items on this one city lord were worth 20 billion points.
Otherwise, the tenfold critical strike he just used would have been a huge loss.
The tenth times critical strike at the Ninth-grade True Immortal Level consumes as much as 5 billion points at once.

chapters.title: Chapter 233 Team Battle?
chapters.content:
Chapter 233: Chapter 233 Team Battle?
Jiang Cheng had no interest in slowly revealing his trump card and then fighting for three days and nights.
He always preferred to stack all the buffs and use his ultimate technique right away.
Since he couldn’t defeat the opponent quickly and couldn’t die anyway, he might as well use a critical strike.
One critical strike, instant kill, saving time and effort.
As he won, one of the three blue flags opposite the dueling platform slowly disappeared.
This indicated that the opponent had lost a round.
Jiang Cheng was transmitted back to his ascension platform.
The experts from Zhanxiao City were in pandemonium.
They had participated in many ascension battles and had seen both wins and losses.
But the City Lord being killed caught them unprepared.
After all, if you couldn’t win, you could always escape back.
A dignified Profound Immortal wasn’t that easy to kill anyway.
As long as you could escape back to the ascension platform, it would be counted as a loss, and the battle would end.
And under the constraints of the game’s rules, the opponent couldn’t pursue them.
So you could generally keep your life.
But who could have thought that Jiang Cheng would kill the City Lord with one strike, leaving no chance to escape...
Especially since Brother Cheng was quite meticulous in his actions.
Others might have just won and stopped at that, but he took the opportunity during the few seconds of battle settlement to scavenge the spoils.
With the City Lord dead, Zhanxiao City was left leaderless!
This made things very troublesome.
The other side was in chaos; some even lost their fighting spirit on the spot.
Some showed fear in their eyes.
They finally understood why the opponent’s City Lord was so confident, daring to challenge with 2 wins against 4 wins.
If he could instant kill a Profound Immortal, could he be a Golden Immortal?
"Calm down, everyone!"
"The next round is ours to watch, this person cannot act!"
"Right, there’s nothing to fear anymore!"
According to the rules, the second round was a massive group battle involving 29,999 people.
In the past, the Immortal Martial Army of Dingtian City handled these matters.
And the City Lord who fought in the first round couldn’t fight in the second round.
"But he’s so strong, how could he not have powerful subordinates?"
"His subordinates might be lying in wait..."
"What to do, I don’t want to die."
For a moment, some were full of fighting spirit, while others were worried, suspecting Brother Cheng had a large number of experts waiting.
The black jade dueling platform quietly vanished, replaced by a valley.
Tall mountains surrounded the area, with steep cliffs, towering and inaccessible.
The valley was filled with rubble and boulders, vast and boundless.
Though such terrain wouldn’t mean much to Immortals, it was merely a setting for the scene.
The 29,999 people on the opposite side entered the field, carrying mixed feelings.
Preparation for the second round commenced.
Brother Cheng planned to fly in but found he couldn’t get in.
It was as if an invisible barrier blocked him in the void, preventing him from entering the battle.
Recalling the words of the group on the other side, he was speechless.
Was it possible?
He couldn’t fight in the second round?
Instead, he had to send his subordinates into group combat?
What’s the point in fighting like this?
He couldn’t possibly call out all the Golden Dragon King and others from the ascension platform.
And call upon disciples like Lan Ti and Ji Linghan too?
Summon them to die?
The opposing side was all Immortals, while more than ninety percent of his side hadn’t become Immortals yet.
There are limits to challenging across levels.
Without Sect Leader Jiang intervening personally, it was impossible to win.
He didn’t want to send anyone to die, so he sat in place waiting for the countdown to end.
After all, there wouldn’t only be two rounds.
The group opposite was quite anxious.
The atmosphere was tense and oppressive as they awaited the battle, with three Profound Immortals urgently arranging combat formations.
Nearly thirty thousand immortals quickly got into position.
Each person summoned their own weapon or magical treasure, hiding within the mountains according to assigned duties.
As the great array formed, the entire valley darkened quietly, fogs swirled, and it became a killing field.
Then, they waited for the massive army from Dingtian City to be in position.
The first battle had been so disastrous; the second was bound to be perilous, and they dared not be careless.
However, after waiting for a while, there was no movement from the other side.
After waiting longer, there was still no one from the other side.
There was no sign of the army entering the arena.
The people from Zhanxiao City were puzzled, what was going on?
Could it be the opponent really had only a City Lord alone, with no others?
No way?
Could this be the case?
They had fought many ascension battles, and the second round was always the most lively and intense.
After all, both sides together involved nearly 60,000 people in a chaotic melee.
This round was extremely important; various City Lords recruited experts to win in this melee.
They encountered opponents with incomplete numbers before, with the fewest being just 10 people.
That was a battle decades ago when they were challenged by a powerful Immortal City.
The opponent had just one Golden Immortal and thirty-one Profound Immortals, and in the second round, only 10 Profound Immortals fought; the rest didn’t bother.
On that occasion, their City Lord and General wisely chose to concede.
Today, that city ranks among the top hundred and is often talked about by them.
It’s as if having fought against such a renowned top-ranking Immortal City was a sort of honor.
But they’d never encountered a situation where the opponent didn’t dispatch anyone in the second round, never even heard of it.
How could this happen?
Wouldn’t that be considered giving up?
As time passed, the second round indeed exhausted the countdown.
Since Dingtian City didn’t send anyone to fight, it was considered a forfeit.
Thus, the second round was ruled a win for Zhanxiao City.
One of the three red flags for Dingtian City also fell.
Everyone in Zhanxiao City stared at each other.
"Did we just win a round?"
"We did win, very strange."
"I swear I’ve never had such an easy ascension challenge in my life."
If Brother Cheng hadn’t performed so dominantly in the first round, they might have felt humiliated again.
"Hey, expert from the other side, do you only have one person in your city?"
"If you’re alone, why start a challenge?"
"Don’t you know ascension battles rely on group strength?"
"Why not join us here in Zhanxiao City?"
"Yes, yes, why not be our Vice City Lord!"
"We just lost an expert, and you have no people over there, so it’s quite complementary."
Hearing these words, Brother Cheng was amused.
Please, I just killed your City Lord, didn’t I?
It’s one thing for you not to seek revenge, but actually recruiting on the spot?
Why be so pragmatic?
Of course, he wouldn’t agree, especially since Dingtian City’s Essence Core Xiaobai had become his son.
Switching cities would mean separating father and son.
Most importantly, they offered just the Vice City Lord position, not attractive at all.
If he was to be something, he wanted to be the main one!
At this moment, the third round began.
As the valley in the field slowly faded away, a transparent bubble appeared in the void.
The bubble wasn’t large, only about tens of meters in radius.
Smooth, thin warp rose around it, surrounding the bubble, appearing and disappearing.
The Jade Ruler magical treasure in Brother Cheng’s hand suddenly trembled violently.
The Essence Core Xiaobai, originally under the ascension platform, appeared beside him out of thin air.
Following closely, Ah Huang also chased out.
The third round was a duel between the Essence Cores of the Immortal Cities!

chapters.title: Chapter 234: This posture isn’t correct
chapters.content:
Chapter 234: Chapter 234: This posture isn’t correct
Brother Cheng almost didn’t recognize the two kids upon seeing them again.
Ah Huang had her hair disheveled and was covered in marks all over.
Whereas Xiaobai had a bruised and swollen face, with a black ring circling his left eye.
"What the heck happened to you two?"
He was a bit in disbelief.
Wasn’t it their first time meeting?
"Did you two have a fight?"
"Didn’t I teach you to be kind and loving towards each other?"
Ah Huang giggled, "Mom, you’ve misunderstood. We were just teasing you."
With that, she spun around on the spot, golden light spots gracefully draping around her like ribbons.
The whole process looked like a moment of transcendence, and then the girl transformed, looking completely refreshed with no signs of disarray.
"You can do that?"
Brother Cheng clicked his tongue, impressed by the girl’s flashy special effects, wishing she could do that for him as well.
"Tsk!"
Xiaobai, off to the side, rolled his eyes inconspicuously.
He also waved his hand, flashed with white light, and returned to his previous pristine appearance.
As if the bruised and swollen face belonged to someone else.
"Dad, it’s my turn to fight now. I’ll be right back!"
"You?"
Brother Cheng glanced at the bubble in the field. At this moment, the Essence Core of Zhanxiao City had already appeared in it.
This Essence Core didn’t take a childlike form, nor even humanoid, but was a monster with only two legs and a massive gaping mouth.
Though the monster wasn’t large, similar to an adult man, its huge mouth took up almost half of its body.
But looking at its sharp teeth and constantly drooling mouth, Brother Cheng started to sweat torrents.
No way?
Such a stark contrast between cute and fierce, isn’t the comparison too brutal?
"With your small frame, can you beat it?"
Xiaobai coolly lifted his chin, proudly saying, "It’s just a bunch of weaklings. Watch me defeat them with a laugh!"
Brother Cheng’s body trembled with excitement.
Indeed, in the Cultivation Realm, power is never solely judged by size.
Otherwise, the first place in the Lower Realm Ten Thousand Realms would belong to the Celestial Demon Domain, not the Desolate Domain.
Seems like his son is exceptionally talented too!
"Great!"
Brother Cheng was overjoyed, casually using 1 point to conjure a bowl of wine.
"Warrior, please drink this bowl dry; your father cheers for you on your quest!"
The only ones who could make Brother Cheng willingly give up the spotlight were his own kids.
Without saying a word, Xiaobai took the bowl, chugged it down, and then smashed the bowl to pieces.
He turned around and charged straight towards the battlefield!
Brother Cheng was delighted rather than angry.
He even gave Ah Huang a thumbs up.
"Look at the spirit your brother has before the battle; it resembles my own bold style."
"Hehehe..."
Ah Huang covered her mouth, not sure what she was laughing about.
Afterward, Brother Cheng witnessed a tragic scene.
Inside the bubble, Xiaobai had no chance to fight back, constantly battered by the monster, the beating was brutal.
Soon he was bruised and swollen again, looking like a pig’s head.
He was even shouting, "I only let you have three moves!"
"Don’t push it, my patience has its limits!"
Bang! Bang! Bang!
"You think I’m a weakling?"
"Hey, don’t you know when to stop?"
Bang! Bang! Bang!
"Don’t force me to use my ultimate technique!"
After hundreds of hits, Xiaobai’s so-called ultimate technique was never seen; it was entirely a one-sided beating.
Laughter erupted from the other side, their victory of the third round was sure.
The Ascension Battle, that’s how it went, in three rounds, two wins out of three.
Brother Cheng was dumbfounded.
So his son in the Essence Core was actually just a weakling?
The only impressive thing was his talking abilities?
"Ahem, Dad just said that offhandedly."
Feeling a bit embarrassed, he looked towards his daughter and once again advised, "Don’t learn from him, pretending to be competent without actual skill will only lead to beating. What he did was a mistake."
"Hehe..."
Ah Huang laughed again.
Brother Cheng felt a bit embarrassed: "Your brother got beaten so badly, how can you be so gloating? At least show some sadness for me?"
"Mom, do you want him to win?"
Hmm?
Brother Cheng was startled, then delighted: "Do you have a way?"
"I can’t beat that monster either, but we can gang up on it."
Gang up?
Jiang Cheng hadn’t reacted yet when Ah Huang flew out and soon appeared inside the bubble as well.
The monster inside was chasing Xiaobai, not expecting a third person to appear.
Unprepared, it was kicked in the air, spun twice, and heavily slammed into the ground.
Xiaobai, who had been running away, reacted quickly and rushed back to deliver two more fierce kicks.
However, the monster got up, turned, and bit his arm.
"Ow ow ow, that hurts, it hurts!"
While Xiaobai screamed, Ah Huang jumped onto the monster’s back again.
She grabbed the monster’s hair, which was as stiff as steel needles, and performed a shoulder throw.
This move threw both Xiaobai and the monster away.
With a crash, the monster was left dazed and confused.
Then, the siblings pounced on it, furiously pounding the monster with all their might!
Under their combined attack, the situation was finally turned around.
The monster was quickly left toothless on the ground.
Xiaobai finally glowed with pride.
"I told you I’d let you have three moves, but you just got addicted, didn’t you?"
Bang! Bang! Bang!
"I told you my patience has limits! You just had to provoke me!"
Bang! Bang! Bang!
"You forced me to unleash my ultimate technique!"
Watching from afar, Brother Cheng beamed with satisfaction.
Ah yes, that’s the way to do it!
This aligns with the proper style!
As for the notion that two-on-one is dishonorable?
He didn’t even consider that; he even cupped his hands into a makeshift megaphone and shouted to the field.
"Well done!"
"Siblings united, their strength can break gold!"
The other side was dumbfounded.
What was this?
Each city only had one Essence Core, even Five Seas City, which was ranked first, was no exception.
Every time, the third round had always been Essence Core vs. Essence Core, a single match.
For millions of years, so many Ascension Wars had been like this, without exception.
Under the constraints of the rules, not even they, let alone Immortal Kings, could intervene in the third-round battle.
But...
Who was the girl who jumped in there?
"This is cheating!"
"This breaks the rules!"
"How can this be happening?"
"Something went wrong, it must be a mistake in the Ascension Battle!"
Seeing their victory slipping away, with the Essence Core Monster being battered nearly to death, they couldn’t remain still any longer.
Each flew from the Ascension Platform, attempting to intervene in this battle.
But they couldn’t get in.
Rules set by the Immortal Emperor couldn’t be broken by mere Profound Immortals.
With no other option, they could only activate their Magical Treasure to summon the Essence Core Monster back.
However, upon activation, the General was shocked.
"It can’t be summoned back!"
"The Essence Core has lost connection with the Magical Treasure, isolated by some mysterious power..."
"How, how, how did this happen?"
Under normal circumstances, if the Essence Core was losing, it could be summoned back instantly.
Even if not recalled, the Essence Core could effectively exit on its own.
But now, the monster seemed stuck and unable to return.

chapters.title: Chapter 235: Aren’t You Unable to Kill?
chapters.content:
Chapter 235: Chapter 235: Aren’t You Unable to Kill?
Soon after, the monster’s form could no longer maintain itself.
Quickly, it transformed into a white orb of light.
Then, before everyone’s eyes, the brother and sister within the bubble simultaneously rushed toward the orb, vying against each other.
They split the orb of light in two.
Immediately, the divided orbs entered their bodies respectively.
Both of them returned to their original forms, and it seemed they had become somewhat stronger.
Ah Huang and Xiaobai were simultaneously transmitted back to the Ascension Platform, marking the end of the third round.
The opposing blue flag fell.
The final result was two to one, with Dingtian City emerging victorious!
This outcome was completely unacceptable to the opposing Zhanxiao City.
This Ascension Battle was bizarre from beginning to end.
First, their City Lord was instantly killed, then they won the second round without a fight, and the third round was like a rule-breaking two-on-one.
And that Essence Core...
Could the Essence Core have been killed?
Can the Essence Core even die?
They had never heard of such a thing.
At that moment, the Ascension Platform beneath their feet suddenly began to crumble.
"How could this happen?"
"Is our Ascension Platform broken?"
They had lost before, and each time they lost, a portion of the Power of Rules on the Ascension Platform would automatically be deducted.
And transferred to the opposing Ascension Platform.
But the entire Ascension Platform actually remained intact; it was never destroyed.
"Oh no, it’s because the Essence Core is destroyed!"
The Essence Core is the core foundation of the Ascension Platform, and their Essence Core had just been devoured by Ah Huang and Xiaobai.
Thus...
The Ascension Platform naturally could no longer sustain itself.
Rumble!
The Ascension Platform quickly cracked into pieces, collapsing as dust continued to fall.
In an instant, there was no more ground beneath their feet.
The next moment, both sides were transmitted out of this battle space.
Brother Cheng returned to Dingtian City along with his Ascension Platform.
He had been waiting to absorb the power from the opponent’s Ascension Platform, knowing there was supposed to be such a reward for victory.
He didn’t expect it to turn out like this.
"Did I lose out?"
He rubbed his chin, feeling a little regretful.
But then he noticed something amiss.
The Ascension Platform back in Dingtian City was noticeably much stronger than before.
The aura of the Power of Rules was at least fifty percent stronger, and even the concentration of Immortal Yuan Qi had increased.
"Is it because of you two?"
He turned his attention to the two children.
Previously, he had heard from the native inhabitants that, after winning, they could obtain part of the opponent’s rules aura.
But it was said to increase by at most one percent.
He had never heard of an increase of fifty percent.
Moreover, this time, the concentration of Immortal Yuan Qi had also increased!
"Of course!"
Xiaobai proudly patted his chest, "Who told it to be so dumb, not even knowing to escape, meat delivered to the mouth that isn’t eaten will get struck by lightning."
Ah Huang gave him a sympathetic look, then shook her head.
"Brother, you’re indeed adorably stupid."
"What did you say?"
Xiaobai rolled up his sleeves, his morale high after just winning a match.
Brother Cheng waved his hand, "Alright, alright, you both did great this time, Daddy is quite pleased."
He was no fool and noticed that devouring the Essence Core this time was an unprecedented anomaly.
Such a thing had never happened even in the Immortal Realm.
And the reason the opponent’s Essence Core couldn’t escape was certainly because of Ah Huang’s presence.
This daughter was indeed quite extraordinary.
Originally, he thought she could only be impressive in the Lower Realm, but it turned out she was also formidable in the Immortal Realm.
"Did you not say you couldn’t kill?"
Brother Cheng glanced at her, teasingly saying, "I saw you were quite ruthless just now, using every possible trick like face grabbing and peach stealing!"
Ah Huang covered her mouth with a giggle.
"Mom, you forgot, it’s not considered a living being."
Huh?
Brother Cheng was left speechless by the retort.
After the two children returned beneath the Ascension Platform, the experts cultivating inside rushed out one after another.
They weren’t disturbed by the battle; none of the three rounds affected them inside.
They were alarmed by the changes in the rules aura and Immortal Yuan Qi.
"Sect Leader Jiang, what happened?"
Within just a day’s work, the Gui Cang Sword Immortal had already become a Second-Grade True Immortal.
But the old sword immortal had no time to be joyful, his face full of bewilderment.
The Void Abyss True Demon was also quite curious, "Why did the Power of Rules suddenly strengthen so much?"
"Did Sect Leader Jiang do something?"
Everyone looked at Brother Cheng.
Faced with everyone’s curiosity, Jiang Cheng’s desire to show off was once again greatly satisfied.
Alas, his life was thus, boring without showing off for a single day.
"Nothing much, I was just bored, so I destroyed a city and brought back a victory."
He pressed his hands down in a casual manner.
"You all know, winning grants you a reward of Power of Rules."
The wonder of the two children, he naturally wouldn’t reveal.
Especially Xiaobai, who wouldn’t truly appear until the Ascension battle.
As he expected, everyone was shocked.
"What? There’s already been a victory?"
"Why were we completely unaware?"
"How could a battle be completed in such a short time?"
"Who fought in it?"
Brother Cheng smiled faintly, "I fought alone, this Ascension Battle was quite easy."
Alone in battle?
And it was easy?
No one knew what to say anymore.
What are they striving so hard in cultivation for now?
Isn’t it mostly to become stronger and quickly become a powerful force for Dingtian City?
Only then could they shine in the next session a million years later.
But now, while they were still cultivating, someone had already won a round.
"May I ask, Sect Leader Jiang, which city did you just challenge?"
"I think it was called Zhanxiao City, a Four Victories City."
"Four Victories City!"
There was another outburst of astonishment.
Unlike Brother Cheng, they had gathered information about the Ascension Battle from local residents before starting their cultivation.
In Four Victories City, all their thirty thousand participants were basically immortals.
How did he win alone?
The Taichang True Immortal of the Celestial Book Domain looked incredulous.
"This... I’ve heard that the Ascension Battle has three rounds, one of which is a group battle."
"Indeed, having just one person isn’t enough."
Others couldn’t fathom it either.
Sect Leader Jiang shrugged, "What’s the difficulty? Just give up that one round; there are still two rounds left, right?"
"Just make sure to win those two rounds."
Everyone was completely silenced by this statement.
Simply giving up a round, certainly straightforward and brutal.
It implied they weren’t needed at all.
This remark surely stung deeply.
In an instant, they all felt profoundly discouraged.
They looked at each other, gradually filled with intense determination.
"Sect Leader Jiang, rest assured, from today onward, we will exhaust every effort to cultivate and become your capable aides as quickly as possible!"
"Indeed, since you’re planning to make an impact in this Ascension Battle, we won’t lag behind either!"
This group could never be content to be hangers-on.
Brother Cheng felt helpless, there was no need for them to try so hard; he could carry the burden of showing off alone.

chapters.title: Chapter 236 Continuous Challenges
chapters.content:
Chapter 236: Chapter 236 Continuous Challenges
The news of defeating Zhanxiao City quickly spread throughout the entire Dingtian City.
In a short time, the residents of the Immortal City were overjoyed.
For this New City Lord, who had just arrived a day ago, they quickly became supportive at the speed of light.
Anyone who dared to say anything bad or mention the former City Lord would be on the receiving end of furious scolding.
No choice, with such strength, he could lead everyone to better days.
The increase in Power of Rules and Immortal Yuan Qi in the city was proof.
The experts cultivating inside experienced faster breakthroughs.
Throughout the day, Thunder Tribulations continued.
Meanwhile, the busy Sect Leader Jiang was pondering the next ’grand development plan’.
To ensure the two kids could eat meat, he definitely had to let them off for a round in the first two matches.
Otherwise, they wouldn’t even make it to the third round; the best of three would end prematurely.
But the issue was, at this rate, he, the City Lord, would be ’overworked’.
To squeeze into the top ten, he had to win a hundred matches.
Brother Cheng commented that he had never fought as many battles in his life.
Especially with only one opportunity for a Critical Strike per day, he’d need to complete it in 100 days.
Although the spoils could earn back the Points spent on the Critical Strike several times over, it was exhausting.
He pondered for a long time, unable to come up with a good way to conserve effort.
"Alas, I’m just destined for hard work."
If this word got out, other cities might be exasperated.
We spent hundreds of years, working ourselves half to death, with thousands exhausting their utmost efforts, only winning a few dozen matches.
Some cities even had negative records.
You, on the other hand, can win 100 times in 100 days, only needing to make a move once a day, yet still not satisfied?
If it were anyone else, they’d wake up laughing from their dreams.
Time quickly arrived at the second day; Critical Strike cooldown was up, and he clicked on the Ascension Chart again.
He browsed and selected a city with 6 wins.
Within the city, there was an uproar once again.
"Is the City Lord going to battle again?"
"This time it’s Kuniu City, a city ranked within the top million!"
"There are nine Profound Immortals on the opposing side, how can we fight?"
"No matter how strong the City Lord is, it won’t work, the second round will surely be unbearable."
Those ordinary residents didn’t know Brother Cheng would directly forfeit the second round.
If they knew, their expressions would be more fascinating.
"The City Lord is great everywhere, just a bit overly ambitious."
"Yeah, challenges should be gradual. We’re at 3 wins now, we can easily pick a 0-win city, it’s more secure this way."
In the Ascension Battle space, amid the city’s discussions, the battle proceeded leisurely.
As usual, Brother Cheng took the lead, winning the first match with a tenfold Critical Strike.
Along the way, he plundered all the opponent’s collections.
Then forfeited the second round.
Finally, Ah Huang and Xiaobai joined forces, taking on two opponents, winning another match.
This time, unlike the last, these siblings were much stronger than in the previous round.
It seemed they had become stronger after devouring Zhanxiao City’s Essence Core.
And in the match against Kuniu City, the two siblings unsurprisingly divided and devoured the opponent’s Essence Core again.
Thus their power advanced further.
As for the opposing Kuniu City, it unfortunately became the second Immortal City in history where the Ascension Platform collapsed.
After gaining this victory, Dingtian City achieved four wins.
Due to the many Immortal Cities with the same record in the low-win bracket, just one more win propelled the ranking forward by over two million places.
When this ’family of three’ returned to Dingtian City, discussions were still ongoing below.
Many were anxious, worried about losing a match and having the Power of Rules taken back.
And at that moment, the Ascension Platform returned to the city.
The crowd immediately felt the presence of the Power of Rules increased by fifty percent compared to before, and the concentration of Immortal Yuan Qi also increased by forty percent.
To be honest, considering the cultivation environment in Dingtian City, it could already rank in the top ten in the Lower Immortal Realm.
After all, others winning a match increased the Power of Rules by one percent, while theirs was fifty percent.
This significant change left everyone frozen in place.
"How did the improvement increase so much again?"
"Did we win again?"
"We won! We really won!"
"On the Ascension Chart, Dingtian City is already at four wins, ranking at 2,585,343!"
"My gosh, this is simply a leap!"
"It’s incredible, that they could even defeat a City with six wins!"
"How did they win?"
They just couldn’t figure it out.
Clearly, our lineup is so weak, even less than the former City Lord’s Immortal Martial Army, how did we defeat the six-win city?
"Who cares how, as long as we win!"
"Yes, as long as we win, long live the City Lord!"
The entire city plunged into revelry once again.
Inside the Ascension Platform, those cultivating opened their eyes once more.
They exchanged looks, silent beyond their shock.
Sect Leader Jiang won another round...
As elites from the Lower Realm Ten Thousand Realms, whether Bi Chang or Gui Cang Void Abyss Golden Dragon King, they were inherently very proud.
Being carried so dominantly, one or two times was fine.
But every time like this just made them feel incompetent.
This strongly aroused their self-esteem.
They didn’t venture out to investigate this time; everyone held a fire in their hearts.
After this stimulus, they cultivated even more zealously.
Brother Cheng waited a moment in the grand hall, but didn’t get anyone to praise his new achievements.
Couldn’t help feeling a little disappointed.
It was the two kids pulling at his pant legs from left to right.
"Daddy, hurry up and start the next battle!"
"Mommy, the opponent’s Essence Core is very helpful to us..."
Ah Huang and Xiaobai seemed to be hooked on fighting, urging him to start the next battle quickly.
Brother Cheng thought, should he also tell them about his one tenfold Critical Strike per day?
Originally, he considered using the system’s Resurrection to fight the next match after the Critical Strike was exhausted.
But he thought carefully, these were contests, not ordinary fights.
If he died, the result of the battle would be decided immediately.
The competition rules would rule that his side lost that round.
Even if he resurrected, he couldn’t change the outcome.
So now, he could only rely on the tenfold Critical Strike.
"Alright, alright, wait until tomorrow!"
Papa has a secret pain!
The two kids immediately looked crestfallen.
"Huh? Have to wait until tomorrow?"
"Can’t we do it today?"
Brother Cheng straightened his face: "Don’t you understand the need to balance work and rest? Continuous high-intensity combat causes muscles to accumulate a lot of lactic acid, and if you don’t relax, it will harm the body..."
He babbled a pile of stuff he himself felt was meaningless.
The two kids looked bewildered.
Just seeing that their dad seemed quite skilled, knowing all these things.
The time quickly arrived at the second day.
Sect Leader Jiang was still in dreamland when the two kids shook him awake.
"Dad, can we go fight today?"
"I’m ready!"
"Let’s start challenging, we can’t wait!"
The two kids rubbed their hands, like fighting maniacs.
With the tenfold Critical Strike restored, Brother Cheng regained his confidence and naturally waved grandly.
He pulled up the chart and casually picked a seven-win Immortal City.
Thus the city boiled over again.
This time, however, the sentiment wasn’t overwhelmingly pessimistic anymore, many turned expectant.

chapters.title: Chapter 237: Rising Fame
chapters.content:
Chapter 237: Chapter 237: Rising Fame
On the tenth day, Dingtian City achieved ten consecutive victories.
With a total of 12 victories, it ranked 9875th on the Ascension Chart!
Initially, when it was ranked in the millions, aside from the defeated Immortal City, not many paid attention.
After all, with a total of 18 million Immortal Cities, the number was overwhelmingly large.
Occasional victories, advancing several million ranks, were normal and not particularly noteworthy.
But when Dingtian City steadily advanced to the top 1 million, 500,000, 100,000, 50,000...
Until this time in the top 10,000.
This city finally caught the attention of experts from other Immortal Cities.
"What’s happening in this Dingtian City?"
"Is this an unexpected rise of a dark horse?"
"Have they recruited a Golden Immortal?"
"Even recruiting a Golden Immortal can’t guarantee victory in every match, right?"
Each Ascension Battle has three rounds; even with a powerful Golden Immortal, only one victory can be assured.
The remaining two rounds are still unknowns.
Especially the final round, the Essence Core duel, which no one can interfere with, leaving it to fate.
Thus, everyone tries to win completely in the first two rounds to avoid betting on luck in the last round.
"There are no famous Golden Immortals in the Lower Immortal Realm yet; they all have their affiliations."
"That’s right, they’re all concentrated in the top hundred large cities, there can’t be any left out."
"How does Dingtian City manage this?"
"It’s just good luck, nothing to worry about."
"If they were that strong, why didn’t they rise in the past 90 years?"
While the outside world speculated, people inside Dingtian City were immersed in a dreamy joy.
To the city’s residents, the last ten days felt like a dream.
The Power of Rules ascended by a step each day, and the concentration of Immortal Yuan Qi improved by a level daily.
Now, ten days later, it has reached five times the past level.
What concept is this?
Even cultivating outside the Ascension Platform is now better than the effects inside it ten days ago.
The top-ranked Immortal City in the Lower Immortal Realm doesn’t have this treatment.
And those inside the Ascension Platform kept breaking through.
Disciples like Lan Ti, Ji Linghan, and Lin Ning also ascended to immortality, bringing Brother Cheng billions of points.
With daily challenges, Brother Cheng maintained a pace of elevating one disciple daily.
Now half of the fourth generation disciples have entered the Ascending to Saint Realm, and the second and third generation disciples have generally reached the Mid-stage Saint Tier.
Ten victories, although only defeating ten opposite City Lords, were all Profound Immortals, with considerable spoils.
Apart from Immortal Pills and Immortal Crystals, Brother Cheng kept nothing, converting all into points.
He finally gathered 180 billion points, and with the disciples’ upgrades brought points, he totaled 250 billion.
After drawing 250 times the Level 7 lottery, his main rules reached 370 lines in the Small Success Realm.
Then he took pills to upgrade, rising to Third Grade Celestial Immortal.
Power reaching Celestial Immortal level, combined with numerous buffs, his combat power already surpassed most Profound Immortals.
If he activates tenfold critical strikes, he can even wipe out Golden Immortals.
Brother Cheng, full of confidence, could finally proceed boldly with his challenges.
As Dingtian City’s consecutive victories accumulated, the city drew more and more attention.
Because it rose too fast.
Especially those who had been watching from the start were shocked to discover the city challenged daily.
Notice, other Immortal Cities always take long breaks between battles.
The Ascension Battle is often brutal, especially the second round which causes serious attrition, even leading to losses.
During this time, many City Lords seek additional combat power to supplement manpower.
It might be years before they commence another battle.
But Dingtian City incredibly won daily without interruption.
"Isn’t this too abnormal?"
"Don’t they have any attrition?"
When Brother Cheng reached a 50-win streak, their ranking surged to top 500.
Even without consecutive wins, reaching this rank garnered widespread attention and discussion.
Moreover, their rapid rise was outright abnormal.
It’s just that the Lower Immortal Realm is so vast, finding them would be difficult.
Otherwise, Dingtian City might already be surrounded by layers of watchers.
"I’ve heard that Dingtian City only fights two rounds each time, directly forfeiting the second round."
"Their City Lord is undoubtedly a Golden Immortal; each first-round showdown is an instant kill."
"Then how do they ensure victory in the third round?"
"You may not know, but they have two Essence Cores! Two against one, it’s hard to lose!"
"What? Two Essence Cores?"
"Yes, those two cores are exceptionally powerful. Any core defeated by them is killed, and the Ascension Platform is destroyed."
"Isn’t this plainly violating rules? How can this be?"
"What violation, who said the rules couldn’t allow two Essence Cores?"
"This..."
In fact, after Ah Huang and Xiaobai finished the fourth Ascension Battle, there was no need for a gang-up anymore.
From then on, the brother and sister duo stabilized their overwhelming power over other Essence Cores by devouring them.
Even one-on-one, they could easily defeat other cores.
But to seize the core’s power, the two would rush in together.
After 50 consecutive victories, the Power of Rules here surged to ten times its previous intensity!
Now, half of the experts who entered the Ascension Platform have become True Immortals.
No choice, after devouring so many cores, Dingtian City’s cultivation environment exceeds the Middle Immortal Realm, even surpassing many places in the Upper Immortal Realm.
With the exceptional talents of Gui Cang, Void Abyss, and other Domain heads, they have reached Fifth and Sixth Grade True Immortals.
And disciples of the Feixian Sect’s second and third generations have ascended to immortality.
Fourth generation disciples have entered the Saint Tier.
Holding the loot exchange and disciple upgrades bringing 700 billion points, Brother Cheng resolutely performed 700 draws.
Skills like Transmission Invisibility, Alchemy, and Artifact Refining upgraded to Level 7.
This time, he pushed the remaining main rules to the Small Success Level, and advancing to Profound Immortal was unobstructed, only lacking Immortal Soul and cultivation accumulation.
Meanwhile, his Heroic Soul Buff reached 30!
The enemies facing him endured extreme hardship.
Beset by various negative effects, they might suffer defeat if careless, unable to fully exert their power.
After another round of ascetic cultivation with pills, Brother Cheng barely increased his realm to Seventh-grade Celestial Immortal.
In truth, fortunately, he had so many points for draws.
Normal cultivation could take millions of years without progress.
Later, he opened the challenge list again.
His streak continued.
consecutive wins.
consecutive wins.
consecutive wins.
consecutive wins.
consecutive wins...
Until the day of 110 consecutive wins, Dingtian City climbed to the 8th spot!
At this moment, they became the most prestigious entity in the entire Lower Immortal Realm.
Countless people talked about this black horse Immortal City sweeping through the ranks.
And those Immortal Cities ranked near them trembled in fear, afraid of being challenged.

chapters.title: Chapter 238 Shuangdeng City
chapters.content:
Chapter 238: Chapter 238 Shuangdeng City
Losing to Dingtian City, the cost was truly too great.
The Essence Core was destroyed, the Ascension Platform collapsed directly, even an Immortal City with 100 victories would have its ranking erased and fall to the bottom because of this.
After achieving one hundred victories, since there were too few ranked targets nearby, it was possible to challenge across ten ranks.
And the challenge could be repeated.
It’s said that many Immortal Cities chose to avoid Dingtian City, even resorting to desperate measures.
For example, by first challenging other Immortal Cities and then deliberately losing to them.
After losing a match, there would be a ’protection period’ of one year where they couldn’t be challenged.
This was also out of helplessness.
However, the top ten cities were mostly not that cowardly.
After all, they all had over 100 victories, with so many instances of Power of Rules reinforcement, their Essence Cores themselves were also relatively strong.
Moreover, the City Lords of these Immortal Cities were all ninth-grade Golden Immortals.
Some were even from the Middle Immortal Realm, with strength far beyond ordinary Golden Immortals.
They didn’t believe Jiang Cheng could shake their position.
As for Dingtian City, everyone had already started worshipping the new City Lord as a god.
In just over 100 days, he led an Immortal City ranked six million to eighth place.
This was simply a miracle.
According to the rules of the Ascension Battle, now they just need to wait for the ten-year settlement period to arrive to be transferred to the Middle Immortal Realm.
And in fact, everyone wasn’t very concerned about entering the Middle Immortal Realm anymore.
Now the Power of Rules and Immortal Yuan Qi in the city absolutely exceeded that of any city in the Upper Immortal Realm.
consecutive wins increased by fifty-five times on the original foundation.
It’s uncertain if there’s a place like this in the Immortal Realm.
Even if there is, it’s probably occupied by Immortal Emperors and Demon Emperors as Grotto Heaven Blessed Lands.
In such a place, it’s easy to imagine the effect of cultivation.
During this time, even some of the native inhabitants reached immortality.
Among the Ascenders, experts like Gui Cang and Void Abyss all reached ninth-grade True Immortal.
Even Heart Division experts like Qingsuo reached True Immortal status.
Among Brother Cheng’s disciples, Ji Linghan and Lan Ti Lin Ning also reached ninth-grade True Immortal.
At this breakthrough speed, it would likely only slow down when reaching Profound Immortal Golden Immortal.
After all, at the Golden Immortal stage, breaking through to Immortal Venerable is not something an optimal Grotto Heaven Blessed Land environment can solve.
The entire Dingtian City was thriving, now able to form a force of thirty thousand Immortals.
And on this day, Brother Cheng routinely opened the Ascension Chart, intending to pick another opponent.
He had no intention of stopping there.
How could he live up to the title of King Bi without taking first place?
But then, he found that his two children were not urging him to start the battle as usual.
This was strange.
Recently, the two children had been eager every day.
He quickly found the two children, only to discover they were both asleep under the Ascension Platform.
"Hey hey, what’s with you two?"
"Get up quickly, it’s time to fight."
Xiaobai turned over, not even opening his eyes.
Ah Huang mumbled, "Mom, we can’t devour any more Essence Cores, we’re too full..."
What?
Is there a limit to devouring Essence Cores?
He squatted down worriedly.
"You two won’t have any problems, right?"
As an old father, he certainly didn’t want anything to happen to the two kids, even if they didn’t have such miraculous abilities.
"We’re fine, just need some time to digest."
This...
Brother Cheng was relieved.
However, the original plan for challenges could only be temporarily set aside.
He was confident of defeating the opponent’s City Lord in the first round.
But without the two kids, he’d definitely lose in the third round.
As for the second round, although everyone’s cultivation had improved rapidly, it was still not enough against the top ten cities.
Those Immortal Cities had Celestial Immortals as bottom-tier in the second round, with hundreds of Profound Immortals and several Golden Immortals leading.
"Looks like we can only take a break for now."
Fighting once every day during this time had already exhausted him.
He felt really tired.
Now was a rare time to relax.
So on this day, Dingtian City, which had attracted much attention, showed no change in its victory count.
Until the end of this day, countless people stared at the Ascension Chart until their eyes ached.
"Dingtian City has stopped!"
"They didn’t challenge today."
This kind of thing was very normal for other Immortal Cities, but it seemed abnormal happening to Dingtian City.
"What happened? Why didn’t they continue?"
"No need to ask, they reached the limit of their strength."
"Right, the top seven aren’t easy to mess with, losing would deduct their battle record."
"They’re already in the top ten, no need to take risks anymore."
"I almost thought they could keep pushing and reach number one."
"Do you think cities like Five Seas City are just pushovers?"
As time went on, Dingtian City never challenged again.
The nearby Immortal Cities all quietly sighed in relief.
Over the endless sea at an unknowable number of billions of miles from Dingtian City, black clouds filled the sky, so dark you couldn’t see your hand before your face.
This place was perpetually in a state of night, but on that sea, there were two extremely bright flames.
Getting closer, you would see a huge suspended Immortal City.
Above the Immortal City, there were two towering Everlasting Lamps.
In this dark sea, they were as dazzling as lighthouses.
Around and below the city, there were cultivators in short clothes covered in water rust flying into the sea now and then.
Soon, giant sea beasts tens of thousands of meters long would be carried back into the city, exuding blood.
If outsiders came here, they would know this was the famous Shuangdeng City of the Lower Immortal Realm.
Currently ranked eleventh, with a record of 102 victories.
Six Golden Immortals guarded it, assisted by three hundred Profound Immortals.
Its strength was formidable, scarcely anyone dared provoke it.
Recently, however, the City Lord had been in a foul mood.
Dingtian City’s sudden rise disrupted the original order of the Lower Immortal Realm.
Although Shuangdeng City was fortunately not chosen by Jiang Cheng, they were the most affected because they were pushed out of the top ten.
The eleventh place could not ascend to the Middle Immortal Realm.
This loss was huge, few could accept it.
To regain their ranking, they challenged twice in recent days.
Raising their record from 100 wins to 102 wins.
But due to insufficient preparation time, they paid a great price.
"We can only continue challenging those behind us, to increase our battle record."
"The cities behind are also not easy to fight. Last time when we defeated Profound Light City, we lost 32 Profound Immortals and 550 Celestial Immortals, the loss was too great."
"Yes, everyone’s strength is close, it’s very difficult to fight."
"Several of the Immortal Cities in the 90+ victories range are in a protection period and can’t be challenged at the moment."
"Currently, Silver Bell City, ahead of us in ninth place, has a record of 107 wins, 5 matches ahead, almost impossible to catch up."
"Silver Bell City has seven Golden Immortals, we can’t shake them."
"This damned Dingtian City!"
The City Lord was furious, they had been striving for the top ten for 90 years.
Now so close yet unreachable, how could they accept it?
"How about we challenge that Dingtian City?"
"Challenge Dingtian City, are you crazy? If the Essence Core gets destroyed, it’s all over!"

chapters.title: Chapter 239 Sacrificing 1 City Lord
chapters.content:
Chapter 239: Chapter 239 Sacrificing 1 City Lord
Losing to other Immortal Cities is just one defeat.
Losing to Dingtian City means complete destruction.
Others are trying to avoid it, who would dare to challenge proactively?
"Haven’t you noticed something strange? Dingtian City suddenly stopped challenging."
"I think there’s probably something wrong over there."
"Strike while the iron is hot!"
Hearing this, the City Lord of Shuangdeng City was gradually tempted.
Thinking carefully, none of the opponents defeated by Dingtian City before were Ninth-grade Golden Immortals.
And I am a Ninth-grade Golden Immortal.
Was it not luck that they didn’t challenge Shuangdeng City before, but because they intentionally avoided me?
The more he thought about it, the more it seemed so.
If you have the strength, who wouldn’t want to win a few more battles?
If Dingtian City was confident of defeating Shuangdeng City, how could there be no activity these days?
They should have challenged me long ago.
So, I’m sure to win!
"Let’s do it!"
"Beat them back to their original form!"
"Challenge! Challenge!"
On Dingtian City’s side, Brother Cheng found himself with nothing to do lately.
Ah Huang and Xiaobai’s slumber period was also uncertain.
At this moment, he felt the Jade Ruler tremble.
Then, he and the Ascension Platform were transported to the Challenge Space.
Damn, what’s going on?
I’ve actually been challenged?
He saw silhouettes from Shuangdeng City on the opposite side; similar scenes he had seen over a hundred times and was unimpressed.
The only difference was that this time he was the one being challenged, and the three flags on this side were blue.
"Jiang Cheng, your myth ends today with us from Shuangdeng City!"
Opposite, Shuangdeng City’s City Lord, full of confidence, was the first to fly onto the Dueling Platform.
Retreating was not in Brother Cheng’s dictionary.
"Thank you for your points."
"What do you mean?"
Shuangdeng City’s City Lord couldn’t comprehend and could only shake the long spear in his hand.
"Mysterious nonsense!"
"A Ninth-grade Golden Immortal, how could you shake..."
Swish!
His vision and Immortal Soul perception were filled with boundless mist, leaving no gap visible.
The Immortal Body was rapidly eroded, becoming riddled with holes, which was unbelievable to him.
How could a Ninth-grade Golden Immortal’s Immortal Body be damaged by a Celestial Immortal’s attack?
He frantically wielded his long spear, only to find himself seemingly trapped by countless chains.
Wanting to break out, his whole body felt like it was stuck in a quagmire, completely unable to extricate himself.
Within that mist, negative effects such as blazing flames, frost, thunder, and corrosion came in succession.
"No..."
This was the last sound he made.
Immediately thereafter, the more than twenty thousand people behind him found their City Lord disappeared.
Everything seemed like an illusion, happening too fast.
In just the blink of an eye, the ceiling of the Lower Immortal Realm, a Ninth-grade Golden Immortal, had fallen.
Died cleanly.
They were almost scared senseless.
"City Lord!"
"Lord City Lord..."
Unlike Zhanxiao City before, they still had feelings for their City Lord.
After all, over the past century, they had fought side by side more than two hundred times.
In so many battles, they had faced stronger Immortal Cities, and the City Lord had not always won.
But at least he survived each time.
A Ninth-grade Golden Immortal has many means to save their life; it’s not so easy to be killed.
Even if you can’t win, can’t you escape?
However, this time it was an instant kill.
"What kind of strength does he have?"
"Immortal Venerable! This must be an Immortal Venerable!"
"How could an Immortal Venerable be knocked down to the Lower Immortal Realm?"
"That’s impossible..."
Brother Cheng, after collecting the spoils, listened to the discussions from the opposite side, feeling secretly pleased inside.
Sigh, though challenged this time, under the rules of winning two out of three rounds, I was sure to lose.
But unintentionally showing off once more was worth it.
The wealth of a Ninth-grade Golden Immortal was extremely rich; from this City Lord, he obtained resources worth a full 50 billion points.
But forget about the Immortal Venerable stuff.
He had now reached a Seventh-grade Celestial Immortal, with normal combat power only just breaking through the limits of a Profound Immortal.
The instant kill was possible due to a tenfold critical strike, allowing that strike’s power to break through the Golden Immortal limits.
After that strike, he was exhausted too.
In the second round that followed, the opponent naturally won without a fight.
And in the third round, just when they thought defeat was certain, Dingtian City forfeited again.
No Essence Core appeared in battle.
This left Shuangdeng City’s people who initially thought they were bound to lose both surprised and delighted.
"What’s going on?"
"Don’t they have an Essence Core?"
"That’s impossible; without an Essence Core, the Ascension Platform would collapse."
"Then what’s happening now?"
"Yeah, wasn’t it said that Dingtian City has two Essence Cores, making this round a foregone conclusion?"
"Could this be the reason Dingtian City hasn’t been challenging lately?"
"Their Essence Core has an issue!"
Finally realizing this, Shuangdeng City’s people cheered.
No matter what, they secured this victory, right?
Though the City Lord was gone, winning was what mattered.
Looking at the enthusiastic celebrations on the opposite side, Brother Cheng helplessly pouted.
Just this level of aspiration?
Merely a victory, and that too due to the opponent’s forfeit, and you can’t remain composed?
After this round, the ranking on the Ascension Chart changed.
Shuangdeng City increased from 102 victories to 103.
While Dingtian City fell from 112 victories to 111.
Though unable to see the scene, as a front-ranking Immortal City, they naturally attracted attention.
The invincibly victorious Dingtian City actually lost!
This news quickly set the entire Lower Immortal Realm ablaze, exciting countless Immortal Cities.
The top ten Immortal Cities all sighed in relief at this moment.
Honestly, although they had claimed not to fear before, in reality, they were still very worried.
Just like the first-ranked Five Seas City, with over a dozen Golden Immortals holding the fort, and eight hundred Profound Immortals as their aides.
Dominating with overwhelming power, their previous 157 victories were achieved through relentless crushing.
If not for the second-ranked Bitao City’s 146 victories being unreachable, their record would be even higher.
But facing the bizarre Dingtian City was different.
They let the second round pass quietly and still win.
Your dozen Golden Immortals, eight hundred Profound Immortals were completely useless.
"I thought that Dingtian City was strong, but it turns out to be no more than this."
"They couldn’t even defeat Shuangdeng City; they don’t deserve to be in the top ten!"
"Indeed, we were just intimidated before."
Ninth-place Silver Bell City and seventh-place Red Moon City, currently with 107 and 117 victories respectively.
Both can challenge the 111-win Dingtian City.
"If it weren’t for the one-year protection period after a loss, we could go destroy them now!"
"One year isn’t very long."
"By then, Dingtian City will be finished."
This Ascension Battle is like this; once a weakness is exposed, it immediately attracts others’ attention.
Before, no one dared to provoke; now, it becomes bait, and everyone wants a bite.
However, after learning the details of this battle, the two City Lords suddenly fell silent.
Dingtian City’s Essence Core encountered a problem, allowing the last two rounds to be won without a fight.
Steadfastly secure!
But the issue is, what about the first round?
A Ninth-grade Golden Immortal, instantly slain.
Meaning to win, must one sacrifice a City Lord first?
Looking at their earnest subordinates below, clamoring to strike while they’re vulnerable, ready to challenge in a year, the two City Lords had expressions of constipation.

chapters.title: Chapter 240: The Strategy of Red Moon City
chapters.content:
Chapter 240: Chapter 240: The Strategy of Red Moon City
On the Dingtian City side, Brother Cheng wasn’t idle either.
Thinking that this ascension battle failed, he would surely be challenged again in the future, so he decided to undergo some serious ascetic cultivation again.
Since all the main rules had already reached Entry Level, this time he chose the Level 8 lottery.
billion points for a spin, but there is a chance to win a Level 3 Rule Fragment.
A Level 3 Rule Fragment can either elevate ten rules to Mastery Level, or elevate one rule to Great Success Level.
Rules at Mastery Level correspond to the Golden Immortal Realm.
If he doesn’t elevate all 992 main rules to this realm, he won’t be able to become a Golden Immortal in the future.
Sect Leader Jiang is indeed doing something unprecedented, with so many main rules, yet able to ascend so quickly.
Calculating the recent points gained from disciples leveling up, plus the rewards accumulated from previous battles, he now had 7500 billion points.
He drew seventy times, obtaining nine Rule Fragments.
In addition, he gained two Tier Four Immortal Artifacts, and one book each of Golden Immortal Level martial arts techniques.
Among these seventy draws, the highest value reward was a Taishu Immortal Rhyme.
Corresponding to Immortal Venerable and Immortal King Level Martial Dao Realm, it was utterly priceless.
After Brother Cheng used it, the Five Elements Martial Dao within his Daoist Heart instantly reached the Immortal King Level.
Various insights poured in, even causing flowers to rain down within the Immortal City, with extraordinary visions abound.
Everyone stepped outside, gazing at the spectacular scenery with a mesmerized look, seemingly ready to be utterly captivated.
Until Jiang Cheng’s elevation was completed, the visions disappeared.
"Ah, it really becomes harder to progress the further you get."
"Points seem plentiful, but they’re still not enough."
Many pills accumulated from battles and lottery draws over 100 times during this period.
If it were other immortals, they’d easily stack a few Golden Immortals.
But for him, it ultimately only resulted in elevating from Seventh-grade Celestial Immortal to First Grade Profound Immortal.
The following year’s time was calm in Dingtian City.
Being in a protection period, no one could challenge him.
The two children remained in a state of sleep.
As for the expert cultivators inside the Ascension Platform, they all made significant progress in power.
Key figures such as Gui Cang, Void Abyss, and Golden Dragon King among hundreds of leaders all achieved Celestial Immortal, with Bi Chang being the strongest, reaching Tier Four Celestial Immortal.
And at the Feixian Sect, Lan Ti, Ji Linghan, and Lin Ning reached Tier Three Celestial Immortal.
Throughout the year, Brother Cheng maintained the pace of elevating one person a day.
Second and Third Generation disciples were all elevated to Second-class Talent, currently all reaching Celestial Immortal.
As for the Fourth Generation disciples, they all achieved True Immortal Realm.
Among the others who ascended together, more than half became immortals.
Today’s Dingtian City is thousands of times stronger than before.
Even without Jiang Cheng, they could mostly survive in the Immortal Realm.
On this day, the year-long protection period finally ended.
Countless beings from the Lower Immortal Realm turned their gaze to the Ascension Chart at that moment, helping Brother Cheng tally days.
A year of complete stillness was enough to prove Dingtian City was indeed failing.
Their essence core truly could not bear it any longer.
As soon as time arrived, Shuangdeng City, Silver Bell City, and Red Moon City almost simultaneously pressed the challenge button.
Ultimately, the Red Moon City Lord ranked seventh, swiftly seized the lead.
Thus earning the right to challenge Dingtian City.
The other two sides felt exceedingly regretful, disappointment and dejection filled the entire city.
Meanwhile, over at Red Moon City, celebrations erupted.
As if they had already claimed victory.
Challenged once more, Brother Cheng felt immensely embarrassed.
Had he become a mere sitting duck in others’ eyes?
Seems like unless he gives these folks a profound lesson, it won’t work.
When both parties appeared in the Challenge Space, the Red Moon City crowd felt assured.
True to the rumors, each time Dingtian City only sends Jiang Cheng alone to battle.
Even if he’s strong, he can only win once in the first round, their side can win without fighting in the following two rounds.
"Jiang Cheng, do you think we won’t challenge you out of fear our City Lord might be killed?"
"To tell you the truth, your power doesn’t intimidate anyone!"
Opposite of him, the Red Moon City Lord had a smug expression.
The army ready for the second round also laughed heartily.
They had long devised their strategy.
Sect Leader Jiang felt speechless.
"I hadn’t thought that way..."
As someone who relied on cheats all the way, where did he have the free mind to guess his opponents’ psychology?
"Hmph, you’re just stalling, we’re securing this victory!"
"We have nine years ahead, playing several rounds is certain."
The Red Moon City Lord waved his hand grandly, motioning for a Saint Tier Cultivator, trembling, to step forward.
"Get moving!"
The power of the Saint Tier Cultivator was too weak, initially unfit to represent Red Moon City in battle.
He was forcibly recruited temporarily this time.
Indeed, this was the brilliant trick the Red Moon City Lord and his subordinates spent a year conceiving.
Is not Jiang Cheng killing a City Lord each first round?
Then I won’t send the City Lord the first round, just send a nobody in, consuming this round for good.
The Immortal City Ascension Battle’s first round is a duel.
Best of three, the first round’s importance is equal to the other two.
Such a crucial round, certainly send the strongest, it’s undeniably imperative.
The reason why every time this round pits City Lord vs. City Lord is merely because each Immortal City invariably has their strongest being the City Lord.
In reality, not sending the City Lord, sending someone else doesn’t breach the rules.
Furthermore, even if it’s truly restricted to City Lords, they could always change City Lords temporarily.
As for the Saint Tier Cultivator being slain by Jiang Cheng?
What concern is it of theirs, it’s not their funeral.
"City Lord, spare me, City Lord, spare me..."
Of course that Saint Tier Cultivator didn’t want to die, his legs shook like a sieve, he kneeled on the floor, begging tearfully.
"Think of your family, think of your clan!"
"For all of Red Moon City, your sacrifice is so meaningful!"
"Once you’re gone, I’ll ensure their welfare. All Red Moon City will remember you."
Between the lines, implying if he didn’t go, they would suffer greatly.
The Red Moon City Lord bore an indifferent face, sacrificing one person for grand achievements seemed greatly worthwhile to him.
Provided the sacrifice wasn’t himself.
Under his threats and the coercion of other surrounding Profound Immortal Celestial Immortal beings, the Saint Tier Cultivator eventually trembled into the arena.
As he entered, the countdown for the first round officially began.
Everyone rested assured, waiting for Jiang Cheng to eliminate this Saint Tier.
Go ahead, this is offered for your slaughter.
After all, a sacrifice must be made.
Observing their inexplicable antics, Brother Cheng lit a cigarette, conjured up a chair, crossed one leg, sat down, and clapped his hands to express his astonishment.
"Your performance is truly magnificent."
"I nearly cried with emotion."
He always felt he was rather daring in his actions.
Compared to this bunch, he was a paragon of virtuous conduct.
He had zero intention of engaging in combat.

chapters.title: Chapter 241: The Opportunity to Show Face
chapters.content:
Chapter 241: Chapter 241: The Opportunity to Show Face
"Why aren’t you fighting?"
The Red Moon City Lord was stunned.
This wasn’t the scenario he had envisioned.
If Jiang Cheng doesn’t fight this round, then he can fight in the next group battle.
With his power to instantly defeat a Ninth-Grade Golden Immortal, who knows if they can take him down then?
Even if they could defeat him, their side’s 29,999 elite troops would likely suffer more than half the casualties.
That’s not a worthwhile trade.
Brother Cheng lifted his chin with a disdainful look.
"I’m not in the mood, don’t feel like fighting."
What does that mean?
Who does that kind of thing?
Do you know how important the Ascension Battle is, and yet you’re still sulking?
"Don’t you want to beat him?"
Red Moon City Lord was a bit anxious.
"Nope. Such an opponent isn’t worthy of me personally taking action."
"How can you be like this? Do you want to lose all three matches? Winning one would be a bit more dignified, wouldn’t it?"
Red Moon City Lord was worried sick, but alas, Brother Cheng on the other side had no ambition at all.
"Can dignity be eaten?"
"You..."
Red Moon City Lord was directly choked and left speechless.
At this moment, however, a general beside him suddenly approached.
"My Lord, we don’t actually need to urge him to fight."
"Since he’s not taking the first round, let’s take the first round ahead of time."
"That way, we can sit out the second round, and he won’t have a chance to whittle down our forces."
Red Moon City Lord thought about it and figured it made sense.
Anyway, they would surely win the third round, so they might as well forfeit the second round.
So even if they win the first and third rounds, it’s still a best-of-three victories.
Thinking like this, he instantly felt at ease.
Then, almost immediately, he heard Jiang City Lord on the other side suddenly come to realization.
"Oh, you reminded me; I actually can win this one."
After saying that, Brother Cheng released his Immortal Soul and communicated, summoning the Three-Eyed Tiger who was cultivating inside the Ascension Platform.
He wasn’t short on manpower...
Since you guys sent a Saint Tier to sacrifice and exhaust, well then, I’ll gladly accept the victory in this first match.
The Three-Eyed Tiger had been cultivating in the Ascension Platform recently.
It’s not that it suddenly became diligent, but it was forced by the Golden Dragon King.
Brother Cheng was, of course, happy to see that.
Over the past year, this tiger demon with second-class talent and a Dark Gold Demon Body had become a Third Grade Celestial Immortal.
Its cultivation was almost on par with the Golden Dragon King.
"Bro, you finally remembered me. Is there something good happening again?"
Once out, the lazy tiger demon clung to Brother Cheng’s thigh.
"Nothing much, just a major task for you."
"A major task?"
The Three-Eyed Tiger took one look at the other side and shivered all over.
"Whoa, Golden Immortal, and so many Profound Immortals?"
"What’s going on? Is this an Ascension Battle?"
"You’re not planning to have me fight, right?"
"I’m not strong enough yet, still need a few more years of ascetic cultivation... no, a few million years."
Although Brother Cheng could resurrect it, the moment of dying was very painful.
It didn’t want to experience that.
It thought there might be something good coming its way, but seeing this, it would rather go back to cultivating.
"Oh come on, this is an incredibly honorable opportunity!"
Jiang City Lord grabbed its tail.
"This is the first round, a solo challenge! You representing our city to win the first victory, how cool and glorious is that?"
"Nope, nope, I like being low-key, not flashy..."
The Three-Eyed Tiger struggled repeatedly, but then it saw the Saint Tier Cultivator in the field.
"Oh? Oh? That’s... is that my opponent this round?"
It quietly came to a stop.
"That’s right."
"Just him?"
"Mm-hmm, what else?"
"You should’ve said so earlier, bro!"
The Three-Eyed Tiger grinned and gave Brother Cheng’s thigh a slap of complaint.
Then, it instantly became filled with battle intent.
"For Dingtian City, for everyone, for glory..."
"Even if a thousand enemies stand before me, what harm is climbing mountains of blades or descending into seas of fire?"
It stood up and hammered its chest forcefully.
Solemnly declared, "This battle, I, the Three-Eyed Fierce Tiger King, will take on and not tarnish the reputation of the Tiger Race!"
"If I unhappily fall in battle, please take care of my..."
Brother Cheng saw that the countdown was only seconds from ending, and this guy was still gloating, so he kicked it out in a huff.
"Get out of here!"
The Three-Eyed Tiger traced a beautiful parabola as it flew into the field, kicking off the first match.
It wasn’t angry at all; instead, it looked back and gave Brother Cheng a thumbs up.
"Bro, you’re so thoughtful, thinking of me first for such a high-profile opportunity. Good brother!"
Then, it turned to face its opponent.
"Heh heh, kid, how would you like to die?"
Facing the unfamiliar Saint Tier Cultivator on the other side, the Three-Eyed Tiger swiftly expanded its size to over ten million meters, baring its fangs and claws with overwhelming ferocity.
Brother Cheng in the back cursed silently.
Darn, does a Celestial Immortal need such a big display to fight a Saint Tier?
The Saint Tier Cultivator was so scared he scrambled away.
"I-I don’t want to die..."
If it were Jiang Cheng, he might not be so afraid.
But the sheer size of the Three-Eyed Tiger gave a different kind of terror.
"That’s not gonna work, this is a sacred Ascension Battle!"
"Also a grand moment for my grand entrance of awesomeness..."
"I promise, I’ll give you a quick death."
A guaranteed no-loss battle, the Three-Eyed Tiger loved those the most.
It wished for more rounds like this.
So many Ascension Battles had been fought solely by Brother Cheng; no one else had the chance to step in.
Only this time, it represented everyone else.
Just think about how long it could boast afterward.
"Ga ga ga... Come on, let’s have a dragon-tiger battle!"
With that, it summoned its inner Demon Pill, and Immortal Yuan Power surged like rolling black clouds.
Immediately, it realized the Saint Tier Cultivator was gone.
Looking carefully, nearly made it faint with rage.
The guy was so scared he sneaked back to his own Ascension Platform.
"Damn, what are you doing?"
"A rare chance for me to fight, and you’re running?"
The Three-Eyed Tiger was infuriated.
It felt like being ready for battle, the moment of flaunting was approaching its peak, but the opponent withdrew, leaving it empty.
If this got out, the awe factor would immediately drop by 80%.
In future tales, it wouldn’t be the Three-Eyed Fierce Tiger King gloriously slaying enemy generals.
Rather it would be a victory without a fight, or even rumored as a bye.
Unfortunately, no matter how unsatisfied it was, it was useless.
After the Saint Tier Cultivator fled, the challenge declared Dingtian City victorious.
It was even transmitted back to its own Ascension Platform.
"Well done."
Brother Cheng patted its head, satisfied with claiming the win as the top priority.
As for the tiger demon’s unmet flaunting needs, what did that have to do with him?
"Ah, this is so frustrating..."
The Three-Eyed Tiger was quite annoyed.
Brother Cheng gloated, "Maybe you shouldn’t have talked so much, just going in and fighting would be better."
"I just wanted the scene to have more of a ceremony vibe..."
As they were bantering, the other side was frustrated to the point of spitting blood.
After all, now they must go all out for the second round.
And in the second round, Jiang Cheng could fight.
And there, as the countdown dwindled to the final few seconds, the guy turned on his critical strike.

chapters.title: Chapter 242 Scared Stiff
chapters.content:
Chapter 242: Chapter 242 Scared Stiff
Jiang Cheng is now a First Grade Profound Immortal.
With the 992 Main Rule Daoist Hearts, plus one Immortal King Level Five Elements Martial Dao, his normal attack power has already surpassed the Golden Immortal range.
And with the Azure Dragon Essence Blood, dozens of Heroic Soul Buffs, and Immortal Slayer Spear added...
"Jiang Cheng, have you thought this through? Even if you can kill some of us, you yourself definitely won’t survive this battle!"
The Red Moon City Lord opposite was still spouting nonsense.
This round, they had a definite advantage in numbers.
They weren’t worried about not winning, the key was how to win.
The difference between losing one person and losing ten thousand.
The former is painless, while the latter would cause Red Moon City to instantly collapse, and not recover for many years afterwards.
"Anyway, you’re bound to lose this time, why risk your life?"
"I advise you to retreat, at least then you’ll survive."
They hoped to win without fighting.
That way, no cost would be incurred.
