But unfortunately, Brother Cheng was resolute.
It was his first time being pointed at and told someone wanted to ’play’ with him more.
He couldn’t let this stand.
So, he swung his sword.
Accompanying this swing, the entire challenge space began to shake violently.
The original scene vanished instantly, deafening explosion sounds filled the air.
The space distorted repeatedly, in the void, a giant sword swept across everything.
Whether mountains, rivers, or living beings.
Under this strike, everything turned to dust in an instant!
No resistance, and certainly no counterattack, because there simply wasn’t time.
Boom!
Countless Immortal Cities in the Lower Immortal Realm even saw the Ascension Chart shaking constantly.
"What’s going on?"
"What happened?"
"Did something go wrong with the Ascension Battle?"
"Now, Red Moon City should be challenging Dingtian City, right?"
Perhaps because this strike exceeded the limits set by the Lower Immortal Realm, the challenge space shook for quite a long time before slowly calming down.
Brother Cheng didn’t have such thoughts, he quickly collected the scattered spoils.
Due to the overwhelming attack power this time, many items were destroyed on the spot.
Fortunately, what remained was plenty, much more worthwhile than several dozen prior solo duels.
"See, this is the correct battle posture."
"Why all the pointless chatter?"
Behind him, the Three-Eyed Tiger was petrified.
That was 29,999 experts, not 29,999 pigs.
Among them, no less than seven Golden Immortals, hundreds of Profound Immortals, the rest were all Celestial Immortals.
Defeated in one strike?
This is ridiculously exaggerated!
"Brother, how strong are you really? Could you have actually been an Immortal once?"
Having witnessed Brother Cheng during his Soul Splitting Realm before, its belief wavered now.
"What else?"
"I’ve told you countless times, yet you don’t believe."
Brother Cheng casually responded, then waved at the last remaining Saint Tier Cultivator opposite.
He was the only survivor on that side.
"Little brother, it’s really unfortunate that we can’t play more times with your Red Moon City."
The Saint Tier Cultivator looked dazed.
The changes happened too quickly for him to process, leaving him in a state of shock.
After winning the first two rounds, they didn’t even need to fight the third round, Dingtian City was declared the winner.
By now, countless Immortal Cities in the Lower Immortal Realm were eagerly awaiting the challenge’s conclusion.
Despite knowing the outcome was predetermined, they all wanted to witness that moment.
"Red Moon City took a big advantage this time."
"Wonder if they sacrificed their City Lord or not."
"Surely not, we thought of finding replacements, they’d surely think of it too."
"Alas, have to wait another year."
The top-tier of Silver Bell City and Shuangdeng City were still regretting.
"It’s over!"
"Finished so quickly?"
Countless cultivators staring at the Ascension Chart finally saw movement on the list.
"Dingtian City... 112 wins."
"Red Moon City... 116 wins."
First there was a stunned silence, then a collective uproar.
This result was the complete opposite of what they initially anticipated.
"How can this be?"
"Did Dingtian City win?"
"How could Dingtian City win? Weren’t they seen through and reduced to mere chickens?"
"Impossible..."
"What’s impossible, what if Dingtian City’s Essence Core was restored?"
"In hindsight, wasn’t Red Moon City essentially courting death?"
"Huh, that’s not right either!"
A blind group member suddenly spotted the crux.
"Look at the list, Red Moon City didn’t fall to the bottom, meaning their Ascension Platform is intact!"
If the Essence Core was devoured and the Ascension Platform destroyed, all victories would be reset to zero.
Now, Red Moon City just dropped from 117 wins to 116, indicating their Essence Core wasn’t devoured.
"What exactly happened?"
Countless people expressed curiosity.
With so many inquiries, the result of that battle soon spread.
After all, there was still a survivor remaining.
From the City Lord down, Red Moon City faced total annihilation!
And Jiang Cheng on the opposite side only used one move.
The Ascension Battles have been held numerous times, uncountable matches staged.
Heavy casualties are common, but total annihilation seems to be unprecedented.
This is simply too shocking.
When the news spread, countless cultivators across the Lower Immortal Realm were overwhelmingly jolted!
Especially Shuangdeng City and Silver Bell City, the two cities narrowly escaped such devastation, sweating profusely.
Just a bit more, just a tiny bit, and total annihilation would have befell them.
Nothing shakes them more than thinking of that.
After this battle, no one dared challenge Dingtian City again.
Such huge losses, who could bear them?
And in Dingtian City, the atmosphere was one of celebration.
Everyone initially thought the City Lord had weakened, after all, a year ago a slip occurred.
Throughout this year, many city dwellers worried they wouldn’t stay in the top ten ranks.
Now they’ve beaten the seventh, everyone felt reassured as if having taken a calming pill.
"City Lord Jiang is too reliable."
"Absolutely, single-handedly turned the Ascension Battle into a solo performance. Is anyone else capable of this?"
"Haha, having such a strong City Lord is truly fortuitous."
"Indeed, in nine more years we could reap benefits from Ascending to the Middle Immortal Realm!"
"Ascension doesn’t even matter. Now our Immortal City is unparalleled, crushing all Immortal Cities in the Middle Immortal Realm."
"Hahaha, that’s true!"
Sect Leader Jiang is also elated, as this haul was substantial.
After meticulous counting, he exchanged the points, accumulating over 8 trillion.
After drawing 80 Level 8 prizes, his Main Rules had over 220 reached Mastery Level.
Now, his Daoist Heart can crush any Golden Immortal even without activating tenfold critical strikes.
He could even challenge an Immortal Venerable.
Another Taishu Immortal Rhyme elevated his Four Extremes Martial Dao to the Immortal King Level.
However, the Immortal Yuan Power needed to elevate his Realm is exorbitant, despite so many draws and pills, he only advanced from a First Grade to a Third Grade Profound Immortal.
With his combat power rising repeatedly, Brother Cheng felt somewhat lost.
He realized he hadn’t died in a long time.
He found this a bit disconcerting.
And with his current power, there’s seemingly no existence in the Lower Immortal Realm capable of killing him.

chapters.title: Chapter 243: You Came Out Too Late
chapters.content:
Chapter 243: Chapter 243: You Came Out Too Late
The battle with Red Moon City shocked the entire Lower Immortal Realm.
No one dared to challenge Dingtian City anymore.
Jiang Cheng also didn’t go to challenge others, not because he didn’t want to, but because he didn’t want to drop in rankings.
Winning against Red Moon City was purely an unexpected gain.
At that time, he was already prepared to lose, but he didn’t expect the opponent to only send a Saint Tier cultivator.
If the opponent dispatched a Golden Immortal in the first round, the result would have been different.
At that time, if he didn’t fight, none of his subordinates could win.
If he did, what about the second round?
The two kids were always asleep, and he even had no solution for the third round.
He could only be grateful, fortunately, they reached eighth place.
If they had stopped at 11th place, it would have been truly frustrating.
In the following years, Red Moon City, completely defeated, was challenged several times by a few big cities at the front, further lowering its victories.
In the end, it unexpectedly benefited Dingtian City, automatically boosting them to seventh place.
By the tenth year of Jiang Cheng and others ascending to the Immortal Realm, the wars between various Immortal Cities had also reached a peak.
Many Immortal Cities had been conserving their strength and biding their time, deliberately laying low for years.
Now, the last year was an opportunity for many Immortal Cities to make their final attempt.
Especially around the tenth place, the competition was said to be fierce.
Almost every few days, there would be a change.
For these Immortal Cities, the Ascension Battle was a very complex affair.
Before the battle, intelligence was needed, along with various strategic arrangements, not just a simple fight.
But all of this had nothing to do with Sect Leader Jiang.
Over the years, he had elevated all fourth-generation disciples to third-class talent, and those four with the protagonist scripts further up to second-class talent.
The second and third-generation disciples were similarly all elevated to second-class.
After all, raising them once cost him a sky-high price of one or two billion points before, which now didn’t mean much to him.
A ten-shot draw was over a hundred billion, entirely manageable.
The disciples also lived up to expectations, as everyone ascended to Celestial Immortal within these ten years.
Even among the second and third-generation disciples, many reached the Profound Immortal Realm.
Ji Linghan, Lin Ning, and Lan Ti even reached seventh-grade Profound Immortal and eighth-grade Profound Immortal respectively.
The upgrades of his disciples brought Brother Cheng about five to six trillion points over these years.
So many points also allowed him to push all the main rules to mastery level, with even ten main rules reaching great success level.
And all nine Martial Dao realms achieved Immortal King Level due to the Taishu Immortal Rhyme.
His cultivation eventually stepped into First Grade Golden Immortal.
Every disciple was deeply thankful for his nurturing, feeling entirely brought up by the Sect Leader.
This even made Brother Cheng a bit embarrassed.
In fact, the reason he could upgrade so quickly was essentially completed by a thousand disciples working together.
Without them, where would he get so many points for draws?
Thinking about trillions of points was enough to give someone a headache.
To make it up to them, he finally bit the bullet and made a ’big splurge’ this time.
He spent over a hundred billion points to elevate Ji Linghan, Lan Ti, Lin Ning, and those four main characters to first-class talent.
During those days, even heaven and earth descended with unusual phenomena once again...
This made the Three-Eyed Tiger incredibly envious.
"Brother, did you forget the most important one?"
"We’ve been with you for so many years, we’ve put in both effort and determination..."
Unable to shake it off, Sect Leader Jiang could only give it a buff, also elevating it to first-class talent.
Once the Three-Eyed Tiger opened this gap, Luo Yuan, Yin Xuer, Shan Tai, and others all looked over eagerly.
Second-generation disciples had been with him the longest, and besides, elevating them was also beneficial to himself.
Brother Cheng finally used up the remaining points to elevate all of the 21 remaining second-generation disciples to first-class talent.
Everyone achieved a uniform top-tier Purple Gold Demon Body.
He didn’t realize how his actions today would have such a profound impact on the future landscape of the Immortal Realm.
The day of ascension drew nearer, and after reaching Profound Immortal, the upgrade speed was not as fast, so everyone else emerged from seclusion one after another.
"Sect Leader Jiang, thanks to your protection over the years!"
Old Sword Immortal Gui Cang had already reached eighth-grade Profound Immortal.
If anyone had told him before that after ascending, he could reach this realm within ten years, he would have given them a slap, saying they were dreaming.
But now, all this, with the help of the 55-fold Power of Rules on the Ascension Platform and a vast amount of Immortal Yuan Qi, seemed natural.
"Indeed!"
Void Abyss also sighed: "Without the conditions created by our benefactor, we would still be struggling at the bottom of the Immortal Realm, or might have even fallen prematurely."
"That’s right, we owe Sect Leader Jiang countless favors!"
"This kindness and sentiment may take a lifetime to repay!"
Brother Cheng thought to himself, forget it, I don’t need you to repay me.
The opportunities to show off, I’d rather enjoy them alone.
While everyone was talking, a long laugh suddenly came from the rear hall.
"Hahahaha, I have finally emerged from seclusion!"
Then, the long-missed Mo Chen flew out.
His body was still at the level of the Colorful Deer Demon King, but the immortal soul aura had reached an unprecedented height.
Jiang Cheng, with just a slight sense, realized that his immortal soul had recovered to the peak of the Golden Immortal.
Stronger than those Golden Immortals he had slain.
It seemed this old man hadn’t lied before; he was once a Demon Venerable, a level above even Golden Immortals.
Gui Cang, Void Abyss, Golden Dragon King, and others were greatly surprised.
They had already noticed Mo Chen back in the Fake Immortal Realm.
After all, he was Sect Leader Jiang’s first trusted aide, an important confidant.
But before, they hadn’t seen him in action.
As for his realm, it was the same Saint Tier as theirs.
Especially after ascending to the Immortal Realm, while others broke through to True Immortal, he remained at Saint Tier, showing no progress.
Who would have thought that now he would stand above everyone else?
Although his body remained at Saint Tier, just with that immortal soul, his combat power could crush most Golden Immortals.
"Thank you, Sect Leader, now this old man can travel freely through the Lower Immortal Realm!"
"Does the Sect Leader want to challenge other Immortal Cities? This old man would like to be the vanguard!"
This old man, having recovered for ten years, had greatly increased in strength and was now brimming with confidence.
In front of everyone, he pounded his chest and boasted: "As long as the opponent isn’t a Golden Immortal, even if they send thirty thousand, I can destroy them!"
"With this old man as support, Dingtian City can definitely break into the top thousand!"
These words left everyone looking at each other in dismay.
Brother, your news is way too outdated!
Sect Leader Jiang’s slain Golden Immortals could already form a team of a hundred, and the ranking had entered the top ten.
Boldly claiming to break into the top thousand, such words had no impact.
After a brief moment of stunned silence, the Three-Eyed Tiger burst into laughter.
"Hahahaha, were you still thinking you’d shock everyone by achieving great success in divine skill upon emerging from seclusion?"
"Look at everyone’s strength now, and see how things stand in Dingtian City now."
"Is there any need for you to carry the flag of showing off?"
Mo Chen was left dumbfounded by these words.
Carefully sensing everyone’s realm and the rule aura here, he was even more doubtful about life.

chapters.title: Chapter 244: From Rifles to Cannons
chapters.content:
Chapter 244: Chapter 244: From Rifles to Cannons
After learning what happened in the past ten years, Mo Chen was greatly shocked.
"This, the Sect Leader is actually so brave?"
"An unbroken streak of 110 victories..."
"This Power of Rules is more concentrated than anywhere else in the Immortal Realm before!"
He had another thought in his heart that he didn’t voice.
Truly worthy of being the Child of the Plane.
No, no, no, even the previous Child of the Plane didn’t have such fortune!
Seeing his incredulous expression, the Three-Eyed Tiger was elated.
It jumped in front of Mo Chen, proudly wagging its tail.
"To be honest, during the last challenge against the seventh rank, this Master Tiger made the first move."
"That battle was so fierce that the sky turned dark, and the sun and moon lost their light. The enemy’s main general lost his armor and fled in front of Master Tiger..."
Mo Chen glanced at its current realm, indeed a bit surprising—it was already a Fifth-grade Profound Immortal.
But is that all there is to it?
Can it really take on the City Lord at Golden Immortal Level?
There must be more to the story.
Immortal Mo had immense respect for Jiang Cheng, but not for the Three-Eyed Tiger.
He secretly pursed his lips and was too lazy to echo its words.
"What’s the Sect Leader’s plan next?"
It’s the final year now, and the seventh rank is secured.
No matter how other Immortal Cities struggle, it’s unlikely that Dingtian City will be pushed out of the top ten.
To others, now is the time to do nothing, just wait for the settlement day in a month and ascend to the Middle Immortal Realm.
But Immortal Mo knows well the King Bi style of Sect Leader Jiang—how could seventh rank possibly satisfy him?
As the Child of the Plane, not taking first place is likely a disgrace to him.
His guess was completely on point.
Even if Brother Cheng was willing to accept a rank other than first, his style wouldn’t allow it.
Although he hadn’t challenged anyone in nine years, his restless heart never settled.
The reason for waiting nine years was only to wait for everyone’s power to greatly improve, helping him in the second round.
"How many Ninth-grade Golden Immortals can you defeat?"
"Um..."
Mo Chen was embarrassed once again.
"With full effort, a Sixth-grade Golden Immortal could be fought."
He was indeed helpless, although he was strong before, he now had no Immortal Body.
Being able to fight against a Sixth-grade Golden Immortal in this situation was already very remarkable.
Defeat several?
The task given by the Sect Leader was way beyond expectations.
Indeed, Brother Cheng seemed a bit disappointed.
He then asked Gui Cang Sword Immortal, Bi Chang in Void Abyss, Golden Dragon King, and others.
"What about you guys? Can you defeat Golden Immortals?"
Bi Chang immediately assured with chest puffed out: "No problem, the six Profound Immortals of our Desolate Domain can all fight against Golden Immortals!"
Golden Dragon King also pledged upfront: "Our Celestial Demon Domain, currently with three Profound Immortals, can also fight against Golden Immortals, but only those below Fourth and Fifth Grades."
"Good, certainly all are geniuses, still so flashy in the Immortal Realm!"
Sect Leader Jiang was overjoyed.
Bi Chang and the Desert People grinned broadly: "Hahaha, of course! Whenever the brothers need us, just speak up!"
Over on the Celestial Demon Domain side, another War Monkey King who reached the Profound Immortal level also roared.
"If it wasn’t for Brother Golden Dragon always holding back, I would have already wanted to beat those immortals and bring them down."
But others weren’t as confident.
Gui Cang Sword Immortal honestly said: "Our Sword Domain may not be able to confront Golden Immortals."
Void Abyss from the Demon Realm felt a bit ashamed: "With full effort, risking life and death, we can probably only defeat Ninth-grade Profound Immortals."
"Ah?"
Weren’t these all the top elites from the Lower Realm?
Gui Cang and Void Abyss are both Seventh-grade Profound Immortals, yet they can’t even challenge First Grade Golden Immortals?
Defeating a Ninth-grade Profound Immortal would require full effort and risking life and death—and they’re still uncertain?
Does that mean there’s no absolute certainty?
"Didn’t you guys say you can challenge higher ranks? Why can Desolate Domain and Celestial Demon Domain, but not you?"
Upon hearing Sect Leader Jiang’s logical question, Desolate Domain and Celestial Demon Domain were indeed proud, while others were helpless.
Boss, each Great Domain has different circumstances.
Also, there’s a limit to challenging higher ranks.
Taichang Profound Immortal sighed: "Sect Leader Jiang might not know, we are different from the Celestial Demon Domain and Desolate Domain."
"They don’t heavily rely on weapons and magical treasures. But for us human race cultivators to exert full power, weapons account for a large part..."
"Immortal Realm’s Golden Immortals will definitely have Immortal Artifacts above Third Grade, their magical treasures are far superior to ours."
"Not to mention they also have Immortal Talismans, Immortal Arrays, and Exotic Treasures..."
"All these years we’ve been focusing on Daoist Heart cultivation, Immortal Tier Martial Techniques, only practicing what we captured last time and without intense research."
"To win by challenging a Great Realm level higher is almost impossible."
Upon hearing their words, Jiang Cheng finally understood.
He himself had set up a bunch of buffs, and could directly get Immortal Artifacts from the system lottery, extracting Martial Techniques to full level, so he never had these worries.
But this group of people was different.
Though they ascended to Profound Immortal, they hadn’t fought in the Immortal Realm, and the time was too short, they hadn’t had a chance to trade up yet.
Under such circumstances, being able to defeat other Profound Immortals of the same level was already quite extraordinary.
The domains that can challenge a higher Great Realm are only Desolate, Celestial Demon, Ten Thousand Bones, and Hundred Refinement Domains with non-human experts.
They are either naturally strong in physical form or simply are weapons and magical treasures themselves.
This group of non-humans occupied one-third of the entire crowd, but most are still Celestial and True Immortal levels, with only nine reaching the Profound Immortal level from Desolate and Celestial Demon Domains.
Challenging the top ten Immortal Cities, obviously, isn’t enough.
After pondering a bit, he finally decided to bring out the Immortal Artifacts from his lottery winnings for them to use.
No other choice, obtaining first place to boost style is more important than anything.
Besides, the weapons obtained from the system lottery can’t be exchanged for points, keeping them is pointless.
Thinking of this, he clicked extract.
In the next moment, over a hundred Immortal Artifacts floated before Gui Cang Sword Immortal and others.
There were swords, knives, spears, and Immortal Armor, ranging from First to Third Grade.
For the sake of Rule Fragments, Brother Cheng drew in the level six, seven, eight lottery interfaces, over a thousand times each.
Thus the Immortal Artifacts here are quite evenly spread, with over thirty pieces in each grade.
Actually, these are not his entire collection.
With so many challenges, he captured quite a few treasures too.
There are also dozens of Tier Four Immortal Artifacts and top-grade magical treasures, which he plans to keep for his own sect disciples.
"You, who have reached Profound Immortal, take your pick, choose what suits you."
Upon hearing this, Gui Cang, Void Abyss, and others had their eyes glazed.
"These, these are all for us?" They couldn’t believe what they were hearing.
Brother Cheng intentionally waved his sleeve with an indifferent expression.
"Yes, take them freely, anyway, it’s all for increasing our collective power."
With his statement, the entire scene became hectic.
"Oh my heavens, Sect Leader Jiang is too generous, isn’t he?"
"These are Immortal Artifacts!"
"And not just Tier One Immortal Artifacts!"
"Sect Leader Jiang has already helped us immensely, and now he’s giving Immortal Artifacts, how can we not feel embarrassed..."
Even as they said this, their hands were indeed quick and honest.
Within seconds, over a hundred Immortal Artifacts were all claimed.
After all, in the Lower Realm, the most they utilized were Sacred Artifacts, never having touched Immortal Artifacts.
Used to hard days, those Celestial and True Immortals were envious to the point of drooling.

chapters.title: Chapter 245: Remolding the Immortal Body
chapters.content:
Chapter 245: Chapter 245: Remolding the Immortal Body
If Brother Cheng is trying to win people’s hearts, then you could say he’s made a very profitable deal.
Using a batch of Immortal Artifacts he considers not worth much in exchange for the hearts of future leaders.
This kind of business, even the Immortal Emperors and Demon Emperors in the Upper Immortal Realm don’t have a chance to do.
After all, no one can encounter all the top elites of the Lower Realm Ten Thousand Realms at the same time.
Especially during their most difficult and needy times.
At this period, even a little favor can make them eternally grateful.
Yet, when they become leaders in the future, trying to move them and win their hearts will be near impossible.
Unfortunately, Sect Leader Jiang doesn’t care much about this.
He even occasionally guards against these people, fearing they might steal his thunder.
Watching Gui Cang, Ling Xing, Void Abyss, Taichang, and others, unable to contain their smiles after receiving new Immortal Artifacts, he secretly twitched his mouth.
Look at your lack of ambition.
What happened to your lofty image?
"Ahem, I have a single request."
"What request?"
"Sect Leader Jiang, feel free to say!"
"Next time we win a battle, the spoils of war..."
He rubbed his fingers, thinking he could earn back the Immortal Artifacts he gifted away.
What he gave were items drawn from the system, not worth much.
The spoils are snatched back and can be exchanged for points.
Pretty profitable if calculated...
Before he finished speaking, Void Abyss very perceptively announced loudly.
"Those must belong to Sect Leader Jiang!"
Gui Cang, Taichang, and other leaders also immediately agreed.
"Indeed, without Sect Leader Jiang, how would we have today?"
"Sect Leader Jiang gifting us Immortal Artifacts and Immortal Armor is like giving us the capital to survive, which we must repay!"
Not just them, even the leaders of the Desolate Domain, Celestial Demon Domain, and Ten Thousand Bones Domain, who didn’t need equipment, all expressed that as long as Sect Leader Jiang was happy, he could have anything he desired.
Originally, this group wouldn’t be so noble.
Keep in mind, some of them used to make a living from killing and seizing treasures.
Who doesn’t want resources?
They truly owe Brother Cheng too many favors.
Moreover, Gui Cang Sword Immortal wasn’t wrong.
Without the capital given by Jiang Cheng, what would they use to defeat their enemies?
"Alright, you all go and refine them first."
"There’s one month until the settlement day, and everyone will set out together in half a month!"
Half a month is not enough to fully refine the Immortal Artifacts.
But it’s enough to unleash a large portion of their power.
With Tier Two and Tier Three Immortal Artifacts, this group of Profound Immortals is brimming with confidence.
Though their Daoist Hearts are not as heaven-defying as Brother Cheng’s 992 main rules, they are not something ordinary talents of Golden Immortal can match.
"Sect Leader Jiang, rest assured, in half a month, we will surely have the confidence to confront Golden Immortals."
"Whatever domain Brother wishes to challenge, we have no objections!"
"Following our benefactor’s lead, wherever you want to fight, we’ll fight!"
After everyone left, Brother Cheng distributed another batch of Immortal Artifacts to the members of the Feixian Sect.
The closest members, Lan Ti, Ji Linghan, and Lin Ning, all received Tier Four Immortal Artifacts and Magical Treasures.
Brother Cheng was still not at ease and handed the Bone Refining Banner to Lan Ti.
As for the remaining Fourth Generation Disciples, since there weren’t enough Immortal Artifacts, they could only receive some Sacred Artifacts and Immortal Talismans.
The disciples, having received their war supplies, were instantly full of fighting spirit.
As a Second Generation Elder, Luo Yuan now held considerable authority as well.
"This is a rare collective appearance for our Feixian Sect, don’t lose face in front of other domains!"
"Perform well so Sect Leader shines!"
Brother Cheng found this rather exasperating.
I give you all these things hoping you don’t die too much and waste my resurrection skill.
Now that you’re all Immortals, reviving you isn’t something that can be done with just a few hundred points.
After the disciples went to refine their Immortal Artifacts and Sacred Artifacts, he ’summoned’ Immortal Mo alone.
"Old Mo, is your body fixed now?"
He’s never improved Mo Chen’s talent, not because he had anything against him.
This old Immortal is his strongest sidekick to show off after all.
It’s just because this Sacred Body was taken over, not his own, so he cannot advance Realm.
Upgrading the talent would be useless.
Upon hearing the mention, Mo Chen gave a bitter smile.
"Thank you, Sect Leader, for your concern. I will find a way to remold my Immortal Body in the future, then I can continue advancing."
Currently, his Immortal Soul has been repaired.
Remolding the Immortal Body isn’t impossible, but it requires a long time.
Sect Leader Jiang didn’t quite understand and asked curiously, "How do you remold it?"
"Remolding the Immortal Body requires many marvels, but it needn’t be urgent."
"What treasures? Let me see if I have any."
Having drawn many times and defeated many enemies, Sect Leader Jiang indeed had a pile of marvels in his hand, most of which have yet to be used.
Upon hearing this, Mo Chen cursed himself as foolish.
Indeed, the opportunities of the Child of the Plane are extremely heaven-defying; maybe he could help get some materials.
Quickly, with hope on his face, he said, "The item needed most is Purple Jade Sunset Burnt Sand, this treasure has a very high affinity with the Immortal Soul, incredibly magical, and fundamental for the Immortal Body..."
Before he finished, Brother Cheng interrupted.
"How much is needed?"
This...
Mo Chen was a bit embarrassed.
Purple Jade Sunset Burnt Sand is a valuable treasure even in the Immortal Realm; even a couple of ounces could incite many Immortals to fight for it.
And to remold the Immortal Body, a fair amount is actually needed.
"If three to five pounds could be had, it would roughly form the structure of the Immortal Body, then through long cultivation and supplementation..."
The five pounds figure was something he dared not hope for.
But even if he got just a couple of ounces, it would be good.
With a starting point, he could slowly craft it over a few billion years using time.
Brother Cheng raised his eyebrows: "So, the more the better?"
"Indeed..."
"Would 100 pounds be enough?"
"100 pounds, ah... ah?"
pounds?
Mo Chen doubted if he heard it right.
Brother, that’s Purple Jade Sunset Burnt Sand, not common dirt found everywhere!
Sect Leader Jiang didn’t dilly-dally and waved to withdraw 100 pounds of Purple Jade Sunset Burnt Sand from the system warehouse.
This stuff was obtained in a Level 6 draw, once giving 10 pounds; at the time, he didn’t know what it was for.
He still had a few hundred pounds of it.
"If it’s not enough, just say the word, I have more."
Staring at the pile of Treasure Sand floating in front of him, Mo Chen was completely stunned.
Is this a dream?
He actually took out 100 pounds?
Such an act, not even an Immortal King could manage it?
Collecting this much, perhaps only an Immortal Emperor could do it.
But the problem is that Sect Leader just ascended to the Immortal Realm not long ago and hasn’t gone out exploring—where did he get such treasures?
"It’s enough, more than enough! Thank you, Sect Leader..."
He was so moved that he teared up; 100 pounds of Purple Jade Sunset Burnt Sand could save him billions of years of work!
"What other materials are needed, just say."
Brother Cheng was very generous to his people. Besides, this could be considered war preparation, right?

chapters.title: Chapter 246: Competing to Be the First to Fight
chapters.content:
Chapter 246: Chapter 246: Competing to Be the First to Fight
Grateful and tearful, Mo Chen took a moment to calm himself and stopped being polite.
He then mentioned dozens of materials, each of which Brother Cheng had.
Some were obtained through random draws, while others were just part of the spoils of battle.
And every single one was more than sufficient.
In just a short while, Mo Chen was shocked to find that he could immediately reshape his Immortal Body.
This left him both surprised and delighted, though the shock far outweighed the joy.
He couldn’t fathom how so many precious materials were gathered together.
Even if the Child of the Plane had extremely strong luck and could find treasures just by stepping out, it would still require some training to obtain them, wouldn’t it?
"Are all the materials gathered?"
"Yes, yes! They really are all gathered!"
Mo Chen was profoundly moved.
To reshape the Immortal Body, he had originally planned to spend a billion years slowly enduring it.
Although he had thought of getting help from Jiang Cheng, he had only hoped for a few materials at most.
He never would have dreamed that everything would be gathered at once.
Additionally, because the quantity of materials was extremely abundant, this time the starting point of his reshaped Immortal Body wouldn’t be low.
This Child of the Plane, it’s truly worth following him.
In just three days, Mo Chen reappeared in front of Brother Cheng.
His apparent cultivation had completely transformed, becoming a Ninth-grade True Immortal.
The system unsurprisingly dinged again, notifying Brother Cheng that he received 80 billion points.
Because his value in the eyes of the system had increased yet again.
"Thank you, Sect Leader, for the grace of rebirth; the old me cannot repay you even with my utmost gratitude..."
Upon meeting again, this former Demon Venerable directly knelt down.
Jiang Cheng hurriedly lifted him up, "We are all one family, there’s no need for such formality."
"Has your talent been enhanced now?"
Even though Mo Chen didn’t want to burden Brother Cheng further, he couldn’t utter a single polite refusal.
As a cultivator, who wouldn’t want better talent?
He had been enviously watching those disciples of the Feixian Sect transform themselves one after another.
Back then, he had no way to improve.
But now, it was finally his turn.
"Much obliged to the Sect Leader!"
Three days later, Mo Chen, who originally had Fourth-class Talent, was directly raised to First-class.
His Demon Body also reached the Purple Gold Level.
Having mingled in the Immortal Realm for many years, he knew more than anyone what this talent signified.
As long as he continued to live, there was a great chance he could achieve Immortal Emperor status in the future!
This talent was just that terrifying.
The half-month period quickly arrived, and experts from various Great Realms gathered once more.
Jiang Cheng waved his hand and sent out all the disciples of the Feixian Sect.
"I’ll leave these disciples of mine to you to command this time."
He hoped that in the last few Ascension Battles, his disciples could seize the opportunity to gain combat experience from the Immortal Realm.
"In the second round, only 29,999 people can participate; you can arrange the rest yourselves."
In fact, various Great Realms already had a rough list of candidates.
More than 50 Profound Immortal level experts were undoubtedly all on board, led by Mo Chen.
After Immortal Mo’s talent was raised to First-class, he also broke through to a Celestial Immortal in these few days.
Don’t look at his realm not matching that of Profound Immortals; the foundation of the former Demon Venerable is there.
Among these more than 50 people, he is currently the only one who can contend with a Ninth-grade Golden Immortal alone.
There are also 12,000 Celestial Immortals who will all enter the battle.
After all, such Ascension Battles are about sending in the strongest, not a conventional war where ambushes or fort defenses come into play.
The remaining candidates are entirely True Immortals.
Nowadays, the superficial realm of Dingtian City isn’t high, but its overall strength is quite formidable.
Even if Brother Cheng isn’t around, it’s likely still in the top ten.
The choices for Profound Immortal and Celestial Immortal candidates are easy, but not so for True Immortals.
Of today’s 120,000 experts, only the last few thousand haven’t become Immortals yet.
With limited slots and a pressing desire to secure a place on the battlefield, the Great Realms have even started to quarrel.
Besides wanting to show themselves off, there was also Jiang Cheng’s promise driving them.
The spoils obtained in this battle, the Storage Rings belong to the ’investor’ Sect Leader Jiang, but the Immortal Artifacts belong to them.
How could they not all scramble for a chance?
Ninety-nine percent of them still don’t have an Immortal Artifact!
The heavy task of selecting True Immortal positions fell on the few War Saints of the Hundred Battle Domain.
This put them in a difficult position.
"Our Desolate Domain is definitely going all out; no one should think about taking our slots!"
"If you don’t believe in the combat power of our Demon Realm, we can have a test run."
"Winning the first battle is important; we sword cultivators love a challenge!"
"Our few True Immortals from the Ten Thousand Bones Domain, in terms of skeleton hardness, can match Profound Immortals. If you don’t pick us, then you have no eyes for talent!"
"We might as well have a battle; let me show you what it means to be the strongest True Immortal!"
"You think you’re the strongest True Immortal? Come on, let’s compete with our Spiritual Void Domain!"
For a while, the place became a chaotic, almost resembling an internal selection contest.
Jiang Cheng was quite helpless.
Damn it, do you all have to be this eager?
Do you really need to show off how impressive you are?
In the end, it was the Gui Cang Sword Immortal, Taichang Profound Immortal, and a few other esteemed old experts, along with Mo Chen as a veteran judge, who considered various factors such as coordination and collaboration, finally selecting all the True Immortal candidates.
Those selected were elated.
They didn’t actually know that Sect Leader Jiang could resurrect them; they were taking the risk of dying in battle.
But it’s not like they lacked the power to fight this time.
Under these conditions, if they were still afraid of death and avoided battle, they wouldn’t have risen to the top of a Domain in the first place.
Those who weren’t selected were pounding their chests, strongly requesting to rotate in the next battle.
Everyone arrived at the Ascension Platform.
Although Jiang Cheng had already challenged so many times and was used to it, he still flamboyantly held a swearing-in ceremony.
He went on stage to make a brief speech full of hot air.
He couldn’t help it; in a venue full of thousands of eyes on him, he succumbed to his urge to be pretentious.
Afterwards, under the watchful eyes of the city’s citizens, he once again operated the Jade Ruler to call up the Ascension Chart.
Until now, everyone still didn’t know which city he wanted to challenge.
Brother Cheng unhesitatingly selected Shuangdeng City, the old nemesis.
Although he killed their City Lord last time, they broke his victory streak, and it had been irking him!
With a blinding light, the Ascension Platform vanished from the crowd’s view.
When it reappeared, they were already in the Challenge Space.
When the two sides met, Shuangdeng City was incredibly surprised.
After their City Lord was slain back then, they quickly had a new City Lord.
In the years that followed, they even intended to challenge Dingtian City again, but they couldn’t secure the chance.
Over the years, they steadily developed, especially flaunting the title of the only city that had defeated Dingtian City, and recruited some experts.
Now they had climbed back to the top ten.
"Jiang Cheng, do you dare to challenge us again?"
"Don’t forget, last time you lost to us!"
It was commonly recognized that in Dingtian City, Jiang Cheng was the only one who could truly hold his own in a battle.
People avoided provoking him not because they feared a face-off, but rather because if they encountered him, they wouldn’t even have a chance to flee.
The loss would be too great.
If it really came to a fight, they still believed they could secure this victory.
But this time, the situation was evidently different. Dingtian City, which had always sent only one person into battle, was now overwhelmingly filled with warriors.
"""

chapters.title: Chapter 247: Definitely Satisfy Sect Leader Jiang
chapters.content:
Chapter 247: Chapter 247: Definitely Satisfy Sect Leader Jiang
"How did you suddenly get so many people?"
"Where did you find these people?"
This question made Brother Cheng feel rather bewildered.
He wasn’t just some lone commander; he still had tens of thousands of people waiting to go on stage.
"What’s it to you?"
He couldn’t be bothered with petty arguments and directly flew into the arena to start the first round of one-on-one combat.
However, the new City Lord of Shuangdeng City quickly composed himself.
"Jiang Cheng, no matter where you found these people, I can only say you’ve made a miscalculation!"
"Hoping to win against us with these people? Foolish dreams!"
Other than Jiang Cheng, only a Three-Eyed Tiger from Dingtian City had ever been in action.
As for the others, the outside world knew nothing about them.
And now, upon meeting, they could tell the cultivation realm of this side at a glance.
Although they were all Immortals, there were no Golden Immortals, and not many Profound Immortals either.
There were quite a few Celestial Immortals, but that didn’t decide much.
Facing Jiang Cheng, it didn’t matter who they sent, they were going to lose.
So they might as well forfeit the first round and aim for victory in the second.
The City Lord of Shuangdeng City felt there was no need to go up and get killed; it served no purpose.
Thus, he straightforwardly chose to forfeit.
This pissed off Brother Cheng like crazy; damn it, he was still hoping to show off his battle prowess in front of everyone.
But their cowardly display just let him pass this round.
"Jiang Cheng, I’ll see how you will handle the second round!"
"Our side has six Golden Immortals, more than enough to annihilate all of you."
"Hahaha, even your Dingtian City will have a day of a total wipeout, didn’t see that coming?"
"Let us grant Dingtian City another defeat!"
"Our Shuangdeng City is your nemesis!"
The countdown to the next round eventually wound down amid their continuous trash talk.
On Dingtian City’s side, 29,999 people didn’t utter a word.
Even though their realm wasn’t as high as their opponents, all had been leaders of their domains before.
In terms of strategic thinking, they were far superior to those native-born Immortals.
At this moment, they watched their opponents coldly, as if looking at a bunch of fools.
Brother Cheng, having missed the chance to show off in the first round, flew back, feeling rather upset despite the win.
The main thing was how annoying their opponent’s attitude was.
Even though they forfeited, they kept taunting as if they were the victors.
"For the second round, beat the crap out of them for me!"
Upon Sect Leader Jiang’s words, the others immediately dropped their aloof demeanor and responded loudly.
"No problem!"
"Sect Leader Jiang, just watch us!"
"Old man here will give it his all to finish them off and satisfy Sect Leader Jiang!"
Hearing these words, laughter erupted from their opponents.
"Haha, talking big, aren’t you?"
"With just you?"
"Look at them, some of them are even using Sacred Artifacts."
"Hahaha, what a ragtag team of beggars..."
"Who knows where this bunch came from, never even heard of them before."
"No need to know, though; after today, they won’t exist anymore."
Shuangdeng City wasn’t worried, after all, the difference in realm was clear, and they felt at ease.
This mood continued until the official start of the second round.
The scene of the second round was intricate, and both sides couldn’t engage immediately upon entering.
But the moment they finally clashed, Shuangdeng City’s formation, which had been used hundreds of times, was instantly shattered.
Once numbers reach a certain quantity, strategic tactics become critical.
On Dingtian City’s side, under the command of several War Saints and Chess Saints, they dispersed from the start.
Then, a section took the role of main force for frontal feints, while flanking from both sides.
The most lethal part was their arrangement of three special ops teams and five harassment teams, each with few numbers, dedicated to piercing through and disrupting the enemy.
Aside from the inexperienced Feixian Sect disciples, most of them were hero-level figures who thrived on tactical and dirty tricks.
Within less than ten seconds of the battle, the camps of Shuangdeng City lost coherence, turning into a chaotic, leaderless mess.
Seeing their formation crumble into disarray, Shuangdeng City’s City Lord, generals, and commanders shouted in despair.
However, it wasn’t yet hopeless.
They still had their cultivation realm advantage!
With their formidable personal strength, they could force a breakthrough.
After all, when the power disparity is significant, any tactics are just clouds.
But then, they hit a brick wall.
Mo Chen, Bi Chang, the Golden Dragon King, Void Abyss, Gui Cang, Ling Xing, and other top experts had long set their sights on the opposing Golden Immortals.
Behind them, there were Brother Cheng’s elite disciples, Ji Linghan, Lin Ning, Luo Yuan, Duan River, and others supporting, meaning it was two or three against one Golden Immortal.
With Immortal Artifacts, these talented geniuses from the Lower Realm could already challenge significantly higher Realms.
What’s more, it was a siege.
The City Lord of Shuangdeng quickly realized that he couldn’t even take down Mo Chen standing before him, let alone decisively change the tide.
The Mo Chen facing him had lower cultivation, yet his Immortal Soul was above his own.
Moreover, his combat style was extremely seasoned.
Despite being just a Celestial Immortal, he seemed to have experienced more than himself, a Golden Immortal...
It was like witnessing a ghost.
Especially with Lin Ning and Lan Ti supporting, Mo Chen was actually overpowering him, leaving him unable to fight back.
"This can’t be!"
The City Lord of Shuangdeng City suddenly began to doubt life itself.
Could it be that this man and two women before him were their ultimate force?
It must be!
In the heat of battle, he struggled to glimpse the situation in other sectors.
Only to catch sight of his own Sixth-grade Golden Immortal commander having his skull smashed by Bi Chang’s club.
The Golden Immortals, overwhelmed by the numbers, found their situation dire.
The Profound Immortals didn’t fare any better, as the over ten thousand Celestial Immortals of Dingtian City each had the ability to exchange a couple of moves with a Profound Immortal.
Though they couldn’t match them in power, the moment it became two or three versus one, the tide instantly shifted.
There were only around five hundred Profound Immortals from Shuangdeng City, simply insufficient to face them.
The remaining thousands of Celestial Immortals found it ridiculously easy to take on Shuangdeng City’s Celestial Immortals.
Two minutes into the battle, only one City Lord remained alive on Shuangdeng City’s side.
Most of the Profound Immortals were dead or injured.
The command system was utterly collapsed, the entire field turning into scattered chaos, only to be rapidly consumed and slaughtered.
As more of their people fell, the situation grew increasingly lopsided.
"Escape!"
"Quickly, flee!"
The remaining ten thousand from Shuangdeng City lost all will to fight, their previous arrogance and confidence seeming like a joke.
Unfortunately, they could no longer escape.
Under the War Saints’ guidance, the Dingtian City forces had surrounded them from the start, giving Shuangdeng City no escape route.
As time ticked away, and the City Lord of Shuangdeng City finally fell under Mo Chen’s blade, the battle reached its conclusion.
The experts from the Lower Realm on Dingtian City’s side had long become bloodthirsty, like a pack of tactically astute wolves.
Many, in the end, complained they couldn’t find any more enemies or appropriate Immortal Artifacts.
When the battle ended, many still unsatisfied, rifled through the bodies, hoping to find some broken Immortal Armor or something.
Seeing this, Brother Cheng smirked, "Can you guys stop copying me?"

chapters.title: Chapter 248: Everyone is lined up
chapters.content:
Chapter 248: Chapter 248: Everyone is lined up
Dingtian City gained a victory, while Shuangdeng City lost one.
Obviously, the two had battled again, and this time Shuangdeng City lost.
And when the result of the battle came out, it caused an uproar.
Everyone in Shuangdeng City from the City Lord down was killed in battle.
This Immortal City has been utterly destroyed.
Total annihilation!
Once again, total annihilation!
"How was it done?"
"Yeah, isn’t it just Jiang Cheng? Even if he fought, it’s only one round, right?"
"Didn’t Shuangdeng City know to skip his round?"
"Yeah, as soon as they saw Jiang Cheng fight, they should have forfeited, it’s so simple."
"Were the people of Shuangdeng City too stupid?"
People outside hadn’t seen the process of this battle and thought if it were them, it definitely wouldn’t have been so tragic.
Just as they were discussing, Dingtian City challenged again.
After returning to the city following the battle, the whole city cheered for victory.
The True Immortals who participated this time all received Immortal Armor and Immortal Artifacts, each grinning from ear to ear.
Those who didn’t get a chance to appear were naturally envious.
Strongly demanding to start the next battle immediately and to replace people.
"Sect Leader Jiang, let’s have another round!"
"Yeah, look, the brothers don’t have Immortal Artifacts yet..."
"Let us show up once too!"
"Battle again!"
Suddenly, a True Immortal from some Domain raised his arm and shouted.
Then the remaining True Immortals collectively responded.
"Battle again!"
The voices of the masses echoed to the sky, shocking the Immortal City residents outside.
They just finished fighting, aren’t they going to take a break?
War fanatics?
In fact, until now, the Immortal City residents still didn’t know the origin of this group of overbearing newcomers.
After all, these people have been ascetic cultivators for ten years, barely interacting with the outside world.
Even if they did, who could pry some information out of these old foxes without being led astray?
The crowd was on fire.
The Profound Immortal Celestial Immortals who just fought fiercely showed no signs of tiredness or war-weariness.
They were all full of fighting spirit.
They were never peace lovers. They had just been low-key upon arriving in the Immortal Realm until now.
Now was the time to show their fangs.
Besides, Jiang Cheng wasn’t too stingy; he promised them that if they obtained better Immortal Artifacts, they could keep them.
But they had to give him the eliminated Immortal Artifacts.
After all, they could still be exchanged for points.
"You all want to continue fighting?"
Gui Cang Sword Immortal was quite reserved, smiling as he said: "I think it’s worth considering!"
Bi Chang was very straightforward, loudly shouting: "Brother, start quickly, we haven’t fought enough!"
Thinking about his unused ten-times critical strike today, Brother Cheng also felt unsatisfied.
Previously, so many challenges were fought single-handedly with two kids, it’s rare to have tens of thousands of ’spectators’ together now.
This show had to be put on today!
"Alright, let’s do it again!"
This time he challenged West Wu City, ranked 15th.
In the past year, the leading cities accumulated strength to explode in output at the last moment.
Frequent challenges with not much difference in victory counts, competition was extremely fierce.
In terms of strength, West Wu City was not much different from the tenth-ranked Shuangdeng City, recently taking down the previously ranked 12th Luomu City, being in the limelight.
However, it was unfortunate for them to be selected by Brother Cheng this time.
Seeing the lineup on Dingtian City’s side, West Wu City was equally astonished.
First, amazed that they could gather 30,000 immortals; wasn’t it said that it was always just Jiang Cheng alone?
Second, astonished that Shuangdeng City, could they have been defeated by this group?
Since a batch of new True Immortals had been swapped in, many of them used Sacred Artifacts.
In the Ascension Battles among tens or hundreds of thousands, indeed, not everyone could have Immortal Artifacts, but this was a battle among the top twenty.
Reaching this level and still using Sacred Artifacts seemed too shabby and ridiculous, right?
"Don’t underestimate the enemy!"
The City Lord of West Wu City remained calm.
"The lesson of Shuangdeng City is right in front of us."
"Pay close attention to Jiang Cheng, he might deceive!"
Brother Cheng indeed intended to deceive; in the first round, he was hesitant to go first, hoping the opponent would send an expert over.
As a result, he didn’t appear, and the opponent remained inactive.
Both sides actually stalled.
There was no choice; his name preceded him, having destroyed a city single-handedly. Who dared to act recklessly?
"Cough, Sect Leader Jiang, aren’t you planning to fight?"
Gui Cang and Golden Dragon King and others looked over eagerly.
Facing a Ninth-grade Golden Immortal City Lord, they still had to rely on a gang fight, unable to win by individually crossing over ten Small Realms.
Even Mo Chen needed Lin Ning and Ji Linghan and other juniors to assist from the side.
The first round was single duel, only Brother Cheng could take the lead and ensure victory in this round.
"This..."
In his heart, Brother Cheng cursed.
He could almost foresee that once he appeared, the opponent would choose to forfeit, not sending anyone up.
Which meant he couldn’t put on the show again.
But he couldn’t avoid it.
If he sent someone else, and their City Lord came up...
"Sigh, there’s really no way."
He could only appear.
And unsurprisingly, the opponent chose to forfeit this round.
Dingtian City took the first city, then the second round began.
This time, with 12,000 Celestial Immortals all possessing Immortal Artifacts, their combat power was much stronger than the last round.
It was a complete rout; despite West Wu City’s overall higher Realm, their combat power couldn’t compare.
Thus, Dingtian City achieved another victory.
In one day, they won two consecutive battles, completely shocking other Immortal Cities.
"Whoa, this Dingtian City is too fierce, right?"
"They fought two battles in one day; do they not have any losses?"
"Don’t they need to recover?"
"West Wu City is also totally annihilated, nobody knows how they won."
"Dingtian City likely has new allies..."
Amidst the discussions from the outside, Jiang Cheng and others returned to the city.
Those remaining True Immortals who didn’t join the battle gathered around again.
"Sect Leader Jiang, is it our turn now?"
"Line up, line up, all get in line!"
"Those of you who got Immortal Artifacts and Magical Treasures, roll aside, can’t you see our hands are still empty?"
Gui Cang, Void Abyss, and others had just acquired new Tier Four Immortal Artifacts and wanted to continue their efforts to get even better ones.
Naturally, no one wanted to stop.
Brother Cheng, too, was too lazy to ask, once again opening the Ascension Chart.
When the second day arrived, the entire Lower Immortal Realm was dumbfounded!
In just one night, Dingtian City challenged ten battles in succession, winning every match.
As soon as they fought, the battles were resolved in a short time without exception.
Whether ranked fifteenth or fifth, they couldn’t beat these overbearing newcomers from the Lower Realm.
In fact, by the sixth opponent, nobody dared to fight them anymore.
After all, the gap in power was clear; even if the Dingtian City army seemed low in Realm, those previous annihilations stood as a testament.
Subsequent opponents directly forfeited the first two rounds, without dispatching anyone.
Dingtian City’s ranking soared to fifth place.

chapters.title: Chapter 249: No Need to Be Low-key
chapters.content:
Chapter 249: Chapter 249: No Need to Be Low-key
Reaching this point, the overall strength of Dingtian City is also undergoing a transformation.
Continuously obtaining spoils of war, all the Ascenders from the Lower Realm have upgraded their gear.
All of the Profound Immortals are equipped with Tier Four Immortal Artifacts, and the Celestial Immortals have at least Tier Three Immortal Artifacts.
Even the True Immortals have all acquired Tier Two Immortal Artifacts.
In terms of equipment, not only do they not have a disadvantage, they actually have an advantage.
However, these new Immortal Artifacts haven’t been refined much, so they can’t exert their full power.
Though Brother Cheng didn’t get a chance to show off, as the Leader, he did snag an unprecedented deal.
A large number of obsolete Immortal Artifacts fell into his hands, which he then converted into points.
Upon counting, he gained a whopping five trillion points.
This somewhat filled the emptiness in his wounded heart.
As for other resources in the ring, he hasn’t exchanged them yet and kept them aside for now.
Currently, there’s no urgent need to raise his Realm, so he finally has time to improve his system a bit.
He still remembers that the next skill level is to raise the grade of inanimate objects.
Opening the system panel, he pressed the upgrade button.
But the system had no reaction, the button was actually grayed out.
"System, what’s going on?"
"After changing the Plane, the system needs to reboot and update to adapt to the new Plane. Before that, the system upgrade function is temporarily disabled."
"Damn, there’s this limitation?"
In the past decade, all other system skills functioned quite normally, and he thought that rebooting and updating wouldn’t matter.
He even almost forgot about this issue.
Thinking about it now, once reaching the Middle Immortal Realm, it’s time to find some free time to update it.
Inside the City Lord’s Mansion, everyone was discussing the next plan.
"These guys from the Immortal Realm are really timid, not a single one dares to fight."
"Knowing they’ll die for sure, of course, they don’t dare."
"Should we continue to fight for the top four?"
Currently, Dingtian City has 122 wins, while the fourth-ranked Brahma Emperor City has 130 wins.
As for the top spot, it still belongs to Five Seas City with 157 wins.
It seems impossible for Dingtian City to gather over 30 more victories because there are only so many opponents left to challenge.
But actually, when those top Great Powers initially set the Ascension Battle rules, they already considered this point.
Once in the top five, winning upwards will result in exchanging victories with the opponent.
Defeating Brahma Emperor City means directly obtaining the opponent’s wins, becoming 130 wins.
All the way up, it’s really only four matches away from the top spot.
"It feels like there’s no value in fighting further, and getting to first place would make us too conspicuous."
"Indeed, ranking fifth and first results in hugely different attention after ascending to the Middle Immortal Realm."
"From a prudent perspective, stopping now is the best choice."
"Being too high-profile will attract attention."
Gui Cang, Void Abyss, and others thought a lot.
They worried that after reaching the Middle Immortal Realm, they would be targeted by those malicious Immortal Emperors.
Even though no one’s face reads ’I’m an Ascender from the Lower Realm,’ they still have no clear background, with no prior experience in the Immortal Realm.
This large group of people, if traced back thoroughly, would eventually reveal issues.
In their view, reaching fifth place is already quite good.
They’ve got all the Immortal Artifacts they wanted; it’s time to stop.
However, Brother Cheng didn’t think so.
With the Resurrection Skill, he’s not afraid of anyone.
If he can’t reach the top spot, his style won’t reach perfection, which would be a lifelong regret!
"Hesitation and timidity, is that the style of us cultivators?"
"Clearly possessing the strength for the top spot but not daring to fight, what is this?"
As soon as he finished speaking, Bi Chang jumped out and loudly declared, "Brother is absolutely right!"
"We Desert People have never been content to be beneath others!"
"That’s right, do what needs to be done!"
The War Monkey King and other Demon Races also cried out fervently, their battle intent soaring to the sky.
"The first place must be ours!"
Gui Cang, Void Abyss, Taichang, and other seniors exchanged looks, all seeing the helplessness in each other’s eyes.
They are more stable, considering long-term consequences in their actions.
If it were only Bi Chang, the War Monkey King, and others suggesting this, they’d simply take it as a fart, telling them to fight on their own.
But now Brother Cheng spoke.
"Since Sect Leader Jiang is not yet satisfied, we should accompany the gentleman even unto death!"
"We the Demon Realm are willing to advance and retreat with Sect Leader Jiang!"
"We the Celestial Book Domain follow Sect Leader Jiang’s commands..."
In a blink of an eye, everyone quickly agreed to continue fighting.
Mo Chen, standing by Brother Cheng’s side, felt an immense sense of admiration.
Silently, the sect leader had already become the true leader of this group.
With just one word, he could make them decide on something they originally did not want to do.
The role of this prestige is not apparent now.
If, after a billion years, when all these people become giants in the Immortal Realm, it would be different...
But suddenly he shook his head smiling, is it necessary to wait till then?
With Sect Leader’s terrifying fortune, he doesn’t even need anyone’s assistance at all.
Only then did Brother Cheng contentedly open the Ascension Chart and unhesitatingly choose Brahma Emperor City.
In his view, the top four Great Immortal Cities definitely wouldn’t submit willingly.
Once challenged, they would definitely counterattack with all their might.
By then, his First Grade Golden Immortal level with tenfold critical strike would have a platform to shine on.
However, to his disappointment, Brahma Emperor City very straightforwardly chose to forfeit in face of his challenge.
They did not send out anyone to fight in both rounds.
Dingtian City once again won without a fight, increasing its wins to 130 and rising in the rankings to fourth.
Already attracting a lot of attention, they now drew the gaze of nearly everyone in the Lower Immortal Realm.
Everyone is now curious whether this Immortal City, which suddenly rose in the past decade, can really take the top spot.
A quarter hour later, Dingtian City ascended to third place.
The original third-place Liehuang City directly forfeited and conceded the spot.
Another half quarter-hour later, Dingtian City rose to second place.
The previously second-place Bitao City also straightforwardly forfeited both rounds.
This was actually the rational choice.
Given the wins and rankings of these Immortal Cities, they would not fall out of the top ten in the last few days anyway.
Since being in the top ten equally means ascending to the Middle Immortal Realm, why take the risk of total defeat and fight to the death?
Dropping by one rank doesn’t matter to them; they can afford it.
At this moment, Dingtian City had reached 146 wins, with only one opponent left ahead at 157 wins—Five Seas City.
Reaching this point, since there’s only one remaining opponent, according to the rules, they don’t need to restrict to within 10 matches and can directly challenge.
Brother Cheng was agitated, hoping the last Five Seas City could rise to the occasion.
Please don’t forfeit again; his long-kept tenfold critical strike has yet to be used.
The battle for the top spot was no different from any other match.
The City Lord of Five Seas City sneered a few times opposite.
"You’ve climbed quickly indeed."
"Beware, the higher you climb, the faster you fall."
"Some positions, without the fortune, you cannot hold down."
"If not to avoid casualties among my brothers, I’d determine to make you bleed rivers."
Such a yin and yang monster’s trash talk had zero damage effect on Dingtian City’s side.
The heroes from the Lower Realm had seen all sorts of scenes, in their eyes, this was just a clown.
"Then let’s have a grand battle, stop dawdling!"
Brother Cheng actually held some hope for him.
But in the end, after those few words, this guy too chose to retreat and give up.
Just like that, Dingtian City won again without fighting, achieving the top spot in the Ascension Battle!

chapters.title: Chapter 250: The Immortal Emperor Descends
chapters.content:
Chapter 250: Chapter 250: The Immortal Emperor Descends
Nine days later, the deadline for the Ascension Battle arrived.
On this day, the number of challenges between great Immortal Cities reached a peak not seen in a hundred years.
Many Immortal Cities wanted to seize this last opportunity to make a push.
The rankings changed almost every second.
However, this had nothing to do with Dingtian City, their position was so steady that no one dared to challenge them at all.
Over the past tens of million years in the Lower Immortal Realm, this was already the tenth Ascension Battle.
There had never been an Immortal City with such intimidating power.
The moment the time was up, a dazzling golden light shot down from the sky above.
Within the Immortal City, countless people took to the streets.
Looking at the golden light, some knelt in worship, while others cheered joyously.
"The Reception Golden Light has come down!"
"Haha, we are to ascend to the Middle Immortal Realm!"
"I never thought our Dingtian City would see this day."
"All thanks to the new City Lord!"
"And his group of helpers, simply too strong."
"They killed Five Seas City into not daring to fight, I really suspect this is a dream."
"With City Lord Jiang present, even in the Middle Immortal Realm, we can still stand our ground."
Upon hearing them mention the Reception Golden Light again, Brother Cheng and Void Abyss Bi Chang’s expressions became grim.
Damn it, there’s a shadow there.
Back then, being trapped in the Treasure Bottle False Immortal Realm was because they fell for the Reception Golden Light.
For them, it counted as a collective dark history.
"Now seeing the golden light gives me a headache."
"I hope nothing goes wrong this time."
"It should be fine, after all, so many sessions of the Ascension Battle, it should have some reputation."
"Indeed, this time it shouldn’t be a scam."
With a flash of golden light, the entire Dingtian City disappeared from its original place.
Everyone felt a distortion of time and space, then immediately appeared in a strange land.
Here, the Immortal Yuan Qi was twice as thick as before, and the breath of the Power of Rules was also more obvious.
Clearly, they had arrived in the Middle Immortal Realm.
"What plans do you all have next?"
Now that the Ascension Battle was over, the next one would have to wait a million years.
During the Ascension Battle, the various great Immortal Cities couldn’t freely move about or communicate.
And now this restriction was gone.
In the coming million years, the Power of Rules energy and Immortal Yuan Qi rewarded to the various Immortal Cities would dissipate, and everything would return to normal levels.
Many cultivators within the Immortal Cities would leave, and the Sect and Family Alliance would reappear everywhere.
Until a million years later, when they would be summoned by the great Immortal Cities to participate in the next Ascension Battle.
Gui Cang Sword Immortal smiled slightly: "We sword cultivators plan to travel around, after all, cultivating the heart is also very important to us."
Void Abyss smiled: "We demon cultivators also plan to go out and experience, perhaps in the future Sect Leader Jiang will hear our names again soon."
The Golden Dragon King also said: "We plan to visit the Demon Race gathering place of the Middle Immortal Realm."
The other people also bid farewell.
Not everyone could rely on luck like Sect Leader Jiang, where martial arts and rule enlightenment all depended on lottery, only needing to stay home and take medicine.
Cultivation is not just about cultivating, but also about practice.
For these talented ascenders, being trapped in one place for a long time was not conducive to further growth.
Moreover, each of them had their own fate.
Hearing they were leaving, Brother Cheng was delighted!
Man, you guys are finally going.
Such capable people, it’s better never to see each other again.
Just like the last dozen Ascension Battles, they stole all the limelight.
At the farewell, Gui Cang lamented: "Over these years, without Sect Leader Jiang, we would absolutely not have been able to establish ourselves in the Immortal Realm."
"This kindness and sentiment, never forgetting, Sect Leader Jiang should receive a bow from the entire Sword Domain!"
With this said, over two hundred sword cultivators of the Sword Domain solemnly bowed to the ground.
With their lead, the remaining 120,000 ascenders also saluted.
To Brother Cheng, among this group, whether righteous or evil, they were sincerely convinced.
Not only were there life-saving graces, but also creation sentiments, and there was also power far exceeding theirs laid before them.
"Sect Leader Jiang, in the future, just a call from you, even if separated by countless miles, we will rush to serve at night!"
"Alright, alright, goodbye, goodbye..."
Brother Cheng quickly waved his hand, thinking in his heart it was better to avoid it.
He had a system cheat, didn’t need any helpers.
The moment he finished speaking, the entire Dingtian City seemed to suddenly enter an isolated space.
The sky was clearly still bright, but it felt as though they had arrived in the long-lost night.
A tremor from deep within the heart struck at everyone’s consciousness defenses, making them involuntarily want to kneel.
The native inhabitants in the city were already prostrated on the ground, unable to lift their heads at all.
Whether Gui Cang, Void Abyss, or Ji Linghan and Lin Ning, they were all struggling to support themselves, as if an invisible pressure was oppressing their Immortal Souls and Daoist Hearts.
It was a natural tier suppression, leaving no room for resistance.
"You don’t need to go anywhere..."
This voice came from all directions, followed by a sky full of purple fire appearing in the void.
The fire covered the sky and finally formed chains of rules.
A middle-aged man with black mustache, exuding grandeur, walked slowly from the sky.
He wore a red python robe, a purple golden crown on his head, with a fire phoenix as large as the sky beneath his feet.
The fire phoenix just let out a soft chirp, causing everyone’s Divine Soul to tremble violently.
As though separated by countless tiers.
And when everyone truly saw the man with the purple crown above, it was as if they got struck by lightning.
Behind him, the river of flame rules faintly carried the interweaving of time and space and the life and death of all things.
Within the deep river, the people seemed to glimpse a whole new world.
At a glance, they almost got lost.
At this moment, all the cultivators present simultaneously felt their Daoist Hearts losing control, unable to mobilize the main rule.
They were like insects caught on a web, even their consciousness began to become slow and sluggish.
A piercing scream sounded from behind Jiang Cheng.
"It’s the Immortal Emperor!"
Mo Chen’s face was full of panic, as if he had gone mad, completely collapsing.
"This is the true body of the Immortal Emperor descending!"
Compared to others, he was the most knowledgeable.
After all, as a former Demon Venerable, he was fortunate to have seen a true Demon Emperor.
He knew what this all meant.
And knew, that this was hostile!
"Oh, it’s actually a Demon Venerable Level Divine Soul..."
The Immortal Emperor above was only slightly surprised, then returned to indifference.
"I thought there was only one ascender."
"Unexpectedly, you are all..."
His voice echoed throughout the city, like the impending judgment.
"It seems, I came right this time."
Mo Chen’s heart completely sank.
He knew very well that the achievements of Dingtian City were just too abnormal.
And the matter of ascending to the Middle Immortal Realm was neither big nor small for the Immortal Emperors of the Upper Immortal Realm.
The Golden Immortals and Profound Immortals of these Immortal Cities could only be considered as ants to the Immortal Emperor.
But the ascension from the Lower Immortal Realm was, after all, a grand event once in a million years, with only ten slots at a time.
Jiang Cheng took the first place, which was as conspicuous as one could get.

chapters.title: Chapter 251: Worthy of Sect Leader Jiang
chapters.content:
Chapter 251: Chapter 251: Worthy of Sect Leader Jiang
Mo Chen guessed correctly.
The Ascension Battle in the Lower Immortal Realm is just a small skirmish among Golden Immortals and Profound Immortals, not worthy of the attention of Immortal Emperors.
However, the rise of Dingtian City is too sudden.
Ninety years ago, it was still rolling around in the ranks of millions, having no presence.
Suddenly, it surged into the top ten in an extremely short time.
This could still be considered as a buildup and breakthrough.
But in just two days from eighth place to first, that is truly inexplicable.
Fighting so many battles without any attrition?
Is no rest or replenishment needed?
The Nine Flames Immortal Emperor of the Upper Immortal Realm was the first to notice the anomaly in the Ascension Chart and sent people to investigate secretly.
This investigation immediately uncovered more shocking inside information.
The City Lord of this city can wipe out nearly thirty thousand people with one sword in the second round.
This combat power far exceeds the limits of the Lower Immortal Realm.
With such power, before the Ascension Battle, this lord should have been well-known in the Lower Immortal Realm.
Yet before this, no one had heard of Jiang Cheng’s existence.
The Golden Immortals of the Lower Immortal Realm couldn’t figure out the reason and just assumed he was some reclusive old monster.
The Nine Flames Immortal Emperor is different.
Back then, he struck down into the Void Immortal Realm, set up the Nine Treasures Immortal Extinction Array, and placed the Treasure Bottle Trap some time ago; he was involved throughout.
He was the first to associate it with the ascenders from the Lower Realm Ten Thousand Realms.
Only they can create such miracles.
Especially the first batch ascending this time, suppressed for millions of years, they are bound to be extraordinary.
If such people are not quickly annihilated, the landscape of the Immortal Realm will change.
During the Ascension Battle, no one from the Upper Immortal Realm could intervene, so he didn’t act.
But secretly, Dingtian City was firmly locked onto.
Now, at the moment Dingtian City enters the Middle Immortal Realm, he finally makes his move.
He hardly planned to dispatch his Immortal Kings, Immortal Venerables, or Immortal Palace armies, but instead came personally as an Immortal Emperor.
A dignified Immortal Emperor lowering himself to deal with a group of Profound Immortals and Celestial Immortals seems over-ambitious and over-the-top.
But to reach the level of an Immortal Emperor, none are fools.
The Nine Flames Immortal Emperor profoundly understands one thing—the monstrous fortune of the lower realm ascenders often allows them to pass crises in inconceivable ways.
Because he was once an ascender from the lower realm over a billion years ago.
Sending Immortal Kings and Immortal Venerables seems stable, but they may not contend with that elusive and mystic power of fortune.
In the end, it might instead be delivering an experience package to the opponent.
To override this miraculous fortune protection, only an Immortal Emperor personally striking with supreme magical power can forcefully suppress.
Upon arriving here, he very coincidentally overheard the conversations of Gui Cang, Void Abyss, Golden Dragon King, and others.
Originally, he thought there was only one ascender, Jiang Cheng.
Now he shockingly discovers all 120,000 present are indeed ascenders.
In fact, even without hearing the conversation, he could guess it.
After all, the ’variety’ of these 120,000 people is too extensive, all kinds of rare and peculiar races are present, an amalgam of various types.
Aside from the newly ascended, other Immortal Cities could not gather them simultaneously.
At this moment, despite these people’s low realms, the Nine Flames Immortal Emperor almost wanted to call other Immortal Emperors to come jointly massacre them.
The Ascension Rules have only been restored for ten years, yet among this group appear many Profound Immortals and Celestial Immortals, which is terrifying.
If he had not discovered it this time, the consequences would be unthinkable.
In another billion years, very likely, among this group will emerge more than a dozen Immortal Emperors.
And these new Immortal Emperors, being suppressed for so many years, will certainly regard old established Immortal Emperors as enemies!
"How did you do it?"
"Ascending together, advancing so fast."
It must be a great chance that creates such miracles.
Even he, an Immortal Emperor, rarely felt greed stir.
He slightly relaxed the restriction, the rule chains on the 120,000 people loosened a bit, reluctantly allowing a breath.
"Submit to this emperor, engrave the enslavement mark on your immortal souls, henceforth pledge loyalty to this emperor, and you will be spared."
"This emperor will even cultivate you in the future."
If this group is marked with enslavement, they become his power.
That is more profitable than killing them.
In another billion years, the Nine Flames Immortal Emperor could instead become the strongest force in the Upper Immortal Realm.
Only soul search is easy, killing is simple, but planting enslavement marks requires voluntary acceptance, even an Immortal Emperor can’t break this rule.
Gui Cang, Void Abyss, Bi Chang, and others felt their hearts sinking to the bottom.
The enemy severely overstepped!
If it were Immortal Venerables, they could still summon the spirit to fight fiercely.
But encountering an Immortal Emperor, they have no counter strength whatsoever.
However, facing the Immortal Emperor’s ’recruitment’, all chose to refuse.
Gui Cang Sword Immortal lowered his gaze and blandly said, "As sword cultivators, we would rather shatter like jade!"
Void Abyss’s mouth curled slightly, his smile seemed somewhat ironic, "Although we demon cultivators act without scruples, almost without a baseline, we still refuse to be enslaved."
The Golden Dragon King struggled to raise his dragon head, spewing a weak breath of dragon.
Though it had no impact on those rule chains, it represented its stance.
Bi Chang struggled fiercely and roared, "Just kill, wanting our Desolate Race to submit, you’re not worthy!"
As these words sounded, the crowd responded one after another.
"Indeed, so what if it’s an Immortal Emperor?"
"A few billion years ago, you were merely the same as us, nothing significant!"
"Get lost, stop pretending in front of us!"
"Hahaha, after we die, ascenders will surely come up from the lower realm endlessly..."
All 120,000 people, not a single one submitted.
The Nine Flames Immortal Emperor wasn’t angry; living to his age, rarely does anything cause emotional fluctuations.
Their choice only strengthened his resolve to kill.
Because they are different from the majority of the native inhabitants of the upper realm.
They themselves were the bosses of domains, wouldn’t see anyone as superior.
They fear nothing, have no awe for anyone.
Asking them to temporarily bow and endure might be possible, but to enslave them is impossible.
