Standing above the Fire Phoenix, the Nine Flames Immortal Emperor waved his hand, the rule chains tightening once more.
"Since you guys..."
The words weren’t finished and were interrupted.
"All this time, I still don’t know who you are."
The rule chains still remained, yet inexplicably a gap appeared.
A stunningly handsome young man flew up before him, confronting him.
Who else but Brother Cheng?
The Nine Flames Immortal Emperor rarely paused.
How is this possible?
These rule chains, even Immortal Kings can’t escape, this person, although the only Golden Immortal among 120,000, is ultimately just a Golden Immortal!
"Sect Leader Jiang!"
"Haha, our brother is truly different!"
"As expected of Sect Leader Jiang, indeed a miraculous person..."
Everyone was both surprised and delighted; even the Immortal Emperor’s methods couldn’t bind him, how amazing!
If it were anyone else, they wouldn’t hold out hope.
The realm difference is too vast.
But putting up Sect Leader Jiang who’s repeatedly created miracles, everyone once again felt hope rising.

chapters.title: Chapter 252: Do Not Kill Nameless Ghosts
chapters.content:
Chapter 252: Chapter 252: Do Not Kill Nameless Ghosts
"Ahem!"
Brother Cheng cleared his throat, "Do I need to tell you that I have 992 main rules?"
Though these main rules realms aren’t high, they are diverse.
The rule chains might trap others, but thinking of using them to bind his Daoist Heart brought by 992 rules is quite insufficient.
"Finally, you’re here."
He twirled the Tier Four Immortal Sword in his hand.
After holding back for so many days, a worthy opponent has finally arrived, allowing him to show off properly in front of everyone.
As for this opponent’s immense weight, he’s not considering it at all.
Because he’s in such a good mood, even the sight of this Immortal Emperor seems pleasant.
"You’re honored to be named by this Sect Leader."
"State your name, this Sect Leader’s sword does not cut nameless ghosts!"
Clearly such bold words, yet they made everyone really want to roast him.
Bro, can you be a bit more serious?
This is an Immortal Emperor, why does it sound like a small fry to you?
And cutting nameless ghosts, it’s not like you haven’t waved your hand and wiped out thousands before, never seen you asking names one by one then?
The Nine Flames Immortal Emperor certainly wouldn’t cooperate with him; it would be too damaging to the image.
"You do have some uniqueness."
Brother Cheng flicked a strand of beautiful hair on his forehead, casually responded.
"You do have some discernment."
"..."
Although just at the Golden Immortal Realm, and with a somewhat abnormal style, the Nine Flames Immortal Emperor indeed didn’t underestimate Brother Cheng.
"Did you break the seal of the Void Immortal Realm?"
That altar’s seal isn’t something just anyone could break.
Not only is sufficient power required, but being alive to reach there as well.
Being able to do such a thing even before becoming an immortal speaks volumes about how extraordinary this person is.
Power definitely can’t be judged from the surface realm.
Facing his inquiry, Brother Cheng admitted it without hesitation.
"Of course, even this trivial matter you knew about?"
For him, this is an achievement made for showing off.
Though he said this, in reality, he wished he could announce it to the whole world.
"Hahaha, I originally planned to hide my identity and fame, but you bringing it up in front of so many people really makes me feel embarrassed."
Sure enough, though everyone else was still unable to move, their admiration for him reached a new height.
So when they were once searching for a way out in the Void Immortal Realm, it was Sect Leader Jiang who unsealed it for everyone?
Truly a divine being!
Especially the Heart Division members, they were moved to tears.
On seeing this, if not for Jiang Cheng, they would be drained to death by the Array Hub of the Nine Treasures Immortal Extinction Array sooner or later.
"Was it also you who cracked the Myriad Phenomena Illusion Immortal Bottle?"
"Do you think anyone other than the charming me could accomplish such a thing?"
"You’re really quite capable!"
At this moment, the Nine Flames Immortal Emperor has already upgraded him to the top of the must-kill list, even above those opposing Demon Emperor ranks.
If not for this person, their series of plans would have succeeded long ago.
This person is the sole key to continuously breaking the Immortal Realm’s seal from the Lower Realm!
He must be killed no matter what.
"Much appreciated, much appreciated!"
"Can we start the fight now, little brother?"
Even if the Nine Flames Immortal Emperor was profound and deep, he finally couldn’t bear it anymore.
His figure suddenly became illusionary, the purple fire around him sharply contracted, and the rule chains extending through the void intertwined.
In no time, it turned into a black flame.
As if crossing the boundaries of time and space, the black flame suddenly appeared on Jiang Cheng’s forehead.
The Nine Flames Immortal Emperor was nowhere to be seen.
At this moment, all cultivators who’ve cultivated the Fire Main Rule experienced a sudden void in their hearts.
As if this rule no longer existed in the world.
At this moment, all flames in the Upper, Middle, and Lower Three Immortal Realms extinguished simultaneously.
As if he was the embodiment of the Fire Rule.
And now, he’s commanding all flames to destroy the target before him.
Then Jiang Cheng was willing to be destroyed.
So thoroughly destroyed that not even smoke could rise.
The black flame reappeared, reverting to the form of the Nine Flames Immortal Emperor.
The rule chains spread out again, sealing the world and isolating it into another time and space.
The Nine Flames Immortal Emperor let out a slight breath.
That strike just now looked simple, but it was actually the strongest strike he’s used in over a billion years.
It embedded the great Dao of rules, vast as the sea and profound beyond comprehension.
Even the Fire Phoenix below could only see a tiny bit of it.
To become an Immortal Emperor indeed means to become the embodiment of a rule, as that’s the premise of achieving Immortal Emperor status.
This level of attack is extremely perilous, directly targeting the essence of a rule.
Far from the simple and crude release of so-called immortal techniques and martial techniques controlled by lower-level immortals using Immortal Artifacts and magical treasures.
"Sect Leader Jiang..."
Though unable to voice anything, all the experts from the Lower Realm present were shocked to their cores.
Sect Leader Jiang was killed?
A Golden Immortal facing an Immortal Emperor, being killed was inevitable.
Surviving would have been a miracle.
Yet the first thought that crossed their minds was that this was impossible.
Such a man shouldn’t die just like that.
Lan Ti, Ji Linghan, Lin Ning, Luo Yuan, and other Feixian Sect disciples were grief-stricken on the spot, vision going black.
Had it not been for the ’benevolent’ Nine Flames Immortal Emperor preemptively restraining them, many might have fainted on the spot.
The only two who remained calm were Mo Chen and the Three-Eyed Tiger.
The former believed in Sect Leader Jiang’s overwhelming fortune, reaching the level of blind faith.
And the latter, it didn’t believe that the King Bi, who rivaled it, would foolishly rush to die.
Brother Hu had seen similar scenes too many times, alright?
At this moment, Jiang Cheng was waiting for the familiar system notification sound.
"Ding..."
Then there was no follow-up, instead a noise like a bad signal was heard.
Hey, hey, no way?
At this critical moment, bro is waiting for you to charge up my show-off gear, don’t break on us now.
He finally realized the consequences of the system not rebooting and updating.
If things went poorly and there was a problem with the system, he might truly die.
Brother Cheng’s largest wish all along indeed was to be killed several more times, but he didn’t want to die without the chance of resurrection.
Luckily, his worries didn’t materialize.
The system, struggling with all its might, eventually resumed operation.
"Ding, the host has obtained three opportunities to use random Origin Rules."
What the heck is this?
Brother Cheng actually didn’t understand.
Soon after, a colossal wheel appeared before him.
On that wheel, there were as many as three thousand different tiny squares, each with a small icon on it.
Some were swords, some were knives, some were flames, some were water droplets, some were pieces of paper, some were leaves...
It was practically all-encompassing.
Some Brother Cheng could tell what rules they represented, some he truly couldn’t.
For example, a hair, a yellow blob, a cloud...
Don’t tell me, these also represent some rule, huh?
He didn’t hesitate long before he pressed the start button.
The wheel spun rapidly, making him dizzy.

chapters.title: Chapter 253: Betting Everything
chapters.content:
Chapter 253: Chapter 253: Betting Everything
Brother Cheng was hoping to get a Sword Rule, Blade Rule, or something like Power Rule, Slaughter Rule, etc.
Although, according to common logic, the Three Thousand Rules are all equal, and each one can become a dao.
But don’t these rules sound mighty and impressive?
After a rapid spin, the roulette finally stopped.
In the end, the pointer landed on a dice icon.
What the heck is this?
Does it want me to crush this Immortal Emperor with a dice?
Could it be any more ridiculous?
However, after obtaining this dice, he understood what it was.
Gambling Rule Origin: If you have enough stakes, everything can be gambled, and you’ll win every time you bet.
What?
Brother Cheng was initially confused; this rule was vague. What exactly did it mean?
But soon after, he burst into laughter.
The next moment, he resurrected again, appearing once more in front of the Nine Flames Immortal Emperor.
The Immortal Emperor had just dealt with him and was now planning to deal with the others.
But before killing them, he intended to search their souls to see what these Ascenders had been up to during this time.
Seeing Jiang Cheng appear before him once more, he halted.
After all, even if it were the same Demon Emperor or Immortal Emperor, they couldn’t possibly be unscathed.
"You’re actually alive?"
Even as an Immortal Emperor who seldom showed emotions, he was visibly surprised.
Everyone present was equally astonished and delighted.
If they weren’t immobilized, the entire place would be cheering.
Not in vain is he Sect Leader Jiang!
Under the strike of an Immortal Emperor, he didn’t die. Isn’t that against the heavens?
"How did you do it?"
The Nine Flames Immortal Emperor genuinely couldn’t understand.
Is the power of fortune really so mystical that even an Immortal Emperor level rule attack can’t kill?
Brother Cheng opposite him was somewhat disappointed.
The Immortal Emperor was really no different from those previous opponents. After seeing he wasn’t dead, they all reacted the same way.
He thought he would be more sophisticated and unique.
"You want to know?"
"Call me Grandpa, and I might consider telling you."
An Immortal Emperor wouldn’t stoop to such meaningless banter.
He was beginning to suspect that maybe the rules were ineffective against this person.
Though such a thing was too bizarre, completely defying the rules of heaven and earth, but fortune is a tricky thing.
So this time, he directly wielded his Immortal Sword, launching a frontal attack with an Immortal Technique.
With one strike, the space was instantly torn apart.
Countless rifts continuously retreated in the river of time, and Brother Cheng even saw scenes of when he first arrived in this world.
Damn, this is too fierce.
He hurriedly activated the Gambling Origin.
Swish!
Everyone present heard a clear sound of stones falling.
Though the Immortal Emperor’s attack was enough to destroy the heavens and the earth, it couldn’t overshadow this sound; it was incredibly wondrous.
Soon after, the torn space and the chaotic time all came to a standstill.
A giant six-sided dice hung high in the sky.
"What is this?"
The Nine Flames Immortal Emperor was utterly shocked; he’d never encountered anything like this.
His full-force strike could cause drastic changes in the entire Middle Immortal Realm, needing an Immortal Emperor-level opponent to stop it.
His attack had been blocked before.
But never like this, stopping out of thin air.
All rules in this world simultaneously ceased to function and couldn’t be triggered again.
Even the Fire Rule, his specialty, was no exception.
The only thing that existed was the die, constantly turning, representing the Gambling Rule.
Under this rule, Jiang Cheng himself couldn’t attack either.
But that was enough.
Standing beneath the dice, he slowly pointed at the Immortal Emperor and the Fire Phoenix opposite.
"With all my treasure, all my cultivation techniques and realms, Martial Dao enlightenment, Rule Realm, and all talents as stakes, I bet all their attacks are ineffective on me!"
The silent venue echoed with his solitary voice.
The six-sided die turned slower and slower until it finally stopped.
A voice from an unknown source resonated in the depths of everyone’s divine souls.
"Jiang Cheng—wins!"
Everyone present, along with all in the outside Middle Immortal Realm.
Even the Immortal Emperors and Demon Emperors in the Upper Immortal Realm heard these three words!
This was the Origin Rule announcing a major outcome.
For a while, everyone in the Immortal Realm looked up in unison.
The Immortal Emperors and Demon Emperors deep in cultivation also furrowed their brows, some sending vast Immortal Souls to sense the surroundings, others calculating with their fingers.
However, ultimately, they found nothing.
Here in the Middle Immortal Realm, everything resumed operation.
The Nine Flames Immortal Emperor’s strike landed on Jiang Cheng without suspense.
However, that strike, powerful enough to destroy the heavens and the earth, felt like a gentle breeze, passing through him.
Finally, it dissipated into nothingness.
He stood proudly in mid-air, unharmed.
"That’s impossible!"
The Nine Flames Immortal Emperor finally lost his composure.
He waved his Immortal Sword, space once again torn open, endless rules disrupted and obliterated, even his Immortal Country began to burn.
Inside, it had become a hell of blazing flames.
Saw countless living beings wailing, then turning to ashes...
The Fire Phoenix also turned into a sky full of red clouds, attacking Jiang Cheng billions of times in an instant.
However, it was all in vain.
Under the guidance of the Gambling Origin, that prior ’gamble’ took effect.
From now on, any of their attacks were ineffective against Jiang Cheng.
Amidst the attack, Brother Cheng finally let go of a big rock on his heart.
Thank goodness, despite not having a user manual, he didn’t misunderstand how to use this origin.
Under the Gambling Rule, whenever he wanted to gamble, the gamble would immediately establish.
Everything targeted by the gamble would temporarily halt.
To refuse the gamble, the other party had to surpass the interference of the Power of Origin.
Unfortunately, the Nine Flames Immortal Emperor hadn’t reached that level.
Unless he mastered a Power of Origin himself, he couldn’t refuse the gamble from happening, nor break this inevitable loss.
Initially, Brother Cheng just wanted to casually wager some stakes.
Like a sword, an Immortal Crystal, something like that.
However, after he placed the bet, the gamble couldn’t commence.
Because betting on his ability to be immune to all attacks from an Immortal Emperor, such small stakes clearly weren’t enough.
He had to raise the bet.
So he could only bet all his treasures, but it still wasn’t enough.
Bet his entire cultivation, not enough.
Bet his Martial Dao enlightenment, far from enough.
Bet those 992 main rules, still not enough.
Bet all the Heroic Souls he possessed, still insufficient.
In the end, when he wagered all his talents, including the Celestial Desolation Indestructible Body, it was finally enough.
Only then did the gamble commence.
Fortunately, the Nine Flames Immortal Emperor’s rule realm hadn’t reached the Origin Level, otherwise Jiang Cheng might have lost.
Once lost, everything he wagered would also be lost.
And now, he won.
"Little Brother, you’re not good enough, this level of attack is lacking."
"How could you possibly do this!"
The Nine Flames Immortal Emperor had already given up on long-range Immortal Techniques and switched to melee attacks.
"Who are you really!"
He was right in front of Jiang Cheng, frantically swinging his sword.
One could say every sword struck flesh, even Brother Cheng’s head was hit countless times.
Yet, Jiang Cheng remained unscathed.

chapters.title: Chapter 254: Precious Integrity
chapters.content:
Chapter 254: Chapter 254: Precious Integrity
Gui Cang, Void Abyss, Bi Chang, and the others have completely started seeing Sect Leader Jiang as a god.
Because the experience he’s going through now, only a legendary and elusive god could possibly achieve it.
A full-force attack from an Immortal Emperor, yet he remains unscratched.
It completely shattered everyone’s understanding.
Even the disciples of the Feixian Sect, who always worshipped Brother Cheng immensely, couldn’t imagine what kind of ultimate power this is.
Now, a peculiar thought has floated in all their minds.
They always thought the Sect Leader was a show-off, liking to flaunt.
Now it seems, they misunderstood him, the old master.
He’s too low-key...
Even an Immortal Emperor couldn’t hurt him a bit, and yet he always just claimed to be an Immortal to outsiders.
This can be described with merely an Immortal title?
Too overly modest, right?
For a moment, everyone even secretly felt ashamed and reflected.
They shouldn’t have grumbled against the Sect Leader in their hearts before, the old master is way too deep for their small minds to fathom.
"Tired from hitting?"
With a smile, Brother Cheng looked at the Immortal Emperor laboring strenuously, once again activated the Origin Rule of gambling.
"Who exactly are you!"
The Nine Flames Immortal Emperor was nearly going crazy.
As an Immortal Emperor, he had never felt so powerless as now.
All attacks were ineffective.
His overwhelming power seemed nothing more than an illusionary bubble.
His ten billion years of cultivation, seemed as if it never happened, just a dream.
After waking from the dream, he’d find he was just an ordinary person unable to bind a chicken.
This bizarre cognitive error drove his mental defenses to collapse.
"Die!"
"Die!"
Whoosh!
The sound of dice rolling once again filled the scene.
All actions of the Nine Flames Immortal Emperor and his Fire Phoenix steed halted again.
Sect Leader Jiang placed his bet once more.
"With my whole life’s integrity, speaking ability, all I’ve learned and thought, all consciousness, I bet every word you say from now on will include ’grandpa’!"
As soon as these words fell, the whole Immortal Realm once again echoed with the origin’s judgment.
"Jiang Cheng—wins!"
"What did you say grandpa?"
The Nine Flames Immortal Emperor couldn’t comprehend what his words meant.
However, immediately after, he was utterly skeptical about life.
He didn’t intend to say ’grandpa’ in that sentence.
He sternly questioned, "What did you do grandpa?"
Brother Cheng knew instantly it worked.
This Immortal Emperor appeared with a dominator’s stance, wanting to enslave him, annihilate the scene, as if he was above earthly concerns.
Now, his words finally became pleasing.
"I’m acknowledging you as a kin, dear grandson." Sect Leader Jiang joked with a smile.
Since he had three chances to use the Origin Rule of gambling, he could squander one.
This bet was merely a small mischievous pleasure, and he originally intended just to pledge some integrity.
But after staking integrity, the wager didn’t increase, instead, it deducted a bit.
Clearly, in the determination of the Origin Rule, his precious integrity was not just worthless, but negative.
No choice, he could only add a pile of other stakes to finally establish the gamble.
The Nine Flames Immortal Emperor completely went insane.
"I’ll kill you grandpa!"
He swung the Immortal Sword frantically hacking at the target in front.
Unfortunately, the previous round of the gamble was permanent.
Unless he could transcend the manipulation of the Origin Rule, he would never be able to hurt Sect Leader Jiang.
Brother Cheng glared, "Grandson, this is rebellion and unfilial behavior!"
The Nine Flames Immortal Emperor had completely lost all presence of a great power.
"Ah grandpa!"
With his hair disheveled, he appeared as if he’d lost his senses.
Roaring while continuing to deliver meaningless attacks.
And every word he uttered automatically carried the word ’grandpa’, utterly uncontrollable.
"Grandpa go die!"
"No grandpa maybe..."
"All this is grandpa fake..."
"This Emperor doesn’t believe grandpa..."
Everyone in the scene was now doubting their ears.
This was a dignified Immortal Emperor!
Even if killed, captured, or executed, they could still strive to understand.
But the current situation, they truly couldn’t understand.
The Fire Phoenix steed of the Nine Flames Immortal Emperor was completely stunned.
The high and mighty Immortal Emperor, at this moment, had no dignity or identity left.
Each ’grandpa’ completely dragged him from the celestial peak into the filthy mud, leaving him stripped bare and disgracefully exposed.
If not for being restrained by Rule Chains, everyone present might have burst into laughter.
Sect Leader Jiang played too well.
Though they didn’t know how he achieved it, his act today had entirely solidified in everyone’s heart that rebellious seed.
Henceforth, the so-called Immortal Emperor and Demon Emperor would have no aura in their eyes.
Gradually, the Nine Flames Immortal Emperor closed his mouth.
He couldn’t always let others take advantage, could he?
His only thought now was to grind Jiang Cheng’s bones to dust.
The silent attack continued.
Finding he went silent, Brother Cheng suddenly felt it boring.
So he activated the Origin Rule of gambling again, preparing to deal with him.
Initially, he intended to make this Immortal Emperor his slave.
Knowing his own abilities, if not for system hacks, his own power is far from enough in front of an Immortal Emperor.
If this Immortal Emperor could be his subordinate, it’d be marvelous.
At least in the Middle Immortal Realm, he could walk horizontally, Immortal Kings and Immortal Venerables would have to step aside.
But no matter how he increased the stake, the gamble couldn’t be established.
Trying to subdue an Immortal Emperor, his current wager simply wasn’t enough, couldn’t make it...
Helplessly, he could only settle for the second best, choosing to eliminate him.
Someone hating him so intensely couldn’t be left.
He pointed at the Nine Flames Immortal Emperor and the Fire Phoenix steed.
"I, Jiang Cheng, bet with all my life, you will die on the spot within 3 seconds!"
The spinning dice stopped.
A vast and majestic voice echoed in the Immortal Realm.
"Jiang Cheng—wins!"
Hearing this profound sound from the origin three times, all the great powers in the Upper Immortal Realm couldn’t sit still.
At this moment, countless people were inquiring about who Jiang Cheng was?
What did these three sounds represent?
The Nine Flames Immortal Emperor once more opened his mouth in uncontrollable rage: "What did you say gran..."
Before finishing the sentence.
Boom!
Boom!
Two bursts of blood mist exploded, the Nine Flames Immortal Emperor and the Fire Phoenix steed simultaneously disintegrated.
Under the suppression of the Origin Rule, there was nothing to resist with all his knowledge.
Body and spirit were obliterated, nothing left.
Along with it, even his vast Immortal Country collapsed rapidly before their eyes, destroyed into nothingness.
Brother Cheng again pretended to dust off his sleeves.
The skyful of purple fire scattered and vanished.
The Rule Chains binding everyone disappeared invisibly, everyone regained freedom.
In fact, after the Immortal Emperor’s death, these things would disappear anyway.
Brother Cheng promptly seized that Tier Nine Immortal Sword and another Fire Lotus Immortal Treasure belonging to the Nine Flames Immortal Emperor.
Yet he couldn’t find the expected Storage Ring.
On reflection, at the level of an Immortal Emperor, it seemed indeed unnecessary for a Storage Ring.
This left him a bit disappointed, hoping to strike it rich this time.

chapters.title: Chapter 255: The Days When I Wasn’t Present
chapters.content:
Chapter 255: Chapter 255: The Days When I Wasn’t Present
After collecting the spoils of war, everyone else also gathered around.
As usual, there was a wave of shock and admiration.
Even those like Gui Cang and Void Abyss were a bit hesitant to fly at the same height as Sect Leader Jiang.
The ability to take down an Immortal Emperor was indeed a bit too fierce.
"Sect Leader Jiang, could it be that you’ve always been invincible?"
"Did you come to the Lower Realm specifically to rescue us?"
Brother Cheng waved his hand with a smile, planning to say something pretentious, like the mere Immortal Emperor was nothing to worry about, completely not worth a fight, stay calm, stay calm.
But then the system notification suddenly sounded.
"Ding! Due to not matching the current plane, having mobilized excessive power in advance, the system is unstable and is about to forcibly reboot for an update."
"Reboot countdown: 59 minutes and 59 seconds."
Damn, it’ll forcibly reboot in an hour?
"System, during the reboot, what will happen to me?"
"The host will vanish into the void, fall into slumber, and be untraceable."
That’s acceptable, essentially a prolonged enhanced invisibility status.
At least it guarantees absolute safety during this period.
"How long will the reboot take?"
"Unknown."
"Can you give me an estimate? Will it take a year?"
"Yes."
Well, Brother Cheng has a plan now.
Looks like he really needs to ’go into forced seclusion’ for a while.
But no matter what, after this battle, the legend of brother will continue to spread throughout the world, right?
Thinking about needing a reason for ’forced seclusion’, he activated Immortal Yuan Power to make his face pale as paper.
He even coughed up a bit of blood, putting on a convincing show.
This frightened everyone.
"Sect Leader Jiang!"
"Sect Leader Jiang, what’s wrong with you?"
"Could it be that the battle with the Immortal Emperor just now cost you a great deal?"
"It must be. After all, it’s the Immortal Emperor. Never mind that Sect Leader Jiang won effortlessly, there must be hidden dangers that we can’t even imagine."
Everyone was deeply moved, and many cultivators had red eyes.
"Sect Leader Jiang sacrificed so much to protect us from harm!"
Lan Ti and Ji Linghan were the first to rush to Brother Cheng’s side, eagerly embracing him.
"Brother Cheng, please don’t scare me!"
"Tell me what I can do for you, quickly..."
"Sect Leader, you won’t be in trouble, you definitely won’t!"
Smelling the fragrance of the two beauties, with his head being squeezed by four snowy peaks simultaneously, Brother Cheng almost ascended on the spot.
Damn, had I known that playing the victim would lead to this treatment, what was I doing before?
When the system finishes updating later, I must try this more often.
However, when the tears of the two women fell on his face, he couldn’t help but feel a twinge of guilt.
Brother Cheng is careless with others; he treats everything as a game.
But with his own people, he’s earnest.
"Don’t worry..."
"I’m just overdrawn and need to go into forced seclusion for a while."
Lan Ti, Ji Linghan, and the other women finally wiped their tears and relaxed.
By now, Dingtian City had reappeared in the outside space.
The city’s residents looked skyward, still in shock from the Immortal Emperor’s pressure, utterly unaware of what had just happened.
Everyone re-entered the City Lord’s Mansion, with Sect Leader Jiang contemplating the long-term seclusion he needed, things needed arranging.
"Without a doubt, the death of the Nine Flames Immortal Emperor will draw attention from the Upper Immortal Realm."
"In the future, more Immortal Emperors might arrive."
"And I need a long time to recover, unable to face the enemy."
Sigh, no pretending to be grand for a while.
But this truth in everyone else’s ears meant something else.
Sect Leader Jiang really sacrificed too much for everyone.
Already severely injured, yet still concerned about everyone’s safety.
For a moment, many evil demon cultivators were deeply touched, regarding Brother Cheng as the only truly respected person in this life.
"So, Dingtian City... is not safe anymore."
Everyone had already realized this point.
"We need to leave here temporarily."
"If you’re willing, you can travel with my Sword Domain. While Sect Leader Jiang is in seclusion healing, my Sword Domain is willing to risk our lives to protect!"
Gui Cang Sword Immortal had good intentions.
In his opinion, Jiang Cheng wouldn’t have much self-preservation ability during recovery.
But before he could finish speaking, Bi Chang shoved him aside.
"Since when is it up to your Sword Domain? Of course, a brother should follow us, the Desolate Domain! Before we’re all dead in battle, not a hair of his will be harmed!"
Void Abyss chuckled coldly, "With your Desolate Race’s little brain, it’s fortunate if you don’t screw over the benefactor."
"How about coming with our Demon Domain. Heh, demon cultivators getting things done... you get it."
Bi Chang was enraged, "What do you mean?"
"I mean we can better protect Sect Leader Jiang!"
"Want to try fighting it out?"
Luo Yuan, Shan Tai, and others also stood out, "Don’t argue, Sect Leader already has us Feixian Sect disciples as guards! For life and death, as one, inseparable..."
Before they finished speaking, they were quickly drowned out by others’ voices.
"Come on."
"You guys are too inexperienced and young. Any experience of hardships? You’d get cheated and count money for the crooks."
This group respects Brother Cheng greatly, but not so much the Feixian Sect disciples.
For a moment, the great hall was in chaos.
Sect Leader Jiang helplessly clapped his hands.
"There’s no need for everyone to compete. During my seclusion healing, I am confident of ensuring my own safety."
"You can each disperse."
"Based on Nine Flames Immortal Emperor’s reaction today, they currently suspect only me as the ascender, unaware of any of you."
"That means if you leave here and scatter across the Middle Immortal Realm, you won’t arouse suspicion."
The Middle Immortal Realm, reportedly a hundred times larger than the Lower Immortal Realm.
Once dispersed, finding someone again is almost impossible.
Having said this, he looked to his group of disciples.
"It’s time for you to also go out and experience the world."
Originally, he planned to put them in the Xuanji Map.
But considering the words from Gui Cang and others were reasonable, cultivating behind closed doors without going out lacks something.
His wings can protect them for a while, but not for a lifetime.
"This is all I can do for you as Sect Leader."
His pretentious desire rose again, intentionally creating a scene of farewell as though it were grandly sad.
"In the future, you’ll rely on yourselves."
"During my absence, you must take good care of yourselves. The Feixian Sect’s pretentious sect culture, you must uphold and promote it wonderfully..."
Sect Leader Jiang’s act was over the top, heading straight for tear-jerking rhythm.
"Sect Leader..."
"Sob, sob, sob. When will we see you again?"
Feixian Sect disciples cried as one, and for a moment emotion filled the City Lord’s Mansion.
In a year, when the pretentious device reboots, the legend of brother will resound throughout the Immortal Realm again!
The crown of pretending king in the Immortal Realm belongs to this Sect Leader!
Yet in his performance high, he started spouting nonsense: "Maybe a hundred years, maybe a thousand, maybe ten thousand..."
After just a year apart, creating such pathos sounds like a joke—hardly enough to astound.

chapters.title: Chapter 256: Delivering Food
chapters.content:
Chapter 256: Chapter 256: Delivering Food
Hearing that it would take so long, the disciples cried even louder.
"We can’t bear to part with you!"
"Don’t worry, once I’m healed, you’ll hear my name again."
The disciples nodded vigorously.
Brother Cheng went to the Ascension Platform below, where Ah Huang and Xiaobai were still asleep.
Thinking about the next wave of Immortal Emperors possibly arriving soon, and not wanting to let them off easily, he put the two children into the Xuanji Map.
Only then did everyone rise, reluctant to leave Dingtian City.
But as soon as they flew into the air, the sound of wind and thunder rumbled from all sides, like dark clouds pressing down on a city.
"What’s happening?"
"What’s going on?"
"Is there another Immortal Emperor coming?"
Brother Cheng was also a bit frustrated, such a good atmosphere was ruined.
Who could be so blind?
The enemy soon appeared, and everyone realized they had guessed wrong.
Facing them was the City Lord of Five Seas City, along with tens of thousands of immortals from Five Seas City.
And beside them were the armies from Immortal Cities like Bitao City, Liehuang City, Brahma Emperor City, and Yin Yue City.
This time, the ten cities ascending to the Middle Immortal Realm were all present here.
"Didn’t expect we’d meet again so soon, did you?"
"I warned you last time, this first place isn’t so easy to take."
The City Lord of Five Seas City sneered coldly and slowly drew his Immortal Sword.
The City Lord of Bitao City also had a malicious look on his face.
"During the Ascension Battle, we couldn’t go to other Immortal Cities, letting you enjoy your success for so long."
"Now, it’s time for you to pay the debt."
"Did you really think taking first place would come without any cost?"
Though the ten ascending Immortal Cities weren’t far apart, they had the chance to contact each other, then gathered here in an imposing manner.
"What do you intend to do?"
Gui Cang Sword Immortal stepped forward.
"Asking what we intend to do?"
The City Lord of Brahma Emperor City laughed aloud.
"What do you think?"
"You wiped out so many Immortal Cities, now it’s your turn!"
"Winning without fighting looked impressive, didn’t it?"
"It’s no longer the Ascension Battle; let’s see how you plan to win now."
Gui Cang, Void Abyss, Bi Chang, and the others tensed up, knowing another huge crisis was upon them.
The current situation was different from the Ascension Battle.
In the Ascension Battle, a side could field at most 30,000; now it’s unrestricted, with no competition rules, and no surrender option.
Lose, and it’s death.
The nine Immortal Cities united, with more than 300,000 immortals.
Nearly a hundred Golden Immortals, and over seven thousand Profound Immortals.
While it wasn’t as despairing as the arrival of an Immortal Emperor, such a vast formation was certainly formidable.
The most crucial part was that without Sect Leader Jiang, no one in Dingtian City could face a Ninth-grade Golden Immortal alone.
Previously, it required a group effort.
Now with Sect Leader Jiang ’severely injured,’ even if they could break through this battle, it would be a devastating loss.
"What is your intent?"
Gui Cang Sword Immortal slightly lowered his brows and said slowly: "In the Ascension Battle, life and death are determined by Celestial Fate, and everything was within the rules."
"Gathering after the battle to seek vengeance, is it because you can’t afford to lose?"
"So what if it is?"
The City Lord of Five Seas City smirked and gestured, surrounding them quietly with numerous Profound Immortals and Celestial Immortals.
"Blame yourselves for being too high-profile."
"If you had just been content with seventh or eighth place, that would have been it. Did you think you could take first place?"
The City Lord of Yin Yue City chuckled lightly, teasingly, "You should be proud; in all the Ascension Battles, this is the first time an Immortal City has provoked the united fury of the other nine."
"To be attacked and killed by us nine families, you should feel honored."
In fact, there was no deep-seated hatred between them and Dingtian City; after all, they had conceded defeats back then.
What mattered most was that during that period, Dingtian City had incited too much fear among the other Immortal Cities.
Being challenged meant the City Lord might be killed instantly, the entire army decimated, or the Essence Core destroyed, none of which they could withstand.
This fear had been building up, and now with Five Seas City taking the lead, of course, everyone responded.
They were unaware that an Immortal Emperor had just fallen here.
But truthfully, upon arriving here, they were still quite taken aback.
To find Dingtian City with more than 100,000 immortals, and even the True Immortals didn’t seem ordinary.
This battle would indeed require some effort.
Brother Cheng listened for a while, and seeing the system restart time approaching.
If he didn’t make a move soon, it would be too late.
Leaving these people would only bring disaster to his disciples.
Thus, he stood up again.
As he flew out, tens of thousands across from him stepped back in unison.
A man’s name casts his shadow; if they weren’t wary of Jiang Cheng, they would have immediately started killing instead of engaging in banter.
"Sect Leader Jiang!"
Gui Cang, Void Abyss, Bi Chang, and others gazed worriedly at his familiar back.
Always so reliable, but this time he was severely injured!
"This time, let us handle it!"
"Yes, you’ve already done so much for us..."
"Even if we die in battle, we’ll carve a bloody path for you!"
Everyone clenched their fists, eyes filled with a determination to die.
For heaven’s sake, do you all have to be so righteous?
Bro wasn’t even hurt a bit; it’s just the pretending device about to reboot.
This last chance to show off, could you please not compete with me for it?
"Cough, cough!"
He deliberately coughed up a big mouthful of blood.
Since everyone was already moved, why not move them even more.
Looking back at everyone’s expressions, he wore a calm smile, accepting fate.
"For everyone, I’m willing to burn my last bit of strength."
With that, he activated the tenfold critical strike.
No choice, the system was rebooting, and who knew if he’d resurrect after being killed.
Better to use the skills he already mastered to be safe.
And the City Lord of Five Seas City and others on the opposite side, upon seeing this, couldn’t help but rejoice greatly!
"Haha, you’re already seriously injured?"
"Jiang Cheng, this must be Celestial Fate!"
With this ’big killer’ being so weak, their last bit of concern dissipated.
"Kill!"
The City Lord of Five Seas City and the City Lord of Bitao City simultaneously gave the order, then tens of thousands of immortals over there surged forward, covering the sky and ground.
The world once again shifted colors.
The multi-colored glows of magical treasures and Immortal Artifacts veiled the skies, exuding a terrifying aura capable of obliterating everything ahead.
When numbers reach a certain amount, a qualitative change occurs.
And under the myriad radiance, a lonely figure raised their Immortal Sword in front.
Ninth-grade Immortal Sword—Rainbow Extreme.
"Sect Leader Jiang!"
Gui Cang, Void Abyss, Bi Chang, and others could no longer stay behind.
Forcing a move in such an injured state would, at best, destroy their foundation, and at worst, lead to an immediate fall.
Moreover, the enemy in this battle was second only to the previous Immortal Emperor.
Everyone activated their Daoist Hearts, madly surging towards those tens of thousands, only wanting to shield Brother Cheng.
The Feixian Sect disciples were even more heartbroken.
"Sect Leader..."
"No..."
Hand rises!
Sword falls!
The entire sky suddenly turned a pale white.
All targets within the cover of this sword strike appeared like overexposed shadows, leaving only black silhouettes.
Then, tens of thousands of shadows were simultaneously torn apart, disappearing at a speed visible to the naked eye.
Above the void, a massive gap was slowly closing.
And within it, no living creature remained.

chapters.title: Chapter 257: A New System
chapters.content:
Chapter 257: Chapter 257: A New System
Brother Cheng is now a First Grade Golden Immortal.
Under the support of so many BUFFs, his full-force strike was already not something the Golden Immortal level could withstand.
Even Immortal Venerables would be at risk of their lives.
What’s more, he had triggered a tenfold Critical Strike.
The outcome of the battle was never in doubt from the beginning.
He just didn’t understand why these people had to foolishly come to die.
Clearly, if they hadn’t come, everyone could have stayed in peace.
The Ascension Battle was over; he wasn’t brutal enough to go slaughtering the Great Immortal Cities.
But he couldn’t resist when the other side offered themselves up.
The originally intended desperate fight from Gui Cang, Void Abyss, and Golden Dragon King stopped.
Everyone was staring blankly at the empty hole still exuding a destructive aura...
Was it resolved just like that?
With just one sword?
Over three hundred thousand immortals annihilated all at once?
Although Sect Leader Jiang had recently taken down an Immortal Emperor, far stronger than this group of immortals.
The level of visual shock it brought was still different.
The process of taking down the Immortal Emperor was too strange for them to understand at all.
But this sword strike now was an unmistakable frontal attack.
Immediately, they noticed Sect Leader Jiang’s figure beginning to blur and fade.
"Ding, the system is overloaded, entering reboot and update state in advance!"
The others didn’t know this; their first reaction was that it was over.
Sect Leader Jiang was about to fall.
"Sect Leader!"
"Sect Leader Jiang!"
The crowd screamed and wept, but it was of no use.
Brother Cheng was also in pain; damn, he hadn’t collected the spoils yet!
He wanted to grab a few things before falling asleep, but it was impossible.
He couldn’t touch anything, nor could he affect the outside world in any way.
It was as if he was no longer in the same plane as the world before him.
He could only struggle to signal Mo Chen, Ji Linghan, and Lan Ti, reminding them to be smart, and not let the profits flow to outsiders!
But at this time, all of Feixian Sect was immersed in deep sorrow and pain.
Crying filled the sky, tears like rain, like mourning...
No one was in the mood to think about taking advantage.
Even Gui Cang, Void Abyss, and others were hit hard.
"Sect Leader..."
"No..."
When Sect Leader Jiang’s figure completely disappeared from this world, many disciples of Feixian Sect even fainted.
"Sect Leader Jiang... where did he go?"
Gui Cang Sword Immortal also became lost and looked blankly into the void, seeming even older.
Bi Chang’s tiger eyes welled with tears, and his clenched fists trembled involuntarily.
Void Abyss bowed his proud head and remained silent for a long time.
Who could have guessed out of nowhere this was the so-called ’healing’? They only knew Sect Leader Jiang disappeared from this world.
He was... gone.
The Three-Eyed Tiger became serious for the first time.
Silently moving all the disciples of Feixian Sect onto his back.
"Let’s go, let’s go!"
The Golden Dragon King sighed deeply, looking at everyone present.
"Sooner or later, other Immortal Emperors will come, and if we don’t leave now, our benefactor’s sacrifice will be in vain."
Only then did people start leaving Dingtian City in twos and threes.
They dispersed in all directions of the Middle Immortal Realm.
Like droplets of water merging into the sea.
Soon after they left, Dingtian City was indeed once again covered by several terrifying auras.
But the people were gone, and they gained nothing this time.
...
Jiang Cheng’s consciousness gradually fell into a deep sleep.
When he awoke again, stretching casually, he felt like he’d only slept for a night.
"Ding, the system update is complete, now fully compatible with the current plane."
The familiar system prompt sounded in his mind.
"Ding, the system has converted all Points to Merit Points, as the new upgrade material."
Brother Cheng wasn’t surprised at all.
Merit Points, huh, another common thing.
However, they were quite valuable: 1 Merit Point = 10 billion Points.
He seriously suspected it was because the system panel couldn’t fit so many zeros, hence this superficial change.
Now he only had 535 Merit Points.
Fortunately, the next system upgrade only required 100 Merit Points.
"Ding, from now on, hosts can ask questions without spending Merit."
Brother Cheng casually grumbled: "About time!"
"Ding, due to subordinates’ upgrades that earned Points, which was a system bug, it’s now fixed. In the future, you’ll only get one-time rewards for recruiting new subordinates."
What the hell?
What does that mean?
No more Points or Merit from disciples’ upgrades in the future?
Brother Cheng was about to curse; he was counting on waking up to billions more Points.
Given Ji Linghan, Lan Ti, and others’ First-class Talent, they might have leveled up several times during his slumber.
"System, come out, what’s going on? What’s this about a bug?"
The system responded firmly with just one line: "The host knows full well."
It really wasn’t wrong.
Brother Cheng had long discovered this bug.
Improving disciples’ talents and then having them level up was essentially a money-making business.
A little cost yielded hundredfold and thousandfold returns.
The keystone was, these Points required no effort from him; it was like earning while lying down.
So he had maintained the habit of enhancing one disciple’s Talent daily in previous years.
Frankly, it was farming a bug.
Unexpectedly, this loophole had long been noticed by the system, no wonder it kept demanding a restart.
"Due to incomplete system causes, no penalties for the host’s malicious bug exploitation; the earned profits won’t be reclaimed."
Brother Cheng, irritated, retorted: "Should I thank you then?"
"To compensate, the host will have unlimited daily resurrections, up to one billion uses."
"Now that sounds like a human being."
Brother Cheng’s mood slightly improved, with no limit on daily resurrections, it was much freer.
"Then how will I earn Points—Oh no, Merits— from now on?"
"Catering to the host’s preference, the system has thoughtfully introduced the Shock Value feature, which will score and reward Merit based on the level of shock you cause others."
Brother Cheng was dumbfounded.
Seriously, they developed this?
The system was quite skilled.
This feature was tailor-made for someone like him, the King Bi.
He used to regret that the system didn’t evaluate based on acting cool, but now they actually satisfied this desire.
He was best at astonishing others by acting cool!
Though previously annoyed by the bug fix, he immediately found joy.
"Hahaha, my parents may have given birth to me, but it’s the system that truly understands me!"
"That’s good, I haven’t wasted my time nurturing you, little thing."
System: "..."
Looking carefully at the system panel now, there were quite a few changes.
The previous lottery function remained, and the shop allowing direct exchanges of Merit for rewards was logically present.
It featured Level 4 Rule Fragments, Level 5 Rule Fragments, Immortal Beast Essence Blood, Immortal King Level Techniques, Ninth-grade Immortal Artifacts—all in one.
After watching for a while, he silently closed the shop.
Better find someone to shock, to earn some Merit!

chapters.title: Chapter 258: Clearing the Boss?
chapters.content:
Chapter 258: Chapter 258: Clearing the Boss?
With 535 points of merit in hand, Jiang Cheng first upgraded the system.
Level: 11
Merit: 0/10000
Available Merit: 435
Current Skills: The host can consume merit points to upgrade dead objects.
Note: The higher the target’s value, the more merit points consumed.
Subordinate Skills: The host can consume merit points to borrow any target’s skills.
Note: The higher the strength of the borrowed skills, the more merit points consumed.
Borrow?
Does this mean that as long as I have enough merit points, I can use Dragon Breath like the Golden Dragon King in the future?
And use Sword Heart like the Gui Cang Sword Immortal?
Thinking about it, it’s indeed a tool for showing off.
But...
"System, come out quickly and explain to me why the next level has increased a hundredfold?"
"Since asking questions now doesn’t consume points or merit, the system may choose not to answer certain questions."
What the hell? Playing this trick?
"Why don’t you answer?"
"Are you too embarrassed to face me?"
"You piece of junk!"
"Jealous of how fast I earn points?"
Being scolded like this, the system endured it and simply played dead.
Damn!
Brother Cheng wished he could pull it out and beat it up.
Then he thought of his two kids, still inside the Xuanji Map.
Quickly released them.
"Mom, where are we?"
"It’s so desolate here, Dad."
The two kids looked around, circling him as soon as they got out.
Indeed, they were in the middle of a desolate wasteland. Using his Immortal Soul, Jiang Cheng scanned the area and didn’t see a trace of anything.
But it didn’t matter, since his power was intact, and he figured it was a good time to educate the kids.
"You two finally woke up!"
"Do you know how close we were to failing the last Ascension Battle?"
"You guys were so capable before, always urging me to challenge!"
"And what happened?"
"Without a word, suddenly you couldn’t fight."
"Do you know what this behavior is called? On the battlefield, this is desertion, and it gets you executed!"
He waved his right hand, spittle flying.
"Thought I could count on you two, but in the end, you just fell asleep!"
"If it weren’t for Dad turning the tide single-handedly, how could we face the folks back home if we failed?"
The two kids were dumbfounded by the scolding.
Xiaobai stood still obediently, head lowered in a reflective stance.
Ah Huang was much more nimble.
"Oh dear, why isn’t there a single spirit vein around here?"
She held her forehead, staggering slightly.
"Mom, it’s so uncomfortable out here; let’s go back inside."
After saying this, without caring about Brother Cheng’s expression, she dragged Xiaobai back into the Xuanji Map.
Sect Leader Jiang was a bit puzzled.
Isn’t he the owner of the map?
How could they enter the Xuanji Map without his permission?
How come it’s like a public bus, coming and going as they please?
But those two kids weren’t normal beings anyway, so he didn’t bother to think much about it.
Calming his heart, he scanned the surroundings again.
Then he picked a random direction and flew straight out.
He hadn’t flown far before a bear-headed, winged, hundred-footed strange demon beast appeared ahead.
This demon beast didn’t appear large, only a few dozen meters, but was exceptionally agile.
Jiang Cheng gave a casual blow, but it evaded.
Quickly after, he was engulfed by countless chaotic wind blades.
Standing amidst the wind blades, Brother Cheng sensed that the attack’s intensity was roughly equivalent to an ordinary First Grade Profound Immortal, unable to scratch him.
Itching?
"Tired of fighting yet?"
Impatiently, he drew his Immortal Sword and swung it.
With one swing, a more violent storm roared out.
The raging wind blades in front seemed like paper scraps blown by a tempest, scattering and disintegrating.
The demon beast had no resistance, being swept away and killed on the spot.
"Seriously."
"Can’t it be over already!"
While complaining, Brother Cheng planned to see if there was any loot.
Parts of the demon beast like bones, blood, and pelts were mostly useful, either for alchemy or artifact refining, not to mention the more valuable demon pill.
His previous destructive sword strike might have seemed huge, but he actually restrained its power, controlling the damage extent.
Yet upon cleaning up the battlefield, he found not even a trace left.
The demon beast’s corpse was gone.
"What the heck?"
"Something like this can happen right under my nose?"
With reluctance, he searched around to no avail and could only choose to abandon it.
After flying some distance further, another demon beast appeared ahead.
Again, it lunged without any intention for conversation or restraint.
Moreover, this demon beast’s power was similar to the last one, only with a different attack method.
Jiang Cheng couldn’t be bothered to draw his sword, casually waving his hand to easily destroy it.
This time he observed carefully, noticing that after being killed, the demon beast rapidly turned into an illusion and dissolved into the air.
"This..."
This didn’t seem like a real demon beast; rather, it felt like a ’combat machine’ created by someone.
After effortlessly dispatching more than ten demon beasts along the way, he confirmed his suspicion.
Because after killing one demon beast, not only did it dissolve, but it also dropped a jade talisman.
Probing with Immortal Soul, it was identified as a regular jade talisman engraved with array patterns, probably some kind of token.
"Am I in some Trial Secret Realm now?"
"System, is this a trial you’ve set up for me?"
He felt a bit dissatisfied because these were all mindless dead objects, unable to cause any shock when slain.
The more important thing was the lack of loot.
To someone who acts only when there’s something to gain, fighting for nothing felt too costly.
"No."
The system’s answer was concise.
"How strange."
Brother Cheng continued exploring and after defeating over 30 demon beasts, he had accumulated four jade talismans.
Then, a demon beast Purple Simurgh appeared ahead.
When its wings expanded, the distant void not only echoed with thunderous winds but also overshadowed the sky, far grander and mightier than the preceding demon beasts.
Its mere size was tens of thousands of times larger.
Could this be the passage BOSS?
Surely killing the BOSS would drop something?
Brother Cheng got his spirits up, once more summoning his Immortal Sword.
Before the Purple Simurgh could approach, he cleaved with a strike.
A near-transparent virtual line stretched from sky to earth, in a moment slicing through the center of the Purple Simurgh’s pointed beak.
Then slicing out from its tail end, finally dissipating into nothing.
Thump!
The flying Purple Simurgh split in two, spilling copious amounts of fresh blood, like a torrential downpour.
Brother Cheng casually sheathed his sword.
The passage BOSS was indeed different from the previous ones; the earlier slain demon beasts didn’t shed a drop of blood.
The Purple Simurgh had both flesh and blood, seemingly even crying out before dying.
What a pity, knowing it was a living being, I should’ve left it intact.
Now with my sword, its skeleton and demon pill are all destroyed.
Just as he was considering checking out if there were any usable materials left, he heard a shrill cry from high above.
"Xiaozhi!"
"Ah..."
The bifurcated body of the Purple Simurgh fell, revealing a young woman in a green dress on its back.
This woman’s skin was as fair as snow, her features painted like a picture, truly stunning.
Yet at this moment, her beautiful eyes were filled with either grief or murderous intent.
Glaring at Brother Cheng below with hatred, the Immortal Sword in her hand grew increasingly bright, as if looking at a deadly enemy.

chapters.title: Chapter 259 I Was Wrong, Senior
chapters.content:
Chapter 259: Chapter 259 I Was Wrong, Senior
Ah, what?
Brother Cheng felt a bit awkward.
Turns out this Purple Simurgh has an owner?
Did I just kill someone else’s mount with a sword?
"Ahem, sorry, miss, I made a mistake. I thought it was a trial monster."
Although he’s known for being quite destructive, Brother Cheng won’t deny his own mistakes.
But clearly, this answer didn’t satisfy the beautiful lady in the green dress.
"You killed Xiaozhi!"
"You vile person actually killed my Xiaozhi!"
Her eyes, filled with fury, were already red, with two lines of sparkling tears quietly rolling down.
The accompanying Immortal Sword also became brighter.
Seeing the girl’s heartbroken appearance, Brother Cheng felt a rare twinge of guilt.
After all, he destroyed her beloved treasure.
"How about this, miss? Leave me a contact, and I’ll catch an even stronger one to compensate you in the future."
"Compensate?"
The lady’s teeth were grinding so hard they were about to break, and her voice came out through clenched teeth.
"There won’t be another Xiaozhi in this world. Use your life as compensation!"
"Not necessarily."
Brother Cheng suddenly remembered he had a Resurrection Skill.
Not wanting to trouble himself further, he decided to simply resurrect the Purple Simurgh.
The result was a pop-up window appearing as he activated the skill—targets killed by the host personally cannot be resurrected.
This...
"No words left to say, huh!"
"You murderer!"
As she maneuvered the Immortal Sword, a Magical Treasure spun and landed over Brother Cheng’s head, enveloping him in a space of several dozen meters.
"Let’s talk reasonably, miss. Don’t resort to violence right away."
Admitting his mistake, he, who once vanquished countless immortals, instantly turned into a pacifist.
"Harmony is precious, and there’s no conflict in the world that can’t be resolved."
Brother Cheng didn’t draw his sword because the lady’s murderous aura posed no real threat to him.
"Actually, I have some questions for you, like where is this place..."
Upon hearing this, the lady’s killing intent didn’t weaken; instead, it grew stronger.
"I forgot you weren’t part of my sect!"
"Breaking into our Demon-slaying Tower with malicious intent! Even if you hadn’t killed Xiaozhi, I wouldn’t have let you go!"
"What is the Demon-slaying Tower?"
Just as Brother Cheng was about to ask, the lady attacked directly.
Beside him, a golden river formed by the Sword Power swept past, swallowing him completely.
Accompanied by an omnipresent Immortal Soul attack.
Brother Cheng sensed a little, realizing that the lady was a Golden Immortal, even a Second-Grade Golden Immortal.
Her power was quite acceptable, slightly stronger than an ordinary Third-Grade Golden Immortal.
The lady above subtly breathed a sigh of relief.
Her Purple Simurgh was a Profound Immortal-level Immortal Beast, killed by this person in one strike, without even having time to react for help, showing his strong abilities.
If not for her overwhelming anger, she would have at least probed whether she could win first.
Now, seeing Jiang Cheng enveloped by her attack, his figure trapped within the Magical Treasure, and her Immortal Soul penetrating deep inside, she was finally at ease.
This was a sure-kill situation, and the person certainly couldn’t escape.
As she had this thought, Brother Cheng’s voice came from behind her.
"Is this all the strength you have?"
"You!"
She was startled. How could this be?
How did he escape from the Magical Treasure?
Her Immortal Soul had entered his Sea of Consciousness, so why couldn’t she detect him?
Just as she was about to turn back and attack, Sect Leader Jiang wouldn’t give her another chance.
Lacking any masochistic tendency to let others harm him, he easily subdued the Second-Grade Golden Immortal lady with a wave of his hand.
Then quickly disarmed her, taking all her Immortal Sword and Magical Treasure.
Upon inspection, it was merely a Fourth-Grade Immortal Sword and Top-grade Magical Treasure, and he lost interest immediately.
"Told you to talk reasonably, why do this to yourself?"
Thrown to the ground by him, the lady was dizzy and disoriented, unable to move.
Her anger and hatred flashed on her face but quickly transformed into a pitiable look, even squeezing out a slight smile.
"I was blind, elder, spare me."
Whoa?
Even as experienced as Brother Cheng, he was taken aback.
Girl, your change in demeanor is too fast!
Just moments ago, you were heartbroken, filled with deep hatred, wanting to tear me apart.
And now you’re pleading?
While understanding that it’s wise and timely to plead when defeated, he still found it hard to accept the sudden change.
It’s too abrupt, especially because you’re not a male.
"Aren’t you avenging your grudge?"
The lady immediately gave a sweet smile: "I have no grudge with you, elder. It was a misunderstanding. I hope you can overlook it."
Sect Leader Jiang almost choked on her words.
He gritted his teeth, purposefully saying: "But you had the right reason, killing your Immortal Beast was indeed wrong of me."
The woman immediately retorted loudly: "You’re joking, elder. Killing mere Immortal Beast is its fortune."
Brother Cheng felt his teeth aching.
He’s never met a woman of this style before.
Isn’t your ability to adapt a bit too much?
This performance, if the Oscars don’t give you ten Best Actress awards, they’re blind.
Actually, he could tell that the lady hadn’t truly let go of it; the flash of hatred upon capture was still vivid.
Right now, she’s probably holding on to the idea of revenge someday?
But for someone with over a billion lives, he didn’t mind, and even hoped she’d improve her skills to kill him a few more times.
He chuckled with interest: "Now you know you were wrong?"
"Mm-hmm, I was wrong, please forgive me, elder."
"Forgiveness is out of the question. If you’re wrong, you need to be punished, don’t you think?"
Not waiting for her agreement, Brother Cheng stripped her down to her underwear and took her Immortal Sword, Magical Treasure, and stored them all.
Having a post-battle loot is his style.
"Elder, you..."
Her eyes flickered with anger once again, but she soon trembled, fearing he’d do something terrible.
Though, she clearly misunderstood.
Brother Cheng simply grabbed her hand, removing her last Storage Ring.
He planned to leave, but then noticed her figure became blurry and vanished from the original spot.
"What’s happening?"
"Did she get automatically transmitted out of this Demon-slaying Tower?"
Frowning, he probed the Storage Ring, finding Immortal Crystals, Pills, Immortal Talismans, and 8 pieces of identical Jade Talismans.
Were these Jade Talismans proof of staying inside the Demon-slaying Tower? Without them, you can’t remain inside?
But he had originally obtained the Jade Talisman only after encountering a trial monster, so why didn’t he get automatically transmitted out back then?
With that, he sensed a transmission force pulling him constantly.

chapters.title: Chapter 260 Demon-slaying Tower
chapters.content:
Chapter 260: Chapter 260 Demon-slaying Tower
He let go of his resistance, deciding to see where he would be transported.
In the blink of an eye, he too disappeared from the original place and appeared in another space.
Sect Leader Jiang understood that this Demon-slaying Tower was likely to ascend layer by layer.
Gathering a certain number of jade talismans would automatically elevate him to the next level. He should be on a higher level now.
Sure enough, this time he didn’t fly far before new trial monsters appeared ahead.
And this time, the trial monsters’ power had already reached the Fifth-Grade Profound Immortal level.
As Brother Cheng continued fighting monsters, it got lively outside.
Outside this Trial Tower, thousands of elders and tens of thousands of disciples were standing.
At the forefront, Sect Leader Yuan Zhen Immortal Venerable was resting his eyes.
Meanwhile, the disciples were discussing the battle results of this Demon-slaying Tower adventure.
The Demon-slaying Tower was considered an important assessment of their sect.
This tower had thirteen levels, and every hundred years, the sect would hold a trial tower test for all its disciples.
The achievement was based on the final level reached.
Jiang Cheng guessed correctly; gathering ten jade talismans on each level would allow one to ascend a level.
The disciples outside were those who had been eliminated.
Each assessment lasted a hundred days, and only ten days had passed now, but those remaining inside were at least of the Inner Sect Disciple level.
Everyone valued this assessment greatly.
Because it determined the status change in the next hundred years, whether one became a True Disciple, an Inner Sect Disciple, or an Outer Disciple.
The first floor was easy; the trial demon beasts inside were only at Saint Tier, and almost everyone could successfully kill dozens, then smoothly enter the second floor.
On reaching the second floor, the trial monsters were at First Grade True Immortal level.
"Alas, I just gathered nine Demon-Slaying Talismans on the seventh level, almost reached the eighth floor."
"That’s indeed a pity. I also thought, Senior Brother Zhang, you could become an Inner Sect Disciple in one go this time."
The seventh floor’s monsters were Ninth-Grade Celestial Immortal level, and the eighth floor was the First Grade Profound Immortal level Jiang Cheng was previously on.
This was considered a watershed.
Once crossing it, one could directly become an Inner Sect Disciple.
"Who wouldn’t agree?"
That Senior Brother Zhang was also frustrated: "I just finished killing a demon beast and hadn’t had time to recover when I found another trial monster nearby, which was infuriating."
In the Demon-slaying Tower, one would not die after being killed.
However, if he wanted to become an Inner Sect Disciple, he would have to wait another hundred years, which was naturally quite depressing.
"Who do you think will take the top spot this time?"
"Do you even need to ask? It must be Senior Brother Leng Huahan, the first among True Disciples and a direct disciple of the Great Elder!"
"That may not be the case. Don’t forget Senior Sister Gu Qingyu! She is also the Sect Leader’s only direct disciple!"
"Right, right, Senior Sister Gu Qingyu joined only three hundred thousand years ago and is already a Second-Grade Golden Immortal."
"Such talent is truly rare!"
"This time, the top spot in the assessment is a contest between the two of them."
"Naturally!"
"I wonder which level they’ll reach."
"Reaching the eleventh level would be at the True Disciple level."
"Senior Brother Leng and Senior Sister Gu have many means and should at least reach the twelfth level."
The discussions grew even more heated, and many were exclaiming in surprise.
"The twelfth floor!"
"That’s not easy!"
The testing monsters on the eleventh level were at First-Grade Golden Immortal level. To reach the twelfth floor, one needed to defeat at least 30 trial monsters on the eleventh level.
Though Golden Immortal cultivators have weapons, magical treasures, and immortal talismans, the environments become increasingly complex.
Encounters with two or three monsters at once are not uncommon.
This affair also hinges on luck; it’s not just about power.
Moreover, factors like injury and recovery come into play, which is why disciples who make it to the twelfth level are exceptionally rare.
The vast majority of True Disciples stopped at the eleventh level.
This time, Leng Huahan and Gu Qingyu were rare geniuses with extraordinary fortune, thus being held in high expectation.
Listening to their discussions, Sect Leader Yuan Zhen Immortal Venerable smiled while stroking his beard.
Gu Qingyu was his disciple, and he knew her well.
The twelfth floor?
Her combat power shouldn’t only be judged by her apparent realm; she has the strength to contend even with Fourth-Grade Golden Immortals.
The twelfth floor’s trial monsters were at Fourth-Grade Golden Immortal level.
If her luck isn’t bad and she performs exceptionally, she might even create a miracle and reach the thirteenth floor!
As the Sect Leader, he also harbored a bit of competitiveness.
If his disciple stunned the entire sect, wouldn’t that shine a light on the master too?
In the Demon-slaying Tower, disciples who ’died in battle’ would occasionally be transmitted out.
Some were happy, some were worried.
Sporadically, cheers erupted from the crowd—it was someone who, after years of effort, had finally reached the eighth floor, becoming an Inner Sect Disciple.
At times, sighs were heard; some regressed and fell back from Inner Sect Disciple to Outer Disciple.
Yuan Zhen Immortal Venerable remained expressionless.
The Sect Founder himself had once said that an immortal’s talent and effort were important.
But the most crucial was fortune.
This fortune is ephemeral and elusive, yet it truly exists.
When venturing outside, how could it be so coincidental that only a single equal-rank enemy would duel with you each time?
So, this seemingly unfair trial might actually be the most realistic.
He glanced at the leaderboard, where both Gu Qingyu and Leng Huahan were still on the eighth level.
With their strength, they could have quickly entered the ninth level.
However, both weren’t foolish and knew that the hard battles were yet to come.
They needed to conserve strength and adjust timely, rather than exert their full effort from the start to charge ahead.
He nodded slightly, intending to continue resting his eyes during the exam, which lasts dozens of days.
Just then, an overwhelming wave of cheers erupted from the crowd, interrupting his meditation.
"Senior Sister Gu!"
"What, Senior Sister Gu is out already?"
"How is that possible?"
"It’s only the eighth floor!"
"The trial monsters on the eighth floor, couldn’t Senior Sister Gu have easily defeated them?"
"And what about Senior Sister Gu’s mount?"
Amid endless discussions, an elder sternly shouted in anger.
"Silence, focus your attention!"
Gu Qingyu didn’t appear to be in a good state.
She looked disconsolate, wearing only underwear, as if she’d been violated.
Could this be real?
"Who did this?"
Yuan Zhen Immortal Venerable quickly flew over, placed an outer robe on his disciple, his old face filled with fury.
His Immortal Venerable’s aura expanded, seething with killing intent.
The entire scene fell silent, chilled, with many disciples trembling and their immortal souls shaking.
Inside the Demon-slaying Tower, trial monsters had no intelligence—it wouldn’t be plausible for them to perform such a ’detailed task’ as removing clothes, would it?
Could it have been another disciple?
"Could it be... Leng Huahan!"
Yuan Zhen Immortal Venerable’s face turned ashen, and being eliminated on the eighth floor was secondary.
The most crucial thing was Gu Qingyu’s current state, suggesting a more serious issue.
Speaking of Leng Huahan as a suspect, he couldn’t quite believe it himself.
However, besides trial monsters, only sect disciples were inside the Demon-slaying Tower.
Among the True Disciples, the only one capable of threatening Gu Qingyu was Leng Huahan.

chapters.title: Chapter 261: There Are Still People Inside the Tower
chapters.content:
Chapter 261: Chapter 261: There Are Still People Inside the Tower
The Great Elder, Immortal Venerable Yuan Sheng, hurriedly flew over.
"Sect Leader, please see clearly. Hua Han was personally nurtured by me. I know that child very well; he would never do such a thing."
"If it really were him, I would not spare him lightly!"
Gu Qingyu, who had just put on her outer robe again, finally regained her senses at this moment.
"It wasn’t him..."
"Then who? Were you besieged by other disciples?"
Immortal Venerable Yuan Zhen clenched his teeth, and the expressions of the other sect leaders were incredibly grave.
If such a thing indeed happened, it would be even more serious.
It would signify that among the most elite disciples of the sect, there appeared to be a large number of black sheep, enough to threaten the future foundation of the sect.
"No, it wasn’t."
Finally returning under the protection of her sect’s seniors, Gu Qingyu rekindled her hatred.
She said harshly, "That person is not a disciple of our sect; he must be a villain sent by another sect!"
"What!"
"Another sect?"
"Without the aura of our sect’s disciples, he simply couldn’t have entered the Demon-slaying Tower."
"How did he sneak in?"
Everyone was baffled.
Prior to this trial, the Demon-slaying Tower hadn’t been opened at all, and outsiders couldn’t have lurked in beforehand.
Even if they did get in, triggering the Demon-slaying Tower in advance would have drawn attention.
During the opening, the Sect Leader and all the elders were standing outside the tower, so there was no chance to slip in.
However, that was no longer the important part.
What mattered is that an ill-intentioned enemy had appeared within the tower.
"Once the Demon-slaying Tower is activated, except for the day the trial is opened, one cannot enter midway."
The Second Elder, Primordial City Immortal Venerable, tightened his expression and urgently asked, "What kind of power does this person possess?"
Gu Qingyu thought carefully for a while, "At least a Seventh-grade Golden Immortal?"
Recalling the situation at that time, Jiang Cheng was able to restrain her easily, must be above Fifth Grade.
Estimating him as a Seventh-grade Golden Immortal was already giving him quite some credit.
"What!"
"Seventh-grade Golden Immortal?"
"The strongest among the disciples inside is only Leng Huahan, who is a Third-grade Golden Immortal!"
"What should we do?"
"If this person slaughters our sect’s true disciples inside, wouldn’t that result in a great disaster?"
This Demon-slaying Tower is an heirloom Immortal Treasure, passed down through many generations within the sect.
Though these elders are Immortal Venerables, they cannot interfere with the trial inside.
The sect also has several Eighth-grade and Ninth-grade Golden Immortals, but they are elders and naturally did not enter the Demon-slaying Tower to participate in the trial this time.
And now, midway through the trial, they can’t go in even if they want to.
"Stop the trial, close the Demon-slaying Tower!"
Immortal Venerable Yuan Zhen decided promptly.
The other elders nodded in succession; at this point, the trial was no longer important.
The priority was to weed out foreign enemies.
With a command, the towering stone tower dimmed down, and a large number of disciples still struggling inside the tower were passively transmitted out.
Many wore bewildered expressions.
"I wasn’t killed, so why was I eliminated?"
"Yeah, I was in the middle of a fight; what’s going on?"
"Darn, I was just about to ascend to the eighth level..."
Leng Huahan, who was on par with Gu Qingyu, also flew over.
"Master, what happened?"
The Great Elder, Immortal Venerable Yuan Sheng, glanced at the cold-faced disciple and solemnly said, "An outsider snuck into the tower."
"An outsider?"
Leng Huahan’s icy eyes narrowed slightly, his blade-like eyebrows slightly furrowed.
"How could an outsider enter the Demon-slaying Tower?"
"I don’t know either, but Gu Qingyu encountered that person and was controlled."
Upon hearing this, a tremor involuntarily shook Leng Huahan’s rigid face as he finally displayed emotion.
If the other could control Gu Qingyu, then he might also fall for the same trick.
All the disciples had retreated to the rear, and the sect’s Great Array and Restriction were activated.
All the elders wielded Immortal Artifacts, setting up formations, fully prepared for battle.
Sect Leader Immortal Venerable Yuan Zhen had even brought out the Magical Treasure, the Li Yuan Mirror.
Under the light of this treasure, any disguise or transformation would be revealed.
In the sky above, beams of silver light swept not only over the elders and disciples but didn’t spare even a speck of dust on the ground.
However, they found nothing.
Under the Li Yuan Mirror, everyone revealed their true form, all were disciples of the sect; there were no external enemies present.
Elders and senior disciples from various peaks and halls all accounted for their disciples, and everything matched up.
No one was missing, nor was there anyone extra.
The disciples were buzzing with discussions as they learned of a foreign enemy infiltrating the tower.
"Now that the Demon-slaying Tower is closed, why hasn’t that person appeared?"
"Yeah, when the Demon-slaying Tower closes, those inside are expelled."
"Could that person be invisible?"
"Invisible? Even if invisible, they couldn’t hide under the Li Yuan Mirror."
"Then where are they?"
"Could Senior Sister Gu have been mistaken? Maybe there wasn’t any foreign enemy after all."
"That seems unlikely..."
Leng Huahan approached Gu Qingyu.
"Junior Sister Gu, are you sure there was no mistake at that time?"
This voice of questioning represented the opinion of most present.
Gu Qingyu’s expression changed, and she coldly said, "Senior Brother Leng, what do you mean? Are you accusing me of lying?"
"I mean no such thing, I’m merely doubtful of your strength."
Leng Huahan spoke expressionlessly, "Perhaps you experienced a Qigong Deviation inside the tower, causing your Immortal Soul to be disturbed, leading to hallucinations."
Gu Qingyu almost exploded with anger.
Her precious Immortal Beast was killed right in front of her, and she still remembered the visage of that thief distinctly; how could it possibly be a hallucination?
"Leng Huahan, do you want to compare skills with me?"
In her fury, she even omitted the honorific "Senior Brother."
Over the years, there had been a fierce rivalry between Leng Huahan and her.
One was the True Disciple, the other the Sect Leader’s personal disciple; neither could suppress the other.
Although they hadn’t resorted to dark tricks and underhanded moves, they could cooperate during joint training.
However, deep down, they were dissatisfied with each other, both eager to outdo the other.
"With pleasure!"
Leng Huahan drew his sword proudly, "Since the Demon-slaying Tower didn’t decide who was superior, let’s have a direct fight."
"Enough from both of you!"
The Sect Leader and the Great Elder shouted angrily at the same time.
"You two will have plenty of opportunities for dueling in the future!"
The competition among disciples was something they were eager to see, but not at this moment.
Their eyes fixed unblinkingly on the leaderboards high in the sky.
The others finally realized something was off.
The Demon-slaying Tower was closed, the trial leaderboard should have disappeared, yet it still existed.
"There’s someone still inside!"
"That person hasn’t come out yet!"
"How can this be?"
"With the tower closed, how can they still remain inside?"
This situation had never occurred in their sect’s creation of over a hundred million years.
It surpassed their comprehension; nobody could figure it out.
Just then, another disciple exclaimed in surprise.
"Look quickly, the leaderboard has changed!"
"Someone has broken into the tenth level!"
"The tower is closed, how can the leaderboard still change?"
"It’s true! The name displayed is... Senior Sister Gu Qingyu?"
All the disciples looked at Gu Qingyu in unison, bewildered; hadn’t she already come out?

chapters.title: Chapter 262: Remote Shock
chapters.content:
Chapter 262: Chapter 262: Remote Shock
But right after, the crowd understood.
Each of them had an Identity Jade Talisman, representing their identity.
Gu Qingyu’s talisman was stolen, so now it’s actually the person who stole her talisman who is breaking through.
"What does that thief want to do?"
"Why is he trying to break through?"
Everyone present was completely puzzled.
A ’sinister’ expert sneaking into the Demon-slaying Tower would most likely kill the elite disciples inside, wouldn’t they?
That would be the simplest way to undermine the future foundation of a sect.
Up until now, this person had only targeted Gu Qingyu.
And he only stripped off her clothes without killing her.
Now he’s even trying to break through, what a bizarre situation.
"Could he really expect to get a good ranking and become a true disciple of our sect?"
"That’s impossible! Just for what he did to Senior Sister Gu, it’s unforgivable!"
