Gu Qingyu was cherished by the elders, and she was the goddess in the hearts of many male disciples, with both strength and beauty.
Treating her this way was indeed touching everyone’s reverse scale.
The Sect Leader Yuan Zhen Immortal Venerable was staring at the ranking board, wanting to see what the person inside intended to do.
Though cultivators are not bound by many rules, stripping a woman’s clothes is still very serious.
The impact of this matter was extremely damaging.
No matter how he tried to excuse or argue after coming out, he would not be spared!
Brother Cheng, who was currently inside breaking through the trials, had no idea so many people were waiting for him outside. If he knew...
He might have been very proud.
The anticipation of thousands, this is the stage the protagonist should have.
Whether greeted with flowers or swords, those are just details, not important.
The reason he continued breaking through was because he couldn’t find a way out.
He seemed quite special; even if he threw all the Demon-Slaying Talismans aside, the Demon-slaying Tower wouldn’t expel him.
This made him very melancholic.
"Looks like I can only fight until I clear it."
"Truly a life of toil!"
To him, who had once wiped out over thirty thousand immortals in a single blow, the trial monsters here were just at a kindergarten level.
Whether one jumped out, or three or four suddenly appeared, it was all instantly killed, no difference at all.
In no time, he gathered ten more Demon-Slaying Talismans and was transmitted to the eleventh level.
Along with it came a ding from the system.
"Congratulations, host, for receiving 30,356 shock value points, automatically converted to 3 points of merit."
Hmm?
Brother Cheng frowned, sensing something unusual.
points of merit might not sound like much, but it was equivalent to 30 billion points before!
"In this barren area, not a single soul, who could’ve been so shocked by Brother’s charm from afar?"
"And to give as much as 30,000 shock value."
His shock value feature was quite intricate.
There were several levels of the opponent’s degree of shock.
A slight surprise, a shiver of the tiger’s body, astonished, awe-inspired, prostration in worship, etc.
A slight surprise definitely didn’t yield as much shock value as prostration in worship.
Besides, it also depended on the number of shocked individuals; the more people shocked, the higher the shock value.
Lastly, it was related to the power of the shocked target.
Making a thousand True Immortals prostrate in worship was no comparison to slightly surprising an Immortal Emperor.
Accumulating thirty thousand shock value was actually quite difficult.
He didn’t think much, continued to slay monsters, and soon reached the twelfth level.
"Congratulations, host, for receiving 20,154 shock value points, automatically converted to 2 points of merit."
Gained more merit, though the shock value was a little less than before, it was still a significant gain.
Brother Cheng flicked his beautiful hair, feeling a tinge of solitude.
"Ah, to King Bi, shocking others is so liberating."
"Brother hasn’t even shown up yet, and it’s already had this effect. What about a grand entrance?"
As he continued to easily wipe out the trial monsters on this level, there were indeed many disciples outside who were astonished by his power.
"This person is so powerful!"
"Isn’t that obvious? If he can defeat Senior Sister Gu and reach the 12th level, it’s quite normal, what’s strange about it?"
"You don’t understand, just look at the speed at which he is breaking through!"
With this reminder, many disciples gasped, realizing the impressive feat.
The Demon-slaying Tower’s test originally had a hundred-day cycle. The early levels were easy, but usually, by the seventh or eighth level, the speed would slow down.
After defeating a monster, one would need to take medicines to replenish and repair status.
That all took time.
Disciples like Gu Qingyu and Leng Huahan, upon reaching levels above the tenth, might need over ten days to advance just once.
And this person had just been on the eleventh level for less than a quarter hour.
"There’s another change!"
"It really changed again!"
"He reached the 13th level!"
"Throughout our sect’s history, true disciples reaching this level have been very few!"
This time, far more people were shocked than before, and quite a few had their shock levels increased significantly.
Such breakthrough speed was indeed worth some astonishment.
Hence, Brother Cheng, who reached the 13th level, found his shock value had risen by over 60,000, adding 6 more points of merit.
"The art of posturing is ever with me!"
"Aweing the entire field, as it should be!"
He didn’t have the time to ponder the fact that a large group outside was eyeing him, waiting to kill him; King Bi always focused only on showing off.
And with no one else here, the only thing he could show off to was the system.
"See how Brother scores easily and joyfully, system, are you convinced?"
The system remained silent, not bothering to respond to such rubbish talk.
What, did you also want to shock the system?
"Level 13 corresponds to Ninth-grade Golden Immortal level trial monsters."
Outside, Yuan Zhen Immortal Venerable was fully prepared for battle.
Once slain by a trial monster, naturally one would be eliminated from the stage.
"This person is about to come out."
"All outer disciples, step back to avoid being hurt by battle ripples!"
"No worries, just a mere Golden Immortal, we can easily subdue him."
Gu Qingyu borrowed an Immortal Sword again, standing behind Yuan Zhen Immortal Venerable, glaring with hatred at the tower.
"Master, I suggest capturing him alive, and interrogating him severely!"
Gu Qingyu was the one who most wanted to tear Brother Cheng to pieces.
But simply killing him wouldn’t satisfy her rage; she wanted to torture him a bit.
Yuan Zhen Immortal Venerable already doted on this precious disciple, not to mention the suspicious points in this matter of infiltrating the Demon-slaying Tower.
"You are right."
"Later try to subdue this person first, cripple his cultivation and soul search."
His words had just fallen when the scene erupted into buzz, quickly becoming explosive.
The name ’Gu Qingyu’ on the Demon-slaying Tower ranking board had already broken through the 13th level!
In other words, the person had cleared this tower?
With a rumble, the Demon-slaying Tower burst into bright light.
Nine-colored halos glittered in the sky, bringing visions of Immortal Beasts, phantasmagorical.
It was as if the dazzling fireworks-like ’special effects’ were celebrating the first person to clear the tower!

chapters.title: Chapter 263: Paying Respects to the Ancestor Master
chapters.content:
Chapter 263: Chapter 263: Paying Respects to the Ancestor Master
At this moment, not to mention those disciples, even the elders were completely shocked.
Even Yuan Zhen Immortal Venerable wore an expression of disbelief.
It was as if witnessing a miracle.
He couldn’t help but be shocked.
Because this was the first time someone had cleared the Demon-slaying Tower since its establishment.
The tower itself had restrictions; at most only Ninth-grade Golden Immortals could enter, Immortal Venerables couldn’t enter at all.
The trial monsters on the thirteenth floor weren’t only Ninth-grade Golden Immortal level, but also usually appeared in groups, rarely alone.
Plus, a Fifth-grade Golden Immortal would automatically be promoted to a sect elder, and this tower was used for disciple evaluation. So since the founding, no one had cleared it.
The figure slowly rose from the top of the tower under the illumination of the nine-colored aura high above.
Everyone finally saw Brother Cheng’s figure clearly.
And looking around him, the tower body continuously emitted petals formed by the immortal qi, which was quite awkward!
This was the Demon-slaying Tower celebrating on its own.
But the problem was, this person wasn’t from their sect!
After a brief depression, everyone angrily summoned their immortal artifact magical treasures, encircling Brother Cheng tightly.
Their own sect’s Demon-slaying Tower was broken by an outsider first, completing the first clearance.
Where could they find justice in this?
If word got out, they’d become a massive laughingstock.
This was an embarrassing disgrace!
Moreover, there was the previous incident of Gu Qingyu being humiliated!
Now everyone wished they could tear Brother Cheng to pieces to vent their anger.
Unfortunately, the person involved seemed unaware of the impending crisis; he was still smiling and waving to the crowd.
Because upon clearing the tower, he surprisingly received over a million shock value, increasing his merit points by 105.
In the past, that would have accumulated over ten billion points.
This came way too easily.
So he was in a pretty good mood.
However, his smile was taken by others as a provocative show.
The crowd’s eyes turned red.
"Kill!"
"Kill him!"
"Grab that thief!"
Instantly, countless immortal artifacts unleashed terrifying waves of immortal power, charging forward.
Brother Cheng sighed.
If these people didn’t attack him, for the sake of contributing so much shock value, he wouldn’t bother to retaliate.
Just passing by, fine.
But since they wanted to kill him, he had no choice but to return the favor—wipe them out.
Although there were over twenty Immortal Venerables among them, he not only had tenfold critical strike but also the resurrection skill.
Just as he was about to unleash the Ninth-grade Immortal Sword, intending for a massacre, two figures swiftly blocked his front.
"No..."
"Stop!"
Boom Boom Boom!
Continuous explosions almost changed the color of heaven and earth.
When everything stopped, everyone was dumbfounded.
Jiang Cheng was still standing perfectly fine, even without drawing his sword.
Because he wasn’t hit at all, and two others had taken all the attacks for him.
At this moment, the two appeared dusty and disheveled, their crowns knocked off, hair disarrayed, bruised and battered.
Their immortal robes were riddled with holes, looking extremely disheveled.
Upon closer inspection, who else but Sect Leader Yuan Zhen Immortal Venerable and Great Elder Yuan Sheng Immortal Venerable?
"Sect Leader?"
"Master?"
"What happened?"
Those who just made a move were stunned on the spot.
Too bad this shock was not directed at Brother Cheng, so there was no harvest of shock value.
"Everyone stop immediately!"
"Who ordered you to act?"
Yuan Zhen Immortal Venerable urgently began to balance his breathing, thankfully there were more than ten Immortal Venerables and elders who hadn’t acted, otherwise, his old life might not have been preserved.
Yuan Sheng Immortal Venerable was even more furious, his Immortal Sword had been broken, and his Immortal Armor was riddled with holes.
"What are you doing?"
"Huh? Acting without orders, who gave you the guts?"
"Are you all insane?"
Everyone looked at each other, wanting to ask him instead, are you mad?
Facing external threats, are you confused?
Wasn’t it agreed to attack all at once after appearing?
"Sect Leader, what’s going on?"
"Why?"
Not only the disciples but even the elders were baffled.
This person infiltrated the Demon-slaying Tower and even humiliated your direct disciple, Sect Leader!
Not only did you not kill him, but you saved him instead?
Gu Qingyu flew over, her pretty face full of disbelief.
"Master, why did you save this thief?"
Yuan Zhen Immortal Venerable was furious, shouting sternly: "What thief, you wretch quickly apologize to...to this senior!"
This shout stunned Gu Qingyu.
Since entering the sect, it was the first time her master had scolded her.
But her beloved master was entirely too busy to pay attention to her at this moment, immediately turning to Jiang Cheng after scolding her.
Great Elder Yuan Sheng’s old face already wore an incredibly respectful smile, bending down as if ready to kneel immediately.
"You...are Elder Jiang, right?"
He didn’t even dare to call Brother Cheng by name.
Brother Cheng nodded: "That’s right, my surname is Jiang."
He was bewildered too.
First attacking then saving me, not giving me a chance to retaliate at all, what’s going on, acting?
Moreover, I’ve only been in this world for a few years, what elder, aren’t you mistaken?
Upon hearing he really was surnamed Jiang, the two sect leaders seemed to confirm the identity.
Thus, both of them simultaneously knelt down with a thud.
Sect Leader Yuan Zhen Immortal Venerable bowed repeatedly, causing his head to turn red, his entire being close to ecstasy: "Junior Feixian Sect Sect Leader Yuan Zhen, greets the Ancestral Master..."
Brother Cheng was instantly shocked.
What?
This sect with tens of thousands of disciples, is the Feixian Sect?
Has the Feixian Sect spread its leaves in the Immortal Realm? Why am I completely unaware?
Moreover, he didn’t recognize a single one of these disciples.
What’s going on?
"Ding, congratulations to the host for obtaining 25,750,154 shock value, automatically converted to 2575 merit points."
The Sect Leader and Great Elder simultaneously performed the kneeling ceremony to him, their respectful gestures utterly astounding the audience.
The level of shock clearly surpassed the one from clearing the tower earlier by several degrees.
After all, for the vast majority of sect disciples, they seldom even see the Sect Leader and Great Elder.
When they finally do, they witness this inconceivable scene.
The Sect Leader and Great Elder actually knelt to someone...
And this time, the target of the shock was obviously Brother Cheng.
Who exactly is this person?
Why do the Sect Leader and Great Elder regard him with such respect?
Could he truly be some senior elder of the Feixian Sect?
But on closer inspection, this person is merely a First Grade Golden Immortal.
With this power, he could be a true disciple in the Feixian Sect, but not qualified enough to be an Inner Sect Elder.
However, this person’s power can’t be judged based on the surface realm, certainly considering he just cleared the Demon-slaying Tower.
More likely, he possesses Ninth-grade Golden Immortal strength?
But even so, it still wouldn’t warrant the worship of the Sect Leader and Great Elder, these two Immortal Venerables!
In fact, it was precisely because of these inexplicable events that the shock effect became even stronger.
Allowing Brother Cheng to gain a large amount of merit.
His elder smile almost reached his ears.
It’s amazing; even before I started performing, the shock value poured in.
After calming down, he began to ask a more important question.

chapters.title: Chapter 264: Even Shocked Myself
chapters.content:
Chapter 264: Chapter 264: Even Shocked Myself
"Did you just say you are from the Feixian Sect?"
"What on earth is going on?"
He is the sect leader of the Feixian Sect. How was a new sect leader chosen without his approval?
Where are his disciples from before?
What about Xiaohan? What about Luo Yuan? What about Lin Ning?
If anyone should be sect leader, it should be them, right?
Yuan Zhen Immortal Venerable seemed to have seen his confusion and bowed, "There are too many people here with prying ears, Sect Founder, could we speak privately?"
Jiang Cheng nodded his head.
Then, accompanied by the sect leader and Great Elder, the three of them flew straight to the core of this "Feixian Sect."
Leaving behind a large group of people exchanging glances, faces full of bewilderment.
"Sect Founder?"
"Has our sect ever had such a Sect Founder?"
"I have visited the ancestral hall of past sect leaders and elders. There truly wasn’t this person."
Cultivators have even immortal souls; their memory is exceptional.
"I also have no impression of this. There have been five Jiang surname seniors enshrined in our sect’s history, but none match this person."
"Perhaps just an ordinary senior disciple from Feixian Sect’s history, not qualified to enter the ancestral hall?"
"But the reaction of the sect leader and Great Elder was so significant..."
They truly couldn’t figure it out.
At this time, under the guidance of Yuan Zhen and Yuan Sheng, Jiang Cheng also entered the ancestral hall.
Upon entering the vast hall, his mouth formed an O shape.
He’s always been the one to shock others, but this time he was the one being shocked.
At the top end of the hall were rows upon rows of lifelike immortal jade statues, each crafted to perfection, just like real people.
The first row contained 23.
The second row had over 50.
The third row was much more, with 900 plus.
From the fourth row onwards, the immortal jade statues were halved in size, and Jiang Cheng recognized none.
However, he remembered every single one in the first three rows clearly.
The 23 in the first row were none other than the Second Generation Disciples along with Mo Chen, the Immortal Mo!
The first one was the jade statue of Ji Linghan.
Her appearance hadn’t changed at all, but her aura was vastly different from Jiang Cheng’s impression, carrying supreme dignity between her brows.
Yet in her eyes of the jade statue, there was a faint trace of sorrow, as if it could never dissipate.
Under her jade statue was a line of text—First Generation Sect Leader of Feixian Sect.
The second statue was Mo Chen, and it also had a line—First Generation Great Elder of Feixian Sect.
The third was Luo Yuan—First Generation Elder of External Affairs Hall of Feixian Sect.
The fourth was Yin Xuer—First Generation Elder of Internal Affairs Hall of Feixian Sect.
The statues in the second row were Third Generation Disciples.
The first was Lin Ning—Second Generation Sect Leader of Feixian Sect.
Behind her were Tang Ru, Lu Fan, Wei Miao, and other Third Generation Disciples.
Of course, there was also Duan River and other four who had the protagonist template and were exceptionally promoted by Brother Cheng.
As for the third row of statues, they were Fourth Generation Disciples.
Jiang Cheng was speechless.
Could anyone tell him what on earth happened?
His astonishment hadn’t ceased.
"Xiaohan actually became sect leader?"
"I always thought her temperament wasn’t suitable..."
"Lin Ning actually took over Xiaohan’s position. Weren’t they always not on good terms?"
"And Wei Miao, this sycophant actually was the fifth sect leader?"
"Among the Fourth Generation Disciples, how did 58 sect leaders emerge in a row?"
"Is that a joke?"
"These guys are too reckless, playing house, are they?"
Calling the sect founder Xiaohan and labeling the fifth sect leader as a sycophant would be seen as great disrespect by any other Feixian Sect disciple, which would surely result in severe punishment.
But Yuan Zhen and Yuan Sheng looked at each other and couldn’t contain their joyful nodding.
There was no mistake!
Besides him, no one else was qualified to comment on Feixian Sect’s past sages this way.
"The ancestor might not know, but all the Second and Third Generation Founders ascended to the Upper Immortal Realm. Ancestor Wei Miao, who was the Supreme Elder at the time, grew restless and re-emerged to take over as sect leader again."
"As for why the Fourth Generation Founders produced 58 sect leaders, it was because their ascension periods were too short. Often, the previous sect leader would ascend after a few hundred years."
"And the Fifth Generation Founders, their power was too far below them, and at that time, no one could take on the great responsibility."
"Yes indeed, the ancestors of the first three rows were all unparalleled figures."
"It was precisely them who laid the billion-year foundation of the Feixian Sect!"
"We juniors have brought disgrace upon them..."
Brother Cheng was shocked again; he couldn’t keep listening to this.
"Wait, wait, wait, you just said, how long has it been?"
"A billion years?"
Yuan Zhen and Yuan Sheng both nodded.
"Since our Feixian Sect was founded, it’s been 1 billion and 265 million years now."
"The First Generation Sect Leader initially chose this location because it was where the ancestor last disappeared; it was to commemorate you!"
Brother Cheng nearly fainted.
"No way!"
He thought he just took a nap, not even a year has passed.
And just like that, a billion years went by? Could it be any more absurd?
No wonder Ji Linghan and others had to recreate the sect on their own, the span was too long.
It’s a good thing that the only ones in the Xuanji Map during that time were Ah Huang and Xiaobai, special beings without a concept of time, otherwise, other disciples might have already gone crazy.
"So how did you recognize me?"
This Yuan Zhen was already the 135th generation sect leader; he had never seen him before.
"Sect Founder, please look."
Yuan Zhen and Yuan Sheng, the heads of the sect, acted like obedient sword attendants, each offering a petal-shaped magical treasure into the air.
The two petals gently floated and flew above the jade statue row of Ji Linghan.
It was then that Jiang Cheng noticed there was an empty Nine-Colored Lotus Platform above.
He thought it was just a decoration.
The two petals fitted into the lotus platform, completing the missing parts. Immediately, a more gigantic immortal jade statue slowly emerged above the lotus platform.
The person appeared very young, with an indescribably handsome face—a masterpiece from the creator himself.
His eyes looked straightforward, expression calm, as if nothing posed a challenge to him.
This person, who else could it be but Jiang Cheng?
Under his jade statue, there were also four words—Sect Founder.
Staring intently at his own immortal jade statue, Brother Cheng felt slightly odd.
It felt like he had been gone for a long, long time.
After gazing for quite a while, he finally nodded.
"Not bad, it’s got a bit of my flair."
But soon after, he was dissatisfied.
"Why is my jade statue hidden?"
"Is it shameful?"
No wonder earlier only these two old fellows could recognize him while other disciples knew nothing about him.
Turns out, they were completely unaware!
His question of blame scared Yuan Zhen and Yuan Sheng into a shiver, and they hurriedly knelt again.
"The ancestor might not know, but this was also the will of the First Generation Sect Leader and elders."
"Yes, the circumstances were different back then."
"Over a billion years ago, when you, the ancestor, killed the Nine Flames Immortal Emperor, and destroyed nine other Immortal Cities, it caused great tremors across the Upper, Middle, and Lower Three Immortal Realms!"
As they spoke of this, looking at Brother Cheng with eyes brimming with admiration.
Having such a fierce person in Feixian Sect’s history was a matter of great pride.

chapters.title: Chapter 265: Aren’t You Planning to Lead the Way?
chapters.content:
Chapter 265: Chapter 265: Aren’t You Planning to Lead the Way?
Jiang Cheng then expressed his understanding.
Indeed, at that time, he was the only one identified as an Ascender by the Upper Immortal Realm.
Others had not been exposed yet back then.
Combined with having slain the Nine Flames Immortal Emperor, admitting to knowing him at that time would have been a foolish move.
Ji Linghan and Immortal Mo did the right thing.
As expected, Yuan Zhen Immortal Venerable continued, "At that time, dozens of Immortal Emperors descended from the Upper Immortal Realm, searching everywhere for your trail."
"It lasted for tens of millions of years, slightly relaxing only in recent years."
"If it had been known then that the Feixian Sect was your legacy, the entire Sect wouldn’t have been able to survive..."
"However, the ancestors always missed you, so they took the risk of sculpting your Immortal Jade Statue and instructed each generation’s Sect Leader and Great Elder to pass it down."
So that’s how it was.
They were really thoughtful, Brother Cheng rarely felt a warm feeling inside.
"What happened during those years?"
"Why didn’t they ascend to the Upper Immortal Realm together? Wasn’t there the Immortal City Ascension Battle?"
In his memory, everyone ascended collectively.
"Well..."
Yuan Zhen Immortal Venerable said, "Actually, since your generation, the Immortal City Ascension Battle was canceled."
"Huh? Canceled? Why?"
Brother Cheng was planning, once out, to participate in another Ascension Battle like in the Lower Immortal Realm.
Now that the two children had awakened, the three of them working together could win two rounds in each match and dominate, ensuring ascension to the Upper Immortal Realm.
Yuan Zhen and Yuan Sheng, the two Immortal Venerables, exchanged a slightly awkward glance. Wasn’t this because of you?
You destroyed the essence cores of over a hundred Immortal Cities in the Lower Immortal Realm and wiped out another nine Immortal Cities upon ascending to the Middle Immortal Realm.
With such a huge impact, how could the Ascension Battle continue?
The power of the Ascender completely shocked the Upper, Middle, and Lower Three Immortal Realms.
Many were led to mistakenly believe there were many similar prodigies in the Lower Realm, and once they came up, the native Immortal Cities wouldn’t be able to compete.
So eventually, it was canceled.
Upon hearing this reason, Brother Cheng felt it was absurd yet strangely gratifying.
Unexpectedly, not long after ascending over a billion years ago, he was already influencing the entire Immortal Realm’s structure.
Indeed, the protagonist is truly different.
"So how can one go to the Upper Immortal Realm now?"
Immortal Venerable Yuan Sheng replied, "There are two ways. One is to ascend to the Immortal King level, which allows you to directly traverse the Upper Immortal Realm’s barrier."
"The second, third, and fourth-generation ancestors of our sect all ascended this way."
Brother Cheng first felt relieved but immediately a bit unacceptable, feeling his pride was seriously hurt.
"Are you saying, all my disciples back then, even the fourth-generation ones, all became Immortal Kings?"
Damn, the system really screwed me over.
This reboot made me sleep on the starting line for a billion years, and I’m still just a First Grade Golden Immortal.
Meeting those disciples in the future, if they glance and see my Cultivation Realm, won’t it be quite embarrassing?
If Yuan Zhen and Yuan Sheng were to notice his thoughts, they would definitely find it incomprehensible.
You’ve even slain an Immortal Emperor, what more could you want?
Such feats are unattainable by ninety-nine percent of Immortal Emperors, is there a need for you to envy Immortal Kings?
"Indeed, every third-generation ancestor was of extraordinary talent, with incredible fortune, achieving Immortal King status was naturally easy for them."
Upon hearing them describe his disciples like this, Brother Cheng felt quite speechless.
Their talents were indeed unparalleled, all nurtured by me through countless trials, okay?
Without me, most of them would have been mediocre, some even outright useless!
As for fortune, there were even protagonist templates among them, how could their fortune not be high?
Yuan Zhen and Yuan Sheng, these old ones, didn’t know his feelings, still prideful and proud.
"A sect producing thousands of Immortal Kings!"
"In terms of foundation, our Feixian Sect is one of the most notable in the entire Middle Immortal Realm."
"When the second, third, and fourth-generation ancestors established the Feixian Sect’s foundation here, it was initially very challenging, surrounded by covetous Immortal Sects."
"The first Sect Leader led everyone in expeditions east and west, subduing hundreds of large and small Immortal Sects within Qianlan Celestial Realm in just ten million years!"
"That was our Feixian Sect’s most glorious period, our fame spread across every major Celestial Domain."
"Even ancient Immortal Sects from antiquity took the initiative to connect with us and treated us with great respect!"
"At the 20-million-year founding grand ceremony, nearly every top sect from all major Celestial Domains in the Middle Immortal Realm sent people to congratulate, it was a spectacular event!"
The more Brother Cheng listened, the more discomfort he felt.
Such grand events should have included him, the King Bi; it felt too imperfect.
Imagine if back then, those domineering shows were hosted by him, how much shock value would that generate?
"Unfortunately, as the fourth-generation ancestors also went to the Upper Immortal Realm one by one, there was no one left to carry the torch, and our sect gradually declined."
"Among later generations of disciples, few became Immortal Kings again..."
"In the most recent tens of millions of years, not a single one even emerged."
"Alas, we can barely make it into the top hundred within the Qianlan Celestial Realm now, and we’re even more insignificant in the entire Middle Immortal Realm."
Saying this, the two old men looked at Brother Cheng with anticipation, their gaze full of endless expectations.
Seemingly hoping the venerable elder would express some intent, like leading them to rekindle their glory or something.
The feats of this initial ancestor were not much disclosed by the second, third, and fourth generations of ancestors.
But just the name Jiang Cheng was enough.
This was the person who could kill an Immortal Emperor!
Even if the second, third, and fourth generations were prodigious, they were trained by him, so imagine how defying he could be.
Brother Cheng smirked, seeing through their ideas, but he wasn’t very interested.
What, were they hoping he would do another large-scale talent enhancement?
The system bug has been fixed; now enhancing talents is just spending merit for nothing in return.
With so many generations in between, though still the Feixian Sect, the people are completely strangers.
There were hardly any emotions like with Ji Linghan and her group.
Only a thin bond of legacy remains.
"People from the Upper Immortal Realm can come down anytime, right?"
"It’s not like being separated by life and death, with them above shielding you, how could you decline?"
Upon mentioning this, the two old men couldn’t help but sigh.
"In the initial tens of millions of years, the ancestors indeed often came down to care and support us, but gradually the visits became fewer."
"Especially in the recent ten million years, we don’t know what happened in the Upper Immortal Realm, but the ancestors haven’t come down since."
After finishing, the two again looked at Brother Cheng eagerly.
Evidently hoping for him to beat his chest and declare, with this old ancestor here, everyone can go to the Upper Immortal Realm.
The ascension rules of the three Immortal Realms were established by all Immortal Emperors and Demon Emperors together.
No single Immortal Emperor could make an exception to bring a bunch of juniors along to the Upper Immortal Realm.
Even if they came down, they could only stay briefly, giving some guidance and support to successors.
Not allowed to violate the rules and interfere in the affairs of the Middle Immortal Realm as Immortal Emperors.
But Jiang Cheng was an exception.
He hadn’t been to the Upper Immortal Realm and had slain an Immortal Emperor.
If he led...
But unfortunately, Brother Cheng merely asked, "Besides ascending to Immortal King, what’s the other way to go to the Upper Immortal Realm?"

chapters.title: Chapter 266: Isn’t this way too shady?
chapters.content:
Chapter 266: Chapter 266: Isn’t this way too shady?
"The other thing is to obtain an Immortal Fate Order from the Upper Immortal Realm."
"Every hundred thousand years, a varying number of Immortal Fate Orders will fall from the Upper Immortal Realm."
"Those who possess this order can ascend to the Upper Immortal Realm when the next hundred thousand years arrive."
"According to the ancestors who went up, it’s because there are constant battles in the Upper Immortal Realm, and it’s not peaceful, so they need replenishment."
Brother Cheng secretly complained, it’s really troublesome, these Immortal Emperors in the Upper Immortal Realm really think of themselves as superior.
"So, where can we get these Immortal Fate Orders?"
Surely it can’t be that one has to search aimlessly, right?
That would be quite annoying.
"Immortal Fate Orders are not difficult to obtain, the Celestial Pavilion in the Qianlan Celestial Realm has them for sale."
"What? They’re actually for sale?"
Although ascending to the Upper Immortal Realm doesn’t seem like such a monumental task for Brother Cheng.
With his talent and his overpowered system, no conditions set by those great powers could stop him.
But that’s only true for him personally.
For others in the Middle Immortal Realm, ascending to the Upper Immortal Realm should still be extremely difficult, yet enormously tempting, right?
After all, once there, one can obtain better cultivation conditions.
The opportunity is being sold just like that?
"What is the price?"
Not having to search aimlessly and being able to solve it with money seemed like a cost-effective and convenient matter to him.
"A hundred thousand top-grade Immortal Crystals!"
"So cheap?"
Brother Cheng was surprised once again.
A hundred thousand top-grade Immortal Crystals, for him, was actually a large sum.
Back when he eliminated so many Immortal Cities in the Ascension Battle, the spoils of war included tens of billions of Immortal Crystals, but almost all were lower grade.
Converted to top-grade Immortal Crystals, it was actually only over one million.
Moreover, back then he exchanged a large portion for points, and his remaining assets now total only around 200,000 top-grade Immortal Crystals.
At that price, he could only buy two Immortal Fate Orders.
However, after all, it is a ’tool’ that can ascend to the Upper Immortal Realm, it’s too outrageous to be so casually purchasable.
"At this price, the Immortal Fate Orders should have been sold out long ago, right?"
"And what’s the background of this Celestial Pavilion, to have something like this for sale, and at such a reasonable price?"
In his view, the opportunity to ascend to the Upper Immortal Realm, let alone a hundred thousand top-grade Immortal Crystals, even ten million, or even a hundred million top-grade Immortal Crystals, someone would gather everything they have to try and buy one.
The Celestial Pavilion obtained the Immortal Fate Orders but didn’t use them themselves, selling them cheap to others, could they be doing charity?
Immortal Venerable Yuan Sheng quickly answered: "The Celestial Pavilion has existed in the Immortal Realm since the ancient times, and its headquarters are now located in the Upper Immortal Realm, with several Immortal Emperors backing it. In the Middle Immortal Realm, there are also over a dozen Immortal Kings overseeing it."
"They only do business, do not meddle in any feuds, and no one dares to provoke them."
"As for the Immortal Fate Orders, they were sold to them."
"Sold to them?"
Brother Cheng was even more puzzled, why sell the hard-earned Immortal Fate Order to the Celestial Pavilion?
"What’s the situation here?"
Yuan Zhen quickly explained: "The ancestors have been in seclusion for so long, they may not know, there’s a hidden reason."
"The Immortal Fate Order is not a free pass upon obtaining it; it must be in possession on the day the hundred thousand-year period ends to be valid."
Brother Cheng was quite speechless, those Immortal Emperors indeed just changed the form but kept the essence the same.
Although the Immortal City Ascension Battle was gone, the struggle had not disappeared.
Yuan Zhen continued: "The Immortal Fate Order will reveal its aura to the outside world every ten years, so cultivators within a hundred million miles can sense it. And in the center of the Middle Immortal Realm, there’s also an Immortal Fate Chart that displays the location of all Immortal Fate Orders every ten years."
"The display lasts for a whole month every time."
"During this period, no matter where you are or what isolation methods you use, you cannot hide!"
This is quite ruthless, Brother Cheng finally understood.
If someone is lucky enough to get an Immortal Fate Order, for the tens of thousands of years that follow, they will never have peace.
Every ten years, their whereabouts will be exposed in various ways to other immortals in the Middle Immortal Realm.
In this situation, anyone holding an Immortal Fate Order is holding a Life-Ending Talisman.
Even if one’s power is strong enough, it’s hard to withstand the gazes of hungry wolves.
"So the real competition is in the final ten years?"
"Exactly!"
"After the final exposure of the Immortal Fate Order’s location in the last ten years, the struggle enters a fever pitch."
"At that point, if you get the Immortal Fate Order and hide it in a secret place, you can successfully ascend to the Upper Immortal Realm by the deadline day."
"Besides the first four generations of ancestors, over tens of millions of years, our sect has had 357 predecessors ascend to the Upper Immortal Realm through this method."
Immortal Venerable Yuan Zhen’s face darkened: "But there were even more predecessors who fell due to the competition for the Immortal Fate Order..."
"As for the tens of thousands of years before that, most people who obtained the Immortal Fate Order would choose to sell it to the Celestial Pavilion, for the price of ten thousand top-grade Immortal Crystals."
"The Celestial Pavilion, regardless of power, background, or neutral attitude, is the only place daring enough to purchase Immortal Fate Orders."
If you don’t sell, keeping it in your hands is like holding a burning potato.
Not only can’t you keep it safe, but it could also bring calamity.
Rather than let it go to waste, exchanging it for ten thousand Immortal Crystals is a gain, right?
The only ones that can hold onto it are possibly some extremely powerful Ancient Immortal Sects.
"Damn, this Celestial Pavilion really knows how to do business."
Originally, Brother Cheng thought ten thousand Immortal Crystals was cheap, but instantly he felt the Celestial Pavilion was quite scheming.
Buying in at ten thousand, selling out at a hundred thousand, and this business can be done every hundred thousand years, just profiting indefinitely.
"Master Ancestor, do you plan to buy the Immortal Fate Order?"
Jiang Cheng’s apparent realm was only that of a First Grade Golden Immortal, which Yuan Zhen and Yuan Sheng saw instantly.
But the two had no doubt about his identity.
Because the legends left by the second, third, and fourth generations also mentioned this, that the First Ancestor appeared to have a low realm.
But he could slay Immortal Emperors, so what could you say?
"How long until the next deadline?"
"131 years."
"That’s quite a while..."
Thinking that he would have to wait another 131 years to ascend to the Upper Immortal Realm, Brother Cheng felt a bit irritated.
But then he thought again, if he had awakened 131 years later, wouldn’t he have to wait for the next hundred thousand years?
Would have been better to cultivate to the Immortal King Realm then.
Yuan Zhen and Yuan Sheng were quite puzzled, secretly wondering how cultivation had no years, and besides, you’ve been in seclusion for over a billion years, why care about a mere 131 years?
"Then buy it, what else can we do?"
Brother Cheng had actually thought about whether to rob that black shop, the Celestial Pavilion, so he wouldn’t have to pay a single cent.
But then he thought that would be too uncivilized, after all, he was a reasonable person.
The main reason was that he could easily leave, but in the future, this group of disciples and grand-disciples from the Feixian Sect might face retaliation.
For the sake of some connection, better to hold back a bit.
With his confirmed answer, Yuan Zhen and Yuan Sheng beamed with delight.
"Then, could Master Ancestor perhaps buy a little more..."
These two old fellows started scheming, hoping Brother Cheng would take them along.

chapters.title: Chapter 267 Respect the Ancestor
chapters.content:
Chapter 267: Chapter 267 Respect the Ancestor
Others dare not buy too many Immortal Fate Orders, after all, even if they buy them, they can’t protect them, and in the last decade, they will still be besieged.
Even those Ancient Immortal Sects with an Immortal King guarding them, only dare to take a few hundred each time, going about it cautiously, not daring to take too many.
Getting too many Immortal Fate Orders at once is akin to leaving others with nothing to drink, which would provoke public anger, and there’s a chance they would all rise to attack you.
This has become an unwritten rule.
But the Ancestor is different!
When he is standing there, who in the Middle Immortal Realm could snatch food from him?
Jiang Cheng could see the thoughts of the two of them.
He didn’t mind taking care of the younger generation of the sect, but...
"Forget it, Ancestor I don’t have that many Immortal Crystals."
The Feixian Sect has as many as hundreds of thousands of disciples, with each requiring a hundred thousand Immortal Crystals, he really couldn’t afford it now.
Yuan Zhen and Yuan Sheng were both at a loss whether to cry or laugh.
The Ancestor is truly humorous, how could they dare to let him spend money?
"Patriarch, you’ve misunderstood, the Sect Treasure Vault still has some savings, this amount of Immortal Crystals will be handled by us naturally."
"Is that so, then that’s fine."
Upon hearing that he doesn’t have to help pay, Brother Cheng was quite agreeable.
Especially as Yuan Zhen’s next words left him ’greatly comforted.’
"The Immortal Fate Order for you, Patriarch, will also be purchased by the sect!"
"Hahaha, you are quite good!"
From meeting to just now, the Ancestor had always maintained an uninterested attitude, but now he finally gave some praise, making Yuan Zhen and Yuan Sheng elated.
"To show some respect for the Patriarch, is what we should do."
Brother Cheng suddenly felt that these two old men spoke quite nicely, on the right path!
Along with it, the two of them seemed much more approachable.
"How many Immortal Fate Orders do you plan to buy?"
The two naturally wanted to buy as many as possible, bringing more people to the Upper Immortal Realm.
But they didn’t dare to decide, so they could only tentatively ask, "That depends on what the Patriarch thinks."
Brother Cheng waved his hand grandly, "What I think, that depends on how many Immortal Crystals you have."
A simple sentence threw the two of them back into ecstasy.
The Patriarch had made it very clear, no matter how many people bought the Immortal Fate Order, he could protect them.
Not to mention a hundred or a thousand, even ten thousand or a hundred thousand would be no problem, provided they could afford to buy!
The Feixian Sect currently has 150,000 disciples, if all were to buy, it would need 15 billion top-grade Immortal Crystals.
This truly is a huge fortune, even turning the Feixian Sect inside out, it wouldn’t be possible to gather so much.
The two gritted their teeth and made a fierce decision, you have to take a risk to seek wealth!
If things come to the worst, just sell some other resources to gather more Immortal Crystals!
This once-in-a-lifetime opportunity for collective ascension cannot be missed!
"Patriarch, could you give us a few days to prepare the Immortal Crystals?"
"Sure."
Brother Cheng actually had his own considerations, he was eager for the Feixian Sect to gather more Immortal Crystals, to buy more.
Because in the future, he had other purposes for these Immortal Fate Orders.
As the two were about to leave, Brother Cheng called them back again.
"By the way, where are Lan Ti and the Three-Eyed Tiger? Why haven’t I seen their jade statues?"
These two were important figures around him back then, at least more close than the fourth-generation disciples.
Upon hearing this question, both Yuan Zhen and Yuan Sheng looked troubled, as if unsure how to begin.
"What? Is there something hidden in this matter?"
"Senior Lan Ti, indeed, the ancient records of the sect did mention her, supposedly she was involved during the early days of founding."
"At the beginning of the Feixian Sect’s establishment, there were powerful enemies nearby. During the first sect defense battle, she killed several leading figures of the enemy, second only to Elder Mo Chen in achievements."
Brother Cheng nodded slightly, Lan Ti’s development path was different from the other disciples.
She had faced great changes early on, and before knowing him, she had practiced alone outside for years, excelling in both experience and combat capabilities.
"But before long, she fell out simultaneously with the first two generations of sect leaders. The specifics are unclear in the ancient records. After leaving, she disappeared without a trace..."
What the?
Did Lan Ti have a grudge with Ji Linghan and Lin Ning?
When he was around, they got along quite well.
Brother Cheng too was at a loss, could only sigh that women’s thoughts are truly unpredictable.
"And what about the Three-Eyed Tiger?"
"We have never heard of Senior Three-Eyed Tiger."
What?
Brother Cheng thought it through and realized that lazy tiger demon must have deemed building a sect too much trouble and went off to live leisurely and happily.
After all, without him, other disciples couldn’t keep it in line.
If it stayed to protect the sect diligently, that would indeed be surprising.
"Alright, you may go."
"Do not speak of my identity to others."
Yuan Zhen and Yuan Sheng understood; once the Patriarch’s real identity spreads, it would surely attract many Immortal Emperors to descend from the Upper Immortal Realm!
The Ancestor could slay an Immortal Emperor once, but doesn’t mean he could handle so many.
Concealing his identity is a wise move.
Those two cunning heads never guessed Brother Cheng’s real intention.
He didn’t want to reveal his identity simply for Shock Value.
Shock depends on expectations, a Golden Immortal killing an Immortal Venerable would certainly cause a great shock reaction.
Who would be shocked if an Immortal Emperor kills an Immortal Venerable?
If all the disciples of the Feixian Sect were to know he had killed an Immortal Emperor, then whatever he does afterward would be taken for granted.
There wouldn’t be any Shock Value.
Moreover, he didn’t want to expose his identity so quickly, the disciples back then had all become Immortal Kings, and he was still just a Golden Immortal; it would be embarrassing if words got out!
Yuan Zhen and Yuan Sheng cautiously retracted the petals, and Brother Cheng’s jade statue was hidden again.
Once the two came out, they were immediately besieged by many disciples outside.
"Sect Leader, who on earth was that?"
"Why so respectful to him?"
"Master, he’s just a Golden Immortal. Even if he is strong, he’s still just a Golden Immortal, is it necessary..."
"There are plenty of ancestors in our sect who haven’t been enshrined in the Ancestral Hall, they’re not worth such reverence, are they?"
"Could be a fraudster..."
Upon hearing these doubts, Yuan Zhen Immortal Venerable’s expression changed dramatically.
This is the first-generation ancestor, outweighing everyone in the Ancestral Hall combined!
Not worth reverence?
A fraud?
His omnipotent might, these discussions might even reach his ears.
"You all know nothing!"
Seeing the crowd still chattering on, he was so furious that he directly burst out with a swear word.
"He is an extremely important Ancestor of our sect, show some damn respect!"
Great Elder Yuan Sheng also sternly said, "Listen carefully, when facing the Ancestor, be more respectful than you are to your masters and parents!"
Yuan Zhen added, "Anyone who dares to disrespect the Patriarch will be expelled from the sect, no exceptions!"
His gaze focused sharply on his treasured disciple, his tone not at all like he was joking.
Gu Qingyu was stunned.
She couldn’t quite believe her ears.
This person killed her Immortal Beast, stripped her clothes, took her Immortal Artifact and Storage Ring.
And now her master says if she disrespects him, she will be expelled from the sect?

chapters.title: Chapter 268: Resolutely Disagree
chapters.content:
Chapter 268: Chapter 268: Resolutely Disagree
"Why?"
Gu Qingyu was extremely indignant.
After all, she had accompanied Yuan Zhen as a direct disciple for three hundred thousand years.
When something happened, it was bad enough her master didn’t help her, but to even force her to bow her head in submission?
No one could accept that, could they?
It was truly unjust, wasn’t it?
But Yuan Zhen Immortal Venerable didn’t see it that way.
"Because this is the latest sect regulation!"
In front of the first ancestor, what is a disciple who is a hundred generations behind?
Seeing her master’s stern eyes, which were almost devoid of emotion, Gu Qingyu’s heart turned cold.
Her eyes reddened, she wiped away her tears and then turned around fiercely, flying out immediately.
The others also stopped their discussions.
They realized that the Sect Leader and the Great Elder were serious this time.
Even someone like Gu Qingyu, a jewel of the sect, had to give way in this matter.
After everyone left, Second Elder Yuan Shu frowned and asked, "Sect Leader, who exactly is that ancestor?"
The other elders also expressed their confusion.
"Could you at least give us some background?"
"The Ancestral Hall indeed doesn’t have this person."
"Even if he is truly a predecessor of our sect, a bit of respect would suffice; I don’t see the need for such a fuss."
"Yes, Qingyu is heartbroken by you, isn’t it a bit too much?"
The cultivation realm is indeed wondrous; someone thirty hundred thousand years old is still called a child.
Yuan Zhen and Yuan Sheng, the two leaders, were at their wit’s end.
They couldn’t reveal Jiang Cheng’s identity.
There’s no wall with no crack; the more people who know, the easier it will spread.
But if they don’t explain clearly, the disciples would keep imagining things and that isn’t good either.
"Has this Sect Leader and Great Elder ever gone mad?"
"Never..."
"Then that’s it. All you need to know is that this is beneficial to the sect."
What kind of explanation is this?
Everyone was speechless.
Then Yuan Zhen Immortal Venerable announced an even more baffling order.
"Gather all the Immortal Crystals in the sect’s Treasure Pavilion, and sell the treasures that are temporarily unused to convert them all into top-grade Immortal Crystals."
"Also, as elders, each of you must contribute 300,000 top-grade Immortal Crystals."
What?
What are they up to?
Before they could ask, Great Elder Yuan Sheng immediately set an example and handed over a Storage Ring.
"This is all of this old man’s Immortal Crystal collection, roughly 2.73 million top-grade Immortal Crystals!"
Yuan Zhen took the Storage Ring, did a quick count, and nodded heavily.
Seeing their actions, all the elders were dumbfounded.
"Sect Leader, Great Elder, can we ask what so many Immortal Crystals are for?"
Is it necessary to sell the sect’s treasures just to gather Immortal Crystals?
Since when did we fall so low as to sell our assets to make ends meet?
Yuan Zhen Immortal Venerable naturally said, "To purchase Immortal Fate Orders."
"What?"
"Buy Immortal Fate Orders?"
This time, the elders truly suspected the Sect Leader was insane.
Even the Great Elder showed a fanatic excitement on his face.
Third Elder Yuan Mu had always supported the Sect Leader’s decisions, but this time he had to speak out.
"Forgive me for being blunt, buying Immortal Fate Orders is inadvisable!"
The other elders also advised.
"Yes, Sect Leader, you should know yourself, with 131 years to go, buying Immortal Fate Orders now is buying life-ending talismans!"
"Especially by gathering so many Immortal Crystals, does the Sect Leader intend to make extensive purchases?"
"This would bring a catastrophic disaster to our sect!"
The Great Elder thought if he revealed the true identity of that honorable person, they would be more eager than I am.
Unfortunately, these elders couldn’t recognize Jiang Cheng at all.
Even if they recognized him, they wouldn’t know Jiang Cheng was their Sect Founder.
"Don’t you all want to ascend to the Upper Immortal Realm, such a good opportunity?"
Everyone was speechless.
What kind of good opportunity is this?
Of course, they wanted to ascend, but if buying Immortal Fate Orders could fulfill their wish, it wouldn’t be up to them to buy them.
"This is utterly inadvisable, I disagree!"
"Buying two or three near the deadline might be acceptable, but it’s too early now."
"Indeed, we absolutely disagree!"
Although the Sect Leader and Great Elder hold the most power in the sect, the opinion of the Elder Council also matters greatly.
If they collectively oppose it, this matter won’t succeed.
"Alas, you all..."
Yuan Zhen and Yuan Sheng were so anxious they could almost jump.
With such a thick leg of the ancestor here, you refuse to cling to it.
In a hurry, Great Elder Yuan Sheng couldn’t help but blurt out, "With the ancestor here, those Immortal Fate Orders wouldn’t be snatched by outsiders at all!"
The hall fell silent.
Yuan Zhen couldn’t help but glare at Yuan Sheng, cautioning him not to spill the beans.
However, soon the elders all shook their heads again.
"That ancestor? Even if his seniority is high, isn’t his power just at the Golden Immortal level?"
"Once we extensively purchase Immortal Fate Orders, the sects eyeing us will be countless, including Immortal Kings attacking."
"Such a scenario, even the Ancient Immortal Sects dare not face, let alone him?"
"Precisely, what means does he have to fend them off?"
"Could he possibly summon a group of Immortal Kings as his backing?"
He himself is the biggest backing!
But the casual remarks of the crowd gave Yuan Zhen an idea.
Indeed, the ancestor’s identity mustn’t be exposed, but it’s fine to guide everyone to suspect otherwise.
As long as it can prove he is reliable enough.
"Indeed, the ancestor is of extremely high seniority, with extensive connections in the Middle Immortal Realm, many Immortal Kings are his old acquaintances."
"He can help us preserve the Immortal Fate Orders, so be assured and purchase them!"
Yuan Sheng chimed in as well, "He returned this time specifically to support us, don’t miss this opportunity!"
Everyone looked at each other in dismay.
"May we know the name of this ancestor?"
Truly, if such a well-connected person existed, they should have long become famous in the Middle Immortal Realm, correct?
They should have heard of him.
"This..."
Yuan Zhen and Yuan Sheng were at a loss again.
They couldn’t reveal Jiang Cheng’s name!
"That esteemed ancestor has roamed in the mortal world for so long, he has long forgotten his name; you only need to know that we wouldn’t harm anyone!"
"Indeed, do you think the Sect Leader and I would harm the Feixian Sect?"
Despite their persuasions, ultimately only a dozen elders were half-convinced and contributed some Immortal Crystals.
Including Second Elder and Third Elder, several hundred other elders still disagreed.
Yuan Zhen and Yuan Sheng were so exasperated it hurt their chests, yet they were helpless.
In the end, they could only seek Jiang Cheng again to see if he had any solutions.
After hearing them recount the recent meeting, Brother Cheng was a little disappointed.
"This kind of thing actually happened?"
Thinking back to when he was the Sect Leader, how authoritative he was.
No one else even had the right to speak, right?
Even if it was a pit of fire ahead, he would say jump, and everyone would follow him with their eyes closed.
"How many Immortal Crystals have you gathered now?"
"Currently, our accessible sect treasury isn’t much. After selling some, plus the savings from our disciples and members, we have roughly 3.3 billion top-grade Immortal Crystals."
Yuan Sheng regretted, "If all the other elders had agreed, it wouldn’t have been just this amount..."
Brother Cheng waved his hand, "No need for more."

chapters.title: Chapter 272: How Are You a Lackey
chapters.content:
Chapter 272: Chapter 272: How Are You a Lackey
"Haha, after living for so many years, it’s my first time seeing such an amusing spectacle."
The group of immortals opposite burst into laughter.
Then a young man with a purple crown swaggered over.
Pointing at Brother Cheng, wearing a cheeky grin.
"Hey, are your Immortal Crystals burning a hole in your pocket?"
"If it’s too much, why not hand them over to me, and let me spend it for you?"
As he walked over, an elder behind him hastily grabbed him.
With a serious expression, he shook his head at him.
"Young master, these people are of unknown origin, but daring to buy so many Immortal Fate Orders suggests they are not ordinary..."
But the young man was indifferent: "This is Danhua City!"
That simple sentence seemed to be his entire confidence.
By then, he was already standing right in front of Brother Cheng.
He chuckled weirdly twice: "I’m running short lately, how about lending me some Immortal Crystals to spend..."
Upon hearing this, Leng Huahan’s anger surged.
Just as he was about to draw his sword, Yuan Zhe restrained him and secretly transmitted a message.
"Let’s watch and see!"
"But the other side is blatantly causing trouble..."
"Just a good chance to see what this so-called Ancestor Jiang has up his sleeve."
Upon hearing this, Leng Huahan held back.
Thinking it over, it made sense; the person before him was just a typical worthless fool. If he couldn’t handle this little issue, even if he were truly their sect’s ancestor, it would be disappointing.
But that Reception Immortal’s face darkened: "Chu Dynasty, you should know in our Celestial Pavilion, anyone is..."
They opened their doors for business, and if they couldn’t guarantee their customers’ safety, what was the point?
The Celestial Pavilion had rules, and no conflicts were allowed here.
If you want to fight, take it outside.
But before he could finish, the voice of Branch President Ding Rui sounded in his ear.
"Don’t interfere; let them resolve it themselves."
Ding Rui would not have issued this command; it was on the instruction of Miao Yu and Ye Yang Immortal King.
At this moment, they were watching Jiang Cheng on screen calmly, to see how he would handle it next.
Someone who wanted to buy hundreds of Immortal Fate Orders was suspicious to the extreme.
In their eyes, this spoiled brat Chu Dynasty, who appeared just at the right moment, might be able to help them probe some background in advance.
Initially, with a shout from the Reception Immortal, Chu Dynasty was a bit apprehensive.
But as the sentence remained unfinished, the Reception Immortal withdrew his words instead.
This immediately bolstered his courage; was the Celestial Pavilion actually afraid of him?
Thinking this, he became even more emboldened.
With a wave of his hand, a few follower immortals gathered around.
"I’m talking to you, deaf?"
Brother Cheng didn’t know several groups were secretly ’assessing’ him; he just thought this kid in front of him was quite adorable.
So cute that he was reluctant to kill him on the spot.
Wasn’t he just fretting about finding an opportunity to rack up Shock Value?
So he replied on the spot: "Are you my son?"
Everyone present had thought of many possible responses, such as Jiang Cheng asserting his status, intimidating Chu Dynasty, displaying superior power, or speaking conciliatory words to resolve the matter...
But no one expected this kind of response.
Chu Dynasty didn’t react immediately: "What do you mean?"
Brother Cheng said calmly, "If you’re not my son, why would you ask me for money?"
Everyone nearby was at a loss for words, realizing this was a roundabout insult.
Seeing the subtle expressions on their faces, Chu Dynasty couldn’t maintain his composure.
"You’re courting death!"
"Do you even know I’m of Danhua City..."
His voice abruptly stopped.
A sword light suddenly flashed through and was gone.
Immediately after, blood splattered fiercely in the hall.
Chu Dynasty fell wordlessly, along with the six followers behind him.
Brother Cheng gracefully sheathed his sword.
These few were mere Profound Immortals, yet dared to act out; they really did not understand the word ’death.’
He could’ve killed them even more effortlessly.
However, to create a more grand scene and earn more Shock Value, he drew his sword instead.
As for their identity or background, he couldn’t care less about hearing it.
After killing them, he immediately began collecting the spoils of war.
The recent period had seen no income, and he had been holding back for a long time.
Before anyone noticed, several Storage Rings were all in his hands, and the weapons of these individuals were all quickly stowed in the Storage Rings.
In the blink of an eye, the Immortal Armor on those fallen was also stripped off.
The speed of which could win a prize in a clothes-stripping contest.
"Ding, congratulations host, you earned 50,348 Shock Value points, automatically converted to 5 points of Merit."
Damn, only 5 points of Merit?
This was too weak, Brother Cheng deeply reflected on himself, wondering if he’d killed too quickly just now.
The process wasn’t clear enough, which might have left the audience unsatisfied, leading to fewer Shock Value points.
He forgot there were only a thousand or so people in the hall; having over 50,000 Shock Value points was already an extremely high level of shock.
Everyone was petrified; they couldn’t believe what had just happened.
Indeed, being provoked by a spoiled brat and drawing a sword to retaliate was normal.
But wasn’t this a bit too sudden and intense?
Not even asking for the other party’s name?
No negotiation?
Moreover, with such strong power, he could have chosen to subdue them instead of killing them!
The elder who previously tried to stop Chu Dynasty was the first to react.
"You!"
With eyes full of shock, he pointed at Jiang Cheng, even his fingers trembling.
"Are you crazy?"
"You actually dared to kill City Lord Yu’s nephew, you’re done for..."
Brother Cheng impatiently waved his hand: "I know you’re part of the City Lord’s people, impressive, okay?"
"Why are you still standing here dilly-dallying? Like a fool, not quickly going to call for help?"
"Do you really expect me to be so scared I’ll surrender and bind myself just because of a few words?"
"Thinking it over, isn’t that impossible? Does it make sense?"
"How can you be such an unprofessional lackey!"
Being scolded so pointedly, the elder opposite was furious, yet speechless.
Because Brother Cheng had a damned good point.
Finally, he obediently ’followed orders’ and flew off to get reinforcements.
Everyone present was somewhat doubting if they had misheard, or if the world had gone mad.
Dude, whose side are you on?
Even giving advice to the other side, is that really necessary?
Even Miao Yu and Ye Yang Immortal King, observing the scene, were stunned.
This move was too peculiar, they had never seen anything like it.
Leng Huahan, Yuan Zhe, and the others were almost shocked to dumbness, but more so frightened.
Was this ancestor out of his mind?
For killing people just on a whim, and the ones killed seemed to be far from ordinary figures.
And that’s not all, he stayed at the scene after killing them.
Hadn’t he heard that a powerful dragon is no match for a local snake?
"Ancestor, quickly leave here."
"It’s not wise to linger this time..."
Brother Cheng couldn’t be bothered with them.
"Leave? Why? How did those cowardly kids become my descendants?"
"I haven’t even finished shopping!"
He turned to the Reception Immortal again, smiling with outstretched hands: "Here, killing people shouldn’t be a problem, right? It doesn’t affect our transaction, does it?"

chapters.title: Chapter 273: Then what nonsense are you saying?
chapters.content:
Chapter 273: Chapter 273: Then what nonsense are you saying?
The Reception Immortal really wanted to say, of course it matters!
This is the first time someone has dared to commit murder on Celestial Pavilion’s territory.
And the murder was so savage that blood stained the ground everywhere, making the scene incredibly brutal.
This is blatantly embarrassing the Commerce Association!
In the past, Commerce Association experts would immediately intervene.
Then there would be punishment where needed and compensation where necessary. In the face of Celestial Pavilion’s power, everyone had to submit.
But now, they truly have no grounds to act like that.
Because they had just tacitly allowed the Chu Dynasty’s provocation, effectively breaking their own rules.
If they now pursue Jiang Cheng for the issue, it would be typical double standards, damaging Celestial Pavilion’s reputation.
"Hmm?"
Brother Cheng frowned.
"No, no, if our honored guest wants to trade, of course, you can. Please follow me..."
At this moment, the Reception Immortal received instructions from above to continue the transaction.
However, Branch President Ding Rui would personally appear.
Under the complex gaze of everyone, the group quickly proceeded to the inner layers of the Commerce Association.
Here, Brother Cheng met Ding Rui, but sitting in front of him was still Miao Yu.
Facing this fairy who was so beautiful she didn’t seem real, Brother Cheng couldn’t help but take a few more glances to show respect.
He silently scored her 99 points in his mind, deducting one point to prevent her from becoming arrogant.
Her looks were among the only ones he had seen that could rival Lan Ti.
Thinking of Lan Ti, he rarely felt a hint of worry.
Ji Linghan and Lin Ning should still be together after reaching the Upper Immortal Realm, but Lan Ti was alone and her whereabouts unknown.
He actually had the mood to admire other beauties, which was truly unacceptable!
At least he should wait until he finds her.
Miao Yu was obviously unaware she was being scored by the person across from her.
Her expression remained calm as she spoke, "We have 115 Immortal Fate Orders here. Do you want to buy them all?"
"Yes."
Upon hearing there were only 115, Brother Cheng was somewhat disappointed.
"May I know your esteemed name?"
Miao Yu hadn’t gathered much information previously.
Instantly killing several Profound Immortals is something most Golden Immortals can accomplish, which doesn’t prove much.
And Jiang Cheng’s current realm is only First Grade Golden Immortal, but he has three Immortal Venerables behind him, obviously more than meets the eye.
Thus, she decided to engage in this negotiation to gather further information.
Brother Cheng didn’t think much of it and directly handed over a Storage Ring containing 1.15 million Top-grade Immortal Crystals.
"My surname is Jiang; the Immortal Crystals are all here. Where’s the goods I want?"
Miao Yu glanced at Ding Rui, who quickly laid out all 115 Immortal Fate Orders.
Brother Cheng casually picked up one Immortal Fate Order and examined it. This thing was indeed delicate, emanating a mysterious and vast aura, far from being a mere mortal object.
Miao Yu, meanwhile, pondered all the significant figures she knew with the surname Jiang.
Unfortunately, except for the slain Nine Flames Immortal Emperor, others had merely heard of Jiang Cheng but never actually seen him.
She truly had no idea what he looked like.
"May I ask what your purpose is for buying so many Immortal Fate Orders?"
Brother Cheng gazed at her as if she were a fool, "Ascend to the Upper Immortal Realm, of course. What else?"
Miao Yu’s demeanor remained unaltered as she continued, "There’s no need to pretend ignorance; you and I both know, at this time, buying so many Immortal Fate Orders is unusual."
"So you mean now is not the peak season for Immortal Fate Order sales?"
Miao Yu hadn’t heard terms like sales or peak seasons before, but she understood the general idea.
"It seems you are aware..."
"Indeed."
Brother Cheng rubbed his fingers together with a smile, "Since I purchased so much during your off-season, shouldn’t you offer a discount?"
"Discount?"
"I mean, can you make it cheaper?"
He didn’t only want 115 pieces; after buying here, he needed to hurry to the next branch.
Saving a bit here and there had always been Brother Cheng’s thrifty approach.
Not just Miao Yu, but even Ding Rui and Ye Yang Immortal King were a bit taken aback.
This was the first time they had seen someone try to bargain when purchasing Immortal Fate Orders.
"You’re quite humorous; the price of Immortal Fate Orders has always been 100,000 Top-grade Immortal Crystals and has never changed. Those are the rules..."
Brother Cheng was rather disappointed, "If the price can’t be discussed, why did you waste time saying so much nonsense? It really is a waste of precious time."
Packing the 115 Immortal Fate Orders into his Storage Ring, he stood up to leave.
Miao Yu was completely stunned.
She had never seen someone like this before.
What, is chatting with her a grievance?
Even those behind him, like Leng Huahan and Yuan Zhe, were speechless.
Really so straightforward?
The patriarch is a bit too iron-willed, isn’t he?
If this provoked the other party, what then?
Ye Yang Immortal King across the room was indeed enraged; this person was truly impolite, far too disrespectful to the lady.
Just as he was about to speak, Miao Yu stopped him.
"The person you just killed is the nephew of this city’s City Lord."
Her expression had already returned to calm, showing remarkable composure.
"Regarding this matter, the City Lord will certainly not let it rest. Retribution is inevitable."
"With the manpower beside you, they are surely insufficient to withstand this city’s experts and three thousand Immortal Guard Army."
Brother Cheng frowned, "So, are you going to help me confront them?"
Honestly, he didn’t need teammates.
Fortunately, Miao Yu didn’t disappoint him; she shook her head.
"Our Celestial Pavilion remains neutral, not interfering in any grudges or vendettas. At most, we can guarantee your safety within the store."
Brother Cheng curtly cupped his hand, "Then farewell."
This woman had nothing wrong, except for her love of talking nonsense.
If Miao Yu knew he evaluated her like this, she might be too furious to speak.
Confidently, she then changed her tone, "However, we can provide a Transmission Array that extends directly ten billion miles."
"The condition is that you reveal the true purpose for purchasing the Immortal Fate Orders and its underlying intention."
"You must know, the Commerce Association’s Transmission Arrays have never been available for outsiders to use, so this counts as an exception."
"Therefore, I think this condition is not unreasonable."
Upon hearing this, Leng Huahan, Yuan Zhe, and others immediately became overjoyed.
Their current pressure indeed was substantial.
Although without the Immortal City Ascension Battle, each Immortal City was less crucial than before, to be a City Lord certainly wouldn’t rank below an Immortal Venerable.
And the City Lord wouldn’t be without some experts nearby.
If a battle erupts, whether their side can retreat unscathed is truly uncertain.
If they could covertly use the Commerce Association’s Transmission Array to leave here, avoiding future disputes, it would be the optimal choice.
Sadly, Brother Cheng couldn’t empathize with their sentiments.
He vigorously waved his hand, "You’re too considerate; asking for exceptions and changing principles must be really embarrassing. I don’t like troubling others!"
"Farewell, farewell!"
With that said, and not caring about the dismayed expressions of the others in the room, he strode out.
Once outside, Elder Yuan Zhe couldn’t restrain himself any longer.
"Patriarch, I believe this is quite inappropriate!"
If this wasn’t the patriarch appointed by the Sect Leader but just an ordinary Feixian Sect Elder, he would have reprimanded him harshly long ago.
Since entering, his high-profile objectives had exposed him, and every subsequent step chose the wrong options.
He even suspected Jiang Cheng might have done it intentionally.

chapters.title: Chapter 274: Don’t praise so bluntly
chapters.content:
Chapter 274: Chapter 274: Don’t praise so bluntly
Brother Cheng really did it on purpose.
But so what?
This brother has the system hack, there’s nothing to fear.
"Not appropriate?"
He glanced back at the three anxious and disgruntled Elders and Leng Huahan, without offering any reply.
His gaze finally fell on the two female Outer Disciples.
"Are you afraid?"
The two female disciples were indeed quite shocked.
However, such major matters didn’t require them to consider the consequences.
When asked by the Founder, naturally, they would say...
"Not afraid!"
The two girls answered loudly in unison.
"Why aren’t you afraid?"
"The Founder is so powerful, he will definitely protect us!"
With their sweet words, Brother Cheng was overjoyed.
"Good~!"
Smiling, he gave them a thumbs-up, then shrugged at the remaining four people with a meaningful expression.
The meaning was clear, the sect’s top management was more cowardly than the Outer Disciples.
Leng Huahan and Yuan Zhe almost ended up with brain aneurysms.
Is this a question of fear or not?
But now, no matter what they said, it was already too late. They hadn’t even left the Celestial Pavilion when over a thousand members of the Immortal Guard Army surrounded them outside.
Leading them was a middle-aged man with a black beard, dressed in Immortal Armor and holding a spear.
"Come out!"
The young man pointed his spear forward, and a thousand members of the Immortal Guard Army shouted aggressively in unison.
"Kill!"
"Kill!"
"Kill!"
An array of strange and colorful Magical Treasures hovered in mid-air, exuding an aura of destruction.
The Immortal Artifacts all lit up, ready to strike at any moment.
The murderous aura was palpable, causing even the other people in the commerce association to feel suffocated.
Still, they weren’t too worried. After all, in the Middle Immortal Realm, no one dared to be so daring as to bring a large troop to storm into the Celestial Pavilion.
"That is Deputy Commander Chu Yue of the Immortal Guard Army, a Second Grade Immortal Venerable!"
"His sister is the Lady of the City, and Chu Chao, who was killed just now, was his son. Now things have really gotten serious..."
"This elite Immortal Guard Army is comprised of experts at or above Third Grade Profound Immortal!"
"Indeed, powerful individuals can’t suppress local potentates!"
All eyes turned sympathetically toward Jiang Cheng, realizing this would be difficult to settle.
Sure, Jiang Cheng had three Immortal Venerables backing him, but here in the Immortal City, the City Lord hadn’t even personally intervened yet.
Not to mention that their numbers were not on the same scale.
Inside the Celestial Pavilion, Ye Yang Immortal King and Miao Yu watched the scene outside indifferent.
For an Immortal King, Danhua City’s forces could be eliminated with a flick of a hand, so they viewed the situation with a detached interest.
Ding Rui respectfully inquired from the side: "Do you need them expelled?"
With so many people blocking the door, could they still conduct business?
Miao Yu slightly shook her head: "No need."
"I’d like to see what he relies on."
The earlier conversation had not put Jiang Cheng in her good graces.
She had never encountered someone so reckless and disrespectful.
Yet, she held a position of authority and would not lose composure over something trivial.
Ye Yang Immortal King also commented coolly, "Even if they can hold off this lot, there’s still the City Lord of Danhua City and another two thousand Immortal Guard Army."
"The conflict is now open, and even if he regrets and seeks help, we can’t intervene in others’ feuds."
"He’s missed his only chance to live."
"Leave him to his fate."
Ding Rui agreed, the Immortal King made sense.
If Jiang Cheng had backed down earlier and agreed to Miao Yu’s terms, he might have slipped away unnoticed.
Now that the enemy was at the gate, it was too late for everything.
The Celestial Pavilion couldn’t change its neutral tradition for him.
"Ancestor, what should we do now?"
Su Ye and Su Meng faced the situation. It would be self-deceptive denial to say they weren’t scared.
While Yuan Zhe, Yuan Wu, and Yuan He, the three Immortal Venerables, remained silent, just watching Jiang Cheng.
Since the trouble was stirred up, let’s see how you handle it.
Brother Cheng was feeling disappointed.
If what the inside people said was true, the opposing force was only one-third of their strength.
Did they really look down on him that much?
"Just find a good angle and watch the show."
Having said that, he walked out of the commerce association alone to face the thousand strong adversaries.
Leng Huahan was anxious and quickly followed him out.
"Ancestor, don’t act recklessly. It’s best to de-escalate the situation..."
Currently, he had no trust in this Ancestor; a casual remark could escalate the matter further, truly a worrisome concern.
"Just play your part as a spectator."
Brother Cheng ignored him, busy expressing his displeasure to the opposing side.
"Is this the extent of your power?"
"Without the Ascension Battle nowadays, these Immortal Cities are really declining. Even Profound Immortals can join the Immortal Guard Army."
Thinking back to the Ascension Battle back then, the top ten Immortal Cities in the Lower Immortal Realm usually had seven to eight hundred Profound Immortals.
This is the Middle Immortal Realm, and Danhua City is a central Immortal City in the Celestial Domain, yet this is all?
As the representative of the Qianlan Celestial Realm, it’s quite subpar, isn’t it?
Such words were adding fuel to the fire.
The entire crowd was in an uproar, and Leng Huahan almost fainted.
Was he dissatisfied that the other side already didn’t hate him enough?
Chu Yue took two deep breaths, struggling to regain composure.
"Are you the one who killed my son?"
Facing the spear pointed at him, Brother Cheng nodded honestly.
"That’s right, it was me."
Whether it was Yuan Zhe and Yuan Wu in the rear or Miao Yu and Ye Yang Immortal King above, they all shook their heads silently.
Such direct admission, offering no explanation, showed a lack of savvy.
If you really had to fight, at least establish a moral high ground beforehand.
Chu Yue’s eyes turned red with anger, his fury turned into laughter, "So, it was indeed your satisfactory act!"
"Don’t praise it so plainly."
Brother Cheng graciously accepted the ’praise’ from the other side.
"I personally enjoy helping others, and since you had no time to teach your son, I did it for you."
"No need to come here to thank me, after all, we do good deeds without seeking repayment."
Everyone’s jaws dropped; was this something a person would say?
Miao Yu above suddenly felt more balanced.
It turned out, his way of speaking was consistent with everyone, not just targeted at her alone.
As for Leng Huahan, he was already in despair.
Everything was ruined.
The ties were irreparably severed.
Don’t mention Chu Yue already being fuming, even if he originally had no plans to start a fight, he now had no choice but to engage.
"Die!"
The spear arched a colossal rainbow light, instantly engulfing Jiang Cheng.
"Kill!"
"Destroy him!"
In an instant, a thousand members of the Immortal Guard Army charged forward in unison.
"Not good!"
Leng Huahan’s face changed dramatically, although these thousand members were still only Profound Immortals, a coordinated thousand would be impossible for an ordinary Immortal Venerable to withstand head-on under the battle formation’s support.
Not to mention he was only a Third Grade Golden Immortal.
"Uncle Master!"
He quickly turned back for help.
Though the three Elders Yuan Zhe, Yuan Wu, Yuan He hadn’t intended to watch passively forever, they knew it was their turn to act.
After all, the Sect Leader had entrusted the Ancestor to them; they couldn’t let him die here.
However, the three Elders had just started summoning their Immortal Artefacts and Magical Treasures when they stopped.
For they realized, it was unnecessary now.
The immense rainbow light from the spear was suddenly dispelled as they watched.
"""
