chapters.title: Chapter 275: Can this also steal my thunder?
chapters.content:
Chapter 275: Chapter 275: Can this also steal my thunder?
The crimson glow rapidly expanded, sweeping across, and instantly engulfed Chu Yue within.
As the radiant light passed, the people around Chu Yue screamed miserably.
The Immortal Body had long since become impervious to fiery scorching, and the Immortal Armor itself was wonderfully miraculous, but unfortunately, this was no ordinary flame.
With so many Heroic Soul Buffs plus 992 Main Rules, Brother Cheng’s casual strike had already surpassed most Immortal Venerables.
In the sky above, figures were visibly evaporating at a speed visible to the naked eye, turning into dust.
Wherever he killed, the sky was covered by the radiant glow.
And the Immortal Guard Army there was annihilated in swathes, rendering formations completely useless.
After all, he was using the Rainbow Absolute Immortal Sword of the Nine Flames Immortal Emperor.
This is a Ninth-grade Immortal Sword.
To these people, it was nothing short of a Dimensional Reduction Strike.
The efficiency of the slaughter was simply outrageous.
In just a few seconds, only Chu Yue remained on the field.
As an Immortal Venerable, he was still struggling to hold on.
However, with the demise of the other Immortal Guard Army members, as Jiang Cheng officially reached him, he couldn’t hold out any longer.
Swipe!
The Immortal Sword swung down, and a figure fell, abruptly ending the grim battle.
Now without the good helpers like Three-Eyed Tiger and Mo Chen to clean up the battlefield, Brother Cheng was busy indeed, immediately starting to collect all the scattered Storage Rings.
Unfortunately, most of the Immortal Armor here had been destroyed in the battle.
However, the harvest was still very rich, as there was an Immortal Venerable among them, after all.
A rough estimate showed about 300 points of Merit, equivalent to 3 trillion points from before.
Meanwhile, the system continuously notified him of the Shock Value credits.
Annoyed by the incessant noise, he could only turn off that notification sound.
After this battle, he had amassed as much as 350,000 in Shock Value.
The shock levels of many present had already exploded, reaching the extent of awe and even worship.
Because this battle power was simply too strong.
Until he was done, others finally closed their mouths.
"Did Chu Yue Immortal Venerable really die?"
"A thousand Immortal Guard Army members were wiped out just like that?"
"Just one person, so quickly?"
There were very few Immortal Kings in the Middle Immortal Realm, and Immortal Venerables were already highly esteemed.
They weren’t just Elders of a sect or major city leaders; they were undoubtedly significant figures.
To the people here, Immortal Venerables were heights unattainable in their lifetime.
Yet just now, an Immortal Venerable had died before their eyes.
If they hadn’t seen it themselves, most of those present would never have believed it to be true.
"What kind of power does this person possess?"
"No... the key is that sword!"
"The power of that sword... seems quite abnormal."
"Indeed, I’d bet that it’s at least a Seventh-grade Immortal Sword!"
"A Seventh-grade Immortal Sword? Impossible?"
The difference in power between grades of Immortal Artifacts is often worlds apart.
Back during the Ascension Battle in the Lower Immortal Realm, the top city lords used Fourth-grade Immortal Artifacts.
While in the Middle Immortal Realm, some great sect leaders often use Sixth-grade Immortal Artifacts.
Once an Immortal Sword surpasses the Sixth-grade, it undergoes a qualitative leap.
At this stage, Immortal Artifacts are no longer just about power augmentation or Artifact Spirits at such a low level.
Seventh-grade Immortal Artifacts communicate to a certain extent with the Power of Rules with every strike, essentially attacking with the most fundamental rules.
For this reason, Immortal Artifacts above the Seventh-grade not only require crafting techniques at a high level, but also enough understanding of the rules, and beyond that, need opportunities.
In addition, the vast amounts of treasure materials and terrifying failure rates are enough to make many great sects unable to bear it.
Even a giant like the Celestial Pavilion, which is said to collect all treasures in the Middle Immortal Realm and has everything for sale, doesn’t have Seventh-grade Immortal Artifacts for sale.
At this moment, everyone’s eyes were on Brother Cheng’s Immortal Sword.
Their gaze was not just full of envy and covetousness, but inevitably tinged with greed and frenzy.
A Seventh-grade Immortal Artifact was too tempting for them.
"Is that sword really a Seventh-grade Immortal Sword?"
Ding Rui looked incredulous.
How could a Seventh-grade Immortal Sword appear in the hands of a Golden Immortal?
Miao Yu stared at the sword for a long time before an increasingly deep doubt appeared in her dark eyes.
She vaguely felt that the sword’s appearance seemed familiar.
But upon further thought, she couldn’t recall where from.
Ye Yang Immortal King also looked intently at the scene, and upon hearing this, said in a deep voice, "It should be, but this person himself is definitely not just at the Golden Immortal level."
"Seventh-grade Immortal Artifacts have extremely strong power, but not to the extent of letting a First Grade Golden Immortal instantly kill an Immortal Venerable."
"He himself likely has the power of an Immortal Venerable too."
If Brother Cheng could hear Ye Yang Immortal King’s assessment, he would certainly be delighted, patting him on the shoulder and saying, "Brother, you have a good eye, recognizing my extraordinary nature."
But unfortunately, the crowd present were not Ye Yang Immortal King.
Their hearts and minds were all captured by that Immortal Sword.
Hearing everyone praise... his weapon, Brother Cheng felt both lost and furious.
It was truly infuriating; after carefully making a show of himself, the spotlight was actually stolen by his own weapon.
Are you all blind?
Don’t you know the main character is standing right in front of you?
Don’t you understand what it means to be the center of attention?
But fortunately, he had now cultivated two new sycophants.
Su Ye and Su Meng, the two outer sect female disciples, rushed out, chattering incessantly in praise around Brother Cheng.
"Wow, the ancestor is amazing!"
"Simply too formidable, annihilating so many enemies with one sword, oh my god..."
They were still just True Immortals, with little understanding of the power of a Profound Immortal, Golden Immortal, or Immortal Venerable.
But that wasn’t important, what mattered was making the ancestor happy.
Only then did Brother Cheng beamingly revel in joy.
In the past, whenever he showed off, a bunch of disciples cheered on the side, and lately, he wasn’t used to not having them.
The long-missed flattery was so wonderful it brought tears to his eyes!
Though these two female disciples praised plainly without much creativity or flair, he wasn’t picky.
Given time, they would improve.
However, this wonderful atmosphere was quickly interrupted by Leng Huahan.
"Ancestor, it’s not safe here, we should leave as soon as possible!"
His face was solemn, deeply shaken by the recent battle, but as an experienced True Disciple, he thought further.
After taking down those people earlier, the city lord and other experts certainly wouldn’t let it go!
No one could be sure if the ancestor’s Immortal Sword would be as miraculous next time.
Yuan Wu, Yuan Zhe, and Yuan He also looked hurried as they said,
"Anyone who can become a city lord definitely has backing; the issue has now blown up completely."
"Yes, it’s best to leave here as soon as possible!"
"Returning to the sect, we have the Great Array protection..."
Seeing these four not only not praising him but also constantly eyeing his Immortal Sword while speaking, like everyone else, Brother Cheng was furious.
What the heck?
Do you also think it was the sword, not this ancestor, who just showed off?
Then I must truly vindicate myself!
"Isn’t it just the little ones being followed by the older ones, and the older ones by their backing? It’s an old routine!"
Everyone was speechless, so you know everything after all.
Then why aren’t you leaving?

chapters.title: Chapter 276 Eliminating Harm for the People
chapters.content:
Chapter 276: Chapter 276 Eliminating Harm for the People
City Lord Yu Xun of Danhua City quickly rushed over, just like in the old routine.
But what happened next took everyone by surprise.
City Lord Yu, with a large group of experts, flew down and rushed up to Jiang Cheng in just a few steps.
"You killed Chu Dynasty?"
Brother Cheng, of course, nodded straightforwardly: "That’s right, it was me."
Come on, let’s start the fight.
Don’t bother with any foreplay, I’m eager to overshadow my own weapon to prove my strength.
"Thank you!"
Before he could react, his hands were grabbed by Yu Xun.
"Thank you for ridding Danhua City of a menace!"
The city lord looked grateful, as if he’d met a savior, utterly excited.
Uh, this...
Everyone else present was also stunned.
What’s going on?
A comrade was killed, and not only is there no revenge, but thanks are given to the enemy?
This is too outrageous, isn’t it?
Brother Cheng was also caught off guard, he was still expecting a grand battle.
But now he finds himself in this situation, isn’t that losing the chance to gain Shock Value?
"Well, I heard that guy earlier was your nephew, wasn’t he?"
He still wanted to ’remedy’ this, reminding the other party of their deep-seated hatred.
As soon as he finished speaking, Yu Xun immediately snapped, "I don’t have such a nephew!"
"Chu Dynasty was a dissolute person, bullying and oppressive, causing public resentment, this City Lord has long been disgusted with him!"
"Originally, I wanted to sacrifice family loyalty for justice, but I never had the heart to go through with it!"
"Today, you rid me of this scourge, it’s truly a great relief!"
"This City Lord represents the entire Immortal City in thanking your righteousness, may I know your esteemed name?"
Sect Leader Jiang, not weak in verbal combat, for the first time felt out of step with the conversation’s pace.
This doesn’t fit the script.
Are you pretending?
Trying to stabilize me first, then take me down when I’m off guard?
"But, I’ve also killed a thousand of your subordinates, including an Immortal Venerable."
Upon hearing this, Leng Huahan and Yuan Zhe both wanted to cover his mouth.
Ancestor, can’t you say a little less?
Whether this city lord is pretending or not, don’t just pick sensitive words to say.
Stabilize him first, then look for a chance to escape!
"Well killed!"
City Lord Yu wasn’t angry upon hearing a thousand of his subordinates were killed, instead, he clapped excitedly.
Laughed and said: "Killed perfectly!"
"That’s the second thing I want to thank you for!"
Brother Cheng and all the audience were dumbfounded together.
Brother, are you out of your mind?
That Immortal Venerable Chu Yue, if I’m not mistaken, should be your wife’s brother, your brother-in-law, right?
And those thousand Immortal Guard Army members were your subordinates.
No matter how forgiving someone is, it’s impossible to act like nothing happened.
And you even express gratitude?
Isn’t your act a bit over the top?
Even if there aren’t many simple-minded people who can become immortals, many quickly figured it out.
If Jiang Cheng can easily take out a thousand Immortal Guard Army members and an Immortal Venerable, even if the city lord brought the remaining two thousand, it’d just be giving away.
At most, it’d just delay it a little longer.
After all, that Immortal Sword is too fierce.
If he wants revenge, he’d have to think of another way, like lowering Jiang Cheng’s guard.
"You must find it hard to believe!"
Yu Xun seems to have realized everyone’s thoughts, and sighed deeply.
"Alas, this city lord appears glorious on the surface, but actually knows his own struggles."
"Ever since Chu Yue and his faction settled in Danhua City years ago, this city lord has gradually been marginalized by them..."
"Marginalized?"
Yu Xun nodded heavily: "Over the years, he secretly formed factions, colluded with powerful outsiders, many Immortal Guard Army members are already his direct lineage."
"My orders often aren’t as effective as his single word."
"For this reason, I haven’t been able to act against Chu Dynasty."
"If this continued, it’s only a matter of time before I was replaced."
He grasped Sect Leader Jiang’s hand again, and earnestly expressed his gratitude: "If it wasn’t for your act of destroying them, how would I ever have a chance to turn the tide?"
"Now say, should I not thank you?"
"This..."
Brother Cheng’s mouth twitched, this is too coincidental, isn’t it?
"It seems my words alone aren’t enough to convince you."
City Lord Yu clapped his hands, and the Immortal Guard Army behind him pushed forward several hundred varied dressed immortals.
"These are all Chu Yue’s relatives and followers!"
"If not for you slaying the main culprit today, I wouldn’t dare move against them easily!"
"But now..."
Those several hundred people were terrified, struggling mightily but unable to escape, desperately begging for mercy.
"No, please!"
"Lord City, we were unaware!"
"Uncle, I’m your nephew, you even held me when I was young..."
Yu Xun slowly closed his eyes, and his right hand slowly lowered.
Immediately, those several hundred people were executed on the spot, not one left alive!
Although fewer people died than before, it felt several times more brutal and bloody, some immortals present even turned their faces away.
No other choice, at least earlier it was war, life and death by fate.
But now it’s a one-sided execution.
"From now on, the sky of Danhua City is restored to brilliance!"
With these words, over ten thousand residents of the Immortal City behind him waved their arms and shouted praises, exclaiming the kill was well done, a relief for the people, the city lord is wise...
It seems the resentment had really built up for a long time.
"Do you believe me now?"
Brother Cheng twitched his mouth helplessly, he didn’t expect to stumble upon such a situation.
Turns out by wiping out those thousand people, he actually fulfilled the city lord’s wishes?
But this city lord himself isn’t an easy character, such a ruthless heart.
"It was just a minor matter, not worth mentioning."
Unable to keep up the act, he felt a bit disinterested.
"No, no, no..."
"For me, this is an immense favor, I can’t ignore it!"
"I feel like we’ve known each other at first sight, preparations have already been made for a banquet, may I invite you to the mansion for a chat?"
Yu Xun’s warm invitation was natural, after all, Jiang Cheng helped him out majorly, so being overly grateful was expected.
However, Leng Huahan once again suspected.
The reason being, it’s too coincidences.
And with this person’s decisiveness just now, he doesn’t seem like a weak city lord who would be marginalized.
He hurriedly transmitted a message: "Ancestor, it’s best not to go to this banquet, it could very well be a trap."
Brother Cheng looked speechless, thinking you’re the clever one?
He’d rather it be a trap.
That way, he’d have a stage to continue showing off!
If everything City Lord Yu said was true, he’d actually be disappointed.
"Lead the way!"
Brother Cheng waved his hand, and Yu Xun was momentarily stunned, seemingly not used to his new ’Pathfinder’ role.
But shortly after, he resumed his smile.
"Please, please, please!"
With that, the group set off for the City Lord’s Mansion.
Leng Huahan was both angry and anxious at the back.
He exchanged glances with Elders Yuan Zhe, Yuan Wu, and Yuan He, meaning what to do next?
"What else can we do, follow him!"
"We can’t let him die here."
"Proceed with caution!"
After they all departed, the immortals in the Celestial Pavilion resumed their heated discussions.
And Ding Rui upstairs couldn’t help but remark: "This Yu Xun is indeed ruthless when it comes to killing, this matter is getting more and more mysterious."

chapters.title: Chapter 277: Isn’t It Beautiful
chapters.content:
Chapter 277: Chapter 277: Isn’t It Beautiful
"There’s nothing mysterious about this; it’s just a trap."
Ye Yang Immortal King concluded, expressionless.
"That Jiang fellow is finished."
Ding Rui was a bit surprised.
Indeed, Yu Xun might be lying to deliberately make Jiang Cheng lower his guard, but it’s only a possibility.
Before he reveals his true intentions, no one can make a direct conclusion.
Because he just behaved so naturally, showing no traces of acting.
Moreover, he killed so many people.
Honestly, Ding Rui’s inner suspicions inclined towards him being genuine.
"Immortal artifacts simply allure people."
Miao Yu seemed indifferent about the Seventh-grade Immortal Artifact, her words carried a hint of sarcasm.
"For Divine Weapons and Immortal Artifacts, some people will do anything, even kill their own."
Ding Rui was still puzzled: "But even if he’s really acting, trying to seize the artifact, it would be quite difficult, wouldn’t it?"
Yu Xun has two Immortal Venerables under his command, over a hundred Golden Immortals, and two thousand from the Immortal Guard Army.
Such a force is undeniably strong.
But it’s not that Ding Rui was underestimating him; it’s rather that this force, before that Immortal Artifact, doesn’t seem sufficient.
With Jiang Cheng’s speed of slaughter earlier, even if these people set an ambush and deployed a Great Array, they might still just be cannon fodder.
The power of that Immortal Artifact was too great.
Not to mention Jiang Cheng had three Immortal Venerables by his side.
No matter how one sees it, it seems impossible to succeed.
Ye Yang Immortal King said calmly, "That’s because you don’t know Yu Xun’s background."
"His background?"
As the Branch President here, Ding Rui knew about Yu Xun, the City Lord.
"I know that before he became the City Lord, he was an Inner Sect Elder of the Mixed Yang Sect."
The Mixed Yang Sect is one of the top three Great Sects within the Qianlan Celestial Realm, with over a hundred Immortal Venerables within, an undeniably powerful force.
Most outsiders only know Yu Xun gradually rose tens of thousands of years ago, eventually becoming the City Lord of Danhua City.
Few really know he originally had deeply rooted ties with the Mixed Yang Sect.
Ding Rui, as the Branch President of the Celestial Pavilion, was indeed very well-informed.
"Could it be he’s planning to notify the Mixed Yang Sect, to mobilize experts and collectively kill that Jiang fellow, to seize his Immortal Artifact?"
Ye Yang Immortal Venerable shook his head.
"Being an Elder of the Mixed Yang Sect is merely a surface identity of his."
"That’s just a superficial identity?"
Ding Rui was taken aback, sensing he might have touched upon some deep secrets.
"Then his true identity..."
"He’s a member of the Ghost Alliance."
"What!"
Ding Rui almost jumped up.
The words ’Ghost Alliance’ were like a venomous snake, making his spine prick with fear.
It’s a colossal organization spanning over thirty surrounding Celestial Domains, with the Qianlan Celestial Realm as just one of their activity areas.
Almost everyone in the surrounding domains has heard of this organization, yet no one can specifically say who the members are.
They don’t have a fixed sect residence, resembling more of a loose alliance.
But no one dares to underestimate them, because there are more than one Immortal King level experts behind this organization.
Furthermore, their conduct is secretive and ruthless, having overturned countless forces in recent years.
The Qianlan Celestial Realm’s unsolved cases often have them as the first suspect.
Facing the Ghost Alliance, even some Ancient Immortal Sects dare not provoke them easily.
"Yu Xun was able to become the City Lord of Danhua City precisely because the Ghost Alliance aided behind the scenes."
Miao Yu evidently knew this information too.
She gazed pensively in the direction of the City Lord’s Mansion: "So that Jiang fellow is actually being targeted by the Ghost Alliance now."
Ding Rui took a deep breath, trying to calm his mind.
He eventually sighed: "Then he’s really doomed."
In recent years, none of the targets marked by the Ghost Alliance have survived; they’ve even killed Immortal Kings.
Elsewhere, Leng Huahan and Yuan Wu alongside others followed Brother Cheng into the City Lord’s Mansion.
By this time, a grand feast had already been prepared inside.
Colorful performances, and immortal music echoed.
Dan Hua City’s other two Immortal Venerables and a group of Golden Immortals had been waiting for quite a while.
Seeing them arrive, everyone rose to welcome them.
Leng Huahan and Yuan Zhe among others grew increasingly tense as the opponent also had three Immortal Venerables.
Hopefully, it’s genuine gratitude.
If it’s an ambush, it would be a dragon’s lair and a tiger’s den!
"Hahaha, please come, my honoured guest!"
City Lord Yu Xun was exceedingly hospitable, taking Jiang Cheng by the hand and personally leading him to the head seat.
Subsequently, the banquet proceeded normally.
The dazzling performances of fairies were of no interest to Leng Huahan.
He kept glancing at Elder Jiang, hoping he would be cautious.
As it turned out, the elder seemed completely unguarded, accepting drinks from all comers, fully immersed.
This made him increasingly anxious.
Yu Xun was in high spirits, even started sporting an arm over Jiang Zhang’s shoulders.
"Hahaha, I find myself kindred to Brother Jiang, and so I have a rather presumptuous request!"
"Speak!"
"Why don’t we seize this moment to become sworn brothers, wouldn’t it be splendid..."
"Not splendid."
The entire room abruptly fell silent, with even the performances halted.
Everyone stared blankly at Brother Cheng, wondering if they had heard wrong.
These kinds of proposals for brotherhood are usually never refused.
After all, there’s no binding obligation; it’s not like they’ll actually share life and death.
If one truly unwilling, they could forget the next day.
Furthermore, City Lord Yu is a Sixth-grade Immortal Venerable, and you’re merely a First Grade Golden Immortal.
If it weren’t for having a Tier Seven Immortal Artifact, you wouldn’t even be qualified to converse with him, right?
Yu Xun’s expression became somewhat unnatural; he didn’t expect to be refused, especially so outright.
"Brother, this, this..."
Brother Cheng waved his hand: "It’s better not to call me brother; I’m much higher in rank than you."
"If you want, you may call me Elder Jiang."
Want to become sworn brothers with him?
Why, do you wish to be Ji Linghan and Luo Yuan’s elder, perchance?
The lively banquet descended into an eerie silence.
Leng Huahan was overwhelmed, thinking Elder Jiang might have gone mad?
Others want to be your brother, and you somehow wish to be their ancestor?
This blatant public humiliation, oh no, it’s actually a slap in someone’s face.
Not afraid of tearing face in the next moment?
Even if unwilling, the words could be gentler to stabilize the counterpart!
Such remarks even without existing animosity can create new hatred.
Yu Xun’s cultivation of grace was indeed exceptional; after brief awkwardness, he managed a smile once more.
"Haha, my honored guest does love to jest..."
He wouldn’t possibly call Jiang Cheng ’Elder’.
Just then, his ears subtly perked up, followed by seven differently aged immortals entering the hall.
Yuan Zhe, Yuan Wu, and Yuan He subtly perceived, their faces drastically changed; the seven were all Immortal Venerables!
Moreover, all seven possessed cultivation above theirs.
The leading white-beard elder smirked and spoke two words.
"It’s settled."
Yu Xun rose gracefully, once again smilingly looking at Jiang Cheng.
"Honored guest, how would you like to die?"

chapters.title: Chapter 278: Brother Cheng’s Fury
chapters.content:
Chapter 278: Chapter 278: Brother Cheng’s Fury
The plot has finally been set into motion, and Brother Cheng was overjoyed.
Just as he was about to speak, Elder Yuan Zhe jumped out with a tense expression.
"City Lord Yu, what do you mean by this?"
In this day and age, Immortal Cities aren’t as important, so their power isn’t very strong.
Usually, an Immortal City might have one or two Immortal Venerables, so it’s odd for Danhua City to suddenly have so many.
Yu Xun had already retreated to the back, putting some distance between himself and the others.
"You’re asking me what I mean?"
"You killed my nephew and over a thousand of my Immortal Guard Army. Don’t you think I should seek revenge?"
The City Lord still wore a smile, but now it seemed filled with hatred rather than warmth.
"But earlier you said it was to rid the people of evil..."
Though he originally suspected a trick, hearing this admission from his own mouth made Elder Yuan Zhe find it hard to accept.
Your act was too convincing, wasn’t it?
"If I hadn’t acted convincingly, would you have fallen for it?"
Leng Huahan looked incredulous and said, "Just to trick us, you even killed your own people?"
The hundreds of people killed before their eyes were truly dead, no tricks involved.
City Lord Yu nodded with a grin.
"Exactly, sacrifices must be made for a grand plan."
"Their sacrifice was meaningful, at least it lured you here and bought time for my allies to arrive."
He spread his hands: "Any other questions?"
"Before you die, at least know why."
Looking at his grinning face, Leng Huahan and the others were chilled to the core.
Is this even a human?
A twisted lunatic with psychological issues.
How did he manage to cultivate into an Immortal?
To gain trust and lure Jiang Cheng here to delay time, couldn’t he have used other methods instead of going to such extremes?
Being related to this City Lord must truly be a high-risk occupation.
"You’re ruthless!"
"What exactly do you want?"
Faced with the accusations and questions from Yuan Zhe and Yuan Wu, Yu Xun shrugged.
"I want that sword."
He pointed at Brother Cheng’s Immortal Sword and smiled again, "Of course, you won’t just hand it over."
"And I don’t want to force anyone against their will."
"So, I’ll just have to ask you all to die."
"You!"
His words made so much sense that Elder Yuan Zhe was momentarily speechless.
He could only issue a dry threat: "Aren’t you afraid the Feixian Sect will come after you?"
Yuan Wu and Yuan He quickly joined in to bolster the threat.
"That’s right, our Feixian Sect has 19 Immortal Venerables. You’d better think carefully!"
In these times, the power of Immortal Cities doesn’t match those of Cultivation Sects.
"If you act against us, you won’t survive either!"
Yu Xun almost laughed aloud.
"Feixian Sect?"
"Once I have this Immortal Sword, why would I care about any Immortal City?"
"Besides, can your Feixian Sect contend with the Ghost Alliance?"
Ghost Alliance!
Hearing these two words, the faces of Leng Huahan and the three elders changed drastically again.
This organization is extremely mysterious, but it’s known throughout the major Celestial Domains.
For one simple reason, its notorious reputation is overwhelming, feared by all.
"You, you’re actually part of the Ghost Alliance?"
"That’s right."
The white-bearded old man beside Yu Xun also chuckled.
"We’re all members of the Ghost Alliance."
"Moreover, we’re not Immortal Cultivators, we’re Demon Cultivators."
Their candidness left Leng Huahan and the others in utter despair.
Not to mention Feixian Sect, even the largest sect in the Qianlan Celestial Realm wouldn’t dare oppose the Ghost Alliance!
Why has this terrifying underground giant set its sights on them?
The three elders slowly turned to look at Jiang Cheng.
If it weren’t for his high-profile actions, slaughtering so many, and revealing a Tier Seven Immortal Artifact, they wouldn’t have attracted such a powerful enemy.
In their eyes, this could have been completely avoided.
The fact that it wasn’t is entirely due to his series of blundering decisions.
Thinking of this, how could they not feel a bit resentful?
"Elder Jiang, what should we do now?"
"With your prowess, guide us to safety."
"Right, you’re so good at causing trouble, you should be able to settle it, right?"
This tone was a bit sarcastic and mocking.
However, Brother Cheng seemed not to notice, proudly stepping forward.
"That’s a must!"
"Ah, it’s that time again where I, Brother, must save the day and rescue my comrades."
Even in the face of despair, Leng Huahan and the three elders felt an overwhelming urge to mock.
Where does this never-ending confidence come from?
Finishing his words, he slowly summoned the Rainbow Absolute Immortal Sword.
He had no choice; although Jiang Cheng wished for death, he couldn’t just let himself be killed.
Once the Immortal Sword appeared, the ten Demon Venerables opposite him all tensed up, becoming serious.
If not for this sword, they wouldn’t have mobilized so many people.
"So, your confidence is based on this sword."
The leading white-bearded old man smiled slightly.
"Out of respect for the Tier Seven Immortal Artifact, we not only use numbers against the few, but also employ the Seven-Star Blood Banner."
"I hope you understand..."
As his words fell, a blood-red flag rose above the heads of the seven Demon Venerables.
Subsequently, the original City Lord’s Mansion transformed into a dense Sea of Blood, making it hard to breathe.
"To activate the Seven-Star Blood Banner, it requires not only seven Demon Cultivators but also sufficient blood energy as an impetus."
"In this Sea of Blood, we Demon Cultivators grow stronger the more we fight."
"As for you all, regardless of your power realm or weapons, all will be tainted with blood filth..."
Their smug explanations were interrupted by an annoyed Brother Cheng.
"Stop, stop, stop!"
"What did you just say?"
"Putting on this spectacle is just to honor this sword?"
Damn it, everyone only has eyes for this Immortal Sword, completely ignoring its master!
Intolerable!
Moreover, who said this is a Tier Seven Immortal Artifact?
Why does everyone assume this sword is Tier Seven?
Yu Xun and that old man exchanged a puzzled glance, not understanding why he was so agitated.
"Then what is it?"
Brother Cheng had to remind them of the key point: "Did you forget who’s wielding this sword?"
"It’s you."
"So who’s the key to this battle?"
Leng Huahan and Yuan Zhe had expected some profound insight from him.
After all this, was he just resentful that the weapon overshadowed him?
We’re in a desperate situation!
Desperate!
Is this really the time to be worrying about such nonsensical issues?
The Demon Cultivators on the other side, though quite twisted themselves, found it hard to keep up with his thought process.
They had no choice, this guy was even more abnormal than they were.
Yu Xun opened his mouth, momentarily unsure how to respond.
But one of the Demon Venerables in the back sneered.
"You’re overthinking it, aren’t you?"
You’re just a Golden Immortal, without this sword, any Demon Venerable could easily finish you off.
Hearing this, Brother Cheng, who had maintained a casual attitude, was finally enraged.
"Damn you, how dare you!"
"Blind trash! Die for me!"
In a fit of rage, he unleashed a tenfold critical strike!

chapters.title: Chapter 282 282: Immortal Artifact Moves the Heart!
chapters.content:
Brother Cheng turned back in surprise: "You people from the Celestial Pavilion are really strange. What do you want with the Immortal Fate Order? Aside from ascending to the Upper Immortal Realm, does this thing have any other use?"
Yan Wei thought to himself, of course, I know it's for ascension.
The problem is you're buying way too many.
"So, how many exactly does the gentleman wish to purchase?"
Brother Cheng candidly revealed: "Let's try out the waters with over three thousand first."
Yan Wei almost jumped up.
Over three thousand?
And that's just to test the waters?
He gulped hard, continuing: "If you want to ascend, one is enough."
In fact, Jiang Cheng had the Xuanji Map, so buying one was really enough.
There was no need to waste so many Immortal Crystals.
Others might pack into the Xuanji Map, possibly bringing them up directly like when entering the Void Immortal Realm and ascending to the Immortal Realm.
The reason for buying so many was for other purposes.
But this purpose was something he naturally wouldn't foolishly reveal to outsiders.
He glanced at Leng Huahan, Yuan Zhe, and others, then looked at Su Ye and Su Meng.
He suddenly covered half his face, mysteriously saying: "Let me tell you a secret, I am the ancestor of the Feixian Sect, with many disciples and grandchildren."
Everyone was speechless, what kind of nonsense secret is this.
Yan Wei originally didn't know the Feixian Sect, but with the big things Jiang Cheng did in the last couple of days, the Feixian Sect naturally became famous, making it hard not to know.
It was a normally-sized middle-class Sect that was said to have had a glorious history but is now already in decline.
"You're not planning on taking a few thousand people to the Upper Immortal Realm, are you?"
"Why not?"
Yan Wei gasped.
He wanted to ask if he was crazy.
Those large powerful entities like the Ancient Immortal Sect with several Immortal Kings, or the formidable behemoth like the Ghost Alliance, can only send up a hundred or so people at most each time.
That is already considered exaggerated.
And you actually want to bring up a few thousand at once?
Dreaming?
Leng Huahan and Yuan Zhe had already given up reasoning with him.
This ancestor, offering answers to whatever people asked, didn't have any sense of precaution or secrecy.
These days, what they most wanted to do was find a seal to shut his mouth, just that they didn't dare to do it.
But seeing the dumbfounded expression on Yan Wei's face across, they couldn't help but find it a bit amusing.
If you knew the ancestor actually wanted to buy tens of thousands, just temporarily didn't have that many Immortal Crystals, who knows what your expression would be.
Holding back for a long time, Yan Wei could only awkwardly give Brother Cheng a thumbs up.
"Your style is really grand!"
He was in business, even if he thought it ridiculous, there was no reason to discourage a customer from buying more.
"Not really."
Brother Cheng was about to leave, planning to depart to the next location, when Yan Wei quickly approached again.
"Please wait, may I report to headquarters for a moment..."
"Report what?"
"See if we can gather the Immortal Fate Orders from other branches so that you don't have to run around."
This suggestion made Brother Cheng's eyes light up with joy.
Thinking about 3,300 Immortal Fate Orders, he'd have to visit at least 30 places.
The Celestial Pavilion often has branches separated by several Celestial Domains, unsure of how far he would have to travel.
"Alright, then you report."
Leng Huahan and Yuan Zhe panicked, quickly advising him again.
"Ancestor, we cannot linger here!"
"Why not, could this Celestial Pavilion covet Brother's wealth and harm us?"
"Not that, just that more and more people are watching us from the outside, staying too long in one place is too dangerous."
Moving around at least made their whereabouts more erratic, which they believed was safer.
Brother Cheng glanced at them disdainfully, carelessly saying: "If you're scared, you can return first."
Anyway, he was already the focus of the Middle Immortal Realm; the stage for showing off was big enough, and missing a few audience members didn't matter.
Leng Huahan and the others could only shut their mouths.
Meanwhile, Miao Yu and Ye Yang Immortal King, along with other high-ranking members of the Celestial Pavilion, also received the news here.
"He wants over 3,000 Immortal Fate Orders?"
"Is he crazy, courting death?"
Soon, of the 12 Immortal Kings within the Celestial Pavilion, even 9 joined the discussion.
It wasn't that the order was so large, a few billion Immortal Crystals wouldn't shake the Celestial Pavilion up or down.
The main thing was that the Immortal Fate Order itself was too special.
"According to him, he's planning to take over 3,000 members of the Feixian Sect up."
"He's really ambitious, bringing what along?"
"Someone with a Tier Eight Immortal Artifact surely isn't a fool, could there be multiple Immortal Kings backing him?"
"Unless a few Ancient Immortal Sects of the Middle Immortal Realm teamed up, no one can take so many up at once!"
"This Feixian Sect... actually isn't simple!"
"Indeed, I've heard of that history. Several tens of millions of years ago, they were once the top faction in the Middle Immortal Realm!"
"Had they not moved up to the Upper Immortal Realm early without managing the Middle Immortal Realm, the current situation might have long been changed..."
"Enough, the current state of the Feixian Sect is already in decline, talking about history is meaningless."
After discussing for a long time, the Immortal Kings couldn't figure it out.
What exactly Jiang Cheng wanted to do, where his confidence came from, no one could guess out of thin air.
"So do we sell or not?"
"Sell!"
"We are in business, there's no reason to refuse business, no matter how they fight it has nothing to do with us."
In the end, Yan Wei conveyed the new 'meeting decision' to Brother Cheng.
"The surrounding branches will gather over 3,000 Immortal Fate Orders within three days."
"We will ensure your safety inside the Celestial Pavilion."
"But after you leave the Celestial Pavilion, our protection does not extend, and we hope you understand."
Jiang Cheng readily agreed: "No problem."
The news that their group settled in the Celestial Pavilion quickly spread.
Being invited to stay in the Celestial Pavilion was quite prestigious.
However, the danger outside was also very real.
Before long, batches of experts appeared outside the Celestial Pavilion.
Not only from the Ghost Alliance but also from large sects and noble families rushing from other distant Celestial Domains.
Tier Eight Immortal Artifacts were truly tempting!
Among these people, Immortal Kings had already appeared.
It was merely out of consideration for the Celestial Pavilion's background and power that forces hadn't directly charged in yet.
Yuan Zhe, Yuan Wu, and others were worried, the situation clear at a glance.
They felt trapped on an isolated island, with sharks circling in the sea around them, ready to tear them apart once they left.
Seeing more and more experts outside, especially hearing the Immortal Kings were almost arriving, they gradually fell into despair.
Even if the ancestor held a Tier Eight Immortal Artifact, it should be impossible to break out, right?
And on that very afternoon, Miao Yu and Ye Yang Immortal King rushed over again personally.
Seeing Jiang Cheng, her first words were: "The Ghost Alliance has already brought 25 Immortal Venerables and 77 Demon Venerables, led by Meng Qin, right outside!"
Hearing just the Ghost Alliance had 102 Immortal Venerable level experts, Leng Huahan almost fainted.
And upon hearing the name Meng Qin, his whole body trembled violently.
"Which Meng Qin?"
"Could it be that son of the Frost Shadow Demon King, Meng Qin?"

chapters.title: Chapter 283 283: Sir, You Must See the Situation Clearly
chapters.content:
Miao Yu's crimson lips curled slightly: "That's right, it's him."
"That one who cultivated for three million years to achieve the position of Demonic Venerable. After another three million years, he advanced to ninth-grade Demonic Venerable, Meng Qin."
The Middle Immortal Realm doesn't really have rankings like the Immortal King rankings or the Demonic Venerable rankings.
However, peerless geniuses are naturally the focus of everyone's attention, so over the long years, a rough comparison can still be made.
Among countless Immortal Venerables and Demonic Venerables, Meng Qin is one of those geniuses who could rank in the top hundred in combat power.
Because he once had the achievement of single-handedly killing three ninth-grade Immortal Venerables.
That battle also established his status in the Middle Immortal Realm.
Furthermore, he has a Demon King-level father.
"Without surprise, the Frost Shadow Demon King should also be on the way."
Miao Yu herself wasn't worried.
Even if Meng Qin, the Double Shadow Demon King, and the Ghost Alliance were strong, they wouldn't dare to wage war with the Heavenly Axis Pavilion.
Her playful gaze was always fixed on Jiang Cheng's face.
The moods of Leng Huahan and his companions grew darker.
But Brother Cheng seemed completely oblivious to the danger, instead, he said eagerly: "So, he's quite famous then?"
Miao Yu didn't understand why he would ask such a useless question.
Of course, Meng Qin is famous. Not only in these dozens of surrounding Celestial Domains but most immortals across the entire Middle Immortal Realm should have heard of this peerless genius.
She had no idea that Brother Cheng was secretly contemplating whether he should eliminate Meng Qin first.
Killing someone so famous should surely generate a high shock value, right?
"Besides the Ghost Alliance, the Ancient Emperor Sect has also sent 31 Immortal Venerables, and there is an Immortal King-level Supreme Elder."
Elder Yuan Zhe was once again shocked, quickly inquiring: "That Ancient Emperor Sect, ranked first in the Blue Heaven Domain, with more than a dozen ninth-grade Immortal Venerables?"
Miao Yu calmly nodded: "That's right."
Yuan Zhe's face turned pale as he slumped back into his chair, muttering to himself: "They are more than twenty Celestial Domains away from here, yet they arrived so quickly..."
Miao Yu seemed oblivious to his despair and continued: "Additionally, the Evil Cloud Palace, the Minghai Ancient Race, and the Candle Mountain Demons have all sent experts, who will arrive soon."
Every name she mentioned represented the pinnacle forces of various Celestial Domains.
Any one of them could wipe out the entire Feixian Sect many times over.
What could they possibly use to defend against them?
Not to mention those who weren't named, which doesn't mean they pose no threat.
"What are we going to do?"
"If we're not careful, not only will we all be killed, but the entire sect could be destroyed!"
Miao Yu was evidently well aware of their current concerns.
"Elder Jiang, as it stands now, your desire to ascend to the Upper Immortal Realm with 3,000 disciples is impossible."
She didn't know Brother Cheng's full name, so she could only address him as the sect elder.
"The Immortal Fate Order is already drawing attention, let alone the Tier Eight Immortal Artifact that countless would covet."
"You simply can't keep it safe."
Brother Cheng found her certainty amusing, as if she had seen through him.
"So, what's your proposal, little sister?"
This woman had been continuously emphasizing how strong and terrifying the enemies were since she arrived. She was clearly applying pressure.
There had to be a purpose.
Sure enough, Miao Yu confidently curled her lips: "We, the Heavenly Axis Pavilion, have a way to resolve the current crisis, but I wonder if you'd be willing to accept it."
As soon as she finished speaking, Leng Huahan, Yuan Zhe, and others looked as if they were drowning people who had seen a piece of driftwood.
"There's actually a way?"
"We are all ears!"
"If we can escape this predicament, we will surely be grateful!"
Even Jiang Cheng was a bit curious now; could it be that the Heavenly Axis Pavilion would send experts over?
Weren't they supposed to not intervene in personal vendettas?
"We want to purchase this sword from Elder Jiang."
Before Jiang Cheng could refuse, Miao Yu quickly added: "The price will certainly satisfy you!"
This sword was 'Tier Eight'; they were tempted as well.
To know their twelve Immortal Kings were still using Tier Seven Immortal Artifacts.
"In addition, we will resolve the exposure issue of the Immortal Fate Order for you."
She continued eloquently: "You may store your 3,300 Immortal Fate Orders with us at the Heavenly Axis Pavilion, and we will keep them safe for you. When you wish to retrieve them, you can do so at any time."
"This way, you indeed have a chance to bring 3,300 people into the Upper Immortal Realm, don't you?"
At first, Leng Huahan, Yuan Zhe, and others frowned deeply at this proposal.
A Tier Eight Immortal Sword was priceless, and it was questionable if such a tier of Immortal Artifact even existed in the Middle Immortal Realm, so what price could be satisfactory?
Anyone who could obtain such a treasure would never sell it.
The Heavenly Axis Pavilion saw they couldn't hold onto it, so they were just taking advantage of the opportunity.
But hearing the latter part, they were eagerly inclined to accept it for Brother Cheng.
Because Miao Yu's promise to keep 3,300 Immortal Fate Orders safe was truly valuable!
Originally, they had no hope for a collective ascension to the Upper Immortal Realm and were always worried about the Immortal Fate Order positions' exposure every ten years.
With Miao Yu's promise, the 3,300 Immortal Fate Orders were effectively stored here, not sold to anyone else.
Nowhere in the Middle Immortal Realm could be safer for storing Immortal Fate Orders than the Heavenly Axis Pavilion.
Once the last ten-year exposure period passed, they could discreetly retrieve all 3,300 Orders without anyone knowing.
By then, there would indeed be a great chance to ascend collectively to the Upper Immortal Realm.
"Can we trust you? What if you deny it later..."
Leng Huahan was cautious, which was their only concern.
Miao Yu's faint smile vanished as she solemnly said: "3,300 Immortal Fate Orders are very valuable to you, but for us at the Heavenly Axis Pavilion, they're nothing special."
"Honestly, keeping Immortal Fate Orders on behalf of others has never happened before; it goes against our principles."
"If not for the sake of that Immortal Sword, we wouldn't make an exception!"
At this point, Leng Huahan, Yuan Zhe, and the others were thoroughly moved.
Selling the Tier Eight Immortal Artifact meant those pursuing it would find the Heavenly Axis Pavilion, not the Feixian Sect.
It was akin to getting rid of a hot potato.
Moreover, they would gain a solid chance to ascend to the Upper Immortal Realm!
Thinking carefully, they even felt they profited from it.
"Ancestor!"
"Do you think we should agree to her..."
Brother Cheng didn't pay any attention.
He realized a serious problem — everyone wasn't coming after him, just after this Immortal Sword.
This realization suddenly infuriated him.
Damn, this sword is hogging my spotlight?
Everyone focused on it, and all the attention was on it, even this beautiful woman across was no exception.
As the master of this Immortal Sword... he felt overshadowed.
Outrageous!
He posed a soul-searching question: "Who do you think is more important, me or this sword?"
Miao Yu thought he was reluctant to part with the sword, so she gave a gentle laugh: "I believe you can see the situation clearly."
I see your granddaddy's clarity!
You're implying I should recognize my own 'position'?
Unable to sit still any longer, Brother Cheng stood up with the sword in hand.
"By the way, the most famous is that Meng Qin outside, right?"

chapters.title: Chapter 284 284: This Deal Is Very Constructive
chapters.content:
"Elder Jiang, you mustn't act impulsively!"
Miao Yu thought he couldn't bear having so many people trying to snatch the Immortal Sword and was ready to go down fighting.
She hurriedly stepped forward to persuade him.
"As far as I know, the Treasure Light Sword used by Meng Qin is also a Tier Seven Immortal Artifact."
"Moreover, this person's own power is already at the peak below the Immortal King."
She looked Brother Cheng up and down: "The advantage that a Tier Eight Immortal Artifact gives you also has its limits."
The implication was that even with a Tier Eight Immortal Artifact, even in a one-on-one fight, you wouldn't be his match.
Don't go out and get yourself killed, obediently sell the sword to me.
Although Jiang Cheng's life or death had nothing to do with her, if he was killed by Meng Qin outside, she wouldn't be able to buy the Tier Eight Immortal Sword.
As soon as she finished speaking, Yan Wei beside her turned pale.
"Meng Qin has barged in!"
"He's right downstairs!"
The faint smile on Miao Yu's exquisite face did not disappear; instead, it became increasingly confident.
"You see, the temptation of treasures is so great it can drive people mad."
Brother Cheng realized she was using the people outside to pressure him.
Basically telling him, the situation is getting more dangerous; if you don't sell the sword to me, I can't guarantee what might happen next.
He raised an eyebrow and intentionally asked, "Doesn't the Celestial Pavilion prohibit fighting inside?"
Miao Yu nodded, "Indeed, that's the rule. We will do our best to ensure the guests' safety."
"But each branch has limited power. If the enemy ignores the rules, leading to your untimely death, even if we pursue it afterwards, it would be meaningless to you, wouldn't it?"
"What you say makes a lot of sense."
Brother Cheng spread his hands with a smile, "But if people have come all this way, and I don't go out to meet them, wouldn't that be too disrespectful?"
Finishing his words, before anyone could respond, he alone went to the grand hall downstairs.
"Ancestor!"
Leng Huahan and Yuan Zhe were anxious, stomping their feet, yet they couldn't stop him.
Even Miao Yu and Ye Yang Immortal King couldn't help but frown.
"Is this person truly a sect's ancestor?"
"So impulsive, merely a foolhardy youth."
Miao Yu instructed, "Make him truly feel the pressure of despair, but don't let him be actually killed by Meng Qin."
Ye Yang Immortal King nodded and disappeared from the room.
At this moment, downstairs, Branch President Yan Wei was also in a panic.
"Meng Qin, Elder Jiang is our honored guest!"
"You should know our rules, no fighting here is allowed!"
Opposite him stood a young man over ten feet tall with green eyebrows, his eyes sharp with divine light, exuding an overwhelming pressure, as if he could tear you to pieces at any moment.
Standing there, all the other guests in the hall naturally backed away more than a hundred meters, not daring to approach him.
Wasn't it indeed Meng Qin?
"Heh, I certainly know the rules of your Celestial Pavilion."
He grinned, his white teeth glinting with a chilling gleam.
"I wasn't planning to cause trouble. Is it not allowed even to look around?"
"It's possible, of course..."
Yan Wei wiped his sweat, thinking you must be kidding.
I've heard enough about your Ghost Alliance's ways; if Jiang Cheng shows himself, you won't care about any rules.
Moreover, standing here seething with killing intent, how are we to do business?
What he dreaded came to pass— the next second, Brother Cheng truly appeared in the grand hall.
"Oh, quite lively, is this Meng Qin?"
His appearance caused a stir in the crowd.
"Is he that Jiang?"
"Is he crazy, not hiding upstairs and actively coming down?"
"Does he really think Meng Qin would dare not make a move here?"
Even Meng Qin was taken aback, then laughed.
"Indeed, I am Meng Qin."
His gaze landed on the Rainbow Absolute Immortal Sword, and his smile broadened.
Yan Wei quickly stepped forward, "Meng Qin, don't you dare act recklessly!"
"Chairman Yan, what you're saying isn't right. I'm just borrowing your venue to conduct a little transaction with him."
He put away his smile, leaned close to overlook Yan Wei, and spoke softly: "Is this not allowed either?"
The emotionless gaze made Yan Wei shiver, extremely doubtful that this madman might kill him at any moment.
"It's possible, of course..."
Luckily, Brother Cheng helped him out of the situation, asking with interest, "What transaction do you want to make with me?"
As the corners of Meng Qin's mouth lifted, he flaunted the Treasure Light Sword in his hands, "I want to exchange weapons with you. What do you think of this trade?"
"Immortal Artifact for Immortal Artifact, quite fair, right?"
These words left everyone speechless.
You really dare call this a transaction? The value difference between a Tier Seven Immortal Artifact and a Tier Eight Immortal Artifact is at least tens of times, isn't it?
Fair?
Just say it's a robbery.
Even Miao Yu, closely observing on the second floor, couldn't help but shake her head.
The ways of these Demon Cultivators are truly inexplicable.
Meng Qin clearly calculated that Jiang Cheng wouldn't agree and was using it as a pretext.
And even if Jiang Cheng did agree, he probably still wouldn't get the Tier Seven Immortal Sword afterwards.
She naturally wouldn't step in to uphold any fairness; the more domineering Meng Qin was, the more pressure he exerted, making Jiang Cheng more likely to surrender to their Celestial Pavilion, after all.
"Your proposal is truly constructive and worth considering."
Brother Cheng surprisingly clapped with a smile, praising.
This cheerful reaction was beyond everyone's expectations; was he a fool?
Even Meng Qin was momentarily surprised, then he laughed heartily, extending the Treasure Light Sword.
"Refreshing! I'm starting to find you a bit likable, since you've agreed, let's trade quickly!"
"Wait a moment!"
Meng Qin's aura of murderous intent surged forth, his face darkened, "What, are you backing out?"
Brother Cheng shook his head, "Of course not, but trading weapons, shouldn't we inspect the goods first?"
"Inspect the goods?"
Meng Qin couldn't fathom his thoughts; did he truly take this as a trade?
"Sure, then let me inspect your sword."
Looking at the outstretched left hand, Brother Cheng wore a look of disdain.
"Are you a newbie who just entered the field? Weapon inspection should be via actual combat; holding it in hand, what can you see?"
"Not understanding this, I even doubt how you've survived until today."
Damn, even being lectured by him.
Newcomer, me?
For millions of years, Meng Qin hadn't been appraised like this; his fury was instantly ignited.
"Heh, you're really gutsy."
He chuckled angrily, "So, how do you want to inspect? Want a fight with me?"
"Yeah..."
Brother Cheng, still smiling, pulled out the Rainbow Absolute Immortal Sword, silently activating a tenfold critical strike.
Under everyone's gaze, Meng Qin, feeling humiliated, could no longer hold back.
"You're seeking death!"
He swung his sword, and the grand hall first went dark.
Next, blinding light exposed everyone's Immortal Souls!
"No..."
"Stop!"
Yan Wei was in a panic, but with his Ninth-grade Immortal Venerable strength, how could he block it?
With a loud bang, purple flames like meteors fell, slowly dissipating in the void.
Meng Qin's towering figure disintegrated into ashes like a melting sand pile.
Clatter!
Bereft of its master, the Treasure Light Sword fell to the ground with a crisp sound.
This Demon Venerable, ranked among the top hundred in the Middle Immortal Realm, just turned to dust!

chapters.title: Chapter 285 285 Don't Delay Us from Brown-Nosing
chapters.content:
The entire place fell silent.
The main gate of the Celestial Pavilion had been completely destroyed, a long and wide passage scorched by the Flame Rule.
The passage extended far into the Immortal City below, burning a deep, giant pit into it.
This was already Brother Cheng controlling himself.
Otherwise, under his tenfold critical strike, the Celestial Pavilion would have long ceased to exist.
Yet even so, the dozen or so Demon Venerables of the Ghost Alliance who followed Meng Qin inside all fell in that one strike just now.
They had no power to resist.
That single strike left them no chance to escape.
Brother Cheng, not caring about anyone else's gaze, immediately drew the Treasure Light Sword into his hand.
"Seems like your Immortal Sword isn't that powerful."
"With this broken sword, you want to make a deal with me?"
After saying this, he calmly stored the sword into his ring without a hint of embarrassment.
"Thankfully, I was smart enough to choose to inspect the goods in advance."
Was that what you call being smart? You did it on purpose, didn't you?
Despite the strong urge to retort, everyone was deeply shocked by the power of that strike just now.
Meng Qin just died like that?
Wasn't he the one who attacked first, so why did he die?
Most people hadn't clearly seen what happened at that moment.
And those few experts who could see clearly were even more shocked than them.
Because what they saw was very brief—Meng Qin was instantly killed by a single sword strike.
Possessing a Tier Seven Immortal Artifact, he should have been able to hold out for a while even against an Immortal King, right?
How could this be possible?
"That's not a Tier Eight Immortal Sword!"
Miao Yu on the second floor could no longer maintain her calm composure and stood up abruptly.
"It's Tier Nine!"
"Only a Tier Nine Immortal Sword could have such power!"
She couldn't sit still anymore and in the blink of an eye reappeared by Jiang Cheng's side.
"Sir, whatever you want, just say it."
"As long as you're willing to sell this sword."
The Celestial Pavilion was conducting matters with far more civility, not to the point of blatant robbery.
And hidden in the shadows, originally planning to rescue Jiang Cheng before he was killed, Ye Yang Immortal King also revealed himself.
He didn't need to raise a hand at all, as the man never took Meng Qin seriously from the start.
"If you agree, our Celestial Pavilion's twelve Immortal Kings are willing to come forth, to ensure your safety and that of the Feixian Sect, until the day you ascend to the Upper Immortal Realm!"
When this condition was offered, the entire place erupted in an uproar.
What is the Celestial Pavilion trying to do?
All twelve Immortal Kings coming forward breaks their original neutral stance, doesn't it?
Does this man have such a grand persona?
Can he really make the Celestial Pavilion disregard their reputation and openly violate principles upheld for countless years?
But soon everyone understood.
This is a Tier Nine Immortal Sword!
What concept is Tier Nine?
Supreme Divine Weapons that only Immortal Emperors and Demon Emperors in the Upper Immortal Realm can possess!
With this sword, even an Immortal Venerable can match an Immortal King in battle.
If an Immortal King wields it, they'd become invincible in the Middle Immortal Realm!
It's worth any price for this sword...
After collecting the spoils of war, Brother Cheng opened the system panel, checking that the shock value from that single strike just now was 18.3 million, automatically converting to 1,830 merit points.
There weren't many people on-site or in the Immortal City outside.
No matter how shocking, it was just that.
"Ye Yang Immortal King, are you trying to oppose our Ghost Alliance?"
Outside, more than eighty Immortal Venerables and Demon Venerables barged in, the remaining experts of the Ghost Alliance.
"This person has repeatedly killed members of our Ghost Alliance, and just now even killed the son of the Frost Shadow Demon King, an unforgivable vendetta!"
"And you're intending to break neutral ground and protect him?"
"A dignified Celestial Pavilion, going back on your words, is this all you amount to?"
Although the Ghost Alliance is far less powerful than the Celestial Pavilion, they weren't afraid of them either.
Besides, three Demon Kings and one Immortal King would soon come personally.
To be reproached by a group of Demon Venerables, Ye Yang Immortal King felt his anger rise.
Just about to flare up, Miao Yu held him back.
"Everyone, that's a misunderstanding!"
This woman faced over eighty venerable-level experts with composure and said, "If Elder Jiang is willing to sell the Immortal Sword to our Celestial Pavilion in exchange for our protection, it's merely a transaction."
"It's like he's using the sword as money to buy our protection."
"Protecting him becomes part of the deal, a cost we ought to pay."
"We aren't breaking a neutral stance."
Her quick mind was impressive.
She managed to spin protecting Jiang Cheng as a service listed for sale.
Going all out to protect him, instead, made it worthwhile for the customer and maintained Celestial Pavilion's reputation.
Upon reflection, it felt quite reasonable.
The premise being Brother Cheng agrees to this deal.
At this moment, Brother Cheng was almost infuriated by them.
Brother just instantly killed Meng Qin, shouldn't you all be shocked by Brother's power now?
Shouldn't you praise Elder Jiang's earth-shattering power?
Even seeking revenge would be a normal plot progression.
Instead, it all went back to this Immortal Sword in no time.
When will it end?
What's so special about a Tier Nine Immortal Sword that it can take away Brother's fame?
Luckily, at this critical moment, Su Meng and Su Ye once again dissipated his anger like a spring breeze and rain.
"Grandmaster, you're amazing!"
"Again showcasing divine might, in front of Grandmaster, anyone is just a mere chicken or dog..."
"Absolutely, Grandmaster certainly wasn't using full power yet."
These two female Outer Sect disciples were truly audacious.
Facing the negotiation scene between the two giants, boldly interrupting to praise Elder Jiang.
The two had tasted the sweetness of rewards before and were eagerly waiting to seize another chance.
Yet these two groups of big shots kept on bickering endlessly, making them quite annoyed.
Enough already?
Can't they just shut up for a moment and let us compliment him?
Flattery requires precise timing; do it too late, and the horse's rump would be cool, leading to no effect at all.
The observing Leng Huahan and Yuan Zhe didn't know what to say.
Damn, you two should at least consider the occasion even if you want to flatter someone!
Is this the right time for praises?
Aren't you afraid of being instantly killed by those Ghost Alliance demons?
In their attempt to please the patriarch, the two were absolutely fearless.
"Ah, you two are really thoughtful."
Brother Cheng wiped nonexistent tears from the corner of his eyes and affectionately patted their heads.
This dauntless spirit of praising despite facing enemy fury was truly commendable.
"Grandmaster didn't treasure you in vain!"
He decided to reward them doubly in the future.
Because these two girls made his cold heart feel warm again.
These were his real allies.
With their interruption, the negotiation between the two giants paused.
Miao Yu looked towards Jiang Cheng, "Elder Jiang, this is just a part of the Ghost Alliance's forces, and it's not only them who have their sights on you."
"Soon, the entire Middle Immortal Realm will know you possess a Tier Nine Immortal Artifact."
"Only our Celestial Pavilion can protect you."
"Would you be willing to accept this transaction?"
This was plainly forcing him to take a stance.
She couldn't believe it, how could he still refuse at such a critical juncture?
"I appreciate your kindness..."
Brother Cheng was eager to reply before being interrupted by the Ghost Alliance crowd opposite.
"Hahaha, he didn't even accept your deal, Celestial Pavilion!"
"So if it's not a deal, you have no grounds to protect him!"

chapters.title: Chapter 286 286: Greetings to Sect Leader Jiang
chapters.content:
The Demon Venerables of the Ghost Alliance didn't say anything incorrect.
Since Jiang Cheng refused the deal, if the Celestial Pavilion intervened, it would truly violate the principle of neutrality.
Miao Yu glared fiercely at Jiang Cheng, completely unable to comprehend his decision.
"Elder Jiang, what do you mean by this?"
She thought her offer wasn't harsh.
A lot of treasures would be given in exchange for the Tier Nine Immortal Artifact, offering protection, and allowing your Feixian Sect's 3000 disciples to ascend safely to the Upper Immortal Realm.
How does this not seem like a win-win?
If she were Jiang Cheng, she would definitely agree to it.
"Miss, I can fully feel your good intentions, but after all, I'm a man. How can I accept protection from a woman?"
Brother Cheng felt he was very graceful, rejecting the offer politely.
After all, she was a peerless beauty; speaking nicely would make future meetings more pleasant.
However, to others, it was filled with reasons for criticism.
Those unaware might think this was Miao Yu's personal attempt to express affection to him.
"Elder Jiang, please mind your words!"
The usually calm and composed fairy was genuinely angered this time.
"Since you're determined to go your own way, then fend for yourself!"
"We, the Celestial Pavilion, won't interfere!"
Even if she wanted to intervene, she couldn't.
Unless they wanted to publicly damage the Celestial Pavilion's long-standing prestigious reputation.
With those words, it formally declared the Celestial Pavilion's withdrawal from the whirlpool of conflict.
Including Ye Yang Immortal King and the other eleven absent Immortal Kings, all experts of the Celestial Pavilion would not interfere in the future.
"Ha ha ha!"
The Demon Venerables and Immortal Venerables of the Ghost Alliance were gloating.
"Good!"
"Then we will wait!"
They weren't foolish; although there were still more than eighty of them, they weren't stubborn enough to charge at Jiang Cheng at this moment.
With Meng Qin being taken out by a single sword strike, without an Immortal King or Demon King, winning this battle was impossible.
What they needed to do now was watch Jiang Cheng closely.
Seeing them retreat from the Celestial Pavilion, Brother Cheng felt a bit conflicted.
Just now, to make a spectacular scene, he had used the ten-times Critical Strike in advance.
Now without the Critical Strike, wanting to take down these people might require dying once first.
With so many people here…
Oh well, it's not the first time I've been killed publicly; I can come up with an excuse later if necessary.
With that thought, he also held his sword and followed them outside.
"Old Ancestor!"
"There are many people outside, including the Jiyun Immortal King from the Ancient Emperor Sect!"
Leng Huahan and Yuan Zhe were anxious.
Inside the Celestial Pavilion, there at least was a rule prohibiting conflict, and opponents would at least show some restraint.
Outside, there would be no such restraint.
But if Brother Cheng wanted to go out, they couldn't stop him.
Miao Yu watched his back with indifference, thinking he was walking to his doom.
"Seems we won't be able to wait for those four from the Ghost Alliance; he'll be killed first."
Ye Yang Immortal King communicated over.
The Jiyun Immortal King from the Ancient Emperor Sect wasn't someone to be trifled with, even he didn't dare provoke easily.
Miao Yu replied emotionlessly: "He truly doesn't know the meaning of danger."
Just after making that evaluation, battle suddenly erupted again outside.
By this moment, outside had transformed into another world.
With one step, ahead was an endless starry sky.
Everyone caught within appeared to have suddenly been switched into another space.
"Who is it?"
"Not good!"
"Jiyun Immortal King, how dare you!"
The faces of the Demon Venerables from Ghost Alliance paled, but it was already too late!
Only to see two massive celestial bodies collide heavily with a thunderous roar.
Afterwards, blinding light and terrifying explosions erupted in succession.
But bizarrely, the explosion was perfectly controlled within a small range and didn't make any noise.
In that strike, over half of the eighty demon venerables fell on the spot.
An elder clad in a white robe, with a youthful face despite being old, rode with a sword, traversing the space river, appearing as the dominator of that starry sky, sacred and inviolable.
"Jiyun Immortal King, let's talk it out!"
"Quick, stop!"
"Our Ghost Alliance's grand ancestors won't let you off!"
Jiyun Immortal King, one of the founders of the Ancient Emperor Sect, was an old Immortal King with unfathomable power.
Because he hadn't ascended to the Upper Immortal Realm, the Ancient Emperor Sect under his protection had remained as the strongest sect within the Blue Heaven Domain over the years.
No surprise he came this time, after all, the Immortal Artifact was tempting.
Choosing to take out competitors from the Ghost Alliance wasn't strange either; it's no surprise considering the desire for the Tier Nine Immortal Artifact.
But he seemed to act a bit early this time?
Jiang Cheng wasn't dead yet, the sword was still with him!
Isn't it a bit hasty to take out the Ghost Alliance now?
Not only the immortals from other surrounding forces, even the thirty-plus Immortal Venerables from the Ancient Emperor Sect were all shocked.
And that Jiyun Immortal King seemed determined to first eliminate the competitors!
Just beneath that silent starry sky, flashes of sword light swept by, accompanied by the demise of Demon Venerables.
Everyone was silent with fear.
Thinking of this terrifying Immortal King eradicating the Ghost Alliance, the next target would be the Feixian Sect, Yuan Zhe, Yuan Wu, Yuan He, and the three elders were trembling, nearly scared to the point of losing control.
Even Yan Wei, standing inside the Celestial Pavilion's hall, felt no sense of safety.
The might of the Immortal King was daunting, Immortal Venerables were mere ants before him!
Ye Yang Immortal King showed a solemn expression; this power made him feel a profound sense of danger.
That starry sky was enough to prove Jiyun Immortal King's advancement in shaping the Immortal Country ahead of him.
"The Ghost Alliance has three Demon Kings and one Immortal King, yet this person disregards it completely..."
Miao Yu remained calm: "Given those four from the Ghost Alliance haven't arrived yet, taking early action for the Tier Nine Immortal Artifact isn't surprising for Jiyun Immortal King."
As the final demon venerable from the Ghost Alliance fell, the mysterious starry sky vanished.
Jiyun Immortal King sheathed his sword, gracefully descending to the entrance of the Celestial Pavilion.
Everyone wore a look of terror, scrambling to flee in all directions.
Even representatives from major forces like Evil Cloud Palace, Minghai Ancient Race, and Candle Mountain Demons retreated.
No one dared to ascertain if this relentless Immortal King would go mad and kill all competitors present.
Amidst the gaze of everyone, Jiyun Immortal King strode confidently to Jiang Cheng's front.
His expression was peculiar, with a hint of excitement, disbelief, yet deeply fervent.
It looked like a sign of madness.
Yuan Zhe, Yuan Wu, and the others were even more fearful, their hands trembling on their swords.
Their only hope now was that Elder Jiang could hold off this person...
Subsequently, everyone present witnessed a scene they would never forget.
"Sect Leader Jiang... it's truly you!"
This Immortal King, who stood at the pinnacle of the Middle Immortal Realm, flung back the front of his white robe, and slowly knelt down on one knee!
"Jiyun pays respects to Sect Leader Jiang!"
After desperately uttering those words, the seasoned old Immortal King's eyes reddened.
He, as if seeing his elder, was overwhelmed with emotion: "Sect Leader Jiang! This old one is fortunate to behold your celestial visage... Heaven has shown mercy!"
At this moment, countless individuals were stunned, plummeting straight from the sky.
Even Miao Yu inside the Celestial Pavilion was staggered, nearly tumbling onto the ground.
What is happening?
Her face was filled with disbelief, as though witnessing the magical spectacle of the Immortal Realm's destruction.
A dignified Immortal King, why would he kneel for someone, even calling himself a little old one?

chapters.title: Chapter 287 287: The Delivered Immortal King
chapters.content:
Even Miao Yu had this reaction, so it was even worse for the others.
An Immortal King in the Middle Immortal Realm is like the heavens.
For the heavens to kneel to someone, it's simply absurd.
A dignified Immortal King wouldn't even kneel before an Immortal Emperor.
But now here he is, submitting before Jiang Cheng, whose Realm is plain to most present—just a First Grade Golden Immortal.
Even kneeling on one knee seems impossible!
No one could comprehend it.
From Jiyun Immortal King's words, many heard that he seemed to have known Jiang Cheng for a long time, akin to old friends reuniting?
But even so, the ceremony is way too grand, right?
Their shock was not yet over.
Then, from among the 31 Ninth-grade Immortal Venerables of the Ancient Emperor Sect, three Ninth-grade Immortal Venerables flew out again.
Many recognized them; these three were Supreme Elders from many generations ago in the Ancient Emperor Sect.
In recent years, they have rarely ventured out.
But millions of years ago, when they roamed the Middle Immortal Realm, their talents and accomplishments were no less than Meng Qin's, just without the support of a Tier Seven Immortal Artifact.
In the Ancient Emperor Sect, these three held a remarkable status, only beneath Jiyun Immortal King.
And at this moment, the three Supreme Elders fell down swiftly, practically crawling to kneel before Jiang Cheng.
"Greetings to Sect Leader Jiang!"
"For years, we've longed day and night, hoping you'd return to lead us again..."
"Finally seeing you again... Sob sob sob!"
One of the Supreme Elders even held Brother Cheng's thigh, crying uncontrollably in public.
Everyone felt questioned about reality once more.
They originally thought Jiyun Immortal King might have just gone mad with excessive power from the recent battle.
Watching the performance of these three, it seemed they had a history!
Leng Huahan, Yuan Zhe, and others nearly had their jaws drop in shock.
How was this even possible?
They had just thought they'd be wiped out by Jiyun Immortal King's wave of the hand, yet now this Immortal King...
They thought back to the day Elder Jiang made his appearance, seeing Sect Leader Yuan Zhen and Great Elder Yuan Sheng's excited reactions, seemingly identical to the scene now with these four!
Could it be... that Elder Jiang truly has an extraordinary origin?
Especially Leng Huahan, recalling his master's hint that day—Elder Jiang's standing is no lower than the first two rows of the Ancestral Hall.
Could it be true?
The Sect Leader of the Ancient Emperor Sect, with those remaining, also flew down.
"Ancestor, what are you doing..."
In the entire venue, they were the ones most questioning their reality.
Jiyun Immortal King, this ancestor alone was best left unmentioned, as the Sect Leader hadn't seen him in over a million years except for the news of a Tier Eight Immortal Artifact, sometimes even suspecting he might already be gone.
The other three Supreme Elders were each characters the Sect Leader must thoroughly respect.
Even though all were Ninth-grade Immortal Venerables, the background, talent, and combat power were worlds apart.
Besides, these three had followed the Immortal King since the beginning of the sect, with their seniority well-established.
He could not fathom these four kneeling; it truly shook his beliefs...
Weren't we agreed on coming to seize the Immortal Artifact?
What is this show we're playing here?
We are now at a loss, our minds in chaos.
With all of you kneeling, should we kneel too?
But the question is, why kneel before a Golden Immortal?
Just at this moment, Brother Cheng suddenly said, "Who are you guys?"
In truth, he thought that these four might be Ascenders from the Lower Realm Ten Thousand Realms from back then.
Over millions of years, having these few become Immortal Kings was quite normal.
But back then, there were 120,000 Ascenders, and he truly couldn't know them all.
Well, Brother Cheng, being so laid-back and careless, could only remember those few hundred that frequented the spotlight.
For instance, Gui Cang, Void Abyss, Golden Dragon King, Bi Chang, Ling Xing, Taichang, the leaders of the Great Domains.
Others were merely background characters for him.
Like this Jiyun Immortal King, he had no impression of him at all.
This straightforward question was a little hurtful.
Even Miao Yu and Ye Yang Immortal King felt intense indignation on behalf of the four.
These distinguished Immortal Kings had knelt before you, yet you claim not to know them?
The rest of the crowd appeared more dumbfounded.
Are you tired of living?
Denying recognition to Immortal Kings who willingly present themselves?
Yuan Zhe, Yuan Wu, and Yuan He almost wet themselves again in fright; Leng Huahan genuinely wanted to cover this ancestor's mouth.
This is an Immortal King!
Whether you know them or not, even if they recognized the wrong person, you should take the opportunity to acknowledge it!
How dare a dignified Immortal King be insulted lightly?
This simple retort alone could provoke fatal rage!
Yet the anticipated scene did not happen.
As Jiyun Immortal King initially looked disappointed but then smiled broadly.
"It's normal if you don't remember me. I was once the Jiyun Daoist Saint of the Evergreen Domain, and my senior brother, Qingyun Daoist Saint, spoke with you!"
In his eyes, speaking with Brother Cheng back then was something immensely brag-worthy.
The Lower Realm had as many as Ten Thousand Domains!
Back then, in times of great events, only the strongest few hundred would make it into meetings inside; others could only stand outside.
The overall strength of the Evergreen Domain couldn't break into the top thousand of the Ten Thousand Domains back then.
However, his senior brother, Qingyun Daoist Saint, had exceptional encounters, being the top expert of the Evergreen Domain, his power unusually strong.
His combat prowess was not inferior to the top Sword Saints of the Sword Domain, so he had the fortune to attend council and once received a response from Sect Leader Jiang during a speech.
Such encounters became their most cherished memories afterward.
"These three were youngsters who ascended with us back then."
"They also saw you at the time and received your orders."
Those three Supreme Elders kept bowing repeatedly, their faces wearing blissful grins.
Back then, they had no qualifications for direct conversation with Sect Leader Jiang in close quarters.
Now they felt incomparably honored, terribly excited.
Brother Cheng then slapped his head: "Oh, you mean Qingyun Daoist Saint, now I remember him!"
"Haha, so it's you guys!"
Jiyun Daoist Saint was moved to tears, feeling immensely grateful he remembered.
"Yes, yes, yes, it's us."
"By the way, where's your senior brother?"
Jiyun Immortal King elaborated: "Back then we wandered everywhere, later co-founded the Ancient Emperor Sect, extensively recruiting disciples."
"Seventy million years ago, Senior Brothers Qingyun and Liuyun advanced to Immortal Kings and then successively went to the Upper Immortal Realm."
"I chose to stay behind, wishing to continue attending to the younger generation."
He reflected: "Thankfully, I stayed, so I was the first to see you. Perhaps, it's fate!"
Brother Cheng laughed heartily: "I thought you were here to seize the Immortal Sword."
Jiyun Immortal King's face changed, immediately declaring: "How dare we seize your Treasure? Honestly, I'm here leading people to aid you, Sect Leader Jiang!"
"The Ghost Alliance, those scoundrels, dared to provoke you; I've long been unable to tolerate it!"
"Taking the liberty to annihilate them, I hope Sect Leader Jiang won't take offense!"
He said these words decisively, with the other three Supreme Elders echoing in agreement.
Yes, yes, that's exactly what we thought.
Listening to this, the Sect Leader and the other Elders from the Ancient Emperor Sect secretly grumbled, knowing full well that initially, they intended to seize the Immortal Sword.
"""

chapters.title: Chapter 288 288: What an Honor
chapters.content:
In fact, Sect Leader of the Ancient Emperor Sect had misunderstood.
Jiyun Immortal King didn't know that Jiang was Brother Cheng before setting out, but he remembered the three words 'Feixian Sect.'
He was cautious about it from the very start.
