The Immortal Artifact was indeed tempting, and he was no exception.
Originally, he only planned to take the Immortal Sword and leave, trying his best not to harm people from the Feixian Sect.
But after recognizing Jiang Cheng, that naturally was a different matter.
He immediately killed the demons of the Ghost Alliance to show his loyalty!
What about snatching the Immortal Sword, was there such a thing?
He didn't know, didn't remember, and didn't dare...
Damn, could he not recognize that sword which others didn't know?
Wasn't that the Jade Splendor treasured sword of the Nine Flames Immortal Emperor back in the day?
This unsolved public case that once shook for a time is still being pursued in the Upper Immortal Realm today.
This sword was clearly 'stolen property,' only Sect Leader Jiang dared to use it openly.
"By the way, Sect Leader Jiang, where do you plan to go next?"
"If you have time, why not visit our Ancient Emperor Sect as a guest..."
Brother Cheng waved his hand: "Better not, I'm busy lately, and the Immortal Fate Order isn't fully collected here yet."
After saying this, he went back inside.
"Our transaction of 3,300 Immortal Fate Orders, still counts, right?"
Miao Yu nodded in a daze: "Of course, it counts!"
Jiyun Immortal King asked, "Then... can we accompany Sect Leader Jiang together?"
Brother Cheng nodded: "Yes."
With his permission, Jiyun Immortal King was overjoyed.
"Quickly follow up!"
The three Supreme Elders were also flattered; they didn't have the qualifications to accompany Sect Leader Jiang back then and quickly followed respectfully into the shop.
Once inside, they didn't even dare to sit; they stood behind Brother Cheng, looking like personal guards.
This sight left Leng Huahan, Yuan Zhe, and others in awe.
Isn't this too powerful?
Immortal Kings serving as bodyguards, and they seemed to find it an honor.
Is this the reason why Sect Leader respects Elder Jiang so much?
What is his real background?
The Ancient Emperor Sect Leader was also puzzled.
"Elder, who is this person?"
"Why show him such respect, I see he's just a Golden Immortal, even if there were past ties..."
Before he could finish his voice transmission, a Supreme Elder severely slapped him.
"What the hell do you know!"
"Sect Leader Jiang being a playful wanderer, his Cultivation Realm has long become trivial to him."
"For him, wiping us out is as easy as blowing out a candle!"
They all have witnessed the whole process of Jiang Cheng slaying the Nine Flames Immortal Emperor.
"Moreover, he has saved us multiple times!"
"Without him, we would have died countless times, how could we have today?"
"If you dare disrespect him, it means disrespecting us and the Master!"
"The consequences, you should know yourself!"
With this rebuke, the high rankings of the Ancient Emperor Sect immediately became as obedient as grandchildren.
"Yes, yes, yes..."
"We understand..."
Their feelings now were similar to those of the elders from the Feixian Sect.
They still didn't quite understand internally, but the look in their eyes towards Jiang Cheng became much more obedient.
At this time, the top forces like Evil Cloud Palace, Minghai Ancient Race, and Candle Mountain Demons outside had all retreated far away.
They still had thoughts about the Tier Nine Immortal Sword.
But since Jiyun Immortal King miraculously sided with Jiang Cheng, the difficulty of seizing the sword increased by countless times, becoming an almost unattainable goal.
Now their only hope was pinned on the Ghost Alliance.
The four masters of the Ghost Alliance would arrive soon, and surely there would be an earth-shattering battle.
Perhaps during the grand chaos, they might have an opportunity to seize the sword.
Meanwhile, Miao Yu was still steeped in extreme confusion and bewilderment.
Judging from the conversation just now, Jiyun Immortal King and Jiang Cheng had indeed known each other early on.
Jiyun Immortal King seemed to have been his subordinate back then.
Otherwise, he wouldn't have shown him such respect.
And it wasn't just Jiyun; even Qingyun Immortal King and Liuyun Immortal King, who ascended to the Upper Immortal Realm, were his subordinates back then.
Who else could have three Immortal Kings as subordinates?
Could he be the Immortal Emperor?
Ye Yang Immortal King also couldn't figure it out and secretly sent a voice transmission again.
"Jiyun Immortal King calls him Sect Leader Jiang. Has the Feixian Sect ever had a Sect Leader with the surname Jiang?"
"No, they haven't."
Miao Yu had investigated Feixian Sect's information over the past few days and was clear about the sect.
"Even if he was once an Elder of Feixian Sect, he couldn't command the Immortal King of the Ancient Emperor Sect."
"This matter is really suspicious."
Unfortunately, from start to finish, Jiyun Immortal King always called him Sect Leader Jiang without daring to call him by his name directly.
Otherwise, with the mention of Jiang Cheng, others might not understand, but with Miao Yu's knowledge, she would certainly think of something.
Ye Yang Immortal King slowly said, "There's actually an even bigger question."
"The Qingyun Immortal King that Jiyun Immortal King mentioned earlier had ascended to the Upper Immortal Realm seventy-five million years ago."
Miao Yu nodded solemnly, saying, "If Qingyun Immortal King was once under this person's command, then this person has existed at least seventy-five million years ago."
"Over such a long time, how could there be no word about him?"
"And how can he still be just a First Grade Golden Immortal?"
Ye Yang Immortal King agreed, as it indeed didn't make sense.
After much contemplation, he sighed, "Anyway, this person must have countless untold secrets behind him."
"But having three Immortal Kings as subordinates makes him possessing the Tier Nine Immortal Sword quite reasonable."
"Indeed..."
During their private conversation, Brother Cheng quietly checked the system.
He found out that he just gained 65,540,000 Shock Value.
This was the most Merit he had earned recently.
With an illustrious Immortal King kneeling in submission, it elevated the level of shock of everyone present to mind-blowing reverence, even worship.
And considering there were many Immortal Venerables and Demon Venerables, and given their high Realms,
even though there weren't many people present, the Shock Value accumulated was still substantial.
This was indeed a pleasant surprise.
Consequently, Brother Cheng looked at Jiyun Immortal King with a much friendlier gaze.
"By the way, Sect Leader Jiang, are you planning to take the disciples of Feixian Sect to the Upper Immortal Realm together?"
"That's right."
Jiyun Immortal King sighed, "These youngsters who joined the Feixian Sect must have accumulated luck from past lives to receive your care."
The three Supreme Elders behind also nodded continuously.
"Yes, truly envious of them to follow Sect Leader Jiang."
"It looks like Feixian Sect is going to rise again!"
This left Leng Huahan, Yuan Zhe, Yuan Wu, Yuan He, and others utterly confused.
This Elder's ability to stir trouble was first-rate, and although he seemed genuinely senior, following him was fraught with fear, with no certainty of surviving any day.
Where is the luck in that?
How to rise?
The little do they know, these four were linking back to Ji Linghan and Lin Ning's group.
Back when they ascended the Immortal Realm, countless experts from the Lower Realm Ten Thousand Realms were present, and they had interacted.
At that time, they were envious of those Feixian Sect disciples.

chapters.title: Chapter 289 289: Helping You Ascend to Paradise Early
chapters.content:
When they first arrived in Dingtian City in the Lower Immortal Realm, there were only about ten thousand potential cultivation spots within the Ascension Platform.
The Lower Realm Ten Thousand Realms was full of heroes, and the Jiyun Immortal King almost didn't get a chance.
But the disciples of the Feixian Sect got the best spots in the central circle.
Especially Ji Linghan, who ridiculously sat directly on the only throne.
It's worth knowing that Jiyun started as Saint Tier, while many of those disciples were just in the Daoist Palace Realm.
After that, Immortal Artifacts were distributed, and they also received the best ones.
While Jiyun and the others had to fight their way through several Ascension Battles to earn them.
The difference in treatment was as vast as heaven and earth, truly heartbreaking to hear and tear-inducing to see!
As for the reason, there was only one: they were direct lineage of Sect Leader Jiang; fairness didn't matter.
In their view, the current juniors of the Feixian Sect, led by Sect Leader Jiang, are about to take off again benefiting from his influence.
Can they not be envied?
Yet Leng Huahan and the others couldn't feel their sentiments, still contemplating what to do next.
"Ancestor, do you think we should plan something?"
Brother Cheng was a bit bewildered, "Plan what?"
Since his debut, he has always directly confronted issues, never overthinking.
"The four experts of the Ghost Alliance will be here soon; shouldn't we avoid their sharp edge first? Otherwise, it might be difficult to escape..."
Before Brother Cheng could speak, Jiyun Immortal King angrily interrupted.
"Just four experts of the Ghost Alliance and you're scared?"
"You've really underestimated your ancestor, haven't you?"
"Let me tell you, once they arrive, they won't be able to leave."
He glanced coldly at Leng Huahan and Yuan Zhe and scoffed, "So timid and afraid, truly a worse generation after another..."
This old man was jealous of Ji Linghan and others from back then, and naturally didn't have a friendly face for their disciples and grand-disciples.
The reprimand left Leng Huahan and the others stunned.
Even the Sect Leader and Elders of the Ancient Emperor Sect were drenched in sweat.
Although you are an Immortal King, there's only one of you, while there are four on the opposite side!
Isn't this too arrogant?
Miao Yu not far away was also visibly surprised.
"Can Jiyun Immortal King take on four?"
"Impossible."
Ye Yang Immortal King shook his head slightly, frowning, "I don't know where his confidence is coming from."
"Among the four Ghost Alliance members, the Frost Shadow Demon King and Xiao Kun Demon King may be on par with me in power."
"But Shari Demon King and Hua Yin Immortal King are different, they've defeated other Immortal Kings head-on, even taking on two at one time."
"Without a doubt, their Immortal Countries have solid foundations."
"If it weren't for those two, the Ghost Alliance wouldn't have developed so fast."
"Any one of them should be able to steadily hold off Jiyun Immortal King."
Miao Yu nodded, "It seems the key is that Sect Leader Jiang; he must have secrets we don't know if he can make Jiyun Immortal King submit."
Her curiosity about Jiang Cheng was growing.
Her words had just fallen when Jiyun Immortal King stood up in the field.
"They're here!"
A group came outside, and from afar, thick clouds high in the sky gradually morphed into a human figure.
All surrounding clans quickly retreated even further.
"It's the Frost Shadow Demon King!"
"He's here; an earth-shattering battle is inevitable."
"Yeah, if I were them, I would have left early."
The Frost Shadow Demon King unfurled his Tier Seven Immortal Blade, and said grimly, "Jiyun, your Ancient Emperor Sect needn't exist!"
"This person killed my son Meng Qin, and you have slain many of my Ghost Alliance elites!"
"From today onwards, not even chickens or dogs will remain in the Ancient Emperor and Feixian Sects!"
The Immortal Blade swung down, spreading countless dark thunders, some cultivators who didn't escape in time were caught in it.
In an instant, they were shredded by the rules.
The Ancient Emperor Sect folks' hearts tightened.
Ghost Alliance's declaration of war had never been a joke.
When they say they will exterminate, they surely will.
The demon cultivators will fight madly to the end...
The Ancient Emperor Sect's tens of thousands of disciples face bleak prospects.
Yet Jiyun Immortal King showed no concern.
He swung his sword, blocking the subsequent attack, and then laughed coldly, "Frost Shadow, you'll never know who you've provoked."
"Sect Leader Jiang, may this old fellow take the lead?"
Damn, an Immortal King needs permission to go to battle?
The Frost Shadow Demon King was a bit stunned.
"Alright, go on," Brother Cheng waved his hand.
With his current true power, he couldn't handle Demon King Level experts unless he died once.
With so many watching, he'd rather not die if possible.
Receiving approval from Commander Sect Leader Jiang, Jiyun Immortal King charged like a tiger unleashed, immediately unfolding his Immortal Country, roaring into battle.
The frenzied momentum, unlike his prior elegant display of Immortal Dao, was fierce.
In a flash, the budding Immortal Country of the Frost Shadow Demon King was severely damaged.
The two quickly entered a fierce life-and-death battle, directly clashing with Immortal Artifacts and manipulating rules.
Ye Yang Immortal King was not wrong; Jiyun's combat power was far stronger than Frost Shadow's.
Barring surprises, Jiyun was sure to win.
The distant Immortals gazed at the exploding starry sky in awe.
The battle between Immortal King and Demon King isn't a common spectacle.
Even knowing the Ghost Alliance had three more experts, the Ancient Emperor Sect's morale soared immensely seeing their ancestor dominating.
"Ancestral divine might!"
"Truly, among Immortal Kings, our ancestor is top-tier!"
"If the Frost Shadow Demon King has no help, our ancestor surely will win..."
Caught in the middle, Brother Cheng found the intense battle dull.
He was used to finishing battles quickly, not accustomed to this prolonged fight full of sparks.
He conjured a chair to sit.
"Jiyun, you're not very effective, still not done?"
"If it can't be done, I might as well handle it myself."
He puffed a smoke ring, offering a small critique.
Ancient Emperor Sect folks nearly spat blood.
Yuan Zhe, Yuan Wu, and others covered their faces, thinking they've never seen anyone like him feigning modesty before.
Receiving criticism, high up Jiyun Immortal King couldn't stand it.
He immediately intensified his attacks, ignoring defense.
His frantic assault left the Frost Shadow Demon King reeling.
Old man, I came for revenge, why are you more desperate than me?
Seeing the Frost Shadow Demon King wounded and retreating, Brother Cheng perked up.
Just then, heavy demon shadows obscuring the sun launched from the rear.
The other three Ghost Alliance experts had arrived.
Suddenly, Ancient Emperor and Feixian sect people panicked.
"It's over!"
"They're really here..."
Only the three Supreme Elders stayed calm.
With Sect Leader Jiang present, even if the Immortal Emperor came, they'd remain unfazed as mountains collapse ahead.
"Help me quickly!"
The Frost Shadow Demon King, already on the brink, cried loudly.
Four against one, surely that's stable!
The three experts swiftly scanned the field, then burst into hearty laughter.
"Sure thing!"
"We'll help you ascend to Paradise soon!"
Before Frost Shadow Demon King understood their words, the three experts turned their weapons on him.
In an instant, his Immortal Country collapsed entirely!

chapters.title: Chapter 290 290: These 3 people are actually?
chapters.content:
The Frost Shadow Demon King hadn't reacted yet, and the Immortal Country was already collapsing.
Immediately, the terrifying backlash force attacked.
In shock and anger, he wanted to say something.
Aren't you my teammates?
Shouldn't you be helping me deal with the Jiyun Immortal King?
Why are you attacking me instead?
Could it be a mistake?
The others around hadn't seen clearly what happened yet, but Miao Yu and Ye Yang Immortal King couldn't help but exclaim.
"How is this possible?"
At the King and Demon King level, it's impossible to make such low-level mistakes of accidentally injuring teammates.
But why would the Sahili Demon King, Xiao Kun Demon King, and Hua Yin Immortal King attack their own people?
Are they mad?
The Frost Shadow Demon King also wanted to roar and question, he had countless questions.
Since the creation of the Ghost Alliance, the four of them have been fighting side by side for tens of millions of years.
They called each other brothers every day, so how could you...
Unfortunately, he didn't get the chance.
The Jiyun Immortal King was already stronger than him, and with the addition of those three, he was quickly driven to a dead end.
In his final moments, he could only see the blade of destruction slicing through the entire starry sky.
He remembered it was Xiao Kun Demon King's blade.
In front of this strike, a proud Demon King could not even move, and his immortal body began to disintegrate quickly.
This felt like suppression by rank!
After spending millions of years together, only on the verge of death did he realize that the usually unassuming Xiao Kun was the strongest among the four.
No wonder Sahili and Hua Yin were willing to respect him as the eldest brother.
But this discovery was meaningless now.
Swoosh!
The Frost Shadow Demon King was beheaded, and the Jiyun Immortal King reacted the fastest, being the first to rush over and capture the head.
He flew over with it, seeking credit.
"Haha, Brother Cheng, luckily I did not fail you!"
"This old man has already defeated the enemy!"
The three Demon Kings in the rear were furious.
"Damn you, Jiyun!"
"How dare you steal our credit?"
"Despicable little man!"
The Jiyun Immortal King was not weak, and he angrily retorted, "Go to hell with you all; you almost destroyed my Immortal Country just now, right? It was on purpose, wasn't it?"
Everyone present was confused, not understanding what was going on.
The four experts of the Ghost Alliance, aren't they on the same side?
When the three appeared, they thought that Jiyun and Jiang Cheng were finished, but instead, they started fighting amongst themselves?
Could there be deep internal conflict within the Ghost Alliance?
However, even the more than 300 Demon Venerables and Immortal Venerables who followed behind were puzzled.
This was just as bewildering to them.
How did the Ghost Alliance's fourth leader, Frost Shadow Demon King, just die like that?
Is the Ghost Alliance doing an internal purge to eliminate dissidents without informing us?
Looking at the bloody head in front of him, Brother Cheng cast a sideways glance at the Jiyun Immortal King, are you crazy?
"Put it down, put it down!"
Although he had killed many people, he didn't enjoy admiring severed heads.
The Jiyun Immortal King, failing to earn merit, looked dejected.
And above, the three Ghost Alliance leaders, Xiao Kun Demon King, Sahili Demon King, and Hua Yin Immortal King, had already landed.
Under the gaze of everyone present, the three put away their weapons and slowly walked toward Jiang Cheng.
Thud!
Thud!
Thud!
Kneeling on one knee simultaneously, with utmost excitement.
"Greetings, Sect Leader Jiang!"
"So you're still in the Middle Immortal Realm, haha, this is wonderful!"
"We've been missing you constantly all these years, hoping for your return!"
Even with the previous example of the Jiyun Immortal King, everyone present was still stunned, almost losing their divine souls.
Damn, judging by this scene, could it be that these three were also under Sect Leader Jiang?
How could this be possible?
Who could command these three giants?
Especially since the Jiyun Immortal King was from the Ancient Emperor Sect, completely separate from the Ghost Alliance.
After the fight, the two sides were still cursing each other, seemingly not being on good terms.
Yet they all unanimously kneeled to this Sect Leader Jiang.
Miao Yu could no longer remain calm.
She finally understood why Jiang Cheng refused to part with that sword and declined Celestial Pavilion's protection.
Because he didn't need it at all.
This man under his command already had four Immortal King level giants.
However, she was still mostly bewildered.
Why would this happen?
A mere First Grade Golden Immortal, how could he make supreme Immortal Kings and Demon Kings bow their heads?
Especially after over a hundred Demon Venerables and Immortal Venerables had been killed.
Weren't those all the elite subordinates of the Ghost Alliance?
They should include your disciples and grandchildren, right?
Such deep vendettas!
And yet, all of this was cast aside?
For Jiang Cheng, directly betraying the Frost Shadow Demon King, a comrade of many years?
She was almost convinced these people were under a spell.
Without being mesmerized, there was no other explanation.
How on earth was this done?
Just when she was in a daze, 18 Ninth Grade Demon Venerables flew out from the crowd of over three hundred Demon Venerables from the Ghost Alliance.
Like the three Supreme Elders from the Ancient Emperor Sect earlier, these 18 also knelt in front of Brother Cheng.
"Sect Leader Jiang!"
"It's really you!"
"Do you remember us?"
"My God, to think there's still a day to meet Sect Leader Jiang again..."
"Had we known it was you, we would have gladly burned our Immortal Souls just to rush here to greet you sooner!"
"Whoever said we were going to wipe out everyone on the other side when setting out, step forward!"
"I was wrong! Brother, I was wrong, had I known it was him, I would have settled that bastard Meng Qin before setting out..."
Seeing these Demon Venerables who have lived for billions of years react like this, the remaining members of the Ghost Alliance could only be bewildered.
Before setting out, weren't they talking about paying blood debts with blood?
Upon hearing of Meng Qin's death, weren't they clamoring for revenge?
The once puzzled members of the Ancient Emperor Sect quickly felt balanced upon realizing this.
Turns out it wasn't just their sect's patriarch who submitted to this Sect Leader Jiang, the Ghost Alliance high-ups did the same.
Brother Cheng opened the system to check, and the Shock Value was soaring rapidly, without any sign of stopping.
The show-off effect was outstanding.
Sigh, outstanding people are just that flamboyant. They don't even need to lift a finger, Merit Points come to them automatically.
"You are Xiao Kun, ah, I remember you."
"Back then you were behind Void Abyss, right?"
He rarely recognized one, after all, Xiao Kun was one of the leaders of the Demon Realm back then, always sitting in the front row in meetings.
Xiao Kun Demon King was so excited, he nodded joyfully.
"Yes, yes, it's been so many years, and you still remember me, hahaha!"
Nearby, Shali Demon King and Hua Yin Immortal King looked at each other with a tinge of envy and complained.
"Sect Leader Jiang, don't forget us too!"
"Do you not remember us at all?"
"Didn't we follow you too?"
"I joined you even before them, together with the Sword Domain, before they did in the Demon Realm!"
Xiao Kun Demon King immediately retorted, "It doesn't look like that matters at all, does it?"
Jiyun Immortal King was not one to be outdone, and shot back with a retort: "Not everyone can follow Sect Leader Jiang, is that what you think?"
"Get out, get out!"
Although he had destroyed a lot of people, he had no interest in toting heads around for admiration.

chapters.title: Chapter 291 291: You really are quite capable
chapters.content:
With those few words from Jiyun, Hua Yin and Shali immediately launched a joint counterattack.
"You old bastard, do you think you have a say here?"
"Back in the day, you were still behind me in line!"
"Had I known, I would have flattened your Ancient Emperor Sect back then!"
"Exactly, I've never liked this old bastard!"
This casual remark had the sect leader and elders of the Ancient Emperor Sect sweating bullets.
Could you consider our little hearts when you speak?
The surrounding onlookers, though not knowing the truth, could see something was up.
Even though the four of them oddly respected Sect Leader Jiang, they clearly weren't on the same team.
In fact, their relationships were quite hostile.
In reality, they guessed correctly.
The Lower Realm Ten Thousand Realms was never a solid block, and before entering the Void Immortal Realm, they had hardly any dealings with one another.
Getting together at that time was thanks to all the secret targeting and suppression by that group of Immortal Emperors from the Upper Immortal Realm.
After Jiang Cheng disappeared, these people each developed independently.
In the millions of years since, some had never contacted each other, while others even became enemies.
There was no such thing as mutual support, or brotherly love.
"Oh, oh, so it's you guys!"
"Ha, haha..."
Brother Cheng felt a bit awkward; they were so enthusiastic, but he didn't recognize them. How embarrassing!
He could only awkwardly laugh twice to show respect, pretending he still remembered.
The crowd was too tired to criticize, your acting is so fake.
"I thought you guys came for this sword too."
He waved the Rainbow Absolute Sword in his hand, and the reactions of Xiao Kun, Hua Yin, and Shali were exactly the same as those of Jiyun Immortal King from before.
"How could we? Give us ten times the guts, and we still wouldn't dare to snatch something of yours."
"That's right, we're here to support you!"
"Are those people outside here to snatch it?"
"Evil Cloud Palace, Minghai Ancient Race, Candle Mountain Demons... quite the feast!"
Shari Demon King licked his lips with a grin, exuding murderous intent, making it seem like he saw people as food.
As he spoke, he suddenly vanished on the spot.
Soon after, there was an explosion on the Evil Cloud Palace side!
The remaining three's faces drastically changed.
Jiyun was the first to react: "Not good, he's trying to steal the credit!"
Although Xiao Kun was also from the Demon Realm, he was equally furious: "Shali, how dare you! In front of Sect Leader Jiang, is it up to you to take the lead?"
"Out of the way, let me do it!" Hua Yin had already gone after them.
Cursing loudly, the three of them charged into the Minghai Ancient Race, Candle Mountain Demons, and a few other forces.
These people came for that Immortal Sword; they had ill intentions from the start.
Brother Cheng naturally wouldn't stop them from taking action.
And as those four struck, the surrounding forces faced complete devastation.
They hadn't brought any Immortal Kings or Demon Kings. Originally thinking to seize the opportunity in chaos, little did they know they'd become targets themselves.
"We will leave immediately!"
"Spare us..."
"Dare to mess with Candle Mountain Demons, don't you know we have the Ancient Demon Sect behind us?"
"Misunderstanding, misunderstanding!"
"Misunderstanding my ass, daring to surround Sect Leader Jiang, even dying ten thousand times isn't enough!"
As the four great experts engaged in battle, the remaining Ghost Alliance Demon Venerable and Ancient Emperor Sect Immortal Venerables naturally followed their ancestor.
The crowd was like tigers hunting sheep, slaughtering zealously, with corpses falling from the sky in a scene akin to an apocalyptic battle.
Scaring the Branch President of the Celestial Pavilion, Yan Wei, into a cold sweat.
For the first time, he felt that the golden brand of the Celestial Pavilion wasn't so safe after all.
Other guests in the pavilion trembled even more, fearing these people would go berserk and encircle them within the attack range.
The battle raged above the Celestial Pavilion, while Miao Yu and Ye Yang Immortal King could only watch silently.
Right now, they were quite glad; fortunately, they'd stayed neutral all along. Even if they wanted the Immortal Sword, they attempted to buy it, not snatch it outright.
Otherwise, they too would likely be under attack.
The two of them knew well that the landscape of Qianlan Celestial Realm and its surroundings had changed.
Moments later, the battle ended.
None of those who had surrounded them earlier managed to escape, all wiped out.
Looking at the four aggressive experts in the sky, Leng Huahan and Yuan Zhe, Yuan Wu, and others were stunned.
This was too ruthless!
Thank goodness they were on their side this time; if they were enemies, even Feixian Sect wouldn't be enough to last a few rounds.
Looking back at Jiang Cheng, they were completely convinced.
No wonder Sect Leader Yuan Zhen and Grand Elder Yuan Sheng were so respectful to the ancestor from the start!
Turns out they were telling the truth.
The ancestor truly had 'extensive acquaintances', making friends wherever he went!
Just what level was this ancestor at that even Immortal Kings and Demon Kings listened to him?
They deeply reflected, realizing this journey could have been carefree like the ancestor, without all the anxiety!
At the same time, they regretted not praising the ancestor like Su Ye and Su Meng had; wouldn't future gains be endless...
But they didn't know that Brother Cheng was currently in a less than lovely mood.
Watching those people happily clean up the spoils of war above, his eye twitched, and his heart bled.
He was also annoyed at those four great experts for not having any awareness!
At this moment, the four of them cheerfully flew back to 'report'.
"Sect Leader Jiang, mission accomplished!"
"We've wiped out all the enemies!"
"Dare to mess with Sect Leader Jiang, we'll even go sweep through their old lairs afterward."
Brother Cheng silently cursed, Mission accomplished my foot!
I could've dealt with them myself; dying once wouldn't be a big deal.
Those spoils were rightfully mine anyway, how dare you claim credit for taking them?
He curled his lips, saying indifferently, "Really? You guys are quite capable then!"
Jiyun and Xiao Kun, among others, were stunned; this was not the praise they expected.
They looked at each other, thinking maybe they messed up by acting without clearing the way for him first, making him unhappy.
"Sect Leader Jiang, please forgive us. We acted without your permission..."
"Yes, yes. We promise not to act on our own next time!"
Everyone nearby heard this and once again questioned reality.
Do you Immortal Kings and Demon Kings really need to be this humble?
Even facing an Immortal Emperor, you wouldn't be like this!
But they didn't experience the era when Brother Cheng led the Ten Thousand Realms' ascenders and used them as pawns.
"Alright, alright, I can't manage you guys."
Brother Cheng turned away, waving his hand, and returned to the shop.
"Your wings have grown strong, and you don't follow the rules anymore, wonderful, isn't it?"
The four great experts turned ashen, hurried in after him.
Sect Leader Jiang was truly angry now, with words implying he would no longer include them.
For them, Brother Cheng was the only superior they needed to respect.
Not to mention the multiple times he saved and aided them. They finally reunited and didn't want to be abandoned.
"Sect Leader Jiang, we were wrong!"
"Yes, although we don't know what we did wrong, as long as you point it out, we'll change right away!"
Brother Cheng shook his head, looking disappointed: "No, you did well, it's just that I'm old..."
Su Ye and Su Meng quickly approached.
"Ancestor, you're still young, nowhere near old!"
"That's right, I've never seen an Immortal more handsome than the ancestor..."
"And the ancestor resolved such a massive crisis without even lifting a finger, it's simply a heavenly figure descended!"
The two women, having held back for so long, finally found another chance to flatter and chime in.

chapters.title: Chapter 292 292: The Trusted Aide Beside Sect Leader Jiang
chapters.content:
Brother Cheng felt slightly comforted.
He rubbed the heads of the two girls: "You two are really the most considerate."
"If only everyone had your keen sense."
"I'm going inside to rest, call me when all those 3,000 Immortal Fate Orders arrive."
With that, he left the others behind and returned to his room, lamenting the spoils that should have been his.
Leng Huahan, Yuan Zhe, and the others wore expressions of dismay.
Elder, please stop playing around.
If you keep it up, things will really get out of hand.
It's not easy to get these super strong allies, don't offend them all with just a few words.
And you're not here, leaving us to face this group of fierce people, it's really scary and helpless...
Miao Yu and Ye Yang Immortal King, who had been closely watching from the side, were also speechless.
Is this a joke?
They helped you eliminate the enemies, and you not only aren't grateful but also unhappy?
Are you crazy?
A Middle Immortal Realm's Immortal King is a peak powerhouse, how many people can get them to make a single move?
"If I were them, with this attitude, I'd be disheartened too."
Ye Yang Immortal King took a deep breath and said solemnly, "At their level, they cannot be lightly disrespected! No one has the right to show a sour face to a dignified Immortal King!"
"No matter what the past relationship was, it no longer matters, they're going to break up."
Miao Yu nodded.
Even an Immortal Emperor from the Upper Immortal Realm cannot treat an Immortal King like this.
However, the scene they imagined of the four great experts being disheartened and breaking up never happened.
What a joke, in their minds, Sect Leader Jiang's status is much higher than that of the seniors when they first began cultivating.
"What's going on here?"
"What exactly does Sect Leader Jiang mean by his rules?"
"We must have done something to displease him!"
"Don't drag me into it, it's definitely because of you three!"
"Nonsense, you were the first one to make a move just now..."
The four of them started arguing among themselves, and neither the other Immortal Venerables nor Demon Venerables dared to interject, let alone ask.
After arguing for a long time without any resolution, Xiao Kun Demon King suddenly had a flash of inspiration.
The old demon adjusted his expression, pulled up his stiff mouth, and approached Su Ye and Su Meng.
"Heh heh, just now, Sect Leader Jiang's conversation with the two fairies... could it be that you are very close to him?"
Seeing his old face, which was very unnatural when he smiled due to years of sternness, Su Ye and Su Meng were so scared that they quickly stepped back two steps.
They had heard about the Ghost Alliance since their first day of cultivation, a terrifying force secretly dominating the surrounding Celestial Domain, able to stop children from crying at night!
This is the Grand Alliance Leader of the Ghost Alliance, an indisputable Great Demon King!
Don't be fooled by their respect for Elder Jiang; truly, to kill oneself would only require a look.
"We... we've only known the Elder for a short time, but we've been together every day during this period..."
The two of them trembled, and before they were asked further, they honestly spilled everything.
"Oh? Together every day?"
Hua Yin Immortal King's eyes lit up and he also approached with a smile: "So you've been with Sect Leader Jiang day and night these days?"
Su Ye quickly nodded her little head: "Yes, yes, the Elder is very kind to us, not fierce at all!"
"He even gave us Tier Six Immortal Artifacts."
Su Meng cautiously finished speaking, and like presenting a treasure, she displayed the Tier Six Immortal Artifact.
Hoping that these Great Demon Kings, considering the Elder's affection for them, would not erase them with a mere look.
"Fairies, do not fear, we mean no harm!"
Jiyun Immortal King also reacted.
Only after a few days of knowing each other are you already together, and even received his rewards.
This... these are the number one red people around Sect Leader Jiang!
The old Immortal King's face turned into a blooming chrysanthemum as he reached out and took out two pieces of Tier Six Immortal Armor to gift.
"I have two little things here, hope you like them."
"Additionally, could you say a few nice things about me to Sect Leader Jiang and ask what exactly was wrong this time?"
Whoa!
Leng Huahan was almost popping his eyes out.
Who would have thought?
The dignified Immortal King giving gifts to curry favor with two True Immortals?
This can't be real, right?
Not far from them, Miao Yu and Ye Yang Immortal King expressed that their three views were completely shattered into pieces, all over the ground!
Weren't you supposed to be disheartened and then break up with Sect Leader Jiang?
What kind of operation is this?
"We, we..."
Su Ye and Su Meng were also stunned.
This gift is invaluable to them, and more importantly, it was given by an Immortal King, the significance is extraordinary!
They truly didn't dare to accept it, fearing there might be some sort of conspiracy behind it.
"Rest assured and accept, how can you have a Tier Six Immortal Sword without matching Tier Six Immortal Armor?"
Jiyun Immortal King, without any explanation, directly placed the two pieces of Immortal Armor into the hands of the two girls.
And at this moment, Xiao Kun Demon King also squeezed in.
"Fairies, with Immortal Armor and Immortal Sword, yet you don't have an appropriate Magical Treasure?"
"Coincidentally, these are two little things from me that seem quite fated with you."
As he spoke, two bell-shaped Magical Treasures floated out.
"These are called Twin Bells, no matter how far apart you are, as long as you're still in the Middle Immortal Realm, a single shake will instantly transmit you to each other's side."
Again, everyone inhaled sharply.
This may not be for attack or defense, but it's definitely a Top-Grade Magical Treasure!
Just given away like that?
Given to two True Immortals?
Su Ye and Su Meng had just each received a bell when Hua Yin Immortal King took out two small porcelain bottles.
"Hehe, fairies have Immortal Artifact Magical Treasures, so I shall give some pills."
"In each bottle, there are ten Void Essence Pills, which may prove useful after you break through to Immortal Venerable someday!"
At this, Yuan Zhe, Yuan Wu, and other Immortal Venerables' eyes turned red.
Void Essence Pill, that's a Tier Seven Immortal Pill, they have never even dared to hope for it!
Shali Demon King glared at the other three: "You've all given your gifts, what do I give?"
He pondered for two seconds, then, smiling fully, took out two jade pendants.
"Fairies, these two Celestial Nether Jades contain two strands of the Power of Rules from me. In times of crisis, they can save you from three tribulations!"
"Take it, this is also the Ghost Alliance's token, seeing it is like seeing the Alliance Leader!"
The already dizzy Su Ye and Su Meng nearly dropped the jade pendants out of fright upon hearing this sentence.
Everyone else nearly went mad.
What?
Is this the legendary supreme Celestial Nether Jade of the Ghost Alliance?
They're just True Immortals, isn't giving this too much?
In the future, when other Demon Venerables and Immortal Venerables from the Ghost Alliance see them, won't they have to salute and obey their orders?
This treatment, not to mention everyone around, even Miao Yu started turning green with envy.
The other treasures she couldn't care less about, since she herself had both Tier Seven Immortal Artifacts and Immortal Treasures.
But those final two Celestial Nether Jades capable of commanding the Ghost Alliance's horde, meant something completely different, it represented a powerful underground force at her disposal!
Not to mention the gifts sounded superficial, while they actually represented the favor of the four great experts, the value was immeasurable.
Leng Huahan, whose mind felt as if it had been trampled by a thousand horses, suddenly let out a bitter laugh.
He thought of Gu Qingyu far on the other side at the Feixian Sect.
If she knew the treatment of these two Outer Sect Maids, what would she think?

chapters.title: Chapter 293 293: So It Was the Creditor
chapters.content:
Receiving so many valuable gifts, Su Ye and Su Meng felt a little uneasy.
They hadn't done anything significant, and before this, they'd only interacted with other low-level outer disciples, constantly struggling for limited cultivation resources.
Facing this situation now, they were completely inexperienced.
"We're just afraid the Elder won't listen..."
Xiao Kun Demon King chuckled lightly, "Don't worry, just say some nice words. Even if it doesn't work, the gifts are still yours."
"Whether it works or not, we won't blame you, go ahead."
The four experts turned into scheming old grandpas fooling the naive girls with good words, gently persuading them to go to the third-floor resting area.
At this time, Brother Cheng was tallying up the merit he'd accumulated over this period, which had surpassed fifteen thousand.
He was thinking about whether he should upgrade his system or exchange it for pills and rule fragments to boost his realm.
Eventually, he decided to elevate his realm first.
The former 'cheer squad' was already filled with Ninth-Grade Demon Venerables and Immortal Kings, while he was still a First-Grade Golden Immortal, which just didn't sit right.
Level 4 Rule Fragments could elevate ten main rules to the Great Success Level.
And to advance to Immortal Venerable, the condition was that all main rules must reach the Great Success Level.
Looking at the exchange prices at the store, 200 merit points for one Level 4 Fragment.
He quickly exchanged for 40 pieces, elevating 400 main rules to the Great Success Level.
Although his realm was still First-Grade Golden Immortal, with the rapid advancement of the main rules, his power was at least several times stronger than before.
As for his Immortal Power Cultivation, though he had plenty of Immortal Pills from his previous spoils, the foundation was too deep.
All nine martial dao pathways were Immortal King level; after consuming all of them, his realm only reached Second-Grade Golden Immortal.
Reluctantly, he had to exchange merit to boost his Immortal Power and Immortal Soul with a thousand Seventh-Grade Immortal Pills each, finally raising his realm to Sixth-Grade Golden Immortal.
While his merit points dwindled to just about a thousand.
"Sigh, upgrading is too slow, seems I'll need to figure out how to earn more merit points."
Within a few minutes, he ascended from First-Grade Golden Immortal to Sixth-Grade Golden Immortal. If others heard this, they'd probably be infuriated to the point of spitting blood.
Even if you have the talent, each Golden Immortal realm upgrade generally takes tens of thousands of years, right?
Footsteps outside interrupted his contemplation.
"Elder, may we come in?"
Letting them in the room, he smiled, "You two aren't staying downstairs, why did you come up here?"
"Couldn't have missed me already in this short time?"
This indeed hit the mark with the two girls.
When facing the terrifying four experts and Ghost Alliance demons, let alone Leng Huahan and Yuan Zhe, they felt uncomfortable.
After all, the latter were high-ranking members of Feixian Sect, whose majestic image had been ingrained over the years.
Afraid a single wrong word might invite rebuke.
Except in front of Elder Jiang, they could relax.
Brother Cheng didn't put on airs with them at all. Every chat felt like it was with a brother from next door.
"Yes, without Ancestor around, we feel uneasy."
The two girls sat on his sides.
"Only by your side, Ancestor, do we have a soul."
"Your charm is too great, just like a lighthouse in the dark night, we're like moths that simply can't resist you..."
Even with Brother Cheng's thick skin, he felt their sweet talk was a tad excessive.
However... he quite enjoyed it.
"So, what happened downstairs?"
The two girls hastily revealed the gifts they received earlier.
"Those four seniors gave us lots of treasures saying to speak a few good words for them..."
"Hah, they gave gifts to you?"
Upon hearing this, Brother Cheng was a bit shocked.
This operation was indeed too absurd; those guys did things rather casually.
"What's the situation exactly?"
The two immediately stood up and spontaneously performed for him.
One played the recipient, while the other played four roles to recreate the situation back then.
Not missing a single word, they even imitated the expressions remarkably well.
Brother Cheng was dumbfounded, thinking they were honest, he merely asked them to describe verbally but ended up with a full reenactment.
"Alright, alright, I get it."
Su Ye sat back down at his left, feeling a bit uneasy, "Elder, did we do something wrong?"
"Accepting their gifts like that, if it disrupts your plans, please punish us..."
Su Meng also quickly placed the gifts on the table, cautiously admitting fault, "We really didn't dare not accept at that time, afraid of offending them and getting killed."
"So we initially accepted them on your behalf, now transferring them to you!"
Brother Cheng shook his head, smiling, "It's fine, you keep them."
"Really?"
"Thank you, Elder!"
The two girls were jubilant.
With his assurance, they dared to truly accept the treasures as their own.
Brother Cheng nodded inwardly, not bad, knowing when to advance and retreat.
"From now on, if they give you other gifts, you can accept them too..."
"Actually, if you fancy something, feel free to ask them for it."
"If they dare not give, tell them it's on my behalf!"
"Huh?"
Su Ye and Su Meng froze, looking incredulous.
"This, isn't this inappropriate?"
Actively asking for things from Immortal Kings and Demon Kings, that's practically insane!
And isn't it a bit impolite?
"What's inappropriate? They owe me!"
"Do they owe you money, Ancestor?"
Their bright black eyes full of speculation, could Ancestor be their creditor?
No wonder they respect Ancestor so much.
Thinking of those spoils rightfully his, Brother Cheng gritted his teeth and said fiercely, "Of course!"
"They owe me a lot, so you two don't have to be polite, take whatever anyone gives, if they don't give, just directly ask!"
Well, you owe me, let these two lasses recover a bit of interest for me.
Anyway, both were certified by the system as his own from day one.
The two girls considered and nodded.
Suddenly a little excited.
From Ancestor's words, it seemed these debts were quite a lot.
"Then they asked us to speak well of them..."
Brother Cheng waved his hand, "Tell them it's fine, and to show a bit of perception in the future."
"Got it!"
After the girls went downstairs, the four experts and those Ninth-grade Demon Venerables hurriedly surrounded them.
"How did it go?"
"Has Sect Leader Jiang calmed down?"
Su Ye replied, "Ancestor said it's fine now, but asked you to show a bit of perception next time."
"Huh?"
Xiao Kun Demon King was stunned, anxiously asked, "Did he mention where the mistake was?"
"This..."
Su Meng directly quoted Brother Cheng's words, "Ancestor said you owe him a lot, so let us take them confidently, representing him."
Oh this...
Leng Huahan and Yuan Zhe suddenly gained a corporate-level understanding,
No wonder the Elder was still a First-Grade Golden Immortal, yet these Immortal Kings and Demon Kings showed him so much respect.
Turns out they owed him debts from before.
However, isn't it usually the debtor who is the boss?

chapters.title: Chapter 294 294 Sect Leader Jiang, Lead Us
chapters.content:
The four great experts exchanged glances, still not thinking about the battle spoils.
After all, who would expect someone who had slain Immortal Emperors to care about the battle spoils from a group of Immortal Venerables and Golden Immortals?
But thinking back to those years, I indeed owe Sect Leader Jiang tremendous debts of gratitude.
And it's not just me; there are as many as 120,000 others who owe him!
"That's right, that's right!"
"We'll never be able to repay the kindness we owe Sect Leader Jiang in this lifetime, haha!"
Xiao Kun patted his chest heartily and said, "In the future, whatever the two fairies fancy, just let us know. As long as we have it!"
Jiyun also laughed and said, "That's right, we're all one family now, no need to be polite with us!"
Reaching the level of an Immortal King is not the end of their cultivation; they still have needs.
Following Sect Leader Jiang and being astonishingly carried to new heights was their personal experience from those years.
If they stick with him again this time, perhaps they might inexplicably reach the level of Immortal Emperor!
So it's definitely necessary to strengthen the relationship with those around him.
They are clever, and from that remark earlier, they've already noticed how highly favored these two women are.
They can represent Sect Leader Jiang in receiving things; they are truly close confidantes and highly esteemed.
In some sense, they weren't wrong.
Now that Brother Cheng no longer has that group of sycophantic disciples around, Su Ye and Su Meng have filled his empty heart.
It's as if he's temporarily transferred the care he had for those disciples in past years onto these two.
Could their status not be high?
Therefore, the four of them looked at these two women with eyes as if looking at beloved daughters, so affectionate.
This made those nearby envious and jealous.
What kind deeds did these two True Immortals accumulate in their past lives to deserve such treatment?
Two days later, over 3,000 Immortal Fate Orders arrived in succession from various branches around the Celestial Pavilion.
And in the past two days, the events that happened here spread quickly.
The Frost Shadow Demon King of the Ghost Alliance was killed; this was a huge news event.
After all, once someone reaches the level of an Immortal/Demon King, affecting one could impact everything; the fall of even one can cause a sensational upheaval.
However, this time, the news of the Demon King being killed had to take a backseat, because there was an even more significant event.
An Elder Jiang of the Feixian Sect subdued three other Alliance Leaders of the Ghost Alliance as well as Jiyun Immortal King of the Ancient Emperor Sect.
This sort of thing isn't even easily accomplished by an Immortal Emperor.
Reaching the level of an Immortal King makes one a big shot of sorts, not easily willing to submit to another.
For a while, countless people in the surrounding Celestial Domain discussed Jiang Cheng.
They all speculated about who exactly he might be, perhaps an incarnation of an Immortal Emperor?
Unfortunately, no matter how they guessed, they couldn't make heads or tails of it, not even knowing his true name.
"Here are the Immortal Fate Orders you wanted."
In the Celestial Pavilion, Miao Yu pushed over the ring containing the Immortal Fate Orders.
Now, she could no longer view Jiang Cheng indifferently; anyone who can have four Immortal King level subordinates deserves the utmost attention.
Even in the Upper Immortal Realm, a character like this wouldn't be overlooked.
Brother Cheng counted them, and combined with the previous two purchases, there were exactly 3,300.
After paying the Immortal Crystals, he stood upright.
"Pleasant transaction, goodbye."
Miao Yu suddenly felt a bit annoyed; every time this person looked at her, his gaze was so blatant, no different from some rogues.
But when discussing business, he was incredibly pragmatic, with no intention of flattering a beauty at all.
When leaving, he was utterly decisive.
"Your cultivation, how come it's reached Sixth-grade Golden Immortal already?"
She remembered that Jiang Cheng was still a First Grade Golden Immortal two days ago.
Brother Cheng turned back and shrugged: "Oh, I have an extraordinary talent. I cultivated hard these past two days, so I broke through."
Miao Yu almost wanted to point at his nose and sneer—do you take me for a fool?
Rising five-layered Golden Immortal Small Realms in just two days is a dream.
She simply believed Jiang Cheng was indeed hiding his strength, far beyond just the Golden Immortal level, and was just letting a bit more of his cultivation show now.
"We've met several times now, yet I still don't know your full name."
She was exceedingly curious about Jiang Cheng.
Her intuition told her there must be an earth-shattering secret behind this.
Brother Cheng originally planned to tell her.
After all, he has no fear and doesn't care if Immortal Emperors come looking for trouble.
But considering the shock value…
This time, his subduing of the four great experts shocked countless people.
However, once the news spread, the millions of immortals in the surrounding Celestial Domain who were shocked didn't yield much shock value.
Ultimately it only converted to 13,000 more merit points.
According to the system's explanation, it's because they didn't experience the event at the moment it occurred.
Shocking news passed through others' mouths becomes second-hand, and the system significantly reduces its effect.
And after three or four times, it's even less.
As for those who only received the news after tens of thousands of retelling, they provided no shock value at all.
In fact, once Jiang Cheng's name connects with that Immortal Emperor's fall from over a billion years ago, the resulting sensation would definitely be unprecedented!
The problem is, the main contributor of shock value would only be those people from back then.
Those who hear the news later won't contribute much shock value.
And it wouldn't be good for the long-term impact on his act of impressing others.
He planned that such a major event as revealing his identity should wait until he reaches the Upper Immortal Realm in the future.
Then he'll find a way to gather a big group of Immortal Emperors and announce it in their presence.
The shock effect will definitely be nice!
As for whether those Immortal Emperors will want to kill him after knowing his identity…
That's not important, just minor details.
"My name, in the future, will resound like thunder in your ears, so don't scream then!"
Leaving behind this line full of adolescent bravado, he walked out of the Celestial Pavilion.
Miao Yu was dumbstruck.
No one had ever said such words to her in her life; talking about screaming, making it seem like she's idolizing him.
"This person is way too arrogant!"
"Who does he think he is?"
Ye Yang Immortal King was extremely annoyed: "When he learns of your identity, Miss, he'll be the one whose name resounds like thunder!"
Outside, the four great experts had already been waiting for quite some time.
"Sect Leader Jiang, are you returning to the Feixian Sect?"
"May we accompany you?"
"Yes, we want to continue following you, listening to your guidance."
"Not seeing you for a day, we can't eat or drink, and have no motivation for cultivation..."
Hearing the words of the four great experts, everyone else was numb.
What did this Elder Jiang do in the past to make them like this?
Brother Cheng thought to himself, do you all still want to steal my thunder and battle spoils from me?
He impatiently waved his hand: "Go, go, go, don't you have your own sects?"
"Go back where you came from!"
The crowd almost spat blood, an Immortal King coming to take refuge with him and he declines?
Leng Huahan and Yuan Zhe felt their hearts break.
Elder Jiang, why didn't you agree?
If you had taken them back with you, having four Immortal King level experts in Feixian Sect would have been so prestigious!
Xiao Kun Demon King's heart also broke; Sect Leader Jiang didn't want to hang out with him anymore?
This meant he couldn't continue to be led to new heights by his elder!
He could only lick his face and say: "Then can we still visit you at the Feixian Sect in the future?"
"I'll let you know if I need you, don't just drop by uninvited, that's all."
Brother Cheng waved as he stepped onto the flying ship.
"""

chapters.title: Chapter 295 295: They Are All Promising Talents!
chapters.content:
After the flying ship set off, Su Ye and Su Meng were jubilant with their bountiful gains from this journey.
The two leaned close to Brother Cheng, once again entering their flattery mode.
"Ancestor, why didn't you let them follow us to the Feixian Sect?"
Su Meng curiously asked, "Is it because their abilities are too weak and you look down on them?"
Of course, Brother Cheng couldn't say it was because he was afraid they'd steal the limelight, so he nodded in agreement.
"That's right, you're absolutely right."
Su Ye said proudly, "Not many can catch Ancestor's eye, what are Immortal Kings and Demon Kings even worth?"
"Hehe, Ancestor must be the strongest person in the Immortal Realm."
Leng Huahan quietly grumbled to himself, you two are merely True Immortals, yet you dare to say 'what are Immortal Kings and Demon Kings worth'?
Who gave you the courage?
But looking at the ancestor's delighted expression, it was clear he didn't mind such excessive flattery.
Alas, I've made a mistake on this trip!
Looking back on the great opportunity Immortal Venerable Yuan Sheng mentioned before departure, turns out it was like this.
It's a shame I was so dismissive then.
Gu Qingyu missed the chance because she didn't come; I, despite coming, ended up empty-handed!
Thinking about it, I almost want to hit myself.
If I had flattered all the way like Su Ye and Su Meng, would I have also returned full-handed?
Tier Six Immortal Armor, Top-Grade Magical Treasures, Seventh-grade Elixirs...
The treatment is truly enviable!
Moreover, there's the Ancestor's future guidance, the hidden rewards of goodwill from the four experts.
Should I give it a try?
"Ahem, Ancestor's divine might is unparalleled, commanding the Middle Immortal Realm with no dissent!"
This abrupt shout drew the attention of everyone on the flying ship.
Yuan Zhe and Yuan Wu, among other elders, doubted their ears.
This statement, could it be Leng Huahan who said it?
This true disciple, always proud and aloof, indifferent to everyone,
He's long been capable of managing by himself, so even his master Yuan Sheng mostly lets him be.
But for him to actually flatter?
And in such a cringeworthy manner?
Brother Cheng was also startled by the shout.
He hadn't paid much attention to Leng Huahan along the way, but could see his pride and aloofness, like an upright pine tree in the snow.
The type of person who sticks to his principles and doesn't 'go with the flow.'
Jiang Zhang respects those unwilling to flatter and does not force them.
But he didn't expect that he'd succumb.
Brother Cheng was secretly delighted, this is a significant progress!
However, kid, your flattery is too stiff, isn't it?
It's like shouting slogans, awkward to the ear.
For a moment, people might think I'm the Star Old Immortal with boundless power.
Look at Su Ye and Su Meng; although not yet evolved to the level of a Flattery King, at least their every flattering point is solidly reasoned.
Unlike your unnatural approach.
Seeing everyone's perplexed gaze, Leng Huahan's face, hard like a sculpture, twitched, wishing he could die on the spot.
Have I gone mad?
It's as if my mind's covered in lard, forgetting my original pride!
However, right afterward, Elder Jiang flew to his side and kindly patted his broad shoulder.
"You've done well; I've noticed your transformation and improvement along the way."
"Truly a pillar of Feixian Sect's future!"
"I have my hopes in you."
"I also don't need this Treasure Light Sword, so I'll reward it to you, hoping you'll continue to work hard and not let me down!"
What!
The Treasure Light Sword?
Isn't this the Tier Seven Immortal Sword used by Meng Qin?
Behind them, Yuan Zhe, Yuan Wu, and Yuan He, the three elders, almost spat blood on the spot.
No one in the Feixian Sect has yet used a Tier Seven Immortal Artifact; even the Sect Leader and the Great Elder do not have one.
And Leng Huahan, this true disciple, has it now?
Where is his progress along the way?
Just because he made a terribly unskilled flattery?
Is that all it takes?
Staring at the floating Treasure Light Sword before him, then the Ancestor's approving gaze with a smile, Leng Huahan's recently determined aloof nature utterly collapsed.
The steadfast pine tree in the snow quietly bent.
What's 'don't go with the flow,' what's losing principle, in front of a Tier Seven Immortal Artifact, are they all illusions?
Moreover, this is the Ancestor of this Sect. As a younger generation, if not aligning with him, who else should I align with?
His tiger-like eyes gleamed, trembling hands took the sword.
"I will not let Ancestor's expectations down!"
"Good!"
Brother Cheng nodded in satisfaction.
Honestly, Leng Huahan wasn't as favored by him as Su Ye and Su Meng.
Merely such an astonishing piece of flattery wouldn't warrant such a reward; he's not some Sudhana.
But firstly, this person's flattery is rarer and needs encouragement.
Secondly, while not necessarily valuing talent, even considering character and qualities, this person counts as a rare talent.
Lastly, it's to set an example with a generous reward!
When returning, other disciples of Feixian Sect seeing that even the true inheritor senior brother Leng Huahan has become a flattery expert, wouldn't it be a good leading example?
Thus, he deliberately rewarded the Treasure Light Sword.
Seeing Leng Huahan's treatment, the three elders could no longer hold it in.
In front of him, does maintaining a status mean anything?
Yuan Zhe was the first to speak up in flattery: "Following the Ancestor out this time, I finally see what it means for thousands of immortals to worship!"
Yuan Wu was not willing to lag behind: "The Ancestor's power and connections are completely beyond our comprehension, truly astonishing!"
Yuan He took a different angle, attacking himself: "Initially, I thought Ancestor's actions were reckless; now looking back, I find my perspective so myopic, like a barnyard bird unaware of the vastness of heaven and earth..."
Even Brother Cheng was taken aback by Yuan He.
Wow, this one's a talent, almost reminiscent of Immortal Mo of the past!
Actually, he's not foolish, knowing these three were originally overseeing to prevent any misconduct like absconding with funds.
But all are from Feixian Sect, with no ill intentions towards the sect.
"Not bad, not bad!"
"Following me out this time, even if there's no merit, there's hard work."
Tier Seven Immortal Artifacts are surely unavailable, but Tier Six ones can still be rewarded as encouragement, hoping they set a good example within the elder circle.
Each holding a Sixth Tier Immortal Sword with joy, the three expressed their gratitude profoundly.
Turns out, this is the proper way to interact with the Ancestor!
Why didn't we realize earlier?
The three deeply reflected, realizing it must have been their poor performance before, costing them points, hence the reward wasn't as good as Leng Huahan's.
As for Su Ye and Su Meng, these two who long advanced to trusted aides/red favorites, they dare not compare, only look up to the big shots.
Along the rest of the way, everyone shared smiles and laughter on the flying ship.
In stark contrast to when they came.
Even Leng Huahan, under the elders' instigation, told two jokes to liven the atmosphere, as if everyone became a family, blurring the line between elders and disciples.
And so, they returned to Feixian Sect.
As soon as they got off the flying ship, Sect Leader Yuan Zhen and Great Elder Yuan Sheng couldn't wait to greet them.
"Patriarch, you're finally back!"
"We've heard of your achievements outside!"
They saw Second Elder Yuan Shu and Third Elder Yuan Mu leading a group of elders, all bowing respectfully.

chapters.title: Chapter 296 296 Attitude Changes Drastically
chapters.content:
Recalling their initial mistrust, Yuan Shu and Yuan Mu were red-faced with embarrassment.
Now they had no choice but to accept it.
The news outside had spread far and wide.
The ancestor possessed a Tier Nine Immortal Sword, destroyed Danhua City, and defeated Meng Qin in an instant.
Jiyun Immortal King, Hua Yin Immortal King, Xiao Kun Demon King, and Sahili Demon King, these legendary experts were now closely associated with him!
When this news first circulated, they did not believe it at all.
But as time went by, not only did no one deny it, but the stories became more exaggerated, with some even claiming Elder Jiang was an Immortal Emperor.
It was then they realized they might have missed something.
They hurried to find Yuan Zhen and Yuan Sheng to probe for more information.
But these two old men kept their mouths shut, only saying he was an ancestor of the sect, refusing to disclose his full name.
Truth be told, Yuan Zhen and Yuan Sheng were equally astounded to hear that the four great experts were chatting amiably with the sect founder.
They knew Jiang Cheng was the sect founder, aware of his defeat of an Immortal Emperor.
They knew about his astounding feats during the Immortal Ascension Battle in Immortal City.
But they did not know he had brought 120,000 ascenders from the Lower Realm back then, and in Dingtian City, he was the only one whose name was known.
They also did not know about the past of the Void Immortal Realm and the Fake Immortal Realm.
This was only natural.
The ascenders of that time, whether Mo Chen from Void Abyss or Gui Cang Golden Dragon King, were all thoughtful individuals.
After learning that Upper Immortal Realm's Immortal Emperors considered them a target, how could they expose their origins?
They, of course, concealed their identities and quietly developed.
So, after a billion years, these secrets remain hidden, and the Feixian Sect's classics do not record them.
In Yuan Zhen and Yuan Sheng's view, Elder Jiang's prestige might be high but likely limited to within the Feixian Sect itself?
The second and third generation ancestors showing utmost respect if they were to meet him would be normal.
As for others…
Xiao Kun Demon King, Jiyun Immortal King, these individuals should have nothing to do with him!
None of them belonged to the Feixian Sect, how could they even have a connection with him?
They truly couldn't figure it out.
"Ancestor, do those seniors from the Ghost Alliance and Ancient Emperor Sect truly show you such respect as the rumors claim?"
As soon as this question was raised, all the other elders perked up their ears.
No matter how true the rumors were, without seeing it with their own eyes, they couldn't believe it, it was too incredible.
That was the Ghost Alliance after all!
Qianlan Celestial Realm was merely one of the thirty celestial domains they secretly controlled.
And the Feixian Sect's strength in the Qianlan Celestial Realm didn't even rank in the top fifty.
When compared, the gap was too vast.
As for the Ancient Emperor Sect, that too was a leader of a domain, an existence they once looked up to.
However you looked at it, this was too unreal.
Looking at the eager faces of the crowd, Brother Cheng felt a certain satisfaction for showing off.
He simply nodded: "That's right."
Upon receiving his personal confirmation, all the elders exclaimed in shock.
"Is it really true?"
"How on earth did this happen?"
"Could it be the ancestor had dealings with them before?"
"Gaining the goodwill of those top experts is immensely significant..."
After a brief moment of amazement, Elders Yuan Shu, Yuan Mu, and others entered a state of ecstatic joy.
Everyone was beaming as if celebrating a festival.
"This is the honor of our Feixian Sect!"
"The ancestor indeed has an extensive network, with such formidable old friends outside!"
"Haha, our Feixian Sect is blessed..."
Yuan Zhen and Yuan Sheng remarked, at the time we said the ancestor had an extensive network, it was just an excuse.
Who knew we inadvertently spoke the truth.
Watching the other elders' revelry, the three elders Yuan Zhe, Yuan He, and Yuan Wu, who had been shocked multiple times, felt superior.
"You people really are quite humble."
"What old friends, those four Demon Kings and Immortal Kings are deferential to the ancestor, aren't they?"
"Receiving their goodwill? Is that necessary?"
"Clearly, they are eagerly currying favor, there's a hierarchical distinction, they are merely subordinates of the ancestor!"
Having traveled with Brother Cheng, they had seen the world and straightened their backs.
"What?"
Yuan Zhen, Yuan Shu, and others were even more shocked.
"The ancestor's subordinates?"
"Quickly, tell us in detail!"
"Yes, exactly, what happened back then?"
With Brother Cheng's permission, the three elders quickly recounted the course of this trip amidst the crowd's encirclement.
Shouts of astonishment erupted from the crowd from time to time.
Their admiration for the ancestor soared to new heights.
Brother Cheng glanced at the system panel and was awarded some Shock Value.
When converted into Merit, it was about over a thousand.
The main reason was most of the information had already spread, now it was just a personal confirmation.
After he went in to rest, the elders couldn't wait to start a meeting in the chamber.
"Ladies and gentlemen, what more is there to say?"
Sect Leader Yuan Zhen Immortal Venerable felt euphoric.
Some time ago, because he fully supported Elder Jiang's decision, he was almost branded as willful and reckless.
Third Elder Yuan Mu cleared his throat and managed to squeeze out four words: "The Sect Leader is wise!"
The Second Elder wasn't as reserved.
"It truly is a spectacle that the ancestor can command those four to his use!"
He exclaimed loudly: "I'm convinced, previously I was blind to fail to believe in him!"
And the other elders couldn't help but press once more: "Sect Leader, Great Elder, who exactly is Elder Jiang?"
"For the past few days, I've searched through the classics but cannot find any predecessor from our sect who matches him..."
"To have four Immortal King level experts as subordinates, during his time roaming the Middle Immortal Realm, he surely must have been famous across the world!"
"Indeed, those four have been famous for at least seventy or eighty million years. From their era, Elder Jiang should be even earlier."
"It seems his seniority is truly high!"
This question, even those who traveled with Brother Cheng for a few days, such as Yuan Zhe and Yuan Wu, couldn't fathom.
Yuan He paid respects towards the Ancestral Hall direction, then furrowed his brow and pondered: "I remember those four addressed the ancestor as Sect Leader Jiang..."
Yuan Zhe and Yuan Wu also recalled: "Yes, that's indeed how they called him!"
"Could it be the ancestor was a sect leader of a certain generation?"
"But in our Feixian Sect's history, there was never a Jiang as sect leader!"
"Does this mean the ancestor founded another sect outside? And those four great experts belonged to that sect?"
"I've never heard of those four ever belonging to the same sect."
Seeing their speculations growing increasingly wild, Yuan Zhen and Yuan Sheng thought the title Sect Leader Jiang was indeed fitting.
"Enough, you will naturally know the ancestor's identity in due time."
"Right now, the more pressing matter is the purchase of the Immortal Fate Order!"
He swept a gaze over the gathered elders, dissatisfied: "Last time when I asked you all to contribute Immortal Crystals, you all made excuses and didn't trust that the ancestor could keep us safe!"
"What now?"
Upon hearing this, Yuan He was the first to respond.
"I am willing to contribute 2 million Immortal Crystals!"
After laying out a storage ring, he added: "Besides, there are some Immortal Artifacts and Treasures to be sold!"
"To ensure my lineage of disciples and grandchildren can reach the Upper Immortal Realm together, I'm going all out this time!"

chapters.title: Chapter 297 297: Where did you get your Immortal Artifact?
chapters.content:
Yuan Zhen was overjoyed; it seemed that following the Ancestor on a trip had increased his understanding exponentially!
Previously, Yuan He was one of those who firmly opposed it.
Immediately after, Yuan Zhe and Yuan Wu were unwilling to fall behind and each took out two to three million Immortal Crystals.
Afterward, dozens of Elders also took out Immortal Crystals one after another.
But when it came to Second Elder Yuan Shu, everything came to a halt again.
"Yuan Shu, Yuan Mu, what are you still doubting?"
Great Elder Yuan Sheng discontentedly pounded the table: "At this stage, do you still distrust the Ancestor, and think he is a fraud?"
Yuan Shu hurriedly said, "Of course not!"
"The foundation and connections the Ancestor showed this time are awe-inspiring; we are thoroughly convinced both in word and heart."
"But..."
"Tens of thousands of Immortal Fate Orders, what does this mean? Have you thought about it?"
"The number of Ascension Immortal Fate Orders varies each time, but mostly it is only twenty to thirty thousand."
"Buying tens of thousands at once is almost buying them all; this will cause public outrage across the Middle Immortal Realm!"
"Even if the Ancestor has four Immortal Kings and Demon Kings assisting, it will be... difficult to hold on."
The Middle Immortal Realm is too vast; countless intentionally unascended Immortal Kings and Demon Kings combined would likely number over a thousand.
Those four individuals alone simply cannot contend against such a massive group.
He originally wanted to say it would be endless catastrophe, but at the last moment softened his words a bit.
Yuan Zhen and Yuan Sheng really wanted to share frankly, to tell them the Ancestor is an 'Immortal Emperor.'
He can walk sideways in the Middle Immortal Realm...
At a critical moment, Yuan He once again stepped forward.
"The Ancestor's decisions, no matter how absurd or unreasonable they may seem at first, are ultimately proven correct!"
"Thinking too much only disrupts oneself; just listen to him and everything will be fine."
"This is the deepest insight I gained on this trip with him!"
Indeed, Brother Cheng really didn't misjudge him.
This Yuan He is somewhat characteristic of Immortal Mo, beginning to blindly follow him with faith.
Upon hearing this, Yuan Zhe and Yuan Wu also nodded nonstop.
"That's right, throughout this journey, we repeatedly thought he was wrong."
"Yet ultimately, it turned out we were the ones proven wrong!"
"No matter the crisis, he can resolve it in miraculous ways, and even gain substantial rewards."
"The Ancestor's actions cannot be viewed in common sense terms."
"Since he said buy as many as possible, it means he has absolute confidence!"
"If you delay further, you'll only miss the opportunity!"
Listening to these three former 'opponents' telling their stories, Yuan Shu and Yuan Mu could not help but be at a loss for words.
And then think about the inexplicable confidence of the Sect Leader and Great Elder, knowing the Ancestor's background...
Could it be they are really too conservative?
"Well then!"
"Let's make a gamble this time!"
"I am also willing to contribute three million Immortal Crystals!"
As Yuan Shu spoke, the other Elders also no longer hesitated and began gathering Immortal Crystals as a sect.
Not only the Elders, but each sect branch, peak, and hall had their own task quotas.
After all, eventually, all sect disciples could go to the Upper Immortal Realm.
"Alright, go and handle it!"
Yuan Zhen announced the dismissal of the meeting, and everyone stood up.
Afterward, he noticed something peculiar.
The swords of Yuan Zhe, Yuan Wu, and Yuan He seemed different from when they went out!
He suddenly realized something.
"Did the three of you change your Immortal Artifacts?"
This call made the Elders who were planning to leave all stop and look over.
This observation is accurate; the three previous swords were Tier Five Immortal Swords they've used for over a million years and are well recognized by all.
Now these three swords are clearly not the same.
"What happened?"
Faced with the questioning gazes of Yuan Shu, Yuan Mu, and others, Yuan Zhe and the others regretted not disclosing the full story.
Earlier, they narrated a whole series of events from the trip, except they omitted the part where Brother Cheng distributed rewards.
Intending to quietly amass their own wealth!
Imagine if all the Elders mimicked them, wouldn't it mean more competitors?
Then next time the Ancestor rewards, they might not get a turn.
But faced with the pressure of all the present Elders, the three knew they couldn't hide and could only honestly confess.
"Ahem, these are indeed Tier Six Immortal Swords."
"What?"
The others couldn't stay calm, their eyes widened.
Currently, in the Feixian Sect, those owning Tier Six Immortal Swords are only the Sect Leader and Yuan Sheng, Yuan Shu, Yuan Mu the four.
Other Elders are using Tier Five Immortal Artifacts.
Tier Six is something they all dream of, and now these three are equipped with them; it's unbearable.
"Where did you get them?"
"Quickly tell the truth!"
"Could it be, the Ancestor..."
Yuan Zhe nodded, thick-skinned, "Rewarded by the Ancestor; he saw our hard work and gave each of us a sword."
The atmosphere froze, then exploded with chatter!
"Just like that?"
"Is this for real?"
"You three just accompanied him out, not even having drawn a sword; hard work my foot!"
"Why should I agree; this is unfair!"
"This is outrageous; why is there still reward without contribution?"
"Confess honestly, why did the Ancestor reward you?"
As the three were cornered, Leng Huahan arrived at the sect's Trial Pavilion.
Having finally obtained a Tier Seven Immortal Sword, he couldn't tear himself away from it!
On the Flying Ship, he yearned countless times to fly out and test the power of the sword but had no opportunity then.
Now back at the sect, the first thing he did was test its firepower.
Almost every sect has a Trial Pavilion, the Feixian Sect is no exception.
Now he found himself within a Testing Immortal Array.
Facing the nearly transparent, illusory sphere ahead, he unleashed all his Immortal Power, using his lifelong strongest sword technique to strike!
This Testing Immortal Array was set up by Ji Linghan and Mo Chen in the past and cannot be broken by anyone below an Immortal King.
Leng Huahan's sword strike made the entire array tremble slightly.
Next, the transparent sphere rapidly changed color.
Red, orange, yellow, green, cyan, blue, violet...
Finally turning light purple!
Before this, Leng Huahan's full force strike could only achieve a pure blue, roughly representing the power of a Fifth-Grade Golden Immortal.
But now this pale purple represented at least the attack power above a Second Grade Immortal Venerable!
Gazing at the enchanting purple, this True Disciple known for his solemn and cold demeanor couldn't hold back.
With no one around, he grinned foolishly, ultimate joy washing over him!
"The enhancement of the Tier Seven Immortal Sword is indeed enormous!"
"I haven't even fully refined this sword, yet its damage power already surpassed the level of Immortal Venerable..."
"Once I completely refine it, I'll be able to contend with a Fifth Grade Immortal Venerable!"
"This advance is simply worlds apart!"
He clenched his fist, simultaneously excited and deeply grateful!
This reward was all bestowed by the Ancestor!
He was very aware, though having gone with the Ancestor this time, he truly contributed nothing, even hindering the Ancestor and causing displeasure.
Under such circumstances, the Ancestor disregarded previous grievances and still gave him such grand rewards!
This magnanimity made him feel touched and secretly ashamed.
Raising the sword with both hands, he gazed towards the top of the array: "From now on, I am your most loyal sword!"
Putting away the sword, he strode out of the Testing Array, only to find the place ahead already crowded with other disciples.
Leading the group was none other than Gu Qingyu!

chapters.title: Chapter 298 298: Gu Qingyu Doubts Life
chapters.content:
"Wow! It's really Senior Brother Leng!"
"Is Senior Brother Leng really that powerful?"
"Did Senior Brother Leng gain a tremendous opportunity outside, causing his strength to skyrocket?"
As the crowd of disciples exclaimed, Gu Qingyu also widened her bright eyes, looking utterly incredulous.
"Leng Huahan, it's really you!"
She hadn't been in a good mood recently.
