After being 'bullied' by Jiang Cheng, not only did she not vent her anger, but even her master and the Great Elder sided with the 'enemy.'
Then they wanted her to accompany this unknown 'ancestor' to buy an Immortal Fate Order?
Dream on, right?
Back then she had thrown things around, cursing Brother Cheng thoroughly.
It's just that Su Ye and Su Meng didn't pass her exact words on that time.
These days, she's been sulking on her own, not even talking to her master.
However, fortunately, most people in the sect privately sided with her, feeling indignant on her behalf, which slightly comforted her.
Yet in recent days, the tide had turned once again.
As shocking news from outside trickled in, the disciples gradually stopped supporting her complaints, instead becoming impressed and proud of the ancestor's feats outside.
Everywhere she went, she could hear people speaking in admiring tones about that person, making her so angry she felt a liver ache.
She didn't believe in those rumors at all; they must have been exaggerated countless times!
So she decided to stay in the Trial Pavilion, out of sight and out of mind.
Today her master wanted her to welcome the ancestor, but she refused to show up, expressing her disdainful attitude.
Who would've thought Leng Huahan would astonish her once more here.
"Was that attack just now really yours?"
The Great Array test result and the identity jade talisman were displayed outside.
Right now, the elders were all in a meeting, and without Immortal Venerables present, a strike causing a purple mark naturally drew a lot of attention.
Seeing the identity jade talisman display 'Leng Huahan,' it became even more sensational.
And as his biggest rival, Gu Qingyu was the most concerned.
"How could you possibly achieve that?"
"Could it be cheating?"
She couldn't believe this was real.
They had always secretly competed with each other, and she was extremely attentive to Leng Huahan's strength.
She naturally knew his capabilities well.
Leng Huahan's previous full-strength strike could only reach regular blue, the same tier as hers.
But now he directly surpassed dark blue, broke through the Immortal Venerable limit, and hit purple, leaving her eight streets behind?
Looking at his doubtful eyes, Leng Huahan shook his head and suddenly felt a bit sympathetic.
Sigh, you really have no idea what you've missed.
A Tier Seven Immortal Sword, can you even imagine it?
"If you don't believe it, then just consider it fake."
Like Yuan Zhe and Yuan He, he wanted to keep a low profile and quietly accumulate wealth, unwilling to reveal his treasures.
This response made Gu Qingyu feel as if she had punched cotton, completely unable to accept it.
"Stay right there!"
"What do you mean by 'consider it fake'?"
"Explain yourself clearly!"
"Explain what? Must I report to you if my power improves?"
"Power improves?"
Gu Qingyu scanned him up and down: "Do you think I'm blind? Your aura is clearly still at Golden Immortal level, no different from before!"
Her gaze unconsciously fell on Leng Huahan's sword.
"Did you change your weapon?"
"Could this sword be a Tier Six Immortal Artifact?"
If it was because of the weapon, she could feel a bit better.
While weapons are an important part of strength, they are ultimately external and don't mean Leng Huahan surpassed her.
But she was immediately puzzled again.
"Does a Tier Six Immortal Artifact enhance that much?"
Having never used a Tier Six Immortal Artifact, she truly didn't know.
"Where did you get this sword?"
She wasn't dumb; having heard that Leng Huahan went out with Jiang Cheng, she naturally connected the dots.
"Did that thief give it to you?"
Leng Huahan had been too lazy to refute those earlier speculations, even happy to see her guessing towards the Tier Six Immortal Artifact.
But he could not tolerate the last word—'thief.'
"Gu Qingyu, mind your status and words!"
He bowed towards Brother Cheng's place before speaking coldly: "Elder Jiang is our predecessor and ancestral master. I hope you show more respect towards him!"
His words left the disciples extremely surprised.
Despite their awe of Elder Jiang's feats, no one would be so tactless as to speak so bluntly before her.
Especially in such a heavy manner.
"Leng Huahan! What did you just say?"
Gu Qingyu couldn't believe her ears.
"Did you actually side with that thief?"
"I'm merely reminding you of the etiquette and respect owed to a sect elder!"
Leng Huahan wouldn't consider her feelings like other disciples might.
He kept his hand on his sword hilt, eyes full of menace: "Elder Jiang, whether in power or magnanimity, is unrivaled and worthy of my lifelong admiration!"
"If you denigrate him with such titles again, even if he doesn't care, I won't let you go!"
It wasn't just about standing with Brother Cheng anymore.
In the past, Gu Qingyu would've jumped up to fight him immediately.
But now, seeing that sword, she truly dared not.
After all, Leng Huahan was always someone who meant what he said.
So she could only resort to verbal attacks.
"Haven't seen you for a few days, but you've lost your backbone."
She shook her head with pity and disdain: "I used to think you were someone who wouldn't yield to anyone, only to break and not bend. Now, what a disappointment you've become."
"Did a Tier Six Immortal Sword buy you so easily? Turn you into someone else's follower and lackey?"
She thought these words would anger Leng Huahan.
To her surprise, he nodded his head at her words: "You're right; it's an honor to be Elder Jiang's follower."
"You..."
Not just Gu Qingyu, even other disciples were dumbfounded.
Could this still be the same Senior Brother Leng?
Or has someone else taken his place?
"To think I once regarded you as a worthy rival, and you have no ambition left!"
Leng Huahan said lightly: "Elder Jiang is like a brilliant sun, and it's my dim star's duty to orbit around him."
"You can't understand; that's because your vision is too limited."
This obsequious praise coming from him left Gu Qingyu completely stunned.
Meanwhile, Yuan Zhe, Yuan He, and Yuan Wu, nearly drowned in saliva due to possessing three Tier Six Immortal Swords, were under intense questioning.
"You must be hiding something from us!"
"Hurry and confess, why would the ancestor reward you?"
"Did you secretly steal from the ancestor?"
Yuan Zhe gritted his teeth, and in a moment of gutsiness said: "Can't the ancestor be in a good mood?"
"If you're dissatisfied, go ask him directly!"
"Why complain to us? Even Leng Huahan got a Tier Seven Immortal Sword!"
This old man began to divert attention.
That sentence was like a thunderbolt!
Tier Seven Immortal Sword?
Leng Huahan, a junior?
The Great Elder Yuan Sheng almost spat blood on the spot.
He had sent Leng Huahan to follow Brother Cheng in hopes of getting some benefits, but who expected such unimaginable rewards as a Tier Seven Immortal Artifact!

chapters.title: Chapter 299 299: Times Have Changed
chapters.content:
How could the master still use a Tier Six, while the disciple has moved up to a Tier Seven? Where's the justice in that?
If I'd known this would happen, I would have left sect affairs behind and gone personally!
As a disciple, Leng Huahan wasn't qualified to attend the Elder Council.
So the Elders sensed something and charged towards the Trial Pavilion in a grand manner.
Seeing so many Elders suddenly rush over, the disciples thought something big was happening.
Soon after, Yuan Sheng grasped Leng Huahan's shoulder and urgently asked, "Did you get a Tier Seven Immortal Artifact?"
Other Elders came surrounding him one after another.
"Quickly explain, how did it come about!"
"Why did the Elder reward you?"
"Is it this sword of yours?"
"What great achievement did you make to deserve a Tier Seven Immortal Sword?"
Seeing Leng Huahan trapped among the crowd, Gu Qingyu was completely stunned.
What did I just hear?
Tier Seven Immortal Sword?
The sword in his hand is actually a Tier Seven Immortal Sword, not Tier Six?
A Tier Seven Immortal Sword is a Divine Weapon that only an Immortal King can possess, how could it appear here?
That scoundrel actually gifted a Tier Seven Immortal Sword to him?
Impossible!
Absolutely impossible, something must be wrong somewhere!
This is simply a joke!
Yet soon after, she saw her master Yuan Zhen Immortal Venerable also appearing among the crowd, completely lacking the image of a Sect Leader.
"Leng Huahan, would you be willing to exchange this Immortal Sword?"
"You can choose any treasure from my collection freely!"
"Also, why did the Elder reward you with such a precious treasure?"
Leng Huahan certainly wouldn't trade, but he couldn't say he got it by flattering.
"Maybe the Elder was in a good mood?"
"Besides, I only got a sword..."
Yuan Sheng angrily said, "Is that human language you're speaking?"
"Master, calm down. If you knew the rewards Su Ye and Su Meng got, you'd understand the situation."
He also chose to change the topic.
Those two girls didn't receive Tier Seven Immortal Artifacts, but they got a lot of things!
"Who are Su Ye and Su Meng?"
Among so many disciples, most Elders had no impression of the names of two Outer Disciples.
It was Sect Leader Yuan Zhen who figured it out.
"Are you talking about those two Sword Attendant Disciples?"
He said with incredible disbelief, "Even they got rewards?"
So everyone who went along got prizes this time?
Yuan He, who had caught his breath beside him, said sourly, "What do you mean even they got prizes? They got more treasured rewards than us this time!"
"The Sect Leader gave two Tier Six Immortal Swords, Jiyun Immortal King gave two pieces of Tier Six Immortal Armor, Xiao Kun Demon King gave two Top-Grade Magical Treasures, Hua Yin Immortal King gave two bottles of Seventh-grade Immortal Pills..."
Hearing these items, almost all Elders in the audience nearly went mad.
Each piece was enough to make them envious!
Neither Sect Leader Yuan Zhen nor high-level figures like Yuan Sheng and Yuan Shu could stay calm.
"What merits do they have?"
"They're just two Outer Disciples, isn't this reward too much?"
"And why would those well-respected figures also reward them?"
Several Outer Sect Elders couldn't help but grow greedy.
Leng Huahan was a True Disciple, out of their reach.
But Su Ye and Su Meng were just Outer Disciples, originally under their jurisdiction.
Treating them like this and coaxing them, it should... be easy?
"These rewards are too heavy, they can't bear them, right?"
"Right, they can't hold onto it."
"Why not let us keep it for them..."
Seeing their expressions, Yuan He knew what they were thinking.
He whispered, "Let me remind you, they're not the same as before."
"The Elder personally explained that if anyone dares to touch them, he would personally intervene!"
After hearing this, several Elders immediately backed off.
Yuan Zhe looked at them and chuckled coldly.
"Let me add one more thing, Shari Demon King sent two Celestial Nether Orders to them. From now on, Ghost Alliance will protect them!"
"You'd better weigh the consequences."
The whole audience was filled with the sound of drawing cold breaths, yet no one dared to say anything more.
The disciples nearly suffocated.
The Celestial Nether Order is a token of the Ghost Alliance, able to command the demons of the Ghost Alliance!
How could such treasures also be awarded?
With this item, the power these two maids wield... has far surpassed the Sect Leader Yuan Zhen Immortal Venerable!
After all, Yuan Zhen could at most command the disciples of the Feixian Sect, which pales greatly compared to the Ghost Alliance.
Just going out for a stroll, two Outer Disciples inexplicably became the highest-ranked people in Feixian Sect?
This is too magical!
Originally, Yuan Sheng and Yuan Shu intended to call those two maids to ask about the situation.
But now suddenly it seemed inappropriate.
After thinking carefully, maybe it's better to visit them in person?
After the Elders left, the disciples present completely erupted!
"I know Su Ye and Su Meng, we've even cultivated together!"
"What the heck, how is this possible? Did I hear it wrong just now?"
"Just them? Their power isn't even better than mine!"
"You shouldn't say that, perhaps from today on, we aren't qualified to approach them anymore."
"Yes, they're not the same as before!"
"So many rewards, plus the Celestial Nether Order... they've truly soared to the top like phoenixes!"
"Is it just from following Elder Jiang out this time, that their fate was completely changed?"
"If I'd known this, I would've done anything to go too, crying and begging!"
"I can't take it, I'm losing my mind!"
Standing outside the crowd, Gu Qingyu seemed soulless, as if she heard no sound from the bustling crowd.
Her whole person was in disarray.
She knew Su Ye and Su Meng well, they used to serve her often.
She was crystal clear about their situation.
Except for those two pretty faces, everything else in terms of talent, disposition, and intelligence seemed utterly unremarkable.
She had heard they replaced her to accompany Elder Jiang, and she even sympathized with them.
Spending so many days with that scoundrel, really a miserable fate.
But now, she suddenly realized the one needing sympathy was herself.
Those rewards, whether Immortal Swords and Armors or Magical Treasures and Pills, were beyond her resistance.
And the Celestial Nether Order was even beyond her wildest dreams.
If she had gone along that time...
When she finally entertained this thought, she almost collapsed entirely.
"Alas!"
Yuan Zhen patted his disciple's back, not wanting to reprimand her further.
"You pushed away the opportunity before you, that might be destiny, the fate that those chances weren't meant for you."
After saying this, he disappeared from the spot.
No joke, he still needed to rush to see the Elder!
As the Sect Leader, his status was waning, he couldn't wait!
When he arrived, he found that Yuan Sheng, Yuan Shu, and other Elders had reached there before him.
The Elder wasn't in seclusion either, yet his cultivation had wondrously reached Ninth-grade Golden Immortal.
Yuan Zhen didn't find it strange.
He always believed the Elder couldn't be just a Golden Immortal; now it seems like he's merely releasing a bit more of his cultivation aura?
There was no way for him to know that Brother Cheng had casually gained thirteen thousand merits after returning.

chapters.title: Chapter 300 300: Corpse Race Invasion
chapters.content:
"What are you all doing here?"
"Could it be that there is an outside invasion?"
Brother Cheng got a bit excited, it's been a while since he had captured a large amount of spoils.
He is currently very short on merit, yet hasn't even reached the level of Immortal Venerable.
"No, no. We've come here just to ask the Ancestor whether the Immortal Artifacts that Yuan Zhe, Yuan He, Yuan Wu, and Leng Huahan received this time were bestowed by you?"
As Yuan Sheng said this, he couldn't help but glance at the Quiet Chamber behind Brother Cheng.
Those two maids are still cultivating inside!
It's simply a spectacle, two Outer Disciples being privileged to serve as door guardians for the Ancestor is already quite an honor.
These two actually manage to seclude themselves here?
The rumors are true, these two have indeed ascended to greatness.
The intimacy with the Ancestor has already surpassed everyone within the Sect.
Brother Cheng nodded: "I was the one who bestowed them."
"What, do you have any objections?"
All the Elders quickly apologized: "We dare not."
"We came to bother you merely to consult, Grandmaster... Why were they awarded?"
"You're asking why they were awarded?"
Brother Cheng couldn't straightforwardly say it was because of flattery, as that would lower the Grandmaster's dignity.
Some things, when said outright, just don't have the same flavor—one has to let them grasp it themselves.
So he casually replied, "Because they performed well."
"Performed well?"
Yuan Zhen, Yuan Sheng, Yuan Shu and the others exchanged glances, looking puzzled.
According to the news received, the business of the Immortal Fate Order was settled by the Ancestor alone.
And any enemies encountered along the way were either annihilated personally by the Ancestor or dealt with by those four experts.
Did Yuan He or Leng Huahan play any role?
Was there any performance at all?
"Ahem, Ancestor, could you enlighten us?"
Seeing their eyes filled with eager curiosity, Brother Cheng slightly lowered his gaze and said indifferently: "Some things can only be expressed, not comprehended."
"You need to use your own eyes to observe."
"Use your own heart to feel."
"There are many aspects of them worth learning from."
He waved his robe, making it look like he was giving a profound Dao transmission to the disciples.
"Alright, disperse now!"
All the Elders got up to leave, still seeming quite confused.
Did Leng Huahan and Yuan Zhe have something special worth learning from?
Second Elder Yuan Shu, as the former superior of the three, decided to call them over for a good inquiry.
And Great Elder Yuan Sheng also decided to have a long talk with his disciples.
Only after they left did Brother Cheng sigh.
He knew why these Elders had come—just trying to request some rewards.
This is to be expected, there are always people who are less capable than oneself.
However, as he said before, he's not a Sudhana.
These disciples are not the same as the ones he had back then; it's impossible to distribute rewards to everyone.
Especially as he's recently short on spoils to exchange for merit.
The reason for rewarding those few was merely to set them up as examples.
The ones still deserving of reward would be Sect Leader Yuan Zhen and Great Elder Yuan Sheng.
The identity of close confidants like Su Ye and Su Meng was just a joke; Brother Cheng himself didn't take it seriously.
He knew very well that these two only qualified as mascots for entertainment.
In terms of true confidants, Yuan Zhen and Yuan Sheng were the genuine ones.
They were the first to recognize him, incredibly loyal, and had flattered quite a bit; truly 'meritorious and honored'.
Moreover, these two were the top leaders of the Sect, losing the dignity of the Sect Leader role wouldn't do.
He contemplated whether to go fetch a couple of Immortal Artifacts to bolster their prestige.
In the following three days, Feixian Sect buzzed with activity, selling off Sect treasures to consolidate Immortal Crystals.
On this day, Great Elder Yuan Sheng and Second Elder Yuan Shu arrived in a panic.
"Greetings, Ancestor! There's someone outside wishing to see you!"
"To see me?"
Seeing their expressions filled with panic and fear, Brother Cheng raised an eyebrow: "Who is it?"
"It's Zhan Yan, Wan Mo, Yin Sha—three Corpse Kings from the Soulless Celestial Realm—along with over a hundred high-ranking members of the Corpse Race!"
One can't blame them for being so terrified.
The notorious reputation of the Corpse Kings is such that the mere mention of them invokes fear throughout the Middle Immortal Realm.
It's said that a hundred million years ago, when they first appeared in the Tuo Luo Celestial Realm, they were merely Profound Immortals.
The Tuo Luo Celestial Realm at that time had no presence of the Corpse Race.
Back then, the three Corpse Immortals were merely hiding in the deep mountains, refining Corpse Puppets from corpses, isolated, with little interaction with the outside world.
Unintentionally discovered by the local middle-class Sect, Fenghuang Sect, they were deemed as evil heretics.
The three were besieged by numerous Golden Immortals and quickly all 'perished'.
For the Fenghuang Sect, the annihilation of mere wicked Profound Immortals was a trivial matter soon forgotten.
Unexpectedly, merely a hundred years later, the three returned as Corpse Immortals at the Golden Immortal level, and behind them marched an army of Corpse Puppets numbering over a thousand!
These Corpse Puppets lacked Immortal Souls; their internal organs long deteriorated, making them difficult to kill by ordinary means.
Especially the three Corpse Immortals—so long as a remnant ember remained—they would inevitably resurrect.
Unless special methods are used for ritual refinement, they can't be completely destroyed.
In the drawn-out battle spanning ten thousand years, increasing numbers of Fenghuang Sect disciples were turned into Corpse Puppets after being slain.
Until the Fenghuang Sect was exterminated, with the entire Sect transformed into Corpse Puppets, the three had evolved to Immortal Venerable level.
It was then that they finally drew caution from several top-tier Immortal Sects of the Tuo Luo Celestial Realm.
Subsequently, both Immortal Kings and Immortal Venerables emerged, the Corpse Puppet army was ritualistically refined and incinerated, the three major Corpse Immortals were heavily injured and fled, vanishing for tens of millions of years.
When they reappeared tens of millions of years later, they had reached the Ninth-grade Immortal Venerable level.
This time, the three changed their combat style, refrained from large assaults, and began subtly infiltrating disciples from various Immortal Sects.
The Corpse Puppets they refined became increasingly advanced, some capable of acting independently and smartly.
Over the long years, more and more Sect Elders were killed and turned into Corpse Puppets, altering the balance of power between the two sides.
When Zhan Yan evolved to match an Immortal King as a Corpse King, the Tuo Luo Celestial Realm's Immortal Sects could no longer withstand it.
Some were destroyed, some forced to relocate to other Celestial Domains.
The expansion of the Corpse Race also induced panic and resistance among neighboring Celestial Domains.
Several intense battles ensued with mutual losses, and eventually, concessions were made leading to an agreement.
Ever since, the Corpse Race operated only within the Tuo Luo Celestial Realm, forbidden from invading other Celestial Domains.
In return, the Tuo Luo Celestial Realm became their unofficial territory, a mass exodus of Immortals occurred, leaving it a haven for the Corpse Race, even its name was changed to Soulless Celestial Realm!
Faced with this indestructible and eerie race, few wouldn't tremble in fear, their hearts filled with dread.
Compared to them, the Ghost Alliance seemed practically elegant.
Fortunately, in recent years, they've truly remained contained within the Soulless Celestial Realm, showing no signs of expanding outward.
Yet the grisly reputation they earned in the past remains etched in everyone's memory.
Now, with the Corpse Race emerging once again, and personally led by three Corpse Kings, Feixian Sect couldn't remain calm.
Many disciples paled, shaking like leaves.
Fearing that a single glance from a Corpse King could turn them into Corpse Puppets.
"Zhan Yan, Wan Mo, Yin Sha?"
Brother Cheng searched through his memory, then recalled.
"So it's them!"

chapters.title: Chapter 301 301: Let Them Come In Themselves
chapters.content:
The Three Great Corpse Kings originated from the Mad Corpse Domain, one of the Lower Realm Ten Thousand Realms.
Back then, they ascended together with Brother Cheng.
At that time, among the elites of the Ten Thousand Realms, they were not particularly outstanding.
The advantage of the Corpse Race is that it's very difficult to kill them completely, and they can easily rise from the ashes.
Moreover, when they revive, there's a great chance they'll come with a massive army of corpse puppets.
But unfortunately, during that era, they didn't have the opportunity to make a name for themselves.
Every crisis they encountered was sudden and far exceeded everyone's capabilities, leaving no prolonged time for them to rise from the ashes, and not enough corpses for refining corpse puppets.
Immediate combat power was always needed, and the Corpse Race's frontal combat power wasn't particularly strong, relying mostly on their formidable bodies.
In the Lower Realm Ten Thousand Realms, there were many with stronger bodies than theirs, such as the Bone Race, Demon Race, and Celestial Artifact Race...
And those like the Desolate Race, Demon Cultivators, and Sword Cultivators were even more formidable, each having endless means.
So, back then, these three Corpse Saints were quite marginalized.
During meetings, they didn't have seats and could only wait outside.
And in the long history of their Mad Corpse Domain, no one had successfully ascended to become an immortal.
Brother Cheng noticed them because they faintly emitted a corpse stench.
Every time they stood there, an automatic space of over ten meters cleared around them, leaving them quite hurt.
Coupled with their peculiar dress at the time, wrapped in white cloth like mummies, they were quite conspicuous.
Otherwise, he wouldn't have had any impression of them.
Unexpectedly, they clung to the Middle Immortal Realm and didn't ascend.
"Elder, do you... know them?"
Seeing his suddenly enlightened expression, Yuan Sheng and Yuan Shu quickly and anxiously inquired.
"Could it be that they are old friends of yours?"
Facing their hopeful gazes, Brother Cheng nodded.
"Sort of!"
Yuan Sheng and Yuan Shu were overjoyed: "That's great!"
"We were scared to death just now!"
The two exhaled in relief.
Since they were also old friends, they shouldn't be enemies here to destroy the Feixian Sect.
After all, when facing the Corpse Kings, they couldn't even muster the thought of resistance.
The ancestor indeed had 'broad social connections', even with the terrifying Corpse Race?
What had he done in the past?
"What did they come for?"
"They didn't say. Elder, why don't you go out and meet them?"
Go out and meet them?
Brother Cheng silently complained, should he personally go to the mountain gate to welcome these three marginal figures?
They weren't that prestigious, right?
If this spread, wouldn't Gui Cang, Void Abyss, and others look down on him in the future?
He waved his hand: "Tell them to come in and see me themselves."
"And leave those shabby coffins outside, and don't bring too many corpse puppets, I dislike the strong stench!"
Huh?
Yuan Sheng and Yuan Shu were speechless and couldn't help but complain.
These were the Three Great Corpse Kings, who shook the Middle Immortal Realm, compelling dozens of surrounding Celestial Domains to concede!
Elder, could you treat them with a bit more caution?
Outside the mountain gate now, Yuan Zhen, Yuan Mu, and other elders led a group of disciples waiting outside the gate.
The autumn wind blew, causing a chill to run through them, as if winter had come early.
The Three Great Corpse Kings on the opposite side looked mostly like normal people, with noses and eyes, but a slight perception revealed the heavy death qi.
Even a glance from them seemed to threaten to drag one into a world of eternal darkness.
Along with the thousand silent corpse puppets behind them, the feeling was even more chilling.
As the three arrived, they spoke only two sentences.
"Is Sect Leader Jiang here?"
"Tell him Zhan Yan, Wan Mo, and Yin Sha request a meeting."
Afterwards, there was no further movement.
No breathing, no divine soul waves, not even a glint in their eyes, truly appearing as lifeless.
Yuan Zhen Immortal Venerable really wanted to say something to ease the ice-cold atmosphere.
But in the face of these Three Great Corpse Kings, he truly didn't know how to phrase anything.
He feared that speaking rashly might violate some taboo and provoke a catastrophic attack.
Even he, as the sect leader, had such thoughts, let alone the other elders and distant disciples.
Everyone was tense, sweating and holding their breath.
Just hoping Elder Jiang would appear soon and deal with these three fearsome presences.
They didn't wait long before Yuan Sheng and Yuan Shu flew over.
Yuan Zhen genuinely wanted to ask what the elder said and how he responded.
But now, he didn't even dare to transmit his voice aloud.
Seeing the two return without Jiang Cheng, both he and the other elders felt alarm bells ringing in their hearts, silently dreading.
Seeing the two return, the Three Great Corpse Kings finally moved.
Zhan Yan, at the forefront, slowly spoke, his voice like countless grains of sand constantly rubbing: "Where is Sect Leader Jiang?"
"He…"
Yuan Sheng was drenched in sweat, momentarily unsure how to respond.
The elder was quite firm in his attitude, unwilling to appear, unable to be forced.
"How is he?"
Wan Mo and Yin Sha simultaneously pursued the question.
Yuan Shu could only boldly say, "He, he said to meet him yourselves, and also…"
"And what?"
"And he said not to bring those coffin dharma artifacts, and not too many corpse puppets inside…"
Even with his courage, Yuan Shu dared not repeat Brother Cheng's final comment about disliking the stench.
As his words fell, the people of the Feixian Sect immediately despaired.
The ancestor was practically insane!
No matter how senior you are, that only counts within the Feixian Sect.
Now facing these Three Great Corpse Kings, what's the harm in coming out to greet them?
Currently, they seem restrained; if greeted warmly and kindly, perhaps nothing bad would occur.
But you come up with this. It's intentionally ruining their face...
It's over, completely over.
Yuan Zhen tried to muster some courage and spoke with difficulty: "Please do not be offended, our sect's elder does not like going out…"
His explanation hadn't been completed before Zhan Yan interrupted.
"Lead the way!"
"Ah, ah?"
Yuan Zhen hadn't reacted yet, when Yuan Zhe and Yuan He hurriedly bent over in invitation.
"Please, please!"
Soon after, the Three Great Corpse Kings were led into the Feixian Sect.
The three truly didn't bring their coffins, while thousands of corpse puppets, only five leading ones followed in, the rest waited outside.
The crowd surrounded them, feeling uneasy inside, unable to discern the three's intentions.
Were they enraged or not? It was hard to see!
They quickly arrived at Sect Leader Jiang's residence.
Instead of Jiang Cheng standing at the entrance, Su Ye and Su Meng, the two maids, were there.
After only a few days... these two were still True Immortals.
No choice, their talent was too poor, and refining the medicinal power of an Immortal Pill takes many years.
"Elder said, let you enter to meet him!"
Yuan Zhen, Yuan Sheng and others were on the verge of collapse.
Your status is too grand, unwilling to even step out of the main hall, let alone greeting guests at the door?
This is intentionally provoking and humiliating the Three Great Corpse Kings, isn't it?
"Good!"
Zhan Yan still spoke sparingly, without any signs of violence.

chapters.title: Chapter 302 302 Not Following the Dao at All
chapters.content:
Following the Three Great Corpse Kings into the hall, everyone finally saw Elder Jiang.
There he was, sitting far away, surrounded by flowers.
Sect Leader Yuan Zhen was first stunned, then completely speechless.
It seemed he was using the floral scent to cover up the corpse stench!
Could he have done it any more obviously?
This was simply an insult to the others!
Besides, the three of them actually didn't smell bad at all, possibly because they had reached the Immortal King Level, radiating a faint fragrance instead.
Under the tense atmosphere, the Three Great Corpse Kings suddenly changed their previously lifeless demeanor.
They rushed forward several steps, then bowed deeply.
"Sect Leader Jiang!"
"It truly is you!"
"We've come to see you!"
The hall was in an uproar.
What the hell, not only were the three of them not angered, but they were also paying respects to the founder?
Previously, when hearing that the four masters, Jiyun and Xiao Kun Shali, knelt before the ancestor, they were shocked, but never truly felt it without seeing it firsthand.
And now seeing the legendary Three Great Corpse Kings behaving in such a way, their perceptions were shattered.
Could these three also have been his subordinates?
Not old acquaintances or enemies seeking revenge, but his subordinates?
This was truly unbelievable!
Brother Cheng sniffed carefully; indeed, there was no stench.
With due respect already shown, he smiled and flew over to help the three up.
"Haha, long time no see."
"How did you come looking for me?"
Zhan Yan quickly responded, "We heard news of you, knew that Jiyun and Xiao Kun Shali had already paid their respects, so we guessed it must be you, returning to the world."
Yin Sha also chimed in swiftly, "Your healing took so long that we almost thought you wouldn't return…"
"Over the years, we have secretly explored many Immortal Tombs, hoping to resurrect you and have you lead us once more!"
No matter their internal emotional turmoil, their outward expressions were indifferent.
But just from these few words, Sect Leader Yuan Zhen and Yuan Sheng had grasped many things.
These were not just subordinates, but loyal death warriors!
To be able to see the ancestor, they'd been making efforts behind the scenes all this time.
Such dedication even touched them.
Brother Cheng thought to himself, you're underestimating me.
And resurrecting me as a corpse puppet, forget it.
"How have the years gone, where have the others gone?"
"We haven't been in touch with others, but few remain in the Middle Immortal Realm."
Zhan Yan said, "Now with your comeback, we have a leader again, and we can safely expand around, even march to the Upper Immortal Realm!"
Though the tone was calm, the words caused cold sweats among the hall elders.
No way, the Corpse Race plans to expand?
That would mean carnage!
And they intended to have the ancestor as their leader?
"Stop, stop!"
Brother Cheng hurriedly waved his hand, "You're mistaken; when did I say I'd lead you?"
"Such nonsense, you'd better be peaceful!"
He preferred lively people, not to be surrounded by the Corpse Race.
Sect Leader Yuan Zhen and Yuan Sheng sighed in relief.
Luckily, the ancestor was a normal person, not a psychopath.
The Three Great Corpse Kings still wanted to persist: "If the Corpse Race grows, we'll have a chance to challenge those enemies in the future."
"They tried many times to destroy us; don't you want revenge?"
"We've been gathering power over the years, waiting for you to lead us to conquer the Immortal Realm…"
"Enough, enough!"
Brother Cheng interrupted them again.
Others might not understand, but he knew the three referred to the Immortal Emperors and Demon Emperors of the Upper Immortal Realm.
Back then, with the Fake Immortal Realm, Nine Treasures Extinction Array, True Immortal provocations, and Nine Flames Immortal Emperor stepping in.
It was indeed a sea of blood feud!
However…
Brother Cheng didn't care much since he'd been killed more than once, and each time he could easily overcome it, he was used to it.
Immortal Emperors and Demon Emperors were not worth obsessing over daily.
He'd deal with it if he got up there.
"Such matters don't call for you, I'll personally handle it someday."
The Three Great Corpse Kings exchanged looks and nodded.
"We'll follow your lead."
"Can we follow you, continue fighting by your side?"
Though they appeared wooden, they were shrewd.
Following Sect Leader Jiang, getting carried along; they understood that logic.
The elders of Feixian Sect were excited!
They wanted to follow the ancestor?
Many elders envisioned the future, feeling excited at heart.
The joining of the three Corpse Kings, along with their vast army of corpse puppets and guards!
This was not a mere alliance but a willingness to follow as subordinates, without conditions...
Who would dare provoke Feixian Sect in the future?
But then, they heard Brother Cheng say: "That depends on your performance."
What?
The Three Corpse Kings' willingness to follow, something dreams couldn't even wish for, was politely rejected?
Elders couldn't sit still.
"Ancestor, this…"
"Is that too…?"
They wanted to say, isn't this stance a bit too high?
Even disdaining Immortal Kings?
What if the three Corpse Kings get angry after rejection…
"We'll behave well." The Three Corpse Kings said in unison.
Wow, how obedient!
The elders were thoroughly impressed.
To the ancestor, the terrifying Corpse Kings behaved like entry-level disciples.
They didn't know what happened back then, just thought it was unbelievable, couldn't fathom why these three acted this way.
Even facing an Immortal Emperor, they wouldn't react like this, right?
Brother Cheng was dissatisfied.
This was seriously off-track.
He could only hint directly: "I heard you destroyed many sects over the years; gains should be plenty, right?"
Other things aside, because the Corpse Race's cultivation system was quite different, most Immortal Pills were toxic to them.
And their weapons were special Dharma Artifacts; normal Immortal Artifacts weren't needed.
Keeping them would be moldy.
So they could hand them over to Sect Leader Jiang!
Sect Leader Yuan Zhen and Yuan Shu nearly spat blood.
Others feared avoiding them, and yet, you're trying to take advantage of them? Asking them for things?
That's seriously bold!
The Three Great Corpse Kings suddenly realized and nodded.
"We have, we have!"
"See how forgetful we are."
Then, the three directly reached out to the void, and after a swirl of space, piles of gleaming Immortal Artifacts and various bottles appeared in the hall.
Everyone was breathless because among them were not only many Tier Six Immortal Artifacts but even a few Tier Seven ones!
Riches!
Brother Cheng was overjoyed, in a flash he swept all the items into his rings.
"Not bad, not bad, your performance is better than Jiyun and Xiao Kun."
Receiving such praise, the Three Great Corpse Kings felt both joy and pride.
For a moment, the atmosphere in the hall became cheerful.

chapters.title: Chapter 303 303: How much admiration?
chapters.content:
Having accepted gifts, Brother Cheng now found the Three Corpse Kings more pleasing to the eye.
He made an exception and let them stay at the Feixian Sect for a few days.
However, the army of corpse puppets outside needed proper arrangements; he didn't want to scare his disciples.
After sending the three away, Yuan Zhen and Yuan Sheng took over the hosting duties.
Not that hosting was necessary, as the Corpse Race mostly lay inside their dharma artifacts with hardly any normal needs.
The Feixian Sect collectively breathed a sigh of relief and completely admired Elder Jiang.
They still didn't know the strength of this patriarch.
But this kind of standing was absolutely unique in the Middle Immortal Realm!
Once again, the entire sect speculated who this patriarch was in the sect's history.
In the process, Brother Cheng garnered quite a bit of shock value.
Meanwhile, Brother Cheng was busy tallying his gains.
Among them were three Tier Seven Immortal Artifacts and five pieces of Top-Grade Immortal Treasure, which he kept.
Besides, there were about five hundred pieces each of Top-Grade Magical Treasures and Tier Six Immortal Artifacts, all converted into merit points.
The Corpse Race had once wiped out all the top-tier sects in a Celestial Domain, and with some later developments, naturally, they had terrifying accumulations.
Coupled with the shock everyone experienced this time, he ended up with 130,000 merit points, ten times more than his previous efforts!
"I've really hit the jackpot, haha!"
He immediately exchanged the Level 4 Rule Fragments entirely and pushed the remaining Main Rules to Great Success Level.
Then he continued to tally the pills he acquired this time.
There were hundreds of thousands of Sixth-grade Immortal Pills and over five thousand Seventh-grade Immortal Pills!
He once again started his 'ascetic cultivation'.
After using all the pills that could boost his cultivation, not only did he break through to the Immortal Venerable Realm, but he also reached Third Grade Immortal Venerable.
If these pills were given to other immortals, they could produce hundreds of Ninth-grade Immortal Venerables.
No help for it, Brother Cheng's foundation was too deep, requiring a staggering amount.
Upon reaching the Immortal Venerable Realm, the demand increased several folds.
"These three really helped me a lot!"
Thinking of Xiao Kun and Jiyun, who not only didn't bring much benefit but also 'snatched his spoils'.
The difference in people's conduct was really that vast.
"It seems I really should support these three more in the future."
Staring at the remaining 120,000 merit points, he first upgraded the system a bit.
Level: 12
Merit: 0/1,000,000
Available Merit: 112,275
Current Skills: The host can consume merit to borrow skills from any target.
Note: The higher the skill strength borrowed, the more merit consumed.
Subordinate Skills: The host can consume merit to see through the target's true thoughts, without cooldown.
Note: The stronger the target, the higher the merit consumed.
Isn't this just a mind-reading technique?
Brother Cheng felt the system was a bit overpowered.
There were techniques targeting mentalities, like the Heart Division's Heart Control Seal, which could also know some of the target's thoughts.
But that required the opponent to willingly accept the Heart Control Seal, and it would fail with even slight resistance.
Moreover, it required a certain realm.
This system, ignoring realms and directly probing target thoughts, was purely a legendary main god level method.
But I don't really need it.
After all, I'd just cheat in fights, no matter what they think, resurrect and it's an instant win.
He stroked his chin, pondering what benefits this skill might bring him in the future.
Revealing the Immortal Emperor's secrets should cause a bit of shock, right?
On second thought, not bad.
"Elder, Senior Sister Gu requests to meet you!"
Hearing the maids' announcement, Brother Cheng was stunned.
Who's Senior Sister Gu?
It wasn't until he saw Gu Qingyu that he recognized her.
Isn't this the girl he met in the Demon-slaying Tower?
"What brings you to me?"
He'd intended to compensate her with an immortal beast mount, but Gu Qingyu had attacked him then, so naturally, he dropped the matter.
This woman bowed respectfully, murmuring: "Back then, I didn't know the Patriarch's identity and was quite offensive. I've come this time to apologize specifically."
Brother Cheng wasn't inclined to hold grudges against a junior; if Gu Qingyu hadn't arrived, he'd have forgotten.
Moreover, the incident was initially his own fault.
"Ignorance isn't a sin, that matter is long past."
"Really?"
Gu Qingyu's eyes sparkled with innocence.
"What else?"
She immediately cheered up: "Thank you for your magnanimous generosity, Patriarch!"
Brother Cheng couldn't figure out what her real intentions were: "Do you have any other matters?"
"Well..."
Gu Qingyu glanced at Su Ye and Su Meng, and then sweetly said: "I have long admired the Patriarch, and really wish to accompany you like them. I wonder if that's possible..."
Admired for long?
Jiang Cheng thought, could your words be more insincere?
In the Demon-slaying Tower, hadn't he witnessed her acting skills, of bowing and standing at once.
He could see her intentions; it was nothing more than being tempted by the rewards given to Su Ye, Su Meng, and Leng Huahan.
She wanted some benefits for herself.
He purposely smirked, saying: "Really? Admired me for long?"
"Uh-huh!"
"How much admiration?"
"This..."
Looking left and right at Su Ye and Su Meng, Gu Qingyu's face reddened as if unable to bear it.
Damn, why is this guy so smug and requires public praise?
In front of other disciples, she always maintained the image of an aloof and untouchable senior sister, not giving anyone face.
Doing this could ruin her image, couldn't it?
"Utmost admiration! Whether in strength or social circles, Patriarch leaves someone like me in complete awe!"
"That's all?"
Brother Cheng seemed a bit disappointed.
"Aren't those already well-known facts?"
What? I praised you against my will and you're still not satisfied?
"Additionally, Patriarch's broad mind and forgiving nature make me feel ashamed."
"Hmm, anything else?"
Gu Qingyu's teeth were nearly clenched in frustration.
She could only continue the forced flattery.
"And Patriarch's handsome features, ethereal grace, are unmatched in my life."
Brother Cheng almost laughed out loud.
Even though he knew her words were insincere, they were still quite enjoyable to hear, yearning for more.
It's not like he forced her; she volunteered.
"So this whole time, have you been secretly admiring and secretly loving me?"
Looking at Su Ye and Su Meng's enlightened expressions, Gu Qingyu nearly fainted.
How did this suddenly evolve into affection?
However, it didn't seem entirely bad?
Those two were mere maids and received so many rewards. If she carried the title 'Woman of the Patriarch', wouldn't she...
Only pondered for a second, she decided to go along!
"Yes, indeed..."
She shyly nestled into Brother Cheng's embrace like a bashful flower.
She was quite confident in her own allure.
"Ah, this just won't do!"
Sect Leader Jiang pressed her soft fragrant shoulders, taking a deep breath.
He then earnestly said: "The difference in seniority between us is vast; if we were together, it would be an illicit romance."
"So even if you admire me, restrain it!"
"Go home and bury this affection in your heart, let it fuel your ascetic cultivation!"

chapters.title: Chapter 304 304: Azure Dragon Bloodline
chapters.content:
Screw your absurdity!
Get a grip on yourself, damn it!
Gu Qingyu nearly lost it.
She had never met someone with such an inflated ego in her entire life.
Compared to Su Ye and Su Meng, those two maids, she just couldn't figure it out!
Not to mention strength and talent, but just in terms of looks, am I not several times prettier than them?
This feeling of defeat is really too strong.
Watching her retreating figure, Brother Cheng burst into laughter.
Even though the system hadn't developed a mind reading technique yet, he knew full well what this girl truly thought of him.
However, there's something strangely satisfying about someone who clearly dislikes you pretending to like you.
It's even more exhilarating than the usual butt-kissing.
Besides, he could see that this girl was persistent and probably wouldn't give up easily. He suddenly found himself looking forward to the next encounter.
After Gu Qingyu left, looking at the remaining 110,000 Merit points, he clicked on the exchange.
To ascend to Immortal King, all main rules need to reach Perfection Realm.
The price for a Level 5 Rule Fragment, which can boost ten main rules at once, is 3,000 points of Merit in the system.
"Damn, that's too expensive."
"Sigh, cultivation is always so tough, it's really not easy."
If it weren't for riding the coattails of the Three Great Corpse Kings, who knows how many years it would take.
He exchanged for 30, upgrading 300 main rules to Perfection Level for now.
Looking through the dazzling collection of treasures in the system mall, his gaze finally settled on the Azure Dragon Essence Blood.
To this day, the enhancement from that drop of Azure Dragon Essence Blood from years ago has become increasingly feeble for him.
Its bit of suppression is virtually ineffective against True Immortals.
"Might as well exchange some more."
Looking at the mall prices, one drop of Azure Dragon Essence Blood costs only 1 point of Merit.
He promptly exchanged for 10 drops and unhesitatingly chose to fuse them.
Unlike the last time when he died right after, this time besides a brief tingling, there was no anomaly.
That was to be expected—now that he's an Immortal Demon Body, his tolerance is unbelievably strong.
Moreover, having fused once before, his body had adapted.
After successfully fusing 10 drops, a system notification popped up.
The host's Azure Dragon Bloodline reached Level 2, with Azure Dragon Suppression and Stepping on Wind and Cloud also rising to Level 2.
Additionally, two more Talent Secret Techniques of the Azure Dragon Race were unlocked.
One is Azure Dragon Flash Strike, which temporarily boosts attack power by 50%. The bloodline upgrade can make it stronger, but the user will enter a weakened state after one strike.
The other is Hidden Dragon Wings, which can double flight speed and also get faster with a bloodline upgrade.
"Only Level 2 bloodline, how could that be worthy of my reputation?"
With over 20,000 Merit in hand, he didn't hesitate at all buying items that cost 1 Merit point each.
After continuing to fuse up to 100 drops, the system indicated the Azure Dragon Bloodline had reached Tier Three, unlocking three more secret techniques.
Brother Cheng didn't bother to study them and forged ahead, fusing up to 1,000 drops, elevating the Azure Dragon Bloodline to Tier Four.
"Still not at full level?"
"Is this bloodline really so hard to upgrade?"
He was being greedy; genuine members of the Azure Dragon Race with Tier Four bloodlines are extremely rare.
Only a handful of elder dragons who have cultivated for countless billions of years could achieve this.
"I won't accept it!"
He exchanged for 1,000 at a time, and upon reaching 10,000 drops, the system finally chimed again.
"The host's Azure Dragon Bloodline is complete, gaining the Azure Dragon True Body, all talent secret techniques of the Azure Dragon Race reached Tier Five..."
He opened up those talents again and saw all the effects of the talent secret techniques had increased.
For the Azure Dragon Flash Strike, for instance, it now boosts attack power by 200%.
He stroked his chin, thought a bit, then chuckled merrily.
"If I use this with a critical strike, won't its power be downright earth-shattering?"
As for the Azure Dragon True Body, the system description mentioned he could transform into a real Azure Dragon.
This was fundamentally different from his previous Transformation Technique.
Transformation only changes the outer appearance and mimics the aura.
While switching to the Azure Dragon form, all talent secret techniques of the Azure Dragon Race will have doubled effects.
At that time, the Azure Dragon Suppression could reach the level of the Azure Dragon Ancestor, Azure Dragon Flash Strike could achieve 300% attack power, and Hidden Dragon Wings could attain 500% speed.
He decided to give it a try, so in a flash, he vanished from his original spot.
Then he appeared high in the sky, switching to the Azure Dragon form.
At once, an immense dragon body stretched across the sky, covering an unimaginable expanse.
The whole body of the Azure Dragon shone with intense light, making it impossible to look directly!
After releasing all the suppression, it even greatly affected the surroundings.
The clouds were instantly compressed and dissipated, causing a chaotic flow of aura.
If a Lower Realm cultivator were to stand beside him, even at the Saint Tier, they would explode and die, unable to withstand it.
Below, the Sect Protection Array of the Feixian Sect activated automatically, desperately resisting that terrifying pressure.
And the surrounding peaks without array protection began to slowly collapse!
Many elders inside the sect wore faces of horror, and the disciples were so suppressed they couldn't move, prostrating on the ground.
"Who is it?"
"Why is a Dragon Race member here?"
The Three Great Corpse Kings were also alarmed, feeling an intense threat and flying into the sky one by one...
Brother Cheng retracted his divine techniques, went invisible, and returned to his original location.
Damn, that was a bit too flashy, better save it for showing off later.
After the brief excitement, he looked again at the Cyan Dragon Essence Blood, Golden Dragon Essence Blood, and over a thousand kinds of Ancient Divine Demon Bloodline in the mall, and sighed.
"A full-level one of these costs 10,000 Merit, better wait for the future."
The mall also had heroic souls, but the one he wanted most was the War Heroic Soul.
That was the ultimate heroic soul he briefly experienced when he wiped out the Red Sun Sect in the Lower Realm.
This heroic soul had increased his attack power by 50 times and defense by 10 times back then!
Compared to the War Heroic Soul, other heroic souls were simply pathetic.
If he could own it permanently, he could ignore the inherent essence difference of the Immortal King's Immortal Country and directly break through with sheer force!
The deepest part of the system mall had this heroic soul for sale, with the simple description - the one and only invincible heroic soul.
Meaning only one cultivator under heaven could possess this War Heroic Soul.
As for the price - 1 billion Merit.
"System, why don't you just rob someone?"
Compared to before, where he could rely on points for a chance to obtain heroic souls, it's prohibitively expensive.
So now, he could only look at it.
The next day, Yuan Sheng and Yuan Shu came running again.
"Ancestor, the Mingchi Immortal King from the Silver Qilin Celestial Realm and the Liuyuan Immortal King from the Cyan Fire Celestial Realm are here together, saying they wish to see you!"
This time, the two elders were much more composed.
With the previous encounter with the three Corpse Kings, these two must also be old acquaintances of their ancestor.
Moreover, compared to those three notorious Corpse Kings, Immortal Kings Mingchi and Liuyuan are the peak masters of artifact refining and alchemy in the Middle Immortal Realm, respectively.
Although they rose in the last tens of millions of years, they are considered authorities and have a significant status in the Middle Immortal Realm.
"Mingchi Immortal King and Liuyuan Immortal King?"
Brother Cheng thought for a while but couldn't remember who they were.
But he couldn't be bothered to think any further, they must be Domain Saints from back in the day that he had no impression of.
"Let them in to see me then."

chapters.title: Chapter 305 305: You guys have been doing pretty well over the years
chapters.content:
"Ah, this..."
Although they knew the Ancestor once held a high position, it was still hard for the two to accept.
Whether in the Lower Realm or the Immortal Realm, cultivators who are masters of skills like alchemy, artifact refining, and talisman arrays are always in demand.
An Immortal King-level master, even more so, is a distinguished guest wherever they go.
It's said that even an Immortal King wanting to meet them must wait for their mood.
Hearing of their arrival, the entire Feixian Sect was extremely excited, feeling incredibly honored.
"These two are legendary figures in the Alchemy Dao and Artifact Dao, millions of years ago, Mingchi Immortal King even successfully refined a Tier Seven Immortal Artifact, which shocked the entire Middle Immortal Realm..."
Ancestor, no matter how high your status was, when encountering such experts, you must show proper respect!
Brother Cheng thought to himself, the artifact refining techniques he won in a lottery could directly produce a Ninth-grade Immortal Artifact, is he proud?
It's just that he never gathered the materials and didn't have a need for it, so he never paid attention.
"Alright, alright, tell them to come if they want to!"
Yuan Sheng and Yuan Shu certainly didn't dare to pass his original words over.
The two returned to the gate looking conflicted once again.
Sect Leader Yuan Zhen and the other elders were passionately chatting with the two Immortal Kings, almost turning into sycophants.
"Ancestor Jiang is about to come out!"
"We beg for the patience of you two seniors..."
"Haha, your arrival truly brings glory to our Feixian Sect!"
"I heard you two Immortal Kings once refused to join the Pill Alliance and the Artifact Alliance?"
The two Immortal Kings maintained a pleasant demeanor, responding with smiles.
"Indeed, that's true."
Liu Yuan Immortal King said leisurely: "That's because the Pill Alliance and Artifact Alliance are backed by the Upper Immortal Realm, standing with several Immortal Emperors."
The elders of Feixian Sect couldn't grasp how this formed a causal connection.
Isn't it beneficial to have a deep background with Immortal Emperors as a backing for the Pill Alliance and Artifact Alliance?
Why would this be the reason not to join these alliances?
No one dared to ask further questions.
Yuan He, still flattering, said: "Losing you, two seniors, is indeed a loss for the Pill Alliance and the Artifact Alliance!"
Yuan Zhe added: "Yes, if you two seniors had joined the Pill Alliance and Artifact Alliance, it would have been a blessing for the Middle Immortal Realm!"
The two Immortal Kings simultaneously frowned.
So, these future generations of Feixian Sect are unaware that the Immortal Emperors of the Upper Immortal Realm have repeatedly targeted their grandmaster?
And they still speak well of the Pill Alliance and Artifact Alliance?
"It seems you know nothing."
All the elders were startled and quickly apologized.
"What are the seniors referring to?"
"Please forgive us if we inadvertently said something taboo?"
The two Immortal Kings shook their heads, their frowns relaxing again.
"It seems your grandmaster has protected you well, not intending to let you get caught up in that terrifying vortex."
The members of Feixian Sect were bewildered, completely not understanding what this meant.
Only Sect Leader Yuan Zhen recalled the Nine Flames Immortal Emperor from back then.
This is when Yuan Sheng and Yuan Shu returned.
Seeing the two without Ancestor Jiang, the elders were quite helpless.
These two masters, renowned throughout the Middle Immortal Realm, were highly sought after, and it's said the Pill Alliance and Artifact Alliance have invited them multiple times.
Even they, you won't grant them face?
"So, will Sect Leader Jiang see us?"
"Does the elder have time?"
The two masters were quite excited, Yuan Sheng could only stutter: "The elder has time and allows you to meet him yourselves..."
As for the words 'come if you want', he definitely dared not convey them.
Upon hearing this, the group of disciples and grandchildren behind the two masters showed anger.
"Master, who exactly is this person?"
"Yes, grandmaster, what's so exceptional about him? On what basis?"
"Since he doesn't even want to come out to greet us, why not just leave?"
"Exactly, wherever we go, aren't we always treated with high respect? What is this mere Feixian Sect?"
"All of you, shut up!"
Mingchi Immortal King glared angrily at his disciples and grandchildren.
"In the presence of that person, if you dare to be so rude again, don't blame me for expelling you from the sect, I will not forgive!"
After saying this, he and Liu Yuan Immortal King adjusted their attire.
"Where is Sect Leader Jiang, lead the way quickly!"
Seeing their reaction, finally, all the elders of Feixian Sect breathed a sigh of relief.
The uncanny respect Ancestor had, really worked with anyone?
As expected, these two masters performed solemn rituals upon meeting Sect Leader Jiang.
The two even wept with excitement as if a disciple had finally found a long-lost master.
The elders of Feixian Sect were already numb with shock.
As for the pill masters and artifact masters behind these two masters, they were dumbfounded, completely unable to comprehend the scene.
They had heard of Ancestor Jiang of Feixian Sect.
He bought 3300 Immortal Fate Orders, had a Tier Nine Immortal Artifact, and had connections with several Immortal Kings and Demon Kings.
And yet?
Even that shouldn't make the two masters bow?
It is said many in the Middle Immortal Realm are gearing up, planning to trouble him because he bought too many Immortal Fate Orders, breaking some unspoken rules.
"Why didn't you two go to the Upper Immortal Realm?"
"We've been waiting for you to return and lead us again!"
Brother Cheng thought to himself, why is it this sentence again?
This group seems to expect him to rally them and take the Immortal Realm by storm, to achieve something big?
To this day, he still hadn't figured out from which Domain these two were from back then.
Even if he asked, he wouldn't have remembered.
Come to think of it, pill masters and artifact masters typically have lower combat power than cultivators of the same level.
During those tumultuous times, they probably had no opportunity to exhibit skills in alchemy and artifact refining, likely being peripheral figures then.
"I heard you two have been doing quite well in recent years!"
"My disciples seem to have heard quite a lot about you."
The two quickly nodded and waved modestly: "Sect Leader Jiang jests, those are just empty reputations..."
"Compared to you, our achievements amount to nothing."
This statement made those pill masters and artifact masters feel indignant once more.
The two grandmasters wouldn't even be this humble in front of an Immortal Emperor.
Brother Cheng smiled enigmatically: "You must have been well-informed over the years, right?"
"Ahem, fairly so."
"Is there something Sect Leader Jiang wants to inquire about?"
"I just want to ask, you should have heard of Feixian Sect long ago, right?"
The two nodded quickly: "Of course."
"This is Sect Leader Jiang's sect, we've always been very attentive!"
"Really?"
Brother Cheng's expression suddenly darkened: "I've recently discovered that my disciples never received any care from you!"
"Not just you, but Xiao Kun, Shali, and Jiyun, none of you have ever cared for my descendants either!"
He slammed the armrest heavily, suddenly stood up, and laughed coldly.
"Your promises from back then sounded nice!"
"What about taking care of Feixian Sect's future disciples, and yet?"

chapters.title: Chapter 306 306: Now You Can Release Your Concerns
chapters.content:
Regarding this, Jiang Cheng was truly a bit angry.
After consecutively encountering several Immortal Kings and Demon Kings, he gradually discovered something.
These disciples of his, completely viewed those Immortal Kings and Demon Kings as legendary strangers.
Both respectful and fearful, they were entirely unqualified to establish connections with these giants.
They had no idea that these big shots were supposed to be 'their own people'.
It was imaginable that in these years, they hadn't received any care whatsoever!
Otherwise, how could the Feixian Sect have continuously declined?
Upon hearing that their Ancestor was angry about this, Yuan Zhen, Yuan Sheng, Yuan Shu, and others were stirred up, their eyes turning red.
Was there really such a past?
Only then did they realize that these Immortal Kings once promised to take care of the Feixian Sect.
Then why... hadn't they felt anything in all these years?
"Sect Leader Jiang, calm down!"
His anger made the two Immortal Kings shudder.
Even the Three Great Corpse Kings, who were always watching from the side, hurriedly flew over.
"Sect Leader Jiang, forgive us!"
"We really had no choice."
Thinking about the current decline of the Feixian Sect, Brother Cheng was truly furious: "If you don't give a reasonable explanation today, get lost immediately!"
Were you happy to be taken flying back then?
Now that I'm not around, have you turned cold and indifferent?
Mingchi cautiously glanced at his darkened face and quickly explained: "There is a cause behind this matter."
"Speak!"
"Back when Mo Chen, Ji Linghan, Lin Ning, and Duan River were around, the Feixian Sect was at its peak, thriving with countless talents; back then, we were not even as good as them."
"Hmm, what happened after they ascended?"
"After they ascended, we gradually cultivated ourselves, finally earning some achievements. Originally, we planned to support and care for the Feixian Sect's disciples."
Zhan Yan, one of the Three Corpse Kings, interjected: "But at that time, a change occurred in the Upper Immortal Realm."
Brother Cheng furrowed his brows: "What change?"
"As more and more Immortal Kings ascended from the Feixian Sect, accumulating to over a thousand, they finally aroused the suspicion and fear of those Immortal Emperors above."
"Consequently, even the Feixian Sect within the Middle Immortal Realm was marked for extermination!"
Upon hearing this, the numerous Elders of the Feixian Sect were astounded.
Yuan Zhen and Yuan Sheng suddenly comprehended.
Both looked up, speaking sorrowfully: "No wonder our Ancestors never descended again after going to the Upper Immortal Realm, were they oppressed by the Immortal Emperors?"
The Elders collectively shouted: "May our Ancestors be safe and sound!"
Brother Cheng secretly sighed, having missed many critical events during his billion years absence.
"What then?"
"The Upper Immortal Realm couldn't directly intervene in the Middle Immortal Realm's disputes, so they continuously instructed some sects in the Middle Immortal Realm to annihilate the Feixian Sect."
"Fortunately, at that time, experts from the Sword Domain, Demon Realm, and Desolate Race hadn't gone up, which managed to protect the Feixian Sect. That was eighty million years ago."
Yuan Zhen was suddenly startled, then heavily nodded: "This indeed happened!"
Yuan Shu, suddenly awakening from a dream, repeatedly said: "The classics of our sect recorded that eighty million years ago, there were several sieges by the Ancient Immortal Sect, perilous like eggs in danger. But finally, the enemies mysteriously retreated. Was there really someone helping us?"
Liu Yuan Immortal King nodded: "Correct, without them, the Feixian Sect would have been eradicated at least ten times over."
"As those powerful individuals continuously ascended, our strength in the Middle Immortal Realm weakened significantly, having difficulty resisting those Ancient Immortal Sects and Demon Sects."
"Fortunately, the miraculous nature of the Feixian Sect faded. Later disciples became increasingly mediocre, practically none becoming Immortal Kings, failing to pique the interest of the Upper Immortal Realm."
"Thus, it was preserved."
These words made Yuan Zhen and the others deeply ashamed.
So it was the incompetence of our descendants that allowed survival?
"All these years, the development of the Ghost Alliance also indirectly protected you."
Mingchi continued: "They secretly dominate over thirty Celestial Domains around, eliminating many potential threats for you."
"Only they act very discreetly, never directly contacting you."
"Moreover, as the Ghost Alliance grows larger every year, it becomes increasingly mixed internally."
"Additionally, this command cannot be openly announced, so many Ghost Alliance members themselves don't realize how special the Feixian Sect is."
It's just Mingchi and Liu Yuan, these two masters.
Due to professional reasons, they maintained good relationships with most Ascenders.
For others, like the Three Great Corpse Kings and the Ghost Alliance, without any connections, the secrets would indeed remain unknown.
With this, the numerous Elders of the Feixian Sect recalled things and found it to be true.
In this million-year span, since the emergence of the Ghost Alliance, the Feixian Sect never met any crisis again.
Many times, when conflicts arose with other sects, shortly after, those sects would mysteriously encounter issues.
Although the Feixian Sect's power was ordinary, it seemed to be more peaceful than any other sect.
Brother Cheng was awkwardly embarrassed, realizing he had misunderstood them.
With this thought, instead of supporting the Feixian Sect later, was it actually well-intentioned?
"Ahem, if that is the case, let's leave the matter here."
Mingchi and Liu Yuan Immortal King discreetly wiped off virtual sweat, relieved to have passed this hurdle.
No matter how things were said, they really hadn't done anything for the Feixian Sect all these years.
This was also a fact.
Their respect for Brother Cheng was immense, but for Ji Linghan, Lin Ning, and those disciples, they weren't as impressed.
Back then, they were all taken flying alone by Sect Leader Jiang; what's so special about you guys?
To remember to casually safeguard some of their descendants, to assure the existence of the Feixian Sect, was already quite rare.
Brother Cheng understood their mentality and was too lazy to expose it.
"Now that I've returned, you don't have to hide anything anymore."
He smiled, rubbing his fingers: "You can boldly show your care for the Feixian Sect's descendants."
"To compensate for the grievances they've endured!"
Grievances?
Have we experienced any grievances lately?
Yuan Zhen and Yuan Sheng were somewhat out of sync.
Just knowing this Ancestor is truly not one to overlook, capable of soliciting from anyone.
"Ah, that's only natural!"
"As seniors, we indeed should give a meeting gift to the juniors."
Mingchi and Liu Yuan Immortal King laughed heartily, the latter then took out five bottles of Immortal Pills and distributed them to Yuan Zhen, Yuan Sheng, Yuan Shu, and other Elders.
"These are Supreme Profound Soul-Melting Immortal Pills, refined by this old man in recent years, hopefully, they will be of help to you!"
Upon hearing that these bottles contained Supreme Profound Soul-Melting Immortal Pills, Yuan Zhen and Yuan Sheng nearly cheered right away.
This pill is a Seventh-grade Immortal Pill, additionally used to assist the cultivation of the Immortal Soul.
Compared to pills that elevate Spiritual Power Cultivation, these are naturally rarer.
No need to even think about one bottle containing ten pills, just one pill seemed unimaginable for them.
Previously, cultivation used Fifth- and Sixth-grade Immortal Pills; with these Seventh-grade Immortal Pills, perhaps they'd break through their bottlenecks.
"Thank you, seniors!"
Regarding these Immortal Pills, Brother Cheng was quite calm, having just consumed thousands not long ago.
As everyone expressed their gratitude, some disciples behind Liu Yuan Immortal King couldn't stand it anymore.

chapters.title: Chapter 307 307 This is too valuable
chapters.content:
What's going on?
My master took the initiative to visit, you should feel extremely honored and receive him with the utmost respect.
How could he ask for something directly?
Especially the Supreme Profound Soul-Melting Immortal Pill, even they rarely received such rewards.
Why should it be given to them?
Several disciples showed discontent on their faces, but did not dare to speak, only staring with longing eyes.
Seeing Yuan Zhen, Yuan Sheng, and others having received the immortal pill last time, other elders from the Feixian Sect were extremely envious.
They finally completely understood what it meant when Leng Huahan, Yuan Zhe, Su Meng, and others went out with the ancestor.
Always being by his side, they could gain numerous benefits.
It's just a pity that the ancestor seems not to have plans to expand his trusted followers.
Seeing Liu Yuan Immortal King take out the Seventh-grade Immortal Pill, Mingchi Immortal King was a bit conflicted.
Others took out seventh-grade items, while he had a Tier Six Immortal Artifact, which somehow didn't seem prestigious.
After all, Yuan Zhen, Yuan Sheng, and Yuan Shu from the Feixian Sect all had Tier Six Immortal Artifacts.
But to give away a Tier Seven as a gift would really hurt.
Tier Seven Immortal Artifact and Seventh-grade Immortal Pill, one can be passed down forever, while the other is a temporary consumable, the value differs by many times.
The latter can still be obtained with effort, while the former is unattainable, fundamentally impossible to meet.
Mingchi Immortal King, as an Artifact Refining Immortal Master, currently possesses two Tier Seven Immortal Artifacts, one of which is his usual weapon.
The other is intended to be passed to his true successor once found in the future.
Among his disciples, he has yet to determine who will inherit it, hence it remains unused.
Thinking about what Sect Leader Jiang means to him, he made up his mind.
How could he let the old master view him lightly?
Therefore, Mingchi Immortal King ultimately brought out the Tier Seven Immortal Sword—Li Yun Sword.
At this point, his disciples really couldn't hold back.
"Master!"
"A Tier Seven Immortal Sword, how can it be given away…"
"Patriarch, please reconsider!"
Mingchi Immortal King took a deep breath: "No need to say more, my mind is made up!"
Seeing him take out the Tier Seven Immortal Sword, even Liu Yuan Immortal King was taken aback.
Old brother, you are really generous.
He knew that to refine this sword, Mingchi Immortal King spent tens of millions of years.
Just collecting the materials was hard enough, the key was bestowing the Power of Rules into the sword, which requires not only sufficient power but also elusive fortune.
If unsuccessful in bestowing the rules, the final product would just be a slightly better Tier Six Immortal Sword.
Before refining this sword, Liu Yuan Immortal King due to failures, ended up refining 15 Tier Six top-grade Immortal Swords...
This was considered lucky, at least succeeding on the 16th time.
Some Artifact Refining Immortal Masters refine thirty to forty times, utilizing alarmingly vast amounts of rare materials, and still fail in the end, which is not surprising.
Holding the sword horizontally in both hands, Mingchi Immortal King walked toward Sect Leader Yuan Zhen Immortal Venerable with great care.
"Senior…"
"This, this Immortal Sword..."
Yuan Zhen was panting heavily, his breath even disrupted.
As the sect leader for millions of years, apart from seeing the ancestor last time, he had never been so excited.
This is a Tier Seven Immortal Sword!
He even hesitated to accept it, too precious, beyond his ability to bear.
Yet, the words of refusal were hard to articulate.
The temptation of divine weaponry was enormous.
His hands honestly extended forward.
And at that moment, another hand reached over, separating the two.
Looking up, who else could it be but Brother Cheng?
"Ha, just rewarding a junior, no need for such painful love!"
He saw that this sword was indeed dear to Mingchi Immortal King.
Consider this old man and the Three Great Corpse Kings were different.
Those three didn't need immortal artifacts, so it was nothing to tap them hard.
Whereas this one's disciples still were numerous, this sword was clearly useful and couldn't be tapped too hard.
Mingchi Immortal King hurriedly said: "Sect Leader Jiang, the old man has no reluctance!"
"If you say the word, this old life can be given away, what counts as trifling external possessions?"
These words left everyone dumbfounded.
Especially Mingchi Immortal King's disciples, all thought he must be insane.
"No, no, no!"
Brother Cheng waved his hand: "Such a heavy reward, I'm afraid they cannot bear..."
Yuan Zhen could only withdraw his hands awkwardly, feeling somewhat disappointed, but then, it's true, he couldn't harbor peace even with the Tier Seven Immortal Artifact himself.
Then, Brother Cheng's words shifted: "How about this, do you have materials for Tier Seven Immortal Artifact?"
"Indeed, but what does Sect Leader Jiang need the materials for?"
The materials, though extremely precious, were still purchasable, giving them away wasn't so painful.
This was evident when seeing the many Tier Six Immortal Swords he refined before.
Compared to the finished Immortal Sword, the material value of a sword is at least dozens of times less.
After all, the most precious aspect of the Tier Seven Immortal Sword is the final bestowed Power of Rules.
Mingchi Immortal King carried the artifact refining materials with him, but did not understand Brother Cheng's intention.
Who gives materials as a gift to juniors?
Most artifact refining materials serve no other purpose before being refined into a product.
Brother Cheng deliberately acted calmly, casually saying: "Oh, I forgot to mention, I am actually an Artifact Refiner."
"Ah?"
"You are actually an Artifact Refiner?"
Not just the members of Feixian Sect, but even Mingchi, Liuyuan, and the Three Great Corpse Kings all wore puzzled expressions.
They had never heard it before.
Sect Leader Jiang had never shown any sign related to artifact refining.
"Correct, how many materials did you bring, do you have two sets?"
Having drawn artifact refining skills for so long, Brother Cheng thought it should be time to show off.
Moreover, to give Yuan Zhen and Yuan Sheng, the genuine confidants, some special treatment.
However, the cost should not come from himself, obtaining some materials from Mingchi sounded fantastic.
"This, two sets of Immortal Sword materials are available..., but only lack the crucial Cold Jade Immortal Core..."
Brother Cheng checked his System Mall, the exchange price for Cold Jade Immortal Core was 50 merit points per core.
Luckily, the rest of the hundreds of materials didn't need gathering himself, or else it would be daunting.
"No problem, I happen to have two Cold Jade Immortal Cores."
"That's excellent!"
Without hesitation, Mingchi Immortal King fetched a large amount of Heavenly and Earthly Treasures from the void, illuminating the entire hall with a dazzling brilliance.
Seeing these rare materials, his disciples again showed a look of pain.
Though those materials could be gathered with effort, they were part of the master's long-held collection, so giving them for wastage felt regretful.
Indeed, in their view, giving these materials to Sect Leader Jiang was akin to pearls before swine, too wasteful.
They didn't believe Brother Cheng could refine artifacts.
If he truly could refine Tier Seven Immortal Artifacts, he'd have been famous in the Middle Immortal Realm long ago.
Until now, they had never heard of him.
"Sect Leader Jiang, where do you plan to set the furnace for refining?"
"May this old one assist?"
Mingchi Immortal King, having witnessed several miracles accomplished by Brother Cheng, kept a certain level of expectation.
He internally resolved, even if luck wasn't in the two attempts, he would greatly praise Sect Leader Jiang.
After all, succeeding once out of two attempts was extremely improbable.
The important thing was that the old master enjoyed himself...

chapters.title: Chapter 308: My Own Creation
chapters.content:
Chapter 308: Chapter 308: My Own Creation
Brother Cheng looked at these materials.
"Are the materials for these two swords all Water Element?"
His System Refining Art extracted them and became his knowledge, so he knew it at a glance.
In fact, he had far surpassing Artifact Refining skills beyond Mingchi, just that he didn’t need to use them usually.
"Exactly, Sect Leader Jiang has sharp eyes!"
The disciples were murmuring in their hearts, what’s so sharp about this, any Artifact Refiner could see it.
Brother Cheng waved his hand and collected these materials into the System Warehouse.
Adding those two exchanged Cold Jade Immortal Cores, the two swords were only one step away from completion—clicking the button to start refining.
Looking at so many people present, he pondered on what to do next.
System Artifact Refining essentially had no process; once started, the progress bar would flash to the end, and the finished product could be extracted.
But if he just directly extracted them, it would seem too absurd and frivolous in others’ eyes.
Instead, they might suspect he had prepared two Tier Seven Immortal Artifacts in advance.
"I don’t need any assistance to refine artifacts."
"Nor do I need an Artifact Refining Furnace or an Immortal Array."
"Not even needing to change places, right here will do."
Of course, showing off needs to be done in person.
But these words didn’t make the same sense to others.
Even those who couldn’t refine artifacts knew some basics.
The refining process of Immortal Artifacts is extremely complex and tedious, far from merely adding materials to a furnace.
Choosing a treasure land, deploying a Great Array spanning hundreds or thousands of miles, and invoking the power of the Five Elements and Eight Desolates, with rule fortification, was considered the most standard operation.
This process generally required the assistance of friends and disciples; it’s very difficult for an Artifact Refiner to complete alone.
It’s considered a massive project.
Not using assistance, not even the most basic Artifact Refining Furnace, refining it directly in this hall?
