Even the blacksmith shop in the Mortal World didn’t forge so simply, right?
The group of disciples and descendants behind the two all showed disdainful expressions, thinking it was just bragging.
Were it not for the presence of so many Immortal Kings, they would have laughed out loud.
Immortal King Mingchi had strong faith in Brother Cheng.
Sect Leader Jiang had never failed to accomplish what he said.
However, despite the confidence, he couldn’t imagine how it would work.
"Refining an artifact without a furnace or array, Sect Leader Jiang is indeed extraordinary, doing things in an unconventional manner!"
"Haha, this old man must observe carefully!"
His gaze at Brother Cheng was just like a fanboy!
Beside him, Liu Yuan Immortal King was also full of anticipation.
This made Brother Cheng a bit depressed, why didn’t the two of you doubt me like the others?
Just like those disciples of yours, full of contempt and disbelief.
This way, when I bring out the Immortal Artifact later, I can harvest more Shock Value!
He secretly shook his head.
Indeed, those who knew he had once slain an Immortal Emperor had too high an initial expectation of him.
No matter what grand feat he accomplished later, they would take it for granted.
"My Refining Art is called—the Void Refining Technique!"
Immortal King Mingchi, very interested, immediately asked: "What is the Void Refining Technique? This old self has never heard of it, not knowing from which school it originates?"
Brother Cheng thought to himself, if you had heard of it, it would be strange, I made it up.
He patted his chest: "The so-called Void Refining Technique emphasizes being inspired from the heart, with the heart and spirit as the focus, forgetting those cumbersome external forms..."
"This method was self-created by me, never shown before outsiders until now."
"You all are fortunate to witness it in person!"
Immortal King Mingchi and Liu Yuan Immortal King widened their eyes, their expressions serious, just like students in a classroom listening to a teacher explain exam key points.
They were completely attentive.
However, the disciples and descendants behind them all had faces of disbelief.
They were a bit suspicious now whether Brother Cheng was a charlatan.
Then, they saw a bunch of ’special effects’.
Brother Cheng released a bunch of Heroic Souls and light beams, swirling around him, the scene looked as cool as it could be.
He even closed his eyes, his entire being bathed in a multicolored mist.
Soon, 992 Main Rules emerged together, with anomalies springing up in the hall.
Such a multitude of Power of Rules left everyone dumbfounded.
This truly seemed quite legitimate.
With eyes closed, Brother Cheng’s hands slowly waved, as if drawing mysterious trajectories, performing some incredibly mystical ritual.
In fact, it was still a sham to confuse the sight.
This ’ritual’ lasted for a full three minutes, he himself got a bit impatient.
Estimating everyone was now filled with questions, he only then clicked to start refining in the system; progress bar swish swish—two finished Immortal Swords lay in the System Warehouse.
He selected one to extract, then slowly pulled that sword from the void.
First to appear was the sword’s pommel, then the handle, and then the guard slowly appeared in everyone’s view.
When the blade, shimmering with a faint blue light and exuding a profound and dangerous aura, finally emerged, everyone was stunned!
Is it possible he really refined an Immortal Sword?
The group of disciples and descendants under Mingchi Immortal King were themselves Artifact Refining Immortal Masters, each having hundreds of thousands to millions of years’ experience in this field, they could instantly see the sword was extraordinary!
Because on this sword, there really was the aura of the Power of Rules!
Could it be he had prepared a sword beforehand?
No, not at all!
They weren’t that inexperienced, newly minted Immortal Artifacts and used ones have many subtle differences.
And this sword was clearly newly minted!
How could this be?
Brother Cheng, to create an effect, had indeed put in effort.
Deliberately pulling it out slowly from the System Warehouse, making it seem like it was gradually forming amongst all those special effects.
When the full appearance of the sword was completely revealed within the hall, many couldn’t help but hold their breath.
Immortal King Mingchi walked forward in a daze to the front of the Immortal Sword.
First sensing with his Immortal Soul, he couldn’t help but directly touch it with his hands.
Brother Cheng didn’t stop him.
He knew, such maestros and pioneers in various fields had a passion and focus unmatched by ordinary people.
"It’s truly Water Rule..."
Immortal King Mingchi murmured.
His words equated to declaring the sword was indeed a Tier Seven Immortal Artifact!
Thus, the hall instantly erupted.
Success at the first try?
And without using an Alchemy Furnace or Immortal Array, no other setup needed, nor a span of tens or hundreds of millions of years?
Before everyone’s eyes, in such a short time, a legendary Tier Seven Immortal Sword took shape?
Isn’t this too outrageous?
Yet, what’s even more outrageous comes next.
"No!"
Immortal King Mingchi suddenly exclaimed: "This sword... is not right!"
The entire hall fell silent, was it a mistake?
He suddenly looked at Sect Leader Jiang, eyes filled with deep disbelief.
"The power of this sword’s Rules far exceeds that of an ordinary Tier Seven Immortal Sword!"
"If wielded by someone with a highly profound Realm, it could even convert into Ice Rule Power!"
"This sword... can be considered the king among Tier Seven Immortal Artifacts!"
What?
Not only did he refine a Tier Seven Immortal Sword, but it’s the top-grade Tier Seven Immortal Sword?
This, the hall was in an uproar.

chapters.title: Chapter 309: A Groundbreaking Feat to Be Remembered in History
chapters.content:
Chapter 309: Chapter 309: A Groundbreaking Feat to Be Remembered in History
Brother Cheng secretly sighed with relief.
Earlier, when Mingchi Immortal King said something was wrong, he thought the system might have malfunctioned.
Turns out it was just because the quality was too good.
Well, isn’t that as expected?
The system refines artifacts, so the final product is naturally the best result achievable with the current materials.
However, others couldn’t see it as expected.
How does this allow others to live?
In just a moment, using nothing, directly produced a Tier Seven Top Grade?
"This is simply a miracle!"
"What kind of Divine Technique is the Void Refining Technique?"
"I just closely watched the whole process and truly didn’t understand it."
"Yes, it’s too profound and unfathomable..."
That was still the reaction of ordinary elders from the Feixian Sect.
As for the group of disciples and grandchildren behind Mingchi Immortal King, they were almost petrified.
Who am I?
Where am I?
What just happened?
Just casually tinkering, and refined a Tier Seven Immortal Sword? And it’s of the Top Grade?
Can someone tell them, how exactly was this achieved?
Brother Cheng placed the sword before Sect Leader Yuan Zhen Immortal Venerable.
Anyway, the products made by the system could not be reclaimed for merit, so in his eyes they were worthless.
"Yuan Zhen, I have witnessed your efforts, and this sword is considered a joint reward from me and Mingchi Immortal King to you."
This made the old man very excited.
Earlier, when Mingchi Immortal King’s reward was interrupted by the sect founder, he felt a bit disappointed.
Now, he was doubly ecstatic.
This sword is the king among the Tier Seven, much stronger than the one Mingchi Immortal King had given before.
Not to mention buying it, I’m afraid one couldn’t find another sword comparable to it under the Upper Immortal Realm!
Moreover, it was personally refined by the ancestress, representing the sect founder’s recognition of him.
The significance is comparable to the Feixian Sect’s Imperial Sword!
"Thank you, Ancestress!"
"Thank you, Senior Immortal King!"
Yuan Zhen, in utter euphoria, the respectable sect leader directly knelt down and bowed.
But no one mocked him.
Besides Brother Cheng and the Three Great Corpse Kings, others looking at the sword were burning with passion, wishing they could snatch it away.
Especially the other elders of the Feixian Sect, suddenly feeling that their Tier Five and Tier Six weapons were all rubbish.
"Sect Leader Jiang, this... this Void Refining Technique, how exactly is it done?"
Mingchi Immortal King could not remain calm.
He was more concerned not about the sword’s worth, but about this completely new artifact refining method.
It’s like a door opened before him, showing him a hazy new world.
Seeing his eyes full of passionate curiosity, Brother Cheng thought to himself that without a system, any thoughts were in vain.
"This, it mainly depends on an extraordinary talent."
"It requires special root bone divine soul and bloodline constitution, and there should only be one person in the world who can do it."
"You better not try to replicate it..."
He didn’t want the old man to go astray and dive into an impossible dead end.
Mingchi Immortal King couldn’t hide the regret in his eyes.
At the same time, he increasingly revered Sect Leader Jiang.
"Then... could Sect Leader Jiang refine it again, allowing this old man to witness and learn once more..."
The dignified Immortal King, Middle Immortal Realm’s artifact refining authority, said he wanted to learn.
If word spread, everyone would think it was an act of humility.
But now, everyone present, including his disciples and grandchildren, found it very normal.
In their view, if comparing artifact refining to mountain climbing, Mingchi Immortal King could only look up at Sect Leader Jiang from afar, and even then he couldn’t see the full picture.
Brother Cheng originally intended to do it again; after all, Great Elder Yuan Sheng was still envious on the side.
So he pretended once more, with special effects.
Then he pulled out another Tier Seven Immortal Sword.
As the sword appeared, Immortal Kings Liuyuan and Mingchi couldn’t wait to inspect it.
Once again, they exclaimed continuously.
"Another king among the Tier Seven!"
"How is this possible?"
"Two consecutive successes, and each of such Top Grade!"
"Incredible!"
"Is this a dream?"
The whole venue was boiling again.
Another success proved the previous wasn’t coincidental.
The general people might not realize anything.
Those used to countless artifact refining failures, the artifact refiners, had their perceptions shattered completely.
The miracles occurring twice before their eyes dealt a near-destructive blow to their century-old artifact refining profession.
Does this Void Refining Technique never fail?
And so easily, producing Top Grades they couldn’t achieve in their lifetime?
Many disciples even began to doubt and deny themselves.
Had they been on the wrong artifact refining path all along?
But, weren’t countless refiners throughout the years just like them?
For a while, they were utterly bewildered.
"Yuan Sheng, you too have worked hard, this sword is rewarded to you!"
Brother Cheng, not wanting to waste words, directly tossed the sword to Great Elder Yuan Sheng.
The latter was instantly overwhelmed with joy.
"Thank you, Ancestress!"
"Thank you, Senior Immortal King!"
Earlier, he thought only the sect leader would receive a Tier Seven reward; he didn’t expect he would too.
The sword, although also Tier Seven, is way more Top Grade than Leng Huahan’s Treasure Light Sword!
Suddenly, his master’s prestige instantly soared!
The old chap couldn’t put the sword down, eager to test its fire, especially wanting to compare with his own disciples.
The other elders couldn’t stand still anymore.
"Ancestress..."
"What about us..."
Elders Yuan Shu, Yuan Mu, and others were waiting eagerly.
Brother Cheng didn’t plan to reward everyone; firstly, he didn’t have that much material, secondly, giving everyone a reward wouldn’t make it valuable and special.
"You guys?"
"You still need to perform well."
"Look up to the sect leader and Great Elder, learn well from them."
These words made Yuan Zhen and Yuan Sheng extremely proud.
See, this was recognition by the ancestror for their work in the past period.
Being the first to recognize the ancestror’s identity, was indeed advantageous.
Earlier, you kept opposing; how about now?
"Haha, Yuan Shu, Yuan Mu, don’t rush!"
"Elder Yuan Bai, this old man’s Tier Six Immortal Sword is useless now, just give it to you!"
"This... cough, alright, thank you, Sect Leader!"
Elder Yuan Bai took the sword, his expression extremely complex.
Originally using a Tier Five Immortal Sword, getting a Tier Six Immortal Sword would have left him ecstatic in the past.
But now, compared to the two Tier Seven Immortal Swords, it’s not as appealing.
Especially since it was someone else’s leftover, discarded...
"Sect Leader Jiang..."
Mingchi Immortal King completely lost his sage-like demeanor, scratching his ears anxiously on the side, eager to no end.
Pity, no more materials; otherwise, he really wished Brother Cheng could do it again.
See if another instant success could happen.
Even if he couldn’t learn the Void Refining Technique, as an artifact refiner, seeing such a miraculous artifact refining technique, was impossible to stay calm.
"You’ve truly pioneered a completely new school!"
"This is enough to be recorded in the history of artifact refining, a great innovation!"
"Your name will be sung by countless refiners in future generations..."
"Truly remarkable!"
"Compared to you, this old man is small as dust..."
His disciples and grandchildren were no better, having completely turned into fan mode too.
Now they dared not show disdain, looking at Sect Leader Jiang as if looking at a divine being who established a sect.

chapters.title: Chapter 310 Qingjing Palace
chapters.content:
Chapter 310: Chapter 310 Qingjing Palace
Brother Cheng checked the system panel.
The show-off effect of the two recent artifact refining events was remarkable, leaving everyone present utterly shocked.
Even the two Immortal Kings who knew about his past were no exception.
They could understand artifact refining, but using such a style for artifact refining was beyond their comprehension.
Brother Cheng felt a bit regretful; too bad there weren’t many people on-site.
If he had known, he should have gathered all the disciples before starting the show.
In the following days, the Feixian Sect continued to gather Immortal Crystals to purchase more Immortal Fate Orders.
And in those days, three more Immortal Kings traveled a long way to visit Sect Leader Jiang.
The entire Feixian Sect was almost numb.
What big deeds did the Ancestor do back then?
This widespread connection has to have its limits.
The Immortal Kings, who they might not have had a chance to see once in a lifetime before, were now eight in number, stationed right beside them.
And each one showed him great respect, completely following his lead; the prestige was overwhelming.
Yuan Shu, Yuan Mu, and others had privately speculated countless times but couldn’t guess what was going on.
On the other hand, Brother Cheng was not in such a good mood.
These eight Immortal Kings stayed at the Feixian Sect after arriving, as if they intended to follow him from now on.
He knew well how capable ascenders from the Lower Realm could be, and with such a group, his chances to show off would be greatly diminished.
But it’s hard to drive people away when you’ve accepted their goodwill.
Especially Mingchi Immortal King and his disciples, who clung to him like sticky candy over the past few days.
As if he was the beacon, the morning star, the lighthouse of the artifact refining world...
"I’ve said it countless times, that Void Refining Technique can’t be replicated."
"Following me won’t help you!"
He was truly tormented to a headache, while Mingchi Immortal King and his disciples just chuckled along.
"It’s alright, we know."
"We can’t replicate your ultimate techniques, Elder, we just want to follow you closely and listen to your teachings."
They’re not fools.
An Ancestral Master level figure who can single-handedly create a new school must have unparalleled artifact refining mastery.
Following such a person, even a brief word of guidance could be enlightening, greatly enhancing one’s artifact refining skills.
"I have no teachings to give!"
"I know nothing about artifact refining..."
"To be honest, this is my first time refining artifacts; I’m not as experienced as you guys."
Everyone thought skeptically, who would believe you!
Could your lie be any more unbelievable?
First-time refining and you crafted a Tier Seven Top-Grade Immortal Artifact?
Even amazing talents have their limits, right?
"Sect Leader Jiang is too modest!"
While Mingchi Immortal King sighed in admiration, he didn’t pass up the chance to educate his disciples.
"Learn from him!"
"See how profound Sect Leader Jiang’s artifact refining skills are, yet he’s still so humble!"
"And look at you, swaying with just half a bucket of skills, yet so conceited usually..."
All the disciples nodded repeatedly with deep self-reflection, expressing their desire to learn Sect Leader Jiang’s down-to-earth and modest spirit.
Brother Cheng felt helpless.
As an arrogant person, of course, he wouldn’t ordinarily be modest.
The Artifact Refining Technique drawn from the system had automatically endowed him with knowledge for crafting Tier Nine Immortal Artifacts.
Moreover, this knowledge was comprehensive, covering all aspects of artifact refining.
Even without using the system and refining in a conventional Artifact Refiner’s way, he could still produce Immortal Artifacts, only with a certain failure rate.
He indeed had the capacity to teach these people.
But recalling the cultivation of the batch of Feixian Sect disciples back in the day, he never taught them, always hands-off.
How could he possibly start an artifact refining class to teach students?
No time for that!
And during this time, the outside of the Feixian Sect was also turbulent.
Brother Cheng’s sudden emergence indeed stunned the Middle Immortal Realm.
Especially the scene outside the Celestial Pavilion of the four great experts showing submission, which caused quite a stir among various nearby forces.
The first to bear the brunt was the Qingjing Palace, the leading Great Sect in the Qianlan Celestial Realm where the Feixian Sect was located.
This was an ancient sect with a history of tens of billions of years. Although during the Ascension Battle, Immortal City was the center, the status of Qingjing Palace remained transcendent.
They still had a more powerful main sect in the Upper Immortal Realm, with an Immortal Emperor holding the fort.
The branch left in the Middle Immortal Realm for development.
When Mo Chen, Ji Linghan, and Lin Ning’s batch of prodigies rose, Qingjing Palace attempted to defend its position as the leading sect in Qianlan Celestial Realm by attacking.
But they practically couldn’t handle the ferocious dragons emerging from the river, and eventually ranked second.
Ji Linghan, Luo Yuan, and others suspected Sect Leader Jiang went to the Upper Immortal Realm, with no intention of expanding further in the Middle Immortal Realm.
So they didn’t plan to eliminate surrounding forces and adopt a supreme dominance strategy.
After the thousand Immortal Kings of the Feixian Sect all ascended, Qingjing Palace resumed its position at the top.
During that period, under the directive of their Upper Immortal Realm branch, they once united with other sects to attack the Feixian Sect.
But that time, they unfortunately encountered the fierce Sword Domain Sword Cultivators.
The Sword Domain was aggressive, unlike the Feixian Sect disciples who just disciplined their adversaries...
Not only did Qingjing Palace fail to benefit, but they also lost three Immortal Kings, severely decreasing their power.
This scared them from making any significant moves afterward.
Their heritage remained, and after millions of years of recuperation, Qingjing Palace now housed two Immortal Kings again.
Making it the strongest sect among surrounding ten celestial realms.
If the Feixian Sect hadn’t declined drastically afterward, posing no threat to them anymore, they would have likely attacked again.
Brother Cheng’s reappearance threatened them.
This Feixian Sect is restless.
If left unchecked, they might repeat the scenario from millions of years ago, overwhelming Qingjing Palace.
This is unacceptable to them.
Threats should be nipped in the bud.
It’s said that Jiang Cheng lacks personal strength besides having a Tier Nine Immortal Sword.
The toughest to deal with are the four great experts Xiao Kun and Jiyun.
For this reason, Qingjing Palace has been secretly contacting a few powerful sects and noble families in the surrounding celestial realms, planning to eradicate the Feixian Sect.
Their proposal for alliance quickly received responses from several surrounding forces.
Even though their motives differed, their interests aligned.
Qingjing Palace aims to maintain their dominance over the Qianlan Celestial Realm and several nearby celestial realms.
Other forces eye the Tier Nine Immortal Sword.
Some are outraged over the 3,300 Immortal Fate Orders.
And yet others seek revenge.
For instance, behind the Candle Mountain Demons extinguished at the Celestial Pavilion stood the Blood Flame Sect.
As an Ancient Demon Sect, they also had two Demon King-level Supreme Elders.
So far, five Great Sects and one Noble Family have gradually joined the joint encirclement.
The number of Immortal King and Demon King-level experts reached nine!
Amidst the swirling undercurrents, the Feixian Sect had not made any preparations yet.
Many merely heard outward complaints about the Feixian Sect holding so many Immortal Fate Orders.
Unaware, a battle at the Immortal King level was indeed about to break out.

chapters.title: Chapter 311: What if the enemy steals home?
chapters.content:
Chapter 311: Chapter 311: What if the enemy steals home?
The outside world is unaware that this battle is brewing.
However, as the only neutral force in the Middle Immortal Realm, the Celestial Pavilion still has its own unique intelligence channels.
At this moment, Miao Yu and Ye Yang Immortal King are also discussing this imminent great war.
"Qingjing Palace won’t rest until they achieve their goals this time."
"Yes, both Wuheng and Miao Xuan, the two Immortal Kings, have been in seclusion for many years, having not emerged for millions of years, yet this time even they are taking action."
"The two Demon Kings from the Blood Flame Sect, their true goal is probably that Tier Nine Immortal Sword."
"Naturally, among the nine experts coming out for this battle, none can remain unfazed by that sword."
"The so-called revenge and Immortal Fate Order are just excuses."
Miao Yu sees it very clearly.
Indeed, possessing the Immortal Fate Order would provoke public outrage, but there’s still over a hundred years until the deadline.
Even if they are to besiege and snatch the Immortal Fate Order, it’s better to wait for later. For now, making a move is premature.
The true lure for the wolves watching eagerly this time is still Brother Cheng’s sword.
"How are the Ghost Alliance and the Ancient Emperor Sect planning to handle this?"
"Those four are not simple individuals."
Ye Yang Immortal King said lightly, "Besides the Five Sects and One Family, they have also rallied another sixteen major sects with thousands of Immortal Venerable practitioners this time."
"The role of these Immortal Venerables is to attract the attention of the Ghost Alliance and the Ancient Emperor Sect, keeping the four great experts pinned down."
"Ensuring they can’t aid the Feixian Sect."
Miao Yu nodded slightly; this is a classic strategy of feinting east and attacking west, diverting their attention.
Without those four great experts, Jiang Cheng facing nine Immortal King level experts would be hard-pressed to survive.
"Are Mingchi Immortal King and Liu Yuan Immortal King still at Feixian Sect?"
Immortal Kings are as elusive as dragons; these two went to Feixian Sect to visit Brother Cheng without taking many people, and didn’t alert anyone before setting off.
Most outsiders are currently unaware of this news.
However, it can’t escape the ears and eyes of the Celestial Pavilion.
But, after all, their intelligence isn’t yet watertight.
The Soulless Celestial Realm has long become the domain of the Corpse Race; outsiders cannot infiltrate, so the Celestial Pavilion does not know that the Three Great Corpse Kings also went to Feixian Sect.
And in the following days, the three Immortal Kings entering Feixian Sect did so alone, making it even harder to detect.
This alone surprised them greatly.
"To think he not only has connections with both Immortal and Demon Dao, but also has old ties with the grandmaster figures of Pill and Artifact Dao!"
Miao Yu really can’t comprehend how this was managed.
These experts don’t even walk the same paths; how could they all have connections with him?
Especially those two grandmaster figures of Pill and Artifact Dao, the Celestial Pavilion once tried recruiting them several times, only to be refused each time.
Ye Yang Immortal King couldn’t help but admire: "Able to gain so many people’s help, I almost suspect he might be an Immortal Emperor in disguise."
Miao Yu shook her head.
"Even if he is an Immortal Emperor, it doesn’t mean he can gain the help of those two grandmasters."
Ye Yang Immortal King had to admit she was right.
Grandmaster figures in the fields of Alchemy and Artifact Refining hold a very special status, and often have eccentric temperaments.
Even if an Immortal Emperor appeared, they couldn’t force them.
And according to the information they received, those two went to visit Jiang Cheng at Feixian Sect voluntarily.
"Unfortunately, with only these two Immortal Kings, they can’t withstand the attack."
The Qingjing Palace side alone has nine Immortal King level experts.
Besides, Mingchi and Liu Yuan are not the combat type, not to mention one against two, even one-on-one might be challenging.
"Should we secretly disclose some information to him in advance and let him prepare defenses?"
Ye Yang Immortal King isn’t necessarily fond of Jiang Cheng.
He just feels there must be some earth-shattering secret behind this person.
Maybe this favor will come in handy later.
Perhaps saving him this time would make him so grateful he’d sell that Tier Nine Immortal Sword to me?
Besides, there’s the favor from Mingchi and Liu Yuan, those two grandmasters.
Miao Yu pondered for a moment and finally shook her head.
"Don’t forget, our stance is neutral."
"Moreover, I see this person as one bearing great fortune, even if Feixian Sect falls, he might amazingly survive."
The Feixian Sect really has no defenses.
Plans on an Immortal King level aren’t something Yuan Zhen and Yuan Sheng can perceive.
And Brother Cheng...
Does he need to be wary of this and that?
When the Feixian Sect was surrounded by the Five Sects and One Family and the nine experts stood at the gates, the entire Feixian Sect was thrown into chaos.
Yuan Shu, Yuan Mu, Yuan Zhe, and other elders scrambled frantically to see Brother Cheng.
"Ancestor, what should we do?"
"Yes, the enemy is strong, should we first activate the Sect Protection Array?"
"Yes, yes, open the Great Array first, the Great Array left by ancestors can even stall Immortal Kings for a while!"
If they were just Immortal Venerables, they could stay calm, but Immortal Kings are beyond what they can handle.
Not to mention there are nine of them.
However, Yuan Zhen and Yuan Sheng were full of confidence.
"What’s the panic?"
"That’s right, just nine Immortal Kings, what’s there to be afraid of?"
"Look at how disordered you are, is there any semblance of an elder? What a disgrace."
The ancestor used to slay Immortal Emperors back in the day, why fear a few Immortal Kings?
Yuan Shu and Yuan Mu were at a loss for words.
You two are just Immortal Venerables, where do you get the confidence to call Immortal Kings trivial?
Could it be Zhan Yan or Mingchi, those eight Immortal Kings?
Yuan Shu sighed: "Even with those eight seniors helping, we’re still one short!"
"Right, especially..."
Yuan Mu didn’t continue, but everyone understood his implication.
Mingchi and Liu Yuan, though at the Immortal King level, may lack the combat power when facing Immortal Kings of the same level.
After all, they have been focused on the Artifact and Alchemy Dao for years.
Just when they finished speaking, the Three Great Corpse Kings and experts like Liu Yuan, Mingchi also arrived.
"Sect Leader Jiang, let us lead the charge in this battle!"
"Indeed, now it’s our turn to fight for you!"
Zhan Yan patted his chest, "The three of us together can defend against five of them!"
Hearing this, Yuan Shu and the others were overjoyed.
Looks like these Three Great Corpse Kings have exceptional combat power!
However, Brother Cheng nearly got furious hearing these words.
Darn it, are you planning to imitate Xiao Kun and Jiyun in taking credit?
He’s still sore about not getting the spoils of last battle.
Now that enemies have finally arrived, he can’t let the opportunity slip away again.
"The sect is a crucial place, they must be guarded by experts. What if the enemy sneaks in?"
"There are many disciples at Feixian Sect, what if some of them accidentally get killed?"
"Even if no disciples are killed, damage to the internal structures is still a loss!"
"None of you eight are allowed to engage without my command!"
"Did you hear me?"
Brother Cheng, abandoning his usual calm demeanor, had a look of unprecedented severity.

chapters.title: Chapter 312: Providing Some Shock Value Before Death Isn’t Bad
chapters.content:
Chapter 312: Chapter 312: Providing Some Shock Value Before Death Isn’t Bad
The eight people looked at one another, and in the end, could only nod and accept the order.
This was the command of Sect Leader Jiang; the decision he made, even powerful figures like Void Abyss, Gui Cang, and Bi Chang back in the day could only accept it.
Not to mention, they had all witnessed the shocking scene of Nine Flames Immortal Emperor being killed.
As for Brother Cheng’s personal ’combat power,’ they were completely assured.
"Then, let’s wish Sect Leader Jiang victory in his first battle!"
Seeing all eight people bow together, Yuan Shu and Yuan Mu became anxious.
What’s going on?
The eight main forces won’t go to battle, and only the founder will go out?
Go out for what, to negotiate with the enemy?
Or to his death?
"Founder, please reconsider!"
"We must not be careless in this battle, even a slight mishap could lead to the destruction of the sect..."
Before Brother Cheng could say anything, Yuan Zhen and Yuan Sheng stepped out dissatisfied.
"Can’t you say something auspicious?"
"Do you have no confidence in our founder?"
"The founder will definitely return in triumph, you bunch of frogs in the well!"
Yuan Shu, Yuan Mu, Yuan Bai, and other elders were dumbfounded.
Completely unable to understand where these two’s confidence came from.
Could blindly supporting the founder be the reason why the two of them could receive a reward of two Immortal Swords?
When Brother Cheng flew out of the mountain gate alone, the other side had already set up their formation.
"That’s the one surnamed Jiang!"
"The sword is on him!"
As soon as they saw him, the nine experts and the Immortal Venerables and Golden Immortals behind them all took notice.
Brother Cheng glanced around, all nine Immortal Kings and Demon Kings were present.
"All here?"
"No stragglers, right?"
To handle it all at once, to avoid any fish that escaped the net.
This exceptional confidence took the nine experts by surprise.
Wuheng Immortal King of Qingjing Palace secretly communicated using the Communication Immortal Artifact with the distant containment forces.
Upon learning that there were no anomalies with the Ghost Alliance and the Ancient Emperor Sect, and that Xiao Kun and Jiyun and others were currently stuck there, they felt at ease.
"Ha, do you still count on Xiao Kun Demon King, Shari Demon King, Hua Yin Immortal King, Jiyun Immortal King these four to save you?"
"If that’s your plan, then you’re doomed today!"
"To be honest, those four are held up and can’t come!"
Upon hearing this, Brother Cheng couldn’t help but laugh happily.
"I really have to thank you all for that."
Initially, he was truly worried that those four would suddenly come charging in from all directions at the most critical moment of the battle, shouting to support Sect Leader Jiang or something.
So, who gets credit for the victory in the end?
How should the spoils be divided?
Now, with the opponent’s strategy of feigning an attack to cover for their real intentions, those four can’t come, which means they have relieved him of his concerns.
The nine experts frowned simultaneously.
This was not the reaction they imagined.
Immortal King Miao Xuan sneered coldly: "Do you still rely on Mingchi Immortal King and Liuyuan Immortal King to save you?"
"To tell you the truth, we’ve seen through your tricks!"
"Even with them, it’s not enough."
"Let those two come out!"
Brother Cheng found it quite amusing, so their intelligence capability was this poor?
Eight came, and you only know about two of them?
If he called out all eight now, wouldn’t he just harvest a wave of Shock Value?
The five sects and one noble family before him had no fewer than ten thousand experts, all at least at the Golden Immortal Realm.
These people needed to be killed; before killing them, making them shocked to create some merit points wouldn’t be bad either!
Thinking of this, he sent a message to the eight experts inside the gates.
"All of you come out!"
The eight experts stationed inside remained calm, not worried about Sect Leader Jiang’s ability to handle the situation.
Upon hearing his communication, they were quite surprised.
Is it possible the enemy this time has special means, making Sect Leader Jiang outnumbered?
They flew out as quickly as possible.
"Sect Leader Jiang, we are here!"
"Huh, the battle hasn’t started yet?"
"Do you need us to take action?"
When the Three Great Corpse Kings and the other three Immortal Kings also appeared, the reaction from the five sects and one noble family was one of extreme shock!
"The Three Great Corpse Kings of the Soulless Celestial Realm!"
"How, how are you all here?"
"Didn’t you agree not to leave the Soulless Celestial Realm?"
The nine experts felt something was amiss.
These Three Great Corpse Kings were extremely difficult to deal with, and it was very hard for experts of the same level to completely eliminate them.
If they couldn’t be killed and enmity was formed, what followed would be endless revenge.
The Three Great Corpse Kings were notorious, and imagining being turned into Corpse Puppets made those Immortal Venerables and Golden Immortals behind them pale with fear.
"Immortal King Wu Jue, don’t you always travel alone, never associating with anyone?"
"Why are you here?"
"And that one, is that Immortal King Jingyu? You are over fifty Celestial Domains away from us, always minding your own business, so why get involved in this mess?"
With these eight appearing, the nine experts realized they had no chance of victory.
They couldn’t figure it out.
Immortal King Mingchi and Immortal King Liuyuan were always immersed in the Dao of Pill Artifacts, seldom even engaging with others in combat.
The Three Great Corpse Kings hadn’t left the Soulless Celestial Realm in millions of years and didn’t belong to any faction.
Immortal King Wu Jue and Immortal King Jingyu were also famously solitary, like idle clouds and wild cranes.
Why were they all here to support one person?
This made no sense!
In fact, not only those on the scene, but even at the distant Celestial Pavilion, Miao Yu and Ye Yang Immortal King were equally shocked.
This grand battle attracted quite a lot of attention.
The Celestial Pavilion naturally had its spies gather intelligence nearby.
Seeing the eight Immortal King level experts clearly on the screen, they were equally unable to remain calm.
"Why are there eight more?"
"How many people does he have connections with?"
"These are the toughest ones to invite, how did he manage to call them over?"
Miao Yu took a deep breath and muttered, "Judging from the reactions of Xiao Kun Demon King and Jiyun Immortal King and others that day, I’m afraid they were not invited by him."
"But they came voluntarily."
"His background is too profound, and the power he wields is already on par with our Celestial Pavilion in the Middle Immortal Realm!"
Ye Yang Immortal King was speechless.
Immortal King Mingchi in the field looked at the nine experts opposite, though one was missing, he was not afraid at all.
"Why wouldn’t we be here?"
"Are you blind to dare to oppose Sect Leader Jiang?"
Zhan Yan glanced around at everyone present, leisurely saying, "Soon, you factions will become the Corpse Race, celebrate."
The nine experts felt a chill down their spines and suddenly began to worry about their sects behind them.
If they didn’t completely eliminate the Three Great Corpse Kings today, there would be endless trouble!
Just when they were resolved to fight to the death, Brother Cheng stood out again.
He had just checked the record of the system panel, and with these eight appearing together, it brought him no less than 175,487 points of merit.
This was more than he had accumulated in previous instances combined!
Of course, it was mainly because the other side had nine Immortal Kings.
Higher realm targets generating shock also provide more Shock Value.
Thus, the automatically exchanged merit was naturally more.

chapters.title: Chapter 313: Your Mission is Complete
chapters.content:
Chapter 313: Chapter 313: Your Mission is Complete
Brother Cheng couldn’t help but admire his own cleverness.
It’s a good thing he didn’t just kill them outright, otherwise wouldn’t that be a waste?
Now, the last value of this group of enemies across from him has finally been used up.
The eight experts have shown their faces, completing their mission as pretentious props, it’s time for him to take the stage.
"Alright, alright, you guys can go back now!"
He waved his hand towards the eight Immortal Kings like Zhan Yan, Mingchi, and Wu Jue.
The eight of them were a bit confused.
"Sect Leader Jiang, don’t you need us to assist in the battle?"
"No need, with just these few enemies, you think I can’t handle it?"
"Then you..."
Why did you call us out in the first place?
Brother Cheng also couldn’t directly say that their role was just to show their faces, that would be too hurtful.
He could only find a ’justifiable reason’ to some extent.
"Wasn’t I showing enough respect to the other side, letting them know who the heavyweights are here?"
"So that later when they die, they will feel it was worth it."
Despite this reason being quite nonsensical, upon hearing Sect Leader Jiang describe themselves as heavyweights, the eight people were flattered and a bit proud.
Back in the day, they were the fringe figures who couldn’t even get into meetings.
It seems that the years of hard work have finally earned them a higher regard from the old man.
"Still, Sect Leader Jiang is far-sighted, his thinking always surpasses our knowledge!"
"Yes, yes..."
"We’ll return to guard the mountain gate right away!"
"Call us whenever you need us again."
The eight were satisfied and then flew back to the mountain gate.
With this in-and-out, the nine top experts on the opposite side were caught off guard and didn’t know what was happening at all.
What is this all about?
Calling out those eight people just to scare them and then not using them to fight?
On the distant side of the Celestial Pavilion, watching this scene, Ye Yang Immortal King was also stupefied.
"What does he want? Why let those eight people go back?"
Miao Yu glanced with narrow brows, thought for a moment and then said uncertainly, "Maybe, it’s a strategy to confuse the enemy?"
"Deliberately letting the enemy think he’s alone, causing them to become complacent, while the other eight are likely secretly ambushing around."
Ye Yang Immortal King suddenly realized: "So that’s it!"
At this time, Brother Cheng, who had already gained shock value, naturally wouldn’t continue to waste words with the group of experience bags in front of him.
He directly activated all his cheats.
Dozens of Heroic Souls empowered him, Full Level Azure Dragon Bloodline Suppression, and 992 Main Rules of Daoist Heart...
Of course, there’s also that Tier Nine Immortal Sword.
Activating the Talent Skill Azure Dragon Flash Strike, and then pressing the tenfold critical strike.
This was his strongest strike at present.
As he swung the sword down, the world changed colors!
A phantom Azure Dragon spanning thousands of miles appeared in the sky, devouring everything in the void.
The nine top experts ahead of him and the hundreds of thousands of Immortal Venerables and Golden Immortals were instantly enveloped in the tremendous mouth of the Azure Dragon.
Under the Flame Rule attached to the Rainbow Absolute Sword, countless mountains burned crazily, then turned into streams of black smoke!
All the cultivators in the mouth of the Azure Dragon faced imminent destruction.
All the Golden Immortals vaporized instantly, not even leaving a trace.
The Immortal Venerables didn’t fare much better; they barely had time to feel fear before meeting the same fate.
Under the suppression of the Azure Dragon, they couldn’t even mobilize techniques or Immortal Armor to defend themselves.
When he was a First Grade Golden Immortal, Brother Cheng could knock out several Immortal Venerables with tenfold critical strikes.
And now he is a Third Grade Immortal Venerable, with 992 Main Rules, and 300 of them having reached Perfection Level.
Most importantly, his Azure Dragon Bloodline was at Full Level.
Not only was the suppression terrifying, but Azure Dragon Flash Strike itself had a doubled attack effect.
This power compared to before was a world of difference.
Even the nine Immortal King-level experts were stunned by this strike. At the front, Wuheng and Miao Xuan’s Immortal Bodies even showed cracks!
The nine people immediately unfolded their Immortal Countries, using the strength of their Immortal Countries to withstand.
In the pervasive dark sea of flames, the edges of the nine Immortal Countries were quickly scorched into large patches of rubble remains.
Within the Immortal Countries, it was a cataclysmic disaster, like an apocalypse!
The main rules of the nine Immortal Countries madly contested with that strike, clashing fiercely in the void countless times in a perilous manner!
When the strike ended, the massive Azure Dragon phantom disappeared, and the pervasive black flames were extinguished, revealing a huge void ahead.
In it, some Tier Six Immortal Artifacts and Top-Grade Magical Treasures not yet completely incinerated remained.
As for the living beings left, they were only the nine top experts.
Everyone else had been wiped out!
The nine, still in shock and anger, could hardly believe it was real.
An attack obliterating over a hundred thousand Golden Immortals and Immortal Venerables was something no Immortal King could do.
And Brother Cheng on the other side couldn’t quite believe it either.
What the heck, he used so many cheats and executed his strongest strike, yet none of these nine are dead?
When he was a Golden Immortal, tenfold could take down an Immortal Venerable.
He was confident that as an Immortal Venerable, tenfold could take down an Immortal King without issue.
Now he realized he had overestimated himself.
The Immortal Kings with their Immortal Countries were a completely different concept than Immortal Venerables.
The strike he used had ignored spatial barriers, yet the Immortal Countries were not even in this world.
The main rules within the Immortal Countries had fundamentally changed; even the Perfection Level was not comparable.
Jiang Cheng’s strike had remained at the level of infinitely accumulating attack power.
But the Immortal Kings had surpassed this level, comparing beyond attack power strength.
Although their full-force strikes weren’t as destructive, they had crossed a threshold, becoming higher-existence beings...
The accumulation of strength at a lower level could never truly extinguish them.
"It really is troublesome..."
As the strike ended, Brother Cheng reverted to his original state.
The aftereffects of Azure Dragon Flash Strike hit, leaving him extremely weak.
"It seems wise to not bring too many people out this time."
He understood clearly that this time he would face a long-awaited death.
The nine on the opposite side had their hearts bleeding at this point.
The hundreds of thousands of people behind them were the elite disciples of their sects.
Yet here they were, utterly annihilated.
Their biggest goal in coming here was to seize that sword, the other excuses were just a facade.
Now, all that’s left is the hatred!
"You... you’re ruthless!"
"Even if I die, I’ll take you down with me!"
"Kill!"
The nine Immortal Kings could see Brother Cheng’s weakness right now.
They naturally understood that the strike just now could only be executed once.
And looking back, they figured it out too.
That strike was earth-shattering to those below Immortal King, but to those above, it was just a scratch.
Impressive in scale, but not fatal.
"Kill him first!"
Killing Jiang Cheng would secure them that Tier Nine Immortal Sword.
Even without time to refine it, just a portion of the power of the Tier Nine Immortal Artifact could far surpass a Tier Seven Immortal Sword.
Then even if the Three Great Corpse Kings came out, they would still have the power to fight!
Under the combined assault of these nine top experts, the already very weak Brother Cheng had no chance of survival and was killed without suspense.

chapters.title: Chapter 314: Divine Slide Tackle
chapters.content:
Chapter 314: Chapter 314: Divine Slide Tackle
As he died, the nine experts all focused on that sword.
The first to grab the sword was Wuheng Immortal King, but as soon as he got it, he was attacked from behind.
Two Demon Kings from the Blood Flame Sect charged forward, one after another, and while he was defending, they seized the sword into their hands!
"Put down that sword!"
"You dare!"
Immortal King Miao Xuan, furious, struck out, and the other Immortal Kings were not willing to lose either.
They were originally not from the same Sect.
Now that the Immortal Sword was right in front of them, they couldn’t bother with anything else.
A battle for the sword naturally broke out.
At this moment, Brother Cheng also heard a familiar sound without any suspense.
"Ding! Host killed, detecting enemy power, arranging resurrection plan!"
"Ding! Host encounters a higher level target, unable to break through with force, endless pent-up frustration gathers in the chest! In a state of extreme anger, gain Divine Slide Tackle ten times!"
Damn, what’s this?
Sounds just like how Yi got ten arrows, but when did I ever reach a state of extreme anger?
What the heck is a slide tackle?
Can one slide tackle take out an Immortal King?
Once again, it’s a plan full of absurdities.
The system didn’t give any explanation or instructions.
"Ding, host resurrected!"
Upon resurrection, Jiang Cheng found himself facing a nearly transparent panel.
On the panel, there were ten identical strange symbols, and their posture appeared like a slide tackle.
The ten symbols were like ten divine arrows aimed forward, ready to launch.
Leaving him almost speechless with a sense of powerlessness.
Glancing at the sky, the nine Immortal Kings were engaged in battle, surprisingly no one noticed him.
How the hell do you use this slide tackle?
With a mindset to test things out, Brother Cheng casually tapped one of the slide tackle symbols.
Upon tapping, that slide tackle symbol flashed briefly.
Immediately after, he found he lost control.
His whole body suddenly appeared in the high sky, faster than instant teleportation.
Moreover, the posture couldn’t be commanded by himself, forcibly twisted into a slide tackle...
Turns out this slide tackle actually shoots himself out?
By the time this thought flashed in his mind, he’d already automatically slid out.
And the target was none other than Immortal King Miao Xuan holding the Immortal Sword.
Everyone was caught off guard, including Jiang Cheng himself.
The Immortal Country doesn’t belong to this world unless matched by fellow rank experts, otherwise, even rule attacks are rarely possible to touch.
Yet, this one kick not only hit the core of Immortal King Miao Xuan’s Immortal Country but kicked right into the core of this Immortal Country.
For an Immortal Country to take shape, initially, a foundation object for the Daoist Heart is needed.
This object can be anything, whether an Immortal Artifact or a grain of ordinary sand, even a wisp of ephemeral obsession is sufficient, irrespective of grades, only determines the future direction of Immortal Country.
Once the Daoist Heart has a foundation it can gradually transform into a real existence of a Vast Immortal Country.
It’s no exaggeration to say, this core reliance object is the fundamental of the Immortal Country taking shape!
This place usually wouldn’t be hit...
After the Immortal Country shaped, the initial core has been covered countless times, even many Immortal Kings can’t precisely tell where it is.
Yet if it miraculously got hit, the consequences are catastrophic.
Buzz!
A muffled sound came from the void.
Immediately after, Immortal King Miao Xuan’s Immortal Country suddenly collapsed and shrank violently, rapidly extinguished.
Just like a world prematurely reaches the day of silent extinction without any warning.
In the blink of an eye, it disappeared without a trace.
Poof...
Immortal King Miao Xuan himself spurted fresh blood on the spot, turning ghostly pale, plummeting from mid-air.
He didn’t die.
But the disappearance of Immortal Country had an unimaginably massive impact on an Immortal King.
In a common battle between Immortal Kings, even if an Immortal Country was broken or even destroyed, it merely damages the foundation.
It would eventually recover.
However, that one slide tackle had rendered the Immortal Country vanished, never possible to restore...
Imagine the impact this had.
At this moment, Immortal King Miao Xuan was so repulsed his status fell lower than the usual Immortal Venerable.
Whoa, is this slide tackle so powerful?
One kick nearly sent an Immortal King directly to Western Heaven!
Brother Cheng, freshly revived, was overjoyed!
The solution offered by the system sure wasn’t ordinary.
He naturally wouldn’t miss this opportunity, instantly flash across, reclaim the Immortal Sword.
Then raise the sword, to bring down this former Immortal King.
Thus, Immortal King Miao Xuan fell just like that.
Jiang Cheng looked again at those ten slide tackle symbols, one was already gone.
Meanwhile, the remaining eight Immortal Kings in the sky were stunned.
Did Miao Xuan die just like that?
How did he die?
They totally didn’t understand.
And Jiang Cheng, wasn’t he killed by their combined attack just now, how is he alive and kicking again?
Could he be like the Corpse Race, able to resurrect from the ashes?
But the resurrection of the Corpse Race requires a lengthy period of time, doesn’t it?
Numerous question marks hovered in their minds.
Meanwhile, Brother Cheng already tapped the second slide tackle symbol.
Soon after he again lost control of his body, sliding directly towards a Demon King from the Blood Flame Sect.
The entire process still seemed to shoot against his will, lacking any autonomy.
Until that one slide tackle struck the core of that Demon King’s Demon Country.
Buzz!
Demon Country silenced, immediately vanished.
This Demon King similarly suffered a fatal blow, spurted blood furiously, fell downward.
Brother Cheng swift on the draw, slashed again with the sword.
By this step, the remaining seven finally reacted.
Immortal Countries and Demon Countries could actually be obliterated?
Such a thing they’d never heard of!
"Too uncanny!"
"Join forces!"
The seven ceased the struggle, targeted Jiang Cheng again.
But at this moment, Brother Cheng just pressed the third slide tackle symbol.
Whoosh!
A flicker of a silhouette, all seven’s rule attacks missed entirely.
That slide tackle felt like it occurred on another plane, ignoring constraint by rules, and ignoring any attack.
It seemed like once pressed, it would inevitably reach the designated location, then slide tackle down naturally.
Another Immortal King fell!
In a panic, the remaining six...
Before they could re-organize offense, Brother Cheng pressed down three symbols in succession.
He felt like an ordinary person tossed onto a weightless flying disk, uncontrollably performed three more slides!
Buzz! Buzz! Buzz!
Three more Immortal Countries silenced, three Immortal Kings were slain!
Faced with this, the last three remaining Immortal Kings were utterly terrified!
This kind of attack, exceeded the limits of their understanding.
Even if an Immortal Emperor descended, it would take quite an effort to annihilate them.
Yet facing Jiang Cheng now, they seem as if targeted bulls-eye.
One after another.
Couldn’t hide, couldn’t defend, and didn’t know from where to defend.
This sense of helplessness made them ultimately opt to flee.
But Brother Cheng wouldn’t grant them such opportunity.
Finally pressed again three slide tackle symbols.
In the mere blink of an eye, one fleeing Immortal King had already torn open a spatial rift, crossing tens of millions of miles.
Yet that one slide tackle, seemed like it fulfilled its mission, still precisely struck his Immortal Country core.
The very last Immortal King, seemingly realizing something, withdrew his Immortal Country.
But still to no avail.
After that slide tackle swept past, his hidden Immortal Country automatically revealed itself.
Like it was eagerly waiting for the tackle...

chapters.title: Chapter 315: Could It Be the Immortal Emperor
chapters.content:
Chapter 315: Chapter 315: Could It Be the Immortal Emperor
After the nine slide-tackle symbols disappeared, all nine Immortal Kings had fallen.
It was only then that Brother Cheng stopped.
Having cultivated to this point, he was already a dignified Immortal Venerable, yet he experienced dizziness for the first time.
The dizziness wasn’t physical, but rather a result of being completely out of control.
"This slide-tackle is indeed badass."
"But it feels like I’ve become a tool."
"So passive..."
At this moment, only one slide-tackle symbol remained on the panel.
He quickly put this big killer away; perhaps he could use it again next time.
On the bodies of the nine Immortal Kings, he found 13 Tier Seven Immortal Artifacts and 21 top-grade Immortal Treasures.
Besides these, there were some sixth and seventh-grade Immortal Pills and top-grade Immortal Crystals they carried.
Unfortunately, most of the treasures belonging to the Immortal Kings are not kept in storage rings but rather in spaces they open up themselves.
This hidden space is impossible for anyone else to find other than they themselves.
With their demise, those items are temporarily untraceable.
Brother Cheng was not disappointed, as the haul this time was already extremely huge.
After exchanging most of the Immortal Artifacts and Magical Treasures for merit, his merit reached 430,000 points.
This time, the Tier Seven Immortal Artifacts he seized would not be casually given away.
Considering how hard it has been to level up recently, the pills needed to advance each level of an Immortal Venerable increase exponentially, like a massive sea.
Opening the system panel, he first exchanged for Level 5 Rule Fragments, raising all main rules to perfection level.
This way, the biggest bottleneck to advancing to the Immortal King stage was gone.
Then, he used all the pills he obtained, ultimately advancing only to a Fifth-grade Immortal Venerable.
Afterward, he spent over 300,000 merit points to exchange for seventh-grade Immortal Pills.
Finally, he raised his realm to a Ninth-grade Immortal Venerable!
"Damn, it’s so hard to advance as an Immortal Venerable, how the hell am I supposed to deal with the Immortal King stages?"
"It feels like a distant dream."
With the remaining 100,000 merit points, he decided to enhance his Martial Dao Realm enlightenment, so he opened the shop again.
It included treasures like the Daoist Celestial Immortal Rhyme and Mystic Immortal Rhyme from before.
Now, all nine of his Martial Dao Realm understandings were at the Immortal King level.
Looking at results, perhaps there’s no other Immortal King in the Middle Immortal Realm with such profound accomplishments.
As for raising the Martial Dao Enlightenment to the Immortal Emperor level’s Ultimate Immortal Rhyme, each of them incredibly required 5 million merit points!
After all, the Immortal Emperor is the pinnacle of the entire Immortal Realm.
Even many Immortal Emperors may not be able to raise their Martial Dao Realm to that level.
Being able to do so with 5 million is already considered miraculous.
For now, he had to give up on that.
"The road stretches far and wide, and we must continue to be down-to-earth..."
"The ancestral master’s words are well spoken!"
A voice interrupted his thoughts.
Looking back, who else could it be but Leng Huahan?
Other elders of the Feixian Sect were also flying over from his front and back.
"The ancestral master’s words are truly enlightening!"
Elder Yuan He already had paper and pen out, writing furiously while flying: "From today onward, I will remember every word of the ancestral master’s teachings!"
Yuan Zhe and Yuan Wu nodded in agreement.
"That’s right, the ancestral master is teaching us to endure the monotony of ascetic cultivation!"
"His realm is one we can only look up to..."
Their flattery left the other Elders and disciples baffled.
Are you guys being too straightforward with the flattery?
There are still several Immortal King seniors here, don’t let others laugh at us.
However, those Immortal Kings didn’t seem to have any intentions of laughing but rather looked around the space with awe.
"Sect Leader Jiang, where are the enemies?"
"Could it be... you’ve already wiped them out?"
They were just inside the sect, not far away.
After Brother Cheng launched his first sword with a tenfold critical strike and unleashed that world-ending power, everyone there could feel it.
But after that, the commotion gradually diminished.
There was even a period where they couldn’t sense Sect Leader Jiang’s presence.
Vaguely, they felt the Immortal Country outside was continuously clashing, still battling.
This left the people inside gradually losing their confidence.
It wasn’t until Brother Cheng’s aura reappeared and the fluctuations of the nine Immortal Countries silently vanished that they regained their hope.
After the battle ended, while Brother Cheng was busy exchanging and consuming pills, they were anxiously waiting inside.
The aura of the nine Immortal Kings and tens of thousands of Immortal Venerables and Golden Immortals was nowhere to be felt.
Were the enemies destroyed?
If they were, why hasn’t Sect Leader Jiang returned yet?
Unable to endure the long wait any longer, they finally came out to have a look.
"Indeed, the enemies have been completely slain by me, the old ancestor, on the battlefield!"
After saying this, Brother Cheng happily received a ton of shock value.
Zhan Yan and Mingchi, those eight experts, were easier to handle.
In their eyes, Sect Leader Jiang was supposed to have such strong power.
For the disciples and the entire Feixian Sect, however, it was a different story.
Their minds were blown by this statement.
What?
The enemies were truly all wiped out?
By whom?
The eight experts were all inside; doesn’t that mean that...
Elder Jiang alone took down those nine Immortal Kings?
How could that be possible?
In the Middle Immortal Realm, Immortal Kings being killed wasn’t particularly uncommon, but being able to take on two at the same rank was already considered top-notch.
One against nine and completely wiping them out, this broke through the limits of their imagination.
Could it be that this Elder Jiang is actually an Immortal Emperor?
No way, right?
Impossible, right?
However, aside from an Immortal Emperor, there’s no one else who could accomplish such a feat.
Reaching this consensus, everyone drew in a breath of cold air.
Yuan Zhen and Yuan Sheng stood proudly, as if they had fought this battle themselves.
The two of them were actually pretty shocked too, since they hadn’t experienced the previous slaying of the Nine Flames Immortal Emperor, only heard it passed down from generation to generation.
This time, it was officially confirmed.
Elder Jiang truly is as powerful as the legends say!
Others like...
Elders Yuan Shu, Yuan Mu, Yuan Zhe, and others finally understood why the old ancestor dared to buy so many Immortal Fate Orders.
Disciples like Leng Huahan also realized why Xiao Kun, Jiyun, and Mingchi these Immortal Kings respected Elder Jiang so much.
Turns out he is an ’Immortal Emperor’!
Suddenly everything started to make sense.
There was a collective gasp until the silence was broken by the two maids, Su Ye and Su Meng.
These two had been looking for an opportunity, not daring to speak while there were so many elders and experts around.
But now that everyone had quieted down, they gathered their courage and quickly chimed in.
"Wow, is our ancestral master actually that powerful?"
"He’s been keeping such a low profile all this time, isn’t that just too humble?"
With that, they clung to Brother Cheng’s arm, almost causing the other elders and Immortal Kings to be taken aback.
Oh my, you two True Immortals actually dare to touch a Grandmaster-level Immortal Emperor?
However, Sect Leader Jiang didn’t seem to mind their affectionate gestures, instead he was clearly quite elated.
The other elders and Immortal Kings were looking at the two women with pure envy and jealousy.

chapters.title: Chapter 316: Miss, You Are Truly Wise
chapters.content:
Chapter 316: Chapter 316: Miss, You Are Truly Wise
With that smile, Yuan Zhe, Yuan He, Leng Huahan, and the others finally came to their senses.
Almost missed the chance to flatter the ancestor.
There is indeed an order to flattery.
The impression left by the first flatterer and the second are different.
By the tenth or hundredth, well, those have long been lost among the crowd, who would remember?
"The ancestor’s divine techniques are vast and unmatched!"
"Truly unfathomable, it seems Su Ye was right before, the ancestor has been invincible!"
"Absolutely, absolutely, Ancestor Jiang shakes the Middle Immortal Realm with a single battle..."
Brother Cheng discreetly shook his head; this praise is still rather dry and lacks creativity.
It can only be described as commendable spirit.
Yuan Shu, Yuan Mu, and the others wore expressions of sudden realization, finally understanding something.
No wonder these individuals all received rewards!
Turns out it was because of this?
A few exchanged glances, with many disciples and outsiders watching; such blatant flattery in public seemed somewhat excessive.
A bit too much to handle...
At that crucial moment, Gu Qingyu ’stood up’.
Seeing Su Ye, Su Meng, Leng Huahan, and others earning Brother Cheng’s favor, possibly even rising in status, she could not bear it.
She refused to believe she couldn’t compete with them.
"Ancestor Jiang, you are even stronger than I imagined, a thousandfold!"
"Thinking back, you were truly merciful that day at the Demon-slaying Tower."
"And later you never held any grudges against me, such a rude person..."
"Though there are many Immortal Kings and Emperors in this world, when it comes to breadth of heart, none surpass Ancestor Jiang!"
"That is why I admire you even more!"
Others were praising Brother Cheng’s strength, but she didn’t want to follow suit, choosing a different path.
Her praise nearly shocked everyone.
Wasn’t Senior Sister Gu the one who hated the ancestor the most?
Even if she let go now, wouldn’t it be too much of a turnaround?
It was too absurd.
Her words were sincere, leaving Brother Cheng unsure if Gu Yinghou was acting again.
But it didn’t matter...
Act or not, he didn’t care.
This woman really had a flair for flattery, much more talented than Leng Huahan and Yuan Zhe.
He nearly couldn’t resist rewarding her, wanting to encourage her.
Alas, perhaps later.
Let’s observe further; motivation leads to progress...
With Gu Qingyu leading, Yuan Shu, Yuan Mu, and the others let loose.
"Yes, yes, Ancestor Jiang is truly amazing."
"With you around, Feixian Sect’s restored glory is within reach!"
"Ancestor Jiang’s journey isn’t in the Middle Immortal Realm..."
Unfortunately, Yuan Zhe and Leng Huahan’s assessment was correct.
These subsequent praises hardly left any impression on Brother Cheng; he barely paid attention.
While Feixian Sect’s morale was soaring, Celestial Pavilion in the distance was anxiously awaiting news.
"What’s the outcome?"
"That sword’s power was quite remarkable!"
"Such a pity, we couldn’t see what happened next..."
Brother Cheng’s tenfold critical strike had just started, destroying all nearby Communication and Image Transmission Immortal Artifacts.
No joke, that strike could even kill an Immortal Venerable.
The spies hidden in the shadows naturally suffered collateral damage.
It took a full hour before news from the ’frontline battlefield’ finally arrived again!
"Nine experts completely killed!"
"Five Sects and One Family utterly annihilated!"
"Not a single survivor!"
"According to Feixian Sect disciples, it was their Ancestor Jiang who single-handedly killed them."
"However, there were no eyewitnesses."
This string of news left Miao Yu and Ye Yang Immortal King speechless, unable to believe it.
They had estimated the outcome beforehand.
But even giving Feixian Sect’s power a high regard, the most they thought possible was to repel the nine experts.
To kill one or two would already be quite impressive.
How could Immortal Kings be killed so easily?
Initially, they thought this news was fake.
But after verifying repeatedly, the news was confirmed true.
Thus, they fell into prolonged shock.
The fall of nine Immortal King level experts, in the Middle Immortal Realm, was earth-shattering!
"How was this done?"
"Does the Tier Nine Immortal Sword have such immense power?"
"Could he be an Immortal Emperor?"
Ye Yang Immortal King muttered, face full of disbelief.
Miao Yu shook her head, solemnly saying, "Even an Immortal Emperor wielding a Tier Nine Immortal Sword can’t guarantee killing all nine Immortal King level experts without exception."
An Immortal Emperor can defeat nine Immortal Kings but would leave loose ends.
If they can’t win, wouldn’t they flee?
Immortal Kings have strong survival abilities.
She pondered for a moment before slowly concluding.
"He can’t possibly be an Immortal Emperor."
Ye Yang Immortal King was stunned: "If not an Immortal Emperor, how could he accomplish such a feat..."
"An Immortal Emperor can stay in the Middle Immortal Realm for at most half an hour." Miao Yu interrupted him.
"It’s the law set jointly by all Immortal Emperors when the Upper, Middle, and Lower Three Immortal Realms were divided, to prevent disrupting the balance below."
"And this person has been in the Middle Immortal Realm all this time."
Ye Yang Immortal King realized.
Given this, Jiang Cheng wasn’t as strong as he had imagined.
But then, a bigger doubt emerged.
"Since he’s not even an Immortal Emperor, how did he kill those nine Immortal King level experts?"
Miao Yu again threw out an unexpected conclusion.
"Those nine were likely killed by the Three Great Corpse Kings and the other eight experts!"
"How could that be..."
Ye Yang Immortal King couldn’t comprehend: "The news from Feixian Sect credits it all to Ancestor Jiang alone!"
"There were no eyewitnesses, right?"
Miao Yu took a deep breath, her expression gradually calming.
"Those eight deliberately returned to the mountain gate, which was very unusual."
"There’s bound to be something strange about it, they must have been lying in ambush."
She reasoned further: "Only falling into a terrifying trap could make it impossible for the nine experts to escape!"
"As for that Jiang fellow, he should be acting as bait, actually not even reaching the Immortal King level in strength."
Really? Not only not an Immortal Emperor but not even an Immortal King?
Ye Yang Immortal King was incredibly surprised.
"But when he began that sword strike, it already exceeded the destructive power of ordinary Immortal Kings..."
Miao Yu shook her head: "I don’t know how he managed that strike, maybe some kind of forbidden technique to temporarily stimulate power."
"But it was precisely because of that strike that I could tell he’s still relying on primitive power accumulation, far from reaching the Immortal King level."
Her insight was sharp.
Despite seeing only the image and merely the preliminaries of the strike, she discerned the fundamental difference between Jiang Cheng and an Immortal King.
"Feixian Sect being attacked by a strong enemy, normally all disciples should appear on the battlefield."
"Yet ultimately, there wasn’t a single witness."
"Don’t you think it’s suspicious?"
"Clearly, something’s being deliberately hidden."
Ye Yang Immortal King was convinced.
Now he believed the battle was orchestrated by the Three Great Corpse Kings and other eight experts setting a terrifying trap.
"Why would Feixian Sect promote such a story?"
"Intentionally concealing the feats of the eight experts, claiming it was Jiang’s solo effort, what benefit does it bring them?"
Miao Yu chuckled softly, speaking gently: "It’s exactly where their cunning lies."
"Don’t forget, they purchased many Immortal Fate Orders."
"Exaggerating their strength, announcing an Immortal Emperor level expert is overseeing them; that way, even if they have more Immortal Fate Orders, no one would dare seize them in the future."
Ye Yang Immortal King was enlightened.
The lady truly possessed wisdom; nothing escaped her!

chapters.title: Chapter 317: As Many As You Want
chapters.content:
Chapter 317: Chapter 317: As Many As You Want
In the following days, news of the battle at the Feixian Sect gradually spread.
Although many people didn’t know the law that the Immortal Emperor couldn’t stay long in the Middle Immortal Realm.
But to make them believe Jiang Cheng was the Immortal Emperor, they would rather believe those eight already renowned experts.
This is also a reasonable assumption.
With eight Immortal King Level experts, who wouldn’t use them but instead keep them at home as decoration?
That’s just not logical!
So those eight must have acted at the time.
So it was them who did this battle!
As for that Ancestor Jiang from the Feixian Sect, he’s just a red herring, right?
Anyone with a normal thought process would guess this, but how could they know Brother Cheng had an abnormal thought process?
Suddenly, the Three Great Corpse Kings and Immortal King Wu Jue, Jingyu Immortal King, and others caught tremendous attention.
This left Brother Cheng at a loss between tears and laughter, feeling quite conflicted.
Damn it, clearly, this is all my work, why are you giving credit to others?
Outrageous!
On the other hand, this kind of speculation has its advantages for him too.
If he were confirmed to have Immortal Emperor level power, it would be hard to gain any Shock Value in the future.
An Immortal Emperor in the Middle Immortal Realm is already a god who stops other gods, anything done would seem normal at that point.
A few days later, the Feixian Sect finally gathered over 14 billion top-grade Immortal Crystals.
With so many crystals, they could purchase over 140,000 Immortal Fate Orders, enough for all Feixian Sect disciples to ascend.
Holding the crystals, Brother Cheng embarked once again on the journey to the Celestial Pavilion.
This time, the eight great experts insisted on accompanying him no matter what!
On the other hand, the people of Feixian Sect almost fought to get onboard with Ancestor Jiang.
Besides Su Ye and Su Meng, who Brother Cheng personally selected, the other spots weren’t confirmed yet.
And this trip to buy things didn’t really need many people, ten at most was the limit.
"Ancestor Jiang, take me with you, last time I couldn’t go, and I’ve regretted it every day, crying my eyes out..."
"Get lost, you have the nerve to mention last time? Didn’t you strongly oppose it back then?"
"And you, you went last time, this time you should give your spot to others!"
"Exactly, leave the opportunity for those in more need!"
"Ancestor Jiang, I’m your indispensable accessory, you can’t leave me behind..."
Brother Cheng was speechless.
The people from Feixian Sect couldn’t provide any more Shock Value, he was originally too lazy to bring them along.
In the end, among the ten people selected, Great Elder Yuan Zhen and Second Elder Yuan Shu managed to squeeze in, as did Leng Huahan and Gu Qingyu.
Whereas Yuan Zhe, Yuan Wu, and Yuan He, who had accompanied him before, were eliminated this time.
So, the group boarded the Flying Ship and once again headed to the Celestial Pavilion.
Brother Cheng chose the Danhua City branch he first visited.
The reason was simple, it was closer.
As for the Immortal Fate Orders there being purchased entirely by him, that didn’t matter.
Anyway, the Celestial Pavilion could transfer stock from other branches.
Upon entering, Branch President Ding Rui hurriedly came out to greet them.
When he saw everyone, his face blossomed into a smile like a chrysanthemum.
"Ah, Elder Jiang, your visit truly graces our humble Celestial Pavilion with your presence!"
"If you had informed us earlier, we would have sent someone to welcome you!"
He was considered an acquaintance now.
When Brother Cheng first visited, he thought this was just a naive fool.
But now, his impression had completely changed.
Killing nine Immortal Kings was not something anyone could take lightly.
Even in the Upper Immortal Realm, it was a big deal.
Although he thought it was those eight Immortal Kings who did it, weren’t those eight following Jiang Cheng?
That also represented his strength!
The other customers in the store, upon hearing this was Ancestor Jiang of the Feixian Sect, immediately quieted down and looked on with reverence.
Brother Cheng was very satisfied, his status was much higher than last time.
The last time, there were even ignorant scions trying to provoke him.
"Haha, long time no see, how are you, Chairman Ding?"
Ding Rui felt slightly relieved.
This man now had a fearsome reputation!
If he disregarded the sanctions from the Upper Immortal Realm, leading Immortal Kings recklessly, even the Celestial Pavilion would suffer greatly.
"I’m good, I’m good... Elder Jiang, what brings you here this time?"
"What else can I be here for? Buying Immortal Fate Orders, of course!"
"Huh?"
Ding Rui was stunned, and the other customers were all dumbfounded as well.
Jiang Cheng had purchased 3,300 Immortal Fate Orders last time, and it had caused a huge stir.
It caused a commotion precisely because he bought so many.
Typical Ancient Immortal Sect or Demon Sect might gather only hundreds of Immortal Fate Orders per turn, more would break the "rules" and they couldn’t digest them.
3,300 was already very envy-inducing.
And yet, he hadn’t bought enough?
"You still want to buy more?"
Brother Cheng nodded: "Yeah, last time I didn’t bring enough money, so I just bought some to test the waters."
Last time was just testing the waters?
Ding Rui couldn’t help but ask, "So how many do you plan to buy this time?"
"It depends on how much stock your Celestial Pavilion has."
Brother Cheng actually planned to buy more than 140,000.
He had gathered a lot of spoils from the nine Immortal Kings and the Five Sects and One Family, and now he personally possessed 18 billion top-grade Immortal Crystals.
Combined with what the Feixian Sect gathered, they could buy 320,000.
This statement shocked everyone present.
Before the final decade arrives, most Immortals who’ve obtained Immortal Fate Orders would choose to sell them to the Celestial Pavilion first.
After all, they couldn’t keep them safe, and it would invite assassination attempts.
So, at this time, the Celestial Pavilion should hold at least eighty percent of the Middle Immortal Realm’s Immortal Fate Order stock.
Although the number of Immortal Fate Orders issued each turn varied, by judging from past patterns, all branches combined should have no less than 250,000, and possibly even up to 300,000.
Buy as many as there are?
Could he take all 300,000?
Ding Rui tried hard to calm his breathing, his mind buzzing.
This guy’s crazy, isn’t he?
Really crazy!
"What do you plan to do with so many Immortal Fate Orders?"
"Didn’t I say before, I have a lot of disciples and grand-disciples."
Are you really planning to take everyone in the Feixian Sect up there?
Even if you plan to take them all, you don’t need to buy them all up!
Ding Rui was speechless with criticism.
Seeing him dumbfounded and unable to speak a word, Brother Cheng impatiently waved his hand.
"Alright, alright, you clearly can’t make the decision on this deal."
"Let that pretty lady from last time take over!"
"Besides, you’ll need time to gather the stock, so prepare a dozen superior rooms for us first!"
You think my Celestial Pavilion is an inn, and I’m the waiter?
Despite the sarcasm in his heart, Ding Rui immediately put on a professional, warm smile.
"Got it!"
"Everyone, please come in!"
No choice, these guests were too special.
As soon as Brother Cheng moved in, the place erupted.
"Whoa, did I hear that right, buy it all up?"
"How many Immortal Crystals would that take?"
"Even selling off all of Feixian Sect’s assets wouldn’t be enough, right?"
"Not necessarily, Feixian Sect was once incredibly glorious; their assets are far more considerable than most Immortal Sects."
"How many Immortal Crystals isn’t important, what’s important is how he plans to keep them safe?"
"Exactly, even if they’ve slain nine Immortal Kings, it wouldn’t help. There are over a thousand Immortal Kings in the Middle Immortal Realm; if he takes everything, won’t others fight them to the death?"
"Looks like the Middle Immortal Realm is about to undergo major turmoil..."
"The final decade is the day the chaos fully erupts!"

chapters.title: Chapter 318: Enlightenment Immortal Tree
chapters.content:
Chapter 318: Chapter 318: Enlightenment Immortal Tree
Miao Yu, located hundreds of celestial domains away, quickly received the transmission report from Ding Rui.
"What?"
"Buy as many as there are?"
"Does he not know how many Immortal Fate Orders Celestial Pavilion has?"
"What exactly is this person trying to do..."
Miao Yu didn’t doubt that Sect Leader Jiang could afford it.
She just couldn’t understand this decision.
Buying all the Immortal Fate Orders was practically declaring war against the entire Middle Immortal World.
Others are afraid of being besieged by multiple forces, even those with profound backgrounds, like the Ancient Immortal Sects and Demon Sects, are no exception.
This person is quite peculiar, as if he’s afraid the Middle Immortal World won’t join forces against him.
One Immortal Fate Order costs 100,000 Immortal Crystals, which is nothing to Celestial Pavilion.
But when the number reaches tens of thousands, or even hundreds of thousands, that’s not small.
Especially since the Immortal Fate Order itself carries significant meaning; it’s a ’ticket’ to the Upper Immortal Realm.
