For this reason, all twelve Immortal Kings of Celestial Pavilion were alarmed.
The question before them was simple — to sell or not to sell?
"We can sell, but not too many."
"If we sell them all to him, Celestial Pavilion will incur the displeasure of the entire Middle Immortal World."
"This could negatively impact our other businesses."
The first to speak was Du Chen Immortal King, the head president of the Middle Immortal World, who has been an Immortal King for billions of years. He’s a true antique, with unfathomable power.
His words received agreement from many Immortal Kings.
"Indeed, selling all the Immortal Fate Orders to one party will offend too many people."
"Moreover, bringing a group of people without any cultivation talent up there contradicts the original intention of the Upper Immortal Realm selecting elites..."
However, there were opposing voices.
Ji Ming Immortal King, who oversees the daily affairs of Celestial Pavilion, shook his head.
"You’re overthinking it, with so many Immortal Fate Orders, no one can hold onto them forever."
"By the final decade, they will inevitably be stolen and divided."
"Things will be as they should be, and the Immortal Fate Orders will eventually end up in the hands of those meant to have them."
"Whether ten thousand people each buy one, or one person buys tens of thousands, we earn the same, there’s no difference."
"Selling to one party is still a sale, isn’t it?"
"If we arbitrarily change the rules and refuse to sell, that would actually ruin our reputation!"
His words also received nods of agreement from many elders.
But Du Chen Immortal King still held his ground.
"I believe that the ancestor of the Feixian Sect is not foolish, he should know that he can’t hold onto so many Immortal Fate Orders."
"Yet he still spent a fortune to buy them."
"Why is he doing this?"
"Such unusual behavior must have a secret agenda behind it!"
"If we agree to sell to him, we are essentially assisting him in completing that unknown plan."
Ji Ming Immortal King was indifferent.
"No matter what schemes he’s plotting, it has nothing to do with us!"
The two sides quickly began to debate.
Sitting at the top, Miao Yu just listened quietly, as she was the one who would make the final decision.
It wasn’t until both sides had argued sufficiently that she finally spoke.
"This person definitely has a hidden agenda."
"But as a business, we shouldn’t refuse trade without reason."
"Coincidentally, the Enlightenment Immortal Tree is about to reappear, and we could use the sale of the Immortal Fate Orders as goodwill to gain his cooperation."
"This..."
"The Enlightenment Immortal Tree?"
Upon hearing these four words, the Immortal Kings present all showed unusual expressions.
The originally most vehemently opposed Du Chen Immortal King was silent.
He’d been in seclusion for fifty million years, and the Immortal Fate Orders, sold once every hundred thousand years, couldn’t have disturbed him.
The main reason for his choice to exit seclusion was indeed the Enlightenment Immortal Tree’s emergence.
This is a once-in-fifty-million-years opportunity, of great significance to every Immortal King.
Ye Yang Immortal King was the first to express approval: "This person already has 12 Immortal King Level experts by his side. If he is willing to cooperate, it’ll be a huge help to us!"
Ji Ming Immortal King also said: "Having allies can help us go further during the Enlightenment Immortal Tree journey!"
"Indeed, those 12 by his side are not to be underestimated; they are immensely useful!"
"Xiao Kun Demon King and Immortal King Wu Jue’s power could very well be second only to the president!"
"They are definitely strong reinforcements!"
Finally, Du Chen Immortal King nodded.
"We can consider it."
Three days later, Miao Yu arrived once more at the Danhua City branch.
"Currently, there are 303,621 Immortal Fate Orders across all Celestial Pavilion branches. Are you sure you want them all?"
After the last meeting, she thought there wouldn’t be another opportunity to meet.
Looking at the overly beautiful female immortal in front of him, Brother Cheng smiled and nodded.
"That’s right, if you have more, that would be even better!"
Even 300,000 isn’t enough to satisfy his appetite?
The few people in the room were speechless.
Honestly, even the Three Great Corpse Kings, Wu Jue, Mingchi, and other Immortal Kings behind him didn’t understand why he wanted so many.
Miao Yu, of course, understood even less.
But she also knew Jiang Cheng definitely wouldn’t answer.
"You want too many, it’s difficult for us."
"Really?"
Brother Cheng stood up, this was indeed what he was most worried about.
Having Immortal Crystals but no one willing to sell, he was at a loss.
"Your Celestial Pavilion doesn’t seem to limit the number of purchases, you won’t even earn money?"
Miao Yu said calmly: "Selling all these Immortal Fate Orders to one person does pose great risks and criticisms for Celestial Pavilion."
Brother Cheng shrugged and sat back down.
"So, are you setting conditions?"
"Then just say it directly."
Miao Yu looked him straight in the eye and spoke slowly: "We want an opportunity for cooperation with you!"
"What kind of cooperation?"
"The Enlightenment Immortal Tree!"
Brother Cheng was taken aback, looking confused.
"What Enlightenment Immortal Tree?"
This reaction caught Miao Yu off guard.
She had considered Jiang Cheng possibly refusing, or readily agreeing, or negotiating terms, but never expected his ignorance.
In the Middle Immortal Realm, anyone with some knowledge and status should know about the Enlightenment Immortal Tree, right?
He, who had dealings with 12 Immortal Kings, seemed like a long-standing figure; how could he possibly have no idea?
But soon, he heard Immortal King Wu Jue quickly explaining to Jiang Cheng.
"Sect Leader Jiang might not know, the so-called Enlightenment Immortal Tree is a major opportunity for all Immortal Kings."
"It greatly helps in shaping the Immortal Country!"
"It happens once every fifty million years, I went there last time but, regrettably, couldn’t enter..."
"Entering the Enlightenment Immortal Tree requires a certain level of power."
"And it’s said in that tree world, there will be further competition, so some Immortal Kings choose to join forces."
Seemingly understanding, Brother Cheng nodded: "So that’s how it is!"
Miao Yu was speechless.
So, before this, he truly didn’t know at all?
What on earth is this person?
He seems to have an unimaginably large background, yet lacks even such basic knowledge?
Realizing the other party needed him, Brother Cheng immediately found his footing.
"Our people definitely can’t show up for nothing, right?"
He smiled, rubbing his fingers together: "Since you need us, shouldn’t the Immortal Fate Orders be free?"

chapters.title: Chapter 319: Giving Brother Cheng Some Face
chapters.content:
Chapter 319: Chapter 319: Giving Brother Cheng Some Face
Free?
How could this person even say that?
Miao Yu nearly wanted to slice open his face with a sword to see just how thick-skinned he was.
Over 300,000 Immortal Fate Orders, a total of over 30 billion top-grade Immortal Crystals!
This was a huge amount even for the Celestial Pavilion.
How could he just brush it off with a few words and expect it to be free?
She frowned and said, "Sect Leader Jiang, let’s not make such jokes."
"In the Enlightenment Immortal Tree, your people will also need our strength!"
"It’s not just us who need you; it’s a mutual accomplishment. I hope you understand."
Brother Cheng didn’t like hearing that!
What do you mean, mutual accomplishment?
He leaned forward close to Miao Yu’s face, leaving this peerless beauty momentarily unsure of his intentions.
Then Brother Cheng cupped his hand over his mouth and whispered sneakily, "I’ll tell you a secret: actually, I’m very powerful. I can solo carry any instance."
"By moving with me, you won’t even need to lift a finger. Just lie back and relax."
"So, actually, I’m the one making a one-sided effort, and it’s unreasonable for you to not offer some compensation."
Although Miao Yu didn’t quite understand some terms, she grasped the meaning.
She couldn’t help but find it both amusing and exasperating.
What’s the point of whispering like that?
Everyone here is an Immortal King; do you think lowering your voice means they can’t hear?
And you think you can solo carry just because you say so?
Moments ago, you hadn’t even heard of the ’Enlightenment Immortal Tree’, let alone know what’s inside!
Lead with what, huh?
Do you take me for a fool?
There were so many points to complain about that she didn’t even know where to start.
She could only suppress the urge to insult and asked back meaningfully.
"You’re very powerful?"
When it came to saving money, Brother Cheng’s attitude was unprecedentedly serious: "Very powerful! Beyond your imagination!"
"Heh..."
Miao Yu’s lips curved slightly, looking amused yet not: "The Enlightenment Immortal Tree can only be accessed by Immortal Kings."
"Don’t you know that?"
Alright, fine, you’re powerful, but you can’t even get in!
Without an Immortal Country, it’s impossible to survive inside the Enlightenment Immortal Tree.
You’re not even an Immortal King; do you think I don’t know?
As soon as she said this, Mingchi, Liuyuan, Wu Jue, and the others’ faces all changed.
Indeed, they had just realized this point!
They too were eagerly anticipating the Enlightenment Immortal Tree.
After all, it was almost considered a place for Immortal Kings to change their fates.
Just now, when they heard Sect Leader Jiang talk about solo carrying, they were quite excited.
Being able to hang onto his coattails was truly lucky; staying in the Middle Immortal Realm was the wisest choice.
But thinking about it now, he had slain an Immortal Emperor!
Clearly, his realm wasn’t below that of an Immortal Emperor.
And an Immortal Emperor, having merged with the rules and becoming an embodiment of a rule, couldn’t enter the Enlightenment Immortal Tree either!
While one side thought he hadn’t reached the level of an Immortal King, the other thought he surpassed an Immortal King, but the ultimate conclusion was the same.
The Enlightenment Immortal Tree is a unique opportunity for the likes of Immortal Kings and Demon Kings.
This made Brother Cheng quite embarrassed.
"Only Immortal Kings can enter?"
Want to solo carry but can’t even get a chance?
Facing his questioning gaze, Zhan Yan Corpse King nodded: "Sect Leader Jiang, what she said is true."
Realizing they couldn’t hang onto his coattails, Mingchi, Liuyuan, Wu Jue, and the others could only sigh again and again.
"What are we going to do about this?"
"Yes, it’s such a shame, especially after finally returning to Sect Leader Jiang’s side."
"Sigh, if only he could enter, then we wouldn’t have to worry about anything."
"Why do you even need to say that?"
Their words left Miao Yu and Ye Yang Immortal King quite surprised.
Judging from what these Immortal Kings said, if he could enter, would he really play a significant role?
Jiang Cheng always talked at a different rhythm, and Miao Yu didn’t quite believe him.
But these Immortal Kings were famous for tens of millions of years, some entering the Enlightenment Immortal Tree five million years ago, clearly not people who would speak nonsense.
Could it be that this person truly had some outstanding qualities?
No matter how she looked, she couldn’t see it.
"Ah..."
Brother Cheng let out a long sigh; it seemed he’d have to find a way to achieve the Immortal King Realm sooner.
Setting aside that small disappointment, he rallied his spirits and continued negotiating.
"Ahem, even if I can’t enter, the eight people around me plus Xiao Kun, Jiyun, those four, a total of 12 people can enter, right?"
Miao Yu nodded: "That’s correct."
"So we’re cooperating, we’re allies, right?"
"Yes."
That indeed made them allies.
"Since we’re allies, you still have the nerve to charge me money? Even if it’s not free, you should give a discount, right?"
Brother Cheng made his final effort: "I’ll take a loss here, let’s say 50% off, how about that?"
He wasn’t originally so obsessed with price haggling, nor was he not able to afford it.
But having talked about it being free right from the start, with the price unchanged and the other side not budging, left him feeling like he lost face.
No matter what, even a tiny 99.999% discount, even if it just saved one Immortal Crystal, would at least give Brother Cheng some face, wouldn’t it?
When you’re out and about, face is very important; this is a matter of principle!
Miao Yu shook her head and said calmly, "Sect Leader Jiang, I hope you understand, there has never been a precedent for Immortal Fate Orders to decrease in price since the first round!"
"Then let this time be the precedent!"
Brother Cheng glanced back at the several Immortal Kings behind him, spreading his hands in regret.
"Being so unfeeling towards allies, I can’t help but doubt your sincerity in cooperation."
"I can’t guarantee that, upon entering, they won’t choose to slack off."
Damn, is this a threat?
You can say something like this to someone’s face?
Are you even human?
You can’t even enter and still want to remote control them or something?
Miao Yu really felt like hitting him.
If she hadn’t been through so much and had excellent self-control, she would’ve probably resorted to cursing.
"Sect Leader Jiang, collaborating like this is meaningless."
Brother Cheng immediately countered.
"I find you Celestial Pavilion quite meaningless; wasn’t there no restriction on purchase numbers before? It was you who first used this to block me, and what risk and pressure you bear has nothing to do with me!"
The Immortal Kings present had to admit, he really had a point.
It was actually the Celestial Pavilion that first broke the principle.
After a tug-of-war of back-and-forth negotiations, both sides actually agreed on a price with an 80% discount.
303,621 Immortal Fate Orders, each reduced from 100,000 to 80,000.
Yuan Sheng, Yuan Shu, and the others were dumbfounded.
The Grandfather Master really was formidable; in front of him, even the dignified Celestial Pavilion chose to back down.
The Immortal Fate Order, which hadn’t dropped in price for a hundred million years, was slashed by over 6 billion top-grade Immortal Crystals because of him!
"Wishing us a pleasant cooperation!"
The amount of Immortal Crystals saved was a minor matter; the key was that face was restored.
Brother Cheng was in a good mood and extended his right hand with a smile.
Miao Yu had never seen this handshake gesture either, and having been taken advantage of, she wasn’t in a pleasant mood at all.
She frowned and gave a half-hearted grip before turning away without saying a word.
Watching her leave, Brother Cheng still unwittingly added a comment from behind.
"Beauty, you’ll find out later that this is the wisest decision you’ve made."
Despite Miao Yu’s usually calm demeanor, her fair and delicate hands couldn’t help but clench into fists.

chapters.title: Chapter 320: Innate Dao Foundation
chapters.content:
Chapter 320: Chapter 320: Innate Dao Foundation
The Middle Immortal Realm is vast, even though the Celestial Pavilion has its own Transmission Array, gathering these 300,000 Immortal Fate Orders will still take several days.
Fortunately, the appearance of the Enlightenment Immortal Tree also requires some time.
Brother Cheng and his entourage settled down in the Celestial Pavilion.
As soon as the negotiations ended, he sent someone to summon Xiao Kun, Jiyun, and those four.
At the same time, he gathered several Immortal Kings around him.
"What exactly is the situation with that Enlightenment Immortal Tree?"
Miao Yu was willing to cooperate with him even at a 20% discount, clearly suggesting the benefits of the Enlightenment Immortal Tree are immense.
With such benefits, Brother Cheng’s eyes sparkled.
The Three Great Corpse Kings and Mingchi, Wu Jue, and others quickly explained to him.
Establishing one’s own Immortal Country is a hallmark of achieving Immortal King status.
The more perfected the Immortal Country, the stronger the Immortal King’s power.
The vast majority of Immortal Kings’ Immortal Countries can’t even be called a world; they are merely chaotic, dangerous alternate spaces.
While powerful Immortal Kings have Immortal Countries that already contain the prototype of a world.
For instance, the starry skies of the Jiyun Immortal King were already evolving towards a real Immortal Country.
The reason for this disparity, apart from different degrees of rule mastery, is the low level of the Innate Dao Foundation of the Immortal Country.
Rules can be slowly understood and elevated.
But the level of the Innate Dao Foundation is fixed from the moment the Immortal Country is established.
To put it bluntly, some Immortal Countries are innately deficient from the moment of their birth, making it impossible to develop as well as others.
The Innate Dao Foundation determines each Immortal Country’s future limit.
It is so important yet cannot be improved through cultivation, only changed by accidental opportunity.
No matter how intensely and long an Immortal King cultivates, the upper limit is set, and the ultimate achievement will not be particularly strong...
The Enlightenment Immortal Tree is the great opportunity that changes the Innate Dao Foundation.
This tree forms a world of its own, appearing once every fifty million years, existing for eighty-one years each time it appears.
After eighty-one years, it once again vanishes into the void. To encounter it again, one must wait another fifty million years.
During those eighty-one years, those who have reached the Immortal King Realm have the chance to enter the Immortal Tree and be nourished by the World Origin within the tree.
Thus, elevating the level of their Innate Dao Foundation and increasing their Immortal Country’s upper limit.
Through these introductions, Brother Cheng learned that Innate Dao Foundations are divided into eight levels: Mustard Seed, Sumeru, Extraordinary, Dustless, Feather Transformation, Ascension, Profound Mystery, Divine Communication.
The lowest is the Mustard Seed level. The Immortal Countries constructed at this level of Dao Foundation, even at maximum development, can only slightly exceed the power wielded by a Daoist Heart.
However, being an Immortal Country, it can still easily defeat an Immortal Venerable.
The Immortal Kings at this level are actually quite rare; to become an Immortal King with such a poor innate start is itself a miracle.
At the Sumeru level, Immortal Countries already transcend the concept of space; as long as there is enough Immortal Power to develop it, it can expand almost infinitely.
But at this level, only the most primitive Power of Rules exists within the Immortal Country, without even a speck of dust, and lacking any concept of true substance.
The last time Brother Cheng defeated nine Immortal Kings, seven were at the Sumeru level.
Their Immortal Countries were empty.
Immortal Countries at the Extraordinary level can develop real entities, but the interior is extremely chaotic.
While the Dustless level can construct the true prototype of a world.
For example, the Jiyun Immortal King and Xiao Kun Demon King have Dustless level Innate Dao Foundations.
They have only been immortal kings for tens of millions of years, still considered newly appointed compared to other kings with billions or tens of billions of years.
But because their upper limit is set, Ye Yang Immortal King immediately knows he is no match.
Immortal Countries with Feather Transformation level Innate Dao Foundations, when fully developed, contain self-sustaining and endless cycles of various Powers of Rules, no longer like water without a source.
Such Immortal Countries can easily defeat two or three Immortal Kings at the Extraordinary Realm during battles.
To become an Immortal Emperor in the future, the minimum requirement is to have a Feather Transformation level Immortal Country.
As for the last three levels, they are typically obtained when breaking through to Immortal Emperor, rebuilding foundations.
It is said that the Profound Mystery level Dao Foundation, when fully developed, can transcend the concept of time and exist eternally.
Their introduction opened Brother Cheng’s eyes wide.
He couldn’t help but ask curiously: "So, what level are your Innate Dao Foundations?"
Immortal King Wu Jue stroked the three strands of black beard under his chin with a slightly proud smile: "Although during the last manifestation of the Enlightenment Immortal Tree, the old one had no fate to enter..."
"But my Innate Dao Foundation was Dustless level from the start!"
The others covertly criticized him in their hearts, this guy is really showing off.
Just to get Sect Leader Jiang’s praise, he deliberately used a ’although... but’ phrase. Only you can?
However, Immortal King Wu Jue was destined to be disappointed.
Brother Cheng currently has no concept of the difficulty involved with this thing.
His understanding is quite superficial; there are eight levels, and you are only at the fourth level?
He had no idea that the Dustless level is already considered an exceptionally rare talent among many Immortal Kings.
Especially since Wu Jue himself has never entered the Enlightenment Immortal Tree, making him even more extraordinary.
It’s not an exaggeration to say that if he were in the Upper Immortal Realm, there would be many Immortal Emperors eager to recruit him.
"What about you few?"
The faces of the other few were somewhat unnatural.
"Cough..."
Immortal King Jingyu awkwardly coughed lightly: "Reporting to Sect Leader Jiang, I’m at the Extraordinary level, just a bit less than him, though I’ve never been into the Enlightenment Immortal Tree either, so who’s strong and who’s weak in the future isn’t certain..."
Starting at Extraordinary is already quite rare, but this Wu Jue guy already threw out Dustless from the start.
And Sect Leader Jiang doesn’t seem particularly impressed by Dustless.
Immortal King Jingyu, feeling ashamed, could only insist on ’future potential’ to forcefully salvage respect for himself.
Another She Lan Demon King quickly and vaguely said with his head lowered: "I also have an Extraordinary level Innate Dao Foundation."
The Three Great Corpse Kings also gloomily said: "We are the same as him."
Wu Jue deliberately shot a sidelong glance at these four, expressing disdain: "You four entered the Enlightenment Immortal Tree once fifty million years ago, and still are merely Extraordinary?"
Having failed to receive praise, he now opted to demean the others, trying to elevate his own stature in Sect Leader Jiang’s mind.
She Lan Demon King and the Three Great Corpse Kings raged!
"Wu Jue, what do you mean?"
"In front of Sect Leader Jiang, how dare you, a petty person, stir trouble?"
"We will rid him of treacherous elements on his behalf!"
Brother Cheng quickly separated both sides: "Alright, alright..."
"You’re all quite good."
He perfunctorily responded, lacking sincerity, and didn’t bother asking Mingchi and Liuyuan any further.
Seeing the embarrassed expressions of those two, it’s clear they’re likely still at the Sumeru level—people aren’t easy to expose!
Once back in his room, Brother Cheng began pondering the major task of advancing to Immortal King.
The recent explanation from those eight made him a bit worried. Although the initial level of the Innate Foundation does relate somewhat to Talent, it’s not the entirety.
Nobody can clearly explain the specific rules.
Some people are the most talented at the Immortal Venerable stage, yet their final Immortal Country might still fall short of others.
Could it be random?
If, after becoming an Immortal King, he’s only at the Extraordinary to Dustless level, how could he face others?
He must advance to Immortal King as soon as possible, seize this repair opportunity; waiting another fifty million years isn’t an option.
Thus, he opened the mall, exchanging all remaining Merit for Immortal Pills.

chapters.title: Chapter 321 321: This Makes No Sense
chapters.content:
For anyone, ascending to Immortal King is an extremely challenging hurdle.
No one dares say they will surely succeed before ascending.
Except for the confident Brother Cheng.
All the Main Rules are at Perfection Level, Martial Dao Enlightenment has long reached Immortal King Level, Immortal Soul quality surpasses Ten Thousand Ancient Level, his talents can't even be described by "thick accumulation and thin hair."
Not to mention he also has the strongest Chaos Demon Body and Immortal Body.
What he's lacking is just that bit of accumulation in cultivation.
After consuming all the pills exchanged for one hundred thousand merit points, he has pushed from Ninth-grade Immortal Venerable to the extreme peak of Immortal Venerable, ahead lies the hurdle to enter Immortal King.
The Daoist Heart keeps spinning, gradually sublimating into a mist, then continuously expands.
At this time, a starry sky reflection already appears within his Immortal Soul.
It's not a real existence but a magical omen.
Brother Cheng's heart slightly relaxes.
Those few Immortal Kings just now have educated him on the Innate Dao Foundation.
Seeing a starry sky reflection before the Immortal Country forms means the final achievement of the Immortal Country is at least at the Dustless Level!
Dustless is at least not lower than those few people.
Following this, all stars in the starry sky reflection shine brightly, vitality blooming...
Wipe, isn't this at least the Feather Transformation Level?
Brother Cheng is delighted!
The entire process looks very smooth, with an extraordinarily grand momentum.
If it weren't for the Celestial Pavilion's Immortal Array isolation, it would surely attract countless onlookers.
However, at the moment the Immortal Country is about to form, he encounters a situation.
Establishing an Immortal Country requires an item as the core.
Without a vessel, the Daoist Heart has nothing to rely on, and the Immortal Country simply cannot truly form.
Brother Cheng was busy with other matters and forgot about this.
But fortunately, it's still not too late now.
Without hesitation, he summoned the Tier Nine Immortal Sword, Rainbow Extreme.
This Immortal Artifact is coveted by countless people, even in the Upper Immortal Realm, it would still cause innumerable battles.
But in his eyes, it doesn't mean much.
Even because it snatched the limelight several times, it doesn't quite please him.
So using it as the core doesn't make him feel any hesitation.
When using a treasure, use the most valuable one; otherwise, how can it match Brother Cheng's status?
The turbulent Immortal Country is like clouds parting to see the sun, a dazzling Immortal Sword slowly descending, the mist formed by the Dao Heart quickly surrounding it and continuously spinning.
Getting faster and faster, the Immortal Sword appears intermittently.
Seemingly about to succeed, the entire Immortal Country suddenly trembles violently, the Immortal Sword flashes and disappears, being rejected!
Because the vessel didn't match his Daoist Heart completely, the fusion process failed this time.
Luckily, after the failure, the Immortal Sword returned to his hand undamaged.
He didn't really suffer any loss.
What...
What's going on?
Brother Cheng was stunned, not quite reacting.
This even includes a failure?
Wasn't it said that any vessel would work?
Even a blade of grass, a tree, a sand particle, a stone, and even a wisp of void intention or emotion could do, and naturally, a Magical Treasure should work too.
Could it be that the Tier Nine Immortal Sword is too high level?
He hasn't heard of such a saying.
Helpless, he could only try something cheaper, casually selecting a Top-grade Immortal Crystal and placing it at the core of the Immortal Country, also quite casual.
This time it failed even faster than before.
After the Immortal Crystal went in, not even a second passed, and it was immediately rejected.
"Wipe, this doesn't work either?"
In the following time, Brother Cheng tried at least hundreds of different vessels.
Ranging from Tier Seven Immortal Artifact, Tier Six Immortal Artifact, Top-Grade Magical Treasure, Immortal Treasure Ten Thousand First Illusion Immortal Bottle...
To Tier One Immortal Artifact, Sacred Artifact, Spiritual Artifact, Heavenly and Earthly Treasures, Immortal Pill, Spirit Pill, Array Disc, Spirit Stone, tables and chairs in the room, wood strips, cloth pieces, stones, water droplets, hair, body hair...
Besides this, he also tried void intention, memories, enlightenment...
Yet, none of them succeeded.
He's truly a peculiarity, failing so many times, yet the unformed Immortal Country surprisingly can be forcibly maintained without collapsing.
Until finally finding nothing else to try, he reluctantly stopped the breakthrough process.
Without a core, maintaining that half-completed Immortal Country was quite laborious.
"Where did it go wrong exactly?"
Brother Cheng couldn't understand!
"This big brother has such great talent!"
"Everywhere is a spotlight-filled protagonist!"
"And with the system cheat open!"
"Most importantly, unparalleled handsomeness..."
"This makes no sense, shouldn't someone as outstanding as me be insulated from failure?"
He stroked his chin, pondering for half a day, finally arriving at only one conclusion.
"Could it be jealousy of talent?"
Brother Cheng eventually decided to find a beauty for consultation.
Knock knock knock!
Miao Yu, hearing the knock on the door, had already sensed Sect Leader Jiang outside the door.
Isn't the cooperation deal settled, could it be that this person is still not satisfied?
She couldn't help but furrow her brows.
After entering, Brother Cheng glanced around, discovering no one else in the large room, he then relaxed.
"Miss Miao..."
The two sat facing each other, Miao Yu's expression as calm as water.
"My surname isn't Miao."
"Alright Miss Yu, I have something I want to ask you."
Faced with this person, she could only give up on this naming issue.
"What do you want to ask?"
"I want to ask you about the requirements for the vessel needed for ascending to Immortal King, is there something special about it?"
His decision to consult Miao Yu about ascending matters was out of options.
Immortal King Wu Jue and the Three Great Corpse Kings all worship him as the Immortal Emperor; asking them about how to ascend to Immortal King would be too ridiculous!
Miao Yu is different, she knows he's not yet Immortal King, so there's no embarrassment.
Most importantly, even Ye Yang Immortal King takes orders from her, so surely this woman knows a lot.
"You just failed to ascend to Immortal King?"
Miao Yu actually felt quite speechless.
Why do you come to me for advice so confidently?
Are we that familiar?
Although there is a temporary alliance cooperation, even true allies aren't close enough to discuss cultivation, right?
She immediately saw that Jiang Cheng's aura had strengthened significantly compared to before.
Yet still hasn't broken through that limit.
"That's right, I failed."
"It's normal; Immortal King isn't so easy to succeed."
"Indeed."
Brother Cheng spread his hands: "I tried many vessels, but all were rejected, truly inexplicable..."
"You said what?"
Miao Yu suddenly raised her voice, her previously indifferent expression now serious.
"You said you failed because the vessel was rejected?"
Brother Cheng nodded, silently criticizing her for the loudness; are you mocking me on purpose?
"How is that possible..."
Miao Yu slowly got up, her graceful figure carrying a breathtaking beauty.
She walked slowly to the window, silent for a long time, then suddenly turned back to ask.
"Do you know what this situation implies?"
"Imply what?"
"It implies that those vessels are too low in rank, mismatched with your Main Rules, unworthy of being their core."
Her eyes that spoke seemed to penetrate Brother Cheng's heart.
"With less than 15 Main Rules, this situation wouldn't occur."
"And you said you tried various vessels and all failed; then your Main Rules must be over 20?"

chapters.title: Chapter 322 322: About 900 or so
chapters.content:
Miao Yu couldn't help but be shocked.
Her knowledge indeed far surpassed other Immortal Kings, but it was precisely because she knew more that she understood the significance behind this.
The number of Main Rules was fixed at the moment the Holy Sanctuary forms.
There's no possibility of increasing it thereafter.
Even if one conducts more profound research on other rules later on, they will always remain Secondary Rules.
Because of this reason, many Great Powers in the Immortal Realm deliberately let their juniors stay at Ascending to Saint Ninth Layer for millions of years.
Only when their life span is almost exhausted do they allow them to breakthrough to Saint Tier.
The aim is to accumulate and subsequently soar, hoping that at the moment of achieving the Holy Sanctuary, they can possess as many Main Rules as possible.
Even gaining just one more would be a huge advantage when becoming an Immortal, Immortal Venerable, Immortal King, or Immortal Emperor!
The typical Saint Tier has only three to five Main Rules.
A peerless genius could very well have nine or ten.
Elite cultivators like those who stand out among billions of cultivators in a Domain like Gui Cang Void Abyss often boast a dozen or more.
And those blessed with grand fortunes, the Child of the Plane, have a significant chance of reaching over fifteen.
It's only geniuses with an extraordinary number of Main Rules who might encounter the phenomenon of their chosen objects being rejected.
"There's no innate ranking among the chosen objects themselves."
"Immortals with less than 15 Main Rules have no requirements regarding their chosen objects, they can succeed no matter what they select."
"Most people's Main Rules won't reach 15, hence the saying that they can pick anything and succeed."
"But actually, Immortals whose Main Rules exceed 15 are exceptions."
"Their Daoist Heart is too complex and grand, ordinary objects cannot support such a powerful Daoist Heart."
"The more Main Rules, the higher the requirements for the chosen object."
Miao Yu had never imagined she'd patiently explain 'popular science' to someone one day.
But Jiang Cheng's situation just explained was too astonishing, had he failed many times?
What does that signify?
Fifteen Main Rules might succeed after one or two tries, failing many times means he far exceeds 15.
This person's foundation is surprisingly profound!
She found it hard to believe!
Brother Cheng initially felt quite embarrassed.
Upon hearing her explanation, he realized that failure carried an aspect of prestige?
Observing the shock in the beautiful lady's eyes in front of him, he couldn't help but feel a sense of loneliness.
Ah, unintentionally he acted cool again.
"Hahaha, you flatter me…"
"Then may I ask how to resolve this?"
I didn't praise you!
Miao Yu forcibly resisted the urge to ridicule and continued, "To avoid failure, you should utilize cultivating objects."
She didn't hold back, as it's actually quite easy to resolve.
Brother Cheng expressed surprise, "Cultivating objects? Spiritual Artifact or Immortal Artifact?"
"Yes, Heavenly and Earthly Treasures, Pills, Magical Treasures all work."
"Did you previously use mortal objects? Actually, just using a Spiritual Artifact would definitely succeed."
"I've tried Spiritual Artifacts, neither Tier One nor Tier Nine worked."
"Tried?"
Miao Yu was once again shocked.
Being unable to succeed even with Spiritual Artifacts was unheard of!
How many Main Rules does he have?
Surely over 50!
How is that possible?
How can one person have so many Main Rules?
"Then you could try using Immortal Artifacts."
"Immortal Artifacts don't work either…"
"What?"
Miao Yu was completely unable to stay calm!
"You must be joking, how many Main Rules do you actually have?"
Main Rules are not discernible on the surface.
Even in direct combat, one can only perceive the opponent's Daoist Heart is very powerful, not see the exact number.
Unless the opponent actively displays their Daoist Heart.
Brother Cheng decided to strive once again to act impressively.
So he took a deep breath and said deliberately, "Not many, just over 900."
After saying this, he secretly anticipated the reaction of the beauty before him.
Miao Yu, who had been immensely shocked, suddenly calmed down, even frowned, displaying a trace of displeasure.
"Sect Leader Jiang, do you think I'm easy to amuse?"
Her tone turned cold and distant.
She was foolish enough to actually believe he had dozens of Main Rules just now.
Upon reflection, seeing no process, his words were empty.
He claims to have failed, did he really fail?
Just boasting?
Brother Cheng felt frustrated, having acted too grandly, others wouldn't believe it.
"I really have over 900!"
Because his Daoist Heart had exalted while breaking through to Immortal King Level, he genuinely couldn't show it to the woman.
Miao Yu just assumed he was insulting her intelligence and straightforwardly chased him out.
"If you want to joke, find someone else. I still need to cultivate, please leave!"
After speaking, she sat back on the cultivating platform in the room, her long eyelashes fell as she closed her eyes.
Brother Cheng wasn't very disappointed, after all, asking Miao Yu led to identifying the crux of the issue.
According to her, failure is possible with 15 Main Rules.
Then exceeding a hundred and eighty, perhaps only Immortal Artifacts can meet the requirements.
What about 992?
No wonder even the Tier Nine Immortal Sword, Rainbow Extreme, wasn't enough.
It appears to find a treasure even more advanced than the Tier Nine Immortal Sword, then can his Immortal Country form!
Afterwards, both parties remained peaceful for several days.
Xiao Kun, Jiyun, and three other experts, upon Sect Leader Jiang's summons, rushed to assemble.
Upon hearing this journey was for the Enlightenment Immortal Tree, the four were overjoyed and elated.
"Hahaha, Sect Leader Jiang certainly hasn't forgotten us!"
"Yet again venturing alongside Sect Leader Jiang!"
"With him around, our Immortal Country may be elevated…"
"That's for sure!"
Nearby, Immortal King Wu Jue said leisurely, "Have you thought too beautifully? Don't forget, he's long surpassed Immortal Emperor Level, fundamentally can't enter the Enlightenment Immortal Tree!"
The four's expressions changed.
It seemed they only recalled this point just now.
But soon, Xiao Kun laughed, "Wu Jue, you're really ill-informed, I believe other Immortal Emperors can't enter, but Sect Leader Jiang, I truly doubt it!"
"Is there anything he can't accomplish?"
With what he said, the other eleven exchanged glances, quickly relaxed their brows.
Indeed, Sect Leader Jiang was born for miracles!
Brother Cheng thought to himself, why is your confidence in me greater than my own?
These few days, he tried numerous times again, still unable to find an object suitable for his Daoist Heart.
As the day the Enlightenment Immortal Tree would appear drew nearer, he truly felt uncertain.
Ten days later, Immortal Fate Orders requisitioned from various places arrived.
All thirty thousand plus Immortal Fate Orders arrived, and Brother Cheng paid in Top-grade Immortal Crystals, completing this transaction.
Next, the remaining eleven Immortal Kings from the Celestial Pavilion also arrived successively.
"There's still one month until the Enlightenment Immortal Tree emerges, time to set off!"
Miao Yu noticed, he still hadn't successfully advanced to Immortal King Level.
"Sect Leader Jiang, do you really want to go together?"
"Of course! Without me there, you all won't get far!"
Xiao Kun, Jiyun, Wu Jue, and others nodded in agreement.
As for the Immortal Kings from the Celestial Pavilion, they showed a look of dismay.
Eventually, Brother Cheng didn't return to Feixian Sect this time.
With all the Immortal Fate Orders, he, Miao Yu, and the other 24 Immortal King Level experts boarded the Celestial Pavilion's Transmission Array together.

chapters.title: Chapter 323 Emperor Moon Celestial Realm
chapters.content:
Chapter 323: Chapter 323 Emperor Moon Celestial Realm
The Enlightenment Immortal Tree is located at the outskirts of the Middle Immortal Realm, outside the three great celestial domains of Gen Mountain, Emperor Moon, and Golden Cauldron.
The location is fixed and does not change.
In fact, this tree is not within the boundaries of the Middle Immortal Realm; it just happens to be the closest to it.
Except for the 81-year period of its appearance, it can’t be seen nor touched at other times.
Throughout the journey, the transmission array and flying ships kept changing, and the trip was quite smooth.
After all, this was a ship full of Immortal Kings and Demon Kings; they were essentially the top figures of the Middle Immortal Realm.
Twenty days later, they finally arrived at the Emperor Moon Celestial Domain.
Brother Cheng was unaware of how many moons existed in this world, much like the Emperor Moon Celestial Domain itself, which resembled a bright moon.
Upon arrival, the Immortal Yuan Qi became very thin, yet the power of moonlight enveloped them completely.
"This is the Moon Race’s territory."
"Moon Race people are very exclusive, seldom interacting with the outside world. The entrance we chose last time was also here."
Xiao Kun and Jiyun had entered last time, and could be considered experienced guides.
The Enlightenment Immortal Tree is located beyond the outskirts of the Middle Immortal Realm, in a chaotic and dangerous zone where nothing below Immortal Emperor can survive.
So despite the tree’s size, one cannot simply fly in from any direction.
To enter the tree, one must pass through its tendrils.
When the Enlightenment Immortal Tree appears, three tendrils will connect to the three great celestial domains.
These three locations thus become three fixed and safe entrances.
The entrance to the Emperor Moon Celestial Domain is guarded by the Moon Race people.
Others wishing to enter must gain their permission.
"These Moon Race people are pretty impressive; they actually guard this fat piece of meat."
Brother Cheng now understood the rules.
The entrance on Gen Mountain Celestial Domain allows 301 people, Golden Cauldron Celestial Domain only allows 161, and the Emperor Moon Celestial Domain allows 271.
Once this number is reached, the tendrils of the Enlightenment Immortal Tree will vanish.
No matter how powerful those behind are, they cannot enter.
There are only 733 slots, and while the exact number of Immortal Kings in the Middle Immortal Realm isn’t known, it’s definitely not less than a thousand.
It’s noteworthy that after the Immortal Realm split into three, the Upper Immortal Realm does not have an entrance to the Enlightenment Immortal Tree.
Over the hundreds of millions of years, many Immortal Kings purposely remained in the Middle Immortal Realm instead of ascending, largely because of the opportunity granted once every fifty million years by the Enlightenment Immortal Tree.
For them, the innate foundation is extremely important, and they wouldn’t miss it.
When the time comes, the entrances of the three celestial domains will gather all the Immortal Kings of the Middle Immortal Realm.
It’s inevitable that some will not be able to enter.
Such an important entrance is bound to draw a lot of competition.
Without some power, it really wouldn’t be possible to hold it.
Xiao Kun Demon King laughed heartily: "Sect Leader Jiang, you may not know, the Moon Race isn’t powerful; they only have two Immortal Kings."
Brother Cheng was surprised: "Then how do they hold onto this entrance?"
Two Immortal Kings sitting here would be considered a force at the large sect level.
But to fend off the covetous eyes of so many outside Immortal Kings, it’s truly far from enough.
Xiao Kun continued to explain: "The Moon Race’s entrance is a natural Sacrificial Moon Sacred Land, where only Immortal Kings with the Moon Race bloodline can open it."
"It does no good for others to seize it."
Immortal King Wu Jue added: "Six million years ago, someone once attacked, but the Moon Race withdrew without fighting, completely retreating from the Emperor Moon Celestial Domain."
"Then when the fifty million-year period arrived, without the Moon Race Immortal Kings, the entrance simply couldn’t be opened."
"Seeing that it was about to be missed, everyone became anxious."
"In the end, it developed into hundreds of Immortal Kings respectfully inviting them, not only speaking good words, but even helping them eliminate the Immortal Kings who attacked the Emperor Moon Celestial Domain."
"Only then did they finally invite them back to reopen the entrance."
"Since then, no one dared to meddle with the Moon Race."
"Really this pretentious?"
Brother Cheng curled his lips: "Why didn’t anyone just kidnap their people and use them as hostages to coerce compliance?"
Xiao Kun and Shari Demon King subtly gave a thumbs-up — Boss, this idea truly matches our demon cultivator tastes.
Jiyun sighed: "That’s because the Moon Race does not possess the same seven emotions as us; they completely don’t care about the life and death of other members."
"What about the other two entrances?"
"The other two entrances aren’t like this; they are jointly controlled by several Ancient Immortal Sects and Demon Sects, entirely occupied based on power."
Brother Cheng couldn’t help but muse: "Others fight until they bleed broken, yet the Moon Race is doing well, relying on Heaven’s generosity for a meal."
The experts from Celestial Pavilion nearby were quite speechless.
This person is so lacking in common knowledge that he just learned these things today?
Miao Yu had no choice but to transmit her voice over: "Now that we’re in the Moon Race’s territory, such talk might displease them, so please pay attention to your words and actions later, Sect Leader Jiang."
What?
Even have to watch other’s expressions?
Brother Cheng’s mind began to wander.
The Emperor Moon Celestial Domain is vast, but the Moon Race’s population is sparse; along the way, hardly any cities or sect gates are seen.
Occasionally, one can see a few Moon Race people; their physical build is similar to normal people.
But their faces are transparent, seemingly wrapped in a soft thin membrane, revealing even their skeleton and meridians clearly.
This obviously didn’t match Brother Cheng’s aesthetic taste; he lost interest after a couple of glances.
They flew all the way to the Moon Race’s core area, the Moon Immortal Palace, where Miao Yu and the twelve Immortal Kings from Celestial Pavilion descended and switched to walking.
As a ’newbie’, although feeling bewildered, Brother Cheng still obediently followed their example.
He casually asked: "Why can’t we fly?"
Miao Yu once again transmitted her voice to explain: "The Moon Immortal Palace is a crucial place for the Moon Race, flying here is seen as disrespectful to them."
"What happens if we’re disrespectful?"
"Then you won’t enter the Enlightenment Immortal Tree!"
Seeing Brother Cheng had more questions, Miao Yu directly cut him off with transmission.
"Sect Leader Jiang, I understand you might have substantial background."
She earnestly remarked: "But I also hope you can see the current situation clearly; the entrance to the Emperor Moon Celestial Domain can only be opened by the Moon Race, the initiative is in their hands."
"On the day it opens, they decide who gets to enter."
"I believe you wouldn’t want to miss this opportunity due to some unnecessary reasons."
Brother Cheng asked with interest: "Then why don’t you choose the other two entrances in the celestial domains?"
Continuing forward, Miao Yu was silent for a moment, then said softly: "Those two entrances have formed the Immortal Demon camps; unless you’re willing to join their factions and gain their recognition."
"Otherwise, you can’t enter either."
"The grudges between those Ancient Immortal Sects and Demon Sects in those camps are longstanding, even in the Upper Immortal Realm, it’s no exception. It’s a deep whirlpool."
Celestial Pavilion is, after all, a commerce association known for neutrality, so joining either of the Immortal Demon camps would severely violate their stance.
While the two were transmitting sound, the group finally reached the barrier edge of the Moon Immortal Palace.
A Moon Race man, only at the Profound Immortal Realm, glanced expressionlessly at the crowd.
"From Celestial Pavilion?"
Miao Yu nodded: "That’s correct."
"Celestial Pavilion totals 12 Immortal Kings. Who are the other miscellaneous people?"

chapters.title: Chapter 324: The Privileged Moon Race
chapters.content:
Chapter 324: Chapter 324: The Privileged Moon Race
Damn, riffraff?
Brother Cheng almost laughed out loud at that comment.
He’s not blaming the Moon Race for being disrespectful; it’s surprising they didn’t send anyone important to greet him.
A Profound Immortal, acting all high and mighty in front of a bunch of Immortal Kings and Demon Kings?
Not expecting groveling or trembling, but he should recognize the gap, right?
Where does he get off calling people thousands of times stronger than himself riffraff?
Who’s given him the courage?
Knowing his fiery temper, having taken down nine Immortal Kings before, Ye Yang Immortal King hastily picked up the conversation.
"They are our allies, planning to go inside together this time."
"This is Elder Jiang, and this is Xiao Kun Demon King..."
Before he finished, the Moon Race’s Profound Immortal interrupted him.
"Enough, I don’t care who they are."
"With 13 extra people, you need to offer more tribute, otherwise no entry."
Another fee?
Brother Cheng touched the hilt of his sword, it seems a bit of intimidation might be necessary.
Then, Ye Yang Immortal King interjected again.
"We’ve been prepared."
He handed over a Storage Ring, and the other Profound Immortal glanced at it, finally nodding.
Brother Cheng secretly used his High-level Advanced Insight to look at the ring.
Inside was actually 1.3 billion Top-grade Immortal Crystals and thirteen bottles of Seventh-grade Immortal Pills!
Holy crap, this is daylight robbery!
He shot a surprised look at Miao Yu, this woman is quite generous.
She quietly paid this for me?
Thinking about it, she really is thoughtful and considerate.
Even though he knew her intention was to avoid trouble, he couldn’t ignore this gesture.
Since she’s so worried about mishaps, he decided to give her some face.
The group was then led by the Profound Immortal into Moon Immortal Palace.
Along the way, they saw some other Moon Race Profound Immortals and Golden Immortals, but none above Immortal Venerable.
If not knowing Moon Race has two Immortal Kings, Sect Leader Jiang would think this is a non-distinguished small sect.
Through twisted and turn corridors shining bright and ornate, they eventually arrived at a common courtyard behind Moon Immortal Palace.
The Profound Immortal left without a word of explanation.
"Alright, stay inside."
"Ten days from now, when the opening occurs, the Moon Race will hold a selection assembly."
"Try not to wander and avoid unforeseen occurrences during this time."
Ye Yang Immortal King’s gaze almost never left Brother Cheng as he spoke.
Clearly, he’s been marked as the one to closely watch!
Even the two Demon Kings from the Ghost Alliance are more rule-abiding than him.
Later, the Immortal Kings from Celestial Pavilion found their places within the courtyard.
Brother Cheng looked quite dumbstruck.
Is this it?
Clearly, Moon God Palace is massive with grand, luxurious halls, yet they deliberately place us in this low and rundown courtyard?
Seriously, they are dignified Immortal Kings!
Though Immortals have little need for food and accommodation, this placement surely counts as humiliating, right?
"When others come, they stay here too."
"It’s not a deliberate targeting against us."
Miao Yu left those words and went into her room on her own.
Brother Cheng could only sigh once again.
Girlie, I’m holding it in painfully, just for you!
As soon as he entered the room, Xiao Kun, Jiyun, Mingchi and the other twelve followed him.
"Sect Leader Jiang, what’s your plan?"
"If you decide to level the Moon Race, we’re right behind you!"
This group is different.
Thinking back to when they just arrived in the Immortal Realm, everyone thought to bear with it initially, and what happened?
Sect Leader Jiang got temperamental, and everyone ended up enjoying the good life immediately.
Ascension Platform with fifty times the Power of Rules, gaining the glory of being first in the Ascension Battle upon entering the Middle Immortal Realm—that’s truly satisfying!
Following him, there’s no need to follow the regular path, right?
"Whatever you say, we’ll do, even if it means opposing the entire Middle Immortal Realm!"
Brother Cheng consoled them with a wave: "Let’s observe a few days first, I don’t even know the situation at the entrance yet."
"But this Moon Race is really arrogant."
As soon as he mentioned this, Immortal King Wu Jue started complaining: "Who says otherwise?"
"The last time opened, I wanted access to the Enlightenment Immortal Tree from here, but ended up shut out because I didn’t bring enough tribute."
"It’s infuriating thinking back!"
"Made me waste fifty million years!"
Jingyu Immortal King sternly snorted: "You were lucky, I managed to pay my tribute and get in, but was eliminated at the selection assembly."
"That was truly suffocating; back then, I wanted to wipe them out!"
"Really?"
Brother Cheng found himself struggling to keep up with Moon Race’s pace.
"Pay but can’t board?"
"There were a lot of people, altogether 271 slots from Moon Race, but 400 Immortal Kings showed up, many were cut."
"Do they refund?"
"Refund my ass, just our misfortune!"
"That’s just too shady, aren’t they afraid of causing brawls?"
Brother Cheng remarked this seems even more arrogant than himself.
Though he’s eliminated many, when it comes to principles, he adheres, like reciprocating after accepting others’ benefits.
Xiao Kun smiled wryly and spread his hands: "There’s no choice, they have the edge, opening cannot happen without them, everyone needs them."
Zhan Yan also nodded: "Indeed, fifty million years ago there were dissatisfaction."
"Ended with others rallying without needing Moon Race to act themselves."
Brother Cheng figured it out.
This Moon Race appears to be a protected species now.
Due to the Immortal Tree entrance, no one can touch them, instead, they’re pampered.
"What’s that selection assembly about?"
"It happens when too many people attend on the opening day, requiring some eliminations."
"How are candidates determined, are there any standards?"
"None, fully dependent on Moon Race’s mood."
"Damn!"
Brother Cheng couldn’t help but curse.
No wonder Miao Yu and Ye Yang Immortal King were cautious not to offend Moon Race along the way, wielding life and death authority!
With time passing, more and more Immortal Kings entered Moon Immortal Palace.
By the last day, even neighboring areas filled up.
Every arriving Immortal King made everyone’s hearts sink.
Each one is a competitor, indirectly reducing one’s chance to enter!
Every arriving Immortal King and Demon King remained very restrained, not only avoiding conflict but also barely visiting.
No help for it, everyone feared affecting Moon Race’s mood.
Leading to final rejection.
One day, on the dark edge of the Celestial Domain, a lush towering giant tree quietly emerged.
Though far from the Middle Immortal Realm, it’s still too vast to see an end.
Branches and leaves layered endlessly, as if it’s truly a colossal world.
Even before touching it, its immense and dreamy aura easily stirred hearts and souls!
Just one glimpse and Brother Cheng sensed his unformed Immortal Country begin stirring, becoming active.
At this moment, he truly understood the tree’s significance.
"This Enlightenment Immortal Tree must be entered!"

chapters.title: Chapter 325: Rewarding Good and Punishing Evil Here?
chapters.content:
Chapter 325: Chapter 325: Rewarding Good and Punishing Evil Here?
No one can say for sure how far the boundless Enlightenment Immortal Tree has extended.
However, there indeed has been a change in the Moon Immortal Palace.
At the center of the Immortal Palace, a green beam shoots up into the sky, where a faintly visible tendril seems to spiral upwards, akin to a path to the heavens.
"The Immortal Tree has emerged!"
All Immortal Kings emerged from their quarters, gazing longingly at the green beam’s location.
"The selection tournament is about to begin!"
"Don’t rush, we must wait for the Moon Race to summon us. Rushing over carelessly would offend them!"
Thus, all the Immortal Kings stood where they were.
Despite feeling anxious, eager to enter immediately, they patiently waited.
Brother Cheng felt like laughing, wondering why the whole situation seemed so ridiculous?
The Moon Race won’t change unless they’re dealt with.
He had a plan, so instead of being angry, he found the situation amusing.
At this time, there were altogether 422 Immortal Kings and Demon Kings present!
Such a large group of orderly Immortal Kings was quite a spectacle, wasn’t it?
A full quarter hour later, the Moon Race finally arrived, rather leisurely.
This time the ’appearance’ was grander, accompanied by an Immortal Venerable and two Golden Immortals.
"Stand properly and proceed in order!"
"Anyone making noise will be harshly punished and immediately expelled!"
Faced with so many Immortal Kings and Demon Kings, the Moon Race people remained mysteriously confident and overwhelmingly superior.
Many Immortal Kings and Demon Kings had a fleeting hint of murderous intent in their eyes.
How could these people truly be so obedient? Not even an Immortal Emperor could suppress so many people, let alone a mere Immortal Venerable.
If not for the chance with the Immortal Tree, who would pretend to be servile?
Brother Cheng was also at the back of the line, joyfully watching everyone advance in unison, finding the scene strangely absurd.
He even discreetly summoned a Transmission Immortal Artifact to record the scene, so he could watch it repeatedly when bored in the future.
After another quarter hour, the procession finally reached the central high platform of the Moon Immortal Palace.
Here lay the Sacrificial Moon Sacred Land, linking to the entrance of the Enlightenment Immortal Tree.
The entire high platform was enveloped in green light, dazzlingly splendid.
Two Moon Race Immortal Kings hovered above the high platform, looking indifferently down at everyone present.
As if they were gods, and everyone else mere mortals.
A male and female Moon Race Immortal Venerable flew out from the sides, landing just in front of the two Immortal Kings.
"The entrance selection tournament for the Enlightenment Immortal Tree begins!"
Unlike Brother Cheng’s relaxed mood, everyone else immediately became tense.
With 271 spots, those two Moon Race Immortal Kings would surely take two.
The remaining 422 people would vie for 269 spots, leaving 153 people to be mercilessly eliminated.
Many felt anxious; failing to be selected meant waiting another 50 million years for another chance.
And even then, who could guarantee entry next time?
If they remained unselected each time, they’d eventually lag far behind other Immortal Kings.
A spot of white light gradually brightened before the two Immortal Venerables, who simultaneously waved, pulling out a long scroll-shaped Magical Treasure from the void.
Before Brother Cheng could understand what this was, the male Immortal Venerable began to read from the scroll.
"Puman, Si He, Xishui..."
He read out sixteen names in total, each belonging to an Immortal King or Demon King.
"You have protected the vicinity of the Emperor Moon Celestial Realm for the past fifty million years, serving the Moon Race."
"You may enter this time and next time as well!"
As soon as he spoke, sixteen Immortal Kings flew out from the crowd, landing at the white jade steps below the high platform.
Each could not hide their excitement, their faces overflowing with joy, as if they’d won a lottery.
Not only were they selected, but they would also be automatically selected for the next 50-million-year term.
The rest below sighed in envy and regret.
If only they had stayed near the Moon Race selling favors for the last fifty million years!
"Di Gu, Yun Zhen, Fu Xuan..."
"You seven have been kind to my Moon Race people over the past fifty million years."
"You may enter this time and next time as well."
Seven more Immortal Kings flew to the steps, under the blazing gaze of everyone else.
Brother Cheng privately mocked that the scene resembled elementary school students going on stage to receive certificates.
Also, wasn’t it said that the Moon Race had no Seven Emotions?
Yet they cared about whether their people were treated well?
"Miao Yu, Du Chen, Ye Yang..."
All thirteen from the Celestial Pavilion were named, but their expressions were rather calm, as if they never worried about not going in from the start.
"For fifty million years, the Celestial Pavilion has upheld its neutral principles, setting an example in the Middle Immortal Realm!"
"You thirteen may enter this time and next time as well!"
The surrounding people cast envious, jealous, and hateful glances again, even including Brother Cheng among their scrutiny.
With each ascent, the chances for those below grew slimmer.
At this moment, many Immortal Kings felt as if their hearts were being scratched anxiously, eager to hear their name next.
However, after the Celestial Pavilion people ascended the steps, the male Immortal Venerable closed his mouth.
Then, the female Immortal Venerable beside him spoke.
"Rewards are complete!"
"Ju Tang, 35 million years ago, our Moon Race people suffered injustice in your Profound Master Celestial Domain, you’re guilty!"
"You may not enter!"
An Immortal King in the crowd turned pale, flew into the air, and repeatedly cried out: "It’s unfair. I knew nothing about it. The Profound Master Celestial Domain isn’t entirely under my Bi Shang Academy!"
With an icy expression, the female Immortal Venerable coldly said: "Flying unauthorized in the Moon Immortal Palace adds to your offenses. Don’t come in fifty million years either!"
The blood drained almost entirely from Ju Tang Immortal King’s face, and he descended as if struck by lightning, grieving, daring not utter another word.
"Ji Lu, your Fuyou Valley refused entry to our Moon Race people, you’re guilty!"
"You may not enter!"
A female demon, with a beautiful face, turned white upon hearing this, wanting to say something.
Fuyou Valley is her kin’s core forbidden land, even her own Demon Venerable allows only a few high-ranking members in, let alone a foreign race?
Just let them in?
Ultimately, she simply sighed deeply.
As the Moon Race female Immortal Venerable continued naming offenders, one Immortal King after another was struck down.
At this point, people’s mood was entirely opposite to before.
Previously, they envied those named; now they feared being named themselves.
Brother Cheng exclaimed they’re experts!
Darn, the Moon Race knows how to play, engaging in ’rewarding virtue and punishing vice’ here?
Do they truly fancy themselves the Middle Immortal Realm’s arbitration committee?
But isn’t their reward and punishment system a bit too arbitrary?
There’s no standard of good or evil.
If you’re favored, you enter; if not liked, you’re penalized, unrelated to these people’s usual actions, good or bad, loyal or treacherous.
While he internally criticized, the female Immortal Venerable named others.
"Xiao Kun, Shali, Hua Yin, Jiyun, Wu Jue, Mingchi..."
"You twelve spoke disrespectfully within the Moon Immortal Palace, you’re guilty!"
"You may not enter!"
Well, the brothers were all gloriously named.
Looks like there really was ’surveillance’ inside the Moon Immortal Palace; everything said in Brother Cheng’s room was fully heard by them.
Because of that conversation, they were all taken out.
Watching everyone around cast glances in unison, Brother Cheng inexplicably envied those brothers, finding their situation rather prominent.

chapters.title: Chapter 326: Seriously Underestimating Me
chapters.content:
Chapter 326: Chapter 326: Seriously Underestimating Me
Miao Yu and Ye Yang, along with the others on the stairs, were getting anxious.
Xiao Kun, Jiyun, and the rest were allies that the Celestial Pavilion had brought in this time. After entering the Immortal Tree, they would need to rely on their strength.
Being eliminated for such inexplicable reasons was really ridiculous, wasn’t it?
Miao Yu had to speak up.
"Moon Crow Immortal King, isn’t this too strict?"
"They’re my friends; could you give them a pass?"
A Moon Race Immortal King above listened but remained expressionless, coldly spitting out two words.
"No way."
Miao Yu’s lips were still moving, clearly trying to bargain through sound transmission.
But the Moon Crow Immortal King above just shook his head.
"The results of the selection conference are sacred and cannot be violated!"
"If you say any more, there’s no need for the Celestial Pavilion to enter."
With this, Miao Yu could only reluctantly give up.
As the remaining unnamed Immortal Kings on the scene felt a shiver up their spines, they couldn’t help but feel a bit gloat-worthy.
After all, twelve competitors were suddenly eliminated.
To them, these twelve people must be filled with regret and heartache.
Who would have thought that in the next moment, Xiao Kun grinned and rubbed his hands towards Brother Cheng.
"Sect Leader Jiang, aren’t we starting yet?"
Immortal King Wu Jue also chuckled, "If you need us to cooperate in any way, just give us a heads-up!"
"You must not be able to swallow this anger, right?"
Although Brother Cheng hadn’t said anything yet, they didn’t believe for a second that this brother would be sitting quietly.
He’s definitely going to stir things up.
So they’re not worried about not getting in, because with him around, there’ll definitely be some gains.
"Xiao Kun, Wu Jue, Shali, your words and actions are inappropriate. Your punishment is increased; you won’t be needed in the next round either."
Poof!
Brother Cheng directly burst out laughing.
"How do you all dare to laugh after being eliminated? You should be crying, look how dissatisfied people are..."
Before he could finish his words, he was also called out.
"Elder Jiang of the Feixian Sect, you have illegally collected 3,300 Immortal Fate Orders, violating the rules of the Middle Immortal Realm. Guilty!"
They didn’t know Sect Leader Jiang’s real name, but Brother Cheng’s record seemed rather long.
"Additionally, since entering the Emperor Moon Celestial Realm, you have been disrespectful seven times, adding to your guilt!"
"The Thunder Immortal King you previously killed had a past with our Moon Race; your crime is unforgivable!"
"You are permanently banned from entering!"
Who was the Thunder Immortal King?
Brother Cheng had no impression at all; he must have been one of the nine Immortal Kings killed during the last attack on the Feixian Sect, right?
Anyway, he didn’t ask for names when he went to war that time.
After a moment of surprise, he laughed aloud.
"Hahaha!"
Then he flew into the sky, happily cupped his hands towards everyone present.
"Hello everyone, I am Elder Jiang, who was just named!"
"Nice to meet you!"
Nice to meet my foot?
Everyone looked speechless, having no strength to retort.
You’ve been permanently banned from entering, how can you still be so pleased?
How could they know, Brother Cheng only cared about whether the spotlight was enough on him, nothing else mattered.
Look at those who were eliminated, they can’t enter this time.
Even if they’re formidable, they can’t enter next time either.
Only he can never enter!
What’s this called?
This is called being unique, one of a kind!
He felt extremely proud!
Before anyone could follow his train of thought, he opened the ring filled with all the Immortal Fate Orders.
"Hey, your Moon Race intelligence is lacking."
"My Immortal Fate Orders are 300,000, not 3,000, okay?"
"You really underestimate me..."
In an instant, 306,921 Immortal Fate Orders were revealed to everyone!
Each one glowed brightly, radiating an extraordinary aura.
For a moment, everyone almost went crazy.
Even though the Moon Race had a prohibition against noise initially, no one could hold it in at this moment.
The entire crowd erupted in chaos.
Even the two Moon Race Immortal Kings trembled.
And the other Immortal and Demon Kings were dazzled.
"Oh my gosh!"
"How can there be so many?"
"Is this person crazy? Where did he get so many Immortal Fate Orders?"
"He must have bought them, didn’t you see him come with the Celestial Pavilion?"
"This almost wiped out more than seventy percent of the Middle Immortal Realm’s Immortal Fate Orders, right?"
"Seventy percent, you estimate less, it’s at least ninety percent!"
"Is this person eager to die?"
Miao Yu and Du Chen, Ye Yang, and the others were also stunned; they never dreamed Jiang Cheng would publicly show his Immortal Fate Orders.
And in front of more than 400 Immortal Kings.
What on earth is going on, bro?
Xiao Kun, Shali, Jiyun, and the others also couldn’t guess what Brother Cheng wanted to do, only thinking that his elder always acted unpredictably.
This move could not be explained by common sense.
No one rushed to snatch the 300,000 plus Immortal Fate Orders.
Because it wasn’t necessary.
This item would become the target of countless people in the last decade, but taking it now was futile.
Furthermore, they needed to maintain their state for entering the Enlightenment Immortal Tree and didn’t want to start a fight here.
And Brother Cheng smoothly collected a massive amount of Shock Value, earning as much as 550,000 of Merit Points!
No choice, there were over 400 Immortal Kings present with high realms.
Although pulling out 300,000 Immortal Fate Orders didn’t cause an earth-shattering shock, Brother Cheng’s objective was already achieved.
Last time, he used all his Merit Points to reach Immortal King; now he needed merit again.
Then he quickly opened the System Mall, under the bloodline category.
He searched and found the Moon Race bloodline.
Priced at 1 Merit Point for 5 drops, much cheaper than the Azure Dragon Essence Blood.
That’s right; this was Brother Cheng’s plan.
Isn’t it said that only the Moon Race bloodline can open it?
This Moon Race bloodline was far less than the Azure Dragon’s; it only took 800 drops of essence blood to reach full level.
In the blink of an eye, he possessed all the Moon Race’s talents and divine techniques!
At this moment, there was only one natural choice left for him: to rush onto the high platform and replace the Moon Race as the controller of the Immortal Tree’s entrance!
However, Brother Cheng stopped.
He opened the system panel and another skill—Time Reversal.
This brother’s train of thought was indeed different; he suddenly thought of exploiting a glitch.
At this critical moment, an idea popped into his mind: according to the system’s Time Reversal rules, he would retain his current state when going back in time.
In other words, already acquired Merit and bloodlines wouldn’t disappear with the reversal.
If he reverses time back now and then shows the 300,000 Immortal Fate Orders again, wouldn’t everyone be shocked once more?
Then it’s another 550,000 of merit!
And then reverse time again, damn, glitch out enough times, and he could empty the System Mall.
The Time Reversal panel was special, like a video replay progress bar.
Going back a day required 2 Merit Points, going back within the same day only 1 Merit Point, very cheap.
He dragged the progress bar back to the moment he just flew into the sky.
Swoosh, Time Reversal, and everyone once again looked up at him in surprise.

chapters.title: Chapter 327: Profound Sound Burning Moon
chapters.content:
Chapter 327: Chapter 327: Profound Sound Burning Moon
Everything went back to how it was, except for Brother Cheng himself.
Sure enough, he still retained the full-level bloodline of the Moon Race, and the 550,000 Merit Points he earned previously were still there.
Then, without hesitation, he once again displayed more than 300,000 Immortal Fate Orders.
The entire venue burst into an uproar as expected, everyone was shocked.
Unfortunately, he did not gain any Shock Value this time.
"System, what’s happening here? They are clearly shocked!"
Brother Cheng was very dissatisfied.
"Shock events that have been experienced cannot earn Shock Value again!"
The system was also helpless.
This host is lazy when it comes to doing other things but is obsessed with finding shortcuts.
If someone else got the system, wouldn’t they worship it like a golden rule?
Only this guy, from the first day he got the system, has been thinking about how to exploit bugs to save effort.
"Please host, be down-to-earth and don’t always think about loopholes!"
Unable to exploit bugs, Brother Cheng was a bit disappointed.
So, he had to be forced to do serious work and use showing off to soothe his wounded heart.
The next moment, he suddenly flashed onto the high platform!
The audience gasped in shock.
"What are you going to do?"
"Stop him!"
Before anyone could react, he rushed into the inner part of the Sacrificial Moon Sacred Land.
"How did you get in?"
The two Moon Race Immortal Kings did not stop him initially.
Because without the Moon Race bloodline, one simply cannot enter this Sacrificial Moon Sacred Land.
But now, they couldn’t help but be surprised.
With a slight sense, they discovered the Moon Race bloodline on Brother Cheng.
The concentration of that bloodline was actually higher than theirs, forming a natural suppression on them.
"How do you have the Moon Race bloodline?"
"You’re definitely not one of our Moon Race people!"
Although the two Moon Race Immortal Kings were emotionless, the meaning in their words carried a strong disbelief.
And the crowd present also erupted again.
This person actually has the Moon Race bloodline too?
How is this possible?
The Moon Race characteristics are extremely distinct, and Jiang Cheng clearly isn’t, so where did his Moon Race bloodline come from?
"You two obedient grandsons, this is the correct bloodline stance, higher level than yours!"
Brother Cheng disdainfully glanced at the two of them: "Your low-level bloodline power is a path gone astray."
The two Moon Race Immortal Kings were silent, only speaking again after a moment.
"How did you do it?"
"If you tell us, you can enter permanently."
Wow!
The crowd below once again stirred up.
From the sound of it, this person’s Moon Race bloodline is indeed more advanced than the two Moon Race Immortal Kings, making them covetous?
Xiao Kun and Jiyun exchanged glances, after a brief shock, they laughed out loud and flew into the sky.
"Hahaha, I knew Sect Leader Jiang would have tricks up his sleeve!"
"But I truly didn’t expect it to be this kind, always unpredictable as ever..."
"Sect Leader Jiang has created a miracle once again!"
"From now on, this entrance will bear our name!"
Since Sect Leader Jiang has Moon Race bloodline, he can open the entrance himself, no need to plead with the Moon Race!
Not only them, but even the people from the Celestial Pavilion were equally shocked and delighted.
This person is way too miraculous, right?
How did he manage it?
Brother Cheng sneaked a peek at the panel and gained a huge number of Shock Value, a full 420,000 Merit Points.
Indeed, showing off in front of Immortal Kings is totally worth it.
Then, he encountered a situation.
Only the Moon Race Immortal Kings can open this Sacrificial Moon Sacred Land, Brother Cheng wasn’t an Immortal King, but his bloodline level was higher than an Immortal King, so that wasn’t the issue.
The problem was his first time here, he had never opened this Sacred Land before.
So, he didn’t know how to operate it at all.
After using several Moon Race bloodline talent secret techniques, winds surged within the sacrificial altar, but the entrance to the Immortal Tree did not change at all.
Oh shoot, miscalculation.
Looks like this thing still requires specific cultivation technique secret arts from the Moon Race to open!
As expected, the two Moon Race Immortal Kings surrounded him from the left and right.
"Almost got tricked by you."
"Turns out you don’t know the Profound Sound Burning Moon Secret Technique."
"In the end, only we true Moon Race can open this entrance!"
They were indeed frightened just now.
Imagine if Jiang Cheng could really open it, then they wouldn’t be unique anymore, a new competitor would emerge.
At that time, if the Moon Race wanted to manipulate other Immortal Kings like they are now, it wouldn’t be that easy.
If those Immortal Kings couldn’t ask the Moon Race, they could ask Jiang Cheng instead.
Fortunately, Jiang Cheng didn’t know ’Profound Sound Burning Moon.’
The shocked crowd below finally reacted again.
Dozens of Immortal Kings took the initiative to fly up.
"Daring to challenge the noble Moon Race, unforgivable sin!"
"Why trouble the two Immortal Kings to act, let us do it!"
Since Jiang Cheng couldn’t handle this task, they still needed to rely on the Moon Race, these people were very shrewd and thought to grab this chance to curry favor.
Brother Cheng sighed and activated ’Time Reversal’ again.
The next instant, he was back at the moment after showing off the 300,000 Immortal Fate Orders.
At this point, he hadn’t gone on the high platform yet, so no one knew he had the Moon Race bloodline.
The previous events were effectively erased.
Everyone stared at him with their mouths agape, still puzzled about why he bought so many Immortal Fate Orders and even more puzzled about why he self-destructed publicly.
This time Brother Cheng didn’t rush up but flew down instead.
"Sect Leader Jiang, you..."
Xiao Kun and Jiyun were bewildered!
According to Sect Leader Jiang’s style, the act of showing 300,000 Immortal Fate Orders was clearly a prelude to something big.
Why did he come down again?
"Aren’t you going to do something?"
"Do what?"
Brother Cheng’s eyes widened: "All you know is causing trouble all day, so unruly!"
"Yes, yes, yes..."
They were full of question marks, only able to secretly sigh in amazement at how inscrutable this elder was!
Others were equally baffled, even the ’Selection Tournament’ temporarily paused.
Brother Cheng floated up again, raising his hands to calm the crowd.
"Well, I just came out to say hi to everyone, to fulfill your wish of seeing a celebrity."
"Are you satisfied now?"
"What are you still looking at me for, no autographs! That Judgment of Good and Evil, get it going again!"
This statement had too many points for ridicule that everyone was too powerless to critique.
For a moment, many even thought this guy might have gone crazy, being hit too hard by his failure.
And the selection tournament soon resumed.
’Judgment of Good’ had long ended, now it was still the ’Judgment of Evil process.’
One immortal king or demon king was called after another and then brushed off.
Most were eliminated for some inexplicable displeasure caused to the Moon Race, so they either couldn’t get in this time or not until the next time either.
Once the 153rd name was called, the elimination list was finally finalized.
Those left could all go in.
Those not called each sighed in relief, as if surviving a great calamity.
Brother Cheng also sighed in relief, lucky no one else stole his thunder afterward.
At most two years without entry, being permanently barred was still uniquely his!
The main character’s prestige was maintained.
Next, he should watch how those two Moon Race Immortal Kings operate the sacrificial altar.

chapters.title: Chapter 328: Finally Able to Show Off Smoothly
chapters.content:
