Chapter 328: Chapter 328: Finally Able to Show Off Smoothly
Immortal Kings and Demon Kings have already been selected. Along with the Moon Race’s own two Immortal Kings, a group of 271 people ascended the high platform under the envious, jealous, and hateful gazes of the others below.
Xiao Kun, Jiyun, and others were beginning to panic.
Why is Sect Leader Jiang still indifferent? If he doesn’t act soon, it will be too late!
"That..."
Shali Demon King just started to speak but was interrupted by Brother Cheng.
"Watch closely."
He came back to learn that ’Profound Sound Burning Moon’ Secret Technique, and now it’s a crucial moment.
The two Moon Race Immortal Kings didn’t disappoint him.
One of them entered the altar and, following a specific ritual, activated the Moon Race’s cultivation technique.
Immediately, a blood-red moon slowly rose from within the altar, looking both eerie and startling.
When the red power of moonlight filled the altar, a circular void appeared, as if it corresponded to another unknown space.
On the other side of that space was a tentacle of the Immortal Tree.
The entrance was opened just like that?
This simple?
In fact, of course, it wasn’t simple. Without the Moon Race’s Sacrificial Moon Sacred Land, the Immortal Tree’s tentacle wouldn’t have manifested.
Similarly, the entrances of those other two Celestial Domains are not ordinary places.
Moreover, without the Moon Race bloodline, one cannot practice the Moon Race’s cultivation technique, especially since this is an Immortal King Secret Technique.
But for Brother Cheng, none of this is a problem.
He opened the system panel and then clicked on the ’Borrow’ skill.
He then targeted the borrowing towards the Immortal King.
In the next moment, all the skills the Immortal King mastered were displayed on the panel in detail.
Moreover, each one had a price tag beside it.
The borrowing fee for the Profound Sound Burning Moon skill was 10 merit points.
It could be borrowed for 1 day.
And if one wanted to make it a permanent skill of their own, it would require 150 merit points.
Brother Cheng thought about it and felt a permanent option was more stable.
What if he needs it again in the future?
He clicked to use the skill, and in the next instant, he mastered the ’Profound Sound Burning Moon Secret Technique’, with comprehension identical to that of the Immortal King up above.
At this point, the ten-plus Immortal Kings at the forefront had already entered the Immortal Tree through the entrance.
Among those eliminated below, some shook their heads and chose to leave.
Watching any further would only increase inner resentment and dissatisfaction.
Brother Cheng deliberately waited with wicked amusement until everyone on the platform had cheerfully entered the entrance before he opened ’Time Reversal’ again.
"Everyone, come back!"
He pulled the progress bar, specifically selecting the moment when the list of 271 people was confirmed.
Time reversed; those 269 people were planning to ascend the platform, with the crowd below still depressed.
Brother Cheng made a swift move and once again rushed into the altar’s interior with lightning speed.
"What are you going to do?"
"Stop him!"
The reactions of the crowd below were almost the same as before.
The two Moon Race Immortal Kings reacted similarly to before.
"How did you enter the altar?"
"How do you have the Moon Race’s bloodline?"
"I am definitely not a member of your Moon Race, but my bloodline is more advanced than yours. Satisfied?"
Brother Cheng impatiently interrupted them.
"And as for what I’m doing, are you blind?"
"It’s obviously to seize entry control rights!"
He was quite busy; although he had perfectly borrowed the Profound Sound Burning Moon Secret Technique, he hadn’t used it yet.
He discovered the Secret Technique is not instant; it requires accumulating momentum.
Hearing that he also had the Moon Race bloodline, others reacted similarly to before.
Xiao Kun, Jiyun, Wu Jue, and others were as excited as before, cheering loudly that Sect Leader Jiang finally took action!
As for others, they all stopped to watch.
Standing rashly on the side of the Moon Race Immortal King at this point, what if Jiang Cheng did control this entrance?
The two Moon Race Immortal Kings were uncertain and then said, "Do you think having a bloodline can open the Sacrificial Moon Sacred Land?"
"No matter where you got your bloodline, without our Moon Race’s Secret Technique..."
Brother Cheng interrupted them again, "The Secret Technique you’re talking about is the Profound Sound Burning Moon?"
Damn it, with both time reversal and borrowing, he was busier than ever; now he could finally flaunt smoothly again.
With his words falling, a round blood moon slowly rose, making his whole body seem much more ethereal.
The Immortal Tree entrance on the other side of the void slowly opened...
At this moment, he realized the power of the altar.
This altar is currently connected to the Enlightenment Immortal Tree, and it can borrow a portion of the Immortal Tree’s Origin Power.
Whoever controls this place first holds absolute control.
Now, even if those two Moon Race Immortal Kings wanted to reclaim it, they couldn’t, unless they wished to endure the dual attack from the Immortal Tree’s Origin and the altar.
That even Immortal Kings can’t withstand.
"How did you do it?"
"Profound Sound Burning Moon is a Moon Race’s unpassable Secret, not taught to non-Immortal Kings; you couldn’t have learned it..."
The two Moon Race Immortal Kings were genuinely anxious this time.
Apart from them, there’s another person who can open the Immortal Tree entrance, meaning they are no longer the only ones.
If this monopoly can’t be maintained, their once supernal status would instantly plummet.
"You Moon Race are quite the players, huh?"
Brother Cheng smiled, glancing at the two, and teased, "You’ve made the selection tournament quite lively, haven’t you? I’m learning from you now."
"Want to enter the entrance? Beg me."
"Make me happy, and I might consider it."
The two Moon Race Immortal Kings, accustomed to arrogance, have been hailed for so many years that they’ve practically made themselves earthly emperors.
"Dream on."
"Get out!"
Having been emperors, how can one beg?
They couldn’t adjust their mindset.
"Looks like you two bastards still can’t recognize the situation!"
Xiao Kun, Shali, Jiyun, Wu Jue, and others surrounded them with malicious intent.
Besides the consistent admiration for Sect Leader Jiang, all that remained was the satisfaction of venting anger.
The Moon Race had been too arrogant before, causing everyone to hold back a stomach full of anger.
Especially Wu Jue and Jingyu, they were refused entry last time, so one can imagine how much resentment they held!
The two Moon Race Immortal Kings panicked; the situation was unfavorable.
"What do you want to do?"
"Do you never want to enter again..."
Xiao Kun Demon King let out an eerie laugh and was the first to summon the Demon Country, enveloping the entire Moon Immortal Palace!
"Now that Jiang Cheng is here, you are unnecessary!"
"Kill these two bastards!" Wu Jue Immortal King, holding both new and old grudges, also unsheathed his sword.
All the other Immortal Kings present turned pale.
Immediately, dozens of Immortal Kings and Demon Kings flew over, blocking the two Moon Race Immortal Kings.
"Let’s see who dares to act!"
"If you dare to touch the Moon Race, ask us first!"
They had no other choice.
If Xiao Kun, Jiyun, and others were allowed to kill the two Moon Race Immortal Kings, then Jiang Cheng would be the only one who could open the entrance in the future.
What they most wanted to see was the coexistence of the Moon Race and Jiang Cheng, so both compete, neither can monopolize.
"Just you lot?"
"Seek death!"
All twelve of Xiao Kun and others summoned the Immortal Country, killing intent overflowing, completely unconcerned about the disadvantage in numbers.
Brother Cheng was a bit dissatisfied, asking if they knew how to play?

chapters.title: Chapter 329 Sect Leader Jiang Selects Personnel
chapters.content:
Chapter 329: Chapter 329 Sect Leader Jiang Selects Personnel
He shouted from the back: "We’re people of status, getting our hands dirty with two little thieves is beneath us, isn’t it?"
"Yes, yes, yes!"
"Sect Leader Jiang speaks very truthfully."
The twelve experts who were initially intent on fighting immediately restrained their killing intent; Sect Leader Jiang’s words were more effective than a royal decree.
As for the feelings of the others, they no longer mattered.
"Now it’s time for Brother to call some names."
Having secured the entrance for once, Brother Cheng couldn’t miss this chance to show off.
"Let’s play the game of rewarding virtue and punishing vice!"
The whole venue suddenly fell silent.
Everyone finally snapped out of the nearly explosive fight just now, realizing a bigger matter—the previous selection results of the conference were invalid.
Those picked by the Moon Race earlier might not be chosen this time.
All at once, everyone clammed up.
Even the dozen who rushed out to protect the two Immortal Kings of the Moon Race hurriedly retreated, faces full of tension.
Missing this chance would mean waiting fifty million years.
Besides, who knows what the next event entails?
Brother Cheng found their reaction a bit surprising, as this atmosphere was too serious, indeed.
Blame it on the Moon Race’s previous ’training’: a whole set of rules that caused these people to develop conditioned reflexes.
"No need for everyone to be nervous, I’m not big on formalities."
This statement didn’t help at all; it’s a major event for the Immortal Country, and no one dared to be careless.
He glanced at Xiao Kun, Shali, Jiyun, and others, these twelve brothers were his direct lineage subordinates.
"As the moral models of the Middle Immortal Realm, you’re certainly able to get in. To commend your achievements, you can enter permanently!"
And so, he started by granting permanence.
The crowd below was filled with envy, jealousy, and resentment.
What a load of moral models—do they have any achievements? It’s just because they’re his own people, right?
The two Immortal Kings of the Moon Race shifted slightly, obviously unwilling to accept their loss of power, but helpless nonetheless.
On the high platform, Xiao Kun, Jiyun, and others stood tall with pride.
"Hahaha, Sect Leader Jiang flatters us, we’ll definitely work even harder in future and contribute more to the Middle Immortal Realm!"
"We knew you wouldn’t treat us unfairly!"
"Following Sect Leader Jiang means living abundantly!"
Liu Yuan Immortal King, having gained advantage, feigned modesty as he stroked his beard and chuckled: "Permanence, this really makes an old man like me feel embarrassed..."
The other few cast a sideways glance at the old coot: "If you don’t want permanence, just return it to Sect Leader Jiang then."
Liu Yuan puffed his beard and glared: "Sect Leader Jiang granted it, how dare I refuse? That would be disrespecting his old age, wouldn’t it?"
The crowd below was speechless.
Brother Cheng then looked at Miao Yu, Ye Yang Immortal King, and others; the Celestial Pavilion was his ally and hadn’t betrayed him, so naturally there were still spots.
Honestly, the group from Celestial Pavilion was still feeling a bit apprehensive.
This guy never played by the rules—more unpredictable than even the Moon Race. Who knows if he’d suddenly go crazy and intentionally leave them out?
Clearly, Brother Cheng wouldn’t do such a thing.
"Everyone from Celestial Pavilion can enter as well!"
"Moreover, since you helped us pay for thirteen entrance fees earlier, I owe you—I grant you entry for the next thirteen events!"
With these words, not only did the crowd from Celestial Pavilion feel relieved, but they were also overjoyed.
The next thirteen events span six to seven billion years.
This ally... is really reliable.
They no longer thought Sect Leader Jiang was always messing around—this was more than enough!
"Thank you, Sect Leader Jiang!"
"Sect Leader Jiang, we’ll remember this!"
Leading the pack was Miao Yu, whose emotions were extremely complex.
Along the way, she’d always felt Jiang Cheng was a restless factor, especially the Moon Race’s previous selection which validated this view.
The allies gathered all ’failed completely.’
But now, she finally began to understand why Xiao Kun, Wu Jue, Mingchi, and others always respected this man so deeply.
Even though she still didn’t understand how he obtained the Moon Race bloodline and learned Profound Sound Burning Moon.
Yet doing it means doing it.
With this person around, miracles could happen any moment.
After selecting Celestial Pavilion, Brother Cheng wasn’t familiar with the remaining people, all completely unrelated.
Watching the Immortal Kings stretching their necks below, he shouted directly.
"Who were the ones brushed off during the Moon Race selection earlier?"
"Fly up and let me see!"
The crowd below looked at each other, unsure of his intentions.
Previously brushed off, Ju Tang Immortal King, Ji Lu Demon King, and others complied and flew up into the air.
Of the 153 brushed aside, besides the 13 loyal to Brother Cheng, the remaining 140 were evident.
Brother Cheng even asked the few beside him: "Is this the right group?"
Xiao Kun and Shali examined carefully: "Yes, these are them; Sect Leader Jiang intends to..."
"Sigh!"
Brother Cheng sighed deeply, adjusting his expression to one of sorrow and sympathy: "We are all wanderers of the same world!"
"They are all like us, victimized by the Moon Race!"
He widened his arms, declaring resolutely: "Now that the clouds have parted, and the sun shines bright, I cannot tolerate such injustice!"
"All of you, come up!"
As soon as the words came out, the crowd below was in uproar.
Selecting 140 just for this reason—too arbitrary, isn’t it?
What noble souls—can you come up with a more ludicrous reason?
Clearly, you don’t even know each other!
The 140 were first stunned, then ecstatic!
Life’s ups and downs happen too fast; just now their hearts were in the depths.
Suddenly everything reversed.
This caused great emotional shock.
Especially Ji Lu Demon King, whose eyes even reddened.
"Thank you, Sect Leader Jiang!"
"We’ll never forget Sect Leader Jiang’s grace!"
Under the gaze of the crowd, the 140 flew joyously to the high platform, standing firmly beside Sect Leader Jiang.
Brother Cheng deliberately chose the ’Time Reversal’ moment right after the Moon Race’s selection ended, precisely for this reason.
He was indeed good at winning favor.
These who failed earlier have a different mindset.
Having just experienced despair, now he gave them hope—they achieved a redemption, imparting a sense of gratitude.
Unlike the Moon Race, no matter whom they choose, everyone secretly harbors resentment.
spots, 105 still remaining.
Brother Cheng found it troublesome, so he conveniently offered another favor.
"Xiao Kun, Shali, Jiyun, Wu Jue... You twelve have been with me the longest, we’re all close."
"Earlier, being brushed off must have caused great psychological trauma."
Xiao Kun, Wu Jue, and the Three Great Corpse Kings exchanged glances, what trauma?
Was there any?
Though they’re Immortal Kings, being brushed off was annoying but not quite a psychological trauma, right?
Besides, from the start, they expected you’d step in, didn’t even bother about it.
Yet, Jiyun Immortal King reacted fastest, nodding his head vigorously to support.
"Right, right!"
"We experienced great psychological trauma, feeling really bad, even now unstable mentally!"
"Please, Sect Leader Jiang, stand up for us!"
Brother Cheng heartbrokenly patted his chest.
"I understand, I understand, such trauma needs soothing!"
"Next, you twelve each select five, pick anyone you want."

chapters.title: Chapter 330: Brother Cheng, the experienced psychologist
chapters.content:
Chapter 330: Chapter 330: Brother Cheng, the experienced psychologist
What?
We get to choose?
Is the power being given to us?
Xiao Kun and the others were thrilled!
This is about selecting Immortal Kings of their own rank!
Even though everyone silently cursed the Moon Race for being full of themselves during the selection, the feeling of having that power in your own hands is quite exhilarating.
Just think about how those with similar power levels are waiting for you to choose them, how grand would that be?
"Sect Leader Jiang always takes care of us!"
"This opportunity truly soothes the wounds in our hearts, hahaha..."
"We guarantee to complete the task you entrusted to us!"
Xiao Kun and the others headed out and stood before the two Immortal Kings of the Moon Race, showing a playful smile.
"Aren’t you going to wait?"
"Maybe if I’m in a good mood, I might choose you?"
The two Immortal Kings of the Moon Race couldn’t show any expression, though they were definitely displeased.
The two squeezed out two sentences through gritted teeth.
"You won’t be smug for long."
"After this round, you’ll never get in again."
They had been careless this time, allowing Jiang Cheng to first seize the entrance to the Sacrificial Moon Sacred Land.
Thus losing the initiative entirely.
Next time, they wouldn’t be so careless.
Xiao Kun and the others exchanged a glance, revealing an amused expression in mutual understanding.
Being targeted by Sect Leader Jiang, how will you ever turn things around?
Once these 12 stepped down, the remaining Immortal Kings and Demon Kings were itching with anticipation.
They wanted to be chosen but couldn’t bring themselves to ask.
Jiyun glanced around and deliberately sighed.
"Oh, it seems like nobody wants this position."
Immortal King Wu Jue smiled slightly, "Indeed, they’re all so proud and indifferent, treating opportunities like dirt, I’m impressed!"
This statement instantly caused some Immortal Kings to become restless.
They had no choice, this opportunity was too important to them.
They must seize the chance to curry favor!
"Demon King Xiao Kun, do you remember me, 12 million years ago, we met..."
"I have had dealings with your Ghost Alliance!"
"Immortal King Mingchi, back then when you were refining artifacts, I even helped you!"
"Zhan Yan Corpse King, even though we had some issues back then, I’ve been decent to your Soulless Celestial Realm these many million years, right?"
In the blink of an eye, these twelve were surrounded by Immortal Kings.
Since coming to the Middle Immortal Realm, have they ever received such treatment!
Being Immortal Kings, none would yield to another.
Normally, they are opponents or even enemies.
Only Mingchi and Liuyuan, because of their professions in Alchemy and Artifact Refining, are welcomed wherever they go.
But even they couldn’t reach this level of flattery!
The bunch was ecstatic, more accomplished than breaking through a realm.
"Haha, don’t rush, one at a time!"
"You just said we have a connection, why don’t I remember?"
"Oh, Shali old brother, you must have forgotten, do you remember 43 million years ago when the Daoist Blood Treasure of the Red Gauze Celestial Realm opened, and we talked face to face and even exchanged a word..."
"Immortal King Kun, how dare you come and ask me?"
"24 million years ago, when I went to the Abyssal Celestial Realm to gather Tear Leaf Immortal Water, it was just three drops, but you didn’t let me in!"
"I’m sorry, King Jingyu, I was out of my mind back then..."
"From now on, the Abyssal Celestial Realm warmly welcomes you, and the Tear Leaf Immortal Water, however much you need, you can have!"
The audience was suddenly like a marketplace, noisy.
Gazing at Xiao Kun, Jiyun, and others picking people, the Immortal Kings of the Celestial Pavilion were inexplicably a bit envious.
This power, when wielded, is indeed quite satisfying.
Imagine, not even the Immortal Emperor can have so many Immortal Kings ingratiating themselves!
Each of the 12 picked 5 people, and it took a full quarter hour to settle on 60 people.
Those who valued their status and said nothing, Xiao Kun and the others respected their dignity.
So, not a single one was picked.
Now the Immortal Kings who weren’t chosen regretted deeply.
Why did you have to put on airs?
This was actually much easier than before.
These 12 were quite casual in picking people, saying a few nice words and you’d be in. Unlike the Moon Race with their enigmatic rules.
Seeing only 45 spots left, the rest could no longer stay calm.
"Sect Leader Jiang, choose me!"
"Sect Leader Jiang, just say what you need!"
"Exactly, just pick me, and there will be great rewards..."
Brother Cheng knew it was just about time.
Initially, none were chosen, and only Xiao Kun, Jiyun, and others were on his side.
Back then, many were still watching.
If he had acted against the two Moon Race Immortal Kings, it would have triggered a lot of counterattacks.
But now, after choosing over two hundred, the mood was different.
Those chosen, to secure their spots, would firmly stand by him, upholding his authority.
As for those not chosen, seeing the spots dwindle, would grow increasingly anxious.
Their mindset subtly shifted.
Unknowingly, the entire scene was already under his control.
Brother Cheng was quite the master psychologist.
Facing the crowd, he waved his hand, "Forget about future rewards, words are just words, I value actual performance more."
Actual performance?
What can one demonstrate here?
At first, people didn’t understand, but then a few Demon Kings slowly set their eyes on the two Moon Race Immortal Kings.
"How dare you oppose Sect Leader Jiang!"
"Kill them, to vent for Sect Leader Jiang!"
These few Demon Kings were ruthless, directly considering the two Moon Race Immortal Kings as trophies to secure entry.
The Moon Race Immortal Kings panicked.
They never dreamed this would happen.
Today was supposed to be their most glorious day, controlling everyone’s fate.
They even rehearsed for it privately, only to find themselves in hot water now.
"How dare you!"
"If you kill us, the next round..."
These Demon Kings were initially just caught up in the moment, but now their killing intent was truly ignited.
"Next round, Sect Leader Jiang will open the entrance for us, you’re already redundant!"
Thinking of how hateful the Moon Race was before, enduring so much, it was indeed a deep-seated hatred.
"Absolutely not!"
"If they are killed, we will have to rely solely on the one named Jiang in the future..."
Some still kept their wits, hoping to see Brother Cheng and the two Immortal Kings compete to take over in the future, so they hurried to stop it.
But Brother Cheng would not let this happen.
When harshness is needed, be harsh!
This entrance must bear his name alone from now on!
He immediately called out to those Demon Kings: "Your awareness is commendably high, worthy of reward! Whether or not it’s you who finally kill them, you can all enter!"
This encouraging line was pure instigation.
Whoa, you can gain entry just like that?
Those Demon Kings were overjoyed!
The rest of the Immortal Kings couldn’t hold back any longer.
The heads of the two Moon Race Immortal Kings could indeed be used to gain favor?
At this critical moment, who cares about the future, let’s get in today first!
"I’ll do it!"
"Don’t all rush, let me personally behead them..."
"And the other Moon Race members, I’ve long found them disagreeable!"
"The majesty of an Immortal King must not be insulted lightly! Along the way, there were Immortal Venerables and Profound Immortals, deliberately sending some ants to humiliate us, they deserve to die!"
"Exactly, this old ancestor has swallowed a bellyful of anger, kill!"
Once this was said, the scene became chaotic, like a marketplace.
Seeing Xiao Kun, Jiyun, and the others making their selections, the Immortal Kings of the Celestial Pavilion were inexplicably envious.
Exercising this power is indeed uniquely satisfying.
Even an Immortal Emperor couldn’t have so many Immortal Kings buttering him up like this, right?
"""

chapters.title: Chapter 331: Could He Have Died Inside?
chapters.content:
Chapter 331: Chapter 331: Could He Have Died Inside?
The two Immortal Kings of the Moon Race were utterly panicked.
"How dare you..."
"Stop!"
They couldn’t fathom why it turned out this way.
Recalling fifty million years ago, hundreds of Immortal Kings came to invite them, speaking honeyed words and making countless requests.
And over the years, wherever they went, they were treated like Supreme Emperors, enjoying such glory.
But alas, this was not built on power.
It was based on their status as ’protected creatures.’ When they were no longer unique or precious, retaliation and backlash were bound to happen sooner or later.
At this moment, there were still nearly two hundred Immortal Kings below the stage; where could the two of them escape?
Almost in the blink of an eye, their Immortal Country was shattered!
Then a figure soared high, carrying a head towards the stage.
An Immortal King, with his face full of blood, didn’t bother to wipe it off and quickly said, "Sect Leader Jiang, I killed them with my own hands!"
"I have the head as proof!"
Brother Cheng nodded with satisfaction, "Very good, you’ve earned a spot for ten consecutive entries!"
At this, the crowd below went even crazier.
There was a special prize for getting the head?
"Don’t fight over it!"
"Who was protecting the Moon Race earlier?"
"Take them out too!"
In an instant, another Immortal King of the Moon Race was also torn to pieces.
And soon after, the dozen or so Immortal Kings who had been protecting the Moon Race became the focus of collective attacks.
These people had gone mad with killing...
The scene made Miao Yu, Ye Yang Immortal King, and others tremble with fear.
A battle among two hundred Immortal Kings was truly earth-shattering; even if the Immortal Emperor descended, he would have to retreat temporarily.
Blood flowed like rivers in the Moon Immortal Palace, with not a single intact brick or tile left.
Too brutal!
Watching this scene, they couldn’t imagine how a moment ago the entire place had been deathly silent, like cicadas in winter.
At that time, how obedient these Immortal Kings were, not even daring to breathe heavily.
Now they were finally unleashed.
By the time the battle ended, those who had protected the two Moon Race Immortal Kings had been slain on the spot.
The grand and magnificent Moon Immortal Palace had become a bottomless pit, with no living Moon Race people left.
The once-arrogant Moon Race Profound Immortal Golden Immortal Venerables were all killed thoroughly.
Without their ’protective talisman,’ they were revealed for who they truly were, and no one paid them any heed.
Before dying, those accustomed to being high and mighty finally realized their own weakness.
It was all just a matter of an Immortal King casually waving a hand.
Especially those two male and female Venerables who presided over ’rewarding good and punishing evil,’ ordering everyone around, died the most miserably.
No one present didn’t want to kill them; previously, they were just holding back.
In a way, Brother Cheng gave everyone a chance to vent their anger.
Xiao Kun, Wu Jue, and others were convinced.
Sect Leader Jiang really knew how to handle it; there was no need to do it himself to kill those two Moon Race Immortal Kings.
There would naturally be a bunch of people fighting to help.
According to the merits of the battle just now, Sect Leader Jiang selected another group.
At this point, there were only 20 spots left.
However, he hadn’t made a decision yet.
The reason was simple: these people weren’t playing along!
After just taking down two Moon Race Immortal Kings and flattening the Moon Immortal Palace, where were the spoils?
Alright, even if not for the spoils, the entrance fee Miao Yu helped pay earlier should be returned!
He was thrifty and frugal!
"Um, Sect Leader Jiang, I also contributed during the fight, do you see..."
"Me too..."
There were just those few spots left, but more than 150 people were still waiting eagerly.
"Ahem!"
Brother Cheng cleared his throat and said lightly, "About that entrance fee just now..."
As soon as he started, someone immediately caught on and handed over two storage rings.
"Forgetting myself, these were just seized from the Moon Race and haven’t been opened yet!"
In reality, most of the collection of the two Immortal Kings had already scattered into some alternate space.
But the entire Moon Immortal Palace was obviously incredibly wealthy.
How much they had accumulated and plundered over these years was simply incalculable!
Brother Cheng received the rings with great satisfaction, "Haha, you’re very good, come in!"
That Immortal King was overjoyed!
Compared to the two rings, this opportunity was far more precious.
With this example, others immediately followed suit.
"Sect Leader Jiang, I just seized 4 rings too!"
"And I, I raided their Treasure Hall, originally intending to offer it to you!"
Soon, the loot from the Moon Immortal Palace was all turned over to Sect Leader Jiang.
Just by sensing casually, he was overjoyed; there were even more treasures than he imagined.
There were just over ten thousand bottles of seventh-grade Immortal Pills alone.
This time coming to the Emperor Moon Celestial Realm, regardless of what the Enlightenment Immortal Tree might yield, he had already profited greatly.
Soon, the last person was selected, and the group stepped into the entrance.
With Brother Cheng’s entry, the entrance indeed disappeared.
Upon entering the tendril space of the Immortal Tree, Brother Cheng immediately felt a destructive force attacking him.
That feeling was akin to drowning.
No matter how strong his Immortal Demon Body was, he couldn’t resist this penetration.
Subsequently, he straightforwardly died.
On the other side, the other 270 people smoothly passed through the tendrils and entered the Immortal Tree.
At this moment, everyone had activated their Immortal Country, using the Power of Rules to avoid direct projection from the Immortal Tree Origin.
It’s like how ordinary people can’t withstand all the rays of sunlight directly, only absorbing it safely after atmospheric filtering.
Their Immortal Country acted as this protective layer.
The Immortal Tree Origin power, filtered by their Immortal Country, wasn’t as aggressive, subtly enhancing their Innate Foundation layer.
The Enlightenment Immortal Tree was regarded as a unique opportunity for Immortal Kings for this reason.
Inside, they had to keep their Immortal Country activated at all times.
And they could face crises at any moment.
Once stabilized, they looked around and noticed Brother Cheng was absent.
"Where is Sect Leader Jiang?"
"Yes, why isn’t he here?"
"Everyone from the Moon Immortal Palace entrance should have ended up here!"
"Could it be that he forgot to save himself a spot?"
"No, there are only 270 people here, so one is missing!"
Everyone searched around, especially Xiao Kun and Jiyun, who were incredibly anxious.
Although they had entered, they suddenly felt insecure.
Because the thickest leg was gone.
The Celestial Pavilion people frowned as they searched, but Miao Yu instead said softly.
"Did he... die inside?"
"What?"
Mingchi, Wu Jue, and others were furious.
"That’s impossible; he’s incredibly powerful!"
"How can you curse Sect Leader Jiang to die? Has he ever mistreated you?"
Miao Yu shook her head, her perfectly beautiful face remaining calm, as if very little could escape her control.
"I think you have forgotten one thing; he hasn’t reached the level of an Immortal King yet."
"Someone who hasn’t become an Immortal King can’t survive without the protection of an Immortal Country."
"I don’t wish for him to die either, but I hope you recognize reality!"

chapters.title: Chapter 332: I’m covering your retreat
chapters.content:
Chapter 332: Chapter 332: I’m covering your retreat
This...
All the Immortal Kings who were unfamiliar with Brother Cheng were utterly dumbfounded.
What?
The Sect Leader Jiang, who dominated the entire venue, single-handedly overturned the Moon Race’s status, forcing hundreds of Immortal Kings to bow down...
He’s not even an Immortal King himself?
This is just too absurd, right?
Du Chen, Ye Yang, and other Immortal Kings from the Celestial Pavilion were also left speechless.
Brother Cheng’s performance was so explosive just now that they all had forgotten this point.
Well, now it’s...
Such a significant and a magical ally, just died like that?
Thinking about it is quite regrettable.
At this moment, an Immortal King suddenly said weakly, "If Sect Leader Jiang has died, then who will open this entrance in the next term?"
This question hits right at the soul’s depth.
Just now, two Immortal Kings of the Moon Race were killed, and the others have also been completely wiped out.
If Jiang Cheng also died, then...
Really, no one can open this entrance in the next term.
For a while, an unspeakable awkward silence appeared in the venue.
But Xiao Kun and Jiyun Wu Jue and others suddenly breathed a sigh of relief.
What was the big deal!
Sect Leader Jiang can’t possibly be without an Immortal Country, right?
He had even slain Immortal Emperors before, so it’s likely that due to his Realm being so high, reaching the Immortal Emperor Realm that aligns with the Rules, he was autonomously excluded by the Immortal Tree.
He’s just unable to enter, right?
Meanwhile, Brother Cheng unsurprisingly heard the system notification sound.
"Ding, host killed, detecting enemy strength, arranging a resurrection plan."
How did I die?
Did anyone see it?
Just now, I made such a big show, and being killed now is really embarrassing.
He himself actually forgot that the Immortal Kings couldn’t enter this time.
"Ding, the host has obtained an Origin Aura identical to the Enlightenment Immortal Tree."
"Ding, host resurrected."
Once revived, Brother Cheng found himself unchanged.
However, the Power of Origin here no longer harmed him.
Soon, he also appeared at the ’landing point.’
"Oh, Sect Leader Jiang!"
"Why did you just arrive now?"
"Hahaha, we thought you had met with an accident!"
Seeing him, the crowd was both surprised and delighted.
Surprised that he could survive here without opening an Immortal Country.
But considering that this person could miraculously possess the bloodline of the Moon Race, he may have some extraordinary encounters?
Delighted that he wasn’t dead, meaning this entrance can still be opened in the future.
Especially the 140 who were previously eliminated and directly selected by him; they secretly remembered his favor.
Seeing him unharmed, naturally, they were very happy.
Brother Cheng looked up at the sky with his hands behind him, adding a touch of nonchalance.
"What are you all thinking? I just arrived a step late to cover everyone’s retreat. How could someone as handsome as me die?"
The crowd collectively looked at Miao Yu.
Known for her calm demeanor, Fairy Miao was always the epitome of wisdom.
But now, she felt she had never been so embarrassed in her life.
Just seconds ago, she confidently declared Jiang Cheng’s death, urging everyone to face reality.
Yet seconds later, the person appeared alive and kicking right before her.
What else could she say?
She could only continue to maintain her mysterious and calm fairy image.
"Time to set off!"
The crowd also chimed in, "Indeed, time to explore the Immortal Tree!"
The Power of Origin of each area of the Enlightenment Immortal Tree is different.
After entering through the tendril entrance, they were currently positioned at the end of a branch of the Immortal Tree.
This was considered the most peripheral part of the Immortal Tree world, where the quality of the Immortal Tree Origin power was at its lowest.
Every time they entered, the Immortal Kings would explore along the branch toward the central area until they could advance no further.
Because the closer to the main trunk, the greater the benefits.
Having never entered before, Brother Cheng naturally couldn’t express any opinions, so he followed the large group flying forward.
On the journey, he quietly asked Xiao Kun Demon King, "With two hundred plus people together, why does the Celestial Pavilion still want to team up with us?"
"There’s no need for that at all!"
Xiao Kun hurriedly replied, "Sect Leader Jiang might not know, each branch of the Immortal Tree is a natural cultivation area."
"And some people cannot proceed to the next segment."
"So at each fork, some choose to leave and stay behind."
Through his explanation, Brother Cheng understood.
Currently, they were on a branch referred to as the First Realm.
This branch could lead forward to the next segment.
The Power of Origin of that branch is higher in quality than the First Realm, so it’s called the Second Realm.
Continuing along the branch passing forks, they could enter the Third Realm and Fourth Realm.
But due to the increasingly intense Origin further along, some Immortal Kings’ Immortal Countries also couldn’t withstand, so they opted to stop.
The fork located at the intersection of two realms was merely slightly less dense compared to the next realm.
At the same time, the fork was relatively stable, unlike the path that had dangers.
Thus, it became what Xiao Kun referred to as a cultivation area.
He glanced at Miao Yu leading the way in front, who held something resembling a map for reference as she flew.
After all, the First Realm entered each time from the Moon Immortal Palace entrance was the same branch, so predecessors summarized the experience, drawing routes.
After flying for three whole days, the consistent light blue scene abruptly disappeared ahead.
Brother Cheng found himself inside a strange bubble.
The surrounding areas of this bubble glowed pink, enveloping all 271 of them inside.
After entering here, everyone’s Immortal Countries vanished collectively.
They didn’t truly disappear but were unable to be summoned within due to the bubble’s suppression.
At the same time, he felt that his Immortal Power was rapidly depleting.
As if something invisible was extracting his strength.
What’s going on?
Instinctively, Brother Cheng swung a sword towards the bubble’s edge.
A Fire Dragon, carrying the power to swallow the universe, heavily struck the bubble’s edge, causing it to mildly tremble.
Wow, this hard?
Currently on the verge of advancing to Immortal King, using the Tier Nine Immortal Sword with full force, the power can be imagined.
Yet he couldn’t even break the bubble of the First Realm?
Does he need a tenfold critical strike?
Everyone was startled by this blow.
"Sect Leader Jiang’s strike exceeds all expectations!"
"Indeed, if it were us, we couldn’t sway this place at all."
Lacking the ability to use their Immortal Countries inside the bubble, purely in terms of Attack Power, they were indeed inferior to Jiang Cheng.
However, more eyes were focused on the sword.
Could it be the legendary Tier Nine Immortal Sword?
"Tier Nine Immortal Sword truly is extraordinary!"
"Yes, this sword’s amplification is too powerful..."
"Look at that appearance, worthy of Tier Nine!"
Brother Cheng felt proud hearing the first part; was his strike already considered excellent?
But hearing the latter, it almost angered him.
Could you focus more on the owner of the Immortal Sword?
Miao Yu withdrew her gaze, "Alright, let’s all strike together!"
Everyone released their Immortal Artifacts and Magical Treasures one after another.
This First Realm had already been traversed twice by many, so they were quite familiar.
They weren’t caught off guard by the challenge at the outset, remaining rather composed.

chapters.title: Chapter 333: All the limelight was stolen
chapters.content:
Chapter 333: Chapter 333: All the limelight was stolen
Over two hundred Immortal Kings and Demon Kings used their ultimate techniques simultaneously towards a certain point in front of the bubble.
The most direct way to break this bubble is to blast it with force.
This is also the experience summarized by the ancients.
Accompanied by a violent rumbling sound, the pink bubble burst.
Then, the pale blue ’sky’ appeared again.
Everyone hurriedly summoned their Immortal Country again and continued on their way.
This stage posed no difficulty for them.
In the following ten days, everyone joined forces to break two more suddenly appearing bubbles.
On this day, a fork in the road finally appeared ahead.
The quality of origin here has reached the peak of the First Realm, making cultivation here much better than when they first entered.
However, different from what Brother Cheng imagined as a normal intersection, there were two unknown entrances ahead.
The two entrances were identical, and it was unclear what the situation inside was.
The Immortal Tree has countless branches and forks; one of the paths, left or right, would lead to the Second Realm, getting closer to the main trunk.
The other one might lead to another branch of the First Realm.
Inside, there’s no omniscient view of the whole map, so they can only guess by intuition.
If they choose wrong, it would be very troublesome.
There is no return entrance along each path; they would have to continue along the wrong path.
Miao Yu unhesitatingly chose the right path, and everyone else followed without hesitation.
The reason is simple: many people here have been through this.
Experience was accumulated during the previous two openings of the Immortal Tree, knowing that the right is correct.
Crossing the entrance, they indeed entered a branch of the Second Realm.
The quality of origin here is much higher than in the First Realm, significantly helping the innate foundation.
However, no one stopped and continued to forge ahead.
After five days, the scene ahead suddenly changed again.
people simultaneously descended into a small city.
The buildings in this city were lifelike, just like the outside world.
However, it was deserted and filled with death qi.
Brother Cheng glanced around, and once again everyone’s Immortal Country was sealed away, indicating that this was the danger of the Second Realm.
He naturally drew the Rainbow Absolute Immortal Sword.
"No!"
Miao Yu hurriedly stopped his next attack.
"What’s wrong?"
"Here, brute force can’t break it."
Jiyun also sent a message: "Sect Leader Jiang, here, a specific exit must be found."
"If we destroy this place, we will lose the clues, and then we will have to wait a month for this city to slowly reconstruct."
"To pass this layer, it’s said that some people have wandered here for decades."
Brother Cheng helplessly shook his head, feeling like it was a game of breaking through stages in this Immortal Tree.
What clues need to be found?
Under the guidance of ’strategic’ Miao Yu, everyone didn’t have to search aimlessly; they directly crossed several streets into a pharmacy.
Pushing open the back door of the pharmacy, everyone entered in single file.
They then found a dried well in the backyard.
Before Brother Cheng could react, Miao Yu was the first to jump in.
Following the crowd into the dried well, the scene before their eyes changed once again.
A new small city appeared ahead.
"Why is there more?"
"This stage has a total of three illusion realms; we just passed the First Layer."
Jiyun explained to him.
"If someone has cultivated the Illusion Rule, passing this stage would be much easier."
"But now that Miao Yu knows the way, it’s not needed."
Sure enough, Miao Yu quickly led everyone to a side room in a mansion in the city.
The room was fully furnished with tables, chairs, beds, and cabinets, and there was a painting on the wall.
The woman rushed directly into the painting.
Darn, is this the exit?
Brother Cheng didn’t know what to say.
If he were here alone, who knows when he would figure out it was here.
Passing through the scroll, they entered the small city in the painting.
Led by Miao Yu again, they transmitted once more in this painted city.
This time everyone finally passed this stage, returning to the outside world.
Among the 271 people, a good number of them, like Brother Cheng, were here for the first time.
And some were here for the second time, but only knew the route and vague rules, without such detailed ’strategy’.
Just now, this stage caused many people to complain.
"It’s too complicated; without Miss Miao Yu leading the way, I wouldn’t have thought of it even if I hit my head hard."
"Indeed, thanks to her."
"The Celestial Pavilion folks, they were clearly well prepared!"
"Following her is incredibly reliable, it feels like there’s nothing to worry about..."
Miao Yu herself did not show any pride, just inexplicably glanced at Jiang Cheng, then continued to lead the way.
Brother Cheng couldn’t understand what her gaze meant.
Was she showing off?
Thinking about it, he felt a bit jealous.
The limelight had been completely stolen by this woman!
Currently, she was clearly the protagonist of this team, all the spotlight was on her.
If the team were to choose a captain now, probably ninety percent would choose her.
This made Brother Cheng feel embarrassed but helpless.
She had the map and preparation, like playing a game with a strategy guide; even with his system, it was hard to steal her spotlight.
He could only secretly hope that later there would be particularly difficult stages, so he could turn the tide and reclaim the grandeur of King Bi.
If this thought were revealed, others might vomit blood in anger.
After all, everyone hoped for simplicity.
Half a month later, when they reached the fork in the Second Realm, two entrances appeared ahead again.
This time, a dozen Immortal Kings in the team stayed behind.
"This is our limit."
"We definitely can’t withstand the origin of the Third Realm."
"Thank you, Miss Miao Yu, for bringing us here!"
Miao Yu nodded and then chose the left entrance.
Everyone else followed.
In the Third Realm, they encountered difficulties again but passed easily under Miao Yu’s leadership.
At the fork in the Third Realm, over a hundred people stayed behind.
They were unable to continue.
Even one Immortal King from the Celestial Pavilion stayed behind.
While Mingchi and Liu Yuan Immortal King in Brother Cheng’s team also stopped here.
"Sect Leader Jiang, I really wanted to follow you forward!"
"But unfortunately, our strength is lacking!"
The two felt quite regretful, but there was no way.
Even if Brother Cheng wanted to lead them, he couldn’t; their Immortal Country couldn’t withstand such strong origin power in the next realm.
It would instead harm them.
As they continued on, when they reached the fourth realm’s fork, another hundred people stayed behind.
At this moment, the team of 271 people was reduced to only 35.
Again, five Immortal Kings from the Celestial Pavilion stayed behind.
None from Brother Cheng’s side were left behind this time.
Neither Xiao Kun, Shali, Hua Yin, nor Jiyun, the Three Great Corpse Kings, Wu Jue, Jingyu, or She Lan were ordinary Immortal or Demon Kings.
Their foundation, luck, and combat power far surpassed ordinary Immortal Kings, with innate foundations that all were extraordinarily solid.
In the Enlightenment Immortal Tree, such individuals were destined to go farther.
And this was precisely the main reason why the Celestial Pavilion initially sought them as allies.
The earlier stages were just a prelude; the true tests lay ahead.

chapters.title: Chapter 334: Your Strategy Is Finally Used Up
chapters.content:
Chapter 334: Chapter 334: Your Strategy Is Finally Used Up
After stepping into the Fifth Realm, Miao Yu glanced at Brother Cheng once again.
In fact, she was quite surprised.
She originally thought that Jiang Cheng couldn’t survive in the Immortal Tree.
Yet this man had followed along all the way until now, where even more than two hundred Immortal Kings and Demon Kings had fallen behind, and he still seemed unbothered.
It was as if those Powers of Origin were completely harmless to him.
Brother Cheng didn’t realize that this look was one of surprise, otherwise he would have definitely come forward to show off.
He thought this woman was showing off her ’Captain’ title again.
At the intersection of the Fifth Realm, another 15 people stayed behind.
Among them, the Celestial Pavilion only had five people who could continue, while Xiao Kun, Jiyun, and others still had all ten without anyone falling behind.
Two new entrances appeared ahead, and Sect Leader Jiang, who had been dawdling in the soy sauce pool the whole time, waited for Fairy Miao to continue leading him forward.
But this time, Fairy Miao didn’t make a choice.
"The map from previous times ends here."
"The challenges ahead can only be faced with eyes closed."
"This time, we have to choose based on our instincts. If you don’t wish to, you can stay here."
The two entrances looked identical, and before entering, it was impossible to know what was inside.
If luck was good and they chose correctly, they would directly enter the Sixth Realm.
If luck was bad, they might downgrade into another Fourth Realm.
Then they would have to continue exploring that fourth realm and re-enter another Fifth Realm.
This is still under the condition of being lucky. If luck is bad, the next choice might be wrong again, causing further downgrades.
After all, other Fourth Realms are not the same path they have traveled, and previous people didn’t leave maps there.
This is also what makes the Enlightenment Immortal Tree the most troublesome.
A fifty percent chance - to keep gambling or stay and maintain the Fifth Realm is a difficult choice.
On hearing that the map finally ran out, Brother Cheng finally perked up.
Your strategy is finally exhausted.
Miao Yu, Miao Yu, you’ve held the lead role long enough, it’s time to step down, isn’t it?
I’m not a swimming champion; I’m here to show off, to gain Shock Value!
The others naturally couldn’t guess his thoughts and said in unison: "Let’s continue!"
"If it’s wrong, so be it!"
"Take a gamble!"
Miao Yu nodded: "Alright then, I’ve chosen."
Then, she led everyone into the entrance on the left.
One by one, twenty people entered, and as soon as they got inside, they began to sigh.
"Alas, we chose wrong."
Each realm’s origin quality is different, and the quality of the origin in this unfamiliar branch was even below the Fifth Realm just now.
Although aware it’s a fifty-fifty chance and any result could happen, initially, everyone certainly holds a hopeful expectation.
Pfft!
This time Brother Cheng laughed out loud.
Be careful what you wish for.
The others immediately looked over, and Miao Yu raised an eyebrow.
"Sect Leader Jiang, what are you laughing at?"
Brother Cheng quickly waved his hand: "Nothing, I just suddenly thought of something happy."
Now the others from the Celestial Pavilion also looked displeased.
We just took a wrong turn, and you’re thinking of something happy, are you joking?
Don’t forget you’re part of this team too!
Jiyun, Hua Yin, Wu Jue, and others were helpless; even if you’re going to revel in others’ mishaps, you don’t need to be so obvious about it!
"No problem, no problem, let’s keep exploring!"
The Xiao Kun Demon King clapped his hands, helping to defuse the situation for Sect Leader Jiang.
"We still have plenty of time."
"Exactly, there’s 81 years, only three months have passed, we can afford to lose!"
Jiyun and Wu Jue also smiled willingly: "It’s not Miss Miao Yu’s fault; we’d surely choose wrong too."
"Yeah, if we all work together, we can still return to the Sixth Realm."
Miao Yu and the Du Chen Immortal King from the Celestial Pavilion exchanged glances and secretly sighed in relief.
Though Jiang Cheng is ’very unreliable’, his people are very sensible.
If it were unreasonable people, after choosing the wrong path, they might be busy blaming teammates or complaining now.
Watching the group preparing to move forward again, Brother Cheng silently brought up the system panel and clicked on the Time Reversal button again.
In fact, after learning about the series of rules within the Immortal Tree, he knew that this ’Time Reversal’ would become a divine technique.
Others who chose wrong could only continue to err, as there was no turning back.
They completely relied on luck.
But he was different.
Time Reversal meant he could try infinitely without worrying about making mistakes.
He returned to the intersection at the end of the Fifth Realm.
Everyone was looking at the two entrances again.
"This time we can only choose based on luck. If you don’t wish to, you can stay here."
Miao Yu’s voice just fell, and the others still had the same lines.
"Let’s continue!"
"If it’s wrong, so be it!"
"Take a gamble!"
"Gamble on what?"
This time Brother Cheng made a dramatic entrance, pointing directly at the entrance on the right: "The correct entrance is this one."
Everyone was stunned, and Miao Yu, who had originally intended to choose the left, turned back.
"Sect Leader Jiang, how do you know the right is correct?"
Because you just chose the left and it was wrong, so the remaining right must naturally be correct.
Thanks for scouting the way for me, Miss.
Of course, Jiang Cheng wouldn’t say that.
He rubbed his non-existent long beard and said leisurely, "Based on feel."
Everyone was at a loss for words to retort.
Based on feel, yet you seem so confident about it?
Miao Yu thought he was going to say something insightful, but couldn’t help feeling a bit disappointed when she heard this.
"Sect Leader Jiang, let’s not joke."
"If you don’t believe me, then follow me."
Brother Cheng couldn’t be bothered to argue, directly drilling into the entrance on the right.
Others exchanged looks; is he not considering the team’s opinion at all?
"We’re going in as well!"
Xiao Kun, Jiyun, and others naturally followed closely behind Sect Leader Jiang.
Once they went in, Miao Yu and the others had no choice.
Unless they wanted to abandon this group of allies.
"Well, we have to choose this side too!"
"Oh well, everyone is relying on intuition anyway."
Miao Yu felt a bit frustrated in her heart.
She originally intended to choose the left, but now choosing the right, she naturally didn’t have high hopes.
Once entering the entrance, the scene changed ahead.
A denser Power of Origin from the Immortal Tree surged around, making even her Immortal Country a bit more active.
Could this really be the Sixth Realm?
Did he choose correctly?
By now, the others were already cheering.
"Hahaha, it’s really not wrong!"
"Sect Leader Jiang is amazing, this feeling is spot on!"
Others thought it was just good luck, randomly hitting that fifty percent chance.
But Xiao Kun, Shali, Wu Jue, and others’ eyes lit up.
Knowing Brother Cheng, his entrance choice was likely not random!
Sect Leader Jiang kept a low profile all the way, but is he finally going to display his divine prowess now?
The knowing looks they exchanged were caught by Miao Yu’s keen senses.
"How did you do it?"
Her intuition told her there must be a secret behind it.
Just like before with the Moon Race bloodline and secret techniques, and later moving freely within the Immortal Tree with the Ninth-grade Immortal Venerable Realm, this person was just too enigmatic.

chapters.title: Chapter 335 Sect Leader Jiang’s Science Popularization
chapters.content:
Chapter 335: Chapter 335 Sect Leader Jiang’s Science Popularization
Upon hearing the question, Du Chen Immortal King and Ji Ming Immortal King from the Celestial Pavilion looked over in surprise.
"You don’t think this person found the entrance through some special method, do you?"
"This is clearly a wild guess."
"With a fifty percent chance, it’s quite easy to guess correctly."
The two spoke through transmission, so Brother Cheng didn’t hear it.
However, Miao Yu felt things weren’t that simple, and she was becoming increasingly attentive to Sect Leader Jiang.
The team of twenty continued forward, and six days later, they encountered a new challenge.
Brother Cheng was quite accustomed to it. It seemed like each realm had different checkpoints.
Moreover, he also discovered a pattern; each checkpoint was actually a test of a certain rule.
For example, the first checkpoint tested the Power Rule.
The second checkpoint, which involved three cities in a row, tested the Illusion Rule.
In such checkpoints, having a group of people teaming up had a definite advantage.
Even if one’s understanding of that rule wasn’t deep, the strength of the group could make up for it.
In front of them, the scene was a massive circular arena.
Aside from the empty stands surrounding it, the combat area spanned over a thousand miles in diameter.
As usual, no one could activate their Immortal Country.
Everyone looked around, cautiously releasing their Immortal Soul to probe every corner, but there were no special findings.
"What rule will this checkpoint test?"
"Could it be the Rule of War, making us enter the arena for combat?"
"It’s possible!"
"But, there are no opponents here."
A few Immortal Kings had already entered the massive arena, but nothing happened.
"Surely, it won’t make us fight each other?"
"What’s that?"
Miao Yu suddenly pointed to a corner of the arena, where a few colorful butterflies were fluttering.
These butterflies were very small, only the size of beans, and were almost transparent.
Counting carefully, there were five in total.
Just moments ago, when they had scanned the entire place with their Immortal Souls, they hadn’t discovered these five butterflies.
Du Chen Immortal King stroked his beard and concluded solemnly, "This challenge should be related to these butterflies."
The others also agreed one after another.
This was obvious; a few butterflies appearing in this dead silence was too unusual.
Xiao Kun Demon King frowned and asked, "So how do we pass? By killing these butterflies?"
As he said this, he couldn’t help but look at Sect Leader Jiang, seeking his advice.
Brother Cheng, being here for the first time, didn’t know a thing.
But seeing Xiao Kun looking at him with such expectation, he had to at least make a gesture.
So he raised his hand and swung a sword towards the butterflies.
"Don’t..."
Miao Yu hurriedly tried to stop him; many checkpoints couldn’t be recklessly attacked.
If those butterflies were the key clues, destroying them would be a disaster.
But, it was already too late.
Bang!
A surging Fire Dragon roared through the area, sweeping everything before disappearing in an instant.
The crowd thought, brother, you’re a bit too direct, aren’t you?
But looking back in the arena, those butterflies were still there.
And at some point, hundreds more had appeared.
The colorful butterflies fluttered, dancing in the arena, appearing beautifully enchanting.
"Could it really be that we need to exterminate these butterflies?"
"It might be!"
"Then let’s all make our move together!"
This time, Miao Yu had no objections, so everyone flew to the sky.
They unleashed their respective ultimate techniques, bombarding the arena wildly.
The stance was practically a carpet bombing.
If it weren’t for the special nature of this arena, it would have long been destroyed.
They bombarded for a full minute before gradually stopping, staring dumbfounded at the billions of continuously fluttering butterflies before them.
Even the slowest among them now realized.
These butterflies seemed to multiply because of their attacks.
If they didn’t attack, there would be fewer of them.
Well-traveled Du Chen Immortal King sighed, "We might have made a mistake. These butterflies likely use our attacks as a source of nourishment."
"That’s why they multiply so much."
In the outside world, such a thing would be unbelievable, but within the Immortal Tree, anything could happen.
"So... what do we do now?"
Looking at the dense butterflies, everyone felt a headache coming on.
Miao Yu remained silent; she quietly observed the chaotic dance of the butterflies, her Immortal Soul seemingly scanning every detail.
No one knew how long it took, but just as everyone was at their wit’s end, she finally had a discovery.
"Among these butterflies, there’s one that’s not colorful but transparent and colorless."
Everyone, being Immortal Kings and Demon Kings, immediately remembered.
Indeed, among the initial five butterflies, there was one that was colorless, but at the time, everyone hadn’t thought it was special.
Now, with Miao Yu’s reminder, as they looked again, they found that among the billions of butterflies, there was every color except there was still only the one colorless butterfly from the start.
Only they could do it; if it were anyone else, finding a single colorless butterfly among billions would be impossible.
"That’s right! It seems it’s the true key!"
"But shouldn’t our earlier attacks have hit it?"
"Yeah, earlier my attack covered the whole area; it couldn’t have escaped!"
"No!"
Miao Yu shook her head again, a spark of wisdom shining in her eyes.
"Look at its erratic flight path, it’s like it’s instant teleporting."
"If I’m not mistaken, catching this colorless butterfly will allow us to pass."
"This test is on the Speed Rule!"
Her analysis suddenly enlightened everyone.
"As expected of Miss Miao Yu, truly intelligent!"
"Indeed, with her around, no puzzle is unsolvable!"
Once again, Brother Cheng elegantly became a side character.
No way around it, besides showing off, he wasn’t very focused on other things, while Miao Yu was exceptionally focused and intelligent.
"It’s a pity there are too many butterflies now, which makes it quite a disruption."
"Let’s give it a try!"
After confirming this was a Speed Rule test, everyone was eager to get onto the field to catch the butterfly.
Then, Brother Cheng directly activated Time Reversal.
Recently, having used this skill frequently, he found it very suitable for showing off.
In the next instant, time rewound to the moment they first entered the arena.
At this point, the arena was empty, and everyone was searching for clues.
Brother Cheng flew into the arena alone, and then five butterflies appeared.
He clasped his hands behind his back, lifted his chin slightly, and lightly coughed.
"Alright, no need to search aimlessly, the clue is right here."
"Ah?"
So quickly?
Upon hearing this, everyone rushed over, including Miao Yu.
"What did Sect Leader Jiang find?"
"Five colorful butterflies?"
"This really seems like a clue."
"Sect Leader Jiang has such sharp eyes!"
"To notice something unusual right upon entering!"
Brother Cheng, not blushing or gasping, continued to ’educate’ everyone.
"These butterflies can’t be attacked."
"Ah, why?"
"Could it be that killing them cuts off the clue?"
"No."
"The reason they can’t be attacked is that they can turn our attacks into nourishment."
Sect Leader Jiang gravely warned everyone.
To prove this point, he lightly flicked a finger towards one of the butterflies, and that butterfly immediately turned into two.

chapters.title: Chapter 336: This woman is a monster
chapters.content:
Chapter 336: Chapter 336: This woman is a monster
"Did you see that?"
Sect Leader Jiang pointed at the colorful butterfly that had just been attacked.
"Even with such a light attack, it turns into two."
"Once we attack with full force, this place will be quickly filled with butterflies, tens of billions would be nothing!"
At the thought of the sky being covered with tens of billions of butterflies, everyone suddenly felt a headache.
Besides that, there was admiration for Sect Leader Jiang.
The old gentleman could see the special nature of these butterflies at a glance, truly a discerning eye!
If it weren’t for his reminder, we might have made a mistake.
Brother Cheng quietly glanced at the system panel, not bad, he gained some shock value.
However, because the level of shock wasn’t high, he didn’t get much and needed to keep working hard.
"So how do we pass this stage?"
Even the Du Chen Immortal King from the Celestial Pavilion rarely took the initiative to ask for advice.
"Could Sect Leader Jiang please enlighten us?"
His change in attitude made Brother Cheng quite happy.
Especially now, even Miao Yu’s face was full of curiosity.
Thus, surrounded by 19 Immortal Kings, Brother Cheng pointed to the colorless butterfly.
"Do you see that butterfly?"
Everyone nodded obediently like students, they saw it.
Like an excellent teacher, Brother Cheng patiently guided them: "Did you notice anything different?"
Everyone took a careful look, and Miao Yu was still the smartest one.
The first to say: "It’s not a colorful butterfly, and its movements are more erratic and swift than the other butterflies!"
Brother Cheng nodded with a smile: "A teachable student!"
Secretly wiping sweat in his mind, girl, it was all you who found out.
But my need to show off is too great, I can only borrow yours to flaunt.
Ji Ming Immortal King asked in confusion: "What does this unique butterfly represent? Can it be killed?"
Brother Cheng shook his finger, with an expression of having seen through everything.
"It can’t be killed, it is immune to our attacks."
"Then what do we do?"
"Very simple, catch it!"
Brother Cheng shook his robe sleeves and said sternly: "This stage tests the speed rule!"
His words made everyone suddenly realize!
"Sect Leader Jiang is amazing, isn’t he?"
"Without your guidance, we could never have guessed there were so many mysteries!"
"Yes, indeed, it’s like seeing the dawn through clouds and dim willows!"
Xiao Kun and Jiyun proudly guarded Brother Cheng on both sides.
"Our Boss was too lazy to make a move before, but now without a map, the old gentleman finally got serious!"
"Now you see, right?"
"Once Sect Leader Jiang makes an effort, it’s really steady!"
Others also expressed their admiration: "Sect Leader Jiang is wise and mighty!"
"Hahaha, low key, low key..."
Brother Cheng pressed his hands down, and secretly looked at Miao Yu, finding her eyes twinkling with amazement.
Apparently, she was stunned by his near-prescient miraculous actions.
Checked the panel, the shock level was mostly in place.
Even though there were only 19 people, the merit converted amounted to 90,000 or more.
The joy of gain covered his last shred of guilt, making him feel even more delighted.
"Since we know it’s a test of speed rules, it’s simple!"
"Exactly, I have confidence in speed!"
All Immortal Kings displayed their fastest speed, dashing towards the colorless butterfly.
After all, they were Immortal Kings, even without summoning an Immortal Country, their speed was still extraordinary.
The arena quickly filled with countless illusions.
After a round of chasing and blocking, a full quarter-hour passed, and everyone had to stop.
The colorless butterfly was still there, not caught.
"Isn’t this butterfly too fast?"
"Yes, even though I practice speed rules, I still couldn’t catch up with it."
"And it’s too agile, completely without pattern."
"If only the Immortal Country were here, perhaps we could have tried."
Brother Cheng was also a bit surprised, this stage was really difficult to pass.
This butterfly wouldn’t leave the arena boundary, but not only was it fast, it was immune to attacks.
The wind couldn’t move it, fire couldn’t burn it, and confinement was out of the question.
Otherwise, an immortal could easily settle it with a glance and will.
"Catching it like this will never succeed."
No matter how unwilling, everyone had to admit this was a fact.
If they couldn’t pass this stage, they would be trapped here until the Immortal Tree closed.
This trip would mean nothing.
At this crucial moment, it was Fairy Miao who stood out again.
"If we want to catch it, we must scatter."
"Scatter?"
Everyone was taken aback, then immediately understood.
All of them chasing behind the butterfly, not only failed to catch it but also interfered with each other.
There are 20 people here, why not be responsible for 20 small areas?
This way, everyone’s task is much lighter, and they can also intercept the flying butterfly head-on.
"Truly a word to wake the dreamer, as expected of Miss Miao Yu!"
"This method is absolutely feasible!"
Everyone praised it, even secretly grateful that Fairy Miao was from the neutral Celestial Pavilion, not from other forces.
"Please, Miss Miao Yu, arrange the formation."
"Yes, we will certainly follow orders."
Scattering positions also requires coordination, having a commander would make it even more effective.
In everyone’s eyes, Miao Yu, who suggested this, must have a plan, and letting her command was only natural.
Brother Cheng was anxious.
What the hell, is this a joke?
Even after using time reversal to steal her discovery, she’s still taking the limelight at the end?
This woman is a monster, right?
Even an ascender isn’t as capable as her!
No way!
I must defend the dignity of a system enhancer.
This is a battle of honor!
"Why go through so much trouble?"
"I can catch this butterfly like taking something out of a bag!"
"Ah?"
Upon hearing this, Xiao Kun, Jiyun, and others were extremely delighted, but Du Chen, Ji Ming, and others couldn’t understand.
"Sect Leader Jiang, this butterfly is not something we even have confidence in at our peak."
"Yes, it’s impossible to rely on just one person..."
Miao Yu also frowned, "Sect Leader Jiang, this pass is no time for jokes."
Brother Cheng shrugged and smiled, "What’s the harm in trying?"
With his words, everyone could only leave the arena first.
Then, Brother Cheng began stacking buffs on himself.
He has 992 Main Rules, and the speed rule is among them, currently at the Perfection level.
To ensure showing off more steadily, he specifically expended merit to exchange for Rule Fragments, elevating this rule to the Great Perfection Realm of the Immortal Emperor Level!
Although he had not yet reached the Immortal King Realm, at that moment, in terms of speed, he had already surpassed most Immortal Kings with their Immortal Countries.
Then, he called out the Speed Heroic Soul.
The Speed Heroic Soul provides a 5-fold speed boost.
When this heroic soul emerged, everyone trembled in unison.
Even Miao Yu and Du Chen, who weren’t optimistic about him at first, couldn’t help but feel a glimmer of hope.

chapters.title: Chapter 337: Calculated in Advance
chapters.content:
Chapter 337: Chapter 337: Calculated in Advance
Upon reaching the Saint Tier, some cultivators begin to come into contact with Heroic Souls.
However, it requires great fortune, and those who possess them are extremely rare.
All present were Immortal Kings, each with extraordinary opportunities.
Over the long years, they have also obtained their own Heroic Souls.
Each cultivator can have up to three Heroic Souls, and once obtained, they cannot be changed.
The Speed Heroic Soul is one of the most difficult to acquire, so seeing Sect Leader Jiang ’happen’ to have this Heroic Soul was naturally very surprising.
"I didn’t expect Sect Leader Jiang to possess the rare Speed Heroic Soul!"
Du Chen Immortal King looked at the Heroic Soul and said shakily, "This is an upper-rank Heroic Soul; among countless cultivators in the Cultivation Realm, regardless of realm, only 15 people can have it!"
"Once 15 are filled, no matter how monstrous others are, they cannot obtain it!"
"Unexpectedly, Sect Leader Jiang is one of those 15 people..."
The Heroic Soul does not regard realms; perhaps a Saint Tier with immense fortune had long obtained an upper-rank Heroic Soul.
Yet an Immortal King might have spent half a lifetime, only to obtain two lower-rank Heroic Souls.
Hearing their discussions, Brother Cheng chuckled inwardly, so even Speed Heroic Soul can be used to show off?
Then, he activated the hidden Dragon Wing Talent within the Azure Dragon Bloodline.
Speed increased fourfold again!
Thinking this should be steady now, right?
"Alright, you can go to the audience seats to cheer now."
Before the others could react, he vanished from where he stood.
Reappearing, his palm already held the colorless butterfly.
The entire process was unbelievably fast, not even a moment.
The previous judgment was indeed correct; once the butterfly was caught, this level swiftly disappeared, and they returned to the outside of the Sixth Realm.
Brother Cheng was also taken aback; he originally thought he would have to chase it around for hundreds of laps.
In the end, with so many amplifications, his speed was overly fast.
In the face of such speed, the incredibly swift butterfly appeared sluggish instead.
The others almost dropped their jaws in shock.
Succeeded just like that?
The level was passed, so it must have been caught.
But the problem was they couldn’t even clearly see with their eyes, let alone their Immortal Souls perceive the entire process.
This was just too strong, wasn’t it?
Even with the amplification of the Speed Heroic Soul, it shouldn’t reach this level.
After a gasp of cold air, the crowd finally came to their senses.
Du Chen Immortal King no longer cared about his image, and ran over in delight.
"Sect Leader Jiang, you’re unbelievably fast!"
"How exactly did you do it?"
He looked at Sect Leader Jiang as if he were a Divine Being.
Others also exclaimed repeatedly, "Such speed already rivals an Immortal Emperor, doesn’t it?"
"Too incredible!"
Miao Yu’s eyes too were filled with undisguisable shock. Even with 20 people positioned separately, there wasn’t absolute assurance.
Only a higher success rate, really.
Even if truly successful, surely it would require countless efforts.
But in one go, Sect Leader Jiang managed it as if it were as simple as reaching into a bag.
Besides this speed, she was even more surprised by Brother Cheng’s ’prophetic’ nature.
Honestly, she almost suspected this person might have been to the Sixth Realm before.
Knowing the correct entrance in advance, clues ahead of time, understanding that this level tested the speed rule...
This was all too irregular.
After a smooth journey, two months later, everyone reached the end of the Sixth Realm.
Ahead, at the fork, two entrances appeared once more.
And here, the Three Great Corpse Kings and the other four also stopped.
The Power of Origin within the Seventh Realm was too overwhelming for them to continue forward.
Among the remaining 13, Brother Cheng’s party still held 8, while the Celestial Pavilion had 4.
As for Ye Yang Immortal King, he stayed behind in the Fourth Realm.
Gazing at the two unknown entrances in front, everyone looked at Sect Leader Jiang in unison.
His previous performance was so extraordinary that everyone was filled with expectations for him.
Even Miao Yu took the initiative to ask, "Sect Leader Jiang, do you have any suggestions for these two entrances?"
Brother Cheng had no suggestion.
The two entrances were identical; before entering, no one could know what was inside.
Aside from guessing wildly, there was no other way.
"The correct entrance is this one!"
He pointed to the right entrance. His words were resolute, as if the correctness of the right was an indisputable truth.
So confident?
Everyone trusted his words.
Then, under his guidance, they all stepped into that entrance.
The scene changed, and the Origin Aura reduced.
This was the Fifth Realm.
With a fifty percent chance, he still guessed wrong.
Everyone was at a loss for words.
It felt like he really was just guessing?
If he was guessing, why did he look so confident earlier?
Seeing the near-collapse expressions in Miao Yu and Du Chen Jiming’s eyes, Brother Cheng’s face turned slightly red, he had blundered.
Start over, start over!
He hurriedly activated time reversal again.
Swoosh, everyone returned to the previous time point.
Facing the two entrances once again, Miao Yu asked him again.
"Sect Leader Jiang, do you have any suggestions for these two entrances?"
"The left!"
Brother Cheng suddenly pointed to the left, "The correct entrance is this one!"
"I dare to bet my lifetime’s cultivation, if I guess wrong, my cultivation will be utterly ruined, and I’ll never progress again!"
Everyone was frightened by this oath.
Though oaths can be reneged, at their realm, breaking oaths would affect the Daoist Heart.
Possibly in future breakthroughs, Heart Demons would emerge.
So Immortals rarely bet or swear heavily.
"Sect Leader Jiang!"
"You don’t need to go this far..."
It was already enough, really.
No one said what would happen if guessed wrong.
Is it necessary to be this serious, this formal?
Really not needed.
"No!"
Brother Cheng’s expression turned solemn, he said deeply, "If guessed wrong, it will cause countless troubles later!"
"It concerns everyone’s destiny, I must take responsibility!"
"This is my creed!"
Everyone suddenly looked on with respect.
Brother Cheng chuckled inwardly, having tried the right before, now the left definitely had to be right, he was relying on this to show off intentionally.
Feeling the show was almost enough, he led and stepped into the left entrance first.
Indeed, this side was truly the Seventh Realm.
The remaining 12 followed in, without exception, convinced in heart and soul.
"Sect Leader Jiang has chosen correctly again!"
"Simply godlike!"
"Judging from Sect Leader Jiang’s confidence just now, is there really some special method to see through the entrance early?"
Miao Yu could no longer resist asking, "Sect Leader Jiang, have you been to the Seventh Realm before?"
Being prophetic so often, it was hard to chalk it up to coincidence.
Now even if Jiang Cheng claimed it was a guess, she wouldn’t believe it.
"Alas, it seems it ultimately can’t be concealed."
Brother Cheng sighed a long sigh, saying slowly, "I’ve never been here, and the reason I can foresee the entrance is that I have mastery over the rules of divination."
"These two entrances, I calculated them in advance."
He wouldn’t say it was due to time reversal, trying another time.
Instead, he took the opportunity to show off again.

chapters.title: Chapter 338: Another Opportunity to Show Off
chapters.content:
Chapter 338: Chapter 338: Another Opportunity to Show Off
Pill Rule?
This rule is so obscure, no one has really encountered it before.
For a moment, everyone was in awe, feeling Sect Leader Jiang was truly mysterious and profound.
Only Miao Yu in the crowd frowned secretly.
Pill Rule?
Unfortunately, her Immortal Country happens to have a main rule that is a perfect Pill Rule!
However, this rule doesn’t really come into play when faced with a choice between two entrances.
Both entrances look identical from the outside, and the secrets within the Immortal Tree are shrouded, making it impossible to calculate anything.
Furthermore, according to her calculations, even an Immortal Emperor entering here would have to rely on guessing when faced with the two entrances.
Unless they can transcend the Origin!
So, this person is lying.
What exactly is he trying to hide?
On the way afterwards, she focused more of her attention on Jiang Cheng.
The glances and immortal soul fluctuations that occasionally drifted over, Brother Cheng could certainly sense them.
Why are you paying so much attention to me, miss?
Have you perhaps fallen in love with my overflowing talent?
Thinking of this, he became quite pleased with himself and even proactively flaunted himself a few more times in front of Fairy Miao.
Several days later, the scene before their eyes changed, and they finally encountered the Seventh Realm challenge.
A heavy and luxurious Pill Furnace appeared before everyone.
Next to the Pill Furnace floated various Heavenly and Earthly Treasures.
This time, there was no need for Miao Yu to remind them; everyone realized at a glance that this challenge was to test the ’Pill Rule’.
Looking at the Pill Furnace and those dazzling materials, Xiao Kun, Jiyun, Wujue, and others were dumbfounded.
Letting them fight and kill is their old profession.
But when it comes to alchemy, they are complete amateurs.
"What should we do now?"
"Does taking pills count? If it does, I have plenty of experience."
"You really have the nerve to say that!"
"What a pity, Liu Yuan that old coot stopped at the Third Realm."
