Liu Yuan Immortal King was an alchemist capable of refining Tier Seven Immortal Pills; if he were here, this challenge would be a walk in the park.
But alas, alchemists generally lack combat prowess and the Immortal Country isn’t that strong, after all.
"Who’s not saying so, if only that guy had hung on until now and then dropped dead with us, that would be great."
Brother Cheng was speechless. Damn it, do you take your companions as tools?
Far off meditating in the Third Realm, Liu Yuan Immortal King seemed to sense something, looking around with confusion.
Meanwhile, everyone had to turn their gaze to the four from Celestial Pavilion.
Fairy Miao was also out of ideas this time: "I’ve only dabbled in alchemy, at most I can refine Second-grade Immortal Pills."
Du Chen Immortal King regretfully shook his head: "Judging by the quality of these materials, if we can’t refine a Seventh-grade Immortal Pill, we definitely can’t pass."
Celestial Pavilion, being in business for years, was very familiar with these materials.
They even knew what Immortal Pills could be refined from these materials.
But having them actually do it was beyond their capability.
"What should we do now?"
"We can’t become talented alchemists in a short time."
"This Immortal Tree is really messing with us; where have you ever seen such a thing?"
This time, obviously knowing the question in advance, it was like an open-book exam, but unfortunately, everyone was collectively lacking in this subject and hadn’t studied it!
Seeing them all fall into despair, Brother Cheng tried hard to suppress his joyful mood.
The chance to show off had come again.
He had the Level 8 Alchemy Skill drawn from the system, capable of refining Ninth-grade Immortal Pills.
He knew he would need this skill sooner or later, but he hadn’t expected it would be in this situation.
Pretending to hesitate, he flew near the Pill Furnace.
"How about I give it a try?"
"Huh? Sect Leader Jiang?"
The crowd was completely surprised.
Brother Cheng had been quite miraculous before, but alchemy was a completely different domain.
And as the saying goes, if you were truly an Alchemy Master, you’d have been famous in the Middle Immortal Realm long ago.
"You can perform alchemy?"
Miao Yu’s jewel-like eyes were filled with disbelief.
This time, even Xiao Kun, Jiyun and others didn’t have much confidence, after all, they’ve never heard Sect Leader Jiang mention anything about alchemy.
"I know a little bit."
Brother Cheng displayed great modesty.
"A little bit?"
Miao Yu eyed him up and down, truly not seeing any signs of an Alchemy Master on him.
"Can you refine a Tier Seven Immortal Pill?"
Brother Cheng’s lips curled into a slight smile, "Perhaps I can."
Though the others had zero confidence, they couldn’t stop him; since no one else could do it either, why not let him try?
Like treating a dead horse as if it were alive!
Everyone retreated to a distance, leaving the stage to Sect Leader Jiang.
Gazing at these materials, Brother Cheng fell into deep thought.
If not for passing the challenge and just for refining pills, it would be easy as pie.
He’d stash these materials into the System Warehouse, hit the alchemy start button, and the progress bar would zip along until the finished pill emerged.
But the challenge required passing through alchemy with the provided Pill Furnace.
Reviewing all the alchemy knowledge from the Level 8 Alchemy Skill, he took a deep breath and then began activating the Pill Furnace and the surrounding auxiliary Immortal Array.
Seeing the Pill Furnace and all Immortal Arrays activated, Xiao Kun Demon King bubbled with excitement.
"It’s lit up!"
"Sect Leader Jiang truly knows alchemy!"
Du Chen and Ji Ming were speechless.
This was the most basic step; if you can’t even do this, how could you talk about alchemy?
Soon after, they saw Brother Cheng’s hands weaving various seals filled with profound mystery.
Clearly able to observe all actions, yet strangely unable to remember them.
Clearly able to see that the techniques were in harmony with the world’s dao, yet not knowing where the profundity lay.
Because behind it lay the vast and profound Alchemy Dao.
Miao Yu, Du Chen, and others’ eyes began to brighten gradually.
Laymen watch for excitement, experts watch for expertise.
"Sect Leader Jiang’s seals seem even more seamless than those of the Celestial Pavilion’s alchemist!"
"This has reached the level where technique approaches Dao..."
"Perhaps this time, there’s indeed hope."
As time passed, various materials flew into the Pill Furnace.
The immense Pill Furnace fluctuated, emitting brilliantly glowing colors, while the surrounding auxiliary Immortal Arrays worked at full capacity.
Sect Leader Jiang fluttered up and down, continuously casting various seals into it.
Everyone feared disturbing him and ceased their chatter, quietly waiting on the side.
This time’s show-off was Brother Cheng’s most laborious attempt.
It lasted for seven times seven, forty-nine days, even though he used the fastest method.
Many times, he had the urge to give up; it was too damn boring.
But giving up meant not passing the challenge, and everyone would be disappointed in him.
That was something the King Bi’s reputation couldn’t allow to happen.
On the day the pill was completed, a rainbow descended from the sky!
Under the fervent gaze of all, 18 Seven-Life Primordial Demon Pills were produced!
This is a Seventh-grade pill, not for cultivation, but it has great benefits for Demon Cultivators in battle.
Seeing these 18 pills, the 19 people who had watched for so many days all cheered in unison.
"We did it!"
"It really worked!"
"Hahaha, Seventh-grade Immortal Pill!"
"Sect Leader Jiang is truly deep and unfathomable, actually a Tier Seven Immortal Pill Master!"
"And succeeded in just one attempt!"
Du Chen Immortal King was the first to approach the Immortal Pills, sensing them carefully, and was utterly surprised.
"The quality of these Immortal Pills is very high!"
"These are rare, top-quality pills!"

chapters.title: Chapter 339 - 8th Grade Immortal Pill
chapters.content:
Chapter 339: Chapter 339: 8th Grade Immortal Pill
Everyone gathered around, especially the three Great Demon Kings, Xiao Kun, Shali, and She Lan, who were staring intently at the Immortal Pill, their eyes wide open.
This pill was what they had been dreaming of.
"Since you all want it, just take it!"
Since the Seven-Life Primordial Demon Pill couldn’t be used to increase cultivation, Brother Cheng was generous enough to give it to these three, six pills each.
The three were overjoyed and thanked him repeatedly.
Even the three Elders of the Celestial Pavilion were a bit envious.
The Celestial Pavilion did have Seven-Life Primordial Demon Pills, but not of this high quality.
Off to the side, Jiyun, Wu Jue, and others sourly curled their lips, lamenting that they weren’t Demon Cultivators themselves and could only make snide remarks.
"Do you three have any shame?"
"That’s right, Sect Leader Jiang has supported you all along, and not only do you not repay him, you even dare to take his pills?"
"So greedy, so inconsiderate, I disdain you all!"
"What else can you expect from Demon Cultivators?"
Xiao Kun, Shali, and She Lan were happy with their pills and didn’t take offense.
On the contrary, they deliberately flaunted their pills with a grin.
"Is your jealousy going to help?"
"These were rewarded by Sect Leader Jiang, how could we not accept them? Otherwise, wouldn’t that be disrespectful?"
"This reward signifies our different status in Sect Leader Jiang’s eyes compared to you, hahaha!"
At that moment, Miao Yu suddenly spoke.
"This stage is still ongoing."
Those words were like a bucket of cold water, instantly waking everyone up.
"That’s right!"
"Why haven’t we passed yet?"
The scene hadn’t changed.
The Pill Furnace remained, and there were still plenty of precious materials around.
"Could it be that the Seventh-grade Immortal Pill isn’t enough?"
"This is a top-quality Seventh-grade pill!"
"Could it be that we need an Eighth grade?"
Even Du Chen Immortal King couldn’t help but roar: "This is ridiculous, there’s simply no Eighth-grade Immortal Alchemist in the Middle Immortal Realm!"
"This stage wasn’t meant to be passed, was it?"
"Damn, what should we do now?"
Seeing that the Seventh-grade Immortal Pill couldn’t get them through, Brother Cheng was also speechless.
He had worked hard for forty-nine days!
All his previous flaunting combined wasn’t as tiring as this, and this was the result?
After thinking for a long time, he finally decided to make another attempt.
Given his alchemy skills, an Eighth-grade Immortal Pill wasn’t hard.
What really troubled him was the time; the fastest method still required sixty-four days.
In fact, for other Pill Masters who might take years or even decades to refine a single batch of Immortal Pills, this was an enviably short time.
"Sigh, looks like I’ll have to put in some effort."
The others didn’t understand until they saw him fly to the Pill Furnace again.
Du Chen looked incredulous: "Sect Leader Jiang, could it be that you can refine Eighth-grade Immortal Pills?"
"Somewhat acquainted."
Somewhat acquainted again?
He said the same when refining the Seventh-grade Immortal Pill, yet he succeeded.
In an instant, everyone was excited.
"Looks like it might actually be possible!"
"This is unbelievable, he’s actually an Eighth-Grade Immortal Alchemist?"
Xiao Kun, Wu Jue, and others were thrilled.
"Indeed, every time Sect Leader Jiang decides to take action, he’s absolutely confident!"
"Haha, this one’s definitely in the bag!"
"Indeed, Sect Leader Jiang can create miracles at any time..."
Soaking in this shower of praise, Sect Leader Jiang felt a bit more motivated.
Once again, he earnestly began his work.
Day by day passed.
Sixty-four days later, the day of the pill completion arrived.
Under the reflection of celestial phenomena, 24 Eighth-grade Grand Soul Returning Dust Pills glittered as they emerged from the furnace.
At this moment, the surrounding scene suddenly changed, and everyone found themselves in the outside Seventh Realm.
This stage was finally cleared!
"Succeeded again!"
"Even the Eighth-grade Immortal Pill was a one-time success!"
"Sect Leader Jiang is simply godlike."
"Without him, this stage would have been unimaginable."
"That’s right, even if Liuyuan, that old scoundrel, were here, he couldn’t have refined an Eighth-grade Immortal Pill..."
This was unequivocally a forceful carry.
Without Brother Cheng, they wouldn’t have made it through.
In no time, Du Chen Jiming and others flocked to express their gratitude.
But as they offered their thanks, their eyes couldn’t leave the Eighth-grade Immortal Pill.
The Soul Returning Dust Pill was for repairing Immortal Souls.
A single pill could restore an Immortal King from a damaged to a perfect Immortal Soul status.
It was known that problems with the Immortal Soul were often very tricky.
In mild cases, it would affect progress; in severe cases, one could end up like Mo Chen back in the mortal realm.
In other words, every extra Soul Returning Dust Pill was equivalent to an additional life insurance.
This grade of pill simply didn’t exist in the Middle Immortal Realm.
They had been able to remain calm with the Seventh-grade Immortal Pills, but this time, with the Eighth-grade ones, they couldn’t remain calm.
However, before they could speak, Brother Cheng nonchalantly distributed the 24 Immortal Pills among the four Immortal Kings, Jiyun, Hua Yin, Wu Jue, and Jingyu.
He wasn’t interested in them as they weren’t for improving cultivation.
He wanted to refine Immortal Pills to enhance cultivation, but the materials provided from the last stage weren’t suitable for that.
Once again, it was six pills each, keeping it fair and even.
The four who received the pills were a bit dumbfounded, unable to believe that such valuable Eighth-grade Immortal Pills were so easily given to them.
Just moments ago, the three Great Demon Kings, Xiao Kun, Shali, and She Lan, who were smug, suddenly turned envious.
They had been given Seventh-grade pills, while these guys got Eighth-grade ones!
When compared like this, it felt a bit unfair.
But unfortunately, these Immortal Pills were useless for Demon Cultivators.
Therefore, Shali Demon King could only offer his insidious advice from the sidelines: "Sect Leader Jiang, the Eighth-grade Immortal Pill is too valuable to be rewarded so casually!"
Xiao Kun also quietly whispered: "They totally aren’t worthy of such a high-level reward; maybe you should give them a lower-grade one?"
Jiyun and Wu Jue finally snapped out of their ecstasy.
Upon hearing this, they nearly exploded in anger.
"Who are you to tell Sect Leader Jiang how to do things?"
"Exactly, it was rewarded by him, and even though we wouldn’t dare to accept it if we were unworthy..."
"Being given Eighth-grade Immortal Pills by him signifies his higher recognition and expectations of us!"
Even Hua Yin Immortal King, a leading figure of the Ghost Alliance, sternly distanced himself from them: "You three insolent heretics, stop speaking, as if Sect Leader Jiang would be swayed by you!"
Meanwhile, Du Chen, Ji Ming, and others from the Celestial Pavilion were rubbing their hands as they approached the four Immortal Kings, smiling broadly.
"Ahem, Jiyun Immortal King, would you be interested in selling your Immortal Pills?"
"We’ll offer a price you’ll be satisfied with. How about considering it, Wu Jue Immortal King?"
"Given by Sect Leader Jiang, we intend to cherish it, how could we sell?"
As they went on their way, the group was quite lively.
And Brother Cheng was approached by Fairy Miao.
"How did you manage to do that?"
Before, she suspected that Jiang Cheng might have visited here before, but refining Immortal Pills was no act of ’prophecy’; it was real skill.
Having borrowed some of her wisdom before, Brother Cheng felt a tiny bit apologetic, so he was uncharacteristically sincere for once: "As you saw, I’m an alchemist, so this is naturally what I do."
"An Eighth-Grade Immortal Alchemist would be eagerly recruited by even the Upper Immortal Realm; you should have already made a name for yourself across the Immortal Realm! But I had never heard of you before."
"That’s because I keep a low profile and don’t care about superficial fame."
Miao Yu thought to herself, you’re fooling no one; there’s no bigger braggart than you on this journey.

chapters.title: Chapter 340 - 32nd Realm
chapters.content:
Chapter 340: Chapter 340: 32nd Realm
At the Seventh Realm’s checkpoint, only Brother Cheng, Xiao Kun, Jiyun, and Wu Jue were able to continue forward.
On the Celestial Pavilion’s side, only Miao Yu and Du Chen were left.
Looking at the two entrances again, everyone handed the decision to Sect Leader Jiang.
Brother Cheng waved his hand and casually picked one.
This time he guessed right and directly entered the Eighth Realm, saving himself a time reversal.
The remaining five now believed he could see through the entrance.
Miao Yu and Du Chen were immensely grateful to have found this ally.
Previously, they thought Sect Leader Jiang couldn’t make it.
Even if he did, they hadn’t hoped for anything from him.
But now...
They just wanted to cling tightly to this sturdy thigh.
The Eighth Realm tested the Earth Rule, a rule familiar to them, and with Brother Cheng’s leadership, they passed easily.
At the Eighth Realm’s checkpoint, Du Chen, Xiao Kun, Jiyun, and Wu Jue all stopped as well.
"Sect Leader Jiang, we truly owe this to you!"
Du Chen Immortal King was deeply moved, as the president of the Celestial Pavilion in the Middle Immortal Realm, he had never truly submitted to anyone before.
This time, he was thoroughly shocked.
Though he could cultivate in the Eighth Realm, he initially hadn’t hoped to reach this far.
The farthest the previous map reached was the Fifth Realm, and his initial plan was to reach the Sixth Realm and consider it a gain.
"Though the Celestial Pavilion’s stance is not to intervene in grudges, this debt and this sentiment, I have noted them down!"
Brother Cheng thought, old man, you’re just talking nonsense; giving me a discount or free stuff in the future would be a more serious gesture.
"Can you continue?"
Without Jiang Cheng, Fairy Miao’s original plan was to reach the Seventh Realm and consider it complete.
After all, as ’teammates’ dwindled, the chances of passing further became slimmer, even if picking the right entrance seemed futile.
One careless move, she’d be stuck in the checkpoint for eighty years until the Immortal Tree closed, and that wouldn’t be worth it.
"Of course, I want to continue."
Traveling alongside beauty is delightful, and Brother Cheng was very willing.
Under the envious gaze of others, the two of them stepped into the entrance and entered the Ninth Realm.
Though only two remained, the journey continued as smoothly as ever.
With one of them being perceptive and sharp, and the other powering up with buffs when facing challenges, they complemented each other well.
Three years later, the two were at the astonishing Thirty-second Layer!
In fact, the farthest record for the three entrances was only the Seventh Realm.
After the Seventh Realm, no one really knew how many stages were left.
The quality of the Origin Aura here was like facing the rule itself, giving an illusion of being able to touch it.
Along the way, Miao Yu gradually went from being curious, shocked, puzzled, to now being completely indifferent.
The checkpoints were varied, testing different rules.
And starting from the Ninth Realm, it often involved more than one rule.
She was sure, even without the limitation of the Origin Aura, all the Immortal Kings in the Middle Immortal Realm working together couldn’t pass the first Ten Realms.
Yet following Jiang Cheng, she had reached here.
This man was almost omnipotent; nothing seemed able to stymie him.
She suddenly remembered what he had said earlier—that he had over 900 Main Rules.
That time she thought it was an insult to her intelligence.
And now, she was starting to believe it.
But even if he truly had over 900 main rules, it was still hard to explain.
Because the difficulty of many of these challenges had already exceeded what an Immortal King level could handle.
She didn’t know Brother Cheng was actually quite amazed by her too.
Who was this woman anyway?
The highest an Immortal King’s Immortal Country could withstand was the Eighth Realm’s Origin projection, yet she seemed limitless.
Could she, like him, possess an aura consistent with the Origin?
Upon entering the 32nd Realm’s checkpoint, an inexplicable sensation stirred from deep within him.
Glancing at the woman beside him, he suddenly felt she became more beautiful.
Beautiful to the point of making his heart itch; it was hard to take his eyes off of her.
This kind of feeling was near impossible for someone who had lived as long as an Immortal.
Beauty fades, grass and trees wither, and allure had long been like fleeting clouds in their eyes.
"This is due to the Rule of Emotion and the Rule of Desire,"
Fairy Miao’s eyes were as sharp as ever.
Brother Cheng felt a bit embarrassed.
He was almost impulsive, yet how could this girl remain so composed?
He took a deep breath, controlling his emotions: "So how do we pass this checkpoint? Do we have to merge together to pass?"
If that’s the case, wouldn’t he have to sacrifice himself?
He was curious, if only he came here alone without this girl, how would he pass this checkpoint?
If three people entered, how would it be divided?
"No..."
Miao Yu shook her head.
"If we did that, it would mean being defeated by the Rule of Desire."
Hearing he didn’t need to sacrifice, Brother Cheng was inexplicably disappointed.
"And it’s not that simple."
Following her jade-like finger, Brother Cheng looked up.
Against the clear sky, a giant purple wheel hung high above, like a special moon.
The wheel rotated slowly, an enigmatic illusion continuously welled up, making his Immortal Soul feel a constant release.
"This is the Wheel of Destiny..."
Miao Yu slowly closed her eyes, seeming to guard against its influence.
"So there’s also a Destiny Rule?"
"Not only that, look at the round mirror within the wheel, that’s the Reincarnation Mirror, and there’s also the Reincarnation Rule..."
Brother Cheng almost crumbled: "This is too complicated, so what should we do next?"
Every time they passed a checkpoint, Miao Yu would explain the method, and he would power through it, so he didn’t bother thinking.
This woman knew everything.
"This checkpoint clearly requires us to enter the Wheel of Destiny in Immortal Soul state. Under the dominion of the Destiny Rule, our identities and cultivation will change."
"And under the Reincarnation Rule, our Immortal Souls will be sealed."
"To pass, we need to find each other under the condition of memory loss, and develop emotions..."
Brother Cheng was at a loss for words.
Could it be more melodramatic; now we have reincarnation lovers in the mix?
This Immortal Tree really knows how to play!
"Then what are we waiting for, let’s start!"
His eager reaction left Miao Yu slightly puzzled.
"Aren’t you afraid?"
"Afraid of what?"
"In the Wheel of Destiny, you might just be an ordinary person without the strength to even truss a chicken, maybe even worse."
Brother Cheng shrugged, nonchalantly: "After all, we are immortals, even if our identity changes, isn’t our power still there? It’s just acting with different identities."
Miao Yu softly replied: "If it were just the Destiny Rule, indeed. But there’s also the Reincarnation Rule, the Immortal Soul gets sealed. Before recovering memory, your power cannot return."
"These two rules combined are extremely treacherous; they could truly reduce someone to oblivion."
Brother Cheng remained silent, and after a long while, he spoke calmly: "No worries, when the Immortal Tree closes, won’t it end?"
Though he said this, he was thinking: I’m not afraid, once I’m dead inside, the system’s resurrection will restore settings to factory defaults.
Miao Yu stayed silent.
Finally, she nodded: "Let’s begin then."

chapters.title: Chapter 341: Cheating-Type Training
chapters.content:
Chapter 341: Chapter 341: Cheating-Type Training
"Hold on a second!"
Brother Cheng decided it’s better to be safe.
He couldn’t rely solely on the system’s resurrection to restore his factory settings. What if he didn’t actually die in there?
That Destiny Rule could be left alone, but he had to be wary of the Reincarnation Rule.
So, he opened the System Mall and spent 3000 Merit to exchange for a Level 5 Rule Fragment, upgrading the Reincarnation Rule to the Great Perfection Realm.
This was already at the Immortal Emperor Level Rule Understanding.
"Alright, mission accomplished, let’s go!"
The two sat cross-legged, their Immortal Souls left their bodies, relaxing their restraints.
A powerful attraction emanated from the Wheel of Destiny, and their light streams disappeared from the original place.
When they reappeared, Brother Cheng was already wearing a conical hat, rolling up his pants, and carrying a hoe, standing in the fields.
Staring at the blinding sun above and listening to the cicadas chirping in the nearby forest, he was somewhat dumbfounded.
This is too extreme, isn’t it?
The Wheel of Destiny had changed him from an Immortal to a farmer?
"Xiaojiang, why are you daydreaming again, slacking off?"
A shout pulled him back to the present moment, as an old farmer behind him, wiping sweat with a headscarf, was glaring at him.
Several others in the fields burst into laughter.
"Failed the exam three times, better settle down!"
"Hahaha, I bet he’s thinking of Cui Zhi from the neighboring village..."
What the heck is failing the exam three times?
Brother Cheng was immensely grateful he upgraded the Reincarnation Rule to Great Perfection before entering.
Because of this, he resisted the influence of the Reincarnation Mirror, his Immortal Soul wasn’t sealed, and he retained his memory.
Otherwise, in this peaceful village life, it would be far from easy to perform a resurrection and memory restoration operation once killed.
Better hurry up and get to business to complete the level!
Could that Cui Zhi from the neighboring village be Princess Miaoyu’s reincarnated new identity?
He let his Divine Thought expand, quickly sensing every move within a thousand-mile radius.
However, after sifting through this vast range countless times, he couldn’t find anyone matching Miao Yu’s characteristics.
He had to continue spreading his Divine Thought, sensing further afield.
This world wasn’t big, at most a few ten thousand miles in circumference.
And it had no Spiritual Qi, a super Low Martial World where cultivation hadn’t even appeared.
Quickly, he located Miao Yu within a deep palace of red walls and green tiles.
No need to distinguish, that person’s appearance was identical to hers, both were immensely beautiful Celestial Immortals.
She was sitting behind a curtain of pearls at the moment, surrounded by a large group of palace maids.
Beyond the curtain stood a dozen talented youth.
"Princess Miaoyu, the literary and martial arts talents competition is over, the outstanding performers are already here!"
"His Majesty has decreed that the royal consort is to be chosen by you personally..."
Brother Cheng nearly cursed aloud.
Is this Immortal Tree’s trial intentionally designed to be impossible to complete?
This woman wants to pick a royal consort and marry right from the start, then what’s the point of the subsequent Rule of Emotion trial, huh?
Moreover, the disparity in starting conditions between them is way too huge!
One’s a farmer, the other a favored princess.
If he hadn’t regained his memory, how could they even meet up later?
Brother Cheng really couldn’t figure it out.
He just knew that even if they truly met, it would certainly be after overcoming countless hardships and challenges.
He wasn’t interested in following that kind of script.
He planned to fly directly into the imperial palace and confess to Miao Yu to complete the Rule of Emotion.
But immediately, he found this woman had vanished from the palace.
Brother Cheng almost couldn’t help but rub his eyes; how could this be?
With his Immortal Soul level, how could a mere princess in a Low Martial World disappear right under his nose?
His Divine Thought discovered a hundred meters away on the dirt ridge, a stunning beauty dressed in a pale purple palace gown leisurely approaching.
She walked on the weed-covered dirt road, looking around at the scenery with interest.
The corners of her lips carried an elusive smile.
As she appeared, the farmers working in the fields all ceased their activities.
Upon seeing her, everyone seemed to lose their souls.
Not only because she was so beautiful, but because her demeanor unconsciously made them feel inferior, stirring a sense of embarrassment within.
Her presence transformed this place into her palace, while everyone else seemed to appear in an improper setting.
This woman was precisely Princess Miaoyu’s reincarnated self.
Brother Cheng understood almost instantly; this woman had also overcome the influence of the Reincarnation Rule, preserving her memory!
In this Low Martial World, only she could instantaneously appear here from the deep palace.
Isn’t this absurd?
The Immortal Tree set up this grand spectacle just to stage a heart-wrenching tale of Reincarnation Lovers’ alternating bouts of joy and sorrow...
Yet, the two entrants both activated their Celestial Eyes, essentially cheating!
Neither lost their memory, so what is there to sink into?
Clearly, Miao Yu had the same thought as him, uninterested in the lengthy process of reuniting after countless hardships and coincidences, directly taking the initiative by flashing before him.
Should he go up to her and recognize her?
Wouldn’t that count as a failed mission?
Brother Cheng was somewhat uncertain.
He could only pretend to be one of the other farmers, wide-eyed, mouth agape, drooling as he watched the fairy approach.
"I am Princess Miaoyu, you are destined to share a romance with me, come with me."
"Uh, uh?"
Brother Cheng looked stunned; girl, you’re really straightforward.
If he really did have amnesia, what expression should he have now?
Should he be overjoyed or bewildered?
Under the shocked yet envious and jealous gazes of the other farmers, Miao Yu linked arms with him, leading him away.
Brother Cheng resolved to play a good role as a regular farmer.
As for developing feelings and passing the Rule of Emotion test, he’d leave that challenge to Miao Yu.
In the days that followed, they went to many places and did numerous things.
Brother Cheng initially thought that such an esteemed Immortal King, in charge of the Celestial Pavilion, would surely not be skilled at romance.
Yet surprisingly, Miao Yu wasn’t just good; she was indeed proficient.
She would take him on ’dates’ to various places in this world, occasionally creating little surprises, and knew how to evoke emotions.
She was completely a romance expert, extremely rare among cultivators!
What’s more, she was already stunningly beautiful, constantly exuding an irresistible charm,
Brother Cheng introspected, if he were truly oblivious, a farmer with amnesia, he would have long been captivated by her, unable to escape.
According to the rules, having just one party develop feelings means passing the test.
However, unfortunately, he was aware this was all for show...
Sometimes, he even regretted upgrading the Reincarnation Rule to Great Perfection; had he truly lost his memory, this would have been over.
His earlier complication instead wasted her efforts.
"Don’t you like me?"
She lowered herself, her soft scent bringing a fragrant aroma, her curved eyelashes seemingly expressing love talk.
Feeling somewhat passive beneath her, Brother Cheng responded.
"I do like you..."
"You’re lying, you haven’t truly fallen for me!"
Upon saying this, she waved her hand, and the world rapidly crumbled and vanished.

chapters.title: Chapter 342 Immortal Tree Core
chapters.content:
Chapter 342: Chapter 342 Immortal Tree Core
The scene changed, and Brother Cheng appeared inside a dark and solemn palace.
After a quick check, he found that this time he was no longer a mortal, but a demon cultivator at approximately the Spirit Platform Realm.
Is this reincarnation?
How is it reincarnation?
He vaguely felt that it was Miao Yu who forcibly accomplished it.
Could it be?
Did she control that Reincarnation Mirror?
It shouldn’t be, right? This is the Immortal Tree’s domain, even his Great Perfection Reincarnation Rule couldn’t manage that.
At this moment, two demon cultivators rushed into the hall.
"Demon Lord, the Liuli Sect’s army has attacked, we’d better retreat quickly!"
The Demon Lord sitting on the throne coldly shouted, "Retreat? What retreat? Go out and fight them to the death!"
Then he led the demons out to battle.
Following them outside, Brother Cheng saw Fairy Miao again, but she was standing on the opposite side with the Liuli Sect.
Judging by her position, she should still be a True Inheritor or even a Saintess level.
This time, her cultivation was about the First Layer of Celestial Fate, but Brother Cheng knew she retained her memories and could wipe out the entire field with a thought.
He didn’t know what to say.
This time in reincarnation, have I and she become opposing identities?
The two sides first engaged in a lengthy war of words before engaging in soldier-on-soldier and general-on-general combat.
He was considered a mid-tier backbone in this Demon Sect, and he faced off against a Spirit Platform Realm Elder of the Liuli Sect.
While handling the fight nonchalantly, he also took a moment to observe Miao Yu.
He saw her busy fighting a high-level demon sect member, fighting quite properly, matching her apparent cultivation level.
This grand battle didn’t last long before it became one-sided, with the Liuli Sect’s power clearly superior.
The sect master of the Demon Sect, seeing the adverse situation, fled, resulting in the remaining members scattering like birds and beasts, and Brother Cheng followed the crowd in retreat.
Soon, he discovered Miao Yu was pursuing alone.
Due to having to play the role of amnesiac, he couldn’t defeat a Celestial Fate Realm opponent, so he pretended to be captured by her.
Thereafter, the two once again experienced a series of moving and stirring romances.
The forbidden love between a righteous sect’s Saintess and a Demon Sect genius, the strong opposition from the sect’s elders, defecting from the sect, external rumors and gossip; through storms, they supported each other and kept each other warm...
Brother Cheng had to admit, Miao Yu was a master of romance.
If it were someone else, they would have fallen for her again long ago.
However, knowing the plot in advance, he maintained the mindset of an observer, never truly involved in the drama, thus how could he feel emotional.
Under the joint siege of the righteous and demonic paths, they ended up cornered, ’trapped’ in a stormy cave.
"Do you regret it?"
"No regrets!"
"Then why have you not fallen for me?"
The sound of killing outside grew closer, she slowly closed her eyes, and then this world darkened as it quickly collapsed and dispersed.
Brother Cheng reincarnated again...
He was now almost certain that neither reincarnation ending was due to her influence.
Afterward, the two experienced a total of seven more reincarnations, forming nine lifetimes of destined romantic partners.
In these reincarnations, sometimes they were childhood sweethearts, sometimes senior and junior apprentices, and sometimes even one was human while the other was a demon.
Watching the girl always striving so hard to create a romantic atmosphere to pass each level, Brother Cheng felt a bit guilty.
So he could only follow along and make efforts as well.
Finally, during the tenth reincarnation, at a certain moment the scene of the level quietly vanished and the two returned to the Immortal Tree.
This level was cleared.
As to how it was cleared, Brother Cheng was a bit confused himself.
However, when they looked at each other afterwards, they couldn’t help but feel a bit awkward together.
Miao Yu’s eyes welled with a hint of doubt: "Were you not affected by the Reincarnation Rule?"
Brother Cheng shook his head decisively: "No! Definitely not!"
"Those five reincarnations were really challenging..."
Brother Cheng was very surprised: "Wasn’t it ten times? Did I remember wrong?"
"How do you know it was ten times?"
Miao Yu gave him a deep look, and said softly: "If you were truly trapped in reincarnation, you wouldn’t remember anything that happened in there now."
Darn, she was trying to trick me?
"I just blurted it out casually, why, do you know it really was ten times?"
Miao Yu took a deep breath, and for a moment didn’t know how to respond to him.
If she admitted she knew, it would mean she wasn’t affected either.
So, she had to just let it go.
A few days later, the two reached the end of this level.
This time, ahead there were not two entrances, just a continuously rotating nine-colored vortex.
"No surprise, stepping in there would take you into the heart of the Enlightenment Immortal Tree."
"Can you continue?"
Brother Cheng naturally said: "Of course."
Because he possessed the same-source aura as the Immortal Tree, he felt no pressure inside at all.
Forget about the 33rd Realm, even at the 330th Realm, nothing would happen.
"I’m already at my limit."
"In the next realm, I definitely cannot bear it."
As Miao Yu spoke, there seemed to be some unwillingness in her words.
She was actually outdone.
Yet, there was no choice; facing a system hack, no matter how special she was, she couldn’t compete.
In the end, Brother Cheng went into the vortex alone.
The moment he entered, the entire Immortal Tree shuddered violently once.
The Immortal Kings and Demon Kings inside the three entrances woke from their cultivation in unison, stared blankly around, and speculated what had happened.
What appeared before Brother Cheng wasn’t a series of paths like before, only a huge emerald green light mass.
On this light mass, he sensed an origin aura hundreds of times more intense than the 32nd Realm before.
If it weren’t for being of the same source, he might’ve been uncontrollably absorbed and assimilated by it.
Before he could react, a flash of white light darted from the Xuanji Map into that huge green light mass.
Subsequently, Ah Huang appeared by his side.
"Mom!"
"Where is this place?"
"This is the Enlightenment Immortal Tree, how did you get out?"
"I was attracted out." Ah Huang said while skillfully climbing onto his shoulder again.
Brother Cheng knew she was mystical, so he couldn’t be bothered to explore the reason, only sensed in the Xuanji Map, only to find Xiaobai was missing.
"Where is your brother Xiaobai?"
"Him?"
Ah Huang pointed towards the light mass, covering her mouth with a laugh: "Swallowed by this Immortal Tree Core!"
"What did you say?"
Brother Cheng nearly jumped up.
Xiaobai had been with him for so long, having made great contributions during the Immortal City Ascension Battle.
He was quite attached to this son and didn’t want him to meet with misfortune.
"He was staying well inside the Xuanji Map, how could he be swallowed?"
Ah Huang naturally said: "They are all Origin Fragments, the closer they get, the easier they are mutually attracted. Unfortunately, little brother is too weak, of a much lower level than it, so being swallowed is naturally expected."
She indeed knew a lot.
Brother Cheng looked at her gloating smile and was nearly speechless.
"How can you be so happy when your brother is in danger?"
Then, he too plunged headlong into the Immortal Tree Origin.

chapters.title: Chapter 343 Promotion to Immortal King
chapters.content:
Chapter 343: Chapter 343 Promotion to Immortal King
As soon as he entered the core of the Immortal Tree, Brother Cheng felt himself suddenly dissolving.
His consciousness was constantly drifting away.
In the midst of it, he vaguely saw his wayward son sinking deeper into the green ocean.
At this moment, Xiaobai had long lost consciousness.
The system also issued a warning at this moment.
"Danger!"
"The host is about to become a part of the World Origin!"
"This situation does not count as death, resurrection is impossible!"
Brother Cheng was startled, quickly retreating from the Immortal Tree core.
What should be done?
He could only call on Time Reversal, hoping to reverse back to the moment before Xiaobai was devoured.
However, the system panel indicated: This Time Reversal requires one hundred million Merit.
Currently, he had less than two million Merit, selling everything he had wouldn’t be enough.
"How could this happen?"
"It’s just going back a moment ago!"
The system replied: "Time Reversal interferes with the original trajectory of all present targets. Due to the Origin Core’s tier being too high, the cost of retrospection is extremely high."
This...
Brother Cheng checked all the skills he had learned, but none could resolve the current situation.
The reason was simple, this Immortal Tree core’s tier was too high, too high.
So high that one has no way out...
Wait, tier too high?
Suddenly enlightened, Brother Cheng thought of something.
The next moment, he sat cross-legged, beginning to attempt breaking through to Immortal King.
His previous failure to reach Immortal King was because the item serving as the core was too low in grade, simply could not bear the Daoist Heart of 992 Main Rules.
Even Tier Nine Immortal Sword and Immortal Treasures weren’t qualified, then finding suitable Treasure in the Immortal Realm was as hard as ascending to the heavens.
Now this Immortal Tree core’s grade is high enough, right?
So high that for the system to perform Time Reversal even once would require a huge price.
Using it as a core, there should no longer be a situation of insufficient grade, right?
Sect Leader Jiang was also daring beyond measure, there was nothing he didn’t dare to think of.
As long as he turned this thing into the core of an Immortal Country, it would be under his control, saving Xiaobai would then be a piece of cake!
Thinking of it, he immediately embarked on the step of entrusting the core.
Rules all plunged into the Immortal Tree Origin, like stars rapidly orbiting around a blazing sun.
The green light orb trembled violently again, as if struggling desperately.
Brother Cheng desperately tried to drag it into his unformed Immortal Country, however, this process was even more difficult than he imagined.
The entire Immortal Tree trembled again at this moment.
All Immortal Kings in cultivation had to stop once more.
Brother Cheng felt like an ant, towing a mountain!
The 992 Main Rules were like ropes wrapped around the massive mountain.
He simply couldn’t move it.
This task seemed like the futile attempt of shaking a tree by an ant, there was no possibility of success at all.
This was actually quite natural, as the Immortal Tree didn’t belong to him.
If anything he saw could become the core of his Immortal Country, it would be too far-fetched.
At the critical moment, Ah Huang came hopping to the side of the light orb.
"Mommy, what are you doing?"
"Are you going to absorb it?"
"Then you must first refine it!"
Brother Cheng thought to himself that if he could refine it, it would be simple.
Once refined, it would truly belong to him, then even the heaviest mountain would be light as a cloud to him.
But the problem was, the resistance of the Immortal Tree Origin was too fierce, far surpassing his current power.
It was fortunate he wasn’t devoured by it in return.
"I’ll help Mommy!"
Ah Huang’s shiny black eyes rolled around, suddenly reaching her little hand into the green light sphere.
Quietly, the previously struggling Immortal Tree Origin calmed down.
After an unknown amount of time, it seemed to fall asleep, no longer resisting.
At this moment, Brother Cheng almost wanted to lift Ah Huang up and kiss her hard!
This good daughter was too considerate!
Moreover, she was too powerful, being able to intervene even with this level of Divine Object?
With the Immortal Tree no longer resisting, he was truly able to refine it.
At this thought, he temporarily gave up breaking through to Immortal King and instead started to refine the Immortal Tree Origin.
Time passed day by day in this manner.
Jiang Cheng fell into the longest ’cultivation’ session yet, if this could also be considered cultivation.
As time passed, the Immortal Kings scattered throughout various parts of the Immortal Tree began to sense something unusual.
The Power of Origin in their positions was becoming increasingly thin.
"How could this happen?"
"Can the Immortal Tree’s Origin weaken?"
"This is unheard of!"
"Then what should we do?"
"How about we proceed to the next realm?"
"What if we choose the wrong entrance?"
"For a greater opportunity, it’s worth the risk!"
Similar conversations occurred among the Immortal Kings in various regions.
Soon, many Immortal Kings rose again, continuing to explore forward.
Xiao Kun, Jiyun, Mingchi, Liuyuan, and others were relatively lucky, as when they stopped, they could confirm the next entrance Jiang Sect Leader chose was correct.
And that entrance was chosen in front of them.
So, they could at least advance securely to the next level.
But it was hard to say for those other cultivators, many chose wrong, ever wandering in lower regions thereafter.
Time continued to pass, the Power of Origin from the Immortal Tree grew weaker and weaker.
Decades later, most regions had already been refined by Brother Cheng.
He finally gained control over a portion of the Immortal Tree Origin, only to find that Xiaobai was already missing.
What was going on?
His heart sank, could it be that the child had already merged with the Immortal Tree Origin and disappeared into the world?
Reflecting on the days when he used to challenge him, Jiang Cheng for the first time felt a pang of sorrow.
"No!"
"I refuse to accept this fate!"
"He must be retrievable!"
Within the Origin, he continued to look...
Until one day, he finally found a trace of lingering aura inside.
"Luckily!"
He directly used the Resurrection Skill on that wisp of aura!
This resurrection was unprecedentedly costly, consuming a whopping 1.2 million Merit, incomparable to the hundreds of Points required before!
As the skill took effect, Xiaobai reappeared alive before him.
Upon emerging, this child clutched his heart and continuously expressed his relief.
"Dad, was it you who saved me?"
"Wow, did sister really have such a kind heart?"
"What did you think? I’ve been telling you two siblings to love each other and help one another!" Brother Cheng felt deeply gratified.
He wasn’t aware that this resurrection carried new implications.
The fragment of Origin Xiaobai originally had been devoured and merged by the Immortal Tree Origin long ago.
Now resurrected, the fragments constructing his body were new.
When time reached the 72nd year, his refinement process reached its final stage.
The entire Origin had become his private property!
At the moment the refinement was completed, the gigantic Enlightenment Immortal Tree disappeared silently.
All Immortal Kings and Demon Kings practicing within were expelled!
Many were puzzled and stunned.
"What happened with the frequent anomalies of the Enlightenment Immortal Tree this time?"
"Yeah, wasn’t it supposed to open for 81 years? Why did it close before time?"
"I have a feeling that this tree will never appear again..."
"I have that feeling too!"

chapters.title: Chapter 344: The Unprecedented Innate Dao Foundation
chapters.content:
Chapter 344: Chapter 344: The Unprecedented Innate Dao Foundation
Very soon, everyone discovered that the three entrances, including the Sacrificial Moon Sacred Land of the Moon Race, were all destroyed.
Previously, with the protection of the power of the Immortal Tree, these three entrances were impossible to destroy.
The occurrence of such an event now confirms their recent speculation—the Enlightenment Immortal Tree will never appear again.
All the Immortal Kings lamented one after another.
"Without the Enlightenment Immortal Tree, how will we enhance our Innate Foundation in the future?"
"Indeed, how could such a great opportunity just disappear like this?"
"Without the Immortal Tree, there’s seemingly no reason for you or me to continue staying in the Middle Immortal Realm..."
"That’s right, staying in the Middle Immortal Realm was originally for this opportunity. Now it seems, it’s time to go to the Upper Immortal Realm."
Many Immortal Kings have begun to consider new plans.
In the Upper Immortal Realm, there will actually be other opportunities.
However, with experts gathering there and greater competition, they chose to stay here before.
This time, Brother Cheng’s refinement has invisibly created a profound impact on the entire Middle Immortal Realm.
The ascension of numerous Immortal Kings will undoubtedly lead to a major reshuffle of the power structure across the major Celestial Domains.
Returning to the Moon Immortal Palace entrance, Xiao Kun, Jiyun, Wu Jue, and others immediately began searching for Sect Leader Jiang.
Yet, after searching widely, everyone else was there except for him.
"Oh no, could Sect Leader Jiang be in trouble?"
"Impossible, with his venerable power, how could mere Enlightenment Immortal Tree be capable of trapping him?"
This time, many other Immortal Kings didn’t gain much improvement.
First, because other people had come in before, the improvements weren’t as significant in the later stages.
Secondly, as the Immortal Tree was refined by Brother Cheng, the Power of Origin became increasingly thin, and others’ cultivation effects dwindled.
On the contrary, Xiao Kun, Jiyun, and Wu Jue, guided by Sect Leader Jiang, reached the Eighth Realm and later entered the Ninth Realm, so their improvements were significant.
Their Innate Foundations all advanced from the Dustless Level to the Feather Transformation Level.
This was already the ceiling among Immortal Kings.
The Three Great Corpse Kings and Jingyu, Mingchi, and others also had their gains.
But at this moment, they had no time to feel joy.
Without Sect Leader Jiang, everyone lost their backbone.
"Then where has he gone?"
"Has he disappeared like that time before again..."
"He’s fine." Miao Yu, surrounded by experts from the Celestial Pavilion, walked over.
"Rest assured, he’s better than all of us."
"How do you know?"
Miao Yu glanced into the distant chaos outside the sky, her eyes, bright as morning stars, seemingly penetrating layers of barriers.
"I saw it."
For some reason, Xiao Kun, Wu Jue, and others suddenly found they couldn’t see through this woman at all anymore.
That feeling was like a mayfly gazing up at a crane in the sky, not beings of the same tier at all.
"By the way, you were the only one who accompanied Sect Leader Jiang; what happened later?"
Miao Yu’s cherry lips moved slightly, ultimately just saying, "Nothing happened..."
Then she actively extended an invitation to these people: "Would you like to join the Celestial Pavilion? I’m talking about the headquarters in the Upper Immortal Realm."
At these words, all the other Immortal Kings present stopped their discussions, their eyes widening.
It’s very difficult to join the Celestial Pavilion.
This neutral organization has its own direct lineage and seldom recruits outsiders.
Unless one has special talents, like Mingchi and Liuyuan, who are Masters of Pill Artifacts.
And once you join this organization, the treatment is higher than the patriarchs of other sects, after all, the Celestial Pavilion is in business, who has more cultivation resources than them?
Especially since Miao Yu mentioned the Celestial Pavilion in the Upper Immortal Realm, that’s even more extraordinary.
Xiao Kun and the remaining 11 people exchanged glances and then cupped their hands, replying in a hoarse voice, "If you can have Sect Leader Jiang join, we have no objection."
Mingchi, Wu Jue, and others also agreed: "That’s right, that’s exactly what I mean!"
"As long as Sect Leader Jiang nods, we’ll immediately comply."
In the past, Miao Yu would have absolutely been unable to understand why such a group of powerful Immortal Kings would revere Jiang Cheng so much, to the point of completely considering themselves his subordinates.
But now, not only did she understand, but even other Immortal Kings in the Celestial Pavilion felt this was the most natural answer.
So, she could only nod and then fly away from here.
Meanwhile, Sect Leader Jiang was already busy with another breakthrough to Immortal King.
The Immortal Tree Core was successfully refined, and the process that followed was exceedingly simple.
His Daoist Heart, embodying 992 rules, finally smoothly attached itself to the Immortal Tree Core.
Soon after, a dramatically miniaturized Immortal Tree appeared in the rule-less void.
The Immortal Tree radiated brilliantly, and the sublimated Dao Heart quickly expanded.
Time and space began to appear here, fire, wind, lightning, water arose...
An Immortal Country gradually took form!
The Innate Dao Foundation transcended the concept of space from the start and rapidly ascended, swiftly surpassing the Extraordinary and Dustless levels.
Then it surpassed Feather Transformation and Ascension, shattering the ceiling of other Immortal Kings.
And the transformation of that Innate Dao Foundation was not yet finished.
Soon it transcended time, reaching the Profound Mysterious Level, and the Immortal Country became eternal.
As long as he wasn’t dead, it wouldn’t decline.
To use the Enlightenment Immortal Tree as the core of an Immortal Country is simply incredible.
After all, the Immortal Tree inherently had the miraculous effect of enhancing the Innate Dao Foundation.
With this core and 992 main rules, it’s unimaginable what could ultimately be achieved.
At last, his Innate Dao Foundation naturally surged to the supreme state of Divine Communication!
Although the Innate Dao Foundation only represents the heights achievable in the future, truly becoming that strong still requires step-by-step cultivation.
But the upper limit determines future heights.
Very few Immortal Emperors can possess an Innate Dao Foundation at the Divine Communication level.
Reaching this point at the Immortal King Realm is unprecedented.
Currently, Brother Cheng’s Immortal Country has just formally taken shape, still in its most primitive state.
It only contains the most basic Power of Rules, and nothing else.
Going forward, two critical tasks lie ahead: continuing to enhance personal power and shaping and perfecting the Immortal Country.
The more perfect and powerful the Immortal Country, the stronger the strength it brings.
For him, enhancing personal capability remains taking medicine and cultivation.
Regarding the Immortal Country’s enhancement, it’s a long and complex process.
He slightly sensed that his current combat power was several times stronger than before, and crucially, the level of power was different.
If he faces Immortal Kings again, he won’t be so powerless anymore.
"Alright, we should go back now!"
He patted the heads of the two kids, especially praising Ah Huang.
"Thanks to you this time, my good daughter is truly amazing!"
Ah Huang tugged at his sleeve and giggled, "Mom, don’t just say empty words, is there any substantial reward?"
Brother Cheng’s face froze slightly. "Er, well..."
He opened the Xuanji Map, spending 1 merit point to elevate its spirit vein to the Immortal Stone Vein level.
The two children cheered in delight immediately.

chapters.title: Chapter 345: Modified - 345 The Disappeared Immortal Fate Order
chapters.content:
Chapter 345: Modified: Chapter 345 The Disappeared Immortal Fate Order
Brother Cheng touched his nose, was just this little reward able to satisfy them so much?
It was just 1 point of merit.
Even with his thick skin, he felt a rare hint of remorse.
Thinking about how he had been busy showing off lately, neglecting the care for the kids, he really needed to reflect on himself.
So, he continued to work hard, spending 100,000 merit points to upgrade this immortal stone vein from Level 1 to Level 6.
In an instant, the surroundings of the vein for hundreds of millions of miles became flourishing.
Some immortal herbs and spiritual materials started to sprout, becoming the first immortal realm within the Xuanji diagram space!
This made the two kids even happier.
"Dad, you’re amazing!"
"Well, it’s a must!"
Brother Cheng felt gratified and rubbed Xiaobai’s head.
"Mom’s quite capable, huh? I thought Mom wasn’t up to it anymore..."
"When have I ever not been up to it? Explain it clearly to me!"
Brother Cheng’s face was filled with black lines, and he retreated from the Xuanji diagram space with a look of resignation.
Looking at his empty immortal country, he began to consider how to develop it further.
With the improvement of the Immortal Kings’ own strength, the immortal country itself would undergo certain changes.
A ninth-grade Immortal King, unless the limit of his innate Dao foundation is at the Sumeru level, would never have an immortal country weaker than the extraordinary level no matter how weak it was.
But Brother Cheng’s immortal country’s limit was at the Divine Communication level, relying solely on personal upgrades is definitely far from enough.
Besides that, it’s just about enduring over time.
As time goes by, the world of the immortal country itself will slowly evolve.
This is also why the strength of some veteran Immortal Kings is generally stronger.
If not for the limitations of the innate Dao foundation, the immortal realm would probably favor those who live the longest.
However, how could Brother Cheng possibly wait for a process that lasts billions of years or more?
He could only consider alternative methods.
Shaping an immortal country can also be achieved through a third method, using treasures to catalyze the evolutionary process.
The immortal country itself is an unconventional small world, and any treasure that reaches the level of an immortal artifact can stimulate it.
He opened the system warehouse and extracted hundreds of 1st- to 4th-tier immortal artifacts and magical treasures that he had drawn before.
These were drawn, and cannot be exchanged for merit, so they were a form of waste utilization.
Over three hundred immortal artifacts and more than two hundred magical treasures were thrown into the immortal country and were quickly decomposed into nothing.
Soon after, the originally empty ’world’ seemed to accelerate by ten million times, quickly forming some dust elements.
It went from the empty Sumeru stage to the extraordinary stage.
These dust particles drifted aimlessly without any pattern.
He sensed slightly, the power of the immortal country indeed increased a lot, but it was still far from reaching the next dustless stage.
This breakthrough took quite some time, and when he returned to the Moon Immortal Palace, there was no one left.
Picking a direction, he set off back on his journey.
During the time with the Enlightenment Immortal Tree, the entire Middle Immortal Realm was also in an uproar.
The opportunity to ascend to the Upper Immortal Realm came once every hundred thousand years, and the deadline for the current session was drawing increasingly near.
Jiang Cheng entered during the first decade of the Enlightenment Immortal Tree’s period, which was exactly when the Immortal Fate Order was revealed.
As usual, many immortals gathered in front of the Immortal Fate List to watch.
"I heard Feixian Sect in the Qianlan Celestial Realm bought 3,300 Immortal Fate Orders, there will be a big reveal there this time."
"Yeah, I don’t know what kind of madness they’re going through."
"This is literally seeking death, it’s just that with over a hundred years left, everyone is not in a hurry to snatch..."
"It’s out, it’s out!"
"The Immortal Fate List is lighting up!"
Everyone looked up at the massive immortal jade stele, watching the small points of light appear quickly...
A moment later, the crowd was in an uproar!
"How come it’s only this many?"
"Counted, at most there are only about 31,000 pieces, right?"
"No, this isn’t right!"
"I came to see it during the last decade too; back then there were at least over 330,000!"
"Where did those 300,000 go?"
"Could they have been destroyed?"
"Immortal Fate Orders cannot be destroyed, not even hidden by an Immortal King’s nation!"
"How come the Feixian Sect’s side is all dark too, weren’t they said to have 3,300 pieces?"
"Yeah, where did those Immortal Fate Orders go?"
What happened here quickly spread throughout the Middle Immortal Realm.
For a time, countless people were shocked by this.
To lose 300,000 Immortal Fate Orders out of thin air was a monumental event.
That meant a drastic reduction in positions, reducing by tenfold; many Immortal Venerables who had a good chance to enter the Upper Immortal Realm were certainly not able to ascend this time.
Various speculations and rumors were rampant.
Some suspected the Immortal Fate Orders were hidden by special means; others wondered if there was an error with the Immortal Fate List.
Some even speculated the Upper Immortal Realm opened the back door, secretly allowing 300,000 people through early.
Yet in fact, this was all simply because Brother Cheng entered the Enlightenment Immortal Tree.
The Enlightenment Immortal Tree is located outside the Middle Immortal Realm in the chaotic area beyond the sky, which is not within the Immortal Fate List’s perception.
So the 300,000 or so Immortal Fate Orders on him naturally would not appear.
The external speculations continued to the next decade.
This time the immortals gathered outside the Immortal Fate List were at least a hundred times more than the last.
The chance to ascend to the Upper Immortal Realm tugged at many hearts and minds, and no one could ignore it.
Under the huge crowd, only a little over 30,000 Immortal Fate Orders appeared on display again.
The rest of the 300,000 were truly ’gone without a trace’.
Therefore, the entire Middle Immortal Realm exploded completely.
For the next few decades, countless people hurried around searching for the missing Immortal Fate Orders.
Meanwhile, the over 30,000 Immortal Fate Orders that showed up were snatched at an unprecedented rate!
This kind of thing would only usually happen in the last decade, but now the competition intensified tenfold, and many people could no longer remain calm.
Aside from some Ancient Immortal Sects and Demon Sects that no one dared to provoke for the time being, all other Immortal Venerables with Immortal Fate Orders were hunted down by tens and hundreds of enemies.
The entire Middle Immortal Realm was in a state of bloody turmoil.
Feixian Sect had to be thankful that all the Immortal Fate Orders were on Brother Cheng because if even one point had been revealed here, they wouldn’t have peace.
The sect was trembling from top to bottom, and Yuan Zhen and Yuan Sheng immediately sealed off the mountain, forbidding disciples from going out.
This situation continued until the current Enlightenment Immortal Tree closed, and a large number of Immortal Kings returned.
Brother Cheng had previously displayed over 300,000 Immortal Fate Orders at the Moon Immortal Palace.
Therefore, the returning Immortal Kings knew the truth.
The Immortal Fate Orders had not disappeared; they were still there, just all on Jiang Cheng.
This news left countless people in disbelief.
How could 300,000 all be on one person, how was that possible?
What could he possibly need with so many Immortal Fate Orders?
The whole idea seemed irrational.
But also due to this news, the bloody turmoil in the Middle Immortal Realm over the past few decades gradually calmed down considerably.
Feixian Sect was the immediate target thereafter.
Fortunately, after Xiao Kun, Wu Jue, Jiyun, and others returned, they all stationed themselves within Feixian Sect.
Additionally, due to the uncertainty regarding the truthfulness of this news, it was relatively safe for the moment.
But over time, signs of numerous other forces began to appear outside Feixian Sect.
This included several Immortal Kings.
They could ascend to the Upper Immortal Realm at any time, but most Immortal Kings with family wanted to secure benefits for their descendants as well.
Now, the entire Middle Immortal Realm focused on whether Jiang Cheng was still alive.
If alive, when might he return?

chapters.title: Chapter 346: Brother Cheng’s Touring Appearance
chapters.content:
Chapter 346: Chapter 346: Brother Cheng’s Touring Appearance
Brother Cheng didn’t know he had become the focus of the entire Middle Immortal Realm.
Nor did he know that so many people were eagerly awaiting his return.
If he knew, he probably wouldn’t even care about stabilizing his Realm, and would rush back flamboyantly to accept the cheers of the masses.
The breakthrough to Immortal King is a long process, and even at his fastest, it still took him decades.
When he returned, there was just the last ten years left.
Holding 300,000 Immortal Fate Orders, he was flying rapidly, when suddenly his whole body started emitting intense golden light.
The golden light shot straight into the sky, illuminating the entire horizon brilliantly.
The last decade had arrived.
The decadal Immortal Fate Order exposure period, when not only does the Immortal Fate Chart show the location, but the person with the Immortal Fate Order also emits a special light.
This light lasts for a whole month, as a reminder to those nearby that this person has Immortal Fate Orders.
However, Brother Cheng didn’t know.
Although he had bought so many Immortal Fate Orders, he hadn’t personally experienced this before.
He was somewhat puzzled, what was going on?
Why was his body emitting such strong light?
Other than being visually striking, it seemed to have no negative effects.
"Could it be because bro has ascended to Immortal King, causing a transformation in demeanor, making the celestial rules unable to remain calm, hence rewarding me with a personal halo effect?"
He soon figured it out.
And became quite pleased with himself.
"Indeed, the treatment of the protagonist is something special."
Soon he noticed that whenever someone was below him, they would without exception look up at him.
And everyone’s expression was so shocked, so ’worshipful’.
"This effect is really so awesome, absolutely captures everyone’s attention!"
Brother Cheng deliberately stopped to take a look, and even received some Shock Value.
Though these people had low cultivation, didn’t give much, but it was a token of their intention.
"Hahaha, everyone please don’t be too excited!"
He waved at the crowd below pointing at him.
"Thank you all for your love towards me!"
"But I have urgent matters to attend to, can’t come down to shake hands with you!"
"Until next time, until next time!"
After saying this, he flew off into the distance.
As he flew, he found that many people were still chasing him.
"Is this effect that alluring, everyone’s been conquered by this charm, keeping up the chase?"
He could only fly while shouting backward.
"Everyone, fly slower!"
"So many people, what if there’s a collision, that wouldn’t be good..."
He’s an Immortal King, most of those chasing him for the Immortal Fate Orders are merely Immortal Venerables, how can they catch up?
Even other Immortal Kings, in terms of speed, couldn’t match him.
While flying, he realized that wherever he went, he was always treated with attention.
Everyone below had a face of shock, they all contributed Shock Value to him.
Those chasing him, initially he was a bit surprised.
But he quickly figured it out.
These ’dedicated fans’ probably couldn’t suppress their ’excitement’, instinctively chasing after him to get up close...
Didn’t expect to have such a large crowd of fervent ’private fans’ soon after coming to the Middle Immortal Realm.
Feeling quite pleased, he turned back to sell his charm: "Everyone should chase stars rationally, as a superstar I also have my own life... "
The people chasing him were quickly left behind but soon there were new additions.
The grand procession surprisingly never quieted down.
He felt this moment was the most flamboyant in his life.
The lineup was just like a Celestial Emperor Superstar tour.
Everywhere he went caused screams!
And as he passed more places, the Shock Value accumulated more and more, getting higher.
Gradually, Merit Points reached a thousand, five thousand, ten thousand, fifty thousand, a hundred thousand...
According to the original plan, he intended to fly and also take cross-region Transmission Arrays, now he changed his mind.
Such flamboyant exposure, ah no, such a good thing to earn Merit Points, how can it be casually missed?
He simply didn’t use Transmission Arrays, flew the entire way.
And specifically picked those sect locations or Immortal City airspace to pass over, that was truly showy!
"How are the fans in the back?"
"Audience below, let’s get excited together!"
Accompanied by his flamboyant voice, many below were almost fuming with anger.
This guy is crazy?
Seeing the intensity of the golden light knew he had a large amount of Immortal Fate Orders, yet still dares to parade around like this?
This was the last decade!
After this period ends, Immortal Fate Orders can completely hide until the day of ascension to the Upper Immortal Realm.
This is the most brutal period for Immortal Fate Orders struggle, those possessing them would hide as secluded as possible.
Preferably to places others can clearly find, yet find it hard to enter Secret Realms.
And here this guy is.
Where there are many people, he goes!
Doesn’t he know flying above a sect’s territory is strictly forbidden for outsiders?
This is severe provocation to a sect, tired of living?
Originally it was just jealousy for the Immortal Fate Orders, eventually some sects really gritted their teeth and came out to chase.
But unfortunately, Brother Cheng’s speed even without activating Azure Dragon Bloodline, was still unmatched in the entire Middle Immortal Realm.
Even if riding a Transmission Array to intercept upfront, couldn’t even see his car’s tail lights.
Making many people jump with rage all the way.
And at the Immortal Fate Chart, the sea of people was already in an uproar!
The 300,000 Immortal Fate Orders that had been missing for over a hundred years had finally reappeared!
Just the Immortal Jade Stele showing not a bright spot, but a huge light ball!
Clearly showing the vast amount of Immortal Fate Orders.
"Finally appeared!"
"Feixian Sect’s Elder Jiang has returned!"
"It must be him, it seems the rumors weren’t wrong, all 300,000 Immortal Fate Orders are on him!"
"But reportedly that Elder Jiang is very powerful..."
"Anyone who enters the Enlightenment Immortal Tree is surely an Immortal King, can you and I snatch them?"
"What to fear, he is already the target of all, surely other Immortal Kings will also take notice of him!"
"Indeed..."
This opportunity was too rare.
Though knowing well that they surely weren’t Brother Cheng’s match, with 300,000 Immortal Fate Orders, snatching one amidst the chaos shouldn’t be difficult, right?
At once, many flew out with the fastest speed of their lives fearing to miss out.
However, many could still remain calm.
They found the light sphere was always rapidly moving, currently couldn’t catch up.
Once it stops, there’ll surely be a big battle, why not wait for both to be exhausted and then grab it, wouldn’t that be great?
So they waited and waited...
Waited for a full seven days and nights, the stone stele’s representation of 300,000 Immortal Fate Orders still ceaselessly moving.
Moreover, the speed astonishingly fast.
Many were dumbfounded.
"What’s he doing?"
"There’s no discernible destination, is he deliberately circling?"
"Is he playing us, outrageous!"
"Why hasn’t anyone intercepted him?"
"Haven’t the Immortal Kings and Demon Kings taken action yet?"
"No, I’ve heard at least a hundred Immortal Kings have moved..."
"Then why is he still flying?"

chapters.title: Chapter 347: What on Earth Does He Want to Do?
chapters.content:
Chapter 347: Chapter 347: What on Earth Does He Want to Do?
Located in the Infinite Celestial Realm, the Infinite Cave Heaven is one of the foremost Ancient Immortal Sects in the Middle Immortal Realm.
Their existence has been so long that even the disciples within the sect find it hard to pinpoint.
The name of the Sect has long become a symbol within the Immortal Realm, sung by countless immortals for generations.
Back then, one of the three entrances to the Enlightenment Immortal Tree was guarded by the Immortal Dao Alliance led by them.
Even if an Immortal Emperor from the Upper Immortal Realm descended here, they would be respectful and adhere to etiquette.
Because in the Upper Immortal Realm, another Infinite Cave Heaven has three Immortal Emperors stationed!
Currently, the Infinite Cave Heaven in the Middle Immortal Realm also has 15 Immortal Kings present.
And these 15 are all ancient Immortal Kings, having lived for billions, even tens of billions of years.
The main reason they’ve remained in the Middle Immortal Realm is that such an Ancient Immortal Sect values inheritance, needing people to maintain their exalted status.
The Infinite Cave Heaven had initially prepared 300 Immortal Fate Orders.
This number is unparalleled among the Immortal Sects and sects within the Middle Immortal Realm.
After all, they are not the only Ancient Immortal Sect or Demon Sect.
The 300 are tacitly agreed to be the number they are entitled to.
Their Immortal Fate Orders naturally don’t need to be sold to the Celestial Pavilion first, as no one would dare to come and rob them.
At this time, the Immortal Kings of Infinite Cave Heaven were not in seclusion but were gathered in a hall, observing the scenes displayed on a cyan round mirror.
The Qiankong Realm, capable of monitoring any location of immortal treasures in the Middle Immortal Realm.
On the screen was the image of Jiang Cheng flying swiftly.
Wherever he flew, the image extended to it.
Beside the Qiankong Realm, there was another Transmission Immortal Artifact, showing the activities on the Immortal Jade Stele of the Immortal Fate Chart.
Evidently, the 300,000 Immortal Fate Orders had attracted their attention.
"What exactly is this person planning to do?"
Several Immortal Kings in the hall frowned, unable to discern Sect Leader Jiang’s purpose.
"His flying speed..."
The Spirit Ink Immortal King, with lines full of wrinkles, slightly squinted his eyes, his originally dim eyes becoming sharper.
"It seems to have reached the level of an Immortal Emperor!"
Other Immortal Kings in the hall were somewhat incredulous; after all, it was difficult to gauge the specific speed from just the Qiankong Realm.
"How is this possible?"
"Even perfecting the Speed Rule shouldn’t compare to an Immortal Emperor, right?"
The Great Elder, Spiritual Universe Immortal King, shook his head and slowly said, "Only in this way... can we explain why no one has been able to stop him so far."
"No surprise, no one in the entire Middle Immortal Realm can catch up to this person, including you and me here!"
Indeed, in the Immortal Tier, instant teleportation is common knowledge, and for Immortal Kings, it’s a matter of course.
But instant teleportation has distance and frequency limitations, unlike Brother Cheng, who can fly endlessly without rest.
Therefore, they genuinely can’t catch him.
Everyone in the hall was shocked.
"This is too unbelievable."
"Is this the reason he dared to purchase 300,000 Immortal Fate Orders?"
"Because with such speed, he can escape at any time?"
"Does he intend to keep flying like this?"
On reflection, it seems quite possible.
Since he can’t hide, why not keep moving, flying until the day the Immortal Fate Orders are no longer exposed?
"Probably... not, right?"
"He bought so many; surely, they’re not for one person to use."
"Indeed, he will eventually have to stop!"
"Actually, we just need to wait for him at the Feixian Sect; he will definitely return there in the end."
"Humph! 300,000, really, he dares to think so big, not afraid of biting off more than he can chew!"
Originally, after securing 300 Immortal Fate Orders, they had no further thoughts, as it had always been like this each term.
But seeing Brother Cheng holding 300,000 made them uncomfortable.
Apart from the neutral and unneeding Celestial Pavilion, there are customary limits to how many Immortal Fate Orders other sects can possess.
This piece of Immortal Fate Order cake is cut from within their circle.
The Immortal Sects and demon sects in the Middle Immortal Realm are countless as the sand; if divided by the heads of Immortal Venerables, the Wuji Immortal Sect itself would be lucky to get two or three.
Now they stably hold 300, sending 300 Immortal Venerables up steadily each term, ranking among the most in the Middle Immortal Realm along with the other two factions.
This represents their supreme ruling status in the Middle Immortal Realm.
Other Immortal Sects and Demon Sects must not exceed this number, or they will be seen as breaking the rules.
300,000 evidently disrupts these rules entirely.
If it eventually succeeds, these Ancient Immortal Sects and Demon Sects would become a laughingstock.
"Currently, many are watching him closely, waiting to see what happens."
"No one can break the rules."
"Neither he nor his Feixian Sect can, either."
Similar discussions were taking place in other large and small Immortal Sects and Demon Sects.
Even over at Feixian Sect, they too were closely monitoring Brother Cheng’s movements.
They lacked a Qiankong Realm and could only rely on the Transmission Immortal Artifact to track the light groups moving on the Immortal Fate Chart.
"Where is our Master Ancestor heading to?"
"Yes, what destination is the master heading towards?"
Since receiving news of Jiang Cheng’s return, Yuan Zhen, Yuan Sheng, and others had been eagerly waiting for him to return to the Feixian Sect.
Currently, there were many forces, openly and covertly, stationed nearby, with no shortage of Immortal Kings, and everyone was under significant pressure.
Only with his return to hold the fort would everyone feel confident.
However, after waiting for so many days, there was no sign of Brother Cheng returning.
Everyone was baffled, unable to understand his intentions.
Xiao Kun, Jiyun, Mingchi, and others were closely watching the Immortal Jade Stele, trying to discern any patterns, but despite days of analysis, nothing was conclusive.
"The only thing I can see is that Sect Leader Jiang seems to be deliberately flying towards each sect and Immortal City."
"Yes, he has flown over countless sects along the way."
"It seems even the Infinite Cave Heaven can only watch him pass by."
"Hahaha, our master is someone who can catch butterflies; who can stop him?"
"What is the deeper meaning of his actions?"
"You ask me, who am I supposed to ask?"
They didn’t think Brother Cheng would deliberately flee.
With his strength in slaying Immortal Emperors, is that necessary?
"His actions are always profound and unpredictable, beyond comprehension."
The Immortal Kings all nodded in agreement. If they were on the first floor, he had already reached the stratosphere.
Totally unfathomable it is.
It’s no exaggeration to say Brother Cheng is truly the unique superstar of the Middle Immortal Realm now.
Of course, he’s quite flaunting himself, too.
This entire journey, how many detours he took, which locations he flew over, he himself didn’t know.
Anyway, he just kept dashing towards crowds.
Seven days, ten days, fifteen days, twenty-five days...
As time went on, everyone was nearly speechless.
This person roamed around day and night, with chases in front and pursuits behind, yet no one could stop him.
In such a vast Middle Immortal Realm, full of experts, yet they were helpless against him.
They could only watch as he flitted around openly.
At this rate, the month-long exposure period for the Immortal Fate Orders would soon end.

chapters.title: Chapter 348: Why Did He Stop
chapters.content:
Chapter 348: Chapter 348: Why Did He Stop
Despite the fact that most people in the Middle Immortal Realm hoped someone could intercept Sect Leader Jiang before the month was up, things didn’t go as they wished.
This ’war’ involving over half of the Middle Immortal Realm to hunt down one person ended in their failure.
If they knew the person in question didn’t regard it as a war, but merely a showoff, they’d probably be even more frustrated.
On the day the month ended, the golden light on him disappeared.
This was the last decade, anyone else would have breathed a sigh of relief.
But Brother Cheng was different; he rather felt a bit unsatisfied.
"Why isn’t this special effect permanent?"
"Alas, just when I was enjoying it a little, now I have to return to mundane life again."
He opened up the system panel and checked, the smile returned to his face.
This tour had indeed reaped a tremendous harvest.
Because everywhere he flew, people were astonished; he collected a lot of shock value along the way.
Now, in conversion, he had a whopping 23.36 million merit points!
This number is nearly ten times more than what he previously accumulated.
Which is only natural, given he had flown over so many places.
The cultivation levels of these people varied, and so did their degree of shock, but the sheer number of them made up for it!
If there were a ranking in the Middle Immortal Realm for ’most seen by people,’ he would surely lead by a landslide.
He spent 2.97 million merit points to upgrade all the main rules to the great perfection level.
This is the rule understanding level of an Immortal Emperor.
