The remaining over 20 million merit points were all converted into eighth-grade immortal pills to strengthen his cultivation!
Over 20 million merit points could be exchanged for as many as forty to fifty thousand eighth-grade immortal pills!
The medicinal strength of an eighth-grade immortal pill is many times stronger than that of a seventh-grade one.
And the Middle Immortal Realm doesn’t even produce eighth-grade immortal pills.
Such treatment is only enjoyed by an Immortal Emperor.
In Brother Cheng’s view, with so many immortal pills, ascending to ninth-grade Immortal King would be no problem.
However, when he actually started enhancing himself, he realized he had been too optimistic.
After consuming ten thousand immortal pills, he barely advanced from first-grade Immortal King to second-grade.
Even after using up the remaining thirty thousand-plus immortal pills, he still hadn’t reached third-grade...
"How the hell is this possible?"
"Must be a mistake?"
"Is it really this hard to level up as an Immortal King?"
In fact, such a number of eighth-grade immortal pills could easily produce dozens of ninth-grade Immortal Kings.
But he forgot one thing, after having an Immortal Country, the advancement of an Immortal King is tied to the country.
His Immortal Country, with 992 main rules, and using an Enlightenment Immortal Tree as the core...
This foundation was simply too formidable.
So his upgrading was naturally thousands of times more difficult than other Immortal Kings.
If he wasn’t good at earning merit, he might still be stuck at first or second-grade Immortal King even after tens of billions of years.
Meanwhile, on the other side, gazing at the dimmed Immortal Fate Chart, countless people wailed.
"Damn, he actually managed to survive this month?"
"So many rounds of Immortal Fate Orders, this is the first time I’ve seen someone so arrogant, it’s infuriating!"
The Immortal Fate Order wasn’t hidden, it was clearly in front of them, but they couldn’t get it, so frustrating!
"Isn’t there anyone who can deal with this monster?"
"At this rate, the Middle Immortal Realm will fall into chaos, where is the order?"
Everyone inexplicably felt quite humiliated, besides a deep sense of defeat.
"Now it’s useless to say anything, the Immortal Fate Order has completely gone into hiding, it’s no longer visible."
"Yes, we couldn’t catch him when it was exposed, let alone now..."
"But it was 300,000 pieces, this is killing us!"
At this point, everyone had lost hope.
But soon, someone suddenly shouted, holding a transmission immortal artifact.
"Wait, look!"
"He actually stopped!"
"What?"
The crowd gathered around, forming an impenetrable circle.
Although the Immortal Fate Chart didn’t display anything, the group of Immortal Kings and Immortal Venerables chasing Brother Cheng had, by habit, kept on chasing.
As the light ahead vanished, they similarly cursed while thinking it was impossible now.
Yet as they flew, they suddenly discovered that familiar figure appeared again in front of them.
Brother Cheng, busy browsing the system mall for Taobao and leveling up with his pills, naturally stopped in place.
Their first reaction wasn’t surprise, but disbelief that they had seen it wrong.
But after rubbing their eyes, Jiang Cheng still hadn’t left.
Thus, this scene naturally spread quickly along with the transmission immortal artifact projection.
It caused an uproar once more among countless people.
"What’s going on now?"
"What is he doing?"
"Looks like he’s in a daze?"
"No way?"
"I feel like he stopped on purpose to mock us?"
At this moment, countless people in the Middle Immortal Realm focused their attention on Brother Cheng.
Whether it was ancient immortal sects like Infinite Cave Heaven or some medium and small sects, they were all at a loss, unable to fathom his thoughts.
What exactly does this action signify?
Even the Feixian Sect was equally baffled.
Their founder had miraculously survived the month-long exposure period, and they had just been cheering.
Now this...
"Oh, you’re still here?"
Brother Cheng, fresh from leveling up, snapped back to reality, realizing he was surrounded.
Three layers inside and out, nearly seven to eight thousand people.
There were over thirty Immortal Kings leading, with almost the rest being Immortal Venerables.
Actually, several hundred Immortal Kings had been chasing him, but over time, some got left behind, and some gave up midway.
This group in front were the nearest ones.
"Oh, you’re still here?"
"Seeing as you’ve been following me for so long, I’ll reluctantly give you an autograph."
Having flaunted for a whole month and earned so much merit, he was in a pretty good mood, feeling he should give back to these ’stalker fans’ for supporting him.
The people around exchanged glances, not understanding what he meant, but their actions were swift.
Thirty-five Immortal Kings immediately released their Immortal Countries, while the Immortal Venerables on the periphery quietly set up immortal arrays and restrictions.
In a short while, this place turned into a cage with no escape up or down.
Seeing this scene, the high-ranking members of the various immortal sects watching through the transmission images all got excited at the same time.
"Got him!"
"Now he can’t escape even with wings!"
"No matter how fast he is, there’s no way out!"
Brother Cheng watched their setup with open eyes but couldn’t be bothered to stop them, just feeling a bit puzzled.
These didn’t look like the crazy star-chasing ’stalker fans.’
"What are you doing, marking your territory or something..."
"Hmph, you’ve been running quite fast this month!"
The thirty-five Immortal Kings present saw their setup complete and all felt relieved.
"Let’s see how you’ll escape now!"
"Hand over all the Immortal Fate Orders, or you’ll be dead with no burial site!"
"Just kill him already, with so many people here, why even negotiate..."
"Exactly, after such a long chase, I can’t wait to tear him to pieces!"
Brother Cheng finally realized the situation.
These people were chasing him just to steal his Immortal Fate Orders, not out of admiration?
This was awkward.
He had been so pleased with himself for a whole month.
Suddenly, he felt a strong surge of displeasure!
"So it was for the Immortal Fate Orders?"
"A bunch of tasteless idiots, ignoring the charm on me and chasing after those broken tokens instead?"
"Alright then!"
"You can all go to hell."

chapters.title: Chapter 349: Formidable Power
chapters.content:
Chapter 349: Chapter 349: Formidable Power
"You still dare..."
The group opposite was still planning to argue, but the world around them suddenly turned into a domain of pitch-black flames.
Brother Cheng, disappointed and embarrassed, was truly angry this time.
He no longer had the mindset to play around like before.
He didn’t even want to hear another word from them.
With one strike, all the Transmission Immortal Artifacts were instantly destroyed, and immediately, all the Immortal Venerables present fell.
Immortal Kings turned pale, hurriedly launching their Immortal Countries to attack in unison!
With so many Immortal Countries, the river of rules churned and surged, almost every moment depicting scenes of world destruction.
Countless celestial bodies were born and destroyed, creating terrifying power.
In the face of such an attack at this level, Immortal Venerables were mere dust without any resistance.
Unfortunately, Brother Cheng was no longer an Immortal Venerable.
Without hesitation, he summoned his own Immortal Country.
And when his Immortal Country appeared, the entire scene fell silent!
The Immortal Realm Continent has always been known for its stability, especially in the Middle Immortal Realm. Even wars between Immortal Kings rarely cause significant damage.
But now, this region was crumbling.
That Immortal Country was like a pitch-black curtain devouring everything, suppressing all other Immortal Countries.
"What is that!"
"What’s happening?"
In Infinite Cave Heaven, the faces of 15 Ancient Immortal Kings changed drastically in unison.
The Qiankong Realm, capable of monitoring the entire Middle Immortal Realm, suddenly developed cracks from afar, and then all images disappeared!
This Immortal Treasure was destroyed just like that.
"How could this be?"
"What’s happening over there?"
"To destroy this Immortal Treasure from such a distance and sever any spying, what kind of great power is this?"
In the field, the previously rampant river of rules suddenly halted, and the ever-changing celestial bodies dimmed.
A smaller version of the Enlightenment Immortal Tree slowly rose, its nine-colored radiance gently dispersing.
The core of an Immortal Country normally doesn’t reveal itself.
Brother Cheng was a newly promoted Immortal King, and his Immortal Country hadn’t yet stabilized.
Most importantly, the Enlightenment Immortal Tree was of such high grade that his Immortal Country couldn’t contain it and couldn’t stop it from manifesting.
"The Enlightenment Immortal Tree!"
"It’s the Enlightenment Immortal Tree!"
The Immortal Kings present almost went mad.
Apart from the Immortal Fate Order, another major event in the Middle Immortal Realm lately was the disappearance of the Enlightenment Immortal Tree.
Since this was a chance exclusive to Immortal Kings, it wasn’t widely known.
But for every Immortal King, the Enlightenment Immortal Tree was a hundred million times more important than the Immortal Fate Order!
Without the Immortal Fate Order, Immortal Kings can still ascend directly to the Upper Immortal Realm.
They’re here to seize it just to support their sect’s younger disciples.
But the Enlightenment Immortal Tree is directly tied to themselves.
"How is the Enlightenment Immortal Tree with you?"
"What did you do to the Immortal Tree?"
"You lunatic, you actually refined the Immortal Tree into the core of your Immortal Country?"
"It’s none of your business."
Brother Cheng drove his Immortal Country forward to attack!
In the next moment, 35 Immortal Countries emitted shivering wails...
Although Brother Cheng’s Immortal Country is currently only at the Extraordinary Level, its foundation is too strong.
The branches and leaves of the Immortal Tree spread rapidly, and when they touched the other Immortal Countries, they crumbled like paper.
This collapse wasn’t as fatal as the previous Divine Slide Tackle, which directly shattered the core of the Immortal Countries, leading to their irreparable silent extinction.
This time, the collapse was a forcible crush from the outside and did not harm the foundation.
If they survive, they can still be repaired in the future.
Unfortunately, Sect Leader Jiang wasn’t going to give them that chance.
The original encirclement quickly turned into a counterattack and a rout.
"No..."
"Stop!"
"I was wrong, the Immortal Fate Order is yours..."
"Please spare us..."
"Damn it, you aren’t even here to celebrate and you still chatter so much!"
Brother Cheng, already engaged in battle, never had the habit of stopping.
With sword raised and swung, Immortal Kings fell one after another, head and body separated mid-air.
In front of him, their limited speed couldn’t escape at all.
In just a short moment, the fight was over.
Even Jiang Cheng himself was a bit taken aback.
This battle was too easy.
The tenfold critical strike only increased the lower tier attack power and did not amplify the potency of the Immortal Country, which meant he won with his normal strength.
One against thirty-five, victory achieved in minutes.
"Isn’t this too absurd?"
"Am I now this badass?"
"Newly promoted Immortal King and already invincible at this level?"
He knew his Immortal Country was unique.
After all, the Enlightenment Immortal Tree was at its core.
Only now did he finally realize how truly powerful it was.
Having won the battle, it was time to reap the spoils.
In this battle, eliminating 35 Immortal Kings yielded huge gains.
There were over 60 Tier Seven Immortal Artifacts, along with piles of top-grade and even top-grade magical treasures, and innumerable Heavenly and Earthly Treasures.
Unfortunately, the Immortal Pills for cultivation, most people used them regularly and didn’t carry many on them.
Needing to upgrade quickly, Brother Cheng didn’t overthink it, directly storing all the spoils into the system and converting them all into merit.
This exchange yielded an additional 5,500,000 merit.
"Not bad, it’s true that combat increases the points fastest."
After collecting everything, he spread his arms wide.
"Let an even fiercer storm test me!"
"I can handle it!"
As soon as he finished speaking, someone really came.
After all, he was previously the Central Immortal Realm’s all-star, the center of everyone’s attention.
Just before the major battle began, many people had already rushed over quickly.
In their view, being besieged by so many peer Immortal Kings, Jiang Cheng was doomed.
But even if they couldn’t catch the battle, arriving a bit early could still net them a few Immortal Fate Orders, right?
Seeing thousands more arrive, Brother Cheng was excited.
"Hahaha, you’re also here to kill me, right?"
He shook the Rainbow Absolute Immortal Sword in his hand, already viewing these people as piles of merit points.
The newly arrived Immortal Venerables and Immortal Kings, seeing the ruin and debris of the scene, were first dumbfounded.
How is this person still alive?
Where are the others?
Sensing the lingering terrifying aura of the scene and recognizing some of the scattered Immortal King remnants, they immediately understood what had happened.
This person actually wiped out those 35 Immortal Kings along with thousands of Immortal Venerables?
How did he do it?
Whoa, they had just kicked an iron plate!
This man is definitely not just an Immortal King; could he be an Immortal Emperor?
Come to think of it, there had been news of Feixian Sect destroying nine Immortal Kings before!
At that time, everyone attributed it to the Three Great Corpse Kings and others.
All of a sudden, everyone broke out in cold sweat...
Previously shouting for blood, now they looked at Brother Cheng as if mere mortals faced a terrifying dragon, almost wetting themselves with fear.
The leading Immortal King retreated while rapidly putting on a smile and waved his hands apologetically.
"No, no, we wouldn’t dare to fight you, senior!"
"Yes, yes, we absolutely won’t be your enemies!"
"Please continue, senior, we’ll just leave..."
"Did I say you could leave?"
Brother Cheng narrowed his eyes, glaring at them unkindly.
"Then why did you come here?"
He wasn’t stupid.
"Are you going to tell me you’re here for sightseeing?"

chapters.title: Chapter 350: We Admire You, Senior
chapters.content:
Chapter 350: Chapter 350: We Admire You, Senior
When he questioned them, the group on the opposite side trembled with fear.
They wanted to run away, but couldn’t move their legs or summon their Immortal Power.
Fear!
Here was a person who had taken down 35 Immortal Kings.
At this moment, they regretted so deeply their intestines turned green.
If they had known this person was so fierce, they would have kept as far away as possible, instead of rushing here at top speed seeking a share of it.
Now, coming here, it’s simply courting death!
Of course, they didn’t want to die.
Anyone who has reached the Immortal Tier has at least a billion years of life expectancy, living comfortably, not wanting it to end so soon.
So, they had to plead for mercy.
"Senior, spare our lives!"
"We didn’t mean it..."
"Please, Senior, don’t hold grudges against people like us. Killing us would dirty your hands, wouldn’t it?"
Brother Cheng certainly wouldn’t listen to such words.
"Since you came to kill me, you are my enemies."
"I don’t need to teach you what should be done with enemies."
"If you want to resist, pick up your weapons, and let’s fight for three hundred rounds!"
The leading dozen Immortal Kings were about to cry.
"No, no, no..."
"We really don’t want to!"
"We didn’t come to fight you!"
"Yes, yes, it’s because we admire you too much that we couldn’t resist coming over to see your prowess!"
"Admire?"
Brother Cheng raised his eyebrows, oh, now they changed?
Seeing his eyebrows unfold, everyone seemed enlightened.
Instantly they went all out, showering flattery.
"Right, we truly worship you, Senior!"
"Senior’s power shocks the ancient and dazzles the present, an unparalleled existence in the Middle Immortal Realm, second to none!"
"Indeed, indeed, missing someone like you would be a lifelong regret!"
"This old fellow came here just to see the senior, so he could brag to the disciples and descendants in the future."
Brother Cheng was taken aback: "Brag about what?"
"Bragging about having seen your extraordinary real visage with his own eyes is the greatest honor of this old fellow’s life!"
"Yes, yes, now finally seeing the real person, even dying poses no regret!"
"If Senior wants to kill, please do it quickly. Dying under your sword would be this junior’s honor!"
"To die where it is worthwhile, how cheerful!"
Darn, Brother Cheng felt defeated by this group of people.
Their flattery skills were no worse than those of his disciples back then.
The first batch of enemies wasn’t his fans, which he found quite disappointing.
Despite knowing these people were enemies, his cold heart strangely felt comforted. How come?
He was really a bit reluctant to kill them now.
Seeing them lying down, not resisting, having flattered him fully, it was hard to strike...
"Ahem, so you’re all my admirers now?"
Seeing his expression becoming more relaxed, everyone nodded like pecking rice.
"Absolutely!"
"Being an admirer of the senior is already a fortune for three lifetimes!"
Brother Cheng smiled, feeling much better.
"Well, since you’re all my admirers, I must give a little something in return."
"Huh?"
Everyone momentarily failed to understand his meaning.
They could see that Jiang Cheng had long held a killing intent.
Given mercy, that would be a miraculous grace.
Now hearing this, does speaking some good words also earn rewards?
Instantly they were overjoyed, such a strong person, even a little gift, would be an absolute treasure!
"Senior, you’re so gracious!"
"Yes, how can we dare to accept it?"
Brother Cheng laughed: "Haha, I’m always generous with my own!"
Then he wiped his ring, spilling tens of thousands of Immortal Crystals.
There was one floating in front of each person.
This...
Everyone looked at each other, for a moment unable to grasp the situation.
Is this his reward?
This is too ordinary and cheap, isn’t it?
They were all Immortal Venerables and Immortal Kings; a mere Immortal Crystal meant nothing.
Seeing no one had received it, Brother Cheng’s face darkened.
"What’s up, are you complaining that the reward is too little?"
Everyone hurriedly said, "No, no..."
"We wouldn’t dare!"
To be alive was already lucky, how dare they anger Brother Cheng again?
"Senior’s gift is extremely precious!"
Someone even raised the Immortal Crystal high, deliberately exclaiming, "Wow, no way, this Immortal Crystal holds great mystery, extraordinary indeed!"
"Surely it contains supreme Dao, enough for juniors to comprehend for a lifetime!"
"This old fellow has decided, from now on, this Immortal Crystal will be the school’s sacred treasure!"
Brother Cheng secretly curled his lips, you all are truly talented.
In reality, it was, of course, just ordinary Immortal Crystals.
Once everyone had put on a show, and carefully treasured the Immortal Crystals, he smiled and rubbed his hands.
"I gave you a gift, so shouldn’t you give something in return?"
Huh?
There’s such a thing?
Giving a return gift?
Many finally understood that this was just extortion and robbery!
"What, are the customs in the Middle Immortal Realm so corrupt?"
"Looks like I should use my sword to sweep away this filthy world!"
Brother Cheng’s face darkened again, waving the Rainbow Absolute Immortal Sword threateningly.
Everyone was frightened out of their wits, pleading again.
The leading Immortal Kings wore bitter faces, cautiously asking, "So... what kind of return gift does Senior need?"
Brother Cheng slightly lifted his chin, saying casually, "Do you still need to ask me about such things? That would make it seem like I’m wanting to grab things, wouldn’t it?"
"Could I be such a person?"
Couldn’t you?
You are clearly robbing us!
Brother Cheng was certainly intentional.
Though these people had flattered a lot, giving him satisfaction, they originally came to loot.
That fact would never change.
If so, then now I’ll loot them.
Everyone understood internally, yet their mouths had to deny.
"Of course, it’s not Senior wanting it!"
"We’re voluntarily giving it, we admire you so much!"
"Yes, even if you don’t want it, we would feel awkward not giving it..."
"That’s more like it."
Brother Cheng nodded contentedly, adding two more sentences.
"Anyway, below Tier Six Immortal Artifacts and Top-Grade Magical Treasures you surely wouldn’t feel comfortable insulting me with trash."
"As for the rest, do as you see fit."
Everyone nearly spat blood.
The best treasures owned by the present Immortal Venerables were Tier Six Immortal Artifacts and Top-Grade Magical Treasures.
Yet now can they not hand them over?
Having lived for so many years, they weren’t fools.
Ignore the fact that this person hasn’t acted, really wanting to ’insult’ him with ’trash’ would surely mean death.
So next, everyone painfully and obediently handed over their Immortal Artifacts or Magical Treasures.
The scene was spectacular!
Everyone lined up, coming one by one.
As a temporary quality inspector, Brother Cheng was conscientious, inspecting each one personally.
Ensured each one wasn’t below Tier Six, maintaining quality assurance!
After the handover, the leading Immortal King cautiously asked, "Senior, can we leave now?"

chapters.title: Chapter 351 Spiritual Damage Compensation
chapters.content:
Chapter 351: Chapter 351 Spiritual Damage Compensation
After acquiring over ten thousand Tier Six Immortal Artifacts, Brother Cheng was feeling great.
This was a complete unexpected bounty.
The group of ’treasured fools’ in front of him were busy flattering and offering him merits, so he decided it wouldn’t be good to kill more.
Thus, he waved his hand, intending to let them go.
But just at this moment, several thousand people flew over from afar.
The Immortal King leading them saw the masses gathered here and couldn’t figure out what had happened; he thought the Immortal Fate Orders had already been divided.
He hurriedly shouted in anxiety.
"Fengdu Immortal King, leave some Immortal Fate Orders for me, old fellow!"
The Immortal King in front of Brother Cheng who was about to leave was indeed the Fengdu Immortal King.
Upon hearing this shout, he wished he could strangle the incoming person.
Damn it, we were just about to escape from the claws of this Great Demon King, and now you’re yelling what?
He lowered his head in silence, planning to pretend not to know them and slip away.
But by this time, the incoming group had also reached them.
"Brother Daoist Fengdu, why aren’t you responding?"
"Could it be you’ve taken too many Immortal Fate Orders and fear I’m going to ask you for some?"
"We’ve known each other for three billion years; am I really that kind of person?"
The Fengdu Immortal King’s face turned liver-colored; can’t you just say a few words less?
Not only was he being called out, but others were too.
"Haha, Immortal King Shenglei, you’re here too!"
"Sect Master Du He, I was just looking for you earlier, didn’t expect you’d already be ahead, save some for your brother!"
"Yang Lu Immortal King, you haven’t even established a sect yet, only have two disciples, do you need so many Immortal Fate Orders?"
The group of Immortal Kings who originally planned to leave almost lost their minds.
You guys are something, talking so much!
"Oh huh, they seem to be calling you?"
Brother Cheng’s expression became a bit complex.
"Didn’t you say you came specially to see me because of admiration and worship, what, you also want to snatch Immortal Fate Orders?"
"No, no!"
The Fengdu Immortal King and others were sweating coldly, shaking their hands repeatedly: "They’re talking nonsense, you mustn’t believe them, Senior..."
"We don’t know them at all!"
By now, the group behind finally arrived.
Seeing Brother Cheng, they were naturally shocked, assuming battle stances immediately.
"How is this person still alive?"
"Fengdu Immortal King, why haven’t you killed him yet?"
"Yeah, what’s going on?"
"Did you let him go?"
"Where’s his Immortal Fate Order?"
"Fuck your Immortals!"
Brother Cheng didn’t need to say a word; Fengdu Immortal King, who hadn’t cursed in billions of years, started swearing outright.
"Do I know you?"
"Where did you crazies come from, get lost!"
The other Immortal Kings were also infuriated, cursing one after another.
"Who are you? Don’t get too close to me!"
"Move away, I came here out of admiration for Elder Jiang, I’m not like you vile fellows!"
Brother Cheng smiled mischievously: "Not like you?"
"Absolutely!"
The Fengdu Immortal King and others pounded their chests loudly, the stance akin to beating a drum.
"Please understand, Elder Jiang, we have always been at odds with them!"
"Indeed, we have always admired you, Senior, we wouldn’t dare harbor such rebellious thoughts!"
"They even wanted to kill you, such intentions should be punished, please, Senior, punish them severely!"
"If you wish to strike, Senior, I’m willing to be at the forefront to destroy these traitors!"
Even Brother Cheng was impressed.
This group truly were talents, with skin as thick as the Peak of Perfection.
The opposing group were dumbfounded.
"Fengdu Immortal King, what do you mean by this? Have you forgotten the favor from my past?"
"Du He, you’ve gone too far!"
"Yang Lu Immortal King, are you mad to stand with this man?"
"I misjudged you..."
They were furious and disheartened; for mere Immortal Fate Orders, had they truly colluded with Jiang Cheng?
However, the complaints were barely starting when they gradually quieted down.
Because they finally saw the ruins and remnants from the prior battle, and the deceased bodies of 35 Immortal Kings below...
The crowd which was initially roaring suddenly lapsed into silence.
Could anyone tell them what happened?
This group wasn’t foolish; they finally realized.
No wonder the Fengdu Immortal King and others behaved like quails, not daring to breathe loudly before this person.
To single-handedly destroy 35 Immortal Kings, what kind of power is this?
"Um, Senior..."
The leading shouting Immortal King’s face turned colorless and he stammered an explanation.
"Actually, this, this is all a misunderstanding..."
Before he could finish, Brother Cheng coldly chuckled.
"Misunderstanding?"
"Weren’t you just about to kill me and snatch my Immortal Fate Orders?"
"Do you think I’m deaf or senile?"
He drew out the Rainbow Absolute Immortal Sword again, his murderous intent clear!
This group was scared out of their wits, desperately pleading for their lives.
"Spare us, Senior, we were blind and clashed with you, we’ll accept death ten thousand times over to make amends..."
"We just hope you show mercy, have compassion on us!"
"Indeed, had we known your power, even with a thousand guts we wouldn’t dare have such thoughts!"
"Oh? So you mean if I were a bit weaker, you would dare have thoughts?"
Beside them, the Fengdu Immortal King and others, who initially felt pained, suddenly felt a sense of pride.
In comparison, their situation was clearly much better than this present group.
A session of flattering and they were forgiven.
The current group wasn’t the same.
They started by shouting and threatening, and now can’t even backtrack.
They really should watch their words.
Could they possibly first say they wanted to kill and loot treasures, and then suddenly claim they admire and respect him?
Treating others as fools huh?
"How bold you are, all wanting to kill me!"
"In that case, let’s fight it out until one of us dies!"
Seeing Brother Cheng’s expression turn more hostile, the group was ever more panicked.
Fight what? Had they been able to fight him, they would have done so long ago.
Finally, they straightforwardly knelt down, continuously bowing to plead for mercy.
"Spare us!"
"Spare us, Senior, we know our mistake..."
No other choice, compared to losing life, nothing else mattered.
Brother Cheng was both angry and amused, were these even Immortals?
"Alright, I can spare you..."
Before the words were done, the group rejoiced.
"Thank you, Senior, for your great kindness and virtue!"
"Once we return, we’ll build ancestral shrines for you day and night..."
"Alright, alright!"
Brother Cheng frowned and waved his hand: "But you were shouting and threatening earlier, scared me, inflicted great trauma on my spirit!"
"This pain is so deep, it’s enough to keep me despondent for a long time, disrupting my progress!"
"Tell me, is this mental damage large enough?"
Mental damage? Everyone felt speechless, who are you fooling?
As powerful as you are, killing without blinking, who would believe you’re scared?
It’s us who are scared of you, alright?
But Brother Cheng asked, how dare they say no.
They could only agree: "Indeed the damage is too great!"
"Truly heart-wrenching and tear-inducing..."
"Yes, yes, it’s all our fault..."
Brother Cheng’s lips curled up again: "Since you also feel my loss is large, should you compensate a bit?"

chapters.title: Chapter 352 One After Another
chapters.content:
Chapter 352: Chapter 352 One After Another
Compensation?
How to compensate, should it be a life for a life?
At the critical moment, the Fengdu Immortal King didn’t forget his old friend, and quietly conveyed advice.
"If you don’t want to die, then offer up your ring and Immortal Artifact!"
This reminder was a revelation to the leading Immortal King.
To survive, external possessions mean nothing.
He hurriedly was the first to take off his storage ring and also handed over his Tier Seven Immortal Blade.
"Senior, I hope these items will ease your inner pain..."
He was also terribly distressed!
The previous group of flatterers only needed to offer a Tier Six Immortal Artifact.
Now he has to even offer his regularly used Tier Seven Immortal Artifact, all because he spoke a few more ’rebellious’ words initially.
Brother Cheng was overjoyed in his heart, excellent, excellent.
Originally, he thought the battle was over and was ready to leave, but then wave after wave of people came bearing surprises.
How could he not graciously accept this?
He took the Tier Seven Immortal Sword, looked at it, and nodded approvingly.
"Hmm, it’s alright."
"My emotional trauma and mental losses have been slightly compensated."
Was this only a slight compensation?
The leading Immortal King could see that this was indeed extortion on the road.
It’s a pity he was too foolish and ran headlong into it.
Not only was his strength lacking, but there was no justification for his actions!
"Cough, cough, as long as you’re satisfied..."
Brother Cheng waved: "Seeing as you are still sensible, you may leave."
These words were like an imperial pardon; the Immortal King quickly wiped the cold sweat from his forehead.
"Many thanks for your mercy, Senior!"
"Senior is truly magnanimous, a model for us all..."
Brother Cheng nearly burst into laughter.
Robbing them and yet receiving gratitude, where else to find such a great deal?
With this example set, others quickly followed suit.
One by one they stepped forward, voluntarily handing over their entire collection to compensate Sect Leader Jiang’s mental losses.
Though this wave had fewer people, it earned him more than the previous wave, bringing Brother Cheng great joy!
Only then did he wave them on.
A group of people expressed many thanks once more before leaving.
Each one swore internally that they’d never want to see this person again.
Brother Cheng himself also got a revelation.
If there’s a first wave and second wave, surely there would be a third and fourth wave...
After all, some people have far distances to travel, it’s totally understandable to arrive late.
This opportunity cannot be missed, he should be patient.
Hence, he directly conjured a dragon chair to sit in the sky, waiting right there for the next waves to arrive.
His judgment was correct.
Not long after, shadowy figures appeared in the distance again.
More fat sheep coming to the door!
Brother Cheng delightfully stood up, taking the initiative to welcome the new batch of ’customers’.
Half an hour later, this group of Immortal Kings and Immortal Venerables, holding Immortal Artifacts and shouting threats, left very obediently empty-handed.
This ’business’ he engaged in lasted for a full three days.
Finally, he had to stop because too many people had been robbed, and the news had long spread.
The later ones were not silly enough to run to their deaths, so he finally stopped.
Over the three days, nearly a hundred batches of people came here continuously.
Except for one batch that was wiped out for being untactful, the rest were all extorted without exception.
These nearly hundred batches included individuals and groups.
Altogether, close to twenty thousand people.
Among them, just the Immortal Kings numbered over three hundred.
To enhance cultivation, he put all the gains into the system and finally exchanged for as much as 35.48 million merit points!
Even more than the one month of ’touring appearances’ earned!
Then he exchanged all these merits for Eighth-grade Immortal Pills, and his cultivation finally broke through to Second Grade, and continued to advance, ultimately reaching the Fourth Grade Immortal King.
"Alas, this Immortal Country is strong, but it’s so hard to advance."
"Are none of you coming anymore, I am very hospitable..."
"If another hundred thousand or so people came, I might almost reach Ninth-grade Immortal King!"
Brother Cheng, somewhat reluctant, put away his chair, temporarily ending his ’toll collector’ career.
Meanwhile, news of this place finally spread throughout the entire Middle Immortal Realm.
Most thought he dared to hold 300 thousand Immortal Fate Orders just because of his extraordinary flying speed. If he were surrounded, he would surely die.
Yet, the 35 Immortal Kings and thousands of Immortal Venerables besieging him were completely wiped out.
Not counting those, the subsequent Immortal Kings and Immortal Venerables that went there were all robbed by him.
The exceptional combat power had far surpassed the ceiling of the Middle Immortal Realm.
Robbing so many Immortal Kings also refreshed everyone’s understanding.
The two things combined, leaving everyone’s final impression with two words—fierce and strong.
The Middle Immortal Realm was in an uproar due to these two pieces of news.
With such strong power, why stay in the Middle Immortal Realm?
Could nobody manage him?
How could others continue under these conditions?
Meanwhile, over at the Celestial Pavilion, Ye Yang Immortal King and others finally knew why he dared to buy so many Immortal Fate Orders.
It’s no longer a matter of whether he can keep them; it’s entirely up to whether he wants to.
Celebrations naturally broke out over at the Feixian Sect.
The entire sect was filled with pride and joy, as after all, he belonged to their sect.
"Is the ancestor too strong?"
"I thought his limit was when he wiped out nine Immortal Kings, and now he has wiped out 35..."
"Not just that, didn’t you notice he also robbed hundreds of Immortal Kings? His strength is simply unparalleled!"
"Hahaha, with the ancestor out, who can compete?"
"He has once again brought fame to our Feixian Sect, shaking the entire Middle Immortal Realm!"
"I somehow feel he is even more dominant than those ancestors back then?"
The elders were equally jubilant.
"Haha, we have no worries now!"
"Yuan Shu, Yuan Mu, what do you say now? Weren’t you worried before about the ancestor keeping so many Immortal Fate Orders?"
"Convinced, convinced, if we had known the ancestor was this strong, would we have hesitated at all?"
"You guys are too much, knowing he was invincible in the Middle Immortal Realm and still not speaking sooner!"
And Xiao Kun, Jiyun, Wu Jue, and others, wore expressions of calmness as if this was the expected result.
These are just Sect Leader Jiang’s basic operations, why be amazed?
"What about those people outside?"
"Hehe, they have been squatting outside Feixian Sect for so many days..."
Xiao Kun and Shali exchanged sinister smiles, eyes gleaming fiercely.
Recently, many forces had indeed crossed domains for the Immortal Fate Orders.
Unable to find him or catch up to Brother Cheng, they simply chose to block the entrance of Feixian Sect.
After all, Jiang Cheng was the ancestor of Feixian Sect, everyone here are his descendants.
Surely, he couldn’t just ignore them; sooner or later he’d return!
No need to chase everywhere; just wait here for him to come.
Quite a few held this mindset, during this period, outside Feixian Sect gathered nearly a hundred sects, with over a hundred Immortal Kings.
If not for Xiao Kun and the 12 Demon King Immortal Kings stationed here, and the Feixian Sect temporarily lacking any Immortal Fate Orders, they might have stormed in long ago.

chapters.title: Chapter 353: Elder Jiang Misunderstood
chapters.content:
Chapter 353: Chapter 353: Elder Jiang Misunderstood
These days, the Immortal Sect factions surrounding outside are getting a bit uneasy.
Initially, they posed a stance to besiege the Feixian Sect, waiting for Jiang Cheng to return and fall into their trap.
There were 105 Immortal Kings and tens of thousands of Immortal Venerables here, so steady!
As soon as he returned, they would rush up at once and divide the 300,000 Immortal Fate Orders neatly.
Now, with explosive news coming back one by one, their perfect plan of waiting for the rabbit seems no longer so stable.
Brother Cheng’s combat power is overwhelmingly strong, exceeding what the Middle Immortal Realm can handle.
"Immortal King Wu Luo, nice to meet you, where are you heading?"
"Ah, it’s Ren An Demon King, don’t you plan on having a great battle with the Feixian Sect?"
This time, hundreds of factions arrived, among them the Evil Extermination Palace and the Taiyin Palace leading.
Both factions have had inheritances since the Ancient Era, and rank just below Infinite Cave Heaven in foundation.
The large sects in the Middle Immortal Realm have clear stances between Immortal and Demon.
All the sects that came this time were led by these two factions.
If it wasn’t for their unified organization, these days really wouldn’t have been so orderly, maybe some sects would have acted on their own earlier.
"Why bother asking when you already know the answer, Brother Daoist?"
Ren An Demon King glanced at the crowd of Immortal Kings from the Evil Extermination Palace, saying lightly: "The news from outside, you should have received it long ago."
Immortal King Wu Luo nodded solemnly: "Indeed, his power is probably beyond what we can contend with."
They’re not foolish, both are now planning to hit the road back home.
If they stay here, things could go awry once Jiang Cheng returns.
This is also due to the immense pressure brought by Brother Cheng, bringing a rare unity between the Immortal and Demon Dao.
As soon as they leave, other sects naturally respond, unwilling to stay any longer.
For a moment, the outside was bustling with activity.
At that moment, a hoarse long laugh sounding like metal grinding came through.
"Where are you all heading?"
Xiao Kun, Shali, Jiyun, and others, all 12 emerged.
Seeing these people outside about to leave, they couldn’t sit still either.
They must stay!
If they just walk away, would the siege over this period be considered as if it never happened?
Immortal King Wu Luo and Ren An Demon King glanced back, then continued to pack their belongings and count their men, pretending not to hear.
"What’s the matter, having come all these days, don’t you plan to come in for a sit?"
Jiyun Immortal King sent out the Immortal Sword, flew to the perimeter, and laughed coldly: "You all traveled long and hard, yet we haven’t even given you a proper reception!"
Sahili Demon King also stood in the way on the other side: "Indeed, you people truly are interesting."
"Having come all dusty and weary, staying out in the elements for days, doesn’t it make us feel bad?"
With his voice falling, the Three Great Corpse Kings and several others also blocked the perimeter.
"What do you want to do?"
The path to leave was blocked, Ren An Demon King this time found it hard to ignore.
"Move aside!"
"Move aside?"
Immortal King Wu Jue’s expression turned cold, the Vast Immortal Country overwhelming.
"You come and go as you please, have you taken Sect Leader Jiang’s territory for granted?"
The Evil Extermination Palace and Taiyin Palace people initially didn’t regard these twelve, but seeing the scale of this Immortal Country, their expressions changed.
"Feather Transformation Level Immortal Country!"
Immortal King Wu Luo no longer dared to take it lightly, because he himself is only at the Dustless Level.
There’s no way around it, although he entered the Enlightenment Immortal Tree more than once, he’s never reached the Eighth Realm.
Previously, he only stopped at the Sixth Realm.
The gap between the Sixth Realm and the Eighth Realm brings a heaven-and-earth difference in enhancement.
Moreover, Wu Jue’s starting level is Dustless, his talent is too strong.
If it were a one-on-one, the veteran Immortal King Wu Luo likely wouldn’t be his match.
In the next moment, Xiao Kun and Jiyun also unfolded their Demon Country Immortal Country.
"Another Feather Transformation Level!"
"How is this possible?"
Ren An Demon King and the others exclaimed in shock.
It’s said that one of the prerequisites for ascending to Immortal Emperor is achieving Feather Transformation Level Immortal Country during the Immortal King stage.
Though it’s merely one condition, it’s enough to prove how rare it is.
An Immortal King of this level is extremely rare in the Middle Immortal Realm, each being a fierce character with explosive combat power.
Seeing their stunned reactions, Xiao Kun, Jiyun, and Wu Jue felt greatly pleased in their hearts.
Thanks to Sect Leader Jiang leading the way in the Immortal Tree last time, they now had this chance to flaunt.
"You can leave, but isn’t it necessary to have an explanation for the trouble brought to the Feixian Sect during this time?"
"What kind of explanation do you want?"
"Easy to say, leave your Immortal Artifacts."
Xiao Kun and the others were copying the style since Brother Cheng had demonstrated it not long ago.
Ren An Demon King sneered: "With just you all?"
"Do you really think we wouldn’t dare make a move?"
Immortal King Wu Luo and the others gradually calmed down.
Feather Transformation Level Immortal Country is strong, but at most it can challenge two or three Dustless Levels, unable to fundamentally reverse the whole situation.
There are 105 Immortal Kings on their side.
They dare not provoke Jiang Cheng, but these twelve, they’re not afraid at all.
"Want to make a move? Then let’s try!"
In the Lower Realm, Xiao Kun, Wu Jue, and others were never easy to deal with, only behaving so well before Sect Leader Jiang.
"Having recently power increased, long itching to slaughter massively!"
Immortal King Wu Luo and Ren An Demon King raged.
"Since you insist on blocking us..."
"Then don’t blame us for leveling the Feixian Sect!"
At a command from the two leaders, over a hundred Immortal Kings all sent out their Immortal Countries.
A great battle was about to erupt.
At this moment, Brother Cheng’s voice suddenly came from afar.
"Wow, what a lively scene!"
After saying this, he had magically appeared in the field.
"Sect Leader Jiang!"
Mingchi, Liuyuan, and others were ecstatic.
If it really came to a fight, Xiao Kun, Wu Jue, and others were unfazed.
However, they two weren’t, having recently improved their Immortal Countries just barely to the Extraordinary Level in the Enlightenment Immortal Tree.
Moreover, their combat power is still not comparable to the native Immortal Kings in the Immortal Realm of the same rank.
"Finally, you’re back, Elder Jiang!"
"Hahaha, now there’s a good show to watch..."
"Ancestor, they’ve been blocking outside for over a month!"
Yuan Zhen, Yuan Sheng, and others quickly jumped out to complain.
With Brother Cheng’s arrival, everyone’s confidence soared.
Especially the older folks like Yuan Zhe and Yuan He, who cried and wailed even more.
"Ancestor, please take charge for us."
"During this time, we’ve been anxious and scared, bullied too miserably by them..."
Opposite, Immortal King Wu Luo and Ren An Demon King secretly mused, when did we bully you?
This period has evidently been spent surrounding outside, they never even entered the mountain gate, right?
Brother Cheng furrowed his brow, realizing the situation wasn’t simple.
"Did such a thing really happen?"
He honestly didn’t know the Feixian Sect was besieged.
The last of his time being spent in flashy displays outside only reminded him of his own headquarter when there was no flashy job left.
He gazed maliciously at the hundred plus Immortal Kings on the opposite side: "You all are the ones besieging my Feixian Sect?"
To his questioning, Wu Luo and Ren An didn’t dare to slack off.
Both hurriedly said: "Elder Jiang, it’s a misunderstanding!"
"We’ve been here, not infringing each other’s wells with Feixian Sect, absolutely no crossing acts!"

chapters.title: Chapter 354: We Are Good People
chapters.content:
Chapter 354: Chapter 354: We Are Good People
"Oh? Minds our own business?"
Brother Cheng countered with a half-smile.
"Then can I ask what you’re doing here from all the way so far?"
Uh...
Wu Luo Immortal King and Ren An Demon King were at a loss for words.
The truth was they surrounded the Feixian Sect, waiting for you to come back, and then they would take you down.
But now they didn’t dare to say that truth.
Brother Cheng ’kindly’ found them an excuse: "Could it be that your sect’s location has moved here?"
"That’s not the case..."
The two thought that this place where the Feixian Sect is located is not some unparalleled treasure, how could we possibly settle here.
Brother Cheng looked puzzled: "Since you haven’t moved here, then what are you doing surrounding my Feixian Sect?"
"Are you trying to harm my Feixian Sect?"
Seeing his expression suddenly darken, with a hint of killing intent, Wu Luo and Ren An quickly shook their heads to deny.
"No, no!"
"Elder Jiang misunderstands..."
"Right, we absolutely mean no harm to Feixian Sect!"
Seeing those once unattainable giant sects acting so subdued in front of the Elder, like students who made mistakes being questioned by a teacher, Feixian Sect’s elders and disciples felt quite prideful.
Look, this is what prestige means!
The current disciples of the Feixian Sect had never personally seen those ancestors like Ji Linghan, Mo Chen, and Lin Ning.
When they joined the sect, the Feixian Sect hadn’t seen an Immortal King for millions of years. They could only imagine the glory of those days from classics and tales.
But now, Elder Jiang alone seemed to have brought them back to that era.
Thinking about it carefully, even those second and third generation ancestors weren’t as powerful as today, right?
"Misunderstanding?"
"No harm?"
Brother Cheng laughed coldly: "Then give me an explanation as to why you’re blocking the entrance to someone else’s mountain gate."
Let’s see what kind of story you can make.
If they didn’t attack the Feixian Sect, does that mean it’s fine?
Wu Luo Immortal King and Ren An Demon King wiped off their nervous sweat, racked their brains trying to find a reasonable ’excuse’, but for a moment couldn’t come up with one.
At a critical moment, suddenly one Immortal Venerable from the crowd stepped forward.
"Elder Jiang, please be wise. Actually, we not only mean no harm, but we have good intentions!"
Wu Luo and Ren An turned to look, and it was Cen Xuan from the Thundering Sect.
The Thundering Sect only had a dozen Immortal Venerables, not even a single Immortal King, they were entirely here just to watch the fun.
They had not been noticed at all.
But now, their hope rested on him.
"Good intentions?"
Brother Cheng almost laughed when he heard this, he asked curiously: "What’s your version of ’good intentions’?"
"This situation arose because of the Immortal Fate Order..."
Cen Xuan was scrutinized by so many Immortal Kings, which made him extremely nervous, he wiped off his nervous sweat, gathered up his courage.
"Recently, there have been rumors all around the Middle Immortal Realm that you possess three hundred thousand Immortal Fate Orders."
"Of course, now this news has also been confirmed to be true."
"Hmm, so then?"
"So some greedy people had the idea of avarice!"
"Unable to find you personally, they set their sights on Feixian Sect, intending to apply pressure on Feixian Sect to make you yield!"
When Cen Xuan said this, Wu Luo and Ren An almost wanted to crush him to dust!
Damn it, you’re on their side, aren’t you?
The greedy ones you’re talking about isn’t that us?
The ones intending to make a move on Feixian Sect, isn’t it us as well?
If it weren’t for Xiao Kun Jiyun and those 12 people stationed there, they would’ve already gone in to take all Feixian Sect members as hostages.
Are you selling us out, you must be selling us out, right?
If Brother Cheng hadn’t been watching, they would never let this ’traitor’ see the sun tomorrow.
"Mm, continue."
With Sect Leader Jiang’s ’encouragement’, Cen Xuan regained a lot of composure.
"Upon learning all of this, Wu Luo Immortal King and Ren An Demon King, the senior figures holding authority in the Middle Immortal Realm, couldn’t bear to see this happening!"
He firmly clenched his fists and said with conviction: "So, they took the initiative to contact people from various places and organized us all together!"
"Bringing us across the Great Realm, facing dangers and difficulties to come here, protecting Feixian Sect from being exploited by such petty people!"
"For this, we ate the wind and weathered the dew, guarded day and night without tiring, without caring about misunderstanding from the outside world!"
With fists raised high, his voice was simply deafening.
"Only to uphold that sense of justice and equity in our hearts!"
This huge twist stunned everyone present.
For a moment, there was complete silence.
Brother Cheng exclaimed internal mastery, this indeed not only turned the tables but gave them a favor.
So even surrounding Feixian Sect for so long, they have to be thanked instead?
Wu Luo Immortal King and Ren An Demon King were overjoyed!
Originally wanting to shred Cen Xuan, now they looked at him as if he’s a hero.
This guy is talented, just by talking, he managed to reverse the predicament.
They have to properly show gratitude when they go back, and remember to help him up in the future.
With Cen Xuan laying down such a perfect foundation, they naturally knew how to solidify it.
"Elder Jiang, you heard it, we truly had good intentions!"
"Yes, we have no ties with Feixian Sect, no friendship. The reason for crossing hundreds of domains to protect is simply to uphold fairness."
"Such matters, in our view, don’t count for much, it’s what every upright Immortal should do, no need to publicize it."
"Indeed, knowing you were returning, Feixian Sect was completely safe, we realized our mission was complete."
"That’s why we chose to leave silently, who knew, your people would block the way!"
"Heaven help us, we quietly guarded here for days, expecting no return, no thanks, we never disturbed your sect..."
"And now being mistaken for external enemies, how heartbreaking is this!"
The two and the Immortal Kings and Demon Kings behind them each shook their heads and sighed, expressions full of loss and distress.
Xiao Kun, Jiyun, and the others were dumbfounded.
Yuan Zhen, Yuan Sheng, and the others were confused.
Sect Leader Jiang was speechless.
Question them until the end, they become nameless saints who did good deeds, and he became the villain?
Is there any law, is there any justice?
Feixian Sect’s elders could no longer remain silent, anger boiling inside them.
"Elder, they’re subverting black and white!"
"Don’t believe them!"
"These people are vile, clearly here to attack us, if it weren’t for the seniors sitting here, we would’ve already faced disaster!"
"This is all just their one-sided talk..."
"Alright, alright!"
Brother Cheng waved his hand, purposely putting on a stern face.
"Look how you’re shouting, what kind of great contribution did they make by coming all the way here?"
"How can you say such things about others?"
Hearing him say this, the people of Feixian Sect were speechless, while Wu Luo Immortal King and others were pleasantly surprised.
Looks like he’s really convinced?
"Haha, Elder Jiang truly understands justice."
"Since everything’s fine now, then we’ll be leaving first..."
They wouldn’t dare stay here long, in case something changed later.
But Brother Cheng stopped in front of them.
"Don’t rush to leave!"
"You did such a great deed, I haven’t thanked you yet."

chapters.title: Chapter 355: Are You Seeking to Uphold Justice?
chapters.content:
Chapter 355: Chapter 355: Are You Seeking to Uphold Justice?
"Ah, no need, no need..."
Spirit Ink Immortal King and Ren An Demon King weren’t fools; they could hear the subtext in his words.
Clearly, he wasn’t genuinely thankful.
"Yes, it’s needed." Brother Cheng was exceedingly enthusiastic.
The two of them and the Immortal Kings behind them waved their hands repeatedly: "There’s really no need, Elder Jiang is too courteous."
"No, no, it’s what you all deserve."
The more he acted like this, the more everyone felt something was amiss.
"No, no, we feel unworthy of such a favor."
"We never seek anything in return for our good deeds."
Brother Cheng wasn’t having it: "Whether you want something in return is your business, I must express my gratitude."
This was too unusual, Spirit Ink and Ren An felt something was very wrong.
The two cupped their hands repeatedly: "We have felt your attitude, goodbye, goodbye..."
Clang!
Brother Cheng suddenly drew out the Tier Nine Immortal Sword, startling everyone, almost thinking a battle might break out.
"Not giving me face, huh?"
"Elder Jiang, you..."
Spirit Ink, Ren An, and the other Immortal Kings quickly assumed defensive postures.
"We didn’t mean to!"
"Yes, how would we dare not give you face."
Brother Cheng’s gaze turned cold, and he scolded coldly, "I said I wanted to thank you, and you keep backing away, are you looking down on me?"
"We wouldn’t dare..."
With things said this far, no one could refuse.
They could only brace themselves and tentatively ask, "How exactly would Elder Jiang like to thank us?"
"That’s more like it!"
Brother Cheng finally put away the Immortal Sword, his expression softening considerably.
"Isn’t the Middle Immortal Realm quite unstable recently?"
"Uh..."
Spirit Ink Immortal King and Ren An Demon King exchanged a glance, not understanding what he meant by that statement.
They could only nod in agreement.
"Indeed, it’s very unstable."
"Yes, if not for the declining morals and deteriorating public order, we wouldn’t have come here to protect Feixian Sect."
They didn’t forget to offer some flattery.
Brother Cheng nodded: "You’re right, the Middle Immortal Realm is too dangerous, the safety of people’s property can’t be guaranteed, it’s really concerning."
Everyone had no idea what he was trying to say, and could only continue to concur.
"Yes, yes..."
"So heartbreaking!"
Brother Cheng took a deep breath, gazed at the vast sky, and let out a long sigh.
"With this in mind, I’ve decided."
"I’ll help you safeguard your rings and Immortal Artifacts for free, as a token of my gratitude!"
He gave everyone a reassuring look, "With me, they won’t be taken by those greedy villains, I’ll protect them with my life!"
"This way, it counts as returning a favor to you!"
What the!
Can it be done like this?
Everyone present was stunned.
"Hahaha, Sect Leader Jiang is right!"
Xiao Kun Demon King was the first to react, bursting into laughter.
"Such a favor must be repaid, let the elder protect all your treasures to prevent them from being stolen by villains."
Wu Jue, Jiyun, and others laughed heartily too: "Exactly, the elder is truly kind-hearted!"
"You mustn’t refuse, otherwise you’re not giving Sect Leader Jiang face!"
Initially, they had been seething inside due to the upside-down logic on the other side.
If Brother Cheng weren’t there, they would’ve acted out in anger long ago.
Now, Brother Cheng’s ’retaliation’ was exceedingly satisfying.
Weren’t you saying the siege was protection?
Then we can also say robbery is helping safekeep.
Using your logic against you.
This was indeed robbery, Spirit Ink Immortal King and Ren An Demon King were surely well aware.
What safekeeping, once the Immortal Artifacts were in his hands, they would belong to him, never to be retrieved.
Naturally, the two weren’t willing to agree.
"No need, no need, we actually can safeguard our belongings..."
"Yes, yes, how could we trouble Elder Jiang!"
But they didn’t dare refuse too harshly, having to be somewhat tactful.
Brother Cheng’s face darkened, and he waved the sword in his hand.
"Oh, really?"
"Are you sure you can safeguard them?"
"Since you’re so confident, how about we do a trial run?"
How would this trial go?
If you come to rob us yourself, we obviously can’t guard them.
Such a so-called trial might even lead to being killed.
Just say killing for treasures outright.
Spirit Ink Immortal King and Ren An Demon King had often done such domineering things before; now it was happening to them, how stifling.
"No need, no need, Elder Jiang is right, we really can’t safeguard them."
They had the impulse to lash out, but considering Brother Cheng’s record, they dared not.
"Since you can’t safeguard them, then hand them over to me for safekeeping."
Brother Cheng rubbed his fingers with a sly smile: "This is something I should do, no need for thanks."
The two looked bitter, while the Immortal Kings behind were in deep distress.
Knowing this person wasn’t intending to let them go easily.
Without a significant loss, it was impossible to leave alive.
"In that case, we’ll have to trouble Elder Jiang..."
Spirit Ink Immortal King trembled as he reluctantly handed over his Tier Seven Immortal Sword and Top-Grade Magical Treasure.
As Brother Cheng was about to accept, a loud laugh suddenly came from behind.
"What a Feixian Sect, what an Elder Jiang!"
"Such blatant banditry in broad daylight, truly infuriates both gods and men!"
Everyone was surprised; in this situation, was there anyone in the Middle Immortal Realm daring to provoke Jiang Cheng?
Turning their heads, Spirit Ink Immortal King and Ren An Demon King’s group immediately showed surprise.
The newcomers were the Sect Leader of Infinite Cave Heaven, Spirit Ink Immortal King, and a dozen Immortal Kings.
Although fewer in number, Infinite Cave Heaven was a top-tier Immortal Sect in the Middle Immortal Realm, with first-class resources, possibly having the means to deal with Jiang Cheng.
"Elder Jiang, you’re going too far."
Spirit Ink Immortal King elegantly descended on a cloud, his voice slightly tinged with rule’s essence, faintly reaching into the depths of the Immortal Soul.
Many disciples of Feixian Sect showed confused expressions because of this.
Yuan Zhen, Yuan Sheng, and others couldn’t help but become worried; Infinite Cave Heaven had a colossal reputation.
Should a conflict arise here, it wouldn’t bode well for an ascension to the Upper Immortal Realm in the future.
However, such concerns weren’t on Brother Cheng’s mind.
He didn’t know these people at all.
"Old man, are you here to meddle?"
That was a very straightforward question.
Previously, when Feixian Sect was besieged for over a month, why didn’t these people step up for justice, yet now they came to criticize?
"Elder Jiang, your words are mistaken!"
Spirit Ink Immortal King twirled his long beard, responding coldly: "First you monopolized 300,000 plus Immortal Fate Orders, cutting off many people’s opportunities for ascension!"
"Then you slaughtered numerous Immortal Kings and Immortal Venerables, committing heinous crimes of murder!"
"Now you’re extorting fellow practitioners, truly disgraceful!"
Brother Cheng almost laughed.
"Oh, really, and so what?"
"What can you do, are you going to take action?"
"Just talking about justice isn’t enough, show me if you have the qualifications."
He raised his Immortal Sword, flying directly in front of the group from Infinite Cave Heaven.
Instantly, the atmosphere turned into a standoff.

chapters.title: Chapter 356 Quasi-Emperor Descends
chapters.content:
Chapter 356: Chapter 356 Quasi-Emperor Descends
The Spirit Ink Immortal King naturally did not dare to make a move against Brother Cheng.
Although his Immortal Country was of the rare Feather Transformation level, he was well aware that the feats Jiang Cheng had accomplished were beyond his reach by any means.
Even if given a Tier Nine Immortal Sword, he could only defeat three to five Immortal Kings at most.
35?
And still slay them?
Stop joking, would you?
That’s simply not something an Immortal King can achieve.
"Hold on!"
He hastily stepped back, angrily saying, "Elder Jiang, is it possible that you don’t wish to ascend to the Upper Immortal Realm?"
Brother Cheng was puzzled: "What do you mean? Do I need your consent to ascend to the Upper Immortal Realm?"
The Spirit Ink Immortal King’s chest rose with pride as he said, "You should know the esteemed status of our Infinite Cave Heaven in the Upper Immortal Realm!"
He bowed toward the sky, his expression becoming solemn and reverent: "With three Supreme Immortal Emperors overseeing, a force that shocks ancient and modern times!"
"So what?"
Brother Cheng felt utterly baffled: "I now want to kill you, can they come down here to save you?"
"They can’t..."
"Then what are you talking about?"
It’s so laughable.
Could it be that this old man thought he could win by laying out his background, making me fearful, and bowing in submission?
Thinking too much, aren’t you?
Seeing that he genuinely intended to make a move, the Spirit Ink Immortal King panicked and hurriedly retreated once again.
"You are bold! Aren’t you afraid that going to the Upper Immortal Realm will lead you to a disaster beyond redemption?"
"That’s a matter for the future, what’s that to do with the present?"
"Fine, just fine!"
"This is you forcing my hand!"
The Spirit Ink Immortal King was so angry his face turned pale.
Suddenly, he reached into his arms and pulled out a stick of incense.
This incense was azure blue, only about a finger long, yet it exuded a mysterious aura not belonging to this world.
As soon as the elders of Feixian Sect saw this incense, their expressions changed drastically, exclaiming in shock.
"Incense of Divine Descent!"
"Patriarch, you must not let him light this incense!"
"This incense can connect to the Upper Immortal Realm..."
The Incense of Divine Descent is merely a top-grade magical treasure and a one-time use at that, but its creation is extremely difficult.
This incense has only one use, which is to summon reinforcements from the Upper Immortal Realm.
The Incense of Divine Descent will forcibly open a temporary narrow path between two Immortal Realms, and its location will become the point where people from the Upper Realm descend.
Once used, it automatically destroys itself.
The Spirit Ink Immortal King initially planned to use the background of Infinite Cave Heaven to pressure Brother Cheng, but Brother Cheng wasn’t buying it.
Now, he had no choice but to painfully resort to the last means.
The Incense of Divine Descent is extremely precious, no easier to produce than a Tier Eight Immortal Artifact, and only top-tier Ancient Immortal Sects like theirs might possess it.
With this incense, he was absolutely confident of victory!
Jiang Cheng was unmatched in the Middle Immortal Realm, but the Upper Immortal Realm was different; it was a world dominated by Immortal Emperors.
Being able to kill Immortal Kings doesn’t mean he could contend against the means of an Immortal Emperor.
On the other side, Wu Luo Immortal King and others were overjoyed, seeing hope in the incense.
Even Xiao Kun, Jiyun, and others were slightly disturbed.
"Currently, it’s the last decade of the current Ascension Stage, according to the rules, Immortal Emperors can’t descend during this period!"
Immortal King Wu Jue calmed down gradually: "So even with the Incense of Divine Descent, they cannot invite an Immortal Emperor!"
They still had great confidence in Sect Leader Jiang’s strength.
Below Immortal Emperor, he should easily handle matters, right?
However, the Spirit Ink Immortal King opposite remained calm and composed.
He lit that Incense of Divine Descent, and a wisp of blue smoke rose, immediately dissipating in the blink of an eye, disappearing from his hand in no time.
Seeing Brother Cheng unmoved, he couldn’t help but laugh loudly.
"Hahahaha!"
"If you had stopped me just now, you might still have had a sliver of hope, but now it’s too late!"
His confidence left Brother Cheng utterly confused.
"Isn’t it said that Immortal Emperors cannot be summoned?"
"Could it be that Immortal Kings from the Upper Immortal Realm are stronger?"
"It seems you know nothing..."
The look in the old eyes of the Spirit Ink Immortal King showed a trace of pity.
"Indeed, during the last ten years an Immortal Emperor can’t be summoned, but a Quasi-Emperor can be moved!"
"Can’t bring the true body of an Immortal Emperor, but can invite the Laws of an Immortal Emperor!"
These words stirred tension again among Xiao Kun, Wu Jue, and others who previously thought things would be fine.
The so-called Quasi-Emperor is essentially a weakened version of an Immortal Emperor.
It’s just that Quasi-Emperors haven’t fully merged with the Rules, not yet becoming the ’embodiment’ of a certain Rule, so there’s a slight gap compared to actual Immortal Emperors.
But that’s only relative to Immortal Emperors.
When facing Immortal Kings, their might is not much different from a true Immortal Emperor.
As for the Laws, they are truly extraordinary!
After an Immortal Emperor merges with the Rules, they can create their own Laws.
When these Laws appear, the Immortal King stage has no means to resist, hardly different from encountering Rule suppression.
It’s practically a Dimensional Reduction Strike.
Although last time Brother Cheng killed the Nine Flames Immortal Emperor in front of them, no one could be sure if he could continue to perform miracles against other Immortal Emperors.
They could only quietly pray for him to display his divine prowess once again.
The Incense of Divine Descent took effect extremely quickly.
No sooner had the words been spoken than three beams of golden light suddenly descended from the sky.
The light shot directly onto the Spirit Ink Immortal King and two other elders of Infinite Cave Heaven, disappearing on them in the blink of an eye.
The three of them suddenly shook as their aura surged dramatically.
When they opened their eyes again, all the Immortal Kings present couldn’t help but feel a sense of dread.
It was as if they no longer belonged to the same tier of existence.
"That’s the Laws!"
"The Upper Immortal Realm has transmitted three Laws across the void!"
"They have been empowered by the Laws!"
Shari Demon King and Hua Yin Immortal King were both shocked and envious.
The empowerment by Laws is not permanent, and in fact, very short-lived.
But in this brief time, these three could already wield a small portion of Immortal Emperor level might, definitely above all Immortal Kings.
Originally, there was no pressure when facing Spirit Ink Immortal King.
Now facing him again, an extremely fatal danger instinct naturally rose within them.
As if the other could effortlessly annihilate them with a mere wave of a hand.
The terrifying foundation of the Ancient Immortal Sects was evident.
"Hahaha, what else can you say?"
"You’ve broken the rules of the Middle Immortal Realm, this heaven and earth will not tolerate you!"
"Before the Laws, all beings are ants!"
The three Immortal Kings from Infinite Cave Heaven moved forward, surrounding Brother Cheng in a triangle formation.
This man, who could slay 35 Immortal Kings, would not be taken lightly.
And the effect of this Incense of Divine Descent wasn’t over yet.
High above in the heavens, an ancient sword descended, piercing a massive rift.
"Quasi-Emperor!"
The Immortal Kings from Infinite Cave Heaven and Wu Luo Immortal King and others were again overjoyed.
"The Quasi-Emperor descends!"
"It seems the Upper Realm places great importance on this person, not only transmitting the Laws but also having a Quasi-Emperor personally descending!"
"Hahaha, it’s absolutely certain now!"
With celestial music echoing and vibrant rule-formed rivers, a person walked upon the waves.
That figure in white seemed out of place in this world.
Though everyone clearly saw the ancient face, they had an inexplicable feeling it was not that of a real person.
He stood in front of Jiang Cheng, expression calm, without displaying any might.
Yet all present felt their Immortal Souls unstable, no longer able to connect with the surrounding Rules.
Even the three Law-empowered Immortal Kings felt their scalp tingle, as if they were facing a colossal fierce beast from antiquity.

chapters.title: Chapter 357: The No.1 Expert in the Middle Immortal Realm?
chapters.content:
Chapter 357: Chapter 357: The No.1 Expert in the Middle Immortal Realm?
"It’s him!"
"It’s actually him!"
"It’s over..."
When this Quasi-Emperor truly appeared, almost everyone present gasped in shock.
Even Brother Cheng’s diehard fans like Xiao Kun and Jiyun had no confidence in winning anymore.
They knew this person.
This person was also once a member of the Middle Immortal Realm, ascending to Immortal King fifty million years ago, later than them.
But his talent and fortune were unparalleled!
On the first day of becoming an Immortal King, he possessed an Innate Dao Foundation at the Feather Transformation Level.
Not long after, as a newly ascended Immortal King, he became the Pavilion Master of the Sword Pavilion of Infinite Cave Heaven.
The Sword Pavilion is the main combat power of Infinite Cave Heaven.
Unlike those ancient Immortal Kings who retreat for millions of years, this person loved to travel and explore.
In the subsequent twenty million years, his footprints covered every Celestial Domain of the Middle Immortal Realm, visiting various Immortal Sects and Sects.
And he only did one thing—challenge.
In those years, every notable Ancient Demon Sect and Immortal Sect in the Middle Immortal Realm had been challenged by him.
Regardless of whether it was the ancient Immortal Kings who lived for millions of years or the notorious old demons, they all fell to his sword one by one.
If challenged by him, refusing meant death.
But if accepted, there was no risk to life.
The conditions of defeat weren’t harsh either, just allowing him to view all the Sword Dao Classics of the Sect sufficed.
As a result, eventually, whenever he arrived, no one dared to refuse.
Though losing was a disgrace, since everyone lost, it was somewhat acceptable.
What if someone actually won?
Most of the Immortal Kings present had been challenged by this person during that time.
Including Xiao Kun, Jiyun, Wu Jue, and others, they had all experienced defeat at his hands.
Just like that, with victory after victory, this person’s name quickly spread throughout the entire Middle Immortal Realm.
There wasn’t really a power ranking at the Immortal King level, after all, battles were complex with mutual counteractions, and no one dared to claim that any Immortal King or Demon King was the strongest.
But during those twenty million years, this person was revered as the number one expert in the entire Middle Immortal Realm, with no disputes!
Eventually, wherever he went, countless Immortals would follow.
They didn’t expect to witness his challenges firsthand, just hoped to follow in his steps.
It had become a grand event after grand event.
Initially, when he went out to challenge, Spirit Ink Immortal King and others strongly opposed it, fearing it would offend many forces.
Moreover, if he died during the challenges, it would become a laughingstock.
Yet later, they felt honored by association.
Because of his undefeated and unstoppable victories, the already powerful Infinite Cave Heaven’s reputation reached its pinnacle.
During those twenty million years, it firmly held the top spot as the First Sect in the Middle Immortal Realm!
However, what frustrated the high levels of Infinite Cave Heaven was... this person was obsessed with the Sword Dao, indifferent to other matters, and had no intention of gathering followers or launching campaigns against Demon Cultivators.
Even when the Immortal Emperor of the Upper Immortal Realm personally descended to persuade, it couldn’t sway his Sword Heart.
He seemed detached from the world.
Uninformed about worldly affairs, he didn’t associate with anyone, only immersed in his own persistence.
Twenty million years later, perhaps feeling there were no worthy opponents left, disinterested, he finally chose to ascend to the Upper Immortal Realm.
As soon as he left, the major Ancient Demon Sects and Immortal Sects were relieved, no longer living in his shadow.
It’s been thirty million years now, and many had almost forgotten his name.
But now seeing him again, they were suddenly reminded that the name was actually engraved deep in their hearts.
Once opened, it was vividly clear.
"Immortal King Chen Zhou, it’s actually him..."
"No, now he should be addressed as Chen Zhou Quasi-Emperor."
Yuan Zhen murmured to himself, his face quickly turning gloomy.
Even though he knew his forebear had slain an Immortal Emperor, the person before him was an unparalleled prodigy who challenged beyond his level!
Having gone to the Upper Immortal Realm for just thirty million years, he was already a Quasi-Emperor.
What terrifying speed of improvement!
"Sect Leader, who is this person?"
"Why does it seem like everyone knows him..."
The other elders and disciples of the Feixian Sect had never seen this Chen Zhou Quasi-Emperor.
Yuan Zhen discreetly transmitted a brief introduction of this person’s past.
Finally, he added: "Thirty million years ago, I was merely a newly joined True Disciple of Feixian Sect."
"That day, I witnessed this person visiting Feixian Sect firsthand..."
The elders, already overwhelmed by that series of exploits, were now even more astonished.
"What?"
"Our Feixian Sect was challenged by him too?"
"Is this true?"
"What happened then?"
Yuan Zhen’s eyes revealed a hint of reminiscence: "At that time, our only Immortal King was Sect Leader Celestial River Immortal King, and he graciously accepted the challenge."
The crowd hurriedly asked: "What happened afterward?"
Yuan Zhen shook his head: "I do not know. Back then, I was just a disciple and had no privilege to witness it. However, Celestial River Ancestor was neither killed nor severely injured by him..."
The crowd knew this was just to save face; that battle must have been lost.
Celestial River Immortal King was one of the sect’s forebears, but not outstanding among many Immortal Kings.
With so many ancient Immortal Kings and Demon Kings defeated, he clearly wouldn’t be an exception.
Just thinking that Feixian Sect was once forced to open Sword Dao Classics for someone to view was quite embarrassing.
Their conversations seemed to reach the ears of Chen Zhou Quasi-Emperor.
He slowly glanced down, opening his mouth for the first time.
"Feixian Sect was where I last lingered in the Middle Immortal Realm."
His expression remained incredibly calm, merely stating a fact.
For a moment, the crowd couldn’t discern the intention behind his words.
However, Spirit Ink Immortal King was quite accustomed to it.
When Chen Zhou Quasi-Emperor joined Infinite Cave Heaven, he was already the Sect Leader, considered his superior at the time.
Back then, there was not much to say between them.
Just felt that he was enigmatic, operating on a different wavelength, and nothing he did would be surprising.
Even when he finally ascended to the Upper Immortal Realm, he didn’t return to Infinite Cave Heaven for a farewell, nor held an ascension ceremony as customary.
Meanwhile, Xiao Kun, Wu Jue, and others were busy transmitting to Brother Cheng.
"Sect Leader Jiang, be extremely cautious of this person!"
"He might be even more dangerous than the Nine Flames Immortal Emperor!"
"Really?"
Brother Cheng seemed unconcerned.
This worried a few of them greatly.
Sahili Demon King smiled bitterly: "Don’t view him as an ordinary Quasi-Emperor. Back then, when he was still an Immortal King, I was challenged by him. Can you guess what happened?"
"You lost?"
"More than just lost, he only used two swords."
"One sword broke ten thousand laws, one sword vanquished the Demon Country. That battle left me severely wounded!"
Mentioning this, Immortal King Wu Jue was rather proud: "I did much better. I held out for three swords, and fell on the fourth."
Brother Cheng was speechless; what’s there to compare?
"Immortal Chen Zhou... Senior!"
Spirit Demon and the other two Immortal Kings bowed together, seeking guidance from this overwhelmingly strong figure.

chapters.title: Chapter 358: How Do You Want to Deal With It
chapters.content:
Chapter 358: Chapter 358: How Do You Want to Deal With It
Fifty million years ago, Chen Zhou’s status in the Infinite Cave Heaven was not as high as theirs, but now he’s a Quasi-Emperor.
Even in the Upper Immortal Realm’s Infinite Cave Heaven, his status is almost on par with those three Immortal Emperors.
Nowadays, when speaking to him, the Spirit Ink Immortal King must be cautious.
"This person has repeatedly violated the Middle Immortal Realm’s rules. I hope you will use your thunderous means to erase this menace!"
Chen Zhou Quasi-Emperor was indeed as rumored, indifferent to worldly matters.
The eager attitude of the Spirit Ink Immortal King only earned him a single sentence.
"How do you want to handle it?"
The multitude of Immortal Kings at the Infinite Cave Heaven were thrilled.
The words may be few and not enthusiastic, but the attitude was decisive!
Feel free to make any request; whether fried, boiled, stewed, or roasted, it can surely be done.
The Spirit Ink Immortal King thought, since you’re so agreeable, I’ll make more requests.
"It’s best to capture this person. I sense he is filled with secrets and surely carries immense fortunes..."
The other two Immortal Kings added a few more words: "The Feixian Sect is too odd. Whether a billion years ago or today, they constantly encounter accidents!"
"I suggest to utterly annihilate this sect!"
"Cut the weeds without digging out the roots, and they will sprout with the spring breeze!"
Jiyun Immortal King couldn’t help but curse out loud: "Damn! You’re too ruthless!"
Shali and Wu Jue, among others, also erupted in curses: "As soon as a petty individual gains power, they become arrogant!"
"What the hell are you?"
"Without the support of the Upper Immortal Realm, you’re nothing!"
The Spirit Ink Immortal King glanced at them indifferently, let out a cold laugh, and then addressed the Chen Zhou Quasi-Emperor again.
"Moreover, the Xiao Kun Demon King and the other 12 are his comrades. It’s best to deal with them together and return prosperity to the Middle Immortal Realm..."
He had backing, hence the arrogance.
If you don’t agree, tough luck!
Looking at the confident Spirit Ink Immortal King, Brother Cheng smiled.
"Then kill them."
