After saying this, he flew off to the side, seemingly worried about getting blood on himself.
Chen Zhou Quasi-Emperor solemnly nodded.
"Alright!"
Everyone present was dumbfounded.
What’s the situation?
So, asking ’how to handle it’ wasn’t directed at the Spirit Ink Immortal King and others, but at Jiang Cheng?
How is this possible?
Isn’t Chen Zhou Quasi-Emperor from Infinite Cave Heaven?
How could he listen to Sect Leader Jiang and turn against his own?
No one could understand.
Xiao Kun and Jiyun knew Sect Leader Jiang had benefited many, but this Chen Zhou Quasi-Emperor wasn’t among those who ascended alongside them.
There should be no connections, right?
Others were even more puzzled.
The moment Chen Zhou Quasi-Emperor’s words fell, he immediately unfolded his Immortal Country, encompassing Spirit Ink and the three Immortal Kings within.
His Immortal Country was full of grandeur, already manifesting myriad creatures.
On closer inspection, they were not humans, but sword-shaped Spirit Bodies.
The Immortal Country appeared, turning this space into a world constructed of swords, effectively replacing the original world.
Everyone in this world found their place.
Soon, a sense of being completely locked in struck everyone’s hearts.
"No!"
The Spirit Ink Immortal King’s expression changed drastically, filled with terror.
This twist was unimaginable even in his wildest dreams.
The greatest trump card turned against him.
"Chen Zhou, are you crazy?"
"Have you forgotten who you are, forgotten your sect?"
"Infinite Cave Heaven nurtured you, how can you betray, you..."
Countless Sword Spirits, like moths to a flame, an Ancient Sword was already formed, reaching into the sky.
Chen Zhou was expressionless.
"Joined Infinite Cave Heaven back then just to obtain Sword Dao Classics."
"My achievements owe nothing to you."
"What!"
The Spirit Ink Immortal King and other Immortal Kings of Infinite Cave Heaven went mad.
Others present also had their mouths agape, unable to believe what they heard.
This Chen Zhou Quasi-Emperor, once a dominating figure in the Middle Immortal Realm and a banner figure for Infinite Cave Heaven... betrayed the sect?
So abruptly, so casually?
"You traitor!"
The Spirit Ink Immortal King was furious, nearly collapsing.
He roared angrily: "How could you do this!"
"What benefits did that Jiang offer to make you..."
"He... made me."
In a white gown, Chen Zhou Quasi-Emperor’s eyes lowered slightly, as the Ancient Sword spanning the entire Immortal Country slowly cleaved down.
All the Immortal Kings from Infinite Cave Heaven felt a chill race up from their feet to their heads.
At this moment, they found themselves unable to move, only able to watch as the giant sword descended.
The Spirit Ink Immortal King shouted fiercely: "You forced us!"
"Today, we’ll clean the house and eliminate this traitor!"
"Kill!"
The three Immortal Kings in mid-air each had Laws upon them; this Immortal Country couldn’t trap them.
One after another, golden lights soared from their bodies.
In an instant, three holes were blasted into the Immortal Country.
Present, whether Xiao Kun, Jiyun, Wu Luo, or Ren An, all felt three significant alterations in the world.
As Immortal Kings, their understanding of the world was extremely high.
Yet, they could only sense intuitively without knowing precisely what had changed.
As for Yuan Zhen and Yuan Sheng, the Immortal Venerables, they remained completely unaware.
"Heart with Thunder!"
Accompanied by the Spirit Ink Immortal King’s decisive shout, Xiao Kun, Wu Jue, Jiyun, Mingchi, and the rest of the 12 fell from the sky.
All clutched their chests, faces full of pain.
Thunder should come from the outside.
This was a Law of the Immortal Emperor, altering original patterns, causing uncontrollable Thunder Rules to arise within them.
Those Rules were chaotic, with imminent life-threatening dangers.
Mingchi and Liuyuan, with the weakest power, were nearly knocked out on the spot.
Brother Cheng furrowed his brows, he too felt the Thunder Rules acting.
But due to his top-notch Immortal Demon Physique and Great Perfection Level Rule Understanding, he sustained little injury.
Those at the war’s periphery all felt the impact, let alone Chen Zhou Quasi-Emperor in the direct battle.
Pong!
A muffled sound.
The white attire tore open with a rip, but the Immortal Body remained unmarked.
Slash!
Sword light fell like a satin.
The Spirit Ink Immortal King who had just shouted the Laws had no escape, being forcibly slain along with the Immortal Country.
The other two Immortal Kings were horrified!
Yet before they could employ two more Laws, the sword light swept past their waists.
The threat from the Power of Laws was finally eliminated, Xiao Kun, Jiyun, and others relaxed but remained secretly amazed at the individual’s power.
Ignoring the influence of the Immortal Emperor’s Laws, forcefully exerting might, achieving strength over finesse.
Is this the combat power of Quasi-Emperor Level?
With the three Law-enfused Immortal Kings slain, remaining experts from Infinite Cave Heaven had no chance.
Moments later, they were all thoroughly slaughtered.
From this point, Infinite Cave Heaven’s upper echelon in the Middle Immortal Realm was entirely wiped out.
This Ancient Immortal Sect that had been passed down for countless years could never revive its former glory.
Silence pervaded the scene.
Did so many Immortal Kings simply perish?
Looking at this God of Slaughter, even Wu Jue, Jiyun, and others were discreetly cautious.
Chen Zhou Quasi-Emperor descended gracefully, landing once more in front of Brother Cheng.
"Back then when I came here, I wasn’t challenging the Celestial River Immortal King but asking for your whereabouts."

chapters.title: Chapter 359: Brother, make yourself clear!
chapters.content:
Chapter 359: Chapter 359: Brother, make yourself clear!
"You sure are attentive!"
Brother Cheng laughed and patted his shoulder, expressing rare admiration.
"I couldn’t have imagined that you, a protagonist from a wuxia template, could achieve such heights."
Of course, he recognized Chen Zhou Quasi-Emperor.
But after recognizing him, he couldn’t help but find it quite unbelievable himself.
Back in the lower realm of Thousand Spirit Domain, Brother Cheng had conquered the Silence Sacred Land and led the disciples of Feixian Sect to relocate there.
Afterward, he, being boastful, organized a grand opening ceremony and intentionally invited cultivators from nearby to attend the feast.
Because there were several hostile sacred lands around at the time, everyone was skeptical of the newly established Feixian Sect, so not many came, and their cultivation levels were generally low.
The most outrageous of them was the White Feather Sword Saint, invited by Yin Xuer.
Though he was called a Sword Saint, he was just a top-notch expert among mortal martial artists, having never set foot in the realm of cultivation.
Thus, Brother Cheng had some impression of him.
But he never dreamed that this person would later become so formidable.
The achievements of being the foremost expert of the Middle Immortal Realm, even reaching Quasi-Emperor status, exceeded quite a few top-tier cultivators of the various great realms back then.
Simply amazing.
"That banquet opened the door to cultivation for me."
The former White Feather Sword Saint, now the sincere Chen Zhou Quasi-Emperor, bowed slightly to Brother Cheng.
He reverently took out an old storage ring from his bosom.
The storage ring was a yellowish tone, merely a low-tier spiritual artifact, with a very limited space that few would care about in the Immortal Realm.
Yet, from the surface worn smooth from countless rubs, it was clear its owner had cherished it many times over.
"The kindness of gifting fruit and treasures, unforgettable to this day!"
Who said Chen Zhou Quasi-Emperor was unfamiliar with worldly affairs?
At this moment, his unwavering gaze towards Jiang Cheng reflected sincerity anyone could see.
"Even after a hundred thousand years, upon entering the Immortal Realm, I learned you’ve done even more for all ascenders from the lower realm."
Without Brother Cheng moving the Void Immortal Realm and removing the Treasure Bottle False Immortal Realm, the lower realm cultivators would still be unable to ascend.
In hindsight, all future ascenders from the lower realm should really thank him.
"Hahaha, it was just a flick of the wrist, hardly worth mentioning..."
Though speaking humbly, Brother Cheng was genuinely quite proud inside.
Despite not having any grand vision of benefiting future ascenders when he ascended back then.
He hadn’t thought that far ahead at all, come on!
"A flick of the wrist for you, but for me, it was a profound rebirth!"
White Feather Sword Saint solemnly declared, "Without you, I would’ve lived barely a century, already turned into dust."
"Being able to see you again today, my Sword Heart is finally complete; this life has no regrets!"
Hearing this, everyone present caught onto the flavor of the conversation.
So feelings were that this ’foremost expert of the Middle Immortal Realm’, was groomed single-handedly by Sect Leader Jiang?
No wonder he decisively defected from Infinite Cave Heaven for him.
Seriously, just what kind of profound influence does the old master have?
Thinking about it, too, he single-handedly eliminated 35 Immortal Kings; this feat was even more extraordinary than Chen Zhou back then.
But they seem like completely different styles of people, how did they end up together?
"Why did you change your name, if I hadn’t seen it with my own eyes, I wouldn’t have known it was you."
"My original name was Bai Chenzhou. White Feather was a nickname given by martial arts peers when I roamed with a white feather hung on my sword hilt."
In legends, the usually silent Chen Zhou Quasi-Emperor, has now entered a mood of knowing no restraint in sharing.
"Oh, so that’s how it is!"
Sect Leader Jiang suddenly queried with annoyance, "Then when you came to Middle Immortal Realm, why didn’t you join my Feixian Sect?"
"Why so disrespectful?"
Thinking about it too, Bai Chenzhou became renowned in the Middle Immortal Realm 30 to 50 million years ago, when Feixian Sect’s second, third, and fourth generation disciples had long since ascended.
It was precisely during Feixian Sect’s rapid decline.
Had he joined then, Feixian Sect could’ve been glorified for another 20 million years.
And everyone else was helpless.
Dude, he’s a Quasi-Emperor after all.
Moreover, he’s one of those people who keep to himself without cracking a smile!
Shouldn’t we maintain at least a bit of courtesy when speaking with him?
But Bai Chenzhou immediately apologized with our sword in hand.
"When I first arrived in Middle Immortal Realm, I did not know you had a legacy here."
"By the time I learned, I was already about to ascend to the Upper Immortal Realm..."
He is someone who ignores worldly matters, focusing only on challenges.
In the Celestial Domain of Middle Immortal Realm, the declining Feixian Sect was not noticeable in Qianlan Celestial Realm, it’s truly no wonder he hadn’t heard of it initially.
"Alright, I’ll let you off this time."
The crowd was left speechless once again.
"Let off a Quasi-Emperor, how peculiar does that sound?"
"What’s the situation in the Upper Immortal Realm now, are my disciples and grand disciples doing well?"
Now that someone had come down, Brother Cheng wanted to inquire about Ji Linghan and the others’ situation.
This question also drew the attention of all Feixian Sect disciples present, who stood with ears perked and gazes full of anticipation.
Bai Chenzhou shook his head.
"Their situation is not very good, they’ve suffered attacks from both Immortal and Demon Dao, with heavy casualties, currently at..."
He seemed to want to say more, but his figure quickly faded.
There’s a time limit for coming down from Upper Immortal Realm, set by the collective laws of all Immortal Emperors and Demon Emperors of the Upper Immortal Realm.
Compared to the laws just imposed by the three earlier, it’s countless times stronger, even Immortal Emperors themselves can’t break it.
Once time is up, one is forcibly summoned back to the Upper Immortal Realm.
"Hey hey, brother, finish your words before leaving!"
Watching him disappearing completely before his eyes, Brother Cheng became anxious.
"Brother, are you filming a movie? Saying half a sentence and then gone, at least tell me where they are!"
He patted his thigh regrettably.
"Damn it, should’ve skipped pleasantries and gone straight to the point from the start!"
Beside him, Xiao Kun, Shali, and the others already looked up in immense admiration.
Facing a fortune-loaded Demon Level powerhouse like Chen Zhou Quasi-Emperor, probably only Sect Leader Jiang dares to be so casual.
"Haha, Sect Leader Jiang is formidable!"
"As expected of you!"
"No matter the crisis, always able to resolve it easily."
While flattering, a few also curiously asked.
"What past relationship did you have with Chen Zhou Quasi-Emperor back then? I only heard he’s also an ascender from the lower realm."
Their impression of Chen Zhou Quasi-Emperor was profound.
Moreover, Jiang Cheng being familiar with him meant having this connection, maybe when they go to the Upper Immortal Realm, they’d have extra paths through him!
Brother Cheng thought if he revealed his early identity and strength, these defeated ones under him were sure to suffer massive critical strike damage.
Better avoid that.
"Alright, let’s get down to business!"
White Feather Sword Saint was quite ’considerate’, having eliminated the people of Infinite Cave Heaven, yet not cleaning the battlefield.
Brother Cheng naturally, for proper reasons, accepted his spoils of war gleefully.
After collecting them, he came before Wu Luo Immortal King, Ren An Demon King, and other experts.
Smilingly rubbing his chin: "Just now, you seemed to be on the side of Infinite Cave Heaven?"
"No!"
Wu Luo Immortal King’s body trembled, he promptly stated loudly: "Absolutely not! We stood by your side from the beginning to end!"
Ren An Demon King’s head shook with resolute firmness: "Our Taiyin Palace has always been at odds with Infinite Cave Heaven, absolutely couldn’t have sided with them!"
They weren’t stupid.
No matter if they were fence-sitters earlier, they couldn’t admit it now.

chapters.title: Chapter 360: Thank You Elder Jiang
chapters.content:
Chapter 360: Chapter 360: Thank You Elder Jiang
Brother Cheng intentionally nitpicked: "But just now when they arrived, you all cheered."
"Elder Jiang, it’s a misunderstanding!"
Spirit Ink Immortal King righteously stated: "We believe you will definitely defeat the bandits, and seeing them walk into the trap willingly, we couldn’t help but cheer!"
Other Immortal Kings quickly agreed.
"That’s right, we cheered for the impending victory of justice!"
"For the impending doom of the ugly enemies!"
"Infinite Cave Heaven has been rampant for years, it’s about time they were wiped out!"
"Elder Jiang has done a great deed for the Middle Immortal Realm, benefiting this age and the next, truly worthy of being written about!"
"Let’s erect a monument upon our return for generations to sing praises!"
Brother Cheng was quite impressed with these fair-weather friends and smooth talkers.
They could turn black into white, leaving him with no way to deal with them.
"Really?"
"Could it be, seeing Infinite Cave Heaven coming, you thought you wouldn’t have to hand over treasures to me..."
Before he could finish, Spirit Ink Immortal King had already taken off his storage ring, removed his Immortal Sword, and taken off his Seventh-grade Immortal Armor.
Then, he carefully and respectfully presented them to Brother Cheng.
"Elder Jiang, please take the trouble!"
"Allow me to entrust my humble possessions to your safekeeping, hoping you won’t find it bothersome!"
The attitude was as if handing over a thousand-pound burden to Sect Leader Jiang.
"Alright, alright..."
This old man’s perceptiveness was so excessive, even Brother Cheng was a bit bewildered.
Others weren’t slow either.
"Elder Jiang, here’s mine!"
"And mine, please accept it quickly!"
"It’s really troublesome for you, having to take care of these for us..."
The urgency resembled being driven to reincarnate, leaving Brother Cheng almost overwhelmed.
There was no other choice.
With Infinite Cave Heaven wiped out and the Quasi-Emperor submitting, it extinguished the last bit of their wishful thinking.
Seeing Spirit Ink Immortal King’s downfall, now their only thought was to survive.
Once collected, they hurried away from here at the fastest speed.
In the blink of an eye, only a mess was left on the ground and Brother Cheng dazed in the wind.
Clearly, it was him who took their stuff, but why did the process seem somewhat passive?
However, fortunately, the gains were immense.
The loot from Infinite Cave Heaven and these people was all converted into merit, totaling 68.74 million.
And beyond that, Bai Chenzhou’s unexpected submission shocked everyone at the scene.
It significantly increased his shock value once more.
After a final tally, his merit had surpassed 70 million.
While he was busy doing the math, Sect Leader Yuan Zhen, Yuan Sheng, and other Feixian Sect Elders gathered around him.
Everyone started with flattery, Elder Jiang was truly formidable, not only subduing the immortals but even making the once most powerful expert of the Middle Immortal Realm submit.
Then, their faces all turned to worry.
"Elder Jiang, as Chen Zhou Quasi-Emperor just mentioned, our sect’s ancestors are not in a favorable situation in the Upper Immortal Realm!"
For them, the ancestors have always been a totemic presence in their hearts, though never seen, they’ve been their greatest pride.
Before, they guessed the ancestors might be targeted in the Upper Immortal Realm, but it was always just speculation.
Now, this news being confirmed, even Sect Leader Yuan Zhen was somewhat disheartened.
"Yes, and aren’t we sure if the ancestors are well..."
"Just as Chen Zhou Quasi-Emperor mentioned earlier, they’ve suffered heavy casualties, what should we do..."
The other elders were similarly at a loss.
On one hand, they admire and revere the ancestors and don’t wish for anything to happen to them.
On the other hand, they originally hoped to find big backers once they reach the Upper Immortal Realm.
Think about the number of Immortal Kings Feixian Sect has sent up over the years, totaling over a thousand!
This quantity almost matches the current total number of Immortal Kings in the Middle Immortal Realm.
It’s such a massive force.
Moreover, most of them went to the Upper Immortal Realm seventy to eighty million years ago, by now, there might be several Immortal Emperors and Quasi-Emperors.
In Yuan Shu, Yuan Mu, and others’ views, just reaching the Upper Immortal Realm would be like enjoying the shade of a big tree.
The ancestors would protect them well.
But now, it seems the situation is more complicated.
"There’s nothing to worry about."
Brother Cheng shrugged, "Don’t worry, with me around, things will definitely get better."
Although he said this, he was actually more eager than ever to meet those disciples.
This nonchalant assurance couldn’t truly ease Yuan Zhen and the others’ concerns.
Although Ancestor Jiang’s personal strength was outstanding, the Upper Immortal Realm was a world ruled by Immortal Emperors.
Especially since Yuan Shu, Yuan Mu, and other elders, along with the other disciples, didn’t know Brother Cheng was the first-generation ancestor.
In their hearts, given that so many ancestors were heavily injured or dead, even if you went up, the situation might not be too promising...
"Alright, why don’t you all return to the sect first, I have some matters to discuss with them."
Brother Cheng wasn’t in the mood for psychological counseling.
"In nine more years, I’ll take all of Feixian Sect up to the Upper Immortal Realm."
"What are your plans for then?"
Xiao Kun, Shali, and the Twelve Corpse Kings immediately patted their chests and said, "Sect Leader Jiang, wherever you go, we’ll follow!"
They didn’t want to let go of Brother Cheng’s strong backing.
Compared to those disciples of Feixian Sect, their confidence in Sect Leader Jiang was much higher.
Xiao Kun added: "Actually, if it weren’t for the opportunity with the Enlightenment Immortal Tree, I would have already gone up to reunite with Brother Void Abyss!"
Jiyun also sighed: "That’s right, I also want to see Senior Brothers Qingyun and Liuyun as soon as possible!"
Liu Yuan laughed and clapped: "Haha, I am more eager to experience the alchemy techniques of the Upper Immortal Realm..."
The others looked at him with sympathy, suddenly a bit schadenfreude.
How pitiful, the greatest alchemist is right beside you, and yet you’re unaware.
But also, during the alchemy of the Enlightenment Immortal Tree, Sect Leader Jiang demonstrated his powerful skills in refining eighth-grade Immortal Pills, and you missed it, you old man.
"Why are you all looking at me like that?"
Liu Yuan Immortal King was utterly puzzled: "Did I say something wrong?"
"A bunch of commoners, my persistent pursuit of the peak of alchemy is not something you can understand!"
Xiao Kun, Shali, and others laughed loudly: "Indeed, we don’t understand you."
Jiyun, Wu Jue, and others deliberately praised with Yin-Yang sarcasm.
"How high is your realm..."
"Admiration, admiration..."
Brother Cheng didn’t bother to clarify, he didn’t want to endure another stretch of consecutive days busy with alchemy.
After a bout of laughter, Jiyun Immortal King came over a bit embarrassed.
"Sect Leader Jiang, I have an excessive request, could you spare me 20 Immortal Fate Orders, I wish to take some disciples and grand-disciples up."
Wu Jue, Mingchi, and others originally thought that since he himself deemed it excessive, he shouldn’t mention it.
But once Jiyun was done, they all fell silent.
Immediately, Xiao Kun laughed and rubbed his hands.
"Sect Leader Jiang, could you also give me 30, I have some juniors I wish to take up."
"Me too, quite a few disciples I can’t leave behind..."

chapters.title: Chapter 361: Even the Upper Immortal Realm is Helpless
chapters.content:
Chapter 361: Chapter 361: Even the Upper Immortal Realm is Helpless
The Immortal King has an Immortal Country, but to achieve the level of traveling through space with people, it must be at least the Ascension Level.
Moreover, when the Immortal Emperors of the Upper Immortal Realm jointly formulated the Ascension Law, they had already considered this point.
Dragging family along in the Immortal Country would even cause the Immortal King himself to be repelled by the Ascension Rules.
Except for the solitary Wu Jue, Jingyu, and She Lan, others in the Middle Immortal Realm with large families have many juniors to support.
Only need dozens of them, it is already quite conservative.
This time, Brother Cheng gathered over ninety percent of the Immortal Fate Orders in the Middle Immortal Realm together, even if they want to get it themselves, there’s no other way.
They can only seek help from him.
"Are you only bringing this few people?"
Brother Cheng thought to himself, my Xuanji Map can hold over a hundred million people now.
Several people’s eyes brightened, indeed, he has so many Immortal Fate Orders.
"Well, how many do you think are suitable?"
"Whatever, bring as many as you want."
Jiyun took a deep breath and tentatively asked, "Is it okay even with ten thousand people?"
Immortal King Wu Jue immediately cursed, "You’re really asking for too much, how can you even suggest that?"
"Cough, I was just saying it..."
Brother Cheng glanced at him, deliberately showing off, "Look at your ambitions, only ten thousand, what’s the big deal."
"Really?"
Can you really bring as many as ten thousand people?
Although unaware of the existence of Xuanji Map, several people were overjoyed!
Since they won’t return once they ascend, of course they’d want to support more juniors.
"Alright, go back and prepare."
After dismissing these people, he returned to the Feixian Sect.
After exchanging all the Merit gained this time for Pills, he ascended from a Fourth-Grade Immortal King to Sixth-grade.
"This is really tricky, is it so hard to advance as an Immortal King?"
From Fourth Grade to Fifth Grade required three times the amount of Pills as from Third Grade to Fourth Grade.
For Brother Cheng, used to leveling up dramatically after showing off, this leveling speed was naturally unsatisfactory.
"Looks like I indeed need to head to the Upper Immortal Realm sooner."
"The stage of the Middle Immortal Realm isn’t large enough, can’t sustain my pretense, and doesn’t earn much."
Meanwhile, the news of Infinite Cave Heaven’s annihilation reached outside.
Consequently, the entire Middle Immortal Realm unanimously erupted in an uproar.
The previous elimination of 35 Immortal Kings was already enough to shock people.
Though those Immortal Kings hailed from different sects.
This time, the total annihilation of Infinite Cave Heaven’s 15 Immortal Kings meant a top-tier Ancient Immortal Sect in the Middle Immortal Realm now became history.
This was indeed a matter that pierced through the heavens!
It was foreseeable the Infinite Cave Heaven in the Upper Immortal Realm would not let this pass.
Although those 15 Immortal Kings weren’t personally slain by Jiang Cheng, the shock it brought outsiders was just as significant.
The once-renowned Immortal King Chen Zhou resurfaced, and he unexpectedly obeyed Jiang Cheng.
This was even more unbelievable than the annihilation of Infinite Cave Heaven.
Additionally, the looting of over a hundred Immortal Kings, including Immortal King Wu Luo and Ren An Demon King...
These series of events eventually confirmed one conclusion for everyone—no one in the Middle Immortal Realm could provoke Elder Jiang of the Feixian Sect.
Some top-tier Ancient Immortal Sects and Demon Sects had plans similar to Infinite Cave Heaven.
Now they promptly folded, with some even temporarily sealing their gates.
No longer daring to make appearances.
In the Nine-Star Celestial Realm, a group of Demon Kings and Demon Venerables jointly visited the Nine-Star Demon Hall.
"Ji Hun Ancestor, please take action promptly!"
"Indeed, only the Nine-Star Demon Hall can restrain him now!"
"If you invite the Upper Realm Demon Emperors, this villain will surely meet his demise!"
The Nine-Star Demon Hall only had three Demon Kings, which constituted a relatively formidable force in the Middle Immortal Realm.
Yet compared to an Immortal Sect like Infinite Cave Heaven with 15 Immortal Kings, they were not comparable.
And the power of Ji Hun Ancestor wasn’t necessarily much stronger than Spirit Ink Immortal King.
However, during each ascension, they could seize 300 Immortal Fate Orders like Infinite Cave Heaven.
The reason was simple, their counterpart in the Upper Immortal Realm was overwhelmingly powerful—the Nine-Star Demon Hall was one of the dominators of the Demon Camp in the Upper Immortal Realm.
Unless one never planned to ascend there, otherwise who dared to disrespect them.
After the Immortal Realm divided into three, many prominent Ancient Immortal Demon Sect focused on the Upper Immortal Realm and did not leave an inheritance in the Middle Immortal Realm.
Though the Nine-Star Demon Hall wasn’t very attentive to the Middle Immortal Realm, they left their dao lineage at least.
Now Jiang Cheng was unbeatable.
The laws descended by Infinite Cave Heaven could not extinguish him.
In the eyes of these Demon Kings and Demon Venerables, the only force to hold the ’Anti-Jiang Banner’ was the deeper Nine-Star Demon Hall!
Once Ji Hun Ancestor contacts the headquarters in the Upper Immortal Realm, surely stronger measures would descend.
"Return..."
Facing the collective plea of over a hundred Demon Kings, Ji Hun Ancestor, seated atop the Dark Green Soul Platform, shook his head.
"This person won’t live long; the Upper Immortal Realm will be his grave."
Ah, this...
Isn’t this like the ’he will inevitably pay the price’ powerless angry curse, fundamentally the same?
The implication was essentially indifferent to it?
"Ji Hun Ancestor, you can’t just ignore it!"
"The Nine-Star Demon Hall is already our last hope, the entire Middle Immortal Realm is watching you..."
"Indeed, this person has completely disrupted the balance of the Middle Immortal Realm; the hazard is too great; we can’t allow it to carry on!"
"We must extinguish him in the Middle Immortal Realm to prevent future troubles!"
The demons below were fervent, and Ji Hun Ancestor’s slightly closed eyes trembled with discontent.
He indeed wasn’t ignoring.
Actually, he contacted the Upper Immortal Realm right upon hearing the news of Infinite Cave Heaven’s obliteration.
Yet the final response from the Upper Realm Demon Emperors was the laws and the Quasi-Emperor’s cost were too substantial, and might not succeed; it was unnecessary.
Better to wait until Jiang Cheng ascends, then the Demon Emperors would personally act.
So he was well aware, currently, the Upper Realm couldn’t handle Jiang Cheng and could only reluctantly permit him to live a few more years.
Yet he couldn’t state this plainly.
Otherwise, wouldn’t it expose the powerlessness of the Upper Realm, unable to subdue the Middle Immortal Realm?
"The Upper Immortal Realm has already laid a snare, just waiting for him to ascend!"
"Rest assured, he won’t be a future threat; his death is certain."
The demons exchanged glances, does this imply you’ve contacted the Upper Immortal Realm?
"And does the Upper Realm Demon Emperor just let him continue rampaging?"
If Brother Cheng heard the accusation, he would certainly feel innocent; when have I rampaged, unless you actively provoke, I’m not interested in running around, okay?
To someone lazy like him, isn’t it nice to lie down?
"Yes, he seized 300,000 Immortal Fate Orders."
"Because of him, our disciples can’t ascend..."
"This person has cut off our path!"
"Ji Hun Ancestor, you were one of the initiators of distributing Immortal Fate Orders back then."
"Now at this moment, can’t you manage it?"
"Can you contact the Upper Realm Demon Emperors again, urge them to soon deploy thunderous measures!"

chapters.title: Chapter 362 - 2 Ascension Points
chapters.content:
Chapter 362: Chapter 362: 2 Ascension Points
Ji Hun Ancestor almost felt his chest tighten in anger because of them.
Jiang Cheng monopolizing 300,000 Immortal Fate Orders broke the established rules.
He was indeed very upset.
But even the Upper Immortal Realm had no solution, what could he do?
Annoyed and in a chaotic state, he could no longer maintain that calm and unfathomable demeanor.
"Everyone shut up!"
"Immortal Fate Orders aren’t exclusive to this term!"
"If you can’t make it this term, there’s always the next one!"
Looking around at the demons below, he gritted his teeth, wishing he could slap each one, utterly exasperated.
"You’ve all lived for billions of years, can’t wait another hundred thousand?"
"Can’t keep your cool at all!"
"Scram!"
"All of you, scram!"
What bullshit rules for Immortal Fate Orders?
Is there really such a thing?
Who said so?
He doesn’t remember, doesn’t know, never heard of it.
The demons, who had been scolded fiercely, looked helpless.
In the past, they could afford to wait the next hundred thousand years, but this time the situation is different.
With the Enlightenment Immortal Tree gone, staying in the Middle Immortal Realm is meaningless.
Of course, they aim to ascend to the Upper Immortal Realm as soon as possible.
And once all these Demon Kings ascend, their disciples and followers in the Middle Immortal Realm would be left without protection.
Who knows what the next term will be like?
Just look at the Feixian Sect; after the ascension of their previous four generations of ancestors, they quickly declined.
So they all want to take advantage of this opportunity to bring their important heirs with them.
It can be said that this term’s Immortal Fate Orders are the most valuable, and everyone wants to get more.
While the Middle Immortal Realm was wailing, the Upper Immortal Realm also saw some ripples.
The projections of dozens of Immortal Emperors and Demon Emperors appeared out of thin air over a mysterious void.
Each emitted a terrifying might capable of destroying heaven and earth.
And their appearance here was naturally due to Jiang Cheng.
"I never imagined the Feixian Sect still had remnants."
"Even more unexpected...Chen Zhou Quasi-Emperor is also one of his men."
"Is Chen Zhou dead?"
"No."
"The three from Infinite Cave Heaven are enraged and pursuing him."
Several Demon Emperors in the projection laughed, seemingly gloating.
Due to their laughter, the distant space shook and tore apart.
Countless beings perished as a result...
"The Feixian Sect really hid deeply; their people are everywhere!"
"Yes, this time we must uproot them completely..."
"He brought this upon himself, bringing so many people up made him too obvious."
"Heh, I’m more curious to know what is so special about this person."
They hadn’t associated him with the Jiang Cheng from a hundred million years ago, as they had the same surname.
But thinking deeper, it seemed impossible.
A hundred million years ago, that person killed the Nine Flames Immortal Emperor, something they couldn’t achieve.
If he truly had such powerful strength, what would be the point of staying in the Middle Immortal Realm?
Over the years, they’ve gradually concluded that perhaps that person perished alongside the Nine Flames Immortal Emperor.
Otherwise, earthquakes would have long erupted in the Upper Immortal Realm.
"Are you after his opportunity?"
"If he falls on the Zixiao Platform, the Immortal Dao side should act."
"If he falls in the Nether Pool, the Demon Dao should eliminate him."
"Ha, no problem, this emperor very much wants to see what is so marvelous about this person."
Immortal Fate Orders were refined together by the top powers of the Immortal and Demon Dao, and they naturally understood the rules of ascension clearly.
In essence, Immortal Fate Orders are also a cake for the Upper Immortal Realm.
They need to absorb the elites of the Middle Immortal Realm to bolster their own strength.
Therefore, those holding Immortal Fate Orders will fall into one of two ’Reception Points’ upon ascending to the Upper Immortal Realm.
Those cultivating Demon Dao techniques with a Demon Body will fall into the Demon Camp’s Nine-Star Demon Hall’s Nether Pool.
While those cultivating Immortal Dao techniques with an Immortal Body will fall into the Immortal Dao Camp’s Everlasting Hall’s Zixiao Platform.
During each ascension period, the major sects send their higher-ups to recruit.
Immortal Venerables who ascended with relatives in the sects of the Upper Immortal Realm are naturally taken directly by them.
Those without strong backing are divided and selected by these great sects.
As for those who wish to live as free spirits, it’s not impossible, but life in the Upper Immortal Realm won’t be easy.
In the past, in such recruiting matters, Immortal Emperors wouldn’t lower themselves to attend personally.
Sending a Quasi-Emperor showed significant importance; usually, only a few Immortal King Elders were sent.
This time, however, they evidently decided against such an approach.
To massacre Brother Cheng and everyone in the Feixian Sect, they wouldn’t be careless this time!
And because Brother Cheng, after advancing to Immortal King, acted twice without being seen, the Upper Realm still didn’t know whether he was a Demon Cultivator or an Immortal Cultivator.
Thus, they could only block both paths.
At this time, Brother Cheng was unaware that a deadly trap awaited the entire Feixian Sect before they even reached the Upper Immortal Realm.
After leveling up, he felt refreshed and satisfied.
"Everyone, come out, meeting time!"
The ancestor’s summons made the elders hurry to gather at the fastest speed.
"Ancestor, what important matter have you gathered us for?"
"Is there news from the Upper Immortal Realm?"
"Or is there an enemy raid again?"
"Stop guessing wildly, I summoned you for the Immortal Fate Orders."
The elders were stunned; was there still a need to buy more?
"But haven’t we already got over 300,000 of them?"
"That should far exceed what we need, right?"
"Indeed, and even if we wanted to continue buying, no one would sell!"
There are only about 30,000 Immortal Fate Orders left outside, and except for the Celestial Pavilion, other forces wouldn’t choose to sell their orders.
Brother Cheng glanced around at them and said leisurely, "Aren’t you curious why I bought so many?"
Indeed, why?
The Feixian Sect only has 140,000 disciples, buying over 300,000 is unnecessary, isn’t it a waste of Immortal Crystals?
It’s just that Sect Leader Jiang’s status was too high for them to ask directly.
Privately, they’ve pondered over it countless times.
Seeing their puzzled expressions, Brother Cheng smugly curled his lips, "I bought so many because I plan to sell them!"
"Sell them?"
"Is that necessary?"
The elders were bewildered.
Isn’t this absurd?
After buying them with great difficulty, now selling them again, weren’t their efforts all in vain?
"It seems you’re so busy with cultivation that you have no business acumen at all!"
Brother Cheng sighed with an expression of frustration.
"Who said I was going to sell them at cost, we’re not running a charity here."
"Could it be..."
The elders’ eyes suddenly brightened.
Sect Leader Jiang raised his arm and declared, "That’s right, sell them at a high price!"
"Immortal Fate Orders are now monopolized by me, becoming an exclusive resource!"
"You didn’t really think I’d buy so many useless tokens for no reason, did you?"
Brother Cheng was so proud he could hardly contain his excitement.
"Now, even if I raise the price, those people have no choice but to buy them, hahaha!"
The elders looked at him with dazed eyes, not knowing what to say.
So your keen interest in Immortal Fate Orders from the beginning was solely because you saw a business opportunity?
Must you be so commercial?
Other ancestors are often in eternal seclusion, away from worldly affairs, but our ancestor is really down-to-earth, you’d think he was a businessman if you didn’t know better.
With these thoughts, Sect Leader Yuan Zhen still respectfully asked, "So, what price do you plan to set, Ancestor?"

chapters.title: Chapter 363: Aren’t Your Appetites Too Small?
chapters.content:
Chapter 363: Chapter 363: Aren’t Your Appetites Too Small?
At first, when they heard that Brother Cheng was going to sell the Immortal Fate Order, the elders thought it was absurd.
Hoarding and inflating prices really ruins goodwill, and it would certainly attract a united attack from the Middle Immortal Realm.
But on second thought, what’s there to be afraid of?
Who dares to defy Elder Jiang now?
A united attack has already happened, didn’t it all turn out to be nothing?
Counting it, besides the Celestial Pavilion, only the Feixian Sect is qualified to sell this thing now.
The former is because of neutrality, and the latter because it doesn’t care about offending people at all.
Facing the gazes of the elders, Brother Cheng slowly raised three fingers.
"300,000, huh?"
The elders gasped.
"Isn’t this price a bit high?"
"Yeah, it seems a bit much, doesn’t it?"
Celestial Pavilion is only selling it for 100,000, you’re doubling the price at the flip of a hand.
This isn’t just a bit high, it’s outright extortionate!
It’s just that none of the elders dared to say that aloud.
"300,000?"
Brother Cheng was momentarily stunned.
He looked at everyone in bewilderment, then shook his head in disappointment.
"No wonder you guys have never accomplished anything big."
"Your vision and appetite are way too small."
"What 300,000, I said 3 million!"
"Any Upper Immortal can casually put out tens of thousands of top-grade Immortal Crystals, pricing it at 300,000 would be an insult to them."
"3 million?"
The elders almost fainted.
You really dare to set such a price!
Just turning it over once, without any additional cost, you directly inflated the price by 29 times.
Indeed, most Upper Immortals could muster a hundred or eighty thousand Immortal Crystals, but 3 million is much more challenging.
This price point is excruciatingly difficult for them.
Borrowing everywhere and selling off assets they could manage to gather that much, but it would cost them everything they have.
Elder Jiang’s behavior can’t simply be described as unscrupulous anymore; it’s outright ruthless!
"Isn’t this too excessive?"
"Ancestor, this will probably..."
Elder Yuan Sheng wanted to say this would anger many, but then he remembered the ancestor had long since angered many and wouldn’t care about one more time.
"But with such a high price, probably no one will buy, right?"
"Yeah, those outside aren’t stupid, they won’t become suckers."
"If they can’t achieve it this time, they can wait for the next session..."
"Alright, alright."
Brother Cheng waved his hand impatiently.
"Just spread the word."
"And also tell them that anyone who buys an Immortal Fate Order from me can stay at the Feixian Sect’s side hall courtyard."
"They will be under my protection until the day of ascension!"
"Absolutely safe, whoever dares to snatch their Immortal Fate Order will have me to deal with!"
"As long as they don’t court death themselves, they will definitely ascend to the Upper Immortal Realm smoothly."
After delegating the tasks, he returned to his place and handed over more than 300,000 Immortal Fate Orders to the maids Su Ye and Su Meng.
"In the coming days, there will be many people coming to buy the Immortal Fate Order."
"You two are responsible for collecting payments."
With over 300,000 pieces, Brother Cheng was annoyed; was he supposed to meet each buyer himself?
Of course, it had to be handed over to the customer service ladies.
Then, he started doing math again.
Immortal Crystals can also be exchanged for Merit, with ten thousand top-grade Immortal Crystal equalling one point.
It seems little, but one point of Merit already equals 10 billion points from before.
If he sold everything this time, he could get over 900 billion Immortal Crystals, which translates to more than 90 million Merit.
"To upgrade quickly, is it easy for me?"
"Sigh, life is just so busy... "
Now as a Sixth-grade Immortal King, his Immortal Country was moving towards the next stage.
The originally chaotic matter began to gradually condense into small celestial bodies.
If he reached Ninth-grade, he would more or less formally reach the Dustless Level.
As the news of Feixian Sect selling the Immortal Fate Order spread, it unsurprisingly resulted in an uproar outside.
And an unprecedented uproar.
It’s likely that never before have both Immortal and Demon Dao in the Middle Immortal Realm and those Loose Cultivators shared such a unified opinion.
"My goodness! Is he insane?"
"3 million, why doesn’t he just go robbing?"
"Lost himself in the pursuit of money?"
"Exactly, Celestial Pavilion sells it for 100,000, he raises it 29 times, that’s straight-up robbery!"
"No wonder he bought so many, turns out it’s for a huge profit?"
"This guy’s heart is pitch-black to the core..."
"No, he doesn’t even have a heart!"
"Not buying, definitely not buying!"
In front of Brother Cheng, no one dared to curse him.
But behind his back, no one could control it.
In an instant, he went from being revered as the new Supreme Expert in the Middle Immortal Realm to becoming infamous.
This dazzling maneuver must have snapped many people’s backs.
Various Immortal Sects and Demon Sects noted that they couldn’t keep up with his antics; they almost had their eyes blinded.
To the top forces, the Immortal Fate Order is a testament to power and status.
To most Upper Immortals, it represents the greatest opportunity of their life.
No one would ever think of using it as a commodity for business transactions.
Even the Celestial Pavilion, which previously sold the Immortal Fate Orders, was very cautious, daring not to extensively exploit it.
Pricing it at 100,000 was very friendly, affordable to any Upper Immortal.
Its main function was more of a ’safe keeping point’.
"Really didn’t expect, he had such a plan."
In the Celestial Pavilion, Ye Yang Immortal King repeatedly shook his head with a bitter smile.
"Have we been tricked by him?"
"He treated us like fools!"
President Du Chen Immortal King, upon learning of this, was also taken aback.
Previously, they were curious why this person bought so many, now finally the answer was revealed.
But this answer made them terribly distressed, so much they almost vomited blood.
For crying out loud, did this guy regard Celestial Pavilion as a manufacturing plant?
You were stocking up on goods here at a low price?
We buy for 100,000 and sell for 10,000, a profit of 9,000.
You, however, buy for 100,000 and sell for 3 million, a profit of 2,900,000.
"Our Celestial Pavilion hunting geese for a lifetime, this time got pecked in the eye!"
If it were before, even if they didn’t take action, they would have at least cursed him.
But now, they really couldn’t bring themselves to curse.
In the Enlightenment Immortal Tree operation, their Celestial Pavilion owed Brother Cheng an immense favor.
Without him, Du Chen Immortal King wouldn’t have reached the Eighth Realm that time.
He painfully rubbed his aching chest, trying to calm his oppressive emotions.
"Only he could accomplish such a business."
Everyone then thought, of course.
To recklessly raise prices and monopolize a trade, the basic premise is powerful strength.
If a weakling dared to do this, they would long be robbed and left with nothing.
Throughout the Middle Immortal Realm, capable of suppressing others’ intentions, currently, there’s only Jiang Cheng.
This maneuver of his, no one will be able to replicate in the future.
"Forget it, just consider it as repaying him a part of the favor!"
The other Immortal Kings in the hall nodded their heads, such thinking at least made them feel a bit better.
Relative to the opposition and resistance voices outside, these businessmen weren’t at all worried about Brother Cheng’s Immortal Fate Order not selling.

chapters.title: Chapter 364: A Once-in-a-Lifetime Opportunity
chapters.content:
Chapter 364: Chapter 364: A Once-in-a-Lifetime Opportunity
"Not buying, not buying, absolutely not buying!"
"Boycott him, we can’t let such a black-hearted person succeed."
"That’s right! At worst, we won’t ascend this time; there’s always next time!"
"Let his Immortal Fate Order rot in his hands, let him suffer the loss!"
"As long as we in the Middle Immortal Realm unite, he won’t sell a single one!"
"Hahaha, let him be furious!"
On the high platform, Chenhuo Immortal Venerable raised his arm and shouted, "Everyone must work together; this is a war!"
"It’s a war between us and that person surnamed Jiang!"
"This war concerns the face of everyone present; anyone who compromises is a deserter and will be despised by countless people!"
Spit flew everywhere, and hundreds of Immortal Venerables below the stage were filled with excitement, responding one after another.
"Never compromise!"
"Never compromise!"
The scene truly resembled a mobilization rally.
These Immortal Venerables were all loose cultivators, not part of any sect.
However, that doesn’t mean they are always isolated from the world; there are interactions between loose cultivators as well.
There are quite a few large and small Loose Cultivator Alliances in the Middle Immortal Realm. These alliances are very loose, not much binding force, more like a circle for mutual exchange.
Often it’s initiated by three to five people, and gradually more people join.
The Floating Light Celestial Domain’s Loose Cultivator Alliance was established not long ago, only in the recent hundred thousand years, and Chenhuo Immortal Venerable was one of the early initiators, quite revered usually.
With his incitement, many Immortal Venerables were impassioned.
After the ’mobilization rally’ ended, Chenhuo Immortal Venerable held another meeting with a group of core members of the alliance, once again severely criticizing Sect Leader Jiang’s despicable act of hoarding for price hikes.
After the late-night meeting dispersed, Chenhuo Immortal Venerable’s two sons quietly approached him.
Each of them handed over a ring.
"Father, everything you instructed us to sell has been sold."
"All the Immortal Crystals exchanged are in here."
Chenhuo Immortal Venerable eagerly took the two rings, sensed through them carefully several times, and after confirming the number was correct, finally revealed a satisfied smile.
"Father, is it worth it?"
"Yes, this time you even sold your own sword and Magical Treasure, isn’t that too much sacrifice..."
Chenhuo Immortal Venerable carefully put away the two rings and then replied, "Of course, it’s worth it, immensely worth it!"
Although he’s usually good at managing, in terms of assets, he wasn’t much better off than those Immortal Venerables and Elders who joined a sect.
After all, as the head of this loose cultivator alliance, he actually didn’t have much power, and the others were free.
"Finally gathered 3 million Immortal Crystals!"
"The Upper Immortal Realm has finally opened its doors to me!"
That’s right, he sold weapons and Magical Treasures just to go buy the Immortal Fate Order from Brother Cheng.
This decision was made on the first day the news from Feixian Sect was released.
However, the two sons still didn’t quite understand.
"But... didn’t you always say that the 3 million price is too expensive, totally not worth it?"
"Yeah, didn’t you also tell others not to buy?"
If the loose cultivators attending today’s meeting saw this scene now, I’m afraid their worldview would collapse.
Aren’t you the vanguard urging everyone to boycott the purchase of the Immortal Fate Order?
So what’s happening here?
Leading the scolding during the day, and secretly enjoying at night?
"Fools!"
Chenhuo Immortal Venerable sensed his surroundings and then lowered his voice to scold, "Those words are meant for others to hear; don’t you two understand?"
"This is a once-in-a-lifetime opportunity entirely different from others!"
"Missing this time, who knows when the next chance will be!"
"Huh? Why?" The two sons didn’t understand.
Chenhuo Immortal Venerable said in a deep voice, "Because of safety!"
"In the past, the Immortal Fate Orders were sold by the Celestial Pavilion, and though transactions could be kept secret, they would be exposed every ten years."
Everyone knew that enduring past the last exposure and then buying would be infinitely safer.
But the problem is, there are plenty of wolves but not enough meat; you want to wait, but others won’t.
Before the last ten years of each cycle arrives, the Celestial Pavilion’s Immortal Fate Orders would have already been sold out beforehand.
Waiting to buy during the safe period leaves you nothing; it’s already too late.
"This time, Feixian Sect’s sale of the Immortal Fate Orders has surpassed the last exposure period; this is a tremendous advantage!"
"In previous such periods, the entire Middle Immortal Realm would be a frenzy; who would sell then?"
Chenhuo Immortal Venerable clenched his fists tightly and said decisively, "Moreover, this time there’s protection provided by Elder Jiang, making it more reliable than ever before!"
"Think about it, why did those Ancient Demon Sect and Immortal Sect remain silent this time?"
"They were beaten into submission by Elder Jiang!"
"Throughout the Middle Immortal Realm, nowhere is safer than by his side."
"Buying his Immortal Fate Order is like stepping halfway into the Upper Immortal Realm."
"How can I miss such a chance?"
As a Ninth-grade Immortal Venerable, his power was outstanding among Immortal Venerables.
But he couldn’t compete with those Immortal Venerables with sects and factions.
Others rush forward in organized groups, and some Immortal Venerables even have sect Immortal Kings to protect them.
He, without a backer, couldn’t expect the other loose cultivators to help him win the Immortal Fate Order, could he?
By that time, that group might be the first to stab him in the back and stage a treasure-hunting murder.
Unless luck was overwhelmingly on his side, he wouldn’t have a chance to reach the Upper Immortal Realm in this lifetime.
This time, securing his way up with 3 million Immortal Crystals seemed incomparably worthwhile to him.
The Upper Immortal Realm is the world where the Immortal Emperor resides; the Immortal Yuan Qi and the Power of Rules there far surpass the Middle Immortal Realm’s.
Moreover, there are far more opportunities; perhaps he could become an Immortal King there and change his fate against the heavens.
What’s the harm in selling everything for that?
"Just his protection alone is worth the 3 million Immortal Crystals!"
The two sons finally understood, but then they had a new doubt.
"Then why did you go to the trouble of rallying others to boycott the purchase?"
"Yeah, if this were to spread, wouldn’t people mock you for contradicting yourself?"
"You two really have short-sightedness!"
Chenhuo Immortal Venerable looked at his two sons, feeling deeply that they hadn’t inherited his cleverness at all.
"The number of Immortal Fate Orders is limited, and I am not the only one who will choose to buy; the sooner, the better, understand?"
"If I don’t find a way to discourage others, more competitors will emerge!"
"Moreover, if too many people sell Immortal Artifacts and Magical Treasures for Immortal Crystals later, these items will depreciate!"
The two sons were completely convinced; their father was practically playing a game of chess, having thought several steps ahead.
"Alright, I must hurry on my way."
"You two... take care of yourselves from now on."
"If I achieve the Immortal King, I will find a way to come back and see you..."
After hastily leaving some final words, Chenhuo Immortal Venerable flew into the night without looking back.
Leaving the two sons staring at each other, just like that he left? Not even coming home for a last visit?

chapters.title: Chapter 365: A Homely Experience
chapters.content:
Chapter 365: Chapter 365: A Homely Experience
Crossing mountains and rivers, Chenhuo Immortal Venerable arrived at the Feixian Sect in the Qianlan Celestial Realm at the fastest speed.
The journey was quite challenging.
Without an Immortal Artifact or a Magical Treasure, traveling empty-handed was risky, especially if encountering other Immortal Venerables intent on robbery.
Fortunately, he finally succeeded in reaching the ’Sacred Land’.
As soon as he arrived, he saw Nan Meng Immortal Venerable rushing over.
He was quite familiar with Nan Meng Immortal Venerable, as they were both core members of the Loose Cultivator Alliance.
The two had interacted many times, and even addressed each other as brothers in everyday conversations.
That night, he had also specifically criticized Brother Cheng’s actions during a meeting, expressing strong contempt.
Now, as the two unexpectedly met in this place, a cool breeze brought a slight awkwardness.
For a moment, they could only pretend not to know each other tacitly.
Outside the mountain gate, they saw five more unfamiliar Immortal Venerables who had come from afar.
Instantly, a sense of urgency attacked them.
It seemed many people realized how precious this opportunity was!
If they arrived late, they truly might miss out.
Hopefully, there’s still stock!
After stating their intention, the group was smoothly led into the Feixian Sect.
Soon after, they met two female disciples of True Immortal Level.
Are these the ones in charge of reception?
"You all wish to purchase Immortal Fate Orders?"
"Have you prepared the Immortal Crystals?"
All seven people nodded.
"Prepared!"
"Where is your patriarch?"
Su Ye and Su Meng couldn’t help but laugh.
"Of course, our patriarch doesn’t need to personally attend to such business."
Chenhuo Immortal Venerable also thought it made sense, given it’s 300,000.
"Then where is the person in charge of your Feixian Sect? Let’s get on with the transaction."
Without the Immortal Fate Orders in hand, he still felt uneasy.
Su Ye and Su Meng said in unison, "We are the ones in charge!"
Four in the group immediately stood up.
"What?"
"Are you kidding?"
"Is your Feixian Sect playing tricks on us?"
"Could this be a trap?"
Chenhuo Immortal Venerable also sensed that something was amiss.
The transaction of the Immortal Fate Order is of such significance?
Rather than being on high alert, shouldn’t at least a dozen Elders be mobilized to preside over it?
In this hall, there wasn’t even a single Profound Immortal, let alone Elder-level individuals.
This didn’t seem reliable at all.
However, as soon as they finished talking, seven Immortal Fate Orders appeared before the seven of them.
Each one emitted a mysterious and ethereal aura, clearly not mortal objects.
"This..."
Chenhuo Immortal Venerable was dumbfounded.
Such tremendously precious Tokens, costing him everything, were actually being handled by two True Immortals?
This was too casual, wasn’t it?
"Where are your Immortal Crystals?"
Su Ye and Su Meng had seen similar scenes several times in recent days and had grown accustomed to it.
The seven came to their senses and hurriedly handed over the rings containing three million Immortal Crystals.
The two female Immortals counted them, nodded, and handed over the Immortal Fate Orders.
Before coming here, Chenhuo Immortal Venerable was somewhat concerned.
This transaction, which he expected to be extraordinarily serious and grand, akin to traversing a dragon’s lair, was completed so easily.
Even upon receiving the Immortal Fate Orders, he still felt somewhat unreal.
Did it really work?
Staggering out of the hall, seven disciples of the Feixian Sect came up to meet them.
"Do you intend to leave or stay at our sect’s guest residence?"
"We’d rather stay at your guest residence!"
"Haha, thank you for the trouble!"
They were willing to spend these three million, mainly to enjoy Brother Cheng’s protection.
If they left, their Immortal Fate Orders would surely be snatched away without a trace.
"Alright, please follow us."
Led by the seven disciples, the seven quickly arrived at a group of palaces set in a serene environment.
Everyone got their private courtyard.
"Is this the accommodation arranged for us?"
Chenhuo Immortal Venerable slightly sensed the area and found that the Immortal Yuan Qi here was actually higher than his previous cultivation place.
The lead disciple nodded: "Yes, if there’s anything unsatisfactory in the future, feel free to raise it."
"Very satisfactory! Your sect is really attentive!"
Not only did they avoid being hunted for the Immortal Fate Orders, escaping a life of constant fear, but they also had such superior conditions.
How could he be dissatisfied?
It was simply a pleasant surprise, wasn’t it?
The lead disciple couldn’t help laughing as well.
"Our patriarch has said, you are all guests."
"For guests, we must make them feel completely at home!"
Chenhuo Immortal Venerable was impressed.
Although they set a high price, their attitude was impeccable, conducting business even more brightly than the Celestial Pavilion.
They didn’t disregard others even though they were invincible in the Middle Immortal Realm.
After settling in, Chenhuo Immortal Venerable found that there were already over a thousand Immortal Venerables around.
Each had purchased an Immortal Fate Order and stayed.
"So many people have the same idea."
"Fortunately, I came early, otherwise, I might’ve really missed out."
He couldn’t help but feel proud of his foresight.
"Master, 35 pieces were sold today."
"Here is the obtained Immortal Crystal."
Brother Cheng lazily accepted it without bothering to count.
"In the future, once it accumulates to ten billion, bring it up at once. No need to deliver it daily."
The two women helplessly asked, "Not many people came these days. Can we really sell them all?"
As Brother Cheng’s considerate maids, they wished for him to earn more naturally.
"This is just the beginning, many have far to travel, and some are engaged in internal struggles. We need to be patient."
"Internal struggles?"
The two women listened, half understanding.
This period still saw a wave of criticism and boycott from the outside world.
Everywhere, people accused Sect Leader Jiang of being too greedy.
"They definitely won’t sell!"
"Just wait and see, if they sell even 3000, I’ll admit defeat!"
"But I’ve heard there are already over a thousand Immortal Venerables who have entered and not come out..."
"Those are just fools with money to burn; such people are in the minority."
"Exactly, once these people are dealt with, it will become deserted outside the Feixian Sect."
"I don’t know about others, but I certainly won’t buy it; it’s not like not having it for ten thousand years will kill me!"
"Absolutely, I won’t buy it either, just sitting back to watch the joke!"
Some Celestial Domains even set up betting rings, wagering on how many Brother Cheng will finally sell.
This number is quite trackable.
After all, spies were not absent outside the Feixian Sect, and Immortal Venerables entering were in the sights of many forces.
Now, most people were betting that at most, it could sell thirty thousand pieces.
People might enjoy proclaiming one would sell, but their bets honestly reflected their internal judgments.
Days passed just like this.
The number of Immortal Venerables entering the Feixian Sect increased by the day, from dozens initially to hundreds daily.
This caused many who had placed bets to privately worry.
At this rate, surpassing thirty thousand would be a breeze!

chapters.title: Chapter 366: Are These People Crazy?
chapters.content:
Chapter 366: Chapter 366: Are These People Crazy?
This transaction of the Immortal Fate Order initiated by Brother Cheng has become the most watched event in the Middle Immortal Realm recently.
Although no one dares to intrude into the territory of the Feixian Sect, the number of people watching the commotion from afar is increasing.
Many people with nothing better to do count, calculating how many more have entered today.
In a certain sense, Brother Cheng has indirectly made a great contribution.
The last decade of each ascension cycle is a decade of bloodshed.
Countless battles and competitions revolve around the Immortal Fate Order among the major celestial domains, great sects, and genius prodigies.
It’s truly a brain-bashing spectacle.
The Immortal Venerables who die during this period, along with the innocent Golden Immortals, Profound Immortals, and True Immortals affected by the war, are several times more numerous than in the previous 99,910 years combined.
And during these ten years, some small sects may even be exterminated for obtaining an Immortal Fate Order.
However, this cycle is different; the entire Middle Immortal Realm is unprecedentedly peaceful and tranquil.
With the Immortal Fate Orders in Brother Cheng’s hands, there is nothing for everyone to fight over, and they all appear leisurely.
Apart from turning on the Communication Immortal Artifact daily to see how many more have entered yesterday, they’re practically idle.
Every day when people greet each other, the first sentence is often ’How many entered yesterday?’ or ’What’s the total now?’
A rich academic atmosphere wafts through the entire Middle Immortal Realm.
As time went on, the number of Immortal Venerables entering the Feixian Sect quickly surpassed ten thousand, and then in just half a month, it reached twenty thousand.
Seeing this number not decreasing but increasing, there is a tendency to soon break thirty thousand, which made many people both anxious and angry!
They mostly bet on the number not exceeding thirty thousand.
If it exceeds, wouldn’t they lose their pants?
"Damn, why are there so many fools?"
"Are those people brain-damaged? It’s so expensive, yet they rush to deliver Immortal Crystals?"
"I heard that Mu Li Immortal Venerable has also entered."
"Is it the peerless genius Mu Li Immortal Venerable who broke through to Immortal Venerable in just two million years?"
"Who else could it be?"
"No way, isn’t his master Chao Yuan Immortal King?"
"Yeah, with an Immortal King as a backer, does he still need to buy the Feixian Sect’s Immortal Fate Order?"
"Even an Immortal King can’t get an Immortal Fate Order right now since there’s simply no stock."
"Then why don’t they wait for the next hundred thousand years? With an Immortal King protecting him, and Mu Li’s own strong talent, undoubtedly with the bearing of an Immortal King, isn’t it easy to get an Immortal Fate Order in the next session?"
"I heard... Chao Yuan Immortal King also plans to go to the Upper Immortal Realm this time, so Mu Li Immortal Venerable can’t wait."
"What? Is that true?"
"Tsk, your news is outdated."
A Golden Immortal put away the Communication Immortal Artifact, took a deep breath, and tried to calm the violent fluctuations in his emotions.
Only then did he shout with a slightly trembling tone, "Just now, thirty-one Immortal Venerables from the Celestial Phenomenon Sect, along with twenty-five Golden Immortals and seven Profound Immortals, all entered the Feixian Sect and never came out."
"What!"
Some people present jumped up in shock.
"I know the Celestial Phenomenon Sect, isn’t it in the White Phoenix Celestial Domain?"
"That’s right!"
"Oh my God, the Celestial Phenomenon Sect in the White Phoenix Celestial Domain isn’t that strong; they should have just over thirty Immortal Venerables, right?"
"Yes, if I remember correctly, they have exactly thirty-one Immortal Venerables including the Sect Leader..."
"Does this mean their entire upper echelon has bought it?"
The person who first received the news nodded heavily, "Celestial Phenomenon Sect’s thirty-one Immortal Venerables and Elders, twenty-five True Disciples, and seven promising younger talents, a total of sixty-three people are all going to ascend together this time!"
"Damn, have they gone mad?"
"How many Immortal Crystals does that amount to?"
"Less than two hundred million; for a respectable sect, they can still gather it."
"But what I’m more concerned about is what will happen to the Celestial Phenomenon Sect in the future?"
"Exactly, with the sect’s high-level and top talents gone, what about the ones left behind?"
"What else can happen..."
"The top brass of the Celestial Phenomenon Sect clearly do not intend to retain their foundation. The priority is to ascend smoothly to the Upper Immortal Realm; those left behind will have to fend for themselves."
"It’s said that many Celestial Phenomenon Sect disciples have already started defecting to surrounding sects."
Everyone present was wide-eyed, amazed by this bold decision.
Only after a long while did someone burst out a curse.
"Damn, that’s so ruthless?"
"They’ve gone mad, all of them..."
"These traitors!"
Seeing the Feixian Sect earn more and more, these bystanders felt as if they’d been defeated and were quite uncomfortable.
"Justice will never lose!"
"They succumbed to the despicable price-gouging of the Feixian Sect; I’m ashamed to be associated with them!"
"That’s right, they don’t deserve to be called immortals!"
In the crowd, there was a wave of curses, an outpouring of righteous indignation as if they were spending their own Immortal Crystals.
However, some Immortal Venerables did not join in on the cursing; they gradually fell silent.
The Celestial Phenomenon Sect has been established for over ten million years, and in recent years, it has flourished.
The sect leader is obviously no fool.
Even if the Sect Leader was confused for a moment, the many elders and high-level members wouldn’t all follow him collectively in a daze.
So, after careful consideration and weighing the options, they still found it worthwhile to do so!
Thinking carefully, the Celestial Phenomenon Sect has no Immortal King to guard them.
Under normal circumstances, it’s difficult even to preserve an Immortal Fate Order. Not only do they have to fend off external covetousness, but they also have to guard against jealousy and internal rifts within the sect.
The final result might even be the sect’s decline.
This time, they spent less than two hundred million Immortal Crystals, and the 63 people from the sect ascended together effortlessly...
Will there be another chance like this in the future?
Was this a profit or a loss?
To put it bluntly, in the past, you could buy an Immortal Fate Order with a hundred thousand, but what you bought was merely a slim chance, hardly assured.
This time, however, the three hundred thousand bought a guaranteed ascension.
Understanding this, some people suddenly found those who were cursing quite amusing.
Subsequently, they quietly left this place as fast as they could.
Time ticked by day by day.
The number of people entering the Feixian Sect increased more and more, recently even breaking a thousand daily.
Su Ye and Su Meng had long been unable to keep up.
After consulting Elder Jiang, they recruited over a hundred disciples specifically to manage reception and sale matters.
Looking at the increasingly bustling cluster of palace courtyards, Sect Leader Yuan Zhen couldn’t suppress his smile.
They must earn so many Immortal Crystals!
"The Patriarch is truly wise!"
"To think that initially we even considered thirty thousand to be steep..."
"Haha, ultimately, our view isn’t as long-term as his, the elder!"
"Of course, otherwise, how could he become one of the lineage’s..."
At this, Yuan Sheng suddenly clammed up.
Yuan Shu and Yuan Mu, among others, felt their hearts stir.
"Lineage’s what?"
"You and the Sect Leader have been keeping this from us, isn’t it time to reveal the truth by now?"
"Indeed, to this day, I still can’t figure out which of our sect’s elders Elder Jiang is."
"Now there’s no presence in the Middle Immortal Realm that can unsettle him; can it still not be said?"
Yuan Sheng pursed his lips, hesitating for half a day, then shook his head resolutely.
"This truly can’t be disclosed."
Though the patriarch is invincible in the Middle Immortal Realm, if his identity was exposed, it might provoke a siege from a plethora of Immortal Emperors.
They are soon heading to the Upper Immortal Realm; it’s better not to invite unnecessary trouble.

chapters.title: Chapter 367: Can’t Disappoint Everyone’s Heart
chapters.content:
Chapter 367: Chapter 367: Can’t Disappoint Everyone’s Heart
As time passed, the Immortal Fate Orders of the Feixian Sect were selling faster and faster.
Many Immortal Venerables, who initially felt the price was too high and resolutely didn’t want to be ’fools’, gradually changed their mindset.
Seeing so many ’traitors’ choosing to purchase, their hearts grew increasingly anxious.
If you don’t buy it, others will.
At this rate, it won’t be long before they run out of stock.
By then, even if they want to buy one, they won’t be able to.
Will they be able to ascend in the next session?
Even if they are fortunate enough to ascend, others would have already spent a hundred thousand years in the Upper Immortal Realm.
Driven by this inner turmoil, more and more Immortal Venerables chose to ’surrender’.
Those who bet against it earlier had already become a joke.
In just three months, the Immortal Fate Orders sold by the Feixian Sect surpassed ten thousand.
Moreover, there was no sign of this trend weakening.
Sects like the Celestial Phenomenon Sect, using the ’desperate measures’ approach, weren’t the only ones; they participated in collective purchases.
For these sects, this was a once-in-a-lifetime opportunity to change their fate.
Many Demon Kings and Immortal Kings intending to ascend this time couldn’t let go of their juniors and visited in person.
By the fourth month, the number of Immortal Fate Orders sold had soared to 150,000!
Everyone knew that the 140,000 disciples of the Feixian Sect were definitely all going to ascend.
At most, Jiang Cheng would only be selling 160,000 pieces, keeping the rest for himself.
So, they really were about to run out of stock soon!
Thus, in these last few days, the numbers reached three to four thousand daily.
Watching the bustling ’sales hall’ with people coming and going, Elders Yuan He, Yuan Zhe, and others clicked their tongues.
They actually felt they had lost out.
"At this rate, even if the price increased, they would still be snapped up."
"In my opinion, even if it rose to 4 million, they still could be sold."
"Yes, if only we had set the price higher."
Sect Leader Yuan Zhen’s face darkened: "We mustn’t do that! It would ruin the reputation of our Feixian Sect!"
Elder Yuan Shu also nodded solemnly: "Indeed, our Ancestral Master’s kindness must not be tarnished by us."
On that day, the 165,424th Immortal Fate Order was sold.
The remaining 141,497 orders matched exactly the number of Feixian Sect’s current Inner and Outer Sect True Inheritors and all Elders.
The people of the Feixian Sect didn’t know about the Sect Leader’s promise to Xiao Kun, Jiyun, and others. They just thought this was the number left by the Elder to keep.
Thus, as they reached this number, Su Ye and Su Meng both stood up.
"Immortal Fate Orders are sold out!"
This sentence immediately made the thousand or so Immortal Venerables at the back, who hadn’t bought theirs yet, jump up.
"What?"
"Sold out?"
"What should we do then?"
"Yes, I traveled across 96 Celestial Domains here just for this, and now I’ve come in vain?"
"Didn’t you still have Immortal Fate Orders? I just saw you retrieve them!"
"Right, why aren’t you selling them?"
They were already eager; now, failing to buy them, you can imagine how shattered they were.
For a moment, the hall was noisy, chaotic.
Yuan Zhen, Yuan Sheng, and others had to come to mollify them.
"Everyone!"
"Everyone, please listen to me, our Feixian Sect has 141,497 disciples, you know that."
"From the beginning, we planned to ascend as an entire Sect."
"So we have to reserve a sufficient number for ourselves, that’s only human nature, right?"
"We understand your disappointment, and hope you can understand us..."
His words made sense, but the strong sense of disappointment among the crowd meant they couldn’t listen.
"Sect Leader Yuan Zhen, I sold my personal Immortal Artifacts and Magical Treasures for the Immortal Fate Order!"
"I’ve gone all in!"
"If I can’t buy it this time, how should I live after this?"
"Yes, our Jue Zhao Sect even cheaply transferred our sect’s residence to others, now all 103 of us here are counting on this chance to ascend..."
"We’ve cut off all escape routes, if we can’t buy it, we might as well be dead!"
Listening to the crowd’s complaints, Yuan Zhen, Yuan Sheng, and others felt a wave of helplessness.
It wasn’t us forcing you to sell your Immortal Artifacts and even your sect’s residence.
Seeing them about to cause a scene, and even starting a fight, Yuan Zhen and Yuan Sheng started to panic.
The scope of this business was too big, and they couldn’t maintain control.
"Quickly, invite the Elder!"
"Have him come and calm these people!"
Shortly after, Sect Leader Jiang actually arrived after hearing the news.
As soon as he appeared, the noisy Immortal Venerables instantly fell silent.
His reputation was such that in the Middle Immortal Realm, Jiang Sect Leader’s name alone could stop children from crying at night, even though he usually just stayed in his hall sleeping.
"What’s going on?"
Upon his question, the crowd immediately started talking again.
However, compared to earlier complaints, they were much more polite this time.
"Elder Jiang, could you be kind enough to sell one more to this old humble one..."
"Yes, if we can’t buy it this time, our Jue Zhao Sect has no place to stand."
"We know you are a benevolent person, surely you won’t let everyone leave empty-handed, right?"
So now he’s a good person?
Brother Cheng found it amusing; he wasn’t unaware of his reputation outside.
However, he originally intended to sell all of the Immortal Fate Orders.
The 140,000 plus from Feixian Sect, as well as the subordinates and juniors of Xiao Kun, Jiyun, and others, he could take up with the Xuanji Map.
So, there was no need to leave any orders; they all could be sold.
But seeing how desperate these people were, he entertained a different thought.
"You also know, my Feixian Sect has so many disciples..."
"Elder Jiang, please, sell one more!"
"I’ll kowtow to you, sir!"
Thud thud thud, Brother Cheng was at a loss for words; he hadn’t even finished speaking, no need for such grand gestures.
"Ah, I’m soft-hearted and can’t stand seeing you in such a plight."
"Fine, let’s sell a bit more then."
Everyone was overjoyed, and the hall erupted in cheers as if they had found salvation in a desperate situation.
"Thank you, Elder Jiang!"
"Elder Jiang truly is the greatest benefactor in the Middle Immortal Realm!"
"You’re so considerate of us..."
One wonders what those who daily resisted and criticized Brother Cheng for being too ruthless would think if they saw this scene.
They were grateful at that!
Yuan Zhen, Yuan Shu, and others were a bit anxious.
"Ancestral Master..."
"If we sell to them, what about our own people?"
"Yes, if we sell one more, one fewer of our disciples can ascend."
Brother Cheng frowned slightly, saying earnestly: "Don’t be so narrow-minded; we’re all fellow cultivators in the Middle Immortal Realm."
"Letting some go to help others will elevate your own spiritual realm, right?"
"Even if our people endure some hardship, we shouldn’t let everyone down."
This speech left the whole room stunned.
To reach the level of Immortal Venerable, everyone had a good head on their shoulders.
So when they heard this, they felt something was amiss.

chapters.title: Chapter 368: He Actually Dares to Raise the Price?
chapters.content:
Chapter 368: Chapter 368: He Actually Dares to Raise the Price?
Don’t be misled by the words ’Middle Immortal Realm’s greatest benefactor’ I just uttered. That was merely flattery for Sect Leader Jiang, hoping he wouldn’t refuse to sell.
There’s no cost to throwing a compliment.
Only they know what they’re truly thinking.
Now, hearing such talk, they’re quite incredulous.
Sacrificing their own interests just to let us ascend?
And claiming it’d elevate their spiritual realm?
Is there really such a noble person in the Middle Immortal Realm?
They find it hard to believe!
"Elder Jiang, this is..."
"This truly moves us deeply!"
"Such a realm shames us in comparison!"
Brother Cheng accepted the praises with a smile, and only when there was nothing more to praise did he wave his hand.
"But, as you heard earlier, selling one to you means one less Feixian Sect disciple goes up."
"That’s a major loss for our Feixian Sect."
"So, there will be additional loss fees for the subsequent Immortal Fate Orders."
Thud!
Sect Leader Yuan Zhen, Second Elder Yuan Shu, and others nearly fell over.
Earlier, they mentioned not raising the price to retain his elderly reputation.
But now Brother Cheng himself raised the price openly, where could they put their old faces?
The other Immortal Venerables present were stunned...
Oh, so all that build-up earlier was just to raise the price?
Why didn’t you say so earlier, we ended up saying so much nice stuff.
"Why are you all silent? Can’t understand? If you don’t, you can opt not to buy."
Everyone quickly agreed: "We understand, we understand!"
"Of course we understand, with such losses to your sect, compensating them is justified."
At this critical juncture, not buying was not an option for them.
Someone impatiently asked, "So, Elder Jiang, how much do you plan to sell it for?"
"Um..."
Brother Cheng touched his chin in thought: "Let’s increase it by 1 million Immortal Crystals, can’t be too harsh."
