"Henceforth, the Immortal Fate Orders will be sold for 4 million each."
Upon hearing this price, the expressions of those present varied, their moods mixed.
Some breathed a sigh of relief, as they could afford 4 million.
Others could only gather 3 million, so they felt a bit dejected.
"Elder Jiang, can’t you make it a bit cheaper!"
"Yes, we don’t have enough..."
"If you don’t have enough, there’s nothing I can do. This old ancestor must justify the price reasonably for my sect’s disciples, right?"
On this issue, Brother Cheng’s stance was firm, with no room for compromise.
If you think it’s expensive, you don’t have to buy!
He felt no sympathy for these people.
After all, the Immortal Fate Orders were being sold for months, if you hesitated initially and didn’t come sooner, that’s on you.
In the end, when over 30,000 are completely sold, someone will still regret coming too late.
And then, who could they blame?
Blame him?
At the price of 4 million, more than 700 of over 1,000 people made immediate transactions.
Miss this chance, and there won’t be another shop like it.
The remaining folks without sufficient Immortal Crystals could only leave for now.
As soon as they came out, the Immortals outside, eager to watch the excitement, buzzed with interest.
For months, those Immortal Venerables entering Feixian Sect hadn’t come out.
Choosing to remain in the ’safe zone’ for Brother Cheng’s protection.
This was the first batch that went in and came out again.
"What happened?"
"I got it, they’re sold out!"
"Yes, their Immortal Fate Orders are all gone."
"This drama has finally concluded!"
Just as everyone engaged in heated discussions, the group of Elders from Feixian Sect flew out.
Facing the crowd, Yuan Zhen Immortal Venerable infused his voice with Immortal Power, echoing far and wide.
"The sect’s old ancestor commands!"
"Initially, all Immortal Fate Orders were sold, the rest reserved for Feixian Sect disciples."
"However, considering many Immortal Venerables yearn for ascension, the sect’s old ancestor, out of goodwill, has decided to sacrifice some sect interests and offer an additional 50,000 Immortal Fate Orders!"
"Due to the additional 50,000 Immortal Fate Orders causing 50,000 of our disciples to be unable to ascend, the losses are immense, thus prices are adjusted to 4 million top-grade Immortal Crystals!"
With that said, the group returned to Feixian Sect.
The Immortals observing outside became uproarious.
"What, dare to raise the price again?"
"Damn, 3 million was already ridiculously high, who knew it could be even greedier?"
"Has he gone mad?"
"To earn Immortal Crystals, even selling his sect disciples’ chance to ascend..."
"Such a sect ancestor is too cold-hearted."
"4 million, only a fool would buy, right?"
"It seems some already have, many who went in didn’t come out."
"Those folks just couldn’t back down, there won’t be any more later, just wait and see!"
The news of the price increase spread rapidly.
Given that Feixian Sect had become the ’world center’ of the Middle Immortal Realm, everyone was idle and closely watched for movement here.
Upon hearing the price hike, naturally, there was an uproar again.
Those from Feixian Sect’s other branch who purchased the Immortal Fate Orders in advance, like Chenhuo Immortal Venerable, felt absolutely delighted.
They couldn’t help but admire their decisiveness, arriving early and saving 1 million.
But others outside didn’t share the sentiment.
Brother Cheng was unsurprisingly cursed by countless people, attaining the title of ’Middle Immortal Realm’s number one black-hearted person’.
Even being dubbed with the moniker ’Black Heart Immortal King’.
"I dare to bet, certainly no one will buy this time!"
"Indeed, raising the price on a whim, he’s treating everyone like fools."
"These 50,000 Immortal Fate Orders, selling even 10,000 would mean I lose the bet!"
Merely five days later, those predicting unsold orders found themselves embarrassed, swiftly proven wrong.
Staring at Immortal Venerables like a school of carp crossing the river, those outside anticipating a joke were dumbfounded.
"How could this be?"
"Why, despite raising the price by 1 million Immortal Crystals, are more people buying?"
"This... I don’t understand either."
"These people are insane, absolutely insane."
No choice, when the news of the price increase broke, many cursed.
Some originally intending to buy changed their minds.
Yet another group was compelled to act more urgently due to this.
These are already being squeezed out from their share of 50,000, delay any longer and it’ll truly be too late.
Higher price meant greater value, similar to the notion of scalped tickets, the higher the price, the more people scramble to buy. If the price stayed unchanged, not as many would rush.
These days, almost ten thousand people swarm in daily, exceeding everyone’s expectations.
Five days later, the news came from Feixian Sect, the new batch of 50,000 Immortal Fate Orders sold out.
No stock left, everyone disperse.
At the entrance stood many Immortal Venerables unable to buy, filled with sorrow and despair!
"Sell a bit more!"
"Yes, sell some more?"
"We came through great effort, traveled as swiftly as possible, might there be an exception, even selling one more would work!"
Sect Leader Yuan Zhen Immortal Venerable could only offer an apologetic bow.
"No more, everyone, truly no more!"
"Selling additional 50,000 has already caused 50,000 Feixian Sect disciples unable to ascend."
"Hope you understand, return home, return home..."

chapters.title: Chapter 369 Soft-hearted Sect Leader Jiang
chapters.content:
Chapter 369: Chapter 369 Soft-hearted Sect Leader Jiang
Understanding is impossible.
For those who didn’t buy it, it’s like the sky is falling.
This is far more serious than missing out on tickets from scalpers in another world, since the Upper Immortal Realm is about their lifelong fortunes.
"Can we get Elder Jiang to say a few words?"
"Yes, let’s ask what his opinion is!"
"Maybe he’d be willing to sell more?"
After being begged multiple times, Sect Leader Jiang actually came out.
Well, he was going to come out anyway.
The Immortal Fate Orders aren’t sold out yet, he’s still busy.
"Everyone, I understand your desire to purchase the Immortal Fate Orders very well."
Facing the eager gazes of tens of thousands of Immortal Venerables, he put on another earnest performance.
"But you also know, to free up those 50,000 Immortal Fate Orders, my sect’s Outer Sect Disciples have already lost the chance to enter the Upper Immortal Realm using them!"
Anyway, he was talking about using the Immortal Fate Order, not riding the Xuanji Map.
Brother Cheng indicated he wasn’t lying.
"If I sell more, the share for my Inner Sect Disciples would be completely gone."
"How could I bear this?"
"If I do this, I’ll become the sect’s sinner!"
"Even if I want to sell to you, I can’t do it, alas..."
Everyone listened; it seemed like his words weren’t final.
Elder Jiang’s power is terrifyingly strong, but maybe he has a soft heart?
Perhaps with some nudging, he’ll be convinced?
"Elder Jiang, sell a bit more..."
"Yes, please show mercy, it’s not easy for us to come here."
"Inner Sect Disciples are still young; they have endless opportunities!"
"Right, we are counting on this one time..."
"Sell once more!"
Brother Cheng shook his head repeatedly: "No, no, I can’t sell, really can’t sell anymore."
"Let’s forget about the Outer Sect Disciples’ share, but the Inner Sect Disciples’ share cannot be sold!"
"Sell it, sell it!"
"Elder Jiang surely won’t let us leave disappointed!"
Brother Cheng shook his head resolutely: "You also know, it’s the Inner Sect Disciples; they’re different!"
He emphasized the word "different" heavily.
"At worst, we can offer more to compensate your Inner Sect Disciples!"
"How about 4.5 million?"
Finally, Emma—someone with a clue—understood. I have emphasized several times this is the share for the Inner Sect Disciples, different from the previous one.
But, 4.5 million is not my asking price.
"It’s not about the price, really can’t sell..."
"5 million! Elder Jiang, this is my entire fortune!"
Fine, 5 million is acceptable.
"Alas..."
Brother Cheng sighed deeply, his eyes showing a struggle as if experiencing an intense inner conflict.
He then reluctantly nodded.
"Alright, since you are so eager, it would be unreasonable for me not to help."
"Then 5 million it is!"
Wow!
The crowd immediately burst into applause and cheers.
"Elder Jiang is righteous!"
"Elder Jiang is so generous!"
Pfft!
Yuan Zhen and Yuan Sheng and the other elders almost coughed up blood on the spot.
They hadn’t followed the Elder on missions before, only feeling his brilliance from afar.
Now they’ve realized.
This Elder seems to never wake up early unless there’s gain.
Soon, news of yet another price increase spread out.
Feixian Sect decided to endure the pain and sell an additional 50,000 Immortal Fate Orders at a heart-stopping price of 5 million Immortal Crystals.
This caused a frenzy throughout the Middle Immortal Realm.
"Another price hike?"
"Lawless, this is utterly lawless!"
"Someone must put a stop to such despicable behavior!"
"How do you stop it, who dares to stop it?"
At this point, no one dared to confidently claim they wouldn’t sell out this time.
After being slapped in the face multiple times, everyone had to hold their noses and admit a reluctant truth.
It’s not Jiang Cheng begging buyers to come, but buyers begging him to sell.
There are too many Immortal Venerables in the Middle Immortal Realm, like sands of the Ganges.
Moreover, some Golden Immortals and Profound Immortals participated in the buying.
With so many people, 300,000 from the beginning was far from enough, demand exceeded supply.
The initiative was always in his hands.
And this price increase also made some smart people sense the trend.
It was intentional by Elder Jiang, wasn’t it?
He probably planned to sell more, right?
This leaving for Feixian Sect Disciples, he probably never intended to bring too many for Ascension.
After this batch is sold, there’s likely to be another batch.
But by then, the price should be 6 million.
So those who want to buy must decide quickly, otherwise, missing this batch means the next will cost 1 million more Immortal Crystals.
With this realization, the increased-price Immortal Fate Orders sold even faster than before!
Driven by the mindset of saving a million, many scrambled toward Feixian Sect’s direction, racing day and night nonstop.
In just three days, this batch of 50,000 Immortal Fate Orders sold out again.
And then another group wailed, Brother Cheng appeared again to comfort everyone.
Ah...well...really can’t sell this time.
If I sell more, not a single Inner Sect Disciple in my sect can ascend, even some Outer Sect Elders will miss out.
I can’t do this...
Everyone knew his routine by now.
They directly said, we are willing to pay 6 million.
Thus Elder Jiang ’softened his heart’, painfully selling off another 30,000 more, ’returning’ the favor to everyone’s high regard.
This price increase outside wasn’t all that shocking anymore.
People got used to it, and had already expected it.
And this batch priced at 6 million Immortal Crystals for 30,000 Immortal Fate Orders sold out by the second day.
At this time, there were still people rushing to Feixian Sect.
Once again, everyone called out to Elder Jiang, hoping he’d sell more to them.
To be honest, Yuan Zhen, Yuan Sheng, and others now felt a bit anxious.
Now Feixian Sect itself has only over 10,000 left.
If they keep selling, many elders won’t have any.
However, unfortunately, the one in charge of Feixian Sect is Brother Cheng.
"Sigh, everyone, we ourselves only have 10,000 left, Feixian Sect has 140,000 disciples, to sell more then..."
Brother Cheng barely started speaking when many outside very helpfully completed his words.
"We offer 7 million!"
"Right, we offer 7 million!"
"Elder Jiang, your Feixian Sect having fewer people ascend doesn’t really matter."
"Yes, after all, nobody can move their entire sect to the Upper Immortal Realm, we’re helping you reduce worry!"
So, Brother Cheng made another ’difficult’ decision, selling over 9,000 more at a price of 7 million.
At this point, Feixian Sect was left with just 1,000 Immortal Fate Orders.
Yet people were still coming in waves from outside.
Everyone understood, Feixian Sect had to keep some for itself, at least the Inner Sect Elders and Core Elders, and True Disciples should ascend together, right?
Calculating, 1,000 was actually not enough.
But understanding aside, their need to ascend to the Upper Immortal Realm was urgent.
"Elder Jiang, I’ll offer 8 million!"
"Yes, we’ll offer 8 million, can you sell a bit more?"
This time, Brother Cheng didn’t nod.
Because... 8 million no longer satisfied his appetite.

chapters.title: Chapter 370: Selling Even the Underpants
chapters.content:
Chapter 370: Chapter 370: Selling Even the Underpants
At the beginning, Brother Cheng’s expectation was to sell all 306,921 Immortal Fate Orders at a price of 3 million each.
Making a profit of over 900 billion Immortal Crystals was already very satisfying to him.
But as he continued to sell, he found that he had underestimated the purchasing enthusiasm of these people in the Middle Immortal Realm.
So he could only ’respond to everyone’s call’ and reluctantly raise the price in waves.
By now, these last 1,000 pieces, everyone knew it was the final batch.
Of course, he wanted to sell them for a sky-high price.
"Ladies and gentlemen, there are very few Immortal Fate Orders left, so I can’t meet everyone’s needs."
"Even if I generously sell the last Immortal Fate Orders to you, what about those who are still on their way?"
He gazed into the distance, eyes filled with sorrow.
"Many people couldn’t make it because the journey was too long and missed this sale."
"If I were to sell out now, wouldn’t that be disappointing for them?"
"A fair bowl of water; I’ve always advocated fairness and would not allow myself to do otherwise!"
The crowd exchanged glances, what did this mean?
"Then Elder Jiang, how do you plan to sell them?"
Brother Cheng withdrew his gaze and said solemnly, "I plan to hold an auction eight years from now, so everyone can fairly compete for this last batch of Immortal Fate Orders."
"Of course, I originally didn’t want to raise the price again, so the low price will be set at 7 million Immortal Crystals."
Damn!
At this moment, everyone present had a strong urge to curse.
It’s only because Brother Cheng’s power is too great that no one dared to say it to his face.
These people weren’t foolish; once it reached the auction rhythm, the price would really spin out of control.
What do you mean by not raising the price? By that time, let alone 7 or 8 million, I’m afraid even 10 million might not be enough.
Moreover, he deliberately set the time to eight years later.
This was clearly to give you time to scrape together the Immortal Crystals, illustrating his blatant profiteering intent.
The land in the Middle Immortal Realm was going to be stripped bare by him.
Under Elder Jiang’s ’supreme prestige’, everyone eventually had to return home.
And the news of the auction eight years later spread quickly.
Let alone the ordinary immortals in the Middle Immortal Realm, even up and down the Celestial Pavilion were left dumbfounded.
Du Chen and Ye Yang Immortal Kings claimed that they had seen everything now.
They weren’t unfamiliar with auctions; they were even veterans.
But taking out Immortal Fate Orders to auction, such an operation, they really hadn’t thought of.
"Is he not planning to lead Feixian Sect to ascend?"
"Yeah, if he keeps selling, even the people of Feixian Sect won’t be able to go up."
"What’s he planning to do?"
Ye Yang Immortal King suddenly thought of something and slapped his thigh in surprise.
"This guy doesn’t plan to continue staying in the Middle Immortal Realm, waiting for the next batch, does he?"
In the hall, the Immortal Kings were stunned and almost fainted.
The man had only been around for eighty or a hundred years, yet he had already broken all sorts of rules in the Middle Immortal Realm.
If he stayed any longer, it would really drive people mad.
"No way, right?"
"As it goes on like this, if he keeps staying in the Middle Immortal Realm, can’t he sell a batch each time there are Immortal Fate Orders?"
"Damn, he’s the living overlord of the Middle Immortal Realm!"
"The next batch can’t be sold to him in such large quantities."
"Yes, must not be sold anymore."
Listening to everyone’s complaints, Du Chen Immortal King nonchalantly shook his head.
"You all are overthinking, it won’t go so far as that."
"After this ascension cycle, the Immortal Emperors will be able to descend to the lower realm."
"Although they won’t stay for long, they will definitely not allow this person to continue staying."
"So he will definitely go up."
Everyone thought it made sense.
Similar discussions were also taking place among those Ancient Immortal Sects and Demon Sect.
"What exactly does this person want to do?"
"Staying in the Middle Immortal Realm is impossible; when the Immortal Emperors descend, he will die without a trace left!"
"I thought he would take everyone from Feixian Sect up; now it seems he has no such intention."
"Yeah, it seems like he’s planning to earn a bunch and then escape alone into the Upper Immortal Realm?"
During this time, watching Brother Cheng earn so many Immortal Crystals made them both envious and jealous.
They wanted to buy a bit too, but the prestige of the Ancient Sect didn’t allow it.
So they could only curse on the side, and then stay restless.
"He really is ruthless enough!"
"He’s made so many enemies, the disciples left behind in Feixian Sect will suffer because of him."
"Hahaha, I’m very much looking forward to it..."
Meanwhile, on the side of Feixian Sect, the Sect Leader and the Elders were also extremely confused.
"Elder, do you really intend to sell all the Immortal Fate Orders?"
"Otherwise? Such a good opportunity to earn Immortal Crystals, you’d regret missing it for a lifetime, understand?"
The Elders thought to themselves, of course, we know the earnings are substantial.
But shouldn’t it be enough by now?
Who sells things to the point of leaving not even a single pair of their own shorts?
"Then... what about us?"
"If they’re sold out, we all can’t go up."
"Rest assured, you’ll all be able to ascend."
"Ah?"
"Do you still not trust my power?"
Brother Cheng couldn’t preemptively stash them all in the Xuanji Map; he had to continue acting for a few more years.
So everyone could only hold their curiosity and speculate wildly.
The ancestor was indeed miraculous; maybe he could create another miracle?
The same doubts persisted among Xiao Kun, Jiyun, and others.
Upon hearing that Brother Cheng was nearly out of Immortal Fate Orders, they were getting a bit anxious too.
Could Sect Leader Jiang be busy and have forgotten the promised spots?
In response to them, Brother Cheng gave the same assurance that they would all be able to ascend.
Their faith in Brother Cheng was akin to blind worship, and upon hearing this, they immediately felt reassured.
In the following days, it became much quieter outside Feixian Sect.
The Immortal Venerables inside the compound were busy with cultivation, while the sect disciples were immersed in feelings of disappointment and loss.
Originally believing they could collectively ascend, but now...
Fortunately, Brother Cheng’s reputation was high enough to maintain control over everyone.
Time passed year by year, and the auction day eight years later also gradually approached.
Outside Feixian Sect, the place was packed with people, gathered from the major celestial domains of the Middle Immortal Realm.
Besides those preparing to purchase Immortal Fate Orders, there were even more people there to join the fun and witness this grand event.
Just as Brother Cheng had hoped, with eight years of preparation, many people’s rings were bulging, with a considerable amount of Immortal Crystals ready.
Such a big occasion, he certainly wouldn’t miss it and made a personal appearance.
Then, the much-anticipated auction began just like that.
Sect Leader Yuan Zhen and Great Elder Yuan Sheng presided over the event, auctioning each piece one by one.
"One Immortal Fate Order, starting price of 7 million Immortal Crystals! Each bid increment must not be less than 100,000!"
The moment the words fell, someone immediately raised a sign.
"7.1 million!"
"7.2 million!"
"7.5 million!"
"8 million!"
"8.1 million!"
...
"10 million!"
"10.5 million!"
...
"20 million!"
In the blink of an eye, the price for the first Immortal Fate Order soared to 20 million.
At this point, many decided to back out.
Too high; might as well wait for the next one.
After all, weren’t there over a thousand pieces?
Ultimately, the first Immortal Fate Order was sold for 21.3 million.
"The second Immortal Fate Order..."
Without Yuan Zhen needing to say much about the starting price, someone from below directly shouted, "8 million!"
"10 million!"
Once again, the price soared quickly.

chapters.title: Chapter 371 The Day of Ascension
chapters.content:
Chapter 371: Chapter 371 The Day of Ascension
At first, seeing the prices soar, Brother Cheng was quite enthusiastic.
But after watching a dozen or so go by, he began to feel a bit weary.
He even found the constant bidding noise annoying, so he casually set up a barrier and began to meditate with his eyes closed.
The others present were not as at ease as he was.
Everyone was tense, anxious, and on edge.
As time passed, the 100th Immortal Fate Order was sold.
The 200th piece was sold...
Each Immortal Fate Order had a different final price, but one thing was consistent: they were all ridiculously high.
Almost all were around 20 million.
One even shot up to 25.1 million.
Seeing the prices so high for each piece, many who planned to just observe could no longer remain detached.
The situation was not as they had expected.
Prices showed no sign of dropping!
The Middle Immortal Realm was vast, with no less than eighty to a hundred thousand Immortal Venerables holding over 7 million Immortal Crystals participating in this auction.
And less than 1,000 Immortal Fate Orders were left.
Competition wasn’t dwindling; it was intensifying.
When only a few dozen were left, competition would become fiercely inflamed, resulting in astronomical prices.
You wait and see, but others are not waiting.
If you don’t compete now, there won’t be a chance later.
As such, the auction prices for the Immortal Fate Orders never dropped.
By the 800th piece, prices indeed had broken through 30 million.
The last dozens soared to a staggering 40 million.
The final piece, in particular, brought about a frenzy of bidding.
Ultimately, it sold for a staggering price of 73 million.
Yuan Zhen, Yuan Sheng, and others gazed at the mountain of Immortal Crystals, panting heavily.
How many times the profit was this?
The ancestor sure knows how to play!
The previous idea of not raising prices had long been discarded.
Worried about damaging reputation and name...
Did they ever really think that way?
By now, those who had bought Immortal Fate Orders had settled in the side hall courtyard.
All 300,000 plus Immortal Fate Orders now had owners.
The grand event had finally concluded.
But many more present, having not purchased one, were filled with tumultuous emotions, reluctant to leave.
"Alright, it’s all sold out, everyone disperse!"
Brother Cheng awoke from his feigned sleep and stepped forward again.
It’s lucky he was there, able to maintain order.
If it were any other Sect, even with a seated Immortal King, they might not have been able to calm so many extremely disappointed Immortal Venerables wanting to vent.
If someone with ill intentions stirred things up, a massive conflict might have erupted.
With just a light statement, those wanting to vent had no choice but to leave.
The grand event concluded, and everything returned to calm.
Outside, while some were shocked by the auction’s astronomical prices for the Immortal Fate Orders, others calculated and were surprised to find Feixian Sect seemingly had no Immortal Fate Orders left.
"Isn’t Feixian Sect having anyone ascend?"
"They sold every single one?"
"Are they really planning to wait for the next session?"
"There’s no next session; the Immortal Emperor will certainly intervene after this one."
"I wonder how they’ll keep the Immortal Crystals they earned."
Amidst various envious rumors, Brother Cheng remained unaffected.
He was already joyfully tallying his gains.
Originally expected at over 900 billion Top-grade Immortal Crystals, the final count increased by over 300 billion.
After converting to Merit, it totaled over 1.2 billion.
He couldn’t help but admire his own shrewdness.
"Haha, so what if becoming an Immortal King is hard?"
"Our merit-earning speed is unstoppable by anyone!"
After converting all this merit into pills, his long stagnant realm finally leapt from a Sixth-grade Immortal King to an Eighth-Grade Immortal King.
After a moment of joy, he rubbed his chin in thought.
"With my current realm, I should be presentable when visiting Xiaohan and Xiaoning among the disciples, right?"
"The lofty image of their Brother must not crumble."
One hundred million years have passed since they last saw each other, who knows what realm those disciples have reached.
As Sect Leader, it’s necessary to maintain an Immortal King realm as a facade, isn’t it?
It’s the main reason he tirelessly earned merit for upgrading.
Otherwise, with the Resurrection Skill, did he need to increase his power so much?
In the following period, everyone was preparing intensively for Ascension.
Besides Brother Cheng’s 300,000, there were still around 30,000 Immortal Fate Orders outside.
These 30,000 were mostly held by top-tier Ancient Immortal and Demon Sects who, unlike him, did not sell them.
These sects are currently conducting internal selections.
Meanwhile, in the Upper Immortal Realm, many influential figures are heading to the Zixiao Platform and Nether Pool to greet the new batch of Ascenders.
Immortal Emperors and Demon Emperors had long set up traps, just waiting for Feixian Sect to fall into them.
As for Feixian Sect, it was peaceful and harmonious.
Finally, the day of Ascension arrived!
On this day, the skies over all Celestial Domains in the Middle Immortal Realm turned golden, dazzlingly bright.
The Immortal Venerables in the side hall courtyard stepped out, their Immortal Fate Orders gradually lighting up.
"Hahaha, I never thought I’d see the day I’d truly ascend!"
"Elder Jiang truly kept his word!"
"Indeed, though the price was steep, nine years of peace without being robbed was worth it."
"Upper Immortal Realm, here I come!"
"Friends, may we meet again as Immortal Kings someday!"
"When we reunite, may everyone be a leader in the Upper Immortal Realm..."
With excitement and joy, over 300,000 Immortals with Immortal Fate Orders ascended into the sky.
Soon, they were engulfed in the Reception Golden Light, vanishing without a trace.
The scene was truly spectacular.
Not far away, disciples of the Feixian Sect looked up.
Only when the sky was empty and the golden light dispersed did they sigh.
"Oh, they really ascended."
"So envious!"
"If only we could go up too!"
"Our Immortal Fate Orders were bought by them..."
"Say no more, Elders surely have plans."
When Brother Cheng emerged, Yuan Zhen, Yuan Sheng, Xiao Kun, Wu Jue, and their tens of thousands of disciples and followers were already waiting outside.
"They’ve all ascended, so it’s finally our turn."
He had delayed until now because he had promised to protect those people for nine years from being robbed.
Otherwise, he could have left the day they sold out.
"What? How do we ascend?"
The crowd was baffled.
"Forget the Immortal Fate Orders, even the Reception Golden Light is gone!"
"Immortal Kings ascended to the Upper Immortal Realm don’t need any Reception Golden Light, did you forget?"
"But we aren’t Immortal Kings..."
"I forgot to tell you, one of the Immortal Techniques I cultivate is Xuanji Dojo, which can carry others in."
What?
So the ancestor still had this trump card?
Why didn’t he say so earlier, making everyone’s heart pound so crazily?
The previously disappointed and dejected Feixian Sect members instantly shed their despondency and became elated.
"Haha, I knew the ancestor had a backup plan."
"Of course, the Master Ancestor wasn’t going to leave us hanging, he had us in mind all along."
"So it was just an act for outsiders, brilliant!"
"You all weren’t saying that before, there were quite a few complaints..."
"Nonsense, do you have proof?"

chapters.title: Chapter 372: The Embarrassed Immortal Emperors
chapters.content:
Chapter 372: Chapter 372: The Embarrassed Immortal Emperors
Amidst a cheer, Brother Cheng released the Xuanji Map.
Before the crowd could react, everyone below the Immortal King level present was swept into it.
Xiao Kun and Jiyun and others almost popped their eyes—could it really be played like this?
"Sect Leader Jiang, where did you send them?"
Brother Cheng replied as if it were only natural, "Into my Daoist Field! As long as I ascend, they can ascend together."
Xiao Kun and others felt like cursing their luck.
If they had known it was this easy, they would have brought over their entire Ghost Alliance and Ancient Emperor Sect right away.
No wonder the venerable one said from the start that having tens of thousands of people was nothing at all.
It’s truly amusing to see how they speculated every step, thinking this process would be immensely difficult.
Turns out Sect Leader Jiang got it done with just one Divine Technique of ’Daoist Field’?
"Alright, are you guys going into the Daoist Field or ascending by yourselves?"
Without the guidance of the Immortal Fate Order, directly ascending as an Immortal King means the final destination is random.
Even if 12 people ascend together, they won’t end up in the same place.
"Of course, we’ll continue to follow Sect Leader Jiang!"
"That’s right, sticking by your side to receive your guidance!"
Brother Cheng thought to himself, I have no guidance to give.
If you want to latch on, just say so directly.
Collecting all 12 people into the Xuanji Map, Brother Cheng finally left the Middle Immortal Realm.
For an Immortal King, going to the Upper Immortal Realm is simple.
Just summon the Immortal Country, constantly sense the location of the Upper Immortal Realm, and then let go of constraints to accept its pull.
After a swift teleportation, he disappeared from his original place.
Reappearing, he was already in the Upper Immortal Realm.
At this moment, the two Ascension Points in the Upper Immortal Realm were already crowded with people.
Immortal Cultivators entered the Zixiao Platform, Demon Cultivators entered the Nether Pool, tens of thousands of ascenders on both sides feeling excited and thrilled.
But this feeling didn’t last long.
Soon, they discovered their current predicament wasn’t particularly pleasant.
On the Zixiao Platform, icy lights gleamed, the Tier Nine Immortal Array was ready to burst, locking everyone in place.
Facing such a Great Array, the Immortal Venerables had no way to resist.
Even their Immortal Souls kept transmitting fear from deep within.
Deep within the Nether Pool, an endless Sea of Blood surged and covered the sky.
Tens of thousands of Demon Venerables lost connection with those around them.
Though they could see, they couldn’t hear or touch.
"How did it come to this?"
"Where is this?"
"Could ascending to the Upper Immortal Realm be a conspiracy? A trap?"
"No! I refuse to believe it!"
"Cultivating for thirty-five million years, to end up like this, I am unwilling..."
"We didn’t do anything, why?"
There was no answer.
Above the two Ascension Points, those Immortal Emperors and Demon Emperors from the Upper Immortal Realm coldly watched everything.
Looking at this crowd as if looking at the dead.
"The fish is in the net."
"Most of these people should be from the Feixian Sect, right?"
"Wonder if that Jiang fellow is among them."
"There really are many Immortal Venerables from the Feixian Sect, there’s surely something wrong."
"Exterminate them all then..."
"Indeed, lest dreams linger too long!"
When an Immortal Emperor strikes, the momentum is immense.
Below, those ascenders couldn’t even utter a sound, awaiting only death.
But at that moment, some Immortal Kings and Demon Kings at both Ascension Points screamed and flew out.
"Hold up!"
"Forefather! Wait a moment!"
"That person seems to be a junior of our sect!"
"Isn’t that my disciple’s grandchild in the Middle Immortal Realm?"
Indeed, among these 300,000 ascenders, many have sect seniors in the Upper Immortal Realm.
After ascending, they originally planned to find their organizations and latch on.
Who would have thought they’d fall into a desperate situation without even a chance to speak.
Fortunately, at this critical moment, someone among the sect’s leaders recognized them.
Otherwise, they really would have been killed for nothing.
"There’s one of our own?"
Above, those Immortal Emperors and Demon Emperors could only pause.
Opened a gap in the Great Array to let these Immortal Kings and Demon Kings down to fetch them.
Once they descended, they immediately learned about the events in the final stretch of the Middle Immortal Realm.
Jiang Cheng sold all the Immortal Fate Orders.
Now, none of these ascenders are from the Feixian Sect.
Upon learning this series of truths, those Immortal Emperors in the sky, exuding Divine Dao brilliance, felt unexpectedly awkward.
Apparently, they prepared for nine years, arranged Great Arrays, rallied from all sides, and personally intervened with grand pomp and circumstance, only to ultimately hit a blank and almost create a large farce, nearly wiping out unrelated people?
No, these are no longer unrelated people.
Not to mention those Immortal Venerables who already have sects in the Upper Immortal Realm, even those without backing should have been their key recruits.
The Upper Immortal Realm hasn’t been peaceful lately, with endless wars—they desperately need elite reinforcements.
Dispensing those Immortal Fate Orders, a cycle every ten thousand years, wasn’t it all to recruit talents from the Middle Immortal Realm?
Whenever new ones ascended, the major factions of the Upper Immortal Realm would use means to win them over.
This time, however...
Just look at those Immortal Venerables below, each still shaken, their eyes devoid of excitement and joy, showing only wariness and indifference.
Clearly, they were put off on their first day due to the scene just now.
Including the Nine-Star Demon Hall and Everlasting Hall, all top factions’ leaders now had to come forth with kind words to soothe them.
Meanwhile, the half-hidden Immortal Emperors and Demon Emperors above exchanged their thoughts.
"He sold all the Immortal Fate Orders?"
"Is this person still in the Middle Immortal Realm?"
"Not necessarily, he might have ascended, but surely his Feixian Sect remains below!"
"Then obliterate the Feixian Sect; this sect is too bizarre and cannot remain."
"Yes, obliterate them!"
Just after the ascension day, the laws between realms loosened, allowing Immortal Emperors to briefly descend.
From both Ascension Points, scores of Immortal Emperors and Demon Emperors eagerly descended.
The might of an Immortal Emperor, almost in a thought, had them instantly appear over the Feixian Sect.
Sweeping with their Divine Thoughts, everyone was once again caught off guard.
Below was long since empty, not a trace of anyone left behind.
Moreover, most sect facilities had been moved away too.
Brother Cheng was indeed a thrifty person.
If he weren’t returning, not an Immortal Crystal should be left behind.
Thus, the scene greeting these Immortal Emperors and Demon Emperors was one of desolate emptiness.
"Where are the people?"
"Why is it all vacant?"
"Where did they go?"
"They must be hiding, search!"
"Indeed, they can’t escape!"
A group of Immortal Emperors and Demon Emperors began scouring the Middle Immortal Realm.
Among them, the three Immortal Emperors from Infinite Cave Heaven were especially eager and anxious.
Having been pursuing Chen Zhou Quasi-Emperor with no result, they were now charged with retaliation against the Feixian Sect.
Their sweep caused the remaining Immortal Kings in the Middle Immortal Realm to shiver in their boots.
It seemed like a still lake had suddenly seen the emergence of dozens of giant sharks.
For ancient demon sects like Nine-Star Demon Hall, this was a cause for celebration.
In their view, the Feixian Sect’s retribution had arrived.
"Haha, the ancestors have come down, let’s see how Feixian Sect survives now."

chapters.title: Chapter 373 - 6 Major Worlds
chapters.content:
Chapter 373: Chapter 373: 6 Major Worlds
Cultivators in other parts of the Middle Immortal Realm mostly took pleasure in the misfortune.
"Greed comes with a price."
"If he had left some Immortal Fate Orders for his own people, he wouldn’t be in this situation now."
"Once the Immortal Emperor is out, there’s no more room for luck!"
"Who told him to be blinded by Immortal Crystals? This is karma!"
Although Brother Cheng didn’t really offend them, your Immortal Fate Orders were too expensive, and we couldn’t buy them.
So, you’d better run into some trouble soon.
Even if you don’t, I hope something happens to your Feixian Sect.
Unfortunately, their ’wonderful expectations’ were destined to come to nothing.
The Immortal Emperors searched countless times, not missing any corner of the Middle Immortal Realm, but to no avail.
To be honest, Brother Cheng hadn’t even considered the possibility of the Immortal Emperors descending to the lower realms.
However, his unconventional move turned out to be a perfect drift. Everyone was left in a daze, unable to even catch a whiff of his trail.
With time in the Lower Realm running out, some Immortal Emperors, exasperated, targeted the gathering places of demon cultivators below.
Meanwhile, the Demon Emperors weren’t idle either, venting by destroying several Immortal Dao sects at will.
Their destructive power was immense, a complete dimensional reduction strike.
In an instant, countless Immortals who were gloating met inexplicable deaths.
Ji Hun Ancestor was waiting for good news.
Suddenly, three figures landed in front of him, and upon a closer look, he hurriedly knelt down.
"Greetings to the ancestor!"
These three were the Demon Emperors from their Nine-Star Demon Hall.
Ji Hun Ancestor, in front of them, was just a junior.
The Nether Fang Demon Emperor, in the center, couldn’t be bothered with niceties; he was in a hurry.
"Do you know where the people from the Feixian Sect went?"
Ji Hun Ancestor was a bit confused: "Huh? Weren’t they staying put?"
He was expecting to hear the news of a ’satisfying victory.’
"What staying put? The people from the Feixian Sect have long escaped without a trace!"
The Dark Phecda Demon Emperor beside him, with a stern face, coldly demanded, "I asked you, when did they leave the Qianlan Celestial Realm? After leaving, which direction did they head?"
"Well, uh..."
Kneeling on the ground, Ji Hun Ancestor stammered, "I-I don’t know either..."
On that last day of ascension, even his own Nine-Star Demon Hall had 300 Demon Venerables ascending, so he was busy.
He had no time to monitor the Feixian Sect.
"What, you actually don’t know?"
The Dark Phecda Demon Emperor was furious and slapped this Demon King twice.
"What’s the point of you staying in the Middle Immortal Realm?"
"Useless!"
Leaving those words, the three Demon Emperors disappeared from there.
Leaving Ji Hun Ancestor, aggrieved and terrified, trembling on the spot.
Not long after, the Immortal Emperors and Demon Emperors who descended were repelled by the laws and all were forced to return to the Upper Immortal Realm.
With their departure, the Middle Immortal Realm came back to life.
Many places had become devastated, ruined by the indignant Immortal and Demon Emperors, like a disaster had befallen.
The survivors were left tearless with sorrow.
"What on earth happened?"
"Why attack innocent people?"
"In the eyes of the Immortal Emperors, you and I are not even considered people..."
Subtly, they finally realized they were being naive.
Even if the Immortal Emperors came down to destroy the Feixian Sect, it had nothing to do with them.
Moreover, the Feixian Sect seemed to be unharmed.
"Where are the people of the Feixian Sect?"
"Yeah, where did they go?"
"How did they disappear?"
"Even the Immortal Emperors couldn’t find them; could they have already gone to the Upper Immortal Realm?"
"How could that be possible?"
They wanted to laugh at others, but ended up becoming the joke themselves.
But this had nothing to do with Brother Cheng anymore; by now, he was already somewhere in the Upper Immortal Realm.
The difference between the Upper Immortal Realm and the lower two Immortal Realms was significant.
This place was no longer comprised of individual celestial domains, but six vast worlds.
The Immortal Realm, Demon Realm, Monster Realm, Spirit Realm, Netherworld, and Barbaric Realm together formed the complete Upper Immortal Realm.
In terms of vastness, any one of these six realms far exceeded the Middle Immortal Realm by hundreds of times!
Most well-known cultivation sects were located in the Immortal Realm and Demon Realm.
These two realms were also the most powerful forces in the Upper Immortal Realm, where the majority of human Immortal and Demon Emperors resided.
The Immortal-Demon War was instigated by both sides.
As for the other four realms, naturally, most of the Demon Race operated within the Monster Realm.
The Spirit Realm was a gathering place for various living beings.
The Netherworld was a paradise for the Corpse, Ghost, and Nether Races.
And the Barbaric Realm was home to tribes like the Desolate Race, who neither practiced Immortal Techniques nor cultivated Divine Souls.
Due to the significant differences in tribes and cultivation systems, these six realms were distinctly divided with deep barriers between them.
But with the Immortal Realm existing for so many years, it was impossible for all sides to coexist peacefully.
The location where Brother Cheng found himself now was within the power range of a large sect in the Immortal Realm.
After a brief awareness, he finally understood why so many people were so eager to squeeze their way up here.
Compared to here, the Middle Immortal Realm was nothing more than a rundown small village.
Just the density of the Immortal Yuan Qi was over ten times greater.
"Damn, the great powers of the Upper Immortal Realm are just too much!"
When the Immortal Realm was split into three, it was their doing. Originally, he thought it was merely dividing a vast plane into three equal parts.
Looking at it now, only those in the Upper Immortal Realm were truly sitting at the top.
The two lesser Immortal Realms below were just groups of exiles.
Looking around, the area was bustling with people.
Though each one was an Immortal, and Immortal Venerables could be seen everywhere, there were even more Profound Immortals and Golden Immortals.
He casually picked a spot and released the 12 Immortal Kings from the Xuanji Map.
"Ah, is this really the Upper Immortal Realm?"
"Haha, Sect Leader Jiang is amazing; he actually brought us all up here."
"Did you doubt Sect Leader Jiang couldn’t do it from the start?"
"How dare you, that’s a lack of trust in him; such a heart deserves death!"
"Hey, hey, you guys are going too far... "
They all kept quiet about the miraculous treasure that was the Xuanji Map.
Firstly, they were sensible, knowing what to ask and what not to.
Secondly, as Immortal Kings, they had seen a lot; time-manipulating treasures weren’t something they hadn’t encountered before.
"If only we hadn’t stayed in the Middle Immortal Realm for so long."
"Yes, the difference between here and below is too great!"
Everyone was enthusiastically observing their surroundings.
The space and rules in the Upper Immortal Realm were much more stable than those below.
As Immortal Kings, their power hadn’t decreased, but the potential destruction they could cause was reduced by several folds.
They were prepared for this and adjusted quickly.
Regarding their sudden appearance, surrounding passersby were only slightly surprised before continuing with their own activities.
Of course, this was mainly because none of them released the aura of an Immortal King.
Even in the Upper Immortal Realm, Immortal Kings weren’t everywhere, and their status remained quite exalted.
"Alright, alright, why are you guys acting like country bumpkins?"
Despite Brother Cheng knowing the least about the Immortal Realm, he put on an act as if he was a frequent visitor there, a true ’Immortal Realm Expert.’
"Now, go gather some information, see where your senior brothers and big brothers are."
"Also, focus on finding out the whereabouts of the disciples from the Feixian Sect for me."

chapters.title: Chapter 374: Forbidden Sect
chapters.content:
Chapter 374: Chapter 374: Forbidden Sect
The likes of Xiao Kun and Jiyun are at least at the Demon King and Immortal King level. If Mingchi and Liuyuan reveal their master identities, perhaps a Quasi-Emperor would come in person to invite them.
Only Sect Leader Jiang can treat them as mere pawns.
After receiving their orders, the 12 people dispersed to gather information.
Xiao Kun Demon King casually stopped an Immortal Venerable.
"Ha, friend, let me ask you something..."
This person impatiently turned away: "What do you want to ask? Can’t you see I’m busy?"
After speaking, he was about to push past him.
"Is that so?"
Xiao Kun quietly released a hint of the Demon King’s aura.
Immediately, the Immortal Venerable was frightened out of his wits and nearly knelt.
"You, senior you..."
At the Immortal King level, in the Upper Immortal Realm, it’s not common enough to be everywhere.
This level of power is the upper echelon elder in those top Immortal Sects and Demon Sects.
Suddenly encountering such a figure, of course, he was terrified and trembled.
Xiao Kun grinned, his teeth shining with a cold gleam: "Still busy?"
The Immortal Venerable bent over and bowed, waving his hand in apology: "Not busy at all..."
Xiao Kun didn’t bother making things difficult for him: "I want to ask you something."
"Go ahead, senior, I’ll tell all I know!"
"Have you heard of the Void Abyss Demon King?"
"Void Abyss Demon King?"
The Immortal Venerable thought carefully and said bitterly: "Actually, I haven’t heard of him. He must be from the Demon Realm. As someone from the Immortal Realm, I’m not familiar with that side."
Not familiar with the Demon Realm side?
Xiao Kun then changed the subject: "How about Gui Cang Immortal King?"
"Gui Cang Immortal King?"
The Immortal Venerable thought again and uncertainly said: "Isn’t it Gui Cang Quasi-Emperor?"
"Gui Cang Quasi-Emperor? He became a Quasi-Emperor?"
The Immortal Venerable, a bit confused, honestly replied: "If you’re asking about the one from the Immortal Slaying Sword Sect, then yes, he’s definitely a Quasi-Emperor."
"Immortal Slaying Sword Sect?"
Xiao Kun was a bit speechless, hearing the name sounded familiar to those people from the Sword Domain back then.
After all, they harbored hatred for those Immortal Emperors of the Immortal Realm.
"Yes, the Immortal Slaying Sword Sect suddenly rose in the last few million years, with three Quasi-Emperors, formidable strength! However, they have few members and seldom venture outside, often sealing their mountain gate."
"Otherwise, I’d want to join the Immortal Slaying Sword Sect too..."
"Are you familiar with them, senior?"
The Immortal Venerable, speaking now, had an even more admiring and yearning tone.
Quasi-Emperor in the Immortal Realm is undeniably top tier, second only to Immortal Emperor.
"Three Quasi-Emperors?"
Xiao Kun felt a bit unbalanced.
So those Sword Saints back then, Ling Xing Sword Saint and Sorrow Sword Saint, also became Quasi-Emperors?
Gui Cang, that unfathomable old man, was understandable, he admitted wasn’t as good.
But Ling Xing and Sorrow, back then were of similar rank to him.
He then asked: "What about the Feixian Sect?"
As soon as the words Feixian Sect were spoken, the courteous Immortal Venerable’s face instantly changed.
That expression was as if hearing an extremely sensitive forbidden word.
"You, what did you say?"
"I don’t know, never heard of it..."
He even disregarded the Demon King’s pressure, stumbling frantically into the crowd as if fleeing for his life.
Xiao Kun fell into deep thought.
Gradually, he figured out something.
Soon, the dispersed 12 found Brother Cheng, resting with closed eyes in a shop.
"Sect Leader Jiang, we’ve only managed to gather some news from the Sword Domain and Celestial Book Domain about those in the Immortal Cultivation Domain, reportedly Gui Cang and Taichang have both become Quasi-Emperors."
"They actually became Quasi-Emperors?"
Brother Cheng felt a bit unbalanced as well.
This group were once his subordinates, and now their realms have all surpassed his, which was embarrassing.
Some of them were particularly ungrateful.
"Yes, indeed!"
Jiyun Immortal King proudly patted his chest: "Not only them, but my brother Qingyun was said to have reached the Quasi-Emperor position thirty thousand years ago!"
Mingchi, Liuyuan, and several Immortal cultivators couldn’t contain their excitement: "Sect Leader Jiang, why don’t we quickly go find them?"
"With several Quasi-Emperors holding the fort, we’d be much more secure!"
As seasoned veterans of the cultivation realm, they knew well that upon arriving in a strange place, having a big tree to rely on could save a lot of trouble.
Moreover, it wasn’t just one big tree, but many.
Unfortunately, this touched Brother Cheng’s ’Reverse Scale’.
"Find what?"
"We came to the Upper Immortal Realm to seek refuge with relatives and friends? Busy are we?"
"Look at your lack of ambition!"
Despite his unparalleled Immortal Country, together with his system hack, he feared no one in battle.
But the outward realm still mattered.
Being so concerned with pride, he would never willingly make a fool of himself.
"Indeed, look at your lack of ambition!"
Xiao Kun, Shali, She Lan, and the Three Great Corpse Kings didn’t want to stay in the Immortal Realm, promptly chiming in.
"What seeking help, Sect Leader Jiang, wherever he goes, is a big leg to rely on, needing to depend on others?"
"Seems you Immortal cultivators really have no faith in Sect Leader Jiang..."
Jiyun, Mingchi, and others quickly defended: "We don’t mean that..."
Brother Cheng waved his hand: "Alright, alright."
"What about the Feixian Sect I asked you mainly to inquire about?"
"Feixian Sect..."
"Really haven’t gotten any information."
Several showed difficulty, hesitating.
"What?"
Brother Cheng suddenly became anxious, wondering if all his disciples had perished?
He sprang up: "How could you not find anything?"
Immortal King Wu Jue sighed: "Here, the Feixian Sect seems to have become a taboo, no one dares to respond."
She Lan Demon King also nodded: "Yes, whenever we mention those three words, people get scared and quickly flee."
"Back then, the Feixian Sect ascended thousands at once, forming a huge force, eventually attracting intense siege from the Immortal and Demon Dao."
"Presumably, a fierce battle broke out between the two sides."
"Here, the Feixian Sect is seen as the enemy..."
They all were high-ranking figures in the Lower and Middle Immortal Realm back then, well aware of the style of some major forces.
When a powerful entity branded a group as enemies for purging the remnants, guilt by association became commonplace.
Who dared at that time to associate with the Feixian Sect even a bit could be implicated.
Feixian Sect provoked not just one or two Sects, but likely most top-tier forces in the Immortal and Demon Realms.
Being implicated meant losing standing in both realms.
Brother Cheng was outraged!
On one hand, angry at those Immortal and Demon Emperors daring to target his disciples.
On the other hand, mad at his ’unpromising’ foolish disciples. Why act so high-profile when they’re not like him, the Chosen One with a system hack, fearing no death.
Ascending thousands of Immortal Kings in a short time and gathering together, of course, was as conspicuous as it gets.
Look at Gui Cang, Taichang, Qingyun, how much wiser they were back then.

chapters.title: Chapter 375: Searching for the Feixian Sect
chapters.content:
Chapter 375: Chapter 375: Searching for the Feixian Sect
"So you guys didn’t get anything out of them?"
They all looked a bit embarrassed.
It was rare for Sect Leader Jiang to assign them a task, and they failed to accomplish it.
"Sigh, looks like I have to step in myself!" Brother Cheng sighed in disappointment.
They all felt even more ashamed.
Xiao Kun unwillingly said with a face full of reluctance, "It’s a pity that above Celestial Immortal level, the Immortal Soul is too stable to search. Otherwise, I’d definitely root out their ancestors’ eighteenth generations."
"Tsk tsk, is that how you guys handle things? So uncivilized."
Brother Cheng curled his lips and said disdainfully, "They didn’t offend us; they just didn’t answer the questions. Look at your brutality."
Soul Searching can cause irreversible damage, from permanently crippling the Immortal Soul to turning someone into an idiot, or even death.
Even the old demon could only scratch his head awkwardly and laugh dryly, "Hehe, we were just out of options..."
Jiyun, Wu Jue and other Immortal Cultivators nearby took the chance to add fuel to the fire: "Look at these evil demons, not a single one is decent!"
"Good thing Sect Leader Jiang wasn’t corrupted by you all."
"You Demon Cultivators better widen your dog eyes and see how Sect Leader Jiang asks for information, learn something!"
In their view, Sect Leader Jiang surely had some incredible technique.
Like making someone unconsciously spill True Words with some technique.
Then they saw Sect Leader Jiang fly into the sky.
Instantly, they all looked up to him like gazing at a high mountain, with expressions of little fanboys watching the big brother perform.
"Is this technique supposed to be so grand?"
"Doesn’t it require contact, just casting from above?"
"I bet when Sect Leader Jiang performs the technique, someone will rush to tell him..."
"I guess it’s some kind of will suppression, unknowingly controlling their will!"
"You guys lack imagination, I wager Sect Leader Jiang’s technique will turn the whole city into his Corpse Puppets!"
"Get lost! You Corpse Race folks think about turning people into Corpse Puppets all day, truly stinks!"
Sect Leader Jiang flying above didn’t attract much attention.
After all, which Immortal can’t fly? This Immortal City itself floats in the air.
Looking down at the ant-like bustling crowd below, he cleared his throat, infusing his voice with Immortal Power, which resonated far and wide.
"Everyone, hold on a moment!"
"Bro needs to ask a question..."
This voice was extremely penetrating, instantly echoing throughout the vast city, making many people’s ears buzz, almost passing out.
For a moment, everyone involuntarily stopped and looked up.
"Do you know what’s become of the Feixian Sect now?"
"Where are their people now?"
Before everyone could react, he wiped his ring, taking out a hundred thousand Top-grade Immortal Crystals.
"Whoever can tell me, these Immortal Crystals are theirs!"
To quickly find his adorable disciples, Brother Cheng was being uncharacteristically generous.
Thump! Thump!
Xiao Kun and Wu Jue fell over on the spot.
My God, is this your method?
Directly asking in front of the entire city and planning on playing ’correct answer wins’?
That’s quite a lot of Immortal Crystals, definitely a fortune to any Immortal below Immortal Venerable.
But the issue is, who dares to answer?
The entire city suddenly fell silent.
Then, everyone either quickly closed their doors and windows or hurriedly fled towards the city outskirts.
The sight looked like a natural disaster was coming, and everyone was fleeing for their lives!
"Hey, hey, don’t leave!"
Brother Cheng got anxious, hurriedly taking out a few bottles and jars and a Tier Seven Immortal Artifact.
"If you think it’s too little, I can raise the price!"
"Is raising the price not enough?"
"Don’t you want these Seventh-grade Immortal Pills and this Tier Seven Immortal Artifact?"
With these few words, the people below fled even faster.
"What the hell!"
Brother Cheng looked a bit stunned, couldn’t help but complain.
"Is everyone in the Upper Immortal Realm so wealthy? They don’t even care about these?"
Below, Jiyun, Wu Jue, Mingchi, and others finally snapped out of their shock and quickly flew up, begging him to stop his Divine Techniques.
Everyone is about to collapse!
"Sect Leader Jiang, you can’t do this!"
"Yes, if you carry on, it’ll blow up..."
They’re genuinely stressed out.
Why didn’t they just grab a few random people off the street before and try to extract it bit by bit?
Because cities generally have Great Arrays monitoring them, afraid such actions might draw the attention of an Immortal King within the city.
Here is the Immortal Realm’s territory, an enemy camp by nature.
Even as newcomers, they’re seasoned enough to understand the need to act discreetly.
But now, Brother Cheng created such a commotion, there’s no choice but to attract attention.
However, Brother Cheng was nonchalant.
"Why keep a low profile?"
"Is there something to hide?"
He has the resurrection skill, what’s there to fear?
"This isn’t about hiding, if it blows up, it might draw a Quasi-Emperor, even an Immortal Emperor!"
"Do I look like someone who’s afraid of an Immortal Emperor?"
Oh, this?
Your confidence is truly overwhelming!
They quietly closed their mouths, realizing they must follow him all the way now.
At that moment, a large group of people approached from afar.
Leading them were two Immortal Kings, followed by a crowd of Immortal Venerables.
They seemed to be the rulers of this Immortal City.
Xiao Kun and the others hadn’t released their Demon King level aura, so these people boldly surrounded them.
"Was it you asking about the whereabouts of the Feixian Sect?"
"Yes, yes!"
Brother Cheng nodded, openly admitting without hesitation, even eagerly asking in return.
"Do you know about their situation? If you can tell me, these rewards are yours!"
Jiyun, Wu Jue, Mingchi, and others at the back looked helpless.
Boss, you’re quite particular in your ways.
But the issue is these people clearly look like enemies, how can you expect them to cooperate?
Indeed, even the opposing group was taken aback, momentarily not reacting to the ’rewards’.
After a brief surprise, the two leading Immortal Kings coldly chuckled.
"So, you must be their accomplice?"
Here, being labeled as an accomplice of the Feixian Sect makes you an enemy of the Immortal Realm, pretty much declaring your doom.
"No!"
Brother Cheng seriously corrected them: "I’m not an accomplice, we’re close-knit family!"
The two Immortal Kings nearly failed to keep up with his logic.
Pondering over the meaning, this sounds even more serious than an accomplice, doesn’t it?
The pair sorted their thoughts, once again smirking coldly with sarcastic tones.
"Family? So you’re familiar with the Feixian Sect?"
Brother Cheng pounded his chest, proudly, "Very familiar!"
"Really? Then you must be in contact with those remnants?"
"Where are those remnants? Tell us, and you might still leave a Residual Soul for reincarnation!"
Brother Cheng’s smile gradually vanished.
"So you don’t know where they are?"
He got annoyed, "If you don’t know, why the hell are you babbling?"
"What a waste of my feelings!"
As he spoke, he impatiently summoned the Rainbow Absolute Immortal Sword.

chapters.title: Chapter 376: Get Some Travel Expenses
chapters.content:
Chapter 376: Chapter 376: Get Some Travel Expenses
The two Immortal Kings were furious: "Still dare to resist stubbornly..."
Brother Cheng interrupted directly.
"Oh, go to hell!"
If he couldn’t get any answers, then these two Immortal Kings were worthless in his eyes.
He didn’t even have the patience to say a few more words; his expansive Immortal Country was his reply.
These two Immortal Kings were actually only Third or Fourth Grade, their Realm levels couldn’t compare to the now Eighth Grade Brother Cheng.
Moreover, the level of their Immortal Countries was also not high, just Extraordinary.
Facing his attack, the two instinctively summoned their Immortal Countries.
The projection of their Immortal Countries had just appeared when it started to crumble...
Jokingly, Brother Cheng had already swept through 35 Immortal Kings when he was only First Grade.
What do these two count as?
Their Immortal Countries didn’t even have the chance to show their full glory before collapsing loudly.
The two were greatly shocked by the backlash!
"No!"
"Wait..."
Swoosh!
The Immortal Sword sliced down with a fiery glow, and two figures fell, their Divine Souls extinguished!
Then with another sweep, the surrounding Immortal Venerables were wiped out without even knowing what had hit them.
The battle ended in the blink of an eye.
Xiao Kun, Jiyun, and others stared blankly at Brother Cheng collecting the spoils, feeling a bit desolate for a moment.
They knew Sect Leader Jiang would definitely take action.
But they truly didn’t expect it to be so fast and effortless.
They had originally planned to assist, but it seemed entirely unnecessary.
"So unlucky, I thought as Immortal Kings they would know more."
After finishing, he waved to these 12 people.
"Now you go down and keep asking."
"Let’s see who dares to hide anything."
Mere mention of the forbidden Sect might implicate them; keeping silent meant immediate death. He believed those below knew how to choose.
"Alright!"
Towards these people of the Upper Immortal Realm, Xiao Kun, Jiyun, and others had no favorable feelings.
Having fought a battle already, it didn’t matter whether they were exposed or not.
They quickly cast a Barrier and surrounded the huge Immortal City.
All those attempting to flee could no longer move, entirely controlled.
The two Immortal Kings were slain, many wet themselves in fear.
Where did such a fierce dragon come from, gone mad?
Soon, the 12 returned to Brother Cheng’s side.
"Sect Leader Jiang, we’ve managed to extract some information, but it’s all from a long time ago."
"Tell me."
"Approximately 85 million years ago, Ji Linghan and Mo Chen were among the first to ascend to the Demon Realm in the Upper Immortal Realm."
"Initially, they didn’t attract much attention."
Brother Cheng nodded.
His disciples back then were all Demon Cultivators.
There was no choice; back in the Void Immortal Realm, they all obtained the Demon Body prematurely, setting their paths.
"During that time, they also participated in the Demon Realm’s Evangelical Assembly. Ji Linghan and Lin Ning stunned everyone during that gathering, the Purple Gold Demon Body attracted several Demon Emperors who broke seclusion just to meet them."
"They quickly became the brightest new stars in the Demon Realm."
"They even received goodwill gestures from top demon forces like the Nine-Star Demon Hall and Senluo Blood Hall, Celestial Escape Pavilion."
"Unfortunately, instead of joining any faction, they founded the Feixian Sect in the Upper Immortal Realm and recruited disciples widely."
"Over the following tens of millions of years, the Feixian Sect gradually saw Demon Kings ascend, increasingly growing in strength."
There was no need for them to say more; Brother Cheng knew what would happen next.
"Ultimately, top forces of both Immortal and Demon Dao, wary of them, joined forces to launch a siege against the Feixian Sect."
"The Everlasting Hall and Infinite Cave Heaven of the Immortal Realm also joined in."
"Both sides fought several battles, each suffering losses; then both Immortal Emperor and Demon Emperor personally joined the fray."
"The Feixian Sect suffered heavy casualties and fled all the way."
"By about 50 million years ago, they gradually disappeared..."
"Disappeared?"
Brother Cheng felt a headache.
Dying in battle was one thing; as long as even a strand of hair was left, he could resurrect them.
This vanishing act was troublesome.
"We should hurry and withdraw too."
Xiao Kun and others glanced around warily: "We’ve just found out, this is precisely the domain of Infinite Cave Heaven."
"It’s the sect where Chen Zhou Quasi-Emperor resided; although he defected, there are still three Immortal Emperors and seven Quasi-Emperors in residence, over two hundred Immortal Kings, extremely powerful!"
"Our battle here is likely already reported."
Any Quasi-Emperor would be an existence they couldn’t resist.
Not only did they kill two of their Immortal Kings, but openly admitted their connection with Feixian Sect; the opposition was bound to suppress them.
It was best to avoid confrontation, find a place to hide first.
"Is that so?"
Brother Cheng stroked his chin, decisively making a decision: "Then let’s head to Infinite Cave Heaven first."
"Eh?"
The group froze.
Boss, didn’t you catch the hint?
Although you’ve slain an Immortal Emperor before, it’s not just one over there!
That’s an absolute deathtrap, fleeing wouldn’t be enough yet you’re charging in?
"Sect Leader Jiang, please reconsider, this move is very unwise!"
"There’s nothing unwise about it."
Brother Cheng waved his hand grandly: "We’re new here, dirt poor, shouldn’t we earn some travel expenses first?"
Travel expenses?
The crowd was left speechless.
Do you actually see Infinite Cave Heaven as a meat chicken? Bold beyond measure!
With Brother Cheng’s decision made, the group could only head towards Infinite Cave Heaven’s headquarters.
Along the way, Demon Kings Xiao Kun, Shali, She Lan were anxious yet secretly grumbling.
You just told us to be civilized, and now before they even come to demand accountability, you’re trying to obliterate their sect, even more tyrannical than bandits!
How would they know, Brother Cheng made his fortune back then by destroying sects, it’s his specialty.
The time without sect destruction was just because there was no need.
This time, he felt it was necessary to rekindle his old trade.
Didn’t ’Infinite Cave Heaven’ once siege Xiaohan and Xiaoning back then?
Plus the matter with Bai Chenzhou, deep-seated grudge already existed.
Moreover, since Immortal Kings didn’t know the whereabouts of Feixian Sect’s remaining disciples, surely the Quasi-Emperors and Immortal Emperors would have a clue?
He was still hoping the other party would provide him some leads.
As they hastily headed to Infinite Cave Heaven, this top sect also learned what transpired here.
The Immortal City just now and the surrounding dozens of Cultivation Stars were all within their domain, not a whisper of movement escaped them.
"Why has the All Stars Disc lit up?"
"Elders Mi Rong and Primordial Cauldron have been slain!"
"What, who done it?"
"Bold beyond measure, must be executed!"
"Before their fall, report came through saying it might be allies of the Feixian Sect!"
The hundred and more Immortal Kings within the hall trembled, while several Quasi-Emperors in their Cave Mansions broke their meditative state and opened their eyes.
"Could it actually be those remnants?"
"The ancestors went to eradicate them long ago, now running into their remnants again, truly heaven wants them dead!"

chapters.title: Chapter 377: Can You Be Reasonable
chapters.content:
Chapter 377: Chapter 377: Can You Be Reasonable
In a stone cave surrounded by yellow sand, vast immortal sounds echoed from within.
"Baiyi Quasi-Emperor, Feng Meng Quasi-Emperor, Lan Lin Quasi-Emperor, all three of you lead your people over there together!"
A puzzled response came from another place.
"It’s said there are only over ten people there. Deploying three Quasi-Emperors, isn’t that making a mountain out of a molehill?"
"Dealing with the remnants of the Feixian Sect, we must not be careless. Don’t forget the great damage they caused to the Immortal Realm back then!"
"True!"
Just as the three Quasi-Emperors of Infinite Cave Heaven broke through the barrier, each gathering twenty-five Immortal Kings, and were about to head over, Brother Cheng had already arrived ahead of them.
Appearing before them was a gourd surrounded by dense vines.
It sounded somewhat amusing, but those present could no longer laugh, only feeling the vastness of the world.
The gourd spanned countless miles, with clouds swirling around it.
Amid the vines, one could see immortals busy flying around.
Deep within the vines lay hidden, nearly every entrance leading to a small world.
The closer one got, the more dangerous the pressure felt.
This was because they were not from Infinite Cave Heaven, and naturally, they’d be suppressed.
"This is the place."
Immortal King Wu Jue leading the way stopped.
"Sect Leader Jiang, we still have time to go back now..."
His voice hadn’t finished when a sword light slashed past.
Boom!
Crack!
The dense vines in front were cleaved into a long and continuous crack.
Around that crack, countless black flames flickered incessantly.
Many immortals on the vines were affected, and then perished screaming.
Even the gourd shook.
Xiao Kun, Jiyun, Mingchi, and others originally intended to persuade further, but now they were completely at a loss for words.
Well, it’s too late to say anything now.
Thinking back, although Sect Leader Jiang usually appeared easygoing and lazy to wage wars,
once he considered someone an enemy, he was more violent and fierce than anyone.
Recall the time in Treasure Bottle False Immortal Realm, didn’t he utterly destroy those True Immortals then, nobody could stop him.
But the problem is, even if we are attacking, can’t we use some strategy and tactics?
This is the first time coming here, right?
Completely unfamiliar with this place, right?
Couldn’t we scout and investigate first?
At the very least, we should have found out the basic situation here.
Going for a sword without even asking?
Let’s hope a miracle can be created this time.
Brother Cheng used a tenfold critical strike for this sword, the shockwaves quickly spread.
Not only did the long crack appear, but other surrounding vines also seemed to have suffered a catastrophic disaster and began to rapidly disintegrate!
Eventually, a small world turned into a fiery hell.
But then, intense golden light shot out from other small world entrances on the gourd.
Vast and varied powers of rules formed beams of destruction, completely dispelling the sword’s shockwaves.
Subsequently, groups of ferocious immortals flew out from each small world.
Leading them were Baiyi Quasi-Emperor, Feng Meng Quasi-Emperor, Lan Lin Quasi-Emperor.
Luckily, they were originally planning to go out and find Jiang Cheng and his group, otherwise, they wouldn’t have reacted so quickly.
Seeing the outside’s devastation, the Quasi-Emperors were both shocked and angry.
What kind of power would it take to achieve such destruction?
Even if 13 Immortal Kings joined forces opposite, it’s impossible to accomplish, right?
"Who are you, daring to defy the heavens!"
No need for Brother Cheng to respond, behind Baiyi Quasi-Emperor, an Immortal King held a star disc and respectfully said, "Report, Old Ancestor, the aura of these thirteen people is entirely consistent with the aura manifested by the star disc!"
"What?"
"Are they the remnants of the Feixian Sect?"
Honestly speaking, they were also dumbfounded by Brother Cheng’s actions.
Infinite Cave Heaven, as one of the top forces in the Upper Immortal Realm, being domineering was their hallmark.
They were always the ones attacking others, while others trembled under their prestige.
But this time it’s the opposite.
You killed our Immortal Kings, yet you still take on a revengeful stance and proactively come here?
Is this reasonable?
"There’s a road to heaven, you don’t take..."
Brother Cheng kindly finished the sentence for Lan Lin Quasi-Emperor: "No door to hell, but I break in?"
No matter how the opponent felt, he directly asked them.
"Old man, let me ask you, do you know where the other Feixian Sect people are?"
Lan Lin Quasi-Emperor lived for tens of billions of years, his heart had long become as withered wood.
But now he inexplicably wanted to curse.
Why do you think we would answer your question?
Why does your self-perception feel so good, completely disregarding our feelings?
"You want to know? Then go underground to accompany them!"
Brother Cheng seemed quite pleased and nodded: "Looks like you really know, that’s fine then..."
After saying that, he directly initiated a system upgrade.
The reason was simple, at the next level, he’d have the Mind Reading Technique.
Previously, he had some remaining merit, and this time, after destroying two Immortal Kings and a group of Immortal Venerables, he currently had two million merit.
The system, which hadn’t been upgraded in a long time, reached Level 13 after spending one million merit.
Level: 13
Merit: 0/100000000
Available merit: 1186653
Current skills: The host can consume merit to see through the true thoughts in the target’s mind, with no cooldown.
Note: The stronger the target, the higher the merit consumption.
Subordinate skills: The host can consume merit to make any one ability of the target disappear, with no cooldown.
Note: The stronger the target, the higher the merit consumption.
Making the opponent’s ability disappear?
Does it mean mere deprivation, not gaining that ability oneself?
This seems to be of little benefit to oneself, doesn’t it?
The difference from borrowing skills is that after borrowing, one gains, while the opponent still possesses.
With deprivation, the opponent loses, but oneself doesn’t gain.
It’s simply harming others without benefiting oneself.
However, being busy now, he was too lazy to think deeply.
Upgrading and checking skills only took about ten seconds.
Seeing the opponent brimming with killing intent, seemingly ready to make a move, he targeted Lan Lin Quasi-Emperor and activated the Mind Reading Technique.
Swish, 1.2 million merit was gone.
The reason was simple, the target was a Quasi-Emperor, with the realm too high.
Reading the thoughts of a Quasi-Emperor was an act against the heavens.
But fortunately, the skill kept up the quality, Lan Lin Quasi-Emperor’s thoughts were completely exposed before him.
’Who exactly is this person?’
’Was the slash just now made by him?’
’Why is he so confident?’
’What relation does he have with those remnants? Is he perhaps an ascender from the Lower Realm?’
’Why are there demon cultivators and people from the Netherworld behind him?’
’Once I activate my top-grade Immortal Treasure Illusionary Color Needle, can I annihilate him in one fell swoop?’
All sorts of scattered thoughts were completely visible.
But for Brother Cheng, these thoughts were of no value.
He asked again: "Do you really not know the whereabouts of the remaining Feixian Sect members?"
In the eyes of others, this was simply a pointless question.
How could they possibly answer you?

chapters.title: Chapter 378: So You Are the Culprit
chapters.content:
Chapter 378: Chapter 378: So You Are the Culprit
Sure enough, Lan Lin Quasi-Emperor had no intention of answering, merely letting out a cold laugh.
"You should consider how you’re going to die!"
With that said, he summoned a long needle that flickered in and out of view.
Brother Cheng secretly curled his lip. Old man, do you think I don’t know how wary you actually are inside?
He had already obtained what he wanted.
’Weren’t the remnants of the Feixian Sect working for the Dragon Race in the Demon Realm? How could he not know?’
’Could it be he got separated from those remnants?’
’Capture him and those other 12 people, there might be unexpected gains...’
Because he had asked, Lan Lin Quasi-Emperor’s thoughts were now filled with these pieces of information.
So they went to the Demon Realm?
Dragon Race?
Could it be they followed the Golden Dragon King over?
Brother Cheng’s mind raced, but his actions were not slow.
Before Lan Lin Quasi-Emperor could make a move, he had already charged forward resolutely.
Having gotten the intel, these people could now die as well.
Seeing the all-encompassing Immortal Country attack, everyone found it absurd.
Facing a Quasi-Emperor, he didn’t flee but instead dared to launch an attack?
To the unknowing, it would seem as if the many Quasi-Emperor Immortal Kings of Infinite Cave Heaven were surrounded by him alone.
But when the full appearance of that Immortal Country was revealed, everyone was dumbfounded.
"What is that?"
"Enlightenment Immortal Tree?"
"It’s definitely the Enlightenment Immortal Tree, I once stayed in the Middle Immortal Realm!"
"My god, how could the Enlightenment Immortal Tree become the core of the Immortal Country?"
Clearly not even at the Dustless Level, yet the two hundred Immortal Kings of Infinite Cave Heaven were all simultaneously suppressed!
The branches and leaves of the Immortal Tree swept through, seemingly purifying the surrounding world.
Many Immortal Kings retreated, and the Immortal Country they had just summoned became riddled with scars upon being touched by those branches and leaves...
Behind, Xiao Kun, Jiyun, Wu Jue, and others were dumbstruck!
They were previously disappointed and dejected when the Enlightenment Immortal Tree vanished.
This time they ascended to the Upper Immortal Realm, partly to continue following Sect Leader Jiang, and partly because the loss of the Enlightenment Immortal Tree made staying pointless.
In private, they had speculated on many reasons.
Now the truth had come to light.
So the ’culprit’ behind all this was you, old man?
When you heard us discussing it, you always showed a look of ignorance?
Too much, just too much!
Originally, they didn’t have much confidence in this battle, but suddenly they weren’t worried anymore.
Brought the Enlightenment Immortal Tree over, what else can’t he do?
Just a few Quasi-Emperors...
A piece of cake!
But this time, they were wrong after all.
Quasi-Emperors and Immortal Kings are not of the same concept.
Even as the strongest Immortal King in history, Brother Cheng couldn’t break through that profound tier barrier.
After all, it was a qualitative leap, an elevation to a higher level.
Waves rapidly spread around the Immortal Country like a giant net.
Lan Lin Quasi-Emperor murmured True Words, his eyes bursting with divine light.
The giant net slowly contracted.
The powerful edge of Brother Cheng’s Immortal Country immediately cracked with countless fissures.
The Enlightenment Immortal Tree frantically radiated brilliance, quickly repairing it.
The repair and the destruction happened simultaneously, creating an incredibly magical scene.
Meanwhile, Lan Lin Quasi-Emperor’s Ascension Level Immortal Country was greatly shaken in the collision.
At the critical moment, Lan Lin Quasi-Emperor unleashed the Illusionary Color Needle!
Once released, the needle multiplied into countless numbers, capable of directly piercing the Immortal King’s body!
Then, it locked on to Jiang Cheng’s Immortal Body.
No matter how he dodged, he couldn’t evade the lock.
However, Brother Cheng was too lazy to dodge.
The Rainbow Absolute Immortal Sword appeared, clearing away the needle gleams in the sky.
Only a dozen or so managed to strike him.
But they merely left several shallow, minute apertures on his Immortal Demon Body.
Not to mention penetrating, they couldn’t even manage to go deep.
"This is impossible!"
Lan Lin Quasi-Emperor hadn’t been so surprised in a long time.
