His Illusionary Color Needle was a killing top-grade Immortal Treasure capable of severely hurting even Quasi-Emperors.
And to an Immortal King, it was akin to a deadly reaper.
Every time it was summoned, it was infallible.
Yet this time, it caused only such minimal damage.
Not to mention the power of the Tier Nine Immortal Sword, how could the penetrating points be so lightly injured?
"What kind of Immortal Body is this?"
Seeing this scene, the two other Quasi-Emperors, Bai Yi and Feng Meng, were equally astonished.
An Immortal King able to contend with Quasi-Emperors, isn’t this too defiant of the heavens?
The past monsters of the Feixian Sect, even with the Purple Gold Demon Body, couldn’t achieve this!
"Brother Daoist, allow us to lend a hand!"
"Charge together!"
The two great Quasi-Emperors could no longer mind their status.
Just as they finished speaking, two more Quasi-Emperors emerged from the gourd.
One of them was Sect Leader Han Yue Quasi-Emperor!
Infinite Cave Heaven had three Immortal Emperors and seven Quasi-Emperors in total.
This time, due to the Middle Immortal Realm’s ascension, two Quasi-Emperors went to Zixiao Platform to recruit newcomers.
And the three Immortal Emperors were busy pursuing Chen Zhou Quasi-Emperor and annihilating the Feixian Sect in the Middle Immortal Realm, currently none of them were present.
Now with five Quasi-Emperors coming out in full force, they couldn’t hold back anymore.
They had no choice.
Jiang Cheng’s displayed combat power didn’t exceed their ability, but it filled them with shock.
An Immortal King resisting Quasi-Emperors seemed like a miracle.
It made them realize the danger.
If he were to advance to Quasi-Emperor, would there still be any path for the other Quasi-Emperors?
No, even if he merely achieved Dustless Level Immortal Country, Lan Lin Quasi-Emperor might fall into a disadvantage.
This is too terrifying...
If such a person escaped, they would find it hard to sleep at night.
Five people attacked together, Immortal Treasures were all unleashed!
At this moment, even if Xiao Kun, Jiyun, and others wanted to help Sect Leader Jiang, they couldn’t.
They couldn’t even step into the ocean of rules.
Just the aftermath caused waves of chaos inside their Immortal Countries.
The battle had long surpassed the level of Immortal Kings.
All they could do was hope Sect Leader Jiang could perform miracles and achieve that seemingly impossible victory.
The battle concluded quickly.
When the chaotic ocean of rules slowly receded and everything cleared up, more than half of the small world in the gourd was destroyed.
Facing two hundred Immortal Kings, everyone retreated, many were injured from the battle.
Sect Leader Jiang had disappeared without a trace.
The five Quasi-Emperors sighed in relief.
"Finally destroyed."
"This individual was truly terrifying."
"How did such a monster emerge from the Feixian Sect?"
"Fortunately, he walked into our trap..."
They secretly rejoiced, imagining if Jiang Cheng had chosen to flee instead of charging at them.
They might indeed have been helpless against him.
Xiao Kun and the others’ expressions changed, yet they were inexplicably expectant.
They had seen similar scenes more than once before.
When first entering the Lower Immortal Realm at Dingtian City, and when first entering the Middle Immortal Realm as Nine Flames Immortal Emperor descended, Sect Leader Jiang seemed to have vanished as well.
And when he reappeared...
"Ding! Host was killed, detecting enemy strength, arranging resurrection plan!"
The system notification sounded.

chapters.title: Chapter 379 This Tactic is Too Unfair
chapters.content:
Chapter 379: Chapter 379 This Tactic is Too Unfair
No way, with his true power, Brother Cheng really couldn’t win this battle.
There are limits to challenging beyond one’s level.
He has a Heroic Soul, and so do others.
He has the Great Perfection of the Main Rule, but the threshold for a Quasi-Emperor is also Rule Great Perfection.
If it weren’t for having more Heroic Souls and Main Rules, he might not have lasted this long.
From the start, he was prepared to be killed.
"Ding! Host has gained an opportunity to enter the Inner World, duration one minute!"
Inner World, what is that?
This system plan is unclear.
"Ding! Host resurrected!"
Unlike previous resurrections, this time he didn’t appear in the outside world.
What stretched before his eyes was a bizarre, almost line-drawn illusory world.
Here, there is no Spiritual Qi, no Immortal Yuan Power, nor any elements the world should possess.
What appeared before him was a dense grove.
Upon a slight perception, he discovered it wasn’t composed of the Wood Element but merely resembled the form of trees.
The grove had numerous ’trees’ of varying heights.
The smallest were only finger-length, like weeds, the most abundant, numbering over tens of thousands.
The larger ones reached his waist, approximately just over two hundred.
Some of the trunks bore mottled holes, seemingly from injuries.
Besides that, there were five large trees, each several meters tall.
These, of course, weren’t real trees, their biggest distinction being their ability to move.
They were constantly in motion at all times, appearing almost alive.
The whole scene looked extremely strange.
Brother Cheng couldn’t understand what this was at first and became a bit anxious.
Damn it, system, even if you provide a cheat, at least offer a manual!
Especially for such time-limited cheats.
He didn’t even know what this was or how to turn it around?
Quickly arriving in front of the largest tree, he suddenly froze, as he finally made a discovery.
On this large tree, he sensed very familiar characteristics.
It was the rule characteristics brought by one of the Quasi-Emperors from the other side during the battle just now.
When he suddenly awoke and looked at the other four large trees, this idea was further confirmed.
On those four trees were the rule auras of the other four Quasi-Emperors’ Immortal Countries!
Looking further to the edge where the 12 trees were, he finally captured an even more familiar aura.
Weren’t those the auras of Xiao Kun, Jiyun, Wu Jue, and others from the Demon and Immortal Countries?
How could this be?
As he watched the constantly moving and shifting sizes of the trees, he fully understood.
The five large trees represented the five Quasi-Emperors.
The over two hundred small trees, were over two hundred Immortal Kings.
The remaining saplings should all be Immortal Venerables.
In this so-called ’Inner World’, the extent of their rule understanding or Daoist Heart and Immortal Country’s development was displayed in this extremely straightforward manner.
Why was it like this?
Is this the world of the rules themselves, corresponding to the original world?
When those Quasi-Emperors and Immortal Kings move, does it mean their corresponding tree moves?
Is it similar to a reflection of the surface world?
He didn’t understand why this was happening...
It’s too profound, and no cultivation classics have recorded this.
This is a world not yet discovered by people.
He only knew from the moment he stepped here, his Immortal Country began evolving rapidly.
That evolution speed was faster than consuming pills for upgrades.
Time left for him was running out...
No need for further prompts, he knew what to do.
In this world, he had no Immortal Country, no Immortal Sword, nor Immortal Yuan Power, but he did have a unique physical body and intelligence.
Rushing to the largest tree, he unleashed a fierce punch.
Bang!
The Immortal Tree shook violently!
Leaves rustled down, looking just like a real tree.
With one blow, it felt defeated, with no wood chips flying around.
Yet, this large tree bore a shocking hollow, as if a part had disappeared out of nowhere.
Outside, the five Quasi-Emperors had surrounded Xiao Kun, Jiyun, and others.
With the Quasi-Emperors locked on them, the twelve had no escape route.
"You are his accomplices."
"Part of the Feixian Sect too?"
"Speak the full truth, or your Immortal Soul will be tortured eternally without reincarnation!"
Just as Han Yue Quasi-Emperor of the Infinite Cave Heaven uttered these words, he suddenly spurted fresh blood.
Inside his Immortal Country, a large section inexplicably collapsed.
Countless thriving stars fell, mountains crumbled, rivers reversed, a complete scene of destruction.
"No..."
His face paled at lightning speed, teetering on the edge of collapse.
What happened?
Not just the other four Quasi-Emperors, even Xiao Kun, Jiyun, and the others opposite were utterly astonished.
At the power level of an Immortal King, it’s already hard for someone to cough up blood during battle.
Let alone a Quasi-Emperor.
Even if injured, it wouldn’t look so severe.
Meanwhile, in the Inner World, Brother Cheng was very pressed for time.
Not understanding initially after entering, now only about twenty seconds remained.
Bang!
Another punch.
A big hollow appeared in the middle of the tree.
The whole tree began to slowly topple.
Bang!
With the third punch, the tree finally fell flat down, severed crisply.
He then charged towards another large tree without pause.
After three punches, Han Yue Quasi-Emperor’s Immortal Country outside shattered and completely collapsed!
Countless streams of chaotic rules scattered out and then vanished imperceptibly.
Ultimately, the core of his Immortal Country was exposed to the outside and quickly turned grayish, losing its original Immortal charm.
Even his Immortal Body began showing slight cracks from the backlash.
Though he appeared old, he hadn’t shown weariness.
But now, he seemed to suddenly lose vitality, still possessing Immortal Yuan Power, yet inevitably succumbing to decline.
"What, what happened?"
"How could this be?"
"Could it be that man just now?"
The Immortal Kings and Immortal Venerables from Infinite Cave Heaven were in an uproar, almost going mad.
"The Sect Leader is a Quasi-Emperor, even an Immortal Emperor secretly striking shouldn’t leave him in such a sorry state!"
"Besides, that man is dead!"
"Then why?"
Before their words finished, Lan Lin Quasi-Emperor’s Immortal Country also collapsed.
Then the Immortal Countries of the other three Quasi-Emperors followed suit and perished.
Brother Cheng was full of energy inside.
Destroying one tree was equivalent to destroying one person outside.
Frankly... this method was too bullying.
These people didn’t even know what happened and had no way to defend.
Within seconds, the five Quasi-Emperors of Infinite Cave Heaven all fell.
Though not dead yet, they were all extremely weakened.
"This..."
"No, this is an illusion!"
"This can’t be real!"
The two hundred Immortal Kings flew over in frenzy while Brother Cheng had already started clearing those waist-high small trees.

chapters.title: Chapter 380 This is the Power I’ve Hidden
chapters.content:
Chapter 380: Chapter 380 This is the Power I’ve Hidden
In contrast to the big trees that required three punches to break, the small ones were much easier.
A single kick could send one flying.
He moved incredibly fast.
Just before the time was up, over two hundred small trees were down to just a dozen.
Outside, those Immortal King’s Immortal Countries were exploding in a chain reaction, just like fireworks being ignited.
The sky was dazzling and radiant.
Originally, Xiao Kun, Jiyun, Wu Jue, and others, who felt they were doomed, were all stupefied.
Who am I?
Where am I?
What just happened?
Could it be that I’ve fallen into a Quasi-Emperor’s trap, resulting in a dying hallucination?
The Immortal Countries bloomed like fireworks one after another, then extinguished.
The spectacle was both grand and absurd to the extreme.
Not even several Immortal Emperors arriving in person could accomplish such a feat.
Moreover, before that, there were five larger ’fireworks’ from Quasi-Emperors...
Among these fireworks, there was also a series of ’firecrackers’ going off.
That was the shattering of the Daoist Hearts of the Immortal Venerables.
When Brother Cheng destroyed the small trees symbolizing Immortal Kings, he inadvertently crushed many saplings.
To those Immortal Venerables, this was a calamity.
After the Immortal Countries were destroyed, Quasi-Emperor Immortal Kings retained some combat power.
But when the Daoist Hearts of the Immortal Venerables were shattered, their Daoist Practice vanished, leaving only the Immortal Soul and the empty Immortal Body.
"No!"
"Impossible!"
"My Daoist Heart!"
"I don’t believe it!"
Screams filled with intense fear and despair rose up one after another.
In the Inner World, Brother Cheng’s one-minute time limit was up.
After glancing at the few remaining small trees, he disappeared from there.
When he reappeared in the outside world, he found that his own Immortal Country had not only reached the Dustless Level ahead of time but was also not far from Feather Transformation.
It should be known that the advancement to the Dustless Level was several times harder than his previous Extraordinary level.
Previously, he couldn’t cross the barrier from First Grade Immortal King to Eighth Grade.
In that short minute within the Inner World, not only did he make the leap, but he also advanced significantly.
This saved him untold troubles.
"Ah, if only I could stay a little longer!"
After a brief sense of wistfulness, his attention returned to the outside.
Seeing the devastating scene before him, he was overjoyed.
Wow, that was so powerful!
Spending just dozens of seconds as a ’lumberjack’ inside, and the outside world turned upside down, wasn’t it too exhilarating!
"Hahaha, what’s happened to you all?"
"Weren’t you going to kill me?"
"Come on!"
His appearance naturally caught the attention of the others.
"Sect Leader Jiang!"
Xiao Kun, Jiyun, and others were overjoyed.
Indeed, the old man wasn’t dead.
"Did you do all this, sir?"
Brother Cheng, of course, had to honestly claim his credit.
Hearing this, he deliberately sighed: "That’s right, it was me..."
"Heaven has the virtue of giving life; I initially did not intend to kill them all."
"I gave them repeated opportunities to surrender, but they did not cherish them."
"Faced with being surrounded by just me, they chose to fight back, so I can’t be blamed and had to reveal some of my hidden power."
Ah, so that’s how it was?
The others ’realized’ that this was just a fraction of his true power?
At this moment, any thoughts of joining Gui Cang Quasi-Emperor or Taichang Quasi-Emperor were forgotten.
Was there a stronger support than Sect Leader Jiang?
Was there a safer place than by his side?
"How did you do it?"
The extremely weak Lan Lin Quasi-Emperor’s face was as pale as gold paper, hatred burning fiercely in his eyes.
His untouched Immortal Soul was sharp and aggressive, as if ready to devour someone.
However, Brother Cheng paid it no mind.
He suddenly appeared in front of Lan Lin, and before he could react, gave him a slap.
Wasting 1.2 million merits on the Mind Reading Technique, yet you’re the least cooperative!
"You want to know how it was done?"
"Then go find the answer underground; isn’t that your favorite saying?"
Slap!
Another slap came down harshly, defying the impact of the Immortal Soul.
Directly smashing this ancient strong person, leaving the Immortal Body shattered, head separated from the body.
Dignified Quasi-Emperor, fallen just like that!
This scene was like the collapse of heaven and earth!
It was unimaginable how many Infinite Cave Heaven immortals were stimulated by it.
In their understanding, a Quasi-Emperor couldn’t die.
That was like an eternal existence.
But now, they died so easily.
"How dare you!"
Sect Leader Han Yue Quasi-Emperor, eyes bloodshot, shouted in rage.
Swoosh!
Brother Cheng appeared in front of him.
"I really dare."
Swish!
A sword light descended, and this Sect Leader of Infinite Cave Heaven also followed into death.
Before the other three Quasi-Emperors could escape, he swiftly sent out three sword strikes.
These three, having not only lost their Immortal Countries but also suffering backlashes, were at their weakest.
If they escaped and recovered.
Dealing with just the Immortal Yuan Power and the formidable Immortal Body would be challenging.
So naturally, one strikes when the iron is hot.
Thus, the five great Quasi-Emperors were all annihilated!
"Ancestor..."
"No..."
"This can’t be real..."
The entire Infinite Cave Heaven was filled with wails.
Brother Cheng gave them no opportunity.
He first killed the dozen or so unscathed Immortal King Immortals, fearing their escape.
After dealing with these individuals, the remaining Immortal Kings were like chives on the ground.
Carnage ensued!
Finally came the Immortal Venerables.
He didn’t call on Xiao Kun and Wu Jue, to avoid them stealing the loot.
This massacre resulted in the complete annihilation of Infinite Cave Heaven.
Five great Quasi-Emperors, 207 Immortal Kings, and over a hundred thousand Immortal Venerables were all destroyed.
Although the main alternate space where they stored their treasures couldn’t be found, the Immortal Treasures and Immortal Artifacts they carried were astonishing enough.
The five Quasi-Emperors all used Tier Eight Immortal Artifacts and Top-grade Immortal Treasures!
Then, he charged into that gourd.
Inside was indeed another world.
After a round of plundering, he finally came back satisfied.
After emerging, recalling the grievances suffered by his disciples back then, his heart flared with anger again.
Gazing at the devastated gourd, he drew out the Immortal Sword and went on a rampage.
This time, the gourd’s internal Immortal Array had been dismantled by him, with no one guarding, rendering it defenseless.
It quickly became a ruin under his barrage.
With that, the mountain gate and doctrine of Infinite Cave Heaven were utterly destroyed by him.
He clapped his hands lightly: "Alright, let’s set off for the Demon Realm!"
Jiyun, Wu Jue, and the others were utterly astonished.
Such a vast Infinite Cave Heaven, just like that, was decimated?
There were indeed three Immortal Emperors and two Quasi-Emperors not present, still alive.
But those were just a few lone soldiers now.
With the loss of their mountain gate, this once-preeminent Immortal Sect in the Upper Immortal Realm, renowned far and wide, became history.
Shortly after they left, the three Immortal Emperors of Infinite Cave Heaven, located at the Zixiao Platform, sensed something.
Their expressions changed simultaneously.

chapters.title: Chapter 381 Immortal Demon Mountain
chapters.content:
Chapter 381: Chapter 381 Immortal Demon Mountain
The three Immortal Emperors just returned from the Middle Immortal Realm.
Having failed to find Jiang Cheng and the Feixian Sect there, they vented their anger by indiscriminately exterminating countless Demon Cultivators.
Now back at Zixiao Platform in the Upper Immortal Realm, their fury has yet to subside.
Over a hundred thousand Immortal Venerables are outside being selected by various Immortal sects. As a top-tier force, Infinite Cave Heaven has the privilege of priority selection.
However, as the Sect Founder of Infinite Cave Heaven, Immortal Emperor Lei Ji certainly wouldn’t personally attend.
Isn’t his status obvious?
Those mere Immortal Venerables aren’t qualified to meet him.
He is currently discussing with the leaders of other top forces in the Immortal Realm, such as Everlasting Hall and Biluo Heart Palace, about the whereabouts of the people from the Feixian Sect.
"If they’re still in the Middle Immortal Realm, they definitely can’t escape our search."
"Could they have gone to the Lower Immortal Realm?"
It is difficult for Immortal Venerables to ascend, but descending to the Lower Immortal Realm isn’t hard.
Only, due to being restricted by the Laws, the time they can remain there cannot exceed an hour.
"No, I specifically went to the Lower Immortal Realm and found nothing."
The stability of the plane in the Lower Immortal Realm is very poor; it can’t bear the presence of an Immortal Emperor. Generally, when Immortal Emperors descend, they only use projections.
Going to the Lower Immortal Realm in person, even without taking action, would bring disaster to it.
Like a giant stepping into an ant nest.
Immortal Emperor Lei Ji’s casual remark likely meant that billions of True Immortals and Celestial Immortals died without reason.
Yet, none of the dozen giants inside the hall cared.
"Could it be that they came to the Upper Immortal Realm?"
"The Feixian Sect has 140,000 people, how is that possible?"
"What if they have some special means to deceive the Ascension Law?"
"Indeed, we cannot overlook the Upper Immortal Realm!"
"A thorough investigation is necessary!"
"Contact the Demon Realm side..."
As they were discussing, Infinite Cave Heaven was destroyed.
As the Sect Founder, Immortal Emperor Lei Ji naturally sensed it.
He pulled out an Immortal Treasure and looked in that direction, suddenly terrified.
"No!"
"This is impossible!"
Staring at the scene of ruins and corpses everywhere on the screen, the three Immortal Emperors nearly went mad.
The other Immortal Emperors present didn’t even have time to gloat.
All were deeply shocked, completely unable to believe this was real.
That was Infinite Cave Heaven, a vast foundation.
And it was just destroyed?
This was something that could completely alter the landscape of the Immortal Realm.
Immortal Emperor Lei Ji and the other two could no longer sit still and hastily rushed towards that place.
While other Immortal Emperors, whether out of curiosity or to find the cause, coincidentally followed.
Soon, they crossed countless billions of miles and arrived at the site.
Faced with the scene of devastation and corpses scattered far and wide, even though they were already informed in advance, the Immortal Emperors still felt it’s unreal.
How could such a thing occur?
Infinite Cave Heaven had several Quasi-Emperors sitting in charge, plus the mountain gate itself had strong defenses.
Even if they personally came, they couldn’t achieve this.
"Ah!"
Immortal Emperor Lei Ji’s aura became chaotic.
"Who did it!"
"Who dares such audacity!"
"Who is it!"
He roared, he bellowed, furiously enraged.
Unfortunately, Brother Cheng and his people had long left.
This space is now completely filled with lightning!
Moreover, not just here; the entire Immortal Realm at this moment was filled with rumbling thunder.
Immortal Emperor Lei Ji is the embodiment of the Thunder Rule, and at his anger, the entire Immortal Realm trembled.
Countless Immortal Venerables knelt on the ground, trembling.
Immortal Kings and Quasi-Emperors wisely restrained their sharpness, daring not to stand out.
The dozen or so Immortal Emperors wore heavy expressions, one of whom offered an Immortal Treasure and quickly deduced.
Soon, scenes of Infinite Cave Heaven being destroyed replayed overhead.
When Brother Cheng appeared, all the Immortal Emperors present exclaimed.
"It’s him!"
"He really came to the Upper Immortal Realm!"
"And with accomplices!"
"It truly was the Feixian Sect!"
"Where are Feixian Sect’s 140,000 disciples?"
Lan Lin, Quasi-Emperors, and others didn’t recognize Jiang Cheng; these Immortal Emperors did.
Although they had never met face-to-face, when they planned to annihilate the Feixian Sect earlier, they gathered information and knew Brother Cheng by sight.
Seeing him now in person was entirely fresh resentment added to old hatred!
The scenes shifted quickly.
Seeing Brother Cheng’s Immortal Country possessing an Enlightenment Immortal Tree, the Immortal Emperors were incredibly stunned.
And upon witnessing five Quasi-Emperors joining forces to kill this person, they collectively breathed a sigh of relief.
Such a person should indeed not be left alive.
But soon, they saw each Quasi-Emperor’s Immortal Country collapsing and falling.
"This..."
"How was this achieved?"
"What kind of technique is this?"
Finally, upon seeing the complete downfall of Infinite Cave Heaven, including the destruction of the mountain gate, the Immortal Emperors gasped.
A Quasi-Emperor was slapped to death, an unbelievable occurrence they wouldn’t believe if not seen firsthand.
Too absurd, wasn’t it?
The three Immortal Emperors of Infinite Cave Heaven were enraged, shouting furiously!
"Come out!"
"Come out and face death!"
Heaven and earth changed colors, depicting destruction-inducing scenes.
The other Immortal Emperors also couldn’t remain calm.
"Where did they escape to?"
"They can’t escape!"
"This person must not remain, destroy at all costs!"
It’s a pity that the Immortal Realm is too vast.
Even an Immortal Emperor cannot completely perceive it with one Divine Thought.
While they pursued, Brother Cheng was heading towards the Demon Realm.
The previous news was that the Feixian Sect was currently within the Dragon Race’s sphere of influence in the Demon Realm.
Eager to reunite with his beloved disciples, he didn’t have time to count his gains from this time.
After all, with Immortal Kings and Demon Kings, his journey was smooth sailing.
Rushing along, he finally arrived at the junction between the Immortal and Demon Realms—Immortal Demon Mountain.
Such a simple and clear name, but reaching here, it’s utterly absurd.
Is this still a mountain?
This is entirely a chasm extending between the Immortal and Demon Realms that can’t be measured by length.
Looking up, only dense ’fortresses’ are visible, endlessly stretching into the distance.
Brother Cheng released his Divine Thought to sense it but couldn’t grasp its height despite perceiving for a long time.
From the foot to the waist of the mountain, many immortals are busying themselves.
Like diligent worker bees, too numerous to count.
Moreover, countless Immortal Arrays and Restrictions densely cover the mountain body; viewed from any direction, it’s like a gigantic war machine.
"Truly spectacular."
"Indeed!"
They were stunned by the grandiose display.
"Seems the rumors are true; wars frequently occur between the Six Worlds; this is considered the front line."
Brother Cheng was somewhat surprised.
"War leads to deaths; these Immortals truly have a sense of honor for the Immortal Realm!"
This, of course, was a joke.
Cultivators lack concepts like secular countries; contributing to their sect is decent enough, but risking for the vague idea of the Immortal Realm is unlikely.
However, gradually ascending, they began to understand the reason.

chapters.title: Chapter 382: Are You Spies?
chapters.content:
Chapter 382: Chapter 382: Are You Spies?
The higher they flew, the higher the concentration of Immortal Essence and the Power of Rules became.
After flying for a long time, they still couldn’t see where the mountain top was.
Brother Cheng suspected they were still within the foothill region.
Yet, the concentration of Immortal Essence here was already no less than outside the Infinite Cave Heaven.
"No wonder these people are trying so desperately to get here."
"These Immortal Emperors in the Immortal Realm really know how to strategize!"
Jiyun and Wu Jue also saw the reason.
The Upper Immortal Realm had these worlds artificially divided, intentionally making the border areas so unique for a simple reason.
To let those lower-level immortals voluntarily come here to help guard the ’frontline.’
No need for much mobilization; to protect their cultivation treasures, everyone would fight desperately against the ’enemies’ from other worlds.
At the mid-mountain position, they were intercepted and stopped.
"Halt!"
"Who are you?"
"Do you have the Immortal Alliance’s pass token?"
After all, this was an important frontline place.
The foothill area was easier to access; anyone could go up.
At the mountainside, though, identity needed to be confirmed, layer by layer.
As for the Immortal Alliance, it was an alliance formed by some top forces in the Immortal Realm, headquartered centrally in the Immortal Realm.
Considered the most supreme organization in the Immortal Realm, in name.
Pass token?
Brother Cheng and his party, of course, did not have it.
He was pondering whether to fight his way up.
The rest, seeing his posture, were almost frightened, and hurriedly blocked in front of him.
Boss, please don’t make any more trouble, put away the Divine Techniques.
Who knows how many checkpoints there are ahead?
Surely there would be Immortal Emperors holding the line on the front line, right?
Not to mention the countless Immortal Arrays and Restrictions...
Jiyun Immortal King quickly took out a token from the Infinite Cave Heaven from his ring.
This was a trophy picked up after the previous battle, unsure which Immortal King’s identity token it belonged to.
Upon seeing this token, the faces of several blocking Immortal Venerables changed.
The leader hurriedly bent over with a flattering smile.
"So it’s a great power from the Infinite Cave Heaven!"
This token was more effective than the Immortal Alliance’s pass token.
After all, the Infinite Cave Heaven is an extremely top force, ranking at the forefront in the Immortal Realm, quite extraordinary.
"I wonder what brings the senior here, could it be a major offensive operation?"
Several Immortal Venerables respectfully inquired.
They were also puzzled.
Among this group, there were a few Immortal Cultivators, but some seemed to carry the aura of Demon Cultivators and Death Cultivators.
"Is this something you are entitled to know?"
Jiyun Immortal King slightly raised his chin, letting out a faint hum.
"Why don’t you make way quickly, you’ll be held accountable if you delay the big task!"
The few were so frightened they trembled, quickly making way.
In the end, they all respectfully sent off the senior in unison.
The party smoothly passed the mountainside checkpoint, and after encountering several more checkpoints, they all passed easily with the Infinite Cave Heaven’s token.
No way, the news of the destruction hadn’t yet spread over here.
Seeing these guys being so competent, Brother Cheng was also happy to avoid more killings.
Moreover, the journey was too long, who knows how many battles it would take to fight their way up.
Until they approached the summit, the verification became increasingly strict.
"No pass token, no entry!"
Jiyun was still putting on airs: "Do you dare not give face to the Infinite Cave Heaven?"
"Infinite Cave Heaven?"
The Immortal Venerable responsible for the verification was taken aback, scrutinized them, and took the token to sense it.
Then he frowned: "The summit area is a significant place, any sect must have a hand order."
"If the senior came in a hurry and forgot to bring it, I can request permission from the higher-ups..."
Jiyun wanted to say something more, but Brother Cheng waved his hand.
"Then go request it."
Anyway, whether they could bluff through or not, he was bound to cross this mountain into the Demon Realm.
No one could stop him.
While waiting, Xiao Kun and Wu Jue secretly transmitted messages.
"Sect Leader Jiang, we may have been exposed."
"I think the opponent’s eyes don’t look quite right."
They were all experienced people and had seen all kinds of situations.
"It doesn’t matter..."
Brother Cheng shrugged.
The group also thought so, now that they were near the summit, at worst they would fight and forcibly break through.
With Sect Leader Jiang’s power, they should have confidence in such a short distance.
Moments later, a Quasi-Emperor and more than a dozen Immortal Kings appeared from the front, along with over a thousand Immortal Venerables.
The leader was the Immortal Venerable who had just gone to "request instructions."
This time, when he appeared again, he certainly was not as calm as before.
Instead, he immediately pointed to Jiyun Immortal King and the others, shouting with hostility: "It’s them!"
"They are the ones masquerading as Infinite Cave Heaven, plotting nefarious deeds!"
"Please Quasi-Emperor Yuanxu take action to capture them!"
Ah, this...
How were they exposed, Brother Cheng was genuinely interested.
"How did you know we were pretending?"
The Immortal Venerable sneered coldly: "Do you know who I am? I am precisely a disciple of Infinite Cave Heaven, and the identity token you just used belongs to my Granduncle Master Ni Guang!"
Everyone was awkwardly embarrassed.
Apparently, this round of deception happened right in front of their own people, no wonder it was revealed.
"Why would his elder’s identity token be in your hands?"
"Spill the truth quickly!"
As the Immortal Venerable’s words fell, the nearby Immortal Array had already been activated.
Brother Cheng and his group of thirteen were all locked in.
On the opposite side, the more than a dozen Immortal Kings all brandished Immortal Artifacts and Immortal Treasures.
With glistening cold light, the murderous intent was palpable!
In Jiang Cheng’s group, there were Demon Cultivators, and even the Three Great Corpse Kings, already making them particularly suspect.
Just as a great battle was about to break out, the leading Quasi-Emperor Yuanxu raised his right hand, stopping everyone.
He ignored Jiang Cheng and the rest, instead slowly looking towards the Immortal Venerable from Infinite Cave Heaven, and calmly asked: "Are you the one in charge here?"
The Immortal Venerable was stunned, instinctively replied: "No..."
Quasi-Emperor Yuanxu’s expression darkened: "Then are you ordering me?"
The Immortal Venerable was immediately frightened, his face changed dramatically, kneeling and knocking his head repeatedly: "I dare not, I just thought they were enemies..."
"I think you are quite daring!"
Quasi-Emperor Yuanxu’s voice suddenly turned harsh: "Acting on your own, commanding beyond your authority, how audacious!"
"If everyone were like you, where would the rules be?"
Upon saying that, even before the Immortal Venerable could plead for mercy, he struck down with a fierce palm strike.
For a Quasi-Emperor, killing an Immortal Venerable was naturally effortless.
That Immortal Venerable fell without suspense, never to speak again.
The other people present didn’t utter a word, especially those Immortal Kings who found it perfectly reasonable.
You, an Immortal Venerable, only needed to report the enemy’s situation. In front of a Quasi-Emperor and a whole group of Immortal Kings, what right did you have to issue orders?
It’s just that this dead Immortal Venerable was from Infinite Cave Heaven, there might be some trouble later on.
As they surrounded Brother Cheng and his group, planning to annihilate them in one swoop, the leading Yuanxu Quasi-Emperor appeared from across, this time looking less calm than before.
He immediately pointed at Jiyun Immortal King and the others, shouting with hostility: "It’s them!"
"They are the ones impersonating members of Infinite Cave Heaven, plotting something evil!"
Please, Lord Yuanxu Quasi-Emperor, apprehend them!"
Ah... so it’s like this...
Brother Cheng was a bit interested in how they got exposed.
"How did you know we were impostors?"
The Immortal Venerable sneered coldly: "Do you know who I am? I am a disciple of the Infinite Cave Heaven, and the identity token you just used is clearly that of my Granduncle Master Ni Guang!"
Everyone felt extremely awkward.
It was awkward because their trickery fell right into the hands of the other party’s people, no wonder it was exposed.
"Why do you have his elder’s identity token?"
"Hurry up and come clean?"
The Immortal Venerable was so scared his face changed, and he knelt and bowed repeatedly: "I wouldn’t dare, sir. I just thought they were suspicious..."
Just as they surrounded Brother Cheng and others, intending to annihilate them in one fell swoop, the leading Yuanxu Quasi-Emperor appeared again.
Irritated, he immediately spoke out, cursing: "Damn it, stinking Demon Cultivators!"
Xiao Kun released the aura of the Shari Demon King, laughing slyly: "Yes, we are the enemies, so what do you want to do?"
Shali Demon King, unwilling to be outdone, tauntingly said: "We are the enemies, so what do you want to do?"
